The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
quiz.explanation: 以密集鑽探與地球物理探測繪出岩面與溶蝕帶分布，依此決定每支樁的長度；施工時記錄每支樁的實際入岩深度與澆置量，並以載重試驗確認摩擦樁承載；完工後持續監測筏基各角落的沉陷並與預測比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map the rock surface and solution zones with dense borings and geophysics to set each pile's length; during construction record each pile's actual rock penetration and concrete volume and confirm friction-pile capacity by load tests; after completion keep monitoring settlement at the raft corners against predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「深樁與 4.6 m 筏基」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 喀斯特石灰岩中的溶洞若未被探測到，樁底可能落在空洞上方，承載與沉陷都無法預測；筏基若因供料中斷形成冷縫，承受巨大集中力的厚板可能在接縫處剪壞或滲水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Undetected cavities in karstic limestone can leave pile toes above voids, making capacity and settlement unpredictable; a cold joint caused by supply interruption in the raft can let a thick slab carrying huge concentrated loads fail in shear or leak at the joint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：樁長不同是為了配合岩面起伏，使各處沉陷趨於一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The varying pile lengths follow the undulating rock to even out settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 喀斯特石灰岩中的溶洞若未被探測到，樁底可能落在空洞上方，承載與沉陷都無法預測；筏基若因供料中斷形成冷縫，承受巨大集中力的厚板可能在接縫處剪壞或滲水。
knowledge.textEn: Undetected cavities in karstic limestone can leave pile toes above voids, making capacity and settlement unpredictable; a cold joint caused by supply interruption in the raft can let a thick slab carrying huge concentrated loads fail in shear or leak at the joint.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。
喀斯特石灰岩中的溶洞若未被探測到，樁底可能落在空洞上方，承載與沉陷都無法預測；筏基若因供料中斷形成冷縫，承受巨大集中力的厚板可能在接縫處剪壞或滲水。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit.
Undetected cavities in karstic limestone can leave pile toes above voids, making capacity and settlement unpredictable.
quiz.explanation: 喀斯特石灰岩中的溶洞若未被探測到，樁底可能落在空洞上方，承載與沉陷都無法預測；筏基若因供料中斷形成冷縫，承受巨大集中力的厚板可能在接縫處剪壞或滲水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Undetected cavities in karstic limestone can leave pile toes above voids, making capacity and settlement unpredictable; a cold joint caused by supply interruption in the raft can let a thick slab carrying huge concentrated loads fail in shear or leak at the joint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙承包商與垂直度」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two contractors and verticality” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 政府要求六年內完工，兩座塔因此分別由兩個承包團隊施工：塔一由間組領銜，塔二由三星物產領銜。兩塔的施工方法、測量團隊與進度各自獨立，但最後必須以同一座空橋準確相接，對兩塔在第 29 層與第 41、42 層的座標與高程要求一致。公開報導指出塔一施工到約 72 層時曾量得約 25 mm 的垂直偏差，之後以逐層微調修正；這類偏差若累積到空橋層，就會影響空橋支承的就位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙承包商與垂直度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The government required completion within six years, so the two towers were built by separate teams: Tower 1 led by Hazama and Tower 2 led by Samsung C&T. Their methods, survey teams and schedules ran independently, yet they had to meet a single skybridge precisely, demanding consistent coordinates and levels on both towers at level 29 and at levels 41 and 42. Public reports say Tower 1 was found about 25 mm out of plumb at around level 72 and corrected by small adjustments floor by floor; deviations of this kind accumulating at bridge level would disturb the seating of the bridge supports. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two contractors and verticality” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor; at a height of about 300 m, 25 mm corresponds to a tilt of about 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙承包商與垂直度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two contractors and verticality”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制
knowledge.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side
knowledge.text: 政府要求六年內完工，兩座塔因此分別由兩個承包團隊施工：塔一由間組領銜，塔二由三星物產領銜。兩塔的施工方法、測量團隊與進度各自獨立，但最後必須以同一座空橋準確相接，對兩塔在第 29 層與第 41、42 層的座標與高程要求一致。
knowledge.textEn: The government required completion within six years, so the two towers were built by separate teams: Tower 1 led by Hazama and Tower 2 led by Samsung C&T. Their methods, survey teams and schedules ran independently, yet they had to meet a single skybridge precisely, demanding consistent coordinates and levels on both towers at level 29 and at levels 41 and 42.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side" is correct?
options: 政府要求六年內完工，兩座塔因此分別由兩個承包團隊施工：塔一由間組領銜，塔二由三星物產領銜。
兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: The government required completion within six years, so the two towers were built by separate teams: Tower 1 led by Hazama and Tower 2 led by Samsung C&T.
If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 政府要求六年內完工，兩座塔因此分別由兩個承包團隊施工：塔一由間組領銜，塔二由三星物產領銜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The government required completion within six years, so the two towers were built by separate teams: Tower 1 led by Hazama and Tower 2 led by Samsung C&T. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙承包商與垂直度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two contractors and verticality” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。修正量要小到不影響樓板與帷幕的接合。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor; at a height of about 300 m, 25 mm corresponds to a tilt of about 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000. Corrections must stay small enough not to upset slab and façade connections. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。修正量要小到不影響樓板與帷幕的接合。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor; at a height of about 300 m, 25 mm corresponds to a tilt of about 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000. Corrections must stay small enough not to upset slab and façade connections. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side", which statement holds?
options: 不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.
Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor.
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
quiz.explanation: 偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor; at a height of about 300 m, 25 mm corresponds to a tilt of about 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙承包商與垂直度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two contractors and verticality” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約要明訂共同控制網、聯測頻率與容許偏差，關鍵樓層設置聯合簽認的停止點；任何修正計畫由兩塔的結構與測量負責人共同核可，並通知空橋製造商。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Contracts should specify a shared control network, tie-in frequency and tolerances, with jointly signed hold points at key floors; any correction plan is approved by the structural and survey leads of both towers and notified to the skybridge fabricator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。
knowledge.textEn: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約要明訂共同控制網、聯測頻率與容許偏差，關鍵樓層設置聯合簽認的停止點；任何修正計畫由兩塔的結構與測量負責人共同核可，並通知空橋製造商。
knowledge.textEn: Contracts should specify a shared control network, tie-in frequency and tolerances, with jointly signed hold points at key floors; any correction plan is approved by the structural and survey leads of both towers and notified to the skybridge fabricator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。
兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both.
quiz.explanation: 兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙承包商與垂直度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two contractors and verticality” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：公開報導指出塔一施工到約 72 層時曾量得約 25 mm 的垂直偏差，之後以逐層微調修正；這類偏差若累積到空橋層，就會影響空橋支承的就位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Public reports say Tower 1 was found about 25 mm out of plumb at around level 72 and corrected by small adjustments floor by floor; deviations of this kind accumulating at bridge level would disturb the seating of the bridge supports.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。
knowledge.textEn: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」與「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance" and "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土強度驗收」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete strength acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。驗收依統計原則：單一試體偶有偏低是正常變異，但連續數組的平均值不足或單組過低，就代表供料或施工有系統性問題。不合格時的處理順序是先確認試體本身是否有問題，再以鑽心取樣評估結構內的實際強度，最後才由設計者判斷補強或拆除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土強度驗收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload. Acceptance follows statistical rules: an occasional low specimen is normal variation, but a low running average or a single very low set signals a systematic problem in supply or placement. When results fail, the order is to check the specimens themselves first, then assess in-place strength by coring, and only then have the designer decide between strengthening and demolition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete strength acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混凝土強度驗收」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete strength acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance
knowledge.text: 以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。驗收依統計原則：單一試體偶有偏低是正常變異，但連續數組的平均值不足或單組過低，就代表供料或施工有系統性問題。
knowledge.textEn: In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload. Acceptance follows statistical rules: an occasional low specimen is normal variation, but a low running average or a single very low set signals a systematic problem in supply or placement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance" is correct?
options: 只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。
兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。
optionsEn: If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload.
Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.
quiz.explanation: 以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土強度驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete strength acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。f'c = 80 MPa 時，84、78、79 MPa 的平均 80.3 MPa、最低 78 ≥ 72，合格；82、74、76 MPa 的平均 77.3 MPa 不合格，須鑽心評估（三個鑽心平均 ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa 且單一 ≥ 0.75f'c = 60 MPa）。試驗數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c. With f'c = 80 MPa, tests of 84, 78 and 79 MPa average 80.3 MPa with a minimum of 78 ≥ 72 and pass; 82, 74 and 76 MPa average 77.3 MPa and fail, requiring cores (three cores averaging ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa with none below 0.75f'c = 60 MPa). Test values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置；不合格時先檢查試體養護與試驗紀錄，再於該位置鑽心並輔以非破壞檢測，結果送設計者評估，必要時以載重試驗確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location; on failure check specimen curing and test records first, then core the location with supporting non-destructive tests and send the results to the designer, confirming by load testing where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。f'c = 80 MPa 時，84、78、79 MPa 的平均 80.3 MPa、最低 78 ≥ 72，合格；82、74、76 MPa 的平均 77.3 MPa 不合格，須鑽心評估（三個鑽心平均 ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa 且單一 ≥ 0.75f'c = 60 MPa）。試驗數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c. With f'c = 80 MPa, tests of 84, 78 and 79 MPa average 80.3 MPa with a minimum of 78 ≥ 72 and pass; 82, 74 and 76 MPa average 77.3 MPa and fail, requiring cores (three cores averaging ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa with none below 0.75f'c = 60 MPa). Test values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance", which statement holds?
options: 空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。
optionsEn: The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c.
quiz.explanation: ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土強度驗收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete strength acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置；不合格時先檢查試體養護與試驗紀錄，再於該位置鑽心並輔以非破壞檢測，結果送設計者評估，必要時以載重試驗確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location; on failure check specimen curing and test records first, then core the location with supporting non-destructive tests and send the results to the designer, confirming by load testing where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：品質計畫要訂出「試體不合格即停止在其上方施工」的停止點，直到設計者完成評估；配比、供料廠與試驗室資料按日彙整，趨勢下滑時提前介入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The quality plan sets a hold point that stops work above any failing location until the designer completes the assessment; compile mix, plant and laboratory data daily and intervene early when trends slip.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若驗收只看單組結果而忽略連續平均，供料品質的緩慢下滑可能到多層樓完成後才被發現；不合格樓板或柱若未及時處理，上方繼續施工會增加荷重，使補救更困難，最後只能拆除重做。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Judging only single results and ignoring running averages can hide a slow decline in supply quality until many floors are complete; if non-conforming slabs or columns are not dealt with promptly, work above adds load and makes repair harder, until demolition and recasting are the only option. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置；不合格時先檢查試體養護與試驗紀錄，再於該位置鑽心並輔以非破壞檢測，結果送設計者評估，必要時以載重試驗確認。
knowledge.textEn: Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location; on failure check specimen curing and test records first, then core the location with supporting non-destructive tests and send the results to the designer, confirming by load testing where needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 品質計畫要訂出「試體不合格即停止在其上方施工」的停止點，直到設計者完成評估；配比、供料廠與試驗室資料按日彙整，趨勢下滑時提前介入。
knowledge.textEn: The quality plan sets a hold point that stops work above any failing location until the designer completes the assessment; compile mix, plant and laboratory data daily and intervene early when trends slip.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance"?
options: 建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。
optionsEn: Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The skybridge ties the two towers together so they brace each other and sway less.
quiz.explanation: 建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置；不合格時先檢查試體養護與試驗紀錄，再於該位置鑽心並輔以非破壞檢測，結果送設計者評估，必要時以載重試驗確認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location; on failure check specimen curing and test records first, then core the location with supporting non-destructive tests and send the results to the designer, confirming by load testing where needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土強度驗收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete strength acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若驗收只看單組結果而忽略連續平均，供料品質的緩慢下滑可能到多層樓完成後才被發現；不合格樓板或柱若未及時處理，上方繼續施工會增加荷重，使補救更困難，最後只能拆除重做。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Judging only single results and ignoring running averages can hide a slow decline in supply quality until many floors are complete; if non-conforming slabs or columns are not dealt with promptly, work above adds load and makes repair harder, until demolition and recasting are the only option. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不合格時的處理順序是先確認試體本身是否有問題，再以鑽心取樣評估結構內的實際強度，最後才由設計者判斷補強或拆除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When results fail, the order is to check the specimens themselves first, then assess in-place strength by coring, and only then have the designer decide between strengthening and demolition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若驗收只看單組結果而忽略連續平均，供料品質的緩慢下滑可能到多層樓完成後才被發現；不合格樓板或柱若未及時處理，上方繼續施工會增加荷重，使補救更困難，最後只能拆除重做。
knowledge.textEn: Judging only single results and ignoring running averages can hide a slow decline in supply quality until many floors are complete; if non-conforming slabs or columns are not dealt with promptly, work above adds load and makes repair harder, until demolition and recasting are the only option.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若驗收只看單組結果而忽略連續平均，供料品質的緩慢下滑可能到多層樓完成後才被發現。
兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Judging only single results and ignoring running averages can hide a slow decline in supply quality until many floors are complete.
Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.
quiz.explanation: 若驗收只看單組結果而忽略連續平均，供料品質的緩慢下滑可能到多層樓完成後才被發現；不合格樓板或柱若未及時處理，上方繼續施工會增加荷重，使補救更困難，最後只能拆除重做。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Judging only single results and ignoring running averages can hide a slow decline in supply quality until many floors are complete; if non-conforming slabs or columns are not dealt with promptly, work above adds load and makes repair harder, until demolition and recasting are the only option. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Statistical combination of relative movement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩座相同的塔並列時，風經過上游塔產生的尾流會衝擊下游塔，造成比單塔更大的擾動，稱為干擾效應；同時空橋要承受的不是單塔位移，而是兩塔在同一時刻的相對位移。兩塔的運動部分相關、部分獨立：完全同步時相對位移為零，完全反向時最大。風洞試驗必須同時放置兩座塔的模型，量測各風向下兩塔的位移時程，再以統計方法求出相對位移的設計值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When two identical towers stand side by side, the wake from the upwind tower buffets the downwind one, causing more disturbance than for a single tower, known as interference; meanwhile the skybridge must accept not single-tower movement but the two towers' simultaneous relative movement. Their motions are partly correlated and partly independent: in perfect step the relative movement is zero, in exact opposition it is greatest. The wind tunnel must model both towers together, record their displacement histories for each wind direction and derive the design relative movement statistically. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Statistical combination of relative movement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Statistical combination of relative movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應
knowledge.text: 兩座相同的塔並列時，風經過上游塔產生的尾流會衝擊下游塔，造成比單塔更大的擾動，稱為干擾效應；同時空橋要承受的不是單塔位移，而是兩塔在同一時刻的相對位移。兩塔的運動部分相關、部分獨立：完全同步時相對位移為零，完全反向時最大。
knowledge.textEn: When two identical towers stand side by side, the wake from the upwind tower buffets the downwind one, causing more disturbance than for a single tower, known as interference; meanwhile the skybridge must accept not single-tower movement but the two towers' simultaneous relative movement. Their motions are partly correlated and partly independent: in perfect step the relative movement is zero, in exact opposition it is greatest.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference" is correct?
options: 兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。
不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
兩座相同的塔並列時，風經過上游塔產生的尾流會衝擊下游塔，造成比單塔更大的擾動，稱為干擾效應；同時空橋要承受的不是單塔位移，而是兩塔在同一時刻的相對位移。
optionsEn: Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.
Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.
When two identical towers stand side by side, the wake from the upwind tower buffets the downwind one, causing more disturbance than for a single tower, known as interference.
quiz.explanation: 兩座相同的塔並列時，風經過上游塔產生的尾流會衝擊下游塔，造成比單塔更大的擾動，稱為干擾效應；同時空橋要承受的不是單塔位移，而是兩塔在同一時刻的相對位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When two identical towers stand side by side, the wake from the upwind tower buffets the downwind one, causing more disturbance than for a single tower, known as interference; meanwhile the skybridge must accept not single-tower movement but the two towers' simultaneous relative movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Statistical combination of relative movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m：相關係數 ρ = 0.3 時 σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m，乘以尖峰因子 3.5 得約 0.62 m；ρ = 0 時約 0.74 m；完全反向 ρ = −1 時約 1.05 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂). With σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m, a correlation ρ = 0.3 gives σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m and, with a peak factor of 3.5, about 0.62 m; ρ = 0 gives about 0.74 m and fully opposed motion, ρ = −1, about 1.05 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m：相關係數 ρ = 0.3 時 σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m，乘以尖峰因子 3.5 得約 0.62 m；ρ = 0 時約 0.74 m；完全反向 ρ = −1 時約 1.05 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂). With σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m, a correlation ρ = 0.3 gives σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m and, with a peak factor of 3.5, about 0.62 m; ρ = 0 gives about 0.74 m and fully opposed motion, ρ = −1, about 1.05 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference", which statement holds?
options: 相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。
optionsEn: Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂).
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
quiz.explanation: 相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Statistical combination of relative movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞試驗範圍要明列雙塔干擾與相對位移的輸出項目；完工後在兩塔空橋層附近設置同步加速度計，強風事件後比對實測相對位移與設計值，偏差大時通知結構顧問。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make twin-tower interference and relative movement explicit deliverables of the wind-tunnel scope; after completion fit synchronised accelerometers near bridge level in both towers and compare measured relative movement with the design value after strong-wind events, notifying the structural consultant of large deviations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風洞試驗範圍要明列雙塔干擾與相對位移的輸出項目；完工後在兩塔空橋層附近設置同步加速度計，強風事件後比對實測相對位移與設計值，偏差大時通知結構顧問。
knowledge.textEn: Make twin-tower interference and relative movement explicit deliverables of the wind-tunnel scope; after completion fit synchronised accelerometers near bridge level in both towers and compare measured relative movement with the design value after strong-wind events, notifying the structural consultant of large deviations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數。
只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction.
If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Statistical combination of relative movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風洞試驗必須同時放置兩座塔的模型，量測各風向下兩塔的位移時程，再以統計方法求出相對位移的設計值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The wind tunnel must model both towers together, record their displacement histories for each wind direction and derive the design relative movement statistically.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。
knowledge.textEn: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.

Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact.
quiz.explanation: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」與「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate" and "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stainless-steel and glass façade” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。不鏽鋼的熱膨脹係數比玻璃與混凝土大，日照時外露金屬升溫快，三種材料的伸縮差會集中在接縫、密封膠與固定件上；暴雨與高濕度則考驗排水與防水設計。外牆的長期維護包括密封膠更換、固定件腐蝕檢查與玻璃破損更換，都需要能到達每一處的外牆維護設備。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. Stainless steel expands more with heat than glass or concrete, and exposed metal heats quickly in sunshine, so the differential movement of the three materials concentrates at joints, sealants and fixings, while heavy rain and humidity test drainage and waterproofing. Long-term upkeep includes sealant replacement, fixing corrosion checks and broken-glass replacement, all requiring access equipment that can reach every part of the façade. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stainless-steel and glass façade” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stainless-steel and glass façade”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護
knowledge.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate
knowledge.text: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。不鏽鋼的熱膨脹係數比玻璃與混凝土大，日照時外露金屬升溫快，三種材料的伸縮差會集中在接縫、密封膠與固定件上；暴雨與高濕度則考驗排水與防水設計。
knowledge.textEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. Stainless steel expands more with heat than glass or concrete, and exposed metal heats quickly in sunshine, so the differential movement of the three materials concentrates at joints, sealants and fixings, while heavy rain and humidity test drainage and waterproofing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate" is correct?
options: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。
不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
optionsEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours.
Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.
The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
quiz.explanation: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stainless-steel and glass façade” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。4 m 長的構件、溫升 50 °C：沃斯田鐵系不鏽鋼 α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm；玻璃 α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 1.8 mm；兩者相差 1.6 mm，須由接縫與密封膠吸收。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 4 m member heating by 50 °C, austenitic stainless steel with α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C grows ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm, while glass with α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C grows 1.8 mm; the 1.6 mm difference must be taken up by joints and sealant. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。4 m 長的構件、溫升 50 °C：沃斯田鐵系不鏽鋼 α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm；玻璃 α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 1.8 mm；兩者相差 1.6 mm，須由接縫與密封膠吸收。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 4 m member heating by 50 °C, austenitic stainless steel with α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C grows ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm, while glass with α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C grows 1.8 mm; the 1.6 mm difference must be taken up by joints and sealant. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate", which statement holds?
options: 建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。
optionsEn: The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
The skybridge ties the two towers together so they brace each other and sway less.
quiz.explanation: 熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stainless-steel and glass façade” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件列出外牆材料的熱脹設計值、接縫容許變形、密封膠更換週期與異種金屬絕緣細部；維護紀錄依立面與樓層編號管理，方便追蹤重複發生的漏水點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents list the design thermal movements of façade materials, allowable joint deformation, sealant replacement intervals and dissimilar-metal isolation details; organise maintenance records by elevation and floor to track recurring leaks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。
knowledge.textEn: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件列出外牆材料的熱脹設計值、接縫容許變形、密封膠更換週期與異種金屬絕緣細部；維護紀錄依立面與樓層編號管理，方便追蹤重複發生的漏水點。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents list the design thermal movements of façade materials, allowable joint deformation, sealant replacement intervals and dissimilar-metal isolation details; organise maintenance records by elevation and floor to track recurring leaks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。
以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit.
Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement.
quiz.explanation: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stainless-steel and glass façade” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：外牆的長期維護包括密封膠更換、固定件腐蝕檢查與玻璃破損更換，都需要能到達每一處的外牆維護設備。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long-term upkeep includes sealant replacement, fixing corrosion checks and broken-glass replacement, all requiring access equipment that can reach every part of the façade.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
optionsEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
quiz.explanation: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「空橋避難路徑」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Skybridge escape route” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。這使空橋的結構、支承、防火與通道淨寬都成為生命安全系統，必須在整個建築壽命中保持可用。任何改裝（例如增設展示、管線或改變出入口）都要確認不會縮減淨寬、阻礙門扇或侵入空橋的可動空間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「空橋避難路徑」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. That makes the bridge's structure, bearings, fire protection and clear width parts of a life-safety system that must remain available throughout the building's life. Any alteration, such as added displays, services or changed entrances, must be checked so it does not reduce clear width, obstruct doors or encroach on the bridge's movement gaps. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Skybridge escape route” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「空橋避難路徑」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Skybridge escape route”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route
knowledge.text: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。這使空橋的結構、支承、防火與通道淨寬都成為生命安全系統，必須在整個建築壽命中保持可用。
knowledge.textEn: The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. That makes the bridge's structure, bearings, fire protection and clear width parts of a life-safety system that must remain available throughout the building's life.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route" is correct?
options: 空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.

The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts.
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
quiz.explanation: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空橋避難路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Skybridge escape route” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。淨寬 2.4 m、流率 1.3 人/(m·s) 時約 3.1 人/秒；若需疏散 10,000 人，約需 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s，約 53 分鐘。淨寬若因改裝減為 1.8 m，時間增為約 71 分鐘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. A 2.4 m clear width at 1.3 persons per metre per second passes about 3.1 persons per second, so evacuating 10,000 people takes about 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s, about 53 minutes. If an alteration narrows the width to 1.8 m, the time rises to about 71 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。淨寬 2.4 m、流率 1.3 人/(m·s) 時約 3.1 人/秒；若需疏散 10,000 人，約需 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s，約 53 分鐘。淨寬若因改裝減為 1.8 m，時間增為約 71 分鐘。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. A 2.4 m clear width at 1.3 persons per metre per second passes about 3.1 persons per second, so evacuating 10,000 people takes about 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s, about 53 minutes. If an alteration narrows the width to 1.8 m, the time rises to about 71 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route", which statement holds?
options: 高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。
只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。
optionsEn: High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate.
quiz.explanation: 通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空橋避難路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Skybridge escape route” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件把空橋列為生命安全與結構雙重管制的設施，附上淨寬、可動空間、支承規格與檢查表；任何改裝申請須同時經消防與結構審查，並更新避難計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents designate the skybridge as a facility under both life-safety and structural control, with clear widths, movement gaps, bearing specifications and inspection checklists; every alteration request needs both fire and structural review and an updated evacuation plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
