steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
knowledge.textEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件把空橋列為生命安全與結構雙重管制的設施，附上淨寬、可動空間、支承規格與檢查表；任何改裝申請須同時經消防與結構審查，並更新避難計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents designate the skybridge as a facility under both life-safety and structural control, with clear widths, movement gaps, bearing specifications and inspection checklists; every alteration request needs both fire and structural review and an updated evacuation plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route"?
options: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空橋避難路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Skybridge escape route” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：任何改裝（例如增設展示、管線或改變出入口）都要確認不會縮減淨寬、阻礙門扇或侵入空橋的可動空間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Any alteration, such as added displays, services or changed entrances, must be checked so it does not reduce clear width, obstruct doors or encroach on the bridge's movement gaps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。
knowledge.textEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge.
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
quiz.explanation: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓
summary: 世界貿易中心一號大樓以約 61 m 見方的基座、逐漸削角收分的體量，把 14,000 psi 高強混凝土核心筒與周邊延性抗彎鋼框架組成混合抗側系統，再以展開基腳與岩錨坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上。本課從削角形體的風荷載、核心筒剛度與替代傳力路徑，走到岩盤基腳、尖塔分段吊裝、大體積高強混凝土的溫控與驗收，最後談強健性設計在營運期的改裝管制與尖塔維護。
summaryEn: One World Trade Center rises from a base about 61 m square with chamfered, tapering faces, combining a 14,000 psi high-strength concrete core and a ductile perimeter steel moment frame into a hybrid lateral system founded on Manhattan bedrock with spread footings and rock anchors. The course moves from wind on the chamfered form, core stiffness and alternate load paths to rock footings, staged spire erection, temperature control and acceptance of high-strength mass concrete, and finally to protecting robustness during later alterations and maintaining the spire.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：以核心筒外圈牆檢核在重力與風力共同作用下是否出現拉應力。核心筒外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m，面積 A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m²，慣性矩 I ≈ 27,000 m⁴，斷面模數 S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³。核心筒承受重力 N = 1.2×10⁶ kN，平均壓應力 σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa。第 1 單元的收分基座力矩 8.52×10⁶ kN·m 中由核心筒分擔 60%，M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m，彎曲應力 σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa。最大壓應力 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa，只有 96.5 MPa（14,000 psi）的約 11%；最小應力 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa 仍為壓力。若某段牆的重力只有 0.4×10⁶ kN，σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa，最小應力變為 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa 的拉應力，就需要配置受拉鋼筋或岩錨來處理上拔。數值為教學假設，忽略開口、內牆與動力效應，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether the outer core walls go into tension under gravity plus wind. The core is 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, so A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m², I ≈ 27,000 m⁴ and the section modulus S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³. With a gravity load N = 1.2×10⁶ kN, the average compression is σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa. Taking 60% of the tapered base moment of 8.52×10⁶ kN·m from unit 1, M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m and the bending stress σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa. The maximum compression 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa is only about 11% of 96.5 MPa (14,000 psi), and the minimum 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa is still compressive. If a wall segment carried only 0.4×10⁶ kN of gravity, σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa and the minimum stress becomes 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa tension, calling for tension reinforcement or rock anchors to resist uplift. Values are teaching assumptions that ignore openings, interior walls and dynamic effects and do not represent the actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「削角收分形體與風荷載」與「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" and "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「削角錐形體量」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Chamfered tapering massing” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。迎風寬度隨高度遞減，使高處的風壓作用面積變小，而高處的力臂最長，所以基座傾覆力矩下降得比總風力更明顯；斜切的立面也讓背風側渦流脫落沿高度不同步，削弱橫風向的規律激振。形體因此不只是建築表情，而是降低抗側構件需求的第一道結構手段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「削角錐形體量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. Because the windward width shrinks with height, the pressure area is smallest where the lever arm is longest, so the base overturning moment falls faster than the total wind force; the inclined faces also desynchronise vortex shedding along the height, weakening regular across-wind excitation. The form is therefore the first structural measure that reduces demand on the lateral system, not just an architectural gesture. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Chamfered tapering massing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「削角錐形體量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Chamfered tapering massing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載
knowledge.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load
knowledge.text: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。迎風寬度隨高度遞減，使高處的風壓作用面積變小，而高處的力臂最長，所以基座傾覆力矩下降得比總風力更明顯；斜切的立面也讓背風側渦流脫落沿高度不同步，削弱橫風向的規律激振。
knowledge.textEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. Because the windward width shrinks with height, the pressure area is smallest where the lever arm is longest, so the base overturning moment falls faster than the total wind force; the inclined faces also desynchronise vortex shedding along the height, weakening regular across-wind excitation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「削角收分形體與風荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" is correct?
options: 削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。
大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。
核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
optionsEn: Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads.
The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top.
A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
quiz.explanation: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「削角錐形體量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chamfered tapering massing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。取 q = 2.0 kPa、H = 417 m、B₀ = 61 m、B₁ = 43 m：稜柱 M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m，收分後 M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m，約減少 19.7%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism. With q = 2.0 kPa, H = 417 m, B₀ = 61 m and B₁ = 43 m, the prism gives M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m and the tapered form M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m, about 19.7% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。取 q = 2.0 kPa、H = 417 m、B₀ = 61 m、B₁ = 43 m：稜柱 M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m，收分後 M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m，約減少 19.7%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism. With q = 2.0 kPa, H = 417 m, B₀ = 61 m and B₁ = 43 m, the prism gives M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m and the tapered form M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m, about 19.7% less. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

A spire is not primary structure, so crane capacity is the only lifting constraint.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「削角錐形體量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Chamfered tapering massing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：形體凍結前，結構團隊應以初步風洞或經驗係數比較兩到三種收分方案的基座力矩與加速度，把結果寫入設計基準報告，日後建築外形若再調整須重新取得結構確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before the form is frozen, the structural team should compare base moment and acceleration for two or three taper options using a preliminary wind test or empirical coefficients, record the results in the design basis report, and require structural sign-off for any later change to the massing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「削角錐形體量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Chamfered tapering massing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：形體因此不只是建築表情，而是降低抗側構件需求的第一道結構手段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The form is therefore the first structural measure that reduces demand on the lateral system, not just an architectural gesture.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。
knowledge.textEn: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「削角收分形體與風荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振。
核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions.
A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
quiz.explanation: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core–frame hybrid lateral system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工
knowledge.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame
knowledge.text: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。

Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame" is correct?
options: 核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。
公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用。
optionsEn: A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion.
Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。取外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m 的方形管 I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴、E = 48 GPa、w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m、H = 417 m：Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m，約 H/1,170；若外伸臂與框架使等效勁度提高 40%，Δ ≈ 0.254 m，約 H/1,640。數值為教學假設，忽略開口與內牆。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For a square tube 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴; with E = 48 GPa, w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m and H = 417 m, Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m, about H/1,170. If outriggers and frame raise the effective stiffness by 40%, Δ ≈ 0.254 m, about H/1,640. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings and interior walls. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準應明列抗側系統的分工比例與每個子系統的容許變位角，並規定外伸臂的接合時機與調整機制，施工圖上要標示哪些接頭須待指定階段才能最終鎖定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should state how lateral resistance is shared and the allowable drift for each subsystem, define when and how outriggers are connected, and mark on the drawings which joints may only be finally locked at a specified construction stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。
若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion.
If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數」與「周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete" and "Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「14,000 psi 核心牆混凝土」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “14,000 psi core-wall concrete” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 核心筒底部牆厚可達約 1.2 m，向上逐步減至約 0.6 m，所用混凝土強度由約 14,000 psi 漸降，公開資料指出這是紐約市首次採用此強度。對超高層核心筒而言，強度決定牆厚與可用樓地板面積，但控制側向變位與差異縮短的其實是彈性模數、潛變與收縮，因此配比同時規定模數須高於約 7×10⁶ psi，並針對潛變收縮設計；強度高於 8,000 psi 的部位採用自充填混凝土以確保密集鋼筋間的充填。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「14,000 psi 核心牆混凝土」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Core walls are up to about 1.2 m thick at the base and step down to about 0.6 m near the top, with concrete strengths stepping down from about 14,000 psi, reported as the first use of that strength in New York City. For a supertall core, strength sets wall thickness and usable floor area, but lateral drift and differential shortening are governed by modulus, creep and shrinkage, so the mixes also required a modulus above about 7×10⁶ psi and were designed for creep and shrinkage; self-consolidating concrete was used where strength exceeded 8,000 psi to fill around congested reinforcement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “14,000 psi core-wall concrete” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 經驗式 E_c = 57,000√f′c（psi）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 318 gives E_c = 57,000√f′c in psi.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「14,000 psi 核心牆混凝土」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “14,000 psi core-wall concrete”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數
knowledge.titleEn: Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete
knowledge.text: 核心筒底部牆厚可達約 1.2 m，向上逐步減至約 0.6 m，所用混凝土強度由約 14,000 psi 漸降，公開資料指出這是紐約市首次採用此強度。對超高層核心筒而言，強度決定牆厚與可用樓地板面積，但控制側向變位與差異縮短的其實是彈性模數、潛變與收縮，因此配比同時規定模數須高於約 7×10⁶ psi，並針對潛變收縮設計；強度高於 8,000 psi 的部位採用自充填混凝土以確保密集鋼筋間的充填。
knowledge.textEn: Core walls are up to about 1.2 m thick at the base and step down to about 0.6 m near the top, with concrete strengths stepping down from about 14,000 psi, reported as the first use of that strength in New York City. For a supertall core, strength sets wall thickness and usable floor area, but lateral drift and differential shortening are governed by modulus, creep and shrinkage, so the mixes also required a modulus above about 7×10⁶ psi and were designed for creep and shrinkage; self-consolidating concrete was used where strength exceeded 8,000 psi to fill around congested reinforcement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete" is correct?
options: 核心筒底部牆厚可達約 1.2 m，向上逐步減至約 0.6 m，所用混凝土強度由約 14,000 psi 漸降，公開資料指出這是紐約市首次採用此強度。
混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。
只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。
optionsEn: Core walls are up to about 1.2 m thick at the base and step down to about 0.6 m near the top, with concrete strengths stepping down from about 14,000 psi, reported as the first use of that strength in New York City.
Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion.
If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 核心筒底部牆厚可達約 1.2 m，向上逐步減至約 0.6 m，所用混凝土強度由約 14,000 psi 漸降，公開資料指出這是紐約市首次採用此強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Core walls are up to about 1.2 m thick at the base and step down to about 0.6 m near the top, with concrete strengths stepping down from about 14,000 psi, reported as the first use of that strength in New York City. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「14,000 psi 核心牆混凝土」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “14,000 psi core-wall concrete” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 經驗式 E_c = 57,000√f′c（psi）。f′c = 14,000 psi 時 E_c = 57,000×118.3 ≈ 6.74×10⁶ psi（約 46.5 GPa），規格要求 ≥ 7.0×10⁶ psi（約 48.3 GPa），高約 3.8%。以 12 MPa 均勻應力作用 100 m 高的牆段估算彈性縮短：經驗式模數得 25.8 mm，規格模數得 24.9 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 318 gives E_c = 57,000√f′c in psi. For f′c = 14,000 psi, E_c = 57,000×118.3 ≈ 6.74×10⁶ psi (about 46.5 GPa), while the specification required at least 7.0×10⁶ psi (about 48.3 GPa), roughly 3.8% stiffer. For a 100 m wall segment under a uniform 12 MPa stress, elastic shortening is 25.8 mm with the empirical modulus and 24.9 mm with the specified modulus. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配比試拌階段同時做抗壓強度、靜彈性模數（ASTM C469）與潛變收縮試驗，確認模數與時間相依變形參數可直接輸入施工階段分析；量產期間依批次抽驗強度與模數，並追蹤骨材來源變更對模數的影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During trial mixes, test compressive strength, static modulus (ASTM C469) and creep and shrinkage so the modulus and time-dependent parameters can be fed directly into the construction-stage analysis; during production sample strength and modulus by lot, and track how changes of aggregate source affect the modulus.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 經驗式 E_c = 57,000√f′c（psi）。f′c = 14,000 psi 時 E_c = 57,000×118.3 ≈ 6.74×10⁶ psi（約 46.5 GPa），規格要求 ≥ 7.0×10⁶ psi（約 48.3 GPa），高約 3.8%。以 12 MPa 均勻應力作用 100 m 高的牆段估算彈性縮短：經驗式模數得 25.8 mm，規格模數得 24.9 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 318 gives E_c = 57,000√f′c in psi. For f′c = 14,000 psi, E_c = 57,000×118.3 ≈ 6.74×10⁶ psi (about 46.5 GPa), while the specification required at least 7.0×10⁶ psi (about 48.3 GPa), roughly 3.8% stiffer. For a 100 m wall segment under a uniform 12 MPa stress, elastic shortening is 25.8 mm with the empirical modulus and 24.9 mm with the specified modulus. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete", which statement holds?
options: 尖塔不是主結構，吊裝時只要吊車容量足夠就沒有其他限制。
ACI 318 經驗式 E_c = 57,000√f′c（psi）。
建築越高，風壓只隨高度成正比增加。
optionsEn: A spire is not primary structure, so crane capacity is the only lifting constraint.
ACI 318 gives E_c = 57,000√f′c in psi.
Wind pressure simply increases in direct proportion to height.
quiz.explanation: ACI 318 經驗式 E_c = 57,000√f′c（psi）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 318 gives E_c = 57,000√f′c in psi. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「14,000 psi 核心牆混凝土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “14,000 psi core-wall concrete” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配比試拌階段同時做抗壓強度、靜彈性模數（ASTM C469）與潛變收縮試驗，確認模數與時間相依變形參數可直接輸入施工階段分析；量產期間依批次抽驗強度與模數，並追蹤骨材來源變更對模數的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During trial mixes, test compressive strength, static modulus (ASTM C469) and creep and shrinkage so the modulus and time-dependent parameters can be fed directly into the construction-stage analysis; during production sample strength and modulus by lot, and track how changes of aggregate source affect the modulus. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範中把模數、潛變與收縮列為與強度同等的驗收項目，指定骨材來源變更須重新試拌並通知結構工程師；高強度自充填混凝土須另訂坍流度、析離與泵送試驗的允收值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make modulus, creep and shrinkage acceptance items equal to strength in the specification, require new trial mixes and notification of the structural engineer for any aggregate-source change, and set acceptance values for slump flow, segregation and pumping trials of high-strength self-consolidating concrete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗收強度而不驗收模數時，骨材來源改變可能讓模數下降一成以上而強度仍合格，結果核心筒變位、差異縮短與樓板傾斜都超出預測，帷幕牆與電梯導軌的調整空間被吃光。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting strength without accepting modulus lets a change of aggregate source drop the modulus by ten percent or more while strength still passes, so core drift, differential shortening and floor tilt exceed predictions and consume the adjustment range of the façade and elevator rails. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 配比試拌階段同時做抗壓強度、靜彈性模數（ASTM C469）與潛變收縮試驗，確認模數與時間相依變形參數可直接輸入施工階段分析；量產期間依批次抽驗強度與模數，並追蹤骨材來源變更對模數的影響。
knowledge.textEn: During trial mixes, test compressive strength, static modulus (ASTM C469) and creep and shrinkage so the modulus and time-dependent parameters can be fed directly into the construction-stage analysis; during production sample strength and modulus by lot, and track how changes of aggregate source affect the modulus.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規範中把模數、潛變與收縮列為與強度同等的驗收項目，指定骨材來源變更須重新試拌並通知結構工程師；高強度自充填混凝土須另訂坍流度、析離與泵送試驗的允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Make modulus, creep and shrinkage acceptance items equal to strength in the specification, require new trial mixes and notification of the structural engineer for any aggregate-source change, and set acceptance values for slump flow, segregation and pumping trials of high-strength self-consolidating concrete.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
鋼構尖塔只有在颱風或暴風後才需要檢查。
配比試拌階段同時做抗壓強度、靜彈性模數（ASTM C469）與潛變收縮試驗，確認模數與時間相依變形參數可直接輸入施工階段分析。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A steel spire only needs inspection after a hurricane or storm.

During trial mixes, test compressive strength, static modulus (ASTM C469) and creep and shrinkage so the modulus and time-dependent parameters can be fed directly into the construction-stage analysis.
quiz.explanation: 配比試拌階段同時做抗壓強度、靜彈性模數（ASTM C469）與潛變收縮試驗，確認模數與時間相依變形參數可直接輸入施工階段分析；量產期間依批次抽驗強度與模數，並追蹤骨材來源變更對模數的影響。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During trial mixes, test compressive strength, static modulus (ASTM C469) and creep and shrinkage so the modulus and time-dependent parameters can be fed directly into the construction-stage analysis; during production sample strength and modulus by lot, and track how changes of aggregate source affect the modulus. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「14,000 psi 核心牆混凝土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “14,000 psi core-wall concrete” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗收強度而不驗收模數時，骨材來源改變可能讓模數下降一成以上而強度仍合格，結果核心筒變位、差異縮短與樓板傾斜都超出預測，帷幕牆與電梯導軌的調整空間被吃光。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting strength without accepting modulus lets a change of aggregate source drop the modulus by ten percent or more while strength still passes, so core drift, differential shortening and floor tilt exceed predictions and consume the adjustment range of the façade and elevator rails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對超高層核心筒而言，強度決定牆厚與可用樓地板面積，但控制側向變位與差異縮短的其實是彈性模數、潛變與收縮，因此配比同時規定模數須高於約 7×10⁶ psi，並針對潛變收縮設計；強度高於 8,000 psi 的部位採用自充填混凝土以確保密集鋼筋間的充填。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For a supertall core, strength sets wall thickness and usable floor area, but lateral drift and differential shortening are governed by modulus, creep and shrinkage, so the mixes also required a modulus above about 7×10⁶ psi and were designed for creep and shrinkage; self-consolidating concrete was used where strength exceeded 8,000 psi to fill around congested reinforcement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只驗收強度而不驗收模數時，骨材來源改變可能讓模數下降一成以上而強度仍合格，結果核心筒變位、差異縮短與樓板傾斜都超出預測，帷幕牆與電梯導軌的調整空間被吃光。
knowledge.textEn: Accepting strength without accepting modulus lets a change of aggregate source drop the modulus by ten percent or more while strength still passes, so core drift, differential shortening and floor tilt exceed predictions and consume the adjustment range of the façade and elevator rails.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高強混凝土的強度與彈性模數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strength and modulus of high-strength concrete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只驗收強度而不驗收模數時，骨材來源改變可能讓模數下降一成以上而強度仍合格，結果核心筒變位、差異縮短與樓板傾斜都超出預測，帷幕牆與電梯導軌的調整空間被吃光。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。
optionsEn: Accepting strength without accepting modulus lets a change of aggregate source drop the modulus by ten percent or more while strength still passes, so core drift, differential shortening and floor tilt exceed predictions and consume the adjustment range of the façade and elevator rails.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 只驗收強度而不驗收模數時，骨材來源改變可能讓模數下降一成以上而強度仍合格，結果核心筒變位、差異縮短與樓板傾斜都超出預測，帷幕牆與電梯導軌的調整空間被吃光。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accepting strength without accepting modulus lets a change of aggregate source drop the modulus by ten percent or more while strength still passes, so core drift, differential shortening and floor tilt exceed predictions and consume the adjustment range of the façade and elevator rails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「周邊巨型鋼柱與延性接頭」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Perimeter jumbo columns and ductile joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 周邊框架使用約 45,000 美噸高強度鋼材，基座周邊柱採 ASTM A913 Grade 65 的 W14×730 熱軋型鋼，梁柱接頭使用預先認可的延性接頭。延性接頭讓框架在極端荷載下以梁端塑性變形耗能而不脆斷；公開資料也說明周邊梁可像「繩索」般作用，萬一某根周邊柱失效，荷載可經由梁的懸吊作用重新分配到相鄰柱與核心筒。高強度鋼讓同一斷面承載更多，也減少接頭與焊接數量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「周邊巨型鋼柱與延性接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The perimeter frame uses about 45,000 short tons of high-strength steel; base perimeter columns are ASTM A913 Grade 65 W14×730 rolled sections, and beam–column joints use prequalified ductile connections. Ductile joints let the frame dissipate energy through plastic rotation at beam ends instead of fracturing under extreme loads; public descriptions also say the perimeter beams can act like a rope, so if a perimeter column were lost, load could redistribute through hanging action to neighbouring columns and the core. Higher-strength steel carries more load per section and reduces the number of joints and welds. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Perimeter jumbo columns and ductile joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：W14×730 斷面積 A = 215 in²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A W14×730 has A = 215 in².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「周邊巨型鋼柱與延性接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Perimeter jumbo columns and ductile joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths
knowledge.text: 周邊框架使用約 45,000 美噸高強度鋼材，基座周邊柱採 ASTM A913 Grade 65 的 W14×730 熱軋型鋼，梁柱接頭使用預先認可的延性接頭。延性接頭讓框架在極端荷載下以梁端塑性變形耗能而不脆斷；公開資料也說明周邊梁可像「繩索」般作用，萬一某根周邊柱失效，荷載可經由梁的懸吊作用重新分配到相鄰柱與核心筒。
knowledge.textEn: The perimeter frame uses about 45,000 short tons of high-strength steel; base perimeter columns are ASTM A913 Grade 65 W14×730 rolled sections, and beam–column joints use prequalified ductile connections. Ductile joints let the frame dissipate energy through plastic rotation at beam ends instead of fracturing under extreme loads; public descriptions also say the perimeter beams can act like a rope, so if a perimeter column were lost, load could redistribute through hanging action to neighbouring columns and the core.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths" is correct?
options: 只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。
周邊框架使用約 45,000 美噸高強度鋼材，基座周邊柱採 ASTM A913 Grade 65 的 W14×730 熱軋型鋼，梁柱接頭使用預先認可的延性接頭。
坐落在岩盤上的基礎不會沉陷，也不需要上拔設計。
optionsEn: If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
The perimeter frame uses about 45,000 short tons of high-strength steel.
Foundations on bedrock never settle and never need uplift design.
quiz.explanation: 周邊框架使用約 45,000 美噸高強度鋼材，基座周邊柱採 ASTM A913 Grade 65 的 W14×730 熱軋型鋼，梁柱接頭使用預先認可的延性接頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The perimeter frame uses about 45,000 short tons of high-strength steel; base perimeter columns are ASTM A913 Grade 65 W14×730 rolled sections, and beam–column joints use prequalified ductile connections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「周邊巨型鋼柱與延性接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Perimeter jumbo columns and ductile joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：W14×730 斷面積 A = 215 in²。Grade 65（F_y = 65 ksi）的軸向降伏 P_y = 215×65 = 13,975 kips ≈ 62,200 kN；同斷面若為 Grade 50 只有 10,750 kips ≈ 47,800 kN，高強度鋼使承載提高約 30%，或在相同軸力下可選用較輕斷面。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A W14×730 has A = 215 in². With Grade 65 steel (F_y = 65 ksi) the axial yield load is P_y = 215×65 = 13,975 kips ≈ 62,200 kN; the same section in Grade 50 gives only 10,750 kips ≈ 47,800 kN, so the higher-strength steel adds about 30% capacity, or allows a lighter section for the same axial load. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對鋼廠檢驗證明的降伏強度、韌性（Charpy 衝擊值）與化學成分；巨型柱拼接與梁柱接頭依 AWS D1.1 做全滲透焊的超音波檢測，並以替代路徑分析確認移除任一周邊柱時，相鄰構件與接頭的需求容量比在允許範圍內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check mill certificates for yield strength, toughness (Charpy values) and chemistry; ultrasonically test complete-joint-penetration welds at jumbo-column splices and beam–column joints to AWS D1.1, and use alternate-path analysis to confirm that removing any single perimeter column keeps demand-to-capacity ratios of neighbouring members and joints within limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: W14×730 斷面積 A = 215 in²。Grade 65（F_y = 65 ksi）的軸向降伏 P_y = 215×65 = 13,975 kips ≈ 62,200 kN；同斷面若為 Grade 50 只有 10,750 kips ≈ 47,800 kN，高強度鋼使承載提高約 30%，或在相同軸力下可選用較輕斷面。
knowledge.textEn: A W14×730 has A = 215 in². With Grade 65 steel (F_y = 65 ksi) the axial yield load is P_y = 215×65 = 13,975 kips ≈ 62,200 kN; the same section in Grade 50 gives only 10,750 kips ≈ 47,800 kN, so the higher-strength steel adds about 30% capacity, or allows a lighter section for the same axial load.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths", which statement holds?
options: 高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。
強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。
W14×730 斷面積 A = 215 in²。
optionsEn: If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable.
Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion.
A W14×730 has A = 215 in².
quiz.explanation: W14×730 斷面積 A = 215 in²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A W14×730 has A = 215 in². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「周邊巨型鋼柱與延性接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Perimeter jumbo columns and ductile joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對鋼廠檢驗證明的降伏強度、韌性（Charpy 衝擊值）與化學成分；巨型柱拼接與梁柱接頭依 AWS D1.1 做全滲透焊的超音波檢測，並以替代路徑分析確認移除任一周邊柱時，相鄰構件與接頭的需求容量比在允許範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check mill certificates for yield strength, toughness (Charpy values) and chemistry; ultrasonically test complete-joint-penetration welds at jumbo-column splices and beam–column joints to AWS D1.1, and use alternate-path analysis to confirm that removing any single perimeter column keeps demand-to-capacity ratios of neighbouring members and joints within limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：巨型型鋼焊接前須有經認可的焊接程序規範（WPS）、預熱與層間溫度管制，並對厚板做背面清根與超音波檢測；替代路徑所依賴的梁與接頭要在圖上標示為關鍵構件，日後不得任意開孔或更換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Welding of jumbo sections needs qualified welding procedure specifications with controlled preheat and interpass temperature, back-gouging and ultrasonic testing of thick plates; beams and joints relied on for alternate paths should be marked as key elements on the drawings and must not later be cut or replaced at will.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：巨型斷面厚翼板若銲接程序不當，可能出現層狀撕裂或熱影響區脆化；接頭雖通過強度檢核，卻在極端事件時於焊道根部脆性破壞，使原本規劃的懸吊與重分配路徑無法形成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thick flanges of jumbo sections welded with an unsuitable procedure can suffer lamellar tearing or embrittled heat-affected zones; joints that pass strength checks may then fracture brittlely at the weld root in an extreme event, so the planned hanging and redistribution path never forms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對鋼廠檢驗證明的降伏強度、韌性（Charpy 衝擊值）與化學成分；巨型柱拼接與梁柱接頭依 AWS D1.1 做全滲透焊的超音波檢測，並以替代路徑分析確認移除任一周邊柱時，相鄰構件與接頭的需求容量比在允許範圍內。
knowledge.textEn: Check mill certificates for yield strength, toughness (Charpy values) and chemistry; ultrasonically test complete-joint-penetration welds at jumbo-column splices and beam–column joints to AWS D1.1, and use alternate-path analysis to confirm that removing any single perimeter column keeps demand-to-capacity ratios of neighbouring members and joints within limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 巨型型鋼焊接前須有經認可的焊接程序規範（WPS）、預熱與層間溫度管制，並對厚板做背面清根與超音波檢測；替代路徑所依賴的梁與接頭要在圖上標示為關鍵構件，日後不得任意開孔或更換。
knowledge.textEn: Welding of jumbo sections needs qualified welding procedure specifications with controlled preheat and interpass temperature, back-gouging and ultrasonic testing of thick plates; beams and joints relied on for alternate paths should be marked as key elements on the drawings and must not later be cut or replaced at will.

quiz.question: 要驗證「周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths"?
options: 核對鋼廠檢驗證明的降伏強度、韌性（Charpy 衝擊值）與化學成分。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。
optionsEn: Check mill certificates for yield strength, toughness (Charpy values) and chemistry.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads.
quiz.explanation: 核對鋼廠檢驗證明的降伏強度、韌性（Charpy 衝擊值）與化學成分；巨型柱拼接與梁柱接頭依 AWS D1.1 做全滲透焊的超音波檢測，並以替代路徑分析確認移除任一周邊柱時，相鄰構件與接頭的需求容量比在允許範圍內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check mill certificates for yield strength, toughness (Charpy values) and chemistry; ultrasonically test complete-joint-penetration welds at jumbo-column splices and beam–column joints to AWS D1.1, and use alternate-path analysis to confirm that removing any single perimeter column keeps demand-to-capacity ratios of neighbouring members and joints within limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「周邊巨型鋼柱與延性接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Perimeter jumbo columns and ductile joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 巨型斷面厚翼板若銲接程序不當，可能出現層狀撕裂或熱影響區脆化；接頭雖通過強度檢核，卻在極端事件時於焊道根部脆性破壞，使原本規劃的懸吊與重分配路徑無法形成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thick flanges of jumbo sections welded with an unsuitable procedure can suffer lamellar tearing or embrittled heat-affected zones; joints that pass strength checks may then fracture brittlely at the weld root in an extreme event, so the planned hanging and redistribution path never forms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高強度鋼讓同一斷面承載更多，也減少接頭與焊接數量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher-strength steel carries more load per section and reduces the number of joints and welds.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 巨型斷面厚翼板若銲接程序不當，可能出現層狀撕裂或熱影響區脆化；接頭雖通過強度檢核，卻在極端事件時於焊道根部脆性破壞，使原本規劃的懸吊與重分配路徑無法形成。
knowledge.textEn: Thick flanges of jumbo sections welded with an unsuitable procedure can suffer lamellar tearing or embrittled heat-affected zones; joints that pass strength checks may then fracture brittlely at the weld root in an extreme event, so the planned hanging and redistribution path never forms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「周邊鋼框架、延性接頭與替代路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Perimeter frame, ductile joints and alternate paths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
巨型斷面厚翼板若銲接程序不當，可能出現層狀撕裂或熱影響區脆化；接頭雖通過強度檢核，卻在極端事件時於焊道根部脆性破壞，使原本規劃的懸吊與重分配路徑無法形成。
坐落在岩盤上的基礎不會沉陷，也不需要上拔設計。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Thick flanges of jumbo sections welded with an unsuitable procedure can suffer lamellar tearing or embrittled heat-affected zones.
Foundations on bedrock never settle and never need uplift design.
quiz.explanation: 巨型斷面厚翼板若銲接程序不當，可能出現層狀撕裂或熱影響區脆化；接頭雖通過強度檢核，卻在極端事件時於焊道根部脆性破壞，使原本規劃的懸吊與重分配路徑無法形成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thick flanges of jumbo sections welded with an unsuitable procedure can suffer lamellar tearing or embrittled heat-affected zones; joints that pass strength checks may then fracture brittlely at the weld root in an extreme event, so the planned hanging and redistribution path never forms. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工」與「124 m 尖塔的分段吊裝與高空接合」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rock footings, rock anchors and work beside subways" and "Staged erection and high-level splicing of the 124 m spire": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rock footings, rock anchors and work beside subways: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「曼哈頓岩盤展開基腳」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spread footings on Manhattan bedrock” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 結構向地下延伸約 21 m（70 ft），以展開基腳與條形基腳直接坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上，設計承壓至少約 60 美噸／平方英尺，局部加深開挖到更好的岩層可達約 114 美噸／平方英尺；另以伸入岩盤約 24 m（80 ft）的岩錨抵抗極端風下的上拔。部分基腳必須在仍在營運的地鐵線旁施作，因此開挖、爆破或破碎與支撐順序都要配合鐵路設施的振動與變位限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「曼哈頓岩盤展開基腳」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The structure extends about 21 m (70 ft) below grade and bears on Manhattan bedrock through spread and strip footings designed for at least about 60 short tons per square foot, with deeper excavation to better rock reaching about 114 tons per square foot; rock anchors extending about 24 m (80 ft) into the rock resist uplift under extreme wind. Some footings had to be built beside operating subway lines, so excavation, rock breaking and support sequences had to respect vibration and movement limits of the rail structures. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spread footings on Manhattan bedrock” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 60 tsf = 60×2,000/144 ≈ 833 psi ≈ 5.75 MPa, and 114 tsf ≈ 1,583 psi ≈ 10.9 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「坐落在岩盤上的基礎不會沉陷，也不需要上拔設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Foundations on bedrock never settle and never need uplift design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工
knowledge.titleEn: Rock footings, rock anchors and work beside subways
knowledge.text: 結構向地下延伸約 21 m（70 ft），以展開基腳與條形基腳直接坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上，設計承壓至少約 60 美噸／平方英尺，局部加深開挖到更好的岩層可達約 114 美噸／平方英尺；另以伸入岩盤約 24 m（80 ft）的岩錨抵抗極端風下的上拔。部分基腳必須在仍在營運的地鐵線旁施作，因此開挖、爆破或破碎與支撐順序都要配合鐵路設施的振動與變位限制。
knowledge.textEn: The structure extends about 21 m (70 ft) below grade and bears on Manhattan bedrock through spread and strip footings designed for at least about 60 short tons per square foot, with deeper excavation to better rock reaching about 114 tons per square foot; rock anchors extending about 24 m (80 ft) into the rock resist uplift under extreme wind. Some footings had to be built beside operating subway lines, so excavation, rock breaking and support sequences had to respect vibration and movement limits of the rail structures.

steps.title: 岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rock footings, rock anchors and work beside subways: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曼哈頓岩盤展開基腳」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spread footings on Manhattan bedrock” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：60 tsf = 60×2,000/144 ≈ 833 psi ≈ 5.75 MPa；114 tsf ≈ 1,583 psi ≈ 10.9 MPa。若單一基腳承受 60 MN，所需面積 A = 60,000/5,746 ≈ 10.4 m²（約 3.2 m 見方）；在 10.9 MPa 岩層只需約 5.5 m²（約 2.3 m 見方）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 60 tsf = 60×2,000/144 ≈ 833 psi ≈ 5.75 MPa, and 114 tsf ≈ 1,583 psi ≈ 10.9 MPa. A footing carrying 60 MN needs A = 60,000/5,746 ≈ 10.4 m² (about 3.2 m square) at 5.75 MPa, but only about 5.5 m² (about 2.3 m square) on 10.9 MPa rock. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個基腳開挖到底後由大地工程師目視與鑽探確認岩質、節理與風化程度，必要時做岩盤承壓或孔內試驗，簽認後才可澆置；岩錨逐支做驗證拉拔試驗並鎖定預力，地鐵結構旁設置振動計與變位監測點，讀值超過預警值即停工檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each footing is excavated, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality, jointing and weathering by inspection and probe holes, with bearing or borehole tests where needed, and signs off before concrete is placed; every rock anchor gets a proof test and lock-off load, and vibration monitors and movement points on the adjacent subway structures stop work for review when alert levels are exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rock footings, rock anchors and work beside subways: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曼哈頓岩盤展開基腳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spread footings on Manhattan bedrock” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個基腳開挖到底後由大地工程師目視與鑽探確認岩質、節理與風化程度，必要時做岩盤承壓或孔內試驗，簽認後才可澆置；岩錨逐支做驗證拉拔試驗並鎖定預力，地鐵結構旁設置振動計與變位監測點，讀值超過預警值即停工檢討。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each footing is excavated, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality, jointing and weathering by inspection and probe holes, with bearing or borehole tests where needed, and signs off before concrete is placed; every rock anchor gets a proof test and lock-off load, and vibration monitors and movement points on the adjacent subway structures stop work for review when alert levels are exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把基底驗收列為停留點：大地工程師、結構工程師與鐵路管理單位三方共同確認後才能澆置；在地鐵保護範圍內的作業須事先取得營運單位核准的施工方法與監測計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make founding-level acceptance a hold point requiring joint confirmation by the geotechnical engineer, structural engineer and rail operator before concrete is placed, and obtain the operator's approval of method statements and monitoring plans for any work inside the subway protection zone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若岩盤中有未發現的風化帶或斷層泥，基腳可能產生不均勻沉陷，使核心筒與周邊柱出現額外差異變位；在地鐵旁爆破或破碎控制不當，則可能造成隧道襯砌裂縫或軌道變位而被迫停運。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An undetected weathered seam or fault gouge can cause uneven settlement of footings and add differential movement between core and perimeter columns; poorly controlled blasting or breaking next to the subway can crack tunnel linings or shift tracks and force service shutdowns. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rock footings, rock anchors and work beside subways: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曼哈頓岩盤展開基腳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spread footings on Manhattan bedrock” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若岩盤中有未發現的風化帶或斷層泥，基腳可能產生不均勻沉陷，使核心筒與周邊柱出現額外差異變位；在地鐵旁爆破或破碎控制不當，則可能造成隧道襯砌裂縫或軌道變位而被迫停運。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

quiz.question: 在「岩盤基腳、岩錨與地鐵旁施工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
