steps.title: 124 m 尖塔的分段吊裝與高空接合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged erection and high-level splicing of the 124 m spire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「尖塔分段吊裝」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staged spire erection” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主屋頂約 417 m（1,368 ft），其上約 124 m（408 ft）的尖塔把總高度帶到 1,776 ft（541.3 m）。尖塔由 18 段鋼構組成，坐落在由核心筒支承的鋼筋混凝土基座上，並帶有通訊平台環；最後兩段各約 23 m（75 ft），由屋頂上的塔吊從臨時工作平台吊起，與下段以 60 支螺栓在約 518 m（1,701 ft）高空接合。高處風速大且吊物迎風面積大，吊裝時的擺動與定位精度成為控制因素。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「尖塔分段吊裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main roof is about 417 m (1,368 ft), and a spire of about 124 m (408 ft) above it brings the total height to 1,776 ft (541.3 m). steps.title: 124 m 尖塔的分段吊裝與高空接合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged erection and high-level splicing of the 124 m spire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「尖塔分段吊裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staged spire erection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吊物側向風力 F = ½ρV²C_dA。取段長 22.9 m、投影寬 1.5 m（A = 34.4 m²）、C_d = 1.2：V = 15 m/s 時 F = 0.5×1.225×15²×1.2×34.4 ≈ 5.7 kN；V = 25 m/s 時 F ≈ 15.8 kN。若吊重約 18 t（W ≈ 177 kN），擺角 θ = atan(15.8/177) ≈ 5.1°，在 22.9 m 長的吊物上已難以對孔。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The side wind force on a lifted piece is F = ½ρV²C_dA. For a 22.9 m section with a 1.5 m projected width (A = 34.4 m²) and C_d = 1.2, V = 15 m/s gives F = 0.5×1.225×15²×1.2×34.4 ≈ 5.7 kN and V = 25 m/s gives F ≈ 15.8 kN. With a lifted weight of about 18 t (W ≈ 177 kN), the swing angle θ = atan(15.8/177) ≈ 5.1°, which already makes bolt-hole alignment on a 22.9 m piece impractical. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝前比對塔吊在該半徑與高度的荷重表、吊具與吊點的第三方檢驗紀錄，並以屋頂風速計的即時讀值確認在允許吊裝風速內；接合後量測尖塔垂直度與螺栓預拉力（扭矩或轉角法抽驗），並在每段完成後做測量定位紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each lift, check the crane load chart at the actual radius and height, third-party inspection records of rigging and lifting lugs, and live roof anemometer readings against the permitted lifting wind speed; after splicing, survey the spire's verticality, verify bolt pretension by torque or turn-of-nut sampling, and record the as-built position of every section.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

For a 22.9 m section with a 1.5 m projected width (A = 34.4 m²) and C_d = 1.2, V = 15 m/s gives F = 0.5×1.225×15²×1.2×34.4 ≈ 5.7 kN and V = 25 m/s gives F ≈ 15.8 kN. steps.title: 124 m 尖塔的分段吊裝與高空接合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged erection and high-level splicing of the 124 m spire: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「尖塔分段吊裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Staged spire erection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊裝前比對塔吊在該半徑與高度的荷重表、吊具與吊點的第三方檢驗紀錄，並以屋頂風速計的即時讀值確認在允許吊裝風速內；接合後量測尖塔垂直度與螺栓預拉力（扭矩或轉角法抽驗），並在每段完成後做測量定位紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each lift, check the crane load chart at the actual radius and height, third-party inspection records of rigging and lifting lugs, and live roof anemometer readings against the permitted lifting wind speed; after splicing, survey the spire's verticality, verify bolt pretension by torque or turn-of-nut sampling, and record the as-built position of every section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫須明定停止吊裝的風速、尾繩控制、通訊與人員撤離區，並由起重作業主管與結構工程師共同簽認；每段接合完成並經檢驗前，不得移除臨時固定或進行下一吊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan must define the stop-work wind speed, tag-line control, communications and exclusion zones, signed by the appointed lifting supervisor and the structural engineer; temporary restraints must stay and the next lift must not start until each splice is completed and inspected.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在陣風中強行對孔，吊物擺動可能撞擊已安裝段或平台、損傷接合面並危及高空作業人員；螺栓預拉力不足則讓接合面在風振下滑移，日後出現螺栓鬆動與疲勞裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing alignment in gusts lets the swinging piece strike installed sections or platforms, damage the faying surfaces and endanger workers at height; insufficient bolt pretension lets the splice slip under wind vibration, later causing loosened bolts and fatigue cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「124 m 尖塔的分段吊裝與高空接合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 124 m 尖塔的分段吊裝與高空接合：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「尖塔分段吊裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Staged spire erection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在陣風中強行對孔，吊物擺動可能撞擊已安裝段或平台、損傷接合面並危及高空作業人員；螺栓預拉力不足則讓接合面在風振下滑移，日後出現螺栓鬆動與疲勞裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing alignment in gusts lets the swinging piece strike installed sections or platforms, damage the faying surfaces and endanger workers at height; insufficient bolt pretension lets the splice slip under wind vibration, later causing loosened bolts and fatigue cracks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A spire is not primary structure, so crane capacity is the only lifting constraint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」與「風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete" and "Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「大體積混凝土溫控與強度驗收」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mass-concrete temperature and strength acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 厚核心牆與基礎屬大體積混凝土，水泥水化熱使內部溫度升高，與表面的溫差會造成溫度裂縫。公開資料指出配比限制了波特蘭水泥用量，以冰取代部分拌合水並在較涼爽時段澆置，並在混凝土中埋設 RFID 溫度與成熟度記錄器追蹤內部溫度與強度發展。強度驗收則依統計：配比的目標平均強度必須高於規定強度，留出生產變異的餘裕，再以連續試體平均值與單一試體下限判定合格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「大體積混凝土溫控與強度驗收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thick core walls and foundations behave as mass concrete: heat of hydration raises the interior temperature and the difference from the surface can cause thermal cracking. Public descriptions say the mixes limited Portland cement, replaced part of the mixing water with ice, were placed during cooler hours, and contained embedded RFID loggers tracking internal temperature and maturity. Strength acceptance is statistical: the mix's target average strength must exceed the specified strength to allow for production variability, and lots are accepted by the average of consecutive tests and a lower limit for any single test. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mass-concrete temperature and strength acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 對 f′c > 5,000 psi 的目標平均強度 f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For f′c > 5,000 psi, ACI 318 sets the required average strength f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「大體積混凝土溫控與強度驗收」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mass-concrete temperature and strength acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete
knowledge.text: 厚核心牆與基礎屬大體積混凝土，水泥水化熱使內部溫度升高，與表面的溫差會造成溫度裂縫。公開資料指出配比限制了波特蘭水泥用量，以冰取代部分拌合水並在較涼爽時段澆置，並在混凝土中埋設 RFID 溫度與成熟度記錄器追蹤內部溫度與強度發展。

Public descriptions say the mixes limited Portland cement, replaced part of the mixing water with ice, were placed during cooler hours, and contained embedded RFID loggers tracking internal temperature and maturity.

knowledge.text: 誤解：高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete" is correct?
options: 高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。
厚核心牆與基礎屬大體積混凝土，水泥水化熱使內部溫度升高，與表面的溫差會造成溫度裂縫。
建築越高，風壓只隨高度成正比增加。
optionsEn: If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable.
Thick core walls and foundations behave as mass concrete: heat of hydration raises the interior temperature and the difference from the surface can cause thermal cracking.
Wind pressure simply increases in direct proportion to height.
quiz.explanation: 厚核心牆與基礎屬大體積混凝土，水泥水化熱使內部溫度升高，與表面的溫差會造成溫度裂縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thick core walls and foundations behave as mass concrete: heat of hydration raises the interior temperature and the difference from the surface can cause thermal cracking. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大體積混凝土溫控與強度驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mass-concrete temperature and strength acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 對 f′c > 5,000 psi 的目標平均強度 f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s)。f′c = 14,000 psi、標準差 s = 1,000 psi：f′c + 1.34s = 15,340 psi，0.90f′c + 2.33s = 14,930 psi，故 f′cr = 15,340 psi（約 105.8 MPa）；單一試體不得低於 0.90f′c = 12,600 psi（約 86.9 MPa）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For f′c > 5,000 psi, ACI 318 sets the required average strength f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s). With f′c = 14,000 psi and a standard deviation s = 1,000 psi, f′c + 1.34s = 15,340 psi and 0.90f′c + 2.33s = 14,930 psi, so f′cr = 15,340 psi (about 105.8 MPa); no single test may fall below 0.90f′c = 12,600 psi (about 86.9 MPa). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以埋設記錄器的溫度歷程計算成熟度並與現地養護試體比對，確認拆模與加載時機；核心與表面溫差超過規定值（例如 20 °C）即啟動保溫或延後拆模。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute maturity from the embedded temperature histories and compare with field-cured specimens to decide stripping and loading times; when the core-to-surface temperature difference exceeds the specified limit, for example 20 °C, apply insulation or delay stripping.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 對 f′c > 5,000 psi 的目標平均強度 f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s)。f′c = 14,000 psi、標準差 s = 1,000 psi：f′c + 1.34s = 15,340 psi，0.90f′c + 2.33s = 14,930 psi，故 f′cr = 15,340 psi（約 105.8 MPa）；單一試體不得低於 0.90f′c = 12,600 psi（約 86.9 MPa）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For f′c > 5,000 psi, ACI 318 sets the required average strength f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s). With f′c = 14,000 psi and a standard deviation s = 1,000 psi, f′c + 1.34s = 15,340 psi and 0.90f′c + 2.33s = 14,930 psi, so f′cr = 15,340 psi (about 105.8 MPa); no single test may fall below 0.90f′c = 12,600 psi (about 86.9 MPa). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete", which statement holds?
options: 鋼構尖塔只有在颱風或暴風後才需要檢查。
核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
ACI 318 對 f′c > 5,000 psi 的目標平均強度 f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s)。
optionsEn: A steel spire only needs inspection after a hurricane or storm.
A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
For f′c > 5,000 psi, ACI 318 sets the required average strength f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s).
quiz.explanation: ACI 318 對 f′c > 5,000 psi 的目標平均強度 f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For f′c > 5,000 psi, ACI 318 sets the required average strength f′cr = max(f′c + 1.34s, 0.90f′c + 2.33s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「大體積混凝土溫控與強度驗收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mass-concrete temperature and strength acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以埋設記錄器的溫度歷程計算成熟度並與現地養護試體比對，確認拆模與加載時機；核心與表面溫差超過規定值（例如 20 °C）即啟動保溫或延後拆模。強度以標準養護試體判定：每三組連續試驗平均不低於 f′c，且無單一試驗低於 0.90f′c。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute maturity from the embedded temperature histories and compare with field-cured specimens to decide stripping and loading times; when the core-to-surface temperature difference exceeds the specified limit, for example 20 °C, apply insulation or delay stripping. Accept strength on standard-cured specimens: every average of three consecutive tests at least f′c and no single test below 0.90f′c. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大體積澆置前須有溫控計畫，列明最高內部溫度、最大溫差、感測器位置與超限應變措施；試體不合格時依預先約定的程序處理：先查成熟度與溫度紀錄，再決定鑽心或載重評估，由結構工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before any mass pour, require a thermal control plan stating maximum interior temperature, maximum temperature difference, sensor locations and responses to exceedance; handle failed cylinders by a pre-agreed procedure that reviews maturity and temperature records before deciding on coring or load evaluation, signed off by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：冰的配量或澆置時段控制不當，會讓大體積牆內部溫度過高，延遲鈣礬石形成或溫差裂縫在數月後才出現；若試體不合格卻缺乏成熟度與鑽心資料，只能以昂貴的鑽心與載重評估補救。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor control of ice dosage or placement timing lets interior temperatures in massive walls run too high, so delayed ettringite formation or thermal cracks may appear months later; if cylinders fail without maturity and core data, only costly coring and load evaluation remain as remedies. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以埋設記錄器的溫度歷程計算成熟度並與現地養護試體比對，確認拆模與加載時機；核心與表面溫差超過規定值（例如 20 °C）即啟動保溫或延後拆模。強度以標準養護試體判定：每三組連續試驗平均不低於 f′c，且無單一試驗低於 0.90f′c。
knowledge.textEn: Compute maturity from the embedded temperature histories and compare with field-cured specimens to decide stripping and loading times; when the core-to-surface temperature difference exceeds the specified limit, for example 20 °C, apply insulation or delay stripping. Accept strength on standard-cured specimens: every average of three consecutive tests at least f′c and no single test below 0.90f′c.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 大體積澆置前須有溫控計畫，列明最高內部溫度、最大溫差、感測器位置與超限應變措施；試體不合格時依預先約定的程序處理：先查成熟度與溫度紀錄，再決定鑽心或載重評估，由結構工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Before any mass pour, require a thermal control plan stating maximum interior temperature, maximum temperature difference, sensor locations and responses to exceedance; handle failed cylinders by a pre-agreed procedure that reviews maturity and temperature records before deciding on coring or load evaluation, signed off by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete"?
options: 以埋設記錄器的溫度歷程計算成熟度並與現地養護試體比對，確認拆模與加載時機；核心與表面溫差超過規定值（例如 20 °C）即啟動保溫或延後拆模。

If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 以埋設記錄器的溫度歷程計算成熟度並與現地養護試體比對，確認拆模與加載時機；核心與表面溫差超過規定值（例如 20 °C）即啟動保溫或延後拆模。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute maturity from the embedded temperature histories and compare with field-cured specimens to decide stripping and loading times; when the core-to-surface temperature difference exceeds the specified limit, for example 20 °C, apply insulation or delay stripping. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大體積混凝土溫控與強度驗收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mass-concrete temperature and strength acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 冰的配量或澆置時段控制不當，會讓大體積牆內部溫度過高，延遲鈣礬石形成或溫差裂縫在數月後才出現；若試體不合格卻缺乏成熟度與鑽心資料，只能以昂貴的鑽心與載重評估補救。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor control of ice dosage or placement timing lets interior temperatures in massive walls run too high, so delayed ettringite formation or thermal cracks may appear months later; if cylinders fail without maturity and core data, only costly coring and load evaluation remain as remedies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：強度驗收則依統計：配比的目標平均強度必須高於規定強度，留出生產變異的餘裕，再以連續試體平均值與單一試體下限判定合格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Strength acceptance is statistical: the mix's target average strength must exceed the specified strength to allow for production variability, and lots are accepted by the average of consecutive tests and a lower limit for any single test.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冰的配量或澆置時段控制不當，會讓大體積牆內部溫度過高，延遲鈣礬石形成或溫差裂縫在數月後才出現；若試體不合格卻缺乏成熟度與鑽心資料，只能以昂貴的鑽心與載重評估補救。
knowledge.textEn: Poor control of ice dosage or placement timing lets interior temperatures in massive walls run too high, so delayed ettringite formation or thermal cracks may appear months later; if cylinders fail without maturity and core data, only costly coring and load evaluation remain as remedies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
冰的配量或澆置時段控制不當，會讓大體積牆內部溫度過高，延遲鈣礬石形成或溫差裂縫在數月後才出現。
建築越高，風壓只隨高度成正比增加。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Poor control of ice dosage or placement timing lets interior temperatures in massive walls run too high, so delayed ettringite formation or thermal cracks may appear months later.
Wind pressure simply increases in direct proportion to height.
quiz.explanation: 冰的配量或澆置時段控制不當，會讓大體積牆內部溫度過高，延遲鈣礬石形成或溫差裂縫在數月後才出現；若試體不合格卻缺乏成熟度與鑽心資料，只能以昂貴的鑽心與載重評估補救。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor control of ice dosage or placement timing lets interior temperatures in massive walls run too high, so delayed ettringite formation or thermal cracks may appear months later; if cylinders fail without maturity and core data, only costly coring and load evaluation remain as remedies. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「風洞試驗與高度風壓剖面」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wind-tunnel test and pressure profile” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 地表粗糙度使風速隨高度增加，曼哈頓密集高樓群形成粗糙的都市邊界層，超過 400 m 的屋頂所受風壓遠大於街道層。風洞試驗以縮尺模型重現邊界層剖面與周邊建物，量測各風向的整體力與帷幕牆局部風壓；整體力用於主結構，局部尖峰風壓用於帷幕牆與尖塔構件。由於高處風速高，風洞結果也決定頂部加速度、尖塔通訊環與屋頂設備的設計條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「風洞試驗與高度風壓剖面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground roughness makes wind speed increase with height, and Manhattan's dense towers create a rough urban boundary layer, so pressures at a roof above 400 m are far higher than at street level. Wind-tunnel tests reproduce the boundary-layer profile and neighbouring buildings on a scale model, measuring overall forces for every direction and local cladding pressures; overall forces feed the primary structure and local peak pressures the curtain wall and spire members. Because winds aloft are strong, the tests also set the design conditions for top-floor acceleration, the spire's rings and roof equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wind-tunnel test and pressure profile” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，風壓 q ∝ V²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and q ∝ V², take α = 0.25 and V₁₀ = 22 m/s: q₁₀ = 0.5×1.225×22² ≈ 0.296 kPa, and at 417 m q = q₁₀×(41.7)^0.5 = 0.296×6.46 ≈ 1.91 kPa, a wind speed of about 55.9 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建築越高，風壓只隨高度成正比增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wind pressure simply increases in direct proportion to height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「風洞試驗與高度風壓剖面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wind-tunnel test and pressure profile”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載
knowledge.titleEn: Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load
knowledge.text: 地表粗糙度使風速隨高度增加，曼哈頓密集高樓群形成粗糙的都市邊界層，超過 400 m 的屋頂所受風壓遠大於街道層。風洞試驗以縮尺模型重現邊界層剖面與周邊建物，量測各風向的整體力與帷幕牆局部風壓；整體力用於主結構，局部尖峰風壓用於帷幕牆與尖塔構件。

Wind-tunnel tests reproduce the boundary-layer profile and neighbouring buildings on a scale model, measuring overall forces for every direction and local cladding pressures; overall forces feed the primary structure and local peak pressures the curtain wall and spire members.

quiz.question: 關於「風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load" is correct?

steps.title: 風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風洞試驗與高度風壓剖面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wind-tunnel test and pressure profile” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，風壓 q ∝ V²。取 α = 0.25、V₁₀ = 22 m/s：q₁₀ = 0.5×1.225×22² ≈ 0.296 kPa；在 417 m，q = q₁₀×(41.7)^0.5 = 0.296×6.46 ≈ 1.91 kPa，對應風速約 55.9 m/s。這也說明第 1 單元取均布 2.0 kPa 只是粗估。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and q ∝ V², take α = 0.25 and V₁₀ = 22 m/s: q₁₀ = 0.5×1.225×22² ≈ 0.296 kPa, and at 417 m q = q₁₀×(41.7)^0.5 = 0.296×6.46 ≈ 1.91 kPa, a wind speed of about 55.9 m/s. This shows that the uniform 2.0 kPa in unit 1 is only a rough estimate. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認風洞報告的邊界層剖面、紊流強度與周邊模型範圍符合場址條件，並以不同風向的基座力矩與加速度預測對照設計值；局部風壓係數須以帷幕牆分區圖逐區轉換為設計風壓，並由結構與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that the wind-tunnel report's boundary-layer profile, turbulence intensity and proximity-model extent match the site, and compare predicted base moments and accelerations by direction with the design values; convert local pressure coefficients zone by zone into design pressures on the cladding zoning drawings, agreed by both structural and façade consultants.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and q ∝ V², take α = 0.25 and V₁₀ = 22 m/s: q₁₀ = 0.5×1.225×22² ≈ 0.296 kPa, and at 417 m q = q₁₀×(41.7)^0.5 = 0.296×6.46 ≈ 1.91 kPa, a wind speed of about 55.9 m/s. This shows that the uniform 2.0 kPa in unit 1 is only a rough estimate. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load", which statement holds?
options: 冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，風壓 q ∝ V²。
削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。

Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads.

steps.title: 風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風洞試驗與高度風壓剖面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wind-tunnel test and pressure profile” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認風洞報告的邊界層剖面、紊流強度與周邊模型範圍符合場址條件，並以不同風向的基座力矩與加速度預測對照設計值；局部風壓係數須以帷幕牆分區圖逐區轉換為設計風壓，並由結構與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that the wind-tunnel report's boundary-layer profile, turbulence intensity and proximity-model extent match the site, and compare predicted base moments and accelerations by direction with the design values; convert local pressure coefficients zone by zone into design pressures on the cladding zoning drawings, agreed by both structural and façade consultants. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞報告應列出試驗所假設的周邊建物清單與未來情境，並訂定周邊重大開發完成後是否需要重新評估的條件；所有屋頂與尖塔附掛設備須以風洞局部風壓設計固定件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wind-tunnel report should list the surrounding buildings and future scenarios assumed and define when major nearby development triggers re-evaluation; all roof and spire attachments must have their fixings designed for the tunnel's local pressures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若風洞未模擬周邊未來將興建的高樓，完工後鄰棟落成可能改變尾流與局部風壓，造成帷幕牆局部風壓超出設計；若高空風速被低估，尖塔與屋頂設備的固定件可能在暴風中疲勞或鬆脫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the wind tunnel ignores towers planned nearby, their later completion can change wakes and local pressures beyond the façade design values; underestimating winds aloft can let spire and roof-equipment fixings fatigue or loosen in storms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認風洞報告的邊界層剖面、紊流強度與周邊模型範圍符合場址條件，並以不同風向的基座力矩與加速度預測對照設計值；局部風壓係數須以帷幕牆分區圖逐區轉換為設計風壓，並由結構與帷幕牆顧問共同確認。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that the wind-tunnel report's boundary-layer profile, turbulence intensity and proximity-model extent match the site, and compare predicted base moments and accelerations by direction with the design values; convert local pressure coefficients zone by zone into design pressures on the cladding zoning drawings, agreed by both structural and façade consultants.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風洞報告應列出試驗所假設的周邊建物清單與未來情境，並訂定周邊重大開發完成後是否需要重新評估的條件；所有屋頂與尖塔附掛設備須以風洞局部風壓設計固定件。

steps.title: 風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風洞試驗與高度風壓剖面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wind-tunnel test and pressure profile” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若風洞未模擬周邊未來將興建的高樓，完工後鄰棟落成可能改變尾流與局部風壓，造成帷幕牆局部風壓超出設計；若高空風速被低估，尖塔與屋頂設備的固定件可能在暴風中疲勞或鬆脫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the wind tunnel ignores towers planned nearby, their later completion can change wakes and local pressures beyond the façade design values; underestimating winds aloft can let spire and roof-equipment fixings fatigue or loosen in storms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於高處風速高，風洞結果也決定頂部加速度、尖塔通訊環與屋頂設備的設計條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because winds aloft are strong, the tests also set the design conditions for top-floor acceleration, the spire's rings and roof equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「建築越高，風壓只隨高度成正比增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Wind pressure simply increases in direct proportion to height." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若風洞未模擬周邊未來將興建的高樓，完工後鄰棟落成可能改變尾流與局部風壓，造成帷幕牆局部風壓超出設計；若高空風速被低估，尖塔與屋頂設備的固定件可能在暴風中疲勞或鬆脫。
knowledge.textEn: If the wind tunnel ignores towers planned nearby, their later completion can change wakes and local pressures beyond the façade design values; underestimating winds aloft can let spire and roof-equipment fixings fatigue or loosen in storms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風速剖面、風洞試驗與設計風荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind profile, wind-tunnel testing and design wind load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。
若風洞未模擬周邊未來將興建的高樓，完工後鄰棟落成可能改變尾流與局部風壓，造成帷幕牆局部風壓超出設計。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion.
If the wind tunnel ignores towers planned nearby, their later completion can change wakes and local pressures beyond the façade design values.
quiz.explanation: 若風洞未模擬周邊未來將興建的高樓，完工後鄰棟落成可能改變尾流與局部風壓，造成帷幕牆局部風壓超出設計；若高空風速被低估，尖塔與屋頂設備的固定件可能在暴風中疲勞或鬆脫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the wind tunnel ignores towers planned nearby, their later completion can change wakes and local pressures beyond the façade design values; underestimating winds aloft can let spire and roof-equipment fixings fatigue or loosen in storms. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「強健性設計在營運期的維持」與「尖塔熱變形、接合檢查與長期交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Keeping robustness intact during operation" and "Spire thermal movement, joint inspection and long-term handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 強健性設計在營運期的維持：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Keeping robustness intact during operation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「替代傳力路徑與改裝管制」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alternate load paths and alteration control” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 強健性（防止連鎖倒塌）依賴的不只是構件強度，而是連續性與替代路徑：周邊梁與接頭能在某柱失效時以撓曲與懸吊作用把荷載轉送出去，核心筒則提供受保護的逃生梯與消防員專用梯。底部以厚實混凝土牆包覆大廳，公開資料說明其屬額外防護而非主結構。這些設計在營運期最容易被不知情的改裝破壞，例如切斷周邊梁、在核心牆開新孔或拆除防火被覆，因此強健性必須被記錄並納入改裝審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「替代傳力路徑與改裝管制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Robustness against progressive collapse depends not only on member strength but on continuity and alternate paths: perimeter beams and joints must transfer load by bending and hanging action if a column is lost, and the core provides protected exit stairs, including one reserved for first responders. Thick concrete walls enclose the lobby at the base, described publicly as added protection rather than primary structure. During operation these features are most easily defeated by uninformed alterations such as cutting perimeter beams, opening new holes in core walls or stripping fire protection, so robustness must be documented and built into alteration review. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Alternate load paths and alteration control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線性靜力替代路徑檢核：w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Linear-static alternate-path check: w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「替代傳力路徑與改裝管制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Alternate load paths and alteration control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 強健性設計在營運期的維持
knowledge.text: 強健性（防止連鎖倒塌）依賴的不只是構件強度，而是連續性與替代路徑：周邊梁與接頭能在某柱失效時以撓曲與懸吊作用把荷載轉送出去，核心筒則提供受保護的逃生梯與消防員專用梯。底部以厚實混凝土牆包覆大廳，公開資料說明其屬額外防護而非主結構。
knowledge.textEn: Robustness against progressive collapse depends not only on member strength but on continuity and alternate paths: perimeter beams and joints must transfer load by bending and hanging action if a column is lost, and the core provides protected exit stairs, including one reserved for first responders. Thick concrete walls enclose the lobby at the base, described publicly as added protection rather than primary structure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強健性設計在營運期的維持」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Keeping robustness intact during operation" is correct?
options: 強健性（防止連鎖倒塌）依賴的不只是構件強度，而是連續性與替代路徑：周邊梁與接頭能在某柱失效時以撓曲與懸吊作用把荷載轉送出去，核心筒則提供受保護的逃生梯與消防員專用梯。
強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。
鋼構尖塔只有在颱風或暴風後才需要檢查。
optionsEn: Robustness against progressive collapse depends not only on member strength but on continuity and alternate paths: perimeter beams and joints must transfer load by bending and hanging action if a column is lost, and the core provides protected exit stairs, including one reserved for first responders.
Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion.
A steel spire only needs inspection after a hurricane or storm.
quiz.explanation: 強健性（防止連鎖倒塌）依賴的不只是構件強度，而是連續性與替代路徑：周邊梁與接頭能在某柱失效時以撓曲與懸吊作用把荷載轉送出去，核心筒則提供受保護的逃生梯與消防員專用梯。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Robustness against progressive collapse depends not only on member strength but on continuity and alternate paths: perimeter beams and joints must transfer load by bending and hanging action if a column is lost, and the core provides protected exit stairs, including one reserved for first responders. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 強健性設計在營運期的維持：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Keeping robustness intact during operation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「替代傳力路徑與改裝管制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alternate load paths and alteration control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性靜力替代路徑檢核：w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m。原跨度 9 m 時 M = wL²/8 ≈ 220 kN·m；移除一根柱後跨度變 18 m，M = 21.75×18²/8 ≈ 881 kN·m，再乘常用的動力放大係數 2.0 得 1,762 kN·m，約為原需求的 8 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Linear-static alternate-path check: w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m. With the original 9 m span M = wL²/8 ≈ 220 kN·m; removing a column doubles the span to 18 m, M = 21.75×18²/8 ≈ 881 kN·m, and the commonly used dynamic factor of 2.0 gives 1,762 kN·m, about eight times the original demand. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接時建立關鍵構件清冊（周邊梁、接頭、核心牆開口、防火被覆範圍）並以圖面與照片記錄；每項改裝申請須經結構工程師以替代路徑模型核算，完工後現場確認被覆修補與構件未被切割。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At handover create a key-element register covering perimeter beams, joints, core-wall openings and fire-protection extents, documented with drawings and photographs; every alteration request is checked by the structural engineer against the alternate-path model, and after the work the site is inspected to confirm repaired fire protection and uncut members.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 線性靜力替代路徑檢核：w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m。原跨度 9 m 時 M = wL²/8 ≈ 220 kN·m；移除一根柱後跨度變 18 m，M = 21.75×18²/8 ≈ 881 kN·m，再乘常用的動力放大係數 2.0 得 1,762 kN·m，約為原需求的 8 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Linear-static alternate-path check: w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m. With the original 9 m span M = wL²/8 ≈ 220 kN·m; removing a column doubles the span to 18 m, M = 21.75×18²/8 ≈ 881 kN·m, and the commonly used dynamic factor of 2.0 gives 1,762 kN·m, about eight times the original demand. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「強健性設計在營運期的維持」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Keeping robustness intact during operation", which statement holds?
options: 核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。
optionsEn: A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
Linear-static alternate-path check: w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m.
If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 線性靜力替代路徑檢核：w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Linear-static alternate-path check: w = (1.2×5.0 + 0.5×2.5) kPa×3.0 m = 21.75 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 強健性設計在營運期的維持：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Keeping robustness intact during operation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「替代傳力路徑與改裝管制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alternate load paths and alteration control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接時建立關鍵構件清冊（周邊梁、接頭、核心牆開口、防火被覆範圍）並以圖面與照片記錄；每項改裝申請須經結構工程師以替代路徑模型核算，完工後現場確認被覆修補與構件未被切割。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At handover create a key-element register covering perimeter beams, joints, core-wall openings and fire-protection extents, documented with drawings and photographs; every alteration request is checked by the structural engineer against the alternate-path model, and after the work the site is inspected to confirm repaired fire protection and uncut members. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：物業管理規章中明訂：關鍵構件不得切割、焊接或開孔，防火被覆受損須於限期內修復，任何結構改裝須取得結構技師簽證；定期稽核時以關鍵構件清冊逐項巡查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Building rules should state that key elements may not be cut, welded or penetrated, damaged fire protection must be repaired within a set time, and any structural alteration requires sign-off by a licensed structural engineer; periodic audits should walk through the key-element register item by item.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：租戶裝修為了管線切斷周邊梁的翼板或腹板，平常看不出問題，但在某柱遭受火災或撞擊時，替代路徑提早失效，局部破壞可能擴大成多層塌落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A tenant fit-out that cuts the flange or web of a perimeter beam for services shows no everyday distress, but if a column is hit by fire or impact the alternate path fails early and local damage can spread into multi-storey collapse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接時建立關鍵構件清冊（周邊梁、接頭、核心牆開口、防火被覆範圍）並以圖面與照片記錄；每項改裝申請須經結構工程師以替代路徑模型核算，完工後現場確認被覆修補與構件未被切割。
knowledge.textEn: At handover create a key-element register covering perimeter beams, joints, core-wall openings and fire-protection extents, documented with drawings and photographs; every alteration request is checked by the structural engineer against the alternate-path model, and after the work the site is inspected to confirm repaired fire protection and uncut members.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 物業管理規章中明訂：關鍵構件不得切割、焊接或開孔，防火被覆受損須於限期內修復，任何結構改裝須取得結構技師簽證；定期稽核時以關鍵構件清冊逐項巡查。
knowledge.textEn: Building rules should state that key elements may not be cut, welded or penetrated, damaged fire protection must be repaired within a set time, and any structural alteration requires sign-off by a licensed structural engineer; periodic audits should walk through the key-element register item by item.

quiz.question: 要驗證「強健性設計在營運期的維持」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Keeping robustness intact during operation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
尖塔不是主結構，吊裝時只要吊車容量足夠就沒有其他限制。
交接時建立關鍵構件清冊（周邊梁、接頭、核心牆開口、防火被覆範圍）並以圖面與照片記錄。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A spire is not primary structure, so crane capacity is the only lifting constraint.
At handover create a key-element register covering perimeter beams, joints, core-wall openings and fire-protection extents, documented with drawings and photographs.
quiz.explanation: 交接時建立關鍵構件清冊（周邊梁、接頭、核心牆開口、防火被覆範圍）並以圖面與照片記錄；每項改裝申請須經結構工程師以替代路徑模型核算，完工後現場確認被覆修補與構件未被切割。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At handover create a key-element register covering perimeter beams, joints, core-wall openings and fire-protection extents, documented with drawings and photographs; every alteration request is checked by the structural engineer against the alternate-path model, and after the work the site is inspected to confirm repaired fire protection and uncut members. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 強健性設計在營運期的維持：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Keeping robustness intact during operation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「替代傳力路徑與改裝管制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alternate load paths and alteration control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 租戶裝修為了管線切斷周邊梁的翼板或腹板，平常看不出問題，但在某柱遭受火災或撞擊時，替代路徑提早失效，局部破壞可能擴大成多層塌落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A tenant fit-out that cuts the flange or web of a perimeter beam for services shows no everyday distress, but if a column is hit by fire or impact the alternate path fails early and local damage can spread into multi-storey collapse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 尖塔熱變形、接合檢查與長期交接：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spire and antenna-ring maintenance” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 尖塔同時是結構、通訊設備支架與航空障礙燈的載體，長期承受風振、溫度循環與雷擊，螺栓接合與焊接附件是疲勞與腐蝕的熱點。日照使鋼構每日伸縮，通訊天線與纜線的固定方式必須容許這些位移；維護人員需定期攀登檢查螺栓預拉力、塗裝與排水孔。交接文件應把每段尖塔的位置、接合細部、預拉力紀錄與維護通道一併移交，讓營運單位能長期追蹤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「尖塔與通訊環維護」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The spire is at once a structure, a support for broadcast equipment and a carrier of aviation obstruction lights, exposed for decades to wind vibration, temperature cycles and lightning, so bolted splices and welded attachments are hot spots for fatigue and corrosion. Sunlight makes the steel expand and contract daily, and antenna and cable fixings must accommodate those movements; maintenance crews must climb regularly to check bolt pretension, coatings and drain holes. Handover should transfer each section's position, splice details, pretension records and access routes so the operator can track them over the long term. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spire and antenna-ring maintenance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement is ΔL = αLΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼構尖塔只有在颱風或暴風後才需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 尖塔熱變形、接合檢查與長期交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spire thermal movement, joint inspection and long-term handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「尖塔與通訊環維護」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spire and antenna-ring maintenance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT。尖塔長 L ≈ 124 m、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、日照與夜間溫差 ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×124,000×40 ≈ 60 mm。若纜線支架每 3 m 固定且不可滑動，每段需吸收約 60×3/124 ≈ 1.5 mm 的相對位移。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement is ΔL = αLΔT. For a spire L ≈ 124 m long with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and a day–night temperature swing ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×124,000×40 ≈ 60 mm. If cable brackets every 3 m cannot slide, each segment must absorb about 60×3/124 ≈ 1.5 mm of relative movement. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以扭矩扳手或超音波螺栓伸長量測抽驗接合預拉力，以目視與磁粒檢測檢查焊接附件根部，並在尖塔頂部設置加速度計記錄風振；雷擊或強風後執行事件檢查並與基準紀錄比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically sample splice pretension with torque wrenches or ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement, inspect weld toes of attachments visually and by magnetic-particle testing, and record wind vibration with an accelerometer near the tip; after lightning strikes or storms carry out event inspections and compare with the baseline records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT。尖塔長 L ≈ 124 m、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、日照與夜間溫差 ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×124,000×40 ≈ 60 mm。若纜線支架每 3 m 固定且不可滑動，每段需吸收約 60×3/124 ≈ 1.5 mm 的相對位移。數值為教學假設。

If cable brackets every 3 m cannot slide, each segment must absorb about 60×3/124 ≈ 1.5 mm of relative movement. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 尖塔熱變形、接合檢查與長期交接：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「尖塔與通訊環維護」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spire and antenna-ring maintenance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以扭矩扳手或超音波螺栓伸長量測抽驗接合預拉力，以目視與磁粒檢測檢查焊接附件根部，並在尖塔頂部設置加速度計記錄風振；雷擊或強風後執行事件檢查並與基準紀錄比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時移交尖塔維護手冊：檢查週期、攀登與防墜系統、螺栓預拉力基準、附掛設備的審查流程與事件後檢查表；任何新增附掛物都須由結構工程師審查固定方式並禁止未經核准的現場焊接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover provide a spire maintenance manual covering inspection intervals, climbing and fall-arrest systems, bolt-pretension baselines, a review procedure for new attachments and a post-event checklist; every new attachment must have its fixing method reviewed by the structural engineer, and unapproved field welding is prohibited.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：附加天線或燈具時以現場焊接固定在主構件上，容易在焊趾產生疲勞裂縫；纜線固定過緊則在溫度循環下拉裂支架，長期造成水氣侵入與腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Field-welding new antennas or lights directly to main members easily initiates fatigue cracks at weld toes; over-tight cable fixings crack brackets under temperature cycles and let moisture in, causing long-term corrosion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
