steps.instructionEn: Field-welding new antennas or lights directly to main members easily initiates fatigue cracks at weld toes; over-tight cable fixings crack brackets under temperature cycles and let moisture in, causing long-term corrosion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件應把每段尖塔的位置、接合細部、預拉力紀錄與維護通道一併移交，讓營運單位能長期追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover should transfer each section's position, splice details, pretension records and access routes so the operator can track them over the long term.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼構尖塔只有在颱風或暴風後才需要檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel spire only needs inspection after a hurricane or storm." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 附加天線或燈具時以現場焊接固定在主構件上，容易在焊趾產生疲勞裂縫；纜線固定過緊則在溫度循環下拉裂支架，長期造成水氣侵入與腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Field-welding new antennas or lights directly to main members easily initiates fatigue cracks at weld toes; over-tight cable fixings crack brackets under temperature cycles and let moisture in, causing long-term corrosion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「尖塔熱變形、接合檢查與長期交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spire thermal movement, joint inspection and long-term handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
附加天線或燈具時以現場焊接固定在主構件上，容易在焊趾產生疲勞裂縫；纜線固定過緊則在溫度循環下拉裂支架，長期造成水氣侵入與腐蝕。
削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Field-welding new antennas or lights directly to main members easily initiates fatigue cracks at weld toes.
Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads.
quiz.explanation: 附加天線或燈具時以現場焊接固定在主構件上，容易在焊趾產生疲勞裂縫；纜線固定過緊則在溫度循環下拉裂支架，長期造成水氣侵入與腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Field-welding new antennas or lights directly to main members easily initiates fatigue cracks at weld toes; over-tight cable fixings crack brackets under temperature cycles and let moisture in, causing long-term corrosion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 樂天世界塔
summary: 樂天世界塔高 554.5 m、地上 123 層，以鋼筋混凝土核心筒與八根巨柱承擔重力與側力，兩道外伸臂與多道帶狀桁架把巨柱與核心筒綁在一起，並把頂部斜交網格燈籠與飯店柱轉換到巨柱上。基礎是 6.5 m 厚的筏基，斷層帶以不與筏基相連的補強樁改良地盤。本課沿著重力分擔、外伸臂、巨柱細長效應、帶狀桁架延遲鎖定、筏基一次澆置、預拱、監測與長期潛變，拆解這座韓國最高建築的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Lotte World Tower is 554.5 m tall with 123 storeys above ground; a reinforced-concrete core and eight mega-columns carry gravity and lateral load, two outrigger levels and several belt trusses tie the columns to the core and transfer the diagrid lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns. It stands on a 6.5 m thick mat, with ground-reinforcing piles, not connected to the mat, improving fault zones. The course follows gravity sharing, outriggers, mega-column slenderness, delayed locking of belt trusses, a single-pour mat, camber, monitoring and long-term creep to unpack Korea's tallest building.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核筏基在重力加風力下的接觸壓力。塔樓垂直荷重約 75 萬公噸，W = 750,000×9.81 ≈ 7.36×10⁶ kN；筏基 72 m×72 m，A = 5,184 m²，平均接觸壓力 q = 7.36×10⁶/5,184 ≈ 1,419 kPa。設計風傾覆力矩取 M = 2.5×10⁷ kN·m，斷面模數 S = B³/6 = 72³/6 = 62,208 m³，壓力變化 ΔM/S ≈ 402 kPa，故 q_max ≈ 1,821 kPa、q_min ≈ 1,017 kPa，與容許承壓 3,000 kPa 相比利用率約 61%；偏心 e = M/W ≈ 3.4 m 小於 B/6 = 12 m，筏基全面受壓。若 M 加倍為 5.0×10⁷ kN·m，q_max ≈ 2,223 kPa、q_min ≈ 616 kPa，利用率約 74%，e ≈ 6.8 m 仍小於 12 m。荷重與筏基尺寸取自公開資料的約略值，風力矩與承壓判讀為教學假設，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check mat contact pressure under gravity plus wind. The tower's vertical load is about 750,000 t, so W = 750,000×9.81 ≈ 7.36×10⁶ kN; the mat is 72 m×72 m, A = 5,184 m², giving an average contact pressure q = 7.36×10⁶/5,184 ≈ 1,419 kPa. Take a design wind overturning moment M = 2.5×10⁷ kN·m; the section modulus is S = B³/6 = 72³/6 = 62,208 m³, so the pressure change is M/S ≈ 402 kPa, q_max ≈ 1,821 kPa and q_min ≈ 1,017 kPa, a utilisation of about 61% of the 3,000 kPa allowable; the eccentricity e = M/W ≈ 3.4 m is below B/6 = 12 m, so the whole mat stays in compression. If M doubles to 5.0×10⁷ kN·m, q_max ≈ 2,223 kPa and q_min ≈ 616 kPa, utilisation about 74%, and e ≈ 6.8 m is still below 12 m. Load and mat size are approximate public values; the wind moment and bearing interpretation are teaching assumptions, not the actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」與「外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns" and "Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心筒與八根巨柱」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core and eight mega-columns” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出核心筒承擔塔樓約 60% 的重力、八根巨柱約 40%。塔身由下而上收分，核心牆在中段三分之一向內傾斜，周邊柱在兩個方向上傾斜，因此重力不只產生垂直壓力，也在樓板與帶狀桁架處產生需要被平衡的水平分力。分擔比例取決於核心牆與巨柱的相對軸向勁度與施工順序，而不是單純依樓板面積的受載區域劃分；兩者應力水準若差太多，長期潛變就會造成明顯的差異縮短。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心筒與八根巨柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources state that the core carries about 60% of the tower's gravity load and the eight mega-columns about 40%. The tower tapers with height, the core walls slope inward through the middle third and the perimeter columns slope in two directions, so gravity produces horizontal components that floors and belt trusses must balance as well as vertical compression. The split depends on the relative axial stiffness of walls and columns and on the construction sequence, not simply on tributary floor areas; if their stress levels differ greatly, long-term creep produces significant differential shortening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core and eight mega-columns” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設底層總重力 G = 6.0×10⁶ kN：核心筒 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN，八根巨柱共 2.4×10⁶ kN，每根約 300,000 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take a total ground-level gravity load G = 6.0×10⁶ kN: the core carries 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN and the eight mega-columns 2.4×10⁶ kN, about 300,000 kN each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心筒與八根巨柱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core and eight mega-columns”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔
knowledge.titleEn: Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出核心筒承擔塔樓約 60% 的重力、八根巨柱約 40%。塔身由下而上收分，核心牆在中段三分之一向內傾斜，周邊柱在兩個方向上傾斜，因此重力不只產生垂直壓力，也在樓板與帶狀桁架處產生需要被平衡的水平分力。
knowledge.textEn: Public sources state that the core carries about 60% of the tower's gravity load and the eight mega-columns about 40%. The tower tapers with height, the core walls slope inward through the middle third and the perimeter columns slope in two directions, so gravity produces horizontal components that floors and belt trusses must balance as well as vertical compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns" is correct?
options: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。
公開資料指出核心筒承擔塔樓約 60% 的重力、八根巨柱約 40%。
外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。
optionsEn: The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas.
Public sources state that the core carries about 60% of the tower's gravity load and the eight mega-columns about 40%.
More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出核心筒承擔塔樓約 60% 的重力、八根巨柱約 40%。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public sources state that the core carries about 60% of the tower's gravity load and the eight mega-columns about 40%. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心筒與八根巨柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core and eight mega-columns” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設底層總重力 G = 6.0×10⁶ kN：核心筒 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN，八根巨柱共 2.4×10⁶ kN，每根約 300,000 kN。3.3 m×3.3 m 巨柱 A = 10.89 m²，平均壓應力 σ = 300,000/10.89 ≈ 27.5 MPa，約為 80 MPa 混凝土的 34%。數值為教學假設，忽略鋼筋與鋼骨貢獻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take a total ground-level gravity load G = 6.0×10⁶ kN: the core carries 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN and the eight mega-columns 2.4×10⁶ kN, about 300,000 kN each. A 3.3 m×3.3 m mega-column has A = 10.89 m², so the average stress σ = 300,000/10.89 ≈ 27.5 MPa, about 34% of 80 MPa concrete. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring reinforcement and embedded steel. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析比較一次加載與逐層加載的核心筒／巨柱分擔比，確認兩者的長期應力差落在可控制的範圍；施工中於巨柱與核心牆埋設應變計，追蹤實測應力比是否與預測的 60/40 分擔一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare core/mega-column load sharing from one-step loading and from storey-by-storey construction-stage analysis, confirming that their long-term stress difference is controllable; during construction embed strain gauges in mega-columns and core walls to check that the measured stress ratio follows the predicted 60/40 split.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設底層總重力 G = 6.0×10⁶ kN：核心筒 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN，八根巨柱共 2.4×10⁶ kN，每根約 300,000 kN。3.3 m×3.3 m 巨柱 A = 10.89 m²，平均壓應力 σ = 300,000/10.89 ≈ 27.5 MPa，約為 80 MPa 混凝土的 34%。數值為教學假設，忽略鋼筋與鋼骨貢獻。
knowledge.textEn: Take a total ground-level gravity load G = 6.0×10⁶ kN: the core carries 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN and the eight mega-columns 2.4×10⁶ kN, about 300,000 kN each. A 3.3 m×3.3 m mega-column has A = 10.89 m², so the average stress σ = 300,000/10.89 ≈ 27.5 MPa, about 34% of 80 MPa concrete. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring reinforcement and embedded steel.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns", which statement holds?
options: 延遲接合只是施工方便，對結構受力沒有影響。
筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。
設底層總重力 G = 6.0×10⁶ kN：核心筒 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN，八根巨柱共 2.4×10⁶ kN，每根約 300,000 kN。
optionsEn: Delayed connection is only a construction convenience with no structural effect.
A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored.
Take a total ground-level gravity load G = 6.0×10⁶ kN: the core carries 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN and the eight mega-columns 2.4×10⁶ kN, about 300,000 kN each.
quiz.explanation: 設底層總重力 G = 6.0×10⁶ kN：核心筒 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN，八根巨柱共 2.4×10⁶ kN，每根約 300,000 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take a total ground-level gravity load G = 6.0×10⁶ kN: the core carries 0.6G = 3.6×10⁶ kN and the eight mega-columns 2.4×10⁶ kN, about 300,000 kN each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心筒與八根巨柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core and eight mega-columns” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析比較一次加載與逐層加載的核心筒／巨柱分擔比，確認兩者的長期應力差落在可控制的範圍；施工中於巨柱與核心牆埋設應變計，追蹤實測應力比是否與預測的 60/40 分擔一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare core/mega-column load sharing from one-step loading and from storey-by-storey construction-stage analysis, confirming that their long-term stress difference is controllable; during construction embed strain gauges in mega-columns and core walls to check that the measured stress ratio follows the predicted 60/40 split. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計初期就把核心牆與巨柱的長期應力差列為設計目標之一，必要時調整巨柱斷面或混凝土強度讓兩者應力相近，並在設計基準中寫明預期分擔比與監測驗證方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat the long-term stress difference between core walls and mega-columns as a design target from the outset, adjusting column size or concrete strength to bring stresses closer, and state the expected load split and its monitoring verification in the design basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若巨柱應力遠高於核心牆，巨柱的彈性與潛變縮短會比核心筒大，周邊樓板逐年向外傾斜，連接兩者的樓板梁與外伸臂鎖入額外力量；反之核心筒縮短較多時，電梯與管道井的垂直度也會受影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If mega-column stresses are much higher than core-wall stresses, the columns shorten more elastically and by creep, perimeter floors tilt outward year by year and the beams and outriggers between them lock in extra forces; if the core shortens more, elevator and riser verticality suffers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析比較一次加載與逐層加載的核心筒／巨柱分擔比，確認兩者的長期應力差落在可控制的範圍；施工中於巨柱與核心牆埋設應變計，追蹤實測應力比是否與預測的 60/40 分擔一致。
knowledge.textEn: Compare core/mega-column load sharing from one-step loading and from storey-by-storey construction-stage analysis, confirming that their long-term stress difference is controllable; during construction embed strain gauges in mega-columns and core walls to check that the measured stress ratio follows the predicted 60/40 split.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計初期就把核心牆與巨柱的長期應力差列為設計目標之一，必要時調整巨柱斷面或混凝土強度讓兩者應力相近，並在設計基準中寫明預期分擔比與監測驗證方式。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the long-term stress difference between core walls and mega-columns as a design target from the outset, adjusting column size or concrete strength to bring stresses closer, and state the expected load split and its monitoring verification in the design basis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns"?
options: 以施工階段分析比較一次加載與逐層加載的核心筒／巨柱分擔比，確認兩者的長期應力差落在可控制的範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。
optionsEn: Compare core/mega-column load sharing from one-step loading and from storey-by-storey construction-stage analysis, confirming that their long-term stress difference is controllable.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段分析比較一次加載與逐層加載的核心筒／巨柱分擔比，確認兩者的長期應力差落在可控制的範圍；施工中於巨柱與核心牆埋設應變計，追蹤實測應力比是否與預測的 60/40 分擔一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare core/mega-column load sharing from one-step loading and from storey-by-storey construction-stage analysis, confirming that their long-term stress difference is controllable; during construction embed strain gauges in mega-columns and core walls to check that the measured stress ratio follows the predicted 60/40 split. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心筒與八根巨柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core and eight mega-columns” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若巨柱應力遠高於核心牆，巨柱的彈性與潛變縮短會比核心筒大，周邊樓板逐年向外傾斜，連接兩者的樓板梁與外伸臂鎖入額外力量；反之核心筒縮短較多時，電梯與管道井的垂直度也會受影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If mega-column stresses are much higher than core-wall stresses, the columns shorten more elastically and by creep, perimeter floors tilt outward year by year and the beams and outriggers between them lock in extra forces; if the core shortens more, elevator and riser verticality suffers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分擔比例取決於核心牆與巨柱的相對軸向勁度與施工順序，而不是單純依樓板面積的受載區域劃分；兩者應力水準若差太多，長期潛變就會造成明顯的差異縮短。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The split depends on the relative axial stiffness of walls and columns and on the construction sequence, not simply on tributary floor areas; if their stress levels differ greatly, long-term creep produces significant differential shortening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若巨柱應力遠高於核心牆，巨柱的彈性與潛變縮短會比核心筒大，周邊樓板逐年向外傾斜，連接兩者的樓板梁與外伸臂鎖入額外力量；反之核心筒縮短較多時，電梯與管道井的垂直度也會受影響。
knowledge.textEn: If mega-column stresses are much higher than core-wall stresses, the columns shorten more elastically and by creep, perimeter floors tilt outward year by year and the beams and outriggers between them lock in extra forces; if the core shortens more, elevator and riser verticality suffers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若巨柱應力遠高於核心牆，巨柱的彈性與潛變縮短會比核心筒大，周邊樓板逐年向外傾斜，連接兩者的樓板梁與外伸臂鎖入額外力量。
外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

If mega-column stresses are much higher than core-wall stresses, the columns shorten more elastically and by creep, perimeter floors tilt outward year by year and the beams and outriggers between them lock in extra forces.
More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better.
quiz.explanation: 若巨柱應力遠高於核心牆，巨柱的彈性與潛變縮短會比核心筒大，周邊樓板逐年向外傾斜，連接兩者的樓板梁與外伸臂鎖入額外力量；反之核心筒縮短較多時，電梯與管道井的垂直度也會受影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If mega-column stresses are much higher than core-wall stresses, the columns shorten more elastically and by creep, perimeter floors tilt outward year by year and the beams and outriggers between them lock in extra forces; if the core shortens more, elevator and riser verticality suffers. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「兩道外伸臂與帶狀桁架」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two outrigger levels and belt trusses” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂位於約 39–44 層與 72–76 層的機械避難層，帶狀桁架位於約 72–76 層與 104–107 層。當核心筒在風或地震下彎曲旋轉，外伸臂迫使一側巨柱受拉減壓、另一側受壓，形成反向力偶抵消部分核心彎矩，頂部變位與加速度隨之下降；帶狀桁架則把周邊柱串成整圈，使非直接連到外伸臂的柱也參與作用，同時把頂部燈籠與飯店層的柱轉換到巨柱上。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「兩道外伸臂與帶狀桁架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Outriggers sit at mechanical and refuge levels around floors 39–44 and 72–76, and belt trusses around floors 72–76 and 104–107. When the core bends and rotates under wind or earthquake, the outriggers force mega-columns on one side into tension relief and on the other into extra compression, creating a restoring couple that cancels part of the core moment and reduces top drift and acceleration; the belt trusses tie the perimeter into a ring so columns not directly attached to an outrigger also participate, while transferring the lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two outrigger levels and belt trusses” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：外伸臂恢復力矩 M_o = ΔP·d。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The outrigger restoring moment is M_o = ΔP·d.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「兩道外伸臂與帶狀桁架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two outrigger levels and belt trusses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用
knowledge.titleEn: Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses
knowledge.text: 外伸臂位於約 39–44 層與 72–76 層的機械避難層，帶狀桁架位於約 72–76 層與 104–107 層。當核心筒在風或地震下彎曲旋轉，外伸臂迫使一側巨柱受拉減壓、另一側受壓，形成反向力偶抵消部分核心彎矩，頂部變位與加速度隨之下降；帶狀桁架則把周邊柱串成整圈，使非直接連到外伸臂的柱也參與作用，同時把頂部燈籠與飯店層的柱轉換到巨柱上。
knowledge.textEn: Outriggers sit at mechanical and refuge levels around floors 39–44 and 72–76, and belt trusses around floors 72–76 and 104–107. When the core bends and rotates under wind or earthquake, the outriggers force mega-columns on one side into tension relief and on the other into extra compression, creating a restoring couple that cancels part of the core moment and reduces top drift and acceleration; the belt trusses tie the perimeter into a ring so columns not directly attached to an outrigger also participate, while transferring the lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses" is correct?
options: 外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。
巨柱斷面巨大，所以不會有細長或挫屈問題。
外伸臂位於約 39–44 層與 72–76 層的機械避難層，帶狀桁架位於約 72–76 層與 104–107 層。
optionsEn: More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better.
A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues.
Outriggers sit at mechanical and refuge levels around floors 39–44 and 72–76, and belt trusses around floors 72–76 and 104–107.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂位於約 39–44 層與 72–76 層的機械避難層，帶狀桁架位於約 72–76 層與 104–107 層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Outriggers sit at mechanical and refuge levels around floors 39–44 and 72–76, and belt trusses around floors 72–76 and 104–107. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩道外伸臂與帶狀桁架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two outrigger levels and belt trusses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：外伸臂恢復力矩 M_o = ΔP·d。若一側巨柱群產生 ΔP = 50,000 kN 的軸力變化、兩側力臂 d = 50 m，M_o = 50,000×50 = 2.5×10⁶ kN·m；若該高度以下核心筒承受的風彎矩為 1.0×10⁷ kN·m，外伸臂約抵消 25%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The outrigger restoring moment is M_o = ΔP·d. If the mega-column group on one side changes axial force by ΔP = 50,000 kN with a lever arm d = 50 m between sides, M_o = 50,000×50 = 2.5×10⁶ kN·m; against a core wind moment of 1.0×10⁷ kN·m below that level, the outriggers relieve about 25%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在分析模型中逐一移除各外伸臂層，比較頂部變位、加速度與核心筒基座力矩，確認每道外伸臂的效益；並核對外伸臂斜桿與巨柱接頭在風、地震及長期差異縮短組合下的設計力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Remove each outrigger level in turn in the analysis model and compare top drift, acceleration and core base moment to confirm each level's benefit; check the design forces in outrigger diagonals and mega-column connections under wind, earthquake and long-term differential shortening combinations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 外伸臂恢復力矩 M_o = ΔP·d。若一側巨柱群產生 ΔP = 50,000 kN 的軸力變化、兩側力臂 d = 50 m，M_o = 50,000×50 = 2.5×10⁶ kN·m；若該高度以下核心筒承受的風彎矩為 1.0×10⁷ kN·m，外伸臂約抵消 25%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The outrigger restoring moment is M_o = ΔP·d. If the mega-column group on one side changes axial force by ΔP = 50,000 kN with a lever arm d = 50 m between sides, M_o = 50,000×50 = 2.5×10⁶ kN·m; against a core wind moment of 1.0×10⁷ kN·m below that level, the outriggers relieve about 25%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses", which statement holds?
options: 外伸臂恢復力矩 M_o = ΔP·d。
巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。
完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。
optionsEn: The outrigger restoring moment is M_o = ΔP·d.
If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference.
A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂恢復力矩 M_o = ΔP·d。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The outrigger restoring moment is M_o = ΔP·d. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩道外伸臂與帶狀桁架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two outrigger levels and belt trusses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在分析模型中逐一移除各外伸臂層，比較頂部變位、加速度與核心筒基座力矩，確認每道外伸臂的效益；並核對外伸臂斜桿與巨柱接頭在風、地震及長期差異縮短組合下的設計力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Remove each outrigger level in turn in the analysis model and compare top drift, acceleration and core base moment to confirm each level's benefit; check the design forces in outrigger diagonals and mega-column connections under wind, earthquake and long-term differential shortening combinations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外伸臂層位置要與建築的機械、避難與空中大廳樓層共同決定，並在合約文件中規定外伸臂最終接合的時機與調整機制；每道外伸臂都應有可追溯的設計力來源說明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Decide outrigger levels together with the mechanical, refuge and sky-lobby floors, specify in the contract documents when and how outriggers are finally connected, and document the source of every outrigger design force.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：外伸臂太剛時，巨柱與核心筒的差異縮短會在斜桿與接頭中鎖入巨大附加力，甚至超過風荷載本身；外伸臂太柔或位置不當，則無法有效降低變位，只增加機械層的鋼量與施工難度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outriggers that are too stiff lock large additional forces from differential shortening into diagonals and joints, sometimes exceeding the wind forces themselves; outriggers that are too flexible or poorly placed fail to reduce drift and only add steel and complexity to mechanical floors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses"?

在分析模型中逐一移除各外伸臂層，比較頂部變位、加速度與核心筒基座力矩，確認每道外伸臂的效益；並核對外伸臂斜桿與巨柱接頭在風、地震及長期差異縮短組合下的設計力。
外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。

Remove each outrigger level in turn in the analysis model and compare top drift, acceleration and core base moment to confirm each level's benefit.
Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change.

steps.title: 外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩道外伸臂與帶狀桁架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two outrigger levels and belt trusses” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂太剛時，巨柱與核心筒的差異縮短會在斜桿與接頭中鎖入巨大附加力，甚至超過風荷載本身；外伸臂太柔或位置不當，則無法有效降低變位，只增加機械層的鋼量與施工難度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outriggers that are too stiff lock large additional forces from differential shortening into diagonals and joints, sometimes exceeding the wind forces themselves; outriggers that are too flexible or poorly placed fail to reduce drift and only add steel and complexity to mechanical floors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：當核心筒在風或地震下彎曲旋轉，外伸臂迫使一側巨柱受拉減壓、另一側受壓，形成反向力偶抵消部分核心彎矩，頂部變位與加速度隨之下降；帶狀桁架則把周邊柱串成整圈，使非直接連到外伸臂的柱也參與作用，同時把頂部燈籠與飯店層的柱轉換到巨柱上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When the core bends and rotates under wind or earthquake, the outriggers force mega-columns on one side into tension relief and on the other into extra compression, creating a restoring couple that cancels part of the core moment and reduces top drift and acceleration; the belt trusses tie the perimeter into a ring so columns not directly attached to an outrigger also participate, while transferring the lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 外伸臂太剛時，巨柱與核心筒的差異縮短會在斜桿與接頭中鎖入巨大附加力，甚至超過風荷載本身；外伸臂太柔或位置不當，則無法有效降低變位，只增加機械層的鋼量與施工難度。
knowledge.textEn: Outriggers that are too stiff lock large additional forces from differential shortening into diagonals and joints, sometimes exceeding the wind forces themselves; outriggers that are too flexible or poorly placed fail to reduce drift and only add steel and complexity to mechanical floors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外伸臂與帶狀桁架的側向作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral action of outriggers and belt trusses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
巨柱斷面巨大，所以不會有細長或挫屈問題。
外伸臂太剛時，巨柱與核心筒的差異縮短會在斜桿與接頭中鎖入巨大附加力，甚至超過風荷載本身；外伸臂太柔或位置不當，則無法有效降低變位，只增加機械層的鋼量與施工難度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues.
Outriggers that are too stiff lock large additional forces from differential shortening into diagonals and joints, sometimes exceeding the wind forces themselves.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂太剛時，巨柱與核心筒的差異縮短會在斜桿與接頭中鎖入巨大附加力，甚至超過風荷載本身；外伸臂太柔或位置不當，則無法有效降低變位，只增加機械層的鋼量與施工難度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Outriggers that are too stiff lock large additional forces from differential shortening into diagonals and joints, sometimes exceeding the wind forces themselves; outriggers that are too flexible or poorly placed fail to reduce drift and only add steel and complexity to mechanical floors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應」與「帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mega-column step-downs and slenderness" and "Belt-truss connections and delayed locking": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mega-column step-downs and slenderness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「3.3 m 巨柱細長效應」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “3.3 m mega-column slenderness” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨柱由地面約 3.3 m 見方逐段縮小到約 1.4 m×2.3 m，核心牆與巨柱混凝土強度約 40 至 80 MPa。設計者指出底部巨柱在前八層沒有樓板側撐，屬細長構件：無側撐長度大時，軸力會放大柱身的初始彎矩與偏心，二階效應使彎矩比一階分析大得多。巨柱斷面逐段縮小時，偏心與勁度突變處也要特別檢核，避免應力集中與鋼筋續接過度擁擠。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「3.3 m 巨柱細長效應」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The mega-columns step down from about 3.3 m square at ground to about 1.4 m×2.3 m higher up, and core and column concrete ranges from about 40 to 80 MPa. The designers note that the base mega-columns are unbraced by floors for the first eight levels and qualify as slender members: over a long unbraced length the axial load magnifies initial bending and eccentricity, so second-order moments are much larger than first-order analysis suggests. Where the section steps down, eccentricities and abrupt stiffness changes need specific checks to avoid stress concentrations and congested bar splices. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “3.3 m mega-column slenderness” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa, I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴ and an effective EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「巨柱斷面巨大，所以不會有細長或挫屈問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「3.3 m 巨柱細長效應」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “3.3 m mega-column slenderness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應
knowledge.text: 巨柱由地面約 3.3 m 見方逐段縮小到約 1.4 m×2.3 m，核心牆與巨柱混凝土強度約 40 至 80 MPa。設計者指出底部巨柱在前八層沒有樓板側撐，屬細長構件：無側撐長度大時，軸力會放大柱身的初始彎矩與偏心，二階效應使彎矩比一階分析大得多。
knowledge.textEn: The mega-columns step down from about 3.3 m square at ground to about 1.4 m×2.3 m higher up, and core and column concrete ranges from about 40 to 80 MPa. The designers note that the base mega-columns are unbraced by floors for the first eight levels and qualify as slender members: over a long unbraced length the axial load magnifies initial bending and eccentricity, so second-order moments are much larger than first-order analysis suggests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：巨柱斷面巨大，所以不會有細長或挫屈問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mega-column step-downs and slenderness" is correct?
options: 巨柱由地面約 3.3 m 見方逐段縮小到約 1.4 m×2.3 m，核心牆與巨柱混凝土強度約 40 至 80 MPa。
巨柱斷面巨大，所以不會有細長或挫屈問題。
延遲接合只是施工方便，對結構受力沒有影響。
optionsEn: The mega-columns step down from about 3.3 m square at ground to about 1.4 m×2.3 m higher up, and core and column concrete ranges from about 40 to 80 MPa.
A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues.
Delayed connection is only a construction convenience with no structural effect.
quiz.explanation: 巨柱由地面約 3.3 m 見方逐段縮小到約 1.4 m×2.3 m，核心牆與巨柱混凝土強度約 40 至 80 MPa。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The mega-columns step down from about 3.3 m square at ground to about 1.4 m×2.3 m higher up, and core and column concrete ranges from about 40 to 80 MPa. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mega-column step-downs and slenderness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3.3 m 巨柱細長效應」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3.3 m mega-column slenderness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa，I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴，有效 EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m²。無側撐長度 40 m 時 P_c = π²EI/L² ≈ 1.03×10⁶ kN；設計軸力 P_u = 360,000 kN，彎矩放大 δ = 1/(1 − P_u/0.75P_c) = 1/(1 − 0.468) ≈ 1.88。若長度增為 48 m，δ ≈ 3.07。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa, I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴ and an effective EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m². For a 40 m unbraced length P_c = π²EI/L² ≈ 1.03×10⁶ kN; with a design axial load P_u = 360,000 kN the moment magnifier δ = 1/(1 − P_u/0.75P_c) = 1/(1 − 0.468) ≈ 1.88. At 48 m, δ ≈ 3.07. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以考慮幾何非線性、開裂與潛變的二階分析複核巨柱彎矩，並與規範的彎矩放大法比較；施工時量測巨柱垂直度與模板偏位，確認初始偏心不超過分析假設值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check mega-column moments with second-order analysis including geometric nonlinearity, cracking and creep, and compare with the code moment-magnifier method; during construction survey column plumbness and formwork offsets to confirm that initial eccentricity stays within the analysis assumption.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa, I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴ and an effective EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m². For a 40 m unbraced length P_c = π²EI/L² ≈ 1.03×10⁶ kN; with a design axial load P_u = 360,000 kN the moment magnifier δ = 1/(1 − P_u/0.75P_c) = 1/(1 − 0.468) ≈ 1.88. At 48 m, δ ≈ 3.07. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mega-column step-downs and slenderness", which statement holds?
options: 筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。
樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。
optionsEn: A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored.
E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa, I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴ and an effective EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m².
Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat.
quiz.explanationEn: E_c = 4,700√80 ≈ 42,040 MPa, I_g = 3.3⁴/12 ≈ 9.88 m⁴ and an effective EI = 0.4E_cI_g ≈ 1.66×10⁸ kN·m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mega-column step-downs and slenderness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「3.3 m 巨柱細長效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “3.3 m mega-column slenderness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以考慮幾何非線性、開裂與潛變的二階分析複核巨柱彎矩，並與規範的彎矩放大法比較；施工時量測巨柱垂直度與模板偏位，確認初始偏心不超過分析假設值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：無側撐高度大的巨柱應在施工計畫中訂定垂直度允差與量測頻率，並在澆置前檢查鋼筋續接區的淨距；斷面變化層的配筋詳圖須經結構工程師複核。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若忽略二階效應或低估施工偏位，巨柱在設計風或地震下的實際彎矩可能超出容量，柱身出現水平裂縫；斷面縮小處若續接鋼筋過密導致混凝土充填不良，也會形成弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “3.3 m mega-column slenderness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若忽略二階效應或低估施工偏位，巨柱在設計風或地震下的實際彎矩可能超出容量，柱身出現水平裂縫；斷面縮小處若續接鋼筋過密導致混凝土充填不良，也會形成弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

quiz.question: 在「巨柱尺寸遞減與細長效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Belt-truss connections and delayed locking: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「帶狀桁架預埋板與長槽孔」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Belt-truss embed plates and long slots” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 帶狀桁架由預組段件在現場焊接到巨柱外側的預埋鋼板上，讓巨柱混凝土能連續施作而不被鋼構中斷。公開報導指出部分柱與帶狀桁架的接合採長槽孔，螺栓在塔樓完成後才鎖緊與重新定位；設計者也建議延後外伸臂最終接合，並設計長期力量轉移。長槽孔讓核心筒與巨柱在施工期的差異縮短自由發生，等主要重力就位後再鎖定，以減少鎖入的附加力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「帶狀桁架預埋板與長槽孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Belt trusses are pre-assembled in sections and field-welded to embedded steel plates on the outside of the mega-columns, so the column concrete can be cast continuously without interruption by steelwork. Published reports say some column-to-belt-truss connections used long-slotted holes, with bolts tensioned and re-indexed after the tower was completed, and the designers recommended delaying the final outrigger connections and designing for long-term force transfer. The slots let differential shortening between core and columns occur freely during construction and are locked only after most gravity load is in place, reducing locked-in forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Belt-truss embed plates and long slots” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：長槽孔長度 ≈ 孔徑 + 2δ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Long-slot length ≈ hole diameter + 2δ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲接合只是施工方便，對結構受力沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delayed connection is only a construction convenience with no structural effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「帶狀桁架預埋板與長槽孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Belt-truss embed plates and long slots”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Belt-truss connections and delayed locking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「帶狀桁架預埋板與長槽孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Belt-truss embed plates and long slots” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：長槽孔長度 ≈ 孔徑 + 2δ。M30 螺栓標準孔徑 33 mm，若鎖定前預期相對位移 δ = ±20 mm，槽長 = 33 + 2×20 = 73 mm，未超過 AISC 對 M30 長槽孔約 75 mm 的上限；若 δ = ±25 mm，需 83 mm，就必須改用其他可調細部。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Long-slot length ≈ hole diameter + 2δ. For an M30 bolt with a 33 mm standard hole and an expected movement of δ = ±20 mm before locking, the slot is 33 + 2×20 = 73 mm, within the AISC long-slot limit of about 75 mm for M30; for δ = ±25 mm it would need 83 mm, so another adjustable detail is required. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鎖定前量測每個長槽孔內螺栓相對槽端的位置，確認尚有足夠的雙向餘裕；鎖定作業依預拉力規範抽驗，並以測量標高與應變紀錄證明鎖定時差異縮短已達預測比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before locking, measure each bolt's position relative to the slot ends to confirm remaining travel in both directions; sample pretension during locking to the bolting specification, and use level surveys and strain records to show that the predicted proportion of differential shortening had occurred at the time of locking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 長槽孔長度 ≈ 孔徑 + 2δ。M30 螺栓標準孔徑 33 mm，若鎖定前預期相對位移 δ = ±20 mm，槽長 = 33 + 2×20 = 73 mm，未超過 AISC 對 M30 長槽孔約 75 mm 的上限；若 δ = ±25 mm，需 83 mm，就必須改用其他可調細部。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Long-slot length ≈ hole diameter + 2δ. For an M30 bolt with a 33 mm standard hole and an expected movement of δ = ±20 mm before locking, the slot is 33 + 2×20 = 73 mm, within the AISC long-slot limit of about 75 mm for M30; for δ = ±25 mm it would need 83 mm, so another adjustable detail is required. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。

Long-slot length ≈ hole diameter + 2δ.
quiz.explanation: 長槽孔長度 ≈ 孔徑 + 2δ。 重算時請保留單位。
