steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Belt-truss embed plates and long slots” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鎖定前量測每個長槽孔內螺栓相對槽端的位置，確認尚有足夠的雙向餘裕；鎖定作業依預拉力規範抽驗，並以測量標高與應變紀錄證明鎖定時差異縮短已達預測比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before locking, measure each bolt's position relative to the slot ends to confirm remaining travel in both directions; sample pretension during locking to the bolting specification, and use level surveys and strain records to show that the predicted proportion of differential shortening had occurred at the time of locking. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：延遲接頭須在施工圖與現場以醒目標籤標示「暫不鎖定」，鎖定時機列為停留點，由結構工程師依監測資料確認後才可施作，並保存鎖定日期與預拉力紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Delayed joints should be tagged as do-not-lock on drawings and on site, with locking treated as a hold point released only after the structural engineer confirms the monitoring data, and the locking date and pretension records kept.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若螺栓在施工中途就被誤鎖或槽孔餘裕不足，差異縮短會讓螺栓頂住槽端並剪斷或使連接板挫屈；預埋板錨筋若設計不足，現場焊接與鎖入力也可能把預埋板從巨柱拉脫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If bolts are tightened prematurely or the slots run out of travel, differential shortening drives bolts against slot ends, shearing them or buckling the plates; under-designed anchors behind embedded plates can let welding stresses and locked-in forces pull the plates out of the column. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鎖定前量測每個長槽孔內螺栓相對槽端的位置，確認尚有足夠的雙向餘裕；鎖定作業依預拉力規範抽驗，並以測量標高與應變紀錄證明鎖定時差異縮短已達預測比例。
knowledge.textEn: Before locking, measure each bolt's position relative to the slot ends to confirm remaining travel in both directions; sample pretension during locking to the bolting specification, and use level surveys and strain records to show that the predicted proportion of differential shortening had occurred at the time of locking.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 延遲接頭須在施工圖與現場以醒目標籤標示「暫不鎖定」，鎖定時機列為停留點，由結構工程師依監測資料確認後才可施作，並保存鎖定日期與預拉力紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Delayed joints should be tagged as do-not-lock on drawings and on site, with locking treated as a hold point released only after the structural engineer confirms the monitoring data, and the locking date and pretension records kept.

quiz.question: 要驗證「帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Belt-truss connections and delayed locking"?
options: 鎖定前量測每個長槽孔內螺栓相對槽端的位置，確認尚有足夠的雙向餘裕；鎖定作業依預拉力規範抽驗，並以測量標高與應變紀錄證明鎖定時差異縮短已達預測比例。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。
optionsEn: Before locking, measure each bolt's position relative to the slot ends to confirm remaining travel in both directions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas.
quiz.explanation: 鎖定前量測每個長槽孔內螺栓相對槽端的位置，確認尚有足夠的雙向餘裕；鎖定作業依預拉力規範抽驗，並以測量標高與應變紀錄證明鎖定時差異縮短已達預測比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before locking, measure each bolt's position relative to the slot ends to confirm remaining travel in both directions; sample pretension during locking to the bolting specification, and use level surveys and strain records to show that the predicted proportion of differential shortening had occurred at the time of locking. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Belt-truss connections and delayed locking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帶狀桁架預埋板與長槽孔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Belt-truss embed plates and long slots” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若螺栓在施工中途就被誤鎖或槽孔餘裕不足，差異縮短會讓螺栓頂住槽端並剪斷或使連接板挫屈；預埋板錨筋若設計不足，現場焊接與鎖入力也可能把預埋板從巨柱拉脫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If bolts are tightened prematurely or the slots run out of travel, differential shortening drives bolts against slot ends, shearing them or buckling the plates; under-designed anchors behind embedded plates can let welding stresses and locked-in forces pull the plates out of the column. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長槽孔讓核心筒與巨柱在施工期的差異縮短自由發生，等主要重力就位後再鎖定，以減少鎖入的附加力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The slots let differential shortening between core and columns occur freely during construction and are locked only after most gravity load is in place, reducing locked-in forces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「延遲接合只是施工方便，對結構受力沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delayed connection is only a construction convenience with no structural effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若螺栓在施工中途就被誤鎖或槽孔餘裕不足，差異縮短會讓螺栓頂住槽端並剪斷或使連接板挫屈；預埋板錨筋若設計不足，現場焊接與鎖入力也可能把預埋板從巨柱拉脫。
knowledge.textEn: If bolts are tightened prematurely or the slots run out of travel, differential shortening drives bolts against slot ends, shearing them or buckling the plates; under-designed anchors behind embedded plates can let welding stresses and locked-in forces pull the plates out of the column.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「帶狀桁架接頭與延遲鎖定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Belt-truss connections and delayed locking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若螺栓在施工中途就被誤鎖或槽孔餘裕不足，差異縮短會讓螺栓頂住槽端並剪斷或使連接板挫屈；預埋板錨筋若設計不足，現場焊接與鎖入力也可能把預埋板從巨柱拉脫。
巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If bolts are tightened prematurely or the slots run out of travel, differential shortening drives bolts against slot ends, shearing them or buckling the plates.
If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference.
quiz.explanation: 若螺栓在施工中途就被誤鎖或槽孔餘裕不足，差異縮短會讓螺栓頂住槽端並剪斷或使連接板挫屈；預埋板錨筋若設計不足，現場焊接與鎖入力也可能把預埋板從巨柱拉脫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If bolts are tightened prematurely or the slots run out of travel, differential shortening drives bolts against slot ends, shearing them or buckling the plates; under-designed anchors behind embedded plates can let welding stresses and locked-in forces pull the plates out of the column. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置」與「差異沉陷的預拱補償」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Single continuous pour of a massive mat" and "Camber compensation for differential settlement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Single continuous pour of a massive mat: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「6.5 m 筏基連續澆置」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous pour of the 6.5 m mat” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 筏基約 72 m×72 m、厚 6.5 m，開挖深度約 38 m，承載塔樓約 75 萬公噸的垂直荷重，公開報導描述其以單次連續澆置完成。為避免冷縫與過高水化熱，採用 50 MPa 的低熱高流動性混凝土。單次澆置需要同時調度大量預拌車、泵車與布料點，使每一層新混凝土在下層初凝前覆蓋，讓整塊筏基成為無冷縫的整體；同時以溫度感測器控制內外溫差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「6.5 m 筏基連續澆置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The mat is about 72 m×72 m and 6.5 m thick, at an excavation depth of about 38 m, carrying a vertical load of about 750,000 t, and was reported as placed in a single continuous pour. To avoid cold joints and excessive heat of hydration, a 50 MPa low-heat, high-flow concrete was used. A single pour demands simultaneous dispatch of many ready-mix trucks, pumps and placing points so each new layer covers the previous one before initial set, making the mat a monolith without cold joints, while temperature sensors control the interior-to-surface difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Continuous pour of the 6.5 m mat” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：澆置量 V = 31,200 m³、歷時 30 h，平均供料 1,040 m³/h；每層 0.5 m 覆蓋全面積需 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³，約 2.5 h 才回到同一點，初凝時間必須明顯大於 2.5 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A volume V = 31,200 m³ placed in 30 h means an average supply of 1,040 m³/h; covering the whole area in 0.5 m layers needs 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³ per layer, so placement returns to the same spot only after about 2.5 h and initial set must be well beyond 2.5 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「6.5 m 筏基連續澆置」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Continuous pour of the 6.5 m mat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置
knowledge.titleEn: Single continuous pour of a massive mat
knowledge.text: 筏基約 72 m×72 m、厚 6.5 m，開挖深度約 38 m，承載塔樓約 75 萬公噸的垂直荷重，公開報導描述其以單次連續澆置完成。為避免冷縫與過高水化熱，採用 50 MPa 的低熱高流動性混凝土。
knowledge.textEn: The mat is about 72 m×72 m and 6.5 m thick, at an excavation depth of about 38 m, carrying a vertical load of about 750,000 t, and was reported as placed in a single continuous pour. To avoid cold joints and excessive heat of hydration, a 50 MPa low-heat, high-flow concrete was used.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single continuous pour of a massive mat" is correct?
options: 巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。
筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。
筏基約 72 m×72 m、厚 6.5 m，開挖深度約 38 m，承載塔樓約 75 萬公噸的垂直荷重，公開報導描述其以單次連續澆置完成。
optionsEn: If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference.
A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored.
The mat is about 72 m×72 m and 6.5 m thick, at an excavation depth of about 38 m, carrying a vertical load of about 750,000 t, and was reported as placed in a single continuous pour.
quiz.explanation: 筏基約 72 m×72 m、厚 6.5 m，開挖深度約 38 m，承載塔樓約 75 萬公噸的垂直荷重，公開報導描述其以單次連續澆置完成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The mat is about 72 m×72 m and 6.5 m thick, at an excavation depth of about 38 m, carrying a vertical load of about 750,000 t, and was reported as placed in a single continuous pour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single continuous pour of a massive mat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「6.5 m 筏基連續澆置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Continuous pour of the 6.5 m mat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：澆置量 V = 31,200 m³、歷時 30 h，平均供料 1,040 m³/h；每層 0.5 m 覆蓋全面積需 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³，約 2.5 h 才回到同一點，初凝時間必須明顯大於 2.5 h。若 5,300 車次，平均每車約 5.9 m³，每小時約 177 車，即約每 20 s 一車。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A volume V = 31,200 m³ placed in 30 h means an average supply of 1,040 m³/h; covering the whole area in 0.5 m layers needs 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³ per layer, so placement returns to the same spot only after about 2.5 h and initial set must be well beyond 2.5 h. With 5,300 truckloads, each carries about 5.9 m³, about 177 trucks per hour or one every 20 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置前做配比的絕熱溫升與凝結時間試驗、泵送試驗與交通演練；澆置中記錄每車出廠時間、坍流度與溫度，布料點依網格輪替並記錄層面覆蓋時間；之後以埋設感測器追蹤最高溫度與溫差直到降至允許值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the pour, test adiabatic temperature rise and setting time, run pumping trials and rehearse traffic; during the pour record each truck's batch time, slump flow and temperature, rotate placing points on a grid and log layer coverage times; afterwards track peak temperature and differential with embedded sensors until they fall within limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 澆置量 V = 31,200 m³、歷時 30 h，平均供料 1,040 m³/h；每層 0.5 m 覆蓋全面積需 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³，約 2.5 h 才回到同一點，初凝時間必須明顯大於 2.5 h。若 5,300 車次，平均每車約 5.9 m³，每小時約 177 車，即約每 20 s 一車。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A volume V = 31,200 m³ placed in 30 h means an average supply of 1,040 m³/h; covering the whole area in 0.5 m layers needs 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³ per layer, so placement returns to the same spot only after about 2.5 h and initial set must be well beyond 2.5 h. With 5,300 truckloads, each carries about 5.9 m³, about 177 trucks per hour or one every 20 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Single continuous pour of a massive mat", which statement holds?
options: 澆置量 V = 31,200 m³、歷時 30 h，平均供料 1,040 m³/h。
樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。
感測器越多，結構安全就越有保障，不需要人工判讀與維護。
optionsEn: A volume V = 31,200 m³ placed in 30 h means an average supply of 1,040 m³/h.
Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat.
More sensors automatically mean a safer structure without human interpretation or maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 澆置量 V = 31,200 m³、歷時 30 h，平均供料 1,040 m³/h；每層 0.5 m 覆蓋全面積需 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³，約 2.5 h 才回到同一點，初凝時間必須明顯大於 2.5 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A volume V = 31,200 m³ placed in 30 h means an average supply of 1,040 m³/h; covering the whole area in 0.5 m layers needs 72×72×0.5 = 2,592 m³ per layer, so placement returns to the same spot only after about 2.5 h and initial set must be well beyond 2.5 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Single continuous pour of a massive mat: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「6.5 m 筏基連續澆置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous pour of the 6.5 m mat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前做配比的絕熱溫升與凝結時間試驗、泵送試驗與交通演練；澆置中記錄每車出廠時間、坍流度與溫度，布料點依網格輪替並記錄層面覆蓋時間；之後以埋設感測器追蹤最高溫度與溫差直到降至允許值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the pour, test adiabatic temperature rise and setting time, run pumping trials and rehearse traffic; during the pour record each truck's batch time, slump flow and temperature, rotate placing points on a grid and log layer coverage times; afterwards track peak temperature and differential with embedded sensors until they fall within limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大體積澆置須有備援拌合廠、備用泵車與交通管制計畫，並預先規劃萬一中斷時的施工縫位置與處理方式；溫控計畫與停止條件須經結構工程師核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A mass pour needs backup batching plants, standby pumps and a traffic plan, with pre-planned emergency construction-joint locations and treatment in case of interruption; the thermal control plan and stop criteria require the structural engineer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若供料中斷或布料不均使某區層面暴露超過初凝，就形成冷縫，成為地下水滲漏與剪力傳遞的弱面；溫差控制失敗則會在筏基表面產生貫穿性溫度裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If supply is interrupted or placement is uneven so an area stays exposed past initial set, a cold joint forms that weakens shear transfer and admits groundwater; failed temperature control causes through-thickness thermal cracks at the mat surface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 澆置前做配比的絕熱溫升與凝結時間試驗、泵送試驗與交通演練；澆置中記錄每車出廠時間、坍流度與溫度，布料點依網格輪替並記錄層面覆蓋時間；之後以埋設感測器追蹤最高溫度與溫差直到降至允許值。
knowledge.textEn: Before the pour, test adiabatic temperature rise and setting time, run pumping trials and rehearse traffic; during the pour record each truck's batch time, slump flow and temperature, rotate placing points on a grid and log layer coverage times; afterwards track peak temperature and differential with embedded sensors until they fall within limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 大體積澆置須有備援拌合廠、備用泵車與交通管制計畫，並預先規劃萬一中斷時的施工縫位置與處理方式；溫控計畫與停止條件須經結構工程師核准。
knowledge.textEn: A mass pour needs backup batching plants, standby pumps and a traffic plan, with pre-planned emergency construction-joint locations and treatment in case of interruption; the thermal control plan and stop criteria require the structural engineer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Single continuous pour of a massive mat"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
澆置前做配比的絕熱溫升與凝結時間試驗、泵送試驗與交通演練。
外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before the pour, test adiabatic temperature rise and setting time, run pumping trials and rehearse traffic.
More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better.
quiz.explanation: 澆置前做配比的絕熱溫升與凝結時間試驗、泵送試驗與交通演練；澆置中記錄每車出廠時間、坍流度與溫度，布料點依網格輪替並記錄層面覆蓋時間；之後以埋設感測器追蹤最高溫度與溫差直到降至允許值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the pour, test adiabatic temperature rise and setting time, run pumping trials and rehearse traffic; during the pour record each truck's batch time, slump flow and temperature, rotate placing points on a grid and log layer coverage times; afterwards track peak temperature and differential with embedded sensors until they fall within limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Single continuous pour of a massive mat: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「6.5 m 筏基連續澆置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Continuous pour of the 6.5 m mat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若供料中斷或布料不均使某區層面暴露超過初凝，就形成冷縫，成為地下水滲漏與剪力傳遞的弱面；溫差控制失敗則會在筏基表面產生貫穿性溫度裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If supply is interrupted or placement is uneven so an area stays exposed past initial set, a cold joint forms that weakens shear transfer and admits groundwater; failed temperature control causes through-thickness thermal cracks at the mat surface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單次澆置需要同時調度大量預拌車、泵車與布料點，使每一層新混凝土在下層初凝前覆蓋，讓整塊筏基成為無冷縫的整體；同時以溫度感測器控制內外溫差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A single pour demands simultaneous dispatch of many ready-mix trucks, pumps and placing points so each new layer covers the previous one before initial set, making the mat a monolith without cold joints, while temperature sensors control the interior-to-surface difference.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若供料中斷或布料不均使某區層面暴露超過初凝，就形成冷縫，成為地下水滲漏與剪力傳遞的弱面；溫差控制失敗則會在筏基表面產生貫穿性溫度裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: If supply is interrupted or placement is uneven so an area stays exposed past initial set, a cold joint forms that weakens shear transfer and admits groundwater; failed temperature control causes through-thickness thermal cracks at the mat surface.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巨厚筏基的一次連續澆置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Single continuous pour of a massive mat" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。
若供料中斷或布料不均使某區層面暴露超過初凝，就形成冷縫，成為地下水滲漏與剪力傳遞的弱面；溫差控制失敗則會在筏基表面產生貫穿性溫度裂縫。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored.
If supply is interrupted or placement is uneven so an area stays exposed past initial set, a cold joint forms that weakens shear transfer and admits groundwater.
quiz.explanation: 若供料中斷或布料不均使某區層面暴露超過初凝，就形成冷縫，成為地下水滲漏與剪力傳遞的弱面；溫差控制失敗則會在筏基表面產生貫穿性溫度裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If supply is interrupted or placement is uneven so an area stays exposed past initial set, a cold joint forms that weakens shear transfer and admits groundwater; failed temperature control causes through-thickness thermal cracks at the mat surface. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 差異沉陷的預拱補償：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Camber compensation for differential settlement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「巨柱垂直預拱」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical camber of mega-columns” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 核心筒與周邊巨柱的荷重與基底剛度不同，筏基在兩者之下的沉陷量也不同。設計者以在施工中對巨柱做垂直預拱（預先抬高）的方式處理核心筒與周邊之間的差異沉陷，使完工後樓板接近水平。預拱量來自地盤—筏基互制分析與施工順序，並在施工中依實測沉陷修正；若不預拱，周邊樓板會相對核心筒下傾，影響樓板排水、帷幕牆接縫與電梯門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「巨柱垂直預拱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because the core and perimeter mega-columns carry different loads and the mat stiffness beneath them differs, the mat settles differently under each. The designers handled differential settlement between the core and perimeter by vertically cambering, or pre-raising, the mega-columns during construction so floors end up close to level. The camber comes from soil–mat interaction analysis and the construction sequence and is updated with measured settlements; without it, perimeter floors would slope down relative to the core, affecting floor drainage, façade joints and elevator sills. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vertical camber of mega-columns” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若預測核心筒與巨柱間差異沉陷 15 mm、水平距離 20 m，角變量 = 15/20,000 = 1/1,333；對巨柱預抬 15 mm 後若殘餘誤差 ±5 mm，角變量降為 5/20,000 = 1/4,000。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the predicted differential settlement between core and mega-column is 15 mm over 20 m, the angular distortion is 15/20,000 = 1/1,333; pre-raising the column by 15 mm with a residual error of ±5 mm reduces it to 5/20,000 = 1/4,000.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「巨柱垂直預拱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vertical camber of mega-columns”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差異沉陷的預拱補償
knowledge.text: 核心筒與周邊巨柱的荷重與基底剛度不同，筏基在兩者之下的沉陷量也不同。設計者以在施工中對巨柱做垂直預拱（預先抬高）的方式處理核心筒與周邊之間的差異沉陷，使完工後樓板接近水平。
knowledge.textEn: Because the core and perimeter mega-columns carry different loads and the mat stiffness beneath them differs, the mat settles differently under each. The designers handled differential settlement between the core and perimeter by vertically cambering, or pre-raising, the mega-columns during construction so floors end up close to level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異沉陷的預拱補償」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Camber compensation for differential settlement" is correct?
options: 核心筒與周邊巨柱的荷重與基底剛度不同，筏基在兩者之下的沉陷量也不同。
筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。
完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。
optionsEn: Because the core and perimeter mega-columns carry different loads and the mat stiffness beneath them differs, the mat settles differently under each.
A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored.
A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model.
quiz.explanation: 核心筒與周邊巨柱的荷重與基底剛度不同，筏基在兩者之下的沉陷量也不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because the core and perimeter mega-columns carry different loads and the mat stiffness beneath them differs, the mat settles differently under each. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 差異沉陷的預拱補償：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Camber compensation for differential settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「巨柱垂直預拱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical camber of mega-columns” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若預測核心筒與巨柱間差異沉陷 15 mm、水平距離 20 m，角變量 = 15/20,000 = 1/1,333；對巨柱預抬 15 mm 後若殘餘誤差 ±5 mm，角變量降為 5/20,000 = 1/4,000。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the predicted differential settlement between core and mega-column is 15 mm over 20 m, the angular distortion is 15/20,000 = 1/1,333; pre-raising the column by 15 mm with a residual error of ±5 mm reduces it to 5/20,000 = 1/4,000. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在筏基頂面與核心筒、巨柱腳設置沉陷觀測點，每增加若干樓層量測一次，與預測曲線比較並修正後續樓層的預拱值；完工後以全樓層標高測量確認樓板平整度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install settlement points on the mat top, core and mega-column bases, survey them after every few storeys, compare with the predicted curve and adjust camber for later floors; after completion confirm floor levelness with a full-height level survey.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若預測核心筒與巨柱間差異沉陷 15 mm、水平距離 20 m，角變量 = 15/20,000 = 1/1,333；對巨柱預抬 15 mm 後若殘餘誤差 ±5 mm，角變量降為 5/20,000 = 1/4,000。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the predicted differential settlement between core and mega-column is 15 mm over 20 m, the angular distortion is 15/20,000 = 1/1,333; pre-raising the column by 15 mm with a residual error of ±5 mm reduces it to 5/20,000 = 1/4,000. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「差異沉陷的預拱補償」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Camber compensation for differential settlement", which statement holds?
options: 外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。
若預測核心筒與巨柱間差異沉陷 15 mm、水平距離 20 m，角變量 = 15/20,000 = 1/1,333。
核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。
optionsEn: Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change.
If the predicted differential settlement between core and mega-column is 15 mm over 20 m, the angular distortion is 15/20,000 = 1/1,333.
The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas.
quiz.explanation: 若預測核心筒與巨柱間差異沉陷 15 mm、水平距離 20 m，角變量 = 15/20,000 = 1/1,333；對巨柱預抬 15 mm 後若殘餘誤差 ±5 mm，角變量降為 5/20,000 = 1/4,000。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the predicted differential settlement between core and mega-column is 15 mm over 20 m, the angular distortion is 15/20,000 = 1/1,333; pre-raising the column by 15 mm with a residual error of ±5 mm reduces it to 5/20,000 = 1/4,000. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Camber compensation for differential settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「巨柱垂直預拱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vertical camber of mega-columns” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在筏基頂面與核心筒、巨柱腳設置沉陷觀測點，每增加若干樓層量測一次，與預測曲線比較並修正後續樓層的預拱值；完工後以全樓層標高測量確認樓板平整度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install settlement points on the mat top, core and mega-column bases, survey them after every few storeys, compare with the predicted curve and adjust camber for later floors; after completion confirm floor levelness with a full-height level survey. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預拱值應以表格逐層列出並標註版本，每次依監測更新時由結構工程師發布新版，測量團隊只依最新版放樣，避免多版本並存造成錯誤。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List camber values floor by floor in a versioned table; each monitoring-based update is issued by the structural engineer as a new revision, and surveyors set out only from the latest revision to avoid errors from coexisting versions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預拱量若沿用設計預測而不依實測修正，實際沉陷較小時樓板會反向傾斜；預拱分配錯誤也可能讓帶狀桁架或外伸臂在鎖定時就承受非預期的初始力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying design-stage camber without updating for measured settlement leaves floors sloping the other way if real settlement is smaller; misallocated camber can also load belt trusses or outriggers with unintended initial forces at the time of locking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在筏基頂面與核心筒、巨柱腳設置沉陷觀測點，每增加若干樓層量測一次，與預測曲線比較並修正後續樓層的預拱值；完工後以全樓層標高測量確認樓板平整度。
knowledge.textEn: Install settlement points on the mat top, core and mega-column bases, survey them after every few storeys, compare with the predicted curve and adjust camber for later floors; after completion confirm floor levelness with a full-height level survey.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預拱值應以表格逐層列出並標註版本，每次依監測更新時由結構工程師發布新版，測量團隊只依最新版放樣，避免多版本並存造成錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: List camber values floor by floor in a versioned table; each monitoring-based update is issued by the structural engineer as a new revision, and surveyors set out only from the latest revision to avoid errors from coexisting versions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差異沉陷的預拱補償」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Camber compensation for differential settlement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
巨柱斷面巨大，所以不會有細長或挫屈問題。
在筏基頂面與核心筒、巨柱腳設置沉陷觀測點，每增加若干樓層量測一次，與預測曲線比較並修正後續樓層的預拱值；完工後以全樓層標高測量確認樓板平整度。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues.
Install settlement points on the mat top, core and mega-column bases, survey them after every few storeys, compare with the predicted curve and adjust camber for later floors.
quiz.explanation: 在筏基頂面與核心筒、巨柱腳設置沉陷觀測點，每增加若干樓層量測一次，與預測曲線比較並修正後續樓層的預拱值；完工後以全樓層標高測量確認樓板平整度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install settlement points on the mat top, core and mega-column bases, survey them after every few storeys, compare with the predicted curve and adjust camber for later floors; after completion confirm floor levelness with a full-height level survey. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異沉陷的預拱補償：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Camber compensation for differential settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「巨柱垂直預拱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vertical camber of mega-columns” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預拱量若沿用設計預測而不依實測修正，實際沉陷較小時樓板會反向傾斜；預拱分配錯誤也可能讓帶狀桁架或外伸臂在鎖定時就承受非預期的初始力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying design-stage camber without updating for measured settlement leaves floors sloping the other way if real settlement is smaller; misallocated camber can also load belt trusses or outriggers with unintended initial forces at the time of locking. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預拱量來自地盤—筏基互制分析與施工順序，並在施工中依實測沉陷修正；若不預拱，周邊樓板會相對核心筒下傾，影響樓板排水、帷幕牆接縫與電梯門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The camber comes from soil–mat interaction analysis and the construction sequence and is updated with measured settlements; without it, perimeter floors would slope down relative to the core, affecting floor drainage, façade joints and elevator sills.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「筏基夠厚就會整體均勻沉陷，不需要考慮差異沉陷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thick enough mat settles uniformly, so differential settlement can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預拱量若沿用設計預測而不依實測修正，實際沉陷較小時樓板會反向傾斜；預拱分配錯誤也可能讓帶狀桁架或外伸臂在鎖定時就承受非預期的初始力。
knowledge.textEn: Applying design-stage camber without updating for measured settlement leaves floors sloping the other way if real settlement is smaller; misallocated camber can also load belt trusses or outriggers with unintended initial forces at the time of locking.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差異沉陷的預拱補償」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Camber compensation for differential settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 預拱量若沿用設計預測而不依實測修正，實際沉陷較小時樓板會反向傾斜；預拱分配錯誤也可能讓帶狀桁架或外伸臂在鎖定時就承受非預期的初始力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。
optionsEn: Applying design-stage camber without updating for measured settlement leaves floors sloping the other way if real settlement is smaller.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model.
quiz.explanation: 預拱量若沿用設計預測而不依實測修正，實際沉陷較小時樓板會反向傾斜；預拱分配錯誤也可能讓帶狀桁架或外伸臂在鎖定時就承受非預期的初始力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying design-stage camber without updating for measured settlement leaves floors sloping the other way if real settlement is smaller; misallocated camber can also load belt trusses or outriggers with unintended initial forces at the time of locking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」與「地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction" and "Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工中頻率量測與模型校準：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「施工期自然頻率量測」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Natural frequency during construction” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計單位公開說明，結構健康監測系統在施工期間與完工後量測自然頻率，並與分析模型比較。施工中結構的質量與勁度隨樓層、帷幕牆與裝修不斷改變，因此每個階段的實測頻率都是校正模型的機會：若頻率比預測高，表示實際勁度較高或質量較低；若偏低，則可能是混凝土模數、開裂或非結構質量與假設不同。提早校準可以修正完工後的加速度預測與阻尼需求判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「施工期自然頻率量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The design team has stated that the structural health monitoring system measured natural frequencies during and after construction for comparison with analysis. Mass and stiffness change continually as floors, façade and fit-out are added, so each stage's measured frequency is a chance to calibrate the model: a higher frequency than predicted suggests higher stiffness or less mass, a lower one points to different concrete modulus, cracking or non-structural mass than assumed. Early calibration improves the prediction of in-service acceleration and of any damping need. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Natural frequency during construction” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：f = (1/2π)√(k/m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f = (1/2π)√(k/m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「施工期自然頻率量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Natural frequency during construction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工中頻率量測與模型校準
knowledge.titleEn: Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction
knowledge.text: 設計單位公開說明，結構健康監測系統在施工期間與完工後量測自然頻率，並與分析模型比較。施工中結構的質量與勁度隨樓層、帷幕牆與裝修不斷改變，因此每個階段的實測頻率都是校正模型的機會：若頻率比預測高，表示實際勁度較高或質量較低；若偏低，則可能是混凝土模數、開裂或非結構質量與假設不同。
knowledge.textEn: The design team has stated that the structural health monitoring system measured natural frequencies during and after construction for comparison with analysis. Mass and stiffness change continually as floors, façade and fit-out are added, so each stage's measured frequency is a chance to calibrate the model: a higher frequency than predicted suggests higher stiffness or less mass, a lower one points to different concrete modulus, cracking or non-structural mass than assumed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction" is correct?
options: 完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。
設計單位公開說明，結構健康監測系統在施工期間與完工後量測自然頻率，並與分析模型比較。
樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。
optionsEn: A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model.
The design team has stated that the structural health monitoring system measured natural frequencies during and after construction for comparison with analysis.
Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat.
quiz.explanation: 設計單位公開說明，結構健康監測系統在施工期間與完工後量測自然頻率，並與分析模型比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The design team has stated that the structural health monitoring system measured natural frequencies during and after construction for comparison with analysis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工中頻率量測與模型校準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工期自然頻率量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Natural frequency during construction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f = (1/2π)√(k/m)。勁度不變、質量因帷幕牆與裝修增加 25% 時，f₂/f₁ = 1/√1.25 ≈ 0.894；若結構體完成時實測 f₁ = 0.125 Hz，完工後預期約 0.112 Hz。若完工實測為 0.118 Hz，代表質量增量或勁度假設需要修正。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f = (1/2π)√(k/m). With unchanged stiffness and a 25% mass increase from façade and fit-out, f₂/f₁ = 1/√1.25 ≈ 0.894; a measured f₁ = 0.125 Hz at frame completion predicts about 0.112 Hz at handover. A measured 0.118 Hz would mean the mass increment or stiffness assumption needs correcting. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：於核心筒頂與數個中間樓層設置雙向加速度計，在低風時段做環境振動量測，以頻域分解辨識前三個模態；每次量測都記錄當時的樓層數、帷幕牆與裝修完成度，與同一施工狀態的模型比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place biaxial accelerometers at the top of the core and several intermediate levels, take ambient measurements in calm periods and identify the first three modes by frequency-domain decomposition; record the number of floors and the extent of façade and fit-out at each measurement and compare with a model of the same construction state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: f = (1/2π)√(k/m)。勁度不變、質量因帷幕牆與裝修增加 25% 時，f₂/f₁ = 1/√1.25 ≈ 0.894；若結構體完成時實測 f₁ = 0.125 Hz，完工後預期約 0.112 Hz。若完工實測為 0.118 Hz，代表質量增量或勁度假設需要修正。數值為教學假設。

With unchanged stiffness and a 25% mass increase from façade and fit-out, f₂/f₁ = 1/√1.25 ≈ 0.894; a measured f₁ = 0.125 Hz at frame completion predicts about 0.112 Hz at handover. A measured 0.118 Hz would mean the mass increment or stiffness assumption needs correcting. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction", which statement holds?
options: 感測器越多，結構安全就越有保障，不需要人工判讀與維護。
外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。
optionsEn: More sensors automatically mean a safer structure without human interpretation or maintenance.
More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better.
quiz.explanation: f = (1/2π)√(k/m)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: f = (1/2π)√(k/m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction: testing and verification

steps.title: 施工中頻率量測與模型校準：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工期自然頻率量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Natural frequency during construction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只在完工後量一次頻率，與模型差異的原因無法分辨是勁度還是質量；以錯誤的模型推估加速度，可能低估居住性問題或高估需要的阻尼措施。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring frequency only once after completion leaves it impossible to tell whether a mismatch comes from stiffness or mass; predicting acceleration from a wrong model can underestimate habitability problems or overestimate the damping needed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：提早校準可以修正完工後的加速度預測與阻尼需求判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Early calibration improves the prediction of in-service acceleration and of any damping need.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完工後量一次頻率，就足以校準整個結構模型。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single frequency measurement after completion is enough to calibrate the whole structural model." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

quiz.explanationEn: Measuring frequency only once after completion leaves it impossible to tell whether a mismatch comes from stiffness or mass; predicting acceleration from a wrong model can underestimate habitability problems or overestimate the damping needed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斷層帶補強樁與筏基沉陷」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone reinforcing piles and mat settlement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 筏基主要坐落在岩盤上，設計容許承壓約 3,000 kPa；在斷層與剪裂帶，以衝擊旋轉鑽掘（PRD）施作直徑約 1.0 m 的補強樁改良地盤，官方資料稱共 108 根、長約 30 m。依當地法規，這些樁不與筏基相連，樁頂與筏基間以砂墊層隔開，所以它們提高的是地盤勁度，而不是當作傳統樁基礎直接承載柱力。設計以靜態與動態地盤彈簧模擬筏基，使不同區域的勁度差異反映在沉陷與筏基內力中。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷層帶補強樁與筏基沉陷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The mat bears mainly on rock with an allowable bearing pressure of about 3,000 kPa; in fault and shear zones the ground was reinforced with piles about 1.0 m in diameter installed by percussion rotary drilling, reported officially as 108 piles about 30 m long. Under local regulations the piles are not connected to the mat and a sand cushion separates their tops from it, so they stiffen the ground rather than carry column loads directly as a conventional pile foundation. The mat was modelled on static and dynamic soil springs so stiffness differences between zones appear in settlement and mat forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fault-zone reinforcing piles and mat settlement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以地盤反力係數估算沉陷 s = q/k_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate settlement with a subgrade modulus, s = q/k_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斷層帶補強樁與筏基沉陷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fault-zone reinforcing piles and mat settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證
knowledge.text: 筏基主要坐落在岩盤上，設計容許承壓約 3,000 kPa；在斷層與剪裂帶，以衝擊旋轉鑽掘（PRD）施作直徑約 1.0 m 的補強樁改良地盤，官方資料稱共 108 根、長約 30 m。依當地法規，這些樁不與筏基相連，樁頂與筏基間以砂墊層隔開，所以它們提高的是地盤勁度，而不是當作傳統樁基礎直接承載柱力。
knowledge.textEn: The mat bears mainly on rock with an allowable bearing pressure of about 3,000 kPa; in fault and shear zones the ground was reinforced with piles about 1.0 m in diameter installed by percussion rotary drilling, reported officially as 108 piles about 30 m long. Under local regulations the piles are not connected to the mat and a sand cushion separates their tops from it, so they stiffen the ground rather than carry column loads directly as a conventional pile foundation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification" is correct?
options: 樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。
外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。
筏基主要坐落在岩盤上，設計容許承壓約 3,000 kPa。
optionsEn: Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat.
Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change.
The mat bears mainly on rock with an allowable bearing pressure of about 3,000 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 筏基主要坐落在岩盤上，設計容許承壓約 3,000 kPa；在斷層與剪裂帶，以衝擊旋轉鑽掘（PRD）施作直徑約 1.0 m 的補強樁改良地盤，官方資料稱共 108 根、長約 30 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The mat bears mainly on rock with an allowable bearing pressure of about 3,000 kPa; in fault and shear zones the ground was reinforced with piles about 1.0 m in diameter installed by percussion rotary drilling, reported officially as 108 piles about 30 m long. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷層帶補強樁與筏基沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone reinforcing piles and mat settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以地盤反力係數估算沉陷 s = q/k_s。接觸壓力 q = 1,400 kPa：岩盤區 k_s = 150 MN/m³ 時 s ≈ 9.3 mm；未補強的斷層帶 k_s = 50 MN/m³ 時 s = 28 mm，兩區相差約 19 mm。補強樁若把斷層帶 k_s 提高到 120 MN/m³，s ≈ 11.7 mm，差異降到約 2.3 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate settlement with a subgrade modulus, s = q/k_s. For a contact pressure q = 1,400 kPa, rock zones with k_s = 150 MN/m³ settle about 9.3 mm, while an unimproved fault zone with k_s = 50 MN/m³ settles 28 mm, about 19 mm more. If reinforcing piles raise the fault-zone k_s to 120 MN/m³, s ≈ 11.7 mm and the difference falls to about 2.3 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：補強樁施工後以鑽心或非破壞試驗確認樁身完整性，並以平鈑載重或孔內試驗量測改良後地盤勁度；筏基施工後在斷層帶與岩盤區分別設置沉陷點，比較實測差異沉陷與分析值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After installing the reinforcing piles, confirm shaft integrity by coring or non-destructive testing and measure improved ground stiffness with plate-load or borehole tests; after the mat is cast, set settlement points over fault and rock zones and compare measured differential settlement with the analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以地盤反力係數估算沉陷 s = q/k_s。接觸壓力 q = 1,400 kPa：岩盤區 k_s = 150 MN/m³ 時 s ≈ 9.3 mm；未補強的斷層帶 k_s = 50 MN/m³ 時 s = 28 mm，兩區相差約 19 mm。補強樁若把斷層帶 k_s 提高到 120 MN/m³，s ≈ 11.7 mm，差異降到約 2.3 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate settlement with a subgrade modulus, s = q/k_s. For a contact pressure q = 1,400 kPa, rock zones with k_s = 150 MN/m³ settle about 9.3 mm, while an unimproved fault zone with k_s = 50 MN/m³ settles 28 mm, about 19 mm more. If reinforcing piles raise the fault-zone k_s to 120 MN/m³, s ≈ 11.7 mm and the difference falls to about 2.3 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 以地盤反力係數估算沉陷 s = q/k_s。

optionsEn: Estimate settlement with a subgrade modulus, s = q/k_s.
The gravity split between core and mega-columns is set purely by tributary floor areas.
A huge mega-column is too big to have slenderness or buckling issues.
quiz.explanation: 以地盤反力係數估算沉陷 s = q/k_s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate settlement with a subgrade modulus, s = q/k_s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷層帶補強樁與筏基沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone reinforcing piles and mat settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 補強樁施工後以鑽心或非破壞試驗確認樁身完整性，並以平鈑載重或孔內試驗量測改良後地盤勁度；筏基施工後在斷層帶與岩盤區分別設置沉陷點，比較實測差異沉陷與分析值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After installing the reinforcing piles, confirm shaft integrity by coring or non-destructive testing and measure improved ground stiffness with plate-load or borehole tests; after the mat is cast, set settlement points over fault and rock zones and compare measured differential settlement with the analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：補強樁與砂墊層的施工須列入檢驗停留點，包含樁頂高程、墊層厚度與壓實度；地質調查報告與實際開挖揭露的斷層位置要互相比對並由大地工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make reinforcing piles and the sand cushion hold points covering pile-top level, cushion thickness and compaction, and have the geotechnical engineer reconcile and sign off the fault locations in the investigation report against those revealed by excavation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若斷層帶範圍調查不足，筏基某一角落的沉陷可能明顯大於預測，造成筏基彎矩重分配與上部結構差異變位；樁頂若未依設計與筏基隔開，樁會吸收集中荷載而在筏基內形成未預期的衝剪。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the fault zone is poorly mapped, one corner of the mat can settle much more than predicted, redistributing mat moments and adding differential movement to the superstructure; if pile tops are not separated from the mat as designed, the piles attract concentrated loads and create unexpected punching shear in the mat. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 補強樁施工後以鑽心或非破壞試驗確認樁身完整性，並以平鈑載重或孔內試驗量測改良後地盤勁度；筏基施工後在斷層帶與岩盤區分別設置沉陷點，比較實測差異沉陷與分析值。
knowledge.textEn: After installing the reinforcing piles, confirm shaft integrity by coring or non-destructive testing and measure improved ground stiffness with plate-load or borehole tests; after the mat is cast, set settlement points over fault and rock zones and compare measured differential settlement with the analysis.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 補強樁與砂墊層的施工須列入檢驗停留點，包含樁頂高程、墊層厚度與壓實度；地質調查報告與實際開挖揭露的斷層位置要互相比對並由大地工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Make reinforcing piles and the sand cushion hold points covering pile-top level, cushion thickness and compaction, and have the geotechnical engineer reconcile and sign off the fault locations in the investigation report against those revealed by excavation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
補強樁施工後以鑽心或非破壞試驗確認樁身完整性，並以平鈑載重或孔內試驗量測改良後地盤勁度；筏基施工後在斷層帶與岩盤區分別設置沉陷點，比較實測差異沉陷與分析值。
巨厚筏基只要混凝土強度夠，分多次澆置與一次澆置沒有差別。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
After installing the reinforcing piles, confirm shaft integrity by coring or non-destructive testing and measure improved ground stiffness with plate-load or borehole tests.
If the concrete is strong enough, pouring a massive mat in one go or in stages makes no difference.
quiz.explanation: 補強樁施工後以鑽心或非破壞試驗確認樁身完整性，並以平鈑載重或孔內試驗量測改良後地盤勁度；筏基施工後在斷層帶與岩盤區分別設置沉陷點，比較實測差異沉陷與分析值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After installing the reinforcing piles, confirm shaft integrity by coring or non-destructive testing and measure improved ground stiffness with plate-load or borehole tests; after the mat is cast, set settlement points over fault and rock zones and compare measured differential settlement with the analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷層帶補強樁與筏基沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone reinforcing piles and mat settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若斷層帶範圍調查不足，筏基某一角落的沉陷可能明顯大於預測，造成筏基彎矩重分配與上部結構差異變位；樁頂若未依設計與筏基隔開，樁會吸收集中荷載而在筏基內形成未預期的衝剪。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the fault zone is poorly mapped, one corner of the mat can settle much more than predicted, redistributing mat moments and adding differential movement to the superstructure; if pile tops are not separated from the mat as designed, the piles attract concentrated loads and create unexpected punching shear in the mat. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計以靜態與動態地盤彈簧模擬筏基，使不同區域的勁度差異反映在沉陷與筏基內力中。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The mat was modelled on static and dynamic soil springs so stiffness differences between zones appear in settlement and mat forces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樁一定要與筏基連結才能發揮作用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Piles only work if they are structurally connected to the mat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若斷層帶範圍調查不足，筏基某一角落的沉陷可能明顯大於預測，造成筏基彎矩重分配與上部結構差異變位；樁頂若未依設計與筏基隔開，樁會吸收集中荷載而在筏基內形成未預期的衝剪。
knowledge.textEn: If the fault zone is poorly mapped, one corner of the mat can settle much more than predicted, redistributing mat moments and adding differential movement to the superstructure; if pile tops are not separated from the mat as designed, the piles attract concentrated loads and create unexpected punching shear in the mat.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地盤補強樁與沉陷驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ground-reinforcing piles and settlement verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。
若斷層帶範圍調查不足，筏基某一角落的沉陷可能明顯大於預測，造成筏基彎矩重分配與上部結構差異變位。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change.
If the fault zone is poorly mapped, one corner of the mat can settle much more than predicted, redistributing mat moments and adding differential movement to the superstructure.
quiz.explanation: 若斷層帶範圍調查不足，筏基某一角落的沉陷可能明顯大於預測，造成筏基彎矩重分配與上部結構差異變位；樁頂若未依設計與筏基隔開，樁會吸收集中荷載而在筏基內形成未預期的衝剪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the fault zone is poorly mapped, one corner of the mat can settle much more than predicted, redistributing mat moments and adding differential movement to the superstructure; if pile tops are not separated from the mat as designed, the piles attract concentrated loads and create unexpected punching shear in the mat. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量」與「結構健康監測與營運交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces" and "Structural health monitoring and operational handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外伸臂長期力量轉移」如何影響樂天世界塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term outrigger force transfer” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂鎖定後，核心筒與巨柱之間仍持續發生潛變與收縮造成的差異縮短，這部分位移會被外伸臂桁架抵抗，轉成斜桿與接頭中的長期軸力，並把荷重在核心與巨柱間重新分配。設計者因此建議延後外伸臂最終接合，並針對長期力量轉移設計構件。鎖定越晚，鎖定後剩下的差異縮短越少，外伸臂承受的附加力也越小，但施工期間就得依靠其他系統提供側向勁度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外伸臂長期力量轉移」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After outriggers are locked, creep and shrinkage keep producing differential shortening between core and mega-columns; the outrigger trusses resist that movement, turning it into long-term axial forces in diagonals and joints and redistributing load between core and columns. The designers therefore recommended delaying the final outrigger connections and designing members for long-term force transfer. The later the locking, the less differential shortening remains and the smaller the added force, but lateral stiffness during construction must then come from other systems. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-term outrigger force transfer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：附加力 F = k·δ_post。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The added force is F = k·δ_post.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外伸臂長期力量轉移」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-term outrigger force transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量
knowledge.titleEn: Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces
knowledge.text: 外伸臂鎖定後，核心筒與巨柱之間仍持續發生潛變與收縮造成的差異縮短，這部分位移會被外伸臂桁架抵抗，轉成斜桿與接頭中的長期軸力，並把荷重在核心與巨柱間重新分配。設計者因此建議延後外伸臂最終接合，並針對長期力量轉移設計構件。
knowledge.textEn: After outriggers are locked, creep and shrinkage keep producing differential shortening between core and mega-columns; the outrigger trusses resist that movement, turning it into long-term axial forces in diagonals and joints and redistributing load between core and columns. The designers therefore recommended delaying the final outrigger connections and designing members for long-term force transfer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces" is correct?
options: 外伸臂鎖定後，核心筒與巨柱之間仍持續發生潛變與收縮造成的差異縮短，這部分位移會被外伸臂桁架抵抗，轉成斜桿與接頭中的長期軸力，並把荷重在核心與巨柱間重新分配。
外伸臂鎖定後，其中的力量就固定不再變化。
感測器越多，結構安全就越有保障，不需要人工判讀與維護。
optionsEn: After outriggers are locked, creep and shrinkage keep producing differential shortening between core and mega-columns.
Once outriggers are locked, the forces in them no longer change.
More sensors automatically mean a safer structure without human interpretation or maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂鎖定後，核心筒與巨柱之間仍持續發生潛變與收縮造成的差異縮短，這部分位移會被外伸臂桁架抵抗，轉成斜桿與接頭中的長期軸力，並把荷重在核心與巨柱間重新分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After outriggers are locked, creep and shrinkage keep producing differential shortening between core and mega-columns; the outrigger trusses resist that movement, turning it into long-term axial forces in diagonals and joints and redistributing load between core and columns. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外伸臂長期力量轉移」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term outrigger force transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：附加力 F = k·δ_post。外伸臂等效垂直勁度 k = 800 kN/mm：若鎖定後剩餘差異縮短 δ_post = 12 mm，F = 9,600 kN；若提早在結構只完成一半時鎖定，δ_post = 30 mm，F = 24,000 kN，增加 2.5 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The added force is F = k·δ_post. With an equivalent vertical outrigger stiffness k = 800 kN/mm, a residual differential shortening after locking of δ_post = 12 mm gives F = 9,600 kN; locking early with only half the structure complete leaves δ_post = 30 mm and F = 24,000 kN, 2.5 times more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段與時間相依分析預測不同鎖定時點的外伸臂力，選擇鎖定時點後在斜桿上設置應變計長期記錄，比對實測軸力增長與預測曲線，偏離過大時檢討潛變參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use construction-stage, time-dependent analysis to predict outrigger forces for different locking times; after choosing one, install strain gauges on the diagonals for long-term recording, compare measured force growth with the prediction and revisit creep parameters if they diverge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 附加力 F = k·δ_post。外伸臂等效垂直勁度 k = 800 kN/mm：若鎖定後剩餘差異縮短 δ_post = 12 mm，F = 9,600 kN；若提早在結構只完成一半時鎖定，δ_post = 30 mm，F = 24,000 kN，增加 2.5 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The added force is F = k·δ_post. With an equivalent vertical outrigger stiffness k = 800 kN/mm, a residual differential shortening after locking of δ_post = 12 mm gives F = 9,600 kN; locking early with only half the structure complete leaves δ_post = 30 mm and F = 24,000 kN, 2.5 times more. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces", which statement holds?
options: 外伸臂越多、越剛，結構表現就一定越好。
附加力 F = k·δ_post。
延遲接合只是施工方便，對結構受力沒有影響。
optionsEn: More and stiffer outriggers always make the structure perform better.
The added force is F = k·δ_post.
Delayed connection is only a construction convenience with no structural effect.
quiz.explanation: 附加力 F = k·δ_post。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The added force is F = k·δ_post. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潛變收縮與外伸臂的長期力量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Creep, shrinkage and long-term outrigger forces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外伸臂長期力量轉移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term outrigger force transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段與時間相依分析預測不同鎖定時點的外伸臂力，選擇鎖定時點後在斜桿上設置應變計長期記錄，比對實測軸力增長與預測曲線，偏離過大時檢討潛變參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use construction-stage, time-dependent analysis to predict outrigger forces for different locking times; after choosing one, install strain gauges on the diagonals for long-term recording, compare measured force growth with the prediction and revisit creep parameters if they diverge. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應記錄外伸臂鎖定日期、當時的樓層與荷重狀態、預測長期力量曲線與監測基準，並規定定期比對；接頭應設計成可檢查，必要時可調整或補強。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should record the outrigger locking date, the floors and load state at that time, the predicted long-term force curve and monitoring baseline, with periodic comparison required; joints should be inspectable and adjustable or strengthenable if needed.

steps.instruction: 若沒有考慮長期力量轉移，外伸臂接頭可能在完工數年後因持續累積的軸力而出現螺栓滑移或焊道裂縫；核心筒牆體在外伸臂連接處也可能出現局部開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Health monitoring with 600 sensors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lotte World Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 官方資料指出塔內設有超過 600 個感測器的結構健康監測系統，即時監看颱風、地震與其他風險；設計論文提到量測項目包括風荷載、應力、位移、加速度、傾斜與現場反應，並以有限元素模擬輔助判讀。監測的價值在於建立基準：交接時的頻率、傾斜、應力與沉陷基準，讓事件後能以數據判斷結構是否仍在預期行為範圍內，並作為營運單位決定是否需要檢查或限制使用的依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「600 個感測器的健康監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Official sources say the tower has a structural health monitoring system of more than 600 sensors watching typhoon, earthquake and other risks in real time; the design paper lists wind loads, stresses, displacements, accelerations, tilt and field response, interpreted with finite-element simulation. Monitoring is valuable because it sets baselines: handover values of frequency, tilt, stress and settlement let engineers judge after an event whether the structure is still behaving as expected, and give the operator a basis for deciding whether to inspect or restrict use. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Health monitoring with 600 sensors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：基礎傾斜換算頂部變位 Δ = θ·H。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Foundation tilt converts to top displacement as Δ = θ·H.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器越多，結構安全就越有保障，不需要人工判讀與維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More sensors automatically mean a safer structure without human interpretation or maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
