steps.title: 結構健康監測與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural health monitoring and operational handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「600 個感測器的健康監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Health monitoring with 600 sensors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：基礎傾斜換算頂部變位 Δ = θ·H。若筏基傾斜計讀到 θ = 1×10⁻⁴ rad，對 H = 554.5 m 的塔，剛體轉動造成的頂部位移 Δ = 1×10⁻⁴×554,500 ≈ 55 mm。因此傾斜計的漂移或溫度效應若達 0.5×10⁻⁴ rad，就足以在頂部造成約 28 mm 的誤判。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Foundation tilt converts to top displacement as Δ = θ·H. A mat tiltmeter reading θ = 1×10⁻⁴ rad on an H = 554.5 m tower implies a rigid-body top displacement of Δ = 1×10⁻⁴×554,500 ≈ 55 mm. A tiltmeter drift or temperature effect of 0.5×10⁻⁴ rad would therefore misreport about 28 mm at the top. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前完成感測器校正、溫度補償與資料品質檢查，並在低風時段建立頻率、傾斜與應變基準；訂定預警與行動門檻（例如頂部加速度、層間變位角與傾斜增量），每次事件後產出報告並與基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover finish sensor calibration, temperature compensation and data-quality checks, and set baselines for frequency, tilt and strain during calm periods; define alert and action thresholds such as top acceleration, inter-storey drift ratio and tilt increments, and produce an event report compared with the baseline after every event.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 基礎傾斜換算頂部變位 Δ = θ·H。若筏基傾斜計讀到 θ = 1×10⁻⁴ rad，對 H = 554.5 m 的塔，剛體轉動造成的頂部位移 Δ = 1×10⁻⁴×554,500 ≈ 55 mm。因此傾斜計的漂移或溫度效應若達 0.5×10⁻⁴ rad，就足以在頂部造成約 28 mm 的誤判。數值為教學假設。

A mat tiltmeter reading θ = 1×10⁻⁴ rad on an H = 554.5 m tower implies a rigid-body top displacement of Δ = 1×10⁻⁴×554,500 ≈ 55 mm. A tiltmeter drift or temperature effect of 0.5×10⁻⁴ rad would therefore misreport about 28 mm at the top. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.instruction: 交接前完成感測器校正、溫度補償與資料品質檢查，並在低風時段建立頻率、傾斜與應變基準；訂定預警與行動門檻（例如頂部加速度、層間變位角與傾斜增量），每次事件後產出報告並與基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover finish sensor calibration, temperature compensation and data-quality checks, and set baselines for frequency, tilt and strain during calm periods; define alert and action thresholds such as top acceleration, inter-storey drift ratio and tilt increments, and produce an event report compared with the baseline after every event. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents must include the sensor layout, calibration records, baselines, thresholds and reporting procedure, naming the structural engineer responsible for interpretation and the sensor-replacement cycle; the operator reviews the monitoring report every year.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器長期無人維護時，漂移、斷線與時間不同步會讓資料失去判讀價值；若門檻未事先定義，事件後各方對資料的解讀可能不一致，延誤是否疏散或檢查的決策。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前完成感測器校正、溫度補償與資料品質檢查，並在低風時段建立頻率、傾斜與應變基準；訂定預警與行動門檻（例如頂部加速度、層間變位角與傾斜增量），每次事件後產出報告並與基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover finish sensor calibration, temperature compensation and data-quality checks, and set baselines for frequency, tilt and strain during calm periods; define alert and action thresholds such as top acceleration, inter-storey drift ratio and tilt increments, and produce an event report compared with the baseline after every event.

steps.title: 結構健康監測與營運交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural health monitoring and operational handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「600 個感測器的健康監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Health monitoring with 600 sensors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器長期無人維護時，漂移、斷線與時間不同步會讓資料失去判讀價值；若門檻未事先定義，事件後各方對資料的解讀可能不一致，延誤是否疏散或檢查的決策。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unmaintained sensors drift, lose connection and fall out of time sync until the data cannot be interpreted; without predefined thresholds, parties may read post-event data differently and delay decisions on evacuation or inspection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測的價值在於建立基準：交接時的頻率、傾斜、應力與沉陷基準，讓事件後能以數據判斷結構是否仍在預期行為範圍內，並作為營運單位決定是否需要檢查或限制使用的依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitoring is valuable because it sets baselines: handover values of frequency, tilt, stress and settlement let engineers judge after an event whether the structure is still behaving as expected, and give the operator a basis for deciding whether to inspect or restrict use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器越多，結構安全就越有保障，不需要人工判讀與維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More sensors automatically mean a safer structure without human interpretation or maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「結構健康監測與營運交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Structural health monitoring and operational handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

感測器長期無人維護時，漂移、斷線與時間不同步會讓資料失去判讀價值；若門檻未事先定義，事件後各方對資料的解讀可能不一致，延誤是否疏散或檢查的決策。
核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔完全由樓板受載面積決定。

Unmaintained sensors drift, lose connection and fall out of time sync until the data cannot be interpreted.

title: 威利斯大樓
summary: 威利斯大樓（原希爾斯大樓）由 Fazlur Khan 與 SOM 設計，九個 75 ft（22.9 m）見方的鋼框管組成 225 ft 見方的束筒，管筒在 50、66、90 層分批終止，只留兩管到頂。本課從束筒如何以內部框架減少剪力遲滯、分段收進如何降低質心與造成扭轉，到 15 ft 柱距框管、75 ft 複合樓板桁架、每週兩層的鋼構安裝與岩盤沉箱，再到週期量測、外牆熱隔離，以及 2017–2020 年在營運中改造底座時的柱補強與傳力路徑管理。
summaryEn: Willis Tower, formerly Sears Tower, designed by Fazlur Khan and SOM, bundles nine 75 ft (22.9 m) square steel framed tubes into a 225 ft square plan; the tubes stop in groups at floors 50, 66 and 90, leaving two to the top. The course covers how interior frames reduce shear lag, how staged terminations lower the mass centroid and create torsion, the 15 ft column module, 75 ft composite floor trusses, erection at two floors a week and rock caissons, then period measurement, thermal isolation by the skin, and column strengthening and load-path control during the 2017–2020 base repositioning of the occupied tower.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：以平截面假設估算束筒翼板柱在風傾覆力矩下的軸力。取均布風荷載 w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m、高度 H = 442 m，基座力矩 M = wH²/2 = 96.0×442²/2 ≈ 9.38×10⁶ kN·m。抵抗彎矩的翼板線位於 y = ±34.29 m（外牆）與 y = ±11.43 m（內部框架），每線 16 根同斷面柱，Σy² = 16×(2×34.29² + 2×11.43²) ≈ 41,806 m²。角柱軸力 F = M·y/Σy² = 9.38×10⁶×34.29/41,806 ≈ 7,690 kN，內部框架柱約 2,560 kN。若沒有內部框架（單一大管），Σy² = 16×2×34.29² ≈ 37,626 m²，角柱軸力升到約 8,550 kN，增加約 11%；而且單管的剪力遲滯會讓角柱實際軸力再高出更多。若風荷載提高 20%，所有軸力同比例增加。數值為教學假設，忽略腹板柱、剪力遲滯與收進，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate flange-column axial forces in the bundled tube under wind overturning using plane sections. Take a uniform wind load w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m and height H = 442 m, so the base moment M = wH²/2 = 96.0×442²/2 ≈ 9.38×10⁶ kN·m. The flange lines resisting the moment lie at y = ±34.29 m (exterior walls) and y = ±11.43 m (interior frames), each with 16 identical columns, so Σy² = 16×(2×34.29² + 2×11.43²) ≈ 41,806 m². The corner-column force is F = M·y/Σy² = 9.38×10⁶×34.29/41,806 ≈ 7,690 kN, and an interior-frame column carries about 2,560 kN. Without interior frames (one large tube), Σy² = 16×2×34.29² ≈ 37,626 m² and the corner force rises to about 8,550 kN, about 11% more, and shear lag in a single tube would push the real corner force higher still. A 20% increase in wind load raises every axial force by the same proportion. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring web columns, shear lag and setbacks, not the actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束筒與剪力遲滯」與「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bundled tubes and shear lag" and "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「九管束筒與內部腹板」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。單一大管的翼板中段柱因裙梁剪力變形而「跟不上」角柱，軸力向角落集中，這就是剪力遲滯。束筒在 225 ft 見方的平面中多加兩道縱橫向內部框架，把翼板分成三段、腹板由兩道增為四道，使軸力分布更均勻，剪力勁度也加倍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「九管束筒與內部腹板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression. In a single large tube the flange columns near mid-face lag behind the corners because the spandrels deform in shear, concentrating axial force at the corners; this is shear lag. The bundled tube adds two interior frames in each direction within the 225 ft square, splitting each flange into three segments and doubling the web frames from two to four, which evens out axial forces and doubles shear stiffness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「九管束筒與內部腹板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯
knowledge.text: 框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。單一大管的翼板中段柱因裙梁剪力變形而「跟不上」角柱，軸力向角落集中，這就是剪力遲滯。
knowledge.textEn: A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression. In a single large tube the flange columns near mid-face lag behind the corners because the spandrels deform in shear, concentrating axial force at the corners; this is shear lag.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「束筒與剪力遲滯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bundled tubes and shear lag" is correct?
options: 框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。
框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。
收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
optionsEn: All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally.

A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression.
Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 框管結構把密排的周邊柱與深裙梁組成一個空心箱形懸臂，平行風向的兩面像箱梁腹板承受剪力，垂直風向的兩面像翼板承受拉壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A framed tube turns closely spaced perimeter columns and deep spandrels into a hollow box cantilever: the two faces parallel to the wind act like the webs of a box girder and carry shear, while the two faces normal to it act like flanges in tension and compression. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「九管束筒與內部腹板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。取 w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m、H = 442 m、K = 1.0×10⁷ kN：n = 2 時 Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m；n = 4 時 Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m，減半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K. With w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m, H = 442 m and K = 1.0×10⁷ kN, n = 2 gives Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m and n = 4 gives Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m, half as much. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。取 w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m、H = 442 m、K = 1.0×10⁷ kN：n = 2 時 Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m；n = 4 時 Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m，減半。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K. With w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m, H = 442 m and K = 1.0×10⁷ kN, n = 2 gives Δ_s = 96.0×442²/(2×2×10⁷) ≈ 0.469 m and n = 4 gives Δ_s ≈ 0.235 m, half as much. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「束筒與剪力遲滯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bundled tubes and shear lag", which statement holds?
options: 樓板桁架只要強度足夠，剪力釘可以減量而不影響行為。
沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。
懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。
optionsEn: If the floor trusses are strong enough, shear studs can be reduced without affecting behaviour.
A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface.
Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂剪力變形 Δ_s = wH²/(2nK)，n 為腹板框架數、K 為每道框架的等效剪力勁度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cantilever shear deflection is Δ_s = wH²/(2nK), with n web frames each of equivalent shear stiffness K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「九管束筒與內部腹板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢核框管時要以完整三維模型而非平面等效梁取得角柱設計力，並把角柱、角隅接頭與內部框架交會柱列為加強檢驗的構件類別。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check framed tubes with a full three-dimensional model rather than an equivalent plane beam to obtain corner-column design forces, and place corner columns, corner joints and columns where interior frames intersect in an enhanced inspection category.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。
knowledge.textEn: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift.

knowledge.text: 檢核框管時要以完整三維模型而非平面等效梁取得角柱設計力，並把角柱、角隅接頭與內部框架交會柱列為加強檢驗的構件類別。

quiz.question: 要驗證「束筒與剪力遲滯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bundled tubes and shear lag"?
options: 在三維框架模型中比較單一大管與九管束筒在同一風荷載下的翼板柱軸力分布，計算角柱與中段柱的軸力比作為剪力遲滯指標，並把剪力與彎曲兩部分的頂部變位拆開檢討。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces.

quiz.explanationEn: In a three-dimensional frame model compare flange-column axial forces for one large tube and for the nine-tube bundle under the same wind load, use the ratio of corner to mid-face column force as a shear-lag index, and separate the shear and bending components of top drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 束筒與剪力遲滯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bundled tubes and shear lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「九管束筒與內部腹板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束筒在 225 ft 見方的平面中多加兩道縱橫向內部框架，把翼板分成三段、腹板由兩道增為四道，使軸力分布更均勻，剪力勁度也加倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bundled tube adds two interior frames in each direction within the 225 ft square, splitting each flange into three segments and doubling the web frames from two to four, which evens out axial forces and doubles shear stiffness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束筒與剪力遲滯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bundled tubes and shear lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。
收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind.
Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 忽略剪力遲滯會低估角柱與其接頭的軸力，在強風下角柱或接頭可能先達到容量；同時高估中段柱的參與，使實際側向變位與樓板翹曲大於預期，帷幕牆接縫也被額外拉扯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring shear lag underestimates axial forces in corner columns and their joints, which may reach capacity first in strong wind; it also overestimates the contribution of mid-face columns, so real drift and floor warping exceed predictions and façade joints are strained further. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「50／66／90 層分段收進」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 九管全部升到 50 層，西北與東南兩管在此終止；東北與西南兩管在 66 層終止，形成十字形平面；北、東、南三管在 90 層終止，只剩西管與中央管到 108 層。逐段減少的樓板面積讓質量集中在下部，降低地震與風致慣性力的力臂，也讓不同高度的寬度變化擾亂渦流脫落。代價是 90 層以上只剩兩管，平面不再雙軸對稱，質心與剛心產生偏移，上部需要處理扭轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「50／66／90 層分段收進」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop; the northeast and southwest tubes stop at floor 66, leaving a cruciform plan; the north, east and south tubes stop at floor 90, leaving only the west and centre tubes to floor 108. The shrinking floor area concentrates mass low down, shortening the lever arm of seismic and wind-induced inertia forces, and the width changes disrupt vortex shedding along the height. The price is that above floor 90 only two tubes remain, the plan loses double symmetry, the centres of mass and stiffness separate, and the upper levels must handle torsion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「50／66／90 層分段收進」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉
knowledge.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion
knowledge.text: 九管全部升到 50 層，西北與東南兩管在此終止；東北與西南兩管在 66 層終止，形成十字形平面；北、東、南三管在 90 層終止，只剩西管與中央管到 108 層。逐段減少的樓板面積讓質量集中在下部，降低地震與風致慣性力的力臂，也讓不同高度的寬度變化擾亂渦流脫落。
knowledge.textEn: All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop; the northeast and southwest tubes stop at floor 66, leaving a cruciform plan; the north, east and south tubes stop at floor 90, leaving only the west and centre tubes to floor 108. The shrinking floor area concentrates mass low down, shortening the lever arm of seismic and wind-induced inertia forces, and the width changes disrupt vortex shedding along the height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion" is correct?
options: 收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。
九管全部升到 50 層，西北與東南兩管在此終止；東北與西南兩管在 66 層終止，形成十字形平面；北、東、南三管在 90 層終止，只剩西管與中央管到 108 層。
optionsEn: Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters.
All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop.

quiz.explanationEn: All nine tubes rise to floor 50, where the northwest and southeast tubes stop; the northeast and southwest tubes stop at floor 66, leaving a cruciform plan; the north, east and south tubes stop at floor 90, leaving only the west and centre tubes to floor 108. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「50／66／90 層分段收進」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以每管每層為一單位，層高 3.91 m：1–50 層 450 單位，中點 97.8 m；51–66 層 112 單位，226.8 m；67–90 層 120 單位，305.0 m；91–108 層 36 單位，387.1 m。質心高度 z = (450×97.8 + 112×226.8 + 120×305.0 + 36×387.1)/718 ≈ 167 m；若九管都到 108 層，z = 211 m，收進使質心降低約 21%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m. The centroid height z = (450×97.8 + 112×226.8 + 120×305.0 + 36×387.1)/718 ≈ 167 m; with all nine tubes to floor 108, z = 211 m, so the setbacks lower the centroid by about 21%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從模型取出各樓層質心與剛心位置，檢查 90 層以上的偏心距與扭轉振態的頻率與參與質量；風洞試驗則需量測扭矩頻譜，確認上部扭轉造成的角落加速度在居住性準則內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes; the wind-tunnel test must measure torque spectra to confirm that corner accelerations from upper-level torsion meet habitability criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m. The centroid height z = (450×97.8 + 112×226.8 + 120×305.0 + 36×387.1)/718 ≈ 167 m; with all nine tubes to floor 108, z = 211 m, so the setbacks lower the centroid by about 21%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。

Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers.
Code approximate-period formulas accurately predict the real period of a supertall tower.
quiz.explanationEn: Count one unit per tube per floor with a 3.91 m storey: floors 1–50 give 450 units at a mid-height of 97.8 m, floors 51–66 give 112 at 226.8 m, floors 67–90 give 120 at 305.0 m and floors 91–108 give 36 at 387.1 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「50／66／90 層分段收進」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從模型取出各樓層質心與剛心位置，檢查 90 層以上的偏心距與扭轉振態的頻率與參與質量；風洞試驗則需量測扭矩頻譜，確認上部扭轉造成的角落加速度在居住性準則內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes; the wind-tunnel test must measure torque spectra to confirm that corner accelerations from upper-level torsion meet habitability criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：收進樓層應列為結構檢核重點：樓板厚度與配筋、帶狀桁架或深梁的剪力傳遞、終止柱的錨定細部，並要求風洞報告分別列出順風、橫風與扭轉反應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat setback floors as key structural checkpoints for slab thickness and reinforcement, shear transfer through belt trusses or deep beams and anchorage of terminating columns, and require the wind-tunnel report to list along-wind, across-wind and torsional responses separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally; if upper-level torsion is underestimated, corner offices feel noticeable twisting motion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Extract the centres of mass and stiffness at each floor from the model, checking the eccentricity above floor 90 and the frequency and participating mass of torsional modes.

steps.title: 管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「50／66／90 層分段收進」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Setbacks at floors 50, 66 and 90” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally; if upper-level torsion is underestimated, corner offices feel noticeable twisting motion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是 90 層以上只剩兩管，平面不再雙軸對稱，質心與剛心產生偏移，上部需要處理扭轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is that above floor 90 only two tubes remain, the plan loses double symmetry, the centres of mass and stiffness separate, and the upper levels must handle torsion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。
knowledge.textEn: If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally; if upper-level torsion is underestimated, corner offices feel noticeable twisting motion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管筒分段終止、質心與扭轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged tube terminations, mass centroid and torsion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。
若收進處的樓板與帶狀構件沒有足夠的剪力傳遞能力，終止管筒的柱力無法順利交給相鄰管筒，造成局部應力集中；上部扭轉若被低估，角落辦公室會感受到明顯旋轉擺動。

A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters.
If floors and belt members at a setback cannot transfer enough shear, forces from terminating tubes cannot pass smoothly to neighbouring tubes and stresses concentrate locally.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密柱框管的構件與預組單元」與「長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube" and "Long-span composite floor trusses and studs": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密柱框管的構件與預組單元：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「15 ft 柱距框管與裙梁」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “15 ft column module and spandrels” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每個管筒的周邊柱以 15 ft（約 4.57 m）為模組，與深裙梁剛接成近似穿孔牆的框架。在側力下，裙梁兩端承受相反方向的彎矩，反曲點大約在跨中，跨中彎矩接近零，剪力則沿跨長大致固定；柱段與部分裙梁可在工廠預組，現場只做接合，減少高空焊接。SOM 說明鋼構先預組成段件再於現場以螺栓接合，柱段為兩層樓高。剛接框管的勁度主要由裙梁的彎曲與剪力勁度決定，因此裙梁深度與接頭剛度是控制參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「15 ft 柱距框管與裙梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each tube's perimeter columns follow a 15 ft (about 4.57 m) module and are rigidly framed with deep spandrels into something close to a perforated wall. Under lateral load the spandrel ends bend in opposite directions, the point of contraflexure sits near mid-span where moment is nearly zero and shear is constant; column segments and parts of spandrels can be pre-assembled in the shop so the site only makes connections, reducing welding at height. SOM describes the steel as pre-assembled into sections and bolted together on site, with column pieces two storeys tall. Tube stiffness depends mainly on spandrel bending and shear stiffness, so spandrel depth and joint rigidity are the controlling parameters. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “15 ft column module and spandrels” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：反對稱彎矩下裙梁剪力 V = 2M/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under antisymmetric bending the spandrel shear is V = 2M/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「15 ft 柱距框管與裙梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “15 ft column module and spandrels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密柱框管的構件與預組單元
knowledge.titleEn: Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube
knowledge.text: 每個管筒的周邊柱以 15 ft（約 4.57 m）為模組，與深裙梁剛接成近似穿孔牆的框架。在側力下，裙梁兩端承受相反方向的彎矩，反曲點大約在跨中，跨中彎矩接近零，剪力則沿跨長大致固定；柱段與部分裙梁可在工廠預組，現場只做接合，減少高空焊接。

Under lateral load the spandrel ends bend in opposite directions, the point of contraflexure sits near mid-span where moment is nearly zero and shear is constant; column segments and parts of spandrels can be pre-assembled in the shop so the site only makes connections, reducing welding at height.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密柱框管的構件與預組單元」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube" is correct?
options: 每個管筒的周邊柱以 15 ft（約 4.57 m）為模組，與深裙梁剛接成近似穿孔牆的框架。

quiz.explanationEn: Each tube's perimeter columns follow a 15 ft (about 4.57 m) module and are rigidly framed with deep spandrels into something close to a perforated wall. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密柱框管的構件與預組單元：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「15 ft 柱距框管與裙梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “15 ft column module and spandrels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：反對稱彎矩下裙梁剪力 V = 2M/L。若柱面處裙梁端彎矩 M = 600 kN·m、柱距 L = 4.57 m，V = 2×600/4.57 ≈ 263 kN；在反曲點附近設置螺栓續接時，主要傳遞 263 kN 的剪力與很小的彎矩。數值為教學假設，以柱心距近似淨跨。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Under antisymmetric bending the spandrel shear is V = 2M/L. With an end moment M = 600 kN·m at the column face and a column spacing L = 4.57 m, V = 2×600/4.57 ≈ 263 kN; a bolted splice near the contraflexure point mainly carries this 263 kN shear and very little moment. Values are teaching assumptions using the centre spacing as an approximation of the clear span. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠預組單元出廠前檢查柱段長度、裙梁位置與孔位，以樣板或三維量測確認累積誤差；現場螺栓接合依規範抽驗預拉力，並在每組樓層完成後量測柱垂直度與樓層標高。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before shop-assembled units leave the plant, check column length, spandrel position and hole locations with templates or three-dimensional measurement to control cumulative error; on site sample bolt pretension to the specification and survey column plumbness and floor levels after each tier.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 反對稱彎矩下裙梁剪力 V = 2M/L。若柱面處裙梁端彎矩 M = 600 kN·m、柱距 L = 4.57 m，V = 2×600/4.57 ≈ 263 kN；在反曲點附近設置螺栓續接時，主要傳遞 263 kN 的剪力與很小的彎矩。數值為教學假設，以柱心距近似淨跨。
knowledge.textEn: Under antisymmetric bending the spandrel shear is V = 2M/L. With an end moment M = 600 kN·m at the column face and a column spacing L = 4.57 m, V = 2×600/4.57 ≈ 263 kN; a bolted splice near the contraflexure point mainly carries this 263 kN shear and very little moment. Values are teaching assumptions using the centre spacing as an approximation of the clear span.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密柱框管的構件與預組單元」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube", which statement holds?
options: 沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。
反對稱彎矩下裙梁剪力 V = 2M/L。
帷幕牆只負責防水與外觀，與主結構的受力無關。
optionsEn: A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface.
Under antisymmetric bending the spandrel shear is V = 2M/L.
The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces.
quiz.explanation: 反對稱彎矩下裙梁剪力 V = 2M/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Under antisymmetric bending the spandrel shear is V = 2M/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 密柱框管的構件與預組單元：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「15 ft 柱距框管與裙梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “15 ft column module and spandrels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠預組單元出廠前檢查柱段長度、裙梁位置與孔位，以樣板或三維量測確認累積誤差；現場螺栓接合依規範抽驗預拉力，並在每組樓層完成後量測柱垂直度與樓層標高。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before shop-assembled units leave the plant, check column length, spandrel position and hole locations with templates or three-dimensional measurement to control cumulative error; on site sample bolt pretension to the specification and survey column plumbness and floor levels after each tier. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預組單元的分段位置應由結構工程師依彎矩圖確認，並規定工廠與現場的尺寸允差及量測紀錄格式；裙梁開孔或切割一律需結構審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural engineer should confirm splice locations of prefabricated units against the moment diagram, set shop and site dimensional tolerances with a standard record format, and require structural review for any spandrel opening or cut.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：續接若設在彎矩較大的位置卻只按剪力設計，強風下螺栓群會滑移並使框管勁度下降；預組單元尺寸誤差累積則讓上部柱與下部柱偏心接合，增加附加彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A splice placed where moment is significant but designed only for shear lets the bolt group slip in strong wind and softens the tube; accumulated dimensional errors in prefabricated units make upper and lower columns meet eccentrically, adding secondary moments. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 工廠預組單元出廠前檢查柱段長度、裙梁位置與孔位，以樣板或三維量測確認累積誤差；現場螺栓接合依規範抽驗預拉力，並在每組樓層完成後量測柱垂直度與樓層標高。
knowledge.textEn: Before shop-assembled units leave the plant, check column length, spandrel position and hole locations with templates or three-dimensional measurement to control cumulative error; on site sample bolt pretension to the specification and survey column plumbness and floor levels after each tier.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預組單元的分段位置應由結構工程師依彎矩圖確認，並規定工廠與現場的尺寸允差及量測紀錄格式；裙梁開孔或切割一律需結構審查。
knowledge.textEn: The structural engineer should confirm splice locations of prefabricated units against the moment diagram, set shop and site dimensional tolerances with a standard record format, and require structural review for any spandrel opening or cut.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密柱框管的構件與預組單元」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Spandrels only support the façade, so removing one does not affect column capacity.
Before shop-assembled units leave the plant, check column length, spandrel position and hole locations with templates or three-dimensional measurement to control cumulative error.
quiz.explanation: 工廠預組單元出廠前檢查柱段長度、裙梁位置與孔位，以樣板或三維量測確認累積誤差；現場螺栓接合依規範抽驗預拉力，並在每組樓層完成後量測柱垂直度與樓層標高。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before shop-assembled units leave the plant, check column length, spandrel position and hole locations with templates or three-dimensional measurement to control cumulative error; on site sample bolt pretension to the specification and survey column plumbness and floor levels after each tier. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密柱框管的構件與預組單元：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「15 ft 柱距框管與裙梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “15 ft column module and spandrels” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 續接若設在彎矩較大的位置卻只按剪力設計，強風下螺栓群會滑移並使框管勁度下降；預組單元尺寸誤差累積則讓上部柱與下部柱偏心接合，增加附加彎矩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A splice placed where moment is significant but designed only for shear lets the bolt group slip in strong wind and softens the tube; accumulated dimensional errors in prefabricated units make upper and lower columns meet eccentrically, adding secondary moments. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剛接框管的勁度主要由裙梁的彎曲與剪力勁度決定，因此裙梁深度與接頭剛度是控制參數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tube stiffness depends mainly on spandrel bending and shear stiffness, so spandrel depth and joint rigidity are the controlling parameters.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 續接若設在彎矩較大的位置卻只按剪力設計，強風下螺栓群會滑移並使框管勁度下降；預組單元尺寸誤差累積則讓上部柱與下部柱偏心接合，增加附加彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: A splice placed where moment is significant but designed only for shear lets the bolt group slip in strong wind and softens the tube; accumulated dimensional errors in prefabricated units make upper and lower columns meet eccentrically, adding secondary moments.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密柱框管的構件與預組單元」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Members and prefabricated units of the dense-column tube" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 續接若設在彎矩較大的位置卻只按剪力設計，強風下螺栓群會滑移並使框管勁度下降；預組單元尺寸誤差累積則讓上部柱與下部柱偏心接合，增加附加彎矩。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
樓板桁架只要強度足夠，剪力釘可以減量而不影響行為。
optionsEn: A splice placed where moment is significant but designed only for shear lets the bolt group slip in strong wind and softens the tube.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the floor trusses are strong enough, shear studs can be reduced without affecting behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 續接若設在彎矩較大的位置卻只按剪力設計，強風下螺栓群會滑移並使框管勁度下降；預組單元尺寸誤差累積則讓上部柱與下部柱偏心接合，增加附加彎矩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A splice placed where moment is significant but designed only for shear lets the bolt group slip in strong wind and softens the tube; accumulated dimensional errors in prefabricated units make upper and lower columns meet eccentrically, adding secondary moments. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-span composite floor trusses and studs: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「75 ft 複合樓板桁架」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “75 ft composite floor trusses” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每個管筒內部無柱，樓板以跨度 75 ft（22.9 m）、深 40 in（1.02 m）的華倫式桁架、間距 15 ft 支承，桁架以只傳剪力的高強螺栓接到柱上，視為簡支。樓板為 3 in 壓型鋼板加 2½ in 輕質混凝土，以 ¾ in 剪力釘形成複合作用；角隅管筒每六層交替桁架方向，讓管壁受力平均。複合作用使混凝土板承壓、桁架下弦受拉，剪力釘必須把兩者間的水平力完整傳遞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「75 ft 複合樓板桁架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each tube is column-free inside: floors are carried by Warren trusses 75 ft (22.9 m) long and 40 in (1.02 m) deep at 15 ft centres, bolted to columns with high-strength bolts designed for shear only, so they are simply supported. The slab is a 3 in metal deck with 2½ in of lightweight concrete, made composite with ¾ in shear studs; in the corner tubes the truss direction alternates every six floors to balance load on the tube walls. Composite action puts the slab in compression and the bottom chord in tension, and the studs must transfer the full horizontal force between them. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “75 ft composite floor trusses” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m，L = 22.86 m：M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m；有效力臂約 1.10 m 時弦力 C = T ≈ 1,465 kN；每支剪力釘 Q_n 取 70 kN，半跨需約 21 支，全跨約 42 支。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m and L = 22.86 m give M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m; with an effective lever arm of about 1.10 m the chord force is C = T ≈ 1,465 kN; at Q_n = 70 kN per stud, about 21 studs are needed per half span, about 42 per truss.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板桁架只要強度足夠，剪力釘可以減量而不影響行為。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the floor trusses are strong enough, shear studs can be reduced without affecting behaviour." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「75 ft 複合樓板桁架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “75 ft composite floor trusses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘
knowledge.titleEn: Long-span composite floor trusses and studs
knowledge.text: 每個管筒內部無柱，樓板以跨度 75 ft（22.9 m）、深 40 in（1.02 m）的華倫式桁架、間距 15 ft 支承，桁架以只傳剪力的高強螺栓接到柱上，視為簡支。樓板為 3 in 壓型鋼板加 2½ in 輕質混凝土，以 ¾ in 剪力釘形成複合作用；角隅管筒每六層交替桁架方向，讓管壁受力平均。

The slab is a 3 in metal deck with 2½ in of lightweight concrete, made composite with ¾ in shear studs; in the corner tubes the truss direction alternates every six floors to balance load on the tube walls.

quiz.question: 關於「長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-span composite floor trusses and studs" is correct?

steps.title: 長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-span composite floor trusses and studs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「75 ft 複合樓板桁架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “75 ft composite floor trusses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m，L = 22.86 m：M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m；有效力臂約 1.10 m 時弦力 C = T ≈ 1,465 kN；每支剪力釘 Q_n 取 70 kN，半跨需約 21 支，全跨約 42 支。跨深比 22.86/1.016 ≈ 22.5。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m and L = 22.86 m give M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m; with an effective lever arm of about 1.10 m the chord force is C = T ≈ 1,465 kN; at Q_n = 70 kN per stud, about 21 studs are needed per half span, about 42 per truss. The span-to-depth ratio is 22.86/1.016 ≈ 22.5. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：剪力釘焊接後依 AWS D1.1 做彎曲試驗抽驗（敲彎 15° 不得斷裂）並檢查焊趾完整；桁架出廠前做尺寸與焊道檢驗，安裝後量測樓板撓度並以腳步激振量測樓板頻率，與設計預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After stud welding, bend-test a sample to AWS D1.1 (bent 15° without failure) and inspect weld collars; check truss dimensions and welds before delivery, and after erection measure slab deflection and floor frequency under heel-drop excitation for comparison with design predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m，L = 22.86 m：M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m；有效力臂約 1.10 m 時弦力 C = T ≈ 1,465 kN；每支剪力釘 Q_n 取 70 kN，半跨需約 21 支，全跨約 42 支。跨深比 22.86/1.016 ≈ 22.5。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m and L = 22.86 m give M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m; with an effective lever arm of about 1.10 m the chord force is C = T ≈ 1,465 kN; at Q_n = 70 kN per stud, about 21 studs are needed per half span, about 42 per truss. The span-to-depth ratio is 22.86/1.016 ≈ 22.5. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-span composite floor trusses and studs", which statement holds?
options: 規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。
在承載中的鋼柱上焊接補強是沒有風險的例行作業。
optionsEn: Code approximate-period formulas accurately predict the real period of a supertall tower.
Welding reinforcement onto a loaded steel column is a routine task with no risk.
quiz.explanation: w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m，L = 22.86 m：M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m；有效力臂約 1.10 m 時弦力 C = T ≈ 1,465 kN；每支剪力釘 Q_n 取 70 kN，半跨需約 21 支，全跨約 42 支。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: w = (3.0 + 2.4) kPa×4.57 m ≈ 24.7 kN/m and L = 22.86 m give M = wL²/8 ≈ 1,612 kN·m; with an effective lever arm of about 1.10 m the chord force is C = T ≈ 1,465 kN; at Q_n = 70 kN per stud, about 21 studs are needed per half span, about 42 per truss. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-span composite floor trusses and studs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「75 ft 複合樓板桁架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “75 ft composite floor trusses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘焊接後依 AWS D1.1 做彎曲試驗抽驗（敲彎 15° 不得斷裂）並檢查焊趾完整；桁架出廠前做尺寸與焊道檢驗，安裝後量測樓板撓度並以腳步激振量測樓板頻率，與設計預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After stud welding, bend-test a sample to AWS D1.1 (bent 15° without failure) and inspect weld collars; check truss dimensions and welds before delivery, and after erection measure slab deflection and floor frequency under heel-drop excitation for comparison with design predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：剪力釘施工前須做程序試焊並每日開工試驗，雨後或有積水時暫停焊接；樓板開孔改裝時，結構工程師須確認剪力釘與桁架弦桿未被破壞。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Qualify the stud-welding procedure before production and run daily start-up tests, suspending welding after rain or with standing water; for later slab openings, the structural engineer must confirm that studs and truss chords are not damaged.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剪力釘數量或焊接品質不足時，樓板與桁架間發生滑移，複合勁度降低，撓度與樓板振動都增加；在壓型鋼板上焊釘若鍍鋅層或積水處理不當，焊接不良率會明顯上升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Too few studs or poor welds let the slab slip on the truss, reducing composite stiffness and increasing deflection and floor vibration; welding through metal deck with poorly managed galvanising or standing water raises the defect rate sharply. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 剪力釘焊接後依 AWS D1.1 做彎曲試驗抽驗（敲彎 15° 不得斷裂）並檢查焊趾完整；桁架出廠前做尺寸與焊道檢驗，安裝後量測樓板撓度並以腳步激振量測樓板頻率，與設計預測比較。
knowledge.textEn: After stud welding, bend-test a sample to AWS D1.1 (bent 15° without failure) and inspect weld collars; check truss dimensions and welds before delivery, and after erection measure slab deflection and floor frequency under heel-drop excitation for comparison with design predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 剪力釘施工前須做程序試焊並每日開工試驗，雨後或有積水時暫停焊接；樓板開孔改裝時，結構工程師須確認剪力釘與桁架弦桿未被破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Qualify the stud-welding procedure before production and run daily start-up tests, suspending welding after rain or with standing water; for later slab openings, the structural engineer must confirm that studs and truss chords are not damaged.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-span composite floor trusses and studs"?
options: 剪力釘焊接後依 AWS D1.1 做彎曲試驗抽驗（敲彎 15° 不得斷裂）並檢查焊趾完整。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。
optionsEn: After stud welding, bend-test a sample to AWS D1.1 (bent 15° without failure) and inspect weld collars.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘焊接後依 AWS D1.1 做彎曲試驗抽驗（敲彎 15° 不得斷裂）並檢查焊趾完整；桁架出廠前做尺寸與焊道檢驗，安裝後量測樓板撓度並以腳步激振量測樓板頻率，與設計預測比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After stud welding, bend-test a sample to AWS D1.1 (bent 15° without failure) and inspect weld collars; check truss dimensions and welds before delivery, and after erection measure slab deflection and floor frequency under heel-drop excitation for comparison with design predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-span composite floor trusses and studs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「75 ft 複合樓板桁架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “75 ft composite floor trusses” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘數量或焊接品質不足時，樓板與桁架間發生滑移，複合勁度降低，撓度與樓板振動都增加；在壓型鋼板上焊釘若鍍鋅層或積水處理不當，焊接不良率會明顯上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Too few studs or poor welds let the slab slip on the truss, reducing composite stiffness and increasing deflection and floor vibration; welding through metal deck with poorly managed galvanising or standing water raises the defect rate sharply. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：複合作用使混凝土板承壓、桁架下弦受拉，剪力釘必須把兩者間的水平力完整傳遞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Composite action puts the slab in compression and the bottom chord in tension, and the studs must transfer the full horizontal force between them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板桁架只要強度足夠，剪力釘可以減量而不影響行為。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the floor trusses are strong enough, shear studs can be reduced without affecting behaviour." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剪力釘數量或焊接品質不足時，樓板與桁架間發生滑移，複合勁度降低，撓度與樓板振動都增加；在壓型鋼板上焊釘若鍍鋅層或積水處理不當，焊接不良率會明顯上升。
knowledge.textEn: Too few studs or poor welds let the slab slip on the truss, reducing composite stiffness and increasing deflection and floor vibration; welding through metal deck with poorly managed galvanising or standing water raises the defect rate sharply.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長跨複合樓板桁架與剪力釘」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-span composite floor trusses and studs" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
剪力釘數量或焊接品質不足時，樓板與桁架間發生滑移，複合勁度降低，撓度與樓板振動都增加；在壓型鋼板上焊釘若鍍鋅層或積水處理不當，焊接不良率會明顯上升。
鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Too few studs or poor welds let the slab slip on the truss, reducing composite stiffness and increasing deflection and floor vibration.
Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘數量或焊接品質不足時，樓板與桁架間發生滑移，複合勁度降低，撓度與樓板振動都增加；在壓型鋼板上焊釘若鍍鋅層或積水處理不當，焊接不良率會明顯上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too few studs or poor welds let the slab slip on the truss, reducing composite stiffness and increasing deflection and floor vibration; welding through metal deck with poorly managed galvanising or standing water raises the defect rate sharply. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏」與「深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm" and "Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「每週兩層的鋼構安裝」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel erection at two floors per week” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出施工團隊以每週兩層的速度安裝鋼構，柱段為兩層樓高，待兩層柱就位後才開始安裝樓板構架。基座四周的塔吊直接從卡車吊起鋼料送到安裝位置，鋼料不落地堆放。高速度的關鍵在於重複性：九管相同的 15 ft 模組讓預組單元與樓板桁架高度標準化，吊次、接合與檢驗可以形成固定的循環；同時，接合尚未完成的上部樓層需要臨時穩定，安裝順序必須保證每一節在鎖定前有足夠的側向支撐。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「每週兩層的鋼構安裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources report erection at two floors a week, with two-storey column pieces and floor framing starting once two levels of columns were in place. Cranes on all four sides of the base lifted steel straight from delivery trucks into position, so steel never sat on the ground. Speed came from repetition: the identical 15 ft module of all nine tubes standardised the prefabricated units and floor trusses, so lifts, connections and inspections formed a fixed cycle; meanwhile upper tiers with incomplete connections needed temporary stability, so the sequence had to ensure lateral support for each tier before it was locked. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel erection at two floors per week” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以總鋼量約 76,000 美噸、110 層估算，每層約 691 美噸；每週兩層即 1,382 美噸。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With about 76,000 short tons of steel over 110 storeys, each floor needs about 691 tons, so two floors a week is 1,382 tons.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「每週兩層的鋼構安裝」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Steel erection at two floors per week”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏
knowledge.titleEn: Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出施工團隊以每週兩層的速度安裝鋼構，柱段為兩層樓高，待兩層柱就位後才開始安裝樓板構架。基座四周的塔吊直接從卡車吊起鋼料送到安裝位置，鋼料不落地堆放。
knowledge.textEn: Public sources report erection at two floors a week, with two-storey column pieces and floor framing starting once two levels of columns were in place. Cranes on all four sides of the base lifted steel straight from delivery trucks into position, so steel never sat on the ground.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm" is correct?
options: 鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。
沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。
公開資料指出施工團隊以每週兩層的速度安裝鋼構，柱段為兩層樓高，待兩層柱就位後才開始安裝樓板構架。
optionsEn: Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers.
A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface.
Public sources report erection at two floors a week, with two-storey column pieces and floor framing starting once two levels of columns were in place.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出施工團隊以每週兩層的速度安裝鋼構，柱段為兩層樓高，待兩層柱就位後才開始安裝樓板構架。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public sources report erection at two floors a week, with two-storey column pieces and floor framing starting once two levels of columns were in place. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「每週兩層的鋼構安裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel erection at two floors per week” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以總鋼量約 76,000 美噸、110 層估算，每層約 691 美噸；每週兩層即 1,382 美噸。四部塔吊平均每吊 8 美噸，每部每週需 1,382/(4×8) ≈ 43 吊，以每週 5 天計約每天 8.6 吊，另需扣除天候停工的餘裕。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With about 76,000 short tons of steel over 110 storeys, each floor needs about 691 tons, so two floors a week is 1,382 tons. Four cranes lifting an average of 8 tons each need 1,382/(4×8) ≈ 43 lifts per crane per week, about 8.6 a day over five days, before allowing for weather stoppages. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每週以吊次紀錄、到貨序號與安裝順序表比對進度；每節完成後檢查臨時拉索或斜撐、螺栓初鎖數量與柱垂直度，達到規定後才可往上吊裝；強風日依塔吊廠商限制停止吊裝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track progress weekly by comparing lift logs, delivery piece numbers and the erection sequence; after each tier check temporary guys or braces, the number of snug-tight bolts and column plumbness before lifting higher, and stop lifting in strong wind according to the crane manufacturer's limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Four cranes lifting an average of 8 tons each need 1,382/(4×8) ≈ 43 lifts per crane per week, about 8.6 a day over five days, before allowing for weather stoppages. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

帷幕牆只負責防水與外觀，與主結構的受力無關。

The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces.

steps.title: 四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「每週兩層的鋼構安裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel erection at two floors per week” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每週以吊次紀錄、到貨序號與安裝順序表比對進度；每節完成後檢查臨時拉索或斜撐、螺栓初鎖數量與柱垂直度，達到規定後才可往上吊裝；強風日依塔吊廠商限制停止吊裝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track progress weekly by comparing lift logs, delivery piece numbers and the erection sequence; after each tier check temporary guys or braces, the number of snug-tight bolts and column plumbness before lifting higher, and stop lifting in strong wind according to the crane manufacturer's limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝計畫須明定每節的最低接合數量、臨時支撐與允許往上安裝的條件，並由鋼構安裝工程師與結構工程師共同簽認；樓板臨時堆放須標示容許荷重。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection plan must define the minimum connections, temporary bracing and conditions for proceeding upward for each tier, signed by the erection engineer and the structural engineer; temporary storage areas on floors must be marked with allowable loads.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了追趕進度而在下層接合未完成前繼續往上吊裝，上部構架可能在強風或吊物碰撞時失穩倒塌；到貨順序錯亂則迫使鋼料臨時堆放在未完成的樓板上，造成超載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lifting higher before lower connections are finished to catch up on schedule can let the upper frame become unstable in wind or under impact from a load; deliveries out of sequence force steel to be stored on unfinished floors and overload them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
