knowledge.text: 安裝計畫須明定每節的最低接合數量、臨時支撐與允許往上安裝的條件，並由鋼構安裝工程師與結構工程師共同簽認；樓板臨時堆放須標示容許荷重。
knowledge.textEn: The erection plan must define the minimum connections, temporary bracing and conditions for proceeding upward for each tier, signed by the erection engineer and the structural engineer; temporary storage areas on floors must be marked with allowable loads.

quiz.question: 要驗證「四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每週以吊次紀錄、到貨序號與安裝順序表比對進度；每節完成後檢查臨時拉索或斜撐、螺栓初鎖數量與柱垂直度，達到規定後才可往上吊裝；強風日依塔吊廠商限制停止吊裝。
收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Track progress weekly by comparing lift logs, delivery piece numbers and the erection sequence.
Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 每週以吊次紀錄、到貨序號與安裝順序表比對進度；每節完成後檢查臨時拉索或斜撐、螺栓初鎖數量與柱垂直度，達到規定後才可往上吊裝；強風日依塔吊廠商限制停止吊裝。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track progress weekly by comparing lift logs, delivery piece numbers and the erection sequence; after each tier check temporary guys or braces, the number of snug-tight bolts and column plumbness before lifting higher, and stop lifting in strong wind according to the crane manufacturer's limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每週兩層的鋼構安裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel erection at two floors per week” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了追趕進度而在下層接合未完成前繼續往上吊裝，上部構架可能在強風或吊物碰撞時失穩倒塌；到貨順序錯亂則迫使鋼料臨時堆放在未完成的樓板上，造成超載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lifting higher before lower connections are finished to catch up on schedule can let the upper frame become unstable in wind or under impact from a load; deliveries out of sequence force steel to be stored on unfinished floors and overload them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高速度的關鍵在於重複性：九管相同的 15 ft 模組讓預組單元與樓板桁架高度標準化，吊次、接合與檢驗可以形成固定的循環；同時，接合尚未完成的上部樓層需要臨時穩定，安裝順序必須保證每一節在鎖定前有足夠的側向支撐。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Speed came from repetition: the identical 15 ft module of all nine tubes standardised the prefabricated units and floor trusses, so lifts, connections and inspections formed a fixed cycle; meanwhile upper tiers with incomplete connections needed temporary stability, so the sequence had to ensure lateral support for each tier before it was locked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了追趕進度而在下層接合未完成前繼續往上吊裝，上部構架可能在強風或吊物碰撞時失穩倒塌；到貨順序錯亂則迫使鋼料臨時堆放在未完成的樓板上，造成超載。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting higher before lower connections are finished to catch up on schedule can let the upper frame become unstable in wind or under impact from a load; deliveries out of sequence force steel to be stored on unfinished floors and overload them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「四面塔吊與兩層一節的安裝節奏」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Four-side cranes and a two-storey erection rhythm" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。
為了追趕進度而在下層接合未完成前繼續往上吊裝，上部構架可能在強風或吊物碰撞時失穩倒塌；到貨順序錯亂則迫使鋼料臨時堆放在未完成的樓板上，造成超載。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface.
Lifting higher before lower connections are finished to catch up on schedule can let the upper frame become unstable in wind or under impact from a load.
quiz.explanation: 為了追趕進度而在下層接合未完成前繼續往上吊裝，上部構架可能在強風或吊物碰撞時失穩倒塌；到貨順序錯亂則迫使鋼料臨時堆放在未完成的樓板上，造成超載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lifting higher before lower connections are finished to catch up on schedule can let the upper frame become unstable in wind or under impact from a load; deliveries out of sequence force steel to be stored on unfinished floors and overload them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「岩盤嵌入沉箱」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rock-socketed caissons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SOM 說明九個管筒坐落在延伸到岩盤的鋼筋混凝土沉箱上；後來的改造資料也指出塔樓沉箱嵌入岩盤，與廣場區的擴底沉箱各自獨立。芝加哥市中心表層為軟弱黏土，岩盤在地表下相當深處，因此柱荷重必須經由沉箱穿過黏土傳到岩層。沉箱的承載包括嵌岩段的側摩擦與底部端承；施工時地下水與黏土擠入會影響孔壁穩定與底部清潔，所以鋼套管與底部檢查是品質的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「岩盤嵌入沉箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SOM states that the nine tubes rest on reinforced-concrete caissons extending to bedrock, and later renovation records note that the tower caissons are rock-socketed and independent of the belled caissons under the plaza. Downtown Chicago has soft clay near the surface and bedrock at considerable depth, so column loads must pass through the clay to rock via caissons. Capacity comes from side friction in the rock socket and end bearing at the base; during construction groundwater and squeezing clay threaten hole stability and base cleanliness, so steel casings and base inspection are key to quality. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rock-socketed caissons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：嵌岩沉箱 Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a rock-socketed caisson Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「岩盤嵌入沉箱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rock-socketed caissons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎
knowledge.text: SOM 說明九個管筒坐落在延伸到岩盤的鋼筋混凝土沉箱上；後來的改造資料也指出塔樓沉箱嵌入岩盤，與廣場區的擴底沉箱各自獨立。芝加哥市中心表層為軟弱黏土，岩盤在地表下相當深處，因此柱荷重必須經由沉箱穿過黏土傳到岩層。

Downtown Chicago has soft clay near the surface and bedrock at considerable depth, so column loads must pass through the clay to rock via caissons.

quiz.question: 關於「深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons" is correct?
options: SOM 說明九個管筒坐落在延伸到岩盤的鋼筋混凝土沉箱上；後來的改造資料也指出塔樓沉箱嵌入岩盤，與廣場區的擴底沉箱各自獨立。
沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。
規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。
optionsEn: SOM states that the nine tubes rest on reinforced-concrete caissons extending to bedrock, and later renovation records note that the tower caissons are rock-socketed and independent of the belled caissons under the plaza.

steps.title: 深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩盤嵌入沉箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rock-socketed caissons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：嵌岩沉箱 Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b。取 D = 3.05 m（10 ft）、嵌岩長 L_s = 3 m、側摩擦 f_s = 1.0 MPa、端承 q_b = 5 MPa：側摩擦 ≈ 28.7 MN、端承 ≈ 36.5 MN，合計約 65.3 MN；以安全係數 2.5 得容許約 26.1 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a rock-socketed caisson Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b. With D = 3.05 m (10 ft), a socket length L_s = 3 m, side friction f_s = 1.0 MPa and end bearing q_b = 5 MPa, side friction gives about 28.7 MN and end bearing about 36.5 MN, about 65.3 MN in total; a factor of safety of 2.5 gives an allowable load of about 26.1 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支沉箱鑽至岩盤後由大地工程師確認岩質與嵌岩長度，底部清潔度以目視或攝影檢查；澆置前檢查鋼筋籠與套管，澆置時記錄混凝土方量與理論方量比，偏差過大即檢討孔壁坍塌或擴孔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each caisson reaches rock, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality and socket length and checks base cleanliness visually or by camera; reinforcement cages and casings are inspected before concreting, and the ratio of placed to theoretical concrete volume is logged, with large deviations prompting review for collapse or over-break.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 嵌岩沉箱 Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b。取 D = 3.05 m（10 ft）、嵌岩長 L_s = 3 m、側摩擦 f_s = 1.0 MPa、端承 q_b = 5 MPa：側摩擦 ≈ 28.7 MN、端承 ≈ 36.5 MN，合計約 65.3 MN；以安全係數 2.5 得容許約 26.1 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a rock-socketed caisson Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b. With D = 3.05 m (10 ft), a socket length L_s = 3 m, side friction f_s = 1.0 MPa and end bearing q_b = 5 MPa, side friction gives about 28.7 MN and end bearing about 36.5 MN, about 65.3 MN in total; a factor of safety of 2.5 gives an allowable load of about 26.1 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons", which statement holds?
options: 在承載中的鋼柱上焊接補強是沒有風險的例行作業。
嵌岩沉箱 Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b。
框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。
optionsEn: Welding reinforcement onto a loaded steel column is a routine task with no risk.
For a rock-socketed caisson Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b.
All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally.
quiz.explanation: 嵌岩沉箱 Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a rock-socketed caisson Q = πDL_sf_s + (πD²/4)q_b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩盤嵌入沉箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rock-socketed caissons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每支沉箱鑽至岩盤後由大地工程師確認岩質與嵌岩長度，底部清潔度以目視或攝影檢查；澆置前檢查鋼筋籠與套管，澆置時記錄混凝土方量與理論方量比，偏差過大即檢討孔壁坍塌或擴孔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each caisson reaches rock, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality and socket length and checks base cleanliness visually or by camera; reinforcement cages and casings are inspected before concreting, and the ratio of placed to theoretical concrete volume is logged, with large deviations prompting review for collapse or over-break. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：沉箱基底與嵌岩長度驗收列為停留點，每支沉箱都要有含照片與量測的竣工紀錄，作為日後改造時評估既有基礎容量的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make base and socket acceptance a hold point and keep an as-built record with photographs and measurements for every caisson, as the basis for evaluating existing foundation capacity in future alterations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：底部沉泥未清除會讓沉箱在加載後產生額外沉陷；黏土擠入或地下水湧入造成斷樁或夾泥，柱荷重集中到相鄰沉箱，使上部框管出現不均勻沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sediment left at the base causes extra settlement under load; clay squeezing or groundwater inflow creates necking or soil inclusions, shifting column load to neighbouring caissons and causing uneven settlement in the tubes above. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每支沉箱鑽至岩盤後由大地工程師確認岩質與嵌岩長度，底部清潔度以目視或攝影檢查；澆置前檢查鋼筋籠與套管，澆置時記錄混凝土方量與理論方量比，偏差過大即檢討孔壁坍塌或擴孔。
knowledge.textEn: After each caisson reaches rock, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality and socket length and checks base cleanliness visually or by camera; reinforcement cages and casings are inspected before concreting, and the ratio of placed to theoretical concrete volume is logged, with large deviations prompting review for collapse or over-break.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 沉箱基底與嵌岩長度驗收列為停留點，每支沉箱都要有含照片與量測的竣工紀錄，作為日後改造時評估既有基礎容量的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Make base and socket acceptance a hold point and keep an as-built record with photographs and measurements for every caisson, as the basis for evaluating existing foundation capacity in future alterations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。
每支沉箱鑽至岩盤後由大地工程師確認岩質與嵌岩長度，底部清潔度以目視或攝影檢查。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters.
After each caisson reaches rock, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality and socket length and checks base cleanliness visually or by camera.
quiz.explanation: 每支沉箱鑽至岩盤後由大地工程師確認岩質與嵌岩長度，底部清潔度以目視或攝影檢查；澆置前檢查鋼筋籠與套管，澆置時記錄混凝土方量與理論方量比，偏差過大即檢討孔壁坍塌或擴孔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each caisson reaches rock, the geotechnical engineer confirms rock quality and socket length and checks base cleanliness visually or by camera; reinforcement cages and casings are inspected before concreting, and the ratio of placed to theoretical concrete volume is logged, with large deviations prompting review for collapse or over-break. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩盤嵌入沉箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rock-socketed caissons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 底部沉泥未清除會讓沉箱在加載後產生額外沉陷；黏土擠入或地下水湧入造成斷樁或夾泥，柱荷重集中到相鄰沉箱，使上部框管出現不均勻沉陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment left at the base causes extra settlement under load; clay squeezing or groundwater inflow creates necking or soil inclusions, shifting column load to neighbouring caissons and causing uneven settlement in the tubes above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉箱的承載包括嵌岩段的側摩擦與底部端承；施工時地下水與黏土擠入會影響孔壁穩定與底部清潔，所以鋼套管與底部檢查是品質的關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Capacity comes from side friction in the rock socket and end bearing at the base; during construction groundwater and squeezing clay threaten hole stability and base cleanliness, so steel casings and base inspection are key to quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 底部沉泥未清除會讓沉箱在加載後產生額外沉陷；黏土擠入或地下水湧入造成斷樁或夾泥，柱荷重集中到相鄰沉箱，使上部框管出現不均勻沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Sediment left at the base causes extra settlement under load; clay squeezing or groundwater inflow creates necking or soil inclusions, shifting column load to neighbouring caissons and causing uneven settlement in the tubes above.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「深開挖與岩盤沉箱基礎」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deep excavation and rock-socketed caissons" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 底部沉泥未清除會讓沉箱在加載後產生額外沉陷；黏土擠入或地下水湧入造成斷樁或夾泥，柱荷重集中到相鄰沉箱，使上部框管出現不均勻沉陷。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。
optionsEn: Sediment left at the base causes extra settlement under load.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Code approximate-period formulas accurately predict the real period of a supertall tower.
quiz.explanation: 底部沉泥未清除會讓沉箱在加載後產生額外沉陷；黏土擠入或地下水湧入造成斷樁或夾泥，柱荷重集中到相鄰沉箱，使上部框管出現不均勻沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sediment left at the base causes extra settlement under load; clay squeezing or groundwater inflow creates necking or soil inclusions, shifting column load to neighbouring caissons and causing uneven settlement in the tubes above. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「經驗週期公式與實測比對」與「外牆隔熱與柱溫差變形」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Empirical period formulas versus measurement" and "Skin insulation and column thermal movement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 經驗週期公式與實測比對：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Empirical period formulas versus measurement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「週期估算與環境振動」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Period estimates and ambient vibration” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 結構第一週期決定風致共振與地震反應的大小。規範的近似週期公式是為了訂定保守的基底剪力下限，主要由一般高度建築的實測統計得來，套用在超過 400 m 的超高層時只能當作量級檢查。實際週期取決於質量分布、框管勁度、收進與非結構構件，應以模態分析計算，並在完工後以環境振動量測校核；不同方向與扭轉模態要分開辨識，因為束筒在上部的不對稱會讓兩個水平方向的週期不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「週期估算與環境振動」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first period controls wind resonance and seismic response. Code approximate-period formulas exist to set a conservative lower bound on base shear and come mainly from measurements of ordinary-height buildings, so for a tower above 400 m they are only an order-of-magnitude check. The real period depends on mass distribution, tube stiffness, setbacks and non-structural elements and should be computed by modal analysis and checked by ambient-vibration measurement after completion; each horizontal direction and the torsional mode must be identified separately, because the asymmetric upper bundle makes the two horizontal periods differ. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Period estimates and ambient vibration” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ASCE 7 鋼抗彎框架近似週期 T_a = 0.0724h^0.8（h 以 m 計）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The ASCE 7 approximate period for steel moment frames is T_a = 0.0724h^0.8 with h in metres.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Code approximate-period formulas accurately predict the real period of a supertall tower." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「週期估算與環境振動」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Period estimates and ambient vibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 經驗週期公式與實測比對
knowledge.text: 結構第一週期決定風致共振與地震反應的大小。規範的近似週期公式是為了訂定保守的基底剪力下限，主要由一般高度建築的實測統計得來，套用在超過 400 m 的超高層時只能當作量級檢查。
knowledge.textEn: The first period controls wind resonance and seismic response. Code approximate-period formulas exist to set a conservative lower bound on base shear and come mainly from measurements of ordinary-height buildings, so for a tower above 400 m they are only an order-of-magnitude check.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Code approximate-period formulas accurately predict the real period of a supertall tower. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「經驗週期公式與實測比對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Empirical period formulas versus measurement" is correct?
options: 規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。
結構第一週期決定風致共振與地震反應的大小。
帷幕牆只負責防水與外觀，與主結構的受力無關。
optionsEn: Code approximate-period formulas accurately predict the real period of a supertall tower.
The first period controls wind resonance and seismic response.
The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces.
quiz.explanation: 結構第一週期決定風致共振與地震反應的大小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The first period controls wind resonance and seismic response. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 經驗週期公式與實測比對：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Empirical period formulas versus measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「週期估算與環境振動」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Period estimates and ambient vibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ASCE 7 鋼抗彎框架近似週期 T_a = 0.0724h^0.8（h 以 m 計）。h = 442.1 m 時 T_a = 0.0724×442.1^0.8 ≈ 9.47 s；常用的 T ≈ 0.1N 規則則得 0.1×108 = 10.8 s。兩者相差約 14%，說明經驗式只能當量級參考，設計須以模態分析為準。數值為教學比較。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The ASCE 7 approximate period for steel moment frames is T_a = 0.0724h^0.8 with h in metres. For h = 442.1 m, T_a = 0.0724×442.1^0.8 ≈ 9.47 s, while the common rule T ≈ 0.1N gives 0.1×108 = 10.8 s. The 14% gap shows that empirical formulas are only order-of-magnitude references and design must rely on modal analysis. Values are a teaching comparison. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在頂部與中段設置雙向加速度計，於低風時段記錄至少一小時的環境振動，以頻域分解辨識兩個水平方向與扭轉的前幾個模態，並與模態分析比較；差異超過約一成時檢討質量與勁度假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install biaxial accelerometers at the top and mid-height, record at least an hour of ambient vibration in calm conditions, identify the first modes in both horizontal directions and torsion by frequency-domain decomposition, and compare with modal analysis; review mass and stiffness assumptions if the difference exceeds about ten percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

optionsEn: Spandrels only support the façade, so removing one does not affect column capacity.
Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
The ASCE 7 approximate period for steel moment frames is T_a = 0.0724h^0.8 with h in metres.

steps.title: 經驗週期公式與實測比對：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Empirical period formulas versus measurement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「週期估算與環境振動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Period estimates and ambient vibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在頂部與中段設置雙向加速度計，於低風時段記錄至少一小時的環境振動，以頻域分解辨識兩個水平方向與扭轉的前幾個模態，並與模態分析比較；差異超過約一成時檢討質量與勁度假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install biaxial accelerometers at the top and mid-height, record at least an hour of ambient vibration in calm conditions, identify the first modes in both horizontal directions and torsion by frequency-domain decomposition, and compare with modal analysis; review mass and stiffness assumptions if the difference exceeds about ten percent. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計報告應同時列出經驗週期、模態分析週期與（若有）實測週期，並說明採用哪一個做為風與地震設計依據；改造或增減大量質量後，要重新量測並更新紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design reports should list the empirical, modal-analysis and any measured periods and state which governs wind and seismic design; after renovations that add or remove large masses, measure again and update the record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若直接用經驗週期推算風致共振或阻尼需求，可能錯估臨界風速與加速度；忽略兩方向週期不同，則可能把兩個相近的模態誤判為一個，低估扭轉耦合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an empirical period to estimate wind resonance or damping needs can misjudge critical wind speed and acceleration; ignoring the different periods in the two directions can merge two close modes into one and underestimate torsional coupling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「經驗週期公式與實測比對」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Empirical period formulas versus measurement"?

quiz.explanationEn: Install biaxial accelerometers at the top and mid-height, record at least an hour of ambient vibration in calm conditions, identify the first modes in both horizontal directions and torsion by frequency-domain decomposition, and compare with modal analysis; review mass and stiffness assumptions if the difference exceeds about ten percent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 經驗週期公式與實測比對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Empirical period formulas versus measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「週期估算與環境振動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Period estimates and ambient vibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若直接用經驗週期推算風致共振或阻尼需求，可能錯估臨界風速與加速度；忽略兩方向週期不同，則可能把兩個相近的模態誤判為一個，低估扭轉耦合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an empirical period to estimate wind resonance or damping needs can misjudge critical wind speed and acceleration; ignoring the different periods in the two directions can merge two close modes into one and underestimate torsional coupling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際週期取決於質量分布、框管勁度、收進與非結構構件，應以模態分析計算，並在完工後以環境振動量測校核；不同方向與扭轉模態要分開辨識，因為束筒在上部的不對稱會讓兩個水平方向的週期不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The real period depends on mass distribution, tube stiffness, setbacks and non-structural elements and should be computed by modal analysis and checked by ambient-vibration measurement after completion; each horizontal direction and the torsional mode must be identified separately, because the asymmetric upper bundle makes the two horizontal periods differ.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Code approximate-period formulas accurately predict the real period of a supertall tower." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若直接用經驗週期推算風致共振或阻尼需求，可能錯估臨界風速與加速度；忽略兩方向週期不同，則可能把兩個相近的模態誤判為一個，低估扭轉耦合。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「經驗週期公式與實測比對」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Empirical period formulas versus measurement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若直接用經驗週期推算風致共振或阻尼需求，可能錯估臨界風速與加速度；忽略兩方向週期不同，則可能把兩個相近的模態誤判為一個，低估扭轉耦合。
帷幕牆只負責防水與外觀，與主結構的受力無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using an empirical period to estimate wind resonance or damping needs can misjudge critical wind speed and acceleration.
The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 外牆隔熱與柱溫差變形：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Skin insulation and column thermal movement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外牆熱隔離與柱溫差」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Skin thermal isolation and column temperature” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SOM 說明黑色鋁皮與青銅色玻璃外牆把結構與室外隔開，使鋼構溫度相對穩定，減少框架的熱脹冷縮。芝加哥冬夏溫差大，若周邊柱直接暴露，外柱與恆溫室內的內部柱會產生顯著溫差，數百公尺高的柱列累積的長度差會讓上部樓板傾斜、隔間開裂並在樓板梁中產生附加力。外牆保溫與柱的防火被覆共同決定實際溫差，因此外牆改造時也要回頭檢核結構。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外牆熱隔離與柱溫差」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SOM explains that the black aluminium and bronze-tinted glass skin isolates the structure from outside temperature, keeping the steel relatively stable and limiting expansion and contraction of the frame. Chicago has large seasonal temperature swings; if perimeter columns were exposed, the difference between outer columns and interior columns in conditioned space would accumulate over hundreds of metres into length differences that tilt upper floors, crack partitions and induce forces in floor beams. Skin insulation and column fireproofing together set the actual temperature difference, so façade renovations must also be checked structurally. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Skin thermal isolation and column temperature” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柱長差 ΔL = αLΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Column length difference ΔL = αLΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆只負責防水與外觀，與主結構的受力無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外牆熱隔離與柱溫差」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Skin thermal isolation and column temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外牆熱隔離與柱溫差」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Skin thermal isolation and column temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柱長差 ΔL = αLΔT。L = 400 m、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C：外柱與內柱溫差 30 °C 時 ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×400,000×30 = 144 mm；外牆隔熱把溫差降到 5 °C 時 ΔL = 24 mm。若外柱到最近內柱距離 9 m，樓板坡度由 144/9,000 ≈ 1/63 降到 24/9,000 ≈ 1/375。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Column length difference ΔL = αLΔT. For L = 400 m and α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 30 °C difference between outer and inner columns gives ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×400,000×30 = 144 mm; insulating the skin to cut the difference to 5 °C gives ΔL = 24 mm. Over 9 m to the nearest interior column the floor slope falls from 144/9,000 ≈ 1/63 to 24/9,000 ≈ 1/375. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性外柱與內柱裝設溫度感測器，冬季與夏季各記錄數週，並在頂部樓層以精密水準量測外柱與內柱的相對高程變化，與溫差換算值比較；外牆維修時抽查保溫層連續性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install temperature sensors on representative exterior and interior columns, record for several weeks in winter and summer, and use precise levelling at upper floors to measure relative elevation changes between exterior and interior columns, comparing them with values computed from the temperature difference; spot-check insulation continuity during façade maintenance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

For L = 400 m and α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 30 °C difference between outer and inner columns gives ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×400,000×30 = 144 mm; insulating the skin to cut the difference to 5 °C gives ΔL = 24 mm. Over 9 m to the nearest interior column the floor slope falls from 144/9,000 ≈ 1/63 to 24/9,000 ≈ 1/375. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外牆隔熱與柱溫差變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Skin insulation and column thermal movement", which statement holds?
options: 柱長差 ΔL = αLΔT。
框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。
框管的側向勁度主要由柱子決定，裙梁大小影響不大。
optionsEn: Column length difference ΔL = αLΔT.
All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally.
A framed tube's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the columns; spandrel size hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 柱長差 ΔL = αLΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Column length difference ΔL = αLΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外牆隔熱與柱溫差變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Skin insulation and column thermal movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外牆熱隔離與柱溫差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Skin thermal isolation and column temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性外柱與內柱裝設溫度感測器，冬季與夏季各記錄數週，並在頂部樓層以精密水準量測外柱與內柱的相對高程變化，與溫差換算值比較；外牆維修時抽查保溫層連續性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install temperature sensors on representative exterior and interior columns, record for several weeks in winter and summer, and use precise levelling at upper floors to measure relative elevation changes between exterior and interior columns, comparing them with values computed from the temperature difference; spot-check insulation continuity during façade maintenance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外牆或節能改造的設計審查清單應包含柱溫度條件的變化評估，並由結構工程師簽認；交接文件中保留原設計採用的柱溫差假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design review checklist for façade or energy retrofits should include an assessment of changed column temperature conditions signed by the structural engineer, and handover documents should keep the original design assumption for column temperature difference.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：外牆改造時若拆除保溫或改用大面積透明玻璃而未評估柱溫差，上部樓板可能出現季節性傾斜、隔間與門框開裂，連接外柱與內部構件的梁端也會承受反覆溫度應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing insulation or switching to large clear glazing during a façade renovation without assessing column temperatures can cause seasonal floor tilt, cracked partitions and door frames, and cyclic thermal stresses at beam ends linking exterior and interior members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性外柱與內柱裝設溫度感測器，冬季與夏季各記錄數週，並在頂部樓層以精密水準量測外柱與內柱的相對高程變化，與溫差換算值比較；外牆維修時抽查保溫層連續性。
knowledge.textEn: Install temperature sensors on representative exterior and interior columns, record for several weeks in winter and summer, and use precise levelling at upper floors to measure relative elevation changes between exterior and interior columns, comparing them with values computed from the temperature difference; spot-check insulation continuity during façade maintenance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

knowledge.textEn: The design review checklist for façade or energy retrofits should include an assessment of changed column temperature conditions signed by the structural engineer, and handover documents should keep the original design assumption for column temperature difference.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外牆隔熱與柱溫差變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Skin insulation and column thermal movement"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在代表性外柱與內柱裝設溫度感測器，冬季與夏季各記錄數週，並在頂部樓層以精密水準量測外柱與內柱的相對高程變化，與溫差換算值比較；外牆維修時抽查保溫層連續性。
鋼構安裝速度只取決於塔吊數量與工人數量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Install temperature sensors on representative exterior and interior columns, record for several weeks in winter and summer, and use precise levelling at upper floors to measure relative elevation changes between exterior and interior columns, comparing them with values computed from the temperature difference.
Steel erection speed depends only on the number of cranes and workers.

quiz.explanationEn: Install temperature sensors on representative exterior and interior columns, record for several weeks in winter and summer, and use precise levelling at upper floors to measure relative elevation changes between exterior and interior columns, comparing them with values computed from the temperature difference; spot-check insulation continuity during façade maintenance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外牆隔熱與柱溫差變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Skin insulation and column thermal movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外牆熱隔離與柱溫差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Skin thermal isolation and column temperature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 外牆改造時若拆除保溫或改用大面積透明玻璃而未評估柱溫差，上部樓板可能出現季節性傾斜、隔間與門框開裂，連接外柱與內部構件的梁端也會承受反覆溫度應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing insulation or switching to large clear glazing during a façade renovation without assessing column temperatures can cause seasonal floor tilt, cracked partitions and door frames, and cyclic thermal stresses at beam ends linking exterior and interior members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：外牆保溫與柱的防火被覆共同決定實際溫差，因此外牆改造時也要回頭檢核結構。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Skin insulation and column fireproofing together set the actual temperature difference, so façade renovations must also be checked structurally.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆只負責防水與外觀，與主結構的受力無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The curtain wall is only for weather-tightness and appearance and has nothing to do with structural forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外牆隔熱與柱溫差變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

在承載中的鋼柱上焊接補強是沒有風險的例行作業。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Welding reinforcement onto a loaded steel column is a routine task with no risk.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「營運中改造的柱補強」與「改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Column strengthening during an occupied renovation" and "Tube load path and records during alteration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 營運中改造的柱補強：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Column strengthening during an occupied renovation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「既有柱的包覆補強」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Encasement strengthening of existing columns” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 2017 年起的底座改造在原廣場位置加建三層商業裙樓，約 20 根下層廣場鋼柱無法直接承受增加的樓層。可行處以焊接頭剪力釘於腹板後包覆混凝土，讓鋼柱與混凝土共同受壓；無法包覆處則在翼板焊上局部長度的補強板，並以分段（階梯式）構件檢核補強與未補強斷面。改造全程大樓持續營運，施工順序、臨時支撐與既有基礎容量都必須逐步確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「既有柱的包覆補強」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: From 2017 the base repositioning added a three-storey retail podium on the former plaza, and about 20 lower-level plaza columns could not carry the added floors as they were. Where possible, headed studs were welded to the column webs and the columns encased in concrete so steel and concrete share compression; where encasement was impossible, partial-length plates were welded to the flanges and the columns checked as stepped members with reinforced and unreinforced sections. The tower stayed open throughout, so sequencing, temporary support and existing foundation capacity had to be confirmed step by step. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Encasement strengthening of existing columns” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：包覆後軸壓強度 P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Encased squash capacity is P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「在承載中的鋼柱上焊接補強是沒有風險的例行作業。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Welding reinforcement onto a loaded steel column is a routine task with no risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Encasement strengthening of existing columns”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有柱的包覆補強」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Encasement strengthening of existing columns” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：包覆後軸壓強度 P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c。既有鋼柱 A_s = 0.0258 m²、F_y = 345 MPa，P_s ≈ 8.90 MN；包覆 0.6 m×0.6 m、f′c = 35 MPa，A_c = 0.36 − 0.0258 = 0.334 m²，混凝土貢獻 ≈ 0.85×35×0.334 ≈ 9.94 MN，合計約 18.8 MN，約為原鋼柱的 2.1 倍（未計長細比折減）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Encased squash capacity is P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c. An existing column with A_s = 0.0258 m² and F_y = 345 MPa gives P_s ≈ 8.90 MN; a 0.6 m×0.6 m encasement with f′c = 35 MPa has A_c = 0.36 − 0.0258 = 0.334 m² and adds about 0.85×35×0.334 ≈ 9.94 MN, about 18.8 MN in total, roughly 2.1 times the bare steel column before slenderness reduction. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：補強前以現場量測確認既有柱斷面與鋼材等級（必要時取樣試驗），剪力釘焊接做彎曲試驗抽驗，翼板補強焊道做磁粒或超音波檢測；新增荷載分階段施加時量測柱應變與基礎沉陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before strengthening, confirm existing column sections and steel grade by survey, with coupon testing if needed; bend-test a sample of welded studs and inspect flange-plate welds by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing; measure column strain and foundation settlement as new loads are applied in stages.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 包覆後軸壓強度 P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c。既有鋼柱 A_s = 0.0258 m²、F_y = 345 MPa，P_s ≈ 8.90 MN；包覆 0.6 m×0.6 m、f′c = 35 MPa，A_c = 0.36 − 0.0258 = 0.334 m²，混凝土貢獻 ≈ 0.85×35×0.334 ≈ 9.94 MN，合計約 18.8 MN，約為原鋼柱的 2.1 倍（未計長細比折減）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Encased squash capacity is P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c. An existing column with A_s = 0.0258 m² and F_y = 345 MPa gives P_s ≈ 8.90 MN; a 0.6 m×0.6 m encasement with f′c = 35 MPa has A_c = 0.36 − 0.0258 = 0.334 m² and adds about 0.85×35×0.334 ≈ 9.94 MN, about 18.8 MN in total, roughly 2.1 times the bare steel column before slenderness reduction. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「營運中改造的柱補強」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Column strengthening during an occupied renovation", which statement holds?
options: 收進只是為了造型與出租面積，對結構行為沒有影響。
包覆後軸壓強度 P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c。
樓板桁架只要強度足夠，剪力釘可以減量而不影響行為。
optionsEn: Setbacks serve only appearance and leasing and do not affect structural behaviour.
Encased squash capacity is P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c.
If the floor trusses are strong enough, shear studs can be reduced without affecting behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 包覆後軸壓強度 P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Encased squash capacity is P = A_sF_y + 0.85f′cA_c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 營運中改造的柱補強：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column strengthening during an occupied renovation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有柱的包覆補強」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Encasement strengthening of existing columns” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 補強前以現場量測確認既有柱斷面與鋼材等級（必要時取樣試驗），剪力釘焊接做彎曲試驗抽驗，翼板補強焊道做磁粒或超音波檢測；新增荷載分階段施加時量測柱應變與基礎沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before strengthening, confirm existing column sections and steel grade by survey, with coupon testing if needed; bend-test a sample of welded studs and inspect flange-plate welds by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing; measure column strain and foundation settlement as new loads are applied in stages. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對承載中構件的焊接須有專門的焊接程序與熱輸入限制、必要的臨時卸載或支撐，並把「包覆混凝土達到規定強度」列為施加新增荷載前的停留點，由結構工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Welding on loaded members requires a dedicated procedure with heat-input limits and temporary unloading or shoring where needed, and the encasement reaching its specified strength must be a hold point before new loads are applied, signed off by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在承載中的柱上焊接補強板，若熱輸入過大會使局部鋼材在高應力下軟化與變形；包覆混凝土若在新增荷載之前未達強度，荷載仍全部由鋼柱承受，補強效果打折扣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding plates onto a loaded column with excessive heat input can soften and distort the steel locally under high stress; if the encasement has not gained strength before new load arrives, the steel still carries it all and the strengthening is compromised. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 補強前以現場量測確認既有柱斷面與鋼材等級（必要時取樣試驗），剪力釘焊接做彎曲試驗抽驗，翼板補強焊道做磁粒或超音波檢測；新增荷載分階段施加時量測柱應變與基礎沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Before strengthening, confirm existing column sections and steel grade by survey, with coupon testing if needed; bend-test a sample of welded studs and inspect flange-plate welds by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing; measure column strain and foundation settlement as new loads are applied in stages.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對承載中構件的焊接須有專門的焊接程序與熱輸入限制、必要的臨時卸載或支撐，並把「包覆混凝土達到規定強度」列為施加新增荷載前的停留點，由結構工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Welding on loaded members requires a dedicated procedure with heat-input limits and temporary unloading or shoring where needed, and the encasement reaching its specified strength must be a hold point before new loads are applied, signed off by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「營運中改造的柱補強」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Column strengthening during an occupied renovation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
沉箱只要鑽到岩盤表面就能發揮全部承載力。
補強前以現場量測確認既有柱斷面與鋼材等級（必要時取樣試驗），剪力釘焊接做彎曲試驗抽驗，翼板補強焊道做磁粒或超音波檢測；新增荷載分階段施加時量測柱應變與基礎沉陷。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A caisson develops full capacity as soon as it touches the rock surface.
Before strengthening, confirm existing column sections and steel grade by survey, with coupon testing if needed.
quiz.explanation: 補強前以現場量測確認既有柱斷面與鋼材等級（必要時取樣試驗），剪力釘焊接做彎曲試驗抽驗，翼板補強焊道做磁粒或超音波檢測；新增荷載分階段施加時量測柱應變與基礎沉陷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before strengthening, confirm existing column sections and steel grade by survey, with coupon testing if needed; bend-test a sample of welded studs and inspect flange-plate welds by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing; measure column strain and foundation settlement as new loads are applied in stages. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 營運中改造的柱補強：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Column strengthening during an occupied renovation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有柱的包覆補強」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Encasement strengthening of existing columns” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在承載中的柱上焊接補強板，若熱輸入過大會使局部鋼材在高應力下軟化與變形；包覆混凝土若在新增荷載之前未達強度，荷載仍全部由鋼柱承受，補強效果打折扣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding plates onto a loaded column with excessive heat input can soften and distort the steel locally under high stress; if the encasement has not gained strength before new load arrives, the steel still carries it all and the strengthening is compromised. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改造全程大樓持續營運，施工順序、臨時支撐與既有基礎容量都必須逐步確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The tower stayed open throughout, so sequencing, temporary support and existing foundation capacity had to be confirmed step by step.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「在承載中的鋼柱上焊接補強是沒有風險的例行作業。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Welding reinforcement onto a loaded steel column is a routine task with no risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在承載中的柱上焊接補強板，若熱輸入過大會使局部鋼材在高應力下軟化與變形；包覆混凝土若在新增荷載之前未達強度，荷載仍全部由鋼柱承受，補強效果打折扣。
knowledge.textEn: Welding plates onto a loaded column with excessive heat input can soften and distort the steel locally under high stress; if the encasement has not gained strength before new load arrives, the steel still carries it all and the strengthening is compromised.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「營運中改造的柱補強」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Column strengthening during an occupied renovation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在承載中的柱上焊接補強板，若熱輸入過大會使局部鋼材在高應力下軟化與變形；包覆混凝土若在新增荷載之前未達強度，荷載仍全部由鋼柱承受，補強效果打折扣。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
裙梁只是外牆的支承梁，拆除後不影響柱的承載力。
optionsEn: Welding plates onto a loaded column with excessive heat input can soften and distort the steel locally under high stress.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Spandrels only support the façade, so removing one does not affect column capacity.
quiz.explanation: 在承載中的柱上焊接補強板，若熱輸入過大會使局部鋼材在高應力下軟化與變形；包覆混凝土若在新增荷載之前未達強度，荷載仍全部由鋼柱承受，補強效果打折扣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Welding plates onto a loaded column with excessive heat input can soften and distort the steel locally under high stress; if the encasement has not gained strength before new load arrives, the steel still carries it all and the strengthening is compromised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tube load path and records during alteration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「入口裙梁更換與柱無側撐長度」如何影響威利斯大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Entrance spandrel replacement and column bracing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Willis Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 改造時為了新設由街道到二樓的樓梯，三根 42 in 深的組合裙梁與樓梯衝突而被降低、拆除並以新的組合鋼板梁取代。公開資料指出這中斷了框管的傳力路徑，因此在相鄰的 110 層通高巨柱上加設局部補強，並依三維塔樓模型訂定拆除與替換順序。裙梁不只抵抗側力，也為柱提供側向支撐；拆除後柱的無側撐長度變長，受壓挫屈強度隨之下降，必須在替換完成前以臨時支撐補足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「入口裙梁更換與柱無側撐長度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: To create a new stair from the street to level two, three 42 in deep built-up spandrels that clashed with it were lowered, removed and replaced with new built-up plate girders. Public sources note that this interrupted the tube's load path, so local reinforcing was added to the adjacent full-height columns, and the demolition and replacement sequence followed a three-dimensional tower model. Spandrels do not only resist lateral load; they also brace the columns, so removing them lengthens the unbraced length and reduces buckling strength, which must be made up with temporary bracing until replacement is complete. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Entrance spandrel replacement and column bracing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：AISC 柱強度：A = 0.0488 m²、I = 5.37×10⁻⁴ m⁴、F_y = 345 MPa、P_y ≈ 16,840 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: AISC column strength with A = 0.0488 m², I = 5.37×10⁻⁴ m⁴ and F_y = 345 MPa gives P_y ≈ 16,840 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裙梁只是外牆的支承梁，拆除後不影響柱的承載力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spandrels only support the façade, so removing one does not affect column capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「入口裙梁更換與柱無側撐長度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Entrance spandrel replacement and column bracing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄
knowledge.titleEn: Tube load path and records during alteration
knowledge.text: 改造時為了新設由街道到二樓的樓梯，三根 42 in 深的組合裙梁與樓梯衝突而被降低、拆除並以新的組合鋼板梁取代。公開資料指出這中斷了框管的傳力路徑，因此在相鄰的 110 層通高巨柱上加設局部補強，並依三維塔樓模型訂定拆除與替換順序。
knowledge.textEn: To create a new stair from the street to level two, three 42 in deep built-up spandrels that clashed with it were lowered, removed and replaced with new built-up plate girders. Public sources note that this interrupted the tube's load path, so local reinforcing was added to the adjacent full-height columns, and the demolition and replacement sequence followed a three-dimensional tower model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裙梁只是外牆的支承梁，拆除後不影響柱的承載力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Spandrels only support the façade, so removing one does not affect column capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tube load path and records during alteration" is correct?
options: 裙梁只是外牆的支承梁，拆除後不影響柱的承載力。
改造時為了新設由街道到二樓的樓梯，三根 42 in 深的組合裙梁與樓梯衝突而被降低、拆除並以新的組合鋼板梁取代。
框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。
optionsEn: Spandrels only support the façade, so removing one does not affect column capacity.
To create a new stair from the street to level two, three 42 in deep built-up spandrels that clashed with it were lowered, removed and replaced with new built-up plate girders.
All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally.
quiz.explanation: 改造時為了新設由街道到二樓的樓梯，三根 42 in 深的組合裙梁與樓梯衝突而被降低、拆除並以新的組合鋼板梁取代。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: To create a new stair from the street to level two, three 42 in deep built-up spandrels that clashed with it were lowered, removed and replaced with new built-up plate girders. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tube load path and records during alteration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口裙梁更換與柱無側撐長度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Entrance spandrel replacement and column bracing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：AISC 柱強度：A = 0.0488 m²、I = 5.37×10⁻⁴ m⁴、F_y = 345 MPa、P_y ≈ 16,840 kN。無側撐長 3.91 m 時 P_e ≈ 69,300 kN，P_y/P_e ≈ 0.243，P_n = 0.658^0.243×P_y ≈ 15,200 kN；裙梁拆除使長度變 7.82 m，P_e ≈ 17,300 kN，P_y/P_e ≈ 0.971，P_n ≈ 11,200 kN，下降約 26%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: AISC column strength with A = 0.0488 m², I = 5.37×10⁻⁴ m⁴ and F_y = 345 MPa gives P_y ≈ 16,840 kN. At a 3.91 m unbraced length P_e ≈ 69,300 kN, P_y/P_e ≈ 0.243 and P_n = 0.658^0.243×P_y ≈ 15,200 kN; removing a spandrel doubles the length to 7.82 m, P_e ≈ 17,300 kN, P_y/P_e ≈ 0.971 and P_n ≈ 11,200 kN, about 26% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：拆除前以三維模型檢核每個拆除步驟的柱與相鄰構件需求容量比，臨時支撐安裝並驗收後才可切割；施工期間量測相鄰柱應變與垂直度，新裙梁接合完成並檢驗後才拆除臨時支撐，最後更新竣工圖與結構模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before demolition, check demand-to-capacity ratios of columns and adjacent members for every removal step in the three-dimensional model, and cut only after temporary bracing is installed and accepted; during the work monitor strain and plumbness of adjacent columns, remove temporary bracing only after the new spandrel connections are completed and inspected, then update the as-built drawings and structural model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

At a 3.91 m unbraced length P_e ≈ 69,300 kN, P_y/P_e ≈ 0.243 and P_n = 0.658^0.243×P_y ≈ 15,200 kN; removing a spandrel doubles the length to 7.82 m, P_e ≈ 17,300 kN, P_y/P_e ≈ 0.971 and P_n ≈ 11,200 kN, about 26% less. steps.title: 改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tube load path and records during alteration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口裙梁更換與柱無側撐長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Entrance spandrel replacement and column bracing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 拆除前以三維模型檢核每個拆除步驟的柱與相鄰構件需求容量比，臨時支撐安裝並驗收後才可切割；施工期間量測相鄰柱應變與垂直度，新裙梁接合完成並檢驗後才拆除臨時支撐，最後更新竣工圖與結構模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before demolition, check demand-to-capacity ratios of columns and adjacent members for every removal step in the three-dimensional model, and cut only after temporary bracing is installed and accepted; during the work monitor strain and plumbness of adjacent columns, remove temporary bracing only after the new spandrel connections are completed and inspected, then update the as-built drawings and structural model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運中大樓的結構拆除必須有逐步的施工階段分析與臨時支撐計畫，切割作業列為停留點；完工後把變更寫入結構紀錄、竣工圖與模型，作為交接給物業管理與未來改造團隊的正式文件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural demolition in an occupied tower requires step-by-step construction-stage analysis and a temporary bracing plan, with every cut treated as a hold point; afterwards record the change in the structural log, as-built drawings and model as the formal handover to facility management and future renovation teams.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若先切除裙梁再補臨時支撐，柱在短時間內處於較長的無側撐狀態，遇到強風或施工荷載可能側向挫屈；改造後若竣工圖未更新，下一次改造的團隊會以錯誤的傳力路徑做評估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting the spandrel before installing temporary bracing leaves the column unbraced over a longer length for a while, and strong wind or construction loads could buckle it; if as-built drawings are not updated afterward, the next renovation team will assess an incorrect load path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tube load path and records during alteration"?

規範的近似週期公式可以準確預測超高層的實際振動週期。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tube load path and records during alteration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入口裙梁更換與柱無側撐長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Entrance spandrel replacement and column bracing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若先切除裙梁再補臨時支撐，柱在短時間內處於較長的無側撐狀態，遇到強風或施工荷載可能側向挫屈；改造後若竣工圖未更新，下一次改造的團隊會以錯誤的傳力路徑做評估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting the spandrel before installing temporary bracing leaves the column unbraced over a longer length for a while, and strong wind or construction loads could buckle it; if as-built drawings are not updated afterward, the next renovation team will assess an incorrect load path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：裙梁不只抵抗側力，也為柱提供側向支撐；拆除後柱的無側撐長度變長，受壓挫屈強度隨之下降，必須在替換完成前以臨時支撐補足。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Spandrels do not only resist lateral load; they also brace the columns, so removing them lengthens the unbraced length and reduces buckling strength, which must be made up with temporary bracing until replacement is complete.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裙梁只是外牆的支承梁，拆除後不影響柱的承載力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Spandrels only support the façade, so removing one does not affect column capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改造中的管筒傳力路徑與交接紀錄」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tube load path and records during alteration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若先切除裙梁再補臨時支撐，柱在短時間內處於較長的無側撐狀態，遇到強風或施工荷載可能側向挫屈；改造後若竣工圖未更新，下一次改造的團隊會以錯誤的傳力路徑做評估。
框管結構所有周邊柱都均勻分擔傾覆力矩產生的軸力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Cutting the spandrel before installing temporary bracing leaves the column unbraced over a longer length for a while, and strong wind or construction loads could buckle it.
All perimeter columns of a framed tube share the overturning axial force equally.
quiz.explanation: 若先切除裙梁再補臨時支撐，柱在短時間內處於較長的無側撐狀態，遇到強風或施工荷載可能側向挫屈；改造後若竣工圖未更新，下一次改造的團隊會以錯誤的傳力路徑做評估。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 香港環球貿易廣場
summary: 環球貿易廣場高 484 m、地上 108 層（樓層編號至 118），坐落在西九龍填海區的九龍站上方。結構以鋼筋混凝土核心筒、八根巨柱與四道外伸臂組成，最低一道為預力混凝土外伸臂，其餘三道為鋼構；凹角平面與上部 1° 內傾減弱颱風下的渦流激振，巨柱在底部外撇約 3°。岩盤深約 70 至 130 m 且起伏如懸崖，因此改用平均深約 70 m 的灌漿摩擦型壁樁。本課從颱風風荷載、外伸臂、預力與外撇巨柱，到壁樁施工、高空風速管控、風洞縮尺、載重試驗、海埔地耐久與颱風後交接。
summaryEn: The International Commerce Centre is 484 m tall with 108 storeys above ground (numbered to 118), standing over Kowloon Station on West Kowloon reclamation. Its structure combines a reinforced-concrete core, eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels, the lowest in prestressed concrete and the other three in steel; notched corners and a 1° inward lean of the upper façades weaken typhoon vortex excitation, and the mega-columns splay outward about 3° at the base. With bedrock about 70 to 130 m down in a cliff-like profile, shaft-grouted friction barrettes averaging about 70 m deep were used. The course runs from typhoon wind, outriggers, prestress and splayed columns to barrette construction, wind control at height, wind-tunnel scaling, load testing, durability on reclaimed land and post-typhoon handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
