workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算颱風下外伸臂傳給巨柱的軸力變化。以第 1 單元凹角平面的基座力矩 M = 2.2×1.5×60×484²/2 ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m 為例，假設外伸臂把其中 40% 轉成巨柱的拉壓力偶，M_o ≈ 9.28×10⁶ kN·m。兩側巨柱群力臂 d = 50 m、每側 4 根巨柱，每根巨柱軸力變化 ΔP = M_o/(d×4) = 9.28×10⁶/(50×4) ≈ 46,400 kN。若每根巨柱的重力軸力為 250,000 kN，迎風側巨柱的壓力只減少約 18.6%，不會出現淨拉力；若外伸臂分擔提高到 60%，ΔP ≈ 69,600 kN（約 27.8%），仍維持受壓，但外伸臂與巨柱接頭的設計力同比例增加，長期差異縮短造成的附加力也必須一併檢核。數值為教學假設，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the change in mega-column axial force delivered by outriggers under typhoon wind. Take the notched-plan base moment from unit 1, M = 2.2×1.5×60×484²/2 ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m, and assume the outriggers convert 40% of it into a column couple, M_o ≈ 9.28×10⁶ kN·m. With a lever arm d = 50 m between column groups and four mega-columns per side, each column's axial force changes by ΔP = M_o/(d×4) = 9.28×10⁶/(50×4) ≈ 46,400 kN. If each column carries 250,000 kN of gravity, the windward columns lose only about 18.6% of their compression and never go into net tension; raising the outrigger share to 60% gives ΔP ≈ 69,600 kN (about 27.8%), still in compression, but outrigger and joint design forces rise in proportion and the added forces from long-term differential shortening must be checked as well. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」與「巨柱—外伸臂系統的轉動勁度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Typhoon wind and the notched plan" and "Rotational stiffness of the mega-column–outrigger system": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與凹角平面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind and the notched plan: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「凹角方形平面」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Notched square plan” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 香港位於颱風路徑上，超高層的設計風速與紊流由颱風氣候控制，橫風向的渦流激振往往比順風向更影響舒適度。環球貿易廣場採方形平面並在四角做凹角，凹角向上逐漸加寬，上部三分之一的主立面再向內傾斜 1°；公開資料指出初步風洞研究顯示此形狀的風反應接近圓形斷面。凹角讓角隅分離流提早重新附著或被打散，降低橫風向升力的強度與規律性，同時減少整體阻力係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「凹角方形平面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hong Kong lies on typhoon tracks, so design wind speed and turbulence for supertall towers are governed by typhoon climate, and across-wind vortex excitation often matters more for comfort than along-wind response. The tower has a square plan with notched corners that widen toward the top, and the main façades of the upper third lean inward by 1°; public sources report that preliminary wind-tunnel studies found the shape's wind response close to that of a circle. The notches make corner separation reattach earlier or break up, reducing the strength and regularity of across-wind lift and lowering the overall drag coefficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Notched square plan” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：基座力矩 M = q·C_f·B·H²/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Base moment M = q·C_f·B·H²/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「凹角只是建築語彙，與颱風下的結構反應無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Notched corners are an architectural motif with no bearing on typhoon response." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「凹角方形平面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Notched square plan”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 颱風風荷載與凹角平面
knowledge.titleEn: Typhoon wind and the notched plan
knowledge.text: 香港位於颱風路徑上，超高層的設計風速與紊流由颱風氣候控制，橫風向的渦流激振往往比順風向更影響舒適度。環球貿易廣場採方形平面並在四角做凹角，凹角向上逐漸加寬，上部三分之一的主立面再向內傾斜 1°；公開資料指出初步風洞研究顯示此形狀的風反應接近圓形斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Hong Kong lies on typhoon tracks, so design wind speed and turbulence for supertall towers are governed by typhoon climate, and across-wind vortex excitation often matters more for comfort than along-wind response. The tower has a square plan with notched corners that widen toward the top, and the main façades of the upper third lean inward by 1°; public sources report that preliminary wind-tunnel studies found the shape's wind response close to that of a circle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：凹角只是建築語彙，與颱風下的結構反應無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Notched corners are an architectural motif with no bearing on typhoon response. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Typhoon wind and the notched plan" is correct?
options: 凹角只是建築語彙，與颱風下的結構反應無關。
香港位於颱風路徑上，超高層的設計風速與紊流由颱風氣候控制，橫風向的渦流激振往往比順風向更影響舒適度。
外伸臂的效果主要來自外伸臂桁架本身的強度。
optionsEn: Notched corners are an architectural motif with no bearing on typhoon response.

Hong Kong lies on typhoon tracks, so design wind speed and turbulence for supertall towers are governed by typhoon climate, and across-wind vortex excitation often matters more for comfort than along-wind response.
Outrigger effectiveness comes mainly from the strength of the outrigger truss itself.
quiz.explanation: 香港位於颱風路徑上，超高層的設計風速與紊流由颱風氣候控制，橫風向的渦流激振往往比順風向更影響舒適度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hong Kong lies on typhoon tracks, so design wind speed and turbulence for supertall towers are governed by typhoon climate, and across-wind vortex excitation often matters more for comfort than along-wind response. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與凹角平面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind and the notched plan: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「凹角方形平面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Notched square plan” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：基座力矩 M = q·C_f·B·H²/2。取 q = 2.2 kPa、B = 60 m、H = 484 m：方角 C_f = 2.0 時 M ≈ 3.09×10⁷ kN·m；凹角使 C_f 降為 1.5 時 M ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m，約減少 25%。數值為教學假設，未計高度變化與動力放大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Base moment M = q·C_f·B·H²/2. With q = 2.2 kPa, B = 60 m and H = 484 m, sharp corners with C_f = 2.0 give M ≈ 3.09×10⁷ kN·m, while notched corners lowering C_f to 1.5 give M ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m, about 25% less. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring height variation and dynamic amplification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較方角、凹角與不同凹角尺寸的剛性模型風洞試驗結果，檢查各風向的平均與擾動力矩、橫風向力頻譜峰值與頂部加速度；並確認風洞採用的颱風風速剖面與紊流強度符合香港風力規範的要求或經認可的颱風氣候研究。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rigid-model wind-tunnel results for sharp corners, notched corners and several notch sizes, checking mean and fluctuating moments by direction, the peak of the across-wind force spectrum and top acceleration; confirm that the typhoon wind profile and turbulence used match the Hong Kong wind code or an accepted typhoon-climate study.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 基座力矩 M = q·C_f·B·H²/2。取 q = 2.2 kPa、B = 60 m、H = 484 m：方角 C_f = 2.0 時 M ≈ 3.09×10⁷ kN·m；凹角使 C_f 降為 1.5 時 M ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m，約減少 25%。數值為教學假設，未計高度變化與動力放大。
knowledge.textEn: Base moment M = q·C_f·B·H²/2. With q = 2.2 kPa, B = 60 m and H = 484 m, sharp corners with C_f = 2.0 give M ≈ 3.09×10⁷ kN·m, while notched corners lowering C_f to 1.5 give M ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m, about 25% less. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring height variation and dynamic amplification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Typhoon wind and the notched plan", which statement holds?
options: 傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。
地面風速不大時，高空施工面的風也一樣小。
基座力矩 M = q·C_f·B·H²/2。
optionsEn: Inclined columns carry only axial force and impose nothing extra on the floors.
If ground-level wind is light, wind at the high working face is light too.
Base moment M = q·C_f·B·H²/2.
quiz.explanation: 基座力矩 M = q·C_f·B·H²/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Base moment M = q·C_f·B·H²/2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與凹角平面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind and the notched plan: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「凹角方形平面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Notched square plan” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較方角、凹角與不同凹角尺寸的剛性模型風洞試驗結果，檢查各風向的平均與擾動力矩、橫風向力頻譜峰值與頂部加速度；並確認風洞採用的颱風風速剖面與紊流強度符合香港風力規範的要求或經認可的颱風氣候研究。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare rigid-model wind-tunnel results for sharp corners, notched corners and several notch sizes, checking mean and fluctuating moments by direction, the peak of the across-wind force spectrum and top acceleration; confirm that the typhoon wind profile and turbulence used match the Hong Kong wind code or an accepted typhoon-climate study. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建築外形在風洞試驗後若有任何角隅、退縮或頂部造型變更，都要由風工程顧問書面評估是否需要重做試驗，並把結論附入設計基準報告。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: After the wind-tunnel test, any change to corners, setbacks or crown geometry requires a written assessment by the wind consultant on whether retesting is needed, attached to the design basis report.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依規範靜力公式設計而未做風洞，可能忽略特定颱風風向的橫風向共振，完工後在八號以上颱風信號時頂層擺動明顯；凹角若在設計後期被縮小，原有風洞結論就不再適用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only with code static formulas and no wind tunnel can miss across-wind resonance for particular typhoon directions, leading to noticeable top-floor motion under signal No. 8 or higher; if the notches are reduced late in design, the original wind-tunnel conclusions no longer apply. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較方角、凹角與不同凹角尺寸的剛性模型風洞試驗結果，檢查各風向的平均與擾動力矩、橫風向力頻譜峰值與頂部加速度；並確認風洞採用的颱風風速剖面與紊流強度符合香港風力規範的要求或經認可的颱風氣候研究。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rigid-model wind-tunnel results for sharp corners, notched corners and several notch sizes, checking mean and fluctuating moments by direction, the peak of the across-wind force spectrum and top acceleration; confirm that the typhoon wind profile and turbulence used match the Hong Kong wind code or an accepted typhoon-climate study.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建築外形在風洞試驗後若有任何角隅、退縮或頂部造型變更，都要由風工程顧問書面評估是否需要重做試驗，並把結論附入設計基準報告。
knowledge.textEn: After the wind-tunnel test, any change to corners, setbacks or crown geometry requires a written assessment by the wind consultant on whether retesting is needed, attached to the design basis report.

quiz.question: 要驗證「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Typhoon wind and the notched plan"?
options: 比較方角、凹角與不同凹角尺寸的剛性模型風洞試驗結果，檢查各風向的平均與擾動力矩、橫風向力頻譜峰值與頂部加速度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。
optionsEn: Compare rigid-model wind-tunnel results for sharp corners, notched corners and several notch sizes, checking mean and fluctuating moments by direction, the peak of the across-wind force spectrum and top acceleration.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides.
quiz.explanation: 比較方角、凹角與不同凹角尺寸的剛性模型風洞試驗結果，檢查各風向的平均與擾動力矩、橫風向力頻譜峰值與頂部加速度；並確認風洞採用的颱風風速剖面與紊流強度符合香港風力規範的要求或經認可的颱風氣候研究。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare rigid-model wind-tunnel results for sharp corners, notched corners and several notch sizes, checking mean and fluctuating moments by direction, the peak of the across-wind force spectrum and top acceleration; confirm that the typhoon wind profile and turbulence used match the Hong Kong wind code or an accepted typhoon-climate study. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 颱風風荷載與凹角平面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Typhoon wind and the notched plan: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「凹角方形平面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Notched square plan” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依規範靜力公式設計而未做風洞，可能忽略特定颱風風向的橫風向共振，完工後在八號以上颱風信號時頂層擺動明顯；凹角若在設計後期被縮小，原有風洞結論就不再適用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only with code static formulas and no wind tunnel can miss across-wind resonance for particular typhoon directions, leading to noticeable top-floor motion under signal No. 8 or higher; if the notches are reduced late in design, the original wind-tunnel conclusions no longer apply. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：凹角讓角隅分離流提早重新附著或被打散，降低橫風向升力的強度與規律性，同時減少整體阻力係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The notches make corner separation reattach earlier or break up, reducing the strength and regularity of across-wind lift and lowering the overall drag coefficient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「凹角只是建築語彙，與颱風下的結構反應無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Notched corners are an architectural motif with no bearing on typhoon response." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依規範靜力公式設計而未做風洞，可能忽略特定颱風風向的橫風向共振，完工後在八號以上颱風信號時頂層擺動明顯；凹角若在設計後期被縮小，原有風洞結論就不再適用。
knowledge.textEn: Designing only with code static formulas and no wind tunnel can miss across-wind resonance for particular typhoon directions, leading to noticeable top-floor motion under signal No. 8 or higher; if the notches are reduced late in design, the original wind-tunnel conclusions no longer apply.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Typhoon wind and the notched plan" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只依規範靜力公式設計而未做風洞，可能忽略特定颱風風向的橫風向共振，完工後在八號以上颱風信號時頂層擺動明顯；凹角若在設計後期被縮小，原有風洞結論就不再適用。
外伸臂的效果主要來自外伸臂桁架本身的強度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing only with code static formulas and no wind tunnel can miss across-wind resonance for particular typhoon directions, leading to noticeable top-floor motion under signal No. 8 or higher.
Outrigger effectiveness comes mainly from the strength of the outrigger truss itself.
quiz.explanation: 若只依規範靜力公式設計而未做風洞，可能忽略特定颱風風向的橫風向共振，完工後在八號以上颱風信號時頂層擺動明顯；凹角若在設計後期被縮小，原有風洞結論就不再適用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing only with code static formulas and no wind tunnel can miss across-wind resonance for particular typhoon directions, leading to noticeable top-floor motion under signal No. 8 or higher; if the notches are reduced late in design, the original wind-tunnel conclusions no longer apply. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 巨柱—外伸臂系統的轉動勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotational stiffness of the mega-column–outrigger system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「八根巨柱與四道外伸臂」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出 Leslie E. Robertson 在概念階段提出以八根巨柱圍成「方形甜甜圈」平面，鋼筋混凝土核心筒居中，外伸臂桁架在四個樓層把核心筒與巨柱相連。核心筒在側力下彎曲轉動時，外伸臂迫使巨柱一側伸長、一側縮短，巨柱的軸向勁度乘上力臂平方，就成為抵抗核心轉動的彈簧；八根巨柱位於最外圍，力臂最大，因此用相對少的材料取得高轉動勁度，同時讓周邊樓層保有開闊的視野與跨度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「八根巨柱與四道外伸臂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources state that Leslie E. Robertson proposed at concept stage a square-donut plan of eight mega-columns with the reinforced-concrete core at its centre, connected by outrigger trusses at four levels. When the core bends and rotates under lateral load, the outriggers stretch columns on one side and shorten those on the other; the columns' axial stiffness multiplied by the square of the lever arm becomes a spring resisting core rotation. Because the eight mega-columns sit at the outer edge, their lever arm is largest, giving high rotational stiffness for relatively little material while keeping perimeter floors open with long spans. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：巨柱對外伸臂的轉動勁度 K_θ = 2(EA/L)(d/2)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The rotational stiffness the columns give an outrigger is K_θ = 2(EA/L)(d/2)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂的效果主要來自外伸臂桁架本身的強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Outrigger effectiveness comes mainly from the strength of the outrigger truss itself." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「八根巨柱與四道外伸臂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 巨柱—外伸臂系統的轉動勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotational stiffness of the mega-column–outrigger system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「八根巨柱與四道外伸臂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：巨柱對外伸臂的轉動勁度 K_θ = 2(EA/L)(d/2)²。取巨柱 A = 8 m²、E = 36 GPa、外伸臂以下柱長 L = 200 m、兩側柱距 d = 50 m：EA/L = 1.44×10⁶ kN/m，K_θ = 2×1.44×10⁶×25² = 1.8×10⁹ kN·m/rad；核心筒 EI/L 以 I = 3,000 m⁴ 計為 5.4×10⁸ kN·m/rad，巨柱提供約 3.3 倍的轉動約束。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The rotational stiffness the columns give an outrigger is K_θ = 2(EA/L)(d/2)². With A = 8 m², E = 36 GPa, a column length below the outrigger L = 200 m and a spacing d = 50 m, EA/L = 1.44×10⁶ kN/m and K_θ = 2×1.44×10⁶×25² = 1.8×10⁹ kN·m/rad; the core's EI/L with I = 3,000 m⁴ is 5.4×10⁸ kN·m/rad, so the columns supply about 3.3 times the rotational restraint. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在分析模型中分別計算有無各道外伸臂時的頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒彎矩，確認四道外伸臂的位置效益；並以巨柱實際軸向勁度（含潛變與開裂後的有效值）做敏感度分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the analysis model compute top drift, inter-storey drift and core moment with and without each outrigger level to confirm the benefit of each location, and run sensitivity studies with realistic mega-column axial stiffness including creep and effective cracked values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 巨柱對外伸臂的轉動勁度 K_θ = 2(EA/L)(d/2)²。取巨柱 A = 8 m²、E = 36 GPa、外伸臂以下柱長 L = 200 m、兩側柱距 d = 50 m：EA/L = 1.44×10⁶ kN/m，K_θ = 2×1.44×10⁶×25² = 1.8×10⁹ kN·m/rad；核心筒 EI/L 以 I = 3,000 m⁴ 計為 5.4×10⁸ kN·m/rad，巨柱提供約 3.3 倍的轉動約束。數值為教學假設。

With A = 8 m², E = 36 GPa, a column length below the outrigger L = 200 m and a spacing d = 50 m, EA/L = 1.44×10⁶ kN/m and K_θ = 2×1.44×10⁶×25² = 1.8×10⁹ kN·m/rad; the core's EI/L with I = 3,000 m⁴ is 5.4×10⁸ kN·m/rad, so the columns supply about 3.3 times the rotational restraint. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 巨柱—外伸臂系統的轉動勁度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotational stiffness of the mega-column–outrigger system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「八根巨柱與四道外伸臂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在分析模型中分別計算有無各道外伸臂時的頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒彎矩，確認四道外伸臂的位置效益；並以巨柱實際軸向勁度（含潛變與開裂後的有效值）做敏感度分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the analysis model compute top drift, inter-storey drift and core moment with and without each outrigger level to confirm the benefit of each location, and run sensitivity studies with realistic mega-column axial stiffness including creep and effective cracked values. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外伸臂樓層應與避難層和機電層整合，並在設計文件中列出每道外伸臂的勁度假設、巨柱有效勁度與長期附加力，作為施工鎖定時機與日後監測的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Integrate outrigger levels with refuge and plant floors, and record for each outrigger the stiffness assumption, effective mega-column stiffness and long-term added forces as the basis for locking time and later monitoring.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若巨柱有效軸向勁度因潛變或開裂而低於假設，外伸臂的效果打折，頂部變位與加速度上升；外伸臂與巨柱接頭若未設計長期差異縮短造成的附加力，可能在多年後開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If mega-column effective axial stiffness falls below the assumption because of creep or cracking, outrigger effectiveness drops and top drift and acceleration rise; joints between outriggers and mega-columns not designed for long-term differential-shortening forces may crack years later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 巨柱—外伸臂系統的轉動勁度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotational stiffness of the mega-column–outrigger system: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「八根巨柱與四道外伸臂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若巨柱有效軸向勁度因潛變或開裂而低於假設，外伸臂的效果打折，頂部變位與加速度上升；外伸臂與巨柱接頭若未設計長期差異縮短造成的附加力，可能在多年後開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If mega-column effective axial stiffness falls below the assumption because of creep or cracking, outrigger effectiveness drops and top drift and acceleration rise; joints between outriggers and mega-columns not designed for long-term differential-shortening forces may crack years later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：核心筒在側力下彎曲轉動時，外伸臂迫使巨柱一側伸長、一側縮短，巨柱的軸向勁度乘上力臂平方，就成為抵抗核心轉動的彈簧；八根巨柱位於最外圍，力臂最大，因此用相對少的材料取得高轉動勁度，同時讓周邊樓層保有開闊的視野與跨度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the eight mega-columns sit at the outer edge, their lever arm is largest, giving high rotational stiffness for relatively little material while keeping perimeter floors open with long spans.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸臂的效果主要來自外伸臂桁架本身的強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Outrigger effectiveness comes mainly from the strength of the outrigger truss itself." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

預力只是用來增加構件的強度。
若巨柱有效軸向勁度因潛變或開裂而低於假設，外伸臂的效果打折，頂部變位與加速度上升；外伸臂與巨柱接頭若未設計長期差異縮短造成的附加力，可能在多年後開裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Prestress is only used to increase member strength.
If mega-column effective axial stiffness falls below the assumption because of creep or cracking, outrigger effectiveness drops and top drift and acceleration rise.
quiz.explanation: 若巨柱有效軸向勁度因潛變或開裂而低於假設，外伸臂的效果打折，頂部變位與加速度上升；外伸臂與巨柱接頭若未設計長期差異縮短造成的附加力，可能在多年後開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If mega-column effective axial stiffness falls below the assumption because of creep or cracking, outrigger effectiveness drops and top drift and acceleration rise; joints between outriggers and mega-columns not designed for long-term differential-shortening forces may crack years later. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂」與「外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete" and "Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預力混凝土外伸臂」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prestressed concrete outrigger” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出四道外伸臂中最低的一道採預力混凝土，其餘三道為鋼構。低樓層的外伸臂承受的力最大，若以鋼筋混凝土承受反覆拉力，會開裂並降低勁度；施加預力讓構件在常時與設計風荷載下保持受壓或拉應力很小，裂縫受到控制，勁度較穩定，也與周邊混凝土核心牆與巨柱的材料行為較一致。代價是預力損失、錨定區局部應力與施工順序都需要仔細規劃。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預力混凝土外伸臂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources state that the lowest of the four outriggers is prestressed concrete while the other three are steel. The lowest outrigger carries the largest forces; reinforced concrete under reversing tension would crack and lose stiffness, whereas prestress keeps the member in compression or low tension under service and design wind loads, controlling cracks, stabilising stiffness and matching the behaviour of the surrounding concrete core and columns. The price is careful planning of prestress losses, local stresses in anchorage zones and construction sequence. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Prestressed concrete outrigger” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：外伸臂拉桿在設計風荷載下拉力 T = 30 MN，施加有效預力 P = 36 MN 後淨壓力 P − T = 6 MN；斷面 8 m² 時剩餘壓應力 6/8 = 0.75 MPa，預力本身平均壓應力 36/8 = 4.5 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An outrigger tie carrying T = 30 MN under design wind with an effective prestress P = 36 MN keeps a net compression of P − T = 6 MN; over an 8 m² section the residual compression is 6/8 = 0.75 MPa, and the prestress alone averages 36/8 = 4.5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力只是用來增加構件的強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Prestress is only used to increase member strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預力混凝土外伸臂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Prestressed concrete outrigger”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂
knowledge.titleEn: The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出四道外伸臂中最低的一道採預力混凝土，其餘三道為鋼構。低樓層的外伸臂承受的力最大，若以鋼筋混凝土承受反覆拉力，會開裂並降低勁度；施加預力讓構件在常時與設計風荷載下保持受壓或拉應力很小，裂縫受到控制，勁度較穩定，也與周邊混凝土核心牆與巨柱的材料行為較一致。
knowledge.textEn: Public sources state that the lowest of the four outriggers is prestressed concrete while the other three are steel. The lowest outrigger carries the largest forces; reinforced concrete under reversing tension would crack and lose stiffness, whereas prestress keeps the member in compression or low tension under service and design wind loads, controlling cracks, stabilising stiffness and matching the behaviour of the surrounding concrete core and columns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預力只是用來增加構件的強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Prestress is only used to increase member strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete" is correct?
options: 公開資料指出四道外伸臂中最低的一道採預力混凝土，其餘三道為鋼構。
預力只是用來增加構件的強度。
傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。
optionsEn: Public sources state that the lowest of the four outriggers is prestressed concrete while the other three are steel.
Prestress is only used to increase member strength.
Inclined columns carry only axial force and impose nothing extra on the floors.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出四道外伸臂中最低的一道採預力混凝土，其餘三道為鋼構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public sources state that the lowest of the four outriggers is prestressed concrete while the other three are steel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預力混凝土外伸臂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Prestressed concrete outrigger” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：外伸臂拉桿在設計風荷載下拉力 T = 30 MN，施加有效預力 P = 36 MN 後淨壓力 P − T = 6 MN；斷面 8 m² 時剩餘壓應力 6/8 = 0.75 MPa，預力本身平均壓應力 36/8 = 4.5 MPa。若長期預力損失 15%，P_eff = 30.6 MN，淨壓力只剩 0.6 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An outrigger tie carrying T = 30 MN under design wind with an effective prestress P = 36 MN keeps a net compression of P − T = 6 MN; over an 8 m² section the residual compression is 6/8 = 0.75 MPa, and the prestress alone averages 36/8 = 4.5 MPa. A 15% long-term loss leaves P_eff = 30.6 MN and a net compression of only 0.6 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預力施拉時同時記錄千斤頂壓力與鋼腱伸長量，兩者換算的力差應在規定允差內（例如 ±5%）；錨定區依設計配置螺旋筋與格網筋並在澆置前檢查；之後以長期監測或試驗估算預力損失，與設計假設比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During stressing record jack pressure and tendon elongation together, requiring the forces derived from each to agree within a specified tolerance such as ±5%; check spiral and grid reinforcement in anchorage zones before casting, and later estimate prestress losses from long-term monitoring or tests for comparison with the design assumption.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 外伸臂拉桿在設計風荷載下拉力 T = 30 MN，施加有效預力 P = 36 MN 後淨壓力 P − T = 6 MN；斷面 8 m² 時剩餘壓應力 6/8 = 0.75 MPa，預力本身平均壓應力 36/8 = 4.5 MPa。若長期預力損失 15%，P_eff = 30.6 MN，淨壓力只剩 0.6 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An outrigger tie carrying T = 30 MN under design wind with an effective prestress P = 36 MN keeps a net compression of P − T = 6 MN; over an 8 m² section the residual compression is 6/8 = 0.75 MPa, and the prestress alone averages 36/8 = 4.5 MPa. A 15% long-term loss leaves P_eff = 30.6 MN and a net compression of only 0.6 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete", which statement holds?
options: 地面風速不大時，高空施工面的風也一樣小。
外伸臂拉桿在設計風荷載下拉力 T = 30 MN，施加有效預力 P = 36 MN 後淨壓力 P − T = 6 MN。
樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。
optionsEn: If ground-level wind is light, wind at the high working face is light too.
An outrigger tie carrying T = 30 MN under design wind with an effective prestress P = 36 MN keeps a net compression of P − T = 6 MN.
All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂拉桿在設計風荷載下拉力 T = 30 MN，施加有效預力 P = 36 MN 後淨壓力 P − T = 6 MN；斷面 8 m² 時剩餘壓應力 6/8 = 0.75 MPa，預力本身平均壓應力 36/8 = 4.5 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An outrigger tie carrying T = 30 MN under design wind with an effective prestress P = 36 MN keeps a net compression of P − T = 6 MN; over an 8 m² section the residual compression is 6/8 = 0.75 MPa, and the prestress alone averages 36/8 = 4.5 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預力混凝土外伸臂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prestressed concrete outrigger” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預力施拉時同時記錄千斤頂壓力與鋼腱伸長量，兩者換算的力差應在規定允差內（例如 ±5%）；錨定區依設計配置螺旋筋與格網筋並在澆置前檢查；之後以長期監測或試驗估算預力損失，與設計假設比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During stressing record jack pressure and tendon elongation together, requiring the forces derived from each to agree within a specified tolerance such as ±5%; check spiral and grid reinforcement in anchorage zones before casting, and later estimate prestress losses from long-term monitoring or tests for comparison with the design assumption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預力施拉屬高風險作業，須由合格的專業施工單位依核准的施拉程序與順序進行，施拉紀錄由結構工程師審核後才能灌漿或封錨，並規定人員不得站在千斤頂軸線後方。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stressing is a high-risk operation to be done by a qualified specialist under an approved procedure and sequence; stressing records must be reviewed by the structural engineer before grouting or capping, and nobody may stand behind the jack axis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若預力損失被低估，外伸臂在颱風荷載下出現反覆張開的裂縫，勁度降低並讓鋼腱與錨具暴露於濕氣；錨定區配筋不足則在施拉時就可能爆裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underestimated losses let the outrigger crack open repeatedly under typhoon loads, reducing stiffness and exposing tendons and anchors to moisture; insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement can burst during stressing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 預力施拉時同時記錄千斤頂壓力與鋼腱伸長量，兩者換算的力差應在規定允差內（例如 ±5%）；錨定區依設計配置螺旋筋與格網筋並在澆置前檢查；之後以長期監測或試驗估算預力損失，與設計假設比較。
knowledge.textEn: During stressing record jack pressure and tendon elongation together, requiring the forces derived from each to agree within a specified tolerance such as ±5%; check spiral and grid reinforcement in anchorage zones before casting, and later estimate prestress losses from long-term monitoring or tests for comparison with the design assumption.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預力施拉屬高風險作業，須由合格的專業施工單位依核准的施拉程序與順序進行，施拉紀錄由結構工程師審核後才能灌漿或封錨，並規定人員不得站在千斤頂軸線後方。
knowledge.textEn: Stressing is a high-risk operation to be done by a qualified specialist under an approved procedure and sequence; stressing records must be reviewed by the structural engineer before grouting or capping, and nobody may stand behind the jack axis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
50 年回歸期的颱風在 50 年內最多只會發生一次。
預力施拉時同時記錄千斤頂壓力與鋼腱伸長量，兩者換算的力差應在規定允差內（例如 ±5%）。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A 50-year-return typhoon can happen at most once in 50 years.
During stressing record jack pressure and tendon elongation together, requiring the forces derived from each to agree within a specified tolerance such as ±5%.
quiz.explanation: 預力施拉時同時記錄千斤頂壓力與鋼腱伸長量，兩者換算的力差應在規定允差內（例如 ±5%）；錨定區依設計配置螺旋筋與格網筋並在澆置前檢查；之後以長期監測或試驗估算預力損失，與設計假設比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During stressing record jack pressure and tendon elongation together, requiring the forces derived from each to agree within a specified tolerance such as ±5%; check spiral and grid reinforcement in anchorage zones before casting, and later estimate prestress losses from long-term monitoring or tests for comparison with the design assumption. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預力混凝土外伸臂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prestressed concrete outrigger” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若預力損失被低估，外伸臂在颱風荷載下出現反覆張開的裂縫，勁度降低並讓鋼腱與錨具暴露於濕氣；錨定區配筋不足則在施拉時就可能爆裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underestimated losses let the outrigger crack open repeatedly under typhoon loads, reducing stiffness and exposing tendons and anchors to moisture; insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement can burst during stressing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是預力損失、錨定區局部應力與施工順序都需要仔細規劃。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is careful planning of prestress losses, local stresses in anchorage zones and construction sequence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預力只是用來增加構件的強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Prestress is only used to increase member strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若預力損失被低估，外伸臂在颱風荷載下出現反覆張開的裂縫，勁度降低並讓鋼腱與錨具暴露於濕氣；錨定區配筋不足則在施拉時就可能爆裂。
knowledge.textEn: Underestimated losses let the outrigger crack open repeatedly under typhoon loads, reducing stiffness and exposing tendons and anchors to moisture; insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement can burst during stressing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「最低一道預力混凝土外伸臂」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The lowest outrigger in prestressed concrete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若預力損失被低估，外伸臂在颱風荷載下出現反覆張開的裂縫，勁度降低並讓鋼腱與錨具暴露於濕氣；錨定區配筋不足則在施拉時就可能爆裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。
optionsEn: Underestimated losses let the outrigger crack open repeatedly under typhoon loads, reducing stiffness and exposing tendons and anchors to moisture.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Inclined columns carry only axial force and impose nothing extra on the floors.
quiz.explanation: 若預力損失被低估，外伸臂在颱風荷載下出現反覆張開的裂縫，勁度降低並讓鋼腱與錨具暴露於濕氣；錨定區配筋不足則在施拉時就可能爆裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Underestimated losses let the outrigger crack open repeatedly under typhoon loads, reducing stiffness and exposing tendons and anchors to moisture; insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement can burst during stressing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「底部外撇 3° 巨柱」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mega-columns splayed 3° at the base” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出八根巨柱在底部向外撇約 3°，加寬基座以降低傾覆效應，並為飯店與展覽空間提供較長的淨跨。柱在轉折點改變方向時，軸壓力的方向改變會產生一個水平分力：在轉折樓層，柱被推向內側，需由樓板以壓力承接；在柱腳，柱把基礎往外推，需由基礎、地下室樓板或繫梁以拉力平衡。這些水平力隨柱軸力成正比，因此最大的巨柱在最低轉折處需要最強的水平傳力路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「底部外撇 3° 巨柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources state that the eight mega-columns splay outward about 3° at the base, widening the footprint to reduce overturning and giving longer clear spans for hotel and exhibition spaces. Where a column changes direction, the redirected axial compression produces a horizontal component: at the kink floor the column is pushed inward and the floor must take it in compression, while at the column foot the column pushes the foundation outward, which foundations, basement slabs or ties must balance in tension. These horizontal forces are proportional to column axial load, so the largest columns at the lowest kink need the strongest horizontal load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mega-columns splayed 3° at the base” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：水平分力 H = P·tanθ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The horizontal component is H = P·tanθ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Inclined columns carry only axial force and impose nothing extra on the floors." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「底部外撇 3° 巨柱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mega-columns splayed 3° at the base”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties" is correct?
options: 傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。
公開資料指出八根巨柱在底部向外撇約 3°，加寬基座以降低傾覆效應，並為飯店與展覽空間提供較長的淨跨。

quiz.explanationEn: Public sources state that the eight mega-columns splay outward about 3° at the base, widening the footprint to reduce overturning and giving longer clear spans for hotel and exhibition spaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「底部外撇 3° 巨柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mega-columns splayed 3° at the base” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：水平分力 H = P·tanθ。巨柱軸力 P = 250 MN、θ = 3°（tan 3° ≈ 0.0524）：H ≈ 13.1 MN。轉折樓板需以壓力承接約 13.1 MN，柱腳另有同量的外推力由繫梁或地下室樓板受拉平衡；若外撇角加倍為 6°，H ≈ 26.3 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The horizontal component is H = P·tanθ. For P = 250 MN and θ = 3° (tan 3° ≈ 0.0524), H ≈ 13.1 MN. The kink floor must carry about 13.1 MN in compression, and an equal outward thrust at the column foot must be balanced in tension by ties or basement slabs; doubling the splay to 6° gives H ≈ 26.3 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在模型中追蹤每根巨柱在轉折處的水平分力，檢查樓板隔板與繫梁的應力、開口削弱與續接位置；施工時量測巨柱轉折點的座標與傾角，確認符合圖說允差，並在繫梁施作完成前限制上部荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track the horizontal component at each mega-column kink in the model, checking diaphragm and tie stresses, weakening by openings and splice locations; during construction survey kink coordinates and inclination against tolerances and limit load above until the ties are complete.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 水平分力 H = P·tanθ。巨柱軸力 P = 250 MN、θ = 3°（tan 3° ≈ 0.0524）：H ≈ 13.1 MN。轉折樓板需以壓力承接約 13.1 MN，柱腳另有同量的外推力由繫梁或地下室樓板受拉平衡；若外撇角加倍為 6°，H ≈ 26.3 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The horizontal component is H = P·tanθ. For P = 250 MN and θ = 3° (tan 3° ≈ 0.0524), H ≈ 13.1 MN. The kink floor must carry about 13.1 MN in compression, and an equal outward thrust at the column foot must be balanced in tension by ties or basement slabs; doubling the splay to 6° gives H ≈ 26.3 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties", which statement holds?
options: 風洞模型只要外形縮尺正確，量到的數據就可以直接當作實尺度使用。
地下結構不受日曬雨淋，所以不會有耐久問題。
水平分力 H = P·tanθ。
optionsEn: If the model shape is scaled correctly, the measured data can be used directly at full scale.
Below-ground structure is sheltered from sun and rain, so it has no durability problems.
The horizontal component is H = P·tanθ.
quiz.explanation: 水平分力 H = P·tanθ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The horizontal component is H = P·tanθ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底部外撇 3° 巨柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mega-columns splayed 3° at the base” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在模型中追蹤每根巨柱在轉折處的水平分力，檢查樓板隔板與繫梁的應力、開口削弱與續接位置；施工時量測巨柱轉折點的座標與傾角，確認符合圖說允差，並在繫梁施作完成前限制上部荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track the horizontal component at each mega-column kink in the model, checking diaphragm and tie stresses, weakening by openings and splice locations; during construction survey kink coordinates and inclination against tolerances and limit load above until the ties are complete. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜柱與轉折點的樓板應在圖上標示為「隔板傳力區」，限制日後開孔，並在施工順序中規定繫梁與樓板必須在上部荷載加到一定比例前完成。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark floors at inclined columns and kinks as diaphragm transfer zones on the drawings, restricting later openings, and require in the construction sequence that ties and slabs be complete before a set proportion of the load above is applied.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若轉折樓板有大型開口（例如中庭或機電豎井）而未補強，水平分力找不到連續路徑，樓板邊緣開裂；繫梁或地下室樓板受拉能力不足，柱腳可能向外滑移，造成上部結構傾斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the kink floor has large unstrengthened openings such as atria or shafts, the horizontal thrust has no continuous path and slab edges crack; ties or basement slabs short of tensile capacity can let column feet slide outward and tilt the structure above. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在模型中追蹤每根巨柱在轉折處的水平分力，檢查樓板隔板與繫梁的應力、開口削弱與續接位置；施工時量測巨柱轉折點的座標與傾角，確認符合圖說允差，並在繫梁施作完成前限制上部荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Track the horizontal component at each mega-column kink in the model, checking diaphragm and tie stresses, weakening by openings and splice locations; during construction survey kink coordinates and inclination against tolerances and limit load above until the ties are complete.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斜柱與轉折點的樓板應在圖上標示為「隔板傳力區」，限制日後開孔，並在施工順序中規定繫梁與樓板必須在上部荷載加到一定比例前完成。
knowledge.textEn: Mark floors at inclined columns and kinks as diaphragm transfer zones on the drawings, restricting later openings, and require in the construction sequence that ties and slabs be complete before a set proportion of the load above is applied.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties"?
options: 在模型中追蹤每根巨柱在轉折處的水平分力，檢查樓板隔板與繫梁的應力、開口削弱與續接位置。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
凹角只是建築語彙，與颱風下的結構反應無關。
optionsEn: Track the horizontal component at each mega-column kink in the model, checking diaphragm and tie stresses, weakening by openings and splice locations.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Notched corners are an architectural motif with no bearing on typhoon response.
quiz.explanation: 在模型中追蹤每根巨柱在轉折處的水平分力，檢查樓板隔板與繫梁的應力、開口削弱與續接位置；施工時量測巨柱轉折點的座標與傾角，確認符合圖說允差，並在繫梁施作完成前限制上部荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track the horizontal component at each mega-column kink in the model, checking diaphragm and tie stresses, weakening by openings and splice locations; during construction survey kink coordinates and inclination against tolerances and limit load above until the ties are complete. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「底部外撇 3° 巨柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mega-columns splayed 3° at the base” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若轉折樓板有大型開口（例如中庭或機電豎井）而未補強，水平分力找不到連續路徑，樓板邊緣開裂；繫梁或地下室樓板受拉能力不足，柱腳可能向外滑移，造成上部結構傾斜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the kink floor has large unstrengthened openings such as atria or shafts, the horizontal thrust has no continuous path and slab edges crack; ties or basement slabs short of tensile capacity can let column feet slide outward and tilt the structure above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些水平力隨柱軸力成正比，因此最大的巨柱在最低轉折處需要最強的水平傳力路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These horizontal forces are proportional to column axial load, so the largest columns at the lowest kink need the strongest horizontal load path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Inclined columns carry only axial force and impose nothing extra on the floors." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若轉折樓板有大型開口（例如中庭或機電豎井）而未補強，水平分力找不到連續路徑，樓板邊緣開裂；繫梁或地下室樓板受拉能力不足，柱腳可能向外滑移，造成上部結構傾斜。
knowledge.textEn: If the kink floor has large unstrengthened openings such as atria or shafts, the horizontal thrust has no continuous path and slab edges crack; ties or basement slabs short of tensile capacity can let column feet slide outward and tilt the structure above.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外撇巨柱的水平分力與繫梁」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Horizontal thrust of splayed columns and ties" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若轉折樓板有大型開口（例如中庭或機電豎井）而未補強，水平分力找不到連續路徑，樓板邊緣開裂；繫梁或地下室樓板受拉能力不足，柱腳可能向外滑移，造成上部結構傾斜。
岩盤很深時就只能用很長的端承樁，摩擦樁不可靠。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the kink floor has large unstrengthened openings such as atria or shafts, the horizontal thrust has no continuous path and slab edges crack.

quiz.explanation: 若轉折樓板有大型開口（例如中庭或機電豎井）而未補強，水平分力找不到連續路徑，樓板邊緣開裂；繫梁或地下室樓板受拉能力不足，柱腳可能向外滑移，造成上部結構傾斜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the kink floor has large unstrengthened openings such as atria or shafts, the horizontal thrust has no continuous path and slab edges crack; ties or basement slabs short of tensile capacity can let column feet slide outward and tilt the structure above. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「填海地盤上的壁樁基礎」與「颱風季施工與高空風速管控」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Barrette foundations on reclaimed land" and "Typhoon-season construction and wind control at height": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 填海地盤上的壁樁基礎：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Barrette foundations on reclaimed land: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「灌漿摩擦型壁樁」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shaft-grouted friction barrettes” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 基地位於填海區，岩盤深約 70 至 130 m 且起伏如懸崖，傳統鑽掘樁與打入式 H 型鋼樁都不適用，因此採用矩形鋼筋混凝土的摩擦型壁樁（barrette），平均深度約 70 m，以四個側面與周圍土層的摩擦力傳遞荷載；公開資料指出其還做了樁身灌漿。壁樁以抓斗在穩定液保護下開挖成槽，放入鋼筋籠後以特密管澆置；樁身灌漿是在混凝土硬化後經預埋管對樁側土層加壓灌漿，修補泥膜並提高側摩擦。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灌漿摩擦型壁樁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The site is reclaimed land over a cliff-like rock surface about 70 to 130 m deep, ruling out conventional bored piles and driven H-piles, so rectangular reinforced-concrete friction piles called barrettes were used, averaging about 70 m deep and transferring load by friction on their four faces; public sources note they were shaft-grouted. Barrettes are excavated as slots by grab under support fluid, then a reinforcement cage is lowered and concrete placed by tremie; shaft grouting pumps grout under pressure through pre-installed pipes into the surrounding soil after the concrete hardens, repairing the filter cake and increasing side friction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shaft-grouted friction barrettes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：側摩擦承載 Q_s = 周長×L×f_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Side-friction capacity is Q_s = perimeter×L×f_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩盤很深時就只能用很長的端承樁，摩擦樁不可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Where bedrock is deep, only very long end-bearing piles work; friction piles are unreliable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「灌漿摩擦型壁樁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shaft-grouted friction barrettes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 填海地盤上的壁樁基礎：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Barrette foundations on reclaimed land: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌漿摩擦型壁樁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shaft-grouted friction barrettes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：側摩擦承載 Q_s = 周長×L×f_s。壁樁 2.8 m×1.5 m 周長 8.6 m、L = 70 m：未灌漿 f_s = 100 kPa 時 Q_s = 8.6×70×100 = 60,200 kN；灌漿使 f_s 提高到 150 kPa 時 Q_s = 90,300 kN，增加 50%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Side-friction capacity is Q_s = perimeter×L×f_s. A 2.8 m×1.5 m barrette has an 8.6 m perimeter; with L = 70 m and ungrouted f_s = 100 kPa, Q_s = 8.6×70×100 = 60,200 kN; shaft grouting that raises f_s to 150 kPa gives Q_s = 90,300 kN, 50% more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開挖時以超音波槽壁量測儀檢查槽體垂直度與尺寸，穩定液的密度、黏度與含砂率每班抽驗；澆置後以聲波透測（CSL）檢查樁身完整性，灌漿則記錄每個閥口的壓力與灌入量，與預定的停止條件比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During excavation check slot verticality and dimensions with an ultrasonic trench profiler and test support-fluid density, viscosity and sand content every shift; after concreting verify integrity by cross-hole sonic logging, and for grouting record pressure and volume at each valve against the predefined stop criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 側摩擦承載 Q_s = 周長×L×f_s。壁樁 2.8 m×1.5 m 周長 8.6 m、L = 70 m：未灌漿 f_s = 100 kPa 時 Q_s = 8.6×70×100 = 60,200 kN；灌漿使 f_s 提高到 150 kPa 時 Q_s = 90,300 kN，增加 50%。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「填海地盤上的壁樁基礎」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Barrette foundations on reclaimed land", which statement holds?
options: 側摩擦承載 Q_s = 周長×L×f_s。
樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。
50 年回歸期的颱風在 50 年內最多只會發生一次。
optionsEn: Side-friction capacity is Q_s = perimeter×L×f_s.
All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides.
A 50-year-return typhoon can happen at most once in 50 years.
quiz.explanation: 側摩擦承載 Q_s = 周長×L×f_s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Side-friction capacity is Q_s = perimeter×L×f_s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 填海地盤上的壁樁基礎：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Barrette foundations on reclaimed land: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌漿摩擦型壁樁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shaft-grouted friction barrettes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 開挖時以超音波槽壁量測儀檢查槽體垂直度與尺寸，穩定液的密度、黏度與含砂率每班抽驗；澆置後以聲波透測（CSL）檢查樁身完整性，灌漿則記錄每個閥口的壓力與灌入量，與預定的停止條件比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During excavation check slot verticality and dimensions with an ultrasonic trench profiler and test support-fluid density, viscosity and sand content every shift; after concreting verify integrity by cross-hole sonic logging, and for grouting record pressure and volume at each valve against the predefined stop criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：壁樁施工應有逐樁的開挖、穩定液、鋼筋籠與澆置紀錄，灌漿作業列為停留點並由大地工程師核可停止條件；鄰近九龍站與地下管線的區段須另訂變位監測與警戒值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep pile-by-pile records of excavation, support fluid, cage and concreting, make grouting a hold point with stop criteria approved by the geotechnical engineer, and set separate movement monitoring and alert levels for sections next to Kowloon Station and buried utilities.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：穩定液含砂率過高或底部沉渣未清，會在樁側形成厚泥膜或在底部留下軟弱層，使摩擦與端承不足而產生過大沉陷；灌漿壓力控制不當則可能使地表隆起或灌漿流失到鄰近管線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Support fluid with too much sand or uncleaned base sediment leaves a thick filter cake on the faces or a soft layer at the toe, so friction and end bearing fall short and settlement becomes excessive; poorly controlled grout pressure can heave the ground or lose grout into nearby utilities. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「填海地盤上的壁樁基礎」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Barrette foundations on reclaimed land"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
開挖時以超音波槽壁量測儀檢查槽體垂直度與尺寸，穩定液的密度、黏度與含砂率每班抽驗。

steps.title: 填海地盤上的壁樁基礎：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Barrette foundations on reclaimed land: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌漿摩擦型壁樁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shaft-grouted friction barrettes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 穩定液含砂率過高或底部沉渣未清，會在樁側形成厚泥膜或在底部留下軟弱層，使摩擦與端承不足而產生過大沉陷；灌漿壓力控制不當則可能使地表隆起或灌漿流失到鄰近管線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Support fluid with too much sand or uncleaned base sediment leaves a thick filter cake on the faces or a soft layer at the toe, so friction and end bearing fall short and settlement becomes excessive; poorly controlled grout pressure can heave the ground or lose grout into nearby utilities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壁樁以抓斗在穩定液保護下開挖成槽，放入鋼筋籠後以特密管澆置；樁身灌漿是在混凝土硬化後經預埋管對樁側土層加壓灌漿，修補泥膜並提高側摩擦。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Barrettes are excavated as slots by grab under support fluid, then a reinforcement cage is lowered and concrete placed by tremie; shaft grouting pumps grout under pressure through pre-installed pipes into the surrounding soil after the concrete hardens, repairing the filter cake and increasing side friction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩盤很深時就只能用很長的端承樁，摩擦樁不可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Where bedrock is deep, only very long end-bearing piles work; friction piles are unreliable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 穩定液含砂率過高或底部沉渣未清，會在樁側形成厚泥膜或在底部留下軟弱層，使摩擦與端承不足而產生過大沉陷；灌漿壓力控制不當則可能使地表隆起或灌漿流失到鄰近管線。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

If ground-level wind is light, wind at the high working face is light too.

steps.title: 颱風季施工與高空風速管控：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Typhoon-season construction and wind control at height: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「颱風季高空風速管控」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-level wind control in typhoon season” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層施工期長，必然跨越多個颱風季。塔吊、爬模、外架與尚未封閉的樓層都對風敏感：風速隨高度增加，地面風速計的讀值會低估施工面所受的風；颱風來臨前必須讓塔吊自由迴轉、收妥爬模與吊籠、固定鬆散材料並撤離高空人員。外伸臂與鋼構尚未鎖定時，結構的側向勁度與完工狀態不同，也需要檢核施工階段在颱風下的穩定與變位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「颱風季高空風速管控」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A supertall project spans several typhoon seasons. Tower cranes, climbing forms, scaffolds and unenclosed floors are all wind-sensitive: wind speed increases with height, so a ground anemometer underestimates wind at the working face, and before a typhoon cranes must be left free to slew, climbing forms and hoists secured, loose material tied down and workers withdrawn from height. With outriggers and steel not yet locked, lateral stiffness differs from the completed state, so construction-stage stability and drift under typhoon wind must also be checked. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High-level wind control in typhoon season” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，海面與填海區取 α = 0.16：400 m 處 V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16 for sea and reclaimed exposure, at 400 m V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地面風速不大時，高空施工面的風也一樣小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 傳力圖標明「颱風季高空風速管控」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 颱風季施工與高空風速管控：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Typhoon-season construction and wind control at height: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「颱風季高空風速管控」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-level wind control in typhoon season” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，海面與填海區取 α = 0.16：400 m 處 V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀。地面 10 m 讀到 V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，施工面約 18.0 m/s；V₁₀ = 12 m/s 時約 21.7 m/s，已超過常見塔吊吊裝限值 20 m/s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16 for sea and reclaimed exposure, at 400 m V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀. A ground reading of V₁₀ = 10 m/s means about 18.0 m/s at the working face, and V₁₀ = 12 m/s about 21.7 m/s, beyond a common crane lifting limit of 20 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在塔吊頂與施工面設置風速計，以施工面實測值而非地面值決定是否停止吊裝；颱風前依檢查表確認塔吊迴轉釋放、爬模錨定與材料綁紮，並由結構工程師確認未完成結構在颱風風速下的變位與構件應力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install anemometers on crane tops and at the working face and use those readings, not ground values, to stop lifting; before a typhoon confirm crane slewing release, climbing-form anchorage and material lashing against a checklist, and have the structural engineer confirm drift and member stresses of the incomplete structure at typhoon wind speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，海面與填海區取 α = 0.16：400 m 處 V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀。地面 10 m 讀到 V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，施工面約 18.0 m/s；V₁₀ = 12 m/s 時約 21.7 m/s，已超過常見塔吊吊裝限值 20 m/s。數值為教學假設。

A ground reading of V₁₀ = 10 m/s means about 18.0 m/s at the working face, and V₁₀ = 12 m/s about 21.7 m/s, beyond a common crane lifting limit of 20 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「颱風季施工與高空風速管控」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Typhoon-season construction and wind control at height", which statement holds?

冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α，海面與填海區取 α = 0.16：400 m 處 V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀。

With the power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16 for sea and reclaimed exposure, at 400 m V = V₁₀×40^0.16 ≈ 1.80V₁₀.

steps.title: 颱風季施工與高空風速管控：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Typhoon-season construction and wind control at height: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「颱風季高空風速管控」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High-level wind control in typhoon season” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在塔吊頂與施工面設置風速計，以施工面實測值而非地面值決定是否停止吊裝；颱風前依檢查表確認塔吊迴轉釋放、爬模錨定與材料綁紮，並由結構工程師確認未完成結構在颱風風速下的變位與構件應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install anemometers on crane tops and at the working face and use those readings, not ground values, to stop lifting; before a typhoon confirm crane slewing release, climbing-form anchorage and material lashing against a checklist, and have the structural engineer confirm drift and member stresses of the incomplete structure at typhoon wind speed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應包含颱風應變程序：依天文台信號分級的停工、固定與撤離步驟、負責人與檢查表，並在每次颱風後完成塔吊、爬模與外架的檢查才能復工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan must include a typhoon procedure with stop-work, securing and evacuation steps graded by the Observatory signal, named responsible persons and checklists, and work may resume only after cranes, climbing forms and scaffolds are inspected after each typhoon.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以地面風速判斷而在高空繼續吊裝，吊物擺動與塔吊過載的風險大增；颱風前未固定的模板或材料被吹落，對鄰近道路、車站與人員造成嚴重危害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Continuing lifts at height based on ground wind readings greatly raises the risk of swinging loads and crane overload; formwork or material left unsecured before a typhoon can be blown off and endanger nearby roads, the station and people. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
