knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「颱風季施工與高空風速管控」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Typhoon-season construction and wind control at height" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以地面風速判斷而在高空繼續吊裝，吊物擺動與塔吊過載的風險大增；颱風前未固定的模板或材料被吹落，對鄰近道路、車站與人員造成嚴重危害。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
風洞模型只要外形縮尺正確，量到的數據就可以直接當作實尺度使用。
optionsEn: Continuing lifts at height based on ground wind readings greatly raises the risk of swinging loads and crane overload.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the model shape is scaled correctly, the measured data can be used directly at full scale.
quiz.explanation: 以地面風速判斷而在高空繼續吊裝，吊物擺動與塔吊過載的風險大增；颱風前未固定的模板或材料被吹落，對鄰近道路、車站與人員造成嚴重危害。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Continuing lifts at height based on ground wind readings greatly raises the risk of swinging loads and crane overload; formwork or material left unsecured before a typhoon can be blown off and endanger nearby roads, the station and people. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」與「壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests" and "Barrette load tests and elastic shortening": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「風洞縮尺與時間比例」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wind-tunnel scale and time ratio” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風洞試驗把建築與周邊地形縮到數百分之一，並以較低的風速吹拂，因此量到的時間、頻率與壓力都必須依相似律換算回實尺度。長度比與風速比決定時間比，進而決定一段實尺度風暴對應的試驗取樣長度，以及建築模態頻率在模型上應落在的頻段。若時間比換算錯誤，風洞的尖峰值統計與加速度預測都會失真；對於像九龍站上方這種周邊有密集高樓與海面的場址，邊界層模擬同樣重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「風洞縮尺與時間比例」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A wind-tunnel test shrinks the building and surroundings to a few hundredths of full size and blows slower wind over them, so measured times, frequencies and pressures must be converted back to full scale by similitude. The length and velocity scales set the time scale, which in turn sets how long a sample must be to represent a full-scale storm and where the building's modal frequencies fall on the model. A wrong time scale distorts peak statistics and acceleration predictions; for a site like the one above Kowloon Station, with dense towers on one side and open sea on another, boundary-layer simulation is equally important. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wind-tunnel scale and time ratio” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：時間比 λ_t = λ_L/λ_V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The time scale is λ_t = λ_L/λ_V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風洞模型只要外形縮尺正確，量到的數據就可以直接當作實尺度使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the model shape is scaled correctly, the measured data can be used directly at full scale." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「風洞縮尺與時間比例」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wind-tunnel scale and time ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算
knowledge.titleEn: Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests
knowledge.text: 風洞試驗把建築與周邊地形縮到數百分之一，並以較低的風速吹拂，因此量到的時間、頻率與壓力都必須依相似律換算回實尺度。長度比與風速比決定時間比，進而決定一段實尺度風暴對應的試驗取樣長度，以及建築模態頻率在模型上應落在的頻段。
knowledge.textEn: A wind-tunnel test shrinks the building and surroundings to a few hundredths of full size and blows slower wind over them, so measured times, frequencies and pressures must be converted back to full scale by similitude. The length and velocity scales set the time scale, which in turn sets how long a sample must be to represent a full-scale storm and where the building's modal frequencies fall on the model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風洞模型只要外形縮尺正確，量到的數據就可以直接當作實尺度使用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the model shape is scaled correctly, the measured data can be used directly at full scale. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests" is correct?
options: 風洞模型只要外形縮尺正確，量到的數據就可以直接當作實尺度使用。
風洞試驗把建築與周邊地形縮到數百分之一，並以較低的風速吹拂，因此量到的時間、頻率與壓力都必須依相似律換算回實尺度。
樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。
optionsEn: If the model shape is scaled correctly, the measured data can be used directly at full scale.

A wind-tunnel test shrinks the building and surroundings to a few hundredths of full size and blows slower wind over them, so measured times, frequencies and pressures must be converted back to full scale by similitude.
All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides.
quiz.explanation: 風洞試驗把建築與周邊地形縮到數百分之一，並以較低的風速吹拂，因此量到的時間、頻率與壓力都必須依相似律換算回實尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A wind-tunnel test shrinks the building and surroundings to a few hundredths of full size and blows slower wind over them, so measured times, frequencies and pressures must be converted back to full scale by similitude. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風洞縮尺與時間比例」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wind-tunnel scale and time ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：時間比 λ_t = λ_L/λ_V。取長度比 1:500、風速比 1:3：λ_t = (1/500)/(1/3) = 1/166.7，實尺度 1 小時在試驗中只需 3,600/166.7 ≈ 21.6 s；頻率比為 166.7，實尺度 0.15 Hz 的模態在模型上對應約 25 Hz。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The time scale is λ_t = λ_L/λ_V. With a 1:500 length scale and a 1:3 velocity scale, λ_t = (1/500)/(1/3) = 1/166.7, so one full-scale hour needs only 3,600/166.7 ≈ 21.6 s in the tunnel; the frequency scale is 166.7, so a 0.15 Hz full-scale mode corresponds to about 25 Hz on the model. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查風洞報告時核對長度比、風速比與時間比的換算，確認取樣時間足以涵蓋多個實尺度小時並取得穩定的尖峰統計；以空場邊界層量測驗證風速剖面與紊流頻譜，並抽查一個風向的原始時間序列重新計算尖峰值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: When reviewing the wind-tunnel report, check the conversions between length, velocity and time scales, confirm sampling covers several full-scale hours for stable peak statistics, verify the wind profile and turbulence spectrum with empty-tunnel boundary-layer measurements, and recompute peaks from the raw time series for one direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 時間比 λ_t = λ_L/λ_V。取長度比 1:500、風速比 1:3：λ_t = (1/500)/(1/3) = 1/166.7，實尺度 1 小時在試驗中只需 3,600/166.7 ≈ 21.6 s；頻率比為 166.7，實尺度 0.15 Hz 的模態在模型上對應約 25 Hz。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The time scale is λ_t = λ_L/λ_V. With a 1:500 length scale and a 1:3 velocity scale, λ_t = (1/500)/(1/3) = 1/166.7, so one full-scale hour needs only 3,600/166.7 ≈ 21.6 s in the tunnel; the frequency scale is 166.7, so a 0.15 Hz full-scale mode corresponds to about 25 Hz on the model. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests", which statement holds?
options: 50 年回歸期的颱風在 50 年內最多只會發生一次。
外伸臂的效果主要來自外伸臂桁架本身的強度。
時間比 λ_t = λ_L/λ_V。
optionsEn: A 50-year-return typhoon can happen at most once in 50 years.
Outrigger effectiveness comes mainly from the strength of the outrigger truss itself.
The time scale is λ_t = λ_L/λ_V.
quiz.explanation: 時間比 λ_t = λ_L/λ_V。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The time scale is λ_t = λ_L/λ_V. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風洞縮尺與時間比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wind-tunnel scale and time ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查風洞報告時核對長度比、風速比與時間比的換算，確認取樣時間足以涵蓋多個實尺度小時並取得穩定的尖峰統計；以空場邊界層量測驗證風速剖面與紊流頻譜，並抽查一個風向的原始時間序列重新計算尖峰值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: When reviewing the wind-tunnel report, check the conversions between length, velocity and time scales, confirm sampling covers several full-scale hours for stable peak statistics, verify the wind profile and turbulence spectrum with empty-tunnel boundary-layer measurements, and recompute peaks from the raw time series for one direction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：委託風洞試驗時，在合約中要求報告列出相似律參數、取樣長度、天平頻率、周邊模型範圍與原始資料格式，並保留原始時間序列供日後重新分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When commissioning wind-tunnel testing, require the report to list similitude parameters, sampling length, balance frequency, proximity-model extent and raw data format, and retain the raw time series for later reanalysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若試驗取樣只對應實尺度十幾分鐘，尖峰值的統計不穩定，設計風壓可能被低估；若模型的天平或支架自身頻率落在換算後的建築頻段內，量到的力頻譜會被污染而誤判共振。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sampling equivalent to only a few full-scale minutes gives unstable peak statistics and can underestimate design pressures; if the force balance or model mount has its own frequency within the scaled building band, the measured spectrum is contaminated and resonance misjudged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 審查風洞報告時核對長度比、風速比與時間比的換算，確認取樣時間足以涵蓋多個實尺度小時並取得穩定的尖峰統計；以空場邊界層量測驗證風速剖面與紊流頻譜，並抽查一個風向的原始時間序列重新計算尖峰值。
knowledge.textEn: When reviewing the wind-tunnel report, check the conversions between length, velocity and time scales, confirm sampling covers several full-scale hours for stable peak statistics, verify the wind profile and turbulence spectrum with empty-tunnel boundary-layer measurements, and recompute peaks from the raw time series for one direction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 委託風洞試驗時，在合約中要求報告列出相似律參數、取樣長度、天平頻率、周邊模型範圍與原始資料格式，並保留原始時間序列供日後重新分析。
knowledge.textEn: When commissioning wind-tunnel testing, require the report to list similitude parameters, sampling length, balance frequency, proximity-model extent and raw data format, and retain the raw time series for later reanalysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests"?
options: 審查風洞報告時核對長度比、風速比與時間比的換算，確認取樣時間足以涵蓋多個實尺度小時並取得穩定的尖峰統計。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
傾斜柱只承受軸向力，不會對樓板產生額外負擔。
optionsEn: When reviewing the wind-tunnel report, check the conversions between length, velocity and time scales, confirm sampling covers several full-scale hours for stable peak statistics, verify the wind profile and turbulence spectrum with empty-tunnel boundary-layer measurements, and recompute peaks from the raw time series for one direction.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Inclined columns carry only axial force and impose nothing extra on the floors.
quiz.explanation: 審查風洞報告時核對長度比、風速比與時間比的換算，確認取樣時間足以涵蓋多個實尺度小時並取得穩定的尖峰統計；以空場邊界層量測驗證風速剖面與紊流頻譜，並抽查一個風向的原始時間序列重新計算尖峰值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: When reviewing the wind-tunnel report, check the conversions between length, velocity and time scales, confirm sampling covers several full-scale hours for stable peak statistics, verify the wind profile and turbulence spectrum with empty-tunnel boundary-layer measurements, and recompute peaks from the raw time series for one direction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風洞縮尺與時間比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wind-tunnel scale and time ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若試驗取樣只對應實尺度十幾分鐘，尖峰值的統計不穩定，設計風壓可能被低估；若模型的天平或支架自身頻率落在換算後的建築頻段內，量到的力頻譜會被污染而誤判共振。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling equivalent to only a few full-scale minutes gives unstable peak statistics and can underestimate design pressures; if the force balance or model mount has its own frequency within the scaled building band, the measured spectrum is contaminated and resonance misjudged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若時間比換算錯誤，風洞的尖峰值統計與加速度預測都會失真；對於像九龍站上方這種周邊有密集高樓與海面的場址，邊界層模擬同樣重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A wrong time scale distorts peak statistics and acceleration predictions; for a site like the one above Kowloon Station, with dense towers on one side and open sea on another, boundary-layer simulation is equally important.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風洞模型只要外形縮尺正確，量到的數據就可以直接當作實尺度使用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the model shape is scaled correctly, the measured data can be used directly at full scale." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若試驗取樣只對應實尺度十幾分鐘，尖峰值的統計不穩定，設計風壓可能被低估；若模型的天平或支架自身頻率落在換算後的建築頻段內，量到的力頻譜會被污染而誤判共振。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling equivalent to only a few full-scale minutes gives unstable peak statistics and can underestimate design pressures; if the force balance or model mount has its own frequency within the scaled building band, the measured spectrum is contaminated and resonance misjudged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若試驗取樣只對應實尺度十幾分鐘，尖峰值的統計不穩定，設計風壓可能被低估；若模型的天平或支架自身頻率落在換算後的建築頻段內，量到的力頻譜會被污染而誤判共振。
樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Sampling equivalent to only a few full-scale minutes gives unstable peak statistics and can underestimate design pressures.
All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides.
quiz.explanation: 若試驗取樣只對應實尺度十幾分鐘，尖峰值的統計不穩定，設計風壓可能被低估；若模型的天平或支架自身頻率落在換算後的建築頻段內，量到的力頻譜會被污染而誤判共振。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling equivalent to only a few full-scale minutes gives unstable peak statistics and can underestimate design pressures; if the force balance or model mount has its own frequency within the scaled building band, the measured spectrum is contaminated and resonance misjudged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Barrette load tests and elastic shortening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「壁樁載重試驗」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Barrette load testing” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 摩擦型壁樁的承載力取決於土層摩擦與施工品質，必須以現地載重試驗驗證，而不能只靠計算。試驗時樁頭沉陷包含樁身彈性縮短與樁底或樁側土層的位移，兩者需分開：在樁身不同深度埋設應變計或伸縮計，可以得到軸力沿深度的衰減，從而推算各土層的實際摩擦力，並檢驗灌漿是否提高了側摩擦。長達 70 m 的樁，樁身彈性縮短本身就可能達數十毫米。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「壁樁載重試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The capacity of friction barrettes depends on soil friction and workmanship and must be proven by in-situ load tests rather than calculation alone. Head settlement in a test includes elastic shortening of the shaft and movement of soil along the sides or at the toe, and the two must be separated: strain gauges or extensometers at several depths give the decay of axial force with depth, from which the actual friction in each layer is back-calculated and the benefit of grouting verified. For a 70 m pile, elastic shortening of the shaft alone can reach tens of millimetres. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Barrette load testing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樁身彈性縮短 δ = PL/(EA)（以樁頂軸力全長作用估算上限）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Elastic shortening of the shaft is δ = PL/(EA), an upper bound assuming the head load acts over the full length.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「壁樁載重試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Barrette load testing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Barrette load tests and elastic shortening" is correct?
options: 樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。
地下結構不受日曬雨淋，所以不會有耐久問題。
摩擦型壁樁的承載力取決於土層摩擦與施工品質，必須以現地載重試驗驗證，而不能只靠計算。
optionsEn: All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides.
Below-ground structure is sheltered from sun and rain, so it has no durability problems.

quiz.explanationEn: The capacity of friction barrettes depends on soil friction and workmanship and must be proven by in-situ load tests rather than calculation alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Barrette load tests and elastic shortening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壁樁載重試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Barrette load testing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樁身彈性縮短 δ = PL/(EA)（以樁頂軸力全長作用估算上限）。P = 60 MN、L = 70 m、E = 30 GPa、A = 2.8×1.5 = 4.2 m²：δ = 60,000×70/(30×10⁶×4.2) ≈ 0.033 m = 33 mm。若樁頂實測沉陷 40 mm，土層位移只約 7 mm；實際軸力沿深度遞減，真實縮短會小於 33 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Elastic shortening of the shaft is δ = PL/(EA), an upper bound assuming the head load acts over the full length. With P = 60 MN, L = 70 m, E = 30 GPa and A = 2.8×1.5 = 4.2 m², δ = 60,000×70/(30×10⁶×4.2) ≈ 0.033 m = 33 mm. If the head settles 40 mm, soil movement is only about 7 mm; because axial force decays with depth, the true shortening is less than 33 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依核准的試驗計畫分級加載並維持荷載，記錄樁頭沉陷、各深度應變與時間；以試驗荷載（例如設計荷載的兩倍）下的沉陷與殘餘沉陷對照允收準則，並以應變計推算的側摩擦分布與設計假設比較，必要時修正其他壁樁的設計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load in stages and hold each stage under an approved test plan, recording head settlement, strain at each depth and time; compare settlement and residual settlement at the test load, for example twice the design load, with acceptance criteria, and compare the friction profile back-calculated from strain gauges with design assumptions, revising other barrettes if needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樁身彈性縮短 δ = PL/(EA)（以樁頂軸力全長作用估算上限）。P = 60 MN、L = 70 m、E = 30 GPa、A = 2.8×1.5 = 4.2 m²：δ = 60,000×70/(30×10⁶×4.2) ≈ 0.033 m = 33 mm。若樁頂實測沉陷 40 mm，土層位移只約 7 mm；實際軸力沿深度遞減，真實縮短會小於 33 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Elastic shortening of the shaft is δ = PL/(EA), an upper bound assuming the head load acts over the full length. With P = 60 MN, L = 70 m, E = 30 GPa and A = 2.8×1.5 = 4.2 m², δ = 60,000×70/(30×10⁶×4.2) ≈ 0.033 m = 33 mm. If the head settles 40 mm, soil movement is only about 7 mm; because axial force decays with depth, the true shortening is less than 33 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Barrette load tests and elastic shortening", which statement holds?
options: 樁身彈性縮短 δ = PL/(EA)（以樁頂軸力全長作用估算上限）。
凹角只是建築語彙，與颱風下的結構反應無關。
預力只是用來增加構件的強度。
optionsEn: Elastic shortening of the shaft is δ = PL/(EA), an upper bound assuming the head load acts over the full length.
Notched corners are an architectural motif with no bearing on typhoon response.
Prestress is only used to increase member strength.
quiz.explanation: 樁身彈性縮短 δ = PL/(EA)（以樁頂軸力全長作用估算上限）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Elastic shortening of the shaft is δ = PL/(EA), an upper bound assuming the head load acts over the full length. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Barrette load tests and elastic shortening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壁樁載重試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Barrette load testing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依核准的試驗計畫分級加載並維持荷載，記錄樁頭沉陷、各深度應變與時間；以試驗荷載（例如設計荷載的兩倍）下的沉陷與殘餘沉陷對照允收準則，並以應變計推算的側摩擦分布與設計假設比較，必要時修正其他壁樁的設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Load in stages and hold each stage under an approved test plan, recording head settlement, strain at each depth and time; compare settlement and residual settlement at the test load, for example twice the design load, with acceptance criteria, and compare the friction profile back-calculated from strain gauges with design assumptions, revising other barrettes if needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：載重試驗屬高能量作業，反力樑、錨樁或配重須經設計與檢查，試驗區設置警戒範圍；試驗結果由大地工程師出具報告並經主管機關接受後，工程樁才可據以施作或驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A load test stores high energy: reaction beams, anchor piles or kentledge must be designed and inspected and an exclusion zone set; working piles may be installed or accepted on the basis of the results only after the geotechnical engineer's report is accepted by the authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只看樁頭沉陷而不扣除樁身縮短，可能誤判土層已大量滑移而過度保守，或反之把樁身品質問題（例如夾泥造成局部軟化）誤認為土層行為；反力系統不足則可能在試驗中失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reading only head settlement without subtracting shaft shortening can misjudge large soil slip and be over-conservative, or conversely mistake a shaft defect such as a soil inclusion for soil behaviour; an inadequate reaction system can become unstable during the test. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依核准的試驗計畫分級加載並維持荷載，記錄樁頭沉陷、各深度應變與時間；以試驗荷載（例如設計荷載的兩倍）下的沉陷與殘餘沉陷對照允收準則，並以應變計推算的側摩擦分布與設計假設比較，必要時修正其他壁樁的設計。
knowledge.textEn: Load in stages and hold each stage under an approved test plan, recording head settlement, strain at each depth and time; compare settlement and residual settlement at the test load, for example twice the design load, with acceptance criteria, and compare the friction profile back-calculated from strain gauges with design assumptions, revising other barrettes if needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 載重試驗屬高能量作業，反力樑、錨樁或配重須經設計與檢查，試驗區設置警戒範圍；試驗結果由大地工程師出具報告並經主管機關接受後，工程樁才可據以施作或驗收。
knowledge.textEn: A load test stores high energy: reaction beams, anchor piles or kentledge must be designed and inspected and an exclusion zone set; working piles may be installed or accepted on the basis of the results only after the geotechnical engineer's report is accepted by the authority.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Barrette load tests and elastic shortening"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
依核准的試驗計畫分級加載並維持荷載，記錄樁頭沉陷、各深度應變與時間。
岩盤很深時就只能用很長的端承樁，摩擦樁不可靠。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Load in stages and hold each stage under an approved test plan, recording head settlement, strain at each depth and time.
Where bedrock is deep, only very long end-bearing piles work; friction piles are unreliable.
quiz.explanation: 依核准的試驗計畫分級加載並維持荷載，記錄樁頭沉陷、各深度應變與時間；以試驗荷載（例如設計荷載的兩倍）下的沉陷與殘餘沉陷對照允收準則，並以應變計推算的側摩擦分布與設計假設比較，必要時修正其他壁樁的設計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Load in stages and hold each stage under an approved test plan, recording head settlement, strain at each depth and time; compare settlement and residual settlement at the test load, for example twice the design load, with acceptance criteria, and compare the friction profile back-calculated from strain gauges with design assumptions, revising other barrettes if needed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壁樁載重試驗與彈性縮短：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Barrette load tests and elastic shortening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壁樁載重試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Barrette load testing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只看樁頭沉陷而不扣除樁身縮短，可能誤判土層已大量滑移而過度保守，或反之把樁身品質問題（例如夾泥造成局部軟化）誤認為土層行為；反力系統不足則可能在試驗中失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reading only head settlement without subtracting shaft shortening can misjudge large soil slip and be over-conservative, or conversely mistake a shaft defect such as a soil inclusion for soil behaviour; an inadequate reaction system can become unstable during the test. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長達 70 m 的樁，樁身彈性縮短本身就可能達數十毫米。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For a 70 m pile, elastic shortening of the shaft alone can reach tens of millimetres.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樁頭沉陷全部來自樁底或樁側土壤的變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All head settlement in a pile test comes from soil deformation at the toe or sides." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 填海地下結構的氯離子侵蝕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Chloride attack on below-ground structure in reclamation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「海埔地氯離子與耐久」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Chlorides and durability on reclaimed land” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 填海地盤的地下水含鹽，地下室外牆、筏基與壁樁長期接觸含氯離子的水；臨海環境的鹽霧也會影響低樓層外露混凝土。氯離子經混凝土孔隙擴散到鋼筋表面，濃度超過門檻後鈍化膜破壞，鋼筋開始腐蝕並膨脹使混凝土剝落。耐久設計以保護層厚度、低水膠比、摻爐石粉或飛灰降低擴散係數、裂縫寬度控制與防水層共同處理，並以設計年限推估需要的保護層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「海埔地氯離子與耐久」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Groundwater in reclaimed land is saline, so basement walls, the mat and barrettes are in long-term contact with chloride-bearing water, and sea spray affects exposed concrete at low levels. Chlorides diffuse through the pores to the reinforcement; once the concentration exceeds a threshold the passive film breaks down, the steel corrodes and expands, and the concrete spalls. Durability design combines cover depth, a low water–binder ratio, slag or fly ash to reduce the diffusion coefficient, crack-width control and waterproofing, using the design life to estimate the cover needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Chlorides and durability on reclaimed land” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以簡化擴散深度 x ≈ 2√(Dt) 估算氯離子前緣到達保護層的時間 t = x²/(4D)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the simplified penetration depth x ≈ 2√(Dt), the time for the chloride front to reach the cover is t = x²/(4D).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地下結構不受日曬雨淋，所以不會有耐久問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Below-ground structure is sheltered from sun and rain, so it has no durability problems." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「海埔地氯離子與耐久」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 填海地下結構的氯離子侵蝕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chloride attack on below-ground structure in reclamation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海埔地氯離子與耐久」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chlorides and durability on reclaimed land” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以簡化擴散深度 x ≈ 2√(Dt) 估算氯離子前緣到達保護層的時間 t = x²/(4D)。保護層 50 mm：D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t = 0.05²/(4×10⁻¹²) ≈ 6.25×10⁸ s ≈ 19.8 年；摻爐石使 D = 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s 時 t ≈ 39.6 年，加倍。數值為教學假設，未計門檻濃度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the simplified penetration depth x ≈ 2√(Dt), the time for the chloride front to reach the cover is t = x²/(4D). For 50 mm cover and D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s, t = 0.05²/(4×10⁻¹²) ≈ 6.25×10⁸ s ≈ 19.8 years; slag that lowers D to 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s gives t ≈ 39.6 years, twice as long. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring the threshold concentration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配比階段以快速氯離子滲透或遷移試驗確認擴散性能；施工時以保護層測定儀抽查鋼筋保護層，防水層做接縫與破損檢查；營運後定期取芯量測氯離子剖面，推估到達鋼筋的剩餘時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At mix design, confirm diffusion performance with rapid chloride permeability or migration tests; during construction check cover with a covermeter and inspect waterproofing joints and damage; in service take cores periodically to measure chloride profiles and estimate the remaining time before reaching the steel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 填海地下結構的氯離子侵蝕：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海埔地氯離子與耐久」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Chlorides and durability on reclaimed land” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配比階段以快速氯離子滲透或遷移試驗確認擴散性能；施工時以保護層測定儀抽查鋼筋保護層，防水層做接縫與破損檢查；營運後定期取芯量測氯離子剖面，推估到達鋼筋的剩餘時間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At mix design, confirm diffusion performance with rapid chloride permeability or migration tests; during construction check cover with a covermeter and inspect waterproofing joints and damage; in service take cores periodically to measure chloride profiles and estimate the remaining time before reaching the steel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐久設計報告應列出各部位暴露等級、保護層、配比限制與預期年限；竣工交接時附上保護層抽測紀錄與氯離子基準值，物業管理以此安排定期檢測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The durability report should list exposure class, cover, mix limits and expected life for each element; handover should include cover survey records and chloride baselines so facility management can schedule periodic testing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保護層不足或裂縫過寬的部位會提早腐蝕，地下室牆面出現鏽水與剝落；在九龍站等設施上方，地下結構的修補空間與停用時間都極為受限，使問題處理成本倍增。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Areas with thin cover or wide cracks corrode early, showing rust staining and spalling on basement walls; above facilities such as Kowloon Station, repair access and shutdown windows are severely limited, multiplying the cost of remediation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 颱風後檢查、回歸期與營運交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-typhoon inspection, return periods and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「颱風後檢查與回歸期」如何影響香港環球貿易廣場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-typhoon inspection and return period” governs force, deformation or durability in “International Commerce Centre”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計風速以回歸期表示，但「50 年一遇」並不代表 50 年內只會遇到一次或一定不會遇到；在建築數十年的使用期內，遭遇接近設計等級颱風的機率相當高。因此營運階段需要有颱風前後的檢查制度：帷幕牆單元、屋頂設備、擋水與排水、外伸臂與巨柱接頭、監測資料都要在事件後檢視，並與基準比較。交接文件必須讓營運單位理解設計依據的回歸期、各系統的容許反應與事件後何時需要結構工程師介入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「颱風後檢查與回歸期」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Design wind speeds are expressed as return periods, but a 50-year event does not mean exactly one occurrence in 50 years, nor that it will not occur; over a building life of several decades, the chance of meeting a near-design typhoon is high. Operation therefore needs inspections before and after typhoons: curtain-wall units, roof equipment, flood barriers and drainage, outrigger and mega-column joints and monitoring data should be reviewed after each event and compared with baselines. Handover documents must let the operator understand the design return periods, the allowable response of each system and when a structural engineer must be called in after an event. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-typhoon inspection and return period” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：n 年內至少遭遇一次回歸期 T 事件的機率 P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The probability of at least one event of return period T in n years is P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「50 年回歸期的颱風在 50 年內最多只會發生一次。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A 50-year-return typhoon can happen at most once in 50 years." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 颱風後檢查、回歸期與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-typhoon inspection, return periods and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「颱風後檢查與回歸期」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-typhoon inspection and return period” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：n 年內至少遭遇一次回歸期 T 事件的機率 P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ。T = 50 年、n = 50 年：P = 1 − 0.98⁵⁰ ≈ 63.6%；T = 500 年：P ≈ 9.5%；T = 10 年：P ≈ 99.5%。數值為機率示範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The probability of at least one event of return period T in n years is P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ. For T = 50 years and n = 50 years, P = 1 − 0.98⁵⁰ ≈ 63.6%; for T = 500 years, P ≈ 9.5%; for T = 10 years, P ≈ 99.5%. Values are a probability illustration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次八號或以上颱風信號後，依檢查表巡查帷幕牆、屋頂與機電固定件，並調閱頂部加速度與風速紀錄，與設計預測和歷次事件比較；若任一反應超過預警值，由結構工程師進行詳細檢查並出具報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each typhoon signal No. 8 or higher, inspect curtain wall, roof and services fixings against a checklist and review top acceleration and wind records against design predictions and previous events; if any response exceeds its alert level, a structural engineer carries out a detailed inspection and issues a report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: n 年內至少遭遇一次回歸期 T 事件的機率 P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ。T = 50 年、n = 50 年：P = 1 − 0.98⁵⁰ ≈ 63.6%；T = 500 年：P ≈ 9.5%；T = 10 年：P ≈ 99.5%。數值為機率示範。
knowledge.textEn: The probability of at least one event of return period T in n years is P = 1 − (1 − 1/T)ⁿ. For T = 50 years and n = 50 years, P = 1 − 0.98⁵⁰ ≈ 63.6%; for T = 500 years, P ≈ 9.5%; for T = 10 years, P ≈ 99.5%. Values are a probability illustration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 每次八號或以上颱風信號後，依檢查表巡查帷幕牆、屋頂與機電固定件，並調閱頂部加速度與風速紀錄，與設計預測和歷次事件比較；若任一反應超過預警值，由結構工程師進行詳細檢查並出具報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each typhoon signal No. 8 or higher, inspect curtain wall, roof and services fixings against a checklist and review top acceleration and wind records against design predictions and previous events; if any response exceeds its alert level, a structural engineer carries out a detailed inspection and issues a report. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含設計回歸期與容許反應一覽、颱風前後檢查表、監測門檻與通報流程，並約定事件後結構工程師的到場時限與檢查範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include a table of design return periods and allowable responses, pre- and post-typhoon checklists, monitoring thresholds and reporting procedures, and agree the response time and inspection scope for the structural engineer after events.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若營運單位誤以為設計颱風在使用期內不太可能發生而省略檢查，帷幕牆固定件或屋頂設備的累積損傷可能在下一次颱風中突然失效，造成墜落物危害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An operator who believes the design typhoon is unlikely in the building's life and skips inspections can let accumulated damage to curtain-wall fixings or roof equipment fail suddenly in the next typhoon, creating falling-object hazards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 若營運單位誤以為設計颱風在使用期內不太可能發生而省略檢查，帷幕牆固定件或屋頂設備的累積損傷可能在下一次颱風中突然失效，造成墜落物危害。
knowledge.textEn: An operator who believes the design typhoon is unlikely in the building's life and skips inspections can let accumulated damage to curtain-wall fixings or roof equipment fail suddenly in the next typhoon, creating falling-object hazards.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

title: 碎片大廈
summary: 碎片大廈由 Renzo Piano 設計、WSP 擔任結構設計、Mace 承建，官方高度 309.6 m、共 95 層。結構依用途分區：下部辦公層為複合鋼構，上部飯店與住宅層為 200 mm 後拉預力混凝土平板，塔頂以鋼構「散熱器」與桅桿收尾；中央混凝土核心筒是主要抗側骨幹，以費氏桁架與 A 形轉換調整柱距。英國首次採用由上而下的核心筒施工，讓核心筒在地下室開挖時同步上升。本課涵蓋分區質量、扭轉、預力樓板、轉換構件、由上而下施工、尖塔與塔吊、風洞、鄰近鐵路監測、帷幕牆與帽桁架的交接。
summaryEn: The Shard, designed by Renzo Piano with WSP as structural designer and Mace as contractor, is officially 309.6 m tall with 95 storeys. Its structure is zoned by use: composite steel for the lower offices, 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs for the hotel and homes above, and a steel radiator and mast at the crown; a central concrete core is the main lateral spine, with Vierendeel trusses and A-frames changing column spacing. It was the first UK use of top-down core construction, letting the core rise while the basement was being dug. The course covers zoned mass, torsion, post-tensioned slabs, transfer structures, top-down construction, spire and cranes, wind-tunnel testing, monitoring of adjacent rail assets, curtain-wall joints and the handover of hat trusses.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：由允許擺幅反推核心筒所需勁度與牆厚。以等效均布風荷載 w = 60 kN/m 作用於 H = 306 m 的懸臂，頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。若容許 Δ = 0.40 m，需 EI = wH⁴/(8Δ) = 60×306⁴/(8×0.40) ≈ 1.64×10¹¹ kN·m²；取混凝土 E = 40 GPa，I = 1.64×10¹¹/(4.0×10⁷) ≈ 4,110 m⁴。以邊長 b = 20 m 的薄壁方形核心 I ≈ (2/3)t·b³ 估算，t = 4,110/((2/3)×8,000) ≈ 0.77 m。若改要求 Δ = 0.30 m，EI 增為約 2.19×10¹¹ kN·m²，I ≈ 5,480 m⁴，t ≈ 1.03 m，牆厚增加約三分之一；若改以外伸帽桁架提供部分勁度，則可在不加厚牆的情況下達到相同變位。數值為教學假設，未計開口、翼牆、背包次核心與動力效應，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: back-calculate core stiffness and wall thickness from the allowed sway. Apply an equivalent uniform wind load w = 60 kN/m to a cantilever H = 306 m tall, with top drift Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For an allowed Δ = 0.40 m, EI = wH⁴/(8Δ) = 60×306⁴/(8×0.40) ≈ 1.64×10¹¹ kN·m²; with E = 40 GPa, I = 1.64×10¹¹/(4.0×10⁷) ≈ 4,110 m⁴. For a thin-walled square core of side b = 20 m, I ≈ (2/3)t·b³, so t = 4,110/((2/3)×8,000) ≈ 0.77 m. Tightening the limit to Δ = 0.30 m raises EI to about 2.19×10¹¹ kN·m², I ≈ 5,480 m⁴ and t ≈ 1.03 m, about a third thicker; letting outrigger hat trusses supply part of the stiffness reaches the same drift without thickening the walls. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings, wing walls, the Backpack core and dynamic effects, not the actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混合用途分區與樓板系統」與「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" and "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「用途分區與樓板質量」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Use zoning and floor mass” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「用途分區與樓板質量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Use zoning and floor mass” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「用途分區與樓板質量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Use zoning and floor mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統
knowledge.text: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。
knowledge.textEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混合用途分區與樓板系統」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" is correct?
options: 樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面。
只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
optionsEn: Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load.
The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep.
If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
quiz.explanation: 設計者公開說明：下部辦公與零售層採複合鋼構，周邊到混凝土核心筒的跨度可達約 15 m，樓板梁為約 500 mm 深的組合斷面；上部飯店與住宅層改用 200 mm 厚後拉預力混凝土平板，跨度約 9 m、層高約 3.1 m；塔頂約 60 m 為鋼構「散熱器」，容納散熱設備並圍繞中央斜撐鋼桅。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The designers explain that the lower office and retail floors are composite steel with spans of up to about 15 m from the perimeter to the concrete core and built-up floor beams about 500 mm deep; the hotel and residential floors above switch to 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs spanning about 9 m with a storey height of about 3.1 m; the top 60 m or so is a steel radiator housing heat-rejection plant around a central braced steel mast. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「用途分區與樓板質量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Use zoning and floor mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。若上部樓板使第一模態廣義質量增加 20%，在相同風力與阻尼下共振加速度約降為 1/1.2 ≈ 83%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier. If the upper floors raise the first-mode generalised mass by 20%, resonant acceleration under the same wind force and damping falls to about 1/1.2 ≈ 83%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。若上部樓板使第一模態廣義質量增加 20%，在相同風力與阻尼下共振加速度約降為 1/1.2 ≈ 83%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier. If the upper floors raise the first-mode generalised mass by 20%, resonant acceleration under the same wind force and damping falls to about 1/1.2 ≈ 83%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「混合用途分區與樓板系統」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems", which statement holds?
options: 沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。
塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa。
optionsEn: A Vierendeel truss without diagonals carries load about as well as a braced truss.
A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.

Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier.
quiz.explanation: 樓板自重：200 mm 預力平板 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa；複合樓板等效厚 0.11 m×24 kN/m³ + 鋼梁 0.5 kPa ≈ 3.1 kPa，約 1.6 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Floor self-weight: a 200 mm post-tensioned slab gives 0.2×25 = 5.0 kPa, while a composite slab with an equivalent 0.11 m thickness at 24 kN/m³ plus 0.5 kPa of steel gives about 3.1 kPa, so the post-tensioned slab is about 1.6 times heavier. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「用途分區與樓板質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Use zoning and floor mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在模型中分別以鋼構與混凝土樓板計算高處各層質量與第一、二模態的廣義質量，與風洞高頻力平衡試驗換算的加速度比較；完工後以環境振動量測頻率與阻尼，確認無補充阻尼的假設成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute storey masses and first- and second-mode generalised masses with steel and concrete floors in the model and compare the acceleration derived from high-frequency force-balance tests; after completion measure frequency and damping by ambient vibration to confirm that the no-supplementary-damping assumption holds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準應記錄各分區的樓板質量假設與其對加速度的影響，日後若變更用途（例如住宅改辦公）或大幅減輕裝修，須由結構工程師評估居住性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should record the floor-mass assumption of each zone and its effect on acceleration, and any later change of use, such as residential to office, or major lightening of finishes requires the structural engineer to reassess habitability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混合用途分區與樓板系統」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets.

steps.title: 混合用途分區與樓板系統：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mixed-use zoning and floor systems: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「用途分區與樓板質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Use zoning and floor mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上部較重的混凝土樓板增加了高處的模態質量與阻尼，設計者因此認為不需要另設補充阻尼裝置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The heavier concrete floors high up add modal mass and damping, which the designers considered sufficient to avoid supplementary damping devices.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混合用途分區與樓板系統」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上。
只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits.
If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
quiz.explanation: 若上部改用較輕的樓板或大幅減少隔間與裝修質量而未重新評估，高處加速度可能上升到住宅與飯店的舒適度門檻以上；不同樓板系統的交界層若勁度與質量突變未處理，也容易出現樓板裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Switching upper floors to lighter construction or greatly reducing partitions and finishes without re-evaluation can raise upper-level accelerations above residential and hotel comfort limits; abrupt stiffness and mass changes at the interface between floor systems also invite slab cracking if not addressed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背包次核心與扭轉」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backpack secondary core and torsion” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。塔樓低層一側附有被稱為「背包」的低層附屬量體，其中設有次核心，用來減少主核心承受的扭轉。當風力合力或質量中心與剛心不重合時，樓層會繞剛心旋轉，角落位移比中心大；在偏心側增加剪力牆，相當於增大扭轉勁度並拉近剛心與質心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背包次核心與扭轉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. A low-rise annex called the Backpack attaches to one side at the lower levels, and its secondary core reduces torsion on the main core. When the wind resultant or centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of stiffness, floors rotate about the stiffness centre and corners move more than the middle; adding shear walls on the eccentric side raises torsional stiffness and draws the centres together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Backpack secondary core and torsion” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「背包次核心與扭轉」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Backpack secondary core and torsion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉
knowledge.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core
knowledge.text: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。塔樓低層一側附有被稱為「背包」的低層附屬量體，其中設有次核心，用來減少主核心承受的扭轉。
knowledge.textEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. A low-rise annex called the Backpack attaches to one side at the lower levels, and its secondary core reduces torsion on the main core.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core" is correct?
options: 只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。
中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。
optionsEn: If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete.

The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability.
quiz.explanation: 中央混凝土核心筒剪力牆是主要的抗側骨幹，飯店與住宅層另加翼牆提高核心勁度；頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The central concrete core shear walls are the main lateral spine, with wing walls added at hotel and residential levels to stiffen the core, and outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背包次核心與扭轉」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backpack secondary core and torsion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。F = 20,000 kN、偏心 e = 5 m，T = 100,000 kN·m；主核心 K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad 時 θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad，r = 30 m 的角落位移 15 mm；次核心使 K_T 增為 2.5×10⁸，θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad，角落位移 12 mm，減少 20%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. With F = 20,000 kN and e = 5 m, T = 100,000 kN·m; a main-core K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad gives θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 15 mm at a corner r = 30 m away; a secondary core raising K_T to 2.5×10⁸ gives θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 12 mm, 20% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the three-dimensional model to compute the eccentricity between centres of mass and stiffness at each level, torsional periods and participating mass, comparing corner displacements with and without the secondary core; the wind-tunnel test must supply torque spectra to confirm corner accelerations meet habitability criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。F = 20,000 kN、偏心 e = 5 m，T = 100,000 kN·m；主核心 K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad 時 θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad，r = 30 m 的角落位移 15 mm；次核心使 K_T 增為 2.5×10⁸，θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad，角落位移 12 mm，減少 20%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. With F = 20,000 kN and e = 5 m, T = 100,000 kN·m; a main-core K_T = 2.0×10⁸ kN·m/rad gives θ = 5.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 15 mm at a corner r = 30 m away; a secondary core raising K_T to 2.5×10⁸ gives θ = 4.0×10⁻⁴ rad and 12 mm, 20% less. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core", which statement holds?
options: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。
由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。
optionsEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r.
Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 扭矩 T = F·e，轉角 θ = T/K_T，角落位移 = θ·r。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Torque T = F·e, rotation θ = T/K_T and corner displacement = θ·r. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背包次核心與扭轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backpack secondary core and torsion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維模型計算各層質心與剛心的偏心距、扭轉模態週期與參與質量，比較有無次核心的角落位移；風洞試驗需提供扭矩頻譜，確認角落加速度在居住性準則內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對有附屬量體或不對稱收分的塔樓，設計報告應逐層列出偏心距與扭轉不規則判定，並說明次核心或翼牆的配置理由；施工中次核心與主核心的連接樓板須按順序完成。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 核心筒抗側與次核心抑制扭轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core lateral resistance and torsion control by a secondary core: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背包次核心與扭轉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backpack secondary core and torsion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the eccentricity created by a low-rise annex loads the corners and coupling beams of the main core with extra shear and torsional stress that can crack them, and corner curtain walls see larger inter-storey movements than designed, causing seal failures. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：當風力合力或質量中心與剛心不重合時，樓層會繞剛心旋轉，角落位移比中心大；在偏心側增加剪力牆，相當於增大扭轉勁度並拉近剛心與質心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When the wind resultant or centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of stiffness, floors rotate about the stiffness centre and corners move more than the middle; adding shear walls on the eccentric side raises torsional stiffness and draws the centres together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。
若忽略低層附屬量體造成的偏心，主核心牆角落與連梁會在風下承受額外剪力與扭轉應力而開裂；角落帷幕牆的層間變位也會大於設計值，造成密封失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete.
