stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱」與「柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns" and "Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「200 mm 後拉預力平板」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上部飯店與住宅層的柱使用約 65 至 80 MPa 高強混凝土，樓板為 50 至 60 MPa 的後拉預力平板。後拉鋼腱以拋物線佈置，在跨中靠下、在柱上靠上，張拉後對混凝土產生向上的等效荷重，抵銷大部分自重；薄板因此能以約 9 m 跨度、200 mm 厚度控制撓度與裂縫，縮小層高並在塔頂收分時節省高度。柱斷面因高強度而縮小，讓逐層收縮的平面仍保有可用面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「200 mm 後拉預力平板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Columns in the upper hotel and residential levels use about 65 to 80 MPa high-strength concrete, and floors are 50 to 60 MPa post-tensioned flat slabs. Tendons follow a parabolic profile, low at mid-span and high over columns, so after stressing they apply an upward equivalent load that cancels most of the self-weight; the thin slab can therefore span about 9 m at 200 mm thick while controlling deflection and cracking, reducing storey height and saving height as the tower tapers. High strength keeps column sections small so the shrinking floor plates retain usable area. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「200 mm 後拉預力平板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱
knowledge.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns
knowledge.text: 上部飯店與住宅層的柱使用約 65 至 80 MPa 高強混凝土，樓板為 50 至 60 MPa 的後拉預力平板。後拉鋼腱以拋物線佈置，在跨中靠下、在柱上靠上，張拉後對混凝土產生向上的等效荷重，抵銷大部分自重；薄板因此能以約 9 m 跨度、200 mm 厚度控制撓度與裂縫，縮小層高並在塔頂收分時節省高度。

Tendons follow a parabolic profile, low at mid-span and high over columns, so after stressing they apply an upward equivalent load that cancels most of the self-weight; the thin slab can therefore span about 9 m at 200 mm thick while controlling deflection and cracking, reducing storey height and saving height as the tower tapers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns" is correct?
options: 上部飯店與住宅層的柱使用約 65 至 80 MPa 高強混凝土，樓板為 50 至 60 MPa 的後拉預力平板。
後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。
沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。
optionsEn: Columns in the upper hotel and residential levels use about 65 to 80 MPa high-strength concrete, and floors are 50 to 60 MPa post-tensioned flat slabs.
A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete.
A Vierendeel truss without diagonals carries load about as well as a braced truss.
quiz.explanation: 上部飯店與住宅層的柱使用約 65 至 80 MPa 高強混凝土，樓板為 50 至 60 MPa 的後拉預力平板。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Columns in the upper hotel and residential levels use about 65 to 80 MPa high-strength concrete, and floors are 50 to 60 MPa post-tensioned flat slabs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 mm 後拉預力平板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。目標平衡 3.5 kPa（約自重 70%）、L = 9 m、垂度 e = 0.06 m：P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m；對 200 mm 板平均預壓 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa；跨深比 9,000/200 = 45。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e). Balancing 3.5 kPa, about 70% of self-weight, over L = 9 m with a drape e = 0.06 m needs P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m, an average precompression of 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa in a 200 mm slab; the span-to-depth ratio is 9,000/200 = 45. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張拉前確認混凝土達到規定的轉移強度（以現場養護試體或成熟度判定），張拉時同時記錄千斤頂力與伸長量並與計算值比較（例如允差 ±7%）；拆模後量測樓板撓度，與含預力損失的預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before stressing, confirm the concrete has reached the specified transfer strength from field-cured specimens or maturity; during stressing record jack force and elongation together and compare with calculation, for example within ±7%; after striking, measure slab deflection against predictions that include prestress losses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。目標平衡 3.5 kPa（約自重 70%）、L = 9 m、垂度 e = 0.06 m：P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m；對 200 mm 板平均預壓 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa；跨深比 9,000/200 = 45。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e). Balancing 3.5 kPa, about 70% of self-weight, over L = 9 m with a drape e = 0.06 m needs P = 3.5×81/(8×0.06) ≈ 591 kN/m, an average precompression of 591/0.2 ≈ 2.95 MPa in a 200 mm slab; the span-to-depth ratio is 9,000/200 = 45. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns", which statement holds?
options: 塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。
只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。
optionsEn: A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.
The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e).
If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets.
quiz.explanation: 平衡荷重 w_bal = 8Pe/L²，故 P = w_bal·L²/(8e)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The balanced load is w_bal = 8Pe/L², so P = w_bal·L²/(8e). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「200 mm 後拉預力平板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張拉前確認混凝土達到規定的轉移強度（以現場養護試體或成熟度判定），張拉時同時記錄千斤頂力與伸長量並與計算值比較（例如允差 ±7%）；拆模後量測樓板撓度，與含預力損失的預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before stressing, confirm the concrete has reached the specified transfer strength from field-cured specimens or maturity; during stressing record jack force and elongation together and compare with calculation, for example within ±7%; after striking, measure slab deflection against predictions that include prestress losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預力樓板竣工圖必須標示鋼腱位置與禁鑽區，物業管理規章規定任何鑽孔須先以掃描定位並經結構工程師核可；張拉屬高風險作業，須由合格專業廠商依核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built drawings of post-tensioned slabs must show tendon locations and no-drill zones, building rules must require scanning and structural approval before any drilling, and stressing, a high-risk operation, must be done by a qualified specialist under an approved procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：日後在預力板上鑽孔或切割若打斷鋼腱，會突然失去預力，造成局部撓度增加，甚至鋼腱彈出的危險；張拉時混凝土強度不足則可能使錨定區爆裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drilling or cutting a post-tensioned slab later and severing a tendon causes a sudden loss of prestress, extra local deflection and even the danger of a tendon ejecting; stressing before the concrete is strong enough can burst the anchorage zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Before stressing, confirm the concrete has reached the specified transfer strength from field-cured specimens or maturity; during stressing record jack force and elongation together and compare with calculation, for example within ±7%; after striking, measure slab deflection against predictions that include prestress losses.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預力樓板竣工圖必須標示鋼腱位置與禁鑽區，物業管理規章規定任何鑽孔須先以掃描定位並經結構工程師核可；張拉屬高風險作業，須由合格專業廠商依核准程序執行。

steps.title: 後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-tensioned slabs and high-strength concrete columns: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「200 mm 後拉預力平板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “200 mm post-tensioned flat slabs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 日後在預力板上鑽孔或切割若打斷鋼腱，會突然失去預力，造成局部撓度增加，甚至鋼腱彈出的危險；張拉時混凝土強度不足則可能使錨定區爆裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drilling or cutting a post-tensioned slab later and severing a tendon causes a sudden loss of prestress, extra local deflection and even the danger of a tendon ejecting; stressing before the concrete is strong enough can burst the anchorage zone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：柱斷面因高強度而縮小，讓逐層收縮的平面仍保有可用面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High strength keeps column sections small so the shrinking floor plates retain usable area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「後拉預力樓板與高強混凝土柱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 日後在預力板上鑽孔或切割若打斷鋼腱，會突然失去預力，造成局部撓度增加，甚至鋼腱彈出的危險；張拉時混凝土強度不足則可能使錨定區爆裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。
optionsEn: Drilling or cutting a post-tensioned slab later and severing a tendon causes a sudden loss of prestress, extra local deflection and even the danger of a tendon ejecting.

A Vierendeel truss without diagonals carries load about as well as a braced truss.

steps.title: 柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 不同用途要求不同柱距：辦公需要開闊空間，住宅與飯店則以房間模組配置柱位。設計者以鋼構費氏桁架把上部柱重新對位到辦公層，並以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 逐步加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m；在與背包量體交接處則用 A 形轉換構架加大下方柱距。核心內另有轉換牆與轉換梁支撐半高處的空中大廳。重新對位的傾斜周邊柱會在樓板隔板產生推拉水平力，最後由核心筒平衡。費氏桁架沒有斜桿，靠弦桿與豎桿的剛接彎矩傳遞剪力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different uses need different column spacing: offices want open space while homes and hotels align columns with room modules. The designers used steel Vierendeel trusses to realign upper columns onto the office floors, and Vierendeel grids to step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m; at the junction with the Backpack, A-frame transfers widen the spacing below. Inside the core, transfer walls and girders support the mid-height sky lobby. Inclined perimeter columns that realign create push–pull forces in the floor diaphragms, finally resolved by the core. A Vierendeel truss has no diagonals and carries shear through bending in rigidly connected chords and verticals. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：費氏桁架每格剪力由上下弦桿平分，反曲點在格中，弦桿端彎矩 M = (V/2)(a/2)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a Vierendeel panel the two chords share the shear equally with contraflexure at mid-panel, so the chord end moment is M = (V/2)(a/2).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A Vierendeel truss without diagonals carries load about as well as a braced truss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架
knowledge.titleEn: Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames
knowledge.text: 不同用途要求不同柱距：辦公需要開闊空間，住宅與飯店則以房間模組配置柱位。設計者以鋼構費氏桁架把上部柱重新對位到辦公層，並以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 逐步加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m；在與背包量體交接處則用 A 形轉換構架加大下方柱距。

The designers used steel Vierendeel trusses to realign upper columns onto the office floors, and Vierendeel grids to step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m; at the junction with the Backpack, A-frame transfers widen the spacing below.

quiz.question: 關於「柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：費氏桁架每格剪力由上下弦桿平分，反曲點在格中，弦桿端彎矩 M = (V/2)(a/2)。格內剪力 V = 1,200 kN、格寬 a = 3.0 m：M = 600×1.5 = 900 kN·m；若格寬改為 1.5 m，M 降為 450 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a Vierendeel panel the two chords share the shear equally with contraflexure at mid-panel, so the chord end moment is M = (V/2)(a/2). For a panel shear V = 1,200 kN and width a = 3.0 m, M = 600×1.5 = 900 kN·m; halving the width to 1.5 m reduces M to 450 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以考慮施工順序的模型計算轉換構件在各階段的內力與撓度，確認上方樓層澆置或安裝時轉換構件已完成並具足夠勁度；剛接節點的全滲透焊依規範做超音波檢測，並量測轉換層的實際撓度與預拱值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a sequence-aware model to compute transfer-member forces and deflections at each stage, confirming the transfers are complete and stiff enough before floors above are cast or erected; ultrasonically test the complete-penetration welds at rigid joints to the code and compare the measured deflection of transfer levels with the camber provided.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.explanation: 費氏桁架每格剪力由上下弦桿平分，反曲點在格中，弦桿端彎矩 M = (V/2)(a/2)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: In a Vierendeel panel the two chords share the shear equally with contraflexure at mid-panel, so the chord end moment is M = (V/2)(a/2). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以考慮施工順序的模型計算轉換構件在各階段的內力與撓度，確認上方樓層澆置或安裝時轉換構件已完成並具足夠勁度；剛接節點的全滲透焊依規範做超音波檢測，並量測轉換層的實際撓度與預拱值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a sequence-aware model to compute transfer-member forces and deflections at each stage, confirming the transfers are complete and stiff enough before floors above are cast or erected; ultrasonically test the complete-penetration welds at rigid joints to the code and compare the measured deflection of transfer levels with the camber provided. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉換構件應列為關鍵構件，施工圖標示預拱、臨時支撐與允許拆撐的條件；轉換層樓板的開孔與日後改裝須經結構工程師審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat transfer members as key elements, showing camber, temporary shoring and conditions for removing it on the drawings, and require structural review for openings and later alterations in transfer-level slabs.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：費氏桁架節點若焊接品質不足或剛接性不夠，弦桿彎矩無法傳遞，轉換構件撓度與上部柱沉陷超出預期，造成上層樓板與隔間開裂；樓板隔板若在傾斜柱處被開孔削弱，推拉力找不到路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If Vierendeel joints are poorly welded or not rigid enough, chord moments cannot transfer, so transfer deflection and settlement of columns above exceed predictions and crack upper floors and partitions; diaphragms weakened by openings at inclined columns leave push–pull forces without a path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以考慮施工順序的模型計算轉換構件在各階段的內力與撓度，確認上方樓層澆置或安裝時轉換構件已完成並具足夠勁度；剛接節點的全滲透焊依規範做超音波檢測，並量測轉換層的實際撓度與預拱值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Use a sequence-aware model to compute transfer-member forces and deflections at each stage, confirming the transfers are complete and stiff enough before floors above are cast or erected; ultrasonically test the complete-penetration welds at rigid joints to the code and compare the measured deflection of transfer levels with the camber provided.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉換構件應列為關鍵構件，施工圖標示預拱、臨時支撐與允許拆撐的條件；轉換層樓板的開孔與日後改裝須經結構工程師審查。
knowledge.textEn: Treat transfer members as key elements, showing camber, temporary shoring and conditions for removing it on the drawings, and require structural review for openings and later alterations in transfer-level slabs.

quiz.question: 要驗證「柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames"?
options: 以考慮施工順序的模型計算轉換構件在各階段的內力與撓度，確認上方樓層澆置或安裝時轉換構件已完成並具足夠勁度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
optionsEn: Use a sequence-aware model to compute transfer-member forces and deflections at each stage, confirming the transfers are complete and stiff enough before floors above are cast or erected.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load.
quiz.explanation: 以考慮施工順序的模型計算轉換構件在各階段的內力與撓度，確認上方樓層澆置或安裝時轉換構件已完成並具足夠勁度；剛接節點的全滲透焊依規範做超音波檢測，並量測轉換層的實際撓度與預拱值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a sequence-aware model to compute transfer-member forces and deflections at each stage, confirming the transfers are complete and stiff enough before floors above are cast or erected; ultrasonically test the complete-penetration welds at rigid joints to the code and compare the measured deflection of transfer levels with the camber provided. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「費氏桁架與 A 形轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vierendeel and A-frame transfers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 費氏桁架節點若焊接品質不足或剛接性不夠，弦桿彎矩無法傳遞，轉換構件撓度與上部柱沉陷超出預期，造成上層樓板與隔間開裂；樓板隔板若在傾斜柱處被開孔削弱，推拉力找不到路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If Vierendeel joints are poorly welded or not rigid enough, chord moments cannot transfer, so transfer deflection and settlement of columns above exceed predictions and crack upper floors and partitions; diaphragms weakened by openings at inclined columns leave push–pull forces without a path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：費氏桁架沒有斜桿，靠弦桿與豎桿的剛接彎矩傳遞剪力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A Vierendeel truss has no diagonals and carries shear through bending in rigidly connected chords and verticals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A Vierendeel truss without diagonals carries load about as well as a braced truss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 費氏桁架節點若焊接品質不足或剛接性不夠，弦桿彎矩無法傳遞，轉換構件撓度與上部柱沉陷超出預期，造成上層樓板與隔間開裂；樓板隔板若在傾斜柱處被開孔削弱，推拉力找不到路徑。
knowledge.textEn: If Vierendeel joints are poorly welded or not rigid enough, chord moments cannot transfer, so transfer deflection and settlement of columns above exceed predictions and crack upper floors and partitions; diaphragms weakened by openings at inclined columns leave push–pull forces without a path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱距轉換：費氏桁架與 A 形構架」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Column-spacing transfers by Vierendeel trusses and A-frames" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
費氏桁架節點若焊接品質不足或剛接性不夠，弦桿彎矩無法傳遞，轉換構件撓度與上部柱沉陷超出預期，造成上層樓板與隔間開裂。
由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If Vierendeel joints are poorly welded or not rigid enough, chord moments cannot transfer, so transfer deflection and settlement of columns above exceed predictions and crack upper floors and partitions.
Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
quiz.explanation: 費氏桁架節點若焊接品質不足或剛接性不夠，弦桿彎矩無法傳遞，轉換構件撓度與上部柱沉陷超出預期，造成上層樓板與隔間開裂；樓板隔板若在傾斜柱處被開孔削弱，推拉力找不到路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If Vierendeel joints are poorly welded or not rigid enough, chord moments cannot transfer, so transfer deflection and settlement of columns above exceed predictions and crack upper floors and partitions; diaphragms weakened by openings at inclined columns leave push–pull forces without a path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」與「爬升塔吊與塔頂尖塔施工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug" and "Climbing cranes and spire construction": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「由上而下的核心筒」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top-down core” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主塔地下室採由上而下施工：先施作周邊直徑 900 mm 的咬合樁擋土牆與直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m 的鑽掘樁，在樁中插入鋼柱（插入柱），再由地面向下逐層施作樓板並開挖，樓板同時作為擋土牆的水平支撐。核心筒則在地下室尚未完成時就開始向上施作，地上與地下同時推進。這縮短工期並限制鄰近地層位移，但在筏基完成前，核心筒與已完成樓層的荷重全靠插入柱與樁承擔，因此可以先蓋多高是一個明確的計算問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「由上而下的核心筒」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main tower basement was built top-down: first a perimeter secant-pile wall of 900 mm piles and 1,500 mm bored piles about 50 m deep were installed, with steel plunge columns set into the piles; then slabs were cast level by level downward as excavation proceeded, each slab propping the retaining wall. The core started rising before the basement was finished, so work advanced above and below ground at once. This shortens the programme and limits ground movement, but until the raft is complete the core and finished floors rely entirely on the plunge columns and piles, so how high the core may go first is an explicit calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Top-down core” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「由上而下的核心筒」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Top-down core”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步
knowledge.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug
knowledge.text: 主塔地下室採由上而下施工：先施作周邊直徑 900 mm 的咬合樁擋土牆與直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m 的鑽掘樁，在樁中插入鋼柱（插入柱），再由地面向下逐層施作樓板並開挖，樓板同時作為擋土牆的水平支撐。核心筒則在地下室尚未完成時就開始向上施作，地上與地下同時推進。
knowledge.textEn: The main tower basement was built top-down: first a perimeter secant-pile wall of 900 mm piles and 1,500 mm bored piles about 50 m deep were installed, with steel plunge columns set into the piles; then slabs were cast level by level downward as excavation proceeded, each slab propping the retaining wall. The core started rising before the basement was finished, so work advanced above and below ground at once.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug" is correct?
options: 由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
主塔地下室採由上而下施工：先施作周邊直徑 900 mm 的咬合樁擋土牆與直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m 的鑽掘樁，在樁中插入鋼柱（插入柱），再由地面向下逐層施作樓板並開挖，樓板同時作為擋土牆的水平支撐。
optionsEn: Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.
The main tower basement was built top-down: first a perimeter secant-pile wall of 900 mm piles and 1,500 mm bored piles about 50 m deep were installed, with steel plunge columns set into the piles.
quiz.explanation: 主塔地下室採由上而下施工：先施作周邊直徑 900 mm 的咬合樁擋土牆與直徑 1,500 mm、深約 50 m 的鑽掘樁，在樁中插入鋼柱（插入柱），再由地面向下逐層施作樓板並開挖，樓板同時作為擋土牆的水平支撐。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The main tower basement was built top-down: first a perimeter secant-pile wall of 900 mm piles and 1,500 mm bored piles about 50 m deep were installed, with steel plunge columns set into the piles; then slabs were cast level by level downward as excavation proceeded, each slab propping the retaining wall. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「由上而下的核心筒」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top-down core” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。D = 1.5 m、L = 50 m、α = 0.5、平均 c_u = 150 kPa：Q_s ≈ 17,670 kN，安全係數 2.5 得容許約 7,070 kN。若核心下方 8 支插入柱樁，核心每層荷重 3,000 kN，筏基完成前最多約 8×7,070/3,000 ≈ 18 層。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u. With D = 1.5 m, L = 50 m, α = 0.5 and average c_u = 150 kPa, Q_s ≈ 17,670 kN, or about 7,070 kN allowable with a factor of safety of 2.5. With 8 plunge-column piles under the core and 3,000 kN of core load per storey, the core can rise at most about 8×7,070/3,000 ≈ 18 storeys before the raft is complete. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：插入柱的位置與垂直度在澆置前以測量確認（常見允差為長度的 1/400 以內），每完成若干核心樓層即核對樁頭沉陷與插入柱應變，並以施工階段分析確認擋土牆與樓板支撐在每一開挖階段的內力；達到允許的核心高度前，筏基須完成並驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before concreting, survey plunge-column position and verticality, commonly within 1/400 of length; after every few core storeys check pile-head settlement and plunge-column strain, and use construction-stage analysis to confirm retaining-wall and slab-prop forces at each excavation stage; the raft must be complete and accepted before the core exceeds its permitted height.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。D = 1.5 m、L = 50 m、α = 0.5、平均 c_u = 150 kPa：Q_s ≈ 17,670 kN，安全係數 2.5 得容許約 7,070 kN。若核心下方 8 支插入柱樁，核心每層荷重 3,000 kN，筏基完成前最多約 8×7,070/3,000 ≈ 18 層。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u. With D = 1.5 m, L = 50 m, α = 0.5 and average c_u = 150 kPa, Q_s ≈ 17,670 kN, or about 7,070 kN allowable with a factor of safety of 2.5. With 8 plunge-column piles under the core and 3,000 kN of core load per storey, the core can rise at most about 8×7,070/3,000 ≈ 18 storeys before the raft is complete. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug", which statement holds?
options: 倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。
只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。
所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。
optionsEn: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u.
If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets.
Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong.
quiz.explanation: 倫敦黏土中鑽掘樁側摩擦 Q_s = πDLαc_u。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Side friction of a bored pile in London Clay is Q_s = πDLαc_u. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「由上而下的核心筒」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Top-down core” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 插入柱的位置與垂直度在澆置前以測量確認（常見允差為長度的 1/400 以內），每完成若干核心樓層即核對樁頭沉陷與插入柱應變，並以施工階段分析確認擋土牆與樓板支撐在每一開挖階段的內力；達到允許的核心高度前，筏基須完成並驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before concreting, survey plunge-column position and verticality, commonly within 1/400 of length; after every few core storeys check pile-head settlement and plunge-column strain, and use construction-stage analysis to confirm retaining-wall and slab-prop forces at each excavation stage; the raft must be complete and accepted before the core exceeds its permitted height. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：由上而下施工須在設計階段就訂出「筏基完成前核心允許高度」與樓板拆撐順序，列為合約中的停留點；插入柱驗收與每階段開挖前的支撐確認都要有結構與大地工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Top-down construction needs a design-stage limit on core height before raft completion and a slab-prop removal sequence, written into the contract as hold points; plunge-column acceptance and prop confirmation before each excavation stage require sign-off by structural and geotechnical engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：插入柱若偏斜超出允差，後續包覆與樓板接合困難並產生附加彎矩；若核心上升超過樁的承載能力而筏基延誤，樁頭沉陷會使核心傾斜，連帶影響後續所有樓層的垂直度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Plunge columns installed out of tolerance are hard to encase and connect to slabs and attract extra moments; if the core outruns the piles' capacity while the raft is delayed, pile settlement tilts the core and affects the verticality of every later storey. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 插入柱的位置與垂直度在澆置前以測量確認（常見允差為長度的 1/400 以內），每完成若干核心樓層即核對樁頭沉陷與插入柱應變，並以施工階段分析確認擋土牆與樓板支撐在每一開挖階段的內力；達到允許的核心高度前，筏基須完成並驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Before concreting, survey plunge-column position and verticality, commonly within 1/400 of length; after every few core storeys check pile-head settlement and plunge-column strain, and use construction-stage analysis to confirm retaining-wall and slab-prop forces at each excavation stage; the raft must be complete and accepted before the core exceeds its permitted height.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 由上而下施工須在設計階段就訂出「筏基完成前核心允許高度」與樓板拆撐順序，列為合約中的停留點；插入柱驗收與每階段開挖前的支撐確認都要有結構與大地工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Top-down construction needs a design-stage limit on core height before raft completion and a slab-prop removal sequence, written into the contract as hold points; plunge-column acceptance and prop confirmation before each excavation stage require sign-off by structural and geotechnical engineers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
插入柱的位置與垂直度在澆置前以測量確認（常見允差為長度的 1/400 以內），每完成若干核心樓層即核對樁頭沉陷與插入柱應變，並以施工階段分析確認擋土牆與樓板支撐在每一開挖階段的內力。
只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before concreting, survey plunge-column position and verticality, commonly within 1/400 of length.
If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
quiz.explanation: 插入柱的位置與垂直度在澆置前以測量確認（常見允差為長度的 1/400 以內），每完成若干核心樓層即核對樁頭沉陷與插入柱應變，並以施工階段分析確認擋土牆與樓板支撐在每一開挖階段的內力；達到允許的核心高度前，筏基須完成並驗收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before concreting, survey plunge-column position and verticality, commonly within 1/400 of length; after every few core storeys check pile-head settlement and plunge-column strain, and use construction-stage analysis to confirm retaining-wall and slab-prop forces at each excavation stage; the raft must be complete and accepted before the core exceeds its permitted height. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「由上而下的核心筒」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Top-down core” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 插入柱若偏斜超出允差，後續包覆與樓板接合困難並產生附加彎矩；若核心上升超過樁的承載能力而筏基延誤，樁頭沉陷會使核心傾斜，連帶影響後續所有樓層的垂直度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Plunge columns installed out of tolerance are hard to encase and connect to slabs and attract extra moments; if the core outruns the piles' capacity while the raft is delayed, pile settlement tilts the core and affects the verticality of every later storey. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這縮短工期並限制鄰近地層位移，但在筏基完成前，核心筒與已完成樓層的荷重全靠插入柱與樁承擔，因此可以先蓋多高是一個明確的計算問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This shortens the programme and limits ground movement, but until the raft is complete the core and finished floors rely entirely on the plunge columns and piles, so how high the core may go first is an explicit calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 插入柱若偏斜超出允差，後續包覆與樓板接合困難並產生附加彎矩；若核心上升超過樁的承載能力而筏基延誤，樁頭沉陷會使核心傾斜，連帶影響後續所有樓層的垂直度。
knowledge.textEn: Plunge columns installed out of tolerance are hard to encase and connect to slabs and attract extra moments; if the core outruns the piles' capacity while the raft is delayed, pile settlement tilts the core and affects the verticality of every later storey.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「由上而下施工：核心先行與地下室同步」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Top-down construction: core ahead while the basement is dug" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
插入柱若偏斜超出允差，後續包覆與樓板接合困難並產生附加彎矩；若核心上升超過樁的承載能力而筏基延誤，樁頭沉陷會使核心傾斜，連帶影響後續所有樓層的垂直度。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.
Plunge columns installed out of tolerance are hard to encase and connect to slabs and attract extra moments.
quiz.explanation: 插入柱若偏斜超出允差，後續包覆與樓板接合困難並產生附加彎矩；若核心上升超過樁的承載能力而筏基延誤，樁頭沉陷會使核心傾斜，連帶影響後續所有樓層的垂直度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Plunge columns installed out of tolerance are hard to encase and connect to slabs and attract extra moments; if the core outruns the piles' capacity while the raft is delayed, pile settlement tilts the core and affects the verticality of every later storey. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 爬升塔吊與塔頂尖塔施工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Climbing cranes and spire construction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跳升塔吊與 66 m 尖塔」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jumping cranes and the 66 m spire” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出工程共使用五部塔吊，其中四部隨塔樓「跳升」，並有英國首部架在滑模頂上的塔吊；塔頂 66 m、約 500 公噸的尖塔由約 800 件玻璃與鋼構件組成，最後一部塔吊專為安裝上部尖塔而架設。爬升塔吊把垂直荷重與傾覆力矩透過兩道以上的支承框傳給核心牆，因此核心牆在支承位置的混凝土齡期、強度與局部承壓都要檢核；塔樓收分到頂部時空間狹小，尖塔構件的分段重量與吊裝順序決定了塔吊選型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跳升塔吊與 66 m 尖塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources say five tower cranes were used, four of which jumped with the tower, including the first UK crane supported on top of a slipform; the 66 m, roughly 500 t spire at the top consists of about 800 pieces of glass and steel, and a final crane was erected specifically to install its upper part. A climbing crane transfers vertical load and overturning moment to the core walls through two or more support collars, so concrete age, strength and local bearing at the collar locations must be checked; as the tower tapers to the top, space becomes tight and the weight and sequence of spire pieces drive crane selection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Jumping cranes and the 66 m spire” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塔吊傾覆力矩由上下兩道支承框以水平力偶傳給核心：H = M/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A climbing crane passes its overturning moment to the core as a horizontal couple at two collars: H = M/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「跳升塔吊與 66 m 尖塔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Jumping cranes and the 66 m spire”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 爬升塔吊與塔頂尖塔施工
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出工程共使用五部塔吊，其中四部隨塔樓「跳升」，並有英國首部架在滑模頂上的塔吊；塔頂 66 m、約 500 公噸的尖塔由約 800 件玻璃與鋼構件組成，最後一部塔吊專為安裝上部尖塔而架設。爬升塔吊把垂直荷重與傾覆力矩透過兩道以上的支承框傳給核心牆，因此核心牆在支承位置的混凝土齡期、強度與局部承壓都要檢核；塔樓收分到頂部時空間狹小，尖塔構件的分段重量與吊裝順序決定了塔吊選型。
knowledge.textEn: Public sources say five tower cranes were used, four of which jumped with the tower, including the first UK crane supported on top of a slipform; the 66 m, roughly 500 t spire at the top consists of about 800 pieces of glass and steel, and a final crane was erected specifically to install its upper part.
