quiz.question: 要驗證「帷幕牆接縫的位移容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
以實尺寸樣品做帷幕牆性能試驗（氣密、水密、風壓與層間位移試驗，例如依 ASTM E283、E331、E330 與 AAMA 501），確認接縫在設計位移組合下不失效。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.

Run full-size mock-up tests for air, water, structural pressure and inter-storey movement, for example to ASTM E283, E331, E330 and AAMA 501, confirming joints survive the design movement combination.
quiz.explanation: 以實尺寸樣品做帷幕牆性能試驗（氣密、水密、風壓與層間位移試驗，例如依 ASTM E283、E331、E330 與 AAMA 501），確認接縫在設計位移組合下不失效；安裝時抽查接縫寬度與單元水平，營運後定期檢查密封膠與排水孔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run full-size mock-up tests for air, water, structural pressure and inter-storey movement, for example to ASTM E283, E331, E330 and AAMA 501, confirming joints survive the design movement combination; during installation spot-check joint widths and unit levels, and in service periodically inspect sealant and drainage holes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：傾斜立面使雨水與日照條件更嚴苛，接縫的耐久與可更換性更為重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inclined façades make rain and sun exposure harsher, so joint durability and replaceability matter even more.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「帷幕牆接縫的位移容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。
optionsEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong.
quiz.explanation: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「未防火被覆的帽桁架」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unprotected hat trusses” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。這是一個需要被記錄的工程判斷：火災時鋼材高溫後勁度下降，帽桁架對側向勁度的貢獻減少，但結構強度仍由核心筒保證。若未來有人不知道這個前提，可能把帽桁架當成承載構件加以利用（例如懸吊設備或改造時依賴其強度），就會破壞原本的防火策略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「未防火被覆的帽桁架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. That is an engineering judgement that must be documented: in a fire, heated steel loses stiffness and the hat trusses contribute less lateral stiffness, while strength is still assured by the core. If future users are unaware of this premise and start relying on the hat trusses, for example to hang equipment or as strength members in a renovation, the original fire strategy is undermined. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Unprotected hat trusses” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Unprotected hat trusses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses
knowledge.text: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。這是一個需要被記錄的工程判斷：火災時鋼材高溫後勁度下降，帽桁架對側向勁度的貢獻減少，但結構強度仍由核心筒保證。
knowledge.textEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. That is an engineering judgement that must be documented: in a fire, heated steel loses stiffness and the hat trusses contribute less lateral stiffness, while strength is still assured by the core.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses" is correct?
options: 所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。
設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。
樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
optionsEn: Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong.
The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected.
Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load.
quiz.explanation: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unprotected hat trusses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。若帽桁架提供 25% 的側向勁度，火災時整體勁度約為 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83，頂部變位放大約 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 倍。數值為教學假設，僅示範勁度降低而非強度設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C. If the hat trusses provide 25% of lateral stiffness, the overall stiffness in a fire is about 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83, increasing top drift by about 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 times. Values are teaching assumptions illustrating stiffness loss, not strength design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。若帽桁架提供 25% 的側向勁度，火災時整體勁度約為 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83，頂部變位放大約 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 倍。數值為教學假設，僅示範勁度降低而非強度設計。
knowledge.textEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C. If the hat trusses provide 25% of lateral stiffness, the overall stiffness in a fire is about 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83, increasing top drift by about 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 times. Values are teaching assumptions illustrating stiffness loss, not strength design.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses", which statement holds?
options: 後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。
由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。
optionsEn: A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete.
Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C.
quiz.explanation: EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「未防火被覆的帽桁架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unprotected hat trusses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防火策略中的「不需被覆」判斷必須附上結構依據、適用條件與禁止事項，納入交接文件與物業管理規章；任何在這些構件上的新增荷載或焊接都需結構與消防工程師共同核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any no-protection decision in the fire strategy must carry its structural justification, conditions of validity and prohibitions, written into handover documents and building rules; any new load or welding on these members needs joint approval by structural and fire engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 防火策略中的「不需被覆」判斷必須附上結構依據、適用條件與禁止事項，納入交接文件與物業管理規章；任何在這些構件上的新增荷載或焊接都需結構與消防工程師共同核准。
knowledge.textEn: Any no-protection decision in the fire strategy must carry its structural justification, conditions of validity and prohibitions, written into handover documents and building rules; any new load or welding on these members needs joint approval by structural and fire engineers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses"?
options: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。
optionsEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unprotected hat trusses” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若未來有人不知道這個前提，可能把帽桁架當成承載構件加以利用（例如懸吊設備或改造時依賴其強度），就會破壞原本的防火策略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If future users are unaware of this premise and start relying on the hat trusses, for example to hang equipment or as strength members in a renovation, the original fire strategy is undermined.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。
knowledge.textEn: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。
樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse.
Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load.
quiz.explanation: 改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
summary: 以台北 101、哈里發塔與上海中心為例，從外伸臂約束核心轉角的旋轉彈簧模型與單道外伸臂的最佳高度出發，處理巨柱有效長度與樓板支撐力、外伸桁架穿入核心牆的力傳遞，再到差異縮短與延遲鎖定、雙層高桁架的焊接收縮、應變監測回推勁度、阻尼外伸臂，最後是外伸臂樓層的改裝管控與長期徐變監測。
summaryEn: Using Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa and Shanghai Tower as examples, start from the rotational-spring model of how outriggers restrain core rotation and from the optimum level of a single outrigger, handle mega-column effective length and floor bracing forces and force transfer where outrigger trusses enter core walls, then differential shortening and delayed lock-off, weld shrinkage in two-storey trusses, strain monitoring to back-calculate stiffness and damped outriggers, ending with alteration control on outrigger floors and long-term creep monitoring.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 單道外伸臂設計練習：某 300 m 高樓的核心筒 EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m²，均布風載 w = 150 kN/m，只有核心時頂部位移 Δ₀ = wH⁴/(8EI) = 150,000×300⁴/(8×7.0×10¹³) ≈ 2.17 m。兩側巨柱群各 EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N、間距 d = 40 m。外伸臂放在離地 a = 165 m 時，以 M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) 求得回復彎矩約 2.29 GN·m，每側巨柱群軸力約 2.29×10⁹/40 ≈ 57 MN，頂部位移減少約 54%，剩約 1.00 m。若改放頂部，只減少約 41%（剩約 1.28 m）；若巨柱軸向勁度減半，最佳位置仍在約 0.54H，但減少量降為約 39%（剩約 1.32 m）。這說明外伸臂的高度與巨柱勁度同樣重要，而且在這個簡化模型中最佳高度與柱勁度無關。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Single-outrigger exercise: a 300 m tower has a core with EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m² and a uniform wind load w = 150 kN/m, so the core alone drifts Δ₀ = wH⁴/(8EI) = 150,000×300⁴/(8×7.0×10¹³) ≈ 2.17 m at the top. The mega-column groups on each side have EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N and are d = 40 m apart. With the outrigger at a = 165 m, M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) gives a restoring moment of about 2.29 GN·m and a column-group force of about 2.29×10⁹/40 ≈ 57 MN, cutting top drift by about 54% to about 1.00 m. Placed at the top it cuts only about 41%, leaving about 1.28 m; with column axial stiffness halved the optimum stays near 0.54H but the reduction falls to about 39%, leaving about 1.32 m. Outrigger level and column stiffness therefore matter equally, and in this simplified model the optimum level does not depend on column stiffness. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」與「單道外伸臂的最佳高度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "How outriggers restrain core rotation" and "Optimum height of a single outrigger": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: How outriggers restrain core rotation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 只有核心筒的高樓像一根懸臂梁，側力下底部彎矩全由核心承擔，頂部變位大。外伸臂是從核心伸出、連到周邊巨柱的深桁架或牆：核心彎曲轉動時，外伸臂一端上翹、一端下壓，迫使兩側巨柱一拉一壓，柱的軸向勁度因此變成抵抗核心轉動的旋轉彈簧，產生反向彎矩。這個反向彎矩減少外伸臂以下核心的彎矩與整棟樓的頂部變位，效果取決於柱的軸向勁度、柱距與外伸臂本身的勁度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tower with only a core behaves like a cantilever: under lateral load the core carries the entire base moment and the top drifts a lot. An outrigger is a deep truss or wall extending from the core to perimeter mega-columns; when the core bends and rotates, one end of the outrigger lifts and the other presses down, forcing the columns on the two sides into tension and compression, so their axial stiffness becomes a rotational spring resisting core rotation and producing a counter-moment. That counter-moment reduces core moment below the outrigger and the building's top drift, by an amount that depends on column axial stiffness, column spacing and the outrigger's own stiffness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柱群提供的旋轉勁度 K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Rotational stiffness from the column groups K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角
knowledge.text: 只有核心筒的高樓像一根懸臂梁，側力下底部彎矩全由核心承擔，頂部變位大。外伸臂是從核心伸出、連到周邊巨柱的深桁架或牆：核心彎曲轉動時，外伸臂一端上翹、一端下壓，迫使兩側巨柱一拉一壓，柱的軸向勁度因此變成抵抗核心轉動的旋轉彈簧，產生反向彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: A tower with only a core behaves like a cantilever: under lateral load the core carries the entire base moment and the top drifts a lot. An outrigger is a deep truss or wall extending from the core to perimeter mega-columns; when the core bends and rotates, one end of the outrigger lifts and the other presses down, forcing the columns on the two sides into tension and compression, so their axial stiffness becomes a rotational spring resisting core rotation and producing a counter-moment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How outriggers restrain core rotation" is correct?
options: 外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。
只有核心筒的高樓像一根懸臂梁，側力下底部彎矩全由核心承擔，頂部變位大。
外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。
optionsEn: An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness.
A tower with only a core behaves like a cantilever: under lateral load the core carries the entire base moment and the top drifts a lot.
An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there.
quiz.explanation: 只有核心筒的高樓像一根懸臂梁，側力下底部彎矩全由核心承擔，頂部變位大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tower with only a core behaves like a cantilever: under lateral load the core carries the entire base moment and the top drifts a lot. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How outriggers restrain core rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柱群提供的旋轉勁度 K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L)。每側柱群 E = 35 GPa、A = 4 m²、兩側距離 d = 50 m、柱長（外伸臂到基礎）L = 200 m：K_θ = 35×10⁹×4×50²/(2×200) = 8.75×10¹¹ N·m/rad；核心在外伸臂處轉角 0.002 rad 時，回復彎矩 M = 8.75×10¹¹×0.002 = 1.75 GN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Rotational stiffness from the column groups K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L). With E = 35 GPa and A = 4 m² per side, d = 50 m between sides and a column length from outrigger to foundation of L = 200 m, K_θ = 35×10⁹×4×50²/(2×200) = 8.75×10¹¹ N·m/rad; a core rotation of 0.002 rad at the outrigger gives a restoring moment M = 8.75×10¹¹×0.002 = 1.75 GN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構模型中分別建立「只有核心」與「核心加外伸臂」兩種情況，比較頂層變位、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力；再以旋轉彈簧手算核對外伸臂回復彎矩，兩者差異過大時，檢查模型中外伸臂與柱的連接是否正確模擬。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build core-only and core-plus-outrigger cases in the structural model and compare top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial forces; then check the outrigger's restoring moment against the rotational-spring hand calculation, and if they differ widely, check whether the outrigger-to-column connection is modelled correctly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 柱群提供的旋轉勁度 K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L)。每側柱群 E = 35 GPa、A = 4 m²、兩側距離 d = 50 m、柱長（外伸臂到基礎）L = 200 m：K_θ = 35×10⁹×4×50²/(2×200) = 8.75×10¹¹ N·m/rad；核心在外伸臂處轉角 0.002 rad 時，回復彎矩 M = 8.75×10¹¹×0.002 = 1.75 GN·m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Rotational stiffness from the column groups K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L). With E = 35 GPa and A = 4 m² per side, d = 50 m between sides and a column length from outrigger to foundation of L = 200 m, K_θ = 35×10⁹×4×50²/(2×200) = 8.75×10¹¹ N·m/rad; a core rotation of 0.002 rad at the outrigger gives a restoring moment M = 8.75×10¹¹×0.002 = 1.75 GN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "How outriggers restrain core rotation", which statement holds?
options: 外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。
鋼構在工廠做得精準，現場焊接不會改變幾何。
柱群提供的旋轉勁度 K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L)。
optionsEn: If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter.
Steel fabricated accurately in the shop keeps its geometry through site welding.
Rotational stiffness from the column groups K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L).
quiz.explanation: 柱群提供的旋轉勁度 K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Rotational stiffness from the column groups K_θ = E·A·d²/(2L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How outriggers restrain core rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構模型中分別建立「只有核心」與「核心加外伸臂」兩種情況，比較頂層變位、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力；再以旋轉彈簧手算核對外伸臂回復彎矩，兩者差異過大時，檢查模型中外伸臂與柱的連接是否正確模擬。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build core-only and core-plus-outrigger cases in the structural model and compare top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial forces; then check the outrigger's restoring moment against the rotational-spring hand calculation, and if they differ widely, check whether the outrigger-to-column connection is modelled correctly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計文件要說明外伸臂系統的力學假設（剛性或彈性、接合鎖定時機、樓板是否參與），並在接合細部圖上標明哪些螺栓在施工期保持可滑動、何時鎖定，由結構設計者確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents should state the mechanical assumptions of the outrigger system (rigid or flexible, when joints are locked, whether slabs participate) and mark on connection details which bolts stay free to slip during construction and when they are locked, confirmed by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模型把外伸臂與柱的連接當成完全剛接，而實際接合因螺栓滑動或焊接變形而較柔，外伸臂效果被高估，核心與基礎承受的彎矩超過設計；樓板若被當成外伸臂的一部分卻沒有足夠的面內強度，地震時會在核心邊緣開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the model treats the outrigger-to-column joint as fully rigid while the real joint is softer through bolt slip or weld distortion, the outrigger's benefit is overestimated and the core and foundation see more moment than designed; floor slabs counted as part of the outrigger without enough in-plane strength crack at the core edge in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構模型中分別建立「只有核心」與「核心加外伸臂」兩種情況，比較頂層變位、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力；再以旋轉彈簧手算核對外伸臂回復彎矩，兩者差異過大時，檢查模型中外伸臂與柱的連接是否正確模擬。
knowledge.textEn: Build core-only and core-plus-outrigger cases in the structural model and compare top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial forces; then check the outrigger's restoring moment against the rotational-spring hand calculation, and if they differ widely, check whether the outrigger-to-column connection is modelled correctly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計文件要說明外伸臂系統的力學假設（剛性或彈性、接合鎖定時機、樓板是否參與），並在接合細部圖上標明哪些螺栓在施工期保持可滑動、何時鎖定，由結構設計者確認。
knowledge.textEn: Design documents should state the mechanical assumptions of the outrigger system (rigid or flexible, when joints are locked, whether slabs participate) and mark on connection details which bolts stay free to slip during construction and when they are locked, confirmed by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "How outriggers restrain core rotation"?
options: 在結構模型中分別建立「只有核心」與「核心加外伸臂」兩種情況，比較頂層變位、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器裝在哪裡都一樣，只要阻尼係數夠大就有效。
optionsEn: Build core-only and core-plus-outrigger cases in the structural model and compare top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial forces.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
It makes no difference where dampers go; a large enough coefficient always works.
quiz.explanation: 在結構模型中分別建立「只有核心」與「核心加外伸臂」兩種情況，比較頂層變位、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力；再以旋轉彈簧手算核對外伸臂回復彎矩，兩者差異過大時，檢查模型中外伸臂與柱的連接是否正確模擬。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build core-only and core-plus-outrigger cases in the structural model and compare top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial forces; then check the outrigger's restoring moment against the rotational-spring hand calculation, and if they differ widely, check whether the outrigger-to-column connection is modelled correctly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How outriggers restrain core rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若模型把外伸臂與柱的連接當成完全剛接，而實際接合因螺栓滑動或焊接變形而較柔，外伸臂效果被高估，核心與基礎承受的彎矩超過設計；樓板若被當成外伸臂的一部分卻沒有足夠的面內強度，地震時會在核心邊緣開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the model treats the outrigger-to-column joint as fully rigid while the real joint is softer through bolt slip or weld distortion, the outrigger's benefit is overestimated and the core and foundation see more moment than designed; floor slabs counted as part of the outrigger without enough in-plane strength crack at the core edge in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個反向彎矩減少外伸臂以下核心的彎矩與整棟樓的頂部變位，效果取決於柱的軸向勁度、柱距與外伸臂本身的勁度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That counter-moment reduces core moment below the outrigger and the building's top drift, by an amount that depends on column axial stiffness, column spacing and the outrigger's own stiffness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若模型把外伸臂與柱的連接當成完全剛接，而實際接合因螺栓滑動或焊接變形而較柔，外伸臂效果被高估，核心與基礎承受的彎矩超過設計；樓板若被當成外伸臂的一部分卻沒有足夠的面內強度，地震時會在核心邊緣開裂。
knowledge.textEn: If the model treats the outrigger-to-column joint as fully rigid while the real joint is softer through bolt slip or weld distortion, the outrigger's benefit is overestimated and the core and foundation see more moment than designed; floor slabs counted as part of the outrigger without enough in-plane strength crack at the core edge in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "How outriggers restrain core rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若模型把外伸臂與柱的連接當成完全剛接，而實際接合因螺栓滑動或焊接變形而較柔，外伸臂效果被高估，核心與基礎承受的彎矩超過設計。
外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

If the model treats the outrigger-to-column joint as fully rigid while the real joint is softer through bolt slip or weld distortion, the outrigger's benefit is overestimated and the core and foundation see more moment than designed.
An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there.
quiz.explanation: 若模型把外伸臂與柱的連接當成完全剛接，而實際接合因螺栓滑動或焊接變形而較柔，外伸臂效果被高估，核心與基礎承受的彎矩超過設計；樓板若被當成外伸臂的一部分卻沒有足夠的面內強度，地震時會在核心邊緣開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the model treats the outrigger-to-column joint as fully rigid while the real joint is softer through bolt slip or weld distortion, the outrigger's benefit is overestimated and the core and foundation see more moment than designed; floor slabs counted as part of the outrigger without enough in-plane strength crack at the core edge in an earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 單道外伸臂的最佳高度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Optimum height of a single outrigger: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「最佳外伸臂高度」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Optimum outrigger level” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂放在頂部時，連接的柱子最長、軸向勁度最小，回復彎矩只對頂部附近有效；放得太低時，柱子短而勁，但該處核心轉角很小，外伸臂幾乎不受力。最佳位置介於兩者之間：在均勻核心、均勻風載、外伸臂本身剛性的簡化模型中，單道外伸臂的最佳位置約在離地 0.54H（距頂約 0.46H），而且與柱的軸向勁度大小無關；多道外伸臂時大致沿高度平均分布。實務上還要配合機電層位置與建築使用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「最佳外伸臂高度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Put at the top, an outrigger engages the longest, axially softest columns and its restoring moment acts only near the top; put too low, the columns are short and stiff but the core barely rotates there, so the outrigger hardly works. The optimum lies between: in a simplified model with a uniform core, uniform wind and a rigid outrigger arm, a single outrigger works best about 0.54H above the base, about 0.46H below the top, independent of column axial stiffness, and several outriggers are best spread roughly evenly up the height. In practice the levels also follow mechanical floors and building use. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Optimum outrigger level” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：頂部位移減少 Δ_red = M·a·(H − a/2)/EI，M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²))，θ_w(a) = w·a·(3H² − 3Ha + a²)/(6EI)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Top-drift reduction Δ_red = M·a·(H − a/2)/EI with M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) and θ_w(a) = w·a·(3H² − 3Ha + a²)/(6EI).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「最佳外伸臂高度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Optimum outrigger level”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「單道外伸臂的最佳高度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Optimum height of a single outrigger" is correct?
options: 外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。
巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。
外伸臂放在頂部時，連接的柱子最長、軸向勁度最小，回復彎矩只對頂部附近有效；放得太低時，柱子短而勁，但該處核心轉角很小，外伸臂幾乎不受力。
optionsEn: An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there.
Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter.
Put at the top, an outrigger engages the longest, axially softest columns and its restoring moment acts only near the top.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂放在頂部時，連接的柱子最長、軸向勁度最小，回復彎矩只對頂部附近有效；放得太低時，柱子短而勁，但該處核心轉角很小，外伸臂幾乎不受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Put at the top, an outrigger engages the longest, axially softest columns and its restoring moment acts only near the top; put too low, the columns are short and stiff but the core barely rotates there, so the outrigger hardly works. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單道外伸臂的最佳高度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Optimum height of a single outrigger: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「最佳外伸臂高度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Optimum outrigger level” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：頂部位移減少 Δ_red = M·a·(H − a/2)/EI，M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²))，θ_w(a) = w·a·(3H² − 3Ha + a²)/(6EI)。H = 300 m、EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m²、w = 150 kN/m、每側柱群 EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N、d = 40 m：無外伸臂時頂部位移 wH⁴/(8EI) ≈ 2.17 m；外伸臂在 a = 165 m 時減少約 54%，放在頂部只減少約 41%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Top-drift reduction Δ_red = M·a·(H − a/2)/EI with M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) and θ_w(a) = w·a·(3H² − 3Ha + a²)/(6EI). With H = 300 m, EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m², w = 150 kN/m, EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N per column group and d = 40 m, the top drift without an outrigger is wH⁴/(8EI) ≈ 2.17 m; an outrigger at a = 165 m cuts it by about 54%, whereas one at the top cuts only about 41%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構模型中把外伸臂逐層移動，繪出頂部位移、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力隨高度的變化曲線，確認選定樓層接近最佳區間；多道外伸臂時再比較不同組合，並把機電層、避難層與建築使用的限制一起納入比選表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Move the outrigger floor by floor in the structural model and plot top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial force against its level, confirming that the chosen floor lies near the optimum band; for several outriggers compare combinations, including the constraints of mechanical floors, refuge floors and building use in the comparison table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 頂部位移減少 Δ_red = M·a·(H − a/2)/EI，M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²))，θ_w(a) = w·a·(3H² − 3Ha + a²)/(6EI)。H = 300 m、EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m²、w = 150 kN/m、每側柱群 EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N、d = 40 m：無外伸臂時頂部位移 wH⁴/(8EI) ≈ 2.17 m；外伸臂在 a = 165 m 時減少約 54%，放在頂部只減少約 41%。數值為教學假設。

With H = 300 m, EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m², w = 150 kN/m, EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N per column group and d = 40 m, the top drift without an outrigger is wH⁴/(8EI) ≈ 2.17 m; an outrigger at a = 165 m cuts it by about 54%, whereas one at the top cuts only about 41%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「單道外伸臂的最佳高度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Optimum height of a single outrigger", which statement holds?
options: 頂部位移減少 Δ_red = M·a·(H − a/2)/EI，M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²))，θ_w(a) = w·a·(3H² − 3Ha + a²)/(6EI)。
外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。
外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。

If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled.
