quiz.explanationEn: Top-drift reduction Δ_red = M·a·(H − a/2)/EI with M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) and θ_w(a) = w·a·(3H² − 3Ha + a²)/(6EI). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單道外伸臂的最佳高度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optimum height of a single outrigger: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「最佳外伸臂高度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Optimum outrigger level” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構模型中把外伸臂逐層移動，繪出頂部位移、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力隨高度的變化曲線，確認選定樓層接近最佳區間；多道外伸臂時再比較不同組合，並把機電層、避難層與建築使用的限制一起納入比選表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Move the outrigger floor by floor in the structural model and plot top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial force against its level, confirming that the chosen floor lies near the optimum band; for several outriggers compare combinations, including the constraints of mechanical floors, refuge floors and building use in the comparison table. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：概念設計階段就以簡化模型做外伸臂位置的敏感度分析，並與建築、機電團隊共同決定加強層樓層；比選紀錄保留在設計基準書，日後若需變更加強層位置，可據以快速評估影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Run a sensitivity study of outrigger level with a simplified model at the concept stage and decide the strengthened floors jointly with the architecture and services teams; keep the comparison in the design basis so any later change in level can be assessed quickly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只因機電層剛好在頂部就把唯一的外伸臂放在那裡，減少的頂部位移可能比最佳位置少四分之一以上，核心與基礎因此必須加大；把外伸臂放得太低，則幾乎沒有減振效果卻增加了大量鋼材。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Putting the only outrigger at the top just because the plant room is there can forgo a quarter or more of the drift reduction available at the optimum, forcing a larger core and foundation; placing it too low adds a great deal of steel for almost no benefit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構模型中把外伸臂逐層移動，繪出頂部位移、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力隨高度的變化曲線，確認選定樓層接近最佳區間；多道外伸臂時再比較不同組合，並把機電層、避難層與建築使用的限制一起納入比選表。
knowledge.textEn: Move the outrigger floor by floor in the structural model and plot top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial force against its level, confirming that the chosen floor lies near the optimum band; for several outriggers compare combinations, including the constraints of mechanical floors, refuge floors and building use in the comparison table.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 概念設計階段就以簡化模型做外伸臂位置的敏感度分析，並與建築、機電團隊共同決定加強層樓層；比選紀錄保留在設計基準書，日後若需變更加強層位置，可據以快速評估影響。
knowledge.textEn: Run a sensitivity study of outrigger level with a simplified model at the concept stage and decide the strengthened floors jointly with the architecture and services teams; keep the comparison in the design basis so any later change in level can be assessed quickly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單道外伸臂的最佳高度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Optimum height of a single outrigger"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在結構模型中把外伸臂逐層移動，繪出頂部位移、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力隨高度的變化曲線，確認選定樓層接近最佳區間。
機電層是設備空間，構件開孔只是施工方便的小事。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Move the outrigger floor by floor in the structural model and plot top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial force against its level, confirming that the chosen floor lies near the optimum band.
Mechanical floors are equipment space, so cutting members is a minor matter of convenience.
quiz.explanation: 在結構模型中把外伸臂逐層移動，繪出頂部位移、核心底部彎矩與巨柱軸力隨高度的變化曲線，確認選定樓層接近最佳區間；多道外伸臂時再比較不同組合，並把機電層、避難層與建築使用的限制一起納入比選表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Move the outrigger floor by floor in the structural model and plot top drift, core base moment and mega-column axial force against its level, confirming that the chosen floor lies near the optimum band; for several outriggers compare combinations, including the constraints of mechanical floors, refuge floors and building use in the comparison table. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單道外伸臂的最佳高度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Optimum height of a single outrigger: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「最佳外伸臂高度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Optimum outrigger level” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只因機電層剛好在頂部就把唯一的外伸臂放在那裡，減少的頂部位移可能比最佳位置少四分之一以上，核心與基礎因此必須加大；把外伸臂放得太低，則幾乎沒有減振效果卻增加了大量鋼材。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Putting the only outrigger at the top just because the plant room is there can forgo a quarter or more of the drift reduction available at the optimum, forcing a larger core and foundation; placing it too low adds a great deal of steel for almost no benefit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實務上還要配合機電層位置與建築使用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In practice the levels also follow mechanical floors and building use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只因機電層剛好在頂部就把唯一的外伸臂放在那裡，減少的頂部位移可能比最佳位置少四分之一以上，核心與基礎因此必須加大；把外伸臂放得太低，則幾乎沒有減振效果卻增加了大量鋼材。
knowledge.textEn: Putting the only outrigger at the top just because the plant room is there can forgo a quarter or more of the drift reduction available at the optimum, forcing a larger core and foundation; placing it too low adds a great deal of steel for almost no benefit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單道外伸臂的最佳高度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Optimum height of a single outrigger" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。
若只因機電層剛好在頂部就把唯一的外伸臂放在那裡，減少的頂部位移可能比最佳位置少四分之一以上，核心與基礎因此必須加大。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter.
Putting the only outrigger at the top just because the plant room is there can forgo a quarter or more of the drift reduction available at the optimum, forcing a larger core and foundation.
quiz.explanation: 若只因機電層剛好在頂部就把唯一的外伸臂放在那裡，減少的頂部位移可能比最佳位置少四分之一以上，核心與基礎因此必須加大；把外伸臂放得太低，則幾乎沒有減振效果卻增加了大量鋼材。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Putting the only outrigger at the top just because the plant room is there can forgo a quarter or more of the drift reduction available at the optimum, forcing a larger core and foundation; placing it too low adds a great deal of steel for almost no benefit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力」與「外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces" and "Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「巨柱長細比與樓板支撐」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mega-column slenderness and floor bracing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨柱斷面很大，在每層樓板都有側向支撐時幾乎不會挫屈；但超高層常有挑空大廳、空中大廳或雙層機電層，若巨柱在數層甚至數十公尺範圍內沒有樓板拉住，有效長度大增，二階效應會明顯放大彎矩。支撐巨柱的樓板或繫梁也必須設計成能承受柱子傾向側移所產生的支撐力，一般以柱軸力的一小部分估計。台北 101 與上海中心都以帶狀桁架或樓板把巨柱與其他構件連成整體。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「巨柱長細比與樓板支撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mega-columns are so large that they hardly buckle when every floor braces them laterally; but supertall towers often have atria, sky lobbies or double-height mechanical floors, and if a mega-column runs several storeys or tens of metres without a slab holding it, its effective length grows and second-order effects markedly amplify moments. Slabs or ties that brace mega-columns must also be designed for the bracing force generated by the column's tendency to sway, usually estimated as a small fraction of its axial load. Taipei 101 and Shanghai Tower both use belt trusses or slabs to tie mega-columns into the rest of the structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mega-column slenderness and floor bracing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：P_cr = π²·EI/L²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: P_cr = π²·EI/L².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「巨柱長細比與樓板支撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mega-column slenderness and floor bracing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力
knowledge.titleEn: Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces
knowledge.text: 巨柱斷面很大，在每層樓板都有側向支撐時幾乎不會挫屈；但超高層常有挑空大廳、空中大廳或雙層機電層，若巨柱在數層甚至數十公尺範圍內沒有樓板拉住，有效長度大增，二階效應會明顯放大彎矩。支撐巨柱的樓板或繫梁也必須設計成能承受柱子傾向側移所產生的支撐力，一般以柱軸力的一小部分估計。
knowledge.textEn: Mega-columns are so large that they hardly buckle when every floor braces them laterally; but supertall towers often have atria, sky lobbies or double-height mechanical floors, and if a mega-column runs several storeys or tens of metres without a slab holding it, its effective length grows and second-order effects markedly amplify moments. Slabs or ties that brace mega-columns must also be designed for the bracing force generated by the column's tendency to sway, usually estimated as a small fraction of its axial load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces" is correct?
options: 巨柱斷面很大，在每層樓板都有側向支撐時幾乎不會挫屈。
巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。
外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。
optionsEn: Mega-columns are so large that they hardly buckle when every floor braces them laterally.
Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter.
If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 巨柱斷面很大，在每層樓板都有側向支撐時幾乎不會挫屈；但超高層常有挑空大廳、空中大廳或雙層機電層，若巨柱在數層甚至數十公尺範圍內沒有樓板拉住，有效長度大增，二階效應會明顯放大彎矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mega-columns are so large that they hardly buckle when every floor braces them laterally; but supertall towers often have atria, sky lobbies or double-height mechanical floors, and if a mega-column runs several storeys or tens of metres without a slab holding it, its effective length grows and second-order effects markedly amplify moments. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「巨柱長細比與樓板支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mega-column slenderness and floor bracing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P_cr = π²·EI/L²。斷面 3.0 m × 3.0 m、E_eff = 30 GPa，EI = 30×10⁹×3⁴/12 ≈ 2.0×10¹¹ N·m²：L = 4.5 m 時 P_cr ≈ 98,700 MN；若無支撐長度 L = 60 m，P_cr ≈ 555 MN，軸力 400 MN 時比值 0.72，彎矩放大 1/(1 − 0.72) ≈ 3.6 倍。每層支撐力若取軸力 1%，約 4 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P_cr = π²·EI/L². For a 3.0 m × 3.0 m section with E_eff = 30 GPa, EI = 30×10⁹×3⁴/12 ≈ 2.0×10¹¹ N·m²: at L = 4.5 m P_cr ≈ 98,700 MN, but over an unbraced L = 60 m P_cr ≈ 555 MN, so a 400 MN axial load gives a ratio of 0.72 and moment amplification of 1/(1 − 0.72) ≈ 3.6. Taking 1% of the axial load as the bracing force gives about 4 MN per floor. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一列出每支巨柱的無支撐長度，對挑空與機電層段做二階分析或挫屈分析，確認放大係數；支撐巨柱的樓板與繫梁以支撐力檢核面內強度與連接，並確認施工期間樓板未完成前的臨時支撐。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List the unbraced length of every mega-column, run second-order or buckling analyses for atrium and mechanical segments to confirm amplification factors, check the in-plane strength and connections of bracing slabs and ties for the bracing force, and confirm temporary bracing before slabs are complete during construction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P_cr = π²·EI/L²。斷面 3.0 m × 3.0 m、E_eff = 30 GPa，EI = 30×10⁹×3⁴/12 ≈ 2.0×10¹¹ N·m²：L = 4.5 m 時 P_cr ≈ 98,700 MN；若無支撐長度 L = 60 m，P_cr ≈ 555 MN，軸力 400 MN 時比值 0.72，彎矩放大 1/(1 − 0.72) ≈ 3.6 倍。每層支撐力若取軸力 1%，約 4 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: P_cr = π²·EI/L². For a 3.0 m × 3.0 m section with E_eff = 30 GPa, EI = 30×10⁹×3⁴/12 ≈ 2.0×10¹¹ N·m²: at L = 4.5 m P_cr ≈ 98,700 MN, but over an unbraced L = 60 m P_cr ≈ 555 MN, so a 400 MN axial load gives a ratio of 0.72 and moment amplification of 1/(1 − 0.72) ≈ 3.6. Taking 1% of the axial load as the bracing force gives about 4 MN per floor. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces", which statement holds?
options: 鋼構在工廠做得精準，現場焊接不會改變幾何。
P_cr = π²·EI/L²。
阻尼器裝在哪裡都一樣，只要阻尼係數夠大就有效。
optionsEn: Steel fabricated accurately in the shop keeps its geometry through site welding.
P_cr = π²·EI/L².
It makes no difference where dampers go; a large enough coefficient always works.
quiz.explanation: P_cr = π²·EI/L²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: P_cr = π²·EI/L². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「巨柱長細比與樓板支撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mega-column slenderness and floor bracing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐一列出每支巨柱的無支撐長度，對挑空與機電層段做二階分析或挫屈分析，確認放大係數；支撐巨柱的樓板與繫梁以支撐力檢核面內強度與連接，並確認施工期間樓板未完成前的臨時支撐。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List the unbraced length of every mega-column, run second-order or buckling analyses for atrium and mechanical segments to confirm amplification factors, check the in-plane strength and connections of bracing slabs and ties for the bracing force, and confirm temporary bracing before slabs are complete during construction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在結構圖上標示每支巨柱的支撐樓層與無支撐長度，任何挑空或樓板開口變更都必須回到結構設計者；施工計畫規定巨柱領先樓板的最大層數與臨時支撐方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark the bracing floors and unbraced lengths of every mega-column on the structural drawings, route any atrium or slab-opening change back to the structural designer, and set in the construction plan the maximum number of floors mega-columns may run ahead of slabs, with the temporary bracing method.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：建築變更新增挑空時若未通知結構設計者，巨柱失去數層支撐，二階彎矩可能讓柱在大震或強風時失穩；施工期間巨柱領先樓板太多，未支撐長度遠超設計，風力或吊裝碰撞就可能造成過大變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An architectural change that adds an atrium without telling the structural designer removes several floors of bracing, and second-order moments can destabilise the column in a major earthquake or strong wind; during construction, mega-columns that run far ahead of the slabs have unbraced lengths well beyond design, so wind or lifting impacts can cause excessive deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐一列出每支巨柱的無支撐長度，對挑空與機電層段做二階分析或挫屈分析，確認放大係數；支撐巨柱的樓板與繫梁以支撐力檢核面內強度與連接，並確認施工期間樓板未完成前的臨時支撐。
knowledge.textEn: List the unbraced length of every mega-column, run second-order or buckling analyses for atrium and mechanical segments to confirm amplification factors, check the in-plane strength and connections of bracing slabs and ties for the bracing force, and confirm temporary bracing before slabs are complete during construction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在結構圖上標示每支巨柱的支撐樓層與無支撐長度，任何挑空或樓板開口變更都必須回到結構設計者；施工計畫規定巨柱領先樓板的最大層數與臨時支撐方式。
knowledge.textEn: Mark the bracing floors and unbraced lengths of every mega-column on the structural drawings, route any atrium or slab-opening change back to the structural designer, and set in the construction plan the maximum number of floors mega-columns may run ahead of slabs, with the temporary bracing method.

quiz.question: 要驗證「巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。
逐一列出每支巨柱的無支撐長度，對挑空與機電層段做二階分析或挫屈分析，確認放大係數。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue.

List the unbraced length of every mega-column, run second-order or buckling analyses for atrium and mechanical segments to confirm amplification factors, check the in-plane strength and connections of bracing slabs and ties for the bracing force, and confirm temporary bracing before slabs are complete during construction.
quiz.explanation: 逐一列出每支巨柱的無支撐長度，對挑空與機電層段做二階分析或挫屈分析，確認放大係數；支撐巨柱的樓板與繫梁以支撐力檢核面內強度與連接，並確認施工期間樓板未完成前的臨時支撐。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List the unbraced length of every mega-column, run second-order or buckling analyses for atrium and mechanical segments to confirm amplification factors, check the in-plane strength and connections of bracing slabs and ties for the bracing force, and confirm temporary bracing before slabs are complete during construction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「巨柱長細比與樓板支撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mega-column slenderness and floor bracing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 建築變更新增挑空時若未通知結構設計者，巨柱失去數層支撐，二階彎矩可能讓柱在大震或強風時失穩；施工期間巨柱領先樓板太多，未支撐長度遠超設計，風力或吊裝碰撞就可能造成過大變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An architectural change that adds an atrium without telling the structural designer removes several floors of bracing, and second-order moments can destabilise the column in a major earthquake or strong wind; during construction, mega-columns that run far ahead of the slabs have unbraced lengths well beyond design, so wind or lifting impacts can cause excessive deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：台北 101 與上海中心都以帶狀桁架或樓板把巨柱與其他構件連成整體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Taipei 101 and Shanghai Tower both use belt trusses or slabs to tie mega-columns into the rest of the structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 建築變更新增挑空時若未通知結構設計者，巨柱失去數層支撐，二階彎矩可能讓柱在大震或強風時失穩；施工期間巨柱領先樓板太多，未支撐長度遠超設計，風力或吊裝碰撞就可能造成過大變形。
knowledge.textEn: An architectural change that adds an atrium without telling the structural designer removes several floors of bracing, and second-order moments can destabilise the column in a major earthquake or strong wind; during construction, mega-columns that run far ahead of the slabs have unbraced lengths well beyond design, so wind or lifting impacts can cause excessive deformation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巨柱的有效長度與樓板支撐力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective length of mega-columns and floor bracing forces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 建築變更新增挑空時若未通知結構設計者，巨柱失去數層支撐，二階彎矩可能讓柱在大震或強風時失穩。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。
optionsEn: An architectural change that adds an atrium without telling the structural designer removes several floors of bracing, and second-order moments can destabilise the column in a major earthquake or strong wind.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 建築變更新增挑空時若未通知結構設計者，巨柱失去數層支撐，二階彎矩可能讓柱在大震或強風時失穩；施工期間巨柱領先樓板太多，未支撐長度遠超設計，風力或吊裝碰撞就可能造成過大變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An architectural change that adds an atrium without telling the structural designer removes several floors of bracing, and second-order moments can destabilise the column in a major earthquake or strong wind; during construction, mega-columns that run far ahead of the slabs have unbraced lengths well beyond design, so wind or lifting impacts can cause excessive deformation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外伸桁架穿入核心牆」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outrigger chords embedded in core walls” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿在核心牆處集中巨大的拉壓力，必須以埋入牆內的鋼骨、鋼板與剪力釘把力量擴散到混凝土牆中；鋼構與混凝土牆的介面是整個系統最複雜的接合。常見做法是讓弦桿穿過核心牆並與牆內鋼板或型鋼連續，或在牆內設置鋼板剪力牆區段；上海中心的核心牆在加強層內即以鋼板或型鋼補強。穿牆處同時有大量鋼筋、預埋件與澆置空間的衝突，需要三維協調。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外伸桁架穿入核心牆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Outrigger chords and diagonals concentrate huge tension and compression where they meet the core, so steel sections, plates and shear studs embedded in the wall must spread that force into the concrete; the steel-to-concrete interface is the most complex connection in the system. Common solutions run the chord through the core wall continuously with embedded plates or sections, or form steel-plate shear-wall zones within the wall; Shanghai Tower's core walls are stiffened with steel plates or sections in the strengthened storeys. Where chords pass through, rebar, embeds and concreting space all compete, demanding three-dimensional coordination. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Outrigger chords embedded in core walls” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：剪力釘數量 n = F/Q_n。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Number of studs n = F/Q_n.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外伸桁架穿入核心牆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Outrigger chords embedded in core walls”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞
knowledge.titleEn: Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls
knowledge.text: 外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿在核心牆處集中巨大的拉壓力，必須以埋入牆內的鋼骨、鋼板與剪力釘把力量擴散到混凝土牆中；鋼構與混凝土牆的介面是整個系統最複雜的接合。常見做法是讓弦桿穿過核心牆並與牆內鋼板或型鋼連續，或在牆內設置鋼板剪力牆區段；上海中心的核心牆在加強層內即以鋼板或型鋼補強。
knowledge.textEn: Outrigger chords and diagonals concentrate huge tension and compression where they meet the core, so steel sections, plates and shear studs embedded in the wall must spread that force into the concrete; the steel-to-concrete interface is the most complex connection in the system. Common solutions run the chord through the core wall continuously with embedded plates or sections, or form steel-plate shear-wall zones within the wall; Shanghai Tower's core walls are stiffened with steel plates or sections in the strengthened storeys.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls" is correct?
options: 外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。
外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿在核心牆處集中巨大的拉壓力，必須以埋入牆內的鋼骨、鋼板與剪力釘把力量擴散到混凝土牆中；鋼構與混凝土牆的介面是整個系統最複雜的接合。
外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。
optionsEn: If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter.

Outrigger chords and diagonals concentrate huge tension and compression where they meet the core, so steel sections, plates and shear studs embedded in the wall must spread that force into the concrete.
The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better.
quiz.explanation: 外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿在核心牆處集中巨大的拉壓力，必須以埋入牆內的鋼骨、鋼板與剪力釘把力量擴散到混凝土牆中；鋼構與混凝土牆的介面是整個系統最複雜的接合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Outrigger chords and diagonals concentrate huge tension and compression where they meet the core, so steel sections, plates and shear studs embedded in the wall must spread that force into the concrete; the steel-to-concrete interface is the most complex connection in the system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外伸桁架穿入核心牆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outrigger chords embedded in core walls” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：剪力釘數量 n = F/Q_n。直徑 22 mm 剪力釘 A_sa ≈ 380 mm²，Q_n = 0.5·A_sa·√(f'c·E_c) = 0.5×380×√(60×36,000) ≈ 279 kN，但上限 A_sa·F_u = 380×450 ≈ 171 kN，取 171 kN；弦桿力 40 MN 需 40,000/171 ≈ 234 支，計入強度折減 0.65 約需 360 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Number of studs n = F/Q_n. A 22 mm stud has A_sa ≈ 380 mm² and Q_n = 0.5·A_sa·√(f'c·E_c) = 0.5×380×√(60×36,000) ≈ 279 kN, capped by A_sa·F_u = 380×450 ≈ 171 kN, so 171 kN governs; a 40 MN chord force needs 40,000/171 ≈ 234 studs, or about 360 with a resistance factor of 0.65. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以局部有限元素模型檢查弦桿力在牆內的擴散與混凝土局部壓應力，確認剪力釘間距符合規範最小值；施工前做三維碰撞檢查與足尺模型或試作段，驗證鋼筋綁紮、剪力釘焊接與混凝土澆置的可行性，剪力釘以彎曲試驗抽查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the spread of chord force within the wall and local concrete bearing stresses with a local finite-element model and confirm stud spacing meets code minimums; before construction run three-dimensional clash checks and a full-scale mock-up or trial section to prove rebar fixing, stud welding and concreting are feasible, and spot-check studs by bend testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 剪力釘數量 n = F/Q_n。直徑 22 mm 剪力釘 A_sa ≈ 380 mm²，Q_n = 0.5·A_sa·√(f'c·E_c) = 0.5×380×√(60×36,000) ≈ 279 kN，但上限 A_sa·F_u = 380×450 ≈ 171 kN，取 171 kN；弦桿力 40 MN 需 40,000/171 ≈ 234 支，計入強度折減 0.65 約需 360 支。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Number of studs n = F/Q_n. A 22 mm stud has A_sa ≈ 380 mm² and Q_n = 0.5·A_sa·√(f'c·E_c) = 0.5×380×√(60×36,000) ≈ 279 kN, capped by A_sa·F_u = 380×450 ≈ 171 kN, so 171 kN governs; a 40 MN chord force needs 40,000/171 ≈ 234 studs, or about 360 with a resistance factor of 0.65. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls", which statement holds?
options: 外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。
機電層是設備空間，構件開孔只是施工方便的小事。
剪力釘數量 n = F/Q_n。
optionsEn: If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled.
Mechanical floors are equipment space, so cutting members is a minor matter of convenience.
Number of studs n = F/Q_n.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘數量 n = F/Q_n。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Number of studs n = F/Q_n. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外伸桁架穿入核心牆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outrigger chords embedded in core walls” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以局部有限元素模型檢查弦桿力在牆內的擴散與混凝土局部壓應力，確認剪力釘間距符合規範最小值；施工前做三維碰撞檢查與足尺模型或試作段，驗證鋼筋綁紮、剪力釘焊接與混凝土澆置的可行性，剪力釘以彎曲試驗抽查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the spread of chord force within the wall and local concrete bearing stresses with a local finite-element model and confirm stud spacing meets code minimums; before construction run three-dimensional clash checks and a full-scale mock-up or trial section to prove rebar fixing, stud welding and concreting are feasible, and spot-check studs by bend testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加強層的鋼構、牆內鋼板、鋼筋與澆置孔要在同一個三維模型中定案，並以試作段確認施工可行；澆置前設停止點，由結構設計者確認剪力釘、埋件與鋼筋的位置與檢驗紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Finalise strengthened-storey steel, embedded plates, rebar and placement openings in one three-dimensional model and prove constructability with a trial section; set a hold point before concreting at which the structural designer confirms stud, embed and rebar positions and inspection records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剪力釘過密或鋼筋太擠時，混凝土在鋼板背後形成空洞，弦桿力無法有效傳入牆內，接合在設計載重前就局部滑移或壓碎；弦桿端部若沒有足夠的錨定長度，大地震時可能從牆中拔出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overcrowded studs or congested rebar leave voids behind the plates, so chord force cannot pass effectively into the wall and the joint slips or crushes locally before design load; chord ends without enough anchorage length can pull out of the wall in a major earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以局部有限元素模型檢查弦桿力在牆內的擴散與混凝土局部壓應力，確認剪力釘間距符合規範最小值；施工前做三維碰撞檢查與足尺模型或試作段，驗證鋼筋綁紮、剪力釘焊接與混凝土澆置的可行性，剪力釘以彎曲試驗抽查。
knowledge.textEn: Check the spread of chord force within the wall and local concrete bearing stresses with a local finite-element model and confirm stud spacing meets code minimums; before construction run three-dimensional clash checks and a full-scale mock-up or trial section to prove rebar fixing, stud welding and concreting are feasible, and spot-check studs by bend testing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加強層的鋼構、牆內鋼板、鋼筋與澆置孔要在同一個三維模型中定案，並以試作段確認施工可行；澆置前設停止點，由結構設計者確認剪力釘、埋件與鋼筋的位置與檢驗紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Finalise strengthened-storey steel, embedded plates, rebar and placement openings in one three-dimensional model and prove constructability with a trial section; set a hold point before concreting at which the structural designer confirms stud, embed and rebar positions and inspection records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls"?
options: 以局部有限元素模型檢查弦桿力在牆內的擴散與混凝土局部壓應力，確認剪力釘間距符合規範最小值。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。
optionsEn: Check the spread of chord force within the wall and local concrete bearing stresses with a local finite-element model and confirm stud spacing meets code minimums.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 以局部有限元素模型檢查弦桿力在牆內的擴散與混凝土局部壓應力，確認剪力釘間距符合規範最小值；施工前做三維碰撞檢查與足尺模型或試作段，驗證鋼筋綁紮、剪力釘焊接與混凝土澆置的可行性，剪力釘以彎曲試驗抽查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the spread of chord force within the wall and local concrete bearing stresses with a local finite-element model and confirm stud spacing meets code minimums; before construction run three-dimensional clash checks and a full-scale mock-up or trial section to prove rebar fixing, stud welding and concreting are feasible, and spot-check studs by bend testing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外伸桁架穿入核心牆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outrigger chords embedded in core walls” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘過密或鋼筋太擠時，混凝土在鋼板背後形成空洞，弦桿力無法有效傳入牆內，接合在設計載重前就局部滑移或壓碎；弦桿端部若沒有足夠的錨定長度，大地震時可能從牆中拔出。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overcrowded studs or congested rebar leave voids behind the plates, so chord force cannot pass effectively into the wall and the joint slips or crushes locally before design load; chord ends without enough anchorage length can pull out of the wall in a major earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：穿牆處同時有大量鋼筋、預埋件與澆置空間的衝突，需要三維協調。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Where chords pass through, rebar, embeds and concreting space all compete, demanding three-dimensional coordination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剪力釘過密或鋼筋太擠時，混凝土在鋼板背後形成空洞，弦桿力無法有效傳入牆內，接合在設計載重前就局部滑移或壓碎；弦桿端部若沒有足夠的錨定長度，大地震時可能從牆中拔出。
knowledge.textEn: Overcrowded studs or congested rebar leave voids behind the plates, so chord force cannot pass effectively into the wall and the joint slips or crushes locally before design load; chord ends without enough anchorage length can pull out of the wall in a major earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外伸桁架與核心牆的力傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force transfer between outrigger trusses and core walls" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
剪力釘過密或鋼筋太擠時，混凝土在鋼板背後形成空洞，弦桿力無法有效傳入牆內，接合在設計載重前就局部滑移或壓碎。
外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Overcrowded studs or congested rebar leave voids behind the plates, so chord force cannot pass effectively into the wall and the joint slips or crushes locally before design load.
The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘過密或鋼筋太擠時，混凝土在鋼板背後形成空洞，弦桿力無法有效傳入牆內，接合在設計載重前就局部滑移或壓碎；弦桿端部若沒有足夠的錨定長度，大地震時可能從牆中拔出。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overcrowded studs or congested rebar leave voids behind the plates, so chord force cannot pass effectively into the wall and the joint slips or crushes locally before design load; chord ends without enough anchorage length can pull out of the wall in a major earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定」與「雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off" and "Erection and welding sequence of two-storey outrigger trusses": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「延遲鎖定接合」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delayed lock-off connection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨柱與核心筒的應力水準、材料與施工時間不同，在重力、徐變與乾縮下的縮短量也不同；外伸臂若在施工初期就把兩者剛接，差異縮短會讓外伸臂像槓桿一樣被強迫變形，產生與風、地震無關的巨大附加力。常見做法是施工期間讓外伸臂的一端以長槽孔或可調整接頭保持可動，等主要的重力縮短發生後（例如封頂後）再鎖定，或使用可多次調整的千斤頂接頭。鎖定時機是設計與施工共同決定的關鍵參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「延遲鎖定接合」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mega-columns and the core differ in stress level, material and timing, so they shorten by different amounts under gravity, creep and shrinkage; if an outrigger rigidly joins them early in construction, differential shortening forces it to deform like a lever, inducing large extra forces unrelated to wind or earthquakes. The usual answer keeps one end of the outrigger free during construction through long slotted holes or adjustable joints, locking it after most gravity shortening has occurred, for example after topping out, or uses jacked joints that can be adjusted several times. The lock-off time is a key parameter decided jointly by design and construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Delayed lock-off connection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彈性縮短 δ = σ·L/E。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Elastic shortening δ = σ·L/E.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「延遲鎖定接合」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Delayed lock-off connection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定
knowledge.titleEn: Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off
knowledge.text: 巨柱與核心筒的應力水準、材料與施工時間不同，在重力、徐變與乾縮下的縮短量也不同；外伸臂若在施工初期就把兩者剛接，差異縮短會讓外伸臂像槓桿一樣被強迫變形，產生與風、地震無關的巨大附加力。常見做法是施工期間讓外伸臂的一端以長槽孔或可調整接頭保持可動，等主要的重力縮短發生後（例如封頂後）再鎖定，或使用可多次調整的千斤頂接頭。
knowledge.textEn: Mega-columns and the core differ in stress level, material and timing, so they shorten by different amounts under gravity, creep and shrinkage; if an outrigger rigidly joins them early in construction, differential shortening forces it to deform like a lever, inducing large extra forces unrelated to wind or earthquakes. The usual answer keeps one end of the outrigger free during construction through long slotted holes or adjustable joints, locking it after most gravity shortening has occurred, for example after topping out, or uses jacked joints that can be adjusted several times.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off" is correct?
options: 外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。
鋼構在工廠做得精準，現場焊接不會改變幾何。
巨柱與核心筒的應力水準、材料與施工時間不同，在重力、徐變與乾縮下的縮短量也不同。
optionsEn: The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better.
Steel fabricated accurately in the shop keeps its geometry through site welding.
Mega-columns and the core differ in stress level, material and timing, so they shorten by different amounts under gravity, creep and shrinkage.
quiz.explanation: 巨柱與核心筒的應力水準、材料與施工時間不同，在重力、徐變與乾縮下的縮短量也不同；外伸臂若在施工初期就把兩者剛接，差異縮短會讓外伸臂像槓桿一樣被強迫變形，產生與風、地震無關的巨大附加力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mega-columns and the core differ in stress level, material and timing, so they shorten by different amounts under gravity, creep and shrinkage; if an outrigger rigidly joins them early in construction, differential shortening forces it to deform like a lever, inducing large extra forces unrelated to wind or earthquakes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲鎖定接合」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delayed lock-off connection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彈性縮短 δ = σ·L/E。巨柱 25 MPa、核心 12 MPa、E = 38 GPa、高度 200 m：巨柱約 0.000658×200,000 ≈ 131.6 mm，核心約 63.2 mm，相差 68.4 mm；計入徐變係數 1.5 約 171 mm。若立即鎖定，柱群 EA/L = 38×10⁹×4/200 = 7.6×10⁸ N/m，僅彈性差異就產生 7.6×10⁸×0.0684 ≈ 52 MN 的附加力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Elastic shortening δ = σ·L/E. With 25 MPa in the mega-columns, 12 MPa in the core, E = 38 GPa and 200 m height: columns about 0.000658×200,000 ≈ 131.6 mm, core about 63.2 mm, a difference of 68.4 mm, or about 171 mm with a creep coefficient of 1.5. Locked immediately, a column group with EA/L = 38×10⁹×4/200 = 7.6×10⁸ N/m picks up 7.6×10⁸×0.0684 ≈ 52 MN from the elastic difference alone. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析（含材料時間效應）預測巨柱與核心在各施工時點的縮短，在代表性柱與核心牆埋設應變計、在外伸臂接頭設位移計；鎖定前比對實測差異與預測，確認剩餘差異引起的附加力在設計範圍內，才下達鎖定指令。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Predict mega-column and core shortening at each construction stage with a time-dependent construction-sequence analysis, embed strain gauges in representative columns and core walls, and fit displacement gauges at outrigger joints; before lock-off compare measured and predicted differences, issuing the lock-off instruction only when the extra force from the remaining difference is within design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 彈性縮短 δ = σ·L/E。巨柱 25 MPa、核心 12 MPa、E = 38 GPa、高度 200 m：巨柱約 0.000658×200,000 ≈ 131.6 mm，核心約 63.2 mm，相差 68.4 mm；計入徐變係數 1.5 約 171 mm。若立即鎖定，柱群 EA/L = 38×10⁹×4/200 = 7.6×10⁸ N/m，僅彈性差異就產生 7.6×10⁸×0.0684 ≈ 52 MN 的附加力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Elastic shortening δ = σ·L/E. With 25 MPa in the mega-columns, 12 MPa in the core, E = 38 GPa and 200 m height: columns about 0.000658×200,000 ≈ 131.6 mm, core about 63.2 mm, a difference of 68.4 mm, or about 171 mm with a creep coefficient of 1.5. Locked immediately, a column group with EA/L = 38×10⁹×4/200 = 7.6×10⁸ N/m picks up 7.6×10⁸×0.0684 ≈ 52 MN from the elastic difference alone. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off", which statement holds?
options: 彈性縮短 δ = σ·L/E。
阻尼器裝在哪裡都一樣，只要阻尼係數夠大就有效。
外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。
optionsEn: Elastic shortening δ = σ·L/E.
It makes no difference where dampers go; a large enough coefficient always works.
Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue.
quiz.explanation: 彈性縮短 δ = σ·L/E。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Elastic shortening δ = σ·L/E. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延遲鎖定接合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delayed lock-off connection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析（含材料時間效應）預測巨柱與核心在各施工時點的縮短，在代表性柱與核心牆埋設應變計、在外伸臂接頭設位移計；鎖定前比對實測差異與預測，確認剩餘差異引起的附加力在設計範圍內，才下達鎖定指令。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Predict mega-column and core shortening at each construction stage with a time-dependent construction-sequence analysis, embed strain gauges in representative columns and core walls, and fit displacement gauges at outrigger joints; before lock-off compare measured and predicted differences, issuing the lock-off instruction only when the extra force from the remaining difference is within design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要訂出外伸臂的暫時狀態、鎖定條件（例如封頂後且實測差異小於設定值）與施工期強風應變措施；鎖定作業設停止點，由結構設計者依監測資料簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan defines the outriggers' temporary state, the lock-off conditions (for example after topping out and with measured difference below a set value) and construction-stage storm measures; lock-off is a hold point signed by the structural designer on the basis of monitoring data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若外伸臂在施工早期被焊死，數十公釐的差異縮短可能讓斜桿或接合在完工前就接近降伏，或在核心牆內造成裂縫；若鎖定太晚，施工期間遭遇強風時外伸臂無法發揮作用，核心單獨承受風力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If outriggers are welded solid early in construction, tens of millimetres of differential shortening can drive diagonals or joints close to yield before completion or crack the core walls; lock off too late and the outriggers cannot work during a construction-stage storm, leaving the core to resist wind alone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析（含材料時間效應）預測巨柱與核心在各施工時點的縮短，在代表性柱與核心牆埋設應變計、在外伸臂接頭設位移計；鎖定前比對實測差異與預測，確認剩餘差異引起的附加力在設計範圍內，才下達鎖定指令。
knowledge.textEn: Predict mega-column and core shortening at each construction stage with a time-dependent construction-sequence analysis, embed strain gauges in representative columns and core walls, and fit displacement gauges at outrigger joints; before lock-off compare measured and predicted differences, issuing the lock-off instruction only when the extra force from the remaining difference is within design.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要訂出外伸臂的暫時狀態、鎖定條件（例如封頂後且實測差異小於設定值）與施工期強風應變措施；鎖定作業設停止點，由結構設計者依監測資料簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan defines the outriggers' temporary state, the lock-off conditions (for example after topping out and with measured difference below a set value) and construction-stage storm measures; lock-off is a hold point signed by the structural designer on the basis of monitoring data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以施工階段分析（含材料時間效應）預測巨柱與核心在各施工時點的縮短，在代表性柱與核心牆埋設應變計、在外伸臂接頭設位移計。
外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Predict mega-column and core shortening at each construction stage with a time-dependent construction-sequence analysis, embed strain gauges in representative columns and core walls, and fit displacement gauges at outrigger joints.
An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段分析（含材料時間效應）預測巨柱與核心在各施工時點的縮短，在代表性柱與核心牆埋設應變計、在外伸臂接頭設位移計；鎖定前比對實測差異與預測，確認剩餘差異引起的附加力在設計範圍內，才下達鎖定指令。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Predict mega-column and core shortening at each construction stage with a time-dependent construction-sequence analysis, embed strain gauges in representative columns and core walls, and fit displacement gauges at outrigger joints; before lock-off compare measured and predicted differences, issuing the lock-off instruction only when the extra force from the remaining difference is within design. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異縮短與外伸臂的延遲鎖定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential shortening and delayed outrigger lock-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延遲鎖定接合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Delayed lock-off connection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若外伸臂在施工早期被焊死，數十公釐的差異縮短可能讓斜桿或接合在完工前就接近降伏，或在核心牆內造成裂縫；若鎖定太晚，施工期間遭遇強風時外伸臂無法發揮作用，核心單獨承受風力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If outriggers are welded solid early in construction, tens of millimetres of differential shortening can drive diagonals or joints close to yield before completion or crack the core walls; lock off too late and the outriggers cannot work during a construction-stage storm, leaving the core to resist wind alone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鎖定時機是設計與施工共同決定的關鍵參數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lock-off time is a key parameter decided jointly by design and construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erection and welding sequence of two-storey outrigger trusses: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外伸桁架吊裝與焊接順序」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outrigger erection and welding sequence” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩層高的外伸桁架構件又大又重，常拆成可吊裝的分段，在高空以全滲透焊或高強度螺栓接合。大量厚板焊接會產生收縮，若焊接順序不當，收縮累積會讓桁架節點偏離設計位置、在構件中留下殘餘應力，甚至把核心埋件或巨柱拉偏。施工方以預留收縮量、對稱焊接、先組後焊與臨時支撐控制幾何，並同時考慮塔吊在該半徑的吊重能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外伸桁架吊裝與焊接順序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two-storey outrigger members are large and heavy, so they are usually split into liftable segments joined at height by full-penetration welds or high-strength bolts. Welding so much thick plate causes shrinkage; with a poor sequence it accumulates, pulling truss nodes off their design positions, leaving residual stresses and even dragging core embeds or mega-columns out of line. Contractors control geometry with shrinkage allowances, symmetric welding, assembly before welding and temporary supports, while respecting tower-crane capacity at the working radius. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Outrigger erection and welding sequence” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：焊接收縮累積：若每道全滲透焊接頭橫向收縮約 1.5 mm，一條弦桿上有 6 個接頭，總收縮約 6×1.5 = 9 mm；跨距 15 m 的弦桿兩端因此靠近 9 mm，製造時應預留同量延長，或以對稱焊接讓兩端各收縮約 4.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Accumulated weld shrinkage: if each full-penetration joint shrinks about 1.5 mm transversely and a chord has 6 joints, the total is about 6×1.5 = 9 mm, pulling the ends of a 15 m chord 9 mm closer; fabrication should add the same allowance, or symmetric welding can split it into about 4.5 mm at each end.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼構在工廠做得精準，現場焊接不會改變幾何。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel fabricated accurately in the shop keeps its geometry through site welding." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外伸桁架吊裝與焊接順序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Outrigger erection and welding sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Welding so much thick plate causes shrinkage; with a poor sequence it accumulates, pulling truss nodes off their design positions, leaving residual stresses and even dragging core embeds or mega-columns out of line.

steps.title: 雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erection and welding sequence of two-storey outrigger trusses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外伸桁架吊裝與焊接順序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outrigger erection and welding sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：焊接收縮累積：若每道全滲透焊接頭橫向收縮約 1.5 mm，一條弦桿上有 6 個接頭，總收縮約 6×1.5 = 9 mm；跨距 15 m 的弦桿兩端因此靠近 9 mm，製造時應預留同量延長，或以對稱焊接讓兩端各收縮約 4.5 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Accumulated weld shrinkage: if each full-penetration joint shrinks about 1.5 mm transversely and a chord has 6 joints, the total is about 6×1.5 = 9 mm, pulling the ends of a 15 m chord 9 mm closer; fabrication should add the same allowance, or symmetric welding can split it into about 4.5 mm at each end. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：焊接前後量測節點座標與構件長度，比對預留收縮量是否正確；厚板焊接記錄預熱、層間溫度與焊接順序，完成後以超音波檢測並量測殘餘變形，偏差超過容許值時暫停後續焊接，由設計者評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure node coordinates and member lengths before and after welding to check the shrinkage allowance, record preheat, interpass temperature and welding sequence for thick plates, and after completion test ultrasonically and measure residual distortion, suspending further welding for the designer's assessment when deviations exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Erection and welding sequence of two-storey outrigger trusses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外伸桁架吊裝與焊接順序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outrigger erection and welding sequence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 焊接前後量測節點座標與構件長度，比對預留收縮量是否正確；厚板焊接記錄預熱、層間溫度與焊接順序，完成後以超音波檢測並量測殘餘變形，偏差超過容許值時暫停後續焊接，由設計者評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure node coordinates and member lengths before and after welding to check the shrinkage allowance, record preheat, interpass temperature and welding sequence for thick plates, and after completion test ultrasonically and measure residual distortion, suspending further welding for the designer's assessment when deviations exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：焊接程序書要指定焊接順序、預留收縮量、預熱與層間溫度與量測時機；高空吊裝與焊接依審查過的吊裝計畫進行，每個階段設停止點，由鋼構工程師與結構設計者確認幾何後才可續作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The welding procedure specifies sequence, shrinkage allowance, preheat and interpass temperature and measurement times; lifting and welding at height follow an approved lifting plan, with a hold point at every stage where the steel engineer and structural designer confirm geometry before work continues.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若從單側依序焊接整條弦桿，收縮會把桁架拉向一側，使與巨柱接合的孔位錯開，只能擴孔或現場切割；焊接殘餘應力與外伸臂的施工期附加力疊加，可能在厚板接頭產生裂紋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding a whole chord in sequence from one side pulls the truss to that side and misaligns the bolt holes at the mega-column, forcing reaming or site cutting; weld residual stresses added to construction-stage outrigger forces can crack thick-plate joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 焊接前後量測節點座標與構件長度，比對預留收縮量是否正確；厚板焊接記錄預熱、層間溫度與焊接順序，完成後以超音波檢測並量測殘餘變形，偏差超過容許值時暫停後續焊接，由設計者評估。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 焊接程序書要指定焊接順序、預留收縮量、預熱與層間溫度與量測時機；高空吊裝與焊接依審查過的吊裝計畫進行，每個階段設停止點，由鋼構工程師與結構設計者確認幾何後才可續作。
knowledge.textEn: The welding procedure specifies sequence, shrinkage allowance, preheat and interpass temperature and measurement times; lifting and welding at height follow an approved lifting plan, with a hold point at every stage where the steel engineer and structural designer confirm geometry before work continues.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
