Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter.

Measure node coordinates and member lengths before and after welding to check the shrinkage allowance, record preheat, interpass temperature and welding sequence for thick plates, and after completion test ultrasonically and measure residual distortion, suspending further welding for the designer's assessment when deviations exceed tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 焊接前後量測節點座標與構件長度，比對預留收縮量是否正確；厚板焊接記錄預熱、層間溫度與焊接順序，完成後以超音波檢測並量測殘餘變形，偏差超過容許值時暫停後續焊接，由設計者評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure node coordinates and member lengths before and after welding to check the shrinkage allowance, record preheat, interpass temperature and welding sequence for thick plates, and after completion test ultrasonically and measure residual distortion, suspending further welding for the designer's assessment when deviations exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Erection and welding sequence of two-storey outrigger trusses: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外伸桁架吊裝與焊接順序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outrigger erection and welding sequence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若從單側依序焊接整條弦桿，收縮會把桁架拉向一側，使與巨柱接合的孔位錯開，只能擴孔或現場切割；焊接殘餘應力與外伸臂的施工期附加力疊加，可能在厚板接頭產生裂紋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding a whole chord in sequence from one side pulls the truss to that side and misaligns the bolt holes at the mega-column, forcing reaming or site cutting; weld residual stresses added to construction-stage outrigger forces can crack thick-plate joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工方以預留收縮量、對稱焊接、先組後焊與臨時支撐控制幾何，並同時考慮塔吊在該半徑的吊重能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Contractors control geometry with shrinkage allowances, symmetric welding, assembly before welding and temporary supports, while respecting tower-crane capacity at the working radius.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼構在工廠做得精準，現場焊接不會改變幾何。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel fabricated accurately in the shop keeps its geometry through site welding." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若從單側依序焊接整條弦桿，收縮會把桁架拉向一側，使與巨柱接合的孔位錯開，只能擴孔或現場切割；焊接殘餘應力與外伸臂的施工期附加力疊加，可能在厚板接頭產生裂紋。
knowledge.textEn: Welding a whole chord in sequence from one side pulls the truss to that side and misaligns the bolt holes at the mega-column, forcing reaming or site cutting; weld residual stresses added to construction-stage outrigger forces can crack thick-plate joints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙層高外伸桁架的吊裝與焊接順序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Erection and welding sequence of two-storey outrigger trusses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若從單側依序焊接整條弦桿，收縮會把桁架拉向一側，使與巨柱接合的孔位錯開，只能擴孔或現場切割；焊接殘餘應力與外伸臂的施工期附加力疊加，可能在厚板接頭產生裂紋。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。
optionsEn: Welding a whole chord in sequence from one side pulls the truss to that side and misaligns the bolt holes at the mega-column, forcing reaming or site cutting.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled.
quiz.explanation: 若從單側依序焊接整條弦桿，收縮會把桁架拉向一側，使與巨柱接合的孔位錯開，只能擴孔或現場切割；焊接殘餘應力與外伸臂的施工期附加力疊加，可能在厚板接頭產生裂紋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Welding a whole chord in sequence from one side pulls the truss to that side and misaligns the bolt holes at the mega-column, forcing reaming or site cutting; weld residual stresses added to construction-stage outrigger forces can crack thick-plate joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」與「在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness" and "Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外伸臂構件應變監測」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strain monitoring of outrigger members” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂系統的實際效果取決於許多不確定因素：混凝土開裂後的核心勁度、接合的實際剛度、樓板參與程度與差異縮短的殘留量。在外伸臂斜桿、弦桿與相連巨柱上安裝應變計並量測溫度，可以把風或重力作用下的構件力量化，再與模型預測比較，回推系統的實際勁度分配。這些資料也是日後評估改裝或事件後狀態的基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外伸臂構件應變監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An outrigger system's real effectiveness depends on many uncertainties: cracked core stiffness, actual joint rigidity, slab participation and residual differential shortening. Strain gauges with temperature sensing on outrigger diagonals, chords and connected mega-columns turn wind or gravity effects into member forces that can be compared with model predictions to back-calculate the real stiffness distribution. The data also become the baseline for later assessment of alterations or post-event condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strain monitoring of outrigger members” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：構件軸力 N = E·A·ε。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Member axial force N = E·A·ε.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外伸臂構件應變監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strain monitoring of outrigger members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度
knowledge.titleEn: Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness
knowledge.text: 外伸臂系統的實際效果取決於許多不確定因素：混凝土開裂後的核心勁度、接合的實際剛度、樓板參與程度與差異縮短的殘留量。在外伸臂斜桿、弦桿與相連巨柱上安裝應變計並量測溫度，可以把風或重力作用下的構件力量化，再與模型預測比較，回推系統的實際勁度分配。
knowledge.textEn: An outrigger system's real effectiveness depends on many uncertainties: cracked core stiffness, actual joint rigidity, slab participation and residual differential shortening. Strain gauges with temperature sensing on outrigger diagonals, chords and connected mega-columns turn wind or gravity effects into member forces that can be compared with model predictions to back-calculate the real stiffness distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness" is correct?
options: 外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。
外伸臂系統的實際效果取決於許多不確定因素：混凝土開裂後的核心勁度、接合的實際剛度、樓板參與程度與差異縮短的殘留量。
阻尼器裝在哪裡都一樣，只要阻尼係數夠大就有效。
optionsEn: If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled.
An outrigger system's real effectiveness depends on many uncertainties: cracked core stiffness, actual joint rigidity, slab participation and residual differential shortening.
It makes no difference where dampers go; a large enough coefficient always works.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂系統的實際效果取決於許多不確定因素：混凝土開裂後的核心勁度、接合的實際剛度、樓板參與程度與差異縮短的殘留量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An outrigger system's real effectiveness depends on many uncertainties: cracked core stiffness, actual joint rigidity, slab participation and residual differential shortening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外伸臂構件應變監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strain monitoring of outrigger members” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：構件軸力 N = E·A·ε。斜桿 A = 0.12 m²、E = 200 GPa，量得風作用下應變 150 με，N = 200×10⁹×0.12×150×10⁻⁶ = 3.6 MN；若模型預測同一風況為 4.0 MN，實際約為預測的 90%，代表接合或核心勁度與假設略有差異。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Member axial force N = E·A·ε. For a diagonal with A = 0.12 m² and E = 200 GPa, a measured wind strain of 150 με gives N = 200×10⁹×0.12×150×10⁻⁶ = 3.6 MN; if the model predicted 4.0 MN for the same wind, the actual force is about 90% of the prediction, indicating joint or core stiffness somewhat different from the assumption. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一斷面四周對稱安裝應變計以分離軸力與彎矩，並以溫度補償扣除日照影響；監測資料與風速計同步，挑選風向穩定的時段回歸出單位風壓下的構件力，再與模型比較，偏差超過約兩成時檢討模型假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount gauges symmetrically around each section to separate axial force from bending, compensate for temperature to remove solar effects, synchronise with anemometers, and regress member force per unit wind pressure over periods of steady wind direction for comparison with the model, reviewing model assumptions when the difference exceeds about 20%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 構件軸力 N = E·A·ε。斜桿 A = 0.12 m²、E = 200 GPa，量得風作用下應變 150 με，N = 200×10⁹×0.12×150×10⁻⁶ = 3.6 MN；若模型預測同一風況為 4.0 MN，實際約為預測的 90%，代表接合或核心勁度與假設略有差異。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Member axial force N = E·A·ε. For a diagonal with A = 0.12 m² and E = 200 GPa, a measured wind strain of 150 με gives N = 200×10⁹×0.12×150×10⁻⁶ = 3.6 MN; if the model predicted 4.0 MN for the same wind, the actual force is about 90% of the prediction, indicating joint or core stiffness somewhat different from the assumption. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。
外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。
構件軸力 N = E·A·ε。
optionsEn: Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue.
An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there.
Member axial force N = E·A·ε.
quiz.explanation: 構件軸力 N = E·A·ε。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Member axial force N = E·A·ε. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外伸臂構件應變監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strain monitoring of outrigger members” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一斷面四周對稱安裝應變計以分離軸力與彎矩，並以溫度補償扣除日照影響；監測資料與風速計同步，挑選風向穩定的時段回歸出單位風壓下的構件力，再與模型比較，偏差超過約兩成時檢討模型假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount gauges symmetrically around each section to separate axial force from bending, compensate for temperature to remove solar effects, synchronise with anemometers, and regress member force per unit wind pressure over periods of steady wind direction for comparison with the model, reviewing model assumptions when the difference exceeds about 20%. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測計畫在設計階段就決定感測器位置、初讀時機（鎖定前後各一次）與資料格式；交接時把原始資料、處理方法與基準值一起移交營運單位，作為日後評估的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Decide sensor locations, initial-reading times (once before and once after lock-off) and data format at the design stage, and hand raw data, processing methods and baseline values to the operator at handover as the basis for future assessments.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：應變計只裝在構件單側時，彎曲應變會被誤當成軸力；未做溫度補償時，日照造成的應變變化可能比風造成的還大，得出錯誤的勁度結論。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gauges on one face only mistake bending strain for axial force; without temperature compensation, solar strain changes can exceed wind-induced ones and lead to wrong stiffness conclusions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一斷面四周對稱安裝應變計以分離軸力與彎矩，並以溫度補償扣除日照影響；監測資料與風速計同步，挑選風向穩定的時段回歸出單位風壓下的構件力，再與模型比較，偏差超過約兩成時檢討模型假設。
knowledge.textEn: Mount gauges symmetrically around each section to separate axial force from bending, compensate for temperature to remove solar effects, synchronise with anemometers, and regress member force per unit wind pressure over periods of steady wind direction for comparison with the model, reviewing model assumptions when the difference exceeds about 20%.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測計畫在設計階段就決定感測器位置、初讀時機（鎖定前後各一次）與資料格式；交接時把原始資料、處理方法與基準值一起移交營運單位，作為日後評估的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Decide sensor locations, initial-reading times (once before and once after lock-off) and data format at the design stage, and hand raw data, processing methods and baseline values to the operator at handover as the basis for future assessments.

quiz.question: 要驗證「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness"?
options: 在同一斷面四周對稱安裝應變計以分離軸力與彎矩，並以溫度補償扣除日照影響。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。
optionsEn: Mount gauges symmetrically around each section to separate axial force from bending, compensate for temperature to remove solar effects, synchronise with anemometers, and regress member force per unit wind pressure over periods of steady wind direction for comparison with the model, reviewing model assumptions when the difference exceeds about 20%.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 在同一斷面四周對稱安裝應變計以分離軸力與彎矩，並以溫度補償扣除日照影響；監測資料與風速計同步，挑選風向穩定的時段回歸出單位風壓下的構件力，再與模型比較，偏差超過約兩成時檢討模型假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount gauges symmetrically around each section to separate axial force from bending, compensate for temperature to remove solar effects, synchronise with anemometers, and regress member force per unit wind pressure over periods of steady wind direction for comparison with the model, reviewing model assumptions when the difference exceeds about 20%. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外伸臂構件應變監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strain monitoring of outrigger members” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 應變計只裝在構件單側時，彎曲應變會被誤當成軸力；未做溫度補償時，日照造成的應變變化可能比風造成的還大，得出錯誤的勁度結論。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Gauges on one face only mistake bending strain for axial force; without temperature compensation, solar strain changes can exceed wind-induced ones and lead to wrong stiffness conclusions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些資料也是日後評估改裝或事件後狀態的基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data also become the baseline for later assessment of alterations or post-event condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「阻尼外伸臂」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damped outrigger” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 阻尼外伸臂把外伸臂端部與巨柱之間原本的剛性接合換成垂直的黏滯阻尼器：核心彎曲轉動時，外伸臂端部與巨柱之間產生相對垂直位移，阻尼器在這個相對運動中耗能，為整棟樓提供附加阻尼，同時避免剛性外伸臂傳遞過大的力。阻尼效果取決於阻尼器兩端的相對位移：外伸臂或柱子太柔時，阻尼器兩端一起動，就耗不了多少能量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「阻尼外伸臂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A damped outrigger replaces the rigid joint between the outrigger tip and the mega-column with vertical viscous dampers: as the core bends and rotates, relative vertical movement arises between outrigger tip and column, and the dampers dissipate energy in that motion, adding damping to the whole building while avoiding the very large forces a rigid outrigger would transmit. The benefit depends on the relative displacement across the dampers: if the outrigger or columns are too flexible, both ends of the damper move together and little energy is dissipated. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Damped outrigger” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：附加阻尼比 ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Added damping ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器裝在哪裡都一樣，只要阻尼係數夠大就有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "It makes no difference where dampers go; a large enough coefficient always works." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「阻尼外伸臂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Damped outrigger”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器
knowledge.titleEn: Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column
knowledge.text: 阻尼外伸臂把外伸臂端部與巨柱之間原本的剛性接合換成垂直的黏滯阻尼器：核心彎曲轉動時，外伸臂端部與巨柱之間產生相對垂直位移，阻尼器在這個相對運動中耗能，為整棟樓提供附加阻尼，同時避免剛性外伸臂傳遞過大的力。阻尼效果取決於阻尼器兩端的相對位移：外伸臂或柱子太柔時，阻尼器兩端一起動，就耗不了多少能量。

The benefit depends on the relative displacement across the dampers: if the outrigger or columns are too flexible, both ends of the damper move together and little energy is dissipated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.title: 在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「阻尼外伸臂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damped outrigger” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：附加阻尼比 ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s)。模態質量 50,000 t、f = 0.15 Hz（ω = 0.942 rad/s）、頂部振幅 0.3 m：E_s = ½·M·ω²·X² ≈ 2.0 MJ；阻尼器總係數 c = 50 MN·s/m、相對位移 u = 0.05 m 時 E_d = π·c·ω·u² ≈ 0.37 MJ，ζ_add ≈ 1.5%；若 u 只有 0.02 m，ζ_add 降為約 0.24%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Added damping ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s). With a modal mass of 50,000 t, f = 0.15 Hz (ω = 0.942 rad/s) and a top amplitude of 0.3 m, E_s = ½·M·ω²·X² ≈ 2.0 MJ; with total damper coefficient c = 50 MN·s/m and relative displacement u = 0.05 m, E_d = π·c·ω·u² ≈ 0.37 MJ and ζ_add ≈ 1.5%; if u is only 0.02 m, ζ_add drops to about 0.24%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以包含阻尼器非線性特性的時間歷程分析計算阻尼器相對位移、力量與附加阻尼，確認在風與地震下都在阻尼器行程與力量範圍內；阻尼器做原型與逐件試驗，完工後以環境振動或強風紀錄辨識實際阻尼比，並與設計值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute damper relative displacement, force and added damping with time-history analyses that include the dampers' nonlinear behaviour, confirming stroke and force limits are respected in wind and earthquake; test prototypes and every production damper, and after completion identify actual damping from ambient or strong-wind records for comparison with the design value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 附加阻尼比 ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s)。模態質量 50,000 t、f = 0.15 Hz（ω = 0.942 rad/s）、頂部振幅 0.3 m：E_s = ½·M·ω²·X² ≈ 2.0 MJ；阻尼器總係數 c = 50 MN·s/m、相對位移 u = 0.05 m 時 E_d = π·c·ω·u² ≈ 0.37 MJ，ζ_add ≈ 1.5%；若 u 只有 0.02 m，ζ_add 降為約 0.24%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Added damping ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s). With a modal mass of 50,000 t, f = 0.15 Hz (ω = 0.942 rad/s) and a top amplitude of 0.3 m, E_s = ½·M·ω²·X² ≈ 2.0 MJ; with total damper coefficient c = 50 MN·s/m and relative displacement u = 0.05 m, E_d = π·c·ω·u² ≈ 0.37 MJ and ζ_add ≈ 1.5%; if u is only 0.02 m, ζ_add drops to about 0.24%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column", which statement holds?
options: 附加阻尼比 ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s)。
外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。
巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。
optionsEn: Added damping ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s).
An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness.
Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 附加阻尼比 ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Added damping ζ_add = E_d/(4π·E_s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「阻尼外伸臂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Damped outrigger” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以包含阻尼器非線性特性的時間歷程分析計算阻尼器相對位移、力量與附加阻尼，確認在風與地震下都在阻尼器行程與力量範圍內；阻尼器做原型與逐件試驗，完工後以環境振動或強風紀錄辨識實際阻尼比，並與設計值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute damper relative displacement, force and added damping with time-history analyses that include the dampers' nonlinear behaviour, confirming stroke and force limits are respected in wind and earthquake; test prototypes and every production damper, and after completion identify actual damping from ambient or strong-wind records for comparison with the design value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：阻尼外伸臂的設計基準要同時寫明附加阻尼目標、阻尼器相對位移範圍與行程限制；阻尼器的檢查、更換通道與鎖定程序在設計階段就預留，並納入維護手冊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis of a damped outrigger should state the added-damping target, the range of damper relative displacement and stroke limits together; provide access, replacement routes and locking procedures for the dampers at the design stage and include them in the maintenance manual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若外伸臂本身太柔，阻尼器兩端相對位移很小，附加阻尼遠低於預期；阻尼器在大地震時若超出行程而撞到止擋，力量突然增大，可能損壞外伸臂或巨柱接合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the outrigger itself is too flexible, the dampers see little relative displacement and added damping falls far short of expectations; dampers exceeding their stroke in a major earthquake hit their stops, abruptly raising force and possibly damaging the outrigger or column connection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以包含阻尼器非線性特性的時間歷程分析計算阻尼器相對位移、力量與附加阻尼，確認在風與地震下都在阻尼器行程與力量範圍內；阻尼器做原型與逐件試驗，完工後以環境振動或強風紀錄辨識實際阻尼比，並與設計值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compute damper relative displacement, force and added damping with time-history analyses that include the dampers' nonlinear behaviour, confirming stroke and force limits are respected in wind and earthquake; test prototypes and every production damper, and after completion identify actual damping from ambient or strong-wind records for comparison with the design value.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 阻尼外伸臂的設計基準要同時寫明附加阻尼目標、阻尼器相對位移範圍與行程限制；阻尼器的檢查、更換通道與鎖定程序在設計階段就預留，並納入維護手冊。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis of a damped outrigger should state the added-damping target, the range of damper relative displacement and stroke limits together; provide access, replacement routes and locking procedures for the dampers at the design stage and include them in the maintenance manual.

quiz.question: 要驗證「在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以包含阻尼器非線性特性的時間歷程分析計算阻尼器相對位移、力量與附加阻尼，確認在風與地震下都在阻尼器行程與力量範圍內。
外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Compute damper relative displacement, force and added damping with time-history analyses that include the dampers' nonlinear behaviour, confirming stroke and force limits are respected in wind and earthquake.
The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better.
quiz.explanation: 以包含阻尼器非線性特性的時間歷程分析計算阻尼器相對位移、力量與附加阻尼，確認在風與地震下都在阻尼器行程與力量範圍內；阻尼器做原型與逐件試驗，完工後以環境振動或強風紀錄辨識實際阻尼比，並與設計值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute damper relative displacement, force and added damping with time-history analyses that include the dampers' nonlinear behaviour, confirming stroke and force limits are respected in wind and earthquake; test prototypes and every production damper, and after completion identify actual damping from ambient or strong-wind records for comparison with the design value. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「阻尼外伸臂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Damped outrigger” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若外伸臂本身太柔，阻尼器兩端相對位移很小，附加阻尼遠低於預期；阻尼器在大地震時若超出行程而撞到止擋，力量突然增大，可能損壞外伸臂或巨柱接合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the outrigger itself is too flexible, the dampers see little relative displacement and added damping falls far short of expectations; dampers exceeding their stroke in a major earthquake hit their stops, abruptly raising force and possibly damaging the outrigger or column connection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：阻尼效果取決於阻尼器兩端的相對位移：外伸臂或柱子太柔時，阻尼器兩端一起動，就耗不了多少能量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The benefit depends on the relative displacement across the dampers: if the outrigger or columns are too flexible, both ends of the damper move together and little energy is dissipated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器裝在哪裡都一樣，只要阻尼係數夠大就有效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "It makes no difference where dampers go; a large enough coefficient always works." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若外伸臂本身太柔，阻尼器兩端相對位移很小，附加阻尼遠低於預期；阻尼器在大地震時若超出行程而撞到止擋，力量突然增大，可能損壞外伸臂或巨柱接合。
knowledge.textEn: If the outrigger itself is too flexible, the dampers see little relative displacement and added damping falls far short of expectations; dampers exceeding their stroke in a major earthquake hit their stops, abruptly raising force and possibly damaging the outrigger or column connection.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「在外伸臂與巨柱之間加入阻尼器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Placing dampers between outrigger and mega-column" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
機電層是設備空間，構件開孔只是施工方便的小事。
若外伸臂本身太柔，阻尼器兩端相對位移很小，附加阻尼遠低於預期；阻尼器在大地震時若超出行程而撞到止擋，力量突然增大，可能損壞外伸臂或巨柱接合。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Mechanical floors are equipment space, so cutting members is a minor matter of convenience.
If the outrigger itself is too flexible, the dampers see little relative displacement and added damping falls far short of expectations.
quiz.explanation: 若外伸臂本身太柔，阻尼器兩端相對位移很小，附加阻尼遠低於預期；阻尼器在大地震時若超出行程而撞到止擋，力量突然增大，可能損壞外伸臂或巨柱接合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the outrigger itself is too flexible, the dampers see little relative displacement and added damping falls far short of expectations; dampers exceeding their stroke in a major earthquake hit their stops, abruptly raising force and possibly damaging the outrigger or column connection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控」與「外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors" and "Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外伸臂樓層的改裝管控」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alteration control on outrigger floors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂多設在機電層或避難層，這些樓層在營運期間經常需要更換設備、增設管線或改變用途。外伸桁架的斜桿與弦桿佔據大量空間，維修人員可能為了搬運設備或穿越管線而要求在構件上開孔、切割或焊接附掛物；任何一處削弱都可能切斷整個外伸臂的傳力路徑。因此外伸臂樓層在建築管理上必須被列為結構管制區，所有改裝都要經過結構審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外伸臂樓層的改裝管控」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Outriggers usually sit in mechanical or refuge floors, which in service often need equipment replacement, new services or changes of use. Outrigger diagonals and chords occupy much of the space, and maintenance staff may ask to cut openings, trim members or weld attachments to move equipment or run services; any one weakening can sever the load path of the whole outrigger. Outrigger floors must therefore be designated structural control zones in building management, with every alteration subject to structural review. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Alteration control on outrigger floors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：開孔造成的淨斷面損失：弦桿斷面積 0.12 m²，若在 60 mm 厚的腹板開 600 mm 高的孔，損失 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m²，淨斷面剩 0.084 m²，約為原來的 70%；若原使用率為 0.8，開孔後使用率升為 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14，已超過容量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Net-section loss from an opening: a chord of 0.12 m² with a 600 mm high hole cut in its 60 mm web loses 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m², leaving 0.084 m², about 70% of the original; a utilisation of 0.8 before the cut becomes 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14 after it, beyond capacity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機電層是設備空間，構件開孔只是施工方便的小事。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mechanical floors are equipment space, so cutting members is a minor matter of convenience." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外伸臂樓層的改裝管控」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Alteration control on outrigger floors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控
knowledge.titleEn: Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors
knowledge.text: 外伸臂多設在機電層或避難層，這些樓層在營運期間經常需要更換設備、增設管線或改變用途。外伸桁架的斜桿與弦桿佔據大量空間，維修人員可能為了搬運設備或穿越管線而要求在構件上開孔、切割或焊接附掛物；任何一處削弱都可能切斷整個外伸臂的傳力路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Outriggers usually sit in mechanical or refuge floors, which in service often need equipment replacement, new services or changes of use. Outrigger diagonals and chords occupy much of the space, and maintenance staff may ask to cut openings, trim members or weld attachments to move equipment or run services; any one weakening can sever the load path of the whole outrigger.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：機電層是設備空間，構件開孔只是施工方便的小事。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mechanical floors are equipment space, so cutting members is a minor matter of convenience. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors" is correct?
options: 外伸臂多設在機電層或避難層，這些樓層在營運期間經常需要更換設備、增設管線或改變用途。
機電層是設備空間，構件開孔只是施工方便的小事。
外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。
optionsEn: Outriggers usually sit in mechanical or refuge floors, which in service often need equipment replacement, new services or changes of use.
Mechanical floors are equipment space, so cutting members is a minor matter of convenience.
Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂多設在機電層或避難層，這些樓層在營運期間經常需要更換設備、增設管線或改變用途。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Outriggers usually sit in mechanical or refuge floors, which in service often need equipment replacement, new services or changes of use. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外伸臂樓層的改裝管控」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alteration control on outrigger floors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：開孔造成的淨斷面損失：弦桿斷面積 0.12 m²，若在 60 mm 厚的腹板開 600 mm 高的孔，損失 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m²，淨斷面剩 0.084 m²，約為原來的 70%；若原使用率為 0.8，開孔後使用率升為 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14，已超過容量。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Net-section loss from an opening: a chord of 0.12 m² with a 600 mm high hole cut in its 60 mm web loses 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m², leaving 0.084 m², about 70% of the original; a utilisation of 0.8 before the cut becomes 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14 after it, beyond capacity. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在外伸臂樓層的構件上以顏色或標牌標示「結構關鍵構件，禁止切割與焊接」，定期巡檢是否有未經許可的開孔、附掛或腐蝕；改裝申請附結構計算，完成後由結構工程師現場驗收並更新竣工圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark outrigger-floor members with colour codes or signs reading critical structural member, no cutting or welding; inspect periodically for unauthorised openings, attachments or corrosion; require structural calculations with alteration requests and have the structural engineer accept the work on site and update the as-built drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 開孔造成的淨斷面損失：弦桿斷面積 0.12 m²，若在 60 mm 厚的腹板開 600 mm 高的孔，損失 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m²，淨斷面剩 0.084 m²，約為原來的 70%；若原使用率為 0.8，開孔後使用率升為 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14，已超過容量。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Net-section loss from an opening: a chord of 0.12 m² with a 600 mm high hole cut in its 60 mm web loses 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m², leaving 0.084 m², about 70% of the original; a utilisation of 0.8 before the cut becomes 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14 after it, beyond capacity. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors", which statement holds?
options: 外伸臂放在建築頂部效果最好，因為那裡轉角最大。
開孔造成的淨斷面損失：弦桿斷面積 0.12 m²，若在 60 mm 厚的腹板開 600 mm 高的孔，損失 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m²，淨斷面剩 0.084 m²，約為原來的 70%。
外伸桁架只要鋼構夠強，接到混凝土核心的方式不重要。
optionsEn: An outrigger works best at the top of the building because rotation is largest there.
Net-section loss from an opening: a chord of 0.12 m² with a 600 mm high hole cut in its 60 mm web loses 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m², leaving 0.084 m², about 70% of the original.
If the outrigger steel is strong enough, the way it connects to the concrete core does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 開孔造成的淨斷面損失：弦桿斷面積 0.12 m²，若在 60 mm 厚的腹板開 600 mm 高的孔，損失 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m²，淨斷面剩 0.084 m²，約為原來的 70%；若原使用率為 0.8，開孔後使用率升為 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14，已超過容量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Net-section loss from an opening: a chord of 0.12 m² with a 600 mm high hole cut in its 60 mm web loses 0.6×0.06 = 0.036 m², leaving 0.084 m², about 70% of the original; a utilisation of 0.8 before the cut becomes 0.8/0.7 ≈ 1.14 after it, beyond capacity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外伸臂樓層的改裝管控」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alteration control on outrigger floors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在外伸臂樓層的構件上以顏色或標牌標示「結構關鍵構件，禁止切割與焊接」，定期巡檢是否有未經許可的開孔、附掛或腐蝕；改裝申請附結構計算，完成後由結構工程師現場驗收並更新竣工圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark outrigger-floor members with colour codes or signs reading critical structural member, no cutting or welding; inspect periodically for unauthorised openings, attachments or corrosion; require structural calculations with alteration requests and have the structural engineer accept the work on site and update the as-built drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運手冊附外伸臂樓層的結構管制圖、可用的設備搬運路徑與預留孔位置，任何改裝都須取得結構工程師簽認；設備更換路線應在設計階段就預留，避免日後切割構件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operations manual includes structural control plans for outrigger floors, the permitted equipment routes and the provided openings, with every alteration needing the structural engineer's sign-off; plan equipment replacement routes at the design stage so members never need cutting later.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機電承包商為了更換大型設備而切斷一根斜桿，外伸臂的力流被打斷，強風或地震時核心與基礎承受遠超設計的彎矩；這種損傷平時看不出來，只有在極端事件中才會暴露。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A services contractor cutting through a diagonal to replace large equipment interrupts the outrigger's force flow, so in strong wind or earthquakes the core and foundation take moments far beyond design; the damage is invisible day to day and exposed only in an extreme event. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在外伸臂樓層的構件上以顏色或標牌標示「結構關鍵構件，禁止切割與焊接」，定期巡檢是否有未經許可的開孔、附掛或腐蝕；改裝申請附結構計算，完成後由結構工程師現場驗收並更新竣工圖。
knowledge.textEn: Mark outrigger-floor members with colour codes or signs reading critical structural member, no cutting or welding; inspect periodically for unauthorised openings, attachments or corrosion; require structural calculations with alteration requests and have the structural engineer accept the work on site and update the as-built drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運手冊附外伸臂樓層的結構管制圖、可用的設備搬運路徑與預留孔位置，任何改裝都須取得結構工程師簽認；設備更換路線應在設計階段就預留，避免日後切割構件。
knowledge.textEn: The operations manual includes structural control plans for outrigger floors, the permitted equipment routes and the provided openings, with every alteration needing the structural engineer's sign-off; plan equipment replacement routes at the design stage so members never need cutting later.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
鋼構在工廠做得精準，現場焊接不會改變幾何。
在外伸臂樓層的構件上以顏色或標牌標示「結構關鍵構件，禁止切割與焊接」，定期巡檢是否有未經許可的開孔、附掛或腐蝕。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Steel fabricated accurately in the shop keeps its geometry through site welding.
Mark outrigger-floor members with colour codes or signs reading critical structural member, no cutting or welding.
quiz.explanation: 在外伸臂樓層的構件上以顏色或標牌標示「結構關鍵構件，禁止切割與焊接」，定期巡檢是否有未經許可的開孔、附掛或腐蝕；改裝申請附結構計算，完成後由結構工程師現場驗收並更新竣工圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark outrigger-floor members with colour codes or signs reading critical structural member, no cutting or welding; inspect periodically for unauthorised openings, attachments or corrosion; require structural calculations with alteration requests and have the structural engineer accept the work on site and update the as-built drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外伸臂樓層的改裝管控」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alteration control on outrigger floors” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 機電承包商為了更換大型設備而切斷一根斜桿，外伸臂的力流被打斷，強風或地震時核心與基礎承受遠超設計的彎矩；這種損傷平時看不出來，只有在極端事件中才會暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A services contractor cutting through a diagonal to replace large equipment interrupts the outrigger's force flow, so in strong wind or earthquakes the core and foundation take moments far beyond design; the damage is invisible day to day and exposed only in an extreme event. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此外伸臂樓層在建築管理上必須被列為結構管制區，所有改裝都要經過結構審查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Outrigger floors must therefore be designated structural control zones in building management, with every alteration subject to structural review.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「機電層是設備空間，構件開孔只是施工方便的小事。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mechanical floors are equipment space, so cutting members is a minor matter of convenience." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 機電承包商為了更換大型設備而切斷一根斜桿，外伸臂的力流被打斷，強風或地震時核心與基礎承受遠超設計的彎矩；這種損傷平時看不出來，只有在極端事件中才會暴露。
knowledge.textEn: A services contractor cutting through a diagonal to replace large equipment interrupts the outrigger's force flow, so in strong wind or earthquakes the core and foundation take moments far beyond design; the damage is invisible day to day and exposed only in an extreme event.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外伸臂樓層的使用限制與改裝管控」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Use restrictions and alteration control on outrigger floors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 機電承包商為了更換大型設備而切斷一根斜桿，外伸臂的力流被打斷，強風或地震時核心與基礎承受遠超設計的彎矩；這種損傷平時看不出來，只有在極端事件中才會暴露。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。
optionsEn: A services contractor cutting through a diagonal to replace large equipment interrupts the outrigger's force flow, so in strong wind or earthquakes the core and foundation take moments far beyond design.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue.
quiz.explanation: 機電承包商為了更換大型設備而切斷一根斜桿，外伸臂的力流被打斷，強風或地震時核心與基礎承受遠超設計的彎矩；這種損傷平時看不出來，只有在極端事件中才會暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A services contractor cutting through a diagonal to replace large equipment interrupts the outrigger's force flow, so in strong wind or earthquakes the core and foundation take moments far beyond design; the damage is invisible day to day and exposed only in an extreme event. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「長期徐變監測」如何影響巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term creep monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Mega-column and outrigger structural systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂鎖定之後，巨柱與核心的徐變與乾縮仍會持續數年至十數年，殘留的差異縮短會慢慢增加外伸臂與巨柱的附加力，也可能讓樓板邊緣傾斜。長期監測以應變計、精密水準與接頭位移計追蹤這個過程，並與時間相依分析比較；交接文件要讓營運單位知道哪些數值屬於正常發展、何時需要請結構顧問評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長期徐變監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After lock-off, creep and shrinkage of mega-columns and core continue for years or even more than a decade, and the residual differential shortening slowly adds force to outriggers and columns and can tilt slab edges. Long-term monitoring with strain gauges, precise levelling and joint displacement gauges tracks this process against time-dependent analysis, and handover documents must tell the operator which values are normal development and when to call in the structural consultant. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-term creep monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 209 creep development φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶) with φ∞ = 2.35: φ ≈ 1.02 at 30 days, ≈ 1.82 at 1 year and ≈ 2.19 at 10 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「長期徐變監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-term creep monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems
knowledge.text: 外伸臂鎖定之後，巨柱與核心的徐變與乾縮仍會持續數年至十數年，殘留的差異縮短會慢慢增加外伸臂與巨柱的附加力，也可能讓樓板邊緣傾斜。長期監測以應變計、精密水準與接頭位移計追蹤這個過程，並與時間相依分析比較；交接文件要讓營運單位知道哪些數值屬於正常發展、何時需要請結構顧問評估。
knowledge.textEn: After lock-off, creep and shrinkage of mega-columns and core continue for years or even more than a decade, and the residual differential shortening slowly adds force to outriggers and columns and can tilt slab edges. Long-term monitoring with strain gauges, precise levelling and joint displacement gauges tracks this process against time-dependent analysis, and handover documents must tell the operator which values are normal development and when to call in the structural consultant.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems" is correct?
options: 外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。
外伸臂鎖定之後，巨柱與核心的徐變與乾縮仍會持續數年至十數年，殘留的差異縮短會慢慢增加外伸臂與巨柱的附加力，也可能讓樓板邊緣傾斜。
外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。
optionsEn: Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue.

After lock-off, creep and shrinkage of mega-columns and core continue for years or even more than a decade, and the residual differential shortening slowly adds force to outriggers and columns and can tilt slab edges.
An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂鎖定之後，巨柱與核心的徐變與乾縮仍會持續數年至十數年，殘留的差異縮短會慢慢增加外伸臂與巨柱的附加力，也可能讓樓板邊緣傾斜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After lock-off, creep and shrinkage of mega-columns and core continue for years or even more than a decade, and the residual differential shortening slowly adds force to outriggers and columns and can tilt slab edges. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期徐變監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term creep monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 209 徐變發展 φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶)，φ∞ = 2.35：t = 30 天時 φ ≈ 1.02，1 年時 ≈ 1.82，10 年時 ≈ 2.19。若加載 1 年後才鎖定，剩下的徐變只佔 10 年值的 (2.19 − 1.82)/2.19 ≈ 17%，鎖定後的附加力也大致同比例減少。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 209 creep development φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶) with φ∞ = 2.35: φ ≈ 1.02 at 30 days, ≈ 1.82 at 1 year and ≈ 2.19 at 10 years. Locking off one year after loading leaves only (2.19 − 1.82)/2.19 ≈ 17% of the 10-year creep, and the force added after lock-off falls roughly in proportion. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每年以精密水準量測巨柱與核心在代表樓層的高程差，並讀取應變計與接頭位移計，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較；發展速率異常（例如某支巨柱持續快於其他柱）時，檢查是否有局部超載或材料問題。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each year measure level differences between mega-columns and core on representative floors by precise levelling and read strain gauges and joint displacement gauges, comparing with the predicted time-dependent curves; if a rate is abnormal, such as one column persistently outpacing the others, check for local overloading or material problems.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 209 徐變發展 φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶)，φ∞ = 2.35：t = 30 天時 φ ≈ 1.02，1 年時 ≈ 1.82，10 年時 ≈ 2.19。若加載 1 年後才鎖定，剩下的徐變只佔 10 年值的 (2.19 − 1.82)/2.19 ≈ 17%，鎖定後的附加力也大致同比例減少。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 209 creep development φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶) with φ∞ = 2.35: φ ≈ 1.02 at 30 days, ≈ 1.82 at 1 year and ≈ 2.19 at 10 years. Locking off one year after loading leaves only (2.19 − 1.82)/2.19 ≈ 17% of the 10-year creep, and the force added after lock-off falls roughly in proportion. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems", which statement holds?
options: 巨柱斷面這麼大，不可能挫屈，所以樓板支撐無關緊要。
外伸臂越早鎖定越好，可以讓結構越早完整。
optionsEn: Mega-columns are so large they cannot buckle, so floor bracing does not matter.
The earlier an outrigger is locked, the sooner the structure is complete, so earlier is better.
ACI 209 creep development φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶) with φ∞ = 2.35: φ ≈ 1.02 at 30 days, ≈ 1.82 at 1 year and ≈ 2.19 at 10 years.
quiz.explanation: ACI 209 徐變發展 φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶)，φ∞ = 2.35：t = 30 天時 φ ≈ 1.02，1 年時 ≈ 1.82，10 年時 ≈ 2.19。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 209 creep development φ(t) = φ∞·t⁰·⁶/(10 + t⁰·⁶) with φ∞ = 2.35: φ ≈ 1.02 at 30 days, ≈ 1.82 at 1 year and ≈ 2.19 at 10 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期徐變監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term creep monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每年以精密水準量測巨柱與核心在代表樓層的高程差，並讀取應變計與接頭位移計，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較；發展速率異常（例如某支巨柱持續快於其他柱）時，檢查是否有局部超載或材料問題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each year measure level differences between mega-columns and core on representative floors by precise levelling and read strain gauges and joint displacement gauges, comparing with the predicted time-dependent curves; if a rate is abnormal, such as one column persistently outpacing the others, check for local overloading or material problems. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件包含鎖定時的實測差異、預測的長期曲線、監測點位置與允收範圍，以及超出範圍時的處理流程；監測至少持續到徐變發展趨緩，並由結構顧問定期審閱。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents include the measured difference at lock-off, the predicted long-term curves, monitoring locations and acceptance ranges, and the procedure when values fall outside them; continue monitoring at least until creep growth levels off, with periodic review by the structural consultant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沒有長期監測，殘留差異縮短造成的樓板傾斜與帷幕接縫變形會被誤認為施工瑕疵而反覆修補；外伸臂附加力超出預期，也可能在多年後才以接合螺栓鬆動或裂縫的形式出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without long-term monitoring, slab tilt and façade-joint distortion from residual differential shortening are mistaken for workmanship defects and repaired again and again; outrigger forces beyond expectation may surface only years later as loosened connection bolts or cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每年以精密水準量測巨柱與核心在代表樓層的高程差，並讀取應變計與接頭位移計，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較；發展速率異常（例如某支巨柱持續快於其他柱）時，檢查是否有局部超載或材料問題。
knowledge.textEn: Each year measure level differences between mega-columns and core on representative floors by precise levelling and read strain gauges and joint displacement gauges, comparing with the predicted time-dependent curves; if a rate is abnormal, such as one column persistently outpacing the others, check for local overloading or material problems.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件包含鎖定時的實測差異、預測的長期曲線、監測點位置與允收範圍，以及超出範圍時的處理流程；監測至少持續到徐變發展趨緩，並由結構顧問定期審閱。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents include the measured difference at lock-off, the predicted long-term curves, monitoring locations and acceptance ranges, and the procedure when values fall outside them; continue monitoring at least until creep growth levels off, with periodic review by the structural consultant.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems"?
options: 每年以精密水準量測巨柱與核心在代表樓層的高程差，並讀取應變計與接頭位移計，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
外伸臂在模型裡有效，實際上就一定照模型分擔。
optionsEn: Each year measure level differences between mega-columns and core on representative floors by precise levelling and read strain gauges and joint displacement gauges, comparing with the predicted time-dependent curves.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If outriggers work in the model, they must share load exactly as modelled.
quiz.explanation: 每年以精密水準量測巨柱與核心在代表樓層的高程差，並讀取應變計與接頭位移計，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較；發展速率異常（例如某支巨柱持續快於其他柱）時，檢查是否有局部超載或材料問題。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Each year measure level differences between mega-columns and core on representative floors by precise levelling and read strain gauges and joint displacement gauges, comparing with the predicted time-dependent curves; if a rate is abnormal, such as one column persistently outpacing the others, check for local overloading or material problems. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期徐變監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term creep monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沒有長期監測，殘留差異縮短造成的樓板傾斜與帷幕接縫變形會被誤認為施工瑕疵而反覆修補；外伸臂附加力超出預期，也可能在多年後才以接合螺栓鬆動或裂縫的形式出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without long-term monitoring, slab tilt and façade-joint distortion from residual differential shortening are mistaken for workmanship defects and repaired again and again; outrigger forces beyond expectation may surface only years later as loosened connection bolts or cracks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長期監測以應變計、精密水準與接頭位移計追蹤這個過程，並與時間相依分析比較；交接文件要讓營運單位知道哪些數值屬於正常發展、何時需要請結構顧問評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long-term monitoring with strain gauges, precise levelling and joint displacement gauges tracks this process against time-dependent analysis, and handover documents must tell the operator which values are normal development and when to call in the structural consultant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外伸臂鎖定之後，差異縮短的問題就結束了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the outriggers are locked, differential shortening is no longer an issue." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有長期監測，殘留差異縮短造成的樓板傾斜與帷幕接縫變形會被誤認為施工瑕疵而反覆修補；外伸臂附加力超出預期，也可能在多年後才以接合螺栓鬆動或裂縫的形式出現。
knowledge.textEn: Without long-term monitoring, slab tilt and façade-joint distortion from residual differential shortening are mistaken for workmanship defects and repaired again and again; outrigger forces beyond expectation may surface only years later as loosened connection bolts or cracks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外伸臂系統的長期縮短監測與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term shortening monitoring and handover of outrigger systems" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若沒有長期監測，殘留差異縮短造成的樓板傾斜與帷幕接縫變形會被誤認為施工瑕疵而反覆修補；外伸臂附加力超出預期，也可能在多年後才以接合螺栓鬆動或裂縫的形式出現。
外伸臂是把核心「撐住」的水平支撐，與柱子的軸向勁度無關。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without long-term monitoring, slab tilt and façade-joint distortion from residual differential shortening are mistaken for workmanship defects and repaired again and again.
An outrigger is a horizontal prop that braces the core, regardless of column axial stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有長期監測，殘留差異縮短造成的樓板傾斜與帷幕接縫變形會被誤認為施工瑕疵而反覆修補；外伸臂附加力超出預期，也可能在多年後才以接合螺栓鬆動或裂縫的形式出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without long-term monitoring, slab tilt and façade-joint distortion from residual differential shortening are mistaken for workmanship defects and repaired again and again; outrigger forces beyond expectation may surface only years later as loosened connection bolts or cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高層建築斜交網格結構
summary: 以紐約赫斯特大樓、倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號與廣州國際金融中心為例，從斜柱角度如何在剪力與彎曲勁度之間取捨、樓板如何以環向拉力平衡斜柱外推力出發，處理螺栓與焊接節點、鋼管混凝土斜柱，再到斜柱逐層安裝的穩定與測量控制、節點原型試驗、以實測週期驗證勁度，最後是外露斜柱的耐火防蝕與改裝管控。
summaryEn: Using the Hearst Tower in New York, 30 St Mary Axe in London and the Guangzhou International Finance Center as examples, start from how the diagonal angle trades shear against bending stiffness and how floors balance the diagonals' outward thrust with hoop tension, handle bolted and welded nodes and concrete-filled tube diagonals, then the stability and survey control of erecting inclined members, node prototype tests and stiffness verification from measured periods, ending with fire and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals and control of alterations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 斜交網格初步選角練習：某高 180 m、平面 36 m 見方的辦公塔，以 4 層一組的斜交網格抵抗側力，每個面有 n = 6 根斜柱，設計基底剪力 V = 10 MN、均布風載下基底彎矩 M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m。剪力由兩個腹面承擔：斜柱軸力 N_s = V/(2n·cosθ)；彎矩由翼面以力偶承擔：翼面合力 F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN，每根斜柱垂直分量 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN，軸力 N_b = 4.17/sinθ。θ = 69° 時 N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN、N_b ≈ 4.46 MN；θ = 60° 時 N_s ≈ 1.67 MN、N_b ≈ 4.81 MN。以容許應力 207 MPa 估算，69° 時彎曲控制的斜柱需約 21,600 mm²、剪力只需約 11,200 mm²；改為 60° 時彎曲需求增加約 8% 至約 23,200 mm²，剪力需求降為約 8,100 mm²。細長塔由彎曲控制，因此較陡的角度通常較省鋼；若建築改為更矮胖的比例，剪力比重上升，最佳角度就會變平。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Preliminary diagrid angle study: a 180 m office tower, 36 m square, resists lateral load with a four-storey diagrid of n = 6 diagonals per face; the design base shear is V = 10 MN and under uniform wind the base moment is M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m. Shear is carried by the two web faces, giving diagonal force N_s = V/(2n·cosθ); the moment is carried as a couple by the flange faces, with a flange resultant F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN, a vertical component of 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN per diagonal and axial force N_b = 4.17/sinθ. At θ = 69°, N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN and N_b ≈ 4.46 MN; at θ = 60°, N_s ≈ 1.67 MN and N_b ≈ 4.81 MN. At an allowable stress of 207 MPa, the bending-governed diagonal at 69° needs about 21,600 mm² while shear needs only about 11,200 mm²; at 60° the bending demand rises about 8% to about 23,200 mm² and the shear demand falls to about 8,100 mm². A slender tower is governed by bending, so steeper angles usually save steel; a squatter building, with shear more important, would favour a flatter optimum. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」與「斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" and "Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜柱角度」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diagonal angle” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格以外圍的斜柱同時承擔重力與側力，構件主要受軸力而非彎矩，因此用鋼量比一般的柱梁構架少；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜交網格比同規模的傳統設計少用約兩成鋼材。斜柱的角度決定它對兩種勁度的貢獻：抵抗剪力時，較平的斜柱水平分量大；抵抗整體彎曲（傾覆）時，較陡的斜柱垂直分量大。高樓越細長，彎曲越主導，最佳角度就越陡，實務上多落在約 60° 到 75° 之間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜柱角度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid carries gravity and lateral load through perimeter diagonals that act mainly in axial force rather than bending, so it uses less steel than a conventional column-and-beam frame; public sources state that the Hearst Tower diagrid used about 20% less steel than a comparable conventional design. The diagonal angle sets the contribution to two kinds of stiffness: flatter diagonals have more horizontal component to resist shear, while steeper ones have more vertical component to resist overall bending, or overturning. The more slender the tower, the more bending governs and the steeper the optimum angle, typically between about 60° and 75° in practice. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Diagonal angle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單根斜柱在模組高 h 內的勁度：剪力方向 k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ，彎曲（垂直）方向 k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stiffness of one diagonal over a module height h: in shear k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ, and in bending (vertical) k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ. sinθcos²θ peaks at θ ≈ 35.3° (0.385) and is 0.217 at 60° and 0.120 at 69°; sin³θ is 0.650 at 60°, 0.814 at 69° and 0.901 at 75°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜柱角度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Diagonal angle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨
knowledge.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off
knowledge.text: 斜交網格以外圍的斜柱同時承擔重力與側力，構件主要受軸力而非彎矩，因此用鋼量比一般的柱梁構架少；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜交網格比同規模的傳統設計少用約兩成鋼材。斜柱的角度決定它對兩種勁度的貢獻：抵抗剪力時，較平的斜柱水平分量大；抵抗整體彎曲（傾覆）時，較陡的斜柱垂直分量大。
knowledge.textEn: A diagrid carries gravity and lateral load through perimeter diagonals that act mainly in axial force rather than bending, so it uses less steel than a conventional column-and-beam frame; public sources state that the Hearst Tower diagrid used about 20% less steel than a comparable conventional design. The diagonal angle sets the contribution to two kinds of stiffness: flatter diagonals have more horizontal component to resist shear, while steeper ones have more vertical component to resist overall bending, or overturning.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" is correct?
options: 斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。
斜交網格以外圍的斜柱同時承擔重力與側力，構件主要受軸力而非彎矩，因此用鋼量比一般的柱梁構架少；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜交網格比同規模的傳統設計少用約兩成鋼材。
斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。
optionsEn: The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency.
A diagrid carries gravity and lateral load through perimeter diagonals that act mainly in axial force rather than bending, so it uses less steel than a conventional column-and-beam frame.
Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability.
quiz.explanation: 斜交網格以外圍的斜柱同時承擔重力與側力，構件主要受軸力而非彎矩，因此用鋼量比一般的柱梁構架少；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜交網格比同規模的傳統設計少用約兩成鋼材。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A diagrid carries gravity and lateral load through perimeter diagonals that act mainly in axial force rather than bending, so it uses less steel than a conventional column-and-beam frame; public sources state that the Hearst Tower diagrid used about 20% less steel than a comparable conventional design. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜柱角度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diagonal angle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單根斜柱在模組高 h 內的勁度：剪力方向 k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ，彎曲（垂直）方向 k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ。sinθcos²θ 在 θ ≈ 35.3° 時最大（0.385），θ = 60° 時 0.217、69° 時 0.120；sin³θ 在 60° 時 0.650、69° 時 0.814、75° 時 0.901。角度由 60° 變陡到 69°，彎曲勁度增加約 25%，剪力勁度卻減少約 45%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stiffness of one diagonal over a module height h: in shear k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ, and in bending (vertical) k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ. sinθcos²θ peaks at θ ≈ 35.3° (0.385) and is 0.217 at 60° and 0.120 at 69°; sin³θ is 0.650 at 60°, 0.814 at 69° and 0.901 at 75°. Steepening from 60° to 69° raises bending stiffness by about 25% but cuts shear stiffness by about 45%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以初步模型比較數種斜角與模組高度（例如 2、4、6 層一組）的頂部變位、用鋼量與節點數量，並分別輸出剪力變形與彎曲變形的比例，確認選定的角度讓兩者都在合理範圍；同時檢查角度是否與樓層高度、帷幕分割與節點製造相容。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable; check also that the angle suits storey heights, façade panelling and node fabrication.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
