knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單根斜柱在模組高 h 內的勁度：剪力方向 k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ，彎曲（垂直）方向 k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ。sinθcos²θ 在 θ ≈ 35.3° 時最大（0.385），θ = 60° 時 0.217、69° 時 0.120；sin³θ 在 60° 時 0.650、69° 時 0.814、75° 時 0.901。角度由 60° 變陡到 69°，彎曲勁度增加約 25%，剪力勁度卻減少約 45%。
knowledge.textEn: Stiffness of one diagonal over a module height h: in shear k_h = (EA/h)·sinθ·cos²θ, and in bending (vertical) k_v = (EA/h)·sin³θ. sinθcos²θ peaks at θ ≈ 35.3° (0.385) and is 0.217 at 60° and 0.120 at 69°; sin³θ is 0.650 at 60°, 0.814 at 69° and 0.901 at 75°. Steepening from 60° to 69° raises bending stiffness by about 25% but cuts shear stiffness by about 45%.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斜柱角度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diagonal angle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以初步模型比較數種斜角與模組高度（例如 2、4、6 層一組）的頂部變位、用鋼量與節點數量，並分別輸出剪力變形與彎曲變形的比例，確認選定的角度讓兩者都在合理範圍；同時檢查角度是否與樓層高度、帷幕分割與節點製造相容。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare several angles and module heights, for example two, four or six storeys per module, in a preliminary model for top drift, steel tonnage and number of nodes, separating shear and bending deformation to confirm that the chosen angle keeps both reasonable; check also that the angle suits storey heights, façade panelling and node fabrication. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在設計基準書中記錄斜角與模組高度的比選過程與依據，並明列剪力與彎曲變形的分配；建築若要調整模組或斜角，須回到結構顧問重新評估用鋼量與勁度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record the angle and module-height comparison and its rationale in the design basis, stating the split between shear and bending deformation; any architectural change to module or angle must return to the structural consultant to reassess tonnage and stiffness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只追求最少鋼材而選擇過陡的斜柱，剪力勁度不足，樓層間會出現較大的剪切變形，帷幕與隔間受損；角度過平則傾覆勁度不足，頂部擺動與角落斜柱軸力都會偏大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing over-steep diagonals purely for minimum steel leaves too little shear stiffness, producing large inter-storey shear deformation that damages the façade and partitions; too flat an angle leaves too little overturning stiffness, increasing top sway and corner-diagonal forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Axial load paths and the angle trade-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜柱角度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diagonal angle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只追求最少鋼材而選擇過陡的斜柱，剪力勁度不足，樓層間會出現較大的剪切變形，帷幕與隔間受損；角度過平則傾覆勁度不足，頂部擺動與角落斜柱軸力都會偏大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing over-steep diagonals purely for minimum steel leaves too little shear stiffness, producing large inter-storey shear deformation that damages the façade and partitions; too flat an angle leaves too little overturning stiffness, increasing top sway and corner-diagonal forces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高樓越細長，彎曲越主導，最佳角度就越陡，實務上多落在約 60° 到 75° 之間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The more slender the tower, the more bending governs and the steeper the optimum angle, typically between about 60° and 75° in practice.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板環向繫材」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor hoop ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 在斜交網格中，重力沿著傾斜的構件往下傳，兩根斜柱在節點相交時，垂直分量相加傳給下方，水平分量則把節點往外推。這個外推力必須由該層的樓板或周邊環梁以拉力平衡，否則節點會向外移動、整個網格失去形狀。對圓形或曲面平面的建築，例如聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號的全三角化周邊結構，周邊環梁就像箍桶的鐵箍，承受環向拉力；樓板在這些樓層必須連續，不能被大開口切斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板環向繫材」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a diagrid, gravity runs down inclined members; where two diagonals meet at a node their vertical components add and pass down, while their horizontal components push the node outwards. That outward thrust must be balanced in tension by the floor or perimeter ring beam at that level, otherwise the node moves out and the grid loses its shape. For circular or curved plans, such as the fully triangulated perimeter of 30 St Mary Axe, the perimeter ring works like a hoop on a barrel, carrying ring tension; floors at these levels must be continuous and not cut by large openings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Floor hoop ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板環向繫材」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Floor hoop ties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板環向繫材」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor hoop ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。節點重力 P = 10 MN、θ = 69°（tanθ ≈ 2.605），H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN；圓形平面節點間距 s = 6 m 時，環向等效分布外推力 q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m，半徑 R = 25 m 的環向拉力 T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ). With a node gravity load P = 10 MN and θ = 69° (tanθ ≈ 2.605), H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN; on a circular plan with nodes s = 6 m apart the equivalent radial load is q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m, so a ring of radius R = 25 m carries hoop tension T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust; during construction, before slabs are cast, carry the thrust with temporary ties or early steel ring beams and measure node horizontal movement against tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。節點重力 P = 10 MN、θ = 69°（tanθ ≈ 2.605），H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN；圓形平面節點間距 s = 6 m 時，環向等效分布外推力 q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m，半徑 R = 25 m 的環向拉力 T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ). With a node gravity load P = 10 MN and θ = 69° (tanθ ≈ 2.605), H ≈ 10/(2×2.605) ≈ 1.92 MN; on a circular plan with nodes s = 6 m apart the equivalent radial load is q = 1.92/6 ≈ 0.32 MN/m, so a ring of radius R = 25 m carries hoop tension T = q·R ≈ 8.0 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension", which statement holds?
options: 節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。
斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。
有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。
optionsEn: Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ).
Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support.
Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing.
quiz.explanation: 節點外推力 H = P/(2·tanθ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Node outward thrust H = P/(2·tanθ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板環向繫材」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor hoop ties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust; during construction, before slabs are cast, carry the thrust with temporary ties or early steel ring beams and measure node horizontal movement against tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在結構圖上標示所有承受環向拉力的樓層與環梁，並註明「此層樓板不得開設大開口」；臨時繫材的拆除順序列為施工停止點，須在樓板達到設計強度並經結構工程師確認後才可拆除。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark every floor and ring beam carrying hoop tension on the structural drawings with a note that no large openings may be cut in these slabs; make the removal sequence of temporary ties a construction hold point, allowed only after slabs reach design strength and the structural engineer confirms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若節點樓層的樓板被挑空或大開口切斷，環向拉力無法連續傳遞，節點向外移位，斜柱與帷幕的幾何隨之變形；施工期間若在樓板完成前移除臨時繫材，節點可能在自重下外張。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a node floor is cut by an atrium or large opening, hoop tension cannot pass continuously, the nodes move outwards and the geometry of diagonals and façade distorts; removing temporary ties before slabs are complete during construction can let nodes spread under self-weight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。
knowledge.textEn: Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust; during construction, before slabs are cast, carry the thrust with temporary ties or early steel ring beams and measure node horizontal movement against tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在結構圖上標示所有承受環向拉力的樓層與環梁，並註明「此層樓板不得開設大開口」；臨時繫材的拆除順序列為施工停止點，須在樓板達到設計強度並經結構工程師確認後才可拆除。
knowledge.textEn: Mark every floor and ring beam carrying hoop tension on the structural drawings with a note that no large openings may be cut in these slabs; make the removal sequence of temporary ties a construction hold point, allowed only after slabs reach design strength and the structural engineer confirms.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力。
防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust.
A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection.
quiz.explanation: 在結構模型中輸出每個節點樓層的環梁拉力與樓板面內應力，確認樓板與環梁連接能傳遞外推力；施工期間樓板尚未澆置時，以臨時繫材或先行的鋼環梁承擔外推力，並量測節點的水平位移是否在容許範圍內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Output ring-beam tension and in-plane slab stresses at every node level from the structural model and confirm that slab-to-ring connections can transmit the thrust; during construction, before slabs are cast, carry the thrust with temporary ties or early steel ring beams and measure node horizontal movement against tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板環向繫材」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floor hoop ties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若節點樓層的樓板被挑空或大開口切斷，環向拉力無法連續傳遞，節點向外移位，斜柱與帷幕的幾何隨之變形；施工期間若在樓板完成前移除臨時繫材，節點可能在自重下外張。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a node floor is cut by an atrium or large opening, hoop tension cannot pass continuously, the nodes move outwards and the geometry of diagonals and façade distorts; removing temporary ties before slabs are complete during construction can let nodes spread under self-weight. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對圓形或曲面平面的建築，例如聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號的全三角化周邊結構，周邊環梁就像箍桶的鐵箍，承受環向拉力；樓板在這些樓層必須連續，不能被大開口切斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For circular or curved plans, such as the fully triangulated perimeter of 30 St Mary Axe, the perimeter ring works like a hoop on a barrel, carrying ring tension; floors at these levels must be continuous and not cut by large openings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若節點樓層的樓板被挑空或大開口切斷，環向拉力無法連續傳遞，節點向外移位，斜柱與帷幕的幾何隨之變形；施工期間若在樓板完成前移除臨時繫材，節點可能在自重下外張。
knowledge.textEn: If a node floor is cut by an atrium or large opening, hoop tension cannot pass continuously, the nodes move outwards and the geometry of diagonals and façade distorts; removing temporary ties before slabs are complete during construction can let nodes spread under self-weight.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斜柱外推力與樓板環向拉力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Diagonal outward thrust and floor hoop tension" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。
若節點樓層的樓板被挑空或大開口切斷，環向拉力無法連續傳遞，節點向外移位，斜柱與帷幕的幾何隨之變形；施工期間若在樓板完成前移除臨時繫材，節點可能在自重下外張。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter.
If a node floor is cut by an atrium or large opening, hoop tension cannot pass continuously, the nodes move outwards and the geometry of diagonals and façade distorts.

quiz.explanationEn: If a node floor is cut by an atrium or large opening, hoop tension cannot pass continuously, the nodes move outwards and the geometry of diagonals and façade distorts; removing temporary ties before slabs are complete during construction can let nodes spread under self-weight. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜交網格節點的設計與製作」與「鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes" and "Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓與焊接節點」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolted and welded nodes” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 節點是斜交網格中受力最集中、也最昂貴的部分：多根斜柱、環梁與樓板梁在同一點相交，每根構件的軸力方向不同，節點必須把它們平衡並傳給下一層。做法大致分為工廠焊接的鋼板節點、鑄鋼節點，以及工廠預製後在現場以高強度螺栓接合的節點；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜柱在節點處以螺栓而非焊接連接，以加快高空施工並減少現場焊接的品質風險。螺栓節點的關鍵是摩擦面與預拉力，焊接節點的關鍵則是厚板焊接的韌性與殘留應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺栓與焊接節點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nodes are where diagrid forces concentrate and where most of the cost lies: several diagonals, ring beams and floor beams meet at one point, each with axial force in a different direction, and the node must balance them and pass them to the next level. Approaches include shop-welded plate nodes, cast-steel nodes and shop-fabricated nodes joined on site with high-strength bolts; public sources note that the Hearst Tower diagonals are bolted rather than welded at the nodes, speeding erection at height and reducing the quality risk of site welding. For bolted nodes the keys are faying surfaces and pretension; for welded nodes, the toughness and residual stress of thick-plate welds. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolted and welded nodes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺栓與焊接節點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolted and welded nodes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作
knowledge.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes
knowledge.text: 節點是斜交網格中受力最集中、也最昂貴的部分：多根斜柱、環梁與樓板梁在同一點相交，每根構件的軸力方向不同，節點必須把它們平衡並傳給下一層。做法大致分為工廠焊接的鋼板節點、鑄鋼節點，以及工廠預製後在現場以高強度螺栓接合的節點；公開資料指出赫斯特大樓的斜柱在節點處以螺栓而非焊接連接，以加快高空施工並減少現場焊接的品質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Nodes are where diagrid forces concentrate and where most of the cost lies: several diagonals, ring beams and floor beams meet at one point, each with axial force in a different direction, and the node must balance them and pass them to the next level. Approaches include shop-welded plate nodes, cast-steel nodes and shop-fabricated nodes joined on site with high-strength bolts; public sources note that the Hearst Tower diagonals are bolted rather than welded at the nodes, speeding erection at height and reducing the quality risk of site welding.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜交網格節點的設計與製作」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes" is correct?
options: 節點是斜交網格中受力最集中、也最昂貴的部分：多根斜柱、環梁與樓板梁在同一點相交，每根構件的軸力方向不同，節點必須把它們平衡並傳給下一層。
斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。
鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。
optionsEn: Nodes are where diagrid forces concentrate and where most of the cost lies: several diagonals, ring beams and floor beams meet at one point, each with axial force in a different direction, and the node must balance them and pass them to the next level.
Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter.
A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection.
quiz.explanation: 節點是斜交網格中受力最集中、也最昂貴的部分：多根斜柱、環梁與樓板梁在同一點相交，每根構件的軸力方向不同，節點必須把它們平衡並傳給下一層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nodes are where diagrid forces concentrate and where most of the cost lies: several diagonals, ring beams and floor beams meet at one point, each with axial force in a different direction, and the node must balance them and pass them to the next level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓與焊接節點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolted and welded nodes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。M30、10.9 級：F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN；μ = 0.5、雙剪 n = 2、k_s = 1、γ = 1.25，F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN；斜柱軸力 12 MN 需 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2，取 40 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ. For M30 grade 10.9, F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN; with μ = 0.5, two slip planes n = 2, k_s = 1 and γ = 1.25, F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN, so a 12 MN diagonal force needs 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2, rounded up to 40 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）；焊接或鑄鋼節點則以有限元素分析求熱點應力，厚板焊接做超音波檢測，鑄鋼件做超音波與磁粒檢測並核對材料韌性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked; for welded or cast nodes obtain hot-spot stresses by finite-element analysis, ultrasonically test thick-plate welds, and test castings ultrasonically and by magnetic particle inspection while checking material toughness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ. For M30 grade 10.9, F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN; with μ = 0.5, two slip planes n = 2, k_s = 1 and γ = 1.25, F_s ≈ 1×2×0.5×392.7/1.25 ≈ 314 kN, so a 12 MN diagonal force needs 12,000/314 ≈ 38.2, rounded up to 40 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜交網格節點的設計與製作」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes", which statement holds?
options: 只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。
摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。
週期量測只是學術研究，對結構驗收沒有意義。
optionsEn: If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site.
Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ.
Period measurement is merely academic and means nothing for structural acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦型螺栓抗滑 F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Slip resistance of a preloaded bolt F_s = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓與焊接節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolted and welded nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）；焊接或鑄鋼節點則以有限元素分析求熱點應力，厚板焊接做超音波檢測，鑄鋼件做超音波與磁粒檢測並核對材料韌性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked; for welded or cast nodes obtain hot-spot stresses by finite-element analysis, ultrasonically test thick-plate welds, and test castings ultrasonically and by magnetic particle inspection while checking material toughness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：節點製造前做試作件並經設計者確認；螺栓節點的摩擦面保護、預拉力施作與檢驗列入檢驗計畫，焊接節點的焊接程序、預熱與檢測比例明列；每個節點以編號追蹤製造、檢驗與安裝紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make trial nodes for the designer's approval before production; put faying-surface protection, pretensioning and inspection of bolted nodes into the inspection plan, specify welding procedures, preheat and inspection rates for welded nodes, and track every node by number through fabrication, inspection and installation records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：摩擦面若被油漆或油污污染，抗滑係數下降，節點在風的反覆作用下滑動，造成螺栓承壓與孔壁磨損；厚板焊接節點若有未熔合或層狀撕裂，可能在地震或疲勞作用下由節點內部開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Faying surfaces contaminated with paint or oil lose slip coefficient, so nodes slip under repeated wind loading, putting bolts into bearing and wearing hole walls; thick-plate welded nodes with lack of fusion or lamellar tearing can crack from inside under earthquake or fatigue loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）；焊接或鑄鋼節點則以有限元素分析求熱點應力，厚板焊接做超音波檢測，鑄鋼件做超音波與磁粒檢測並核對材料韌性。
knowledge.textEn: For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked; for welded or cast nodes obtain hot-spot stresses by finite-element analysis, ultrasonically test thick-plate welds, and test castings ultrasonically and by magnetic particle inspection while checking material toughness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 節點製造前做試作件並經設計者確認；螺栓節點的摩擦面保護、預拉力施作與檢驗列入檢驗計畫，焊接節點的焊接程序、預熱與檢測比例明列；每個節點以編號追蹤製造、檢驗與安裝紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Make trial nodes for the designer's approval before production; put faying-surface protection, pretensioning and inspection of bolted nodes into the inspection plan, specify welding procedures, preheat and inspection rates for welded nodes, and track every node by number through fabrication, inspection and installation records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜交網格節點的設計與製作」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
斜交網格的樓板只是一般樓板，租戶可以自由開孔。
螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Diagrid floors are ordinary slabs that tenants may cut freely.
For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked.
quiz.explanation: 螺栓節點須確認摩擦面處理與抗滑係數試驗、螺栓預拉力（以扭矩或轉角法施工並抽驗）；焊接或鑄鋼節點則以有限元素分析求熱點應力，厚板焊接做超音波檢測，鑄鋼件做超音波與磁粒檢測並核對材料韌性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For bolted nodes confirm faying-surface preparation with slip-coefficient tests and bolt pretension, installed by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-checked; for welded or cast nodes obtain hot-spot stresses by finite-element analysis, ultrasonically test thick-plate welds, and test castings ultrasonically and by magnetic particle inspection while checking material toughness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜交網格節點的設計與製作：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺栓與焊接節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolted and welded nodes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 摩擦面若被油漆或油污污染，抗滑係數下降，節點在風的反覆作用下滑動，造成螺栓承壓與孔壁磨損；厚板焊接節點若有未熔合或層狀撕裂，可能在地震或疲勞作用下由節點內部開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Faying surfaces contaminated with paint or oil lose slip coefficient, so nodes slip under repeated wind loading, putting bolts into bearing and wearing hole walls; thick-plate welded nodes with lack of fusion or lamellar tearing can crack from inside under earthquake or fatigue loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：螺栓節點的關鍵是摩擦面與預拉力，焊接節點的關鍵則是厚板焊接的韌性與殘留應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For bolted nodes the keys are faying surfaces and pretension; for welded nodes, the toughness and residual stress of thick-plate welds.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜交網格的節點只要比構件強就好，細部不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diagrid nodes only need to be stronger than the members; details do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 摩擦面若被油漆或油污污染，抗滑係數下降，節點在風的反覆作用下滑動，造成螺栓承壓與孔壁磨損；厚板焊接節點若有未熔合或層狀撕裂，可能在地震或疲勞作用下由節點內部開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Faying surfaces contaminated with paint or oil lose slip coefficient, so nodes slip under repeated wind loading, putting bolts into bearing and wearing hole walls; thick-plate welded nodes with lack of fusion or lamellar tearing can crack from inside under earthquake or fatigue loading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斜交網格節點的設計與製作」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Design and fabrication of diagrid nodes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 摩擦面若被油漆或油污污染，抗滑係數下降，節點在風的反覆作用下滑動，造成螺栓承壓與孔壁磨損。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。
optionsEn: Faying surfaces contaminated with paint or oil lose slip coefficient, so nodes slip under repeated wind loading, putting bolts into bearing and wearing hole walls.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection.

quiz.explanationEn: Faying surfaces contaminated with paint or oil lose slip coefficient, so nodes slip under repeated wind loading, putting bolts into bearing and wearing hole walls; thick-plate welded nodes with lack of fusion or lamellar tearing can crack from inside under earthquake or fatigue loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼管混凝土斜柱」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete-filled tube diagonals” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層斜交網格的斜柱軸力極大，廣州國際金融中心採用鋼管混凝土斜柱，直徑由底部約 1,800 mm 漸減到頂部約 900 mm，網格每 12 層形成高約 54 m 的菱形節點，並與核心筒組成筒中筒。管內混凝土大幅提高軸向勁度與受壓容量，並抑制鋼管向內挫屈；混凝土的熱容量也延緩鋼管升溫，但公開資料指出主要構材仍另外施作兩小時的防火被覆。斜放的鋼管讓混凝土澆置與排氣比垂直柱更困難。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼管混凝土斜柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diagrid diagonals in a supertall tower carry huge axial forces; the Guangzhou International Finance Center uses concrete-filled steel tube diagonals that taper from about 1,800 mm in diameter at the base to about 900 mm at the top, with the grid forming nodes every 12 storeys in diamonds about 54 m tall, combined with the core as a tube-in-tube. The concrete fill greatly raises axial stiffness and compressive capacity and prevents the tube buckling inwards; its thermal mass also slows heating of the steel, though public sources note that two-hour fire protection was still applied to the primary structure. Inclined tubes make concrete placement and venting harder than in vertical columns. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete-filled tube diagonals” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：合成軸向勁度 EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Composite axial stiffness EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼管混凝土斜柱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete-filled tube diagonals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火
knowledge.titleEn: Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire
knowledge.text: 超高層斜交網格的斜柱軸力極大，廣州國際金融中心採用鋼管混凝土斜柱，直徑由底部約 1,800 mm 漸減到頂部約 900 mm，網格每 12 層形成高約 54 m 的菱形節點，並與核心筒組成筒中筒。管內混凝土大幅提高軸向勁度與受壓容量，並抑制鋼管向內挫屈；混凝土的熱容量也延緩鋼管升溫，但公開資料指出主要構材仍另外施作兩小時的防火被覆。
knowledge.textEn: Diagrid diagonals in a supertall tower carry huge axial forces; the Guangzhou International Finance Center uses concrete-filled steel tube diagonals that taper from about 1,800 mm in diameter at the base to about 900 mm at the top, with the grid forming nodes every 12 storeys in diamonds about 54 m tall, combined with the core as a tube-in-tube. The concrete fill greatly raises axial stiffness and compressive capacity and prevents the tube buckling inwards; its thermal mass also slows heating of the steel, though public sources note that two-hour fire protection was still applied to the primary structure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire" is correct?
options: 鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。
超高層斜交網格的斜柱軸力極大，廣州國際金融中心採用鋼管混凝土斜柱，直徑由底部約 1,800 mm 漸減到頂部約 900 mm，網格每 12 層形成高約 54 m 的菱形節點，並與核心筒組成筒中筒。
斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。
optionsEn: A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection.
Diagrid diagonals in a supertall tower carry huge axial forces.
Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support.
quiz.explanation: 超高層斜交網格的斜柱軸力極大，廣州國際金融中心採用鋼管混凝土斜柱，直徑由底部約 1,800 mm 漸減到頂部約 900 mm，網格每 12 層形成高約 54 m 的菱形節點，並與核心筒組成筒中筒。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diagrid diagonals in a supertall tower carry huge axial forces; the Guangzhou International Finance Center uses concrete-filled steel tube diagonals that taper from about 1,800 mm in diameter at the base to about 900 mm at the top, with the grid forming nodes every 12 storeys in diamonds about 54 m tall, combined with the core as a tube-in-tube. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼管混凝土斜柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete-filled tube diagonals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：合成軸向勁度 EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c。D = 1.8 m、t = 50 mm：A_s = π×1.75×0.05 ≈ 0.275 m²、A_c = π×1.7²/4 ≈ 2.27 m²；E_s = 200 GPa、E_c = 38 GPa，EA ≈ 55.0×10⁹ + 86.3×10⁹ ≈ 141×10⁹ N，混凝土提供約 61% 的軸向勁度，總勁度約為空鋼管的 2.6 倍。厚度與模數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Composite axial stiffness EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c. For D = 1.8 m and t = 50 mm, A_s = π×1.75×0.05 ≈ 0.275 m² and A_c = π×1.7²/4 ≈ 2.27 m²; with E_s = 200 GPa and E_c = 38 GPa, EA ≈ 55.0×10⁹ + 86.3×10⁹ ≈ 141×10⁹ N, so the concrete supplies about 61% of the axial stiffness and the total is about 2.6 times that of the empty tube. Thickness and moduli are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：斜管澆置前以足尺斜置模型試灌，切開檢查管頂與節點附近的空洞，確定澆置孔、排氣孔與自充填配比；正式施工以敲擊或超音波抽查，並記錄每段的澆置量與理論體積比對；防火被覆以厚度量測與附著試驗驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before production, cast a full-scale inclined mock-up and cut it open to check voids along the crown and near nodes, fixing placement holes, vent holes and the self-consolidating mix; during construction spot-check by tapping or ultrasonic testing and compare each segment's placed volume with the theoretical volume; accept fire protection by thickness measurement and adhesion tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 合成軸向勁度 EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c。D = 1.8 m、t = 50 mm：A_s = π×1.75×0.05 ≈ 0.275 m²、A_c = π×1.7²/4 ≈ 2.27 m²；E_s = 200 GPa、E_c = 38 GPa，EA ≈ 55.0×10⁹ + 86.3×10⁹ ≈ 141×10⁹ N，混凝土提供約 61% 的軸向勁度，總勁度約為空鋼管的 2.6 倍。厚度與模數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Composite axial stiffness EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c. For D = 1.8 m and t = 50 mm, A_s = π×1.75×0.05 ≈ 0.275 m² and A_c = π×1.7²/4 ≈ 2.27 m²; with E_s = 200 GPa and E_c = 38 GPa, EA ≈ 55.0×10⁹ + 86.3×10⁹ ≈ 141×10⁹ N, so the concrete supplies about 61% of the axial stiffness and the total is about 2.6 times that of the empty tube. Thickness and moduli are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire", which statement holds?
options: 有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。
防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。
合成軸向勁度 EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c。
optionsEn: Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing.
A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection.
Composite axial stiffness EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c.
quiz.explanation: 合成軸向勁度 EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Composite axial stiffness EA = E_s·A_s + E_c·A_c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼管混凝土斜柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete-filled tube diagonals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 斜管澆置前以足尺斜置模型試灌，切開檢查管頂與節點附近的空洞，確定澆置孔、排氣孔與自充填配比；正式施工以敲擊或超音波抽查，並記錄每段的澆置量與理論體積比對；防火被覆以厚度量測與附著試驗驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before production, cast a full-scale inclined mock-up and cut it open to check voids along the crown and near nodes, fixing placement holes, vent holes and the self-consolidating mix; during construction spot-check by tapping or ultrasonic testing and compare each segment's placed volume with the theoretical volume; accept fire protection by thickness measurement and adhesion tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜管的澆置方向、排氣孔位置與澆置速度寫入施工計畫，每段設「模型試灌合格」與「前段檢測完成」兩個停止點；防火被覆的耐火時效依整體防火策略決定，不以填充混凝土替代，並由防火與結構工程師共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write placement direction, vent-hole positions and placement rate for inclined tubes into the construction plan, with two hold points per segment, mock-up approval and completion of checks on the previous segment; set fire-protection ratings from the overall fire strategy rather than relying on the fill, signed jointly by the fire and structural engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降；若以為混凝土填充已足夠防火而省略被覆，火災中鋼管升溫失去強度，斜柱軸力轉移到相鄰構件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inclined tubes collect air and bleed water along the upper side, forming long voids that reduce composite stiffness and the restraint against tube buckling; omitting fire protection on the belief that the fill is enough lets the tube heat up and lose strength in a fire, shifting diagonal force to neighbouring members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 斜管澆置前以足尺斜置模型試灌，切開檢查管頂與節點附近的空洞，確定澆置孔、排氣孔與自充填配比；正式施工以敲擊或超音波抽查，並記錄每段的澆置量與理論體積比對；防火被覆以厚度量測與附著試驗驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Before production, cast a full-scale inclined mock-up and cut it open to check voids along the crown and near nodes, fixing placement holes, vent holes and the self-consolidating mix; during construction spot-check by tapping or ultrasonic testing and compare each segment's placed volume with the theoretical volume; accept fire protection by thickness measurement and adhesion tests.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斜管的澆置方向、排氣孔位置與澆置速度寫入施工計畫，每段設「模型試灌合格」與「前段檢測完成」兩個停止點；防火被覆的耐火時效依整體防火策略決定，不以填充混凝土替代，並由防火與結構工程師共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Write placement direction, vent-hole positions and placement rate for inclined tubes into the construction plan, with two hold points per segment, mock-up approval and completion of checks on the previous segment; set fire-protection ratings from the overall fire strategy rather than relying on the fill, signed jointly by the fire and structural engineers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire"?
options: 斜管澆置前以足尺斜置模型試灌，切開檢查管頂與節點附近的空洞，確定澆置孔、排氣孔與自充填配比。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
斜交網格的角度只是建築造型的選擇，對結構效率沒有影響。
optionsEn: Before production, cast a full-scale inclined mock-up and cut it open to check voids along the crown and near nodes, fixing placement holes, vent holes and the self-consolidating mix.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The diagrid angle is purely an aesthetic choice with no effect on structural efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 斜管澆置前以足尺斜置模型試灌，切開檢查管頂與節點附近的空洞，確定澆置孔、排氣孔與自充填配比；正式施工以敲擊或超音波抽查，並記錄每段的澆置量與理論體積比對；防火被覆以厚度量測與附著試驗驗收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before production, cast a full-scale inclined mock-up and cut it open to check voids along the crown and near nodes, fixing placement holes, vent holes and the self-consolidating mix; during construction spot-check by tapping or ultrasonic testing and compare each segment's placed volume with the theoretical volume; accept fire protection by thickness measurement and adhesion tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼管混凝土斜柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete-filled tube diagonals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降；若以為混凝土填充已足夠防火而省略被覆，火災中鋼管升溫失去強度，斜柱軸力轉移到相鄰構件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inclined tubes collect air and bleed water along the upper side, forming long voids that reduce composite stiffness and the restraint against tube buckling; omitting fire protection on the belief that the fill is enough lets the tube heat up and lose strength in a fire, shifting diagonal force to neighbouring members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斜放的鋼管讓混凝土澆置與排氣比垂直柱更困難。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inclined tubes make concrete placement and venting harder than in vertical columns.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降；若以為混凝土填充已足夠防火而省略被覆，火災中鋼管升溫失去強度，斜柱軸力轉移到相鄰構件。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼管混凝土斜柱的勁度與耐火」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete-filled diagonals for stiffness and fire" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降。
斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Inclined tubes collect air and bleed water along the upper side, forming long voids that reduce composite stiffness and the restraint against tube buckling.
Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support.
quiz.explanation: 斜置鋼管的頂側容易積存空氣與泌水，形成長條狀空洞，該段的合成勁度與鋼管的挫屈約束都下降；若以為混凝土填充已足夠防火而省略被覆，火災中鋼管升溫失去強度，斜柱軸力轉移到相鄰構件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inclined tubes collect air and bleed water along the upper side, forming long voids that reduce composite stiffness and the restraint against tube buckling; omitting fire protection on the belief that the fill is enough lets the tube heat up and lose strength in a fire, shifting diagonal force to neighbouring members. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」與「斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members" and "Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary support of inclined members” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格只有在三角形閉合後才穩定；安裝過程中，一根剛吊上的斜柱只有下端接合，另一端懸空，自重就會讓它傾倒並在下端接合產生彎矩。施工時必須以臨時支撐、纜索或先行安裝的環梁把斜柱拉住，直到相鄰斜柱與環梁組成閉合三角形。安裝順序要讓每一個階段的未完成網格都是穩定的，並考慮施工期間的風力與吊裝碰撞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid is stable only once its triangles close; during erection a freshly lifted diagonal is joined only at its lower end with the other end free, and its own weight tends to tip it over, inducing moment in the lower connection. Temporary struts, cables or ring beams installed in advance must hold the diagonal until neighbouring diagonals and ring beams form a closed triangle. The erection sequence must keep every incomplete stage of the grid stable, allowing for construction wind and lifting impacts. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary support of inclined members” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary support of inclined members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members" is correct?
options: 斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。
只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。
斜交網格只有在三角形閉合後才穩定；安裝過程中，一根剛吊上的斜柱只有下端接合，另一端懸空，自重就會讓它傾倒並在下端接合產生彎矩。
optionsEn: Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support.
If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site.
A diagrid is stable only once its triangles close.
quiz.explanation: 斜交網格只有在三角形閉合後才穩定；安裝過程中，一根剛吊上的斜柱只有下端接合，另一端懸空，自重就會讓它傾倒並在下端接合產生彎矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A diagrid is stable only once its triangles close; during erection a freshly lifted diagonal is joined only at its lower end with the other end free, and its own weight tends to tip it over, inducing moment in the lower connection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary support of inclined members” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。重 15 t（W ≈ 147 kN）、長 L = 17 m、θ = 69°：M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m；若以上端的臨時水平支撐抵抗，支撐力 R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN，另加施工風力與吊裝衝擊係數。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ. For a 15 t member (W ≈ 147 kN), L = 17 m and θ = 69°, M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m; resisted by a temporary horizontal brace at the top, the brace force is R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN, plus construction wind and a lifting-impact factor. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析檢查每個安裝步驟中未完成網格的穩定性與臨時支撐受力，臨時支撐與其錨定點須有計算書；每根斜柱就位後量測上端座標，確認在容許偏差內才可鬆鉤，閉合三角形後才可拆除臨時支撐。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the stability of the incomplete grid and the temporary-support forces at every erection step with a construction-stage analysis, backed by calculations for each support and its anchorage; measure the top coordinates of every diagonal after placement and release the hook only when within tolerance, removing temporary supports only after the triangle closes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。重 15 t（W ≈ 147 kN）、長 L = 17 m、θ = 69°：M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m；若以上端的臨時水平支撐抵抗，支撐力 R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN，另加施工風力與吊裝衝擊係數。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ. For a 15 t member (W ≈ 147 kN), L = 17 m and θ = 69°, M ≈ 147×8.5×0.358 ≈ 448 kN·m; resisted by a temporary horizontal brace at the top, the brace force is R = M/(L·sinθ) ≈ 448/(17×0.934) ≈ 28 kN, plus construction wind and a lifting-impact factor. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members", which statement holds?
options: 單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。
週期量測只是學術研究，對結構驗收沒有意義。
斜交網格的樓板只是一般樓板，租戶可以自由開孔。
optionsEn: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ.
Period measurement is merely academic and means nothing for structural acceptance.
Diagrid floors are ordinary slabs that tenants may cut freely.
quiz.explanation: 單根斜柱的傾倒彎矩 M = W·(L/2)·cosθ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tipping moment of a single diagonal M = W·(L/2)·cosθ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary support of inclined members” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析檢查每個安裝步驟中未完成網格的穩定性與臨時支撐受力，臨時支撐與其錨定點須有計算書；每根斜柱就位後量測上端座標，確認在容許偏差內才可鬆鉤，閉合三角形後才可拆除臨時支撐。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the stability of the incomplete grid and the temporary-support forces at every erection step with a construction-stage analysis, backed by calculations for each support and its anchorage; measure the top coordinates of every diagonal after placement and release the hook only when within tolerance, removing temporary supports only after the triangle closes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫要列出每一根斜柱的安裝順序、臨時支撐位置與鬆鉤條件，並規定風速上限；每一個閉合單元完成前設停止點，由鋼構工程師確認臨時支撐與座標後才可安裝下一根。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan lists the installation order of every diagonal, temporary-support positions, hook-release conditions and the wind-speed limit; set a hold point before each closed unit is completed, at which the steel engineer confirms supports and coordinates before the next member goes in.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在臨時支撐未就位前鬆鉤，斜柱可能傾倒並撞擊下方構件與人員；臨時支撐若錨定在未達強度的樓板或尚未鎖緊的構件上，強風時整片未完成網格可能變形甚至倒塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Releasing the hook before temporary supports are in place can let a diagonal topple onto members and workers below; supports anchored to under-strength slabs or not-yet-tightened members can let a whole incomplete section of grid distort or collapse in strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析檢查每個安裝步驟中未完成網格的穩定性與臨時支撐受力，臨時支撐與其錨定點須有計算書；每根斜柱就位後量測上端座標，確認在容許偏差內才可鬆鉤，閉合三角形後才可拆除臨時支撐。
knowledge.textEn: Check the stability of the incomplete grid and the temporary-support forces at every erection step with a construction-stage analysis, backed by calculations for each support and its anchorage; measure the top coordinates of every diagonal after placement and release the hook only when within tolerance, removing temporary supports only after the triangle closes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫要列出每一根斜柱的安裝順序、臨時支撐位置與鬆鉤條件，並規定風速上限；每一個閉合單元完成前設停止點，由鋼構工程師確認臨時支撐與座標後才可安裝下一根。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan lists the installation order of every diagonal, temporary-support positions, hook-release conditions and the wind-speed limit; set a hold point before each closed unit is completed, at which the steel engineer confirms supports and coordinates before the next member goes in.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以施工階段分析檢查每個安裝步驟中未完成網格的穩定性與臨時支撐受力，臨時支撐與其錨定點須有計算書。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check the stability of the incomplete grid and the temporary-support forces at every erection step with a construction-stage analysis, backed by calculations for each support and its anchorage.
Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability.

quiz.explanationEn: Check the stability of the incomplete grid and the temporary-support forces at every erection step with a construction-stage analysis, backed by calculations for each support and its anchorage; measure the top coordinates of every diagonal after placement and release the hook only when within tolerance, removing temporary supports only after the triangle closes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜柱安裝的臨時支撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary support of inclined members” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在臨時支撐未就位前鬆鉤，斜柱可能傾倒並撞擊下方構件與人員；臨時支撐若錨定在未達強度的樓板或尚未鎖緊的構件上，強風時整片未完成網格可能變形甚至倒塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Releasing the hook before temporary supports are in place can let a diagonal topple onto members and workers below; supports anchored to under-strength slabs or not-yet-tightened members can let a whole incomplete section of grid distort or collapse in strong wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安裝順序要讓每一個階段的未完成網格都是穩定的，並考慮施工期間的風力與吊裝碰撞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The erection sequence must keep every incomplete stage of the grid stable, allowing for construction wind and lifting impacts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜柱是斜的，所以會自己靠在結構上，不需要臨時支撐。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diagonals lean, so they rest against the structure on their own and need no temporary support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在臨時支撐未就位前鬆鉤，斜柱可能傾倒並撞擊下方構件與人員；臨時支撐若錨定在未達強度的樓板或尚未鎖緊的構件上，強風時整片未完成網格可能變形甚至倒塌。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斜柱逐段安裝的穩定與臨時支撐」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stability and temporary support while erecting inclined members" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。
若在臨時支撐未就位前鬆鉤，斜柱可能傾倒並撞擊下方構件與人員；臨時支撐若錨定在未達強度的樓板或尚未鎖緊的構件上，強風時整片未完成網格可能變形甚至倒塌。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site.
Releasing the hook before temporary supports are in place can let a diagonal topple onto members and workers below.
quiz.explanation: 若在臨時支撐未就位前鬆鉤，斜柱可能傾倒並撞擊下方構件與人員；臨時支撐若錨定在未達強度的樓板或尚未鎖緊的構件上，強風時整片未完成網格可能變形甚至倒塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Releasing the hook before temporary supports are in place can let a diagonal topple onto members and workers below; supports anchored to under-strength slabs or not-yet-tightened members can let a whole incomplete section of grid distort or collapse in strong wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節點座標與累積誤差」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Node coordinates and accumulated error” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格的幾何由節點座標決定，帷幕單元、樓板邊緣與環梁長度都依節點位置預先製造；一旦節點位置偏差累積，上方的斜柱長度與角度就無法吻合。與垂直柱不同，斜柱的長度誤差會同時造成水平與垂直偏移，而且相鄰節點的偏差會互相牽動。測量控制必須分辨隨機誤差（各節點獨立）與系統誤差（如測量基準偏移、溫度或焊接收縮造成的同方向偏差），後者會線性累積，是最危險的。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節點座標與累積誤差」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid's geometry is set by its node coordinates, and façade units, slab edges and ring-beam lengths are fabricated in advance from those positions; once node deviations accumulate, the lengths and angles of diagonals above no longer fit. Unlike vertical columns, a length error in a diagonal produces both horizontal and vertical offsets, and deviations at adjacent nodes interact. Survey control must distinguish random errors, independent at each node, from systematic errors, such as datum drift or same-direction offsets from temperature or weld shrinkage; the latter accumulate linearly and are the most dangerous. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Node coordinates and accumulated error” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：誤差累積：每一模組節點的隨機誤差 σ = 3 mm、共 8 個模組時，總誤差約 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm；若同樣 3 mm 是系統性偏差，總誤差為 3×8 = 24 mm，接近三倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Error accumulation: with a random node error σ = 3 mm per module over 8 modules, the total is about 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm; if the same 3 mm is systematic, the total is 3×8 = 24 mm, nearly three times as much.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節點座標與累積誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Node coordinates and accumulated error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：誤差累積：每一模組節點的隨機誤差 σ = 3 mm、共 8 個模組時，總誤差約 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm；若同樣 3 mm 是系統性偏差，總誤差為 3×8 = 24 mm，接近三倍。因此每一模組都要回到固定基準重新定位，而不是以前一層為基準往上累加。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Error accumulation: with a random node error σ = 3 mm per module over 8 modules, the total is about 3×√8 ≈ 8.5 mm; if the same 3 mm is systematic, the total is 3×8 = 24 mm, nearly three times as much. Every module must therefore be set out again from fixed datums rather than built up from the level below. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立獨立於結構的控制網，每一模組完成後以全測站量測所有節點座標，並在溫度均勻的時段量測；把實測座標與考慮自重、溫度與焊接收縮的預測座標比較，偏差趨勢呈同方向時立即檢討原因並調整上方構件的製造尺寸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish a control network independent of the structure, survey every node with a total station after each module in thermally uniform conditions, and compare measured coordinates with those predicted including self-weight, temperature and weld shrinkage; when deviations trend in one direction, investigate at once and adjust the fabrication dimensions of members above.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Every module must therefore be set out again from fixed datums rather than built up from the level below. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節點座標與累積誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Node coordinates and accumulated error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立獨立於結構的控制網，每一模組完成後以全測站量測所有節點座標，並在溫度均勻的時段量測；把實測座標與考慮自重、溫度與焊接收縮的預測座標比較，偏差趨勢呈同方向時立即檢討原因並調整上方構件的製造尺寸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish a control network independent of the structure, survey every node with a total station after each module in thermally uniform conditions, and compare measured coordinates with those predicted including self-weight, temperature and weld shrinkage; when deviations trend in one direction, investigate at once and adjust the fabrication dimensions of members above. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：測量計畫規定固定基準點、量測時段、各模組的容許偏差與趨勢判斷規則；量測結果即時回饋給鋼構製造廠與帷幕廠，作為後續構件尺寸調整的依據，修正量由結構工程師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The survey plan fixes datum points, measurement windows, module tolerances and trend rules; feed results back immediately to the steel fabricator and façade supplier as the basis for adjusting later member sizes, with corrections approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若每層都以下層節點為基準往上放樣，系統誤差會一路累積，到上部時預製的帷幕單元與斜柱無法安裝，只能現場修改或重新製造；節點間距誤差也會使環梁拉力分布不均。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting out each level from the nodes below lets systematic error accumulate upwards until prefabricated façade units and diagonals no longer fit, forcing site modification or refabrication; errors in node spacing also make ring-beam tension uneven. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanationEn: Establish a control network independent of the structure, survey every node with a total station after each module in thermally uniform conditions, and compare measured coordinates with those predicted including self-weight, temperature and weld shrinkage; when deviations trend in one direction, investigate at once and adjust the fabrication dimensions of members above. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節點座標與累積誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Node coordinates and accumulated error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若每層都以下層節點為基準往上放樣，系統誤差會一路累積，到上部時預製的帷幕單元與斜柱無法安裝，只能現場修改或重新製造；節點間距誤差也會使環梁拉力分布不均。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting out each level from the nodes below lets systematic error accumulate upwards until prefabricated façade units and diagonals no longer fit, forcing site modification or refabrication; errors in node spacing also make ring-beam tension uneven. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：測量控制必須分辨隨機誤差（各節點獨立）與系統誤差（如測量基準偏移、溫度或焊接收縮造成的同方向偏差），後者會線性累積，是最危險的。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Survey control must distinguish random errors, independent at each node, from systematic errors, such as datum drift or same-direction offsets from temperature or weld shrinkage; the latter accumulate linearly and are the most dangerous.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斜交網格的測量控制與誤差累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Survey control and error accumulation in a diagrid" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若每層都以下層節點為基準往上放樣，系統誤差會一路累積，到上部時預製的帷幕單元與斜柱無法安裝，只能現場修改或重新製造；節點間距誤差也會使環梁拉力分布不均。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
