As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing.
quiz.explanation: 若每層都以下層節點為基準往上放樣，系統誤差會一路累積，到上部時預製的帷幕單元與斜柱無法安裝，只能現場修改或重新製造；節點間距誤差也會使環梁拉力分布不均。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting out each level from the nodes below lets systematic error accumulate upwards until prefabricated façade units and diagonals no longer fit, forcing site modification or refabrication; errors in node spacing also make ring-beam tension uneven. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」與「以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" and "Verifying diagrid stiffness from ambient vibration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節點足尺試驗」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-scale node tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格節點的幾何複雜，多向受力下的應力集中與塑性發展很難只靠計算確定，因此重要專案常以足尺或大比例原型試驗驗證。試驗以多支油壓千斤頂模擬各斜柱的軸力比例，在設計載重的倍數下量測熱點應變、變形與破壞模式，確認節點強度高於相連構件，並驗證有限元素模型的應力集中係數。試驗結果也用來決定生產節點的檢驗重點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節點足尺試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diagrid nodes are geometrically complex, and stress concentration and plastic development under multi-directional loads are hard to establish by calculation alone, so major projects often verify them with full-scale or large-scale prototype tests. Several hydraulic jacks reproduce the proportions of the diagonal forces, and hot-spot strains, deformations and failure modes are measured at multiples of the design load to confirm that the node is stronger than the connected members and to validate the stress concentration factors of the finite-element model. The results also set the inspection focus for production nodes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full-scale node tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節點足尺試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full-scale node tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks
knowledge.text: 斜交網格節點的幾何複雜，多向受力下的應力集中與塑性發展很難只靠計算確定，因此重要專案常以足尺或大比例原型試驗驗證。試驗以多支油壓千斤頂模擬各斜柱的軸力比例，在設計載重的倍數下量測熱點應變、變形與破壞模式，確認節點強度高於相連構件，並驗證有限元素模型的應力集中係數。
knowledge.textEn: Diagrid nodes are geometrically complex, and stress concentration and plastic development under multi-directional loads are hard to establish by calculation alone, so major projects often verify them with full-scale or large-scale prototype tests. Several hydraulic jacks reproduce the proportions of the diagonal forces, and hot-spot strains, deformations and failure modes are measured at multiples of the design load to confirm that the node is stronger than the connected members and to validate the stress concentration factors of the finite-element model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" is correct?
options: 有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。
斜交網格節點的幾何複雜，多向受力下的應力集中與塑性發展很難只靠計算確定，因此重要專案常以足尺或大比例原型試驗驗證。
週期量測只是學術研究，對結構驗收沒有意義。
optionsEn: Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing.

Diagrid nodes are geometrically complex, and stress concentration and plastic development under multi-directional loads are hard to establish by calculation alone, so major projects often verify them with full-scale or large-scale prototype tests.
Period measurement is merely academic and means nothing for structural acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 斜交網格節點的幾何複雜，多向受力下的應力集中與塑性發展很難只靠計算確定，因此重要專案常以足尺或大比例原型試驗驗證。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diagrid nodes are geometrically complex, and stress concentration and plastic development under multi-directional loads are hard to establish by calculation alone, so major projects often verify them with full-scale or large-scale prototype tests. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節點足尺試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-scale node tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。原型在 1.5 倍設計載重下名目應力 200 MPa、熱點量得 480 MPa（尚在彈性範圍），SCF = 480/200 = 2.4；有限元素預測 2.3，差約 4%，可接受。若量得 SCF 3.0，熱點處的疲勞壽命以應力三次方估計將降為約 (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal. At 1.5 times design load a prototype with 200 MPa nominal stress shows 480 MPa at the hot spot, still elastic, so SCF = 480/200 = 2.4; the finite-element prediction of 2.3 is within about 4%, which is acceptable. Had the SCF been 3.0, fatigue life at the hot spot, scaling with stress cubed, would fall to about (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫先由設計者、試驗室與第三方審查，規定載重比例、加載步驟、應變計位置與停止條件；試驗後比較實測與預測的應變分布、剛度與破壞位置，並將差異納入生產節點的檢驗重點與焊接要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Have the designer, laboratory and a third party review the test plan beforehand, fixing load ratios, loading steps, strain-gauge locations and stop criteria; afterwards compare measured and predicted strain distributions, stiffness and failure location, and carry any differences into the inspection focus and welding requirements for production nodes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。原型在 1.5 倍設計載重下名目應力 200 MPa、熱點量得 480 MPa（尚在彈性範圍），SCF = 480/200 = 2.4；有限元素預測 2.3，差約 4%，可接受。若量得 SCF 3.0，熱點處的疲勞壽命以應力三次方估計將降為約 (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal. At 1.5 times design load a prototype with 200 MPa nominal stress shows 480 MPa at the hot spot, still elastic, so SCF = 480/200 = 2.4; the finite-element prediction of 2.3 is within about 4%, which is acceptable. Had the SCF been 3.0, fatigue life at the hot spot, scaling with stress cubed, would fall to about (2.4/3.0)³ ≈ 51%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks", which statement holds?
options: 斜交網格的樓板只是一般樓板，租戶可以自由開孔。
斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。
應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。
optionsEn: Diagrid floors are ordinary slabs that tenants may cut freely.
Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability.
Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal.
quiz.explanation: 應力集中係數 SCF = σ_熱點/σ_名目。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stress concentration factor SCF = σ_hot/σ_nominal. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節點足尺試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-scale node tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫先由設計者、試驗室與第三方審查，規定載重比例、加載步驟、應變計位置與停止條件；試驗後比較實測與預測的應變分布、剛度與破壞位置，並將差異納入生產節點的檢驗重點與焊接要求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Have the designer, laboratory and a third party review the test plan beforehand, fixing load ratios, loading steps, strain-gauge locations and stop criteria; afterwards compare measured and predicted strain distributions, stiffness and failure location, and carry any differences into the inspection focus and welding requirements for production nodes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對重複數量多或受力最大的節點型式安排原型試驗，試驗通過列為量產前的停止點；試驗報告、應變資料與照片納入竣工文件，作為日後檢查與疲勞評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Schedule prototype tests for the most repeated or most heavily loaded node types, making a passed test a hold point before production; include the test report, strain data and photographs in the as-built documents as the baseline for later inspection and fatigue assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若跳過原型試驗而直接量產，節點中某個未被模型捕捉的應力集中點可能在風的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫；試驗若只加單向載重而未重現多向受力比例，也可能錯估節點真正的弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping prototype tests and going straight to production can leave a stress concentration the model missed to start fatigue cracks under repeated wind loading; tests that apply load in only one direction without reproducing the multi-directional force ratios can also misjudge where the node is truly weak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫先由設計者、試驗室與第三方審查，規定載重比例、加載步驟、應變計位置與停止條件；試驗後比較實測與預測的應變分布、剛度與破壞位置，並將差異納入生產節點的檢驗重點與焊接要求。
knowledge.textEn: Have the designer, laboratory and a third party review the test plan beforehand, fixing load ratios, loading steps, strain-gauge locations and stop criteria; afterwards compare measured and predicted strain distributions, stiffness and failure location, and carry any differences into the inspection focus and welding requirements for production nodes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對重複數量多或受力最大的節點型式安排原型試驗，試驗通過列為量產前的停止點；試驗報告、應變資料與照片納入竣工文件，作為日後檢查與疲勞評估的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Schedule prototype tests for the most repeated or most heavily loaded node types, making a passed test a hold point before production; include the test report, strain data and photographs in the as-built documents as the baseline for later inspection and fatigue assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks"?
options: 試驗計畫先由設計者、試驗室與第三方審查，規定載重比例、加載步驟、應變計位置與停止條件。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。
optionsEn: Have the designer, laboratory and a third party review the test plan beforehand, fixing load ratios, loading steps, strain-gauge locations and stop criteria.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫先由設計者、試驗室與第三方審查，規定載重比例、加載步驟、應變計位置與停止條件；試驗後比較實測與預測的應變分布、剛度與破壞位置，並將差異納入生產節點的檢驗重點與焊接要求。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Have the designer, laboratory and a third party review the test plan beforehand, fixing load ratios, loading steps, strain-gauge locations and stop criteria; afterwards compare measured and predicted strain distributions, stiffness and failure location, and carry any differences into the inspection focus and welding requirements for production nodes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節點足尺試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-scale node tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若跳過原型試驗而直接量產，節點中某個未被模型捕捉的應力集中點可能在風的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫；試驗若只加單向載重而未重現多向受力比例，也可能錯估節點真正的弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping prototype tests and going straight to production can leave a stress concentration the model missed to start fatigue cracks under repeated wind loading; tests that apply load in only one direction without reproducing the multi-directional force ratios can also misjudge where the node is truly weak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗結果也用來決定生產節點的檢驗重點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The results also set the inspection focus for production nodes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有限元素分析已經夠精確，節點不需要做試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Finite-element analysis is precise enough that nodes need no testing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若跳過原型試驗而直接量產，節點中某個未被模型捕捉的應力集中點可能在風的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫；試驗若只加單向載重而未重現多向受力比例，也可能錯估節點真正的弱點。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping prototype tests and going straight to production can leave a stress concentration the model missed to start fatigue cracks under repeated wind loading; tests that apply load in only one direction without reproducing the multi-directional force ratios can also misjudge where the node is truly weak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

steps.title: 以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Verifying diagrid stiffness from ambient vibration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「實測週期與勁度驗證」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Measured period and stiffness check” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格的側向勁度主要來自斜柱的軸向勁度與節點的實際剛度，模型中節點偏心、螺栓滑動、樓板參與與非結構構件都會影響結果。完工後以環境振動量測建築的前幾個模態週期，是驗證整體勁度最直接的方法：週期比預測短代表實際較勁，可能是帷幕與隔間參與；週期比預測長則可能是節點或接合比假設柔。量測結果用來校正模型，作為日後評估改裝與事件後狀態的基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「實測週期與勁度驗證」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diagrid's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the diagonals' axial stiffness and the actual rigidity of the nodes, and node eccentricity, bolt slip, slab participation and non-structural elements all affect the model result. Measuring the first few modal periods by ambient vibration after completion is the most direct check of overall stiffness: a period shorter than predicted means the building is stiffer, perhaps with façade and partitions participating, while a longer period may mean nodes or joints are softer than assumed. The measurements calibrate the model as a baseline for later assessment of alterations and post-event condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Measured period and stiffness check” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Verifying diagrid stiffness from ambient vibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實測週期與勁度驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Measured period and stiffness check” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：由 T = 2π√(m/k) 得 k ∝ 1/T²。若預測週期 4.4 s、實測 4.0 s，實際勁度約為預測的 (4.4/4.0)² ≈ 1.21 倍；若實測 4.8 s，則只有 (4.4/4.8)² ≈ 0.84 倍，代表節點或接合可能比模型柔，須進一步檢查。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: From T = 2π√(m/k), k ∝ 1/T². If the predicted period is 4.4 s and the measured one 4.0 s, actual stiffness is about (4.4/4.0)² ≈ 1.21 times the prediction; a measured 4.8 s gives only (4.4/4.8)² ≈ 0.84 times, suggesting nodes or joints softer than modelled and calling for further checks. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在頂層與中間樓層兩個方向及角落設置加速度計，長時間記錄並以兩種識別方法求週期與振型；先確認質量假設（實際裝修與設備重量），再以勁度修正模型使週期吻合，並檢查修正後的變位與構件力是否仍符合要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install accelerometers in both directions and at corners on the top and intermediate floors, record for long periods and identify periods and mode shapes by two methods; first confirm the mass assumptions, including actual fit-out and equipment, then adjust stiffness so the model matches the periods, and check that drifts and member forces still comply after updating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 以環境振動驗證斜交網格的勁度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Verifying diagrid stiffness from ambient vibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「實測週期與勁度驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Measured period and stiffness check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在頂層與中間樓層兩個方向及角落設置加速度計，長時間記錄並以兩種識別方法求週期與振型；先確認質量假設（實際裝修與設備重量），再以勁度修正模型使週期吻合，並檢查修正後的變位與構件力是否仍符合要求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install accelerometers in both directions and at corners on the top and intermediate floors, record for long periods and identify periods and mode shapes by two methods; first confirm the mass assumptions, including actual fit-out and equipment, then adjust stiffness so the model matches the periods, and check that drifts and member forces still comply after updating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把完工後的環境振動量測列入驗收項目，報告附原始資料、識別方法與校正後的模型參數；大規模改裝前後各量測一次，以確認勁度變化是否在可接受範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make post-completion ambient vibration measurement an acceptance item, with raw data, identification methods and calibrated model parameters in the report; measure again before and after any major refit to confirm that stiffness changes are acceptable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若量得週期明顯偏長卻未追查，可能隱藏節點螺栓未達預拉力或接合滑動的問題，在強風中逐漸惡化；若把偏短的週期全部歸功於結構而忽略非結構構件，改裝拆除隔間後勁度會下降，舒適度變差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring a markedly longer measured period can hide nodes with under-tensioned bolts or slipping joints that worsen in strong winds; crediting a shorter period entirely to the structure and ignoring non-structural elements means stiffness drops when partitions are removed in a refit, worsening comfort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實測週期與勁度驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若量得週期明顯偏長卻未追查，可能隱藏節點螺栓未達預拉力或接合滑動的問題，在強風中逐漸惡化；若把偏短的週期全部歸功於結構而忽略非結構構件，改裝拆除隔間後勁度會下降，舒適度變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。
若量得週期明顯偏長卻未追查，可能隱藏節點螺栓未達預拉力或接合滑動的問題，在強風中逐漸惡化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection.
Ignoring a markedly longer measured period can hide nodes with under-tensioned bolts or slipping joints that worsen in strong winds.
quiz.explanation: 若量得週期明顯偏長卻未追查，可能隱藏節點螺栓未達預拉力或接合滑動的問題，在強風中逐漸惡化；若把偏短的週期全部歸功於結構而忽略非結構構件，改裝拆除隔間後勁度會下降，舒適度變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring a markedly longer measured period can hide nodes with under-tensioned bolts or slipping joints that worsen in strong winds; crediting a shorter period entirely to the structure and ignoring non-structural elements means stiffness drops when partitions are removed in a refit, worsening comfort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護」與「租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals" and "Tenant refits and handover controls for a diagrid": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外露斜柱耐火被覆」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格的斜柱常是建築造型的一部分，在室內或帷幕後方外露，業主希望看得到鋼構，因此多採用薄層膨脹型防火塗料而非厚重的噴覆。斜柱一旦在火災中失去強度，傳力路徑會重新分配，但每根斜柱都同時承擔重力與側力，冗餘度有限；防火被覆的厚度要依構件的斷面係數決定，斷面越厚實，需要的塗層越薄。靠近帷幕的斜柱還可能受到冷凝水與溫度變化影響，塗層的完整性需要長期維護。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外露斜柱耐火被覆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diagrid diagonals are often part of the architecture, exposed inside or behind the glazing, and owners want the steel visible, so thin intumescent coatings are favoured over heavy sprayed protection. If a diagonal loses strength in a fire the load path redistributes, but each diagonal carries both gravity and lateral load, so redundancy is limited; coating thickness is set by the member's section factor, with stockier sections needing thinner coatings. Diagonals next to the façade may also see condensation and temperature swings, so coating integrity needs long-term upkeep. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「外露斜柱耐火被覆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fire protection of exposed diagonals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護
knowledge.titleEn: Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals

If a diagonal loses strength in a fire the load path redistributes, but each diagonal carries both gravity and lateral load, so redundancy is limited; coating thickness is set by the member's section factor, with stockier sections needing thinner coatings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals" is correct?
options: 斜交網格的斜柱常是建築造型的一部分，在室內或帷幕後方外露，業主希望看得到鋼構，因此多採用薄層膨脹型防火塗料而非厚重的噴覆。
防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。
斜交網格的樓板只是一般樓板，租戶可以自由開孔。
optionsEn: Diagrid diagonals are often part of the architecture, exposed inside or behind the glazing, and owners want the steel visible, so thin intumescent coatings are favoured over heavy sprayed protection.
A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection.
Diagrid floors are ordinary slabs that tenants may cut freely.
quiz.explanation: 斜交網格的斜柱常是建築造型的一部分，在室內或帷幕後方外露，業主希望看得到鋼構，因此多採用薄層膨脹型防火塗料而非厚重的噴覆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diagrid diagonals are often part of the architecture, exposed inside or behind the glazing, and owners want the steel visible, so thin intumescent coatings are favoured over heavy sprayed protection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外露斜柱耐火被覆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。600 mm 方管、厚 40 mm：A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m²、H_p = 2.4 m，H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹，屬於厚實斷面，所需膨脹塗層較薄；若改為 H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ 的薄壁構件，同樣耐火時效需要的塗層會厚得多。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area. A 600 mm square box with 40 mm walls has A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m² and H_p = 2.4 m, so H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹, a stocky section needing a relatively thin intumescent coat; a thin-walled member with H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ would need a much thicker coat for the same fire rating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：防火塗料的厚度依經認證的厚度表與實際斷面係數決定，施工後以乾膜厚度計逐構件量測並記錄；營運中定期目視檢查塗層破損、剝離與鏽斑，帷幕附近加強檢查冷凝區域，任何碰撞損傷都要依原規格修補並重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set fire-coating thickness from certified loading tables and the actual section factor, and after application measure dry-film thickness member by member and record it; in service inspect periodically for coating damage, delamination and rust spots, giving extra attention to condensation zones near the façade, and repair any impact damage to the original specification with re-measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。600 mm 方管、厚 40 mm：A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m²、H_p = 2.4 m，H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹，屬於厚實斷面，所需膨脹塗層較薄；若改為 H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ 的薄壁構件，同樣耐火時效需要的塗層會厚得多。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area. A 600 mm square box with 40 mm walls has A = 0.6² − 0.52² ≈ 0.0896 m² and H_p = 2.4 m, so H_p/A ≈ 26.8 m⁻¹, a stocky section needing a relatively thin intumescent coat; a thin-walled member with H_p/A ≈ 150 m⁻¹ would need a much thicker coat for the same fire rating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals", which statement holds?
options: 斜交網格的樓板只承受樓面載重，與斜柱的穩定無關。
斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。
鋼管內灌了混凝土，就不需要另外做防火被覆。
optionsEn: Floors in a diagrid only carry floor loads and have nothing to do with the diagonals' stability.
Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area.
A tube filled with concrete needs no separate fire protection.
quiz.explanation: 斷面係數 H_p/A = 受熱周長/斷面積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Section factor H_p/A = heated perimeter over cross-sectional area. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外露斜柱耐火被覆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 防火塗料的厚度依經認證的厚度表與實際斷面係數決定，施工後以乾膜厚度計逐構件量測並記錄；營運中定期目視檢查塗層破損、剝離與鏽斑，帷幕附近加強檢查冷凝區域，任何碰撞損傷都要依原規格修補並重新量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set fire-coating thickness from certified loading tables and the actual section factor, and after application measure dry-film thickness member by member and record it; in service inspect periodically for coating damage, delamination and rust spots, giving extra attention to condensation zones near the façade, and repair any impact damage to the original specification with re-measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件附每根斜柱的編號、斷面係數、耐火時效、塗層產品與乾膜厚度紀錄；營運手冊規定任何在斜柱上的鑽孔、焊接或附掛都必須事先申請，完成後依原規格修補並由防火與結構工程師確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents give every diagonal's number, section factor, fire rating, coating product and dry-film thickness records; the operations manual requires prior approval for any drilling, welding or attachment on diagonals, with repair to the original specification confirmed by the fire and structural engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：裝修或設備安裝時刮傷、鑽孔或在斜柱上焊接附掛物，會破壞防火塗層且不易被發現，火災時該處成為弱點；冷凝水長期滲入塗層下方則造成鋼材腐蝕與塗層剝落，同時削弱防火與結構斷面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scratching, drilling or welding attachments to diagonals during fit-out or equipment installation damages the fire coating in ways that are easily missed, creating weak points in a fire; long-term condensation under the coating corrodes the steel and lifts the coating, weakening both fire protection and the structural section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 防火塗料的厚度依經認證的厚度表與實際斷面係數決定，施工後以乾膜厚度計逐構件量測並記錄；營運中定期目視檢查塗層破損、剝離與鏽斑，帷幕附近加強檢查冷凝區域，任何碰撞損傷都要依原規格修補並重新量測。
knowledge.textEn: Set fire-coating thickness from certified loading tables and the actual section factor, and after application measure dry-film thickness member by member and record it; in service inspect periodically for coating damage, delamination and rust spots, giving extra attention to condensation zones near the façade, and repair any impact damage to the original specification with re-measurement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件附每根斜柱的編號、斷面係數、耐火時效、塗層產品與乾膜厚度紀錄；營運手冊規定任何在斜柱上的鑽孔、焊接或附掛都必須事先申請，完成後依原規格修補並由防火與結構工程師確認。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents give every diagonal's number, section factor, fire rating, coating product and dry-film thickness records; the operations manual requires prior approval for any drilling, welding or attachment on diagonals, with repair to the original specification confirmed by the fire and structural engineers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要每根斜柱都在工廠做準，現場就不需要逐模組量測。
防火塗料的厚度依經認證的厚度表與實際斷面係數決定，施工後以乾膜厚度計逐構件量測並記錄。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If every diagonal is made accurately in the shop, no module-by-module survey is needed on site.
Set fire-coating thickness from certified loading tables and the actual section factor, and after application measure dry-film thickness member by member and record it.
quiz.explanation: 防火塗料的厚度依經認證的厚度表與實際斷面係數決定，施工後以乾膜厚度計逐構件量測並記錄；營運中定期目視檢查塗層破損、剝離與鏽斑，帷幕附近加強檢查冷凝區域，任何碰撞損傷都要依原規格修補並重新量測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set fire-coating thickness from certified loading tables and the actual section factor, and after application measure dry-film thickness member by member and record it; in service inspect periodically for coating damage, delamination and rust spots, giving extra attention to condensation zones near the façade, and repair any impact damage to the original specification with re-measurement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外露斜柱的耐火與防蝕維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire protection and corrosion upkeep of exposed diagonals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外露斜柱耐火被覆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fire protection of exposed diagonals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 裝修或設備安裝時刮傷、鑽孔或在斜柱上焊接附掛物，會破壞防火塗層且不易被發現，火災時該處成為弱點；冷凝水長期滲入塗層下方則造成鋼材腐蝕與塗層剝落，同時削弱防火與結構斷面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scratching, drilling or welding attachments to diagonals during fit-out or equipment installation damages the fire coating in ways that are easily missed, creating weak points in a fire; long-term condensation under the coating corrodes the steel and lifts the coating, weakening both fire protection and the structural section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：靠近帷幕的斜柱還可能受到冷凝水與溫度變化影響，塗層的完整性需要長期維護。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Diagonals next to the façade may also see condensation and temperature swings, so coating integrity needs long-term upkeep.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防火塗料塗一次就能永久有效，不需要檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fire coating, once applied, lasts for ever and needs no inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「改裝時的斜柱與樓板保護」如何影響高層建築斜交網格結構的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Protecting diagonals and slabs in refits” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-rise diagrid structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜交網格的每一個構件都同時參與重力與側力傳遞，而節點樓層的樓板又承擔環向拉力，因此租戶改裝時常見的動作，例如在樓板開設樓梯或挑空、在斜柱旁增設夾層、或切割環梁穿管，都可能直接影響主結構。交接時必須把「哪些構件與樓板是網格系統的一部分」清楚告訴營運單位，並建立改裝審查流程；帷幕更換或外牆清洗設備的固定點若設在斜柱上，也要經結構確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「改裝時的斜柱與樓板保護」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every diagrid member takes part in both gravity and lateral load paths, and node-level floors carry hoop tension, so common tenant refit actions, such as cutting stair openings or atria in slabs, adding mezzanines beside diagonals or cutting ring beams for services, can directly affect the primary structure. Handover must make clear to the operator which members and slabs belong to the grid system and establish an alteration review process; fixings for façade replacement or cleaning equipment attached to diagonals also need structural confirmation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Protecting diagonals and slabs in refits” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：環向拉力所需鋼筋 A_s = T/(φ·f_y)。

steps.title: 租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tenant refits and handover controls for a diagrid: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改裝時的斜柱與樓板保護」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Protecting diagonals and slabs in refits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：環向拉力所需鋼筋 A_s = T/(φ·f_y)。T = 8.0 MN、φ = 0.9、f_y = 420 MPa，A_s ≈ 8.0×10⁶/(0.9×420) ≈ 21,160 mm²；若改裝開口切斷樓板繫筋的 40%，須以補強鋼環梁或新增鋼筋補足約 0.4×21,160 ≈ 8,470 mm² 的拉力面積。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Reinforcement for hoop tension A_s = T/(φ·f_y). With T = 8.0 MN, φ = 0.9 and f_y = 420 MPa, A_s ≈ 8.0×10⁶/(0.9×420) ≈ 21,160 mm²; if a refit opening cuts 40% of the slab tie bars, a supplementary steel ring beam or added bars must restore about 0.4×21,160 ≈ 8,470 mm² of tension area. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：改裝申請須附結構圖套繪，標出受影響的樓板繫筋、環梁與斜柱；以掃描或鋼筋探測確認開口位置的鋼筋配置，補強完成後由結構工程師現場驗收，並更新竣工圖與結構管制圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Alteration requests must overlay the structural drawings, marking affected slab ties, ring beams and diagonals; confirm the reinforcement at the proposed opening by scanning or cover-meter survey, have the structural engineer accept the strengthening on site and update the as-built and structural control drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 環向拉力所需鋼筋 A_s = T/(φ·f_y)。T = 8.0 MN、φ = 0.9、f_y = 420 MPa，A_s ≈ 8.0×10⁶/(0.9×420) ≈ 21,160 mm²；若改裝開口切斷樓板繫筋的 40%，須以補強鋼環梁或新增鋼筋補足約 0.4×21,160 ≈ 8,470 mm² 的拉力面積。數值為教學假設。

steps.title: 租戶改裝與斜交網格的交接管控：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Protecting diagonals and slabs in refits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 改裝申請須附結構圖套繪，標出受影響的樓板繫筋、環梁與斜柱；以掃描或鋼筋探測確認開口位置的鋼筋配置，補強完成後由結構工程師現場驗收，並更新竣工圖與結構管制圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents include the diagrid system drawing, lists of node floors and ring beams, no-opening zone plans and the alteration review procedure; leases state the structural control clauses, and any work touching diagonals, ring beams or node floors proceeds only after the structural engineer signs off.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未經審查在節點樓層開設挑空，環向拉力傳遞中斷，節點緩慢外移並造成帷幕接縫開裂；在斜柱上焊接夾層支架則可能造成熱影響區脆化與防火塗層破損，形成難以察覺的隱患。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting an atrium on a node floor without review interrupts hoop tension, letting nodes creep outwards and crack façade joints; welding mezzanine brackets to diagonals can embrittle the heat-affected zone and damage the fire coating, creating hidden hazards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 未經審查在節點樓層開設挑空，環向拉力傳遞中斷，節點緩慢外移並造成帷幕接縫開裂；在斜柱上焊接夾層支架則可能造成熱影響區脆化與防火塗層破損，形成難以察覺的隱患。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

title: 束筒高層結構系統
summary: 以威利斯大樓與 One Magnificent Mile 為例，從框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒如何以內部腹框縮短翼面跨度出發，理解九個 75 英尺方筒的逐段截止，處理預製樹狀柱梁段與沉箱基礎、筒體截止處的力流重分配、混凝土六角束筒，再到邊界層風洞試驗與以柱應變驗證剪力滯後，最後是外殼溫度效應與既有束筒超高層的改造交接。
summaryEn: Using Willis Tower and One Magnificent Mile, start from shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling shortens flange spans with interior web frames, understand the staged termination of nine 75-foot tubes, handle prefabricated column-tree units and caisson foundations, force redistribution where tubes stop and hexagonal concrete bundles, then boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing and verifying shear lag from column strains, ending with envelope thermal effects and the retrofit and handover of an existing bundled-tube supertall.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 剪力滯後與抗傾覆練習：某鋼構框架筒翼面寬 68.6 m，翼面共 16 支柱、每支 0.06 m²，角柱容許應力 200 MPa。以力偶近似抗傾覆能力 M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B。單一大筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4，η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60，M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m；改為 3×3 束筒，內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85，η = 0.90，M ≈ 11.9 GN·m，增加約 50%。若窗間梁變淺使單筒 r 降到 0.3，η ≈ 0.53，M 只剩約 7.0 GN·m。也就是說，在角柱應力相同的前提下，束筒的內部腹框把同樣的鋼柱變成更有效的抗傾覆力偶；代價是內部多了框架線，影響平面使用。數值為教學假設，不代表威利斯大樓的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Shear lag and overturning exercise: a steel framed tube has a 68.6 m flange with 16 columns of 0.06 m² each and an allowable corner stress of 200 MPa. Approximating overturning resistance as a couple, M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B. For a single large tube with a centre-to-corner ratio r = 0.4, η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60 and M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m; as a 3×3 bundle whose interior webs raise r to 0.85, η = 0.90 and M ≈ 11.9 GN·m, about 50% more. If shallower spandrels drop the single tube's r to 0.3, η ≈ 0.53 and M falls to about 7.0 GN·m. For the same corner stress, then, the bundle's interior webs turn the same steel columns into a more effective overturning couple, at the price of extra interior frame lines that affect floor planning. Values are teaching assumptions, not Willis Tower's design values.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法」與「九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps" and "Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「框架筒剪力滯後」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shear lag in a framed tube” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 框架筒以密排的外柱與深窗間梁組成一個「有孔的箱」，側力下垂直於風向的翼面柱以軸力抵抗傾覆。但力量要經由窗間梁的剪力從角柱傳到翼面中央，梁有彈性，中央柱分到的軸力比角柱少，這就是剪力滯後，使翼面的效率降低。翼面越寬，滯後越嚴重。束筒把建築分成幾個較小的筒，筒與筒之間的內部框架也是腹面，等於把翼面切成較短的跨度，讓翼面柱的軸力分布更均勻，整體抗傾覆效率提高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「框架筒剪力滯後」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A framed tube uses closely spaced exterior columns and deep spandrel beams to form a perforated box, and under lateral load the flange columns perpendicular to the wind resist overturning in axial force. But force must travel from the corner columns to the middle of the flange through shear in the flexible spandrels, so middle columns pick up less axial force than corner columns; this shear lag lowers flange efficiency, and the wider the flange, the worse it gets. A bundled tube divides the building into several smaller tubes whose shared interior frames also act as webs, cutting the flange into shorter spans so that flange-column forces are more uniform and overall overturning efficiency rises. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shear lag in a framed tube” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線近似翼面柱應力 σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²]，平均效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Approximate flange-column stress with a parabola σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²], giving an average efficiency η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Flange columns of a framed tube share overturning force equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「框架筒剪力滯後」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shear lag in a framed tube”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

But force must travel from the corner columns to the middle of the flange through shear in the flexible spandrels, so middle columns pick up less axial force than corner columns; this shear lag lowers flange efficiency, and the wider the flange, the worse it gets.

knowledge.text: 誤解：框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps" is correct?
options: 框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。
框架筒以密排的外柱與深窗間梁組成一個「有孔的箱」，側力下垂直於風向的翼面柱以軸力抵抗傾覆。

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「框架筒剪力滯後」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear lag in a framed tube” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線近似翼面柱應力 σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²]，平均效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r)。單一寬筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4 時 η = 0.60；束筒內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85 時 η = 0.90，同樣角柱應力下翼面能提供的抗傾覆力約增加 50%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Approximate flange-column stress with a parabola σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²], giving an average efficiency η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r). For a single wide tube with a centre-to-corner stress ratio r = 0.4, η = 0.60; interior web frames in a bundle raising r to 0.85 give η = 0.90, so for the same corner stress the flange provides about 50% more overturning resistance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維模型中輸出側力下翼面各柱的軸力分布，計算中央與角柱的比值，並比較單筒與束筒配置；同時確認窗間梁的剪力與變形是否在設計範圍，因為滯後的程度直接取決於這些梁的勁度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output the axial-force distribution across flange columns under lateral load from the three-dimensional model, compute the centre-to-corner ratio and compare single-tube and bundled layouts; check also that spandrel shears and deformations are within design, since the degree of shear lag depends directly on their stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以拋物線近似翼面柱應力 σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²]，平均效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r)。單一寬筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4 時 η = 0.60；束筒內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85 時 η = 0.90，同樣角柱應力下翼面能提供的抗傾覆力約增加 50%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Approximate flange-column stress with a parabola σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²], giving an average efficiency η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r). For a single wide tube with a centre-to-corner stress ratio r = 0.4, η = 0.60; interior web frames in a bundle raising r to 0.85 give η = 0.90, so for the same corner stress the flange provides about 50% more overturning resistance. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps", which statement holds?
options: 超高層的基礎只要夠深就好，各柱的沉陷差異不重要。
束筒只能用鋼構，混凝土做不出筒體效果。

optionsEn: A supertall foundation only needs to be deep enough; differences in settlement between columns do not matter.

quiz.explanationEn: Approximate flange-column stress with a parabola σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²], giving an average efficiency η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「框架筒剪力滯後」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear lag in a framed tube” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維模型中輸出側力下翼面各柱的軸力分布，計算中央與角柱的比值，並比較單筒與束筒配置；同時確認窗間梁的剪力與變形是否在設計範圍，因為滯後的程度直接取決於這些梁的勁度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「框架筒剪力滯後」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear lag in a framed tube” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若設計時以平面保持平面的梁理論假設翼面柱均勻受力，角柱的實際軸力會被低估，可能在強風或地震時先行降伏或在續接處開裂；窗間梁若因開大窗而變淺，剪力滯後加劇，整棟樓比預期柔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming plane sections and uniform flange forces in design underestimates real corner-column forces, which can yield first or crack at splices in strong wind or earthquakes; shallower spandrels from larger windows worsen shear lag and leave the building more flexible than expected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束筒把建築分成幾個較小的筒，筒與筒之間的內部框架也是腹面，等於把翼面切成較短的跨度，讓翼面柱的軸力分布更均勻，整體抗傾覆效率提高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A bundled tube divides the building into several smaller tubes whose shared interior frames also act as webs, cutting the flange into shorter spans so that flange-column forces are more uniform and overall overturning efficiency rises.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Flange columns of a framed tube share overturning force equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「九筒 3×3 平面」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 威利斯大樓（原西爾斯大樓）由九個約 75 英尺（約 22.9 m）見方、內部無柱的方筒以 3×3 排列組成，底部總寬約 225 英尺（約 68.6 m）。九個筒在第 50 層以下全部存在，之後依序截止：第 50 層西北與東南兩筒結束，第 66 層東北與西南兩筒結束，第 90 層北、東、南三筒結束，只剩兩筒到頂。逐段截止讓上部平面縮小、受風面積減少，同時形成退縮的外觀；但每一次截止都會造成勁度與質量的突然變化，必須在截止層以斜撐或帶狀桁架重新分配力量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「九筒 3×3 平面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Willis Tower, formerly the Sears Tower, consists of nine column-free square tubes about 75 ft (about 22.9 m) on a side arranged in a 3×3 grid, about 225 ft (about 68.6 m) wide at the base. All nine rise to level 50 and then stop in stages: the northwest and southeast tubes end at level 50, the northeast and southwest at level 66, and the north, east and south at level 90, leaving two tubes to the top. Staged termination shrinks the upper plan and reduces wind area while creating the stepped profile; but every termination causes an abrupt change in stiffness and mass, so diagonals or belt trusses at those levels must redistribute forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單筒面積 22.86² ≈ 523 m²：9 筒約 4,703 m²、7 筒約 3,658 m²、5 筒約 2,613 m²、2 筒約 1,045 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One tube is 22.86² ≈ 523 m²: nine tubes give about 4,703 m², seven about 3,658 m², five about 2,613 m² and two about 1,045 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「束筒的筒體可以在任何樓層隨意截止，不需要特別處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tubes in a bundle can stop at any floor without special treatment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「九筒 3×3 平面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Nine-tube 3×3 plan”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「九筒 3×3 平面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單筒面積 22.86² ≈ 523 m²：9 筒約 4,703 m²、7 筒約 3,658 m²、5 筒約 2,613 m²、2 筒約 1,045 m²。第 90 層以上的平面只剩底部的約 22%，該段的抗彎慣性矩與受風寬度同時減少，勁度變化可達數倍。尺寸取自公開資料，比例為計算結果。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One tube is 22.86² ≈ 523 m²: nine tubes give about 4,703 m², seven about 3,658 m², five about 2,613 m² and two about 1,045 m². Above level 90 the plan is only about 22% of the base, so bending inertia and windward width both drop, and stiffness can change several-fold. Dimensions are from public sources; the ratios are computed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模型逐段檢查截止層上下的層間變位、勁度比與構件力，確認沒有形成軟弱層；風洞試驗需涵蓋退縮造成的局部風壓與渦流變化，截止層的帶狀桁架或斜撐以局部模型檢核其傳力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check storey drift, stiffness ratios and member forces above and below each termination level in the model to confirm there is no soft storey; wind-tunnel testing must capture local pressures and vortex changes caused by the setbacks, and belt trusses or diagonals at termination levels are checked with local models for force transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「九筒 3×3 平面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模型逐段檢查截止層上下的層間變位、勁度比與構件力，確認沒有形成軟弱層；風洞試驗需涵蓋退縮造成的局部風壓與渦流變化，截止層的帶狀桁架或斜撐以局部模型檢核其傳力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check storey drift, stiffness ratios and member forces above and below each termination level in the model to confirm there is no soft storey; wind-tunnel testing must capture local pressures and vortex changes caused by the setbacks, and belt trusses or diagonals at termination levels are checked with local models for force transfer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：截止層要在結構圖上特別標示，列出帶狀桁架或斜撐的位置與功能；建築若要變更退縮樓層，須回到結構與風工程顧問重新評估勁度變化與局部風壓。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Flag termination levels on the structural drawings with the position and purpose of belt trusses or diagonals; any change of setback level must go back to the structural and wind consultants to reassess stiffness changes and local pressures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若截止層沒有足夠的力量重分配構件，被截止筒的角柱軸力會突然集中到相鄰的筒，造成局部超載或接頭破壞；退縮處的局部風壓若被低估，帷幕與屋頂設備容易在強風中受損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without enough redistribution members at a termination level, corner-column forces from the stopped tube concentrate abruptly in the adjacent tube, causing local overload or connection failure; underestimated local wind pressures at setbacks leave cladding and rooftop equipment vulnerable in strong winds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「九筒 3×3 平面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若截止層沒有足夠的力量重分配構件，被截止筒的角柱軸力會突然集中到相鄰的筒，造成局部超載或接頭破壞；退縮處的局部風壓若被低估，帷幕與屋頂設備容易在強風中受損。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without enough redistribution members at a termination level, corner-column forces from the stopped tube concentrate abruptly in the adjacent tube, causing local overload or connection failure; underestimated local wind pressures at setbacks leave cladding and rooftop equipment vulnerable in strong winds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：逐段截止讓上部平面縮小、受風面積減少，同時形成退縮的外觀；但每一次截止都會造成勁度與質量的突然變化，必須在截止層以斜撐或帶狀桁架重新分配力量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Staged termination shrinks the upper plan and reduces wind area while creating the stepped profile; but every termination causes an abrupt change in stiffness and mass, so diagonals or belt trusses at those levels must redistribute forces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「束筒的筒體可以在任何樓層隨意截止，不需要特別處理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tubes in a bundle can stop at any floor without special treatment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
現場螺栓接頭比工廠焊接接頭弱，所以預製單元沒有好處。
若截止層沒有足夠的力量重分配構件，被截止筒的角柱軸力會突然集中到相鄰的筒，造成局部超載或接頭破壞；退縮處的局部風壓若被低估，帷幕與屋頂設備容易在強風中受損。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Site bolted joints are weaker than shop welds, so prefabricated units bring no benefit.
Without enough redistribution members at a termination level, corner-column forces from the stopped tube concentrate abruptly in the adjacent tube, causing local overload or connection failure.

quiz.explanationEn: Without enough redistribution members at a termination level, corner-column forces from the stopped tube concentrate abruptly in the adjacent tube, causing local overload or connection failure; underestimated local wind pressures at setbacks leave cladding and rooftop equipment vulnerable in strong winds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製柱梁段與現場螺栓接合」與「鋼構束筒的沉箱基礎」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Prefabricated column-tree units with field bolting" and "Caisson foundations under a steel bundled tube": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製柱梁段與現場螺栓接合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prefabricated column-tree units with field bolting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預製樹狀柱梁段」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prefabricated column-tree units” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 束筒的每一面框架都由密排柱與深梁組成，接頭數量極多；SOM 指出威利斯大樓的鋼構在工廠預先組成段落，再運到現場以螺栓接合。常見做法是把柱與兩側半跨的梁在工廠焊成「樹狀」單元，焊接品質在室內控制，現場只在梁的中央以螺栓續接。側力作用下框架梁的反曲點大致在跨中，該處彎矩接近零，因此在跨中續接只需傳遞剪力，接頭可以做得簡單而快速。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預製樹狀柱梁段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every face of a bundled tube is a frame of closely spaced columns and deep beams, so connections are extremely numerous; SOM notes that Willis Tower's steel frame was pre-assembled in sections and bolted together on site. A common approach shop-welds a column with half-span beams on each side into a tree unit, keeping weld quality under indoor control, and splices the beams with bolts only at mid-span on site. Under lateral load the frame beams have their inflection point near mid-span where moment is close to zero, so a mid-span splice need carry only shear and can be simple and quick. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Prefabricated column-tree units” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：側力下梁端彎矩 M = V·L/2：梁剪力 V = 900 kN、淨跨 L = 4.0 m 時柱面彎矩約 1,800 kN·m，跨中接近 0；跨中續接只需傳遞 900 kN 剪力，若每支螺栓承壓容量取 120 kN，需 900/120 = 7.5，取 8 支。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Beam-end moment under lateral load M = V·L/2: with a beam shear V = 900 kN and a clear span L = 4.0 m, the moment at the column face is about 1,800 kN·m and near zero at mid-span; a mid-span splice need only carry 900 kN of shear, so at 120 kN bearing capacity per bolt it needs 900/120 = 7.5, rounded to 8 bolts.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「現場螺栓接頭比工廠焊接接頭弱，所以預製單元沒有好處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Site bolted joints are weaker than shop welds, so prefabricated units bring no benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預製樹狀柱梁段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Prefabricated column-tree units”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預製柱梁段與現場螺栓接合
knowledge.titleEn: Prefabricated column-tree units with field bolting
knowledge.text: 束筒的每一面框架都由密排柱與深梁組成，接頭數量極多；SOM 指出威利斯大樓的鋼構在工廠預先組成段落，再運到現場以螺栓接合。常見做法是把柱與兩側半跨的梁在工廠焊成「樹狀」單元，焊接品質在室內控制，現場只在梁的中央以螺栓續接。

A common approach shop-welds a column with half-span beams on each side into a tree unit, keeping weld quality under indoor control, and splices the beams with bolts only at mid-span on site.
