steps.title: 黑色鋁皮與青銅色玻璃外殼的溫度效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal effects behind the black aluminium skin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外殼與溫度變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Envelope and thermal movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若外殼改造時移除或削弱了柱周圍的隔熱，冬季外柱收縮使外圍樓板下沉，隔間牆、門框與帷幕接縫開裂；長期反覆的溫度變形也會讓接頭螺栓鬆動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If an envelope retrofit removes or weakens insulation around the columns, winter contraction of the exterior columns lowers perimeter floors, cracking partitions, door frames and façade joints; repeated thermal deformation over the years can also loosen connection bolts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：外殼的隔熱與氣密因此不只是節能問題，也是結構變形控制的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The envelope's insulation and airtightness are therefore not only an energy issue but part of controlling structural deformation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外牆只是建築外觀與節能，與鋼構架的變形無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The façade concerns only appearance and energy, not the deformation of the steel frame." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Retrofitting an existing bundled tube” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 威利斯大樓完工後持續改造：西側天線於 2000 年延長，使頂端高度達到 527 m；2009 年起觀景台翻修，2016 至 2021 年再進行大規模改造。每一次增設天線、觀景設施或改變用途，都會在屋頂或特定樓層增加荷重與受風面積，必須回溯原設計的筒體、帶狀桁架與基礎容量。原始圖說、施工紀錄與歷次改造資料若不完整，評估者只能以保守假設或破壞性調查補足，成本與風險都會增加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「既有束筒超高層的改造」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Willis Tower has been altered repeatedly since completion: the west antenna was extended in 2000, bringing the tip to 527 m; the Skydeck was renovated from 2009; and a major retrofit ran from 2016 to 2021. Every new antenna, visitor attraction or change of use adds load and wind area on the roof or particular floors, so the capacity of the original tubes, belt trusses and foundations must be traced back. If original drawings, construction records and earlier alteration data are incomplete, assessors must fall back on conservative assumptions or destructive investigation, adding cost and risk. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Retrofitting an existing bundled tube” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「老建築已經通過時間考驗，增加一些設備不需要結構評估。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「既有束筒超高層的改造」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Retrofitting an existing bundled tube” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：天線風力 F = q·C_d·D·L。q = 2.07 kPa、C_d = 1.2、直徑 D = 1.5 m、伸出屋頂 L = 85 m：F ≈ 2.07×1.2×1.5×85 ≈ 317 kN，屋頂處彎矩 M = F·L/2 ≈ 13,460 kN·m，須由屋頂框架與下方筒體承擔並檢核接頭疲勞。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind force on an antenna F = q·C_d·D·L. With q = 2.07 kPa, C_d = 1.2, diameter D = 1.5 m and L = 85 m above the roof, F ≈ 2.07×1.2×1.5×85 ≈ 317 kN and the roof moment M = F·L/2 ≈ 13,460 kN·m, which the roof framing and tubes below must carry, with connection fatigue checked. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：改造前調閱原始圖說與歷次改造紀錄，以現場量測確認構件尺寸與接頭狀況，必要時取樣試驗鋼材強度與韌性；新增荷重以模型檢核相關筒體與基礎，完成後更新竣工圖與結構資料庫，並記錄新增設備的重量與受風面積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before any alteration, retrieve original drawings and earlier alteration records, confirm member sizes and joint condition by site survey, and where needed sample the steel for strength and toughness; check the added loads on the relevant tubes and foundations with the model, then update the as-built drawings and structural database, recording the weight and wind area of new equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With q = 2.07 kPa, C_d = 1.2, diameter D = 1.5 m and L = 85 m above the roof, F ≈ 2.07×1.2×1.5×85 ≈ 317 kN and the roof moment M = F·L/2 ≈ 13,460 kN·m, which the roof framing and tubes below must carry, with connection fatigue checked. quiz.question: 依「既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Retrofitting and handover records for an existing bundled-tube supertall", which statement holds?
options: 現場螺栓接頭比工廠焊接接頭弱，所以預製單元沒有好處。
帶狀桁架只是機電層的裝飾性構件，可以晚點再裝。
天線風力 F = q·C_d·D·L。

Belt trusses are decorative members in plant rooms and can go in later.
Wind force on an antenna F = q·C_d·D·L.

steps.title: 既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Retrofitting and handover records for an existing bundled-tube supertall: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有束筒超高層的改造」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Retrofitting an existing bundled tube” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 改造前調閱原始圖說與歷次改造紀錄，以現場量測確認構件尺寸與接頭狀況，必要時取樣試驗鋼材強度與韌性；新增荷重以模型檢核相關筒體與基礎，完成後更新竣工圖與結構資料庫，並記錄新增設備的重量與受風面積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before any alteration, retrieve original drawings and earlier alteration records, confirm member sizes and joint condition by site survey, and where needed sample the steel for strength and toughness; check the added loads on the relevant tubes and foundations with the model, then update the as-built drawings and structural database, recording the weight and wind area of new equipment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應維護一份「結構荷重登錄」，記錄每次改造新增或移除的重量、位置與受風面積，並與原設計容量比較；交接時把原始圖說、改造紀錄與量測資料數位化保存，任何改造須經結構工程師審查簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should keep a structural load register recording the weight, location and wind area added or removed by every alteration and comparing them with original design capacity; at handover digitise original drawings, alteration records and measurements, and require structural engineer review and sign-off for every alteration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin; with records lost, assessors may misjudge actual member sizes or materials, leading to too little or too much strengthening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Retrofitting and handover records for an existing bundled-tube supertall: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有束筒超高層的改造」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Retrofitting an existing bundled tube” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin; with records lost, assessors may misjudge actual member sizes or materials, leading to too little or too much strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：原始圖說、施工紀錄與歷次改造資料若不完整，評估者只能以保守假設或破壞性調查補足，成本與風險都會增加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If original drawings, construction records and earlier alteration data are incomplete, assessors must fall back on conservative assumptions or destructive investigation, adding cost and risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「老建築已經通過時間考驗，增加一些設備不需要結構評估。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An old building has stood the test of time, so adding some equipment needs no structural assessment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin; with records lost, assessors may misjudge actual member sizes or materials, leading to too little or too much strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Retrofitting and handover records for an existing bundled-tube supertall" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。
框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin.
Flange columns of a framed tube share overturning force equally.
quiz.explanation: 若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin; with records lost, assessors may misjudge actual member sizes or materials, leading to too little or too much strengthening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高層建築調諧質量阻尼器
titleEn: Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
summary: 從超高層的橫風向渦流振動與居住舒適度出發，建立主結構模態與擺錘的雙自由度模型，依 Den Hartog 準則決定調頻與阻尼，再處理數百公噸質量塊的吊裝、現場調頻、阻尼器試驗、行程限制與長期監測，最後以台北 101 與上海中心大廈的實例比較油壓與渦電流兩種耗能方式。
summaryEn: Starting from across-wind vortex shedding and occupant comfort in supertall towers, build a two-degree-of-freedom model of the building mode and pendulum, set tuning and damping with the Den Hartog criteria, then handle the erection of a mass of several hundred tonnes, on-site tuning, damper testing, stroke limits and long-term monitoring, comparing hydraulic and eddy-current dissipation through Taipei 101 and Shanghai Tower.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某超高層第一模態 f₁ = 0.140 Hz、結構阻尼 ζ_s = 1%、頂部廣義質量 M* = 100,000 t，選用 m_d = 660 t 擺錘。質量比 μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066；最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ) = 0.9934，阻尼器頻率 f_d = 0.140×0.9934 ≈ 0.139 Hz；最佳阻尼比 ζ_d = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] = √[0.0198/8.159] ≈ 0.049；擺長 L = g/(2πf_d)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m；阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d ≈ 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m。以雙自由度模型掃頻，共振放大由 1/(2×0.01) = 50 降到約 13.6，相當於等效阻尼約 3.7%，風致加速度約降為原來的 √(1%/3.7%) ≈ 52%。若頻率偏離 5%，等效阻尼只剩約 2.1%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a supertall tower has f₁ = 0.140 Hz, structural damping ζ_s = 1% and a top generalised mass M* = 100,000 t, and a 660 t pendulum is chosen. The mass ratio is μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066; the optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ) = 0.9934, so f_d = 0.140×0.9934 ≈ 0.139 Hz; the optimum damping ratio is ζ_d = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] = √[0.0198/8.159] ≈ 0.049; the pendulum length is L = g/(2πf_d)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m; the damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d ≈ 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m. A two-degree-of-freedom sweep lowers the resonant amplification from 1/(2×0.01) = 50 to about 13.6, equivalent to about 3.7% damping, so wind-induced acceleration falls to roughly √(1%/3.7%) ≈ 52% of the original. A 5% frequency offset leaves only about 2.1% equivalent damping. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風致振動與居住舒適度」與「模態質量與雙自由度模型」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" and "Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風致振動與居住舒適度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂層樓板加速度」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top-floor acceleration” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層建築的第一模態頻率常低於 0.2 Hz，風吹過方形或圓角斷面時，背風側交替脫落的渦流會產生垂直於風向的週期性橫風力；當渦流脫落頻率接近結構頻率時，橫風向振動被共振放大，通常比順風向擺動更大。這種擺動很少威脅強度，卻會讓高樓層的人感到暈眩、看到吊燈搖晃或聽到帷幕牆摩擦聲，因此設計目標常以「回歸期內頂層尖峰加速度」表示，而不是位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂層樓板加速度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first-mode frequency of a supertall tower is often below 0.2 Hz. As wind flows past a square or rounded section, vortices shed alternately on the leeward side and produce a periodic across-wind force; when the shedding frequency approaches the structural frequency, across-wind motion is amplified by resonance and usually exceeds along-wind sway. This motion rarely threatens strength, but upper-floor occupants feel queasy, see pendant lights swing or hear façade joints creak, so the design target is usually a peak top-floor acceleration for a given return period rather than a displacement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Top-floor acceleration” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦流脫落頻率 f_s = St·U/B。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vortex-shedding frequency f_s = St·U/B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頂層樓板加速度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Top-floor acceleration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風致振動與居住舒適度
knowledge.text: 超高層建築的第一模態頻率常低於 0.2 Hz，風吹過方形或圓角斷面時，背風側交替脫落的渦流會產生垂直於風向的週期性橫風力；當渦流脫落頻率接近結構頻率時，橫風向振動被共振放大，通常比順風向擺動更大。這種擺動很少威脅強度，卻會讓高樓層的人感到暈眩、看到吊燈搖晃或聽到帷幕牆摩擦聲，因此設計目標常以「回歸期內頂層尖峰加速度」表示，而不是位移。
knowledge.textEn: The first-mode frequency of a supertall tower is often below 0.2 Hz. As wind flows past a square or rounded section, vortices shed alternately on the leeward side and produce a periodic across-wind force; when the shedding frequency approaches the structural frequency, across-wind motion is amplified by resonance and usually exceeds along-wind sway.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風致振動與居住舒適度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" is correct?
options: 超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。
超高層建築的第一模態頻率常低於 0.2 Hz，風吹過方形或圓角斷面時，背風側交替脫落的渦流會產生垂直於風向的週期性橫風力。
阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。
optionsEn: Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened.
The first-mode frequency of a supertall tower is often below 0.2 Hz.
A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight.
quiz.explanation: 超高層建築的第一模態頻率常低於 0.2 Hz，風吹過方形或圓角斷面時，背風側交替脫落的渦流會產生垂直於風向的週期性橫風力；當渦流脫落頻率接近結構頻率時，橫風向振動被共振放大，通常比順風向擺動更大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The first-mode frequency of a supertall tower is often below 0.2 Hz. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風致振動與居住舒適度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂層樓板加速度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top-floor acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦流脫落頻率 f_s = St·U/B。取方形斷面 St ≈ 0.12、寬度 B = 50 m、結構頻率 f₁ = 0.14 Hz，臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St = 0.14×50/0.12 ≈ 58 m/s；若改為斜角或退縮斷面使 St 分散，共振不再集中在單一風速。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex-shedding frequency f_s = St·U/B. With a square-section St ≈ 0.12, width B = 50 m and structural frequency f₁ = 0.14 Hz, the critical wind speed is U_cr = f₁·B/St = 0.14×50/0.12 ≈ 58 m/s; chamfered or tapered sections spread St so resonance no longer locks onto one wind speed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對風洞高頻力平衡（HFFB）或氣動彈性模型試驗得到的橫風向力頻譜與本步估算的臨界風速，並把試驗換算到實尺度的頂層加速度，與居住性準則（例如以半年或一年回歸期計的尖峰加速度限值）逐一比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the across-wind force spectrum from a high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) or aeroelastic wind-tunnel test with the critical wind speed estimated here, scale the test to full-size top-floor acceleration, and check it against habitability criteria such as peak-acceleration limits for a half-year or one-year return period.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 渦流脫落頻率 f_s = St·U/B。取方形斷面 St ≈ 0.12、寬度 B = 50 m、結構頻率 f₁ = 0.14 Hz，臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St = 0.14×50/0.12 ≈ 58 m/s；若改為斜角或退縮斷面使 St 分散，共振不再集中在單一風速。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Vortex-shedding frequency f_s = St·U/B. With a square-section St ≈ 0.12, width B = 50 m and structural frequency f₁ = 0.14 Hz, the critical wind speed is U_cr = f₁·B/St = 0.14×50/0.12 ≈ 58 m/s; chamfered or tapered sections spread St so resonance no longer locks onto one wind speed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風致振動與居住舒適度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。
阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。
渦流脫落頻率 f_s = St·U/B。
optionsEn: The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction.
A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site.
Vortex-shedding frequency f_s = St·U/B.
quiz.explanation: 渦流脫落頻率 f_s = St·U/B。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Vortex-shedding frequency f_s = St·U/B. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風致振動與居住舒適度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂層樓板加速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Top-floor acceleration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對風洞高頻力平衡（HFFB）或氣動彈性模型試驗得到的橫風向力頻譜與本步估算的臨界風速，並把試驗換算到實尺度的頂層加速度，與居住性準則（例如以半年或一年回歸期計的尖峰加速度限值）逐一比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the across-wind force spectrum from a high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) or aeroelastic wind-tunnel test with the critical wind speed estimated here, scale the test to full-size top-floor acceleration, and check it against habitability criteria such as peak-acceleration limits for a half-year or one-year return period. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計階段就要在頂部機械層預留阻尼器的空間、樓板承載與維修動線，並在風洞報告中要求同時提供有無阻尼器兩種情境的加速度預測，作為業主決策依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reserve damper space, slab capacity and maintenance access in the top mechanical levels from the design stage, and require the wind-tunnel report to predict accelerations both with and without a damper so the owner can decide.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只做順風向靜力設計而忽略橫風向共振，結構強度合格，但完工後在中等強風就出現明顯擺動與住戶抱怨，事後才補裝阻尼器時，樓層空間、承載與吊裝路徑都已受限。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only for along-wind static load and ignoring across-wind resonance passes strength checks, yet after completion moderate winds cause noticeable sway and complaints; retrofitting a damper then finds floor space, load capacity and lifting routes already constrained. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對風洞高頻力平衡（HFFB）或氣動彈性模型試驗得到的橫風向力頻譜與本步估算的臨界風速，並把試驗換算到實尺度的頂層加速度，與居住性準則（例如以半年或一年回歸期計的尖峰加速度限值）逐一比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the across-wind force spectrum from a high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) or aeroelastic wind-tunnel test with the critical wind speed estimated here, scale the test to full-size top-floor acceleration, and check it against habitability criteria such as peak-acceleration limits for a half-year or one-year return period.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計階段就要在頂部機械層預留阻尼器的空間、樓板承載與維修動線，並在風洞報告中要求同時提供有無阻尼器兩種情境的加速度預測，作為業主決策依據。
knowledge.textEn: Reserve damper space, slab capacity and maintenance access in the top mechanical levels from the design stage, and require the wind-tunnel report to predict accelerations both with and without a damper so the owner can decide.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風致振動與居住舒適度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort"?
options: 比對風洞高頻力平衡（HFFB）或氣動彈性模型試驗得到的橫風向力頻譜與本步估算的臨界風速，並把試驗換算到實尺度的頂層加速度，與居住性準則（例如以半年或一年回歸期計的尖峰加速度限值）逐一比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。
optionsEn: Compare the across-wind force spectrum from a high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) or aeroelastic wind-tunnel test with the critical wind speed estimated here, scale the test to full-size top-floor acceleration, and check it against habitability criteria such as peak-acceleration limits for a half-year or one-year return period.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building.
quiz.explanation: 比對風洞高頻力平衡（HFFB）或氣動彈性模型試驗得到的橫風向力頻譜與本步估算的臨界風速，並把試驗換算到實尺度的頂層加速度，與居住性準則（例如以半年或一年回歸期計的尖峰加速度限值）逐一比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the across-wind force spectrum from a high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) or aeroelastic wind-tunnel test with the critical wind speed estimated here, scale the test to full-size top-floor acceleration, and check it against habitability criteria such as peak-acceleration limits for a half-year or one-year return period. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風致振動與居住舒適度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂層樓板加速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Top-floor acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只做順風向靜力設計而忽略橫風向共振，結構強度合格，但完工後在中等強風就出現明顯擺動與住戶抱怨，事後才補裝阻尼器時，樓層空間、承載與吊裝路徑都已受限。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only for along-wind static load and ignoring across-wind resonance passes strength checks, yet after completion moderate winds cause noticeable sway and complaints; retrofitting a damper then finds floor space, load capacity and lifting routes already constrained. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種擺動很少威脅強度，卻會讓高樓層的人感到暈眩、看到吊燈搖晃或聽到帷幕牆摩擦聲，因此設計目標常以「回歸期內頂層尖峰加速度」表示，而不是位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This motion rarely threatens strength, but upper-floor occupants feel queasy, see pendant lights swing or hear façade joints creak, so the design target is usually a peak top-floor acceleration for a given return period rather than a displacement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只做順風向靜力設計而忽略橫風向共振，結構強度合格，但完工後在中等強風就出現明顯擺動與住戶抱怨，事後才補裝阻尼器時，樓層空間、承載與吊裝路徑都已受限。
knowledge.textEn: Designing only for along-wind static load and ignoring across-wind resonance passes strength checks, yet after completion moderate winds cause noticeable sway and complaints; retrofitting a damper then finds floor space, load capacity and lifting routes already constrained.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風致振動與居住舒適度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只做順風向靜力設計而忽略橫風向共振，結構強度合格，但完工後在中等強風就出現明顯擺動與住戶抱怨，事後才補裝阻尼器時，樓層空間、承載與吊裝路徑都已受限。
阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing only for along-wind static load and ignoring across-wind resonance passes strength checks, yet after completion moderate winds cause noticeable sway and complaints.
A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight.
quiz.explanation: 若只做順風向靜力設計而忽略橫風向共振，結構強度合格，但完工後在中等強風就出現明顯擺動與住戶抱怨，事後才補裝阻尼器時，樓層空間、承載與吊裝路徑都已受限。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing only for along-wind static load and ignoring across-wind resonance passes strength checks, yet after completion moderate winds cause noticeable sway and complaints; retrofitting a damper then finds floor space, load capacity and lifting routes already constrained. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模態質量與雙自由度模型：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「第一彎曲模態」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “First bending mode” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 調諧質量阻尼器只對準一個模態，因此先把建築在該模態下簡化為等效單自由度系統：等效質量是以阻尼器所在位置的模態位移正規化後的廣義質量，而不是整棟樓的總重。阻尼器質量除以這個廣義質量就是質量比 μ，它決定了阻尼器能提供的最大附加阻尼；把擺錘與主結構串成雙自由度系統後，原本單一共振峰會分裂成兩個較低的峰。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「第一彎曲模態」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tuned mass damper targets a single mode, so the building is first reduced to an equivalent single-degree-of-freedom system for that mode. Its equivalent mass is the generalised mass normalised to the modal displacement at the damper location, not the total building weight. Damper mass divided by this generalised mass is the mass ratio μ, which bounds the added damping the device can supply; coupling the pendulum to the structure as a two-degree-of-freedom system splits the single resonance peak into two lower peaks. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “First bending mode” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：均勻懸臂第一模態以頂端位移正規化時，廣義質量約為總質量的 0.25。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a uniform cantilever normalised to tip displacement, the first-mode generalised mass is about 0.25 of the total mass.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「第一彎曲模態」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “First bending mode”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模態質量與雙自由度模型
knowledge.titleEn: Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model
knowledge.text: 調諧質量阻尼器只對準一個模態，因此先把建築在該模態下簡化為等效單自由度系統：等效質量是以阻尼器所在位置的模態位移正規化後的廣義質量，而不是整棟樓的總重。阻尼器質量除以這個廣義質量就是質量比 μ，它決定了阻尼器能提供的最大附加阻尼；把擺錘與主結構串成雙自由度系統後，原本單一共振峰會分裂成兩個較低的峰。
knowledge.textEn: A tuned mass damper targets a single mode, so the building is first reduced to an equivalent single-degree-of-freedom system for that mode. Its equivalent mass is the generalised mass normalised to the modal displacement at the damper location, not the total building weight.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模態質量與雙自由度模型」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model" is correct?
options: 阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。
質量塊越重，擺錘的擺動頻率就越低。
調諧質量阻尼器只對準一個模態，因此先把建築在該模態下簡化為等效單自由度系統：等效質量是以阻尼器所在位置的模態位移正規化後的廣義質量，而不是整棟樓的總重。
optionsEn: A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight.
The heavier the mass, the lower the pendulum frequency.
A tuned mass damper targets a single mode, so the building is first reduced to an equivalent single-degree-of-freedom system for that mode.
quiz.explanation: 調諧質量阻尼器只對準一個模態，因此先把建築在該模態下簡化為等效單自由度系統：等效質量是以阻尼器所在位置的模態位移正規化後的廣義質量，而不是整棟樓的總重。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tuned mass damper targets a single mode, so the building is first reduced to an equivalent single-degree-of-freedom system for that mode. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模態質量與雙自由度模型：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「第一彎曲模態」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “First bending mode” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：均勻懸臂第一模態以頂端位移正規化時，廣義質量約為總質量的 0.25。若參與擺動的質量取 400,000 t，M* ≈ 0.25×400,000 = 100,000 t；阻尼器 660 t 時 μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a uniform cantilever normalised to tip displacement, the first-mode generalised mass is about 0.25 of the total mass. Taking 400,000 t of participating mass gives M* ≈ 0.25×400,000 = 100,000 t; a 660 t damper then gives μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用有限元素模型取出阻尼器所在樓層的模態向量與廣義質量，與手算懸臂近似比較；再以雙自由度模型掃頻，確認加裝阻尼器後的頻率響應出現兩個峰且峰值低於無阻尼器時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Extract the modal vector and generalised mass at the damper floor from the finite-element model and compare with the hand cantilever estimate; then sweep the two-degree-of-freedom model to confirm that the response with the damper shows two peaks lower than the undamped peak.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 均勻懸臂第一模態以頂端位移正規化時，廣義質量約為總質量的 0.25。若參與擺動的質量取 400,000 t，M* ≈ 0.25×400,000 = 100,000 t；阻尼器 660 t 時 μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a uniform cantilever normalised to tip displacement, the first-mode generalised mass is about 0.25 of the total mass. Taking 400,000 t of participating mass gives M* ≈ 0.25×400,000 = 100,000 t; a 660 t damper then gives μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模態質量與雙自由度模型」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model", which statement holds?
options: 均勻懸臂第一模態以頂端位移正規化時，廣義質量約為總質量的 0.25。
質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。
只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。
optionsEn: For a uniform cantilever normalised to tip displacement, the first-mode generalised mass is about 0.25 of the total mass.
Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan.
Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption.
quiz.explanation: 均勻懸臂第一模態以頂端位移正規化時，廣義質量約為總質量的 0.25。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a uniform cantilever normalised to tip displacement, the first-mode generalised mass is about 0.25 of the total mass. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模態質量與雙自由度模型：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「第一彎曲模態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “First bending mode” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用有限元素模型取出阻尼器所在樓層的模態向量與廣義質量，與手算懸臂近似比較；再以雙自由度模型掃頻，確認加裝阻尼器後的頻率響應出現兩個峰且峰值低於無阻尼器時。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Extract the modal vector and generalised mass at the damper floor from the finite-element model and compare with the hand cantilever estimate; then sweep the two-degree-of-freedom model to confirm that the response with the damper shows two peaks lower than the undamped peak. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：阻尼器通常放在接近頂部、模態位移最大的樓層；若主要問題是第二模態或扭轉，需另行評估位置或採用多組阻尼器，並在結構計算書中寫明所針對的模態編號與方向。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Dampers usually sit near the top where modal displacement peaks; if the problem is the second mode or torsion, re-evaluate the location or use several devices, and state the targeted mode number and direction in the structural calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把整棟樓的總質量當成分母，會把質量比低估數倍，導致阻尼器設計過小；反之若把阻尼器放在模態位移小的樓層，等效質量變大，同一顆質量塊的效果大打折扣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total building mass as the denominator underestimates the mass ratio several-fold and undersizes the damper; conversely, placing the damper where the modal displacement is small inflates the equivalent mass and sharply reduces the benefit of the same block. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用有限元素模型取出阻尼器所在樓層的模態向量與廣義質量，與手算懸臂近似比較；再以雙自由度模型掃頻，確認加裝阻尼器後的頻率響應出現兩個峰且峰值低於無阻尼器時。
knowledge.textEn: Extract the modal vector and generalised mass at the damper floor from the finite-element model and compare with the hand cantilever estimate; then sweep the two-degree-of-freedom model to confirm that the response with the damper shows two peaks lower than the undamped peak.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 阻尼器通常放在接近頂部、模態位移最大的樓層；若主要問題是第二模態或扭轉，需另行評估位置或採用多組阻尼器，並在結構計算書中寫明所針對的模態編號與方向。
knowledge.textEn: Dampers usually sit near the top where modal displacement peaks; if the problem is the second mode or torsion, re-evaluate the location or use several devices, and state the targeted mode number and direction in the structural calculations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模態質量與雙自由度模型」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用有限元素模型取出阻尼器所在樓層的模態向量與廣義質量，與手算懸臂近似比較；再以雙自由度模型掃頻，確認加裝阻尼器後的頻率響應出現兩個峰且峰值低於無阻尼器時。
阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Extract the modal vector and generalised mass at the damper floor from the finite-element model and compare with the hand cantilever estimate.
A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response.
quiz.explanation: 用有限元素模型取出阻尼器所在樓層的模態向量與廣義質量，與手算懸臂近似比較；再以雙自由度模型掃頻，確認加裝阻尼器後的頻率響應出現兩個峰且峰值低於無阻尼器時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Extract the modal vector and generalised mass at the damper floor from the finite-element model and compare with the hand cantilever estimate; then sweep the two-degree-of-freedom model to confirm that the response with the damper shows two peaks lower than the undamped peak. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模態質量與雙自由度模型：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「第一彎曲模態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “First bending mode” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整棟樓的總質量當成分母，會把質量比低估數倍，導致阻尼器設計過小；反之若把阻尼器放在模態位移小的樓層，等效質量變大，同一顆質量塊的效果大打折扣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total building mass as the denominator underestimates the mass ratio several-fold and undersizes the damper; conversely, placing the damper where the modal displacement is small inflates the equivalent mass and sharply reduces the benefit of the same block. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：阻尼器質量除以這個廣義質量就是質量比 μ，它決定了阻尼器能提供的最大附加阻尼；把擺錘與主結構串成雙自由度系統後，原本單一共振峰會分裂成兩個較低的峰。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Damper mass divided by this generalised mass is the mass ratio μ, which bounds the added damping the device can supply; coupling the pendulum to the structure as a two-degree-of-freedom system splits the single resonance peak into two lower peaks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整棟樓的總質量當成分母，會把質量比低估數倍，導致阻尼器設計過小；反之若把阻尼器放在模態位移小的樓層，等效質量變大，同一顆質量塊的效果大打折扣。
knowledge.textEn: Using total building mass as the denominator underestimates the mass ratio several-fold and undersizes the damper; conversely, placing the damper where the modal displacement is small inflates the equivalent mass and sharply reduces the benefit of the same block.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模態質量與雙自由度模型」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Modal mass and the two-degree-of-freedom model" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
質量塊越重，擺錘的擺動頻率就越低。
把整棟樓的總質量當成分母，會把質量比低估數倍，導致阻尼器設計過小；反之若把阻尼器放在模態位移小的樓層，等效質量變大，同一顆質量塊的效果大打折扣。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The heavier the mass, the lower the pendulum frequency.
Using total building mass as the denominator underestimates the mass ratio several-fold and undersizes the damper.
quiz.explanation: 把整棟樓的總質量當成分母，會把質量比低估數倍，導致阻尼器設計過小；反之若把阻尼器放在模態位移小的樓層，等效質量變大，同一顆質量塊的效果大打折扣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total building mass as the denominator underestimates the mass ratio several-fold and undersizes the damper; conversely, placing the damper where the modal displacement is small inflates the equivalent mass and sharply reduces the benefit of the same block. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「擺錘頻率與懸吊幾何」與「耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pendulum frequency and suspension geometry" and "Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 擺錘頻率與懸吊幾何：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pendulum frequency and suspension geometry: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「擺錘質量塊與吊索」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pendulum mass and hangers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型阻尼器常做成單擺：質量塊由多組鋼索或鋼棒懸吊，擺動頻率只由有效擺長與重力加速度決定，與質量本身無關。這讓設計者能用擺長調頻，但低頻需要很長的擺長；當樓層高度不足時，可用多段折返擺、加裝水平彈簧或倒擺組合縮短實體高度。質量塊多以厚鋼板疊合，以便分件吊運並在現場組成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「擺錘質量塊與吊索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large dampers are often simple pendulums: the mass hangs from several sets of steel cables or rods, and the swing frequency depends only on the effective length and gravity, not on the mass. Designers can therefore tune by length, but low frequencies need long pendulums; when storey height is insufficient, folded multi-stage pendulums, horizontal springs or inverted-pendulum combinations shorten the physical height. The mass is usually built from stacked thick steel plates so it can be lifted in pieces and assembled on site. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pendulum mass and hangers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 擺錘頻率與懸吊幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pendulum frequency and suspension geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「擺錘質量塊與吊索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pendulum mass and hangers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單擺 f = (1/2π)·√(g/L)，故 L = g/(2πf)²。目標頻率 0.139 Hz 時 L = 9.81/(2π×0.139)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m；若頻率改為 0.20 Hz，L 只需約 6.2 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a simple pendulum f = (1/2π)·√(g/L), so L = g/(2πf)². A 0.139 Hz target gives L = 9.81/(2π×0.139)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m; a 0.20 Hz target needs only about 6.2 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以小振幅自由擺動量測擺錘週期（記錄至少 10 個週期取平均），換算有效擺長，並與吊點幾何與吊索伸長量計算比較；吊索張力以應變計或液壓千斤頂讀值確認各吊索受力均勻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the pendulum period from small free swings, averaging at least 10 cycles, convert to effective length, and compare with the hanger geometry and cable-stretch calculation; confirm equal hanger forces with strain gauges or hydraulic-jack readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 擺錘頻率與懸吊幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pendulum frequency and suspension geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擺錘質量塊與吊索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pendulum mass and hangers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以小振幅自由擺動量測擺錘週期（記錄至少 10 個週期取平均），換算有效擺長，並與吊點幾何與吊索伸長量計算比較；吊索張力以應變計或液壓千斤頂讀值確認各吊索受力均勻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the pendulum period from small free swings, averaging at least 10 cycles, convert to effective length, and compare with the hanger geometry and cable-stretch calculation; confirm equal hanger forces with strain gauges or hydraulic-jack readings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：質量塊分件設計時，每一片的重量要配合塔吊在該半徑的額定荷重與樓板臨時支撐，組裝順序寫入施工計畫；吊索端錨與吊點須設計成可檢查與可更換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When splitting the mass into pieces, size each plate to the tower-crane rating at that radius and to temporary slab shoring, write the assembly order into the construction plan, and make hanger terminations and pick points inspectable and replaceable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊索受力不均會讓質量塊傾斜並引入扭擺耦合，量到的頻率出現兩個相近峰值；若吊點連接或吊索端錨疲勞，長期擺動會造成鬆弛，頻率逐年漂移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unequal hanger forces tilt the mass and introduce torsional coupling, so the measured frequency shows two close peaks; fatigue at hanger connections or terminations lets long-term swinging cause slack and a frequency that drifts year by year. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 吊索受力不均會讓質量塊傾斜並引入扭擺耦合，量到的頻率出現兩個相近峰值；若吊點連接或吊索端錨疲勞，長期擺動會造成鬆弛，頻率逐年漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「黏滯阻尼器與渦電流板」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Viscous dampers and eddy-current plates” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 擺錘只負責與結構反相運動，真正把能量變成熱的是連接擺錘與樓板的阻尼元件。油壓黏滯阻尼器讓矽油通過活塞孔口，阻尼力與速度的 α 次方成正比；渦電流阻尼器則讓磁鐵在銅板上方移動，感應電流產生與速度成正比的拖曳力，沒有流體密封，改變磁鐵與銅板的間隙即可調整阻尼。兩者都必須在極低速度與毫米級振幅下仍能作用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「黏滯阻尼器與渦電流板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pendulum only moves out of phase with the structure; the damping device between the pendulum and the floor turns energy into heat. A hydraulic viscous damper forces silicone fluid through piston orifices, giving a force proportional to velocity raised to the power α; an eddy-current damper moves magnets over a copper plate so induced currents create a drag proportional to velocity, with no fluid seals and with damping adjusted by the magnet–plate gap. Both must work at very low velocities and millimetre amplitudes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Viscous dampers and eddy-current plates” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：最佳阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The optimum damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「黏滯阻尼器與渦電流板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Viscous dampers and eddy-current plates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流
knowledge.titleEn: Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current
knowledge.text: 擺錘只負責與結構反相運動，真正把能量變成熱的是連接擺錘與樓板的阻尼元件。油壓黏滯阻尼器讓矽油通過活塞孔口，阻尼力與速度的 α 次方成正比；渦電流阻尼器則讓磁鐵在銅板上方移動，感應電流產生與速度成正比的拖曳力，沒有流體密封，改變磁鐵與銅板的間隙即可調整阻尼。
knowledge.textEn: The pendulum only moves out of phase with the structure; the damping device between the pendulum and the floor turns energy into heat. A hydraulic viscous damper forces silicone fluid through piston orifices, giving a force proportional to velocity raised to the power α; an eddy-current damper moves magnets over a copper plate so induced currents create a drag proportional to velocity, with no fluid seals and with damping adjusted by the magnet–plate gap.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current" is correct?
options: 阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。
擺錘只負責與結構反相運動，真正把能量變成熱的是連接擺錘與樓板的阻尼元件。
質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。
optionsEn: The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction.
The pendulum only moves out of phase with the structure; the damping device between the pendulum and the floor turns energy into heat.
Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan.
quiz.explanation: 擺錘只負責與結構反相運動，真正把能量變成熱的是連接擺錘與樓板的阻尼元件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pendulum only moves out of phase with the structure; the damping device between the pendulum and the floor turns energy into heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏滯阻尼器與渦電流板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Viscous dampers and eddy-current plates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：最佳阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d。取 m_d = 660,000 kg、ζ_d = 0.049、ω_d = 2π×0.139 = 0.873 rad/s，c_d = 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m；若擺錘速度 0.2 m/s，總阻尼力約 11.3 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The optimum damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d. With m_d = 660,000 kg, ζ_d = 0.049 and ω_d = 2π×0.139 = 0.873 rad/s, c_d = 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m; at a pendulum velocity of 0.2 m/s the total damping force is about 11.3 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：阻尼器出廠前以試驗機做正弦力—速度試驗，涵蓋設計頻率附近多個振幅與溫度，繪出遲滯迴圈計算等效阻尼係數，與規格允差（例如 ±15%）比較；渦電流阻尼則量測不同間隙下的拖曳力曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery, test each damper on a rig with sinusoidal force–velocity runs at several amplitudes and temperatures near the design frequency, compute the equivalent damping coefficient from the hysteresis loops and compare with the specified tolerance such as ±15%; for eddy-current units, measure drag curves at several gaps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: The optimum damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d. With m_d = 660,000 kg, ζ_d = 0.049 and ω_d = 2π×0.139 = 0.873 rad/s, c_d = 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m; at a pendulum velocity of 0.2 m/s the total damping force is about 11.3 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current", which statement holds?
options: 只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。
阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。
最佳阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d。
optionsEn: Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption.
A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response.
The optimum damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d.
quiz.explanation: 最佳阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The optimum damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏滯阻尼器與渦電流板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Viscous dampers and eddy-current plates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器出廠前以試驗機做正弦力—速度試驗，涵蓋設計頻率附近多個振幅與溫度，繪出遲滯迴圈計算等效阻尼係數，與規格允差（例如 ±15%）比較；渦電流阻尼則量測不同間隙下的拖曳力曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery, test each damper on a rig with sinusoidal force–velocity runs at several amplitudes and temperatures near the design frequency, compute the equivalent damping coefficient from the hysteresis loops and compare with the specified tolerance such as ±15%; for eddy-current units, measure drag curves at several gaps. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規範要寫明低速啟動門檻、溫度範圍內的阻尼變化上限與耐久循環次數，並要求原型試驗與逐件試驗報告；渦電流方案需另檢查磁鐵固定與銅板散熱。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The procurement specification should state the low-velocity breakaway threshold, the maximum change of damping over the temperature range and the endurance cycles, and require prototype and production test reports; eddy-current designs also need checks on magnet retention and copper-plate heat dissipation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：黏滯阻尼器密封老化漏油會使阻尼係數下降、擺錘過度擺動；摩擦過大的導軌或密封則讓微小振幅時阻尼器「卡住」，阻尼器變成附加質量，平常強風幾乎沒有減振效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aged seals that leak oil reduce the damping coefficient and let the pendulum over-swing; excessive friction in guides or seals makes the damper stick at small amplitudes so it behaves like added mass and gives almost no reduction in ordinary strong winds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 阻尼器出廠前以試驗機做正弦力—速度試驗，涵蓋設計頻率附近多個振幅與溫度，繪出遲滯迴圈計算等效阻尼係數，與規格允差（例如 ±15%）比較；渦電流阻尼則量測不同間隙下的拖曳力曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery, test each damper on a rig with sinusoidal force–velocity runs at several amplitudes and temperatures near the design frequency, compute the equivalent damping coefficient from the hysteresis loops and compare with the specified tolerance such as ±15%; for eddy-current units, measure drag curves at several gaps.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購規範要寫明低速啟動門檻、溫度範圍內的阻尼變化上限與耐久循環次數，並要求原型試驗與逐件試驗報告；渦電流方案需另檢查磁鐵固定與銅板散熱。
knowledge.textEn: The procurement specification should state the low-velocity breakaway threshold, the maximum change of damping over the temperature range and the endurance cycles, and require prototype and production test reports; eddy-current designs also need checks on magnet retention and copper-plate heat dissipation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current"?
options: 阻尼器出廠前以試驗機做正弦力—速度試驗，涵蓋設計頻率附近多個振幅與溫度，繪出遲滯迴圈計算等效阻尼係數，與規格允差（例如 ±15%）比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。
optionsEn: Before delivery, test each damper on a rig with sinusoidal force–velocity runs at several amplitudes and temperatures near the design frequency, compute the equivalent damping coefficient from the hysteresis loops and compare with the specified tolerance such as ±15%.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器出廠前以試驗機做正弦力—速度試驗，涵蓋設計頻率附近多個振幅與溫度，繪出遲滯迴圈計算等效阻尼係數，與規格允差（例如 ±15%）比較；渦電流阻尼則量測不同間隙下的拖曳力曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery, test each damper on a rig with sinusoidal force–velocity runs at several amplitudes and temperatures near the design frequency, compute the equivalent damping coefficient from the hysteresis loops and compare with the specified tolerance such as ±15%; for eddy-current units, measure drag curves at several gaps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏滯阻尼器與渦電流板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Viscous dampers and eddy-current plates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 黏滯阻尼器密封老化漏油會使阻尼係數下降、擺錘過度擺動；摩擦過大的導軌或密封則讓微小振幅時阻尼器「卡住」，阻尼器變成附加質量，平常強風幾乎沒有減振效果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aged seals that leak oil reduce the damping coefficient and let the pendulum over-swing; excessive friction in guides or seals makes the damper stick at small amplitudes so it behaves like added mass and gives almost no reduction in ordinary strong winds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩者都必須在極低速度與毫米級振幅下仍能作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both must work at very low velocities and millimetre amplitudes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 黏滯阻尼器密封老化漏油會使阻尼係數下降、擺錘過度擺動；摩擦過大的導軌或密封則讓微小振幅時阻尼器「卡住」，阻尼器變成附加質量，平常強風幾乎沒有減振效果。
knowledge.textEn: Aged seals that leak oil reduce the damping coefficient and let the pendulum over-swing; excessive friction in guides or seals makes the damper stick at small amplitudes so it behaves like added mass and gives almost no reduction in ordinary strong winds.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「耗能元件：油壓黏滯與渦電流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dissipation devices: viscous fluid and eddy current" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
黏滯阻尼器密封老化漏油會使阻尼係數下降、擺錘過度擺動；摩擦過大的導軌或密封則讓微小振幅時阻尼器「卡住」，阻尼器變成附加質量，平常強風幾乎沒有減振效果。
質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Aged seals that leak oil reduce the damping coefficient and let the pendulum over-swing.
Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan.
quiz.explanation: 黏滯阻尼器密封老化漏油會使阻尼係數下降、擺錘過度擺動；摩擦過大的導軌或密封則讓微小振幅時阻尼器「卡住」，阻尼器變成附加質量，平常強風幾乎沒有減振效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Aged seals that leak oil reduce the damping coefficient and let the pendulum over-swing; excessive friction in guides or seals makes the damper stick at small amplitudes so it behaves like added mass and gives almost no reduction in ordinary strong winds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高空吊裝與分件組裝」與「實測頻率與現場調頻」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly" and "Measured frequency and on-site tuning": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高空吊裝與分件組裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「分層鋼板吊裝路徑」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plate-by-plate lifting route” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 數百公噸的質量塊無法一次吊上數百公尺高空，必須在結構封頂前把鋼板分件吊到預留樓層，再於臨時支撐上焊接或螺栓組成整體。吊裝期間樓板承受集中荷重，懸吊系統尚未受力，因此需要臨時支架承托質量塊；完成組裝後再逐步把荷重由臨時支架轉移到吊索，這個轉移過程決定了吊索初始張力是否均勻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「分層鋼板吊裝路徑」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A mass of several hundred tonnes cannot be hoisted to several hundred metres in one lift, so steel plates are raised piece by piece to the reserved floors before the structure is topped out, then welded or bolted together on temporary supports. During this phase the slab carries concentrated loads while the suspension is not yet loaded, so temporary frames hold the mass; after assembly the load is transferred step by step from the frames to the hangers, and this transfer determines whether the initial hanger tensions are even. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Plate-by-plate lifting route” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：質量 660 t 分成 41 片時，平均每片約 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t；若塔吊在 30 m 半徑的額定荷重為 20 t，扣除吊具 1.5 t 後仍有約 2.4 t 餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Splitting 660 t into 41 plates gives about 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t each; with a 20 t tower-crane rating at 30 m radius and 1.5 t of rigging, about 2.4 t of margin remains.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 高空吊裝與分件組裝
knowledge.text: 數百公噸的質量塊無法一次吊上數百公尺高空，必須在結構封頂前把鋼板分件吊到預留樓層，再於臨時支撐上焊接或螺栓組成整體。吊裝期間樓板承受集中荷重，懸吊系統尚未受力，因此需要臨時支架承托質量塊；完成組裝後再逐步把荷重由臨時支架轉移到吊索，這個轉移過程決定了吊索初始張力是否均勻。
knowledge.textEn: A mass of several hundred tonnes cannot be hoisted to several hundred metres in one lift, so steel plates are raised piece by piece to the reserved floors before the structure is topped out, then welded or bolted together on temporary supports. During this phase the slab carries concentrated loads while the suspension is not yet loaded, so temporary frames hold the mass; after assembly the load is transferred step by step from the frames to the hangers, and this transfer determines whether the initial hanger tensions are even.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高空吊裝與分件組裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly" is correct?
options: 質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。
阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。
數百公噸的質量塊無法一次吊上數百公尺高空，必須在結構封頂前把鋼板分件吊到預留樓層，再於臨時支撐上焊接或螺栓組成整體。
optionsEn: Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan.
A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site.

A mass of several hundred tonnes cannot be hoisted to several hundred metres in one lift, so steel plates are raised piece by piece to the reserved floors before the structure is topped out, then welded or bolted together on temporary supports.
quiz.explanation: 數百公噸的質量塊無法一次吊上數百公尺高空，必須在結構封頂前把鋼板分件吊到預留樓層，再於臨時支撐上焊接或螺栓組成整體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A mass of several hundred tonnes cannot be hoisted to several hundred metres in one lift, so steel plates are raised piece by piece to the reserved floors before the structure is topped out, then welded or bolted together on temporary supports. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高空吊裝與分件組裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層鋼板吊裝路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plate-by-plate lifting route” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：質量 660 t 分成 41 片時，平均每片約 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t；若塔吊在 30 m 半徑的額定荷重為 20 t，扣除吊具 1.5 t 後仍有約 2.4 t 餘裕。臨時支架若以 8 支柱承托，每支約 81 t。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Splitting 660 t into 41 plates gives about 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t each; with a 20 t tower-crane rating at 30 m radius and 1.5 t of rigging, about 2.4 t of margin remains. Eight temporary posts would each carry about 81 t. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每一吊次的重量、半徑與塔吊荷重表，吊裝前由第三方確認吊具；荷重轉移時以液壓千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計同步記錄，並量測質量塊水平度與各支架卸載量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check each lift's weight and radius against the crane load chart and have rigging verified by a third party; during load transfer, record jack pressures and hanger strain gauges together and measure the block's levelness and the unloading of each frame.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 質量 660 t 分成 41 片時，平均每片約 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t；若塔吊在 30 m 半徑的額定荷重為 20 t，扣除吊具 1.5 t 後仍有約 2.4 t 餘裕。臨時支架若以 8 支柱承托，每支約 81 t。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高空吊裝與分件組裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。

optionsEn: Splitting 660 t into 41 plates gives about 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t each.
Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building.
A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring.
