quiz.explanationEn: Splitting 660 t into 41 plates gives about 660/41 ≈ 16.1 t each; with a 20 t tower-crane rating at 30 m radius and 1.5 t of rigging, about 2.4 t of margin remains. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高空吊裝與分件組裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層鋼板吊裝路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plate-by-plate lifting route” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每一吊次的重量、半徑與塔吊荷重表，吊裝前由第三方確認吊具；荷重轉移時以液壓千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計同步記錄，並量測質量塊水平度與各支架卸載量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check each lift's weight and radius against the crane load chart and have rigging verified by a third party; during load transfer, record jack pressures and hanger strain gauges together and measure the block's levelness and the unloading of each frame. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應包含吊次清單、樓板臨時支撐計算、荷重轉移的分級步驟與停止條件（例如任一吊索張力偏差超過 10% 即暫停調整），並由結構設計者簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan should include a lift schedule, slab shoring calculations, staged load-transfer steps with hold points (for example pause and adjust if any hanger tension deviates by more than 10%), signed off by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若荷重轉移時某支吊索先受力，質量塊會傾斜並在吊點產生超過設計值的局部應力；臨時支架移除順序錯誤也可能造成樓板局部超載與裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If one hanger picks up load first during transfer, the block tilts and local stresses at its pick point exceed design values; removing temporary frames in the wrong order can locally overload and crack the slab. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對每一吊次的重量、半徑與塔吊荷重表，吊裝前由第三方確認吊具；荷重轉移時以液壓千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計同步記錄，並量測質量塊水平度與各支架卸載量。
knowledge.textEn: Check each lift's weight and radius against the crane load chart and have rigging verified by a third party; during load transfer, record jack pressures and hanger strain gauges together and measure the block's levelness and the unloading of each frame.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫應包含吊次清單、樓板臨時支撐計算、荷重轉移的分級步驟與停止條件（例如任一吊索張力偏差超過 10% 即暫停調整），並由結構設計者簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan should include a lift schedule, slab shoring calculations, staged load-transfer steps with hold points (for example pause and adjust if any hanger tension deviates by more than 10%), signed off by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高空吊裝與分件組裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
核對每一吊次的重量、半徑與塔吊荷重表，吊裝前由第三方確認吊具；荷重轉移時以液壓千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計同步記錄，並量測質量塊水平度與各支架卸載量。
阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check each lift's weight and radius against the crane load chart and have rigging verified by a third party.
A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight.
quiz.explanation: 核對每一吊次的重量、半徑與塔吊荷重表，吊裝前由第三方確認吊具；荷重轉移時以液壓千斤頂讀值與吊索應變計同步記錄，並量測質量塊水平度與各支架卸載量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check each lift's weight and radius against the crane load chart and have rigging verified by a third party; during load transfer, record jack pressures and hanger strain gauges together and measure the block's levelness and the unloading of each frame. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高空吊裝與分件組裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層鋼板吊裝路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plate-by-plate lifting route” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若荷重轉移時某支吊索先受力，質量塊會傾斜並在吊點產生超過設計值的局部應力；臨時支架移除順序錯誤也可能造成樓板局部超載與裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If one hanger picks up load first during transfer, the block tilts and local stresses at its pick point exceed design values; removing temporary frames in the wrong order can locally overload and crack the slab. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊裝期間樓板承受集中荷重，懸吊系統尚未受力，因此需要臨時支架承托質量塊；完成組裝後再逐步把荷重由臨時支架轉移到吊索，這個轉移過程決定了吊索初始張力是否均勻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During this phase the slab carries concentrated loads while the suspension is not yet loaded, so temporary frames hold the mass; after assembly the load is transferred step by step from the frames to the hangers, and this transfer determines whether the initial hanger tensions are even.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若荷重轉移時某支吊索先受力，質量塊會傾斜並在吊點產生超過設計值的局部應力；臨時支架移除順序錯誤也可能造成樓板局部超載與裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: If one hanger picks up load first during transfer, the block tilts and local stresses at its pick point exceed design values; removing temporary frames in the wrong order can locally overload and crack the slab.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高空吊裝與分件組裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High-level lifting and piece-by-piece assembly" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。
若荷重轉移時某支吊索先受力，質量塊會傾斜並在吊點產生超過設計值的局部應力；臨時支架移除順序錯誤也可能造成樓板局部超載與裂縫。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site.
If one hanger picks up load first during transfer, the block tilts and local stresses at its pick point exceed design values.
quiz.explanation: 若荷重轉移時某支吊索先受力，質量塊會傾斜並在吊點產生超過設計值的局部應力；臨時支架移除順序錯誤也可能造成樓板局部超載與裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If one hanger picks up load first during transfer, the block tilts and local stresses at its pick point exceed design values; removing temporary frames in the wrong order can locally overload and crack the slab. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 實測頻率與現場調頻：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measured frequency and on-site tuning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「現場調頻機構」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “On-site tuning mechanism” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 完工建築的實際頻率常與設計模型相差一到兩成，因為非結構牆、帷幕牆、混凝土實際勁度與質量分布都與假設不同；調諧質量阻尼器的最佳頻帶很窄，所以必須在結構與主要裝修完成後量測實際頻率，再調整擺長、彈簧勁度或附加質量，使阻尼器頻率落在最佳比值附近。調頻設計要預留雙向調整範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「現場調頻機構」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The real frequency of a completed building often differs from the design model by ten to twenty percent, because partitions, the façade, actual concrete stiffness and mass distribution differ from the assumptions. A tuned mass damper has a narrow optimum band, so the actual frequency must be measured after the structure and major fit-out are complete, and the pendulum length, spring stiffness or added mass adjusted to place the damper frequency near the optimum ratio. The tuning hardware must allow adjustment in both directions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “On-site tuning mechanism” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Den Hartog 最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Den Hartog optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「現場調頻機構」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “On-site tuning mechanism”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 實測頻率與現場調頻
knowledge.text: 完工建築的實際頻率常與設計模型相差一到兩成，因為非結構牆、帷幕牆、混凝土實際勁度與質量分布都與假設不同；調諧質量阻尼器的最佳頻帶很窄，所以必須在結構與主要裝修完成後量測實際頻率，再調整擺長、彈簧勁度或附加質量，使阻尼器頻率落在最佳比值附近。調頻設計要預留雙向調整範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The real frequency of a completed building often differs from the design model by ten to twenty percent, because partitions, the façade, actual concrete stiffness and mass distribution differ from the assumptions. A tuned mass damper has a narrow optimum band, so the actual frequency must be measured after the structure and major fit-out are complete, and the pendulum length, spring stiffness or added mass adjusted to place the damper frequency near the optimum ratio.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「實測頻率與現場調頻」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measured frequency and on-site tuning" is correct?
options: 完工建築的實際頻率常與設計模型相差一到兩成，因為非結構牆、帷幕牆、混凝土實際勁度與質量分布都與假設不同。
阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。
只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。
optionsEn: The real frequency of a completed building often differs from the design model by ten to twenty percent, because partitions, the façade, actual concrete stiffness and mass distribution differ from the assumptions.
A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site.
Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption.
quiz.explanation: 完工建築的實際頻率常與設計模型相差一到兩成，因為非結構牆、帷幕牆、混凝土實際勁度與質量分布都與假設不同；調諧質量阻尼器的最佳頻帶很窄，所以必須在結構與主要裝修完成後量測實際頻率，再調整擺長、彈簧勁度或附加質量，使阻尼器頻率落在最佳比值附近。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The real frequency of a completed building often differs from the design model by ten to twenty percent, because partitions, the façade, actual concrete stiffness and mass distribution differ from the assumptions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 實測頻率與現場調頻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measured frequency and on-site tuning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「現場調頻機構」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “On-site tuning mechanism” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Den Hartog 最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ)。μ = 0.0066 時 f_opt = 0.9934，結構實測 0.140 Hz 對應阻尼器 0.139 Hz。由 L ∝ 1/f²，頻率要降 5% 時擺長須增加 1/0.95² − 1 ≈ 10.8%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Den Hartog optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ). For μ = 0.0066, f_opt = 0.9934, so a measured 0.140 Hz building calls for a 0.139 Hz damper. Because L ∝ 1/f², lowering the frequency by 5% needs a length increase of 1/0.95² − 1 ≈ 10.8%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以環境振動量測取得結構實際頻率後，先鎖定擺錘量一次、再釋放擺錘量一次，確認雙峰位置大致對稱；調整後重新做自由衰減或強制振動試驗，記錄最終擺長與頻率比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After ambient measurement of the actual building frequency, measure once with the pendulum locked and once released, confirming that the two peaks are roughly symmetric; after adjustment repeat a free-decay or forced-vibration test and record the final length and frequency ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Den Hartog 最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ)。μ = 0.0066 時 f_opt = 0.9934，結構實測 0.140 Hz 對應阻尼器 0.139 Hz。由 L ∝ 1/f²，頻率要降 5% 時擺長須增加 1/0.95² − 1 ≈ 10.8%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The Den Hartog optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ). For μ = 0.0066, f_opt = 0.9934, so a measured 0.140 Hz building calls for a 0.139 Hz damper. Because L ∝ 1/f², lowering the frequency by 5% needs a length increase of 1/0.95² − 1 ≈ 10.8%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「實測頻率與現場調頻」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measured frequency and on-site tuning", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。
Den Hartog 最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ)。
超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。
optionsEn: A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response.
The Den Hartog optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ).
Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened.
quiz.explanation: Den Hartog 最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The Den Hartog optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 實測頻率與現場調頻：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measured frequency and on-site tuning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「現場調頻機構」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “On-site tuning mechanism” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以環境振動量測取得結構實際頻率後，先鎖定擺錘量一次、再釋放擺錘量一次，確認雙峰位置大致對稱；調整後重新做自由衰減或強制振動試驗，記錄最終擺長與頻率比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After ambient measurement of the actual building frequency, measure once with the pendulum locked and once released, confirming that the two peaks are roughly symmetric; after adjustment repeat a free-decay or forced-vibration test and record the final length and frequency ratio. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把調頻機構（可調吊點、加減配重或彈簧）納入設計與合約範圍，並安排在帷幕牆與主要機電完成後的固定時程進行調頻驗收，必要時一年後再複核一次。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Include the tuning hardware (adjustable pick points, removable weights or springs) in the design and contract, schedule tuning acceptance after the façade and major services are complete, and re-check after about a year if needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以設計頻率直接製造而不預留調整，實際頻率偏離 5% 時，雙自由度模型顯示等效阻尼可能由約 3.7% 降到約 2.1%，加速度改善幅度明顯縮水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Building to the design frequency without adjustment range means that a 5% offset in the actual frequency can drop the equivalent damping in the two-degree-of-freedom model from about 3.7% to about 2.1%, sharply shrinking the acceleration benefit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以環境振動量測取得結構實際頻率後，先鎖定擺錘量一次、再釋放擺錘量一次，確認雙峰位置大致對稱；調整後重新做自由衰減或強制振動試驗，記錄最終擺長與頻率比。
knowledge.textEn: After ambient measurement of the actual building frequency, measure once with the pendulum locked and once released, confirming that the two peaks are roughly symmetric; after adjustment repeat a free-decay or forced-vibration test and record the final length and frequency ratio.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把調頻機構（可調吊點、加減配重或彈簧）納入設計與合約範圍，並安排在帷幕牆與主要機電完成後的固定時程進行調頻驗收，必要時一年後再複核一次。
knowledge.textEn: Include the tuning hardware (adjustable pick points, removable weights or springs) in the design and contract, schedule tuning acceptance after the façade and major services are complete, and re-check after about a year if needed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「實測頻率與現場調頻」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measured frequency and on-site tuning"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
質量塊越重，擺錘的擺動頻率就越低。
以環境振動量測取得結構實際頻率後，先鎖定擺錘量一次、再釋放擺錘量一次，確認雙峰位置大致對稱；調整後重新做自由衰減或強制振動試驗，記錄最終擺長與頻率比。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The heavier the mass, the lower the pendulum frequency.
After ambient measurement of the actual building frequency, measure once with the pendulum locked and once released, confirming that the two peaks are roughly symmetric.
quiz.explanation: 以環境振動量測取得結構實際頻率後，先鎖定擺錘量一次、再釋放擺錘量一次，確認雙峰位置大致對稱；調整後重新做自由衰減或強制振動試驗，記錄最終擺長與頻率比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After ambient measurement of the actual building frequency, measure once with the pendulum locked and once released, confirming that the two peaks are roughly symmetric; after adjustment repeat a free-decay or forced-vibration test and record the final length and frequency ratio. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 實測頻率與現場調頻：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measured frequency and on-site tuning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「現場調頻機構」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “On-site tuning mechanism” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以設計頻率直接製造而不預留調整，實際頻率偏離 5% 時，雙自由度模型顯示等效阻尼可能由約 3.7% 降到約 2.1%，加速度改善幅度明顯縮水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Building to the design frequency without adjustment range means that a 5% offset in the actual frequency can drop the equivalent damping in the two-degree-of-freedom model from about 3.7% to about 2.1%, sharply shrinking the acceleration benefit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：調頻設計要預留雙向調整範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The tuning hardware must allow adjustment in both directions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以設計頻率直接製造而不預留調整，實際頻率偏離 5% 時，雙自由度模型顯示等效阻尼可能由約 3.7% 降到約 2.1%，加速度改善幅度明顯縮水。
knowledge.textEn: Building to the design frequency without adjustment range means that a 5% offset in the actual frequency can drop the equivalent damping in the two-degree-of-freedom model from about 3.7% to about 2.1%, sharply shrinking the acceleration benefit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「實測頻率與現場調頻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measured frequency and on-site tuning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若以設計頻率直接製造而不預留調整，實際頻率偏離 5% 時，雙自由度模型顯示等效阻尼可能由約 3.7% 降到約 2.1%，加速度改善幅度明顯縮水。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。
optionsEn: Building to the design frequency without adjustment range means that a 5% offset in the actual frequency can drop the equivalent damping in the two-degree-of-freedom model from about 3.7% to about 2.1%, sharply shrinking the acceleration benefit.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption.
quiz.explanation: 若以設計頻率直接製造而不預留調整，實際頻率偏離 5% 時，雙自由度模型顯示等效阻尼可能由約 3.7% 降到約 2.1%，加速度改善幅度明顯縮水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Building to the design frequency without adjustment range means that a 5% offset in the actual frequency can drop the equivalent damping in the two-degree-of-freedom model from about 3.7% to about 2.1%, sharply shrinking the acceleration benefit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環境振動量測與系統識別」與「阻尼器整體性能驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" and "Whole-system damper performance verification": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環境振動量測與系統識別：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ambient vibration measurement and system identification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂層加速度計陣列」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top-level accelerometer array” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 高樓在日常風與交通擾動下一直有微小振動，只要在頂部與阻尼器上放置高靈敏度加速度計長時間記錄，就能用頻域分解或峰值挑選法辨識模態頻率、振型與阻尼比。量測要同時涵蓋兩個水平方向與扭轉（至少兩個角落），並同步記錄風速風向，才能把阻尼比與振幅、風況關聯起來；超高層阻尼比往往隨振幅改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂層加速度計陣列」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tall building vibrates slightly all the time under everyday wind and traffic, so long records from sensitive accelerometers at the top and on the damper let engineers identify modal frequencies, shapes and damping ratios by frequency-domain decomposition or peak picking. Measurements must cover both horizontal directions and torsion (at least two corners) and be synchronised with wind speed and direction, so that damping can be related to amplitude and wind condition; damping in supertall towers often changes with amplitude. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Top-level accelerometer array” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：半功率頻寬法 ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The half-power bandwidth method gives ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頂層加速度計陣列」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Top-level accelerometer array”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環境振動量測與系統識別
knowledge.titleEn: Ambient vibration measurement and system identification
knowledge.text: 高樓在日常風與交通擾動下一直有微小振動，只要在頂部與阻尼器上放置高靈敏度加速度計長時間記錄，就能用頻域分解或峰值挑選法辨識模態頻率、振型與阻尼比。量測要同時涵蓋兩個水平方向與扭轉（至少兩個角落），並同步記錄風速風向，才能把阻尼比與振幅、風況關聯起來；超高層阻尼比往往隨振幅改變。
knowledge.textEn: A tall building vibrates slightly all the time under everyday wind and traffic, so long records from sensitive accelerometers at the top and on the damper let engineers identify modal frequencies, shapes and damping ratios by frequency-domain decomposition or peak picking. Measurements must cover both horizontal directions and torsion (at least two corners) and be synchronised with wind speed and direction, so that damping can be related to amplitude and wind condition; damping in supertall towers often changes with amplitude.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環境振動量測與系統識別」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" is correct?
options: 只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。
高樓在日常風與交通擾動下一直有微小振動，只要在頂部與阻尼器上放置高靈敏度加速度計長時間記錄，就能用頻域分解或峰值挑選法辨識模態頻率、振型與阻尼比。
阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。
optionsEn: Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption.

A tall building vibrates slightly all the time under everyday wind and traffic, so long records from sensitive accelerometers at the top and on the damper let engineers identify modal frequencies, shapes and damping ratios by frequency-domain decomposition or peak picking.
Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building.
quiz.explanation: 高樓在日常風與交通擾動下一直有微小振動，只要在頂部與阻尼器上放置高靈敏度加速度計長時間記錄，就能用頻域分解或峰值挑選法辨識模態頻率、振型與阻尼比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tall building vibrates slightly all the time under everyday wind and traffic, so long records from sensitive accelerometers at the top and on the damper let engineers identify modal frequencies, shapes and damping ratios by frequency-domain decomposition or peak picking. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環境振動量測與系統識別：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ambient vibration measurement and system identification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂層加速度計陣列」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top-level accelerometer array” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：半功率頻寬法 ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n)。若共振峰 f_n = 0.140 Hz，半功率點 f₁ = 0.1383 Hz、f₂ = 0.1418 Hz，則 ζ ≈ 0.0035/0.280 ≈ 1.25%；頻率解析度需優於 0.0005 Hz，記錄長度至少約 1/0.0005 = 2,000 s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The half-power bandwidth method gives ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n). With a peak at f_n = 0.140 Hz and half-power points at f₁ = 0.1383 Hz and f₂ = 0.1418 Hz, ζ ≈ 0.0035/0.280 ≈ 1.25%; resolving 0.0005 Hz needs a record of at least about 1/0.0005 = 2,000 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩種辨識方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間法）得到的頻率與阻尼，差異應在可解釋範圍內；感測器先在地面並排做相互比對，記錄方位與安裝位置照片，並把結果與有限元素模態比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare frequencies and damping from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and require explainable agreement; co-locate sensors on the ground first for a huddle test, record orientations and mounting photographs, and compare results with finite-element modes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 半功率頻寬法 ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n)。若共振峰 f_n = 0.140 Hz，半功率點 f₁ = 0.1383 Hz、f₂ = 0.1418 Hz，則 ζ ≈ 0.0035/0.280 ≈ 1.25%；頻率解析度需優於 0.0005 Hz，記錄長度至少約 1/0.0005 = 2,000 s。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The half-power bandwidth method gives ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n). With a peak at f_n = 0.140 Hz and half-power points at f₁ = 0.1383 Hz and f₂ = 0.1418 Hz, ζ ≈ 0.0035/0.280 ≈ 1.25%; resolving 0.0005 Hz needs a record of at least about 1/0.0005 = 2,000 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環境振動量測與系統識別」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。
阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。
半功率頻寬法 ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n)。
optionsEn: A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring.
A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight.
The half-power bandwidth method gives ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n).
quiz.explanation: 半功率頻寬法 ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The half-power bandwidth method gives ζ ≈ (f₂ − f₁)/(2f_n). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環境振動量測與系統識別：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ambient vibration measurement and system identification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂層加速度計陣列」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Top-level accelerometer array” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩種辨識方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間法）得到的頻率與阻尼，差異應在可解釋範圍內；感測器先在地面並排做相互比對，記錄方位與安裝位置照片，並把結果與有限元素模態比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare frequencies and damping from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and require explainable agreement; co-locate sensors on the ground first for a huddle test, record orientations and mounting photographs, and compare results with finite-element modes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測系統應包含時間同步、遠端資料傳輸與資料品質檢查（缺值、飽和、漂移），量測報告需附原始資料格式與處理參數，方便日後由他人重算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring system should include time synchronisation, remote data transfer and data-quality checks (gaps, saturation, drift), and the report should attach the raw data format and processing parameters so others can recompute later.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：記錄太短或頻率解析度不足時，半功率頻寬被放大，算出的阻尼比偏高，讓人誤以為阻尼器表現良好；感測器方向裝反則會把兩個方向的模態混在一起。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Records that are too short or too coarse in frequency inflate the half-power bandwidth and overstate damping, suggesting the damper performs better than it does; a reversed sensor orientation mixes the modes of the two directions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較兩種辨識方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間法）得到的頻率與阻尼，差異應在可解釋範圍內；感測器先在地面並排做相互比對，記錄方位與安裝位置照片，並把結果與有限元素模態比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compare frequencies and damping from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and require explainable agreement; co-locate sensors on the ground first for a huddle test, record orientations and mounting photographs, and compare results with finite-element modes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測系統應包含時間同步、遠端資料傳輸與資料品質檢查（缺值、飽和、漂移），量測報告需附原始資料格式與處理參數，方便日後由他人重算。
knowledge.textEn: The monitoring system should include time synchronisation, remote data transfer and data-quality checks (gaps, saturation, drift), and the report should attach the raw data format and processing parameters so others can recompute later.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境振動量測與系統識別」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification"?
options: 比較兩種辨識方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間法）得到的頻率與阻尼，差異應在可解釋範圍內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。
optionsEn: Compare frequencies and damping from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and require explainable agreement.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction.
quiz.explanation: 比較兩種辨識方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間法）得到的頻率與阻尼，差異應在可解釋範圍內；感測器先在地面並排做相互比對，記錄方位與安裝位置照片，並把結果與有限元素模態比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare frequencies and damping from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and require explainable agreement; co-locate sensors on the ground first for a huddle test, record orientations and mounting photographs, and compare results with finite-element modes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環境振動量測與系統識別：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ambient vibration measurement and system identification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂層加速度計陣列」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Top-level accelerometer array” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 記錄太短或頻率解析度不足時，半功率頻寬被放大，算出的阻尼比偏高，讓人誤以為阻尼器表現良好；感測器方向裝反則會把兩個方向的模態混在一起。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Records that are too short or too coarse in frequency inflate the half-power bandwidth and overstate damping, suggesting the damper performs better than it does; a reversed sensor orientation mixes the modes of the two directions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測要同時涵蓋兩個水平方向與扭轉（至少兩個角落），並同步記錄風速風向，才能把阻尼比與振幅、風況關聯起來；超高層阻尼比往往隨振幅改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measurements must cover both horizontal directions and torsion (at least two corners) and be synchronised with wind speed and direction, so that damping can be related to amplitude and wind condition; damping in supertall towers often changes with amplitude.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 記錄太短或頻率解析度不足時，半功率頻寬被放大，算出的阻尼比偏高，讓人誤以為阻尼器表現良好；感測器方向裝反則會把兩個方向的模態混在一起。
knowledge.textEn: Records that are too short or too coarse in frequency inflate the half-power bandwidth and overstate damping, suggesting the damper performs better than it does; a reversed sensor orientation mixes the modes of the two directions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環境振動量測與系統識別」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
記錄太短或頻率解析度不足時，半功率頻寬被放大，算出的阻尼比偏高，讓人誤以為阻尼器表現良好；感測器方向裝反則會把兩個方向的模態混在一起。
阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Records that are too short or too coarse in frequency inflate the half-power bandwidth and overstate damping, suggesting the damper performs better than it does.
Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building.
quiz.explanation: 記錄太短或頻率解析度不足時，半功率頻寬被放大，算出的阻尼比偏高，讓人誤以為阻尼器表現良好；感測器方向裝反則會把兩個方向的模態混在一起。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Records that are too short or too coarse in frequency inflate the half-power bandwidth and overstate damping, suggesting the damper performs better than it does; a reversed sensor orientation mixes the modes of the two directions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 阻尼器整體性能驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Whole-system damper performance verification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「自由衰減與強制振動試驗」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-decay and forced-vibration tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 零件試驗合格不代表裝在樓上的整套系統合格，因此完工後要做系統級驗證：可用千斤頂或纜線把擺錘拉離平衡位置後釋放，觀察擺錘與結構的自由衰減；也可用阻尼器自身或附加的作動器做強制振動掃頻。藉由比較鎖定與釋放擺錘時結構的衰減率或頻率響應，直接得到阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「自由衰減與強制振動試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passing component tests does not prove the installed system, so after completion a system-level verification is done: pull the pendulum off equilibrium with jacks or cables and release it to observe the free decay of the pendulum and structure, or use the damper itself or an added actuator for a forced-vibration sweep. Comparing structural decay or frequency response with the pendulum locked and released gives the added damping directly. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Free-decay and forced-vibration tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ)，ζ ≈ δ/(2π)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The logarithmic decrement is δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ) with ζ ≈ δ/(2π).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「自由衰減與強制振動試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Free-decay and forced-vibration tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 阻尼器整體性能驗證
knowledge.text: 零件試驗合格不代表裝在樓上的整套系統合格，因此完工後要做系統級驗證：可用千斤頂或纜線把擺錘拉離平衡位置後釋放，觀察擺錘與結構的自由衰減；也可用阻尼器自身或附加的作動器做強制振動掃頻。藉由比較鎖定與釋放擺錘時結構的衰減率或頻率響應，直接得到阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
knowledge.textEn: Passing component tests does not prove the installed system, so after completion a system-level verification is done: pull the pendulum off equilibrium with jacks or cables and release it to observe the free decay of the pendulum and structure, or use the damper itself or an added actuator for a forced-vibration sweep. Comparing structural decay or frequency response with the pendulum locked and released gives the added damping directly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「阻尼器整體性能驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Whole-system damper performance verification" is correct?
options: 阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。
阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。
零件試驗合格不代表裝在樓上的整套系統合格，因此完工後要做系統級驗證：可用千斤頂或纜線把擺錘拉離平衡位置後釋放，觀察擺錘與結構的自由衰減。
optionsEn: Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building.
A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response.

Passing component tests does not prove the installed system, so after completion a system-level verification is done: pull the pendulum off equilibrium with jacks or cables and release it to observe the free decay of the pendulum and structure, or use the damper itself or an added actuator for a forced-vibration sweep.
quiz.explanation: 零件試驗合格不代表裝在樓上的整套系統合格，因此完工後要做系統級驗證：可用千斤頂或纜線把擺錘拉離平衡位置後釋放，觀察擺錘與結構的自由衰減；也可用阻尼器自身或附加的作動器做強制振動掃頻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Passing component tests does not prove the installed system, so after completion a system-level verification is done: pull the pendulum off equilibrium with jacks or cables and release it to observe the free decay of the pendulum and structure, or use the damper itself or an added actuator for a forced-vibration sweep. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 阻尼器整體性能驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Whole-system damper performance verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由衰減與強制振動試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free-decay and forced-vibration tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ)，ζ ≈ δ/(2π)。若振幅由 100 mm 經 10 個週期降為 53 mm，δ = ln(100/53)/10 = 0.0635，ζ ≈ 1.0%；釋放擺錘後若 10 個週期降為 10 mm，δ = 0.230，ζ ≈ 3.7%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The logarithmic decrement is δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ) with ζ ≈ δ/(2π). If amplitude falls from 100 mm to 53 mm in 10 cycles, δ = ln(100/53)/10 = 0.0635 and ζ ≈ 1.0%; if, with the pendulum released, it falls to 10 mm in 10 cycles, δ = 0.230 and ζ ≈ 3.7%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：事先寫好試驗計畫：初始拉離量、釋放方式、量測點、取樣率、允收準則（例如附加阻尼不低於設計值的 80%），並重複三次取平均；試驗時段選在低風速時，同步記錄風速以排除外力干擾。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Write the test plan beforehand: initial offset, release method, measurement points, sampling rate and acceptance criterion (for example added damping not below 80% of the design value), and repeat three times for an average; test in low wind and record wind speed simultaneously to exclude external forcing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ)，ζ ≈ δ/(2π)。若振幅由 100 mm 經 10 個週期降為 53 mm，δ = ln(100/53)/10 = 0.0635，ζ ≈ 1.0%；釋放擺錘後若 10 個週期降為 10 mm，δ = 0.230，ζ ≈ 3.7%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The logarithmic decrement is δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ) with ζ ≈ δ/(2π). If amplitude falls from 100 mm to 53 mm in 10 cycles, δ = ln(100/53)/10 = 0.0635 and ζ ≈ 1.0%; if, with the pendulum released, it falls to 10 mm in 10 cycles, δ = 0.230 and ζ ≈ 3.7%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「阻尼器整體性能驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Whole-system damper performance verification", which statement holds?
options: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ)，ζ ≈ δ/(2π)。
超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。
質量塊越重，擺錘的擺動頻率就越低。
optionsEn: The logarithmic decrement is δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ) with ζ ≈ δ/(2π).
Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened.
The heavier the mass, the lower the pendulum frequency.
quiz.explanation: 對數遞減率 δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ)，ζ ≈ δ/(2π)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The logarithmic decrement is δ = (1/n)·ln(x₀/xₙ) with ζ ≈ δ/(2π). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 阻尼器整體性能驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Whole-system damper performance verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由衰減與強制振動試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-decay and forced-vibration tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 事先寫好試驗計畫：初始拉離量、釋放方式、量測點、取樣率、允收準則（例如附加阻尼不低於設計值的 80%），並重複三次取平均；試驗時段選在低風速時，同步記錄風速以排除外力干擾。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Write the test plan beforehand: initial offset, release method, measurement points, sampling rate and acceptance criterion (for example added damping not below 80% of the design value), and repeat three times for an average; test in low wind and record wind speed simultaneously to exclude external forcing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：系統試驗報告要記錄擺長、配重、阻尼器編號與溫度，作為之後每次維護後比對的基準；試驗前須確認行程限制器與安全鎖定可靠，並劃定人員禁入區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The system test report should record pendulum length, weights, damper serial numbers and temperature as the baseline for every later maintenance comparison; before testing confirm stroke limiters and safety locks, and mark exclusion zones for personnel.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在強風下做自由衰減，外力持續輸入會讓衰減曲線失真；擺錘若碰到緩衝器或導軌摩擦突然改變，衰減曲線會出現轉折，用單一 ζ 擬合就會得到錯誤結論。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Free decay in strong wind is distorted by continued forcing; if the pendulum touches a bumper or guide friction changes abruptly, the decay curve kinks, and fitting a single ζ gives the wrong conclusion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
