quiz.question: 要驗證「阻尼器整體性能驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Whole-system damper performance verification"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
事先寫好試驗計畫：初始拉離量、釋放方式、量測點、取樣率、允收準則（例如附加阻尼不低於設計值的 80%），並重複三次取平均。
質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Write the test plan beforehand: initial offset, release method, measurement points, sampling rate and acceptance criterion (for example added damping not below 80% of the design value), and repeat three times for an average.
Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan.
quiz.explanation: 事先寫好試驗計畫：初始拉離量、釋放方式、量測點、取樣率、允收準則（例如附加阻尼不低於設計值的 80%），並重複三次取平均；試驗時段選在低風速時，同步記錄風速以排除外力干擾。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Write the test plan beforehand: initial offset, release method, measurement points, sampling rate and acceptance criterion (for example added damping not below 80% of the design value), and repeat three times for an average; test in low wind and record wind speed simultaneously to exclude external forcing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 阻尼器整體性能驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Whole-system damper performance verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由衰減與強制振動試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-decay and forced-vibration tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在強風下做自由衰減，外力持續輸入會讓衰減曲線失真；擺錘若碰到緩衝器或導軌摩擦突然改變，衰減曲線會出現轉折，用單一 ζ 擬合就會得到錯誤結論。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Free decay in strong wind is distorted by continued forcing; if the pendulum touches a bumper or guide friction changes abruptly, the decay curve kinks, and fitting a single ζ gives the wrong conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：藉由比較鎖定與釋放擺錘時結構的衰減率或頻率響應，直接得到阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Comparing structural decay or frequency response with the pendulum locked and released gives the added damping directly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器零件出廠試驗合格，就能證明整棟樓的減振性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Factory tests of the damper components prove the vibration performance of the whole building." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在強風下做自由衰減，外力持續輸入會讓衰減曲線失真；擺錘若碰到緩衝器或導軌摩擦突然改變，衰減曲線會出現轉折，用單一 ζ 擬合就會得到錯誤結論。
knowledge.textEn: Free decay in strong wind is distorted by continued forcing; if the pendulum touches a bumper or guide friction changes abruptly, the decay curve kinks, and fitting a single ζ gives the wrong conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「阻尼器整體性能驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Whole-system damper performance verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。
若在強風下做自由衰減，外力持續輸入會讓衰減曲線失真；擺錘若碰到緩衝器或導軌摩擦突然改變，衰減曲線會出現轉折，用單一 ζ 擬合就會得到錯誤結論。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response.
Free decay in strong wind is distorted by continued forcing.
quiz.explanation: 若在強風下做自由衰減，外力持續輸入會讓衰減曲線失真；擺錘若碰到緩衝器或導軌摩擦突然改變，衰減曲線會出現轉折，用單一 ζ 擬合就會得到錯誤結論。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Free decay in strong wind is distorted by continued forcing; if the pendulum touches a bumper or guide friction changes abruptly, the decay curve kinks, and fitting a single ζ gives the wrong conclusion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「極端事件的行程限制與防撞」與「長期性能、維護與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events" and "Long-term performance, maintenance and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 極端事件的行程限制與防撞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「緩衝環與行程限制器」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Snubber ring and stroke limiters” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 颱風或地震時，擺錘相對位移可能遠大於日常值；若不限制，質量塊會撞到結構或機電設備。因此大型阻尼器設有緩衝環、油壓緩衝器或非線性彈簧，在超過設計行程時逐漸吸收動能，把衝擊力分散到結構可承受的範圍。行程限制的設計是在減振效果與安全之間取捨：限制太早會削弱效果，太晚則衝擊力過大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「緩衝環與行程限制器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a typhoon or earthquake the pendulum's relative displacement can far exceed everyday values; without limits the mass would hit the structure or services. Large dampers therefore have snubber rings, hydraulic buffers or nonlinear springs that progressively absorb kinetic energy beyond the design stroke, spreading the impact force to levels the structure can take. Stroke limiting trades vibration reduction against safety: limiting too early weakens performance, too late creates excessive impact force. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Snubber ring and stroke limiters” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：擺錘以 0.6 m/s 撞到緩衝器時動能 E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ；若緩衝行程 0.3 m 且力量近似線性增加，峰值力 F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the pendulum reaches the buffer at 0.6 m/s, its kinetic energy is E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ; with 0.3 m of buffer travel and a roughly linear force rise, the peak force is F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「緩衝環與行程限制器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Snubber ring and stroke limiters”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 極端事件的行程限制與防撞
knowledge.titleEn: Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events
knowledge.text: 颱風或地震時，擺錘相對位移可能遠大於日常值；若不限制，質量塊會撞到結構或機電設備。因此大型阻尼器設有緩衝環、油壓緩衝器或非線性彈簧，在超過設計行程時逐漸吸收動能，把衝擊力分散到結構可承受的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: In a typhoon or earthquake the pendulum's relative displacement can far exceed everyday values; without limits the mass would hit the structure or services. Large dampers therefore have snubber rings, hydraulic buffers or nonlinear springs that progressively absorb kinetic energy beyond the design stroke, spreading the impact force to levels the structure can take.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「極端事件的行程限制與防撞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events" is correct?
options: 颱風或地震時，擺錘相對位移可能遠大於日常值；若不限制，質量塊會撞到結構或機電設備。
阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。
阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。
optionsEn: In a typhoon or earthquake the pendulum's relative displacement can far exceed everyday values; without limits the mass would hit the structure or services.
A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response.
A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring.
quiz.explanation: 颱風或地震時，擺錘相對位移可能遠大於日常值；若不限制，質量塊會撞到結構或機電設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a typhoon or earthquake the pendulum's relative displacement can far exceed everyday values; without limits the mass would hit the structure or services. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 極端事件的行程限制與防撞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「緩衝環與行程限制器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Snubber ring and stroke limiters” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：擺錘以 0.6 m/s 撞到緩衝器時動能 E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ；若緩衝行程 0.3 m 且力量近似線性增加，峰值力 F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the pendulum reaches the buffer at 0.6 m/s, its kinetic energy is E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ; with 0.3 m of buffer travel and a roughly linear force rise, the peak force is F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性時間歷程分析輸入設計颱風與地震紀錄，檢查擺錘最大位移、接觸次數與緩衝力，並確認支撐緩衝器的樓板與構件強度；完工後確認實際淨距與緩衝器預壓符合圖說。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with design typhoon and earthquake records to check maximum pendulum displacement, contact count and buffer forces, and verify the slab and members supporting the buffers; after completion confirm actual clearances and buffer preload against the drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 擺錘以 0.6 m/s 撞到緩衝器時動能 E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ；若緩衝行程 0.3 m 且力量近似線性增加，峰值力 F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the pendulum reaches the buffer at 0.6 m/s, its kinetic energy is E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ; with 0.3 m of buffer travel and a roughly linear force rise, the peak force is F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「極端事件的行程限制與防撞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器的效果只取決於它佔整棟樓總重的百分比。
擺錘以 0.6 m/s 撞到緩衝器時動能 E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ。
阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，減振效果一定越好。
optionsEn: A damper's effect depends only on its percentage of the total building weight.
If the pendulum reaches the buffer at 0.6 m/s, its kinetic energy is E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ.
The larger the damping coefficient, the better the vibration reduction.
quiz.explanation: 擺錘以 0.6 m/s 撞到緩衝器時動能 E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ；若緩衝行程 0.3 m 且力量近似線性增加，峰值力 F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the pendulum reaches the buffer at 0.6 m/s, its kinetic energy is E = ½·m·v² = 0.5×660,000×0.6² ≈ 119 kJ; with 0.3 m of buffer travel and a roughly linear force rise, the peak force is F = 2E/s = 2×119,000/0.3 ≈ 790 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 極端事件的行程限制與防撞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「緩衝環與行程限制器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Snubber ring and stroke limiters” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入設計颱風與地震紀錄，檢查擺錘最大位移、接觸次數與緩衝力，並確認支撐緩衝器的樓板與構件強度；完工後確認實際淨距與緩衝器預壓符合圖說。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with design typhoon and earthquake records to check maximum pendulum displacement, contact count and buffer forces, and verify the slab and members supporting the buffers; after completion confirm actual clearances and buffer preload against the drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：事件後檢查清單應包含緩衝器接觸痕跡、吊索與吊點、阻尼器漏油、擺錘水平度與鎖定裝置，並與事件時的監測資料比對，確認是否需要重新調頻或更換元件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A post-event checklist should cover buffer contact marks, hangers and pick points, damper leaks, block levelness and locking devices, compared with the monitoring data from the event to decide whether retuning or component replacement is needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：緩衝器設計不足時，極端事件中質量塊反覆撞擊會損壞阻尼器、吊索與周邊樓板；若擺錘在地震中與結構不同步大幅擺動，也可能對主結構造成不利的附加力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Undersized buffers let the mass impact repeatedly in an extreme event, damaging the dampers, hangers and surrounding slab; if the pendulum swings out of sync during an earthquake it can also apply unfavourable additional forces to the main structure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入設計颱風與地震紀錄，檢查擺錘最大位移、接觸次數與緩衝力，並確認支撐緩衝器的樓板與構件強度；完工後確認實際淨距與緩衝器預壓符合圖說。
knowledge.textEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with design typhoon and earthquake records to check maximum pendulum displacement, contact count and buffer forces, and verify the slab and members supporting the buffers; after completion confirm actual clearances and buffer preload against the drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 事件後檢查清單應包含緩衝器接觸痕跡、吊索與吊點、阻尼器漏油、擺錘水平度與鎖定裝置，並與事件時的監測資料比對，確認是否需要重新調頻或更換元件。
knowledge.textEn: A post-event checklist should cover buffer contact marks, hangers and pick points, damper leaks, block levelness and locking devices, compared with the monitoring data from the event to decide whether retuning or component replacement is needed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「極端事件的行程限制與防撞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
阻尼器在工廠依設計頻率調好，到現場就不需要再調整。
以非線性時間歷程分析輸入設計颱風與地震紀錄，檢查擺錘最大位移、接觸次數與緩衝力，並確認支撐緩衝器的樓板與構件強度；完工後確認實際淨距與緩衝器預壓符合圖說。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A damper tuned at the factory to the design frequency needs no adjustment on site.

Run nonlinear time-history analyses with design typhoon and earthquake records to check maximum pendulum displacement, contact count and buffer forces, and verify the slab and members supporting the buffers.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入設計颱風與地震紀錄，檢查擺錘最大位移、接觸次數與緩衝力，並確認支撐緩衝器的樓板與構件強度；完工後確認實際淨距與緩衝器預壓符合圖說。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run nonlinear time-history analyses with design typhoon and earthquake records to check maximum pendulum displacement, contact count and buffer forces, and verify the slab and members supporting the buffers; after completion confirm actual clearances and buffer preload against the drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 極端事件的行程限制與防撞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「緩衝環與行程限制器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snubber ring and stroke limiters” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 緩衝器設計不足時，極端事件中質量塊反覆撞擊會損壞阻尼器、吊索與周邊樓板；若擺錘在地震中與結構不同步大幅擺動，也可能對主結構造成不利的附加力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Undersized buffers let the mass impact repeatedly in an extreme event, damaging the dampers, hangers and surrounding slab; if the pendulum swings out of sync during an earthquake it can also apply unfavourable additional forces to the main structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：行程限制的設計是在減振效果與安全之間取捨：限制太早會削弱效果，太晚則衝擊力過大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stroke limiting trades vibration reduction against safety: limiting too early weakens performance, too late creates excessive impact force.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器在地震中一定能像在風中一樣大幅降低結構反應。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tuned mass damper always reduces earthquake response as effectively as wind response." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 緩衝器設計不足時，極端事件中質量塊反覆撞擊會損壞阻尼器、吊索與周邊樓板；若擺錘在地震中與結構不同步大幅擺動，也可能對主結構造成不利的附加力。
knowledge.textEn: Undersized buffers let the mass impact repeatedly in an extreme event, damaging the dampers, hangers and surrounding slab; if the pendulum swings out of sync during an earthquake it can also apply unfavourable additional forces to the main structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「極端事件的行程限制與防撞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stroke limits and impact protection in extreme events" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 緩衝器設計不足時，極端事件中質量塊反覆撞擊會損壞阻尼器、吊索與周邊樓板；若擺錘在地震中與結構不同步大幅擺動，也可能對主結構造成不利的附加力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。
optionsEn: Undersized buffers let the mass impact repeatedly in an extreme event, damaging the dampers, hangers and surrounding slab.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring.
quiz.explanation: 緩衝器設計不足時，極端事件中質量塊反覆撞擊會損壞阻尼器、吊索與周邊樓板；若擺錘在地震中與結構不同步大幅擺動，也可能對主結構造成不利的附加力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Undersized buffers let the mass impact repeatedly in an extreme event, damaging the dampers, hangers and surrounding slab; if the pendulum swings out of sync during an earthquake it can also apply unfavourable additional forces to the main structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長期性能、維護與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term performance, maintenance and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「監測與維護紀錄」如何影響高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring and maintenance records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器設計壽命常與建築相同，但其性能會隨結構頻率改變、阻尼液老化、吊索鬆弛與溫度而漂移；建築改裝增加或移除大量質量，也會讓原本的調頻失準。因此交接文件必須包含設計參數、調頻紀錄、試驗基準、檢查週期與允收範圍，並把長期監測資料定期與基準比對，偏離時啟動重新調頻或維修。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「監測與維護紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A damper's design life often matches the building's, yet its performance drifts with changes in structural frequency, fluid ageing, hanger slack and temperature; renovations that add or remove large masses can also detune it. Handover documents must therefore contain design parameters, tuning records, test baselines, inspection intervals and acceptance ranges, and long-term monitoring data must be compared with the baseline periodically to trigger retuning or repair when they diverge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Monitoring and maintenance records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 μ = 0.0066、結構阻尼 1% 的雙自由度模型計算，最佳調頻時共振放大係數由 50 降到約 13.6（等效阻尼約 3.7%）；頻率比偏離 ±5% 時放大係數回升到約 23，等效阻尼約 2.1%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a two-degree-of-freedom model with μ = 0.0066 and 1% structural damping, optimum tuning lowers the resonant amplification from 50 to about 13.6 (equivalent damping about 3.7%); a ±5% frequency-ratio offset raises it back to about 23, an equivalent damping of about 2.1%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「監測與維護紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Monitoring and maintenance records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期性能、維護與交接
knowledge.text: 阻尼器設計壽命常與建築相同，但其性能會隨結構頻率改變、阻尼液老化、吊索鬆弛與溫度而漂移；建築改裝增加或移除大量質量，也會讓原本的調頻失準。因此交接文件必須包含設計參數、調頻紀錄、試驗基準、檢查週期與允收範圍，並把長期監測資料定期與基準比對，偏離時啟動重新調頻或維修。
knowledge.textEn: A damper's design life often matches the building's, yet its performance drifts with changes in structural frequency, fluid ageing, hanger slack and temperature; renovations that add or remove large masses can also detune it. Handover documents must therefore contain design parameters, tuning records, test baselines, inspection intervals and acceptance ranges, and long-term monitoring data must be compared with the baseline periodically to trigger retuning or repair when they diverge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期性能、維護與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term performance, maintenance and handover" is correct?
options: 阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。
阻尼器設計壽命常與建築相同，但其性能會隨結構頻率改變、阻尼液老化、吊索鬆弛與溫度而漂移；建築改裝增加或移除大量質量，也會讓原本的調頻失準。
超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。
optionsEn: A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring.
A damper's design life often matches the building's, yet its performance drifts with changes in structural frequency, fluid ageing, hanger slack and temperature.
Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器設計壽命常與建築相同，但其性能會隨結構頻率改變、阻尼液老化、吊索鬆弛與溫度而漂移；建築改裝增加或移除大量質量，也會讓原本的調頻失準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A damper's design life often matches the building's, yet its performance drifts with changes in structural frequency, fluid ageing, hanger slack and temperature; renovations that add or remove large masses can also detune it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期性能、維護與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term performance, maintenance and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監測與維護紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monitoring and maintenance records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 μ = 0.0066、結構阻尼 1% 的雙自由度模型計算，最佳調頻時共振放大係數由 50 降到約 13.6（等效阻尼約 3.7%）；頻率比偏離 ±5% 時放大係數回升到約 23，等效阻尼約 2.1%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a two-degree-of-freedom model with μ = 0.0066 and 1% structural damping, optimum tuning lowers the resonant amplification from 50 to about 13.6 (equivalent damping about 3.7%); a ±5% frequency-ratio offset raises it back to about 23, an equivalent damping of about 2.1%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每年由監測資料重新辨識結構與擺錘頻率，計算頻率比是否仍在允收範圍（例如偏離 2% 以內）；定期抽驗阻尼器力—速度特性與吊索張力，並把結果寫入維護資料庫與原始基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each year re-identify structural and pendulum frequencies from monitoring data and check that the frequency ratio stays within the acceptance range (for example within 2%); periodically spot-check damper force–velocity behaviour and hanger tension, and enter the results into a maintenance database for comparison with the original baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 μ = 0.0066、結構阻尼 1% 的雙自由度模型計算，最佳調頻時共振放大係數由 50 降到約 13.6（等效阻尼約 3.7%）；頻率比偏離 ±5% 時放大係數回升到約 23，等效阻尼約 2.1%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: In a two-degree-of-freedom model with μ = 0.0066 and 1% structural damping, optimum tuning lowers the resonant amplification from 50 to about 13.6 (equivalent damping about 3.7%); a ±5% frequency-ratio offset raises it back to about 23, an equivalent damping of about 2.1%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期性能、維護與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term performance, maintenance and handover", which statement holds?
options: 質量塊越重，擺錘的擺動頻率就越低。
質量塊只要吊上樓層、掛上吊索就完成安裝，不需要荷重轉移計畫。
以 μ = 0.0066、結構阻尼 1% 的雙自由度模型計算，最佳調頻時共振放大係數由 50 降到約 13.6（等效阻尼約 3.7%）。
optionsEn: The heavier the mass, the lower the pendulum frequency.
Once the mass is lifted and the hangers are attached, installation is complete without a load-transfer plan.
In a two-degree-of-freedom model with μ = 0.0066 and 1% structural damping, optimum tuning lowers the resonant amplification from 50 to about 13.6 (equivalent damping about 3.7%).
quiz.explanation: 以 μ = 0.0066、結構阻尼 1% 的雙自由度模型計算，最佳調頻時共振放大係數由 50 降到約 13.6（等效阻尼約 3.7%）；頻率比偏離 ±5% 時放大係數回升到約 23，等效阻尼約 2.1%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: In a two-degree-of-freedom model with μ = 0.0066 and 1% structural damping, optimum tuning lowers the resonant amplification from 50 to about 13.6 (equivalent damping about 3.7%); a ±5% frequency-ratio offset raises it back to about 23, an equivalent damping of about 2.1%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期性能、維護與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term performance, maintenance and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測與維護紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring and maintenance records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每年由監測資料重新辨識結構與擺錘頻率，計算頻率比是否仍在允收範圍（例如偏離 2% 以內）；定期抽驗阻尼器力—速度特性與吊索張力，並把結果寫入維護資料庫與原始基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each year re-identify structural and pendulum frequencies from monitoring data and check that the frequency ratio stays within the acceptance range (for example within 2%); periodically spot-check damper force–velocity behaviour and hanger tension, and enter the results into a maintenance database for comparison with the original baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含操作與維護手冊、緊急鎖定程序、事件後檢查表、監測資料格式與聯絡窗口；大樓重大改裝或使用變更前，須由結構顧問評估對阻尼器調頻的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the operation and maintenance manual, emergency locking procedure, post-event checklist, monitoring data format and contacts; before major renovation or change of use, the structural consultant must assess the effect on damper tuning.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時沒有留下調頻基準與試驗紀錄，多年後即使阻尼器已失準，管理單位也無法判斷，只能等住戶抱怨；大規模改裝未通知結構顧問，也可能使阻尼器在不知情下失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without tuning baselines and test records at handover, a damper can drift out of tune for years before anyone can tell, until occupants complain; major renovations made without notifying the structural consultant can silently defeat the damper. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每年由監測資料重新辨識結構與擺錘頻率，計算頻率比是否仍在允收範圍（例如偏離 2% 以內）；定期抽驗阻尼器力—速度特性與吊索張力，並把結果寫入維護資料庫與原始基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: Each year re-identify structural and pendulum frequencies from monitoring data and check that the frequency ratio stays within the acceptance range (for example within 2%); periodically spot-check damper force–velocity behaviour and hanger tension, and enter the results into a maintenance database for comparison with the original baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含操作與維護手冊、緊急鎖定程序、事件後檢查表、監測資料格式與聯絡窗口；大樓重大改裝或使用變更前，須由結構顧問評估對阻尼器調頻的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the operation and maintenance manual, emergency locking procedure, post-event checklist, monitoring data format and contacts; before major renovation or change of use, the structural consultant must assess the effect on damper tuning.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期性能、維護與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term performance, maintenance and handover"?
options: 每年由監測資料重新辨識結構與擺錘頻率，計算頻率比是否仍在允收範圍（例如偏離 2% 以內）。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要量到頻率，阻尼比可以直接沿用設計假設。
optionsEn: Each year re-identify structural and pendulum frequencies from monitoring data and check that the frequency ratio stays within the acceptance range (for example within 2%).
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Once the frequency is measured, the damping ratio can simply be taken from the design assumption.
quiz.explanation: 每年由監測資料重新辨識結構與擺錘頻率，計算頻率比是否仍在允收範圍（例如偏離 2% 以內）；定期抽驗阻尼器力—速度特性與吊索張力，並把結果寫入維護資料庫與原始基準比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Each year re-identify structural and pendulum frequencies from monitoring data and check that the frequency ratio stays within the acceptance range (for example within 2%); periodically spot-check damper force–velocity behaviour and hanger tension, and enter the results into a maintenance database for comparison with the original baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期性能、維護與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term performance, maintenance and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測與維護紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring and maintenance records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接時沒有留下調頻基準與試驗紀錄，多年後即使阻尼器已失準，管理單位也無法判斷，只能等住戶抱怨；大規模改裝未通知結構顧問，也可能使阻尼器在不知情下失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without tuning baselines and test records at handover, a damper can drift out of tune for years before anyone can tell, until occupants complain; major renovations made without notifying the structural consultant can silently defeat the damper. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此交接文件必須包含設計參數、調頻紀錄、試驗基準、檢查週期與允收範圍，並把長期監測資料定期與基準比對，偏離時啟動重新調頻或維修。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must therefore contain design parameters, tuning records, test baselines, inspection intervals and acceptance ranges, and long-term monitoring data must be compared with the baseline periodically to trigger retuning or repair when they diverge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器是被動裝置，裝好之後就不需要維護與監測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A damper is passive, so once installed it needs no maintenance or monitoring." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交接時沒有留下調頻基準與試驗紀錄，多年後即使阻尼器已失準，管理單位也無法判斷，只能等住戶抱怨；大規模改裝未通知結構顧問，也可能使阻尼器在不知情下失效。
knowledge.textEn: Without tuning baselines and test records at handover, a damper can drift out of tune for years before anyone can tell, until occupants complain; major renovations made without notifying the structural consultant can silently defeat the damper.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期性能、維護與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term performance, maintenance and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若交接時沒有留下調頻基準與試驗紀錄，多年後即使阻尼器已失準，管理單位也無法判斷，只能等住戶抱怨；大規模改裝未通知結構顧問，也可能使阻尼器在不知情下失效。
超高層擺動大就代表結構不夠強，必須加粗柱子。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without tuning baselines and test records at handover, a damper can drift out of tune for years before anyone can tell, until occupants complain.
Large sway in a supertall tower means it is not strong enough, so the columns must be thickened.
quiz.explanation: 若交接時沒有留下調頻基準與試驗紀錄，多年後即使阻尼器已失準，管理單位也無法判斷，只能等住戶抱怨；大規模改裝未通知結構顧問，也可能使阻尼器在不知情下失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without tuning baselines and test records at handover, a damper can drift out of tune for years before anyone can tell, until occupants complain; major renovations made without notifying the structural consultant can silently defeat the damper. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 液態調諧阻尼器
summary: 從住宅與辦公塔樓的風致舒適度出發，用線性波浪理論決定淺水槽的晃動頻率與參與水量，用 U 形液柱公式設計液柱阻尼器，再處理閘門與阻尼網的振幅相依阻尼、屋頂水槽結構與分階段注水、以水深現場調頻、縮尺振動台試驗與完工監測，最後談蒸發補水、出水高度與交接，並以 Comcast Center、One Wall Centre 與 One Rincon Hill 的公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from wind comfort in residential and office towers, use linear wave theory to set the sloshing frequency and participating water of shallow tanks and the U-tube formula to size liquid-column dampers, then handle amplitude-dependent damping from gates and screens, rooftop tank structures and staged filling, field tuning by water depth, scaled shaking-table tests and post-completion monitoring, and finally evaporation, freeboard and handover, compared with public information on Comcast Center, One Wall Centre and One Rincon Hill.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某住宅塔樓第一模態 f₁ = 0.20 Hz、結構阻尼 1.5%、頂部廣義質量 M* = 30,000 t，目標有效質量比 μ = 1.5%，即 m_eff = 450 t。選用內淨長 L = 6.0 m、水深 h = 0.60 m 的淺水槽：ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L) = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s²，f ≈ 0.199 Hz；第一晃動模態參與比例 8·tanh(πh/L)/(π³·h/L) = 8×0.304/3.10 ≈ 0.785，故總水量約 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t。每槽 6 m × 4 m × 0.60 m = 14.4 m³，40 槽共 576 m³。若加裝後總阻尼達 4.0%，均方根加速度約降為 √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 61%。若完工實測 f₁ 只有 0.185 Hz，水深須降到約 0.50 m，水量減為約 479 m³，有效質量比只剩約 1.26%，必須增至約 48 槽才能回到原目標。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a residential tower has f₁ = 0.20 Hz, 1.5% structural damping and a top generalised mass M* = 30,000 t, with a target effective mass ratio μ = 1.5%, so m_eff = 450 t. Choose shallow tanks with internal length L = 6.0 m and water depth h = 0.60 m: ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L) = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s², so f ≈ 0.199 Hz; the first-mode participation ratio 8·tanh(πh/L)/(π³·h/L) = 8×0.304/3.10 ≈ 0.785, so the total water is about 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t. Each tank holds 6 m × 4 m × 0.60 m = 14.4 m³, and 40 tanks hold 576 m³. If total damping reaches 4.0% with the dampers, RMS acceleration falls to about √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 61%. If the completed building measures only 0.185 Hz, the depth must drop to about 0.50 m, the water to about 479 m³ and the effective mass ratio to about 1.26%, so about 48 tanks are needed to restore the target. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型」與「線性波浪理論與晃動頻率」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper" and "Linear wave theory and sloshing frequency": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「屋頂水槽群」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rooftop tank array” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 液態調諧阻尼器（TLD）把水裝在頂部水槽中，讓水面晃動的第一模態頻率對準建築主模態；建築擺動時水的晃動落後約 90 度相位，水對槽壁的動壓力就成為與結構速度反向的控制力，碎波與阻尼網再把能量轉成熱。與鋼擺錘相比，它沒有軸承與吊索，造價低、維護簡單，水還能兼作消防或給水備用，但只有一部分水真正參與晃動，同樣效果需要較多總水量。住宅塔樓若風洞預測的頂層加速度超過舒適度門檻，水槽型阻尼器常比加厚核心筒便宜。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「屋頂水槽群」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tuned liquid damper (TLD) holds water in rooftop tanks whose first sloshing frequency is tuned to the building's governing mode. As the tower sways the sloshing lags by roughly 90 degrees, so the dynamic water pressure on the tank walls becomes a control force opposing structural velocity, while wave breaking and damping screens turn energy into heat. Compared with a steel pendulum it has no bearings or hangers, costs less and is simpler to maintain, and the water can double as a fire or domestic reserve; however, only part of the water actually sloshes, so the same effect needs more total water. When wind-tunnel predictions put top-floor acceleration above the comfort threshold in a residential tower, a tank damper is often cheaper than thickening the core. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rooftop tank array” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：所需有效質量 m_eff = μ·M*。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The required effective mass is m_eff = μ·M*.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「屋頂水槽群」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rooftop tank array”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型
knowledge.titleEn: Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper
knowledge.text: 液態調諧阻尼器（TLD）把水裝在頂部水槽中，讓水面晃動的第一模態頻率對準建築主模態；建築擺動時水的晃動落後約 90 度相位，水對槽壁的動壓力就成為與結構速度反向的控制力，碎波與阻尼網再把能量轉成熱。與鋼擺錘相比，它沒有軸承與吊索，造價低、維護簡單，水還能兼作消防或給水備用，但只有一部分水真正參與晃動，同樣效果需要較多總水量。
knowledge.textEn: A tuned liquid damper (TLD) holds water in rooftop tanks whose first sloshing frequency is tuned to the building's governing mode. As the tower sways the sloshing lags by roughly 90 degrees, so the dynamic water pressure on the tank walls becomes a control force opposing structural velocity, while wave breaking and damping screens turn energy into heat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper" is correct?
options: 水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。
液態調諧阻尼器（TLD）把水裝在頂部水槽中，讓水面晃動的第一模態頻率對準建築主模態。
水槽越寬、裝的水越多，晃動頻率就越低。
optionsEn: All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass.
A tuned liquid damper (TLD) holds water in rooftop tanks whose first sloshing frequency is tuned to the building's governing mode.
The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency.
quiz.explanation: 液態調諧阻尼器（TLD）把水裝在頂部水槽中，讓水面晃動的第一模態頻率對準建築主模態；建築擺動時水的晃動落後約 90 度相位，水對槽壁的動壓力就成為與結構速度反向的控制力，碎波與阻尼網再把能量轉成熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tuned liquid damper (TLD) holds water in rooftop tanks whose first sloshing frequency is tuned to the building's governing mode. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屋頂水槽群」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rooftop tank array” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：所需有效質量 m_eff = μ·M*。取第一模態廣義質量 M* = 30,000 t、目標質量比 μ = 1.5%，m_eff = 450 t；若淺水槽只有約 78.5% 的水參與第一晃動模態，總水量約 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t，約等於 573 m³ 的水。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The required effective mass is m_eff = μ·M*. With a first-mode generalised mass M* = 30,000 t and a target mass ratio μ = 1.5%, m_eff = 450 t; if only about 78.5% of the water in a shallow tank joins the first sloshing mode, the total water is about 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t, roughly 573 m³. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：要求風洞報告分別給出無阻尼器與加裝 TLD（以等效阻尼比表示）時，1 年與 10 年回歸期的頂層尖峰加速度，與 ISO 10137 或 AIJ 居住性曲線比較；同時由結構設計者確認屋頂樓板與轉換梁能承受水槽滿水加上晃動動壓的荷重組合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Require the wind-tunnel report to give peak top-floor accelerations for 1-year and 10-year return periods both without a damper and with the TLD represented as equivalent damping, and compare them with ISO 10137 or AIJ habitability curves; the structural designer must also confirm that the roof slab and transfer beams carry full tanks plus sloshing pressure in the governing load combinations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 所需有效質量 m_eff = μ·M*。取第一模態廣義質量 M* = 30,000 t、目標質量比 μ = 1.5%，m_eff = 450 t；若淺水槽只有約 78.5% 的水參與第一晃動模態，總水量約 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t，約等於 573 m³ 的水。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The required effective mass is m_eff = μ·M*. With a first-mode generalised mass M* = 30,000 t and a target mass ratio μ = 1.5%, m_eff = 450 t; if only about 78.5% of the water in a shallow tank joins the first sloshing mode, the total water is about 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t, roughly 573 m³. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper", which statement holds?
options: 液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。
液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。
所需有效質量 m_eff = μ·M*。
optionsEn: A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude.
Retuning a liquid damper by changing water depth has no effect on its mass ratio.
The required effective mass is m_eff = μ·M*.
quiz.explanation: 所需有效質量 m_eff = μ·M*。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The required effective mass is m_eff = μ·M*. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋頂水槽群」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rooftop tank array” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 要求風洞報告分別給出無阻尼器與加裝 TLD（以等效阻尼比表示）時，1 年與 10 年回歸期的頂層尖峰加速度，與 ISO 10137 或 AIJ 居住性曲線比較；同時由結構設計者確認屋頂樓板與轉換梁能承受水槽滿水加上晃動動壓的荷重組合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to give peak top-floor accelerations for 1-year and 10-year return periods both without a damper and with the TLD represented as equivalent damping, and compare them with ISO 10137 or AIJ habitability curves; the structural designer must also confirm that the roof slab and transfer beams carry full tanks plus sloshing pressure in the governing load combinations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建築與機電要在概念設計就協調屋頂水槽的平面、高度與樓板加厚區；水槽兼作消防水源時，消防最低水位與調頻水位要在同一份圖說上分開標示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Architects and services engineers should coordinate tank footprint, height and thickened roof-slab zones at concept stage; when tanks double as fire-water storage, the fire minimum level and the tuning level must be marked separately on the same drawing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把整槽水量直接當成有效質量，會高估質量比約兩成，完工後加速度改善不如預期；水槽若放在模態位移較小的中層設備層，同樣水量的效果也會明顯打折。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the full tank volume as effective mass overstates the mass ratio by about a fifth, so the acceleration improvement after completion falls short; placing tanks on a mid-height plant floor where modal displacement is smaller also sharply reduces the effect of the same water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 要求風洞報告分別給出無阻尼器與加裝 TLD（以等效阻尼比表示）時，1 年與 10 年回歸期的頂層尖峰加速度，與 ISO 10137 或 AIJ 居住性曲線比較；同時由結構設計者確認屋頂樓板與轉換梁能承受水槽滿水加上晃動動壓的荷重組合。
knowledge.textEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to give peak top-floor accelerations for 1-year and 10-year return periods both without a damper and with the TLD represented as equivalent damping, and compare them with ISO 10137 or AIJ habitability curves; the structural designer must also confirm that the roof slab and transfer beams carry full tanks plus sloshing pressure in the governing load combinations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建築與機電要在概念設計就協調屋頂水槽的平面、高度與樓板加厚區；水槽兼作消防水源時，消防最低水位與調頻水位要在同一份圖說上分開標示。
knowledge.textEn: Architects and services engineers should coordinate tank footprint, height and thickened roof-slab zones at concept stage; when tanks double as fire-water storage, the fire minimum level and the tuning level must be marked separately on the same drawing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper"?
options: 要求風洞報告分別給出無阻尼器與加裝 TLD（以等效阻尼比表示）時，1 年與 10 年回歸期的頂層尖峰加速度，與 ISO 10137 或 AIJ 居住性曲線比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。
optionsEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to give peak top-floor accelerations for 1-year and 10-year return periods both without a damper and with the TLD represented as equivalent damping, and compare them with ISO 10137 or AIJ habitability curves.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works.
quiz.explanation: 要求風洞報告分別給出無阻尼器與加裝 TLD（以等效阻尼比表示）時，1 年與 10 年回歸期的頂層尖峰加速度，與 ISO 10137 或 AIJ 居住性曲線比較；同時由結構設計者確認屋頂樓板與轉換梁能承受水槽滿水加上晃動動壓的荷重組合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to give peak top-floor accelerations for 1-year and 10-year return periods both without a damper and with the TLD represented as equivalent damping, and compare them with ISO 10137 or AIJ habitability curves; the structural designer must also confirm that the roof slab and transfer beams carry full tanks plus sloshing pressure in the governing load combinations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋頂水槽群」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rooftop tank array” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把整槽水量直接當成有效質量，會高估質量比約兩成，完工後加速度改善不如預期；水槽若放在模態位移較小的中層設備層，同樣水量的效果也會明顯打折。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the full tank volume as effective mass overstates the mass ratio by about a fifth, so the acceleration improvement after completion falls short; placing tanks on a mid-height plant floor where modal displacement is smaller also sharply reduces the effect of the same water. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：住宅塔樓若風洞預測的頂層加速度超過舒適度門檻，水槽型阻尼器常比加厚核心筒便宜。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When wind-tunnel predictions put top-floor acceleration above the comfort threshold in a residential tower, a tank damper is often cheaper than thickening the core.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把整槽水量直接當成有效質量，會高估質量比約兩成，完工後加速度改善不如預期；水槽若放在模態位移較小的中層設備層，同樣水量的效果也會明顯打折。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the full tank volume as effective mass overstates the mass ratio by about a fifth, so the acceleration improvement after completion falls short; placing tanks on a mid-height plant floor where modal displacement is smaller also sharply reduces the effect of the same water.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把整槽水量直接當成有效質量，會高估質量比約兩成，完工後加速度改善不如預期；水槽若放在模態位移較小的中層設備層，同樣水量的效果也會明顯打折。
水槽越寬、裝的水越多，晃動頻率就越低。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating the full tank volume as effective mass overstates the mass ratio by about a fifth, so the acceleration improvement after completion falls short.
The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency.
quiz.explanation: 若把整槽水量直接當成有效質量，會高估質量比約兩成，完工後加速度改善不如預期；水槽若放在模態位移較小的中層設備層，同樣水量的效果也會明顯打折。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the full tank volume as effective mass overstates the mass ratio by about a fifth, so the acceleration improvement after completion falls short; placing tanks on a mid-height plant floor where modal displacement is smaller also sharply reduces the effect of the same water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 線性波浪理論與晃動頻率：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Linear wave theory and sloshing frequency: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「第一晃動模態」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “First sloshing mode” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 矩形水槽受水平擺動時，水會沿槽長方向形成駐波：第一模態是半個波長跨過整個槽長，水面一端升高、另一端下降。晃動頻率由運動方向的內淨長 L 與水深 h 決定，與槽寬及總水量無關；淺水時頻率大致與 √h/L 成正比。水深相對槽長很小的淺水槽在大振幅時會碎波，等效阻尼增加，但頻率也隨振幅略為升高（硬化），所以 TLD 是非線性阻尼器，必須先定義設計振幅。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「第一晃動模態」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a rectangular tank is moved horizontally, the water forms a standing wave along the tank: in the first mode half a wavelength spans the tank length, with the surface rising at one end and falling at the other. The sloshing frequency depends on the internal length L in the direction of motion and the water depth h, not on tank width or total volume; in shallow water it is roughly proportional to √h/L. Shallow tanks break waves at large amplitude, which adds equivalent damping but also raises the frequency slightly (hardening), so a TLD is a nonlinear damper and its design amplitude must be defined first. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “First sloshing mode” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線性波浪理論 ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Linear wave theory gives ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水槽越寬、裝的水越多，晃動頻率就越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「第一晃動模態」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “First sloshing mode”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 線性波浪理論與晃動頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Linear wave theory and sloshing frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「第一晃動模態」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “First sloshing mode” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性波浪理論 ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L)。取 L = 6.0 m、h = 0.60 m：πh/L = 0.314，tanh = 0.304，ω² = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s²，ω ≈ 1.250 rad/s，f = ω/2π ≈ 0.199 Hz，可對準 0.20 Hz 的建築模態；若槽長改為 8 m 而水深比不變，f 降為約 0.172 Hz。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Linear wave theory gives ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L). With L = 6.0 m and h = 0.60 m: πh/L = 0.314, tanh = 0.304, ω² = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s², ω ≈ 1.250 rad/s and f = ω/2π ≈ 0.199 Hz, matching a 0.20 Hz building mode; an 8 m tank with the same depth ratio drops to about 0.172 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作單槽樣品放在振動台上做正弦掃頻，以水位計量測槽端波高，找出共振頻率並與公式比較；再以不同振幅重複掃頻，記錄頻率隨振幅升高的幅度與開始碎波的振幅，作為選擇設計振幅的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Put a single prototype tank on a shaking table and run sinusoidal sweeps, measuring wave height at the tank ends with level gauges, find the resonant frequency and compare it with the formula; repeat at several amplitudes and record how much the frequency rises with amplitude and where wave breaking starts, as the basis for choosing the design amplitude.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 線性波浪理論與晃動頻率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Linear wave theory and sloshing frequency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「第一晃動模態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “First sloshing mode” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製作單槽樣品放在振動台上做正弦掃頻，以水位計量測槽端波高，找出共振頻率並與公式比較；再以不同振幅重複掃頻，記錄頻率隨振幅升高的幅度與開始碎波的振幅，作為選擇設計振幅的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Put a single prototype tank on a shaking table and run sinusoidal sweeps, measuring wave height at the tank ends with level gauges, find the resonant frequency and compare it with the formula; repeat at several amplitudes and record how much the frequency rises with amplitude and where wave breaking starts, as the basis for choosing the design amplitude. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：圖說上應標明每個水槽的內淨長、設計水深與允許偏差（例如水深 ±5 mm），並規定槽內不得穿越管線或增設構件；需要雙向減振時，用正方形或兩向長度不同的水槽分別對準兩個方向的頻率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should state each tank's internal length, design water depth and tolerance (for example ±5 mm on depth), and forbid pipes or members inside the tank; where both directions need control, use square tanks or tanks with different lengths in the two directions to match each direction's frequency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以小振幅線性頻率調頻，但設計風速下的振幅讓水槽進入碎波狀態，水槽頻率升高而與建築脫調，減振效果反而在最需要時下降；槽內若有未計入的柱、管線或隔板，也會改變有效槽長與頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tuning to the small-amplitude linear frequency while the design-wind amplitude drives the tank into wave breaking raises the tank frequency and detunes it from the building, so performance drops exactly when it is needed; columns, pipes or partitions inside the tank that were not modelled also change the effective length and frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 線性波浪理論與晃動頻率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Linear wave theory and sloshing frequency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「第一晃動模態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “First sloshing mode” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以小振幅線性頻率調頻，但設計風速下的振幅讓水槽進入碎波狀態，水槽頻率升高而與建築脫調，減振效果反而在最需要時下降；槽內若有未計入的柱、管線或隔板，也會改變有效槽長與頻率。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「線性波浪理論與晃動頻率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Linear wave theory and sloshing frequency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
U 形液柱阻尼器的頻率可以靠加寬水平段來調整。

The frequency of a U-tube damper can be tuned by widening the horizontal leg.

Tuning to the small-amplitude linear frequency while the design-wind amplitude drives the tank into wave breaking raises the tank frequency and detunes it from the building, so performance drops exactly when it is needed.
quiz.explanation: 若以小振幅線性頻率調頻，但設計風速下的振幅讓水槽進入碎波狀態，水槽頻率升高而與建築脫調，減振效果反而在最需要時下降；槽內若有未計入的柱、管線或隔板，也會改變有效槽長與頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning to the small-amplitude linear frequency while the design-wind amplitude drives the tank into wave breaking raises the tank frequency and detunes it from the building, so performance drops exactly when it is needed; columns, pipes or partitions inside the tank that were not modelled also change the effective length and frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「液柱阻尼器的幾何與調頻」與「水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 液柱阻尼器的幾何與調頻：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Liquid-column damper geometry and tuning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「U 形液柱」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “U-shaped liquid column” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 液柱阻尼器（TLCD）把水放在 U 形管路中：底部水平段的水隨建築擺動被推向一側，兩端垂直段水位一升一降，由重力提供回復力，就像以水為質量的擺。它的頻率只取決於液柱總長，且整段水都參與運動，比淺水晃動容易建立數學模型；控制力來自水平段水的加速度，所以水平段占總長的比例 α 越大，等效質量越有效。費城 Comcast Center 與溫哥華 One Wall Centre 都以大型液柱阻尼器處理風致舒適度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「U 形液柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tuned liquid column damper (TLCD) holds water in a U-shaped conduit: as the building sways the water in the horizontal leg is pushed to one side and the levels in the two vertical legs rise and fall, with gravity supplying the restoring force like a pendulum whose mass is water. Its frequency depends only on the total column length, and the whole column moves, so it is easier to model than shallow sloshing; the control force comes from accelerating the water in the horizontal leg, so the larger the horizontal length ratio α, the more effective the mass. Comcast Center in Philadelphia and One Wall Centre in Vancouver both use large liquid-column dampers for wind comfort. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “U-shaped liquid column” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：f = (1/2π)·√(2g/L)，故 L = 2g/(2πf)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f = (1/2π)·√(2g/L), so L = 2g/(2πf)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「U 形液柱阻尼器的頻率可以靠加寬水平段來調整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 液柱阻尼器的幾何與調頻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Liquid-column damper geometry and tuning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「U 形液柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “U-shaped liquid column” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f = (1/2π)·√(2g/L)，故 L = 2g/(2πf)²。f = 0.16 Hz 時 L = 19.62/1.011 ≈ 19.4 m；取水平段比例 α = 0.65，水平段約 12.6 m，兩端垂直段各約 3.4 m。斷面積 10 m² 時水量約 194 t，耦合有效質量約 α²×194 ≈ 82 t。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f = (1/2π)·√(2g/L), so L = 2g/(2πf)². For f = 0.16 Hz, L = 19.62/1.011 ≈ 19.4 m; with a horizontal length ratio α = 0.65 the horizontal leg is about 12.6 m and each vertical leg about 3.4 m. With a 10 m² cross-section the water is about 194 t, and the effectively coupled mass is about α²×194 ≈ 82 t. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工後先在靜止狀態確認兩端水位相同並複核液柱總長，再以短暫操作閘門造成水位差後釋放，量測垂直段水位的自由振盪週期，換算頻率與設計值比較；斷面有變化時，以等效長度公式重算後再比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After construction, confirm at rest that the two end levels match and re-check the total column length, then create a level difference by briefly operating the gate and release it, measure the free-oscillation period of the vertical legs, and compare the derived frequency with design; where the cross-section varies, recompute with an equivalent-length formula before comparing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

For f = 0.16 Hz, L = 19.62/1.011 ≈ 19.4 m; with a horizontal length ratio α = 0.65 the horizontal leg is about 12.6 m and each vertical leg about 3.4 m. With a 10 m² cross-section the water is about 194 t, and the effectively coupled mass is about α²×194 ≈ 82 t. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「液柱阻尼器的幾何與調頻」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。
只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。

steps.title: 液柱阻尼器的幾何與調頻：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Liquid-column damper geometry and tuning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「U 形液柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “U-shaped liquid column” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工後先在靜止狀態確認兩端水位相同並複核液柱總長，再以短暫操作閘門造成水位差後釋放，量測垂直段水位的自由振盪週期，換算頻率與設計值比較；斷面有變化時，以等效長度公式重算後再比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After construction, confirm at rest that the two end levels match and re-check the total column length, then create a level difference by briefly operating the gate and release it, measure the free-oscillation period of the vertical legs, and compare the derived frequency with design; where the cross-section varies, recompute with an equivalent-length formula before comparing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：液柱總長、各段斷面變化與通氣口位置要在結構與機電圖上同時標示；垂直段頂部應保留至少等於設計振幅加安全餘裕的淨高，閘門須設在可檢修的位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Total column length, cross-section changes and vent locations must appear on both structural and services drawings; leave headroom above each vertical leg at least equal to the design amplitude plus a safety margin, and place the gate where it can be serviced.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若垂直段頂部淨高不足，大振幅時水柱衝出或把空氣壓入水平段，液柱有效長度改變並產生衝擊噪音；兩端若以密閉蓋板封住而未通氣，被壓縮的空氣會變成額外彈簧，把頻率推高而脫調。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If headroom above the vertical legs is insufficient, large amplitudes eject water or drive air into the horizontal leg, changing the effective column length and causing impact noise; sealing the leg tops without venting turns trapped air into an extra spring that pushes the frequency up and detunes the damper. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 若垂直段頂部淨高不足，大振幅時水柱衝出或把空氣壓入水平段，液柱有效長度改變並產生衝擊噪音；兩端若以密閉蓋板封住而未通氣，被壓縮的空氣會變成額外彈簧，把頻率推高而脫調。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

quiz.question: 在「液柱阻尼器的幾何與調頻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Liquid-column damper geometry and tuning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若垂直段頂部淨高不足，大振幅時水柱衝出或把空氣壓入水平段，液柱有效長度改變並產生衝擊噪音。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。
optionsEn: If headroom above the vertical legs is insufficient, large amplitudes eject water or drive air into the horizontal leg, changing the effective column length and causing impact noise.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude.
quiz.explanation: 若垂直段頂部淨高不足，大振幅時水柱衝出或把空氣壓入水平段，液柱有效長度改變並產生衝擊噪音；兩端若以密閉蓋板封住而未通氣，被壓縮的空氣會變成額外彈簧，把頻率推高而脫調。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If headroom above the vertical legs is insufficient, large amplitudes eject water or drive air into the horizontal leg, changing the effective column length and causing impact noise; sealing the leg tops without venting turns trapped air into an extra spring that pushes the frequency up and detunes the damper. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「阻尼網與閘門孔口」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damping screens and gate orifice” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 液體阻尼器的耗能來自水流經孔口、閘門或阻尼網時的紊流水頭損失，損失與流速平方成正比，因此等效阻尼隨振幅增大而增加，不像線性黏滯阻尼是固定值。淺水槽則靠碎波與槽內垂直阻尼網或擋板耗能，阻尼網的開孔率決定損失係數。設計者必須選定代表性振幅（通常是設計回歸期風況下的振幅），讓該處的等效阻尼接近最佳值，並接受其他振幅下偏離最佳。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「阻尼網與閘門孔口」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dissipation in a liquid damper comes from turbulent head loss as water passes orifices, gates or damping screens; the loss is proportional to velocity squared, so equivalent damping grows with amplitude instead of staying fixed as in a linear viscous damper. Shallow tanks rely on wave breaking and on vertical screens or baffles, whose open-area ratio sets the loss coefficient. The designer must choose a representative amplitude, usually the one in the design-return-period wind, at which equivalent damping is near optimum, and accept departures from the optimum at other amplitudes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Damping screens and gate orifice” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以等效線性化，ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: By equivalent linearisation, ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「阻尼網與閘門孔口」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Damping screens and gate orifice”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
