knowledge.text: 液體阻尼器的耗能來自水流經孔口、閘門或阻尼網時的紊流水頭損失，損失與流速平方成正比，因此等效阻尼隨振幅增大而增加，不像線性黏滯阻尼是固定值。淺水槽則靠碎波與槽內垂直阻尼網或擋板耗能，阻尼網的開孔率決定損失係數。
knowledge.textEn: Dissipation in a liquid damper comes from turbulent head loss as water passes orifices, gates or damping screens; the loss is proportional to velocity squared, so equivalent damping grows with amplitude instead of staying fixed as in a linear viscous damper. Shallow tanks rely on wave breaking and on vertical screens or baffles, whose open-area ratio sets the loss coefficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping" is correct?
options: 液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。
液體阻尼器的耗能來自水流經孔口、閘門或阻尼網時的紊流水頭損失，損失與流速平方成正比，因此等效阻尼隨振幅增大而增加，不像線性黏滯阻尼是固定值。
水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。
optionsEn: A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude.
Dissipation in a liquid damper comes from turbulent head loss as water passes orifices, gates or damping screens.
A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member.
quiz.explanation: 液體阻尼器的耗能來自水流經孔口、閘門或阻尼網時的紊流水頭損失，損失與流速平方成正比，因此等效阻尼隨振幅增大而增加，不像線性黏滯阻尼是固定值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dissipation in a liquid damper comes from turbulent head loss as water passes orifices, gates or damping screens; the loss is proportional to velocity squared, so equivalent damping grows with amplitude instead of staying fixed as in a linear viscous damper. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「阻尼網與閘門孔口」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damping screens and gate orifice” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以等效線性化，ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L)。取 L = 19.4 m、水頭損失係數 ξ = 15：液柱振幅 u₀ = 0.50 m 時 ζ_eq = 15/182.9 ≈ 8.2%；u₀ = 0.15 m 時只有約 2.5%。調整閘門開度改變 ξ，就能把最佳阻尼移到另一個設計振幅。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: By equivalent linearisation, ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L). With L = 19.4 m and head-loss coefficient ξ = 15, a column amplitude u₀ = 0.50 m gives ζ_eq = 15/182.9 ≈ 8.2%, while u₀ = 0.15 m gives only about 2.5%. Changing the gate opening alters ξ and moves the optimum damping to another design amplitude. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以振動台試驗量測不同振幅下的水位或晃動力時間歷程，計算每循環耗能並換算等效阻尼比，畫出阻尼—振幅曲線；閘門開度與阻尼網開孔率逐檔試驗，確認設計振幅處的等效阻尼落在最佳值的允許範圍內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a shaking table record level or sloshing-force histories at several amplitudes, compute energy dissipated per cycle and convert it to an equivalent damping ratio to plot damping against amplitude; test each gate setting and screen open-area ratio to confirm that equivalent damping at the design amplitude lies within the allowed band around the optimum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以等效線性化，ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L)。取 L = 19.4 m、水頭損失係數 ξ = 15：液柱振幅 u₀ = 0.50 m 時 ζ_eq = 15/182.9 ≈ 8.2%；u₀ = 0.15 m 時只有約 2.5%。調整閘門開度改變 ξ，就能把最佳阻尼移到另一個設計振幅。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: By equivalent linearisation, ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L). With L = 19.4 m and head-loss coefficient ξ = 15, a column amplitude u₀ = 0.50 m gives ζ_eq = 15/182.9 ≈ 8.2%, while u₀ = 0.15 m gives only about 2.5%. Changing the gate opening alters ξ and moves the optimum damping to another design amplitude. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping", which statement holds?
options: 縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。
水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。
以等效線性化，ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L)。
optionsEn: A scaled model can keep the full-scale water depth and simply shrink the plan dimensions.
As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change.
By equivalent linearisation, ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L).
quiz.explanation: 以等效線性化，ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: By equivalent linearisation, ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「阻尼網與閘門孔口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Damping screens and gate orifice” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以振動台試驗量測不同振幅下的水位或晃動力時間歷程，計算每循環耗能並換算等效阻尼比，畫出阻尼—振幅曲線；閘門開度與阻尼網開孔率逐檔試驗，確認設計振幅處的等效阻尼落在最佳值的允許範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On a shaking table record level or sloshing-force histories at several amplitudes, compute energy dissipated per cycle and convert it to an equivalent damping ratio to plot damping against amplitude; test each gate setting and screen open-area ratio to confirm that equivalent damping at the design amplitude lies within the allowed band around the optimum. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規範應寫明設計振幅、該振幅下的目標等效阻尼與閘門或阻尼網的可調範圍；阻尼網採不鏽鋼等耐蝕材料並設計成可拆卸清洗，閘門開度須有鎖定裝置並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should state the design amplitude, the target equivalent damping at that amplitude and the adjustable range of gates or screens; screens should be stainless steel or another corrosion-resistant material and removable for cleaning, and gate settings must be lockable and recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：阻尼網開孔率太小時，水在小振幅就被鎖住，液體近似附加質量，日常強風幾乎沒有效果；開孔太大則大振幅時阻尼不足，水面振幅超過預留淨高而撞擊槽頂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Screens with too little open area lock the water at small amplitudes so it acts almost as added mass and does little in ordinary strong winds; too much open area leaves too little damping at large amplitude, so the surface excursion exceeds the freeboard and strikes the tank roof. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以振動台試驗量測不同振幅下的水位或晃動力時間歷程，計算每循環耗能並換算等效阻尼比，畫出阻尼—振幅曲線；閘門開度與阻尼網開孔率逐檔試驗，確認設計振幅處的等效阻尼落在最佳值的允許範圍內。
knowledge.textEn: On a shaking table record level or sloshing-force histories at several amplitudes, compute energy dissipated per cycle and convert it to an equivalent damping ratio to plot damping against amplitude; test each gate setting and screen open-area ratio to confirm that equivalent damping at the design amplitude lies within the allowed band around the optimum.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規範應寫明設計振幅、該振幅下的目標等效阻尼與閘門或阻尼網的可調範圍；阻尼網採不鏽鋼等耐蝕材料並設計成可拆卸清洗，閘門開度須有鎖定裝置並記錄。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should state the design amplitude, the target equivalent damping at that amplitude and the adjustable range of gates or screens; screens should be stainless steel or another corrosion-resistant material and removable for cleaning, and gate settings must be lockable and recorded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping"?
options: 以振動台試驗量測不同振幅下的水位或晃動力時間歷程，計算每循環耗能並換算等效阻尼比，畫出阻尼—振幅曲線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。
optionsEn: On a shaking table record level or sloshing-force histories at several amplitudes, compute energy dissipated per cycle and convert it to an equivalent damping ratio to plot damping against amplitude.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass.
quiz.explanation: 以振動台試驗量測不同振幅下的水位或晃動力時間歷程，計算每循環耗能並換算等效阻尼比，畫出阻尼—振幅曲線；閘門開度與阻尼網開孔率逐檔試驗，確認設計振幅處的等效阻尼落在最佳值的允許範圍內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On a shaking table record level or sloshing-force histories at several amplitudes, compute energy dissipated per cycle and convert it to an equivalent damping ratio to plot damping against amplitude; test each gate setting and screen open-area ratio to confirm that equivalent damping at the design amplitude lies within the allowed band around the optimum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「阻尼網與閘門孔口」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Damping screens and gate orifice” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 阻尼網開孔率太小時，水在小振幅就被鎖住，液體近似附加質量，日常強風幾乎沒有效果；開孔太大則大振幅時阻尼不足，水面振幅超過預留淨高而撞擊槽頂。阻尼網鏽蝕或被沉積物堵塞，也會在不知不覺中改變損失係數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Screens with too little open area lock the water at small amplitudes so it acts almost as added mass and does little in ordinary strong winds; too much open area leaves too little damping at large amplitude, so the surface excursion exceeds the freeboard and strikes the tank roof. Corroded or clogged screens silently change the loss coefficient as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者必須選定代表性振幅（通常是設計回歸期風況下的振幅），讓該處的等效阻尼接近最佳值，並接受其他振幅下偏離最佳。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The designer must choose a representative amplitude, usually the one in the design-return-period wind, at which equivalent damping is near optimum, and accept departures from the optimum at other amplitudes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 阻尼網開孔率太小時，水在小振幅就被鎖住，液體近似附加質量，日常強風幾乎沒有效果；開孔太大則大振幅時阻尼不足，水面振幅超過預留淨高而撞擊槽頂。阻尼網鏽蝕或被沉積物堵塞，也會在不知不覺中改變損失係數。
knowledge.textEn: Screens with too little open area lock the water at small amplitudes so it acts almost as added mass and does little in ordinary strong winds; too much open area leaves too little damping at large amplitude, so the surface excursion exceeds the freeboard and strikes the tank roof. Corroded or clogged screens silently change the loss coefficient as well.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
阻尼網開孔率太小時，水在小振幅就被鎖住，液體近似附加質量，日常強風幾乎沒有效果；開孔太大則大振幅時阻尼不足，水面振幅超過預留淨高而撞擊槽頂。
水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Screens with too little open area lock the water at small amplitudes so it acts almost as added mass and does little in ordinary strong winds.
A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼網開孔率太小時，水在小振幅就被鎖住，液體近似附加質量，日常強風幾乎沒有效果；開孔太大則大振幅時阻尼不足，水面振幅超過預留淨高而撞擊槽頂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Screens with too little open area lock the water at small amplitudes so it acts almost as added mass and does little in ordinary strong winds; too much open area leaves too little damping at large amplitude, so the surface excursion exceeds the freeboard and strikes the tank roof. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水槽結構、防水與分階段注水」與「實測建築頻率與現場調頻」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling" and "Measured building frequency and field tuning": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水槽結構、防水與分階段注水：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「水槽結構與防水層」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tank structure and waterproofing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 數百公噸的水集中在屋頂，水槽本身就是承受靜水壓與晃動動壓的結構：混凝土水槽須控制裂縫寬度並加防水內襯，鋼或玻璃纖維水槽則要處理接縫與防蝕。滿水重量經槽底樓板、梁與柱傳到核心筒，屋頂樓板常需加厚或增設轉換梁。注水必須分階段進行，一方面確認樓板撓度與滲漏，一方面在每個水位量測頻率，逐步逼近調頻水位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「水槽結構與防水層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Several hundred tonnes of water concentrated on the roof make each tank a structure that resists hydrostatic and sloshing pressure: concrete tanks need crack-width control and a waterproof liner, while steel or glass-fibre tanks need attention to joints and corrosion protection. The full weight travels through the tank floor, beams and columns to the core, so roof slabs are often thickened or given transfer beams. Filling is done in stages, both to check slab deflection and leakage and to measure frequency at each level while approaching the tuning depth. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tank structure and waterproofing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：靜水壓 p = ρgh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hydrostatic pressure p = ρgh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「水槽結構與防水層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tank structure and waterproofing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水槽結構、防水與分階段注水
knowledge.titleEn: Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling
knowledge.text: 數百公噸的水集中在屋頂，水槽本身就是承受靜水壓與晃動動壓的結構：混凝土水槽須控制裂縫寬度並加防水內襯，鋼或玻璃纖維水槽則要處理接縫與防蝕。滿水重量經槽底樓板、梁與柱傳到核心筒，屋頂樓板常需加厚或增設轉換梁。
knowledge.textEn: Several hundred tonnes of water concentrated on the roof make each tank a structure that resists hydrostatic and sloshing pressure: concrete tanks need crack-width control and a waterproof liner, while steel or glass-fibre tanks need attention to joints and corrosion protection. The full weight travels through the tank floor, beams and columns to the core, so roof slabs are often thickened or given transfer beams.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水槽結構、防水與分階段注水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling" is correct?
options: 水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。
液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。
數百公噸的水集中在屋頂，水槽本身就是承受靜水壓與晃動動壓的結構：混凝土水槽須控制裂縫寬度並加防水內襯，鋼或玻璃纖維水槽則要處理接縫與防蝕。
optionsEn: A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member.
Retuning a liquid damper by changing water depth has no effect on its mass ratio.

Several hundred tonnes of water concentrated on the roof make each tank a structure that resists hydrostatic and sloshing pressure: concrete tanks need crack-width control and a waterproof liner, while steel or glass-fibre tanks need attention to joints and corrosion protection.
quiz.explanation: 數百公噸的水集中在屋頂，水槽本身就是承受靜水壓與晃動動壓的結構：混凝土水槽須控制裂縫寬度並加防水內襯，鋼或玻璃纖維水槽則要處理接縫與防蝕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Several hundred tonnes of water concentrated on the roof make each tank a structure that resists hydrostatic and sloshing pressure: concrete tanks need crack-width control and a waterproof liner, while steel or glass-fibre tanks need attention to joints and corrosion protection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水槽結構、防水與分階段注水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水槽結構與防水層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tank structure and waterproofing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：靜水壓 p = ρgh。液柱垂直段靜水深 4.0 m 加上 0.5 m 振幅，最大水頭 4.5 m：p = 1,000×9.81×4.5 ≈ 44.1 kPa，槽壁每延米合力 F = ½ρgh² = 0.5×9,810×4.5² ≈ 99.3 kN/m；194 t 的水對屋頂結構另增約 1,900 kN 的重量。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Hydrostatic pressure p = ρgh. With 4.0 m of still water in a vertical leg plus 0.5 m amplitude, the maximum head is 4.5 m: p = 1,000×9.81×4.5 ≈ 44.1 kPa and the wall resultant per metre is F = ½ρgh² = 0.5×9,810×4.5² ≈ 99.3 kN/m; the 194 t of water adds about 1,900 kN of weight to the roof structure. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：注水前對防水層與接縫做目視與真空箱或電火花檢漏，注水分 25%、50%、75%、100% 四階段，每階段靜置後量測樓板撓度、水位下降量與槽外滲漏，撓度與滲漏都在允收值內才進入下一階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before filling, inspect the liner and joints visually and by vacuum-box or spark testing; fill in four stages of 25%, 50%, 75% and 100%, and after each hold measure slab deflection, level drop and external seepage, proceeding only when deflection and leakage are within acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 靜水壓 p = ρgh。液柱垂直段靜水深 4.0 m 加上 0.5 m 振幅，最大水頭 4.5 m：p = 1,000×9.81×4.5 ≈ 44.1 kPa，槽壁每延米合力 F = ½ρgh² = 0.5×9,810×4.5² ≈ 99.3 kN/m；194 t 的水對屋頂結構另增約 1,900 kN 的重量。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Hydrostatic pressure p = ρgh. With 4.0 m of still water in a vertical leg plus 0.5 m amplitude, the maximum head is 4.5 m: p = 1,000×9.81×4.5 ≈ 44.1 kPa and the wall resultant per metre is F = ½ρgh² = 0.5×9,810×4.5² ≈ 99.3 kN/m; the 194 t of water adds about 1,900 kN of weight to the roof structure. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水槽結構、防水與分階段注水」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling", which statement holds?
options: 靜水壓 p = ρgh。
只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。
水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。
optionsEn: Hydrostatic pressure p = ρgh.
A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works.
Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 靜水壓 p = ρgh。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrostatic pressure p = ρgh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水槽結構、防水與分階段注水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水槽結構與防水層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tank structure and waterproofing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 注水前對防水層與接縫做目視與真空箱或電火花檢漏，注水分 25%、50%、75%、100% 四階段，每階段靜置後量測樓板撓度、水位下降量與槽外滲漏，撓度與滲漏都在允收值內才進入下一階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before filling, inspect the liner and joints visually and by vacuum-box or spark testing; fill in four stages of 25%, 50%, 75% and 100%, and after each hold measure slab deflection, level drop and external seepage, proceeding only when deflection and leakage are within acceptance limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：水槽施工計畫要列出注水分段、每段持壓時間、撓度與滲漏的停止條件，並由結構設計者與防水承包商共同簽認；注水試驗期間，水槽下方樓層應暫緩精裝修。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The tank construction plan should list filling stages, hold times and stop criteria for deflection and leakage, signed by both the structural designer and the waterproofing contractor; finishes on the floor below should be held back during the fill test.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混凝土水槽若未控制乾縮與溫度裂縫，滿水後滲漏會進入下層住戶或機電空間，持續失水又使阻尼器脫調；一次注滿而不分階段，可能在發現樓板撓度異常前就已造成裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concrete tanks without control of shrinkage and thermal cracking leak into the dwellings or plant rooms below once full, and the continuous loss of water also detunes the damper; filling in one go may crack the slab before abnormal deflection is noticed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 注水前對防水層與接縫做目視與真空箱或電火花檢漏，注水分 25%、50%、75%、100% 四階段，每階段靜置後量測樓板撓度、水位下降量與槽外滲漏，撓度與滲漏都在允收值內才進入下一階段。
knowledge.textEn: Before filling, inspect the liner and joints visually and by vacuum-box or spark testing; fill in four stages of 25%, 50%, 75% and 100%, and after each hold measure slab deflection, level drop and external seepage, proceeding only when deflection and leakage are within acceptance limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 水槽施工計畫要列出注水分段、每段持壓時間、撓度與滲漏的停止條件，並由結構設計者與防水承包商共同簽認；注水試驗期間，水槽下方樓層應暫緩精裝修。
knowledge.textEn: The tank construction plan should list filling stages, hold times and stop criteria for deflection and leakage, signed by both the structural designer and the waterproofing contractor; finishes on the floor below should be held back during the fill test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水槽結構、防水與分階段注水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
注水前對防水層與接縫做目視與真空箱或電火花檢漏，注水分 25%、50%、75%、100% 四階段，每階段靜置後量測樓板撓度、水位下降量與槽外滲漏，撓度與滲漏都在允收值內才進入下一階段。
水槽越寬、裝的水越多，晃動頻率就越低。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before filling, inspect the liner and joints visually and by vacuum-box or spark testing.
The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency.
quiz.explanation: 注水前對防水層與接縫做目視與真空箱或電火花檢漏，注水分 25%、50%、75%、100% 四階段，每階段靜置後量測樓板撓度、水位下降量與槽外滲漏，撓度與滲漏都在允收值內才進入下一階段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before filling, inspect the liner and joints visually and by vacuum-box or spark testing; fill in four stages of 25%, 50%, 75% and 100%, and after each hold measure slab deflection, level drop and external seepage, proceeding only when deflection and leakage are within acceptance limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水槽結構、防水與分階段注水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水槽結構與防水層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tank structure and waterproofing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混凝土水槽若未控制乾縮與溫度裂縫，滿水後滲漏會進入下層住戶或機電空間，持續失水又使阻尼器脫調；一次注滿而不分階段，可能在發現樓板撓度異常前就已造成裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete tanks without control of shrinkage and thermal cracking leak into the dwellings or plant rooms below once full, and the continuous loss of water also detunes the damper; filling in one go may crack the slab before abnormal deflection is noticed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：注水必須分階段進行，一方面確認樓板撓度與滲漏，一方面在每個水位量測頻率，逐步逼近調頻水位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Filling is done in stages, both to check slab deflection and leakage and to measure frequency at each level while approaching the tuning depth.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混凝土水槽若未控制乾縮與溫度裂縫，滿水後滲漏會進入下層住戶或機電空間，持續失水又使阻尼器脫調；一次注滿而不分階段，可能在發現樓板撓度異常前就已造成裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete tanks without control of shrinkage and thermal cracking leak into the dwellings or plant rooms below once full, and the continuous loss of water also detunes the damper; filling in one go may crack the slab before abnormal deflection is noticed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水槽結構、防水與分階段注水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。
混凝土水槽若未控制乾縮與溫度裂縫，滿水後滲漏會進入下層住戶或機電空間，持續失水又使阻尼器脫調；一次注滿而不分階段，可能在發現樓板撓度異常前就已造成裂縫。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Retuning a liquid damper by changing water depth has no effect on its mass ratio.
Concrete tanks without control of shrinkage and thermal cracking leak into the dwellings or plant rooms below once full, and the continuous loss of water also detunes the damper.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土水槽若未控制乾縮與溫度裂縫，滿水後滲漏會進入下層住戶或機電空間，持續失水又使阻尼器脫調；一次注滿而不分階段，可能在發現樓板撓度異常前就已造成裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete tanks without control of shrinkage and thermal cracking leak into the dwellings or plant rooms below once full, and the continuous loss of water also detunes the damper; filling in one go may crack the slab before abnormal deflection is noticed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 實測建築頻率與現場調頻：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measured building frequency and field tuning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「調頻水位」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tuning water level” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 完工建築的實際頻率常與分析值不同；One Wall Centre 的公開報導指出，建築與液柱阻尼器頻率須相差 10% 以內才有效，而其分析與第 41 層實測頻率相差約 3.2%。TLD 最大的優點是現場調頻容易：淺水槽改變水深，液柱阻尼器改變水量或液柱長度，即可移動頻率；但水深降低時參與的水也減少，質量比隨之下降，調頻與有效質量必須一起檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「調頻水位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The real frequency of a completed building often differs from analysis; published accounts of One Wall Centre note that building and liquid-column damper frequencies must be within 10% for the damper to work, and that analysis and measurement at level 41 agreed within about 3.2%. The great advantage of a TLD is easy field tuning: changing water depth in a shallow tank, or water volume or column length in a column damper, shifts the frequency; but lowering the depth also removes water and lowers the mass ratio, so tuning and effective mass must be checked together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tuning water level” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the measured f₁ = 0.185 Hz instead of the design 0.20 Hz, the target tank frequency is 0.185/(1+0.015) ≈ 0.182 Hz and ω² = 1.312; tanh(πh/L) = ω²L/(πg) = 1.312×6/30.82 ≈ 0.255, so πh/L ≈ 0.261 and h ≈ 0.50 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Retuning a liquid damper by changing water depth has no effect on its mass ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「調頻水位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tuning water level”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「實測建築頻率與現場調頻」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measured building frequency and field tuning" is correct?
options: 完工建築的實際頻率常與分析值不同。
液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。
縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。
optionsEn: The real frequency of a completed building often differs from analysis.
Retuning a liquid damper by changing water depth has no effect on its mass ratio.

quiz.explanationEn: The real frequency of a completed building often differs from analysis; published accounts of One Wall Centre note that building and liquid-column damper frequencies must be within 10% for the damper to work, and that analysis and measurement at level 41 agreed within about 3.2%. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 實測建築頻率與現場調頻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measured building frequency and field tuning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調頻水位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tuning water level” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若建築實測 f₁ = 0.185 Hz（設計 0.20 Hz），目標槽頻 f = 0.185/(1+0.015) ≈ 0.182 Hz，ω² = 1.312；tanh(πh/L) = ω²L/(πg) = 1.312×6/30.82 ≈ 0.255，πh/L ≈ 0.261，h ≈ 0.50 m。40 槽總水量由 576 降為約 479 m³，有效質量比降為約 1.26%，需增至約 48 槽才回到 1.5%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the measured f₁ = 0.185 Hz instead of the design 0.20 Hz, the target tank frequency is 0.185/(1+0.015) ≈ 0.182 Hz and ω² = 1.312; tanh(πh/L) = ω²L/(πg) = 1.312×6/30.82 ≈ 0.255, so πh/L ≈ 0.261 and h ≈ 0.50 m. The water in 40 tanks drops from 576 to about 479 m³ and the effective mass ratio to about 1.26%, so about 48 tanks are needed to return to 1.5%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以環境振動量測，在水槽排空或閘門鎖住時與注水後分別辨識建築頻率；再以水位計量測各槽自由晃動頻率，確認全部水槽落在目標值 ±2% 內，最後記錄每槽實際水深作為交接基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify the building frequency from ambient vibration both with tanks empty or gates locked and after filling; then measure the free-sloshing frequency of each tank with level gauges, confirm all tanks are within ±2% of the target, and record each tank's actual depth as the handover baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

The water in 40 tanks drops from 576 to about 479 m³ and the effective mass ratio to about 1.26%, so about 48 tanks are needed to return to 1.5%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「實測建築頻率與現場調頻」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measured building frequency and field tuning", which statement holds?
options: 水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。
水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。
optionsEn: As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change.
If the measured f₁ = 0.185 Hz instead of the design 0.20 Hz, the target tank frequency is 0.185/(1+0.015) ≈ 0.182 Hz and ω² = 1.312.
All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass.
quiz.explanationEn: If the measured f₁ = 0.185 Hz instead of the design 0.20 Hz, the target tank frequency is 0.185/(1+0.015) ≈ 0.182 Hz and ω² = 1.312; tanh(πh/L) = ω²L/(πg) = 1.312×6/30.82 ≈ 0.255, so πh/L ≈ 0.261 and h ≈ 0.50 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 實測建築頻率與現場調頻：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measured building frequency and field tuning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「調頻水位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tuning water level” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以環境振動量測，在水槽排空或閘門鎖住時與注水後分別辨識建築頻率；再以水位計量測各槽自由晃動頻率，確認全部水槽落在目標值 ±2% 內，最後記錄每槽實際水深作為交接基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify the building frequency from ambient vibration both with tanks empty or gates locked and after filling; then measure the free-sloshing frequency of each tank with level gauges, confirm all tanks are within ±2% of the target, and record each tank's actual depth as the handover baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計階段就預留增設水槽的空間與樓板承載，或把水槽設計成可在一段水深範圍內工作；調頻作業安排在帷幕牆與主要裝修完成後，並把每槽水深、水位計零點與實測頻率列表交接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reserve space and slab capacity for extra tanks at design stage, or design tanks to work across a range of depths; carry out tuning after the façade and major fit-out are complete, and hand over a table of each tank's depth, gauge zero and measured frequency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只把水深調到頻率吻合而沒有重算有效質量，有效質量比可能少約 16%，等效阻尼隨之下降；各槽水深若不一致，水槽頻率分散，整體表現像許多小阻尼器各自為政，峰值降低有限。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adjusting depth only for frequency without recomputing effective mass can leave the effective mass ratio about 16% short, with equivalent damping falling accordingly; inconsistent depths across tanks scatter their frequencies, so the array behaves like many small dampers acting independently and the peak reduction is limited. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以環境振動量測，在水槽排空或閘門鎖住時與注水後分別辨識建築頻率；再以水位計量測各槽自由晃動頻率，確認全部水槽落在目標值 ±2% 內，最後記錄每槽實際水深作為交接基準。

knowledge.text: 設計階段就預留增設水槽的空間與樓板承載，或把水槽設計成可在一段水深範圍內工作；調頻作業安排在帷幕牆與主要裝修完成後，並把每槽水深、水位計零點與實測頻率列表交接。

quiz.question: 要驗證「實測建築頻率與現場調頻」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measured building frequency and field tuning"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
U 形液柱阻尼器的頻率可以靠加寬水平段來調整。

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The frequency of a U-tube damper can be tuned by widening the horizontal leg.
Identify the building frequency from ambient vibration both with tanks empty or gates locked and after filling.
quiz.explanation: 以環境振動量測，在水槽排空或閘門鎖住時與注水後分別辨識建築頻率；再以水位計量測各槽自由晃動頻率，確認全部水槽落在目標值 ±2% 內，最後記錄每槽實際水深作為交接基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify the building frequency from ambient vibration both with tanks empty or gates locked and after filling; then measure the free-sloshing frequency of each tank with level gauges, confirm all tanks are within ±2% of the target, and record each tank's actual depth as the handover baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 實測建築頻率與現場調頻：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調頻水位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tuning water level” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
