knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「實測建築頻率與現場調頻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measured building frequency and field tuning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只把水深調到頻率吻合而沒有重算有效質量，有效質量比可能少約 16%，等效阻尼隨之下降。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。
optionsEn: Adjusting depth only for frequency without recomputing effective mass can leave the effective mass ratio about 16% short, with equivalent damping falling accordingly.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A scaled model can keep the full-scale water depth and simply shrink the plan dimensions.
quiz.explanation: 只把水深調到頻率吻合而沒有重算有效質量，有效質量比可能少約 16%，等效阻尼隨之下降；各槽水深若不一致，水槽頻率分散，整體表現像許多小阻尼器各自為政，峰值降低有限。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adjusting depth only for frequency without recomputing effective mass can leave the effective mass ratio about 16% short, with equivalent damping falling accordingly; inconsistent depths across tanks scatter their frequencies, so the array behaves like many small dampers acting independently and the peak reduction is limited. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」與「完工監測與等效阻尼識別」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Froude similitude and model testing" and "Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 福祿數相似律與模型試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Froude similitude and model testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「縮尺水槽振動台試驗」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scaled tank shaking-table test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 晃動由重力主導，縮尺試驗必須維持福祿數相同：幾何縮小 λ 倍時，頻率放大 √λ 倍、時間縮短 √λ 倍、振幅縮小 λ 倍。這讓工程師能在實驗室振動台上以小水槽重現碎波與阻尼網效果，One Rincon Hill 的水槽即曾在加拿大西安大略大學測試。但雷諾數無法同時相似，小模型的黏性損失相對偏大，阻尼網的損失係數最好以接近實尺度的樣品校核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「縮尺水槽振動台試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sloshing is gravity-dominated, so scaled tests must preserve the Froude number: shrinking geometry by λ raises frequency by √λ, shortens time by √λ and reduces amplitude by λ. This lets engineers reproduce wave breaking and screen effects with small tanks on a laboratory shaking table; the tanks for One Rincon Hill were tested at the University of Western Ontario. Reynolds number cannot be matched at the same time, so viscous losses are relatively larger in small models, and screen loss coefficients are best checked with near-full-scale samples. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Scaled tank shaking-table test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：實尺度槽 L = 6.0 m、h = 0.60 m、f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz；以 λ = 5 縮尺為 L = 1.2 m、h = 0.12 m，模型頻率 f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz；實尺度 0.10 m 的建築振幅在模型中只需 0.02 m，10 分鐘的實尺度風暴對應約 600/√5 ≈ 268 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A full-scale tank with L = 6.0 m, h = 0.60 m and f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz becomes L = 1.2 m and h = 0.12 m at λ = 5; the model frequency is f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz, a 0.10 m full-scale building amplitude needs only 0.02 m in the model, and a 10-minute full-scale storm corresponds to about 600/√5 ≈ 268 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A scaled model can keep the full-scale water depth and simply shrink the plan dimensions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「縮尺水槽振動台試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Scaled tank shaking-table test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 福祿數相似律與模型試驗
knowledge.text: 晃動由重力主導，縮尺試驗必須維持福祿數相同：幾何縮小 λ 倍時，頻率放大 √λ 倍、時間縮短 √λ 倍、振幅縮小 λ 倍。這讓工程師能在實驗室振動台上以小水槽重現碎波與阻尼網效果，One Rincon Hill 的水槽即曾在加拿大西安大略大學測試。
knowledge.textEn: Sloshing is gravity-dominated, so scaled tests must preserve the Froude number: shrinking geometry by λ raises frequency by √λ, shortens time by √λ and reduces amplitude by λ. This lets engineers reproduce wave breaking and screen effects with small tanks on a laboratory shaking table; the tanks for One Rincon Hill were tested at the University of Western Ontario.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A scaled model can keep the full-scale water depth and simply shrink the plan dimensions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Froude similitude and model testing" is correct?
options: 縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。
晃動由重力主導，縮尺試驗必須維持福祿數相同：幾何縮小 λ 倍時，頻率放大 √λ 倍、時間縮短 √λ 倍、振幅縮小 λ 倍。
只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。
optionsEn: A scaled model can keep the full-scale water depth and simply shrink the plan dimensions.
Sloshing is gravity-dominated, so scaled tests must preserve the Froude number: shrinking geometry by λ raises frequency by √λ, shortens time by √λ and reduces amplitude by λ.
A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works.
quiz.explanation: 晃動由重力主導，縮尺試驗必須維持福祿數相同：幾何縮小 λ 倍時，頻率放大 √λ 倍、時間縮短 √λ 倍、振幅縮小 λ 倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sloshing is gravity-dominated, so scaled tests must preserve the Froude number: shrinking geometry by λ raises frequency by √λ, shortens time by √λ and reduces amplitude by λ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 福祿數相似律與模型試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Froude similitude and model testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縮尺水槽振動台試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scaled tank shaking-table test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：實尺度槽 L = 6.0 m、h = 0.60 m、f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz；以 λ = 5 縮尺為 L = 1.2 m、h = 0.12 m，模型頻率 f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz；實尺度 0.10 m 的建築振幅在模型中只需 0.02 m，10 分鐘的實尺度風暴對應約 600/√5 ≈ 268 s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A full-scale tank with L = 6.0 m, h = 0.60 m and f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz becomes L = 1.2 m and h = 0.12 m at λ = 5; the model frequency is f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz, a 0.10 m full-scale building amplitude needs only 0.02 m in the model, and a 10-minute full-scale storm corresponds to about 600/√5 ≈ 268 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：振動台以實測或合成的建築頂部位移歷時驅動模型水槽，以荷重元量測槽底水平力、以波高計量測水面，計算力與位移的相位與每循環耗能；結果換算回實尺度後，與數值模型預測的等效阻尼比較，差異須能解釋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Drive the model tank on the shaking table with measured or synthetic top-floor displacement histories, measure base shear with load cells and the free surface with wave gauges, and compute the force–displacement phase and energy per cycle; scale the results back to full size and compare the equivalent damping with numerical predictions, requiring explainable differences.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 實尺度槽 L = 6.0 m、h = 0.60 m、f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz；以 λ = 5 縮尺為 L = 1.2 m、h = 0.12 m，模型頻率 f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz；實尺度 0.10 m 的建築振幅在模型中只需 0.02 m，10 分鐘的實尺度風暴對應約 600/√5 ≈ 268 s。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A full-scale tank with L = 6.0 m, h = 0.60 m and f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz becomes L = 1.2 m and h = 0.12 m at λ = 5; the model frequency is f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz, a 0.10 m full-scale building amplitude needs only 0.02 m in the model, and a 10-minute full-scale storm corresponds to about 600/√5 ≈ 268 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Froude similitude and model testing", which statement holds?
options: 水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。
水槽越寬、裝的水越多，晃動頻率就越低。
optionsEn: Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake.
The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency.
A full-scale tank with L = 6.0 m, h = 0.60 m and f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz becomes L = 1.2 m and h = 0.12 m at λ = 5.
quiz.explanation: 實尺度槽 L = 6.0 m、h = 0.60 m、f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz；以 λ = 5 縮尺為 L = 1.2 m、h = 0.12 m，模型頻率 f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz；實尺度 0.10 m 的建築振幅在模型中只需 0.02 m，10 分鐘的實尺度風暴對應約 600/√5 ≈ 268 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A full-scale tank with L = 6.0 m, h = 0.60 m and f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz becomes L = 1.2 m and h = 0.12 m at λ = 5; the model frequency is f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz, a 0.10 m full-scale building amplitude needs only 0.02 m in the model, and a 10-minute full-scale storm corresponds to about 600/√5 ≈ 268 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 福祿數相似律與模型試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Froude similitude and model testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「縮尺水槽振動台試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scaled tank shaking-table test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 振動台以實測或合成的建築頂部位移歷時驅動模型水槽，以荷重元量測槽底水平力、以波高計量測水面，計算力與位移的相位與每循環耗能；結果換算回實尺度後，與數值模型預測的等效阻尼比較，差異須能解釋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Drive the model tank on the shaking table with measured or synthetic top-floor displacement histories, measure base shear with load cells and the free surface with wave gauges, and compute the force–displacement phase and energy per cycle; scale the results back to full size and compare the equivalent damping with numerical predictions, requiring explainable differences. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗計畫應列出相似律、縮尺比、輸入歷時、量測儀器與允收比較方式並保留原始資料；阻尼網或閘門的設計值，須經接近實尺度的元件試驗確認後才定案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The test plan should list the similitude law, scale, input histories, instruments and acceptance comparison, and keep raw data; screen or gate design values should be fixed only after near-full-scale component tests.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若縮尺試驗沿用實尺度水深而只縮小平面，頻率與碎波行為都不相似，得到的阻尼會誤導設計；只做正弦試驗而不做隨機激振，也可能高估實際風況下的效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scaling only the plan while keeping full-scale depth makes neither frequency nor wave breaking similar, and the damping obtained misleads the design; running only sinusoidal tests without random excitation can also overstate performance in real wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 振動台以實測或合成的建築頂部位移歷時驅動模型水槽，以荷重元量測槽底水平力、以波高計量測水面，計算力與位移的相位與每循環耗能；結果換算回實尺度後，與數值模型預測的等效阻尼比較，差異須能解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Drive the model tank on the shaking table with measured or synthetic top-floor displacement histories, measure base shear with load cells and the free surface with wave gauges, and compute the force–displacement phase and energy per cycle; scale the results back to full size and compare the equivalent damping with numerical predictions, requiring explainable differences.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫應列出相似律、縮尺比、輸入歷時、量測儀器與允收比較方式並保留原始資料；阻尼網或閘門的設計值，須經接近實尺度的元件試驗確認後才定案。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan should list the similitude law, scale, input histories, instruments and acceptance comparison, and keep raw data; screen or gate design values should be fixed only after near-full-scale component tests.

quiz.question: 要驗證「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Froude similitude and model testing"?
options: 振動台以實測或合成的建築頂部位移歷時驅動模型水槽，以荷重元量測槽底水平力、以波高計量測水面，計算力與位移的相位與每循環耗能。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。
optionsEn: Drive the model tank on the shaking table with measured or synthetic top-floor displacement histories, measure base shear with load cells and the free surface with wave gauges, and compute the force–displacement phase and energy per cycle.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude.
quiz.explanation: 振動台以實測或合成的建築頂部位移歷時驅動模型水槽，以荷重元量測槽底水平力、以波高計量測水面，計算力與位移的相位與每循環耗能；結果換算回實尺度後，與數值模型預測的等效阻尼比較，差異須能解釋。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Drive the model tank on the shaking table with measured or synthetic top-floor displacement histories, measure base shear with load cells and the free surface with wave gauges, and compute the force–displacement phase and energy per cycle; scale the results back to full size and compare the equivalent damping with numerical predictions, requiring explainable differences. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 福祿數相似律與模型試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Froude similitude and model testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「縮尺水槽振動台試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scaled tank shaking-table test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若縮尺試驗沿用實尺度水深而只縮小平面，頻率與碎波行為都不相似，得到的阻尼會誤導設計；只做正弦試驗而不做隨機激振，也可能高估實際風況下的效果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling only the plan while keeping full-scale depth makes neither frequency nor wave breaking similar, and the damping obtained misleads the design; running only sinusoidal tests without random excitation can also overstate performance in real wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但雷諾數無法同時相似，小模型的黏性損失相對偏大，阻尼網的損失係數最好以接近實尺度的樣品校核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reynolds number cannot be matched at the same time, so viscous losses are relatively larger in small models, and screen loss coefficients are best checked with near-full-scale samples.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A scaled model can keep the full-scale water depth and simply shrink the plan dimensions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若縮尺試驗沿用實尺度水深而只縮小平面，頻率與碎波行為都不相似，得到的阻尼會誤導設計；只做正弦試驗而不做隨機激振，也可能高估實際風況下的效果。
knowledge.textEn: Scaling only the plan while keeping full-scale depth makes neither frequency nor wave breaking similar, and the damping obtained misleads the design; running only sinusoidal tests without random excitation can also overstate performance in real wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Froude similitude and model testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若縮尺試驗沿用實尺度水深而只縮小平面，頻率與碎波行為都不相似，得到的阻尼會誤導設計；只做正弦試驗而不做隨機激振，也可能高估實際風況下的效果。
只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Scaling only the plan while keeping full-scale depth makes neither frequency nor wave breaking similar, and the damping obtained misleads the design.
A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works.
quiz.explanation: 若縮尺試驗沿用實尺度水深而只縮小平面，頻率與碎波行為都不相似，得到的阻尼會誤導設計；只做正弦試驗而不做隨機激振，也可能高估實際風況下的效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling only the plan while keeping full-scale depth makes neither frequency nor wave breaking similar, and the damping obtained misleads the design; running only sinusoidal tests without random excitation can also overstate performance in real wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 完工監測與等效阻尼識別：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「波高計與頂層加速度計」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave gauges and roof accelerometers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 完工後要證明水槽在真實風況下有效，需要同時量測建築頂層加速度、各水槽水位與風速風向。水位與建築位移的相位差可判斷是否調諧：接近共振時，水面晃動落後建築約 90 度；加速度紀錄則以隨機遞減法或系統識別求出含 TLD 的總阻尼比。由於 TLD 是非線性，阻尼比必須依振幅分組比較，不能只報一個數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「波高計與頂層加速度計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: To prove the tanks work in real wind after completion, measure roof acceleration, the water level in the tanks and wind speed and direction at the same time. The phase between water level and building displacement shows whether the damper is tuned: near resonance the sloshing lags the building by about 90 degrees; the acceleration records give the total damping ratio including the TLD by the random-decrement method or system identification. Because a TLD is nonlinear, damping must be grouped and compared by amplitude rather than reported as a single number. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wave gauges and roof accelerometers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：對寬頻風力，均方根加速度約與 1/√ζ_total 成正比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For broadband wind forcing, RMS acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/√ζ_total.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「波高計與頂層加速度計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wave gauges and roof accelerometers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完工監測與等效阻尼識別
knowledge.text: 完工後要證明水槽在真實風況下有效，需要同時量測建築頂層加速度、各水槽水位與風速風向。水位與建築位移的相位差可判斷是否調諧：接近共振時，水面晃動落後建築約 90 度；加速度紀錄則以隨機遞減法或系統識別求出含 TLD 的總阻尼比。
knowledge.textEn: To prove the tanks work in real wind after completion, measure roof acceleration, the water level in the tanks and wind speed and direction at the same time. The phase between water level and building displacement shows whether the damper is tuned: near resonance the sloshing lags the building by about 90 degrees; the acceleration records give the total damping ratio including the TLD by the random-decrement method or system identification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完工監測與等效阻尼識別」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification" is correct?
options: 只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。
水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。
完工後要證明水槽在真實風況下有效，需要同時量測建築頂層加速度、各水槽水位與風速風向。
optionsEn: A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works.
As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change.
To prove the tanks work in real wind after completion, measure roof acceleration, the water level in the tanks and wind speed and direction at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 完工後要證明水槽在真實風況下有效，需要同時量測建築頂層加速度、各水槽水位與風速風向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: To prove the tanks work in real wind after completion, measure roof acceleration, the water level in the tanks and wind speed and direction at the same time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完工監測與等效阻尼識別：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波高計與頂層加速度計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wave gauges and roof accelerometers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：對寬頻風力，均方根加速度約與 1/√ζ_total 成正比。結構阻尼 1.5%、加裝 TLD 後總阻尼 4.0% 時，加速度比 = √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 0.61，約降低 39%；若實測總阻尼只有 3.0%，比值為 √(1.5/3.0) ≈ 0.71，降幅縮為約 29%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For broadband wind forcing, RMS acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/√ζ_total. With 1.5% structural damping and 4.0% total damping with the TLD, the acceleration ratio is √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 0.61, a reduction of about 39%; if only 3.0% total damping is measured, the ratio is √(1.5/3.0) ≈ 0.71 and the reduction shrinks to about 29%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：監測至少涵蓋一個強風季節，把每段 10 分鐘紀錄依頂層加速度振幅分組，求出各組的頻率與總阻尼，與設計的阻尼—振幅曲線比較；必要時短暫降低水位或鎖住閘門做對照量測，確認差異來自阻尼器而非風況變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Monitor through at least one windy season, group 10-minute records by roof acceleration amplitude, identify frequency and total damping for each group, and compare with the design damping–amplitude curve; where needed briefly lower the water or lock the gates for a comparison run to confirm the difference comes from the damper rather than changing wind.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 對寬頻風力，均方根加速度約與 1/√ζ_total 成正比。結構阻尼 1.5%、加裝 TLD 後總阻尼 4.0% 時，加速度比 = √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 0.61，約降低 39%；若實測總阻尼只有 3.0%，比值為 √(1.5/3.0) ≈ 0.71，降幅縮為約 29%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For broadband wind forcing, RMS acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/√ζ_total. With 1.5% structural damping and 4.0% total damping with the TLD, the acceleration ratio is √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 0.61, a reduction of about 39%; if only 3.0% total damping is measured, the ratio is √(1.5/3.0) ≈ 0.71 and the reduction shrinks to about 29%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「完工監測與等效阻尼識別」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification", which statement holds?
options: 對寬頻風力，均方根加速度約與 1/√ζ_total 成正比。
水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。
U 形液柱阻尼器的頻率可以靠加寬水平段來調整。
optionsEn: For broadband wind forcing, RMS acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/√ζ_total.
All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass.
The frequency of a U-tube damper can be tuned by widening the horizontal leg.
quiz.explanation: 對寬頻風力，均方根加速度約與 1/√ζ_total 成正比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For broadband wind forcing, RMS acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/√ζ_total. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 完工監測與等效阻尼識別：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「波高計與頂層加速度計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wave gauges and roof accelerometers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 監測至少涵蓋一個強風季節，把每段 10 分鐘紀錄依頂層加速度振幅分組，求出各組的頻率與總阻尼，與設計的阻尼—振幅曲線比較；必要時短暫降低水位或鎖住閘門做對照量測，確認差異來自阻尼器而非風況變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor through at least one windy season, group 10-minute records by roof acceleration amplitude, identify frequency and total damping for each group, and compare with the design damping–amplitude curve; where needed briefly lower the water or lock the gates for a comparison run to confirm the difference comes from the damper rather than changing wind. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測報告要附各水槽水位、建築加速度與風資料的同步時間軸，並列明分組方式與識別方法；業主驗收應以設計振幅附近的資料為準，而非全部資料的平均。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring report should include a synchronised timeline of tank levels, building acceleration and wind data and state the grouping and identification methods; owner acceptance should rest on data near the design amplitude rather than on an average of all records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用低風速的環境振動資料識別阻尼，振幅太小使 TLD 幾乎不耗能，會誤判阻尼器無效；反之只挑幾次強風事件，又可能把風況差異誤當成阻尼器效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Identifying damping only from low-wind ambient data, where amplitudes are too small for the TLD to dissipate much, wrongly suggests the damper is ineffective; picking only a few strong-wind events can instead mistake differences in wind for damper performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 監測至少涵蓋一個強風季節，把每段 10 分鐘紀錄依頂層加速度振幅分組，求出各組的頻率與總阻尼，與設計的阻尼—振幅曲線比較；必要時短暫降低水位或鎖住閘門做對照量測，確認差異來自阻尼器而非風況變化。
knowledge.textEn: Monitor through at least one windy season, group 10-minute records by roof acceleration amplitude, identify frequency and total damping for each group, and compare with the design damping–amplitude curve; where needed briefly lower the water or lock the gates for a comparison run to confirm the difference comes from the damper rather than changing wind.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測報告要附各水槽水位、建築加速度與風資料的同步時間軸，並列明分組方式與識別方法；業主驗收應以設計振幅附近的資料為準，而非全部資料的平均。
knowledge.textEn: The monitoring report should include a synchronised timeline of tank levels, building acceleration and wind data and state the grouping and identification methods; owner acceptance should rest on data near the design amplitude rather than on an average of all records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「完工監測與等效阻尼識別」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
監測至少涵蓋一個強風季節，把每段 10 分鐘紀錄依頂層加速度振幅分組，求出各組的頻率與總阻尼，與設計的阻尼—振幅曲線比較。
水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Monitor through at least one windy season, group 10-minute records by roof acceleration amplitude, identify frequency and total damping for each group, and compare with the design damping–amplitude curve.
A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member.
quiz.explanation: 監測至少涵蓋一個強風季節，把每段 10 分鐘紀錄依頂層加速度振幅分組，求出各組的頻率與總阻尼，與設計的阻尼—振幅曲線比較；必要時短暫降低水位或鎖住閘門做對照量測，確認差異來自阻尼器而非風況變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitor through at least one windy season, group 10-minute records by roof acceleration amplitude, identify frequency and total damping for each group, and compare with the design damping–amplitude curve; where needed briefly lower the water or lock the gates for a comparison run to confirm the difference comes from the damper rather than changing wind. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 完工監測與等效阻尼識別：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波高計與頂層加速度計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wave gauges and roof accelerometers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用低風速的環境振動資料識別阻尼，振幅太小使 TLD 幾乎不耗能，會誤判阻尼器無效；反之只挑幾次強風事件，又可能把風況差異誤當成阻尼器效果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Identifying damping only from low-wind ambient data, where amplitudes are too small for the TLD to dissipate much, wrongly suggests the damper is ineffective; picking only a few strong-wind events can instead mistake differences in wind for damper performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於 TLD 是非線性，阻尼比必須依振幅分組比較，不能只報一個數字。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because a TLD is nonlinear, damping must be grouped and compared by amplitude rather than reported as a single number.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只用低風速的環境振動資料識別阻尼，振幅太小使 TLD 幾乎不耗能，會誤判阻尼器無效；反之只挑幾次強風事件，又可能把風況差異誤當成阻尼器效果。
knowledge.textEn: Identifying damping only from low-wind ambient data, where amplitudes are too small for the TLD to dissipate much, wrongly suggests the damper is ineffective; picking only a few strong-wind events can instead mistake differences in wind for damper performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「完工監測與等效阻尼識別」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。
若只用低風速的環境振動資料識別阻尼，振幅太小使 TLD 幾乎不耗能，會誤判阻尼器無效；反之只挑幾次強風事件，又可能把風況差異誤當成阻尼器效果。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change.
Identifying damping only from low-wind ambient data, where amplitudes are too small for the TLD to dissipate much, wrongly suggests the damper is ineffective.
quiz.explanation: 若只用低風速的環境振動資料識別阻尼，振幅太小使 TLD 幾乎不耗能，會誤判阻尼器無效；反之只挑幾次強風事件，又可能把風況差異誤當成阻尼器效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Identifying damping only from low-wind ambient data, where amplitudes are too small for the TLD to dissipate much, wrongly suggests the damper is ineffective; picking only a few strong-wind events can instead mistake differences in wind for damper performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「蒸發、水質與防凍」與「極端事件、出水高度與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection" and "Extreme events, freeboard and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 蒸發、水質與防凍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「補水與水質管理」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Make-up water and water quality” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: TLD 的質量就是水，水量變化就是調頻變化：通氣水槽會蒸發，閥門或接縫會滲漏，寒冷地區水面可能結冰，冰層不但改變晃動形態，也會讓阻尼網與水位計失效。靜止水體容易滋生藻類與微生物，常需添加殺菌劑或防凍劑，但添加物會改變密度與黏性，也可能腐蝕金屬阻尼網。水槽兼作消防水源時，火災後若未補足抽用的水，阻尼器會長期脫調。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「補水與水質管理」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A TLD's mass is its water, so any change in water is a change in tuning: vented tanks evaporate, valves and joints leak, and in cold climates the surface can freeze, which alters sloshing and disables screens and level gauges. Still water breeds algae and microbes, so biocides or antifreeze are often added, but additives change density and viscosity and may corrode metal screens. When the tanks double as fire storage, failing to refill after a fire draw-down leaves the damper detuned for a long time. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Make-up water and water quality” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：40 槽總水面約 960 m²，若日蒸發 1 mm，每月損失約 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³，即 576 m³ 的 5%，水深由 0.60 m 降到 0.57 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The 40 tanks expose about 960 m² of water; at 1 mm of evaporation per day the monthly loss is about 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³, 5% of 576 m³, lowering the depth from 0.60 m to 0.57 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「補水與水質管理」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Make-up water and water quality”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 蒸發、水質與防凍
knowledge.titleEn: Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection
knowledge.text: TLD 的質量就是水，水量變化就是調頻變化：通氣水槽會蒸發，閥門或接縫會滲漏，寒冷地區水面可能結冰，冰層不但改變晃動形態，也會讓阻尼網與水位計失效。靜止水體容易滋生藻類與微生物，常需添加殺菌劑或防凍劑，但添加物會改變密度與黏性，也可能腐蝕金屬阻尼網。
knowledge.textEn: A TLD's mass is its water, so any change in water is a change in tuning: vented tanks evaporate, valves and joints leak, and in cold climates the surface can freeze, which alters sloshing and disables screens and level gauges. Still water breeds algae and microbes, so biocides or antifreeze are often added, but additives change density and viscosity and may corrode metal screens.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「蒸發、水質與防凍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection" is correct?
options: TLD 的質量就是水，水量變化就是調頻變化：通氣水槽會蒸發，閥門或接縫會滲漏，寒冷地區水面可能結冰，冰層不但改變晃動形態，也會讓阻尼網與水位計失效。
水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。
水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。
optionsEn: A TLD's mass is its water, so any change in water is a change in tuning: vented tanks evaporate, valves and joints leak, and in cold climates the surface can freeze, which alters sloshing and disables screens and level gauges.
As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change.
Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: TLD 的質量就是水，水量變化就是調頻變化：通氣水槽會蒸發，閥門或接縫會滲漏，寒冷地區水面可能結冰，冰層不但改變晃動形態，也會讓阻尼網與水位計失效。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A TLD's mass is its water, so any change in water is a change in tuning: vented tanks evaporate, valves and joints leak, and in cold climates the surface can freeze, which alters sloshing and disables screens and level gauges. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 蒸發、水質與防凍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「補水與水質管理」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Make-up water and water quality” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：40 槽總水面約 960 m²，若日蒸發 1 mm，每月損失約 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³，即 576 m³ 的 5%，水深由 0.60 m 降到 0.57 m。tanh(π×0.57/6) = 0.290，頻率比 √(0.290/0.304) ≈ 0.976，頻率約下降 2.4%（0.199 → 0.194 Hz）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The 40 tanks expose about 960 m² of water; at 1 mm of evaporation per day the monthly loss is about 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³, 5% of 576 m³, lowering the depth from 0.60 m to 0.57 m. With tanh(π×0.57/6) = 0.290, the frequency ratio is √(0.290/0.304) ≈ 0.976, a drop of about 2.4% (0.199 to 0.194 Hz). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每槽設連續水位計並設定上下限警報（例如偏離調頻水位 ±10 mm），記錄自動補水閥的動作次數與補水量；每季取樣檢驗水質、添加劑濃度與密度，每年目視檢查阻尼網鏽蝕與沉積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit each tank with a continuous level gauge and alarms at upper and lower limits (for example ±10 mm from the tuning level), and log auto-fill valve operations and volumes; sample water quality, additive concentration and density quarterly, and inspect screens for corrosion and deposits each year.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: The 40 tanks expose about 960 m² of water; at 1 mm of evaporation per day the monthly loss is about 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³, 5% of 576 m³, lowering the depth from 0.60 m to 0.57 m. With tanh(π×0.57/6) = 0.290, the frequency ratio is √(0.290/0.304) ≈ 0.976, a drop of about 2.4% (0.199 to 0.194 Hz). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「蒸發、水質與防凍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection", which statement holds?
options: 水槽越寬、裝的水越多，晃動頻率就越低。
40 槽總水面約 960 m²，若日蒸發 1 mm，每月損失約 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³，即 576 m³ 的 5%，水深由 0.60 m 降到 0.57 m。
液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。
optionsEn: The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency.
The 40 tanks expose about 960 m² of water.
A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude.
quiz.explanation: 40 槽總水面約 960 m²，若日蒸發 1 mm，每月損失約 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³，即 576 m³ 的 5%，水深由 0.60 m 降到 0.57 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The 40 tanks expose about 960 m² of water; at 1 mm of evaporation per day the monthly loss is about 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³, 5% of 576 m³, lowering the depth from 0.60 m to 0.57 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 蒸發、水質與防凍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「補水與水質管理」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Make-up water and water quality” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每槽設連續水位計並設定上下限警報（例如偏離調頻水位 ±10 mm），記錄自動補水閥的動作次數與補水量；每季取樣檢驗水質、添加劑濃度與密度，每年目視檢查阻尼網鏽蝕與沉積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit each tank with a continuous level gauge and alarms at upper and lower limits (for example ±10 mm from the tuning level), and log auto-fill valve operations and volumes; sample water quality, additive concentration and density quarterly, and inspect screens for corrosion and deposits each year. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊要把調頻水位、消防最低水位與溢流水位分別標示，並規定任何添加劑、清洗或排水作業前須通知結構顧問；水位警報應接到中央監控室。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should mark the tuning level, fire minimum level and overflow level separately, and require the structural consultant to be notified before any additive, cleaning or drainage work; level alarms should report to the central control room.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：補水閥故障或水位計漂移時，水位慢慢下降數公分，建築照常使用卻已脫調，直到強風季住戶抱怨才被發現；加入防凍液而未重算密度與黏性，也會讓頻率與阻尼偏離試驗基準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A failed fill valve or drifting gauge lets the level fall a few centimetres; the building stays in normal use but detuned until occupants complain in the windy season; adding antifreeze without recomputing density and viscosity also shifts frequency and damping away from the test baseline. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每槽設連續水位計並設定上下限警報（例如偏離調頻水位 ±10 mm），記錄自動補水閥的動作次數與補水量；每季取樣檢驗水質、添加劑濃度與密度，每年目視檢查阻尼網鏽蝕與沉積。
knowledge.textEn: Fit each tank with a continuous level gauge and alarms at upper and lower limits (for example ±10 mm from the tuning level), and log auto-fill valve operations and volumes; sample water quality, additive concentration and density quarterly, and inspect screens for corrosion and deposits each year.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊要把調頻水位、消防最低水位與溢流水位分別標示，並規定任何添加劑、清洗或排水作業前須通知結構顧問；水位警報應接到中央監控室。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should mark the tuning level, fire minimum level and overflow level separately, and require the structural consultant to be notified before any additive, cleaning or drainage work; level alarms should report to the central control room.

quiz.question: 要驗證「蒸發、水質與防凍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。
每槽設連續水位計並設定上下限警報（例如偏離調頻水位 ±10 mm），記錄自動補水閥的動作次數與補水量。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Retuning a liquid damper by changing water depth has no effect on its mass ratio.
Fit each tank with a continuous level gauge and alarms at upper and lower limits (for example ±10 mm from the tuning level), and log auto-fill valve operations and volumes.
quiz.explanation: 每槽設連續水位計並設定上下限警報（例如偏離調頻水位 ±10 mm），記錄自動補水閥的動作次數與補水量；每季取樣檢驗水質、添加劑濃度與密度，每年目視檢查阻尼網鏽蝕與沉積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit each tank with a continuous level gauge and alarms at upper and lower limits (for example ±10 mm from the tuning level), and log auto-fill valve operations and volumes; sample water quality, additive concentration and density quarterly, and inspect screens for corrosion and deposits each year. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 蒸發、水質與防凍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「補水與水質管理」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Make-up water and water quality” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 補水閥故障或水位計漂移時，水位慢慢下降數公分，建築照常使用卻已脫調，直到強風季住戶抱怨才被發現；加入防凍液而未重算密度與黏性，也會讓頻率與阻尼偏離試驗基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A failed fill valve or drifting gauge lets the level fall a few centimetres; the building stays in normal use but detuned until occupants complain in the windy season; adding antifreeze without recomputing density and viscosity also shifts frequency and damping away from the test baseline. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水槽兼作消防水源時，火災後若未補足抽用的水，阻尼器會長期脫調。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When the tanks double as fire storage, failing to refill after a fire draw-down leaves the damper detuned for a long time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 補水閥故障或水位計漂移時，水位慢慢下降數公分，建築照常使用卻已脫調，直到強風季住戶抱怨才被發現；加入防凍液而未重算密度與黏性，也會讓頻率與阻尼偏離試驗基準。
knowledge.textEn: A failed fill valve or drifting gauge lets the level fall a few centimetres; the building stays in normal use but detuned until occupants complain in the windy season; adding antifreeze without recomputing density and viscosity also shifts frequency and damping away from the test baseline.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蒸發、水質與防凍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補水閥故障或水位計漂移時，水位慢慢下降數公分，建築照常使用卻已脫調，直到強風季住戶抱怨才被發現；加入防凍液而未重算密度與黏性，也會讓頻率與阻尼偏離試驗基準。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。
optionsEn: A failed fill valve or drifting gauge lets the level fall a few centimetres.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 補水閥故障或水位計漂移時，水位慢慢下降數公分，建築照常使用卻已脫調，直到強風季住戶抱怨才被發現；加入防凍液而未重算密度與黏性，也會讓頻率與阻尼偏離試驗基準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A failed fill valve or drifting gauge lets the level fall a few centimetres; the building stays in normal use but detuned until occupants complain in the windy season; adding antifreeze without recomputing density and viscosity also shifts frequency and damping away from the test baseline. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 極端事件、出水高度與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Extreme events, freeboard and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「出水高度與槽頂」如何影響液態調諧阻尼器的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Freeboard and tank roof” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tuned liquid dampers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 颱風或地震時，水面振幅可能遠超過舒適度設計振幅，水面撞擊槽頂會產生衝擊壓力，濺出的水則造成屋頂積水與水量流失。設計須在兩種策略中擇一：保留足夠出水高度讓水自由晃動，或把槽頂設計成承受衝擊的結構。地震時 TLD 也會把晃動動壓傳回結構，須納入屋頂構件設計；事件後的檢查與交接文件，決定阻尼器能否迅速回到調頻狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「出水高度與槽頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a typhoon or earthquake the surface excursion can far exceed the comfort-design amplitude; water striking the tank roof produces impact pressure, and spillage floods the roof and loses water. Design must adopt one of two strategies: enough freeboard for free sloshing, or a tank roof designed for impact. In an earthquake the TLD also returns sloshing pressure to the structure, which must be included in roof member design; post-event inspection and handover documents decide whether the damper can quickly return to its tuned state. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Freeboard and tank roof” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以線性化估計 η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A linearised estimate is η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「出水高度與槽頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Freeboard and tank roof”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Design must adopt one of two strategies: enough freeboard for free sloshing, or a tank roof designed for impact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「極端事件、出水高度與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Extreme events, freeboard and handover" is correct?
options: 水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。
颱風或地震時，水面振幅可能遠超過舒適度設計振幅，水面撞擊槽頂會產生衝擊壓力，濺出的水則造成屋頂積水與水量流失。
水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。
optionsEn: Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake.
In a typhoon or earthquake the surface excursion can far exceed the comfort-design amplitude.
All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass.
quiz.explanation: 颱風或地震時，水面振幅可能遠超過舒適度設計振幅，水面撞擊槽頂會產生衝擊壓力，濺出的水則造成屋頂積水與水量流失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a typhoon or earthquake the surface excursion can far exceed the comfort-design amplitude; water striking the tank roof produces impact pressure, and spillage floods the roof and loses water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 極端事件、出水高度與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Extreme events, freeboard and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出水高度與槽頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Freeboard and tank roof” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以線性化估計 η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g)。槽長 L = 6.0 m、晃動頻率處的樓頂譜加速度 S_a = 0.15 g 時，η ≈ 3.0×0.15 = 0.45 m；水深 0.60 m 時槽內淨高至少約 1.05 m，若只做到 0.90 m，槽頂須按衝擊壓力設計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A linearised estimate is η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g). For L = 6.0 m and a roof spectral acceleration S_a = 0.15 g at the sloshing frequency, η ≈ 3.0×0.15 = 0.45 m; with 0.60 m of water the internal height should be at least about 1.05 m, and if only 0.90 m is provided the tank roof must be designed for impact pressure. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性時間歷程或計算流體力學檢查設計颱風與地震下的最大波高、衝擊次數與槽壁動壓，並複核屋頂構件；事件後依檢查表查看溢水痕跡、阻尼網變形、水位與水質，並以監測資料重新確認頻率比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check maximum wave height, impact count and dynamic wall pressure under design typhoon and earthquake records with nonlinear time-history analysis or computational fluid dynamics, and verify the roof members; after an event, follow a checklist for spill marks, screen deformation, water level and quality, and reconfirm the frequency ratio from monitoring data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以線性化估計 η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g)。槽長 L = 6.0 m、晃動頻率處的樓頂譜加速度 S_a = 0.15 g 時，η ≈ 3.0×0.15 = 0.45 m；水深 0.60 m 時槽內淨高至少約 1.05 m，若只做到 0.90 m，槽頂須按衝擊壓力設計。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A linearised estimate is η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g). For L = 6.0 m and a roof spectral acceleration S_a = 0.15 g at the sloshing frequency, η ≈ 3.0×0.15 = 0.45 m; with 0.60 m of water the internal height should be at least about 1.05 m, and if only 0.90 m is provided the tank roof must be designed for impact pressure. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「極端事件、出水高度與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Extreme events, freeboard and handover", which statement holds?
options: U 形液柱阻尼器的頻率可以靠加寬水平段來調整。
水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。
以線性化估計 η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g)。
optionsEn: The frequency of a U-tube damper can be tuned by widening the horizontal leg.
A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member.
A linearised estimate is η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g).
quiz.explanation: 以線性化估計 η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A linearised estimate is η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 極端事件、出水高度與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Extreme events, freeboard and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出水高度與槽頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Freeboard and tank roof” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性時間歷程或計算流體力學檢查設計颱風與地震下的最大波高、衝擊次數與槽壁動壓，並複核屋頂構件；事件後依檢查表查看溢水痕跡、阻尼網變形、水位與水質，並以監測資料重新確認頻率比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check maximum wave height, impact count and dynamic wall pressure under design typhoon and earthquake records with nonlinear time-history analysis or computational fluid dynamics, and verify the roof members; after an event, follow a checklist for spill marks, screen deformation, water level and quality, and reconfirm the frequency ratio from monitoring data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含每槽尺寸、調頻水位、阻尼網規格、試驗與監測基準、事件後檢查表與補水程序；建築改裝若改變屋頂設備重量或核心勁度，須由結構顧問重新評估調頻並核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should include each tank's dimensions, tuning level, screen specification, test and monitoring baselines, the post-event checklist and refilling procedure; renovations that change roof equipment weight or core stiffness require the structural consultant to reassess and approve the tuning.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出水高度不足而槽頂又按一般屋頂設計時，強震中的衝擊壓力可能破壞槽頂或接縫，大量溢水流入下方樓層；事件後若未補水重調，阻尼器到下一個颱風季仍處於脫調狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With too little freeboard and a tank roof designed as an ordinary roof, impact pressure in a strong earthquake can break the roof or joints and spill large volumes into the floors below; without refilling and retuning afterwards, the damper stays detuned into the next typhoon season. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以非線性時間歷程或計算流體力學檢查設計颱風與地震下的最大波高、衝擊次數與槽壁動壓，並複核屋頂構件；事件後依檢查表查看溢水痕跡、阻尼網變形、水位與水質，並以監測資料重新確認頻率比。

quiz.question: 要驗證「極端事件、出水高度與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Extreme events, freeboard and handover"?
options: 以非線性時間歷程或計算流體力學檢查設計颱風與地震下的最大波高、衝擊次數與槽壁動壓，並複核屋頂構件。

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出水高度不足而槽頂又按一般屋頂設計時，強震中的衝擊壓力可能破壞槽頂或接縫，大量溢水流入下方樓層；事件後若未補水重調，阻尼器到下一個颱風季仍處於脫調狀態。
knowledge.textEn: With too little freeboard and a tank roof designed as an ordinary roof, impact pressure in a strong earthquake can break the roof or joints and spill large volumes into the floors below; without refilling and retuning afterwards, the damper stays detuned into the next typhoon season.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「極端事件、出水高度與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Extreme events, freeboard and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
出水高度不足而槽頂又按一般屋頂設計時，強震中的衝擊壓力可能破壞槽頂或接縫，大量溢水流入下方樓層；事件後若未補水重調，阻尼器到下一個颱風季仍處於脫調狀態。
水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
With too little freeboard and a tank roof designed as an ordinary roof, impact pressure in a strong earthquake can break the roof or joints and spill large volumes into the floors below.
All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass.
quiz.explanation: 出水高度不足而槽頂又按一般屋頂設計時，強震中的衝擊壓力可能破壞槽頂或接縫，大量溢水流入下方樓層；事件後若未補水重調，阻尼器到下一個颱風季仍處於脫調狀態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With too little freeboard and a tank roof designed as an ordinary roof, impact pressure in a strong earthquake can break the roof or joints and spill large volumes into the floors below; without refilling and retuning afterwards, the damper stays detuned into the next typhoon season. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
summary: 從附加阻尼的性能目標出發，建立 F = C·v^α 的非線性本構與麥斯威爾串聯模型，檢查缸體耐壓與密封，再走過逐件出廠試驗、現場安裝的行程預算與置中、原型試驗的頻率與溫升、完工系統識別，最後談長期抽樣復驗與地震後評估，並以 Torre Mayor、台灣高鐵雲林段高架橋與倫敦千禧橋的公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from supplemental-damping performance targets, build the nonlinear law F = C·v^α and the Maxwell series model, check cylinder pressure and seals, then work through production testing of every unit, stroke budgets and centring at installation, prototype frequency and temperature-rise tests and post-completion system identification, and finally long-term sample re-testing and post-earthquake assessment, compared with public information on Torre Mayor, the Taiwan High Speed Rail Yunlin viaduct and London's Millennium Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 驗收練習：規格 C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4。出廠試驗以振幅 u₀ = 50 mm、頻率 f = 1.0 Hz 的正弦位移進行，尖峰速度 v = 2π×1.0×0.05 ≈ 0.314 m/s，預期尖峰力 F = 1,500×0.314^0.4 ≈ 944 kN。非線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = λ·C·u₀^(1+α)·ω^α，α = 0.4 時 λ ≈ 3.58，E ≈ 3.58×1,500×0.0151×2.09 ≈ 169 kJ。若量得迴圈面積 152 kJ，偏差 −10%，在 ±15% 內可允收；若只有 140 kJ（約 −17%）則不合格。若改用在 0.314 m/s 時同樣出力的線性阻尼器（C ≈ 3,005 kN·s/m），每循環耗能 π·F·u₀ ≈ 148 kJ；速度加倍到 0.628 m/s 時線性阻尼器力約 1,888 kN，α = 0.4 的阻尼器只有約 1,246 kN，斜撐與接頭的設計力相差約 34%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或專案。
workedExample.textEn: Acceptance exercise: the specification is C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4. A production test uses sinusoidal displacement with amplitude u₀ = 50 mm at f = 1.0 Hz, so peak velocity is v = 2π×1.0×0.05 ≈ 0.314 m/s and the expected peak force is F = 1,500×0.314^0.4 ≈ 944 kN. A nonlinear damper dissipates E = λ·C·u₀^(1+α)·ω^α per cycle, with λ ≈ 3.58 for α = 0.4, so E ≈ 3.58×1,500×0.0151×2.09 ≈ 169 kJ. A measured loop area of 152 kJ is −10% and acceptable within ±15%; 140 kJ (about −17%) fails. A linear damper giving the same force at 0.314 m/s (C ≈ 3,005 kN·s/m) dissipates π·F·u₀ ≈ 148 kJ per cycle; if velocity doubles to 0.628 m/s the linear damper produces about 1,888 kN while the α = 0.4 damper produces about 1,246 kN, a difference of about 34% in brace and connection design force. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「附加阻尼的性能目標」與「非線性黏滯本構與阻尼指數」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Performance targets for supplemental damping" and "Nonlinear viscous law and damping exponent": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Performance targets for supplemental damping: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「附加阻尼比」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Supplemental damping ratio” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。設計者通常以附加阻尼比表示目標，例如把總阻尼由約 5% 提高到 20% 至 30%，以降低層間變位與樓板加速度。墨西哥市 57 層的 Torre Mayor 設有 98 具流體黏滯阻尼器，製造商公開說明它在 2003 年規模 7.6 與 2017 年規模 7.1 地震中均無損傷。性能驗證的核心，是確認每一具阻尼器真的提供設計所假設的力—速度關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「附加阻尼比」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces. Designers usually express the target as supplemental damping, for example raising total damping from about 5% to 20% to 30% to cut storey drift and floor acceleration. The 57-storey Torre Mayor in Mexico City has 98 fluid viscous dampers, and the manufacturer reports no damage in the magnitude 7.6 earthquake of 2003 or the magnitude 7.1 earthquake of 2017. The core of performance verification is confirming that every damper actually delivers the force–velocity relation assumed in design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Supplemental damping ratio” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Supplemental damping ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標
knowledge.text: 流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。設計者通常以附加阻尼比表示目標，例如把總阻尼由約 5% 提高到 20% 至 30%，以降低層間變位與樓板加速度。
knowledge.textEn: A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces. Designers usually express the target as supplemental damping, for example raising total damping from about 5% to 20% to 30% to cut storey drift and floor acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「附加阻尼的性能目標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Performance targets for supplemental damping" is correct?
options: 加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。
流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。
阻尼指數 α 越小越好，因為最大力被限制住了。
optionsEn: Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase.

A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces.
The smaller the damping exponent α the better, because the peak force is capped.
quiz.explanation: 流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Performance targets for supplemental damping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「附加阻尼比」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Supplemental damping ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。固有阻尼 5% 加附加阻尼 20%，ξ = 25%，η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58，設計譜位移約降為 5% 阻尼時的 58%；若實際附加阻尼只有 15%，η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63，位移增加約 10%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55. With 5% inherent plus 20% supplemental damping, ξ = 25% and η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58, so design spectral displacement falls to about 58% of the 5%-damped value; if only 15% supplemental damping is achieved, η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63 and displacement rises by about 10%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。固有阻尼 5% 加附加阻尼 20%，ξ = 25%，η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58，設計譜位移約降為 5% 阻尼時的 58%；若實際附加阻尼只有 15%，η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63，位移增加約 10%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55. With 5% inherent plus 20% supplemental damping, ξ = 25% and η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58, so design spectral displacement falls to about 58% of the 5%-damped value; if only 15% supplemental damping is achieved, η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63 and displacement rises by about 10%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「附加阻尼的性能目標」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Performance targets for supplemental damping", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。
黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。
Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。
optionsEn: A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness.
A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force.
The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55.
quiz.explanation: Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Performance targets for supplemental damping: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「附加阻尼比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Supplemental damping ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構計算書要附阻尼器需求表與編號對照圖，並在設計說明中寫明附加阻尼比、性能目標與允許性質變異範圍，讓試驗單位與審查者能直接比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural calculations should attach the damper demand table and a numbered location plan, and the design basis should state the supplemental damping ratio, performance targets and allowed property variation so that test laboratories and reviewers can compare directly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用等效阻尼比做線性分析，而沒有算出每具阻尼器的速度與行程，試驗規格可能低估最大速度，使阻尼器在設計地震時超過額定力或觸底，失去耗能並對接頭產生衝擊力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Linear analysis with an equivalent damping ratio alone, without computing each damper's velocity and stroke, can lead to test specifications that underestimate peak velocity, so dampers exceed rated force or bottom out in the design earthquake, losing dissipation and hammering their connections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構計算書要附阻尼器需求表與編號對照圖，並在設計說明中寫明附加阻尼比、性能目標與允許性質變異範圍，讓試驗單位與審查者能直接比對。
knowledge.textEn: The structural calculations should attach the damper demand table and a numbered location plan, and the design basis should state the supplemental damping ratio, performance targets and allowed property variation so that test laboratories and reviewers can compare directly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「附加阻尼的性能目標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Performance targets for supplemental damping"?
options: 設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
optionsEn: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria.
