quiz.questionEn: When "How level compensation is applied" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。
若補償表版本混亂，測量團隊用舊版放樣，可能在數層內累積數十毫米的錯誤；墊片疊太多層而未焊固，日後在反覆荷載下可能滑出，造成局部沉陷。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
If compensation tables are poorly version-controlled and surveyors set out from an old revision, tens of millimetres of error can build up within a few floors.
quiz.explanation: 若補償表版本混亂，測量團隊用舊版放樣，可能在數層內累積數十毫米的錯誤；墊片疊太多層而未焊固，日後在反覆荷載下可能滑出，造成局部沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If compensation tables are poorly version-controlled and surveyors set out from an old revision, tens of millimetres of error can build up within a few floors; stacks of too many unwelded shims can work loose under repeated load and cause local settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「延遲接合時機」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Timing of delayed connections” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂、帶狀桁架或連接核心與周邊柱的剛性構件若在施工早期就鎖定，之後的差異縮短會全部轉成構件內力。樂天世界塔的設計論文指出設置了延遲接頭以限制差異縮短產生的額外構件力，核心牆與巨柱在框架完成後才相連；報導也提到帶狀桁架接頭使用長槽孔，於完工後才鎖緊。鎖定時機是一個取捨：越晚鎖定，殘餘縮短越少；但鎖定前結構缺少這些構件提供的勁度，施工期的側向穩定與颱風、地震下的變位必須另行檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「延遲接合時機」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If outriggers, belt trusses or other stiff members linking core and perimeter columns are locked early, all later differential shortening turns into member forces. The Lotte World Tower design paper says delay joints were installed to limit the extra member forces from differential shortening, with core walls and mega-columns connected only after the frame was complete; reports also mention long-slotted belt-truss connections tightened after completion. Locking time is a trade-off: the later the lock, the less residual shortening, but until then the structure lacks the stiffness these members provide, so construction-stage stability and drift under typhoon or earthquake must be checked separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Timing of delayed connections” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「延遲接合時機」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Timing of delayed connections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機
knowledge.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them
knowledge.text: 外伸臂、帶狀桁架或連接核心與周邊柱的剛性構件若在施工早期就鎖定，之後的差異縮短會全部轉成構件內力。樂天世界塔的設計論文指出設置了延遲接頭以限制差異縮短產生的額外構件力，核心牆與巨柱在框架完成後才相連；報導也提到帶狀桁架接頭使用長槽孔，於完工後才鎖緊。
knowledge.textEn: If outriggers, belt trusses or other stiff members linking core and perimeter columns are locked early, all later differential shortening turns into member forces. The Lotte World Tower design paper says delay joints were installed to limit the extra member forces from differential shortening, with core walls and mega-columns connected only after the frame was complete; reports also mention long-slotted belt-truss connections tightened after completion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「延遲接頭與鎖定時機」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Delay joints and when to lock them" is correct?
options: 外伸臂、帶狀桁架或連接核心與周邊柱的剛性構件若在施工早期就鎖定，之後的差異縮短會全部轉成構件內力。
延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。
應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。
optionsEn: If outriggers, belt trusses or other stiff members linking core and perimeter columns are locked early, all later differential shortening turns into member forces.
Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
All strain read by a gauge is caused by load.
quiz.explanation: 外伸臂、帶狀桁架或連接核心與周邊柱的剛性構件若在施工早期就鎖定，之後的差異縮短會全部轉成構件內力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: If outriggers, belt trusses or other stiff members linking core and perimeter columns are locked early, all later differential shortening turns into member forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲接合時機」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Timing of delayed connections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。加載後 90 天鎖定：90^0.6 ≈ 14.9，已完成 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60%，剩餘約 40%；365 天鎖定：365^0.6 ≈ 34.5，完成約 78%，剩餘約 22%，鎖定後潛變附加力約減少一半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading. Locking 90 days after loading: 90^0.6 ≈ 14.9, so 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60% has occurred and about 40% remains; locking at 365 days: 365^0.6 ≈ 34.5, about 78% has occurred and about 22% remains, roughly halving the creep-induced force after locking. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。加載後 90 天鎖定：90^0.6 ≈ 14.9，已完成 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60%，剩餘約 40%；365 天鎖定：365^0.6 ≈ 34.5，完成約 78%，剩餘約 22%，鎖定後潛變附加力約減少一半。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading. Locking 90 days after loading: 90^0.6 ≈ 14.9, so 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60% has occurred and about 40% remains; locking at 365 days: 365^0.6 ≈ 34.5, about 78% has occurred and about 22% remains, roughly halving the creep-induced force after locking. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「延遲接頭與鎖定時機」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Delay joints and when to lock them", which statement holds?
options: 差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。
ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。
柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。
optionsEn: Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading.
A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant.
quiz.explanation: ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延遲接合時機」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Timing of delayed connections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：延遲接頭的鎖定列為停留點，條件包括：達到指定樓層或荷重比例、監測顯示差異縮短速率低於門檻、施工期颱風或地震檢核仍然滿足，並由結構工程師書面放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Locking delay joints is a hold point released in writing by the structural engineer when a set floor or load fraction is reached, monitoring shows the differential-shortening rate below a threshold and construction-stage wind and seismic checks are still satisfied.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為了施工方便提早全部鎖定，差異縮短在外伸臂內鎖入的附加力可能使接頭螺栓滑移或焊道開裂；若延遲太久而未補足施工期勁度，強風下未完工結構的變位可能超出允許值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Locking everything early for convenience can let differential shortening lock enough added force into outriggers to slip joint bolts or crack welds; delaying too long without temporary stiffness can let the incomplete structure exceed allowable drift in strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。
knowledge.textEn: Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 延遲接頭的鎖定列為停留點，條件包括：達到指定樓層或荷重比例、監測顯示差異縮短速率低於門檻、施工期颱風或地震檢核仍然滿足，並由結構工程師書面放行。
knowledge.textEn: Locking delay joints is a hold point released in writing by the structural engineer when a set floor or load fraction is reached, monitoring shows the differential-shortening rate below a threshold and construction-stage wind and seismic checks are still satisfied.

quiz.question: 要驗證「延遲接頭與鎖定時機」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delay joints and when to lock them"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。
以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.
Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification.
quiz.explanation: 以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延遲接合時機」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Timing of delayed connections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若為了施工方便提早全部鎖定，差異縮短在外伸臂內鎖入的附加力可能使接頭螺栓滑移或焊道開裂；若延遲太久而未補足施工期勁度，強風下未完工結構的變位可能超出允許值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Locking everything early for convenience can let differential shortening lock enough added force into outriggers to slip joint bolts or crack welds; delaying too long without temporary stiffness can let the incomplete structure exceed allowable drift in strong wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鎖定時機是一個取捨：越晚鎖定，殘餘縮短越少；但鎖定前結構缺少這些構件提供的勁度，施工期的側向穩定與颱風、地震下的變位必須另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Locking time is a trade-off: the later the lock, the less residual shortening, but until then the structure lacks the stiffness these members provide, so construction-stage stability and drift under typhoon or earthquake must be checked separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若為了施工方便提早全部鎖定，差異縮短在外伸臂內鎖入的附加力可能使接頭螺栓滑移或焊道開裂；若延遲太久而未補足施工期勁度，強風下未完工結構的變位可能超出允許值。
knowledge.textEn: Locking everything early for convenience can let differential shortening lock enough added force into outriggers to slip joint bolts or crack welds; delaying too long without temporary stiffness can let the incomplete structure exceed allowable drift in strong wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「延遲接頭與鎖定時機」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Delay joints and when to lock them" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若為了施工方便提早全部鎖定，差異縮短在外伸臂內鎖入的附加力可能使接頭螺栓滑移或焊道開裂；若延遲太久而未補足施工期勁度，強風下未完工結構的變位可能超出允許值。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。
optionsEn: Locking everything early for convenience can let differential shortening lock enough added force into outriggers to slip joint bolts or crack welds.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
All strain read by a gauge is caused by load.
quiz.explanation: 若為了施工方便提早全部鎖定，差異縮短在外伸臂內鎖入的附加力可能使接頭螺栓滑移或焊道開裂；若延遲太久而未補足施工期勁度，強風下未完工結構的變位可能超出允許值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Locking everything early for convenience can let differential shortening lock enough added force into outriggers to slip joint bolts or crack welds; delaying too long without temporary stiffness can let the incomplete structure exceed allowable drift in strong wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」與「實測與預測比對後的更新」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges" and "Updating predictions from measurements": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「振弦式應變計」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 振弦式應變計把一根張緊的鋼弦固定在兩個錨端之間並埋入混凝土，構件縮短時鋼弦張力改變，其自然頻率隨之改變；讀取頻率的平方差即可換算應變。它長期穩定、適合埋設在柱與核心牆中多年監測，並通常內建溫度感測器，用來修正鋼弦與混凝土熱膨脹差造成的視應變。量到的總應變包含彈性、潛變、收縮與溫度，因此需要搭配無應力計（不受荷載的同批混凝土）把收縮與溫度分離出來。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「振弦式應變計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A vibrating-wire gauge holds a tensioned steel wire between two anchors embedded in the concrete; as the member shortens, the wire tension and therefore its natural frequency change, and the difference of the squared frequency readings converts to strain. Gauges are stable for years and suit long-term embedment in columns and core walls, usually with a built-in thermistor to correct the apparent strain from different thermal expansion of wire and concrete. The measured total includes elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal strain, so no-stress companion gauges in unloaded concrete from the same pour are needed to separate shrinkage and temperature. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All strain read by a gauge is caused by load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「振弦式應變計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vibrating-wire strain gauges”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短
knowledge.text: 振弦式應變計把一根張緊的鋼弦固定在兩個錨端之間並埋入混凝土，構件縮短時鋼弦張力改變，其自然頻率隨之改變；讀取頻率的平方差即可換算應變。它長期穩定、適合埋設在柱與核心牆中多年監測，並通常內建溫度感測器，用來修正鋼弦與混凝土熱膨脹差造成的視應變。
knowledge.textEn: A vibrating-wire gauge holds a tensioned steel wire between two anchors embedded in the concrete; as the member shortens, the wire tension and therefore its natural frequency change, and the difference of the squared frequency readings converts to strain. Gauges are stable for years and suit long-term embedment in columns and core walls, usually with a built-in thermistor to correct the apparent strain from different thermal expansion of wire and concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All strain read by a gauge is caused by load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges" is correct?
options: 應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。
振弦式應變計把一根張緊的鋼弦固定在兩個錨端之間並埋入混凝土，構件縮短時鋼弦張力改變，其自然頻率隨之改變；讀取頻率的平方差即可換算應變。
設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。
optionsEn: All strain read by a gauge is caused by load.
A vibrating-wire gauge holds a tensioned steel wire between two anchors embedded in the concrete.
A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction.
quiz.explanation: 振弦式應變計把一根張緊的鋼弦固定在兩個錨端之間並埋入混凝土，構件縮短時鋼弦張力改變，其自然頻率隨之改變；讀取頻率的平方差即可換算應變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A vibrating-wire gauge holds a tensioned steel wire between two anchors embedded in the concrete; as the member shortens, the wire tension and therefore its natural frequency change, and the difference of the squared frequency readings converts to strain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「振弦式應變計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。取儀器係數 G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz²，初讀 f₀ = 800 Hz、後讀 f₁ = 780 Hz：ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με（壓縮）。若無應力計同期讀到 −50 με，則與荷載相關的應變約 −76 με。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²). With a gauge factor G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz², an initial reading f₀ = 800 Hz and a later reading f₁ = 780 Hz, ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με, in compression. If a companion no-stress gauge reads −50 με over the same period, the load-related strain is about −76 με. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活；以混凝土剛澆置後、尚未加載時的讀數作為零點，並同步記錄溫度、樓層進度與澆置日期；定期以手持讀數儀抽查自動資料擷取器的讀數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival; take the zero reading after casting but before loading, logging temperature, construction progress and pour date; periodically spot-check the automatic data logger with a hand-held readout.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。取儀器係數 G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz²，初讀 f₀ = 800 Hz、後讀 f₁ = 780 Hz：ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με（壓縮）。若無應力計同期讀到 −50 με，則與荷載相關的應變約 −76 με。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²). With a gauge factor G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz², an initial reading f₀ = 800 Hz and a later reading f₁ = 780 Hz, ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με, in compression. If a companion no-stress gauge reads −50 με over the same period, the load-related strain is about −76 με. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges", which statement holds?
options: 大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。
樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。
ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。
optionsEn: Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.
ε = G(f₁² − f₀²).
quiz.explanation: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「振弦式應變計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活；以混凝土剛澆置後、尚未加載時的讀數作為零點，並同步記錄溫度、樓層進度與澆置日期；定期以手持讀數儀抽查自動資料擷取器的讀數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival; take the zero reading after casting but before loading, logging temperature, construction progress and pour date; periodically spot-check the automatic data logger with a hand-held readout. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測計畫要規定每個監測斷面的應變計數量、無應力計配置、纜線保護路徑與備援，並把零點時間與施工紀錄綁在同一資料庫，供結構工程師判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring plan should define the number of gauges per section, no-stress gauges, protected cable routes and redundancy, linking zero-reading times with construction records in one database for the structural engineer's interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain; cables cut during later work with no redundancy leave gaps in the long-term record so the shortening curve cannot be reconstructed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活；以混凝土剛澆置後、尚未加載時的讀數作為零點，並同步記錄溫度、樓層進度與澆置日期；定期以手持讀數儀抽查自動資料擷取器的讀數。
knowledge.textEn: Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival; take the zero reading after casting but before loading, logging temperature, construction progress and pour date; periodically spot-check the automatic data logger with a hand-held readout.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測計畫要規定每個監測斷面的應變計數量、無應力計配置、纜線保護路徑與備援，並把零點時間與施工紀錄綁在同一資料庫，供結構工程師判讀。
knowledge.textEn: The monitoring plan should define the number of gauges per section, no-stress gauges, protected cable routes and redundancy, linking zero-reading times with construction records in one database for the structural engineer's interpretation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges"?
options: 安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。
optionsEn: Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem.
quiz.explanation: 安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活；以混凝土剛澆置後、尚未加載時的讀數作為零點，並同步記錄溫度、樓層進度與澆置日期；定期以手持讀數儀抽查自動資料擷取器的讀數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival; take the zero reading after casting but before loading, logging temperature, construction progress and pour date; periodically spot-check the automatic data logger with a hand-held readout. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「振弦式應變計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain; cables cut during later work with no redundancy leave gaps in the long-term record so the shortening curve cannot be reconstructed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量到的總應變包含彈性、潛變、收縮與溫度，因此需要搭配無應力計（不受荷載的同批混凝土）把收縮與溫度分離出來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The measured total includes elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal strain, so no-stress companion gauges in unloaded concrete from the same pour are needed to separate shrinkage and temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All strain read by a gauge is caused by load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain; cables cut during later work with no redundancy leave gaps in the long-term record so the shortening curve cannot be reconstructed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。
設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain.
A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction.
quiz.explanation: 零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain; cables cut during later work with no redundancy leave gaps in the long-term record so the shortening curve cannot be reconstructed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Updating predictions from measurements: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「測量回饋與預測更新」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey feedback and prediction update” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預測模型的潛變收縮參數、加載時程與施工速度都有不確定性，因此施工中必須以應變計與水準測量的結果回頭修正預測。報導指出樂天世界塔的在地結構技師在施工中重新計算差異縮短，正是這種回饋。常見做法是比較已完成樓層的實測縮短與同齡期的預測值，求出修正比例，再套用到尚未施工樓層的補償值；若偏差呈系統性（例如所有實測值都偏小），應檢討模數或潛變係數，而不是只做比例縮放。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「測量回饋與預測更新」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The creep and shrinkage parameters, loading history and construction speed in a prediction model are uncertain, so strain gauge and levelling results must be fed back during construction. Reports note that the local engineer of record at Lotte World Tower recalculated differential shortening during construction, which is exactly this feedback. A common approach compares measured shortening of completed floors with predictions at the same age, derives a correction ratio and applies it to compensation for floors not yet built; if the deviation is systematic, for example all measurements smaller, the modulus or creep coefficient should be revisited rather than merely scaled. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Survey feedback and prediction update” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「測量回饋與預測更新」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Survey feedback and prediction update”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新
knowledge.text: 預測模型的潛變收縮參數、加載時程與施工速度都有不確定性，因此施工中必須以應變計與水準測量的結果回頭修正預測。報導指出樂天世界塔的在地結構技師在施工中重新計算差異縮短，正是這種回饋。
knowledge.textEn: The creep and shrinkage parameters, loading history and construction speed in a prediction model are uncertain, so strain gauge and levelling results must be fed back during construction. Reports note that the local engineer of record at Lotte World Tower recalculated differential shortening during construction, which is exactly this feedback.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「實測與預測比對後的更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Updating predictions from measurements" is correct?
options: 設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。
差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。
預測模型的潛變收縮參數、加載時程與施工速度都有不確定性，因此施工中必須以應變計與水準測量的結果回頭修正預測。
optionsEn: A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction.
Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
The creep and shrinkage parameters, loading history and construction speed in a prediction model are uncertain, so strain gauge and levelling results must be fed back during construction.
quiz.explanation: 預測模型的潛變收縮參數、加載時程與施工速度都有不確定性，因此施工中必須以應變計與水準測量的結果回頭修正預測。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The creep and shrinkage parameters, loading history and construction speed in a prediction model are uncertain, so strain gauge and levelling results must be fed back during construction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Updating predictions from measurements: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測量回饋與預測更新」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Survey feedback and prediction update” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。若第 70 層原預測剩餘補償 30 mm，更新後約 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm，以 5 mm 級距取 +20 或 +25 mm，並由後續量測決定。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75. If floor 70 originally needed 30 mm of remaining compensation, the update gives about 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm, applied as +20 or +25 mm in 5 mm increments and settled by later measurements. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響；報告須經業主代表與施工團隊確認後才採用新補償表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking; the new compensation table is adopted only after the owner's representative and the construction team acknowledge the report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。若第 70 層原預測剩餘補償 30 mm，更新後約 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm，以 5 mm 級距取 +20 或 +25 mm，並由後續量測決定。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75. If floor 70 originally needed 30 mm of remaining compensation, the update gives about 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm, applied as +20 or +25 mm in 5 mm increments and settled by later measurements. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「實測與預測比對後的更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Updating predictions from measurements", which statement holds?
options: 第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。
柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。
同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。
optionsEn: At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75.
A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant.
The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.
quiz.explanation: 第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Updating predictions from measurements: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測量回饋與預測更新」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Survey feedback and prediction update” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響；報告須經業主代表與施工團隊確認後才採用新補償表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking; the new compensation table is adopted only after the owner's representative and the construction team acknowledge the report. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以多個斷面與兩種量測方法（應變計與水準）交叉確認後才更新預測，每次更新都保存舊版與理由，形成可追溯的決策紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Update the prediction only after cross-checking several sections with two methods, strain gauges and levelling, and keep every superseded version with its reason as a traceable decision record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction; never updating lets a systematic bias accumulate all the way to the top. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響；報告須經業主代表與施工團隊確認後才採用新補償表。
knowledge.textEn: At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking; the new compensation table is adopted only after the owner's representative and the construction team acknowledge the report.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以多個斷面與兩種量測方法（應變計與水準）交叉確認後才更新預測，每次更新都保存舊版與理由，形成可追溯的決策紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Update the prediction only after cross-checking several sections with two methods, strain gauges and levelling, and keep every superseded version with its reason as a traceable decision record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「實測與預測比對後的更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Updating predictions from measurements"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響。
差異縮短只能在完工後以調整裝修高度來處理。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking.
Differential shortening can only be dealt with after completion by adjusting finish levels.
quiz.explanation: 每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響；報告須經業主代表與施工團隊確認後才採用新補償表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking; the new compensation table is adopted only after the owner's representative and the construction team acknowledge the report. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Updating predictions from measurements: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測量回饋與預測更新」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Survey feedback and prediction update” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction; never updating lets a systematic bias accumulate all the way to the top. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：常見做法是比較已完成樓層的實測縮短與同齡期的預測值，求出修正比例，再套用到尚未施工樓層的補償值；若偏差呈系統性（例如所有實測值都偏小），應檢討模數或潛變係數，而不是只做比例縮放。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A common approach compares measured shortening of completed floors with predictions at the same age, derives a correction ratio and applies it to compensation for floors not yet built; if the deviation is systematic, for example all measurements smaller, the modulus or creep coefficient should be revisited rather than merely scaled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。
knowledge.textEn: Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction; never updating lets a systematic bias accumulate all the way to the top.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「實測與預測比對後的更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Updating predictions from measurements" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。
若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction.
quiz.explanation: 若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction; never updating lets a systematic bias accumulate all the way to the top. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」與「竣工後追蹤與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers" and "Post-completion tracking and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「非結構構件的容許變形」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。帷幕牆的水平堆疊接縫、隔間牆頂部的滑動接頭、電梯導軌的伸縮接頭與立管的伸縮節，都要依每層的預期位移設計。哈里發塔的設計者把退縮配合柱網，使上方的柱落在下方的牆上，平順的傳力路徑也讓構件應力分布較均勻，減少了相鄰構件間的縮短差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「非結構構件的容許變形」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements. Horizontal stack joints in curtain walls, sliding heads of partitions, expansion joints in elevator rails and expansion fittings in risers must all be designed for the expected movement per floor. At Burj Khalifa the designers aligned setbacks with the column grid so columns above sit on walls below, and the smooth load path also evened out member stresses, reducing shortening differences between neighbouring members. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「非結構構件的容許變形」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Movement allowances for non-structural elements”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許
knowledge.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers
knowledge.text: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。帷幕牆的水平堆疊接縫、隔間牆頂部的滑動接頭、電梯導軌的伸縮接頭與立管的伸縮節，都要依每層的預期位移設計。
knowledge.textEn: Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements. Horizontal stack joints in curtain walls, sliding heads of partitions, expansion joints in elevator rails and expansion fittings in risers must all be designed for the expected movement per floor.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers" is correct?
options: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。
差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。
大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。
optionsEn: Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements.
Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
quiz.explanation: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非結構構件的容許變形」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。若安裝提早到結構只完成一半時，每層縮短可能增為 3.0 mm，需求約 16 mm，接縫須重新檢討。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified. Installing the façade earlier, with only half the structure complete, could raise per-floor shortening to 3.0 mm and the demand to about 16 mm, requiring the joint to be reconsidered. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。若安裝提早到結構只完成一半時，每層縮短可能增為 3.0 mm，需求約 16 mm，接縫須重新檢討。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified. Installing the façade earlier, with only half the structure complete, could raise per-floor shortening to 3.0 mm and the demand to about 16 mm, requiring the joint to be reconsidered. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers", which statement holds?
options: 樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。
堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。
鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。
optionsEn: The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.
Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified.
Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem.
quiz.explanation: 堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「非結構構件的容許變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：協調會議中把縮短與撓度值列為帷幕牆、隔間、電梯與機電的共同設計輸入，各系統的接頭圖說須註明其容許位移並經結構工程師確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make shortening and deflection values a common design input for façade, partitions, elevators and services in coordination meetings, and require each system's joint details to state their movement allowance and be checked by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform; partitions without sliding heads are crushed as columns shorten, and elevator rails may bow from accumulated length, causing ride vibration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 協調會議中把縮短與撓度值列為帷幕牆、隔間、電梯與機電的共同設計輸入，各系統的接頭圖說須註明其容許位移並經結構工程師確認。
knowledge.textEn: Make shortening and deflection values a common design input for façade, partitions, elevators and services in coordination meetings, and require each system's joint details to state their movement allowance and be checked by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。
結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly.
quiz.explanation: 結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非結構構件的容許變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform; partitions without sliding heads are crushed as columns shorten, and elevator rails may bow from accumulated length, causing ride vibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔的設計者把退縮配合柱網，使上方的柱落在下方的牆上，平順的傳力路徑也讓構件應力分布較均勻，減少了相鄰構件間的縮短差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At Burj Khalifa the designers aligned setbacks with the column grid so columns above sit on walls below, and the smooth load path also evened out member stresses, reducing shortening differences between neighbouring members.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。
knowledge.textEn: With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform; partitions without sliding heads are crushed as columns shorten, and elevator rails may bow from accumulated length, causing ride vibration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。
optionsEn: With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
quiz.explanation: 接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform; partitions without sliding heads are crushed as columns shorten, and elevator rails may bow from accumulated length, causing ride vibration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-completion tracking and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-completion shortening records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 潛變與收縮在完工後仍會持續數年，交接時結構只完成了部分的長期縮短。營運單位需要知道還剩多少、何時趨緩，以便安排帷幕牆接縫、電梯與管道的調整與檢查。因此交接文件應包含預測曲線、施工中的實測紀錄、補償施作紀錄與延遲接頭鎖定日期，以及長期監測點的位置與讀數方法；若日後改變用途大幅增加荷重，殘餘縮短也會改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Creep and shrinkage continue for years after completion, so at handover the structure has gone through only part of its long-term shortening. The operator needs to know how much remains and when it slows down, in order to schedule adjustments and inspections of façade joints, elevators and risers. Handover documents should therefore include the prediction curves, construction measurements, compensation records and delay-joint locking dates, plus the locations and reading methods of long-term monitoring points; a later change of use that adds substantial load also changes the residual shortening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-completion shortening records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-completion shortening records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接
knowledge.text: 潛變與收縮在完工後仍會持續數年，交接時結構只完成了部分的長期縮短。營運單位需要知道還剩多少、何時趨緩，以便安排帷幕牆接縫、電梯與管道的調整與檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Creep and shrinkage continue for years after completion, so at handover the structure has gone through only part of its long-term shortening. The operator needs to know how much remains and when it slows down, in order to schedule adjustments and inspections of façade joints, elevators and risers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「竣工後追蹤與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-completion tracking and handover" is correct?
options: 大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。
潛變與收縮在完工後仍會持續數年，交接時結構只完成了部分的長期縮短。
柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。
optionsEn: Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
Creep and shrinkage continue for years after completion, so at handover the structure has gone through only part of its long-term shortening.
A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant.
quiz.explanation: 潛變與收縮在完工後仍會持續數年，交接時結構只完成了部分的長期縮短。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Creep and shrinkage continue for years after completion, so at handover the structure has gone through only part of its long-term shortening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-completion tracking and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-completion shortening records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 ACI 209 時間函數估算：加載後 3 年（1,095 天）1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6，已完成 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87%，剩餘約 13%。若潛變總縮短 60 mm，交接後仍有約 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm 會在之後逐年發生。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains. If total creep shortening is 60 mm, about 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm still occurs year by year after handover. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve; if residual shortening clearly exceeds the prediction, assess the effect on façade and elevators and schedule adjustments.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 ACI 209 時間函數估算：加載後 3 年（1,095 天）1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6，已完成 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87%，剩餘約 13%。若潛變總縮短 60 mm，交接後仍有約 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm 會在之後逐年發生。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains. If total creep shortening is 60 mm, about 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm still occurs year by year after handover. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「竣工後追蹤與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-completion tracking and handover", which statement holds?
options: 同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。
差異縮短只能在完工後以調整裝修高度來處理。
optionsEn: The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.
Differential shortening can only be dealt with after completion by adjusting finish levels.
With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains.
quiz.explanationEn: With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-completion tracking and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-completion shortening records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve; if residual shortening clearly exceeds the prediction, assess the effect on façade and elevators and schedule adjustments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接清單應包含縮短預測報告、補償與鎖定紀錄、監測點位置圖與讀數程序，並指定負責判讀的結構顧問與量測週期；用途變更或增加大量荷重前須重新評估殘餘縮短。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The handover list should include the shortening prediction report, compensation and locking records, a monitoring-point plan and reading procedure, and name the structural consultant responsible for interpretation and the measurement interval; residual shortening must be reassessed before any change of use or major added load.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時沒有預測曲線與基準量測，多年後出現的電梯門檻高差或帷幕牆漏水難以判斷原因，各方可能互相推諉，延誤修復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without prediction curves and baseline measurements at handover, elevator sill steps or façade leaks appearing years later are hard to diagnose, parties may blame each other and repairs are delayed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve; if residual shortening clearly exceeds the prediction, assess the effect on façade and elevators and schedule adjustments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接清單應包含縮短預測報告、補償與鎖定紀錄、監測點位置圖與讀數程序，並指定負責判讀的結構顧問與量測週期；用途變更或增加大量荷重前須重新評估殘餘縮短。
knowledge.textEn: The handover list should include the shortening prediction report, compensation and locking records, a monitoring-point plan and reading procedure, and name the structural consultant responsible for interpretation and the measurement interval; residual shortening must be reassessed before any change of use or major added load.

quiz.question: 要驗證「竣工後追蹤與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-completion tracking and handover"?
options: 完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。
optionsEn: Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All strain read by a gauge is caused by load.
quiz.explanation: 完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve; if residual shortening clearly exceeds the prediction, assess the effect on façade and elevators and schedule adjustments. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-completion tracking and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-completion shortening records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接時沒有預測曲線與基準量測，多年後出現的電梯門檻高差或帷幕牆漏水難以判斷原因，各方可能互相推諉，延誤修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without prediction curves and baseline measurements at handover, elevator sill steps or façade leaks appearing years later are hard to diagnose, parties may blame each other and repairs are delayed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
