workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核一榀跨度 L = 18 m、深 d = 7.5 m（兩層樓）的轉換桁架，中點承受上方 20 層的一根柱。每層受載面積 9 m×9 m、服務荷重 8.0 kPa，柱力 P = 20×81×8.0 = 12,960 kN。中點彎矩 M = PL/4 = 12,960×18/4 = 58,320 kN·m，弦桿力 C = T = M/d ≈ 7,776 kN，以 0.9×345 MPa 計所需弦桿斷面約 25,040 mm²。分四格、每格 4.5 m，斜桿角度 θ = atan(7.5/4.5) ≈ 59.0°，端格剪力 V = P/2 = 6,480 kN，斜桿力 = V/sinθ ≈ 7,560 kN。弦桿取 A_c = 0.025 m²，等效 I = A_c·d²/2 ≈ 0.703 m⁴，撓度 δ = PL³/(48EI) = 12,960×18³/(48×200×10⁶×0.703) ≈ 11.2 mm，加上斜桿伸縮約 30% 得約 14.6 mm，預拱取 15 mm。若因建築要求把深度壓縮為一層 3.75 m，弦桿力加倍為約 15,550 kN，I 降為四分之一，撓度約 44.8 mm、含斜桿約 58 mm，預拱與上方樓層高差都難以控制。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check a transfer truss spanning L = 18 m with depth d = 7.5 m (two storeys), carrying at mid-span one column from 20 floors above. Each floor has a 9 m×9 m tributary area and an 8.0 kPa service load, so the column load P = 20×81×8.0 = 12,960 kN. The mid-span moment M = PL/4 = 12,960×18/4 = 58,320 kN·m and the chord force C = T = M/d ≈ 7,776 kN, needing a chord area of about 25,040 mm² at 0.9×345 MPa. With four 4.5 m panels the diagonal angle θ = atan(7.5/4.5) ≈ 59.0°, the end-panel shear V = P/2 = 6,480 kN and the diagonal force = V/sinθ ≈ 7,560 kN. Taking A_c = 0.025 m² for the chords, the equivalent I = A_c·d²/2 ≈ 0.703 m⁴ and the deflection δ = PL³/(48EI) = 12,960×18³/(48×200×10⁶×0.703) ≈ 11.2 mm; adding about 30% for diagonal strain gives about 14.6 mm, so a 15 mm camber is set. If architectural demands squeeze the depth to one 3.75 m storey, the chord force doubles to about 15,550 kN, I falls to a quarter and deflection becomes about 44.8 mm, about 58 mm with diagonals, making camber and level differences above hard to control. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉換桁架的荷重路徑」與「吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path through a transfer truss" and "Hung floors: a reversed load path": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉換桁架的荷重路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path through a transfer truss: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架把上方不連續柱的軸力轉成桁架的彎矩與剪力，再集中送到兩端的支承柱。彎矩以上下弦桿的拉壓力偶抵抗，剪力由斜桿或豎桿承擔，因此桁架深度直接決定弦桿力：深度越大，弦桿越小。碎片大廈以鋼構費氏桁架把上部柱重新對位到辦公層，並以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 逐步加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m；樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架則把頂部燈籠與飯店柱轉換到八根巨柱上。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transfer truss turns the axial force of discontinued upper columns into truss bending and shear and delivers it to the supporting columns at its ends. Bending is resisted by a tension–compression couple in the chords and shear by diagonals or verticals, so truss depth directly sets the chord force: the deeper the truss, the smaller the chords. The Shard used steel Vierendeel trusses to realign upper columns onto the office floors and Vierendeel grids to step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m; at Lotte World Tower belt trusses transfer the lantern and hotel columns onto the eight mega-columns. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡支桁架跨度 L = 24 m、深 d = 8 m（兩層樓），三分點各承受上部柱力 P = 6,000 kN：中段彎矩 M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m，弦桿力 = M/d = 6,000 kN；端格剪力 V = 6,000 kN，45° 斜桿力 = V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A simply supported truss spanning L = 24 m with depth d = 8 m (two storeys) carries upper column loads P = 6,000 kN at its third points: the mid-span moment M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m, chord force = M/d = 6,000 kN; the end-panel shear V = 6,000 kN and a 45° diagonal carries V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉換桁架的荷重路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Load path through a transfer truss
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架把上方不連續柱的軸力轉成桁架的彎矩與剪力，再集中送到兩端的支承柱。彎矩以上下弦桿的拉壓力偶抵抗，剪力由斜桿或豎桿承擔，因此桁架深度直接決定弦桿力：深度越大，弦桿越小。
knowledge.textEn: A transfer truss turns the axial force of discontinued upper columns into truss bending and shear and delivers it to the supporting columns at its ends. Bending is resisted by a tension–compression couple in the chords and shear by diagonals or verticals, so truss depth directly sets the chord force: the deeper the truss, the smaller the chords.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉換桁架的荷重路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path through a transfer truss" is correct?
options: 轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。
轉換桁架把上方不連續柱的軸力轉成桁架的彎矩與剪力，再集中送到兩端的支承柱。
吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。
optionsEn: If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence.
A transfer truss turns the axial force of discontinued upper columns into truss bending and shear and delivers it to the supporting columns at its ends.
Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架把上方不連續柱的軸力轉成桁架的彎矩與剪力，再集中送到兩端的支承柱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A transfer truss turns the axial force of discontinued upper columns into truss bending and shear and delivers it to the supporting columns at its ends. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉換桁架的荷重路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path through a transfer truss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡支桁架跨度 L = 24 m、深 d = 8 m（兩層樓），三分點各承受上部柱力 P = 6,000 kN：中段彎矩 M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m，弦桿力 = M/d = 6,000 kN；端格剪力 V = 6,000 kN，45° 斜桿力 = V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A simply supported truss spanning L = 24 m with depth d = 8 m (two storeys) carries upper column loads P = 6,000 kN at its third points: the mid-span moment M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m, chord force = M/d = 6,000 kN; the end-panel shear V = 6,000 kN and a 45° diagonal carries V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維模型核對轉換桁架在各施工階段與完工狀態的弦桿、斜桿與節點力，並以手算力偶法抽查中段弦桿力；確認上部柱力的來源（樓層數、荷重組合、施工中已加上的部分）與模型一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check chord, diagonal and joint forces in the transfer truss at each construction stage and in the completed state with a three-dimensional model, spot-checking mid-span chord force by the couple method; confirm that the source of upper column loads, meaning number of floors, combinations and portion already applied during construction, matches the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡支桁架跨度 L = 24 m、深 d = 8 m（兩層樓），三分點各承受上部柱力 P = 6,000 kN：中段彎矩 M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m，弦桿力 = M/d = 6,000 kN；端格剪力 V = 6,000 kN，45° 斜桿力 = V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A simply supported truss spanning L = 24 m with depth d = 8 m (two storeys) carries upper column loads P = 6,000 kN at its third points: the mid-span moment M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m, chord force = M/d = 6,000 kN; the end-panel shear V = 6,000 kN and a 45° diagonal carries V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉換桁架的荷重路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path through a transfer truss", which statement holds?
options: 高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。
轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。
簡支桁架跨度 L = 24 m、深 d = 8 m（兩層樓），三分點各承受上部柱力 P = 6,000 kN：中段彎矩 M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m，弦桿力 = M/d = 6,000 kN。
optionsEn: High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened.
If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping.

A simply supported truss spanning L = 24 m with depth d = 8 m (two storeys) carries upper column loads P = 6,000 kN at its third points: the mid-span moment M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m, chord force = M/d = 6,000 kN.
quiz.explanation: 簡支桁架跨度 L = 24 m、深 d = 8 m（兩層樓），三分點各承受上部柱力 P = 6,000 kN：中段彎矩 M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m，弦桿力 = M/d = 6,000 kN；端格剪力 V = 6,000 kN，45° 斜桿力 = V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A simply supported truss spanning L = 24 m with depth d = 8 m (two storeys) carries upper column loads P = 6,000 kN at its third points: the mid-span moment M = P·L/3 = 48,000 kN·m, chord force = M/d = 6,000 kN; the end-panel shear V = 6,000 kN and a 45° diagonal carries V/sin45° ≈ 8,485 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉換桁架的荷重路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path through a transfer truss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維模型核對轉換桁架在各施工階段與完工狀態的弦桿、斜桿與節點力，並以手算力偶法抽查中段弦桿力；確認上部柱力的來源（樓層數、荷重組合、施工中已加上的部分）與模型一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check chord, diagonal and joint forces in the transfer truss at each construction stage and in the completed state with a three-dimensional model, spot-checking mid-span chord force by the couple method; confirm that the source of upper column loads, meaning number of floors, combinations and portion already applied during construction, matches the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉換層的深度、斜桿位置與穿越管線的開口應在設計初期與建築、機電共同凍結，任何後續變更都需結構工程師重新核算並更新預拱值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Freeze the depth, diagonal layout and service openings of transfer levels early with architecture and building services, and require any later change to be recalculated by the structural engineer with updated camber.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若低估上部柱力（例如漏算改用途後的荷重）或把桁架深度在建築協調中壓縮，弦桿與節點應力會大幅上升；轉換桁架撓度過大則讓上方所有樓層跟著下沉，隔間與帷幕牆開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underestimating upper column loads, for example by missing loads from a change of use, or squeezing the truss depth in architectural coordination sharply raises chord and joint stresses; excessive transfer-truss deflection drags every floor above down with it and cracks partitions and façades. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維模型核對轉換桁架在各施工階段與完工狀態的弦桿、斜桿與節點力，並以手算力偶法抽查中段弦桿力；確認上部柱力的來源（樓層數、荷重組合、施工中已加上的部分）與模型一致。
knowledge.textEn: Check chord, diagonal and joint forces in the transfer truss at each construction stage and in the completed state with a three-dimensional model, spot-checking mid-span chord force by the couple method; confirm that the source of upper column loads, meaning number of floors, combinations and portion already applied during construction, matches the model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉換層的深度、斜桿位置與穿越管線的開口應在設計初期與建築、機電共同凍結，任何後續變更都需結構工程師重新核算並更新預拱值。
knowledge.textEn: Freeze the depth, diagonal layout and service openings of transfer levels early with architecture and building services, and require any later change to be recalculated by the structural engineer with updated camber.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉換桁架的荷重路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path through a transfer truss"?
options: 以三維模型核對轉換桁架在各施工階段與完工狀態的弦桿、斜桿與節點力，並以手算力偶法抽查中段弦桿力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。
optionsEn: Check chord, diagonal and joint forces in the transfer truss at each construction stage and in the completed state with a three-dimensional model, spot-checking mid-span chord force by the couple method.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 以三維模型核對轉換桁架在各施工階段與完工狀態的弦桿、斜桿與節點力，並以手算力偶法抽查中段弦桿力；確認上部柱力的來源（樓層數、荷重組合、施工中已加上的部分）與模型一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check chord, diagonal and joint forces in the transfer truss at each construction stage and in the completed state with a three-dimensional model, spot-checking mid-span chord force by the couple method; confirm that the source of upper column loads, meaning number of floors, combinations and portion already applied during construction, matches the model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉換桁架的荷重路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path through a transfer truss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若低估上部柱力（例如漏算改用途後的荷重）或把桁架深度在建築協調中壓縮，弦桿與節點應力會大幅上升；轉換桁架撓度過大則讓上方所有樓層跟著下沉，隔間與帷幕牆開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underestimating upper column loads, for example by missing loads from a change of use, or squeezing the truss depth in architectural coordination sharply raises chord and joint stresses; excessive transfer-truss deflection drags every floor above down with it and cracks partitions and façades. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：碎片大廈以鋼構費氏桁架把上部柱重新對位到辦公層，並以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 逐步加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m；樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架則把頂部燈籠與飯店柱轉換到八根巨柱上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Shard used steel Vierendeel trusses to realign upper columns onto the office floors and Vierendeel grids to step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m; at Lotte World Tower belt trusses transfer the lantern and hotel columns onto the eight mega-columns.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若低估上部柱力（例如漏算改用途後的荷重）或把桁架深度在建築協調中壓縮，弦桿與節點應力會大幅上升；轉換桁架撓度過大則讓上方所有樓層跟著下沉，隔間與帷幕牆開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Underestimating upper column loads, for example by missing loads from a change of use, or squeezing the truss depth in architectural coordination sharply raises chord and joint stresses; excessive transfer-truss deflection drags every floor above down with it and cracks partitions and façades.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉換桁架的荷重路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path through a transfer truss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若低估上部柱力（例如漏算改用途後的荷重）或把桁架深度在建築協調中壓縮，弦桿與節點應力會大幅上升；轉換桁架撓度過大則讓上方所有樓層跟著下沉，隔間與帷幕牆開裂。
吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Underestimating upper column loads, for example by missing loads from a change of use, or squeezing the truss depth in architectural coordination sharply raises chord and joint stresses.
Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors.
quiz.explanation: 若低估上部柱力（例如漏算改用途後的荷重）或把桁架深度在建築協調中壓縮，弦桿與節點應力會大幅上升；轉換桁架撓度過大則讓上方所有樓層跟著下沉，隔間與帷幕牆開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Underestimating upper column loads, for example by missing loads from a change of use, or squeezing the truss depth in architectural coordination sharply raises chord and joint stresses; excessive transfer-truss deflection drags every floor above down with it and cracks partitions and façades. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hung floors: a reversed load path: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊掛樓層與吊桿伸長」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hung floors and hanger elongation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 有些轉換桁架不是承托上方的柱，而是吊住下方的樓層。設計者公開說明樂天世界塔的 5 至 7 層是從最低的帶狀桁架吊掛下來的。吊掛樓層的荷重先以拉力往上傳到桁架，再由桁架送到巨柱，這與一般「由下往上支承」的施工直覺相反：在桁架完成並具勁度之前，吊掛樓層不能自行站立，需要臨時支撐；吊桿受拉伸長，樓層在加載後會下沉，必須預先抬高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊掛樓層與吊桿伸長」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Some transfer trusses do not carry columns above but hang floors below. The designers state that levels 5 to 7 of Lotte World Tower hang from the lowest belt truss. Loads from hung floors travel up in tension to the truss and then to the mega-columns, the opposite of the usual bottom-up construction logic: until the truss is complete and stiff, the hung floors cannot stand by themselves and need temporary shoring, and because the hangers stretch in tension, the floors drop as load arrives and must be set high in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hung floors and hanger elongation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三層吊掛樓板，每層受載面積 9 m×9 m、服務荷重 7.0 kPa：吊桿拉力 T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN；以容許應力 213 MPa 計所需斷面約 7,990 mm²；吊桿長 12 m 時伸長 δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm，最低一層需預抬約 13 mm（另加桁架撓度）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Three hung floors with 9 m×9 m tributary areas and a 7.0 kPa service load give a hanger tension T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN; at an allowable stress of 213 MPa the hanger needs about 7,990 mm²; over a 12 m hanger length the elongation δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm, so the lowest floor must be set about 13 mm high, plus truss deflection.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊掛樓層與吊桿伸長」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hung floors and hanger elongation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉
knowledge.titleEn: Hung floors: a reversed load path
knowledge.text: 有些轉換桁架不是承托上方的柱，而是吊住下方的樓層。設計者公開說明樂天世界塔的 5 至 7 層是從最低的帶狀桁架吊掛下來的。
knowledge.textEn: Some transfer trusses do not carry columns above but hang floors below. The designers state that levels 5 to 7 of Lotte World Tower hang from the lowest belt truss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hung floors: a reversed load path" is correct?
options: 吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。
只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。
有些轉換桁架不是承托上方的柱，而是吊住下方的樓層。
optionsEn: Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors.
If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification.
Some transfer trusses do not carry columns above but hang floors below.
quiz.explanation: 有些轉換桁架不是承托上方的柱，而是吊住下方的樓層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Some transfer trusses do not carry columns above but hang floors below. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hung floors: a reversed load path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊掛樓層與吊桿伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hung floors and hanger elongation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三層吊掛樓板，每層受載面積 9 m×9 m、服務荷重 7.0 kPa：吊桿拉力 T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN；以容許應力 213 MPa 計所需斷面約 7,990 mm²；吊桿長 12 m 時伸長 δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm，最低一層需預抬約 13 mm（另加桁架撓度）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three hung floors with 9 m×9 m tributary areas and a 7.0 kPa service load give a hanger tension T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN; at an allowable stress of 213 MPa the hanger needs about 7,990 mm²; over a 12 m hanger length the elongation δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm, so the lowest floor must be set about 13 mm high, plus truss deflection. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工階段分析須模擬「臨時支撐承托—桁架完成—逐步卸撐轉為吊掛」的過程，計算每一步的吊桿力與樓板標高；卸撐時以液壓千斤頂讀數或吊桿應變計確認荷重逐步轉移，並量測樓板下沉量與預抬值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The construction-stage analysis must simulate shoring support, truss completion and staged release into hanging, computing hanger forces and floor levels at each step; during release confirm gradual load transfer by jack readings or hanger strain gauges and compare measured floor drop with the pre-set.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三層吊掛樓板，每層受載面積 9 m×9 m、服務荷重 7.0 kPa：吊桿拉力 T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN；以容許應力 213 MPa 計所需斷面約 7,990 mm²；吊桿長 12 m 時伸長 δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm，最低一層需預抬約 13 mm（另加桁架撓度）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Three hung floors with 9 m×9 m tributary areas and a 7.0 kPa service load give a hanger tension T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN; at an allowable stress of 213 MPa the hanger needs about 7,990 mm²; over a 12 m hanger length the elongation δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm, so the lowest floor must be set about 13 mm high, plus truss deflection. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hung floors: a reversed load path", which statement holds?
options: 三層吊掛樓板，每層受載面積 9 m×9 m、服務荷重 7.0 kPa：吊桿拉力 T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN。
整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。
外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。
optionsEn: Three hung floors with 9 m×9 m tributary areas and a 7.0 kPa service load give a hanger tension T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN.
In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points.
If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws.
quiz.explanation: 三層吊掛樓板，每層受載面積 9 m×9 m、服務荷重 7.0 kPa：吊桿拉力 T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN；以容許應力 213 MPa 計所需斷面約 7,990 mm²；吊桿長 12 m 時伸長 δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm，最低一層需預抬約 13 mm（另加桁架撓度）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Three hung floors with 9 m×9 m tributary areas and a 7.0 kPa service load give a hanger tension T = 3×81×7.0 = 1,701 kN; at an allowable stress of 213 MPa the hanger needs about 7,990 mm²; over a 12 m hanger length the elongation δ = TL/(EA) = 1,701,000×12,000/(200,000×8,000) ≈ 12.8 mm, so the lowest floor must be set about 13 mm high, plus truss deflection. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hung floors: a reversed load path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊掛樓層與吊桿伸長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hung floors and hanger elongation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工階段分析須模擬「臨時支撐承托—桁架完成—逐步卸撐轉為吊掛」的過程，計算每一步的吊桿力與樓板標高；卸撐時以液壓千斤頂讀數或吊桿應變計確認荷重逐步轉移，並量測樓板下沉量與預抬值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The construction-stage analysis must simulate shoring support, truss completion and staged release into hanging, computing hanger forces and floor levels at each step; during release confirm gradual load transfer by jack readings or hanger strain gauges and compare measured floor drop with the pre-set. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊掛樓層的臨時支撐拆除列為停留點：桁架與吊桿接頭檢驗合格、預拱量確認、分級卸撐程序與停止條件（例如任一千斤頂偏差超過 10%）經結構工程師核准後才可執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make removal of shores under hung floors a hold point released by the structural engineer only after truss and hanger joints pass inspection, the pre-set is confirmed and a staged release procedure with stop criteria, for example any jack deviating by more than 10%, is approved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在桁架尚未完成或接頭未驗收前就拆除吊掛樓層的臨時支撐，樓層會失去支承而下墜；吊桿與桁架接頭若只做壓力設計而疏忽拉力細部（例如焊道或銷孔），可能在荷重轉移時突然破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing the shores under hung floors before the truss is complete or its joints accepted leaves the floors unsupported; hanger-to-truss connections detailed for compression but not for tension, at welds or pin holes for instance, can fail suddenly during load transfer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工階段分析須模擬「臨時支撐承托—桁架完成—逐步卸撐轉為吊掛」的過程，計算每一步的吊桿力與樓板標高；卸撐時以液壓千斤頂讀數或吊桿應變計確認荷重逐步轉移，並量測樓板下沉量與預抬值比較。
knowledge.textEn: The construction-stage analysis must simulate shoring support, truss completion and staged release into hanging, computing hanger forces and floor levels at each step; during release confirm gradual load transfer by jack readings or hanger strain gauges and compare measured floor drop with the pre-set.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊掛樓層的臨時支撐拆除列為停留點：桁架與吊桿接頭檢驗合格、預拱量確認、分級卸撐程序與停止條件（例如任一千斤頂偏差超過 10%）經結構工程師核准後才可執行。
knowledge.textEn: Make removal of shores under hung floors a hold point released by the structural engineer only after truss and hanger joints pass inspection, the pre-set is confirmed and a staged release procedure with stop criteria, for example any jack deviating by more than 10%, is approved.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hung floors: a reversed load path"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
施工階段分析須模擬「臨時支撐承托—桁架完成—逐步卸撐轉為吊掛」的過程，計算每一步的吊桿力與樓板標高。
所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The construction-stage analysis must simulate shoring support, truss completion and staged release into hanging, computing hanger forces and floor levels at each step.
Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading.
quiz.explanation: 施工階段分析須模擬「臨時支撐承托—桁架完成—逐步卸撐轉為吊掛」的過程，計算每一步的吊桿力與樓板標高；卸撐時以液壓千斤頂讀數或吊桿應變計確認荷重逐步轉移，並量測樓板下沉量與預抬值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The construction-stage analysis must simulate shoring support, truss completion and staged release into hanging, computing hanger forces and floor levels at each step; during release confirm gradual load transfer by jack readings or hanger strain gauges and compare measured floor drop with the pre-set. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hung floors: a reversed load path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊掛樓層與吊桿伸長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hung floors and hanger elongation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在桁架尚未完成或接頭未驗收前就拆除吊掛樓層的臨時支撐，樓層會失去支承而下墜；吊桿與桁架接頭若只做壓力設計而疏忽拉力細部（例如焊道或銷孔），可能在荷重轉移時突然破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing the shores under hung floors before the truss is complete or its joints accepted leaves the floors unsupported; hanger-to-truss connections detailed for compression but not for tension, at welds or pin holes for instance, can fail suddenly during load transfer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊掛樓層的荷重先以拉力往上傳到桁架，再由桁架送到巨柱，這與一般「由下往上支承」的施工直覺相反：在桁架完成並具勁度之前，吊掛樓層不能自行站立，需要臨時支撐；吊桿受拉伸長，樓層在加載後會下沉，必須預先抬高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loads from hung floors travel up in tension to the truss and then to the mega-columns, the opposite of the usual bottom-up construction logic: until the truss is complete and stiff, the hung floors cannot stand by themselves and need temporary shoring, and because the hangers stretch in tension, the floors drop as load arrives and must be set high in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊掛樓層：載重路徑反轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hung floors: a reversed load path" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。
若在桁架尚未完成或接頭未驗收前就拆除吊掛樓層的臨時支撐，樓層會失去支承而下墜。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification.
Removing the shores under hung floors before the truss is complete or its joints accepted leaves the floors unsupported.
quiz.explanation: 若在桁架尚未完成或接頭未驗收前就拆除吊掛樓層的臨時支撐，樓層會失去支承而下墜；吊桿與桁架接頭若只做壓力設計而疏忽拉力細部（例如焊道或銷孔），可能在荷重轉移時突然破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing the shores under hung floors before the truss is complete or its joints accepted leaves the floors unsupported; hanger-to-truss connections detailed for compression but not for tension, at welds or pin holes for instance, can fail suddenly during load transfer. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂」與「節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing" and "Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「厚板焊接與碳當量」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thick-plate welding and carbon equivalent” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架弦桿與節點常用 50 至 100 mm 以上的厚板與巨型型鋼，焊縫多為全滲透並在節點處三向交會。厚板冷卻快、拘束大，熱影響區容易硬化並產生氫致冷裂；板厚方向受拉的接頭還有層狀撕裂的風險，需要使用 Z 向性能鋼材並調整接頭幾何。碳當量 CE 綜合了合金元素對硬化傾向的影響，是決定預熱溫度與焊接程序的起點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「厚板焊接與碳當量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Chords and joints of transfer trusses often use plates 50 to 100 mm thick or more and jumbo sections, with complete-penetration welds meeting in three directions at the nodes. Thick plates cool fast under high restraint, so heat-affected zones harden and hydrogen-induced cold cracks can form; joints loaded through the plate thickness also risk lamellar tearing, calling for through-thickness (Z-grade) steel and adjusted joint geometry. The carbon equivalent CE sums the hardening tendency of alloying elements and is the starting point for preheat and welding procedures. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thick-plate welding and carbon equivalent” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：IIW 碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The IIW carbon equivalent is CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「厚板焊接與碳當量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Thick-plate welding and carbon equivalent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂
knowledge.titleEn: Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架弦桿與節點常用 50 至 100 mm 以上的厚板與巨型型鋼，焊縫多為全滲透並在節點處三向交會。厚板冷卻快、拘束大，熱影響區容易硬化並產生氫致冷裂；板厚方向受拉的接頭還有層狀撕裂的風險，需要使用 Z 向性能鋼材並調整接頭幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Chords and joints of transfer trusses often use plates 50 to 100 mm thick or more and jumbo sections, with complete-penetration welds meeting in three directions at the nodes. Thick plates cool fast under high restraint, so heat-affected zones harden and hydrogen-induced cold cracks can form; joints loaded through the plate thickness also risk lamellar tearing, calling for through-thickness (Z-grade) steel and adjusted joint geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing" is correct?
options: 轉換桁架弦桿與節點常用 50 至 100 mm 以上的厚板與巨型型鋼，焊縫多為全滲透並在節點處三向交會。
只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。
高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。
optionsEn: Chords and joints of transfer trusses often use plates 50 to 100 mm thick or more and jumbo sections, with complete-penetration welds meeting in three directions at the nodes.
If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification.
High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架弦桿與節點常用 50 至 100 mm 以上的厚板與巨型型鋼，焊縫多為全滲透並在節點處三向交會。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Chords and joints of transfer trusses often use plates 50 to 100 mm thick or more and jumbo sections, with complete-penetration welds meeting in three directions at the nodes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「厚板焊接與碳當量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thick-plate welding and carbon equivalent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：IIW 碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15。C 0.16、Mn 1.50、Cr 0.05、Mo 0.02、V 0.05、Ni 0.10、Cu 0.15（%）：CE = 0.16 + 0.25 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.45。CE 約 0.45 且板厚 80 mm 時屬高硬化傾向，需依規範決定預熱（常見約 100 °C 以上）與低氫焊材。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The IIW carbon equivalent is CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.50, Cr 0.05, Mo 0.02, V 0.05, Ni 0.10 and Cu 0.15 percent, CE = 0.16 + 0.25 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.45. A CE near 0.45 in 80 mm plate has a high hardening tendency, so preheat, commonly 100 °C or more, and low-hydrogen consumables are set by the code. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以鋼廠證明核對化學成分與 Z 向斷面收縮率，焊接程序以同等厚度與拘束的試板做程序認可（含硬度與衝擊試驗）；施焊時以測溫筆或接觸式溫度計檢查預熱與層間溫度，並保存紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check chemistry and through-thickness reduction of area on mill certificates, qualify the welding procedure on test plates of equal thickness and restraint with hardness and impact tests, check preheat and interpass temperatures during welding with temperature crayons or contact thermometers, and keep the records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: IIW 碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15。C 0.16、Mn 1.50、Cr 0.05、Mo 0.02、V 0.05、Ni 0.10、Cu 0.15（%）：CE = 0.16 + 0.25 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.45。CE 約 0.45 且板厚 80 mm 時屬高硬化傾向，需依規範決定預熱（常見約 100 °C 以上）與低氫焊材。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The IIW carbon equivalent is CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.50, Cr 0.05, Mo 0.02, V 0.05, Ni 0.10 and Cu 0.15 percent, CE = 0.16 + 0.25 + 0.024 + 0.017 ≈ 0.45. A CE near 0.45 in 80 mm plate has a high hardening tendency, so preheat, commonly 100 °C or more, and low-hydrogen consumables are set by the code. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing", which statement holds?
options: 轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。
IIW 碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15。
只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。
optionsEn: If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping.
The IIW carbon equivalent is CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15.
If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct.
quiz.explanation: IIW 碳當量 CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The IIW carbon equivalent is CE = C + Mn/6 + (Cr + Mo + V)/5 + (Ni + Cu)/15. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「厚板焊接與碳當量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thick-plate welding and carbon equivalent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以鋼廠證明核對化學成分與 Z 向斷面收縮率，焊接程序以同等厚度與拘束的試板做程序認可（含硬度與衝擊試驗）；施焊時以測溫筆或接觸式溫度計檢查預熱與層間溫度，並保存紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check chemistry and through-thickness reduction of area on mill certificates, qualify the welding procedure on test plates of equal thickness and restraint with hardness and impact tests, check preheat and interpass temperatures during welding with temperature crayons or contact thermometers, and keep the records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：厚板節點須有經認可的焊接程序規範、預熱與層間溫度紀錄、焊後保溫或延遲檢驗時間（例如 48 小時後才做超音波檢測），並由焊接檢驗師簽認後才可往上安裝。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Thick-plate nodes need a qualified welding procedure specification, preheat and interpass records, post-weld insulation or a delayed inspection time, for example ultrasonic testing only after 48 hours, and sign-off by the welding inspector before erection continues above.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預熱不足或焊材受潮會在焊後數小時到數天才出現延遲裂縫，若在檢驗前就繼續安裝上方構件，裂縫被覆蓋而難以發現；板厚方向受拉的接頭若使用一般鋼板，可能在焊接收縮時就產生層狀撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「厚板焊接與碳當量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thick-plate welding and carbon equivalent” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預熱不足或焊材受潮會在焊後數小時到數天才出現延遲裂縫，若在檢驗前就繼續安裝上方構件，裂縫被覆蓋而難以發現；板厚方向受拉的接頭若使用一般鋼板，可能在焊接收縮時就產生層狀撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient preheat or damp consumables cause delayed cracks hours or days after welding, and if members above are erected before inspection the cracks are hidden; ordinary plate in joints loaded through the thickness can tear lamellarly from weld shrinkage alone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：碳當量 CE 綜合了合金元素對硬化傾向的影響，是決定預熱溫度與焊接程序的起點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The carbon equivalent CE sums the hardening tendency of alloying elements and is the starting point for preheat and welding procedures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預熱不足或焊材受潮會在焊後數小時到數天才出現延遲裂縫，若在檢驗前就繼續安裝上方構件，裂縫被覆蓋而難以發現；板厚方向受拉的接頭若使用一般鋼板，可能在焊接收縮時就產生層狀撕裂。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient preheat or damp consumables cause delayed cracks hours or days after welding, and if members above are erected before inspection the cracks are hidden; ordinary plate in joints loaded through the thickness can tear lamellarly from weld shrinkage alone.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「厚板構件、焊接性與層狀撕裂」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thick-plate members, weldability and lamellar tearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 預熱不足或焊材受潮會在焊後數小時到數天才出現延遲裂縫，若在檢驗前就繼續安裝上方構件，裂縫被覆蓋而難以發現。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。
optionsEn: Insufficient preheat or damp consumables cause delayed cracks hours or days after welding, and if members above are erected before inspection the cracks are hidden.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened.
quiz.explanation: 預熱不足或焊材受潮會在焊後數小時到數天才出現延遲裂縫，若在檢驗前就繼續安裝上方構件，裂縫被覆蓋而難以發現；板厚方向受拉的接頭若使用一般鋼板，可能在焊接收縮時就產生層狀撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient preheat or damp consumables cause delayed cracks hours or days after welding, and if members above are erected before inspection the cracks are hidden; ordinary plate in joints loaded through the thickness can tear lamellarly from weld shrinkage alone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「滑動臨界螺栓接頭」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slip-critical bolted joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架與支承柱的接頭決定力量能否順利進入柱中。樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架由預組段件在現場焊接到巨柱外側的預埋鋼板，使巨柱混凝土能連續施作；鋼構節點則常用滑動臨界高強螺栓，以摩擦傳力而不讓接頭在反覆荷重下滑移。若接頭需容許施工期的差異變形，可先以長槽孔或暫不鎖緊的螺栓連接，待指定階段再鎖定。接頭設計必須同時考慮施工期與完工後的受力方向，因為吊掛或轉換狀態可能讓同一構件由受壓轉為受拉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「滑動臨界螺栓接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The joints between a transfer truss and its supporting columns decide whether force can enter the columns smoothly. At Lotte World Tower belt trusses were pre-assembled and field-welded to embedded steel plates on the outside of the mega-columns so the column concrete could be cast continuously; steel nodes commonly use slip-critical high-strength bolts that transfer force by friction without slipping under reversing load. Where joints must accommodate construction-stage differential movement, they can be connected first with long slots or untightened bolts and locked at a specified stage. Joint design must cover force directions both during construction and after completion, because hanging or transfer states can turn a compression member into a tension member. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Slip-critical bolted joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EN 1993-1-8 滑動抗力 F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-8 slip resistance is F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「滑動臨界螺栓接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Slip-critical bolted joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定
knowledge.titleEn: Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架與支承柱的接頭決定力量能否順利進入柱中。樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架由預組段件在現場焊接到巨柱外側的預埋鋼板，使巨柱混凝土能連續施作；鋼構節點則常用滑動臨界高強螺栓，以摩擦傳力而不讓接頭在反覆荷重下滑移。
knowledge.textEn: The joints between a transfer truss and its supporting columns decide whether force can enter the columns smoothly. At Lotte World Tower belt trusses were pre-assembled and field-welded to embedded steel plates on the outside of the mega-columns so the column concrete could be cast continuously; steel nodes commonly use slip-critical high-strength bolts that transfer force by friction without slipping under reversing load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking" is correct?
options: 高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。
轉換桁架與支承柱的接頭決定力量能否順利進入柱中。
整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。
optionsEn: High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened.
The joints between a transfer truss and its supporting columns decide whether force can enter the columns smoothly.
In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架與支承柱的接頭決定力量能否順利進入柱中。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The joints between a transfer truss and its supporting columns decide whether force can enter the columns smoothly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滑動臨界螺栓接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slip-critical bolted joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-8 滑動抗力 F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3。M30 10.9 級螺栓 F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN；k_s = 1.0、兩個摩擦面 n = 2、μ = 0.5、γ_M3 = 1.25：每支 F_s,Rd ≈ 314 kN。斜桿設計力 8,485 kN 需 8,485/314 ≈ 27.0，取 28 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-8 slip resistance is F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3. An M30 class 10.9 bolt has F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN; with k_s = 1.0, two friction surfaces n = 2, μ = 0.5 and γ_M3 = 1.25, each bolt gives F_s,Rd ≈ 314 kN. A diagonal design force of 8,485 kN needs 8,485/314 ≈ 27.0, so 28 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：摩擦面處理（噴砂等級或塗層類別）須以試驗或認可資料確認摩擦係數；螺栓預拉力以轉角法、扭矩控制或直接張力指示墊圈施作並抽驗；預埋板錨筋與位置在澆置前檢查，澆置後量測預埋板的平整度與座標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm the slip coefficient of the faying surfaces, by blast grade or coating class, through tests or approved data; install bolt pretension by turn-of-nut, torque control or direct-tension-indicator washers and spot-check it; inspect embed-plate anchors and position before casting and survey flatness and coordinates afterwards.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: EN 1993-1-8 slip resistance is F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3. An M30 class 10.9 bolt has F_p,C = 0.7×1,000×561 ≈ 392.7 kN; with k_s = 1.0, two friction surfaces n = 2, μ = 0.5 and γ_M3 = 1.25, each bolt gives F_s,Rd ≈ 314 kN. A diagonal design force of 8,485 kN needs 8,485/314 ≈ 27.0, so 28 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking", which statement holds?
options: 外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。
所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。
EN 1993-1-8 滑動抗力 F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3。
optionsEn: If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws.
Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading.
EN 1993-1-8 slip resistance is F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3.
quiz.explanation: EN 1993-1-8 滑動抗力 F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1993-1-8 slip resistance is F_s,Rd = k_s·n·μ·F_p,C/γ_M3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滑動臨界螺栓接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slip-critical bolted joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 摩擦面處理（噴砂等級或塗層類別）須以試驗或認可資料確認摩擦係數；螺栓預拉力以轉角法、扭矩控制或直接張力指示墊圈施作並抽驗；預埋板錨筋與位置在澆置前檢查，澆置後量測預埋板的平整度與座標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm the slip coefficient of the faying surfaces, by blast grade or coating class, through tests or approved data; install bolt pretension by turn-of-nut, torque control or direct-tension-indicator washers and spot-check it; inspect embed-plate anchors and position before casting and survey flatness and coordinates afterwards. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接頭圖說應標明摩擦面處理等級、螺栓等級與預拉方法，並區分「施工期可滑動」與「最終鎖定」的螺栓；最終鎖定作業與檢驗紀錄須由結構工程師確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Joint drawings should state faying-surface class, bolt grade and pretensioning method and distinguish bolts that may slip during construction from those finally locked; final locking and its inspection records must be confirmed by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：摩擦面被油漆或鏽蝕污染時摩擦係數下降，接頭在設計荷重以下就滑移，轉換桁架撓度突然增加；預埋板位置偏差過大時現場只能加墊板或切割，造成偏心與額外焊接。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Faying surfaces contaminated by paint or rust lose friction so the joint slips below design load and the transfer truss suddenly deflects more; embed plates far out of position force packers or cutting on site, adding eccentricity and extra welding. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 摩擦面處理（噴砂等級或塗層類別）須以試驗或認可資料確認摩擦係數；螺栓預拉力以轉角法、扭矩控制或直接張力指示墊圈施作並抽驗；預埋板錨筋與位置在澆置前檢查，澆置後量測預埋板的平整度與座標。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the slip coefficient of the faying surfaces, by blast grade or coating class, through tests or approved data; install bolt pretension by turn-of-nut, torque control or direct-tension-indicator washers and spot-check it; inspect embed-plate anchors and position before casting and survey flatness and coordinates afterwards.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接頭圖說應標明摩擦面處理等級、螺栓等級與預拉方法，並區分「施工期可滑動」與「最終鎖定」的螺栓；最終鎖定作業與檢驗紀錄須由結構工程師確認。
knowledge.textEn: Joint drawings should state faying-surface class, bolt grade and pretensioning method and distinguish bolts that may slip during construction from those finally locked; final locking and its inspection records must be confirmed by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking"?
options: 摩擦面處理（噴砂等級或塗層類別）須以試驗或認可資料確認摩擦係數。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。
optionsEn: Confirm the slip coefficient of the faying surfaces, by blast grade or coating class, through tests or approved data.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦面處理（噴砂等級或塗層類別）須以試驗或認可資料確認摩擦係數；螺栓預拉力以轉角法、扭矩控制或直接張力指示墊圈施作並抽驗；預埋板錨筋與位置在澆置前檢查，澆置後量測預埋板的平整度與座標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm the slip coefficient of the faying surfaces, by blast grade or coating class, through tests or approved data; install bolt pretension by turn-of-nut, torque control or direct-tension-indicator washers and spot-check it; inspect embed-plate anchors and position before casting and survey flatness and coordinates afterwards. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滑動臨界螺栓接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slip-critical bolted joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 摩擦面被油漆或鏽蝕污染時摩擦係數下降，接頭在設計荷重以下就滑移，轉換桁架撓度突然增加；預埋板位置偏差過大時現場只能加墊板或切割，造成偏心與額外焊接。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Faying surfaces contaminated by paint or rust lose friction so the joint slips below design load and the transfer truss suddenly deflects more; embed plates far out of position force packers or cutting on site, adding eccentricity and extra welding. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接頭設計必須同時考慮施工期與完工後的受力方向，因為吊掛或轉換狀態可能讓同一構件由受壓轉為受拉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Joint design must cover force directions both during construction and after completion, because hanging or transfer states can turn a compression member into a tension member.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 摩擦面被油漆或鏽蝕污染時摩擦係數下降，接頭在設計荷重以下就滑移，轉換桁架撓度突然增加；預埋板位置偏差過大時現場只能加墊板或切割，造成偏心與額外焊接。
knowledge.textEn: Faying surfaces contaminated by paint or rust lose friction so the joint slips below design load and the transfer truss suddenly deflects more; embed plates far out of position force packers or cutting on site, adding eccentricity and extra welding.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節點：預埋板、螺栓群與延遲鎖定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joints: embed plates, bolt groups and delayed locking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
摩擦面被油漆或鏽蝕污染時摩擦係數下降，接頭在設計荷重以下就滑移，轉換桁架撓度突然增加；預埋板位置偏差過大時現場只能加墊板或切割，造成偏心與額外焊接。
整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Faying surfaces contaminated by paint or rust lose friction so the joint slips below design load and the transfer truss suddenly deflects more.
In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦面被油漆或鏽蝕污染時摩擦係數下降，接頭在設計荷重以下就滑移，轉換桁架撓度突然增加；預埋板位置偏差過大時現場只能加墊板或切割，造成偏心與額外焊接。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Faying surfaces contaminated by paint or rust lose friction so the joint slips below design load and the transfer truss suddenly deflects more; embed plates far out of position force packers or cutting on site, adding eccentricity and extra welding. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升」與「預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted" and "Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「整體提升與同步千斤頂」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifting and synchronised jacks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架可以在原位以臨時支架逐件安裝，也可以在地面或較低樓層組裝後以鋼絞線千斤頂整體提升。原位安裝需要能承受桁架與上方施工荷重的臨時支架，並在高空完成大量厚板焊接；整體提升則把焊接移到地面，品質較易控制，但提升時各吊點的荷重分配、同步性與風速都是控制因素，接近就位時還要處理與支承柱的對接誤差。威利斯大樓底座改造中，最東側的一根板梁就以兩段吊裝後再續接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「整體提升與同步千斤頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transfer truss can be erected piece by piece in place on temporary towers, or assembled at ground or a lower floor and lifted whole with strand jacks. In-place erection needs temporary towers that carry the truss and construction loads above and requires extensive thick-plate welding at height; lifting moves the welding to the ground where quality is easier to control, but load sharing between lifting points, synchronisation and wind govern the lift, and the fit-up to supporting columns must be resolved near final position. On the Willis Tower base repositioning, the easternmost plate girder was lifted in two pieces and spliced. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lifting and synchronised jacks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：桁架重 400 t、四個吊點，考慮不均勻係數 1.15：每點 400/4×1.15 = 115 t；再乘動力係數 1.1 得約 126.5 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 400 t truss on four lifting points with an unevenness factor of 1.15 gives 400/4×1.15 = 115 t per point, or about 126.5 t with a dynamic factor of 1.1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「整體提升與同步千斤頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lifting and synchronised jacks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升
knowledge.titleEn: Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架可以在原位以臨時支架逐件安裝，也可以在地面或較低樓層組裝後以鋼絞線千斤頂整體提升。原位安裝需要能承受桁架與上方施工荷重的臨時支架，並在高空完成大量厚板焊接；整體提升則把焊接移到地面，品質較易控制，但提升時各吊點的荷重分配、同步性與風速都是控制因素，接近就位時還要處理與支承柱的對接誤差。
knowledge.textEn: A transfer truss can be erected piece by piece in place on temporary towers, or assembled at ground or a lower floor and lifted whole with strand jacks. In-place erection needs temporary towers that carry the truss and construction loads above and requires extensive thick-plate welding at height; lifting moves the welding to the ground where quality is easier to control, but load sharing between lifting points, synchronisation and wind govern the lift, and the fit-up to supporting columns must be resolved near final position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted" is correct?
options: 整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。
轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。
轉換桁架可以在原位以臨時支架逐件安裝，也可以在地面或較低樓層組裝後以鋼絞線千斤頂整體提升。
optionsEn: In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points.
If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping.
A transfer truss can be erected piece by piece in place on temporary towers, or assembled at ground or a lower floor and lifted whole with strand jacks.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架可以在原位以臨時支架逐件安裝，也可以在地面或較低樓層組裝後以鋼絞線千斤頂整體提升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A transfer truss can be erected piece by piece in place on temporary towers, or assembled at ground or a lower floor and lifted whole with strand jacks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「整體提升與同步千斤頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifting and synchronised jacks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：桁架重 400 t、四個吊點，考慮不均勻係數 1.15：每點 400/4×1.15 = 115 t；再乘動力係數 1.1 得約 126.5 t。使用 200 t 鋼絞線千斤頂時利用率約 63%；若改為三個吊點，每點約 169 t，利用率升到約 84%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 400 t truss on four lifting points with an unevenness factor of 1.15 gives 400/4×1.15 = 115 t per point, or about 126.5 t with a dynamic factor of 1.1. With 200 t strand jacks the utilisation is about 63%; with only three points, about 169 t each, it rises to about 84%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：提升前做試吊（例如提離支架約 100 mm 並停留觀察），以千斤頂壓力與鋼絞線伸長同步監測各吊點荷重，確認偏差在允許範圍；提升中監測桁架水平度與風速，就位後量測對接誤差再進行接合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the lift, test-lift about 100 mm off the supports and hold to observe; monitor load at each point by jack pressure and strand elongation to confirm deviations are within limits; during the lift monitor truss levelness and wind speed, and measure fit-up error at final position before connecting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 桁架重 400 t、四個吊點，考慮不均勻係數 1.15：每點 400/4×1.15 = 115 t；再乘動力係數 1.1 得約 126.5 t。使用 200 t 鋼絞線千斤頂時利用率約 63%；若改為三個吊點，每點約 169 t，利用率升到約 84%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 400 t truss on four lifting points with an unevenness factor of 1.15 gives 400/4×1.15 = 115 t per point, or about 126.5 t with a dynamic factor of 1.1. With 200 t strand jacks the utilisation is about 63%; with only three points, about 169 t each, it rises to about 84%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted", which statement holds?
options: 桁架重 400 t、四個吊點，考慮不均勻係數 1.15：每點 400/4×1.15 = 115 t；再乘動力係數 1.1 得約 126.5 t。
只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。
轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。
optionsEn: A 400 t truss on four lifting points with an unevenness factor of 1.15 gives 400/4×1.15 = 115 t per point, or about 126.5 t with a dynamic factor of 1.1.
If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct.
Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation.
quiz.explanation: 桁架重 400 t、四個吊點，考慮不均勻係數 1.15：每點 400/4×1.15 = 115 t；再乘動力係數 1.1 得約 126.5 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 400 t truss on four lifting points with an unevenness factor of 1.15 gives 400/4×1.15 = 115 t per point, or about 126.5 t with a dynamic factor of 1.1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「整體提升與同步千斤頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lifting and synchronised jacks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 提升前做試吊（例如提離支架約 100 mm 並停留觀察），以千斤頂壓力與鋼絞線伸長同步監測各吊點荷重，確認偏差在允許範圍；提升中監測桁架水平度與風速，就位後量測對接誤差再進行接合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the lift, test-lift about 100 mm off the supports and hold to observe; monitor load at each point by jack pressure and strand elongation to confirm deviations are within limits; during the lift monitor truss levelness and wind speed, and measure fit-up error at final position before connecting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：提升作業屬高風險重型吊裝，須有經核准的提升計畫（含吊點設計、同步控制、試吊、風速限制、緊急停止與人員禁入區），由提升專業廠商與結構工程師共同簽認，並由合格的吊裝主管指揮。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lifting is a high-risk heavy operation requiring an approved lift plan covering lifting-point design, synchronisation, test lift, wind limits, emergency stop and exclusion zones, signed jointly by the specialist lifting contractor and the structural engineer and directed by a qualified lifting supervisor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊點同步失控時某一吊點超載，可能導致千斤頂或錨具破壞，桁架扭轉；原位安裝若臨時支架沉陷，桁架在焊接前就變形，焊後鎖入應力與幾何誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of synchronisation can overload one point and break a jack or anchorage while twisting the truss; in in-place erection a settling temporary tower deforms the truss before welding, locking in stress and geometric error after welding. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 提升前做試吊（例如提離支架約 100 mm 並停留觀察），以千斤頂壓力與鋼絞線伸長同步監測各吊點荷重，確認偏差在允許範圍；提升中監測桁架水平度與風速，就位後量測對接誤差再進行接合。
knowledge.textEn: Before the lift, test-lift about 100 mm off the supports and hold to observe; monitor load at each point by jack pressure and strand elongation to confirm deviations are within limits; during the lift monitor truss levelness and wind speed, and measure fit-up error at final position before connecting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 提升作業屬高風險重型吊裝，須有經核准的提升計畫（含吊點設計、同步控制、試吊、風速限制、緊急停止與人員禁入區），由提升專業廠商與結構工程師共同簽認，並由合格的吊裝主管指揮。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting is a high-risk heavy operation requiring an approved lift plan covering lifting-point design, synchronisation, test lift, wind limits, emergency stop and exclusion zones, signed jointly by the specialist lifting contractor and the structural engineer and directed by a qualified lifting supervisor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
提升前做試吊（例如提離支架約 100 mm 並停留觀察），以千斤頂壓力與鋼絞線伸長同步監測各吊點荷重，確認偏差在允許範圍。
吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before the lift, test-lift about 100 mm off the supports and hold to observe.
Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors.
quiz.explanation: 提升前做試吊（例如提離支架約 100 mm 並停留觀察），以千斤頂壓力與鋼絞線伸長同步監測各吊點荷重，確認偏差在允許範圍；提升中監測桁架水平度與風速，就位後量測對接誤差再進行接合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the lift, test-lift about 100 mm off the supports and hold to observe; monitor load at each point by jack pressure and strand elongation to confirm deviations are within limits; during the lift monitor truss levelness and wind speed, and measure fit-up error at final position before connecting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「整體提升與同步千斤頂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
