steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lifting and synchronised jacks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊點同步失控時某一吊點超載，可能導致千斤頂或錨具破壞，桁架扭轉；原位安裝若臨時支架沉陷，桁架在焊接前就變形，焊後鎖入應力與幾何誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of synchronisation can overload one point and break a jack or anchorage while twisting the truss; in in-place erection a settling temporary tower deforms the truss before welding, locking in stress and geometric error after welding. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：威利斯大樓底座改造中，最東側的一根板梁就以兩段吊裝後再續接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On the Willis Tower base repositioning, the easternmost plate girder was lifted in two pieces and spliced.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊點同步失控時某一吊點超載，可能導致千斤頂或錨具破壞，桁架扭轉；原位安裝若臨時支架沉陷，桁架在焊接前就變形，焊後鎖入應力與幾何誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Loss of synchronisation can overload one point and break a jack or anchorage while twisting the truss; in in-place erection a settling temporary tower deforms the truss before welding, locking in stress and geometric error after welding.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝方法：原位散裝或地面組裝後提升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Erection: piece by piece in place or assembled and lifted" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。
吊點同步失控時某一吊點超載，可能導致千斤頂或錨具破壞，桁架扭轉；原位安裝若臨時支架沉陷，桁架在焊接前就變形，焊後鎖入應力與幾何誤差。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping.
Loss of synchronisation can overload one point and break a jack or anchorage while twisting the truss.
quiz.explanation: 吊點同步失控時某一吊點超載，可能導致千斤頂或錨具破壞，桁架扭轉；原位安裝若臨時支架沉陷，桁架在焊接前就變形，焊後鎖入應力與幾何誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss of synchronisation can overload one point and break a jack or anchorage while twisting the truss; in in-place erection a settling temporary tower deforms the truss before welding, locking in stress and geometric error after welding. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預拱與分級卸撐」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Camber and staged de-propping” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架在承受上方樓層後會撓曲，若不預拱，上方所有樓層的柱都會隨之下沉。預拱值由桁架在預期荷重下的撓度決定，包括弦桿伸縮造成的彎曲撓度與斜桿伸縮造成的剪力撓度。施工中桁架常先坐在臨時支撐上，待上方若干層完成或桁架接頭全部驗收後才分級卸撐，讓荷重逐步從臨時支撐轉到桁架；卸撐順序（由中央向兩端或反之）會影響桁架與支撐的瞬時受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預拱與分級卸撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transfer truss deflects as the floors above load it, and without camber every column above drops with it. Camber is set from the truss deflection under expected load, including flexural deflection from chord strain and shear deflection from diagonal strain. During construction the truss often sits first on temporary supports and is de-propped in stages only after several floors above are complete or all its joints are accepted, so load moves gradually from the props to the truss; the release order, from the centre outward or the reverse, affects the transient forces in truss and props. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Camber and staged de-propping” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以弦桿等效慣性矩 I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴ 計算三分點雙載重撓度 δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm；加上斜桿伸縮約 30%，總撓度約 10 mm，預拱取 10 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an equivalent chord inertia I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴, the deflection under two third-point loads is δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm; adding about 30% for diagonal strain gives a total of about 10 mm, so a 10 mm camber is specified.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預拱與分級卸撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Camber and staged de-propping”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序
knowledge.titleEn: Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架在承受上方樓層後會撓曲，若不預拱，上方所有樓層的柱都會隨之下沉。預拱值由桁架在預期荷重下的撓度決定，包括弦桿伸縮造成的彎曲撓度與斜桿伸縮造成的剪力撓度。
knowledge.textEn: A transfer truss deflects as the floors above load it, and without camber every column above drops with it. Camber is set from the truss deflection under expected load, including flexural deflection from chord strain and shear deflection from diagonal strain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence" is correct?
options: 轉換桁架在承受上方樓層後會撓曲，若不預拱，上方所有樓層的柱都會隨之下沉。
轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。
外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。
optionsEn: A transfer truss deflects as the floors above load it, and without camber every column above drops with it.
If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping.
If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架在承受上方樓層後會撓曲，若不預拱，上方所有樓層的柱都會隨之下沉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A transfer truss deflects as the floors above load it, and without camber every column above drops with it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預拱與分級卸撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Camber and staged de-propping” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以弦桿等效慣性矩 I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴ 計算三分點雙載重撓度 δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm；加上斜桿伸縮約 30%，總撓度約 10 mm，預拱取 10 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an equivalent chord inertia I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴, the deflection under two third-point loads is δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm; adding about 30% for diagonal strain gives a total of about 10 mm, so a 10 mm camber is specified. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠組裝時量測桁架預拱並記錄，安裝後再量一次確認運輸與吊裝沒有改變幾何；卸撐時以千斤頂分級降載（例如每級 25%），每級量測桁架撓度與上方柱標高，與預測曲線比較，偏差超出停止條件即暫停檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure and record the truss camber at shop assembly and again after erection to confirm transport and lifting did not alter geometry; de-prop in jack-controlled stages, for example 25% per step, measuring truss deflection and column levels above at each stage against the predicted curve and pausing for review when a stop criterion is exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以弦桿等效慣性矩 I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴ 計算三分點雙載重撓度 δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm；加上斜桿伸縮約 30%，總撓度約 10 mm，預拱取 10 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With an equivalent chord inertia I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴, the deflection under two third-point loads is δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm; adding about 30% for diagonal strain gives a total of about 10 mm, so a 10 mm camber is specified. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence", which statement holds?
options: 所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。
轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。
optionsEn: Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading.
With an equivalent chord inertia I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴, the deflection under two third-point loads is δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm.
If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence.
quiz.explanation: 以弦桿等效慣性矩 I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴ 計算三分點雙載重撓度 δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm；加上斜桿伸縮約 30%，總撓度約 10 mm，預拱取 10 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With an equivalent chord inertia I = A_c·d²/2 = 0.06×8²/2 = 1.92 m⁴, the deflection under two third-point loads is δ = 23PL³/(648EI) = 23×6,000×24³/(648×200×10⁶×1.92) ≈ 7.7 mm; adding about 30% for diagonal strain gives a total of about 10 mm, so a 10 mm camber is specified. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預拱與分級卸撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Camber and staged de-propping” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠組裝時量測桁架預拱並記錄，安裝後再量一次確認運輸與吊裝沒有改變幾何；卸撐時以千斤頂分級降載（例如每級 25%），每級量測桁架撓度與上方柱標高，與預測曲線比較，偏差超出停止條件即暫停檢討。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure and record the truss camber at shop assembly and again after erection to confirm transport and lifting did not alter geometry; de-prop in jack-controlled stages, for example 25% per step, measuring truss deflection and column levels above at each stage against the predicted curve and pausing for review when a stop criterion is exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖應標示預拱值、臨時支撐位置與容量、卸撐的前提條件與分級步驟；卸撐列為停留點，由結構工程師依監測資料逐級放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should show camber, temporary support positions and capacities, preconditions and stages for de-propping; de-propping is a hold point released step by step by the structural engineer from monitoring data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未預拱或預拱過小時，上方樓層的柱與樓板在卸撐後下沉，與相鄰非轉換柱產生高差；若一次拆除全部支撐，桁架瞬間承受全部荷重，接頭或支承可能受衝擊損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With no or too little camber, columns and floors above drop after de-propping, creating level differences with neighbouring non-transferred columns; removing all props at once loads the truss instantly and can damage joints or bearings by impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 工廠組裝時量測桁架預拱並記錄，安裝後再量一次確認運輸與吊裝沒有改變幾何；卸撐時以千斤頂分級降載（例如每級 25%），每級量測桁架撓度與上方柱標高，與預測曲線比較，偏差超出停止條件即暫停檢討。
knowledge.textEn: Measure and record the truss camber at shop assembly and again after erection to confirm transport and lifting did not alter geometry; de-prop in jack-controlled stages, for example 25% per step, measuring truss deflection and column levels above at each stage against the predicted curve and pausing for review when a stop criterion is exceeded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工圖應標示預拱值、臨時支撐位置與容量、卸撐的前提條件與分級步驟；卸撐列為停留點，由結構工程師依監測資料逐級放行。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings should show camber, temporary support positions and capacities, preconditions and stages for de-propping; de-propping is a hold point released step by step by the structural engineer from monitoring data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。
工廠組裝時量測桁架預拱並記錄，安裝後再量一次確認運輸與吊裝沒有改變幾何。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification.
Measure and record the truss camber at shop assembly and again after erection to confirm transport and lifting did not alter geometry.
quiz.explanation: 工廠組裝時量測桁架預拱並記錄，安裝後再量一次確認運輸與吊裝沒有改變幾何；卸撐時以千斤頂分級降載（例如每級 25%），每級量測桁架撓度與上方柱標高，與預測曲線比較，偏差超出停止條件即暫停檢討。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure and record the truss camber at shop assembly and again after erection to confirm transport and lifting did not alter geometry; de-prop in jack-controlled stages, for example 25% per step, measuring truss deflection and column levels above at each stage against the predicted curve and pausing for review when a stop criterion is exceeded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預拱與分級卸撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Camber and staged de-propping” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未預拱或預拱過小時，上方樓層的柱與樓板在卸撐後下沉，與相鄰非轉換柱產生高差；若一次拆除全部支撐，桁架瞬間承受全部荷重，接頭或支承可能受衝擊損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With no or too little camber, columns and floors above drop after de-propping, creating level differences with neighbouring non-transferred columns; removing all props at once loads the truss instantly and can damage joints or bearings by impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工中桁架常先坐在臨時支撐上，待上方若干層完成或桁架接頭全部驗收後才分級卸撐，讓荷重逐步從臨時支撐轉到桁架；卸撐順序（由中央向兩端或反之）會影響桁架與支撐的瞬時受力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During construction the truss often sits first on temporary supports and is de-propped in stages only after several floors above are complete or all its joints are accepted, so load moves gradually from the props to the truss; the release order, from the centre outward or the reverse, affects the transient forces in truss and props.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未預拱或預拱過小時，上方樓層的柱與樓板在卸撐後下沉，與相鄰非轉換柱產生高差；若一次拆除全部支撐，桁架瞬間承受全部荷重，接頭或支承可能受衝擊損傷。
knowledge.textEn: With no or too little camber, columns and floors above drop after de-propping, creating level differences with neighbouring non-transferred columns; removing all props at once loads the truss instantly and can damage joints or bearings by impact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預拱、臨時支撐與卸撐順序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Camber, temporary support and de-propping sequence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未預拱或預拱過小時，上方樓層的柱與樓板在卸撐後下沉，與相鄰非轉換柱產生高差；若一次拆除全部支撐，桁架瞬間承受全部荷重，接頭或支承可能受衝擊損傷。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。
optionsEn: With no or too little camber, columns and floors above drop after de-propping, creating level differences with neighbouring non-transferred columns.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws.
quiz.explanation: 未預拱或預拱過小時，上方樓層的柱與樓板在卸撐後下沉，與相鄰非轉換柱產生高差；若一次拆除全部支撐，桁架瞬間承受全部荷重，接頭或支承可能受衝擊損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With no or too little camber, columns and floors above drop after de-propping, creating level differences with neighbouring non-transferred columns; removing all props at once loads the truss instantly and can damage joints or bearings by impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」與「荷重轉移的監測與比對」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds" and "Monitoring and comparing load transfer": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 全滲透焊的超音波檢驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「超音波檢測定位瑕疵」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Locating flaws by ultrasonic testing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架的厚板全滲透焊必須做體積檢測，最常用的是超音波檢測：探頭把超音波斜射入鋼板，遇到裂縫、未熔合或夾渣時反射回探頭，依聲程與入射角換算瑕疵的深度與距離，再依反射幅度與長度判定是否合格。相位陣列超音波（PAUT）可同時掃描多個角度並保存影像，便於複核。檢驗時機要配合延遲裂縫的發生時間，並在構件被上方結構覆蓋前完成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「超音波檢測定位瑕疵」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Complete-penetration welds in transfer-truss plates need volumetric inspection, most commonly ultrasonic testing: a probe sends an angled ultrasonic beam into the plate, and cracks, lack of fusion or slag reflect it back; the sound path and beam angle give the flaw's depth and distance, and its echo amplitude and length decide acceptance. Phased-array ultrasonics (PAUT) scan several angles at once and keep images for review. Inspection timing must allow for delayed cracking and be completed before the member is covered by the structure above. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Locating flaws by ultrasonic testing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜角探頭聲程 s = v·t/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an angle-beam probe the sound path is s = v·t/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「超音波檢測定位瑕疵」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Locating flaws by ultrasonic testing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 全滲透焊的超音波檢驗
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架的厚板全滲透焊必須做體積檢測，最常用的是超音波檢測：探頭把超音波斜射入鋼板，遇到裂縫、未熔合或夾渣時反射回探頭，依聲程與入射角換算瑕疵的深度與距離，再依反射幅度與長度判定是否合格。相位陣列超音波（PAUT）可同時掃描多個角度並保存影像，便於複核。
knowledge.textEn: Complete-penetration welds in transfer-truss plates need volumetric inspection, most commonly ultrasonic testing: a probe sends an angled ultrasonic beam into the plate, and cracks, lack of fusion or slag reflect it back; the sound path and beam angle give the flaw's depth and distance, and its echo amplitude and length decide acceptance. Phased-array ultrasonics (PAUT) scan several angles at once and keep images for review.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds" is correct?
options: 外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。
轉換桁架的厚板全滲透焊必須做體積檢測，最常用的是超音波檢測：探頭把超音波斜射入鋼板，遇到裂縫、未熔合或夾渣時反射回探頭，依聲程與入射角換算瑕疵的深度與距離，再依反射幅度與長度判定是否合格。
只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。
optionsEn: If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws.

Complete-penetration welds in transfer-truss plates need volumetric inspection, most commonly ultrasonic testing: a probe sends an angled ultrasonic beam into the plate, and cracks, lack of fusion or slag reflect it back.
If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架的厚板全滲透焊必須做體積檢測，最常用的是超音波檢測：探頭把超音波斜射入鋼板，遇到裂縫、未熔合或夾渣時反射回探頭，依聲程與入射角換算瑕疵的深度與距離，再依反射幅度與長度判定是否合格。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Complete-penetration welds in transfer-truss plates need volumetric inspection, most commonly ultrasonic testing: a probe sends an angled ultrasonic beam into the plate, and cracks, lack of fusion or slag reflect it back; the sound path and beam angle give the flaw's depth and distance, and its echo amplitude and length decide acceptance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全滲透焊的超音波檢驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超音波檢測定位瑕疵」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Locating flaws by ultrasonic testing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜角探頭聲程 s = v·t/2。橫波速度 v = 3,240 m/s、回波時間 t = 30 μs：s = 3,240×30×10⁻⁶/2 ≈ 48.6 mm；入射角 70° 時瑕疵深度 = s·cos70° ≈ 16.6 mm，表面距離 = s·sin70° ≈ 45.7 mm，可判斷瑕疵位於 60 mm 厚板的焊根或焊冠區。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an angle-beam probe the sound path is s = v·t/2. With a shear-wave velocity v = 3,240 m/s and an echo time t = 30 μs, s = 3,240×30×10⁻⁶/2 ≈ 48.6 mm; at a 70° beam angle the flaw depth = s·cos70° ≈ 16.6 mm and the surface distance = s·sin70° ≈ 45.7 mm, locating it relative to the root or cap of a 60 mm plate weld. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢驗人員須具相應資格，儀器與探頭以標準試塊校正；依 AWS D1.1 或對應規範的掃描方式、靈敏度與允收表判定，每道焊縫的檢驗報告記錄位置、瑕疵指示與處置，返修後重新檢驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspectors must hold the appropriate qualification and calibrate instrument and probes on standard blocks; apply the scanning pattern, sensitivity and acceptance tables of AWS D1.1 or the governing code, recording location, indications and disposition for every weld, and re-inspect after repair.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 斜角探頭聲程 s = v·t/2。橫波速度 v = 3,240 m/s、回波時間 t = 30 μs：s = 3,240×30×10⁻⁶/2 ≈ 48.6 mm；入射角 70° 時瑕疵深度 = s·cos70° ≈ 16.6 mm，表面距離 = s·sin70° ≈ 45.7 mm，可判斷瑕疵位於 60 mm 厚板的焊根或焊冠區。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For an angle-beam probe the sound path is s = v·t/2. With a shear-wave velocity v = 3,240 m/s and an echo time t = 30 μs, s = 3,240×30×10⁻⁶/2 ≈ 48.6 mm; at a 70° beam angle the flaw depth = s·cos70° ≈ 16.6 mm and the surface distance = s·sin70° ≈ 45.7 mm, locating it relative to the root or cap of a 60 mm plate weld. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds", which statement holds?
options: 轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。
吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。
斜角探頭聲程 s = v·t/2。
optionsEn: Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation.
Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors.
For an angle-beam probe the sound path is s = v·t/2.
quiz.explanation: 斜角探頭聲程 s = v·t/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an angle-beam probe the sound path is s = v·t/2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全滲透焊的超音波檢驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超音波檢測定位瑕疵」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Locating flaws by ultrasonic testing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢驗人員須具相應資格，儀器與探頭以標準試塊校正；依 AWS D1.1 或對應規範的掃描方式、靈敏度與允收表判定，每道焊縫的檢驗報告記錄位置、瑕疵指示與處置，返修後重新檢驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspectors must hold the appropriate qualification and calibrate instrument and probes on standard blocks; apply the scanning pattern, sensitivity and acceptance tables of AWS D1.1 or the governing code, recording location, indications and disposition for every weld, and re-inspect after repair. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉換構件的全滲透焊應 100% 做體積檢測，檢驗計畫寫明延遲檢驗時間、方法與允收標準；未取得合格報告前不得覆蓋或加載，返修次數超過規定時須由結構工程師評估母材損傷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Inspect 100% of complete-penetration welds in transfer members volumetrically, with the inspection plan stating delay time, method and acceptance criteria; do not cover or load a weld before its report passes, and have the structural engineer assess base-metal damage when repairs exceed the allowed number.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若檢驗在焊後太早進行或被略過，延遲裂縫可能在上方樓層加載後擴展，轉換桁架節點在服務荷重下開裂；以錯誤的入射角或未校正的儀器檢測，會把瑕疵定位錯誤而修錯位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inspecting too soon after welding, or skipping it, lets delayed cracks grow once the floors above load the node, cracking the transfer joint in service; testing with the wrong beam angle or an uncalibrated instrument mislocates flaws so the wrong spot is repaired. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢驗人員須具相應資格，儀器與探頭以標準試塊校正；依 AWS D1.1 或對應規範的掃描方式、靈敏度與允收表判定，每道焊縫的檢驗報告記錄位置、瑕疵指示與處置，返修後重新檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Inspectors must hold the appropriate qualification and calibrate instrument and probes on standard blocks; apply the scanning pattern, sensitivity and acceptance tables of AWS D1.1 or the governing code, recording location, indications and disposition for every weld, and re-inspect after repair.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉換構件的全滲透焊應 100% 做體積檢測，檢驗計畫寫明延遲檢驗時間、方法與允收標準；未取得合格報告前不得覆蓋或加載，返修次數超過規定時須由結構工程師評估母材損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect 100% of complete-penetration welds in transfer members volumetrically, with the inspection plan stating delay time, method and acceptance criteria; do not cover or load a weld before its report passes, and have the structural engineer assess base-metal damage when repairs exceed the allowed number.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds"?
options: 檢驗人員須具相應資格，儀器與探頭以標準試塊校正。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。
optionsEn: Inspectors must hold the appropriate qualification and calibrate instrument and probes on standard blocks.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened.
quiz.explanation: 檢驗人員須具相應資格，儀器與探頭以標準試塊校正；依 AWS D1.1 或對應規範的掃描方式、靈敏度與允收表判定，每道焊縫的檢驗報告記錄位置、瑕疵指示與處置，返修後重新檢驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspectors must hold the appropriate qualification and calibrate instrument and probes on standard blocks; apply the scanning pattern, sensitivity and acceptance tables of AWS D1.1 or the governing code, recording location, indications and disposition for every weld, and re-inspect after repair. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全滲透焊的超音波檢驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超音波檢測定位瑕疵」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Locating flaws by ultrasonic testing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若檢驗在焊後太早進行或被略過，延遲裂縫可能在上方樓層加載後擴展，轉換桁架節點在服務荷重下開裂；以錯誤的入射角或未校正的儀器檢測，會把瑕疵定位錯誤而修錯位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inspecting too soon after welding, or skipping it, lets delayed cracks grow once the floors above load the node, cracking the transfer joint in service; testing with the wrong beam angle or an uncalibrated instrument mislocates flaws so the wrong spot is repaired. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢驗時機要配合延遲裂縫的發生時間，並在構件被上方結構覆蓋前完成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspection timing must allow for delayed cracking and be completed before the member is covered by the structure above.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外觀檢查看不到裂縫，焊縫內部就沒有瑕疵。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若檢驗在焊後太早進行或被略過，延遲裂縫可能在上方樓層加載後擴展，轉換桁架節點在服務荷重下開裂；以錯誤的入射角或未校正的儀器檢測，會把瑕疵定位錯誤而修錯位置。
knowledge.textEn: Inspecting too soon after welding, or skipping it, lets delayed cracks grow once the floors above load the node, cracking the transfer joint in service; testing with the wrong beam angle or an uncalibrated instrument mislocates flaws so the wrong spot is repaired.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若檢驗在焊後太早進行或被略過，延遲裂縫可能在上方樓層加載後擴展，轉換桁架節點在服務荷重下開裂；以錯誤的入射角或未校正的儀器檢測，會把瑕疵定位錯誤而修錯位置。
只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Inspecting too soon after welding, or skipping it, lets delayed cracks grow once the floors above load the node, cracking the transfer joint in service.
If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 若檢驗在焊後太早進行或被略過，延遲裂縫可能在上方樓層加載後擴展，轉換桁架節點在服務荷重下開裂；以錯誤的入射角或未校正的儀器檢測，會把瑕疵定位錯誤而修錯位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspecting too soon after welding, or skipping it, lets delayed cracks grow once the floors above load the node, cracking the transfer joint in service; testing with the wrong beam angle or an uncalibrated instrument mislocates flaws so the wrong spot is repaired. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 荷重轉移的監測與比對：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and comparing load transfer: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「卸載過程的應變監測」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strain monitoring during load transfer” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架從臨時支撐轉為自行承載的過程，是驗證設計假設最好的時機。在弦桿、斜桿與支承柱上安裝應變計，配合千斤頂讀數與撓度量測，可以直接得到構件軸力，與施工階段分析逐步比較。若實測力與預測相符，表示荷重路徑與勁度假設正確；若某根斜桿明顯偏低而相鄰構件偏高，可能是接頭滑移、臨時支撐未完全釋放或桁架幾何偏差。這些資料也成為日後營運監測的基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「卸載過程的應變監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Transferring a truss from temporary supports to self-supporting is the best moment to verify design assumptions. Strain gauges on chords, diagonals and supporting columns, together with jack readings and deflection surveys, give member forces directly for step-by-step comparison with the construction-stage analysis. Agreement confirms the load path and stiffness assumptions; a diagonal clearly lower than predicted with neighbours higher may indicate joint slip, a prop not fully released or geometric deviation. The data also become the baseline for later in-service monitoring. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strain monitoring during load transfer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：構件軸力 F = E·ε·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Member force is F = E·ε·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「卸載過程的應變監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strain monitoring during load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 荷重轉移的監測與比對
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架從臨時支撐轉為自行承載的過程，是驗證設計假設最好的時機。在弦桿、斜桿與支承柱上安裝應變計，配合千斤頂讀數與撓度量測，可以直接得到構件軸力，與施工階段分析逐步比較。
knowledge.textEn: Transferring a truss from temporary supports to self-supporting is the best moment to verify design assumptions. Strain gauges on chords, diagonals and supporting columns, together with jack readings and deflection surveys, give member forces directly for step-by-step comparison with the construction-stage analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「荷重轉移的監測與比對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring and comparing load transfer" is correct?
options: 只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。
所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。
轉換桁架從臨時支撐轉為自行承載的過程，是驗證設計假設最好的時機。
optionsEn: If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct.
Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading.
Transferring a truss from temporary supports to self-supporting is the best moment to verify design assumptions.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架從臨時支撐轉為自行承載的過程，是驗證設計假設最好的時機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Transferring a truss from temporary supports to self-supporting is the best moment to verify design assumptions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 荷重轉移的監測與比對：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and comparing load transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「卸載過程的應變監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strain monitoring during load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：構件軸力 F = E·ε·A。弦桿 A = 0.06 m²、實測應變 ε = 400 με：F = 200×10⁶×400×10⁻⁶×0.06 = 4,800 kN，與預測 5,000 kN 相差 −4%；若同一階段實測只有 250 με（3,000 kN），差 −40%，應暫停並檢查是否仍有支撐未釋放。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Member force is F = E·ε·A. For a chord with A = 0.06 m² and measured strain ε = 400 με, F = 200×10⁶×400×10⁻⁶×0.06 = 4,800 kN, −4% from the predicted 5,000 kN; if only 250 με (3,000 kN) were measured at that stage, −40%, work should pause to check for an unreleased prop. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：應變計在構件無應力時歸零並記錄溫度，每片構件至少在斷面兩側各裝一支以分離彎曲；卸撐每一級後讀取所有應變計、千斤頂與撓度，計算各構件力與預測的比值，設定允許偏差（例如 ±15%）作為繼續卸撐的條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Zero strain gauges with the member unstressed and record temperature, fitting at least one gauge on each side of the section to separate bending; after each de-propping stage read all gauges, jacks and deflections, compute measured-to-predicted force ratios and use an allowable deviation, for example ±15%, as the condition for continuing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 構件軸力 F = E·ε·A。弦桿 A = 0.06 m²、實測應變 ε = 400 με：F = 200×10⁶×400×10⁻⁶×0.06 = 4,800 kN，與預測 5,000 kN 相差 −4%；若同一階段實測只有 250 με（3,000 kN），差 −40%，應暫停並檢查是否仍有支撐未釋放。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Member force is F = E·ε·A. For a chord with A = 0.06 m² and measured strain ε = 400 με, F = 200×10⁶×400×10⁻⁶×0.06 = 4,800 kN, −4% from the predicted 5,000 kN; if only 250 με (3,000 kN) were measured at that stage, −40%, work should pause to check for an unreleased prop. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「荷重轉移的監測與比對」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Monitoring and comparing load transfer", which statement holds?
options: 構件軸力 F = E·ε·A。
轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。
只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。
optionsEn: Member force is F = E·ε·A.
If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence.
If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification.
quiz.explanation: 構件軸力 F = E·ε·A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Member force is F = E·ε·A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 荷重轉移的監測與比對：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and comparing load transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「卸載過程的應變監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strain monitoring during load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 應變計在構件無應力時歸零並記錄溫度，每片構件至少在斷面兩側各裝一支以分離彎曲；卸撐每一級後讀取所有應變計、千斤頂與撓度，計算各構件力與預測的比值，設定允許偏差（例如 ±15%）作為繼續卸撐的條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Zero strain gauges with the member unstressed and record temperature, fitting at least one gauge on each side of the section to separate bending; after each de-propping stage read all gauges, jacks and deflections, compute measured-to-predicted force ratios and use an allowable deviation, for example ±15%, as the condition for continuing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉換桁架的監測計畫應與卸撐程序合併撰寫，列出感測器位置、讀數時機、允許偏差與超限處置，並把最終讀數作為交接基準存檔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write the transfer-truss monitoring plan together with the de-propping procedure, listing sensor positions, reading times, allowable deviations and actions on exceedance, and archive the final readings as the handover baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只看撓度而不量構件力，荷重可能經由未預期的路徑（例如隔間牆或機電支架）傳遞，桁架看似正常但某些非結構構件已被壓壞；監測資料未保存則日後無法判斷桁架是否發生長期變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Watching only deflection without measuring member forces lets load find unintended paths, through partitions or service supports for instance, so the truss looks normal while non-structural elements are being crushed; without retained data no one can later tell whether the truss has changed over time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 應變計在構件無應力時歸零並記錄溫度，每片構件至少在斷面兩側各裝一支以分離彎曲；卸撐每一級後讀取所有應變計、千斤頂與撓度，計算各構件力與預測的比值，設定允許偏差（例如 ±15%）作為繼續卸撐的條件。
knowledge.textEn: Zero strain gauges with the member unstressed and record temperature, fitting at least one gauge on each side of the section to separate bending; after each de-propping stage read all gauges, jacks and deflections, compute measured-to-predicted force ratios and use an allowable deviation, for example ±15%, as the condition for continuing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架的監測計畫應與卸撐程序合併撰寫，列出感測器位置、讀數時機、允許偏差與超限處置，並把最終讀數作為交接基準存檔。
knowledge.textEn: Write the transfer-truss monitoring plan together with the de-propping procedure, listing sensor positions, reading times, allowable deviations and actions on exceedance, and archive the final readings as the handover baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「荷重轉移的監測與比對」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring and comparing load transfer"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
應變計在構件無應力時歸零並記錄溫度，每片構件至少在斷面兩側各裝一支以分離彎曲。
整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Zero strain gauges with the member unstressed and record temperature, fitting at least one gauge on each side of the section to separate bending.
In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points.
quiz.explanation: 應變計在構件無應力時歸零並記錄溫度，每片構件至少在斷面兩側各裝一支以分離彎曲；卸撐每一級後讀取所有應變計、千斤頂與撓度，計算各構件力與預測的比值，設定允許偏差（例如 ±15%）作為繼續卸撐的條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Zero strain gauges with the member unstressed and record temperature, fitting at least one gauge on each side of the section to separate bending; after each de-propping stage read all gauges, jacks and deflections, compute measured-to-predicted force ratios and use an allowable deviation, for example ±15%, as the condition for continuing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 荷重轉移的監測與比對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and comparing load transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「卸載過程的應變監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strain monitoring during load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只看撓度而不量構件力，荷重可能經由未預期的路徑（例如隔間牆或機電支架）傳遞，桁架看似正常但某些非結構構件已被壓壞；監測資料未保存則日後無法判斷桁架是否發生長期變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Watching only deflection without measuring member forces lets load find unintended paths, through partitions or service supports for instance, so the truss looks normal while non-structural elements are being crushed; without retained data no one can later tell whether the truss has changed over time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些資料也成為日後營運監測的基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data also become the baseline for later in-service monitoring.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要量到撓度符合預期，荷重路徑就一定正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If measured deflection matches the prediction, the load path must be correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只看撓度而不量構件力，荷重可能經由未預期的路徑（例如隔間牆或機電支架）傳遞，桁架看似正常但某些非結構構件已被壓壞；監測資料未保存則日後無法判斷桁架是否發生長期變化。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷重轉移的監測與比對」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring and comparing load transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。
若只看撓度而不量構件力，荷重可能經由未預期的路徑（例如隔間牆或機電支架）傳遞，桁架看似正常但某些非結構構件已被壓壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading.

Watching only deflection without measuring member forces lets load find unintended paths, through partitions or service supports for instance, so the truss looks normal while non-structural elements are being crushed.
quiz.explanation: 若只看撓度而不量構件力，荷重可能經由未預期的路徑（例如隔間牆或機電支架）傳遞，桁架看似正常但某些非結構構件已被壓壞；監測資料未保存則日後無法判斷桁架是否發生長期變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Watching only deflection without measuring member forces lets load find unintended paths, through partitions or service supports for instance, so the truss looks normal while non-structural elements are being crushed; without retained data no one can later tell whether the truss has changed over time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度」與「關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers" and "Key-element design and handover records": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉換構件的防火被覆」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fire protection of transfer members” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架承托多層樓，一旦失效後果遠大於一般梁柱，因此通常被列為關鍵構件，要求較高的耐火時效與更可靠的防火被覆。鋼材在高溫下強度與勁度下降，構件失效時的溫度（臨界溫度）取決於火災時的荷重利用率：利用率越低，臨界溫度越高。這與只為使用性設置、經評估可不做被覆的帽桁架不同，轉換構件的被覆厚度、附著力與完整性都必須嚴格驗收，日後改裝也不得破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉換構件的防火被覆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transfer truss supports many floors, so its failure has far greater consequences than that of an ordinary beam or column; it is usually designated a key element with a higher fire-resistance period and more reliable fire protection. Steel loses strength and stiffness at high temperature, and the temperature at which a member fails, its critical temperature, depends on the load utilisation in fire: the lower the utilisation, the higher the critical temperature. Unlike hat trusses provided only for serviceability and judged not to need protection, transfer members require strict acceptance of protection thickness, adhesion and integrity, which later alterations must not damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fire protection of transfer members” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉換構件的防火被覆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fire protection of transfer members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度
knowledge.titleEn: Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架承托多層樓，一旦失效後果遠大於一般梁柱，因此通常被列為關鍵構件，要求較高的耐火時效與更可靠的防火被覆。鋼材在高溫下強度與勁度下降，構件失效時的溫度（臨界溫度）取決於火災時的荷重利用率：利用率越低，臨界溫度越高。
knowledge.textEn: A transfer truss supports many floors, so its failure has far greater consequences than that of an ordinary beam or column; it is usually designated a key element with a higher fire-resistance period and more reliable fire protection. Steel loses strength and stiffness at high temperature, and the temperature at which a member fails, its critical temperature, depends on the load utilisation in fire: the lower the utilisation, the higher the critical temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers" is correct?
options: 轉換桁架承托多層樓，一旦失效後果遠大於一般梁柱，因此通常被列為關鍵構件，要求較高的耐火時效與更可靠的防火被覆。
所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。
轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。
optionsEn: A transfer truss supports many floors, so its failure has far greater consequences than that of an ordinary beam or column.
Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading.
Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架承托多層樓，一旦失效後果遠大於一般梁柱，因此通常被列為關鍵構件，要求較高的耐火時效與更可靠的防火被覆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A transfer truss supports many floors, so its failure has far greater consequences than that of an ordinary beam or column; it is usually designated a key element with a higher fire-resistance period and more reliable fire protection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉換構件的防火被覆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fire protection of transfer members” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。μ₀ = 0.6 時 θ_cr ≈ 554 °C；μ₀ = 0.4 時 θ_cr ≈ 620 °C；μ₀ = 0.7 時 θ_cr ≈ 526 °C。降低火災時利用率可提高臨界溫度、減少所需被覆厚度。數值為公式示範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. For μ₀ = 0.6, θ_cr ≈ 554 °C; for μ₀ = 0.4, θ_cr ≈ 620 °C; for μ₀ = 0.7, θ_cr ≈ 526 °C. Lowering utilisation in fire raises the critical temperature and reduces the protection needed. Values illustrate the formula. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：防火被覆施作後以濕膜或乾膜測厚儀、或針刺法量測厚度，依規定的抽樣密度檢查並記錄；噴覆材料做附著力與密度抽驗，節點與螺栓周邊的被覆完整性逐一目視確認，缺陷修補後重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After application, measure fire-protection thickness with wet- or dry-film gauges or pin gauges at the specified sampling density and record it; spot-check adhesion and density of sprayed materials, visually confirm protection integrity around every node and bolt group, and re-measure after repairs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。μ₀ = 0.6 時 θ_cr ≈ 554 °C；μ₀ = 0.4 時 θ_cr ≈ 620 °C；μ₀ = 0.7 時 θ_cr ≈ 526 °C。降低火災時利用率可提高臨界溫度、減少所需被覆厚度。數值為公式示範。
knowledge.textEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. For μ₀ = 0.6, θ_cr ≈ 554 °C; for μ₀ = 0.4, θ_cr ≈ 620 °C; for μ₀ = 0.7, θ_cr ≈ 526 °C. Lowering utilisation in fire raises the critical temperature and reduces the protection needed. Values illustrate the formula.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers", which statement holds?
options: 吊掛樓層和一般樓層一樣，可以由下往上逐層施作並立即受力。
高強螺栓只要鎖緊，就一定能以摩擦傳力。
optionsEn: Hung floors can be built and loaded bottom-up immediately like ordinary floors.
EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
High-strength bolts always transfer force by friction once they are tightened.
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉換構件的防火被覆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fire protection of transfer members” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 防火被覆施作後以濕膜或乾膜測厚儀、或針刺法量測厚度，依規定的抽樣密度檢查並記錄；噴覆材料做附著力與密度抽驗，節點與螺栓周邊的被覆完整性逐一目視確認，缺陷修補後重新量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After application, measure fire-protection thickness with wet- or dry-film gauges or pin gauges at the specified sampling density and record it; spot-check adhesion and density of sprayed materials, visually confirm protection integrity around every node and bolt group, and re-measure after repairs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工圖與現場標示應把轉換構件標為「關鍵構件—防火被覆不得破壞」，任何在其上的吊掛、焊接或鑽孔都要經結構與消防工程師核准，並在完工後檢查被覆修補。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built drawings and site labels should mark transfer members as key elements whose fire protection must not be damaged; any hanging, welding or drilling on them needs approval from structural and fire engineers, with protection repairs inspected afterwards.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：後續機電管線或吊架安裝時刮除或鑽穿轉換桁架的被覆而未修補，火災時該處鋼材提早升溫，轉換構件失效可能導致上方多層樓板塌落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If later services or hangers scrape off or drill through the protection on a transfer truss without repair, the steel there heats early in a fire, and failure of the transfer can bring down several floors above. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: After application, measure fire-protection thickness with wet- or dry-film gauges or pin gauges at the specified sampling density and record it; spot-check adhesion and density of sprayed materials, visually confirm protection integrity around every node and bolt group, and re-measure after repairs.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
轉換桁架只要強度足夠，就不需要預拱或分級卸撐。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If the transfer truss is strong enough, it needs neither camber nor staged de-propping.
After application, measure fire-protection thickness with wet- or dry-film gauges or pin gauges at the specified sampling density and record it.
quiz.explanation: 防火被覆施作後以濕膜或乾膜測厚儀、或針刺法量測厚度，依規定的抽樣密度檢查並記錄；噴覆材料做附著力與密度抽驗，節點與螺栓周邊的被覆完整性逐一目視確認，缺陷修補後重新量測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After application, measure fire-protection thickness with wet- or dry-film gauges or pin gauges at the specified sampling density and record it; spot-check adhesion and density of sprayed materials, visually confirm protection integrity around every node and bolt group, and re-measure after repairs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉換構件的防火被覆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fire protection of transfer members” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 後續機電管線或吊架安裝時刮除或鑽穿轉換桁架的被覆而未修補，火災時該處鋼材提早升溫，轉換構件失效可能導致上方多層樓板塌落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If later services or hangers scrape off or drill through the protection on a transfer truss without repair, the steel there heats early in a fire, and failure of the transfer can bring down several floors above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這與只為使用性設置、經評估可不做被覆的帽桁架不同，轉換構件的被覆厚度、附著力與完整性都必須嚴格驗收，日後改裝也不得破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unlike hat trusses provided only for serviceability and judged not to need protection, transfer members require strict acceptance of protection thickness, adhesion and integrity, which later alterations must not damage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有鋼構件的防火被覆都一樣重要，不需要分級。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fire protection is equally important on all steel members and needs no grading." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 後續機電管線或吊架安裝時刮除或鑽穿轉換桁架的被覆而未修補，火災時該處鋼材提早升溫，轉換構件失效可能導致上方多層樓板塌落。
knowledge.textEn: If later services or hangers scrape off or drill through the protection on a transfer truss without repair, the steel there heats early in a fire, and failure of the transfer can bring down several floors above.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉換構件的耐火與臨界溫度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire resistance and critical temperature of transfers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 後續機電管線或吊架安裝時刮除或鑽穿轉換桁架的被覆而未修補，火災時該處鋼材提早升溫，轉換構件失效可能導致上方多層樓板塌落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。
optionsEn: If later services or hangers scrape off or drill through the protection on a transfer truss without repair, the steel there heats early in a fire, and failure of the transfer can bring down several floors above.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation.
quiz.explanation: 後續機電管線或吊架安裝時刮除或鑽穿轉換桁架的被覆而未修補，火災時該處鋼材提早升溫，轉換構件失效可能導致上方多層樓板塌落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If later services or hangers scrape off or drill through the protection on a transfer truss without repair, the steel there heats early in a fire, and failure of the transfer can bring down several floors above. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Key-element design and handover records: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「關鍵構件與改裝管制」如何影響跨層轉換桁架施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Key elements and alteration control” governs force, deformation or durability in “Multi-storey transfer-truss construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉換桁架失效會讓上方所有被轉換的柱失去支承，因此常依 EN 1991-1-7 或類似規定檢核為關鍵構件：構件必須能承受額外的意外作用（例如 34 kN/m² 的面壓）而不失效。交接後最大的風險往往來自不了解其重要性的改裝：在弦桿開孔穿管、切除斜桿以增加通道、在節點旁焊接附件。交接文件必須讓營運單位知道哪些構件屬轉換與關鍵構件、它們承托哪些樓層、鎖入了哪些施工期應力，以及改裝的審查流程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「關鍵構件與改裝管制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Failure of a transfer truss leaves every transferred column above unsupported, so it is often checked as a key element under EN 1991-1-7 or similar rules: the member must withstand an additional accidental action, for example a pressure of 34 kN/m², without failure. After handover the greatest risk often comes from alterations by people unaware of its importance: holes in chords for services, removed diagonals for passageways, attachments welded next to nodes. Handover documents must tell the operator which members are transfers and key elements, which floors they carry, what construction-stage stresses are locked in, and how alterations are reviewed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Key elements and alteration control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EN 1991-1-7 關鍵構件意外作用 34 kN/m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1991-1-7 sets an accidental action of 34 kN/m² on key elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「關鍵構件與改裝管制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Key elements and alteration control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄
knowledge.text: 轉換桁架失效會讓上方所有被轉換的柱失去支承，因此常依 EN 1991-1-7 或類似規定檢核為關鍵構件：構件必須能承受額外的意外作用（例如 34 kN/m² 的面壓）而不失效。交接後最大的風險往往來自不了解其重要性的改裝：在弦桿開孔穿管、切除斜桿以增加通道、在節點旁焊接附件。
knowledge.textEn: Failure of a transfer truss leaves every transferred column above unsupported, so it is often checked as a key element under EN 1991-1-7 or similar rules: the member must withstand an additional accidental action, for example a pressure of 34 kN/m², without failure. After handover the greatest risk often comes from alterations by people unaware of its importance: holes in chords for services, removed diagonals for passageways, attachments welded next to nodes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Key-element design and handover records" is correct?
options: 轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。
轉換桁架失效會讓上方所有被轉換的柱失去支承，因此常依 EN 1991-1-7 或類似規定檢核為關鍵構件：構件必須能承受額外的意外作用（例如 34 kN/m² 的面壓）而不失效。
轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。
optionsEn: Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation.

Failure of a transfer truss leaves every transferred column above unsupported, so it is often checked as a key element under EN 1991-1-7 or similar rules: the member must withstand an additional accidental action, for example a pressure of 34 kN/m², without failure.
If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence.
quiz.explanation: 轉換桁架失效會讓上方所有被轉換的柱失去支承，因此常依 EN 1991-1-7 或類似規定檢核為關鍵構件：構件必須能承受額外的意外作用（例如 34 kN/m² 的面壓）而不失效。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Failure of a transfer truss leaves every transferred column above unsupported, so it is often checked as a key element under EN 1991-1-7 or similar rules: the member must withstand an additional accidental action, for example a pressure of 34 kN/m², without failure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Key-element design and handover records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「關鍵構件與改裝管制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Key elements and alteration control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1991-1-7 關鍵構件意外作用 34 kN/m²。斜桿迎面寬 1.0 m、長 8 m：線荷重 w = 34×1.0 = 34 kN/m，簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 34×8²/8 = 272 kN·m，須與構件在意外組合下的軸力共同檢核；若迎面寬 1.5 m，M = 408 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1991-1-7 sets an accidental action of 34 kN/m² on key elements. For a diagonal with a 1.0 m face width and 8 m length, the line load w = 34×1.0 = 34 kN/m and the simply supported moment M = wL²/8 = 34×8²/8 = 272 kN·m, to be checked together with axial force in the accidental combination; a 1.5 m face width gives M = 408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前完成關鍵構件清冊：構件編號、位置、所承托樓層、設計力與鎖入應力、防火等級與檢查週期；以竣工測量確認實際幾何與預拱，並把卸載監測的最終讀數與照片一併歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover complete a key-element register giving member ID, location, floors carried, design and locked-in forces, fire rating and inspection interval; confirm actual geometry and camber by as-built survey and archive the final unloading readings and photographs with it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1991-1-7 關鍵構件意外作用 34 kN/m²。斜桿迎面寬 1.0 m、長 8 m：線荷重 w = 34×1.0 = 34 kN/m，簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 34×8²/8 = 272 kN·m，須與構件在意外組合下的軸力共同檢核；若迎面寬 1.5 m，M = 408 kN·m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: EN 1991-1-7 sets an accidental action of 34 kN/m² on key elements. For a diagonal with a 1.0 m face width and 8 m length, the line load w = 34×1.0 = 34 kN/m and the simply supported moment M = wL²/8 = 34×8²/8 = 272 kN·m, to be checked together with axial force in the accidental combination; a 1.5 m face width gives M = 408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Key-element design and handover records", which statement holds?
options: 只要焊工有證照，厚板焊接就不需要另外的程序認可。
整體提升時各吊點的荷重一定平均分配。
EN 1991-1-7 關鍵構件意外作用 34 kN/m²。
optionsEn: If the welder is certified, thick-plate welding needs no separate procedure qualification.
In a lift, load is always shared equally among the lifting points.
EN 1991-1-7 sets an accidental action of 34 kN/m² on key elements.
quiz.explanation: EN 1991-1-7 關鍵構件意外作用 34 kN/m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1991-1-7 sets an accidental action of 34 kN/m² on key elements. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Key-element design and handover records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「關鍵構件與改裝管制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Key elements and alteration control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前完成關鍵構件清冊：構件編號、位置、所承托樓層、設計力與鎖入應力、防火等級與檢查週期；以竣工測量確認實際幾何與預拱，並把卸載監測的最終讀數與照片一併歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover complete a key-element register giving member ID, location, floors carried, design and locked-in forces, fire rating and inspection interval; confirm actual geometry and camber by as-built survey and archive the final unloading readings and photographs with it. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：物業管理規章明訂：轉換與關鍵構件不得切割、開孔或焊接，相關改裝須提出結構計算並取得結構技師簽證；每年巡檢時對照關鍵構件清冊確認現況，並在構件上設置永久標示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Building rules must prohibit cutting, holing or welding transfer and key elements, require structural calculations and a licensed structural engineer's sign-off for related alterations, and have the annual inspection check each item on the key-element register, with permanent labels fixed on the members.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接文件只有一般結構圖，日後改裝團隊可能把轉換桁架的斜桿當成可移除的支撐而切除，荷重在毫無預警下重新分配，導致上方樓層下沉或局部倒塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If handover provides only general structural drawings, a later renovation team may treat a transfer diagonal as removable bracing and cut it, redistributing load without warning and causing settlement or local collapse of the floors above. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 物業管理規章明訂：轉換與關鍵構件不得切割、開孔或焊接，相關改裝須提出結構計算並取得結構技師簽證；每年巡檢時對照關鍵構件清冊確認現況，並在構件上設置永久標示。

quiz.question: 要驗證「關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Key-element design and handover records"?
options: 交接前完成關鍵構件清冊：構件編號、位置、所承托樓層、設計力與鎖入應力、防火等級與檢查週期；以竣工測量確認實際幾何與預拱，並把卸載監測的最終讀數與照片一併歸檔。

optionsEn: Before handover complete a key-element register giving member ID, location, floors carried, design and locked-in forces, fire rating and inspection interval.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If visual inspection finds no cracks, the weld has no internal flaws.
