steps.title: 關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Key-element design and handover records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「關鍵構件與改裝管制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Key elements and alteration control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接文件只有一般結構圖，日後改裝團隊可能把轉換桁架的斜桿當成可移除的支撐而切除，荷重在毫無預警下重新分配，導致上方樓層下沉或局部倒塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If handover provides only general structural drawings, a later renovation team may treat a transfer diagonal as removable bracing and cut it, redistributing load without warning and causing settlement or local collapse of the floors above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須讓營運單位知道哪些構件屬轉換與關鍵構件、它們承托哪些樓層、鎖入了哪些施工期應力，以及改裝的審查流程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must tell the operator which members are transfers and key elements, which floors they carry, what construction-stage stresses are locked in, and how alterations are reviewed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉換桁架裡的斜桿只是穩定用的支撐，可以在改裝時移除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diagonals in a transfer truss are just stability bracing and can be removed during renovation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交接文件只有一般結構圖，日後改裝團隊可能把轉換桁架的斜桿當成可移除的支撐而切除，荷重在毫無預警下重新分配，導致上方樓層下沉或局部倒塌。
knowledge.textEn: If handover provides only general structural drawings, a later renovation team may treat a transfer diagonal as removable bracing and cut it, redistributing load without warning and causing settlement or local collapse of the floors above.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「關鍵構件設計與交接紀錄」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Key-element design and handover records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若交接文件只有一般結構圖，日後改裝團隊可能把轉換桁架的斜桿當成可移除的支撐而切除，荷重在毫無預警下重新分配，導致上方樓層下沉或局部倒塌。
轉換桁架只要構件夠大，深度淺一點也沒關係。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If handover provides only general structural drawings, a later renovation team may treat a transfer diagonal as removable bracing and cut it, redistributing load without warning and causing settlement or local collapse of the floors above.
If its members are big enough, a transfer truss can be made shallower without consequence.
quiz.explanation: 若交接文件只有一般結構圖，日後改裝團隊可能把轉換桁架的斜桿當成可移除的支撐而切除，荷重在毫無預警下重新分配，導致上方樓層下沉或局部倒塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If handover provides only general structural drawings, a later renovation team may treat a transfer diagonal as removable bracing and cut it, redistributing load without warning and causing settlement or local collapse of the floors above. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 雪梨歌劇院
summary: 從烏戎競圖中無法計算的帆形輪廓出發，說明 Arup 如何以半徑約 75 m 的共同球面把屋殼改為預鑄肋拱，再處理肋段斷面、環氧膠結與後拉預力、伸縮式架設拱與逐段吊裝、電腦化幾何控制，以及風洞與結構模型驗證。最後談海港環境中瓷磚蓋板扣件、預力與混凝土的耐久，以及世界遺產建築的檢測與交接紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from Utzon's competition sails that could not be calculated, the course shows how Arup turned the shells into precast rib arches cut from a common sphere of about 75 m radius, then covers rib sections, epoxy bonding and post-tensioning, telescopic erection arches and segment-by-segment lifting, computerised geometry control, and wind-tunnel and structural-model verification. It ends with the durability of tile-lid fixings, prestress and concrete in a harbour environment and the inspection and handover records of a World Heritage building.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核一處肋段接縫在風載下是否仍保持受壓。接縫面積 A = 0.90 m²、斷面模數 Z = 0.15 m³，以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa：P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN，σ_P = P/A = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.31 MPa。風吸力在該接縫造成彎矩 M = 0.12 MN·m，σ_M = M/Z = 0.12/0.15 = 0.80 MPa。保守忽略自重軸壓，最小應力 σ_min = 1.31 − 0.80 = 0.51 MPa > 0，接縫保持閉合。若長期損失使有效應力降到 1,000 MPa（σ_P ≈ 1.09 MPa），同時風洞修正使彎矩增為 1.5 倍（σ_M = 1.20 MPa），σ_min = 1.09 − 1.20 = −0.11 MPa，接縫邊緣轉為受拉而可能張開，需要增加預力或重新分區。所有數值為教學假設，不代表雪梨歌劇院的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether a rib-segment joint stays in compression under wind. The joint has area A = 0.90 m² and section modulus Z = 0.15 m³ and is stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa: P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN and σ_P = P/A = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.31 MPa. Wind suction causes a joint moment M = 0.12 MN·m, so σ_M = M/Z = 0.12/0.15 = 0.80 MPa. Conservatively ignoring self-weight compression, σ_min = 1.31 − 0.80 = 0.51 MPa > 0 and the joint stays closed. If long-term losses lower the effective stress to 1,000 MPa (σ_P ≈ 1.09 MPa) while a wind-tunnel correction raises the moment by 1.5 times (σ_M = 1.20 MPa), σ_min = 1.09 − 1.20 = −0.11 MPa, the joint edge goes into tension and may open, calling for more prestress or re-zoning. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Sydney Opera House.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「從自由曲面到球面解」與「自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "From free-form sails to the spherical solution" and "Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 從自由曲面到球面解：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: From free-form sails to the spherical solution: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「75 m 共同球面」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Common 75 m sphere” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 烏戎 1957 年的競圖草圖只有帆形輪廓，沒有可計算的幾何定義；高聳陡峭的殼體在風與自重下以彎矩為主，無法像低矮薄殼那樣只靠膜力傳遞荷載。設計團隊在 1957 至 1961 年間試過拋物線、橢圓等至少 12 種方案，最後把所有主殼外表面都取自同一個半徑約 75 m 的球面，讓殼片改由一束束從台座輻射而出的預鑄肋拱組成。共同曲率意味著距台座相同弧長的肋段斷面相同，可以用少數標準模具重複生產，幾何問題因此轉成工業化生產問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「75 m 共同球面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Utzon's 1957 competition sketches gave sail outlines but no computable geometry; tall, steep shells under wind and self-weight are dominated by bending and cannot carry load by membrane action alone like shallow thin shells. Between 1957 and 1961 the team tried at least 12 schemes, including parabolic and ellipsoidal ones, before taking every main shell surface from one sphere of about 75 m radius, so each shell became a fan of precast rib arches radiating from a pedestal. Common curvature means rib segments at the same arc distance from the pedestal share one cross-section and can be produced repeatedly in a few standard moulds, turning a geometry problem into an industrial production problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Common 75 m sphere” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：肋線是通過台座極點的大圓，相鄰兩肋夾角 Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad 時，距極點弧長 s 處的肋間距 w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ribs are great circles through a pole at the pedestal; with an angle Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad between adjacent ribs, the spacing at arc distance s from the pole is w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「75 m 共同球面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Common 75 m sphere”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 從自由曲面到球面解
knowledge.titleEn: From free-form sails to the spherical solution
knowledge.text: 烏戎 1957 年的競圖草圖只有帆形輪廓，沒有可計算的幾何定義；高聳陡峭的殼體在風與自重下以彎矩為主，無法像低矮薄殼那樣只靠膜力傳遞荷載。設計團隊在 1957 至 1961 年間試過拋物線、橢圓等至少 12 種方案，最後把所有主殼外表面都取自同一個半徑約 75 m 的球面，讓殼片改由一束束從台座輻射而出的預鑄肋拱組成。
knowledge.textEn: Utzon's 1957 competition sketches gave sail outlines but no computable geometry; tall, steep shells under wind and self-weight are dominated by bending and cannot carry load by membrane action alone like shallow thin shells. Between 1957 and 1961 the team tried at least 12 schemes, including parabolic and ellipsoidal ones, before taking every main shell surface from one sphere of about 75 m radius, so each shell became a fan of precast rib arches radiating from a pedestal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「從自由曲面到球面解」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "From free-form sails to the spherical solution" is correct?
options: 雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。
烏戎 1957 年的競圖草圖只有帆形輪廓，沒有可計算的幾何定義；高聳陡峭的殼體在風與自重下以彎矩為主，無法像低矮薄殼那樣只靠膜力傳遞荷載。
混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action.
Utzon's 1957 competition sketches gave sail outlines but no computable geometry.
A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 烏戎 1957 年的競圖草圖只有帆形輪廓，沒有可計算的幾何定義；高聳陡峭的殼體在風與自重下以彎矩為主，無法像低矮薄殼那樣只靠膜力傳遞荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Utzon's 1957 competition sketches gave sail outlines but no computable geometry; tall, steep shells under wind and self-weight are dominated by bending and cannot carry load by membrane action alone like shallow thin shells. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 從自由曲面到球面解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: From free-form sails to the spherical solution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「75 m 共同球面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Common 75 m sphere” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：肋線是通過台座極點的大圓，相鄰兩肋夾角 Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad 時，距極點弧長 s 處的肋間距 w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ。取 R = 75 m：s = 10 m 時 w ≈ 0.64 m；s = 64 m 時 s/R = 0.853 rad、sin = 0.754，w = 75×0.754×0.0637 ≈ 3.6 m，肋段因此越往脊線越寬。R 與 3.65° 取自 Arup 公開資料，弧長取值為教學近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ribs are great circles through a pole at the pedestal; with an angle Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad between adjacent ribs, the spacing at arc distance s from the pole is w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ. With R = 75 m: at s = 10 m, w ≈ 0.64 m; at s = 64 m, s/R = 0.853 rad, sin = 0.754 and w = 75×0.754×0.0637 ≈ 3.6 m, so segments widen toward the ridge. R and 3.65° are from Arup's published account; the arc distances are teaching approximations. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維座標把每條肋線的球心、極點與大圓平面寫成方程，抽查肋段四角座標是否落在 75 m 球面上（徑向偏差以毫米計），並確認相同弧長位置的肋段斷面在各殼片間確實可共用模具；1960 年代以電腦程式與幾何模型交互核對，今日則以參數化模型與點雲比對完成同樣的檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Write each rib line as an equation defined by the sphere centre, the pole and its great-circle plane, spot-check that the corner coordinates of rib segments lie on the 75 m sphere with radial deviations in millimetres, and confirm that segments at equal arc distance really can share moulds across shells; in the 1960s this was cross-checked between computer programs and geometric models, today the same check is done with a parametric model and point-cloud comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 肋線是通過台座極點的大圓，相鄰兩肋夾角 Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad 時，距極點弧長 s 處的肋間距 w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ。取 R = 75 m：s = 10 m 時 w ≈ 0.64 m；s = 64 m 時 s/R = 0.853 rad、sin = 0.754，w = 75×0.754×0.0637 ≈ 3.6 m，肋段因此越往脊線越寬。R 與 3.65° 取自 Arup 公開資料，弧長取值為教學近似。
knowledge.textEn: Ribs are great circles through a pole at the pedestal; with an angle Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad between adjacent ribs, the spacing at arc distance s from the pole is w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ. With R = 75 m: at s = 10 m, w ≈ 0.64 m; at s = 64 m, s/R = 0.853 rad, sin = 0.754 and w = 75×0.754×0.0637 ≈ 3.6 m, so segments widen toward the ridge. R and 3.65° are from Arup's published account; the arc distances are teaching approximations.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「從自由曲面到球面解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "From free-form sails to the spherical solution", which statement holds?
options: 環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。
預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。
肋線是通過台座極點的大圓，相鄰兩肋夾角 Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad 時，距極點弧長 s 處的肋間距 w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ。
optionsEn: Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress.
If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection.
Ribs are great circles through a pole at the pedestal.

steps.title: 從自由曲面到球面解：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: From free-form sails to the spherical solution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「75 m 共同球面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Common 75 m sphere” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維座標把每條肋線的球心、極點與大圓平面寫成方程，抽查肋段四角座標是否落在 75 m 球面上（徑向偏差以毫米計），並確認相同弧長位置的肋段斷面在各殼片間確實可共用模具；1960 年代以電腦程式與幾何模型交互核對，今日則以參數化模型與點雲比對完成同樣的檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Write each rib line as an equation defined by the sphere centre, the pole and its great-circle plane, spot-check that the corner coordinates of rib segments lie on the 75 m sphere with radial deviations in millimetres, and confirm that segments at equal arc distance really can share moulds across shells; in the 1960s this was cross-checked between computer programs and geometric models, today the same check is done with a parametric model and point-cloud comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：曲面造型先要有可以寫成方程的幾何母體，再談分割、模具與施工；幾何凍結前不應讓承受屋頂反力的下部結構開工，或至少在合約中保留重新設計台座與基礎的條款。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A curved form first needs a geometric parent that can be written as an equation, before segmentation, moulds and construction are discussed; substructures carrying roof reactions should not start before the geometry is frozen, or the contract should at least reserve the right to redesign pedestals and foundations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有幾何定義就無法計算內力與製作模板：曲面未定案時若照每個殼片各自曲率現場澆鑄，模板成本與工期會失控，殼片之間的脊線也無法保證吻合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a defined geometry, internal forces cannot be calculated and formwork cannot be made: casting each shell in place to its own curvature before the surface is fixed would let formwork cost and programme run out of control and leave ridge lines between shells unmatched. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維座標把每條肋線的球心、極點與大圓平面寫成方程，抽查肋段四角座標是否落在 75 m 球面上（徑向偏差以毫米計），並確認相同弧長位置的肋段斷面在各殼片間確實可共用模具；1960 年代以電腦程式與幾何模型交互核對，今日則以參數化模型與點雲比對完成同樣的檢查。

knowledge.text: 曲面造型先要有可以寫成方程的幾何母體，再談分割、模具與施工；幾何凍結前不應讓承受屋頂反力的下部結構開工，或至少在合約中保留重新設計台座與基礎的條款。

quiz.question: 要驗證「從自由曲面到球面解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "From free-form sails to the spherical solution"?
options: 以三維座標把每條肋線的球心、極點與大圓平面寫成方程，抽查肋段四角座標是否落在 75 m 球面上（徑向偏差以毫米計），並確認相同弧長位置的肋段斷面在各殼片間確實可共用模具。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
縮尺模型的變形按比例放大，就是實際建築的長期變形。
optionsEn: Write each rib line as an equation defined by the sphere centre, the pole and its great-circle plane, spot-check that the corner coordinates of rib segments lie on the 75 m sphere with radial deviations in millimetres, and confirm that segments at equal arc distance really can share moulds across shells.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection.
quiz.explanation: 以三維座標把每條肋線的球心、極點與大圓平面寫成方程，抽查肋段四角座標是否落在 75 m 球面上（徑向偏差以毫米計），並確認相同弧長位置的肋段斷面在各殼片間確實可共用模具；1960 年代以電腦程式與幾何模型交互核對，今日則以參數化模型與點雲比對完成同樣的檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Write each rib line as an equation defined by the sphere centre, the pole and its great-circle plane, spot-check that the corner coordinates of rib segments lie on the 75 m sphere with radial deviations in millimetres, and confirm that segments at equal arc distance really can share moulds across shells; in the 1960s this was cross-checked between computer programs and geometric models, today the same check is done with a parametric model and point-cloud comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 從自由曲面到球面解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: From free-form sails to the spherical solution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「75 m 共同球面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Common 75 m sphere” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有幾何定義就無法計算內力與製作模板：曲面未定案時若照每個殼片各自曲率現場澆鑄，模板成本與工期會失控，殼片之間的脊線也無法保證吻合。雪梨歌劇院的台座在屋頂方案定案前已開工，後來台座柱因無法承受最終屋頂荷載而必須重建，正是設計與施工順序倒置的代價。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a defined geometry, internal forces cannot be calculated and formwork cannot be made: casting each shell in place to its own curvature before the surface is fixed would let formwork cost and programme run out of control and leave ridge lines between shells unmatched. At Sydney the podium started before the roof scheme was settled, and its columns later had to be rebuilt because they could not carry the final roof loads, the price of reversing design and construction order. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共同曲率意味著距台座相同弧長的肋段斷面相同，可以用少數標準模具重複生產，幾何問題因此轉成工業化生產問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Common curvature means rib segments at the same arc distance from the pedestal share one cross-section and can be produced repeatedly in a few standard moulds, turning a geometry problem into an industrial production problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有幾何定義就無法計算內力與製作模板：曲面未定案時若照每個殼片各自曲率現場澆鑄，模板成本與工期會失控，殼片之間的脊線也無法保證吻合。雪梨歌劇院的台座在屋頂方案定案前已開工，後來台座柱因無法承受最終屋頂荷載而必須重建，正是設計與施工順序倒置的代價。
knowledge.textEn: Without a defined geometry, internal forces cannot be calculated and formwork cannot be made: casting each shell in place to its own curvature before the surface is fixed would let formwork cost and programme run out of control and leave ridge lines between shells unmatched. At Sydney the podium started before the roof scheme was settled, and its columns later had to be rebuilt because they could not carry the final roof loads, the price of reversing design and construction order.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「從自由曲面到球面解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "From free-form sails to the spherical solution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
沒有幾何定義就無法計算內力與製作模板：曲面未定案時若照每個殼片各自曲率現場澆鑄，模板成本與工期會失控，殼片之間的脊線也無法保證吻合。
混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Without a defined geometry, internal forces cannot be calculated and formwork cannot be made: casting each shell in place to its own curvature before the surface is fixed would let formwork cost and programme run out of control and leave ridge lines between shells unmatched.
A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored.

quiz.explanationEn: Without a defined geometry, internal forces cannot be calculated and formwork cannot be made: casting each shell in place to its own curvature before the surface is fixed would let formwork cost and programme run out of control and leave ridge lines between shells unmatched. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「肋拱台座反力」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib pedestal reactions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每片主殼由左右兩組肋拱扇面組成，肋拱從混凝土台座起拱，向上延伸到脊梁與對向的肋相接，主要以拱作用把自重壓力傳回台座；左右成對的肋在殼片對稱面上互相平衡水平推力，剩餘反力由台座、下方柱與基礎承擔。台座把所有預鑄段匯集到共同起拱點，因此台座與其下柱的剛度直接決定殼片變形。暴露在雪梨陽光下的外側肋與室內側肋溫差可達十多度，受約束時會產生明顯附加應力，是自重以外不可忽略的荷載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋拱台座反力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each main shell is two mirrored fans of rib arches that spring from concrete pedestals and rise to a ridge beam where they meet the opposing ribs, carrying self-weight mainly by arch action in compression back to the pedestals. Paired ribs balance each other's horizontal thrust across the shell's plane of symmetry, and the remaining reactions go to the pedestals, the columns below and the foundations. The pedestal gathers every precast segment to a common springing point, so its stiffness and that of the columns beneath directly govern shell deformation. Exposed outer ribs in Sydney sunshine can be more than ten degrees warmer than inner ribs, which produces significant additional stress when restrained, a load that cannot be ignored beside self-weight. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib pedestal reactions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Arup 公開的夏季設計溫度為外側肋 43°C、內側肋 27°C，溫差 ΔT = 16°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Arup's published summer design temperatures are 43°C for external ribs and 27°C for internal ribs, a difference ΔT = 16°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「肋拱台座反力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rib pedestal reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path
knowledge.text: 每片主殼由左右兩組肋拱扇面組成，肋拱從混凝土台座起拱，向上延伸到脊梁與對向的肋相接，主要以拱作用把自重壓力傳回台座；左右成對的肋在殼片對稱面上互相平衡水平推力，剩餘反力由台座、下方柱與基礎承擔。台座把所有預鑄段匯集到共同起拱點，因此台座與其下柱的剛度直接決定殼片變形。
knowledge.textEn: Each main shell is two mirrored fans of rib arches that spring from concrete pedestals and rise to a ridge beam where they meet the opposing ribs, carrying self-weight mainly by arch action in compression back to the pedestals. Paired ribs balance each other's horizontal thrust across the shell's plane of symmetry, and the remaining reactions go to the pedestals, the columns below and the foundations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path" is correct?
options: 混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。
預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。
每片主殼由左右兩組肋拱扇面組成，肋拱從混凝土台座起拱，向上延伸到脊梁與對向的肋相接，主要以拱作用把自重壓力傳回台座。
optionsEn: A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored.
As long as a precast rib segment has the right dimensions, its weight and age do not affect erection.

Each main shell is two mirrored fans of rib arches that spring from concrete pedestals and rise to a ridge beam where they meet the opposing ribs, carrying self-weight mainly by arch action in compression back to the pedestals.
quiz.explanation: 每片主殼由左右兩組肋拱扇面組成，肋拱從混凝土台座起拱，向上延伸到脊梁與對向的肋相接，主要以拱作用把自重壓力傳回台座；左右成對的肋在殼片對稱面上互相平衡水平推力，剩餘反力由台座、下方柱與基礎承擔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each main shell is two mirrored fans of rib arches that spring from concrete pedestals and rise to a ridge beam where they meet the opposing ribs, carrying self-weight mainly by arch action in compression back to the pedestals. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「肋拱台座反力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib pedestal reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Arup 公開的夏季設計溫度為外側肋 43°C、內側肋 27°C，溫差 ΔT = 16°C。取 α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C，自由應變 ε = αΔT = 160×10⁻⁶，64 m 弧長的自由伸長差 ΔL = 160×10⁻⁶×64,000 mm ≈ 10 mm；若完全受約束、E = 30,000 MPa，應力 σ = E·αΔT ≈ 4.8 MPa。α、E 與完全約束為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Arup's published summer design temperatures are 43°C for external ribs and 27°C for internal ribs, a difference ΔT = 16°C. With α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C the free strain is ε = αΔT = 160×10⁻⁶ and the free length difference over a 64 m arc is ΔL = 160×10⁻⁶×64,000 mm ≈ 10 mm; fully restrained with E = 30,000 MPa, the stress would be σ = E·αΔT ≈ 4.8 MPa. α, E and full restraint are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構模型中分別施加自重、風與溫差荷載組合，檢查肋拱每一斷面的軸力偏心是否落在斷面核心內或由預力涵蓋；以台座下柱的反力分配核對柱與基礎容量，並在施工中量測柱頂沉陷與肋拱溫度，公開資料記錄主屋頂柱最大沉陷約 3 mm，可作為比較基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply self-weight, wind and temperature combinations separately in the structural model and check at each rib section whether the axial-force eccentricity stays within the section core or is covered by prestress; check the reaction distribution under the pedestals against column and foundation capacity, and during construction measure column-head settlement and rib temperatures, the published maximum settlement of about 3 mm for the main roof columns being a useful benchmark.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Arup 公開的夏季設計溫度為外側肋 43°C、內側肋 27°C，溫差 ΔT = 16°C。取 α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C，自由應變 ε = αΔT = 160×10⁻⁶，64 m 弧長的自由伸長差 ΔL = 160×10⁻⁶×64,000 mm ≈ 10 mm；若完全受約束、E = 30,000 MPa，應力 σ = E·αΔT ≈ 4.8 MPa。α、E 與完全約束為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Arup's published summer design temperatures are 43°C for external ribs and 27°C for internal ribs, a difference ΔT = 16°C. With α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C the free strain is ε = αΔT = 160×10⁻⁶ and the free length difference over a 64 m arc is ΔL = 160×10⁻⁶×64,000 mm ≈ 10 mm; fully restrained with E = 30,000 MPa, the stress would be σ = E·αΔT ≈ 4.8 MPa. α, E and full restraint are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path", which statement holds?
options: Arup 公開的夏季設計溫度為外側肋 43°C、內側肋 27°C，溫差 ΔT = 16°C。
肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。
屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。
optionsEn: Arup's published summer design temperatures are 43°C for external ribs and 27°C for internal ribs, a difference ΔT = 16°C.
A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution.
Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant.
quiz.explanation: Arup 公開的夏季設計溫度為外側肋 43°C、內側肋 27°C，溫差 ΔT = 16°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Arup's published summer design temperatures are 43°C for external ribs and 27°C for internal ribs, a difference ΔT = 16°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋拱台座反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib pedestal reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構模型中分別施加自重、風與溫差荷載組合，檢查肋拱每一斷面的軸力偏心是否落在斷面核心內或由預力涵蓋；以台座下柱的反力分配核對柱與基礎容量，並在施工中量測柱頂沉陷與肋拱溫度，公開資料記錄主屋頂柱最大沉陷約 3 mm，可作為比較基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply self-weight, wind and temperature combinations separately in the structural model and check at each rib section whether the axial-force eccentricity stays within the section core or is covered by prestress; check the reaction distribution under the pedestals against column and foundation capacity, and during construction measure column-head settlement and rib temperatures, the published maximum settlement of about 3 mm for the main roof columns being a useful benchmark. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：曲面屋頂的荷載組合表要單列日照溫差與季節溫差，並寫明所採用的外表面與內側設計溫度；台座與下部柱的勁度假設須寫入計算書，施工後以實測沉陷校核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The load-combination table of a curved roof should list solar and seasonal temperature differences separately and state the external and internal design temperatures used; stiffness assumptions for pedestals and supporting columns should be written into the calculations and checked against measured settlement after construction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用自重推力線設計肋拱而忽略外側肋日照升溫，受約束的肋在脊梁與台座附近會出現額外彎矩，接縫張開、預力損失增加；若台座下柱剛度與假設不同，殼片會不對稱下沉，脊線附近的接縫承受設計範圍外的剪力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing the ribs only for the self-weight thrust line and ignoring solar heating of the outer ribs gives restrained ribs extra bending near the ridge beam and pedestals, opening joints and increasing prestress losses; if the columns under the pedestals differ in stiffness from the assumption, the shells settle unevenly and joints near the ridge carry shear outside the design envelope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構模型中分別施加自重、風與溫差荷載組合，檢查肋拱每一斷面的軸力偏心是否落在斷面核心內或由預力涵蓋；以台座下柱的反力分配核對柱與基礎容量，並在施工中量測柱頂沉陷與肋拱溫度，公開資料記錄主屋頂柱最大沉陷約 3 mm，可作為比較基準。
knowledge.textEn: Apply self-weight, wind and temperature combinations separately in the structural model and check at each rib section whether the axial-force eccentricity stays within the section core or is covered by prestress; check the reaction distribution under the pedestals against column and foundation capacity, and during construction measure column-head settlement and rib temperatures, the published maximum settlement of about 3 mm for the main roof columns being a useful benchmark.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 曲面屋頂的荷載組合表要單列日照溫差與季節溫差，並寫明所採用的外表面與內側設計溫度；台座與下部柱的勁度假設須寫入計算書，施工後以實測沉陷校核。
knowledge.textEn: The load-combination table of a curved roof should list solar and seasonal temperature differences separately and state the external and internal design temperatures used; stiffness assumptions for pedestals and supporting columns should be written into the calculations and checked against measured settlement after construction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在結構模型中分別施加自重、風與溫差荷載組合，檢查肋拱每一斷面的軸力偏心是否落在斷面核心內或由預力涵蓋。
混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them.

quiz.explanationEn: Apply self-weight, wind and temperature combinations separately in the structural model and check at each rib section whether the axial-force eccentricity stays within the section core or is covered by prestress; check the reaction distribution under the pedestals against column and foundation capacity, and during construction measure column-head settlement and rib temperatures, the published maximum settlement of about 3 mm for the main roof columns being a useful benchmark. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「肋拱台座反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib pedestal reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用自重推力線設計肋拱而忽略外側肋日照升溫，受約束的肋在脊梁與台座附近會出現額外彎矩，接縫張開、預力損失增加；若台座下柱剛度與假設不同，殼片會不對稱下沉，脊線附近的接縫承受設計範圍外的剪力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing the ribs only for the self-weight thrust line and ignoring solar heating of the outer ribs gives restrained ribs extra bending near the ridge beam and pedestals, opening joints and increasing prestress losses; if the columns under the pedestals differ in stiffness from the assumption, the shells settle unevenly and joints near the ridge carry shear outside the design envelope. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：暴露在雪梨陽光下的外側肋與室內側肋溫差可達十多度，受約束時會產生明顯附加應力，是自重以外不可忽略的荷載。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Exposed outer ribs in Sydney sunshine can be more than ten degrees warmer than inner ribs, which produces significant additional stress when restrained, a load that cannot be ignored beside self-weight.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。
若只用自重推力線設計肋拱而忽略外側肋日照升溫，受約束的肋在脊梁與台座附近會出現額外彎矩，接縫張開、預力損失增加。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

quiz.explanationEn: Designing the ribs only for the self-weight thrust line and ignoring solar heating of the outer ribs gives restrained ribs extra bending near the ridge beam and pedestals, opening joints and increasing prestress losses; if the columns under the pedestals differ in stiffness from the assumption, the shells settle unevenly and joints near the ridge carry shear outside the design envelope. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠」與「接縫膠結與後拉預力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard" and "Joint bonding and post-tensioning": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預鑄肋段與標準模具」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Precast rib segments and moulds” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 肋段在台座附近是實心 T 形，往上變為實心 Y 形，再往上成為開口 Y 形；斷面隨彎矩與軸力減小而變薄，但外表面始終貼合球面，翼緣直接成為屋面蓋板的支承。所有肋段都在現場預鑄工廠以可調模具生產，標準段長約 4.6 m、最重約 10 t，長度與重量由塔吊能力反推。預鑄讓混凝土在受控環境中養護，強度、尺寸與表面品質比高空現場澆置穩定，接縫面也能先研磨處理以利後續膠結。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預鑄肋段與標準模具」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rib segments are solid T-sections near the pedestal, solid Y-sections higher up and open Y-sections near the top; the section thins as bending and axial force reduce, yet its outer face always follows the sphere and its flanges directly support the roof tile lids. All segments were produced in an on-site precasting yard with adjustable moulds; a standard segment is about 4.6 m long and weighs up to about 10 t, length and weight being derived back from tower-crane capacity. Precasting lets the concrete cure under controlled conditions, so strength, dimensions and surface quality are more consistent than casting at height, and joint faces can be ground beforehand for bonding. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Precast rib segments and moulds” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：標準段重約 10,160 kg、長 4.6 m（Arup 公開資料）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A standard segment weighs about 10,160 kg and is 4.6 m long (Arup's published data).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as a precast rib segment has the right dimensions, its weight and age do not affect erection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預鑄肋段與標準模具」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Precast rib segments and moulds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard" is correct?
options: 肋段在台座附近是實心 T 形，往上變為實心 Y 形，再往上成為開口 Y 形；斷面隨彎矩與軸力減小而變薄，但外表面始終貼合球面，翼緣直接成為屋面蓋板的支承。
預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。
環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。
optionsEn: Rib segments are solid T-sections near the pedestal, solid Y-sections higher up and open Y-sections near the top.
As long as a precast rib segment has the right dimensions, its weight and age do not affect erection.
Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress.
quiz.explanation: 肋段在台座附近是實心 T 形，往上變為實心 Y 形，再往上成為開口 Y 形；斷面隨彎矩與軸力減小而變薄，但外表面始終貼合球面，翼緣直接成為屋面蓋板的支承。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rib segments are solid T-sections near the pedestal, solid Y-sections higher up and open Y-sections near the top; the section thins as bending and axial force reduce, yet its outer face always follows the sphere and its flanges directly support the roof tile lids. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預鑄肋段與標準模具」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Precast rib segments and moulds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：標準段重約 10,160 kg、長 4.6 m（Arup 公開資料）。取鋼筋混凝土密度 2,450 kg/m³，體積 V = 10,160/2,450 ≈ 4.15 m³，平均斷面積 A = 4.15/4.6 ≈ 0.90 m²；若某段改用實心斷面使面積增加 20%，重量升到約 12.2 t，就超出塔吊在 30.5 m 半徑的能力。密度與 20% 增量為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A standard segment weighs about 10,160 kg and is 4.6 m long (Arup's published data). With a reinforced-concrete density of 2,450 kg/m³ the volume is V = 10,160/2,450 ≈ 4.15 m³ and the mean section area A = 4.15/4.6 ≈ 0.90 m²; making a segment solid with 20% more area would raise its weight to about 12.2 t, beyond the cranes' capacity at a 30.5 m radius. Density and the 20% increase are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個肋段出模後量測長度、端面角度與外表面曲率，以樣板或座標量測確認誤差在接縫可吸收範圍內；混凝土以立方試體驗收，公開資料列出最低立方強度 41 與 52 N/mm² 兩級，並記錄每段的澆置日期與實測重量，作為吊裝與加載齡期排程的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After demoulding, measure each segment's length, end-face angles and outer-surface curvature with templates or coordinate survey to confirm deviations within what the joints can absorb; accept concrete by cube tests, the published minimum cube strengths being 41 and 52 N/mm² grades, and record each segment's casting date and measured weight to plan lifting and age at loading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 標準段重約 10,160 kg、長 4.6 m（Arup 公開資料）。取鋼筋混凝土密度 2,450 kg/m³，體積 V = 10,160/2,450 ≈ 4.15 m³，平均斷面積 A = 4.15/4.6 ≈ 0.90 m²；若某段改用實心斷面使面積增加 20%，重量升到約 12.2 t，就超出塔吊在 30.5 m 半徑的能力。密度與 20% 增量為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A standard segment weighs about 10,160 kg and is 4.6 m long (Arup's published data). With a reinforced-concrete density of 2,450 kg/m³ the volume is V = 10,160/2,450 ≈ 4.15 m³ and the mean section area A = 4.15/4.6 ≈ 0.90 m²; making a segment solid with 20% more area would raise its weight to about 12.2 t, beyond the cranes' capacity at a 30.5 m radius. Density and the 20% increase are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard", which statement holds?
options: 預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。
標準段重約 10,160 kg、長 4.6 m（Arup 公開資料）。
縮尺模型的變形按比例放大，就是實際建築的長期變形。
optionsEn: If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection.
A standard segment weighs about 10,160 kg and is 4.6 m long (Arup's published data).
Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection.
quiz.explanation: 標準段重約 10,160 kg、長 4.6 m（Arup 公開資料）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A standard segment weighs about 10,160 kg and is 4.6 m long (Arup's published data). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預鑄肋段與標準模具」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Precast rib segments and moulds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個肋段出模後量測長度、端面角度與外表面曲率，以樣板或座標量測確認誤差在接縫可吸收範圍內；混凝土以立方試體驗收，公開資料列出最低立方強度 41 與 52 N/mm² 兩級，並記錄每段的澆置日期與實測重量，作為吊裝與加載齡期排程的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After demoulding, measure each segment's length, end-face angles and outer-surface curvature with templates or coordinate survey to confirm deviations within what the joints can absorb; accept concrete by cube tests, the published minimum cube strengths being 41 and 52 N/mm² grades, and record each segment's casting date and measured weight to plan lifting and age at loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預鑄工廠應建立一段一卡：模具編號、澆置日期、立方強度、實測重量、端面量測與最早允許吊裝日期；未達齡期或量測不合格的段不得進入吊裝序列，須由現場工程師簽放。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The casting yard should keep one card per segment: mould number, casting date, cube strength, measured weight, end-face survey and earliest permitted lifting date; segments below age or out of tolerance must not enter the lifting sequence until released by the site engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：端面角度誤差會在一條十多段的肋上累積，使肋頂偏離脊線；斷面若因模具變形而超重，吊裝時會接近或超過塔吊額定，或使預定的預力不足以閉合接縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: End-face angle errors accumulate along a rib of a dozen segments and push its tip off the ridge line; a segment that is overweight because of mould distortion approaches or exceeds the crane rating during lifting, or leaves the planned prestress unable to close the joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個肋段出模後量測長度、端面角度與外表面曲率，以樣板或座標量測確認誤差在接縫可吸收範圍內；混凝土以立方試體驗收，公開資料列出最低立方強度 41 與 52 N/mm² 兩級，並記錄每段的澆置日期與實測重量，作為吊裝與加載齡期排程的依據。
knowledge.textEn: After demoulding, measure each segment's length, end-face angles and outer-surface curvature with templates or coordinate survey to confirm deviations within what the joints can absorb; accept concrete by cube tests, the published minimum cube strengths being 41 and 52 N/mm² grades, and record each segment's casting date and measured weight to plan lifting and age at loading.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預鑄工廠應建立一段一卡：模具編號、澆置日期、立方強度、實測重量、端面量測與最早允許吊裝日期；未達齡期或量測不合格的段不得進入吊裝序列，須由現場工程師簽放。
knowledge.textEn: The casting yard should keep one card per segment: mould number, casting date, cube strength, measured weight, end-face survey and earliest permitted lifting date; segments below age or out of tolerance must not enter the lifting sequence until released by the site engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A World Heritage building may not receive any structural repair and must be left exactly as it is.
After demoulding, measure each segment's length, end-face angles and outer-surface curvature with templates or coordinate survey to confirm deviations within what the joints can absorb.
quiz.explanation: 每個肋段出模後量測長度、端面角度與外表面曲率，以樣板或座標量測確認誤差在接縫可吸收範圍內；混凝土以立方試體驗收，公開資料列出最低立方強度 41 與 52 N/mm² 兩級，並記錄每段的澆置日期與實測重量，作為吊裝與加載齡期排程的依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After demoulding, measure each segment's length, end-face angles and outer-surface curvature with templates or coordinate survey to confirm deviations within what the joints can absorb; accept concrete by cube tests, the published minimum cube strengths being 41 and 52 N/mm² grades, and record each segment's casting date and measured weight to plan lifting and age at loading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預鑄肋段與標準模具」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Precast rib segments and moulds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 端面角度誤差會在一條十多段的肋上累積，使肋頂偏離脊線；斷面若因模具變形而超重，吊裝時會接近或超過塔吊額定，或使預定的預力不足以閉合接縫。混凝土齡期太短就承受預力與吊裝，徐變增加會讓肋拱長期下垂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: End-face angle errors accumulate along a rib of a dozen segments and push its tip off the ridge line; a segment that is overweight because of mould distortion approaches or exceeds the crane rating during lifting, or leaves the planned prestress unable to close the joints. Segments loaded by prestress and lifting at too young an age creep more, and the rib sags over time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預鑄讓混凝土在受控環境中養護，強度、尺寸與表面品質比高空現場澆置穩定，接縫面也能先研磨處理以利後續膠結。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Precasting lets the concrete cure under controlled conditions, so strength, dimensions and surface quality are more consistent than casting at height, and joint faces can be ground beforehand for bonding.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as a precast rib segment has the right dimensions, its weight and age do not affect erection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 端面角度誤差會在一條十多段的肋上累積，使肋頂偏離脊線；斷面若因模具變形而超重，吊裝時會接近或超過塔吊額定，或使預定的預力不足以閉合接縫。混凝土齡期太短就承受預力與吊裝，徐變增加會讓肋拱長期下垂。
knowledge.textEn: End-face angle errors accumulate along a rib of a dozen segments and push its tip off the ridge line; a segment that is overweight because of mould distortion approaches or exceeds the crane rating during lifting, or leaves the planned prestress unable to close the joints. Segments loaded by prestress and lifting at too young an age creep more, and the rib sags over time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 端面角度誤差會在一條十多段的肋上累積，使肋頂偏離脊線；斷面若因模具變形而超重，吊裝時會接近或超過塔吊額定，或使預定的預力不足以閉合接縫。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。
optionsEn: End-face angle errors accumulate along a rib of a dozen segments and push its tip off the ridge line.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress.
quiz.explanation: 端面角度誤差會在一條十多段的肋上累積，使肋頂偏離脊線；斷面若因模具變形而超重，吊裝時會接近或超過塔吊額定，或使預定的預力不足以閉合接縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: End-face angle errors accumulate along a rib of a dozen segments and push its tip off the ridge line; a segment that is overweight because of mould distortion approaches or exceeds the crane rating during lifting, or leaves the planned prestress unable to close the joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接縫膠結與後拉預力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint bonding and post-tensioning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「環氧接縫與預力鋼絞線」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Epoxy joints and prestressing strand” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 肋段之間以環氧樹脂膠結，接縫厚度只有約 0.8 至 3 mm，再以穿過肋段孔道的 15.2 mm 鋼絞線後拉，把一段段預鑄件串成連續肋拱。膠在硬化期間必須受壓，因此每吊上一段就先施加臨時預力，使接縫閉合並能傳遞剪力；完成後的永久預力讓肋拱在風吸力與溫差下仍保持接縫受壓。孔道灌漿保護鋼絞線免於腐蝕，也讓鋼絞線與混凝土共同作用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「環氧接縫與預力鋼絞線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segments were bonded with epoxy in joints only about 0.8 to 3 mm thick and post-tensioned with 15.2 mm strand through ducts in the segments, turning individual precast pieces into continuous rib arches. The epoxy must be under compression while it cures, so each newly placed segment was stressed temporarily to close the joint and transfer shear; the permanent prestress then keeps every joint in compression under wind suction and temperature difference. Duct grouting protects the strand against corrosion and makes strand and concrete act together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Epoxy joints and prestressing strand” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某接縫以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根面積 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa，總力 P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN；接縫面積 0.90 m² 時平均預壓 σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A joint stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² each at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa receives P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN; over a 0.90 m² joint the mean precompression is σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「環氧接縫與預力鋼絞線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Epoxy joints and prestressing strand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接縫膠結與後拉預力
knowledge.text: 肋段之間以環氧樹脂膠結，接縫厚度只有約 0.8 至 3 mm，再以穿過肋段孔道的 15.2 mm 鋼絞線後拉，把一段段預鑄件串成連續肋拱。膠在硬化期間必須受壓，因此每吊上一段就先施加臨時預力，使接縫閉合並能傳遞剪力；完成後的永久預力讓肋拱在風吸力與溫差下仍保持接縫受壓。
knowledge.textEn: Segments were bonded with epoxy in joints only about 0.8 to 3 mm thick and post-tensioned with 15.2 mm strand through ducts in the segments, turning individual precast pieces into continuous rib arches. The epoxy must be under compression while it cures, so each newly placed segment was stressed temporarily to close the joint and transfer shear; the permanent prestress then keeps every joint in compression under wind suction and temperature difference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫膠結與後拉預力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint bonding and post-tensioning" is correct?
options: 環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。
肋段之間以環氧樹脂膠結，接縫厚度只有約 0.8 至 3 mm，再以穿過肋段孔道的 15.2 mm 鋼絞線後拉，把一段段預鑄件串成連續肋拱。
肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。
optionsEn: Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress.

Segments were bonded with epoxy in joints only about 0.8 to 3 mm thick and post-tensioned with 15.2 mm strand through ducts in the segments, turning individual precast pieces into continuous rib arches.
A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution.
quiz.explanation: 肋段之間以環氧樹脂膠結，接縫厚度只有約 0.8 至 3 mm，再以穿過肋段孔道的 15.2 mm 鋼絞線後拉，把一段段預鑄件串成連續肋拱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Segments were bonded with epoxy in joints only about 0.8 to 3 mm thick and post-tensioned with 15.2 mm strand through ducts in the segments, turning individual precast pieces into continuous rib arches. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫膠結與後拉預力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint bonding and post-tensioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環氧接縫與預力鋼絞線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Epoxy joints and prestressing strand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某接縫以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根面積 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa，總力 P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN；接縫面積 0.90 m² 時平均預壓 σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa。若損失使有效應力降為 1,000 MPa，預壓降至約 1.1 MPa。鋼絞線數量與應力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A joint stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² each at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa receives P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN; over a 0.90 m² joint the mean precompression is σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa. If losses reduce the effective stress to 1,000 MPa, the precompression falls to about 1.1 MPa. Strand count and stress are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：接縫面須在膠結前研磨露出骨材，事後研究建議研磨後 7 天內完成膠結，施膠後在規定時間內施加臨時預力；以千斤頂壓力與伸長量雙重控制每次張拉，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停查明原因；灌漿以流動度、泌水試驗與每個排氣口出漿確認孔道充滿。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Joint faces must be ground to expose aggregate before bonding, later research recommending bonding within 7 days of grinding, and temporary prestress applied within the specified time after the epoxy is placed; control every stressing operation by both jack pressure and elongation, pausing to investigate when they differ by more than about 5%; confirm grouting by flow-cone and bleed tests and by grout emerging at every vent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某接縫以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根面積 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa，總力 P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN；接縫面積 0.90 m² 時平均預壓 σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa。若損失使有效應力降為 1,000 MPa，預壓降至約 1.1 MPa。鋼絞線數量與應力為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A joint stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² each at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa receives P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN; over a 0.90 m² joint the mean precompression is σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa. If losses reduce the effective stress to 1,000 MPa, the precompression falls to about 1.1 MPa. Strand count and stress are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接縫膠結與後拉預力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint bonding and post-tensioning", which statement holds?
options: 屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。
混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。
某接縫以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根面積 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa，總力 P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN。
optionsEn: Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant.
Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them.
A joint stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² each at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa receives P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN.
quiz.explanation: 某接縫以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根面積 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa，總力 P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN；接縫面積 0.90 m² 時平均預壓 σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A joint stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² each at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa receives P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN; over a 0.90 m² joint the mean precompression is σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接縫膠結與後拉預力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint bonding and post-tensioning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環氧接縫與預力鋼絞線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Epoxy joints and prestressing strand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 接縫面須在膠結前研磨露出骨材，事後研究建議研磨後 7 天內完成膠結，施膠後在規定時間內施加臨時預力；以千斤頂壓力與伸長量雙重控制每次張拉，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停查明原因；灌漿以流動度、泌水試驗與每個排氣口出漿確認孔道充滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Joint faces must be ground to expose aggregate before bonding, later research recommending bonding within 7 days of grinding, and temporary prestress applied within the specified time after the epoxy is placed; control every stressing operation by both jack pressure and elongation, pausing to investigate when they differ by more than about 5%; confirm grouting by flow-cone and bleed tests and by grout emerging at every vent. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：張拉紀錄要逐束保存（千斤頂編號、校正日期、壓力、伸長、鎖定損失），灌漿紀錄要能對應到每一個孔道；Arup 1973 年的公開回顧把孔道灌漿與結構膠結各寫成專文，交接時應把這類程序文件列為必要附件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep stressing records tendon by tendon (jack number, calibration date, pressure, elongation, lock-off loss) and grouting records traceable to each duct; Arup's 1973 published review devoted separate papers to duct grouting and structural adhesives, and such procedure records should be mandatory attachments at handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：膠層在未受壓時硬化會形成空隙與弱面，之後在反覆風吸力下接縫張開；孔道灌漿不密實會讓海風帶來的氯離子腐蝕鋼絞線，預力在不被察覺的情況下逐年流失，這類隱藏性劣化是預力殼體最難檢測的風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Epoxy that cures without compression leaves voids and weak planes, and joints then open under repeated wind suction; incomplete duct grouting lets chlorides carried by sea air corrode the strand so prestress is lost year by year without notice, a hidden deterioration that is the hardest risk to detect in a prestressed shell. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 接縫面須在膠結前研磨露出骨材，事後研究建議研磨後 7 天內完成膠結，施膠後在規定時間內施加臨時預力；以千斤頂壓力與伸長量雙重控制每次張拉，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停查明原因；灌漿以流動度、泌水試驗與每個排氣口出漿確認孔道充滿。
knowledge.textEn: Joint faces must be ground to expose aggregate before bonding, later research recommending bonding within 7 days of grinding, and temporary prestress applied within the specified time after the epoxy is placed; control every stressing operation by both jack pressure and elongation, pausing to investigate when they differ by more than about 5%; confirm grouting by flow-cone and bleed tests and by grout emerging at every vent.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 張拉紀錄要逐束保存（千斤頂編號、校正日期、壓力、伸長、鎖定損失），灌漿紀錄要能對應到每一個孔道；Arup 1973 年的公開回顧把孔道灌漿與結構膠結各寫成專文，交接時應把這類程序文件列為必要附件。
knowledge.textEn: Keep stressing records tendon by tendon (jack number, calibration date, pressure, elongation, lock-off loss) and grouting records traceable to each duct; Arup's 1973 published review devoted separate papers to duct grouting and structural adhesives, and such procedure records should be mandatory attachments at handover.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接縫膠結與後拉預力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint bonding and post-tensioning"?
options: 接縫面須在膠結前研磨露出骨材，事後研究建議研磨後 7 天內完成膠結，施膠後在規定時間內施加臨時預力。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。
optionsEn: Joint faces must be ground to expose aggregate before bonding, later research recommending bonding within 7 days of grinding, and temporary prestress applied within the specified time after the epoxy is placed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action.
quiz.explanation: 接縫面須在膠結前研磨露出骨材，事後研究建議研磨後 7 天內完成膠結，施膠後在規定時間內施加臨時預力；以千斤頂壓力與伸長量雙重控制每次張拉，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停查明原因；灌漿以流動度、泌水試驗與每個排氣口出漿確認孔道充滿。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint faces must be ground to expose aggregate before bonding, later research recommending bonding within 7 days of grinding, and temporary prestress applied within the specified time after the epoxy is placed; control every stressing operation by both jack pressure and elongation, pausing to investigate when they differ by more than about 5%; confirm grouting by flow-cone and bleed tests and by grout emerging at every vent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接縫膠結與後拉預力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint bonding and post-tensioning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環氧接縫與預力鋼絞線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Epoxy joints and prestressing strand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 膠層在未受壓時硬化會形成空隙與弱面，之後在反覆風吸力下接縫張開；孔道灌漿不密實會讓海風帶來的氯離子腐蝕鋼絞線，預力在不被察覺的情況下逐年流失，這類隱藏性劣化是預力殼體最難檢測的風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Epoxy that cures without compression leaves voids and weak planes, and joints then open under repeated wind suction; incomplete duct grouting lets chlorides carried by sea air corrode the strand so prestress is lost year by year without notice, a hidden deterioration that is the hardest risk to detect in a prestressed shell. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔道灌漿保護鋼絞線免於腐蝕，也讓鋼絞線與混凝土共同作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Duct grouting protects the strand against corrosion and makes strand and concrete act together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 膠層在未受壓時硬化會形成空隙與弱面，之後在反覆風吸力下接縫張開；孔道灌漿不密實會讓海風帶來的氯離子腐蝕鋼絞線，預力在不被察覺的情況下逐年流失，這類隱藏性劣化是預力殼體最難檢測的風險。
knowledge.textEn: Epoxy that cures without compression leaves voids and weak planes, and joints then open under repeated wind suction; incomplete duct grouting lets chlorides carried by sea air corrode the strand so prestress is lost year by year without notice, a hidden deterioration that is the hardest risk to detect in a prestressed shell.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接縫膠結與後拉預力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint bonding and post-tensioning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
膠層在未受壓時硬化會形成空隙與弱面，之後在反覆風吸力下接縫張開。
肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Epoxy that cures without compression leaves voids and weak planes, and joints then open under repeated wind suction.
A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution.
quiz.explanation: 膠層在未受壓時硬化會形成空隙與弱面，之後在反覆風吸力下接縫張開；孔道灌漿不密實會讓海風帶來的氯離子腐蝕鋼絞線，預力在不被察覺的情況下逐年流失，這類隱藏性劣化是預力殼體最難檢測的風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Epoxy that cures without compression leaves voids and weak planes, and joints then open under repeated wind suction; incomplete duct grouting lets chlorides carried by sea air corrode the strand so prestress is lost year by year without notice, a hidden deterioration that is the hardest risk to detect in a prestressed shell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「架設拱與逐段吊裝」與「電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting" and "Computerised survey and shell geometry control": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 架設拱與逐段吊裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮式鋼構架設拱」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Telescopic steel erection arch” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 肋拱在與對向肋於脊梁相接之前是不穩定的懸伸構件，因此承包商 Hornibrook 設計了圓弧形、可伸縮調整的鋼構架設拱，在殼片下方承托新吊上的肋段。每段由塔吊吊到定位、塗膠、施加臨時預力後，架設拱繼續承托直到該肋完成並與脊梁連接，再以油壓缸把架設拱移到下一條肋。球面的共同曲率讓同一組架設拱只要調整長度與角度就能服務所有肋，這是球面解在施工上的第二個紅利。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮式鋼構架設拱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Until it meets the opposing ribs at the ridge beam, a rib is an unstable cantilever, so the contractor Hornibrook designed circular, telescopically adjustable steel erection arches to support newly lifted segments from beneath the shell. Each segment was craned into place, glued and temporarily stressed while the erection arch held it until the rib was complete and connected to the ridge beam; hydraulic rams then moved the arch to the next rib. Because every rib shares the sphere's curvature, the same erection arches served all ribs with only length and angle adjustments, a second construction dividend of the spherical solution. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Telescopic steel erection arch” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塔吊能力以力矩表示：最重肋段 W ≈ 10.16 t 在半徑 r = 30.5 m 時，需要 M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m，與公開資料中三台約 300 t·m 級的塔吊相當。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tower-crane capacity is a moment rating: the heaviest segment, W ≈ 10.16 t at a radius r = 30.5 m, needs M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m, matching the three tower cranes of about 300 t·m class in the published record.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「伸縮式鋼構架設拱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Telescopic steel erection arch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「架設拱與逐段吊裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting" is correct?
options: 肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。

optionsEn: A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution.
If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection.

Until it meets the opposing ribs at the ridge beam, a rib is an unstable cantilever, so the contractor Hornibrook designed circular, telescopically adjustable steel erection arches to support newly lifted segments from beneath the shell.
