The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 架設拱與逐段吊裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮式鋼構架設拱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Telescopic steel erection arch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塔吊能力以力矩表示：最重肋段 W ≈ 10.16 t 在半徑 r = 30.5 m 時，需要 M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m，與公開資料中三台約 300 t·m 級的塔吊相當。若把肋段加長到 5.5 m，重量按比例增為 10.16×5.5/4.6 ≈ 12.1 t，需求升到約 370 t·m，超出塔吊能力，可見肋段長度是由吊裝能力反推。比例換算為教學推論。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tower-crane capacity is a moment rating: the heaviest segment, W ≈ 10.16 t at a radius r = 30.5 m, needs M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m, matching the three tower cranes of about 300 t·m class in the published record. Lengthening segments to 5.5 m would raise their weight proportionally to 10.16×5.5/4.6 ≈ 12.1 t and the demand to about 370 t·m, beyond the cranes, showing that segment length was derived from lifting capacity. The proportional scaling is a teaching inference. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：架設拱本身要依最不利的承托段數與位置做強度與穩定檢核，每次移位後量測其標高與角度；每吊一段都核對吊重、半徑與塔吊荷重表，並以測量確認肋段落位後的三維座標，才允許施加臨時預力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the erection arch itself for strength and stability under the most adverse number and position of supported segments and survey its level and angle after every move; for every lift check weight and radius against the crane load chart, and confirm the placed segment's three-dimensional position by survey before temporary stressing is allowed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 塔吊能力以力矩表示：最重肋段 W ≈ 10.16 t 在半徑 r = 30.5 m 時，需要 M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m，與公開資料中三台約 300 t·m 級的塔吊相當。若把肋段加長到 5.5 m，重量按比例增為 10.16×5.5/4.6 ≈ 12.1 t，需求升到約 370 t·m，超出塔吊能力，可見肋段長度是由吊裝能力反推。比例換算為教學推論。
knowledge.textEn: Tower-crane capacity is a moment rating: the heaviest segment, W ≈ 10.16 t at a radius r = 30.5 m, needs M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m, matching the three tower cranes of about 300 t·m class in the published record. Lengthening segments to 5.5 m would raise their weight proportionally to 10.16×5.5/4.6 ≈ 12.1 t and the demand to about 370 t·m, beyond the cranes, showing that segment length was derived from lifting capacity. The proportional scaling is a teaching inference.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「架設拱與逐段吊裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting", which statement holds?
options: 塔吊能力以力矩表示：最重肋段 W ≈ 10.16 t 在半徑 r = 30.5 m 時，需要 M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m，與公開資料中三台約 300 t·m 級的塔吊相當。
縮尺模型的變形按比例放大，就是實際建築的長期變形。
列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。
optionsEn: Tower-crane capacity is a moment rating: the heaviest segment, W ≈ 10.16 t at a radius r = 30.5 m, needs M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m, matching the three tower cranes of about 300 t·m class in the published record.
Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection.
A World Heritage building may not receive any structural repair and must be left exactly as it is.
quiz.explanation: 塔吊能力以力矩表示：最重肋段 W ≈ 10.16 t 在半徑 r = 30.5 m 時，需要 M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m，與公開資料中三台約 300 t·m 級的塔吊相當。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tower-crane capacity is a moment rating: the heaviest segment, W ≈ 10.16 t at a radius r = 30.5 m, needs M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m, matching the three tower cranes of about 300 t·m class in the published record. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 架設拱與逐段吊裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮式鋼構架設拱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Telescopic steel erection arch” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 架設拱本身要依最不利的承托段數與位置做強度與穩定檢核，每次移位後量測其標高與角度；每吊一段都核對吊重、半徑與塔吊荷重表，並以測量確認肋段落位後的三維座標，才允許施加臨時預力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the erection arch itself for strength and stability under the most adverse number and position of supported segments and survey its level and angle after every move; for every lift check weight and radius against the crane load chart, and confirm the placed segment's three-dimensional position by survey before temporary stressing is allowed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應明訂架設拱的卸載條件：該肋全部段落位、臨時預力完成、與脊梁連接並經測量確認；吊裝作業設風速停止門檻，由吊裝負責人與結構工程師共同簽認，這些是停止點，不是操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan should state the release conditions for each erection arch: all segments of that rib placed, temporary prestress complete, ridge connection made and confirmed by survey; lifting should have a wind-speed stop limit jointly signed by the lifting supervisor and the structural engineer, and these are hold points, not operating permits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：架設拱移位太早，尚未與脊梁連接的肋會成為懸臂而下垂甚至傾覆；臨時預力不足時，接縫在膠未硬化前受彎張開，形成永久幾何偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Moving the erection arch too early leaves a rib not yet connected to the ridge as a cantilever that sags or even overturns; insufficient temporary prestress lets joints open in bending before the epoxy hardens, locking in a permanent geometric error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 架設拱本身要依最不利的承托段數與位置做強度與穩定檢核，每次移位後量測其標高與角度；每吊一段都核對吊重、半徑與塔吊荷重表，並以測量確認肋段落位後的三維座標，才允許施加臨時預力。
knowledge.textEn: Check the erection arch itself for strength and stability under the most adverse number and position of supported segments and survey its level and angle after every move; for every lift check weight and radius against the crane load chart, and confirm the placed segment's three-dimensional position by survey before temporary stressing is allowed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫應明訂架設拱的卸載條件：該肋全部段落位、臨時預力完成、與脊梁連接並經測量確認；吊裝作業設風速停止門檻，由吊裝負責人與結構工程師共同簽認，這些是停止點，不是操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan should state the release conditions for each erection arch: all segments of that rib placed, temporary prestress complete, ridge connection made and confirmed by survey; lifting should have a wind-speed stop limit jointly signed by the lifting supervisor and the structural engineer, and these are hold points, not operating permits.

quiz.question: 要驗證「架設拱與逐段吊裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
架設拱本身要依最不利的承托段數與位置做強度與穩定檢核，每次移位後量測其標高與角度。
混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check the erection arch itself for strength and stability under the most adverse number and position of supported segments and survey its level and angle after every move.
A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 架設拱本身要依最不利的承托段數與位置做強度與穩定檢核，每次移位後量測其標高與角度；每吊一段都核對吊重、半徑與塔吊荷重表，並以測量確認肋段落位後的三維座標，才允許施加臨時預力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the erection arch itself for strength and stability under the most adverse number and position of supported segments and survey its level and angle after every move; for every lift check weight and radius against the crane load chart, and confirm the placed segment's three-dimensional position by survey before temporary stressing is allowed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 架設拱與逐段吊裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮式鋼構架設拱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Telescopic steel erection arch” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 架設拱移位太早，尚未與脊梁連接的肋會成為懸臂而下垂甚至傾覆；臨時預力不足時，接縫在膠未硬化前受彎張開，形成永久幾何偏差。吊裝時風速升高使肋段擺盪撞擊已安裝段，也是曲面預鑄架設常見的損傷來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Moving the erection arch too early leaves a rib not yet connected to the ridge as a cantilever that sags or even overturns; insufficient temporary prestress lets joints open in bending before the epoxy hardens, locking in a permanent geometric error. Rising wind during lifting can swing a segment into already placed ones, a common source of damage in curved precast erection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：球面的共同曲率讓同一組架設拱只要調整長度與角度就能服務所有肋，這是球面解在施工上的第二個紅利。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because every rib shares the sphere's curvature, the same erection arches served all ribs with only length and angle adjustments, a second construction dividend of the spherical solution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 架設拱移位太早，尚未與脊梁連接的肋會成為懸臂而下垂甚至傾覆；臨時預力不足時，接縫在膠未硬化前受彎張開，形成永久幾何偏差。吊裝時風速升高使肋段擺盪撞擊已安裝段，也是曲面預鑄架設常見的損傷來源。

Rising wind during lifting can swing a segment into already placed ones, a common source of damage in curved precast erection.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「架設拱與逐段吊裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。
架設拱移位太早，尚未與脊梁連接的肋會成為懸臂而下垂甚至傾覆；臨時預力不足時，接縫在膠未硬化前受彎張開，形成永久幾何偏差。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection.
Moving the erection arch too early leaves a rib not yet connected to the ridge as a cantilever that sags or even overturns.
quiz.explanation: 架設拱移位太早，尚未與脊梁連接的肋會成為懸臂而下垂甚至傾覆；臨時預力不足時，接縫在膠未硬化前受彎張開，形成永久幾何偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving the erection arch too early leaves a rib not yet connected to the ridge as a cantilever that sags or even overturns; insufficient temporary prestress lets joints open in bending before the epoxy hardens, locking in a permanent geometric error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Computerised survey and shell geometry control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「架設幾何測量網」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Erection survey network” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每條肋拱由十多段接續而成，前段的微小角度誤差會在肋頂放大，而脊梁與蓋板又要求各肋位置互相吻合，因此架設期間需要持續的幾何控制。當年以電腦化測量系統追蹤殼片形狀，架設程序也用電腦程式檢核，計算需求大到必須借用南澳武器研究所的電腦。施工延誤使相鄰肋齡期不同，徐變差異被換算為等效溫差納入架設分析，是早期施工階段分析的實例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「架設幾何測量網」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each rib is a chain of a dozen or more segments, so a small angular error in an early segment is magnified at the rib tip, while the ridge beams and tile lids require ribs to match each other; continuous geometric control during erection was therefore essential. A computerised survey system tracked shell shape, and the erection procedure was checked by computer programs whose demands required a computer at the Weapons Research Establishment in South Australia. Delays gave adjacent ribs different ages, and the resulting creep differences were converted into an equivalent temperature difference in the erection analysis, an early example of construction-stage analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Erection survey network” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：起拱段角度誤差 Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad 時，64 m 弧長外的肋頂偏差約 δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm，遠超過 3 mm 級膠結接縫可吸收的量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An angular error Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad at the springing segment displaces the rib tip 64 m away by about δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm, far beyond what 3 mm epoxy joints can absorb.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「架設幾何測量網」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Erection survey network”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制
knowledge.titleEn: Computerised survey and shell geometry control
knowledge.text: 每條肋拱由十多段接續而成，前段的微小角度誤差會在肋頂放大，而脊梁與蓋板又要求各肋位置互相吻合，因此架設期間需要持續的幾何控制。當年以電腦化測量系統追蹤殼片形狀，架設程序也用電腦程式檢核，計算需求大到必須借用南澳武器研究所的電腦。
knowledge.textEn: Each rib is a chain of a dozen or more segments, so a small angular error in an early segment is magnified at the rib tip, while the ridge beams and tile lids require ribs to match each other; continuous geometric control during erection was therefore essential. A computerised survey system tracked shell shape, and the erection procedure was checked by computer programs whose demands required a computer at the Weapons Research Establishment in South Australia.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Computerised survey and shell geometry control" is correct?
options: 每條肋拱由十多段接續而成，前段的微小角度誤差會在肋頂放大，而脊梁與蓋板又要求各肋位置互相吻合，因此架設期間需要持續的幾何控制。
預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。
屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。
optionsEn: Each rib is a chain of a dozen or more segments, so a small angular error in an early segment is magnified at the rib tip, while the ridge beams and tile lids require ribs to match each other.
If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection.
Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 每條肋拱由十多段接續而成，前段的微小角度誤差會在肋頂放大，而脊梁與蓋板又要求各肋位置互相吻合，因此架設期間需要持續的幾何控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each rib is a chain of a dozen or more segments, so a small angular error in an early segment is magnified at the rib tip, while the ridge beams and tile lids require ribs to match each other; continuous geometric control during erection was therefore essential. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Computerised survey and shell geometry control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「架設幾何測量網」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Erection survey network” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：起拱段角度誤差 Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad 時，64 m 弧長外的肋頂偏差約 δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm，遠超過 3 mm 級膠結接縫可吸收的量。公開資料把兩個月架設延遲造成的徐變，當作最後 4 條肋降溫 10°C 處理；以 α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C 換算，等效應變約 100×10⁻⁶。角度誤差與 α 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An angular error Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad at the springing segment displaces the rib tip 64 m away by about δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm, far beyond what 3 mm epoxy joints can absorb. The published record treated creep from a two-month erection delay as a 10°C temperature drop across the last four ribs; with α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C that equals a strain of about 100×10⁻⁶. The angular error and α are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從固定控制點以經緯儀或全測站量測每段落位後的特徵點，與電腦計算的理論座標比較；偏差超過允許值時以接縫墊片或臨時預力修正，不讓誤差帶到下一段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: From fixed control points, survey target points on each placed segment with theodolite or total station and compare with computed theoretical coordinates; when deviation exceeds the allowance, correct with joint shims or temporary prestress rather than carrying it into the next segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 起拱段角度誤差 Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad 時，64 m 弧長外的肋頂偏差約 δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm，遠超過 3 mm 級膠結接縫可吸收的量。公開資料把兩個月架設延遲造成的徐變，當作最後 4 條肋降溫 10°C 處理；以 α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C 換算，等效應變約 100×10⁻⁶。角度誤差與 α 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An angular error Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad at the springing segment displaces the rib tip 64 m away by about δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm, far beyond what 3 mm epoxy joints can absorb. The published record treated creep from a two-month erection delay as a 10°C temperature drop across the last four ribs; with α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C that equals a strain of about 100×10⁻⁶. The angular error and α are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Computerised survey and shell geometry control", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。
起拱段角度誤差 Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad 時，64 m 弧長外的肋頂偏差約 δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm，遠超過 3 mm 級膠結接縫可吸收的量。
雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。
optionsEn: Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them.
An angular error Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad at the springing segment displaces the rib tip 64 m away by about δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm, far beyond what 3 mm epoxy joints can absorb.
The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action.
quiz.explanation: 起拱段角度誤差 Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad 時，64 m 弧長外的肋頂偏差約 δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm，遠超過 3 mm 級膠結接縫可吸收的量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An angular error Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad at the springing segment displaces the rib tip 64 m away by about δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm, far beyond what 3 mm epoxy joints can absorb. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Computerised survey and shell geometry control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「架設幾何測量網」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Erection survey network” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從固定控制點以經緯儀或全測站量測每段落位後的特徵點，與電腦計算的理論座標比較；偏差超過允許值時以接縫墊片或臨時預力修正，不讓誤差帶到下一段。每條肋完成後再量測肋頂與脊梁接點，並把結果回饋到下一條肋的預設偏移量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: From fixed control points, survey target points on each placed segment with theodolite or total station and compare with computed theoretical coordinates; when deviation exceeds the allowance, correct with joint shims or temporary prestress rather than carrying it into the next segment. After each rib, survey its tip and ridge connection and feed the result back into the preset offsets of the next rib. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每片殼都應有架設幾何控制表：理論座標、預設偏移、實測值與修正措施，由測量員與結構工程師逐段簽認；施工延誤超過設計假設的天數時，要通知設計者重算徐變影響後才繼續架設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Each shell should have an erection geometry control sheet with theoretical coordinates, preset offsets, measured values and corrective actions, signed segment by segment by the surveyor and structural engineer; when delays exceed the days assumed in design, the designer must recalculate creep effects before erection continues.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在整條肋完成後才量測，累積誤差已無法修正，脊梁接點只能以大量現場澆置混凝土填補，改變原本的受力路徑；不同齡期肋段的徐變差若未納入分析，殼片完成後會出現不對稱下垂與脊線扭曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surveying only after a whole rib is complete leaves accumulated error uncorrectable, and the ridge connection has to be filled with substantial in-situ concrete that changes the intended load path; if creep differences between segments of different ages are not analysed, the finished shell sags asymmetrically and the ridge line twists. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從固定控制點以經緯儀或全測站量測每段落位後的特徵點，與電腦計算的理論座標比較；偏差超過允許值時以接縫墊片或臨時預力修正，不讓誤差帶到下一段。每條肋完成後再量測肋頂與脊梁接點，並把結果回饋到下一條肋的預設偏移量。
knowledge.textEn: From fixed control points, survey target points on each placed segment with theodolite or total station and compare with computed theoretical coordinates; when deviation exceeds the allowance, correct with joint shims or temporary prestress rather than carrying it into the next segment. After each rib, survey its tip and ridge connection and feed the result back into the preset offsets of the next rib.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每片殼都應有架設幾何控制表：理論座標、預設偏移、實測值與修正措施，由測量員與結構工程師逐段簽認；施工延誤超過設計假設的天數時，要通知設計者重算徐變影響後才繼續架設。
knowledge.textEn: Each shell should have an erection geometry control sheet with theoretical coordinates, preset offsets, measured values and corrective actions, signed segment by segment by the surveyor and structural engineer; when delays exceed the days assumed in design, the designer must recalculate creep effects before erection continues.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Computerised survey and shell geometry control"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。
從固定控制點以經緯儀或全測站量測每段落位後的特徵點，與電腦計算的理論座標比較；偏差超過允許值時以接縫墊片或臨時預力修正，不讓誤差帶到下一段。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
As long as a precast rib segment has the right dimensions, its weight and age do not affect erection.
From fixed control points, survey target points on each placed segment with theodolite or total station and compare with computed theoretical coordinates.
quiz.explanation: 從固定控制點以經緯儀或全測站量測每段落位後的特徵點，與電腦計算的理論座標比較；偏差超過允許值時以接縫墊片或臨時預力修正，不讓誤差帶到下一段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: From fixed control points, survey target points on each placed segment with theodolite or total station and compare with computed theoretical coordinates; when deviation exceeds the allowance, correct with joint shims or temporary prestress rather than carrying it into the next segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Computerised survey and shell geometry control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「架設幾何測量網」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Erection survey network” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在整條肋完成後才量測，累積誤差已無法修正，脊梁接點只能以大量現場澆置混凝土填補，改變原本的受力路徑；不同齡期肋段的徐變差若未納入分析，殼片完成後會出現不對稱下垂與脊線扭曲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surveying only after a whole rib is complete leaves accumulated error uncorrectable, and the ridge connection has to be filled with substantial in-situ concrete that changes the intended load path; if creep differences between segments of different ages are not analysed, the finished shell sags asymmetrically and the ridge line twists. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工延誤使相鄰肋齡期不同，徐變差異被換算為等效溫差納入架設分析，是早期施工階段分析的實例。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Delays gave adjacent ribs different ages, and the resulting creep differences were converted into an equivalent temperature difference in the erection analysis, an early example of construction-stage analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在整條肋完成後才量測，累積誤差已無法修正，脊梁接點只能以大量現場澆置混凝土填補，改變原本的受力路徑；不同齡期肋段的徐變差若未納入分析，殼片完成後會出現不對稱下垂與脊線扭曲。
knowledge.textEn: Surveying only after a whole rib is complete leaves accumulated error uncorrectable, and the ridge connection has to be filled with substantial in-situ concrete that changes the intended load path; if creep differences between segments of different ages are not analysed, the finished shell sags asymmetrically and the ridge line twists.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Computerised survey and shell geometry control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只在整條肋完成後才量測，累積誤差已無法修正，脊梁接點只能以大量現場澆置混凝土填補，改變原本的受力路徑。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。
optionsEn: Surveying only after a whole rib is complete leaves accumulated error uncorrectable, and the ridge connection has to be filled with substantial in-situ concrete that changes the intended load path.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 只在整條肋完成後才量測，累積誤差已無法修正，脊梁接點只能以大量現場澆置混凝土填補，改變原本的受力路徑；不同齡期肋段的徐變差若未納入分析，殼片完成後會出現不對稱下垂與脊線扭曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surveying only after a whole rib is complete leaves accumulated error uncorrectable, and the ridge connection has to be filled with substantial in-situ concrete that changes the intended load path; if creep differences between segments of different ages are not analysed, the finished shell sags asymmetrically and the ridge line twists. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風洞試驗與阻塞效應」與「結構模型試驗與長期變形量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind-tunnel testing and blockage" and "Structural model tests and long-term deformation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與阻塞效應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and blockage: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1:100 風洞模型」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1:100 wind-tunnel model” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 陡峭的球面殼在背風側與脊線附近產生強烈分離流，吸力遠大於迎風壓力，規範的簡單體形係數無法涵蓋。設計團隊先在南安普敦大學以 1:100 實心木模型試驗，再到英國國家物理實驗室以 2.74 m × 2.13 m 的開放射流風洞重做較關鍵的殼片；比較顯示小風洞量到的背風吸力偏高，原因可能是模型佔風洞斷面比例過大的阻塞效應。這是把風洞試驗用於曲面屋頂設計的重要早期案例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1:100 風洞模型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steep spherical shells generate strong separated flow on the leeward side and near the ridge, with suctions far larger than windward pressure, which simple code shape factors cannot cover. The team first tested a 1:100 solid wooden model at the University of Southampton, then repeated the more critical shell at the National Physical Laboratory in a 2.74 m × 2.13 m open-jet tunnel; comparison showed higher leeward suctions in the small tunnel, probably because the model occupied too much of the tunnel cross-section, a blockage effect. It is an important early case of wind-tunnel testing for a curved roof design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1:100 wind-tunnel model” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設計風速 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s，停滯壓力 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa；公開資料記錄背風脊最大吸力達 3.5q，約 4.3 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The design wind speed 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s gives a stagnation pressure q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa; the published maximum leeward ridge suction of 3.5q is about 4.3 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1:100 風洞模型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1:100 wind-tunnel model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風洞試驗與阻塞效應
knowledge.text: 陡峭的球面殼在背風側與脊線附近產生強烈分離流，吸力遠大於迎風壓力，規範的簡單體形係數無法涵蓋。設計團隊先在南安普敦大學以 1:100 實心木模型試驗，再到英國國家物理實驗室以 2.74 m × 2.13 m 的開放射流風洞重做較關鍵的殼片；比較顯示小風洞量到的背風吸力偏高，原因可能是模型佔風洞斷面比例過大的阻塞效應。
knowledge.textEn: Steep spherical shells generate strong separated flow on the leeward side and near the ridge, with suctions far larger than windward pressure, which simple code shape factors cannot cover. The team first tested a 1:100 solid wooden model at the University of Southampton, then repeated the more critical shell at the National Physical Laboratory in a 2.74 m × 2.13 m open-jet tunnel; comparison showed higher leeward suctions in the small tunnel, probably because the model occupied too much of the tunnel cross-section, a blockage effect.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風洞試驗與阻塞效應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind-tunnel testing and blockage" is correct?
options: 屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。
陡峭的球面殼在背風側與脊線附近產生強烈分離流，吸力遠大於迎風壓力，規範的簡單體形係數無法涵蓋。
縮尺模型的變形按比例放大，就是實際建築的長期變形。
optionsEn: Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant.
Steep spherical shells generate strong separated flow on the leeward side and near the ridge, with suctions far larger than windward pressure, which simple code shape factors cannot cover.
Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection.
quiz.explanation: 陡峭的球面殼在背風側與脊線附近產生強烈分離流，吸力遠大於迎風壓力，規範的簡單體形係數無法涵蓋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steep spherical shells generate strong separated flow on the leeward side and near the ridge, with suctions far larger than windward pressure, which simple code shape factors cannot cover. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與阻塞效應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and blockage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1:100 風洞模型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1:100 wind-tunnel model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設計風速 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s，停滯壓力 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa；公開資料記錄背風脊最大吸力達 3.5q，約 4.3 kPa。阻塞比 = 模型迎風面積 / 風洞斷面：1:100 模型迎風面積若為 0.40 m²，在 5.84 m² 的射流斷面中約佔 6.8%，在 1.5 m² 的小風洞則約佔 27%。迎風面積與小風洞斷面為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The design wind speed 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s gives a stagnation pressure q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa; the published maximum leeward ridge suction of 3.5q is about 4.3 kPa. Blockage ratio = model frontal area / tunnel section: a 1:100 model with 0.40 m² frontal area occupies about 6.8% of the 5.84 m² jet, but about 27% of a 1.5 m² small tunnel. The frontal area and small-tunnel section are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對兩個以上風洞或兩種試驗條件的壓力係數分布，針對差異說明原因（阻塞、雷諾數、紊流強度、模型粗糙度）；把最不利吸力區對應到蓋板與扣件的分區設計，並以結構模型確認肋拱在最不利風壓分布下仍保持接縫受壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pressure-coefficient distributions from at least two tunnels or test conditions and explain differences (blockage, Reynolds number, turbulence intensity, model roughness); map the worst suction zones onto zoned design of lids and fixings, and confirm in the structural model that ribs keep their joints in compression under the most adverse pressure distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設計風速 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s，停滯壓力 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa；公開資料記錄背風脊最大吸力達 3.5q，約 4.3 kPa。阻塞比 = 模型迎風面積 / 風洞斷面：1:100 模型迎風面積若為 0.40 m²，在 5.84 m² 的射流斷面中約佔 6.8%，在 1.5 m² 的小風洞則約佔 27%。迎風面積與小風洞斷面為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The design wind speed 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s gives a stagnation pressure q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa; the published maximum leeward ridge suction of 3.5q is about 4.3 kPa. Blockage ratio = model frontal area / tunnel section: a 1:100 model with 0.40 m² frontal area occupies about 6.8% of the 5.84 m² jet, but about 27% of a 1.5 m² small tunnel. The frontal area and small-tunnel section are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風洞試驗與阻塞效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind-tunnel testing and blockage", which statement holds?
options: 列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。
混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。
設計風速 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s，停滯壓力 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa。
optionsEn: A World Heritage building may not receive any structural repair and must be left exactly as it is.
A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored.
The design wind speed 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s gives a stagnation pressure q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 設計風速 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s，停滯壓力 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa；公開資料記錄背風脊最大吸力達 3.5q，約 4.3 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The design wind speed 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s gives a stagnation pressure q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa; the published maximum leeward ridge suction of 3.5q is about 4.3 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與阻塞效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and blockage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1:100 風洞模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1:100 wind-tunnel model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對兩個以上風洞或兩種試驗條件的壓力係數分布，針對差異說明原因（阻塞、雷諾數、紊流強度、模型粗糙度）；把最不利吸力區對應到蓋板與扣件的分區設計，並以結構模型確認肋拱在最不利風壓分布下仍保持接縫受壓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure-coefficient distributions from at least two tunnels or test conditions and explain differences (blockage, Reynolds number, turbulence intensity, model roughness); map the worst suction zones onto zoned design of lids and fixings, and confirm in the structural model that ribs keep their joints in compression under the most adverse pressure distribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：委託風洞試驗時要求報告寫明模型比例、阻塞比、入流紊流剖面與修正方法，並由第二家實驗室或數值模擬抽驗關鍵區；設計者應把風壓分區圖直接交給蓋板與扣件的設計與施工單位。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：只採用單一小風洞的結果，可能因阻塞效應高估吸力而過度設計，也可能因紊流條件不對而低估脊線附近的峰值；若把平均壓力當作設計值、忽略陣風峰值，蓋板扣件會在反覆吸力下逐漸鬆動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Compare pressure-coefficient distributions from at least two tunnels or test conditions and explain differences (blockage, Reynolds number, turbulence intensity, model roughness); map the worst suction zones onto zoned design of lids and fixings, and confirm in the structural model that ribs keep their joints in compression under the most adverse pressure distribution.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與阻塞效應：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1:100 風洞模型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1:100 wind-tunnel model” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只採用單一小風洞的結果，可能因阻塞效應高估吸力而過度設計，也可能因紊流條件不對而低估脊線附近的峰值；若把平均壓力當作設計值、忽略陣風峰值，蓋板扣件會在反覆吸力下逐漸鬆動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Relying on a single small tunnel may overestimate suction through blockage and over-design, or underestimate ridge peaks through wrong turbulence; taking mean pressure as the design value and ignoring gust peaks lets lid fixings loosen gradually under repeated suction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「風洞試驗與阻塞效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Relying on a single small tunnel may overestimate suction through blockage and over-design, or underestimate ridge peaks through wrong turbulence.
Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection.

steps.title: 結構模型試驗與長期變形量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural model tests and long-term deformation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1:60 壓克力結構模型」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1:60 acrylic structural model” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 1960 年代電腦能力有限，Arup 以 1:60 的白色壓克力模型量測殼片在荷載下的應變與變形，用來檢核手算與程式結果，特別是脊梁、台座與不對稱荷載的反應。真實結構完工後還會因混凝土徐變持續變形，因此設計以最終與瞬時撓度的比值估算長期下垂，並在施工與使用期間量測柱沉陷與殼片位置，確認實際行為落在預測範圍內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1:60 壓克力結構模型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With limited computing power in the 1960s, Arup measured strains and deflections of a 1:60 white acrylic model under load to check hand calculations and program results, especially for the ridge beams, pedestals and asymmetric loading. The real structure keeps deforming after completion through concrete creep, so the design estimated long-term sag with a ratio of final to instantaneous deflection, and column settlement and shell positions were measured during construction and use to confirm that actual behaviour stayed within predictions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1:60 acrylic structural model” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：公開資料採用最終／瞬時撓度比 2.8。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The published design used a final-to-instantaneous deflection ratio of 2.8.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縮尺模型的變形按比例放大，就是實際建築的長期變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1:60 壓克力結構模型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1:60 acrylic structural model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The real structure keeps deforming after completion through concrete creep, so the design estimated long-term sag with a ratio of final to instantaneous deflection, and column settlement and shell positions were measured during construction and use to confirm that actual behaviour stayed within predictions.

quiz.question: 關於「結構模型試驗與長期變形量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 結構模型試驗與長期變形量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural model tests and long-term deformation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1:60 壓克力結構模型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1:60 acrylic structural model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：公開資料採用最終／瞬時撓度比 2.8。若某肋頂在自重下的瞬時撓度 δ_i = 18 mm，長期撓度 δ_∞ = 2.8×18 ≈ 50 mm，其中徐變增量約 32 mm；若改用比值 2.0，預測只有 36 mm，會低估約 14 mm 的長期下垂。瞬時撓度與比較用的比值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The published design used a final-to-instantaneous deflection ratio of 2.8. If a rib tip deflects δ_i = 18 mm instantly under self-weight, the long-term deflection is δ_∞ = 2.8×18 ≈ 50 mm, of which about 32 mm is creep; a ratio of 2.0 would predict only 36 mm and underestimate the long-term sag by about 14 mm. The instantaneous deflection and comparison ratio are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：模型試驗先以已知解的簡單荷載校正量測系統，再施加對稱與不對稱荷載，比較模型應變換算到實尺度的內力與分析結果；實結構則在固定測點以精密水準與三維測量建立完工基準，之後定期複測，並與徐變預測曲線比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the model measurement system first with simple loads of known solution, then apply symmetric and asymmetric loads and compare model strains scaled to full-size forces with the analysis; on the real structure, establish an as-built baseline at fixed targets by precise levelling and three-dimensional survey, then re-measure periodically and compare with the predicted creep curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 公開資料採用最終／瞬時撓度比 2.8。若某肋頂在自重下的瞬時撓度 δ_i = 18 mm，長期撓度 δ_∞ = 2.8×18 ≈ 50 mm，其中徐變增量約 32 mm；若改用比值 2.0，預測只有 36 mm，會低估約 14 mm 的長期下垂。瞬時撓度與比較用的比值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The published design used a final-to-instantaneous deflection ratio of 2.8. If a rib tip deflects δ_i = 18 mm instantly under self-weight, the long-term deflection is δ_∞ = 2.8×18 ≈ 50 mm, of which about 32 mm is creep; a ratio of 2.0 would predict only 36 mm and underestimate the long-term sag by about 14 mm. The instantaneous deflection and comparison ratio are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 模型試驗先以已知解的簡單荷載校正量測系統，再施加對稱與不對稱荷載，比較模型應變換算到實尺度的內力與分析結果；實結構則在固定測點以精密水準與三維測量建立完工基準，之後定期複測，並與徐變預測曲線比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the model measurement system first with simple loads of known solution, then apply symmetric and asymmetric loads and compare model strains scaled to full-size forces with the analysis; on the real structure, establish an as-built baseline at fixed targets by precise levelling and three-dimensional survey, then re-measure periodically and compare with the predicted creep curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模型試驗、電腦分析與現場量測三者要寫入同一份驗證矩陣，列出每項檢核的比較對象與允差；完工基準測量的點位、儀器與溫度條件要作為永久紀錄移交業主。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Model tests, computer analysis and field measurements should be entered into one verification matrix listing what each check is compared with and its tolerance; the points, instruments and temperature conditions of the as-built baseline survey should be handed to the owner as a permanent record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓克力與混凝土的泊松比與徐變特性不同，若把模型位移按比例放大直接當作長期變形，會漏掉徐變；沒有完工基準的結構，日後發現變形時無法分辨是早期施工偏差還是持續發展的劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Acrylic and concrete differ in Poisson's ratio and creep, so scaling model displacements directly as long-term deformation leaves creep out; without an as-built baseline, deformation found later cannot be separated into early construction deviation and ongoing deterioration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 結構模型試驗與長期變形量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural model tests and long-term deformation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1:60 壓克力結構模型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1:60 acrylic structural model” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓克力與混凝土的泊松比與徐變特性不同，若把模型位移按比例放大直接當作長期變形，會漏掉徐變；沒有完工基準的結構，日後發現變形時無法分辨是早期施工偏差還是持續發展的劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Acrylic and concrete differ in Poisson's ratio and creep, so scaling model displacements directly as long-term deformation leaves creep out; without an as-built baseline, deformation found later cannot be separated into early construction deviation and ongoing deterioration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：真實結構完工後還會因混凝土徐變持續變形，因此設計以最終與瞬時撓度的比值估算長期下垂，並在施工與使用期間量測柱沉陷與殼片位置，確認實際行為落在預測範圍內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The real structure keeps deforming after completion through concrete creep, so the design estimated long-term sag with a ratio of final to instantaneous deflection, and column settlement and shell positions were measured during construction and use to confirm that actual behaviour stayed within predictions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺模型的變形按比例放大，就是實際建築的長期變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them.
Acrylic and concrete differ in Poisson's ratio and creep, so scaling model displacements directly as long-term deformation leaves creep out.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計」與「世界遺產的耐久維護與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lid suction and durable fixing design" and "Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lid suction and durable fixing design: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「瓷磚蓋板與青銅扣件」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tile lids and bronze fixings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 屋面約一百零五萬片瓷磚先在地面嵌入預鑄混凝土蓋板，再把蓋板以扣件固定到肋拱上；主殼蓋板為人字形，長約 2.3 m、厚 44.5 mm，背面有 152 mm 高的加勁肋。蓋板自重不足以抵抗風吸力，因此扣件必須承受上拉力，且處在海港鹽霧環境。設計採用鋁青銅托架與磷青銅螺栓，脊梁長螺栓用 K-Monel 或鈦合金，並保守限制側向螺栓的疲勞應力，以 300 年壽命為目標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「瓷磚蓋板與青銅扣件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: About 1.05 million tiles were first set into precast concrete lids on the ground, and the lids were then fixed to the ribs; main-shell lids are chevron-shaped, about 2.3 m long and 44.5 mm thick with 152 mm deep stiffening ribs on the back. Lid self-weight cannot resist wind suction, so the fixings carry uplift, and they sit in harbour salt spray. The design used aluminium-bronze brackets and phosphor-bronze bolts, with K-Monel or titanium for the long ridge bolts, and limited fatigue stress in the lateral bolts conservatively, targeting a 300-year life. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tile lids and bronze fixings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：扣件設計吸力 3,832 Pa（公開資料）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fixings were designed for suction up to 3,832 Pa (published data).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「瓷磚蓋板與青銅扣件」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tile lids and bronze fixings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計
knowledge.titleEn: Lid suction and durable fixing design
knowledge.text: 屋面約一百零五萬片瓷磚先在地面嵌入預鑄混凝土蓋板，再把蓋板以扣件固定到肋拱上；主殼蓋板為人字形，長約 2.3 m、厚 44.5 mm，背面有 152 mm 高的加勁肋。蓋板自重不足以抵抗風吸力，因此扣件必須承受上拉力，且處在海港鹽霧環境。
knowledge.textEn: About 1.05 million tiles were first set into precast concrete lids on the ground, and the lids were then fixed to the ribs; main-shell lids are chevron-shaped, about 2.3 m long and 44.5 mm thick with 152 mm deep stiffening ribs on the back. Lid self-weight cannot resist wind suction, so the fixings carry uplift, and they sit in harbour salt spray.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lid suction and durable fixing design" is correct?
options: 屋面約一百零五萬片瓷磚先在地面嵌入預鑄混凝土蓋板，再把蓋板以扣件固定到肋拱上。
混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。
列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。
optionsEn: About 1.05 million tiles were first set into precast concrete lids on the ground, and the lids were then fixed to the ribs.
Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them.
A World Heritage building may not receive any structural repair and must be left exactly as it is.
quiz.explanation: 屋面約一百零五萬片瓷磚先在地面嵌入預鑄混凝土蓋板，再把蓋板以扣件固定到肋拱上；主殼蓋板為人字形，長約 2.3 m、厚 44.5 mm，背面有 152 mm 高的加勁肋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: About 1.05 million tiles were first set into precast concrete lids on the ground, and the lids were then fixed to the ribs; main-shell lids are chevron-shaped, about 2.3 m long and 44.5 mm thick with 152 mm deep stiffening ribs on the back. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lid suction and durable fixing design: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「瓷磚蓋板與青銅扣件」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tile lids and bronze fixings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扣件設計吸力 3,832 Pa（公開資料）。蓋板自重 0.0445 m × 24 kN/m³ ≈ 1.07 kPa，加瓷磚約 0.2 kPa，淨上拉 3.83 − 1.07 − 0.2 ≈ 2.56 kPa。若單片蓋板 2.3 m × 1.2 m = 2.76 m² 由 4 個扣件固定，總上拉約 7.1 kN、每個約 1.8 kN。瓷磚重、蓋板寬度與扣件數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fixings were designed for suction up to 3,832 Pa (published data). Lid self-weight is 0.0445 m × 24 kN/m³ ≈ 1.07 kPa, plus about 0.2 kPa of tiles, leaving a net uplift of 3.83 − 1.07 − 0.2 ≈ 2.56 kPa. A lid of 2.3 m × 1.2 m = 2.76 m² held by 4 fixings carries a total uplift of about 7.1 kN, about 1.8 kN each. Tile weight, lid width and fixing count are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：扣件材料以成分與機械性質證明驗收，抽樣做拉拔試驗並評估鹽霧與電偶腐蝕；使用期間以目視與敲擊檢查瓷磚空鼓與蓋板接縫密封，並定期取出代表性扣件檢查腐蝕與螺紋狀態，與原設計的疲勞與耐蝕假設比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Accept fixing materials by composition and mechanical-property certificates and sample them for pull-out tests and salt-spray and galvanic-corrosion assessment; in service, inspect tiles for debonding by visual and tap testing, check lid-joint sealant, and periodically remove representative fixings to examine corrosion and threads against the original fatigue and corrosion assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 扣件設計吸力 3,832 Pa（公開資料）。蓋板自重 0.0445 m × 24 kN/m³ ≈ 1.07 kPa，加瓷磚約 0.2 kPa，淨上拉 3.83 − 1.07 − 0.2 ≈ 2.56 kPa。若單片蓋板 2.3 m × 1.2 m = 2.76 m² 由 4 個扣件固定，總上拉約 7.1 kN、每個約 1.8 kN。瓷磚重、蓋板寬度與扣件數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fixings were designed for suction up to 3,832 Pa (published data). Lid self-weight is 0.0445 m × 24 kN/m³ ≈ 1.07 kPa, plus about 0.2 kPa of tiles, leaving a net uplift of 3.83 − 1.07 − 0.2 ≈ 2.56 kPa. A lid of 2.3 m × 1.2 m = 2.76 m² held by 4 fixings carries a total uplift of about 7.1 kN, about 1.8 kN each. Tile weight, lid width and fixing count are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lid suction and durable fixing design", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。
扣件設計吸力 3,832 Pa（公開資料）。
環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。
optionsEn: A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored.

steps.title: 蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 不同金屬接觸而沒有隔離時會產生電偶腐蝕，使扣件在看不見的位置斷面減薄；蓋板接縫密封老化讓雨水進入，鹽分在扣件附近濃縮，最後可能造成蓋板鬆動或瓷磚脫落，在人潮密集的廣場上方形成墜物風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dissimilar metals in contact without isolation corrode galvanically and thin fixings where no one can see; ageing lid-joint sealant lets rain in and salt concentrates around the fixings, which can finally loosen lids or drop tiles above a crowded public forecourt, a falling-object hazard. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 世界遺產的耐久維護與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「遺產保存與檢測紀錄」如何影響雪梨歌劇院的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heritage and inspection records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Opera House”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雪梨歌劇院 2007 年列入世界遺產，屋殼既是承重結構，也是受保護的文化資產，任何修繕都必須在結構安全與保存原貌之間取得平衡。海港環境中的混凝土面臨碳化與氯離子侵入，預力鋼絞線與扣件是最關鍵卻最難直接看見的元件，因此維護策略依賴長期檢測紀錄、非破壞檢測與少量取樣。原始設計資料、張拉與灌漿紀錄、量測基準與歷次修繕紀錄共同構成這座建築的工程身分證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「遺產保存與檢測紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Listed as World Heritage in 2007, the Sydney Opera House shells are both load-bearing structure and protected cultural fabric, so every repair must balance structural safety against conservation of the original. Concrete in a harbour environment faces carbonation and chloride ingress, and the prestressing strand and fixings are the most critical yet least visible components, so maintenance relies on long-term inspection records, non-destructive testing and minimal sampling. Original design data, stressing and grouting records, survey baselines and every past repair together form the building's engineering identity card. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Heritage and inspection records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：碳化深度 x = k·√t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Carbonation depth x = k·√t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A World Heritage building may not receive any structural repair and must be left exactly as it is." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Heritage and inspection records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「世界遺產的耐久維護與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon" is correct?
options: 列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。

steps.title: 世界遺產的耐久維護與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「遺產保存與檢測紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heritage and inspection records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：碳化深度 x = k·√t。取 k = 2 mm/√年，50 年後 x = 2×√50 ≈ 14 mm，碳化前緣到達 30 mm 保護層約需 (30/2)² = 225 年；若局部裂縫或密封失效使 k 增為 4 mm/√年，50 年就到 28 mm，約 56 年即到達鋼筋。k 值與保護層厚度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Carbonation depth x = k·√t. With k = 2 mm/√year, x = 2×√50 ≈ 14 mm after 50 years, and the front reaches 30 mm cover in about (30/2)² = 225 years; if local cracking or failed sealant raises k to 4 mm/√year, x reaches 28 mm at 50 years and the reinforcement in about 56 years. The k values and cover thickness are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以保護層測定儀與酚酞試驗抽查碳化深度、以氯離子剖面取樣評估海鹽侵入，並以半電池電位或電阻率掃描找出鋼筋腐蝕熱點；所有取樣位置須事先經保存顧問核可並盡量選在不顯眼處，檢測結果與歷次紀錄放在同一資料庫比較趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Spot-check carbonation depth with cover meters and phenolphthalein tests, sample chloride profiles for sea-salt ingress, and scan half-cell potential or resistivity to locate reinforcement-corrosion hot spots; every sampling location must be approved beforehand by the conservation adviser and kept inconspicuous where possible, with results stored in one database with earlier records to compare trends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With k = 2 mm/√year, x = 2×√50 ≈ 14 mm after 50 years, and the front reaches 30 mm cover in about (30/2)² = 225 years; if local cracking or failed sealant raises k to 4 mm/√year, x reaches 28 mm at 50 years and the reinforcement in about 56 years. The k values and cover thickness are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「世界遺產的耐久維護與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon", which statement holds?
options: 預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。
肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。
碳化深度 x = k·√t。
optionsEn: As long as a precast rib segment has the right dimensions, its weight and age do not affect erection.
A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution.
Carbonation depth x = k·√t.
quiz.explanation: 碳化深度 x = k·√t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Carbonation depth x = k·√t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 世界遺產的耐久維護與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「遺產保存與檢測紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Heritage and inspection records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以保護層測定儀與酚酞試驗抽查碳化深度、以氯離子剖面取樣評估海鹽侵入，並以半電池電位或電阻率掃描找出鋼筋腐蝕熱點；所有取樣位置須事先經保存顧問核可並盡量選在不顯眼處，檢測結果與歷次紀錄放在同一資料庫比較趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Spot-check carbonation depth with cover meters and phenolphthalein tests, sample chloride profiles for sea-salt ingress, and scan half-cell potential or resistivity to locate reinforcement-corrosion hot spots; every sampling location must be approved beforehand by the conservation adviser and kept inconspicuous where possible, with results stored in one database with earlier records to compare trends. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接與資產管理文件應包含原始計算與 Arup 1973 年公開回顧、張拉與灌漿紀錄、完工量測基準、風壓分區、扣件材料表、檢測週期，以及保存管理計畫的核准流程；任何結構介入都要先經結構工程師評估，再依保存程序取得許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover and asset-management records should contain the original calculations and Arup's 1973 published review, stressing and grouting records, as-built survey baselines, wind-pressure zoning, fixing-material schedules, inspection intervals and the approval route under the conservation management plan; every structural intervention must be assessed by the structural engineer and then approved through the conservation procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只做外觀修補而不追查原因，碳化或氯離子造成的鋼筋腐蝕會在修補邊緣繼續發展，形成所謂環狀陽極效應，修補處一再剝落；不了解預力與扣件的原始設計就更換材料，也可能引入新的電偶腐蝕或改變荷載路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cosmetic patching without tracking causes lets carbonation- or chloride-driven corrosion continue at patch edges, the incipient-anode effect, so repairs spall again and again; replacing materials without understanding the original prestress and fixing design can introduce new galvanic corrosion or alter the load path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「世界遺產的耐久維護與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon"?
options: 以保護層測定儀與酚酞試驗抽查碳化深度、以氯離子剖面取樣評估海鹽侵入，並以半電池電位或電阻率掃描找出鋼筋腐蝕熱點。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。
optionsEn: Spot-check carbonation depth with cover meters and phenolphthalein tests, sample chloride profiles for sea-salt ingress, and scan half-cell potential or resistivity to locate reinforcement-corrosion hot spots.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 世界遺產的耐久維護與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「遺產保存與檢測紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Heritage and inspection records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只做外觀修補而不追查原因，碳化或氯離子造成的鋼筋腐蝕會在修補邊緣繼續發展，形成所謂環狀陽極效應，修補處一再剝落；不了解預力與扣件的原始設計就更換材料，也可能引入新的電偶腐蝕或改變荷載路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cosmetic patching without tracking causes lets carbonation- or chloride-driven corrosion continue at patch edges, the incipient-anode effect, so repairs spall again and again; replacing materials without understanding the original prestress and fixing design can introduce new galvanic corrosion or alter the load path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：原始設計資料、張拉與灌漿紀錄、量測基準與歷次修繕紀錄共同構成這座建築的工程身分證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Original design data, stressing and grouting records, survey baselines and every past repair together form the building's engineering identity card.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A World Heritage building may not receive any structural repair and must be left exactly as it is." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只做外觀修補而不追查原因，碳化或氯離子造成的鋼筋腐蝕會在修補邊緣繼續發展，形成所謂環狀陽極效應，修補處一再剝落；不了解預力與扣件的原始設計就更換材料，也可能引入新的電偶腐蝕或改變荷載路徑。
