knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「世界遺產的耐久維護與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只做外觀修補而不追查原因，碳化或氯離子造成的鋼筋腐蝕會在修補邊緣繼續發展，形成所謂環狀陽極效應，修補處一再剝落。
雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Cosmetic patching without tracking causes lets carbonation- or chloride-driven corrosion continue at patch edges, the incipient-anode effect, so repairs spall again and again.
The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action.
quiz.explanation: 只做外觀修補而不追查原因，碳化或氯離子造成的鋼筋腐蝕會在修補邊緣繼續發展，形成所謂環狀陽極效應，修補處一再剝落；不了解預力與扣件的原始設計就更換材料，也可能引入新的電偶腐蝕或改變荷載路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cosmetic patching without tracking causes lets carbonation- or chloride-driven corrosion continue at patch edges, the incipient-anode effect, so repairs spall again and again; replacing materials without understanding the original prestress and fixing design can introduce new galvanic corrosion or alter the load path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 北京國家體育場
summary: 北京國家體育場（鳥巢）把屋蓋、立面與樓梯整合成一個由交織平面桁架構成的鋼結構外殼，屋蓋平面約 313 m × 266 m，與內部混凝土看台結構完全分離。課程從空間門式結構與三級地震性能目標出發，處理 1.2 m 箱形桿件的板厚與扭曲面、複雜節點的原型試驗、78 個臨時支撐點上的分段組裝與分級卸載，再談溫度與施工監測、ETFE 與 PTFE 雙層膜、防蝕排水維護與賽後再利用。
summaryEn: The Beijing National Stadium, the Bird's Nest, merges roof, façade and stairs into one steel shell of interlaced plane trusses, about 313 m × 266 m on plan and fully separated from the concrete seating bowl inside. The course starts from the portalised space-truss system and three-level seismic performance targets, then covers plate thickness and twisted surfaces of 1.2 m box members, prototype tests of congested nodes, sectional assembly and staged unloading on 78 temporary support points, thermal and construction monitoring, the double ETFE and PTFE membranes, corrosion and drainage maintenance and post-Games reuse.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算屋蓋卸載時一個支撐點的反力變化。假設主桁架與環桁架在卸載前總重 30,000 t，由 78 個臨時支撐點承托，平均反力 R̄ = 30,000×9.81/78 ≈ 3,770 kN。該點預測卸載總下沉 270 mm，分 10 級、每級 27 mm；桁架在該點的勁度 k = 15 kN/mm。若千斤頂操作落後一級，附加反力 ΔR = 15×27 = 405 kN，約為 R̄ 的 10.7%；若落後兩級，ΔR = 810 kN，約 21%，已超過常見的 10% 停止門檻。若把每級改為 13.5 mm（20 級），同樣落後一級只增加約 203 kN，約 5.4%。這說明級數越多、單級位移越小，對同步誤差越不敏感，但卸載時間會加倍。所有數值為教學假設，不代表北京國家體育場的實際施工數據。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the change in one support reaction during roof unloading. Assume the primary and ring trusses weigh 30,000 t before unloading, carried by 78 temporary support points, so the mean reaction is R̄ = 30,000×9.81/78 ≈ 3,770 kN. The point is predicted to settle 270 mm in total, unloaded in 10 stages of 27 mm, and the truss stiffness there is k = 15 kN/mm. If its jack lags one stage, the added reaction is ΔR = 15×27 = 405 kN, about 10.7% of R̄; lagging two stages gives ΔR = 810 kN, about 21%, beyond a typical 10% stop threshold. Using 13.5 mm stages (20 stages), the same one-stage lag adds only about 203 kN, about 5.4%. More, smaller stages make unloading less sensitive to synchronisation error, at the cost of doubling its duration. All values are teaching assumptions, not actual construction data of the Beijing National Stadium.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「交織平面桁架的空間門式結構」與「高烈度區的性能化耐震設計」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses" and "Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 交織平面桁架的空間門式結構：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「12 m 深主桁架網」如何影響北京國家體育場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “12 m deep primary truss grid” governs force, deformation or durability in “Beijing National Stadium”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鳥巢屋蓋的主結構是一組組深約 12 m 的平面桁架，彼此交織成網，跨越約 313 m × 266 m 的平面並升高到約 60 m；桁架落在外圍 24 組桁架柱上，柱與桁架剛接形成三維門式構架，同時抵抗重力與側向力。看似隨機的立面桿件多屬次結構，依旋轉平面規則細分主網格，並與樓梯整合。2004 年取消可開合屋頂後，中央開口得以加大，主桁架跨度與用鋼量隨之下降。內部混凝土看台與鋼外殼相距約 15 m，兩者結構獨立，各自承擔自身的地震與溫度作用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「12 m 深主桁架網」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The primary roof structure is a set of plane trusses about 12 m deep that interlace into a web, spanning about 313 m × 266 m on plan and rising to about 60 m; the trusses land on 24 perimeter column trusses, rigidly connected so that columns and trusses form a three-dimensional portal frame resisting both gravity and lateral load. Most of the seemingly random façade members are secondary structure that subdivides the primary grid by rules of rotated planes and is integrated with the stairs. Dropping the retractable roof in 2004 allowed a larger central opening, reducing primary truss spans and steel. The concrete seating bowl stands roughly 15 m inside the steel shell and is structurally independent, each carrying its own earthquake and thermal actions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “12 m deep primary truss grid” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以簡支類比估算主桁架弦桿力：線荷載 w = 5 kPa × 12 m 受荷寬度 = 60 kN/m，等效跨度 L = 150 m，M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m；桁架深 d = 12 m 時弦桿力 C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A simply supported analogy estimates the primary truss chord force: line load w = 5 kPa × 12 m tributary width = 60 kN/m over an equivalent span L = 150 m gives M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m; with depth d = 12 m the chord force is C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「12 m 深主桁架網」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “12 m deep primary truss grid”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 交織平面桁架的空間門式結構
knowledge.titleEn: A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses
knowledge.text: 鳥巢屋蓋的主結構是一組組深約 12 m 的平面桁架，彼此交織成網，跨越約 313 m × 266 m 的平面並升高到約 60 m；桁架落在外圍 24 組桁架柱上，柱與桁架剛接形成三維門式構架，同時抵抗重力與側向力。看似隨機的立面桿件多屬次結構，依旋轉平面規則細分主網格，並與樓梯整合。
knowledge.textEn: The primary roof structure is a set of plane trusses about 12 m deep that interlace into a web, spanning about 313 m × 266 m on plan and rising to about 60 m; the trusses land on 24 perimeter column trusses, rigidly connected so that columns and trusses form a three-dimensional portal frame resisting both gravity and lateral load. Most of the seemingly random façade members are secondary structure that subdivides the primary grid by rules of rotated planes and is integrated with the stairs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交織平面桁架的空間門式結構」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses" is correct?
options: 鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。
鳥巢屋蓋的主結構是一組組深約 12 m 的平面桁架，彼此交織成網，跨越約 313 m × 266 m 的平面並升高到約 60 m。
大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。
optionsEn: The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally.
The primary roof structure is a set of plane trusses about 12 m deep that interlace into a web, spanning about 313 m × 266 m on plan and rising to about 60 m.
A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices.
quiz.explanation: 鳥巢屋蓋的主結構是一組組深約 12 m 的平面桁架，彼此交織成網，跨越約 313 m × 266 m 的平面並升高到約 60 m；桁架落在外圍 24 組桁架柱上，柱與桁架剛接形成三維門式構架，同時抵抗重力與側向力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The primary roof structure is a set of plane trusses about 12 m deep that interlace into a web, spanning about 313 m × 266 m on plan and rising to about 60 m; the trusses land on 24 perimeter column trusses, rigidly connected so that columns and trusses form a three-dimensional portal frame resisting both gravity and lateral load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 交織平面桁架的空間門式結構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「12 m 深主桁架網」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “12 m deep primary truss grid” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以簡支類比估算主桁架弦桿力：線荷載 w = 5 kPa × 12 m 受荷寬度 = 60 kN/m，等效跨度 L = 150 m，M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m；桁架深 d = 12 m 時弦桿力 C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN。若深度降為原可開合屋頂桁架的 8.2 m，C ≈ 20,600 kN，增加約 46%。荷載、受荷寬度與等效跨度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A simply supported analogy estimates the primary truss chord force: line load w = 5 kPa × 12 m tributary width = 60 kN/m over an equivalent span L = 150 m gives M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m; with depth d = 12 m the chord force is C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN. Reducing the depth to the 8.2 m of the former retractable-roof trusses raises C to about 20,600 kN, about 46% more. Load, tributary width and equivalent span are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以整體三維模型做靜力、模態與施工階段分析，抽出每一主桁架的弦桿軸力與彎矩，與手算類比比較數量級；確認 24 個主支承節點的反力分配合理，並檢查次結構在模型中是否被錯誤地當成主要傳力路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run static, modal and construction-stage analyses on the global three-dimensional model, extract chord axial forces and moments of every primary truss and compare their order of magnitude with the hand analogy; confirm that reactions are reasonably distributed among the 24 primary support nodes, and check that the secondary structure is not wrongly acting as a main load path in the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 以簡支類比估算主桁架弦桿力：線荷載 w = 5 kPa × 12 m 受荷寬度 = 60 kN/m，等效跨度 L = 150 m，M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m；桁架深 d = 12 m 時弦桿力 C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN。若深度降為原可開合屋頂桁架的 8.2 m，C ≈ 20,600 kN，增加約 46%。荷載、受荷寬度與等效跨度為教學假設。

Reducing the depth to the 8.2 m of the former retractable-roof trusses raises C to about 20,600 kN, about 46% more. Load, tributary width and equivalent span are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「交織平面桁架的空間門式結構」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses", which statement holds?
options: 節點只要比桿件強就安全，不需要另外做分析或試驗。
卸載就是把臨時支撐拆掉，順序與速度不重要。
以簡支類比估算主桁架弦桿力：線荷載 w = 5 kPa × 12 m 受荷寬度 = 60 kN/m，等效跨度 L = 150 m，M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m。
optionsEn: A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed.
Unloading just means removing temporary supports; order and speed do not matter.
A simply supported analogy estimates the primary truss chord force: line load w = 5 kPa × 12 m tributary width = 60 kN/m over an equivalent span L = 150 m gives M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m.
quiz.explanation: 以簡支類比估算主桁架弦桿力：線荷載 w = 5 kPa × 12 m 受荷寬度 = 60 kN/m，等效跨度 L = 150 m，M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m；桁架深 d = 12 m 時弦桿力 C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A simply supported analogy estimates the primary truss chord force: line load w = 5 kPa × 12 m tributary width = 60 kN/m over an equivalent span L = 150 m gives M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m; with depth d = 12 m the chord force is C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 交織平面桁架的空間門式結構：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「12 m 深主桁架網」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “12 m deep primary truss grid” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以整體三維模型做靜力、模態與施工階段分析，抽出每一主桁架的弦桿軸力與彎矩，與手算類比比較數量級；確認 24 個主支承節點的反力分配合理，並檢查次結構在模型中是否被錯誤地當成主要傳力路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run static, modal and construction-stage analyses on the global three-dimensional model, extract chord axial forces and moments of every primary truss and compare their order of magnitude with the hand analogy; confirm that reactions are reasonably distributed among the 24 primary support nodes, and check that the secondary structure is not wrongly acting as a main load path in the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構圖說與模型應明確標示主結構、次結構與非結構桿件三種層級，並為每一層級訂定不同的性能目標、檢驗等級與焊接要求；建築造型調整時，先確認是否動到主結構網格。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings and models should clearly label primary, secondary and non-structural members, with separate performance targets, inspection grades and welding requirements for each level; when the architectural form changes, first confirm whether the primary grid is affected.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把立面次結構與主桁架以同等勁度建模，荷載會被分配到不該承重的細部桿件，實際施工後次結構過度受力、節點開裂；反之若忽略次結構對主桁架的約束，挫屈長度會被高估或低估，構件尺寸失去依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Modelling façade secondary members with the same stiffness as primary trusses sends load into minor members not meant to carry it, overstressing them and cracking nodes after construction; ignoring the restraint they provide to the primary trusses misjudges buckling lengths, so member sizing loses its basis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以整體三維模型做靜力、模態與施工階段分析，抽出每一主桁架的弦桿軸力與彎矩，與手算類比比較數量級；確認 24 個主支承節點的反力分配合理，並檢查次結構在模型中是否被錯誤地當成主要傳力路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Run static, modal and construction-stage analyses on the global three-dimensional model, extract chord axial forces and moments of every primary truss and compare their order of magnitude with the hand analogy; confirm that reactions are reasonably distributed among the 24 primary support nodes, and check that the secondary structure is not wrongly acting as a main load path in the model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構圖說與模型應明確標示主結構、次結構與非結構桿件三種層級，並為每一層級訂定不同的性能目標、檢驗等級與焊接要求；建築造型調整時，先確認是否動到主結構網格。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings and models should clearly label primary, secondary and non-structural members, with separate performance targets, inspection grades and welding requirements for each level; when the architectural form changes, first confirm whether the primary grid is affected.

quiz.question: 要驗證「交織平面桁架的空間門式結構」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses"?
options: 以整體三維模型做靜力、模態與施工階段分析，抽出每一主桁架的弦桿軸力與彎矩，與手算類比比較數量級。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
膜材越平越好看，只要材料夠強就不需要曲率。
optionsEn: Run static, modal and construction-stage analyses on the global three-dimensional model, extract chord axial forces and moments of every primary truss and compare their order of magnitude with the hand analogy.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The flatter a membrane the better it looks, and it needs no curvature if the material is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 以整體三維模型做靜力、模態與施工階段分析，抽出每一主桁架的弦桿軸力與彎矩，與手算類比比較數量級；確認 24 個主支承節點的反力分配合理，並檢查次結構在模型中是否被錯誤地當成主要傳力路徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run static, modal and construction-stage analyses on the global three-dimensional model, extract chord axial forces and moments of every primary truss and compare their order of magnitude with the hand analogy; confirm that reactions are reasonably distributed among the 24 primary support nodes, and check that the secondary structure is not wrongly acting as a main load path in the model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 交織平面桁架的空間門式結構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「12 m 深主桁架網」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “12 m deep primary truss grid” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把立面次結構與主桁架以同等勁度建模，荷載會被分配到不該承重的細部桿件，實際施工後次結構過度受力、節點開裂；反之若忽略次結構對主桁架的約束，挫屈長度會被高估或低估，構件尺寸失去依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Modelling façade secondary members with the same stiffness as primary trusses sends load into minor members not meant to carry it, overstressing them and cracking nodes after construction; ignoring the restraint they provide to the primary trusses misjudges buckling lengths, so member sizing loses its basis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：內部混凝土看台與鋼外殼相距約 15 m，兩者結構獨立，各自承擔自身的地震與溫度作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The concrete seating bowl stands roughly 15 m inside the steel shell and is structurally independent, each carrying its own earthquake and thermal actions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把立面次結構與主桁架以同等勁度建模，荷載會被分配到不該承重的細部桿件，實際施工後次結構過度受力、節點開裂；反之若忽略次結構對主桁架的約束，挫屈長度會被高估或低估，構件尺寸失去依據。
knowledge.textEn: Modelling façade secondary members with the same stiffness as primary trusses sends load into minor members not meant to carry it, overstressing them and cracking nodes after construction; ignoring the restraint they provide to the primary trusses misjudges buckling lengths, so member sizing loses its basis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交織平面桁架的空間門式結構」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把立面次結構與主桁架以同等勁度建模，荷載會被分配到不該承重的細部桿件，實際施工後次結構過度受力、節點開裂。
大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Modelling façade secondary members with the same stiffness as primary trusses sends load into minor members not meant to carry it, overstressing them and cracking nodes after construction.
A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices.
quiz.explanation: 若把立面次結構與主桁架以同等勁度建模，荷載會被分配到不該承重的細部桿件，實際施工後次結構過度受力、節點開裂；反之若忽略次結構對主桁架的約束，挫屈長度會被高估或低估，構件尺寸失去依據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Modelling façade secondary members with the same stiffness as primary trusses sends load into minor members not meant to carry it, overstressing them and cracking nodes after construction; ignoring the restraint they provide to the primary trusses misjudges buckling lengths, so member sizing loses its basis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高烈度區的性能化耐震設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三級地震性能目標」如何影響北京國家體育場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-level seismic targets” governs force, deformation or durability in “Beijing National Stadium”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 北京屬 8 度設防區，50 年超越機率 10% 的地表加速度約 0.2g。Arup 為屋蓋訂定三級性能：50 年、500 年與 2,500 年回歸期地震；最高等級以非線性歷時分析檢核，主結構保持彈性或接近彈性，次結構允許嚴重損傷但不得倒塌。巨大的鋼屋蓋質量在地震時產生可觀慣性力，必須經由 24 組桁架柱傳到基礎，因此柱腳與柱頂節點是耐震設計的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三級地震性能目標」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beijing lies in seismic intensity zone VIII, with a peak ground acceleration of about 0.2g for a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years. Arup set three performance levels for the roof, for 50-, 500- and 2,500-year return-period earthquakes; the highest level was checked by nonlinear response-history analysis, keeping primary members elastic or nearly elastic while allowing severe damage but no collapse in secondary members. The large mass of the steel roof generates considerable inertia forces that must pass through the 24 column trusses to the foundations, so column bases and column-top nodes are the critical seismic details. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Three-level seismic targets” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：依 GB 50011，8 度（0.20g）多遇地震水平影響係數最大值 α_max = 0.16、罕遇地震為 0.90。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under GB 50011, the maximum horizontal seismic coefficient for intensity VIII (0.20g) is α_max = 0.16 for frequent earthquakes and 0.90 for rare earthquakes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三級地震性能目標」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Three-level seismic targets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高烈度區的性能化耐震設計

knowledge.textEn: Beijing lies in seismic intensity zone VIII, with a peak ground acceleration of about 0.2g for a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years. Arup set three performance levels for the roof, for 50-, 500- and 2,500-year return-period earthquakes; the highest level was checked by nonlinear response-history analysis, keeping primary members elastic or nearly elastic while allowing severe damage but no collapse in secondary members.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高烈度區的性能化耐震設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone" is correct?
options: 大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。
所有桿件外形都是 1.2 m 方管，所以斷面與板厚都一樣。
北京屬 8 度設防區，50 年超越機率 10% 的地表加速度約 0.2g。
optionsEn: A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices.
All members look like 1.2 m boxes, so their sections and plate thicknesses are the same.
Beijing lies in seismic intensity zone VIII, with a peak ground acceleration of about 0.2g for a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years.
quiz.explanation: 北京屬 8 度設防區，50 年超越機率 10% 的地表加速度約 0.2g。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Beijing lies in seismic intensity zone VIII, with a peak ground acceleration of about 0.2g for a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高烈度區的性能化耐震設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三級地震性能目標」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-level seismic targets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：依 GB 50011，8 度（0.20g）多遇地震水平影響係數最大值 α_max = 0.16、罕遇地震為 0.90。若屋蓋與立面鋼結構重量 W = 400,000 kN，平台段基底剪力 V = 0.16×400,000 = 64,000 kN，平均每組桁架柱約 2,670 kN；罕遇地震 0.90 時每組約 15,000 kN，是多遇地震的 5.6 倍。結構重量與平台段假設為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Under GB 50011, the maximum horizontal seismic coefficient for intensity VIII (0.20g) is α_max = 0.16 for frequent earthquakes and 0.90 for rare earthquakes. With a roof and façade steel weight W = 400,000 kN on the spectral plateau, the base shear is V = 0.16×400,000 = 64,000 kN, about 2,670 kN per column truss; with 0.90 for a rare earthquake it is about 15,000 kN per column, 5.6 times larger. Structural weight and plateau response are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以至少三組強震紀錄做非線性歷時分析，統計主構件的需求／容量比是否小於 1、次構件的塑性轉角是否在允許範圍；以反應譜分析與歷時分析的基底剪力互相校核，並檢查 24 組柱的剪力分配與柱腳錨定在最不利方向的受力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run nonlinear response-history analyses with at least three sets of strong-motion records, checking that primary demand/capacity ratios stay below 1 and secondary plastic rotations within limits; cross-check base shear from response-spectrum and response-history analyses, and check the shear distribution among the 24 columns and the column-base anchorage forces in the most adverse direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 依 GB 50011，8 度（0.20g）多遇地震水平影響係數最大值 α_max = 0.16、罕遇地震為 0.90。若屋蓋與立面鋼結構重量 W = 400,000 kN，平台段基底剪力 V = 0.16×400,000 = 64,000 kN，平均每組桁架柱約 2,670 kN；罕遇地震 0.90 時每組約 15,000 kN，是多遇地震的 5.6 倍。結構重量與平台段假設為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Under GB 50011, the maximum horizontal seismic coefficient for intensity VIII (0.20g) is α_max = 0.16 for frequent earthquakes and 0.90 for rare earthquakes. With a roof and façade steel weight W = 400,000 kN on the spectral plateau, the base shear is V = 0.16×400,000 = 64,000 kN, about 2,670 kN per column truss; with 0.90 for a rare earthquake it is about 15,000 kN per column, 5.6 times larger. Structural weight and plateau response are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高烈度區的性能化耐震設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone", which statement holds?
options: 依 GB 50011，8 度（0.20g）多遇地震水平影響係數最大值 α_max = 0.16、罕遇地震為 0.90。
臨時支撐只是施工用，不需要像永久結構一樣計算與檢查。
鋼構屋蓋只要強度夠，溫度變化只會造成小變形，不會產生內力。
optionsEn: Under GB 50011, the maximum horizontal seismic coefficient for intensity VIII (0.20g) is α_max = 0.16 for frequent earthquakes and 0.90 for rare earthquakes.
Temporary supports are only for construction and need no calculation or inspection like permanent structure.
If a steel roof is strong enough, temperature change only causes small movements and no internal forces.
quiz.explanation: 依 GB 50011，8 度（0.20g）多遇地震水平影響係數最大值 α_max = 0.16、罕遇地震為 0.90。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Under GB 50011, the maximum horizontal seismic coefficient for intensity VIII (0.20g) is α_max = 0.16 for frequent earthquakes and 0.90 for rare earthquakes. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高烈度區的性能化耐震設計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三級地震性能目標」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Three-level seismic targets” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以至少三組強震紀錄做非線性歷時分析，統計主構件的需求／容量比是否小於 1、次構件的塑性轉角是否在允許範圍；以反應譜分析與歷時分析的基底剪力互相校核，並檢查 24 組柱的剪力分配與柱腳錨定在最不利方向的受力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run nonlinear response-history analyses with at least three sets of strong-motion records, checking that primary demand/capacity ratios stay below 1 and secondary plastic rotations within limits; cross-check base shear from response-spectrum and response-history analyses, and check the shear distribution among the 24 columns and the column-base anchorage forces in the most adverse direction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：性能化設計報告應列出每級地震的性能目標、所用地震紀錄、構件分級與接受準則，並經專家審查會確認；鋼外殼與看台之間的淨距須在施工圖上標示為不得占用的耐震間隙。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The performance-based design report should list targets for each earthquake level, records used, member classification and acceptance criteria, confirmed by an expert review panel; the clearance between steel shell and bowl should be marked on construction drawings as a seismic gap that must not be obstructed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若未對主次結構區分性能等級，罕遇地震時可能是關鍵柱頂節點先降伏，屋蓋失去門式構架作用而大幅變位；若鋼屋蓋與混凝土看台之間的間隙不足，兩者在地震中碰撞，造成看台邊緣與鋼柱局部損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without separate performance levels for primary and secondary structure, critical column-top nodes may yield first in a rare earthquake, so the roof loses its portal action and displaces heavily; insufficient clearance between steel roof and concrete bowl lets the two pound together, locally damaging bowl edges and steel columns. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以至少三組強震紀錄做非線性歷時分析，統計主構件的需求／容量比是否小於 1、次構件的塑性轉角是否在允許範圍；以反應譜分析與歷時分析的基底剪力互相校核，並檢查 24 組柱的剪力分配與柱腳錨定在最不利方向的受力。
knowledge.textEn: Run nonlinear response-history analyses with at least three sets of strong-motion records, checking that primary demand/capacity ratios stay below 1 and secondary plastic rotations within limits; cross-check base shear from response-spectrum and response-history analyses, and check the shear distribution among the 24 columns and the column-base anchorage forces in the most adverse direction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 性能化設計報告應列出每級地震的性能目標、所用地震紀錄、構件分級與接受準則，並經專家審查會確認；鋼外殼與看台之間的淨距須在施工圖上標示為不得占用的耐震間隙。
knowledge.textEn: The performance-based design report should list targets for each earthquake level, records used, member classification and acceptance criteria, confirmed by an expert review panel; the clearance between steel shell and bowl should be marked on construction drawings as a seismic gap that must not be obstructed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高烈度區的性能化耐震設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以至少三組強震紀錄做非線性歷時分析，統計主構件的需求／容量比是否小於 1、次構件的塑性轉角是否在允許範圍。
鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Run nonlinear response-history analyses with at least three sets of strong-motion records, checking that primary demand/capacity ratios stay below 1 and secondary plastic rotations within limits.
If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion.
quiz.explanation: 以至少三組強震紀錄做非線性歷時分析，統計主構件的需求／容量比是否小於 1、次構件的塑性轉角是否在允許範圍；以反應譜分析與歷時分析的基底剪力互相校核，並檢查 24 組柱的剪力分配與柱腳錨定在最不利方向的受力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run nonlinear response-history analyses with at least three sets of strong-motion records, checking that primary demand/capacity ratios stay below 1 and secondary plastic rotations within limits; cross-check base shear from response-spectrum and response-history analyses, and check the shear distribution among the 24 columns and the column-base anchorage forces in the most adverse direction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高烈度區的性能化耐震設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三級地震性能目標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Three-level seismic targets” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若未對主次結構區分性能等級，罕遇地震時可能是關鍵柱頂節點先降伏，屋蓋失去門式構架作用而大幅變位；若鋼屋蓋與混凝土看台之間的間隙不足，兩者在地震中碰撞，造成看台邊緣與鋼柱局部損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without separate performance levels for primary and secondary structure, critical column-top nodes may yield first in a rare earthquake, so the roof loses its portal action and displaces heavily; insufficient clearance between steel roof and concrete bowl lets the two pound together, locally damaging bowl edges and steel columns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：巨大的鋼屋蓋質量在地震時產生可觀慣性力，必須經由 24 組桁架柱傳到基礎，因此柱腳與柱頂節點是耐震設計的關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The large mass of the steel roof generates considerable inertia forces that must pass through the 24 column trusses to the foundations, so column bases and column-top nodes are the critical seismic details.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若未對主次結構區分性能等級，罕遇地震時可能是關鍵柱頂節點先降伏，屋蓋失去門式構架作用而大幅變位；若鋼屋蓋與混凝土看台之間的間隙不足，兩者在地震中碰撞，造成看台邊緣與鋼柱局部損壞。
knowledge.textEn: Without separate performance levels for primary and secondary structure, critical column-top nodes may yield first in a rare earthquake, so the roof loses its portal action and displaces heavily; insufficient clearance between steel roof and concrete bowl lets the two pound together, locally damaging bowl edges and steel columns.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高烈度區的性能化耐震設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
所有桿件外形都是 1.2 m 方管，所以斷面與板厚都一樣。
若未對主次結構區分性能等級，罕遇地震時可能是關鍵柱頂節點先降伏，屋蓋失去門式構架作用而大幅變位。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All members look like 1.2 m boxes, so their sections and plate thicknesses are the same.
Without separate performance levels for primary and secondary structure, critical column-top nodes may yield first in a rare earthquake, so the roof loses its portal action and displaces heavily.
quiz.explanation: 若未對主次結構區分性能等級，罕遇地震時可能是關鍵柱頂節點先降伏，屋蓋失去門式構架作用而大幅變位；若鋼屋蓋與混凝土看台之間的間隙不足，兩者在地震中碰撞，造成看台邊緣與鋼柱局部損壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without separate performance levels for primary and secondary structure, critical column-top nodes may yield first in a rare earthquake, so the roof loses its portal action and displaces heavily; insufficient clearance between steel roof and concrete bowl lets the two pound together, locally damaging bowl edges and steel columns. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面」與「複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Box-member plate thickness and developable twisted surfaces" and "Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Box-member plate thickness and developable twisted surfaces: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1.2 m 箱形桿件」如何影響北京國家體育場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.2 m box members” governs force, deformation or durability in “Beijing National Stadium”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主桁架與立面桿件外形統一為約 1.2 m 見方的箱形斷面，板厚由 8 mm 到 100 mm，多數小於 70 mm；為了節省成本，部分上弦改為 1.0 m 見方。耐震緊湊斷面要求寬厚比約 b/t ≤ 16，若全面照此要求，板厚需約 70 mm，因此設計須區分哪些桿件需要高韌性。立面上的扭曲箱形桿件以可展曲面構成，能由平板切割後彎捲成形，避免昂貴的三維壓製。厚板也帶來層狀撕裂與焊接殘餘應力的問題，需要指定厚度方向性能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1.2 m 箱形桿件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Primary truss and façade members share an external box profile of about 1.2 m square, with plates from 8 mm to 100 mm, most under 70 mm; some top chords were reduced to 1.0 m square to save cost. Seismically compact sections need a width-to-thickness ratio of about b/t ≤ 16, which would mean plates of about 70 mm everywhere, so the design had to distinguish which members needed high ductility. Twisted façade boxes were formed from developable surfaces, so they could be cut from flat plate and rolled rather than pressed in three dimensions at high cost. Thick plates also bring lamellar tearing and welding residual stress, requiring specified through-thickness properties. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1.2 m box members” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1.2 m 見方箱形斷面面積 A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 1.2 m square box has area A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有桿件外形都是 1.2 m 方管，所以斷面與板厚都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All members look like 1.2 m boxes, so their sections and plate thicknesses are the same." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1.2 m 箱形桿件」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1.2 m box members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Box-member plate thickness and developable twisted surfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1.2 m 箱形桿件」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1.2 m box members” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1.2 m 見方箱形斷面面積 A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)²。t = 40 mm 時 A = 1.44 − 1.12² ≈ 0.186 m²，單位重約 0.186×7,850 ≈ 1,460 kg/m，b/t = 1,200/40 = 30；t = 70 mm 時 A ≈ 0.316 m²、約 2,480 kg/m，重 1.7 倍。滿足 b/t ≤ 16 需 t ≥ 1,200/16 = 75 mm。以外寬近似寬厚比為教學簡化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 1.2 m square box has area A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)². For t = 40 mm, A = 1.44 − 1.12² ≈ 0.186 m², about 0.186×7,850 ≈ 1,460 kg/m, with b/t = 1,200/40 = 30; for t = 70 mm, A ≈ 0.316 m², about 2,480 kg/m, 1.7 times heavier. Meeting b/t ≤ 16 needs t ≥ 1,200/16 = 75 mm. Using the outer width for b/t is a teaching simplification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：厚板進場時核對材質證明的強度、衝擊韌性與厚度方向斷面收縮率，以超音波檢測夾層；扭曲構件在工廠以三維量測比對設計曲面，焊後量測扭轉角與端面位置；全滲透焊縫依規定比例做超音波探傷，厚板焊接記錄預熱與層間溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On delivery check mill certificates of thick plates for strength, impact toughness and through-thickness reduction of area, and test for laminations by ultrasound; measure twisted members in the shop by three-dimensional survey against the design surface, and after welding check twist angle and end positions; test complete-penetration welds ultrasonically at the specified rate, recording preheat and interpass temperatures for thick plates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A 1.2 m square box has area A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)². For t = 40 mm, A = 1.44 − 1.12² ≈ 0.186 m², about 0.186×7,850 ≈ 1,460 kg/m, with b/t = 1,200/40 = 30; for t = 70 mm, A ≈ 0.316 m², about 2,480 kg/m, 1.7 times heavier. Meeting b/t ≤ 16 needs t ≥ 1,200/16 = 75 mm. Using the outer width for b/t is a teaching simplification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 卸載就是把臨時支撐拆掉，順序與速度不重要。
1.2 m 見方箱形斷面面積 A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)²。

A 1.2 m square box has area A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)².
The flatter a membrane the better it looks, and it needs no curvature if the material is strong enough.

quiz.explanationEn: A 1.2 m square box has area A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Box-member plate thickness and developable twisted surfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1.2 m 箱形桿件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1.2 m box members” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 厚板進場時核對材質證明的強度、衝擊韌性與厚度方向斷面收縮率，以超音波檢測夾層；扭曲構件在工廠以三維量測比對設計曲面，焊後量測扭轉角與端面位置；全滲透焊縫依規定比例做超音波探傷，厚板焊接記錄預熱與層間溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On delivery check mill certificates of thick plates for strength, impact toughness and through-thickness reduction of area, and test for laminations by ultrasound; measure twisted members in the shop by three-dimensional survey against the design surface, and after welding check twist angle and end positions; test complete-penetration welds ultrasonically at the specified rate, recording preheat and interpass temperatures for thick plates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構件清單要逐件標明板厚、鋼種、厚度方向等級與是否屬耐震緊湊斷面，並把扭曲面的展開圖納入製造圖；厚板焊接程序須經評定試驗，由焊接工程師與結構設計者共同核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The member schedule should state plate thickness, steel grade, through-thickness class and whether each member is a seismically compact section, with developed patterns of twisted surfaces included in the fabrication drawings; thick-plate welding procedures must be qualified by test and approved jointly by the welding engineer and structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚板在承受厚度方向拉力的 T 形接頭處，若鋼材厚度方向性能不足，焊接收縮會造成層狀撕裂，裂縫隱藏在板內；扭曲構件若用非可展曲面強行冷彎，殘餘應力與局部皺褶會降低挫屈強度，也使現場對接困難。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At T-joints that pull thick plates through their thickness, steel without adequate through-thickness properties can suffer lamellar tearing from weld shrinkage, cracks hidden inside the plate; forcing a non-developable twist by cold bending leaves residual stress and local wrinkling that reduce buckling strength and make site joints hard to fit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.2 m 箱形桿件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1.2 m box members” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚板在承受厚度方向拉力的 T 形接頭處，若鋼材厚度方向性能不足，焊接收縮會造成層狀撕裂，裂縫隱藏在板內；扭曲構件若用非可展曲面強行冷彎，殘餘應力與局部皺褶會降低挫屈強度，也使現場對接困難。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: At T-joints that pull thick plates through their thickness, steel without adequate through-thickness properties can suffer lamellar tearing from weld shrinkage, cracks hidden inside the plate; forcing a non-developable twist by cold bending leaves residual stress and local wrinkling that reduce buckling strength and make site joints hard to fit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：厚板也帶來層狀撕裂與焊接殘餘應力的問題，需要指定厚度方向性能。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 厚板在承受厚度方向拉力的 T 形接頭處，若鋼材厚度方向性能不足，焊接收縮會造成層狀撕裂，裂縫隱藏在板內。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed.
quiz.explanation: 厚板在承受厚度方向拉力的 T 形接頭處，若鋼材厚度方向性能不足，焊接收縮會造成層狀撕裂，裂縫隱藏在板內；扭曲構件若用非可展曲面強行冷彎，殘餘應力與局部皺褶會降低挫屈強度，也使現場對接困難。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: At T-joints that pull thick plates through their thickness, steel without adequate through-thickness properties can suffer lamellar tearing from weld shrinkage, cracks hidden inside the plate; forcing a non-developable twist by cold bending leaves residual stress and local wrinkling that reduce buckling strength and make site joints hard to fit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙 K 節點與柱頂節點」如何影響北京國家體育場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-K and column-top nodes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Beijing National Stadium”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鳥巢的傳力依賴大量節點，梁、柱與樓梯在節點處以不同角度匯集，箱形壁板在交會處產生應力集中與局部彎曲。設計以有限元素分析檢查彎曲構件與擁擠節點，調整局部加厚與加勁板位置以降低尖峰應力，再以試驗驗證：1:2.5 的彎折桁架與扭曲薄壁箱形構件在清華大學試驗，雙 K 節點與柱頂節點在同濟大學試驗，鋼構廠也以 40 mm 鋼板做了一個足尺節點樣品，檢查焊接可行性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙 K 節點與柱頂節點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Load transfer in the Bird's Nest depends on many nodes where beams, columns and stairs meet at varied angles, so box walls see stress concentrations and local bending at intersections. The design checked curved members and congested nodes with finite-element analysis, adjusting local thickening and stiffener positions to reduce peak stress, then verified them by testing: 1:2.5 elbow trusses and twisted thin-walled boxes at Tsinghua University, double-K nodes and column tops at Tongji University, and a full-scale node mock-up in 40 mm plate built by the steel fabricator to check welding feasibility. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double-K and column-top nodes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：幾何縮尺 1:2.5 的鋼模型若要重現相同應力，荷載須按面積比縮小：F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: To reproduce full-scale stress in a 1:2.5 steel model, loads scale with area: F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「節點只要比桿件強就安全，不需要另外做分析或試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙 K 節點與柱頂節點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Double-K and column-top nodes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗
knowledge.titleEn: Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests
knowledge.text: 鳥巢的傳力依賴大量節點，梁、柱與樓梯在節點處以不同角度匯集，箱形壁板在交會處產生應力集中與局部彎曲。設計以有限元素分析檢查彎曲構件與擁擠節點，調整局部加厚與加勁板位置以降低尖峰應力，再以試驗驗證：1:2.5 的彎折桁架與扭曲薄壁箱形構件在清華大學試驗，雙 K 節點與柱頂節點在同濟大學試驗，鋼構廠也以 40 mm 鋼板做了一個足尺節點樣品，檢查焊接可行性。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：節點只要比桿件強就安全，不需要另外做分析或試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests" is correct?
options: 節點只要比桿件強就安全，不需要另外做分析或試驗。
鳥巢的傳力依賴大量節點，梁、柱與樓梯在節點處以不同角度匯集，箱形壁板在交會處產生應力集中與局部彎曲。
臨時支撐只是施工用，不需要像永久結構一樣計算與檢查。
optionsEn: A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed.
Load transfer in the Bird's Nest depends on many nodes where beams, columns and stairs meet at varied angles, so box walls see stress concentrations and local bending at intersections.
Temporary supports are only for construction and need no calculation or inspection like permanent structure.

quiz.explanationEn: Load transfer in the Bird's Nest depends on many nodes where beams, columns and stairs meet at varied angles, so box walls see stress concentrations and local bending at intersections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙 K 節點與柱頂節點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-K and column-top nodes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：幾何縮尺 1:2.5 的鋼模型若要重現相同應力，荷載須按面積比縮小：F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p。足尺節點設計力 20 MN 時，試驗荷載約 3.2 MN；足尺 40 mm 板在模型中為 40/2.5 = 16 mm。焊縫尺寸與殘餘應力不按比例縮放，是縮尺試驗的主要限制。設計力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: To reproduce full-scale stress in a 1:2.5 steel model, loads scale with area: F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p. A full-scale node force of 20 MN corresponds to a test load of about 3.2 MN, and a 40 mm full-scale plate becomes 40/2.5 = 16 mm in the model. Weld sizes and residual stresses do not scale, the main limitation of scaled tests. The design force is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗前以有限元素模型預測應變分布與極限荷載，在高應力區貼應變花；加載至設計荷載與極限荷載，比較量測應變、變形與破壞模式；若破壞位置與預測不同，須回頭修正模型與加勁配置，而不是只看極限荷載是否夠大。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before testing, predict strain distribution and ultimate load with the finite-element model and place rosettes in high-stress zones; load to design and ultimate levels and compare measured strains, deformations and failure mode; if failure occurs where it was not predicted, revise the model and stiffener layout rather than simply checking that the ultimate load is high enough.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 幾何縮尺 1:2.5 的鋼模型若要重現相同應力，荷載須按面積比縮小：F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p。足尺節點設計力 20 MN 時，試驗荷載約 3.2 MN；足尺 40 mm 板在模型中為 40/2.5 = 16 mm。焊縫尺寸與殘餘應力不按比例縮放，是縮尺試驗的主要限制。設計力為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: To reproduce full-scale stress in a 1:2.5 steel model, loads scale with area: F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p. A full-scale node force of 20 MN corresponds to a test load of about 3.2 MN, and a 40 mm full-scale plate becomes 40/2.5 = 16 mm in the model. Weld sizes and residual stresses do not scale, the main limitation of scaled tests. The design force is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests", which statement holds?
options: 鋼構屋蓋只要強度夠，溫度變化只會造成小變形，不會產生內力。
鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。
幾何縮尺 1:2.5 的鋼模型若要重現相同應力，荷載須按面積比縮小：F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p。
optionsEn: If a steel roof is strong enough, temperature change only causes small movements and no internal forces.
If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion.
To reproduce full-scale stress in a 1:2.5 steel model, loads scale with area: F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p.
quiz.explanation: 幾何縮尺 1:2.5 的鋼模型若要重現相同應力，荷載須按面積比縮小：F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: To reproduce full-scale stress in a 1:2.5 steel model, loads scale with area: F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙 K 節點與柱頂節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Double-K and column-top nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗前以有限元素模型預測應變分布與極限荷載，在高應力區貼應變花；加載至設計荷載與極限荷載，比較量測應變、變形與破壞模式；若破壞位置與預測不同，須回頭修正模型與加勁配置，而不是只看極限荷載是否夠大。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before testing, predict strain distribution and ultimate load with the finite-element model and place rosettes in high-stress zones; load to design and ultimate levels and compare measured strains, deformations and failure mode; if failure occurs where it was not predicted, revise the model and stiffener layout rather than simply checking that the ultimate load is high enough. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：節點設計要同時檢查受力與可焊性：每個加勁板都要有焊接可達的路徑與順序，複雜節點先做足尺樣品評估製造性；試驗報告與修正後的節點圖須由結構設計者簽認後才能大量製造。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Node design must check both force flow and weldability: every stiffener needs an accessible welding path and sequence, and complex nodes should be mocked up at full scale to assess fabrication; test reports and revised node drawings must be signed by the structural designer before production.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：擁擠節點內加勁板過多會讓焊工無法到達根部，形成未熔合與高殘餘應力，反而成為裂縫起點；只用梁單元模型而不做節點細部分析，可能遺漏箱形壁板的局部挫屈或撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Too many stiffeners inside a congested node leave welders unable to reach the root, creating lack of fusion and high residual stress that become crack initiators; using only beam-element models without detailed node analysis can miss local buckling or tearing of box walls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗前以有限元素模型預測應變分布與極限荷載，在高應力區貼應變花；加載至設計荷載與極限荷載，比較量測應變、變形與破壞模式；若破壞位置與預測不同，須回頭修正模型與加勁配置，而不是只看極限荷載是否夠大。
knowledge.textEn: Before testing, predict strain distribution and ultimate load with the finite-element model and place rosettes in high-stress zones; load to design and ultimate levels and compare measured strains, deformations and failure mode; if failure occurs where it was not predicted, revise the model and stiffener layout rather than simply checking that the ultimate load is high enough.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 節點設計要同時檢查受力與可焊性：每個加勁板都要有焊接可達的路徑與順序，複雜節點先做足尺樣品評估製造性；試驗報告與修正後的節點圖須由結構設計者簽認後才能大量製造。
knowledge.textEn: Node design must check both force flow and weldability: every stiffener needs an accessible welding path and sequence, and complex nodes should be mocked up at full scale to assess fabrication; test reports and revised node drawings must be signed by the structural designer before production.

quiz.question: 要驗證「複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests"?
options: 試驗前以有限元素模型預測應變分布與極限荷載，在高應力區貼應變花。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。
optionsEn: Before testing, predict strain distribution and ultimate load with the finite-element model and place rosettes in high-stress zones.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally.
quiz.explanation: 試驗前以有限元素模型預測應變分布與極限荷載，在高應力區貼應變花；加載至設計荷載與極限荷載，比較量測應變、變形與破壞模式；若破壞位置與預測不同，須回頭修正模型與加勁配置，而不是只看極限荷載是否夠大。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before testing, predict strain distribution and ultimate load with the finite-element model and place rosettes in high-stress zones; load to design and ultimate levels and compare measured strains, deformations and failure mode; if failure occurs where it was not predicted, revise the model and stiffener layout rather than simply checking that the ultimate load is high enough. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙 K 節點與柱頂節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Double-K and column-top nodes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 擁擠節點內加勁板過多會讓焊工無法到達根部，形成未熔合與高殘餘應力，反而成為裂縫起點；只用梁單元模型而不做節點細部分析，可能遺漏箱形壁板的局部挫屈或撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Too many stiffeners inside a congested node leave welders unable to reach the root, creating lack of fusion and high residual stress that become crack initiators; using only beam-element models without detailed node analysis can miss local buckling or tearing of box walls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計以有限元素分析檢查彎曲構件與擁擠節點，調整局部加厚與加勁板位置以降低尖峰應力，再以試驗驗證：1:2.5 的彎折桁架與扭曲薄壁箱形構件在清華大學試驗，雙 K 節點與柱頂節點在同濟大學試驗，鋼構廠也以 40 mm 鋼板做了一個足尺節點樣品，檢查焊接可行性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design checked curved members and congested nodes with finite-element analysis, adjusting local thickening and stiffener positions to reduce peak stress, then verified them by testing: 1:2.5 elbow trusses and twisted thin-walled boxes at Tsinghua University, double-K nodes and column tops at Tongji University, and a full-scale node mock-up in 40 mm plate built by the steel fabricator to check welding feasibility.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「節點只要比桿件強就安全，不需要另外做分析或試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 擁擠節點內加勁板過多會讓焊工無法到達根部，形成未熔合與高殘餘應力，反而成為裂縫起點；只用梁單元模型而不做節點細部分析，可能遺漏箱形壁板的局部挫屈或撕裂。
knowledge.textEn: Too many stiffeners inside a congested node leave welders unable to reach the root, creating lack of fusion and high residual stress that become crack initiators; using only beam-element models without detailed node analysis can miss local buckling or tearing of box walls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
擁擠節點內加勁板過多會讓焊工無法到達根部，形成未熔合與高殘餘應力，反而成為裂縫起點；只用梁單元模型而不做節點細部分析，可能遺漏箱形壁板的局部挫屈或撕裂。
臨時支撐只是施工用，不需要像永久結構一樣計算與檢查。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Too many stiffeners inside a congested node leave welders unable to reach the root, creating lack of fusion and high residual stress that become crack initiators.
Temporary supports are only for construction and need no calculation or inspection like permanent structure.
quiz.explanation: 擁擠節點內加勁板過多會讓焊工無法到達根部，形成未熔合與高殘餘應力，反而成為裂縫起點；只用梁單元模型而不做節點細部分析，可能遺漏箱形壁板的局部挫屈或撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too many stiffeners inside a congested node leave welders unable to reach the root, creating lack of fusion and high residual stress that become crack initiators; using only beam-element models without detailed node analysis can miss local buckling or tearing of box walls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分段組裝與臨時支撐胎架」與「卸載：把荷載從胎架轉移到結構」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sectional assembly on temporary falsework" and "Unloading: transferring load from falsework to structure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分段組裝與臨時支撐胎架：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sectional assembly on temporary falsework: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「78 個臨時支撐點」如何影響北京國家體育場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “78 temporary support points” governs force, deformation or durability in “Beijing National Stadium”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主桁架在完成閉合前無法自承，因此依四個階段施工：先立 24 組桁架柱、立面次結構、中間環桁架與分段主桁架並由臨時支撐承托；主桁架分段組裝完成後再移除臨時支撐；接著安裝頂面次結構與立面樓梯；最後安裝天溝、步道、照明與排水。分析中設置 78 個臨時支撐點，每一點的反力與標高都影響桁架對接精度與最終應力狀態。分段大小由吊機能力、運輸限制與焊接位置決定，接口應避開高應力區。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「78 個臨時支撐點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The primary trusses cannot carry themselves until closed, so construction followed four phases: first the 24 column trusses, façade secondary structure, middle ring trusses and primary truss sections on temporary supports; then removal of the temporary supports after the primary trusses were assembled; then the top-surface secondary structure and façade stairs; finally gutters, catwalks, lighting and drainage. The analysis used 78 temporary support points, and the reaction and level at each point affect fit-up accuracy and the final stress state. Section size is set by crane capacity, transport limits and weld locations, with joints placed away from high-stress zones. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “78 temporary support points” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若主桁架與環桁架在卸載前的總重為 30,000 t，平均每個支撐點承托 30,000/78 ≈ 385 t（約 3,770 kN）；考慮分布不均取放大係數 2.0，設計反力約 770 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the primary and ring trusses weigh 30,000 t before unloading, each support point carries on average 30,000/78 ≈ 385 t (about 3,770 kN); with a non-uniformity factor of 2.0 the design reaction is about 770 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨時支撐只是施工用，不需要像永久結構一樣計算與檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Temporary supports are only for construction and need no calculation or inspection like permanent structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「78 個臨時支撐點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “78 temporary support points”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分段組裝與臨時支撐胎架
