workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算懸臂箱梁提升所需的鋼絞線數與提升時間。提升件為一對約 80 m 長的箱梁，假設重 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。選用 15.7 mm 鋼絞線，最小破斷力 279 kN，要求安全係數 2.5：所需根數 n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根，以 4 台千斤頂分配每台 28 根。提升高度 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間 t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h。若高空風速 15 m/s，箱梁迎風面 80 m × 10 m、阻力係數 2.0，橫向風力約 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN，約為吊重的 1.8%，鋼絞線偏角約 atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°。若安全係數改為 3.0，需約 134 根，每台 34 根；若風速增為 20 m/s，風力約 392 kN，偏角約 1.8°。所有數值為教學假設，不代表濱海灣金沙的實際提升設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the strands and lifting time for the cantilever box-girder lift. The load is a pair of box girders about 80 m long, assumed to weigh 1,270 t, F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. Using 15.7 mm strand with a 279 kN minimum breaking load and a safety factor of 2.5, the number of strands is n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112, or 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting. At a wind speed of 15 m/s at height, with an 80 m × 10 m frontal area and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is about 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN, about 1.8% of the weight, giving a strand inclination of about atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°. A safety factor of 3.0 needs about 134 strands, 34 per jack; a 20 m/s wind gives about 392 kN and an inclination of about 1.8°. All values are teaching assumptions, not the actual lifting design at Marina Bay Sands.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」與「懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A platform spanning three independent towers" and "Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三塔相對變位」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative movement of three towers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。若把平台與三塔剛接，塔樓的相對位移會在平台中產生巨大附加內力，也會把一座塔的側向力拉到另一座塔。因此平台在各塔頂以斜撐與可滑動支承落座，塔與塔之間的跨段設伸縮接縫，讓每座塔可獨立變位，平台只傳遞重力與必要的水平約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三塔相對變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep; published accounts state that each tower can move about 250 mm from centre. Rigidly connecting the platform to all three would induce large additional forces in the platform from relative tower movement and pull lateral load from one tower into another. The platform therefore sits on raking struts and sliding bearings at each tower top, with movement joints in the spans between towers, so that each tower moves independently and the platform transfers gravity and only the necessary horizontal restraint. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Relative movement of three towers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三塔相對變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Relative movement of three towers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台
knowledge.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers
knowledge.text: 空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。若把平台與三塔剛接，塔樓的相對位移會在平台中產生巨大附加內力，也會把一座塔的側向力拉到另一座塔。
knowledge.textEn: The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep; published accounts state that each tower can move about 250 mm from centre. Rigidly connecting the platform to all three would induce large additional forces in the platform from relative tower movement and pull lateral load from one tower into another.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A platform spanning three independent towers" is correct?
options: 三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。
空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。
鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。
optionsEn: All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest.
The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep.
If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration.
quiz.explanation: 空中花園坐在三座 55 層鋼筋混凝土塔樓頂上，每座塔在風、溫度與混凝土徐變下各自擺動，公開資料指出每座塔可由中心偏移約 250 mm。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The SkyPark sits on three 55-storey reinforced-concrete towers, each swaying on its own under wind, temperature and concrete creep; published accounts state that each tower can move about 250 mm from centre. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三塔相對變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative movement of three towers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。另計鋼平台本身溫度變形：α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、L = 340 m、ΔT = 20°C，ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm。接縫與支承須同時容納兩者。溫差與兩塔反相假設為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm. The steel platform's own thermal movement adds ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm for α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, L = 340 m and ΔT = 20°C. Joints and bearings must accommodate both. The temperature range and out-of-phase sway are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel; confirm that, under bearing friction and the worst combination, the platform does not transfer significant horizontal force from one tower to another.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。另計鋼平台本身溫度變形：α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、L = 340 m、ΔT = 20°C，ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm。接縫與支承須同時容納兩者。溫差與兩塔反相假設為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm. The steel platform's own thermal movement adds ΔL = αLΔT ≈ 82 mm for α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, L = 340 m and ΔT = 20°C. Joints and bearings must accommodate both. The temperature range and out-of-phase sway are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "A platform spanning three independent towers", which statement holds?
options: 滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。
混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。
兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。
optionsEn: Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position.
If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm.
quiz.explanation: 兩座相鄰塔若反向擺動，各偏移 250 mm，接縫處的相對位移最大約 250 + 250 = 500 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If two adjacent towers sway in opposite directions by 250 mm each, the relative movement at the joint is at most about 250 + 250 = 500 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三塔相對變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative movement of three towers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel; confirm that, under bearing friction and the worst combination, the platform does not transfer significant horizontal force from one tower to another. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接縫與支承的設計行程要列出各分量（風、溫度、徐變、施工誤差）與組合方式，並在圖說上標示每個支承的約束方向；任何後續在平台上增設的固定物都不得跨越接縫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State the design travel of joints and bearings by component (wind, temperature, creep, construction tolerance) and combination method, and mark the restrained directions of each bearing on the drawings; nothing added to the platform later may bridge across a joint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若接縫行程只按溫度設計而忽略塔樓反向擺動與徐變，強風時接縫頂死，平台受壓挫屈或把支承螺栓剪斷；反之若接縫過鬆而無止擋，極端風況下平台可能從支承滑脫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing joint travel only for temperature and ignoring opposite tower sway and creep lets joints close solid in strong wind, buckling the platform in compression or shearing bearing bolts; conversely, over-generous joints without stops could let the platform slide off its bearings in extreme wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。
knowledge.textEn: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel; confirm that, under bearing friction and the worst combination, the platform does not transfer significant horizontal force from one tower to another.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接縫與支承的設計行程要列出各分量（風、溫度、徐變、施工誤差）與組合方式，並在圖說上標示每個支承的約束方向；任何後續在平台上增設的固定物都不得跨越接縫。
knowledge.textEn: State the design travel of joints and bearings by component (wind, temperature, creep, construction tolerance) and combination method, and mark the restrained directions of each bearing on the drawings; nothing added to the platform later may bridge across a joint.

quiz.question: 要驗證「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A platform spanning three independent towers"?
options: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。
optionsEn: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once a damper is installed it is certainly effective, so no crowd test is needed.
quiz.explanation: 以整體模型組合三塔在風、溫度與長期徐變下的位移時程，計算每個接縫與支承的最大開合量與轉角，並與支承及接縫的設計行程比較；確認在支承摩擦與最不利組合下，平台不會把一座塔的水平力大量傳到另一座塔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine the three towers' displacement histories under wind, temperature and long-term creep in a global model, compute the maximum opening, closing and rotation at each joint and bearing, and compare with their design travel; confirm that, under bearing friction and the worst combination, the platform does not transfer significant horizontal force from one tower to another. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A platform spanning three independent towers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三塔相對變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative movement of three towers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若接縫行程只按溫度設計而忽略塔樓反向擺動與徐變，強風時接縫頂死，平台受壓挫屈或把支承螺栓剪斷；反之若接縫過鬆而無止擋，極端風況下平台可能從支承滑脫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing joint travel only for temperature and ignoring opposite tower sway and creep lets joints close solid in strong wind, buckling the platform in compression or shearing bearing bolts; conversely, over-generous joints without stops could let the platform slide off its bearings in extreme wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此平台在各塔頂以斜撐與可滑動支承落座，塔與塔之間的跨段設伸縮接縫，讓每座塔可獨立變位，平台只傳遞重力與必要的水平約束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The platform therefore sits on raking struts and sliding bearings at each tower top, with movement joints in the spans between towers, so that each tower moves independently and the platform transfers gravity and only the necessary horizontal restraint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若接縫行程只按溫度設計而忽略塔樓反向擺動與徐變，強風時接縫頂死，平台受壓挫屈或把支承螺栓剪斷；反之若接縫過鬆而無止擋，極端風況下平台可能從支承滑脫。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing joint travel only for temperature and ignoring opposite tower sway and creep lets joints close solid in strong wind, buckling the platform in compression or shearing bearing bolts; conversely, over-generous joints without stops could let the platform slide off its bearings in extreme wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A platform spanning three independent towers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若接縫行程只按溫度設計而忽略塔樓反向擺動與徐變，強風時接縫頂死，平台受壓挫屈或把支承螺栓剪斷；反之若接縫過鬆而無止擋，極端風況下平台可能從支承滑脫。
鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Sizing joint travel only for temperature and ignoring opposite tower sway and creep lets joints close solid in strong wind, buckling the platform in compression or shearing bearing bolts.
If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration.
quiz.explanation: 若接縫行程只按溫度設計而忽略塔樓反向擺動與徐變，強風時接縫頂死，平台受壓挫屈或把支承螺栓剪斷；反之若接縫過鬆而無止擋，極端風況下平台可能從支承滑脫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing joint travel only for temperature and ignoring opposite tower sway and creep lets joints close solid in strong wind, buckling the platform in compression or shearing bearing bolts; conversely, over-generous joints without stops could let the platform slide off its bearings in extreme wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「66.5 m 懸臂端」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “66.5 m cantilever tip” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平台在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m，由一對約 80 m 長的鋼箱梁構成，是遊客聚集觀景的位置。長懸臂勁度有限，靜載撓度大時，其豎向自然頻率會落入人行（約 1.6 至 2.4 Hz）或跳躍、跑動的激振範圍，群眾同步活動可能引起明顯振動。設計除了以預拱抵消自重撓度，還在懸臂端的腹部內藏一組約 4.5 t 的調諧質量阻尼器，專門處理人群活動引起的振動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「66.5 m 懸臂端」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The platform cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower on a pair of steel box girders about 80 m long, the spot where visitors gather for the view. A long cantilever has limited stiffness; when its static deflection is large, its vertical natural frequency falls into the range excited by walking (about 1.6 to 2.4 Hz) or by jumping and running, and synchronised crowd activity can produce noticeable vibration. Besides pre-cambering against self-weight deflection, the design hides a tuned mass damper of about 4.5 t in the belly of the cantilever tip specifically for crowd-induced vibration. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “66.5 m cantilever tip” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以單自由度粗估 f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ)，δ 為等效靜撓度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A single-degree-of-freedom estimate gives f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ) with δ the equivalent static deflection.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「66.5 m 懸臂端」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “66.5 m cantilever tip”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動
knowledge.titleEn: Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration
knowledge.text: 平台在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m，由一對約 80 m 長的鋼箱梁構成，是遊客聚集觀景的位置。長懸臂勁度有限，靜載撓度大時，其豎向自然頻率會落入人行（約 1.6 至 2.4 Hz）或跳躍、跑動的激振範圍，群眾同步活動可能引起明顯振動。
knowledge.textEn: The platform cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower on a pair of steel box girders about 80 m long, the spot where visitors gather for the view. A long cantilever has limited stiffness; when its static deflection is large, its vertical natural frequency falls into the range excited by walking (about 1.6 to 2.4 Hz) or by jumping and running, and synchronised crowd activity can produce noticeable vibration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration" is correct?
options: 鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。
鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。
平台在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m，由一對約 80 m 長的鋼箱梁構成，是遊客聚集觀景的位置。
optionsEn: If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration.
A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
The platform cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower on a pair of steel box girders about 80 m long, the spot where visitors gather for the view.
quiz.explanation: 平台在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m，由一對約 80 m 長的鋼箱梁構成，是遊客聚集觀景的位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The platform cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower on a pair of steel box girders about 80 m long, the spot where visitors gather for the view. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「66.5 m 懸臂端」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “66.5 m cantilever tip” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以單自由度粗估 f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ)，δ 為等效靜撓度。若 δ = 60 mm，f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz，正落在步行頻率範圍；若加大勁度使 δ = 30 mm，f ≈ 2.9 Hz，已高於多數步行頻率，但仍可能被跳躍激發。撓度值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A single-degree-of-freedom estimate gives f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ) with δ the equivalent static deflection. With δ = 60 mm, f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz, right in the walking range; stiffening to δ = 30 mm gives f ≈ 2.9 Hz, above most walking frequencies but still excitable by jumping. The deflections are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型求懸臂的豎向與扭轉模態，並以人群荷載模型（步行、跑動、跳躍）做時程分析，預測尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計量測環境振動與人群試驗，確認頻率與阻尼和預測相符，加速度低於設計舒適度門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute vertical and torsional modes of the cantilever with a finite-element model and run time-history analyses with crowd load models for walking, running and jumping to predict peak acceleration; after completion measure ambient vibration and crowd tests with accelerometers to confirm that frequency and damping match prediction and accelerations stay below the design comfort limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以單自由度粗估 f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ)，δ 為等效靜撓度。若 δ = 60 mm，f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz，正落在步行頻率範圍；若加大勁度使 δ = 30 mm，f ≈ 2.9 Hz，已高於多數步行頻率，但仍可能被跳躍激發。撓度值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A single-degree-of-freedom estimate gives f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ) with δ the equivalent static deflection. With δ = 60 mm, f = (1/2π)·√(9.81/0.06) ≈ 2.0 Hz, right in the walking range; stiffening to δ = 30 mm gives f ≈ 2.9 Hz, above most walking frequencies but still excitable by jumping. The deflections are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration", which statement holds?
options: 以單自由度粗估 f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ)，δ 為等效靜撓度。
鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。
千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。
optionsEn: A single-degree-of-freedom estimate gives f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ) with δ the equivalent static deflection.
Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity.
If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded.
quiz.explanation: 以單自由度粗估 f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ)，δ 為等效靜撓度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A single-degree-of-freedom estimate gives f ≈ (1/2π)·√(g/δ) with δ the equivalent static deflection. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「66.5 m 懸臂端」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “66.5 m cantilever tip” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型求懸臂的豎向與扭轉模態，並以人群荷載模型（步行、跑動、跳躍）做時程分析，預測尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計量測環境振動與人群試驗，確認頻率與阻尼和預測相符，加速度低於設計舒適度門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute vertical and torsional modes of the cantilever with a finite-element model and run time-history analyses with crowd load models for walking, running and jumping to predict peak acceleration; after completion measure ambient vibration and crowd tests with accelerometers to confirm that frequency and damping match prediction and accelerations stay below the design comfort limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：觀景平台與懸臂的設計基準應明列人群活動情境、使用人數與加速度限值，並預留阻尼器的安裝空間與檢修通道；營運單位舉辦大型活動前，須依結構顧問提供的人數與活動類型限制核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis of viewing platforms and cantilevers should list crowd scenarios, occupancy and acceleration limits and reserve space and access for dampers; before large events the operator must approve them against the occupancy and activity limits given by the structural consultant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只檢核強度與靜撓度，懸臂可能在活動或派對時被群眾同步跳動激起共振，地板明顯晃動引起恐慌；倫敦千禧橋 2000 年開放時的側向晃動，就是人行激振被低估的著名例子。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only strength and static deflection can leave a cantilever that resonates when a crowd jumps in time at an event, the floor visibly bouncing and causing alarm; the lateral sway of London's Millennium Bridge on opening in 2000 is a famous case of underestimated pedestrian excitation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素模型求懸臂的豎向與扭轉模態，並以人群荷載模型（步行、跑動、跳躍）做時程分析，預測尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計量測環境振動與人群試驗，確認頻率與阻尼和預測相符，加速度低於設計舒適度門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Compute vertical and torsional modes of the cantilever with a finite-element model and run time-history analyses with crowd load models for walking, running and jumping to predict peak acceleration; after completion measure ambient vibration and crowd tests with accelerometers to confirm that frequency and damping match prediction and accelerations stay below the design comfort limit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 觀景平台與懸臂的設計基準應明列人群活動情境、使用人數與加速度限值，並預留阻尼器的安裝空間與檢修通道；營運單位舉辦大型活動前，須依結構顧問提供的人數與活動類型限制核准。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis of viewing platforms and cantilevers should list crowd scenarios, occupancy and acceleration limits and reserve space and access for dampers; before large events the operator must approve them against the occupancy and activity limits given by the structural consultant.

quiz.question: 要驗證「懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以有限元素模型求懸臂的豎向與扭轉模態，並以人群荷載模型（步行、跑動、跳躍）做時程分析，預測尖峰加速度。
泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compute vertical and torsional modes of the cantilever with a finite-element model and run time-history analyses with crowd load models for walking, running and jumping to predict peak acceleration.
The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素模型求懸臂的豎向與扭轉模態，並以人群荷載模型（步行、跑動、跳躍）做時程分析，預測尖峰加速度；完工後以加速度計量測環境振動與人群試驗，確認頻率與阻尼和預測相符，加速度低於設計舒適度門檻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute vertical and torsional modes of the cantilever with a finite-element model and run time-history analyses with crowd load models for walking, running and jumping to predict peak acceleration; after completion measure ambient vibration and crowd tests with accelerometers to confirm that frequency and damping match prediction and accelerations stay below the design comfort limit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「66.5 m 懸臂端」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “66.5 m cantilever tip” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只檢核強度與靜撓度，懸臂可能在活動或派對時被群眾同步跳動激起共振，地板明顯晃動引起恐慌；倫敦千禧橋 2000 年開放時的側向晃動，就是人行激振被低估的著名例子。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only strength and static deflection can leave a cantilever that resonates when a crowd jumps in time at an event, the floor visibly bouncing and causing alarm; the lateral sway of London's Millennium Bridge on opening in 2000 is a famous case of underestimated pedestrian excitation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計除了以預拱抵消自重撓度，還在懸臂端的腹部內藏一組約 4.5 t 的調諧質量阻尼器，專門處理人群活動引起的振動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Besides pre-cambering against self-weight deflection, the design hides a tuned mass damper of about 4.5 t in the belly of the cantilever tip specifically for crowd-induced vibration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只檢核強度與靜撓度，懸臂可能在活動或派對時被群眾同步跳動激起共振，地板明顯晃動引起恐慌；倫敦千禧橋 2000 年開放時的側向晃動，就是人行激振被低估的著名例子。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only strength and static deflection can leave a cantilever that resonates when a crowd jumps in time at an event, the floor visibly bouncing and causing alarm; the lateral sway of London's Millennium Bridge on opening in 2000 is a famous case of underestimated pedestrian excitation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「懸臂撓度、頻率與人致振動」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cantilever deflection, frequency and crowd-induced vibration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。
若只檢核強度與靜撓度，懸臂可能在活動或派對時被群眾同步跳動激起共振，地板明顯晃動引起恐慌。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
Checking only strength and static deflection can leave a cantilever that resonates when a crowd jumps in time at an event, the floor visibly bouncing and causing alarm.
quiz.explanation: 若只檢核強度與靜撓度，懸臂可能在活動或派對時被群眾同步跳動激起共振，地板明顯晃動引起恐慌；倫敦千禧橋 2000 年開放時的側向晃動，就是人行激振被低估的著名例子。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only strength and static deflection can leave a cantilever that resonates when a crowd jumps in time at an event, the floor visibly bouncing and causing alarm; the lateral sway of London's Millennium Bridge on opening in 2000 is a famous case of underestimated pedestrian excitation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力」與「塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning" and "Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平台的主承重構件是約 10 m 深、3.7 m 寬的鋼箱梁，公開資料記載側壁厚約 35 mm、翼板約 60 mm，並配合後拉預力。深箱梁以高抗彎與抗扭勁度承擔長跨與懸臂，封閉斷面也讓偏心的人群與風荷載不致造成過大扭轉。後拉預力可以在吊裝完成後調整箱梁內力與撓度，抵消部分自重造成的上翼板拉力。跨越塔與塔之間的區段則由每段三榀約 400 噸的巨型桁架組成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The platform's main members are steel box girders about 10 m deep and 3.7 m wide; published data give side walls about 35 mm and flanges about 60 mm thick, combined with post-tensioning. Deep boxes carry the long spans and cantilever with high bending and torsional stiffness, and the closed section keeps eccentric crowd and wind loads from causing excessive twist. Post-tensioning lets engineers adjust girder forces and deflection after erection, offsetting part of the top-flange tension from self-weight. The spans between towers use three mega-trusses of about 400 tons in each bridging section. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力
knowledge.text: 平台的主承重構件是約 10 m 深、3.7 m 寬的鋼箱梁，公開資料記載側壁厚約 35 mm、翼板約 60 mm，並配合後拉預力。深箱梁以高抗彎與抗扭勁度承擔長跨與懸臂，封閉斷面也讓偏心的人群與風荷載不致造成過大扭轉。
knowledge.textEn: The platform's main members are steel box girders about 10 m deep and 3.7 m wide; published data give side walls about 35 mm and flanges about 60 mm thick, combined with post-tensioning. Deep boxes carry the long spans and cantilever with high bending and torsional stiffness, and the closed section keeps eccentric crowd and wind loads from causing excessive twist.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning" is correct?
options: 平台的主承重構件是約 10 m 深、3.7 m 寬的鋼箱梁，公開資料記載側壁厚約 35 mm、翼板約 60 mm，並配合後拉預力。
鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。
滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。
optionsEn: The platform's main members are steel box girders about 10 m deep and 3.7 m wide.
A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 平台的主承重構件是約 10 m 深、3.7 m 寬的鋼箱梁，公開資料記載側壁厚約 35 mm、翼板約 60 mm，並配合後拉預力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The platform's main members are steel box girders about 10 m deep and 3.7 m wide; published data give side walls about 35 mm and flanges about 60 mm thick, combined with post-tensioning. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單根箱梁慣性矩 I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴，斷面模數 Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³。若懸臂兩根箱梁共承受 w = 120 kN/m，根部彎矩 M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m，每根 132,700 kN·m，翼板應力 σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa。荷載為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³. If the two cantilever girders together carry w = 120 kN/m, the root moment is M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m, 132,700 kN·m per girder, giving a flange stress σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa. The load is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³. If the two cantilever girders together carry w = 120 kN/m, the root moment is M = wL²/2 = 120×66.5²/2 ≈ 265,000 kN·m, 132,700 kN·m per girder, giving a flange stress σ = M/Z ≈ 39.5 MPa. The load is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。
阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。
optionsEn: A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position.
Once a damper is installed it is certainly effective, so no crowd test is needed.
quiz.explanationEn: One box girder has I ≈ 2×(3.7×0.06)×4.97² + 2×(0.035×10³/12) ≈ 10.97 + 5.83 ≈ 16.8 m⁴ and Z = I/5 ≈ 3.36 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：箱梁圖說應標示人孔、檢修步道、通風或除濕設備與排水孔位置；後拉預力的錨具應設計為可檢查、必要時可重新張拉，張拉紀錄與標高量測一起歸檔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Box-girder drawings should show manholes, inspection walkways, ventilation or dehumidification and drain holes; post-tensioning anchorages should be inspectable and re-stressable if needed, with stressing records filed together with level surveys.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding box girders at height in wind and rain without shelter risks hydrogen cracking from inadequate preheat; insufficient stiffening of the local bearing zone at post-tensioning anchorages can buckle the web during stressing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。
knowledge.textEn: Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 箱梁圖說應標示人孔、檢修步道、通風或除濕設備與排水孔位置；後拉預力的錨具應設計為可檢查、必要時可重新張拉，張拉紀錄與標高量測一起歸檔。
knowledge.textEn: Box-girder drawings should show manholes, inspection walkways, ventilation or dehumidification and drain holes; post-tensioning anchorages should be inspectable and re-stressable if needed, with stressing records filed together with level surveys.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。
鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep.
Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location.
quiz.explanation: 鋼板依厚度與部位做材質證明、超音波夾層檢查與焊縫非破壞檢測；預力張拉以壓力與伸長雙控，並在張拉前後量測懸臂端標高，確認預拱與撓度變化符合計算；箱梁內部設置檢修通道與除濕或通風，交接前檢查內部塗裝。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check plates by mill certificate, ultrasonic lamination testing and weld non-destructive testing according to thickness and location; control post-tensioning by pressure and elongation, and survey the cantilever tip level before and after stressing to confirm that camber and deflection change match calculation; provide internal access and dehumidification or ventilation in the boxes and inspect internal coatings before handover. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「10 m 深後拉鋼箱梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “10 m deep post-tensioned box girders” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。箱梁內部若無通風檢修，熱帶潮濕空氣凝結，內壁腐蝕長年不被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding box girders at height in wind and rain without shelter risks hydrogen cracking from inadequate preheat; insufficient stiffening of the local bearing zone at post-tensioning anchorages can buckle the web during stressing. Without ventilation and access inside the boxes, condensation from humid tropical air corrodes inner walls unnoticed for years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：跨越塔與塔之間的區段則由每段三榀約 400 噸的巨型桁架組成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The spans between towers use three mega-trusses of about 400 tons in each bridging section.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。箱梁內部若無通風檢修，熱帶潮濕空氣凝結，內壁腐蝕長年不被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Welding box girders at height in wind and rain without shelter risks hydrogen cracking from inadequate preheat; insufficient stiffening of the local bearing zone at post-tensioning anchorages can buckle the web during stressing. Without ventilation and access inside the boxes, condensation from humid tropical air corrodes inner walls unnoticed for years.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼箱梁斷面與後拉預力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel box-girder sections and post-tensioning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。
optionsEn: Welding box girders at height in wind and rain without shelter risks hydrogen cracking from inadequate preheat.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 高空箱梁焊接若在風雨中施作而沒有遮蔽，預熱不足會造成氫致裂紋；預力錨具附近的局部承壓區加勁不足，張拉時腹板局部挫屈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Welding box girders at height in wind and rain without shelter risks hydrogen cracking from inadequate preheat; insufficient stiffening of the local bearing zone at post-tensioning anchorages can buckle the web during stressing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平台跨越各塔的區段以傾斜的鋼 V 形斜撐落在塔頂剪力牆上方，把重力集中傳入塔樓核心牆。在塔與塔之間的跨段端部，使用鋁板與不鏽鋼滑板組成的多向支承，讓平台能相對塔樓自由滑動與轉動，同時傳遞豎向反力。滑動面的摩擦係數決定了塔樓擺動時傳入平台的水平力，因此支承材料、表面光潔度與防塵防水細部，直接影響平台的受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Where the platform passes over each tower it lands on raking steel V-struts above the tower's shear walls, concentrating gravity into the core walls. At the ends of the spans between towers, multidirectional bearings with aluminium and stainless-steel sliding plates let the platform slide and rotate relative to the towers while carrying vertical reactions. The friction coefficient of the sliding surfaces sets the horizontal force fed into the platform when towers sway, so bearing materials, surface finish and dust and water protection directly affect platform forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN；若滑動面因污染或腐蝕卡滯使 μ 升到 0.2，F = 2,000 kN，約為原值的 6.7 倍，會以設計外的水平力推動平台與斜撐。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN; if contamination or corrosion makes the surface stick with μ = 0.2, F = 2,000 kN, about 6.7 times larger, pushing the platform and struts with horizontal force outside the design.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部
knowledge.text: 平台跨越各塔的區段以傾斜的鋼 V 形斜撐落在塔頂剪力牆上方，把重力集中傳入塔樓核心牆。在塔與塔之間的跨段端部，使用鋁板與不鏽鋼滑板組成的多向支承，讓平台能相對塔樓自由滑動與轉動，同時傳遞豎向反力。
knowledge.textEn: Where the platform passes over each tower it lands on raking steel V-struts above the tower's shear walls, concentrating gravity into the core walls. At the ends of the spans between towers, multidirectional bearings with aluminium and stainless-steel sliding plates let the platform slide and rotate relative to the towers while carrying vertical reactions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details" is correct?
options: 滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。
平台跨越各塔的區段以傾斜的鋼 V 形斜撐落在塔頂剪力牆上方，把重力集中傳入塔樓核心牆。
鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。
optionsEn: Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
Where the platform passes over each tower it lands on raking steel V-struts above the tower's shear walls, concentrating gravity into the core walls.
Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity.
quiz.explanation: 平台跨越各塔的區段以傾斜的鋼 V 形斜撐落在塔頂剪力牆上方，把重力集中傳入塔樓核心牆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Where the platform passes over each tower it lands on raking steel V-struts above the tower's shear walls, concentrating gravity into the core walls. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN；若滑動面因污染或腐蝕卡滯使 μ 升到 0.2，F = 2,000 kN，約為原值的 6.7 倍，會以設計外的水平力推動平台與斜撐。反力與摩擦係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN; if contamination or corrosion makes the surface stick with μ = 0.2, F = 2,000 kN, about 6.7 times larger, pushing the platform and struts with horizontal force outside the design. Reaction and friction coefficients are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較；安裝時量測支承水平度、預設偏移量與當時溫度，確認滑板中心位置符合安裝溫度下的設計值；使用期間定期量測支承滑移量並檢查防塵罩與排水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification; at installation survey bearing levelness, preset offset and ambient temperature to confirm the sliding plate is centred for the installation temperature; in service measure bearing travel periodically and inspect dust covers and drainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN；若滑動面因污染或腐蝕卡滯使 μ 升到 0.2，F = 2,000 kN，約為原值的 6.7 倍，會以設計外的水平力推動平台與斜撐。反力與摩擦係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN; if contamination or corrosion makes the surface stick with μ = 0.2, F = 2,000 kN, about 6.7 times larger, pushing the platform and struts with horizontal force outside the design. Reaction and friction coefficients are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details", which statement holds?
options: 千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。
泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。
支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN。
optionsEn: If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded.
The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design.
With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN.
quiz.explanation: 支承豎向反力 N = 10,000 kN，滑動面摩擦係數 μ = 0.03 時，水平摩擦力 F = μN = 300 kN；若滑動面因污染或腐蝕卡滯使 μ 升到 0.2，F = 2,000 kN，約為原值的 6.7 倍，會以設計外的水平力推動平台與斜撐。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a vertical bearing reaction N = 10,000 kN and a sliding-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.03, the horizontal friction force is F = μN = 300 kN; if contamination or corrosion makes the surface stick with μ = 0.2, F = 2,000 kN, about 6.7 times larger, pushing the platform and struts with horizontal force outside the design. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較；安裝時量測支承水平度、預設偏移量與當時溫度，確認滑板中心位置符合安裝溫度下的設計值；使用期間定期量測支承滑移量並檢查防塵罩與排水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification; at installation survey bearing levelness, preset offset and ambient temperature to confirm the sliding plate is centred for the installation temperature; in service measure bearing travel periodically and inspect dust covers and drainage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個支承應有標示牌與行程刻度，安裝紀錄記下溫度與偏移；維護計畫列明清潔、檢查與更換週期，支承更換所需的頂升點與臨時支撐在設計階段就要預留。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Each bearing should have a tag and a travel scale, with installation records stating temperature and offset; the maintenance plan should list cleaning, inspection and replacement intervals, and jacking points and temporary supports needed for bearing replacement should be provided at design stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：安裝時未依溫度設定預設偏移，滑板一側行程不足，塔樓擺動或高溫時支承頂到端部止擋；滑動面積水、鹽分與灰塵造成磨損或腐蝕，摩擦升高後平台與斜撐承受設計外的水平力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a temperature-based preset offset at installation, one side of the sliding plate runs out of travel and the bearing hits its end stop when towers sway or it gets hot; water, salt and dust on the sliding surface cause wear or corrosion, and the raised friction subjects platform and struts to unplanned horizontal force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較；安裝時量測支承水平度、預設偏移量與當時溫度，確認滑板中心位置符合安裝溫度下的設計值；使用期間定期量測支承滑移量並檢查防塵罩與排水。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification; at installation survey bearing levelness, preset offset and ambient temperature to confirm the sliding plate is centred for the installation temperature; in service measure bearing travel periodically and inspect dust covers and drainage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每個支承應有標示牌與行程刻度，安裝紀錄記下溫度與偏移；維護計畫列明清潔、檢查與更換週期，支承更換所需的頂升點與臨時支撐在設計階段就要預留。
knowledge.textEn: Each bearing should have a tag and a travel scale, with installation records stating temperature and offset; the maintenance plan should list cleaning, inspection and replacement intervals, and jacking points and temporary supports needed for bearing replacement should be provided at design stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details"?
options: 支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。
optionsEn: Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest.
quiz.explanation: 支承出廠前做摩擦係數、豎向承載與轉角試驗，與規格比較；安裝時量測支承水平度、預設偏移量與當時溫度，確認滑板中心位置符合安裝溫度下的設計值；使用期間定期量測支承滑移量並檢查防塵罩與排水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery test bearings for friction coefficient, vertical capacity and rotation against the specification; at installation survey bearing levelness, preset offset and ambient temperature to confirm the sliding plate is centred for the installation temperature; in service measure bearing travel periodically and inspect dust covers and drainage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 安裝時未依溫度設定預設偏移，滑板一側行程不足，塔樓擺動或高溫時支承頂到端部止擋；滑動面積水、鹽分與灰塵造成磨損或腐蝕，摩擦升高後平台與斜撐承受設計外的水平力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a temperature-based preset offset at installation, one side of the sliding plate runs out of travel and the bearing hits its end stop when towers sway or it gets hot; water, salt and dust on the sliding surface cause wear or corrosion, and the raised friction subjects platform and struts to unplanned horizontal force. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：滑動面的摩擦係數決定了塔樓擺動時傳入平台的水平力，因此支承材料、表面光潔度與防塵防水細部，直接影響平台的受力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The friction coefficient of the sliding surfaces sets the horizontal force fed into the platform when towers sway, so bearing materials, surface finish and dust and water protection directly affect platform forces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 安裝時未依溫度設定預設偏移，滑板一側行程不足，塔樓擺動或高溫時支承頂到端部止擋；滑動面積水、鹽分與灰塵造成磨損或腐蝕，摩擦升高後平台與斜撐承受設計外的水平力。
knowledge.textEn: Without a temperature-based preset offset at installation, one side of the sliding plate runs out of travel and the bearing hits its end stop when towers sway or it gets hot; water, salt and dust on the sliding surface cause wear or corrosion, and the raised friction subjects platform and struts to unplanned horizontal force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塔頂斜撐與滑動支承細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rooftop struts and sliding-bearing details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
安裝時未依溫度設定預設偏移，滑板一側行程不足，塔樓擺動或高溫時支承頂到端部止擋；滑動面積水、鹽分與灰塵造成磨損或腐蝕，摩擦升高後平台與斜撐承受設計外的水平力。
鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without a temperature-based preset offset at installation, one side of the sliding plate runs out of travel and the bearing hits its end stop when towers sway or it gets hot.
Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity.
quiz.explanation: 安裝時未依溫度設定預設偏移，滑板一側行程不足，塔樓擺動或高溫時支承頂到端部止擋；滑動面積水、鹽分與灰塵造成磨損或腐蝕，摩擦升高後平台與斜撐承受設計外的水平力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a temperature-based preset offset at installation, one side of the sliding plate runs out of travel and the bearing hits its end stop when towers sway or it gets hot; water, salt and dust on the sliding surface cause wear or corrosion, and the raised friction subjects platform and struts to unplanned horizontal force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空」與「斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strand-jack lifting to 200 m" and "Construction-stage control of the leaning towers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack lifting to 200 m: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1,270 t girder lift” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平台在地面或低處分成 14 個主要預製段，再以鋼絞線千斤頂吊上塔頂；最大一次提升是構成懸臂的一對約 80 m 長箱梁，重約 1,270 t，提升速度約每小時 14 m，耗時超過 16 小時。鋼絞線千斤頂以上下夾片交替夾持鋼絞線，像爬繩一樣一個行程一個行程地拉升重物，多台千斤頂由電腦同步控制。懸臂段另以可移動的門架安裝。整個工程用了約 4,000 t 臨時鋼結構，約為永久鋼結構 7,000 t 的一半以上。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The platform was prefabricated in 14 main segments and raised to the tower tops by strand jacks; the largest lift was the pair of box girders about 80 m long that form the cantilever, weighing about 1,270 t, raised at about 14 m per hour over more than 16 hours. A strand jack grips the strands alternately with upper and lower wedge anchors and climbs them stroke by stroke like a rope climber, with several jacks synchronised by computer. Cantilever segments were also placed with a movable gantry. The job used about 4,000 t of temporary steelwork, more than half of the 7,000 t of permanent steel. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1,270 t girder lift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The lift of 1,270 t is F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空
knowledge.text: 平台在地面或低處分成 14 個主要預製段，再以鋼絞線千斤頂吊上塔頂；最大一次提升是構成懸臂的一對約 80 m 長箱梁，重約 1,270 t，提升速度約每小時 14 m，耗時超過 16 小時。鋼絞線千斤頂以上下夾片交替夾持鋼絞線，像爬繩一樣一個行程一個行程地拉升重物，多台千斤頂由電腦同步控制。
knowledge.textEn: The platform was prefabricated in 14 main segments and raised to the tower tops by strand jacks; the largest lift was the pair of box girders about 80 m long that form the cantilever, weighing about 1,270 t, raised at about 14 m per hour over more than 16 hours. A strand jack grips the strands alternately with upper and lower wedge anchors and climbs them stroke by stroke like a rope climber, with several jacks synchronised by computer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

optionsEn: Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity.
A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position.
The platform was prefabricated in 14 main segments and raised to the tower tops by strand jacks.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack lifting to 200 m: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1,270 t girder lift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：提升重量 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。若每根 15.7 mm 鋼絞線最小破斷力 279 kN、要求安全係數 2.5，需 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根鋼絞線，分配到 4 台千斤頂每台約 28 根。提升 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間約 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h，加上停檢與對位即超過 16 小時。鋼絞線規格與安全係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The lift of 1,270 t is F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. With 15.7 mm strands of 279 kN minimum breaking load and a required safety factor of 2.5, about 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 strands are needed, about 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes about 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting, exceeding 16 hours with hold checks and final alignment. Strand size and safety factor are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：提升前完成千斤頂、鋼絞線、錨具與塔頂臨時提升架的設計核算與荷載試驗，並做離地試吊（提升數百毫米後停留觀察）；提升中監測各千斤頂荷載、行程與重物水平度，並記錄風速；到位後先臨時固定，經測量確認位置後才連接永久支承。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting, complete design checks and load tests of jacks, strands, anchors and the temporary lifting frames on the tower tops, and do a trial lift that raises the load a few hundred millimetres and holds it for observation; during the lift monitor each jack's load, stroke and the levelness of the load and record wind speed; on arrival fix temporarily and connect to permanent bearings only after survey confirms position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With 15.7 mm strands of 279 kN minimum breaking load and a required safety factor of 2.5, about 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 strands are needed, about 28 per jack for 4 jacks. steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack lifting to 200 m: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1,270 t girder lift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 提升前完成千斤頂、鋼絞線、錨具與塔頂臨時提升架的設計核算與荷載試驗，並做離地試吊（提升數百毫米後停留觀察）；提升中監測各千斤頂荷載、行程與重物水平度，並記錄風速；到位後先臨時固定，經測量確認位置後才連接永久支承。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting, complete design checks and load tests of jacks, strands, anchors and the temporary lifting frames on the tower tops, and do a trial lift that raises the load a few hundred millimetres and holds it for observation; during the lift monitor each jack's load, stroke and the levelness of the load and record wind speed; on arrival fix temporarily and connect to permanent bearings only after survey confirms position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：提升作業須有完整的提升計畫：荷載分配、同步容許差、風速上限、試吊程序、緊急停止與錨固措施，並由提升專業承包商、結構設計者與業主代表簽認；本課只說明檢核邏輯，實際操作須由合格人員依核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A lift needs a complete lifting plan with load distribution, synchronisation tolerance, wind limit, trial-lift procedure, emergency stop and anchoring measures, signed by the specialist lifting contractor, the structural designer and the owner's representative; this course explains the checking logic only, and actual operation must be performed by qualified personnel under an approved procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：千斤頂不同步會使重物傾斜，荷載集中到少數鋼絞線與吊點，可能拉壞吊耳或局部屈曲箱梁；提升途中風速升高使重物擺動撞擊塔樓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronised jacks tilt the load and concentrate it on a few strands and lifting points, which may tear a lug or locally buckle the girder; rising wind during the lift swings the load into the tower. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack lifting to 200 m: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1,270 t 箱梁整體提升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1,270 t girder lift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂不同步會使重物傾斜，荷載集中到少數鋼絞線與吊點，可能拉壞吊耳或局部屈曲箱梁；提升途中風速升高使重物擺動撞擊塔樓。臨時提升架若未考慮提升時的水平分力，可能在重物離地瞬間失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronised jacks tilt the load and concentrate it on a few strands and lifting points, which may tear a lug or locally buckle the girder; rising wind during the lift swings the load into the tower. A temporary lifting frame that ignores horizontal components during lifting may lose stability just as the load leaves the ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整個工程用了約 4,000 t 臨時鋼結構，約為永久鋼結構 7,000 t 的一半以上。
