steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「鋼絞線千斤頂提升到 200 m 高空」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.objective: 說明「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leaning tower legs and ties” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每座旅館塔樓由兩支不對稱的腿組成，彎曲的東腿向另一支腿傾靠，兩腿在第 23 層以層高鋼桁架連結。施工期間斜腿在連結前無法自立，因此以臨時鋼支撐頂住，並以高強度鋼腱拉住；這些鋼腱原規劃為臨時，最後保留為永久。地面層以後拉預力基礎版承受斜腿產生的水平推力，並以預拱抵消自重造成的側向位移。Arup 預估塔樓的側向變形會持續約 30 年才趨於穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each hotel tower has two asymmetric legs, the curved east leg leaning against the other, connected at Level 23 by storey-high steel trusses. Before connection the inclined leg cannot stand alone, so it was propped by temporary steel struts and tied with high-tensile tendons, which were planned as temporary but finally kept as permanent. A post-tensioned slab at ground level resists the horizontal thrust from the inclined legs, and pre-camber offsets lateral displacement from self-weight. Arup expected the towers to keep deforming laterally for about 30 years before the movements converge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Leaning tower legs and ties” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Leaning tower legs and ties”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制
knowledge.titleEn: Construction-stage control of the leaning towers
knowledge.text: 每座旅館塔樓由兩支不對稱的腿組成，彎曲的東腿向另一支腿傾靠，兩腿在第 23 層以層高鋼桁架連結。施工期間斜腿在連結前無法自立，因此以臨時鋼支撐頂住，並以高強度鋼腱拉住；這些鋼腱原規劃為臨時，最後保留為永久。
knowledge.textEn: Each hotel tower has two asymmetric legs, the curved east leg leaning against the other, connected at Level 23 by storey-high steel trusses. Before connection the inclined leg cannot stand alone, so it was propped by temporary steel struts and tied with high-tensile tendons, which were planned as temporary but finally kept as permanent.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction-stage control of the leaning towers" is correct?
options: 每座旅館塔樓由兩支不對稱的腿組成，彎曲的東腿向另一支腿傾靠，兩腿在第 23 層以層高鋼桁架連結。
混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。
千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。
optionsEn: Each hotel tower has two asymmetric legs, the curved east leg leaning against the other, connected at Level 23 by storey-high steel trusses.
A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position.
If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded.
quiz.explanation: 每座旅館塔樓由兩支不對稱的腿組成，彎曲的東腿向另一支腿傾靠，兩腿在第 23 層以層高鋼桁架連結。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each hotel tower has two asymmetric legs, the curved east leg leaning against the other, connected at Level 23 by storey-high steel trusses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage control of the leaning towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leaning tower legs and ties” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。若以 15.7 mm 鋼絞線、每根工作力 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN 承擔，需約 72,800/167 ≈ 436 根；若傾角增為 25°，H ≈ 93.3 MN，需約 559 根。軸力與傾角為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN. Carried by 15.7 mm strands at a working force of 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN each, about 72,800/167 ≈ 436 strands are needed; at 25°, H ≈ 93.3 MN and about 559 strands. Axial force and angle are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每升高數層就量測斜腿與核心牆的實際座標，與施工階段分析（含徐變、收縮與預拱）比較；監測臨時拉桿與支撐的受力，確認在連結桁架完成前不超過設計值；連結後與卸除臨時支撐時再量測一次，作為塔頂平台安裝的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every few floors survey the actual coordinates of the inclined legs and core walls and compare with the construction-stage analysis including creep, shrinkage and pre-camber; monitor forces in temporary ties and props to confirm they stay within design before the connecting trusses are complete; survey again after connection and when temporary props are removed, as the baseline for installing the rooftop platform.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。若以 15.7 mm 鋼絞線、每根工作力 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN 承擔，需約 72,800/167 ≈ 436 根；若傾角增為 25°，H ≈ 93.3 MN，需約 559 根。軸力與傾角為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN. Carried by 15.7 mm strands at a working force of 0.6×279 ≈ 167 kN each, about 72,800/167 ≈ 436 strands are needed; at 25°, H ≈ 93.3 MN and about 559 strands. Axial force and angle are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction-stage control of the leaning towers", which statement holds?
options: 泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。
斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。
三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。
optionsEn: The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design.
With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN.
All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest.
quiz.explanation: 斜腿軸力 N = 200 MN、傾角 θ = 20° 時，水平推力 H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a leg axial force N = 200 MN at an inclination θ = 20°, the horizontal thrust is H = N·tanθ = 200×0.364 ≈ 72.8 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage control of the leaning towers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leaning tower legs and ties” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每升高數層就量測斜腿與核心牆的實際座標，與施工階段分析（含徐變、收縮與預拱）比較；監測臨時拉桿與支撐的受力，確認在連結桁架完成前不超過設計值；連結後與卸除臨時支撐時再量測一次，作為塔頂平台安裝的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every few floors survey the actual coordinates of the inclined legs and core walls and compare with the construction-stage analysis including creep, shrinkage and pre-camber; monitor forces in temporary ties and props to confirm they stay within design before the connecting trusses are complete; survey again after connection and when temporary props are removed, as the baseline for installing the rooftop platform. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斜腿結構的施工階段分析要列入施工計畫的附件，每一個臨時拉桿與支撐的安裝、張拉與拆除都是停止點，須經結構設計者確認量測結果後才能進行下一步。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction-stage analysis of inclined legs belongs in the construction-plan appendices, and installing, stressing and removing each temporary tie or prop is a hold point that proceeds only after the structural designer confirms the survey results.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若預拱只按彈性變形設定而忽略徐變，塔樓完工多年後仍持續側移，塔頂支承與泳池接縫的行程被逐漸吃掉；臨時拉桿若在連結桁架完成前提早放鬆，斜腿可能出現過大彎矩與裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting pre-camber for elastic deformation only and ignoring creep lets the towers keep drifting years after completion, gradually using up the travel of rooftop bearings and pool joints; releasing temporary ties before the connecting trusses are complete can overload the inclined leg in bending and crack it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每升高數層就量測斜腿與核心牆的實際座標，與施工階段分析（含徐變、收縮與預拱）比較；監測臨時拉桿與支撐的受力，確認在連結桁架完成前不超過設計值；連結後與卸除臨時支撐時再量測一次，作為塔頂平台安裝的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Every few floors survey the actual coordinates of the inclined legs and core walls and compare with the construction-stage analysis including creep, shrinkage and pre-camber; monitor forces in temporary ties and props to confirm they stay within design before the connecting trusses are complete; survey again after connection and when temporary props are removed, as the baseline for installing the rooftop platform.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斜腿結構的施工階段分析要列入施工計畫的附件，每一個臨時拉桿與支撐的安裝、張拉與拆除都是停止點，須經結構設計者確認量測結果後才能進行下一步。
knowledge.textEn: The construction-stage analysis of inclined legs belongs in the construction-plan appendices, and installing, stressing and removing each temporary tie or prop is a hold point that proceeds only after the structural designer confirms the survey results.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction-stage control of the leaning towers"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。
每升高數層就量測斜腿與核心牆的實際座標，與施工階段分析（含徐變、收縮與預拱）比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
Every few floors survey the actual coordinates of the inclined legs and core walls and compare with the construction-stage analysis including creep, shrinkage and pre-camber.
quiz.explanation: 每升高數層就量測斜腿與核心牆的實際座標，與施工階段分析（含徐變、收縮與預拱）比較；監測臨時拉桿與支撐的受力，確認在連結桁架完成前不超過設計值；連結後與卸除臨時支撐時再量測一次，作為塔頂平台安裝的基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Every few floors survey the actual coordinates of the inclined legs and core walls and compare with the construction-stage analysis including creep, shrinkage and pre-camber; monitor forces in temporary ties and props to confirm they stay within design before the connecting trusses are complete; survey again after connection and when temporary props are removed, as the baseline for installing the rooftop platform. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage control of the leaning towers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔樓斜腿與臨時拉桿」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leaning tower legs and ties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若預拱只按彈性變形設定而忽略徐變，塔樓完工多年後仍持續側移，塔頂支承與泳池接縫的行程被逐漸吃掉；臨時拉桿若在連結桁架完成前提早放鬆，斜腿可能出現過大彎矩與裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting pre-camber for elastic deformation only and ignoring creep lets the towers keep drifting years after completion, gradually using up the travel of rooftop bearings and pool joints; releasing temporary ties before the connecting trusses are complete can overload the inclined leg in bending and crack it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Arup 預估塔樓的側向變形會持續約 30 年才趨於穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Arup expected the towers to keep deforming laterally for about 30 years before the movements converge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若預拱只按彈性變形設定而忽略徐變，塔樓完工多年後仍持續側移，塔頂支承與泳池接縫的行程被逐漸吃掉；臨時拉桿若在連結桁架完成前提早放鬆，斜腿可能出現過大彎矩與裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Setting pre-camber for elastic deformation only and ignoring creep lets the towers keep drifting years after completion, gradually using up the travel of rooftop bearings and pool joints; releasing temporary ties before the connecting trusses are complete can overload the inclined leg in bending and crack it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斜腿塔樓的施工階段控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-stage control of the leaning towers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若預拱只按彈性變形設定而忽略徐變，塔樓完工多年後仍持續側移，塔頂支承與泳池接縫的行程被逐漸吃掉；臨時拉桿若在連結桁架完成前提早放鬆，斜腿可能出現過大彎矩與裂縫。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。
optionsEn: Setting pre-camber for elastic deformation only and ignoring creep lets the towers keep drifting years after completion, gradually using up the travel of rooftop bearings and pool joints.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded.
quiz.explanation: 若預拱只按彈性變形設定而忽略徐變，塔樓完工多年後仍持續側移，塔頂支承與泳池接縫的行程被逐漸吃掉；臨時拉桿若在連結桁架完成前提早放鬆，斜腿可能出現過大彎矩與裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting pre-camber for elastic deformation only and ignoring creep lets the towers keep drifting years after completion, gradually using up the travel of rooftop bearings and pool joints; releasing temporary ties before the connecting trusses are complete can overload the inclined leg in bending and crack it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測」與「人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts" and "Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「提升同步與風速監測」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼絞線提升是一連串短行程的累積，每個行程都可能讓各千斤頂出現微小高差；高差累積後重物傾斜，荷載重新分配。80 m 長的箱梁在高空懸吊時也像一面大風帆，橫向風力使重物擺動並在鋼絞線中產生不均勻張力。因此提升系統必須同時監測每台千斤頂的荷載與行程、重物兩端的高程差，以及現場與高空的風速，並以預先約定的門檻決定繼續、暫停或下降。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「提升同步與風速監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strand lifting is a sequence of short strokes, each of which can leave tiny level differences between jacks; accumulated, they tilt the load and redistribute force. An 80 m girder hanging at height also acts like a large sail, so lateral wind makes it swing and loads the strands unevenly. The lifting system must therefore monitor each jack's load and stroke, the level difference between the ends of the load and wind speed at ground and at height, deciding to continue, pause or lower against thresholds agreed in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「提升同步與風速監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測
knowledge.titleEn: Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts
knowledge.text: 鋼絞線提升是一連串短行程的累積，每個行程都可能讓各千斤頂出現微小高差；高差累積後重物傾斜，荷載重新分配。80 m 長的箱梁在高空懸吊時也像一面大風帆，橫向風力使重物擺動並在鋼絞線中產生不均勻張力。
knowledge.textEn: Strand lifting is a sequence of short strokes, each of which can leave tiny level differences between jacks; accumulated, they tilt the load and redistribute force. An 80 m girder hanging at height also acts like a large sail, so lateral wind makes it swing and loads the strands unevenly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts" is correct?
options: 千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。
鋼絞線提升是一連串短行程的累積，每個行程都可能讓各千斤頂出現微小高差；高差累積後重物傾斜，荷載重新分配。
阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。
optionsEn: If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded.
Strand lifting is a sequence of short strokes, each of which can leave tiny level differences between jacks.
Once a damper is installed it is certainly effective, so no crowd test is needed.
quiz.explanation: 鋼絞線提升是一連串短行程的累積，每個行程都可能讓各千斤頂出現微小高差；高差累積後重物傾斜，荷載重新分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Strand lifting is a sequence of short strokes, each of which can leave tiny level differences between jacks; accumulated, they tilt the load and redistribute force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升同步與風速監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。風速 15 m/s 時 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa，迎風面 80 m × 10 m = 800 m²、阻力係數 2.0，橫向力 F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN。風速與阻力係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably. At 15 m/s wind, q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa; with a frontal area of 80 m × 10 m = 800 m² and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN. Wind speed and drag coefficient are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符；提升中以自動系統記錄荷載、行程與高差，超過門檻自動停止；設置地面與高空風速計，並取得氣象預報，決定提升時窗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting, calibrate each jack's pressure sensor and stroke transducer and confirm the load distribution against calculation by a trial lift; during lifting record load, stroke and level difference automatically with automatic stop at thresholds; install anemometers at ground and at height and use weather forecasts to choose the lifting window.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。風速 15 m/s 時 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa，迎風面 80 m × 10 m = 800 m²、阻力係數 2.0，橫向力 F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN。風速與阻力係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably. At 15 m/s wind, q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×15² ≈ 138 Pa; with a frontal area of 80 m × 10 m = 800 m² and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is F ≈ 138×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN. Wind speed and drag coefficient are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts", which statement holds?
options: 平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。
鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。
80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。
optionsEn: Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep.
If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration.
A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably.
quiz.explanation: 80 m 箱梁兩端高差 50 mm，轉角 θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°，看似很小，但在剛性重物上會讓高端吊點荷載明顯增加。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 50 mm level difference over an 80 m girder is a rotation θ = atan(0.05/80) ≈ 0.036°, small in appearance but enough to raise the load on the high-end lifting points of a stiff load noticeably. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升同步與風速監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符；提升中以自動系統記錄荷載、行程與高差，超過門檻自動停止；設置地面與高空風速計，並取得氣象預報，決定提升時窗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting, calibrate each jack's pressure sensor and stroke transducer and confirm the load distribution against calculation by a trial lift; during lifting record load, stroke and level difference automatically with automatic stop at thresholds; install anemometers at ground and at height and use weather forecasts to choose the lifting window. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：提升監測的門檻（荷載偏差、高差、風速）與處置流程須在提升計畫中寫明，並指定唯一的提升指揮與停止權責；熱帶地區要把雷雨季節與每日氣象變化納入時程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Thresholds for load deviation, level difference and wind speed, with the response procedure, must be written into the lifting plan, naming a single lift commander with clear stop authority; in the tropics, thunderstorm seasons and daily weather patterns must be built into the schedule.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只監測千斤頂壓力而不量測重物高差，壓力感測器漂移時可能誤判同步；在午後雷雨前開始提升，突陣風讓懸吊箱梁擺盪撞擊塔樓立面或臨時架，造成構件與結構損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Monitoring only jack pressure without measuring the load's level difference can misjudge synchronisation when a sensor drifts; starting a lift before an afternoon thunderstorm lets a sudden gust swing the hanging girder into the tower façade or temporary frames, damaging both. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符；提升中以自動系統記錄荷載、行程與高差，超過門檻自動停止；設置地面與高空風速計，並取得氣象預報，決定提升時窗。
knowledge.textEn: Before lifting, calibrate each jack's pressure sensor and stroke transducer and confirm the load distribution against calculation by a trial lift; during lifting record load, stroke and level difference automatically with automatic stop at thresholds; install anemometers at ground and at height and use weather forecasts to choose the lifting window.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 提升監測的門檻（荷載偏差、高差、風速）與處置流程須在提升計畫中寫明，並指定唯一的提升指揮與停止權責；熱帶地區要把雷雨季節與每日氣象變化納入時程。
knowledge.textEn: Thresholds for load deviation, level difference and wind speed, with the response procedure, must be written into the lifting plan, naming a single lift commander with clear stop authority; in the tropics, thunderstorm seasons and daily weather patterns must be built into the schedule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts"?
options: 提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。
optionsEn: Before lifting, calibrate each jack's pressure sensor and stroke transducer and confirm the load distribution against calculation by a trial lift.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 提升前校正每台千斤頂的壓力感測器與行程計，並以試吊確認荷載分配與計算相符；提升中以自動系統記錄荷載、行程與高差，超過門檻自動停止；設置地面與高空風速計，並取得氣象預報，決定提升時窗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before lifting, calibrate each jack's pressure sensor and stroke transducer and confirm the load distribution against calculation by a trial lift; during lifting record load, stroke and level difference automatically with automatic stop at thresholds; install anemometers at ground and at height and use weather forecasts to choose the lifting window. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「提升同步與風速監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift synchronisation and wind monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只監測千斤頂壓力而不量測重物高差，壓力感測器漂移時可能誤判同步；在午後雷雨前開始提升，突陣風讓懸吊箱梁擺盪撞擊塔樓立面或臨時架，造成構件與結構損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring only jack pressure without measuring the load's level difference can misjudge synchronisation when a sensor drifts; starting a lift before an afternoon thunderstorm lets a sudden gust swing the hanging girder into the tower façade or temporary frames, damaging both. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此提升系統必須同時監測每台千斤頂的荷載與行程、重物兩端的高程差，以及現場與高空的風速，並以預先約定的門檻決定繼續、暫停或下降。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lifting system must therefore monitor each jack's load and stroke, the level difference between the ends of the load and wind speed at ground and at height, deciding to continue, pause or lower against thresholds agreed in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只監測千斤頂壓力而不量測重物高差，壓力感測器漂移時可能誤判同步；在午後雷雨前開始提升，突陣風讓懸吊箱梁擺盪撞擊塔樓立面或臨時架，造成構件與結構損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring only jack pressure without measuring the load's level difference can misjudge synchronisation when a sensor drifts; starting a lift before an afternoon thunderstorm lets a sudden gust swing the hanging girder into the tower façade or temporary frames, damaging both.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Monitoring only jack pressure without measuring the load's level difference can misjudge synchronisation when a sensor drifts.
Once a damper is installed it is certainly effective, so no crowd test is needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring only jack pressure without measuring the load's level difference can misjudge synchronisation when a sensor drifts; starting a lift before an afternoon thunderstorm lets a sudden gust swing the hanging girder into the tower façade or temporary frames, damaging both. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “4.5 t tuned mass damper” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸臂端的阻尼器是否有效，要在完工後以實測證明：先量環境振動求懸臂實際頻率與阻尼，再以有組織的人群步行、跑動或跳躍試驗，量測加速度並與舒適度限值比較。阻尼器必須調整到實際頻率，鎖定與釋放阻尼器各量一次可以直接看出它提供的附加阻尼。對觀景平台而言，豎向與扭轉模態都可能被偏心人群激發，量測點需包含懸臂端兩側。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Whether the damper at the cantilever tip works must be proven by measurement after completion: first ambient vibration to identify the cantilever's actual frequency and damping, then organised crowd walking, running or jumping tests to measure acceleration against comfort limits. The damper must be tuned to the measured frequency, and measuring once with it locked and once released shows directly the added damping it provides. On a viewing deck both vertical and torsional modes can be excited by eccentric crowds, so measurement points must include both sides of the tip. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “4.5 t tuned mass damper” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For harmonic motion, a = (2πf)²·x.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器裝好就一定有效，不需要做人群試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a damper is installed it is certainly effective, so no crowd test is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “4.5 t tuned mass damper” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。若懸臂頻率 f = 2.0 Hz、人群試驗中振幅 x = 3 mm，a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²；若阻尼器使振幅降為 1.5 mm，a ≈ 0.24 m/s²。頻率與振幅為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For harmonic motion, a = (2πf)²·x. With a cantilever frequency f = 2.0 Hz and a 3 mm amplitude in a crowd test, a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²; if the damper halves the amplitude to 1.5 mm, a ≈ 0.24 m/s². Frequency and amplitudes are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫寫明人數、步頻（以節拍器控制）、活動類型與量測點，重複三次取平均；比較鎖定與釋放阻尼器的頻率響應與尖峰加速度，確認附加阻尼達到設計要求，並把結果與 ISO 10137 等使用性準則比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan should state the number of people, pacing frequency controlled by metronome, activity type and measurement points, repeating three times for an average; compare frequency response and peak acceleration with the damper locked and released to confirm the added damping meets the design requirement, and check the results against serviceability criteria such as ISO 10137.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡諧振動加速度 a = (2πf)²·x。若懸臂頻率 f = 2.0 Hz、人群試驗中振幅 x = 3 mm，a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²；若阻尼器使振幅降為 1.5 mm，a ≈ 0.24 m/s²。頻率與振幅為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For harmonic motion, a = (2πf)²·x. With a cantilever frequency f = 2.0 Hz and a 3 mm amplitude in a crowd test, a = (2π×2.0)²×0.003 ≈ 0.47 m/s²; if the damper halves the amplitude to 1.5 mm, a ≈ 0.24 m/s². Frequency and amplitudes are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。

steps.title: 人群振動試驗與阻尼器驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “4.5 t tuned mass damper” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫寫明人數、步頻（以節拍器控制）、活動類型與量測點，重複三次取平均；比較鎖定與釋放阻尼器的頻率響應與尖峰加速度，確認附加阻尼達到設計要求，並把結果與 ISO 10137 等使用性準則比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan should state the number of people, pacing frequency controlled by metronome, activity type and measurement points, repeating three times for an average; compare frequency response and peak acceleration with the damper locked and released to confirm the added damping meets the design requirement, and check the results against serviceability criteria such as ISO 10137. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含阻尼器的調頻紀錄、鎖定與釋放試驗結果、可承受的人數與活動類型限制，以及阻尼器檢修週期；平台活動規劃須由營運單位依這些限制審核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the damper's tuning record, locked and released test results, permitted occupancy and activity limits and its maintenance interval; the operator must review event plans on the platform against these limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：阻尼器依設計頻率出廠但未現場調頻，實際頻率偏離後效果大減；試驗只做少數人步行，未涵蓋大型活動的同步跳躍，營運後在派對或活動時才發現明顯晃動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A damper shipped to the design frequency and not tuned on site loses much of its effect when the real frequency differs; tests with only a few walkers that omit synchronised jumping at large events reveal noticeable bouncing only after opening, at a party or event. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫寫明人數、步頻（以節拍器控制）、活動類型與量測點，重複三次取平均；比較鎖定與釋放阻尼器的頻率響應與尖峰加速度，確認附加阻尼達到設計要求，並把結果與 ISO 10137 等使用性準則比較。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan should state the number of people, pacing frequency controlled by metronome, activity type and measurement points, repeating three times for an average; compare frequency response and peak acceleration with the damper locked and released to confirm the added damping meets the design requirement, and check the results against serviceability criteria such as ISO 10137.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含阻尼器的調頻紀錄、鎖定與釋放試驗結果、可承受的人數與活動類型限制，以及阻尼器檢修週期；平台活動規劃須由營運單位依這些限制審核。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the damper's tuning record, locked and released test results, permitted occupancy and activity limits and its maintenance interval; the operator must review event plans on the platform against these limits.

steps.titleEn: Crowd-vibration tests and damper acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「4.5 t 調諧質量阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “4.5 t tuned mass damper” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器依設計頻率出廠但未現場調頻，實際頻率偏離後效果大減；試驗只做少數人步行，未涵蓋大型活動的同步跳躍，營運後在派對或活動時才發現明顯晃動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。
阻尼器依設計頻率出廠但未現場調頻，實際頻率偏離後效果大減；試驗只做少數人步行，未涵蓋大型活動的同步跳躍，營運後在派對或活動時才發現明顯晃動。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design.
A damper shipped to the design frequency and not tuned on site loses much of its effect when the real frequency differs.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器依設計頻率出廠但未現場調頻，實際頻率偏離後效果大減；試驗只做少數人步行，未涵蓋大型活動的同步跳躍，營運後在派對或活動時才發現明顯晃動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A damper shipped to the design frequency and not tuned on site loses much of its effect when the real frequency differs; tests with only a few walkers that omit synchronised jumping at large events reveal noticeable bouncing only after opening, at a party or event. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷」與「塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement" and "Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pool joints and levelling jacks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 約 150 m 長的無邊際泳池由三個約 50 m 的不鏽鋼池體組成，以水下伸縮接縫連成一體，跨越塔與塔之間的變位；池體下方以可調鋼千斤頂支承，在建築沉陷與變形後仍能調平。無邊際池緣要求整條溢流堰保持近乎水平，幾毫米的高差就會讓水集中從低處溢流，高處則乾涸露出堰頂。泳池同時是平台上最大的活荷載之一，滿水重量必須納入支承與箱梁設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The infinity pool, about 150 m long, consists of three stainless-steel tanks of about 50 m joined by underwater movement joints that cross the movements between towers; adjustable steel jacks beneath the tanks allow re-levelling after building settlement and deformation. An infinity edge requires the whole weir to stay almost perfectly level: a few millimetres of difference make water spill mostly at the low point while the high part runs dry and exposes the weir. The pool is also one of the largest loads on the platform, and its full water weight must be included in bearing and girder design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pool joints and levelling jacks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pool joints and levelling jacks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷
knowledge.text: 約 150 m 長的無邊際泳池由三個約 50 m 的不鏽鋼池體組成，以水下伸縮接縫連成一體，跨越塔與塔之間的變位；池體下方以可調鋼千斤頂支承，在建築沉陷與變形後仍能調平。無邊際池緣要求整條溢流堰保持近乎水平，幾毫米的高差就會讓水集中從低處溢流，高處則乾涸露出堰頂。
knowledge.textEn: The infinity pool, about 150 m long, consists of three stainless-steel tanks of about 50 m joined by underwater movement joints that cross the movements between towers; adjustable steel jacks beneath the tanks allow re-levelling after building settlement and deformation. An infinity edge requires the whole weir to stay almost perfectly level: a few millimetres of difference make water spill mostly at the low point while the high part runs dry and exposes the weir.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement" is correct?
options: 約 150 m 長的無邊際泳池由三個約 50 m 的不鏽鋼池體組成，以水下伸縮接縫連成一體，跨越塔與塔之間的變位。
泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。
平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。
optionsEn: The infinity pool, about 150 m long, consists of three stainless-steel tanks of about 50 m joined by underwater movement joints that cross the movements between towers.
The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design.
Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep.
quiz.explanation: 約 150 m 長的無邊際泳池由三個約 50 m 的不鏽鋼池體組成，以水下伸縮接縫連成一體，跨越塔與塔之間的變位；池體下方以可調鋼千斤頂支承，在建築沉陷與變形後仍能調平。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The infinity pool, about 150 m long, consists of three stainless-steel tanks of about 50 m joined by underwater movement joints that cross the movements between towers; adjustable steel jacks beneath the tanks allow re-levelling after building settlement and deformation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pool joints and levelling jacks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。堰上水頭 h = 5 mm 時 q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m，146 m 堰全長約 95 L/s；若一端下沉 5 mm 使該端水頭變 10 mm，q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m，約為原值 2.8 倍，而另一端水頭趨近 0、堰頂乾涸。水頭與沉陷量為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m. With a head h = 5 mm, q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m, about 95 L/s along a 146 m weir; if one end settles 5 mm so its head becomes 10 mm, q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m there, about 2.8 times larger, while the head at the other end approaches 0 and the weir runs dry. Head and settlement are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以精密水準或液面量測沿溢流堰每隔數公尺量高程，與允許高差比較；水下接縫做灌水試驗與滲漏監測，並在塔樓擺動、溫度變化期間檢查接縫開合；調平千斤頂每次調整都記錄位置、調整量與當時溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey the weir level every few metres by precise levelling or water-surface measurement and compare with the allowable difference; flood-test the underwater joints and monitor leakage, checking joint opening and closing during tower sway and temperature change; record the position, adjustment and temperature at every levelling-jack adjustment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。堰上水頭 h = 5 mm 時 q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m，146 m 堰全長約 95 L/s；若一端下沉 5 mm 使該端水頭變 10 mm，q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m，約為原值 2.8 倍，而另一端水頭趨近 0、堰頂乾涸。水頭與沉陷量為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m. With a head h = 5 mm, q ≈ 1.84×0.005^1.5 ≈ 0.65 L/s/m, about 95 L/s along a 146 m weir; if one end settles 5 mm so its head becomes 10 mm, q ≈ 1.84 L/s/m there, about 2.8 times larger, while the head at the other end approaches 0 and the weir runs dry. Head and settlement are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement", which statement holds?
options: 鋼結構懸臂只要撓度在規範限值內，人走在上面就不會感到振動。
堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。
滑動支承裝好之後就能永久自由滑動，不需要維護。
optionsEn: If a steel cantilever meets the code deflection limit, people walking on it will not feel vibration.
Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m.
Once installed, a sliding bearing slides freely forever without maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 堰流單寬流量 q = 1.84·h^1.5（m³/s/m）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Weir discharge per metre q = 1.84·h^1.5 in m³/s/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pool joints and levelling jacks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以精密水準或液面量測沿溢流堰每隔數公尺量高程，與允許高差比較；水下接縫做灌水試驗與滲漏監測，並在塔樓擺動、溫度變化期間檢查接縫開合；調平千斤頂每次調整都記錄位置、調整量與當時溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey the weir level every few metres by precise levelling or water-surface measurement and compare with the allowable difference; flood-test the underwater joints and monitor leakage, checking joint opening and closing during tower sway and temperature change; record the position, adjustment and temperature at every levelling-jack adjustment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：泳池的調平紀錄、接縫行程監測與防水檢查應與結構監測整合在同一資料系統，任何排水或清池作業都要通知結構顧問，避免荷載快速變化造成支承與箱梁不預期的反應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pool levelling records, joint-travel monitoring and waterproofing inspections should share one data system with structural monitoring, and any draining or refilling must be notified to the structural consultant to avoid unexpected bearing and girder response to rapid load change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫行程不足或密封老化，池水滲入鋼平台與箱梁，造成腐蝕與下方樓層漏水；長期徐變沉陷未定期調平，溢流不均使部分堰頂乾涸，水流集中處沖刷與噴濺，影響營運與安全。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Joints with insufficient travel or aged seals let pool water into the steel platform and girders, causing corrosion and leaks to floors below; without periodic re-levelling for long-term creep settlement, uneven overflow dries parts of the weir while concentrated flow erodes and splashes elsewhere, affecting operation and safety. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以精密水準或液面量測沿溢流堰每隔數公尺量高程，與允許高差比較；水下接縫做灌水試驗與滲漏監測，並在塔樓擺動、溫度變化期間檢查接縫開合；調平千斤頂每次調整都記錄位置、調整量與當時溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Survey the weir level every few metres by precise levelling or water-surface measurement and compare with the allowable difference; flood-test the underwater joints and monitor leakage, checking joint opening and closing during tower sway and temperature change; record the position, adjustment and temperature at every levelling-jack adjustment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 泳池的調平紀錄、接縫行程監測與防水檢查應與結構監測整合在同一資料系統，任何排水或清池作業都要通知結構顧問，避免荷載快速變化造成支承與箱梁不預期的反應。
knowledge.textEn: Pool levelling records, joint-travel monitoring and waterproofing inspections should share one data system with structural monitoring, and any draining or refilling must be notified to the structural consultant to avoid unexpected bearing and girder response to rapid load change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混凝土塔樓完工後變形就停止，平台可以按完工量測位置一次固定。
以精密水準或液面量測沿溢流堰每隔數公尺量高程，與允許高差比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A concrete tower stops deforming at completion, so the platform can be fixed once to the as-built position.
Survey the weir level every few metres by precise levelling or water-surface measurement and compare with the allowable difference.
quiz.explanation: 以精密水準或液面量測沿溢流堰每隔數公尺量高程，與允許高差比較；水下接縫做灌水試驗與滲漏監測，並在塔樓擺動、溫度變化期間檢查接縫開合；調平千斤頂每次調整都記錄位置、調整量與當時溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey the weir level every few metres by precise levelling or water-surface measurement and compare with the allowable difference; flood-test the underwater joints and monitor leakage, checking joint opening and closing during tower sway and temperature change; record the position, adjustment and temperature at every levelling-jack adjustment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泳池接縫與調平千斤頂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pool joints and levelling jacks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫行程不足或密封老化，池水滲入鋼平台與箱梁，造成腐蝕與下方樓層漏水；長期徐變沉陷未定期調平，溢流不均使部分堰頂乾涸，水流集中處沖刷與噴濺，影響營運與安全。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joints with insufficient travel or aged seals let pool water into the steel platform and girders, causing corrosion and leaks to floors below; without periodic re-levelling for long-term creep settlement, uneven overflow dries parts of the weir while concentrated flow erodes and splashes elsewhere, affecting operation and safety. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：泳池同時是平台上最大的活荷載之一，滿水重量必須納入支承與箱梁設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The pool is also one of the largest loads on the platform, and its full water weight must be included in bearing and girder design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泳池只是建築設施，與平台結構設計無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The pool is only an amenity and has nothing to do with platform structural design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫行程不足或密封老化，池水滲入鋼平台與箱梁，造成腐蝕與下方樓層漏水；長期徐變沉陷未定期調平，溢流不均使部分堰頂乾涸，水流集中處沖刷與噴濺，影響營運與安全。
knowledge.textEn: Joints with insufficient travel or aged seals let pool water into the steel platform and girders, causing corrosion and leaks to floors below; without periodic re-levelling for long-term creep settlement, uneven overflow dries parts of the weir while concentrated flow erodes and splashes elsewhere, affecting operation and safety.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無邊際泳池的接縫、調平與沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Infinity-pool joints, levelling and settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 接縫行程不足或密封老化，池水滲入鋼平台與箱梁，造成腐蝕與下方樓層漏水；長期徐變沉陷未定期調平，溢流不均使部分堰頂乾涸，水流集中處沖刷與噴濺，影響營運與安全。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。
optionsEn: Joints with insufficient travel or aged seals let pool water into the steel platform and girders, causing corrosion and leaks to floors below.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep.
quiz.explanation: 接縫行程不足或密封老化，池水滲入鋼平台與箱梁，造成腐蝕與下方樓層漏水；長期徐變沉陷未定期調平，溢流不均使部分堰頂乾涸，水流集中處沖刷與噴濺，影響營運與安全。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints with insufficient travel or aged seals let pool water into the steel platform and girders, causing corrosion and leaks to floors below; without periodic re-levelling for long-term creep settlement, uneven overflow dries parts of the weir while concentrated flow erodes and splashes elsewhere, affecting operation and safety. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「長期徐變與支承紀錄」如何影響新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term creep and bearing records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Marina Bay Sands SkyPark”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土塔樓的徐變與收縮使側向變形持續多年，公開資料估計約 30 年才趨於穩定，因此平台支承、伸縮接縫與泳池調平都是長期運作的系統，而不是一次性安裝。熱帶海濱環境高溫、高濕與鹽霧，對鋼平台塗裝、滑動支承與泳池不鏽鋼都是考驗。交接文件必須記錄每個支承的初始偏移與行程、預力與調平紀錄、阻尼器參數與監測基準，讓營運者能判斷何時需要調整或更換。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長期徐變與支承紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Creep and shrinkage keep the concrete towers deforming laterally for years, about 30 years before converging according to the published account, so platform bearings, movement joints and pool levelling are long-running systems rather than one-off installations. The hot, humid, salty tropical waterfront tests the steel platform's coatings, the sliding bearings and the pool's stainless steel. Handover documents must record each bearing's initial offset and travel, prestress and levelling records, damper parameters and monitoring baselines, so the operator can tell when adjustment or replacement is needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-term creep and bearing records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Describe creep drift with an exponential curve δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ)).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「長期徐變與支承紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-term creep and bearing records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover
knowledge.text: 混凝土塔樓的徐變與收縮使側向變形持續多年，公開資料估計約 30 年才趨於穩定，因此平台支承、伸縮接縫與泳池調平都是長期運作的系統，而不是一次性安裝。熱帶海濱環境高溫、高濕與鹽霧，對鋼平台塗裝、滑動支承與泳池不鏽鋼都是考驗。
knowledge.textEn: Creep and shrinkage keep the concrete towers deforming laterally for years, about 30 years before converging according to the published account, so platform bearings, movement joints and pool levelling are long-running systems rather than one-off installations. The hot, humid, salty tropical waterfront tests the steel platform's coatings, the sliding bearings and the pool's stainless steel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover" is correct?
options: 平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。
混凝土塔樓的徐變與收縮使側向變形持續多年，公開資料估計約 30 年才趨於穩定，因此平台支承、伸縮接縫與泳池調平都是長期運作的系統，而不是一次性安裝。
三座塔都很堅固，把平台與塔頂全部剛接最安全。
optionsEn: Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep.

Creep and shrinkage keep the concrete towers deforming laterally for years, about 30 years before converging according to the published account, so platform bearings, movement joints and pool levelling are long-running systems rather than one-off installations.
All three towers are strong, so rigidly connecting the platform to every tower top is safest.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土塔樓的徐變與收縮使側向變形持續多年，公開資料估計約 30 年才趨於穩定，因此平台支承、伸縮接縫與泳池調平都是長期運作的系統，而不是一次性安裝。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Creep and shrinkage keep the concrete towers deforming laterally for years, about 30 years before converging according to the published account, so platform bearings, movement joints and pool levelling are long-running systems rather than one-off installations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期徐變與支承紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term creep and bearing records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。取 δ∞ = 60 mm、τ = 8 年：第 10 年 δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm，第 30 年 δ ≈ 58.6 mm，剩餘不到 2 mm；若只預留 40 mm 行程，約第 9 年就會用完。δ∞ 與 τ 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Describe creep drift with an exponential curve δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ)). With δ∞ = 60 mm and τ = 8 years, δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm at year 10 and δ ≈ 58.6 mm at year 30, less than 2 mm remaining; if only 40 mm of travel were provided it would be used up around year 9. δ∞ and τ are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel; inspect bearings, joints and pool level after every severe thunderstorm or strong wind; rate coatings by zone for film thickness and rust.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。取 δ∞ = 60 mm、τ = 8 年：第 10 年 δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm，第 30 年 δ ≈ 58.6 mm，剩餘不到 2 mm；若只預留 40 mm 行程，約第 9 年就會用完。δ∞ 與 τ 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Describe creep drift with an exponential curve δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ)). With δ∞ = 60 mm and τ = 8 years, δ ≈ 60×(1 − e^(−1.25)) ≈ 42.8 mm at year 10 and δ ≈ 58.6 mm at year 30, less than 2 mm remaining; if only 40 mm of travel were provided it would be used up around year 9. δ∞ and τ are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover", which statement holds?
options: 鋼箱梁是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕也不需要檢查。
鋼絞線千斤頂提升只要總吊重小於千斤頂容量就安全。
以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。
optionsEn: A steel box girder is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
Strand-jack lifting is safe as long as the total weight is below the jacks' combined capacity.
Describe creep drift with an exponential curve δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ)).
quiz.explanation: 以指數曲線描述徐變側移 δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ))。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Describe creep drift with an exponential curve δ(t) = δ∞·(1 − e^(−t/τ)). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期徐變與支承紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term creep and bearing records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel; inspect bearings, joints and pool level after every severe thunderstorm or strong wind; rate coatings by zone for film thickness and rust. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含支承與接縫的初始偏移與行程表、徐變預測曲線、提升與預力紀錄、阻尼器調頻紀錄、泳池調平紀錄與監測資料格式；任何在平台上增加重量或改變用途的計畫，須先由結構顧問評估再核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include initial offset and travel tables for bearings and joints, the creep prediction curve, lifting and prestressing records, damper tuning records, pool levelling records and the monitoring data format; any plan that adds weight to the platform or changes its use must be assessed by the structural consultant before approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有初始偏移紀錄，營運者無法判斷支承目前用掉多少行程，直到支承頂到止擋、出現異音或接縫損壞才發現；塗裝破損未及時修補，高濕環境使鋼平台邊緣與排水處快速腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without records of initial offsets, the operator cannot tell how much bearing travel has been used until a bearing hits its stop, makes noise or a joint is damaged; coating damage left unrepaired lets platform edges and drainage points corrode quickly in the humid climate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。
knowledge.textEn: Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel; inspect bearings, joints and pool level after every severe thunderstorm or strong wind; rate coatings by zone for film thickness and rust.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含支承與接縫的初始偏移與行程表、徐變預測曲線、提升與預力紀錄、阻尼器調頻紀錄、泳池調平紀錄與監測資料格式；任何在平台上增加重量或改變用途的計畫，須先由結構顧問評估再核准。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include initial offset and travel tables for bearings and joints, the creep prediction curve, lifting and prestressing records, damper tuning records, pool levelling records and the monitoring data format; any plan that adds weight to the platform or changes its use must be assessed by the structural consultant before approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover"?
options: 每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
千斤頂的總壓力讀數正常，就代表每個吊點都受力平均。
optionsEn: Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the total jack pressure is normal, every lifting point is equally loaded.
quiz.explanation: 每年在固定季節與時段量測塔頂座標、支承滑移量與接縫開度，與預測曲線比較並外推剩餘行程；每次大雷暴或強風後檢查支承、接縫與泳池水平；塗裝依區域做膜厚與鏽蝕評等。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey tower-top coordinates, bearing travel and joint openings every year at a fixed season and time of day, compare with the predicted curve and extrapolate remaining travel; inspect bearings, joints and pool level after every severe thunderstorm or strong wind; rate coatings by zone for film thickness and rust. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塔樓徐變、平台維護與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tower creep, platform maintenance and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期徐變與支承紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term creep and bearing records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有初始偏移紀錄，營運者無法判斷支承目前用掉多少行程，直到支承頂到止擋、出現異音或接縫損壞才發現；塗裝破損未及時修補，高濕環境使鋼平台邊緣與排水處快速腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without records of initial offsets, the operator cannot tell how much bearing travel has been used until a bearing hits its stop, makes noise or a joint is damaged; coating damage left unrepaired lets platform edges and drainage points corrode quickly in the humid climate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須記錄每個支承的初始偏移與行程、預力與調平紀錄、阻尼器參數與監測基準，讓營運者能判斷何時需要調整或更換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must record each bearing's initial offset and travel, prestress and levelling records, damper parameters and monitoring baselines, so the operator can tell when adjustment or replacement is needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平台完工驗收合格後，只需要清潔與美化維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the platform passes completion acceptance it only needs cleaning and cosmetic upkeep." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Without records of initial offsets, the operator cannot tell how much bearing travel has been used until a bearing hits its stop, makes noise or a joint is damaged; coating damage left unrepaired lets platform edges and drainage points corrode quickly in the humid climate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Without records of initial offsets, the operator cannot tell how much bearing travel has been used until a bearing hits its stop, makes noise or a joint is damaged.
