Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋
summary: 千禧巨蛋並非結構意義上的穹頂，而是由 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿以吊索與拉索撐起的穹形索網，上覆 PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維膜，整個屋頂比室內空氣還輕。課程從索網與桅桿的傳力、輕屋蓋的荷載反轉出發，處理膜材選擇、索夾與吊索節點、地面組裝後絞升索網、索長精度與預張力，再談風洞試驗的雷諾數問題、索力現場量測、2022 年風暴後的膜片更換，以及改建為 The O2 時的荷載管理。
summaryEn: The Millennium Dome is not a dome in the structural sense but a dome-shaped cable net held up by hanger and tie-down cables from 12 masts about 100 m high and clad in PTFE-coated glass-fibre fabric, the whole roof weighing less than the air inside. The course starts from the load path of net and masts and load reversal on a lightweight roof, then covers fabric choice, clamps and hanger nodes, winching the ground-assembled net, cable-length accuracy and pretension, Reynolds-number issues in wind-tunnel tests, field measurement of cable forces, panel replacement after the 2022 storm and load control during conversion to The O2.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：評估在一根徑向索上增掛設備的影響。該索吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m、受荷寬 14 m，均布荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 0.6×14 = 8.4 kN/m，原水平張力 H₀ = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×625/8 ≈ 656 kN。現擬在跨中吊掛 10 t 設備，P = 10×9.81 ≈ 98 kN，以集中荷載近似附加 ΔH = PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN，總張力約 1,269 kN，為原值的 1.93 倍。若索的設計上限為 1,000 kN，就不可行；改成在兩個吊點附近各掛 5 t，跨中彎曲效應大減，附加張力可降到原值的一小部分（需以非線性模型重算）。若把垂度設計成 1.5 m，H₀ ≈ 438 kN、ΔH ≈ 409 kN，總計約 847 kN。所有數值為教學假設，不代表千禧巨蛋的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: assess the effect of hanging equipment from one radial cable. The cable spans L = 25 m between hangers with sag f = 1.0 m and a 14 m loaded width; at 0.6 kPa, w = 0.6×14 = 8.4 kN/m and the original horizontal tension is H₀ = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×625/8 ≈ 656 kN. Hanging 10 t at midspan, P = 10×9.81 ≈ 98 kN, adds by the point-load approximation ΔH = PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN, a total of about 1,269 kN or 1.93 times the original. Against a design limit of 1,000 kN this is not acceptable; hanging 5 t near each of the two hanger points greatly reduces the midspan effect and the added tension falls to a small fraction (to be recomputed with a nonlinear model). Designing the sag as 1.5 m gives H₀ ≈ 438 kN and ΔH ≈ 409 kN, about 847 kN in total. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Millennium Dome.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」與「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" and "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」如何影響倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radial net and 12 masts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millennium Dome roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 千禧巨蛋的屋面由徑向布置的鋼索網構成，屋面劃分為 72 個區段，索網在中段由 12 支桅桿頂端垂下的吊索提起，外緣則以壓制索與周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁固定。索網只能受拉，靠曲率與預張力抵抗面外荷載；桅桿則把吊索拉力轉成軸壓傳到基礎，並以拉索平衡。與混凝土或鋼構穹頂不同，這種屋蓋沒有受壓殼面，形狀完全由索長、吊點位置與預張力決定，所以結構重量極輕，卻對荷載方向變化非常敏感。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Millennium Dome roof is a cable net laid out radially and divided into 72 segments; in its middle zone the net is lifted by hanger cables from the tops of 12 masts, and at its edge it is held by tie-down cables and a perimeter reinforced-concrete ring beam. The net works only in tension, resisting out-of-plane load through curvature and pretension, while the masts turn hanger forces into axial compression delivered to their foundations and balanced by stays. Unlike a concrete or steel dome there is no compression shell; the shape is set entirely by cable lengths, hanger positions and pretension, so the structure is extremely light yet very sensitive to changes in load direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Radial net and 12 masts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Radial net and 12 masts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統
knowledge.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system
knowledge.text: 千禧巨蛋的屋面由徑向布置的鋼索網構成，屋面劃分為 72 個區段，索網在中段由 12 支桅桿頂端垂下的吊索提起，外緣則以壓制索與周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁固定。索網只能受拉，靠曲率與預張力抵抗面外荷載；桅桿則把吊索拉力轉成軸壓傳到基礎，並以拉索平衡。
knowledge.textEn: The Millennium Dome roof is a cable net laid out radially and divided into 72 segments; in its middle zone the net is lifted by hanger cables from the tops of 12 masts, and at its edge it is held by tie-down cables and a perimeter reinforced-concrete ring beam. The net works only in tension, resisting out-of-plane load through curvature and pretension, while the masts turn hanger forces into axial compression delivered to their foundations and balanced by stays.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Radial net and 12 masts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。若外緣一段徑向索受荷寬 14 m、荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 8.4 kN/m，吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m，水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN。荷載、跨距與垂度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m. If an outer radial cable carries a 14 m width at 0.6 kPa, w = 8.4 kN/m; with a span of L = 25 m between hanger points and sag f = 1.0 m, the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN. Load, span and sag are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛；把桅桿軸力、拉索力與環梁反力和簡化手算比較，確認傳力路徑閉合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination; compare mast axial forces, stay forces and ring-beam reactions with simplified hand calculations to confirm the load path closes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。若外緣一段徑向索受荷寬 14 m、荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 8.4 kN/m，吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m，水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN。荷載、跨距與垂度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m. If an outer radial cable carries a 14 m width at 0.6 kPa, w = 8.4 kN/m; with a span of L = 25 m between hanger points and sag f = 1.0 m, the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN. Load, span and sag are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever.

quiz.explanation: 72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Radial net and 12 masts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛；把桅桿軸力、拉索力與環梁反力和簡化手算比較，確認傳力路徑閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination; compare mast axial forces, stay forces and ring-beam reactions with simplified hand calculations to confirm the load path closes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索網結構的設計文件須以非線性分析為準，並列出每根索的設計張力範圍（最小與最大），作為施工張拉與日後檢測的依據；任何改變吊點或索長的變更都要重新做整體分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents for a cable net must be based on nonlinear analysis and list each cable's design tension range, minimum and maximum, as the basis for erection tensioning and later inspection; any change to hanger points or cable lengths requires a new global analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Radial net and 12 masts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：與混凝土或鋼構穹頂不同，這種屋蓋沒有受壓殼面，形狀完全由索長、吊點位置與預張力決定，所以結構重量極輕，卻對荷載方向變化非常敏感。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unlike a concrete or steel dome there is no compression shell; the shape is set entirely by cable lengths, hanger positions and pretension, so the structure is extremely light yet very sensitive to changes in load direction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。
屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension.
The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry.
quiz.explanation: 以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「比空氣還輕的屋頂」如何影響倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “A roof lighter than the air inside” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millennium Dome roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。重量輕意味著自重幾乎無法壓住屋面，風吹過低矮的穹形時在頂部與迎風前緣產生吸力，淨荷載方向由向下轉為向上。索網必須同時承受積雪等向下荷載與風吸力等向上荷載，兩種情況下都要保持受拉，因此需要相反曲率或壓制索提供向下的約束，再以預張力使網在兩個方向都有勁度。對輕屋蓋來說，吸力往往比雪載更控制設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「比空氣還輕的屋頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building. Low weight means self-weight can barely hold the roof down; wind over a low dome shape creates suction over the crown and windward edge, reversing the net load from downward to upward. The net must carry downward loads such as snow and upward loads such as suction while staying in tension in both, so tie-down cables or opposite curvature provide downward restraint and pretension gives the net stiffness in both directions. On a lightweight roof, suction often governs the design more than snow. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “A roof lighter than the air inside” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「比空氣還輕的屋頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “A roof lighter than the air inside”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制
knowledge.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs
knowledge.text: Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。重量輕意味著自重幾乎無法壓住屋面，風吹過低矮的穹形時在頂部與迎風前緣產生吸力，淨荷載方向由向下轉為向上。
knowledge.textEn: Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building. Low weight means self-weight can barely hold the roof down; wind over a low dome shape creates suction over the crown and windward edge, reversing the net load from downward to upward.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs" is correct?
options: 屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。
膜材越厚越強，所以應該儘量選厚膜並把它拉得越緊越好。
Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。
optionsEn: The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry.
Thicker fabric is always stronger, so choose the thickest fabric and pull it as tight as possible.
Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building.
quiz.explanation: Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「比空氣還輕的屋頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “A roof lighter than the air inside” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。以直徑 320 m 的平面 π×160² ≈ 80,400 m² 計，屋頂重量上限約 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m²，即約 0.32 kPa。若陣風速 35 m/s，q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa，吸力係數 −1.0 時淨上揚約 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa。風速與係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air. Over a 320 m diameter plan of π×160² ≈ 80,400 m², the roof weight is therefore below about 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m², about 0.32 kPa. With a 35 m/s gust, q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa, and a suction coefficient of −1.0 gives a net uplift of about 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa. Wind speed and coefficient are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍；地錨與環梁要以上拔力為主要檢核項目，並確認基礎重量或樁抗拔力有足夠安全係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both; ground anchors and the ring beam must be checked primarily for uplift, confirming adequate safety factors from foundation weight or pile tension capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。以直徑 320 m 的平面 π×160² ≈ 80,400 m² 計，屋頂重量上限約 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m²，即約 0.32 kPa。若陣風速 35 m/s，q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa，吸力係數 −1.0 時淨上揚約 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa。風速與係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air. Over a 320 m diameter plan of π×160² ≈ 80,400 m², the roof weight is therefore below about 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m², about 0.32 kPa. With a 35 m/s gust, q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa, and a suction coefficient of −1.0 gives a net uplift of about 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa. Wind speed and coefficient are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs", which statement holds?
options: 室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。
索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。

optionsEn: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air.
The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting.
If the wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its pressures apply directly at full scale.
quiz.explanation: 室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「比空氣還輕的屋頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “A roof lighter than the air inside” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍；地錨與環梁要以上拔力為主要檢核項目，並確認基礎重量或樁抗拔力有足夠安全係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both; ground anchors and the ring beam must be checked primarily for uplift, confirming adequate safety factors from foundation weight or pile tension capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：輕屋蓋的設計基準要明確寫出最小自重的取值與吸力的來源（規範或風洞），並把地錨抗拔試驗列為施工停止點；完工後任何移除屋面配重或附屬物的計畫，都要回頭檢查上拔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis of a light roof must state the minimum self-weight used and the source of suction values, code or wind tunnel, and make anchor pull-out tests a construction hold point; after completion any plan that removes roof weight or attachments must be rechecked for uplift.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以向下荷載設計而低估吸力，壓制索與地錨的拉力不足，強風時屋面上浮、索網形狀翻轉，膜片承受設計外的應力而大面積撕裂；輕量屋蓋的風損往往從邊緣與開口附近開始。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only for downward load and underestimating suction leaves tie-downs and anchors short of capacity, so in strong wind the roof lifts, the net shape inverts and the fabric sees unintended stress and tears over large areas; wind damage to light roofs often starts at edges and openings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: PTFE-coated glass fabric and material choice: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1 mm PTFE 玻璃纖維膜」如何影響倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1 mm PTFE-coated glass fabric” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millennium Dome roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 屋面原規劃使用 PVC 塗覆聚酯膜，後來改為 PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維膜，厚約 1 mm，內側另有提供保溫與吸音的內襯，並以 144 片膜片組成 72 個區段。PTFE 玻纖膜強度高、不燃性佳、抗紫外線且表面不易附著污垢，使用壽命遠長於 PVC 聚酯膜；但玻璃纖維怕折，運輸與安裝時不能對折或踩踏折痕，且膜材幾乎不能延伸，裁剪精度要求高。膜片在索之間張緊，局部曲率決定膜面應力，平坦的膜片在吸力下張力會急遽升高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1 mm PTFE 玻璃纖維膜」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The roof was originally planned in PVC-coated polyester but changed to PTFE-coated glass-fibre fabric about 1 mm thick, with an inner liner for thermal and acoustic performance, and 144 panels forming the 72 segments. PTFE-glass is strong, highly fire resistant, UV stable and sheds dirt, giving a far longer life than PVC-polyester; but glass fibres dislike folding, so panels must not be creased or walked on during transport and installation, and the fabric barely stretches, so cutting accuracy is critical. Panels are tensioned between cables and their local curvature governs membrane stress, so a flat panel sees sharply higher tension under suction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1 mm PTFE-coated glass fabric” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：膜片在兩條支承之間局部單向彎曲時 T = p·R，R = s²/(8f) + f/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Where a panel curves locally in one direction between two supports, T = p·R with R = s²/(8f) + f/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膜材越厚越強，所以應該儘量選厚膜並把它拉得越緊越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker fabric is always stronger, so choose the thickest fabric and pull it as tight as possible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「1 mm PTFE 玻璃纖維膜」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “1 mm PTFE-coated glass fabric”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: PTFE-coated glass fabric and material choice: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1 mm PTFE 玻璃纖維膜」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1 mm PTFE-coated glass fabric” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：膜片在兩條支承之間局部單向彎曲時 T = p·R，R = s²/(8f) + f/2。取支承間距 s = 4 m、垂度 f = 0.25 m，R = 16/2 + 0.125 ≈ 8.1 m；吸力 p = 0.75 kPa 時 T ≈ 6.1 kN/m。若垂度只剩 0.1 m，R ≈ 20.05 m，T ≈ 15.0 kN/m，約 2.5 倍。間距、垂度與吸力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Where a panel curves locally in one direction between two supports, T = p·R with R = s²/(8f) + f/2. With support spacing s = 4 m and sag f = 0.25 m, R = 16/2 + 0.125 ≈ 8.1 m; at a suction p = 0.75 kPa, T ≈ 6.1 kN/m. If the sag is only 0.1 m, R ≈ 20.05 m and T ≈ 15.0 kN/m, about 2.5 times larger. Spacing, sag and suction are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：膜材每批做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗，並保存樣品作為日後比對；裁片後量測尺寸，安裝前檢查有無折痕與塗層破損；完成後量測膜面局部垂度，抽查是否有平坦或皺褶區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test each batch of fabric for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, retaining samples for later comparison; measure cut panels before installation and inspect for creases and coating damage; after installation measure local sag of the fabric and spot-check for flat or wrinkled zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 膜片在兩條支承之間局部單向彎曲時 T = p·R，R = s²/(8f) + f/2。取支承間距 s = 4 m、垂度 f = 0.25 m，R = 16/2 + 0.125 ≈ 8.1 m；吸力 p = 0.75 kPa 時 T ≈ 6.1 kN/m。若垂度只剩 0.1 m，R ≈ 20.05 m，T ≈ 15.0 kN/m，約 2.5 倍。間距、垂度與吸力為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Where a panel curves locally in one direction between two supports, T = p·R with R = s²/(8f) + f/2. With support spacing s = 4 m and sag f = 0.25 m, R = 16/2 + 0.125 ≈ 8.1 m; at a suction p = 0.75 kPa, T ≈ 6.1 kN/m. If the sag is only 0.1 m, R ≈ 20.05 m and T ≈ 15.0 kN/m, about 2.5 times larger. Spacing, sag and suction are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

膜片在兩條支承之間局部單向彎曲時 T = p·R，R = s²/(8f) + f/2。
索網外觀形狀正確，就表示每根索的張力都符合設計。
optionsEn: Cable-net pretension can be adjusted freely with jacks at any time after completion.
Where a panel curves locally in one direction between two supports, T = p·R with R = s²/(8f) + f/2.
If the net looks the right shape, every cable's tension matches the design.
quiz.explanation: 膜片在兩條支承之間局部單向彎曲時 T = p·R，R = s²/(8f) + f/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Where a panel curves locally in one direction between two supports, T = p·R with R = s²/(8f) + f/2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: PTFE-coated glass fabric and material choice: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1 mm PTFE 玻璃纖維膜」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1 mm PTFE-coated glass fabric” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 膜材每批做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗，並保存樣品作為日後比對；裁片後量測尺寸，安裝前檢查有無折痕與塗層破損；完成後量測膜面局部垂度，抽查是否有平坦或皺褶區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test each batch of fabric for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, retaining samples for later comparison; measure cut panels before installation and inspect for creases and coating damage; after installation measure local sag of the fabric and spot-check for flat or wrinkled zones. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：膜材規格應寫明強度、塗層、防火等級、透光率與壽命期望，並規定運輸捲筒直徑、禁止對折與安裝時的保護措施；任何材料替代（例如由 PTFE 玻纖改為其他膜）都要重新評估強度、伸長與防火，經設計者核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The fabric specification should state strength, coating, fire classification, light transmission and expected life, and set the shipping roll diameter, a ban on folding and protection during installation; any material substitution, such as changing from PTFE-glass to another fabric, must be re-evaluated for strength, stretch and fire and approved by the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被折出折痕，玻璃纖維斷裂形成弱線，數年後在反覆風吸力下沿折痕撕裂；裁片偏大使膜面鬆弛、出現皺褶與拍打，加速磨損，偏小則安裝時過度張拉、邊緣應力集中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A PTFE-glass panel creased in handling breaks glass fibres along a weak line that tears years later under repeated suction; panels cut too large go slack, wrinkle and flap, accelerating wear, while panels cut too small are over-tensioned at installation with stress concentrated at the edges. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Test each batch of fabric for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, retaining samples for later comparison; measure cut panels before installation and inspect for creases and coating damage; after installation measure local sag of the fabric and spot-check for flat or wrinkled zones.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

quiz.question: 要驗證「PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "PTFE-coated glass fabric and material choice"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
索網屋蓋那麼大，多掛幾噸設備不會有影響。
膜材每批做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗，並保存樣品作為日後比對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A cable-net roof is so large that a few extra tonnes of equipment make no difference.
Test each batch of fabric for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, retaining samples for later comparison.
quiz.explanation: 膜材每批做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗，並保存樣品作為日後比對；裁片後量測尺寸，安裝前檢查有無折痕與塗層破損；完成後量測膜面局部垂度，抽查是否有平坦或皺褶區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test each batch of fabric for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, retaining samples for later comparison; measure cut panels before installation and inspect for creases and coating damage; after installation measure local sag of the fabric and spot-check for flat or wrinkled zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: PTFE-coated glass fabric and material choice: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1 mm PTFE 玻璃纖維膜」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “1 mm PTFE-coated glass fabric” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被折出折痕，玻璃纖維斷裂形成弱線，數年後在反覆風吸力下沿折痕撕裂；裁片偏大使膜面鬆弛、出現皺褶與拍打，加速磨損，偏小則安裝時過度張拉、邊緣應力集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A PTFE-glass panel creased in handling breaks glass fibres along a weak line that tears years later under repeated suction; panels cut too large go slack, wrinkle and flap, accelerating wear, while panels cut too small are over-tensioned at installation with stress concentrated at the edges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：膜片在索之間張緊，局部曲率決定膜面應力，平坦的膜片在吸力下張力會急遽升高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Panels are tensioned between cables and their local curvature governs membrane stress, so a flat panel sees sharply higher tension under suction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膜材越厚越強，所以應該儘量選厚膜並把它拉得越緊越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker fabric is always stronger, so choose the thickest fabric and pull it as tight as possible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被折出折痕，玻璃纖維斷裂形成弱線，數年後在反覆風吸力下沿折痕撕裂；裁片偏大使膜面鬆弛、出現皺褶與拍打，加速磨損，偏小則安裝時過度張拉、邊緣應力集中。
knowledge.textEn: A PTFE-glass panel creased in handling breaks glass fibres along a weak line that tears years later under repeated suction; panels cut too large go slack, wrinkle and flap, accelerating wear, while panels cut too small are over-tensioned at installation with stress concentrated at the edges.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "PTFE-coated glass fabric and material choice" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被折出折痕，玻璃纖維斷裂形成弱線，數年後在反覆風吸力下沿折痕撕裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
索夾螺栓鎖緊一次就能永久維持夾緊力。
optionsEn: A PTFE-glass panel creased in handling breaks glass fibres along a weak line that tears years later under repeated suction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever.
quiz.explanation: PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被折出折痕，玻璃纖維斷裂形成弱線，數年後在反覆風吸力下沿折痕撕裂；裁片偏大使膜面鬆弛、出現皺褶與拍打，加速磨損，偏小則安裝時過度張拉、邊緣應力集中。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A PTFE-glass panel creased in handling breaks glass fibres along a weak line that tears years later under repeated suction; panels cut too large go slack, wrinkle and flap, accelerating wear, while panels cut too small are over-tensioned at installation with stress concentrated at the edges. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索夾與吊索節點」如何影響倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cable clamps and hanger nodes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millennium Dome roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 吊索從桅桿頂端垂下，以索夾抓住徑向索，把網的荷載轉到桅桿；壓制索與周邊錨定則把網往下拉住。索夾靠螺栓夾緊產生的摩擦力抵抗沿索方向的滑移，但鍍鋅螺旋鋼索在受拉後直徑會縮小、表面鍍層也會潛變，螺栓夾緊力隨時間下降，夾具可能滑動，改變索網形狀與內力分布。節點還要容許索在不同荷載下的角度變化，避免在夾具出口處產生彎曲疲勞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索夾與吊索節點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hangers drop from the mast tops and grip the radial cables with clamps that transfer net load to the masts, while tie-downs and edge anchorages pull the net down. A clamp resists slip along the cable by friction generated by bolt clamping, but galvanised spiral strand shrinks in diameter under tension and its zinc coating creeps, so bolt clamping force falls over time and the clamp may slip, changing net shape and force distribution. The node must also accommodate changes in cable angle under different loads to avoid bending fatigue where the cable leaves the clamp. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cable clamps and hanger nodes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：索夾滑移阻力 F = 2μN（兩個摩擦面）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Clamp slip resistance is F = 2μN for two friction faces.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索夾螺栓鎖緊一次就能永久維持夾緊力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索夾與吊索節點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cable clamps and hanger nodes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部
knowledge.titleEn: Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details
knowledge.text: 吊索從桅桿頂端垂下，以索夾抓住徑向索，把網的荷載轉到桅桿；壓制索與周邊錨定則把網往下拉住。索夾靠螺栓夾緊產生的摩擦力抵抗沿索方向的滑移，但鍍鋅螺旋鋼索在受拉後直徑會縮小、表面鍍層也會潛變，螺栓夾緊力隨時間下降，夾具可能滑動，改變索網形狀與內力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Hangers drop from the mast tops and grip the radial cables with clamps that transfer net load to the masts, while tie-downs and edge anchorages pull the net down. A clamp resists slip along the cable by friction generated by bolt clamping, but galvanised spiral strand shrinks in diameter under tension and its zinc coating creeps, so bolt clamping force falls over time and the clamp may slip, changing net shape and force distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：索夾螺栓鎖緊一次就能永久維持夾緊力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details" is correct?
options: 索夾螺栓鎖緊一次就能永久維持夾緊力。
吊索從桅桿頂端垂下，以索夾抓住徑向索，把網的荷載轉到桅桿；壓制索與周邊錨定則把網往下拉住。
索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。
optionsEn: Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever.
Hangers drop from the mast tops and grip the radial cables with clamps that transfer net load to the masts, while tie-downs and edge anchorages pull the net down.
The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting.
quiz.explanation: 吊索從桅桿頂端垂下，以索夾抓住徑向索，把網的荷載轉到桅桿；壓制索與周邊錨定則把網往下拉住。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hangers drop from the mast tops and grip the radial cables with clamps that transfer net load to the masts, while tie-downs and edge anchorages pull the net down. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索夾與吊索節點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cable clamps and hanger nodes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：索夾滑移阻力 F = 2μN（兩個摩擦面）。若沿索方向需抵抗 150 kN、摩擦係數取 0.1，所需總夾緊力 N = 150/(2×0.1) = 750 kN，4 支螺栓各約 188 kN。若索徑縮小與鍍層潛變使夾緊力損失 20%，剩 600 kN，抗滑僅 2×0.1×600 = 120 kN，小於 150 kN 的需求。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Clamp slip resistance is F = 2μN for two friction faces. To resist 150 kN along the cable with μ = 0.1, the total clamping force needed is N = 150/(2×0.1) = 750 kN, about 188 kN for each of 4 bolts. If cable diameter reduction and coating creep cost 20% of the clamping force, 600 kN remains and slip resistance is only 2×0.1×600 = 120 kN, below the 150 kN demand. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：索夾做足尺滑移試驗，在設計張力下的索上量測開始滑移的荷載，與計算比較；安裝時以扭力或張力控制螺栓預拉力並標記索夾位置；完工後數月再複緊一次，之後定期檢查索夾上的標記線是否移位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform full-scale slip tests on clamps fitted to cable at design tension, measuring the load at onset of slip and comparing with calculation; at installation control bolt pretension by torque or tension and mark the clamp position on the cable; re-tighten a few months after completion, then periodically check whether the marker lines on clamps have moved.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 索夾滑移阻力 F = 2μN（兩個摩擦面）。若沿索方向需抵抗 150 kN、摩擦係數取 0.1，所需總夾緊力 N = 150/(2×0.1) = 750 kN，4 支螺栓各約 188 kN。若索徑縮小與鍍層潛變使夾緊力損失 20%，剩 600 kN，抗滑僅 2×0.1×600 = 120 kN，小於 150 kN 的需求。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Clamp slip resistance is F = 2μN for two friction faces. To resist 150 kN along the cable with μ = 0.1, the total clamping force needed is N = 150/(2×0.1) = 750 kN, about 188 kN for each of 4 bolts. If cable diameter reduction and coating creep cost 20% of the clamping force, 600 kN remains and slip resistance is only 2×0.1×600 = 120 kN, below the 150 kN demand. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 風洞模型只要幾何比例正確，量到的壓力就能直接用於實尺度。
PTFE 膜屋面是永久性的，不需要考慮更換。
索夾滑移阻力 F = 2μN（兩個摩擦面）。
optionsEn: If the wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its pressures apply directly at full scale.
A PTFE membrane roof is permanent and never needs replacement planning.
Clamp slip resistance is F = 2μN for two friction faces.
quiz.explanation: 索夾滑移阻力 F = 2μN（兩個摩擦面）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Clamp slip resistance is F = 2μN for two friction faces. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索夾與吊索節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cable clamps and hanger nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 索夾做足尺滑移試驗，在設計張力下的索上量測開始滑移的荷載，與計算比較；安裝時以扭力或張力控制螺栓預拉力並標記索夾位置；完工後數月再複緊一次，之後定期檢查索夾上的標記線是否移位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perform full-scale slip tests on clamps fitted to cable at design tension, measuring the load at onset of slip and comparing with calculation; at installation control bolt pretension by torque or tension and mark the clamp position on the cable; re-tighten a few months after completion, then periodically check whether the marker lines on clamps have moved. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索夾設計要規定預拉力、複緊時程與滑移標記方法，並在維護手冊中列出每個索夾的編號與檢查週期；更換或調整任何吊索前，須由結構工程師評估臨時荷載轉移。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Clamp design should specify pretension, re-tightening schedule and slip-marking method, and the maintenance manual should list every clamp by number with its inspection interval; before replacing or adjusting any hanger, the structural engineer must assess the temporary load transfer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：索夾鬆動滑移後，吊點沿索移動，局部膜片被拉緊或放鬆，出現皺褶與拍打；夾具出口邊緣若無圓弧，索在風振下反覆彎曲，外層鋼絲斷裂，最後在吊點附近斷索。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When clamps loosen and slip, hanger points move along the cable, tightening or slackening local panels so they wrinkle and flap; a clamp exit without a rounded edge bends the cable repeatedly in wind, breaking outer wires until the cable fails near the hanger. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 索夾設計要規定預拉力、複緊時程與滑移標記方法，並在維護手冊中列出每個索夾的編號與檢查週期；更換或調整任何吊索前，須由結構工程師評估臨時荷載轉移。

quiz.question: 要驗證「索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame.

steps.title: 索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索夾與吊索節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cable clamps and hanger nodes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 索夾鬆動滑移後，吊點沿索移動，局部膜片被拉緊或放鬆，出現皺褶與拍打；夾具出口邊緣若無圓弧，索在風振下反覆彎曲，外層鋼絲斷裂，最後在吊點附近斷索。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: When clamps loosen and slip, hanger points move along the cable, tightening or slackening local panels so they wrinkle and flap; a clamp exit without a rounded edge bends the cable repeatedly in wind, breaking outer wires until the cable fails near the hanger. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：節點還要容許索在不同荷載下的角度變化，避免在夾具出口處產生彎曲疲勞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The node must also accommodate changes in cable angle under different loads to avoid bending fatigue where the cable leaves the clamp.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索夾螺栓鎖緊一次就能永久維持夾緊力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 索夾鬆動滑移後，吊點沿索移動，局部膜片被拉緊或放鬆，出現皺褶與拍打；夾具出口邊緣若無圓弧，索在風振下反覆彎曲，外層鋼絲斷裂，最後在吊點附近斷索。
knowledge.textEn: When clamps loosen and slip, hanger points move along the cable, tightening or slackening local panels so they wrinkle and flap; a clamp exit without a rounded edge bends the cable repeatedly in wind, breaking outer wires until the cable fails near the hanger.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
索夾鬆動滑移後，吊點沿索移動，局部膜片被拉緊或放鬆，出現皺褶與拍打；夾具出口邊緣若無圓弧，索在風振下反覆彎曲，外層鋼絲斷裂，最後在吊點附近斷索。
索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
When clamps loosen and slip, hanger points move along the cable, tightening or slackening local panels so they wrinkle and flap.
The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「桅桿豎立與索網絞升」與「索長精度與預張力的關係」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mast erection and winching the net" and "Cable length accuracy and pretension": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 桅桿豎立與索網絞升：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mast erection and winching the net: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「地面組裝與絞升索網」如何影響倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground assembly and winching” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millennium Dome roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 施工時先豎立 12 支桅桿並以拉索穩定，再把索網在地面鋪設、連接索夾，然後以絞車經吊索把整張網拉升到位，最後才安裝膜片。索網在提升過程中呈大垂度的懸鏈形，張力很小；隨著網被拉起、垂度減少，索的水平張力急遽上升。由於最終形狀由已裁好的索長與吊點決定，提升過程主要是控制幾何與同步，而不是用千斤頂力量去決定索力。整個屋頂結構在約 15 個月內完成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「地面組裝與絞升索網」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Construction first raised the 12 masts and stabilised them with stays, then laid the cable net out on the ground, fitted the clamps and winched the whole net into position through the hangers, installing the fabric last. During lifting the net hangs as a deep catenary with low tension; as it rises and its sag reduces, horizontal cable tension climbs steeply. Because the final shape is fixed by prefabricated cable lengths and hanger points, lifting is mainly about controlling geometry and synchronisation rather than setting cable forces by jack force. The roof structure was delivered in about 15 months. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ground assembly and winching” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一段徑向索自重 w = 0.2 kN/m、跨距 L = 100 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A radial cable length weighs w = 0.2 kN/m over a span L = 100 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「地面組裝與絞升索網」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ground assembly and winching”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 桅桿豎立與索網絞升
knowledge.titleEn: Mast erection and winching the net
knowledge.text: 施工時先豎立 12 支桅桿並以拉索穩定，再把索網在地面鋪設、連接索夾，然後以絞車經吊索把整張網拉升到位，最後才安裝膜片。索網在提升過程中呈大垂度的懸鏈形，張力很小；隨著網被拉起、垂度減少，索的水平張力急遽上升。
knowledge.textEn: Construction first raised the 12 masts and stabilised them with stays, then laid the cable net out on the ground, fitted the clamps and winched the whole net into position through the hangers, installing the fabric last. During lifting the net hangs as a deep catenary with low tension; as it rises and its sag reduces, horizontal cable tension climbs steeply.

knowledge.text: 誤解：索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「桅桿豎立與索網絞升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mast erection and winching the net" is correct?
options: 索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。
索網的預張力可以在完工後隨時用千斤頂任意調整。

optionsEn: The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting.
Cable-net pretension can be adjusted freely with jacks at any time after completion.

steps.title: 桅桿豎立與索網絞升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mast erection and winching the net: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地面組裝與絞升索網」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground assembly and winching” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一段徑向索自重 w = 0.2 kN/m、跨距 L = 100 m。提升初期垂度 f = 10 m，H = wL²/(8f) = 0.2×100²/80 = 25 kN；拉到垂度 2 m 時 H = 0.2×10,000/16 = 125 kN，張力增為 5 倍，而垂度只少了 8 m。索重、跨距與垂度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A radial cable length weighs w = 0.2 kN/m over a span L = 100 m. Early in the lift with sag f = 10 m, H = wL²/(8f) = 0.2×100²/80 = 25 kN; pulled up to a 2 m sag, H = 0.2×10,000/16 = 125 kN, five times higher for only 8 m less sag. Cable weight, span and sag are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：提升前核對每根索的標記長度與索夾位置；提升中監測各絞車的拉力與吊點高程，確保各桅桿同步上升，並觀察桅桿頂位移與拉索力；到位後量測索網節點座標，與設計形狀比較，偏差超過允許值時找出是索長、索夾位置還是桅桿傾斜造成。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting, check each cable's marked length and clamp positions; during lifting monitor each winch's pull and hanger-point levels so all masts rise together, watching mast-top movement and stay forces; once in position survey net node coordinates against the design shape, and where deviations exceed tolerance identify whether cable length, clamp position or mast inclination is responsible.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一段徑向索自重 w = 0.2 kN/m、跨距 L = 100 m。提升初期垂度 f = 10 m，H = wL²/(8f) = 0.2×100²/80 = 25 kN；拉到垂度 2 m 時 H = 0.2×10,000/16 = 125 kN，張力增為 5 倍，而垂度只少了 8 m。索重、跨距與垂度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A radial cable length weighs w = 0.2 kN/m over a span L = 100 m. Early in the lift with sag f = 10 m, H = wL²/(8f) = 0.2×100²/80 = 25 kN; pulled up to a 2 m sag, H = 0.2×10,000/16 = 125 kN, five times higher for only 8 m less sag. Cable weight, span and sag are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「桅桿豎立與索網絞升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

索網屋蓋那麼大，多掛幾噸設備不會有影響。
optionsEn: A radial cable length weighs w = 0.2 kN/m over a span L = 100 m.
If the net looks the right shape, every cable's tension matches the design.
A cable-net roof is so large that a few extra tonnes of equipment make no difference.
quiz.explanation: 一段徑向索自重 w = 0.2 kN/m、跨距 L = 100 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A radial cable length weighs w = 0.2 kN/m over a span L = 100 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 桅桿豎立與索網絞升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mast erection and winching the net: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地面組裝與絞升索網」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground assembly and winching” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 提升前核對每根索的標記長度與索夾位置；提升中監測各絞車的拉力與吊點高程，確保各桅桿同步上升，並觀察桅桿頂位移與拉索力；到位後量測索網節點座標，與設計形狀比較，偏差超過允許值時找出是索長、索夾位置還是桅桿傾斜造成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting, check each cable's marked length and clamp positions; during lifting monitor each winch's pull and hanger-point levels so all masts rise together, watching mast-top movement and stay forces; once in position survey net node coordinates against the design shape, and where deviations exceed tolerance identify whether cable length, clamp position or mast inclination is responsible. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索網提升計畫須列出提升階段、各階段的絞車力與吊點高程預測、同步容許差、風速上限與緊急停止方法，並以施工階段分析驗證；由專業承包商、結構設計者與現場安全負責人共同核可，作為停止點管理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A net-lifting plan must list lifting stages with predicted winch forces and hanger levels, synchronisation tolerance, wind limit and emergency stop method, verified by construction-stage analysis; it is approved jointly by the specialist contractor, structural designer and site safety lead and managed as a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：各絞車不同步時，先被拉緊的區段承受大部分重量，索夾可能滑動或桅桿頂受到不平衡水平力而傾斜；若在大風中提升，大面積索網像帆一樣擺動，纏繞或撞擊桅桿與拉索。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronised winches leave the first-tightened zone carrying most of the weight, so clamps may slip or mast tops tilt under unbalanced horizontal force; lifting in strong wind lets the large net sway like a sail and tangle with or strike masts and stays. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「桅桿豎立與索網絞升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mast erection and winching the net"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
提升前核對每根索的標記長度與索夾位置。
屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before lifting, check each cable's marked length and clamp positions.
The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry.
