Acrylic expands about six times as much as steel, so in summer sun the panels grow far more than the cable net beneath; fittings that do not allow relative sliding make panels bow or crack at their holes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：透明覆板只是遮雨用，不需要考慮熱脹與索網變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Transparent cover panels only keep the rain out and need no allowance for thermal movement or net deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels" is correct?
options: 透明覆板只是遮雨用，不需要考慮熱脹與索網變形。
屋蓋以約 8,300 片、每片約 3 × 3 m 的藍灰色壓克力板覆蓋，板片以點狀柔性固定件安裝在索網節點上，板與板之間留有可伸縮的接縫。
桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。
optionsEn: Transparent cover panels only keep the rain out and need no allowance for thermal movement or net deformation.
The roof is covered by about 8,300 blue-grey acrylic panels of about 3 × 3 m, point-fixed to net nodes by flexible fittings with movement joints between panels.
Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets.
quiz.explanation: 屋蓋以約 8,300 片、每片約 3 × 3 m 的藍灰色壓克力板覆蓋，板片以點狀柔性固定件安裝在索網節點上，板與板之間留有可伸縮的接縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The roof is covered by about 8,300 blue-grey acrylic panels of about 3 × 3 m, point-fixed to net nodes by flexible fittings with movement joints between panels. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3 × 3 m 壓克力覆板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3 × 3 m acrylic panels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱脹 ΔL = αLΔT。壓克力 α ≈ 70×10⁻⁶ /°C、板長 L = 3,000 mm、溫差 ΔT = 50°C：ΔL ≈ 10.5 mm；同長度鋼索網 α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C 只伸長約 1.8 mm，相對位移約 8.7 mm，接縫與固定件必須吸收。8,300 片 × 9 m² ≈ 74,700 m²，與公布面積相符。α 與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = αLΔT. For acrylic with α ≈ 70×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 3,000 mm panel and ΔT = 50°C give ΔL ≈ 10.5 mm, while the steel net over the same length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, grows only about 1.8 mm, leaving about 8.7 mm of relative movement for joints and fittings to absorb. 8,300 panels × 9 m² ≈ 74,700 m², consistent with the published area. α and the temperature range are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：覆板材料以抗彎、衝擊、耐候與防火試驗驗收；固定件做往復滑動試驗，確認在設計溫差的行程下不卡死、不磨損；安裝後於冬夏兩季檢查接縫寬度與板面翹曲，並以紅外線或目視檢查孔邊是否出現微裂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Accept panel material by bending, impact, weathering and fire tests; cycle fittings through the design thermal stroke to confirm they neither jam nor wear; after installation inspect joint widths and panel bowing in winter and summer, and check hole edges for micro-cracks visually or by infrared.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱脹 ΔL = αLΔT。壓克力 α ≈ 70×10⁻⁶ /°C、板長 L = 3,000 mm、溫差 ΔT = 50°C：ΔL ≈ 10.5 mm；同長度鋼索網 α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C 只伸長約 1.8 mm，相對位移約 8.7 mm，接縫與固定件必須吸收。8,300 片 × 9 m² ≈ 74,700 m²，與公布面積相符。α 與溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal movement ΔL = αLΔT. For acrylic with α ≈ 70×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 3,000 mm panel and ΔT = 50°C give ΔL ≈ 10.5 mm, while the steel net over the same length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, grows only about 1.8 mm, leaving about 8.7 mm of relative movement for joints and fittings to absorb. 8,300 panels × 9 m² ≈ 74,700 m², consistent with the published area. α and the temperature range are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels", which statement holds?
options: 實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。
只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。
熱脹 ΔL = αLΔT。
optionsEn: A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths.
A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material.
Thermal movement ΔL = αLΔT.
quiz.explanation: 熱脹 ΔL = αLΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement ΔL = αLΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「3 × 3 m 壓克力覆板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “3 × 3 m acrylic panels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 覆板材料以抗彎、衝擊、耐候與防火試驗驗收；固定件做往復滑動試驗，確認在設計溫差的行程下不卡死、不磨損；安裝後於冬夏兩季檢查接縫寬度與板面翹曲，並以紅外線或目視檢查孔邊是否出現微裂。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Accept panel material by bending, impact, weathering and fire tests; cycle fittings through the design thermal stroke to confirm they neither jam nor wear; after installation inspect joint widths and panel bowing in winter and summer, and check hole edges for micro-cracks visually or by infrared. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：覆板固定件設計要寫明滑動方向、行程、孔徑與墊片材料，接縫密封要指定材料壽命與更換方式；更換覆板時必須使用同等熱脹與強度特性的材料，並經結構與建築設計者共同核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Panel-fixing design should state sliding directions, travel, hole size and washer material, and joint seals should specify service life and replacement method; replacement panels must have equivalent thermal-expansion and strength properties and be approved jointly by the structural and architectural designers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：固定孔周邊沒有留滑動間隙，夏季板片膨脹被鎖住，孔邊應力集中而放射狀開裂，雨水由裂縫滲入；接縫密封條老化變硬後失去伸縮能力，板片互相頂撞或接縫脫開漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fixing holes without sliding clearance lock in summer expansion, concentrating stress so radial cracks grow from hole edges and let rain through; joint seals that age and harden lose their movement capacity, so panels butt against each other or joints open and leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 覆板材料以抗彎、衝擊、耐候與防火試驗驗收；固定件做往復滑動試驗，確認在設計溫差的行程下不卡死、不磨損；安裝後於冬夏兩季檢查接縫寬度與板面翹曲，並以紅外線或目視檢查孔邊是否出現微裂。
knowledge.textEn: Accept panel material by bending, impact, weathering and fire tests; cycle fittings through the design thermal stroke to confirm they neither jam nor wear; after installation inspect joint widths and panel bowing in winter and summer, and check hole edges for micro-cracks visually or by infrared.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 覆板固定件設計要寫明滑動方向、行程、孔徑與墊片材料，接縫密封要指定材料壽命與更換方式；更換覆板時必須使用同等熱脹與強度特性的材料，並經結構與建築設計者共同核可。
knowledge.textEn: Panel-fixing design should state sliding directions, travel, hole size and washer material, and joint seals should specify service life and replacement method; replacement panels must have equivalent thermal-expansion and strength properties and be approved jointly by the structural and architectural designers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels"?
options: 覆板材料以抗彎、衝擊、耐候與防火試驗驗收。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。
optionsEn: Accept panel material by bending, impact, weathering and fire tests.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 覆板材料以抗彎、衝擊、耐候與防火試驗驗收；固定件做往復滑動試驗，確認在設計溫差的行程下不卡死、不磨損；安裝後於冬夏兩季檢查接縫寬度與板面翹曲，並以紅外線或目視檢查孔邊是否出現微裂。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Accept panel material by bending, impact, weathering and fire tests; cycle fittings through the design thermal stroke to confirm they neither jam nor wear; after installation inspect joint widths and panel bowing in winter and summer, and check hole edges for micro-cracks visually or by infrared. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「3 × 3 m 壓克力覆板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “3 × 3 m acrylic panels” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 固定孔周邊沒有留滑動間隙，夏季板片膨脹被鎖住，孔邊應力集中而放射狀開裂，雨水由裂縫滲入；接縫密封條老化變硬後失去伸縮能力，板片互相頂撞或接縫脫開漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fixing holes without sliding clearance lock in summer expansion, concentrating stress so radial cracks grow from hole edges and let rain through; joint seals that age and harden lose their movement capacity, so panels butt against each other or joints open and leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：索網在風雪下也會變形，覆板必須跟著轉動而不把荷載傳到相鄰板，因此固定件與接縫的柔性與覆板強度同樣重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The net also deforms under wind and snow, and the panels must rotate with it without passing load to their neighbours, so the flexibility of fittings and joints matters as much as panel strength.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「透明覆板只是遮雨用，不需要考慮熱脹與索網變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transparent cover panels only keep the rain out and need no allowance for thermal movement or net deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 固定孔周邊沒有留滑動間隙，夏季板片膨脹被鎖住，孔邊應力集中而放射狀開裂，雨水由裂縫滲入；接縫密封條老化變硬後失去伸縮能力，板片互相頂撞或接縫脫開漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Fixing holes without sliding clearance lock in summer expansion, concentrating stress so radial cracks grow from hole edges and let rain through; joint seals that age and harden lose their movement capacity, so panels butt against each other or joints open and leak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓克力覆板的熱脹、固定與接縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal movement, fixing and joints of acrylic panels" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
固定孔周邊沒有留滑動間隙，夏季板片膨脹被鎖住，孔邊應力集中而放射狀開裂，雨水由裂縫滲入；接縫密封條老化變硬後失去伸縮能力，板片互相頂撞或接縫脫開漏水。
桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Fixing holes without sliding clearance lock in summer expansion, concentrating stress so radial cracks grow from hole edges and let rain through.
Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets.
quiz.explanation: 固定孔周邊沒有留滑動間隙，夏季板片膨脹被鎖住，孔邊應力集中而放射狀開裂，雨水由裂縫滲入；接縫密封條老化變硬後失去伸縮能力，板片互相頂撞或接縫脫開漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixing holes without sliding clearance lock in summer expansion, concentrating stress so radial cracks grow from hole edges and let rain through; joint seals that age and harden lose their movement capacity, so panels butt against each other or joints open and leak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地面預製索網與吊升就位」與「由邊索與拉索導入預拉力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ground-assembled nets lifted into place" and "Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地面預製索網與吊升就位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground-assembled nets lifted into place: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「地面編網與吊升」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground net assembly and lifting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索網在地面依標準網目編成，連同節點夾具與部分邊索一起準備，再由已豎立並以拉索穩定的桅桿把網吊升到位。吊升過程中網面幾何不斷改變，網只靠自重與吊點維持形狀，風會讓尚未張拉的網大幅擺動；桅桿在吊升時承受的不平衡水平力也與完成狀態不同。因此吊升順序、吊點分配與臨時拉索都必須以施工階段分析確認，並在吊升後才連接邊索與錨具、導入預拉力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「地面編網與吊升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nets were assembled on the ground to the standard mesh, prepared with node clamps and parts of the edge cables, then lifted into position by masts already raised and stabilised by their guys. During lifting the net geometry changes continuously and the net holds its shape only by self-weight and pick points, so wind swings an untensioned net widely, and the masts see unbalanced horizontal forces unlike their final state. The lifting sequence, distribution of pick points and temporary guys must therefore be confirmed by construction-stage analysis, with edge cables and anchorages connected and prestress introduced only after lifting. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ground net assembly and lifting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某網區面積 8,000 m²，索與節點自重取 8 kg/m²，重約 8×8,000 = 64 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A net zone of 8,000 m² with cables and nodes weighing 8 kg/m² weighs about 8×8,000 = 64 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「地面編網與吊升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ground net assembly and lifting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地面預製索網與吊升就位
knowledge.text: 索網在地面依標準網目編成，連同節點夾具與部分邊索一起準備，再由已豎立並以拉索穩定的桅桿把網吊升到位。吊升過程中網面幾何不斷改變，網只靠自重與吊點維持形狀，風會讓尚未張拉的網大幅擺動；桅桿在吊升時承受的不平衡水平力也與完成狀態不同。
knowledge.textEn: Nets were assembled on the ground to the standard mesh, prepared with node clamps and parts of the edge cables, then lifted into position by masts already raised and stabilised by their guys. During lifting the net geometry changes continuously and the net holds its shape only by self-weight and pick points, so wind swings an untensioned net widely, and the masts see unbalanced horizontal forces unlike their final state.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地面預製索網與吊升就位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ground-assembled nets lifted into place" is correct?
options: 桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。
張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。
索網在地面依標準網目編成，連同節點夾具與部分邊索一起準備，再由已豎立並以拉索穩定的桅桿把網吊升到位。
optionsEn: Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets.
Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter.
Nets were assembled on the ground to the standard mesh, prepared with node clamps and parts of the edge cables, then lifted into position by masts already raised and stabilised by their guys.
quiz.explanation: 索網在地面依標準網目編成，連同節點夾具與部分邊索一起準備，再由已豎立並以拉索穩定的桅桿把網吊升到位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nets were assembled on the ground to the standard mesh, prepared with node clamps and parts of the edge cables, then lifted into position by masts already raised and stabilised by their guys. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地面預製索網與吊升就位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ground-assembled nets lifted into place: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地面編網與吊升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground net assembly and lifting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某網區面積 8,000 m²，索與節點自重取 8 kg/m²，重約 8×8,000 = 64 t。由 4 個吊點分擔、動力係數 1.2，每點約 64/4×1.2 ≈ 19.2 t，即約 188 kN。若因不同步使 2 個吊點承擔全部重量，每點升到約 38 t，桅桿頂水平分力隨之倍增。網區面積與單位重為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A net zone of 8,000 m² with cables and nodes weighing 8 kg/m² weighs about 8×8,000 = 64 t. Shared by 4 pick points with a dynamic factor of 1.2, each carries about 64/4×1.2 ≈ 19.2 t, about 188 kN. If loss of synchronisation leaves 2 pick points carrying the whole weight, each rises to about 38 t and the horizontal component at the mast heads doubles. Zone area and unit weight are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊升前檢查桅桿拉索與臨時錨具的張力、絞車與吊具的額定與證書；吊升中監測每個吊點的拉力與高程，並量測桅桿頂位移；就位後先臨時固定，經測量確認網面與錨點位置，再進入預拉階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting check tensions in mast guys and temporary anchors and the ratings and certificates of winches and rigging; during lifting monitor each pick point's load and level and survey mast-head movement; once in position fix temporarily and survey the net and anchor points before moving on to prestressing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某網區面積 8,000 m²，索與節點自重取 8 kg/m²，重約 8×8,000 = 64 t。由 4 個吊點分擔、動力係數 1.2，每點約 64/4×1.2 ≈ 19.2 t，即約 188 kN。若因不同步使 2 個吊點承擔全部重量，每點升到約 38 t，桅桿頂水平分力隨之倍增。網區面積與單位重為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A net zone of 8,000 m² with cables and nodes weighing 8 kg/m² weighs about 8×8,000 = 64 t. Shared by 4 pick points with a dynamic factor of 1.2, each carries about 64/4×1.2 ≈ 19.2 t, about 188 kN. If loss of synchronisation leaves 2 pick points carrying the whole weight, each rises to about 38 t and the horizontal component at the mast heads doubles. Zone area and unit weight are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地面預製索網與吊升就位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ground-assembled nets lifted into place", which statement holds?
options: 某網區面積 8,000 m²，索與節點自重取 8 kg/m²，重約 8×8,000 = 64 t。
索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。
古蹟結構既然已經站了五十年，就證明它一定安全，不需要重新計算。
optionsEn: A net zone of 8,000 m² with cables and nodes weighing 8 kg/m² weighs about 8×8,000 = 64 t.
If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured.
A heritage structure that has stood for fifty years has proven it is safe and needs no recalculation.
quiz.explanation: 某網區面積 8,000 m²，索與節點自重取 8 kg/m²，重約 8×8,000 = 64 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A net zone of 8,000 m² with cables and nodes weighing 8 kg/m² weighs about 8×8,000 = 64 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地面預製索網與吊升就位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground-assembled nets lifted into place: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地面編網與吊升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground net assembly and lifting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊升前檢查桅桿拉索與臨時錨具的張力、絞車與吊具的額定與證書；吊升中監測每個吊點的拉力與高程，並量測桅桿頂位移；就位後先臨時固定，經測量確認網面與錨點位置，再進入預拉階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting check tensions in mast guys and temporary anchors and the ratings and certificates of winches and rigging; during lifting monitor each pick point's load and level and survey mast-head movement; once in position fix temporarily and survey the net and anchor points before moving on to prestressing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊網計畫須包含每一階段的桅桿與臨時拉索受力、吊點拉力預測、風速上限與緊急固定措施，並由結構設計者與施工單位共同核可；吊升與固定的每一步都是停止點，量測合格才進行下一步。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A net-lifting plan must include mast and temporary-guy forces at every stage, predicted pick-point loads, a wind limit and emergency restraint measures, approved jointly by the structural designer and contractor; each lifting and fixing step is a hold point that proceeds only after the survey passes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊升時桅桿拉索只按完成狀態的力設計，未考慮施工中的不平衡水平力，桅桿頂過度偏移甚至傾倒；在風中吊升未張拉的網，網面擺動纏繞拉索或撞擊已完成的結構。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mast guys designed only for final-state forces, ignoring unbalanced horizontal forces during erection, can let mast heads drift excessively or even topple; lifting an untensioned net in wind lets it swing into guys or completed structure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊升前檢查桅桿拉索與臨時錨具的張力、絞車與吊具的額定與證書；吊升中監測每個吊點的拉力與高程，並量測桅桿頂位移；就位後先臨時固定，經測量確認網面與錨點位置，再進入預拉階段。
knowledge.textEn: Before lifting check tensions in mast guys and temporary anchors and the ratings and certificates of winches and rigging; during lifting monitor each pick point's load and level and survey mast-head movement; once in position fix temporarily and survey the net and anchor points before moving on to prestressing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊網計畫須包含每一階段的桅桿與臨時拉索受力、吊點拉力預測、風速上限與緊急固定措施，並由結構設計者與施工單位共同核可；吊升與固定的每一步都是停止點，量測合格才進行下一步。
knowledge.textEn: A net-lifting plan must include mast and temporary-guy forces at every stage, predicted pick-point loads, a wind limit and emergency restraint measures, approved jointly by the structural designer and contractor; each lifting and fixing step is a hold point that proceeds only after the survey passes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地面預製索網與吊升就位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ground-assembled nets lifted into place"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
吊升前檢查桅桿拉索與臨時錨具的張力、絞車與吊具的額定與證書。
錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before lifting check tensions in mast guys and temporary anchors and the ratings and certificates of winches and rigging.
A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 吊升前檢查桅桿拉索與臨時錨具的張力、絞車與吊具的額定與證書；吊升中監測每個吊點的拉力與高程，並量測桅桿頂位移；就位後先臨時固定，經測量確認網面與錨點位置，再進入預拉階段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before lifting check tensions in mast guys and temporary anchors and the ratings and certificates of winches and rigging; during lifting monitor each pick point's load and level and survey mast-head movement; once in position fix temporarily and survey the net and anchor points before moving on to prestressing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地面預製索網與吊升就位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground-assembled nets lifted into place: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地面編網與吊升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground net assembly and lifting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊升時桅桿拉索只按完成狀態的力設計，未考慮施工中的不平衡水平力，桅桿頂過度偏移甚至傾倒；在風中吊升未張拉的網，網面擺動纏繞拉索或撞擊已完成的結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mast guys designed only for final-state forces, ignoring unbalanced horizontal forces during erection, can let mast heads drift excessively or even topple; lifting an untensioned net in wind lets it swing into guys or completed structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此吊升順序、吊點分配與臨時拉索都必須以施工階段分析確認，並在吊升後才連接邊索與錨具、導入預拉力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lifting sequence, distribution of pick points and temporary guys must therefore be confirmed by construction-stage analysis, with edge cables and anchorages connected and prestress introduced only after lifting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊升時桅桿拉索只按完成狀態的力設計，未考慮施工中的不平衡水平力，桅桿頂過度偏移甚至傾倒；在風中吊升未張拉的網，網面擺動纏繞拉索或撞擊已完成的結構。
knowledge.textEn: Mast guys designed only for final-state forces, ignoring unbalanced horizontal forces during erection, can let mast heads drift excessively or even topple; lifting an untensioned net in wind lets it swing into guys or completed structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地面預製索網與吊升就位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ground-assembled nets lifted into place" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。
吊升時桅桿拉索只按完成狀態的力設計，未考慮施工中的不平衡水平力，桅桿頂過度偏移甚至傾倒；在風中吊升未張拉的網，網面擺動纏繞拉索或撞擊已完成的結構。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter.
Mast guys designed only for final-state forces, ignoring unbalanced horizontal forces during erection, can let mast heads drift excessively or even topple.
quiz.explanation: 吊升時桅桿拉索只按完成狀態的力設計，未考慮施工中的不平衡水平力，桅桿頂過度偏移甚至傾倒；在風中吊升未張拉的網，網面擺動纏繞拉索或撞擊已完成的結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mast guys designed only for final-state forces, ignoring unbalanced horizontal forces during erection, can let mast heads drift excessively or even topple; lifting an untensioned net in wind lets it swing into guys or completed structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 由邊索與拉索導入預拉力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拉索端預拉力導入」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pretension at guy anchorages” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索網就位後，預拉力透過邊索與拉索的錨端導入：以液壓千斤頂拉長可調錨具，使整片網的索段長度在幾何上被拉緊。由於網的形狀由網目長度與邊界決定，拉伸任一錨端都會改變整片網的張力分布，因此張拉要依分析決定的順序分階段在多個錨點交替進行，避免一處先到位、另一處遠低於目標。千斤頂伸長量與力必須同時記錄：伸長包含拉索本身的彈性伸長與網面幾何變化兩部分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拉索端預拉力導入」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once the net is in place, pretension is introduced through anchorages of edge and guy cables: hydraulic jacks extend adjustable anchors so the cable segments of the whole net are drawn tight geometrically. Because net shape is fixed by mesh lengths and boundaries, stressing any one anchor changes the tension distribution of the whole net, so tensioning proceeds in analysed stages alternating among several anchors, avoiding one reaching target while another lags far below. Jack extension and force must both be recorded, the extension comprising the elastic stretch of the guy itself and the geometric change of the net. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pretension at guy anchorages” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平行鋼絞線束拉索 A = 5,000 mm²、E = 195 GPa，EA = 975,000 kN；長 L = 120 m 時，張拉至 F = 5,000 kN 的彈性伸長 ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A parallel-strand guy with A = 5,000 mm² and E = 195 GPa has EA = 975,000 kN; over L = 120 m, stressing to F = 5,000 kN stretches it elastically by ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拉索端預拉力導入」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pretension at guy anchorages”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 由邊索與拉索導入預拉力
knowledge.titleEn: Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables
knowledge.text: 索網就位後，預拉力透過邊索與拉索的錨端導入：以液壓千斤頂拉長可調錨具，使整片網的索段長度在幾何上被拉緊。由於網的形狀由網目長度與邊界決定，拉伸任一錨端都會改變整片網的張力分布，因此張拉要依分析決定的順序分階段在多個錨點交替進行，避免一處先到位、另一處遠低於目標。
knowledge.textEn: Once the net is in place, pretension is introduced through anchorages of edge and guy cables: hydraulic jacks extend adjustable anchors so the cable segments of the whole net are drawn tight geometrically. Because net shape is fixed by mesh lengths and boundaries, stressing any one anchor changes the tension distribution of the whole net, so tensioning proceeds in analysed stages alternating among several anchors, avoiding one reaching target while another lags far below.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「由邊索與拉索導入預拉力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables" is correct?
options: 索網就位後，預拉力透過邊索與拉索的錨端導入：以液壓千斤頂拉長可調錨具，使整片網的索段長度在幾何上被拉緊。
張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。
實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。
optionsEn: Once the net is in place, pretension is introduced through anchorages of edge and guy cables: hydraulic jacks extend adjustable anchors so the cable segments of the whole net are drawn tight geometrically.
Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter.
A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths.
quiz.explanation: 索網就位後，預拉力透過邊索與拉索的錨端導入：以液壓千斤頂拉長可調錨具，使整片網的索段長度在幾何上被拉緊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once the net is in place, pretension is introduced through anchorages of edge and guy cables: hydraulic jacks extend adjustable anchors so the cable segments of the whole net are drawn tight geometrically. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 由邊索與拉索導入預拉力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拉索端預拉力導入」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pretension at guy anchorages” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平行鋼絞線束拉索 A = 5,000 mm²、E = 195 GPa，EA = 975,000 kN；長 L = 120 m 時，張拉至 F = 5,000 kN 的彈性伸長 ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m。若千斤頂實際行程 0.90 m，多出的約 0.28 m 來自網面幾何變化；若實測行程遠小於預測，可能表示錨端或網面受阻。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A parallel-strand guy with A = 5,000 mm² and E = 195 GPa has EA = 975,000 kN; over L = 120 m, stressing to F = 5,000 kN stretches it elastically by ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m. If the actual jack stroke is 0.90 m, the extra 0.28 m comes from geometric change of the net; a stroke far below prediction may indicate a blocked anchorage or net. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一階段同時記錄千斤頂壓力、行程、錨具位置與當時溫度，並與施工階段分析的力—行程預測比較，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停檢討；全部完成後抽查各網區索力與網面標高，作為完工基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At every stage record jack pressure, stroke, anchor position and temperature together and compare with the force–stroke prediction of the construction-stage analysis, pausing for review when they differ by more than about 5%; after completion spot-check cable forces and surface levels in each zone as the as-built baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平行鋼絞線束拉索 A = 5,000 mm²、E = 195 GPa，EA = 975,000 kN；長 L = 120 m 時，張拉至 F = 5,000 kN 的彈性伸長 ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m。若千斤頂實際行程 0.90 m，多出的約 0.28 m 來自網面幾何變化；若實測行程遠小於預測，可能表示錨端或網面受阻。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A parallel-strand guy with A = 5,000 mm² and E = 195 GPa has EA = 975,000 kN; over L = 120 m, stressing to F = 5,000 kN stretches it elastically by ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m. If the actual jack stroke is 0.90 m, the extra 0.28 m comes from geometric change of the net; a stroke far below prediction may indicate a blocked anchorage or net. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「由邊索與拉索導入預拉力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables", which statement holds?
options: 只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。
平行鋼絞線束拉索 A = 5,000 mm²、E = 195 GPa，EA = 975,000 kN。
索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。
optionsEn: A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material.
A parallel-strand guy with A = 5,000 mm² and E = 195 GPa has EA = 975,000 kN.
A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 平行鋼絞線束拉索 A = 5,000 mm²、E = 195 GPa，EA = 975,000 kN；長 L = 120 m 時，張拉至 F = 5,000 kN 的彈性伸長 ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A parallel-strand guy with A = 5,000 mm² and E = 195 GPa has EA = 975,000 kN; over L = 120 m, stressing to F = 5,000 kN stretches it elastically by ΔL = FL/EA = 5,000×120/975,000 ≈ 0.62 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 由邊索與拉索導入預拉力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拉索端預拉力導入」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pretension at guy anchorages” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一階段同時記錄千斤頂壓力、行程、錨具位置與當時溫度，並與施工階段分析的力—行程預測比較，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停檢討；全部完成後抽查各網區索力與網面標高，作為完工基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At every stage record jack pressure, stroke, anchor position and temperature together and compare with the force–stroke prediction of the construction-stage analysis, pausing for review when they differ by more than about 5%; after completion spot-check cable forces and surface levels in each zone as the as-built baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：張拉程序書要列出錨點順序、每階段目標力與行程、允許偏差與停止條件，並由結構設計者簽認；張拉屬高能量作業，現場須設警戒區並由合格人員依核准程序執行，本課只說明檢核邏輯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The tensioning procedure should list anchor order, target force and stroke per stage, allowable deviation and stop conditions, signed by the structural designer; tensioning is high-energy work that requires an exclusion zone and qualified personnel under an approved procedure, and this course explains only the checking logic.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按千斤頂力控制而不看行程，可能在錨端摩擦或網面卡住時誤以為已達目標，實際網面預拉不足；單點一次張拉到位會讓相鄰網區暫時過載，節點夾具滑移，造成不可逆的網目變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Controlling by jack force alone without watching stroke can falsely signal success when anchorage friction or a snagged net holds back the force, leaving the surface under-tensioned; stressing one anchor fully in a single step temporarily overloads adjacent zones and slips node clamps, permanently distorting the mesh. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一階段同時記錄千斤頂壓力、行程、錨具位置與當時溫度，並與施工階段分析的力—行程預測比較，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停檢討；全部完成後抽查各網區索力與網面標高，作為完工基準。
knowledge.textEn: At every stage record jack pressure, stroke, anchor position and temperature together and compare with the force–stroke prediction of the construction-stage analysis, pausing for review when they differ by more than about 5%; after completion spot-check cable forces and surface levels in each zone as the as-built baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 張拉程序書要列出錨點順序、每階段目標力與行程、允許偏差與停止條件，並由結構設計者簽認；張拉屬高能量作業，現場須設警戒區並由合格人員依核准程序執行，本課只說明檢核邏輯。
knowledge.textEn: The tensioning procedure should list anchor order, target force and stroke per stage, allowable deviation and stop conditions, signed by the structural designer; tensioning is high-energy work that requires an exclusion zone and qualified personnel under an approved procedure, and this course explains only the checking logic.

quiz.question: 要驗證「由邊索與拉索導入預拉力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
要做出雙曲面索網，每段索都必須裁成不同長度。
每一階段同時記錄千斤頂壓力、行程、錨具位置與當時溫度，並與施工階段分析的力—行程預測比較，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停檢討。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
To make a doubly curved cable net, every cable segment must be cut to a different length.

At every stage record jack pressure, stroke, anchor position and temperature together and compare with the force–stroke prediction of the construction-stage analysis, pausing for review when they differ by more than about 5%.
quiz.explanation: 每一階段同時記錄千斤頂壓力、行程、錨具位置與當時溫度，並與施工階段分析的力—行程預測比較，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停檢討；全部完成後抽查各網區索力與網面標高，作為完工基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At every stage record jack pressure, stroke, anchor position and temperature together and compare with the force–stroke prediction of the construction-stage analysis, pausing for review when they differ by more than about 5%; after completion spot-check cable forces and surface levels in each zone as the as-built baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 由邊索與拉索導入預拉力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拉索端預拉力導入」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pretension at guy anchorages” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按千斤頂力控制而不看行程，可能在錨端摩擦或網面卡住時誤以為已達目標，實際網面預拉不足；單點一次張拉到位會讓相鄰網區暫時過載，節點夾具滑移，造成不可逆的網目變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Controlling by jack force alone without watching stroke can falsely signal success when anchorage friction or a snagged net holds back the force, leaving the surface under-tensioned; stressing one anchor fully in a single step temporarily overloads adjacent zones and slips node clamps, permanently distorting the mesh. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：千斤頂伸長量與力必須同時記錄：伸長包含拉索本身的彈性伸長與網面幾何變化兩部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Jack extension and force must both be recorded, the extension comprising the elastic stretch of the guy itself and the geometric change of the net.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按千斤頂力控制而不看行程，可能在錨端摩擦或網面卡住時誤以為已達目標，實際網面預拉不足；單點一次張拉到位會讓相鄰網區暫時過載，節點夾具滑移，造成不可逆的網目變形。
knowledge.textEn: Controlling by jack force alone without watching stroke can falsely signal success when anchorage friction or a snagged net holds back the force, leaving the surface under-tensioned; stressing one anchor fully in a single step temporarily overloads adjacent zones and slips node clamps, permanently distorting the mesh.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「由邊索與拉索導入預拉力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Introducing pretension through edge and guy cables" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只按千斤頂力控制而不看行程，可能在錨端摩擦或網面卡住時誤以為已達目標，實際網面預拉不足。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。
optionsEn: Controlling by jack force alone without watching stroke can falsely signal success when anchorage friction or a snagged net holds back the force, leaving the surface under-tensioned.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths.
quiz.explanation: 只按千斤頂力控制而不看行程，可能在錨端摩擦或網面卡住時誤以為已達目標，實際網面預拉不足；單點一次張拉到位會讓相鄰網區暫時過載，節點夾具滑移，造成不可逆的網目變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Controlling by jack force alone without watching stroke can falsely signal success when anchorage friction or a snagged net holds back the force, leaving the surface under-tensioned; stressing one anchor fully in a single step temporarily overloads adjacent zones and slips node clamps, permanently distorting the mesh. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算」與「安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation" and "Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「實體模型與迭代計算」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Physical models and iterative computation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 競圖時的概念模型是 1:1000 的木棍與尼龍襪構成，Frei Otto 隨後以較大的實體模型探索帳篷形狀；但要把形狀變成工廠可裁切、可編網的索長，模型量測精度遠遠不足。sbp 指出此案是這類問題首次使用迭代電腦計算：先假設索網形狀與預拉力，反覆計算節點平衡直到收斂，再由平衡形狀求出每段索的無應力長度。斯圖加特的大地測量學者也參與發展網格平衡計算方法，其後發表的力密度法成為索網與膜結構形狀尋找的基本工具。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「實體模型與迭代計算」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The competition concept model was built at 1:1000 from wooden sticks and nylon stocking, and Frei Otto then explored the tent forms with larger physical models; but turning the form into cable lengths that a factory could cut and assemble demanded far more precision than model measurement could give. sbp notes that this project was the first iterative computer application for this class of problem: assume a net shape and prestress, iterate nodal equilibrium until it converges, then derive the unstressed length of every cable segment from the equilibrium shape. Geodesists in Stuttgart helped develop net-equilibrium methods, and the force density method published afterwards became a basic tool for form finding of cable nets and membranes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Physical models and iterative computation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若 1:100 實體模型的座標量測精度為 ±0.5 mm，換算到實尺度為 ±50 mm；對 750 mm 網目而言約 50/750 ≈ 6.7% 的長度誤差，而索網要求的索段長度精度約在毫米級（約 0.1%），差距約 50 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a 1:100 physical model can be measured to ±0.5 mm, that is ±50 mm at full scale; for a 750 mm mesh this is about 50/750 ≈ 6.7% length error, while cable segments need millimetre-level accuracy of about 0.1%, roughly 50 times better.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「實體模型與迭代計算」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Physical models and iterative computation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算
knowledge.titleEn: From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation
knowledge.text: 競圖時的概念模型是 1:1000 的木棍與尼龍襪構成，Frei Otto 隨後以較大的實體模型探索帳篷形狀；但要把形狀變成工廠可裁切、可編網的索長，模型量測精度遠遠不足。sbp 指出此案是這類問題首次使用迭代電腦計算：先假設索網形狀與預拉力，反覆計算節點平衡直到收斂，再由平衡形狀求出每段索的無應力長度。
knowledge.textEn: The competition concept model was built at 1:1000 from wooden sticks and nylon stocking, and Frei Otto then explored the tent forms with larger physical models; but turning the form into cable lengths that a factory could cut and assemble demanded far more precision than model measurement could give. sbp notes that this project was the first iterative computer application for this class of problem: assume a net shape and prestress, iterate nodal equilibrium until it converges, then derive the unstressed length of every cable segment from the equilibrium shape. Geodesists in Stuttgart helped develop net-equilibrium methods, and the force density method published afterwards became a basic tool for form finding of cable nets and membranes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation" is correct?
options: 實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。
競圖時的概念模型是 1:1000 的木棍與尼龍襪構成，Frei Otto 隨後以較大的實體模型探索帳篷形狀。
索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。
optionsEn: A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths.
The competition concept model was built at 1:1000 from wooden sticks and nylon stocking, and Frei Otto then explored the tent forms with larger physical models.
If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured.
quiz.explanation: 競圖時的概念模型是 1:1000 的木棍與尼龍襪構成，Frei Otto 隨後以較大的實體模型探索帳篷形狀；但要把形狀變成工廠可裁切、可編網的索長，模型量測精度遠遠不足。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The competition concept model was built at 1:1000 from wooden sticks and nylon stocking, and Frei Otto then explored the tent forms with larger physical models; but turning the form into cable lengths that a factory could cut and assemble demanded far more precision than model measurement could give. sbp notes that this project was the first iterative computer application for this class of problem: assume a net shape and prestress, iterate nodal equilibrium until it converges, then derive the unstressed length of every cable segment from the equilibrium shape. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實體模型與迭代計算」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Physical models and iterative computation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若 1:100 實體模型的座標量測精度為 ±0.5 mm，換算到實尺度為 ±50 mm；對 750 mm 網目而言約 50/750 ≈ 6.7% 的長度誤差，而索網要求的索段長度精度約在毫米級（約 0.1%），差距約 50 倍。模型比例與精度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a 1:100 physical model can be measured to ±0.5 mm, that is ±50 mm at full scale; for a 750 mm mesh this is about 50/750 ≈ 6.7% length error, while cable segments need millimetre-level accuracy of about 0.1%, roughly 50 times better. Model scale and accuracy are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩種獨立方法（例如不同程式或手算關鍵節點）確認平衡形狀收斂，檢查每個節點的不平衡力小於允許值；把計算形狀與實體模型的量測比較，確認拓撲與整體形態一致；由平衡形狀推得的索長與製造表交叉核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm convergence of the equilibrium shape by two independent methods, such as different programs or hand checks of key nodes, checking that residual force at every node is below the allowance; compare the computed shape with physical-model measurements to confirm topology and overall form agree; cross-check cable lengths derived from the equilibrium shape against the fabrication schedule.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若 1:100 實體模型的座標量測精度為 ±0.5 mm，換算到實尺度為 ±50 mm；對 750 mm 網目而言約 50/750 ≈ 6.7% 的長度誤差，而索網要求的索段長度精度約在毫米級（約 0.1%），差距約 50 倍。模型比例與精度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If a 1:100 physical model can be measured to ±0.5 mm, that is ±50 mm at full scale; for a 750 mm mesh this is about 50/750 ≈ 6.7% length error, while cable segments need millimetre-level accuracy of about 0.1%, roughly 50 times better. Model scale and accuracy are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation", which statement holds?
options: 古蹟結構既然已經站了五十年，就證明它一定安全，不需要重新計算。
錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。
若 1:100 實體模型的座標量測精度為 ±0.5 mm，換算到實尺度為 ±50 mm。
optionsEn: A heritage structure that has stood for fifty years has proven it is safe and needs no recalculation.
A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter.
If a 1:100 physical model can be measured to ±0.5 mm, that is ±50 mm at full scale.
quiz.explanation: 若 1:100 實體模型的座標量測精度為 ±0.5 mm，換算到實尺度為 ±50 mm；對 750 mm 網目而言約 50/750 ≈ 6.7% 的長度誤差，而索網要求的索段長度精度約在毫米級（約 0.1%），差距約 50 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If a 1:100 physical model can be measured to ±0.5 mm, that is ±50 mm at full scale; for a 750 mm mesh this is about 50/750 ≈ 6.7% length error, while cable segments need millimetre-level accuracy of about 0.1%, roughly 50 times better. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「實體模型與迭代計算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Physical models and iterative computation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以兩種獨立方法（例如不同程式或手算關鍵節點）確認平衡形狀收斂，檢查每個節點的不平衡力小於允許值；把計算形狀與實體模型的量測比較，確認拓撲與整體形態一致；由平衡形狀推得的索長與製造表交叉核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm convergence of the equilibrium shape by two independent methods, such as different programs or hand checks of key nodes, checking that residual force at every node is below the allowance; compare the computed shape with physical-model measurements to confirm topology and overall form agree; cross-check cable lengths derived from the equilibrium shape against the fabrication schedule. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實體模型與迭代計算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Physical models and iterative computation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若直接以實體模型量測的座標裁切索長，網目長度誤差在實尺度累積，網面無法閉合或局部完全沒有預拉力；計算未收斂就輸出索長，同樣會在現場出現對不上的錨點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting cable lengths directly from physical-model coordinates accumulates mesh-length errors at full scale, so the surface cannot close or some zones carry no prestress at all; exporting lengths from an unconverged calculation likewise produces anchor points that do not fit on site. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斯圖加特的大地測量學者也參與發展網格平衡計算方法，其後發表的力密度法成為索網與膜結構形狀尋找的基本工具。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Geodesists in Stuttgart helped develop net-equilibrium methods, and the force density method published afterwards became a basic tool for form finding of cable nets and membranes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Cutting cable lengths directly from physical-model coordinates accumulates mesh-length errors at full scale, so the surface cannot close or some zones carry no prestress at all; exporting lengths from an unconverged calculation likewise produces anchor points that do not fit on site.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若直接以實體模型量測的座標裁切索長，網目長度誤差在實尺度累積，網面無法閉合或局部完全沒有預拉力；計算未收斂就輸出索長，同樣會在現場出現對不上的錨點。
索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Cutting cable lengths directly from physical-model coordinates accumulates mesh-length errors at full scale, so the surface cannot close or some zones carry no prestress at all.
If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured.
quiz.explanation: 若直接以實體模型量測的座標裁切索長，網目長度誤差在實尺度累積，網面無法閉合或局部完全沒有預拉力；計算未收斂就輸出索長，同樣會在現場出現對不上的錨點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting cable lengths directly from physical-model coordinates accumulates mesh-length errors at full scale, so the surface cannot close or some zones carry no prestress at all; exporting lengths from an unconverged calculation likewise produces anchor points that do not fit on site. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「網面標高與垂度量測」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surface level and sag survey” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索網完成張拉後，最直接的驗證是量測網面節點座標與索段垂度，再與平衡分析預測比較。由於張力與垂度成反比，形狀偏差可以反推張力偏差：垂度比預測大，代表該處張力偏低；垂度比預測小，則可能局部過拉。量測時必須同時記錄溫度與風況，並在日出前等溫度均勻的時段進行；若某網區偏差集中，應檢查錨具位置、索夾滑移或網目長度誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「網面標高與垂度量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After tensioning, the most direct verification is to survey net node coordinates and segment sags and compare them with the equilibrium analysis. Because tension is inversely proportional to sag, shape deviation can be turned into tension deviation: more sag than predicted means low tension there, less sag may mean local over-tension. Temperature and wind must be recorded and surveys taken at times of uniform temperature such as before sunrise; where deviations cluster in one zone, check anchor positions, clamp slip or mesh-length errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Surface level and sag survey” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：由 H = wL²/(8f) 可知 ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: From H = wL²/(8f), ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「網面標高與垂度量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Surface level and sag survey”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算
knowledge.titleEn: Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force
knowledge.text: 索網完成張拉後，最直接的驗證是量測網面節點座標與索段垂度，再與平衡分析預測比較。由於張力與垂度成反比，形狀偏差可以反推張力偏差：垂度比預測大，代表該處張力偏低；垂度比預測小，則可能局部過拉。
knowledge.textEn: After tensioning, the most direct verification is to survey net node coordinates and segment sags and compare them with the equilibrium analysis. Because tension is inversely proportional to sag, shape deviation can be turned into tension deviation: more sag than predicted means low tension there, less sag may mean local over-tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force" is correct?
options: 索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。
只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。
索網完成張拉後，最直接的驗證是量測網面節點座標與索段垂度，再與平衡分析預測比較。
optionsEn: If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured.
A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material.
After tensioning, the most direct verification is to survey net node coordinates and segment sags and compare them with the equilibrium analysis.

steps.title: 安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「網面標高與垂度量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Surface level and sag survey” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：由 H = wL²/(8f) 可知 ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f。某索段設計垂度 f = 1.00 m、張力 H = 100 kN，實測垂度 1.10 m，張力約為 100×1.00/1.10 ≈ 91 kN，低約 9%；若實測 0.95 m，張力約 105 kN。垂度與張力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: From H = wL²/(8f), ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f. A segment with design sag f = 1.00 m and tension H = 100 kN that is measured at 1.10 m sag carries about 100×1.00/1.10 ≈ 91 kN, about 9% low; at 0.95 m it carries about 105 kN. Sags and tension are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全測站或攝影測量量測代表性節點的三維座標，換算到參考溫度後與分析比較；設定允許偏差（例如垂度 ±5%），超出者以頂升或頻率法直接量測索力確認；結果建立為完工基準，日後定期複測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey three-dimensional coordinates of representative nodes by total station or photogrammetry, correct to the reference temperature and compare with analysis; set an allowable deviation such as ±5% in sag, and for any exceedance confirm the force directly by lift-off or frequency methods; keep the results as the as-built baseline and resurvey periodically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 由 H = wL²/(8f) 可知 ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f。某索段設計垂度 f = 1.00 m、張力 H = 100 kN，實測垂度 1.10 m，張力約為 100×1.00/1.10 ≈ 91 kN，低約 9%；若實測 0.95 m，張力約 105 kN。垂度與張力為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: From H = wL²/(8f), ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f. A segment with design sag f = 1.00 m and tension H = 100 kN that is measured at 1.10 m sag carries about 100×1.00/1.10 ≈ 91 kN, about 9% low; at 0.95 m it carries about 105 kN. Sags and tension are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force", which statement holds?
options: 由 H = wL²/(8f) 可知 ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f。
索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。

quiz.explanationEn: From H = wL²/(8f), ΔH/H ≈ −Δf/f. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「網面標高與垂度量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Surface level and sag survey” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全測站或攝影測量量測代表性節點的三維座標，換算到參考溫度後與分析比較；設定允許偏差（例如垂度 ±5%），超出者以頂升或頻率法直接量測索力確認；結果建立為完工基準，日後定期複測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey three-dimensional coordinates of representative nodes by total station or photogrammetry, correct to the reference temperature and compare with analysis; set an allowable deviation such as ±5% in sag, and for any exceedance confirm the force directly by lift-off or frequency methods; keep the results as the as-built baseline and resurvey periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：完工量測計畫應列明量測點位、時段、溫度修正方法與允許偏差，結果與分析模型一起歸檔；量測儀器與控制點須在之後的檢測中重複使用，以確保數據可比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The as-built survey plan should state points, time of day, temperature correction and allowable deviation, with results filed together with the analysis model; instruments and control points should be reused in later inspections so data remain comparable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在午後日照下量測，鋼索升溫伸長使垂度增加，被誤判為張力不足而去過度張拉，到了冬季索力超過設計；量測點太少，局部鬆弛區未被發現，日後在雪載下才出現積雪窪地。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surveying in afternoon sun, when warm cables lengthen and sag more, can be misread as low tension and lead to over-stressing, so cable forces exceed design in winter; too few survey points miss a locally slack zone that only reveals itself as a snow pocket under later snow load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全測站或攝影測量量測代表性節點的三維座標，換算到參考溫度後與分析比較；設定允許偏差（例如垂度 ±5%），超出者以頂升或頻率法直接量測索力確認；結果建立為完工基準，日後定期複測比較。
knowledge.textEn: Survey three-dimensional coordinates of representative nodes by total station or photogrammetry, correct to the reference temperature and compare with analysis; set an allowable deviation such as ±5% in sag, and for any exceedance confirm the force directly by lift-off or frequency methods; keep the results as the as-built baseline and resurvey periodically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 完工量測計畫應列明量測點位、時段、溫度修正方法與允許偏差，結果與分析模型一起歸檔；量測儀器與控制點須在之後的檢測中重複使用，以確保數據可比較。

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Survey three-dimensional coordinates of representative nodes by total station or photogrammetry, correct to the reference temperature and compare with analysis.
Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets.
