quiz.explanationEn: Survey three-dimensional coordinates of representative nodes by total station or photogrammetry, correct to the reference temperature and compare with analysis; set an allowable deviation such as ±5% in sag, and for any exceedance confirm the force directly by lift-off or frequency methods; keep the results as the as-built baseline and resurvey periodically. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「網面標高與垂度量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Surface level and sag survey” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在午後日照下量測，鋼索升溫伸長使垂度增加，被誤判為張力不足而去過度張拉，到了冬季索力超過設計；量測點太少，局部鬆弛區未被發現，日後在雪載下才出現積雪窪地。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surveying in afternoon sun, when warm cables lengthen and sag more, can be misread as low tension and lead to over-stressing, so cable forces exceed design in winter; too few survey points miss a locally slack zone that only reveals itself as a snow pocket under later snow load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測時必須同時記錄溫度與風況，並在日出前等溫度均勻的時段進行；若某網區偏差集中，應檢查錨具位置、索夾滑移或網目長度誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature and wind must be recorded and surveys taken at times of uniform temperature such as before sunrise; where deviations cluster in one zone, check anchor positions, clamp slip or mesh-length errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在午後日照下量測，鋼索升溫伸長使垂度增加，被誤判為張力不足而去過度張拉，到了冬季索力超過設計；量測點太少，局部鬆弛區未被發現，日後在雪載下才出現積雪窪地。
knowledge.textEn: Surveying in afternoon sun, when warm cables lengthen and sag more, can be misread as low tension and lead to over-stressing, so cable forces exceed design in winter; too few survey points miss a locally slack zone that only reveals itself as a snow pocket under later snow load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝後的幾何量測與索力反算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-erection survey and back-calculated cable force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。
在午後日照下量測，鋼索升溫伸長使垂度增加，被誤判為張力不足而去過度張拉，到了冬季索力超過設計；量測點太少，局部鬆弛區未被發現，日後在雪載下才出現積雪窪地。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material.
Surveying in afternoon sun, when warm cables lengthen and sag more, can be misread as low tension and lead to over-stressing, so cable forces exceed design in winter.
quiz.explanation: 在午後日照下量測，鋼索升溫伸長使垂度增加，被誤判為張力不足而去過度張拉，到了冬季索力超過設計；量測點太少，局部鬆弛區未被發現，日後在雪載下才出現積雪窪地。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surveying in afternoon sun, when warm cables lengthen and sag more, can be misread as low tension and lead to over-stressing, so cable forces exceed design in winter; too few survey points miss a locally slack zone that only reveals itself as a snow pocket under later snow load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆板老化、混濁與整面更換」與「列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement" and "Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆板老化、混濁與整面更換：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「壓克力板劣化與更換」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acrylic degradation and replacement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 原始壓克力板為了防火加入的鐵成分氧化，使板面逐漸混濁變色，後來以不含鐵的塑膠玻璃混合材更換。這是材料配方影響長期性能的典型案例：防火、透光、抗紫外線與熱脹性能要一併考慮，單一性能的改善可能犧牲另一項。更換約 8,300 片覆板是一項大型工程，必須在不破壞索網預拉平衡的前提下分區拆裝，並處理高空作業、臨時防水與場館營運的衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「壓克力板劣化與更換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The original acrylic panels contained iron additives for fire protection that oxidised, gradually clouding and discolouring the panels, and they were later replaced with an iron-free plastic–glass material. It is a classic case of formulation governing long-term performance: fire behaviour, light transmission, UV resistance and thermal expansion must be considered together, and improving one property can sacrifice another. Replacing about 8,300 panels is a major undertaking that must proceed zone by zone without disturbing the net's prestress balance, while managing work at height, temporary weatherproofing and venue operations. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Acrylic degradation and replacement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：8,300 片覆板若每日更換 40 片，需約 8,300/40 ≈ 208 個工作天；若受營運與天候限制每日只能 25 片，需約 332 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Replacing 8,300 panels at 40 per day takes about 8,300/40 ≈ 208 working days; if operations and weather limit work to 25 per day, about 332 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「壓克力板劣化與更換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Acrylic degradation and replacement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆板老化、混濁與整面更換
knowledge.titleEn: Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement
knowledge.text: 原始壓克力板為了防火加入的鐵成分氧化，使板面逐漸混濁變色，後來以不含鐵的塑膠玻璃混合材更換。這是材料配方影響長期性能的典型案例：防火、透光、抗紫外線與熱脹性能要一併考慮，單一性能的改善可能犧牲另一項。
knowledge.textEn: The original acrylic panels contained iron additives for fire protection that oxidised, gradually clouding and discolouring the panels, and they were later replaced with an iron-free plastic–glass material. It is a classic case of formulation governing long-term performance: fire behaviour, light transmission, UV resistance and thermal expansion must be considered together, and improving one property can sacrifice another.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆板老化、混濁與整面更換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement" is correct?
options: 原始壓克力板為了防火加入的鐵成分氧化，使板面逐漸混濁變色，後來以不含鐵的塑膠玻璃混合材更換。
只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。
古蹟結構既然已經站了五十年，就證明它一定安全，不需要重新計算。
optionsEn: The original acrylic panels contained iron additives for fire protection that oxidised, gradually clouding and discolouring the panels, and they were later replaced with an iron-free plastic–glass material.
A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material.
A heritage structure that has stood for fifty years has proven it is safe and needs no recalculation.
quiz.explanation: 原始壓克力板為了防火加入的鐵成分氧化，使板面逐漸混濁變色，後來以不含鐵的塑膠玻璃混合材更換。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The original acrylic panels contained iron additives for fire protection that oxidised, gradually clouding and discolouring the panels, and they were later replaced with an iron-free plastic–glass material. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆板老化、混濁與整面更換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓克力板劣化與更換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acrylic degradation and replacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：8,300 片覆板若每日更換 40 片，需約 8,300/40 ≈ 208 個工作天；若受營運與天候限制每日只能 25 片，需約 332 天。每片 9 m² 若自重 4.5 kg/m²（教學假設），單片約 40 kg，拆下一片時節點荷載的變化很小，但整區同時拆除會改變網面荷載分布。施工效率與單位重為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Replacing 8,300 panels at 40 per day takes about 8,300/40 ≈ 208 working days; if operations and weather limit work to 25 per day, about 332 days. A 9 m² panel at an assumed 4.5 kg/m² weighs about 40 kg, so removing one changes node loads very little, but stripping a whole zone at once alters the load distribution on the net. Production rates and unit weight are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：新覆板材料先做加速老化、透光率、防火與熱脹試驗，並與原板比較；更換時逐區記錄拆裝順序、臨時防水與網面標高變化；完成後於不同季節檢查接縫與固定件，確認新材料在現場的行為符合試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test the new panel material for accelerated ageing, light transmission, fire and thermal expansion and compare it with the original; during replacement record removal and installation order, temporary weatherproofing and surface-level changes zone by zone; afterwards inspect joints and fittings in different seasons to confirm field behaviour matches the tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 8,300 片覆板若每日更換 40 片，需約 8,300/40 ≈ 208 個工作天；若受營運與天候限制每日只能 25 片，需約 332 天。每片 9 m² 若自重 4.5 kg/m²（教學假設），單片約 40 kg，拆下一片時節點荷載的變化很小，但整區同時拆除會改變網面荷載分布。施工效率與單位重為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing 8,300 panels at 40 per day takes about 8,300/40 ≈ 208 working days; if operations and weather limit work to 25 per day, about 332 days. A 9 m² panel at an assumed 4.5 kg/m² weighs about 40 kg, so removing one changes node loads very little, but stripping a whole zone at once alters the load distribution on the net. Production rates and unit weight are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆板老化、混濁與整面更換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement", which statement holds?
options: 錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。
8,300 片覆板若每日更換 40 片，需約 8,300/40 ≈ 208 個工作天；若受營運與天候限制每日只能 25 片，需約 332 天。
透明覆板只是遮雨用，不需要考慮熱脹與索網變形。
optionsEn: A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter.
Replacing 8,300 panels at 40 per day takes about 8,300/40 ≈ 208 working days; if operations and weather limit work to 25 per day, about 332 days.
Transparent cover panels only keep the rain out and need no allowance for thermal movement or net deformation.
quiz.explanation: 8,300 片覆板若每日更換 40 片，需約 8,300/40 ≈ 208 個工作天；若受營運與天候限制每日只能 25 片，需約 332 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing 8,300 panels at 40 per day takes about 8,300/40 ≈ 208 working days; if operations and weather limit work to 25 per day, about 332 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆板老化、混濁與整面更換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓克力板劣化與更換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Acrylic degradation and replacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 新覆板材料先做加速老化、透光率、防火與熱脹試驗，並與原板比較；更換時逐區記錄拆裝順序、臨時防水與網面標高變化；完成後於不同季節檢查接縫與固定件，確認新材料在現場的行為符合試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test the new panel material for accelerated ageing, light transmission, fire and thermal expansion and compare it with the original; during replacement record removal and installation order, temporary weatherproofing and surface-level changes zone by zone; afterwards inspect joints and fittings in different seasons to confirm field behaviour matches the tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：覆板材料變更要做多性能評估（防火、透光、耐候、熱脹、強度）並保留試驗樣品；更換工程的分區、順序與臨時措施須經結構工程師核可，並在古蹟主管機關的程序下進行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Changing panel material requires a multi-property assessment of fire, light transmission, weathering, thermal expansion and strength, with test samples retained; the zoning, sequence and temporary measures of replacement work must be approved by the structural engineer and carried out under the heritage authority's procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了防火而在材料中加入的成分，若未評估長期耐候，可能讓整個屋面在十多年內失去透光；更換時若一次拆除大面積覆板而未考慮雨雪，網面下方的看台與設備受損，也可能因荷載分布突變引起局部索鬆弛。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 覆板老化、混濁與整面更換：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓克力板劣化與更換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Acrylic degradation and replacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了防火而在材料中加入的成分，若未評估長期耐候，可能讓整個屋面在十多年內失去透光；更換時若一次拆除大面積覆板而未考慮雨雪，網面下方的看台與設備受損，也可能因荷載分布突變引起局部索鬆弛。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An additive introduced for fire protection without long-term weathering assessment can cost the whole roof its transparency within a couple of decades; stripping a large area of panels at once during replacement exposes stands and equipment below to rain and snow and can cause local cable slackening through a sudden change in load distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：更換約 8,300 片覆板是一項大型工程，必須在不破壞索網預拉平衡的前提下分區拆裝，並處理高空作業、臨時防水與場館營運的衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Replacing about 8,300 panels is a major undertaking that must proceed zone by zone without disturbing the net's prestress balance, while managing work at height, temporary weatherproofing and venue operations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆板老化、混濁與整面更換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Panel ageing, clouding and wholesale replacement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了防火而在材料中加入的成分，若未評估長期耐候，可能讓整個屋面在十多年內失去透光。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
古蹟結構既然已經站了五十年，就證明它一定安全，不需要重新計算。
optionsEn: An additive introduced for fire protection without long-term weathering assessment can cost the whole roof its transparency within a couple of decades.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A heritage structure that has stood for fifty years has proven it is safe and needs no recalculation.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「古蹟屋蓋重新計算」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Recalculation of a listed roof” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 奧運屋蓋已列為受保護的古蹟建築，sbp 受託重新計算並檢測整個索網屋蓋，記錄其現況；體育場也於 2025 年 10 月起全面封閉整修，預計 2028 年夏季恢復大型活動。五十多年的使用讓鋼索鍍鋅層消耗、鑄鋼節點與錨具承受反覆荷載，原設計所依據的規範與荷載標準也已更新。重新計算的目的是以現行知識檢查既有結構，並找出必須更換或補強的構件，同時盡量保存原貌；所有發現與決策都要寫入可移交的紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「古蹟屋蓋重新計算」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Olympic roof is a listed building, and sbp was commissioned to recalculate and inspect the entire cable-net roof and record its current condition; the stadium itself fully closed for renovation in October 2025, with major events planned to resume in summer 2028. More than fifty years of service have consumed galvanising on the cables and loaded cast nodes and anchorages repeatedly, while the codes and load standards behind the original design have changed. Recalculation checks the existing structure with current knowledge and identifies components to replace or strengthen while preserving the original as far as possible, and every finding and decision must be written into records that can be handed on. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Recalculation of a listed roof” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鍍鋅層厚 50 μm，若在大氣腐蝕等級 C3 環境中以每年約 1.5 μm 消耗，約 50/1.5 ≈ 33 年耗盡；屋蓋 1972 年完工至 2025 年已 53 年，未維護的外露部位鍍層可能早已耗盡而開始腐蝕鋼絲。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 50 μm zinc coating consumed at about 1.5 μm per year in a C3 atmospheric-corrosivity environment lasts about 50/1.5 ≈ 33 years; the roof was completed in 1972, 53 years before 2025, so unmaintained exposed parts may long since have lost their zinc and begun corroding wires.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「古蹟結構既然已經站了五十年，就證明它一定安全，不需要重新計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heritage structure that has stood for fifty years has proven it is safe and needs no recalculation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「古蹟屋蓋重新計算」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Recalculation of a listed roof”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「古蹟屋蓋重新計算」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Recalculation of a listed roof” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鍍鋅層厚 50 μm，若在大氣腐蝕等級 C3 環境中以每年約 1.5 μm 消耗，約 50/1.5 ≈ 33 年耗盡；屋蓋 1972 年完工至 2025 年已 53 年，未維護的外露部位鍍層可能早已耗盡而開始腐蝕鋼絲。若改用每年 0.7 μm，約 71 年。鍍層厚度與腐蝕速率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 50 μm zinc coating consumed at about 1.5 μm per year in a C3 atmospheric-corrosivity environment lasts about 50/1.5 ≈ 33 years; the roof was completed in 1972, 53 years before 2025, so unmaintained exposed parts may long since have lost their zinc and begun corroding wires. At 0.7 μm per year it would last about 71 years. Coating thickness and corrosion rates are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以目視、磁性探傷或電磁檢測抽查鋼索斷絲與截面損失，量測代表性索力與網面幾何並與原始資料比較；鑄鋼節點與錨具做非破壞檢測；以現行規範荷載重算，列出利用率超過 1 或接近 1 的構件，提出更換或補強的優先順序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Spot-check cables for broken wires and section loss by visual, magnetic-flux or electromagnetic inspection, measure representative cable forces and surface geometry against original data, and test cast nodes and anchorages non-destructively; recalculate with current code loads, list components with utilisation above or near 1 and set priorities for replacement or strengthening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鍍鋅層厚 50 μm，若在大氣腐蝕等級 C3 環境中以每年約 1.5 μm 消耗，約 50/1.5 ≈ 33 年耗盡；屋蓋 1972 年完工至 2025 年已 53 年，未維護的外露部位鍍層可能早已耗盡而開始腐蝕鋼絲。若改用每年 0.7 μm，約 71 年。鍍層厚度與腐蝕速率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 50 μm zinc coating consumed at about 1.5 μm per year in a C3 atmospheric-corrosivity environment lasts about 50/1.5 ≈ 33 years; the roof was completed in 1972, 53 years before 2025, so unmaintained exposed parts may long since have lost their zinc and begun corroding wires. At 0.7 μm per year it would last about 71 years. Coating thickness and corrosion rates are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: To make a doubly curved cable net, every cable segment must be cut to a different length.
Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets.
A 50 μm zinc coating consumed at about 1.5 μm per year in a C3 atmospheric-corrosivity environment lasts about 50/1.5 ≈ 33 years.
quiz.explanation: 鍍鋅層厚 50 μm，若在大氣腐蝕等級 C3 環境中以每年約 1.5 μm 消耗，約 50/1.5 ≈ 33 年耗盡；屋蓋 1972 年完工至 2025 年已 53 年，未維護的外露部位鍍層可能早已耗盡而開始腐蝕鋼絲。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 50 μm zinc coating consumed at about 1.5 μm per year in a C3 atmospheric-corrosivity environment lasts about 50/1.5 ≈ 33 years; the roof was completed in 1972, 53 years before 2025, so unmaintained exposed parts may long since have lost their zinc and begun corroding wires. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「古蹟屋蓋重新計算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Recalculation of a listed roof” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以目視、磁性探傷或電磁檢測抽查鋼索斷絲與截面損失，量測代表性索力與網面幾何並與原始資料比較；鑄鋼節點與錨具做非破壞檢測；以現行規範荷載重算，列出利用率超過 1 或接近 1 的構件，提出更換或補強的優先順序。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Spot-check cables for broken wires and section loss by visual, magnetic-flux or electromagnetic inspection, measure representative cable forces and surface geometry against original data, and test cast nodes and anchorages non-destructively; recalculate with current code loads, list components with utilisation above or near 1 and set priorities for replacement or strengthening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接與保存文件應包含原始形狀尋找成果、索長與預拉力表、完工量測、歷次覆板更換紀錄、檢測與重新計算報告；任何構件更換都需經結構工程師設計並取得古蹟主管機關核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover and conservation records should include the original form-finding results, cable-length and prestress schedules, as-built surveys, all panel-replacement records and the inspection and recalculation reports; any component replacement must be designed by the structural engineer and approved by the heritage authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只因外觀完整就延後檢測，鋼索內層鋼絲的腐蝕或錨具內部的疲勞裂紋可能在多年後突然導致斷索；重新計算若未取得現況索力與幾何，只用原設計值輸入模型，結論可能過於樂觀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Postponing inspection because the roof looks intact can let corrosion of inner wires or fatigue cracks inside anchorages cause a sudden cable failure years later; a recalculation fed only with original design values, without measured current forces and geometry, may reach over-optimistic conclusions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof"?
options: 以目視、磁性探傷或電磁檢測抽查鋼索斷絲與截面損失，量測代表性索力與網面幾何並與原始資料比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。
optionsEn: Spot-check cables for broken wires and section loss by visual, magnetic-flux or electromagnetic inspection, measure representative cable forces and surface geometry against original data, and test cast nodes and anchorages non-destructively.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths.
quiz.explanation: 以目視、磁性探傷或電磁檢測抽查鋼索斷絲與截面損失，量測代表性索力與網面幾何並與原始資料比較；鑄鋼節點與錨具做非破壞檢測；以現行規範荷載重算，列出利用率超過 1 或接近 1 的構件，提出更換或補強的優先順序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Spot-check cables for broken wires and section loss by visual, magnetic-flux or electromagnetic inspection, measure representative cable forces and surface geometry against original data, and test cast nodes and anchorages non-destructively; recalculate with current code loads, list components with utilisation above or near 1 and set priorities for replacement or strengthening. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「古蹟屋蓋重新計算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Recalculation of a listed roof” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只因外觀完整就延後檢測，鋼索內層鋼絲的腐蝕或錨具內部的疲勞裂紋可能在多年後突然導致斷索；重新計算若未取得現況索力與幾何，只用原設計值輸入模型，結論可能過於樂觀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Postponing inspection because the roof looks intact can let corrosion of inner wires or fatigue cracks inside anchorages cause a sudden cable failure years later; a recalculation fed only with original design values, without measured current forces and geometry, may reach over-optimistic conclusions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重新計算的目的是以現行知識檢查既有結構，並找出必須更換或補強的構件，同時盡量保存原貌；所有發現與決策都要寫入可移交的紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Recalculation checks the existing structure with current knowledge and identifies components to replace or strengthen while preserving the original as far as possible, and every finding and decision must be written into records that can be handed on.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「古蹟結構既然已經站了五十年，就證明它一定安全，不需要重新計算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A heritage structure that has stood for fifty years has proven it is safe and needs no recalculation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只因外觀完整就延後檢測，鋼索內層鋼絲的腐蝕或錨具內部的疲勞裂紋可能在多年後突然導致斷索；重新計算若未取得現況索力與幾何，只用原設計值輸入模型，結論可能過於樂觀。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「列管古蹟的檢測、重新計算與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inspection, recalculation and handover of a listed roof" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若只因外觀完整就延後檢測，鋼索內層鋼絲的腐蝕或錨具內部的疲勞裂紋可能在多年後突然導致斷索。
索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Postponing inspection because the roof looks intact can let corrosion of inner wires or fatigue cracks inside anchorages cause a sudden cable failure years later.
A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 若只因外觀完整就延後檢測，鋼索內層鋼絲的腐蝕或錨具內部的疲勞裂紋可能在多年後突然導致斷索；重新計算若未取得現況索力與幾何，只用原設計值輸入模型，結論可能過於樂觀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Postponing inspection because the roof looks intact can let corrosion of inner wires or fatigue cracks inside anchorages cause a sudden cable failure years later; a recalculation fed only with original design values, without measured current forces and geometry, may reach over-optimistic conclusions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 大跨度空間桁架提升
summary: 大跨度屋蓋若在高空逐件安裝，需要大量臨時支撐、高空作業與大型吊車；改在地面組裝後整體提升，能提高品質與安全，但提升狀態下桁架的支承點、受力方向與穩定條件都和使用狀態不同。課程以倫敦希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋、新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的 1,270 t 提升，以及川口衞發展、1984 年首用於神戶世界紀念館的 Pantadome 頂升構法為錨點，說明吊點與吊耳、鋼絞線與千斤頂、同步控制、塔架穩定、試提升、風速停止準則與就位轉換的檢核邏輯。
summaryEn: Erecting a long-span roof piece by piece at height needs extensive falsework, work at height and large cranes; assembling it at ground level and lifting it whole improves quality and safety, but in the lifting state the truss has different supports, force directions and stability conditions from service. Anchored on the 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5, the 1,270 t lift of the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark and Mamoru Kawaguchi's Pantadome push-up method first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984, the course explains the checking logic for lift points and lugs, strands and jacks, synchronised control, tower stability, trial lifts, wind stop criteria and final load transfer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
architectureNodes: 地面組裝的空間桁架單元

labels: 地面組裝的空間桁架單元

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一個屋蓋提升單元做初步提升設計。假設單元重 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台千斤頂共 16 點提升，W = 2,200×9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN，平均每點 1,350 kN。（1）鋼絞線：15.7 mm、破斷 279 kN、工作荷載取 40% 破斷，需 1,350/111.6 ≈ 12.1 → 13 根，每根約 104 kN；長 40 m 時伸長約 142 mm。（2）同步：吊點勁度 20 kN/mm、允許反力偏差 10%（135 kN），允許高差約 6.8 mm，警戒設 5 mm。（3）時間：提升 30 m、速度 10 m/h，純提升約 3 h，加試提升停留與就位約半天。（4）若改為 12 點提升，每點 1,800 kN，鋼絞線需 1,800/111.6 ≈ 16.1 → 17 根，伸長約 145 mm，但每座塔架荷載增為 3 台時約 5,400 kN，塔架挫屈需求隨之上升。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案的提升設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: preliminary lifting design for a roof unit. Assume the unit weighs 2,200 t and is lifted at 16 points by 8 towers with 2 jacks each, W = 2,200×9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, an average of 1,350 kN per point. (1) Strands: 15.7 mm with 279 kN breaking load at a working load of 40% of breaking needs 1,350/111.6 ≈ 12.1, so 13 strands of about 104 kN; 40 m long they stretch about 142 mm. (2) Synchronisation: with 20 kN/mm stiffness at a lift point and a 10% (135 kN) allowable reaction deviation, the allowable level difference is about 6.8 mm, with an alarm at 5 mm. (3) Time: lifting 30 m at 10 m/h takes about 3 h of pure lifting, about half a day with the trial-lift hold and final positioning. (4) With 12 points instead, each carries 1,800 kN and needs 1,800/111.6 ≈ 16.1, so 17 strands stretching about 145 mm, while a tower with 3 jacks carries about 5,400 kN and its buckling demand rises accordingly. All values are teaching assumptions, not the lifting design of any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」與「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole" and "Lifting state versus service state": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「地面組裝與整體提升」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground assembly and integral lift” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制；若改在地面或低處組裝成大單元，再以多台千斤頂同步提升，可以在穩定的工作面完成焊接、塗裝甚至部分機電與屋面。希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋就因機場雷達限制不能使用高大吊車，而在地面組裝後頂升到位；Pantadome 構法則把屋頂中央部分在低處組裝，再以推升機構把可折疊的結構撐到最終形狀。選擇方法時要同時比較臨時工程、提升設備、工期與風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「地面組裝與整體提升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control; assembling large units at or near ground level and lifting them with several synchronised jacks lets welding, painting and even some services and roofing be done on a stable working surface. The 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5 was assembled on the ground and jacked into place because airport radar ruled out tall cranes; the Pantadome method assembles the central part of a dome low down and pushes the foldable structure up into its final shape. Choosing a method means comparing temporary works, lifting equipment, programme and risk together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ground assembly and integral lift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「地面組裝與整體提升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ground assembly and integral lift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升
knowledge.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole
knowledge.text: 大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制；若改在地面或低處組裝成大單元，再以多台千斤頂同步提升，可以在穩定的工作面完成焊接、塗裝甚至部分機電與屋面。希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋就因機場雷達限制不能使用高大吊車，而在地面組裝後頂升到位；Pantadome 構法則把屋頂中央部分在低處組裝，再以推升機構把可折疊的結構撐到最終形狀。
knowledge.textEn: Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control; assembling large units at or near ground level and lifting them with several synchronised jacks lets welding, painting and even some services and roofing be done on a stable working surface. The 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5 was assembled on the ground and jacked into place because airport radar ruled out tall cranes; the Pantadome method assembles the central part of a dome low down and pushes the foldable structure up into its final shape.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole" is correct?
options: 整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。
大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制。
提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
optionsEn: Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change.
Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control.
During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
quiz.explanation: 大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制；若改在地面或低處組裝成大單元，再以多台千斤頂同步提升，可以在穩定的工作面完成焊接、塗裝甚至部分機電與屋面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control; assembling large units at or near ground level and lifting them with several synchronised jacks lets welding, painting and even some services and roofing be done on a stable working surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地面組裝與整體提升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground assembly and integral lift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。每台平均荷載 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN；若選用單台容量 5,700 kN 的鋼絞線千斤頂（VSL 公布的上限），利用率約 24%。實際千斤頂型號與容量未公開，此處容量比較為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each. The mean load per jack is 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN; with strand jacks of 5,700 kN each (the upper unit capacity published by VSL) the utilisation would be about 24%. The actual jack models and capacities are not public, so the capacity comparison is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。每台平均荷載 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN；若選用單台容量 5,700 kN 的鋼絞線千斤頂（VSL 公布的上限），利用率約 24%。實際千斤頂型號與容量未公開，此處容量比較為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each. The mean load per jack is 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN; with strand jacks of 5,700 kN each (the upper unit capacity published by VSL) the utilisation would be about 24%. The actual jack models and capacities are not public, so the capacity comparison is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole", which statement holds?
options: 鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。
臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。
公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。
optionsEn: If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely.
A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.
Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地面組裝與整體提升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground assembly and integral lift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：整體提升的可行性要在初步設計階段就與結構設計同步評估，提升點位置、提升反力與臨時塔架基礎都應出現在設計圖說中；提升方法變更屬設計變更，須由結構設計者重新核算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The feasibility of integral lifting should be assessed alongside structural design from preliminary design, with lifting points, reactions and temporary tower foundations shown on the drawings; a change of lifting method is a design change that the structural designer must recheck.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 整體提升的可行性要在初步設計階段就與結構設計同步評估，提升點位置、提升反力與臨時塔架基礎都應出現在設計圖說中；提升方法變更屬設計變更，須由結構設計者重新核算。
knowledge.textEn: The feasibility of integral lifting should be assessed alongside structural design from preliminary design, with lifting points, reactions and temporary tower foundations shown on the drawings; a change of lifting method is a design change that the structural designer must recheck.

quiz.question: 要驗證「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole"?
options: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。
optionsEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
quiz.explanation: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why assemble at ground level and lift whole: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地面組裝與整體提升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground assembly and integral lift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：選擇方法時要同時比較臨時工程、提升設備、工期與風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Choosing a method means comparing temporary works, lifting equipment, programme and risk together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Why assemble at ground level and lift whole" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強。
提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening.
During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
quiz.explanation: 若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「提升點與受力反轉」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift points and force reversal” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。使用狀態中受壓的上弦，在吊點附近可能轉為受拉；原本受拉的下弦或斜桿則可能轉為受壓，而這些桿件原本只依受拉設計，細長比可能不足以抵抗挫屈。所以每一個提升階段都要把結構當成一個新的結構系統來分析，包括動力係數、吊點不同步與風載，而不是只看最終狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「提升點與受力反轉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes. A top chord in compression in service may go into tension near a lift point, while a bottom chord or diagonal designed for tension may go into compression with a slenderness never intended to resist buckling. Every lifting stage must therefore be analysed as a new structural system, including dynamic factors, unsynchronised lift points and wind, rather than checking the final state alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lift points and force reversal” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「提升點與受力反轉」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lift points and force reversal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異
knowledge.text: 提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。使用狀態中受壓的上弦，在吊點附近可能轉為受拉；原本受拉的下弦或斜桿則可能轉為受壓，而這些桿件原本只依受拉設計，細長比可能不足以抵抗挫屈。
knowledge.textEn: During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes. A top chord in compression in service may go into tension near a lift point, while a bottom chord or diagonal designed for tension may go into compression with a slenderness never intended to resist buckling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lifting state versus service state" is correct?
options: 提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。
提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。
optionsEn: During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes.
quiz.explanation: 提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升點與受力反轉」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift points and force reversal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。使用狀態兩端簡支，跨中 M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m；提升時吊點各內縮 20 m，吊點處負彎矩 M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m，跨中變為 w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m。吊點附近上弦由受壓轉為受拉、下弦轉為受壓。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m. In service, simply supported at its ends, the midspan moment is M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m; during lifting with lift points set 20 m inward, the moment at each lift point is M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m and midspan becomes w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m. Near the lift points the top chord turns from compression to tension and the bottom chord into compression. Dimensions and load are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。使用狀態兩端簡支，跨中 M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m；提升時吊點各內縮 20 m，吊點處負彎矩 M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m，跨中變為 w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m。吊點附近上弦由受壓轉為受拉、下弦轉為受壓。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m. In service, simply supported at its ends, the midspan moment is M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m; during lifting with lift points set 20 m inward, the moment at each lift point is M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m and midspan becomes w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m. Near the lift points the top chord turns from compression to tension and the bottom chord into compression. Dimensions and load are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lifting state versus service state", which statement holds?
options: 桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。
同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。
計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。
optionsEn: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m.
The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work.
The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality.
quiz.explanation: 桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升點與受力反轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift points and force reversal” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構計算書要有獨立的提升階段章節，列出每個階段的支承條件、荷載組合、受力反號桿件與臨時加固；未經設計者核可，不得在現場自行改變吊點位置或增減提升單元的範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural calculations need a separate lifting-stage chapter listing support conditions, load combinations, members with reversed force and temporary strengthening for each stage; lift-point positions and the extent of lifting units must not be changed on site without the designer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構計算書要有獨立的提升階段章節，列出每個階段的支承條件、荷載組合、受力反號桿件與臨時加固；未經設計者核可，不得在現場自行改變吊點位置或增減提升單元的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The structural calculations need a separate lifting-stage chapter listing support conditions, load combinations, members with reversed force and temporary strengthening for each stage; lift-point positions and the extent of lifting units must not be changed on site without the designer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lifting state versus service state"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接。
提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections.
Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lifting state versus service state: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「提升點與受力反轉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift points and force reversal” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：所以每一個提升階段都要把結構當成一個新的結構系統來分析，包括動力係數、吊點不同步與風載，而不是只看最終狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every lifting stage must therefore be analysed as a new structural system, including dynamic factors, unsynchronised lift points and wind, rather than checking the final state alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。
knowledge.textEn: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lifting state versus service state" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。
只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally.
quiz.explanation: 只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁」與「鋼絞線千斤頂的行程、伸長與夾片」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening" and "Strand-jack strokes, stretch and wedges": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊耳與提升節點」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifting lugs and nodes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂的集中力要經由吊耳、銷栓或下錨座傳進桁架節點，再分散到弦桿與腹桿。吊耳的淨斷面、銷孔承壓、焊縫與節點板的局部挫屈都要檢核，並考慮提升時吊索可能偏斜所產生的側向分力。節點附近通常需要加勁板或臨時補強，把集中力擴散到足夠的斷面；提升完成後若要切除吊耳，切除方式與殘留部分的疲勞與防蝕也要事先規劃。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊耳與提升節點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The jack's concentrated force passes through lugs, pins or bottom anchor seats into the truss node and then spreads into chords and web members. The net section of the lug, pin-hole bearing, welds and local buckling of node plates must all be checked, including lateral components from strands that may lean during lifting. Nodes usually need stiffeners or temporary strengthening to spread the concentrated force into enough section; if lugs are to be cut off after lifting, the cutting method and the fatigue and corrosion protection of what remains must be planned in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lifting lugs and nodes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：吊點力 F = 1,350 kN，吊耳板厚 t = 60 mm、寬 b = 300 mm、銷孔 d = 120 mm，淨面積 (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm²，平均拉應力 σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa；乘動力係數 1.25 為約 156 MPa，對 S355 鋼仍有餘裕，但孔邊應力集中還需另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a lift-point force F = 1,350 kN, a lug plate t = 60 mm thick and b = 300 mm wide with a d = 120 mm pin hole has a net area (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm², giving a mean tension σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa; with a dynamic factor of 1.25 it is about 156 MPa, still within S355 capacity, though stress concentration at the hole needs a separate check.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊耳與提升節點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lifting lugs and nodes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The net section of the lug, pin-hole bearing, welds and local buckling of node plates must all be checked, including lateral components from strands that may lean during lifting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening" is correct?
options: 千斤頂的集中力要經由吊耳、銷栓或下錨座傳進桁架節點，再分散到弦桿與腹桿。
吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。
鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。

Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely.
