quiz.explanationEn: The jack's concentrated force passes through lugs, pins or bottom anchor seats into the truss node and then spreads into chords and web members. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊耳與提升節點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifting lugs and nodes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吊點力 F = 1,350 kN，吊耳板厚 t = 60 mm、寬 b = 300 mm、銷孔 d = 120 mm，淨面積 (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm²，平均拉應力 σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa；乘動力係數 1.25 為約 156 MPa，對 S355 鋼仍有餘裕，但孔邊應力集中還需另行檢核。尺寸為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a lift-point force F = 1,350 kN, a lug plate t = 60 mm thick and b = 300 mm wide with a d = 120 mm pin hole has a net area (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm², giving a mean tension σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa; with a dynamic factor of 1.25 it is about 156 MPa, still within S355 capacity, though stress concentration at the hole needs a separate check. Dimensions are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊耳與節點以有限元素或手算檢查淨斷面、承壓、撕裂與焊縫，焊縫做全數非破壞檢測；提升前目視與量測吊耳的垂直度與銷栓配合，並在試提升時於吊點附近貼應變計，比較量測應變與計算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check lugs and nodes by finite-element or hand calculation for net section, bearing, tear-out and welds, with 100% non-destructive testing of the welds; before lifting inspect and measure lug verticality and pin fit, and install strain gauges near lift points during the trial lift to compare measured strain with calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 吊點力 F = 1,350 kN，吊耳板厚 t = 60 mm、寬 b = 300 mm、銷孔 d = 120 mm，淨面積 (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm²，平均拉應力 σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa；乘動力係數 1.25 為約 156 MPa，對 S355 鋼仍有餘裕，但孔邊應力集中還需另行檢核。尺寸為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a lift-point force F = 1,350 kN, a lug plate t = 60 mm thick and b = 300 mm wide with a d = 120 mm pin hole has a net area (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm², giving a mean tension σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa; with a dynamic factor of 1.25 it is about 156 MPa, still within S355 capacity, though stress concentration at the hole needs a separate check. Dimensions are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening", which statement holds?
options: 臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。
提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。
optionsEn: A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.

With a lift-point force F = 1,350 kN, a lug plate t = 60 mm thick and b = 300 mm wide with a d = 120 mm pin hole has a net area (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm², giving a mean tension σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa.
The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
quiz.explanation: 吊點力 F = 1,350 kN，吊耳板厚 t = 60 mm、寬 b = 300 mm、銷孔 d = 120 mm，淨面積 (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm²，平均拉應力 σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa；乘動力係數 1.25 為約 156 MPa，對 S355 鋼仍有餘裕，但孔邊應力集中還需另行檢核。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a lift-point force F = 1,350 kN, a lug plate t = 60 mm thick and b = 300 mm wide with a d = 120 mm pin hole has a net area (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm², giving a mean tension σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa; with a dynamic factor of 1.25 it is about 156 MPa, still within S355 capacity, though stress concentration at the hole needs a separate check. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊耳與提升節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lifting lugs and nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊耳與節點以有限元素或手算檢查淨斷面、承壓、撕裂與焊縫，焊縫做全數非破壞檢測；提升前目視與量測吊耳的垂直度與銷栓配合，並在試提升時於吊點附近貼應變計，比較量測應變與計算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check lugs and nodes by finite-element or hand calculation for net section, bearing, tear-out and welds, with 100% non-destructive testing of the welds; before lifting inspect and measure lug verticality and pin fit, and install strain gauges near lift points during the trial lift to compare measured strain with calculation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊耳與提升節點要有正式設計圖、焊接程序與檢驗紀錄，並在圖上註明提升後是否保留；保留者須補防蝕並評估疲勞，切除者須規定切除方式與表面處理，由結構工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lugs and lifting nodes need formal design drawings, welding procedures and inspection records, with a note on whether each stays after lifting; retained lugs need corrosion protection and a fatigue assessment, removed ones a specified cutting method and surface treatment, signed off by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊耳焊縫在現場倉促施作且未檢測，提升時焊趾開裂；吊索偏斜產生的側向力未計入，吊耳平面外彎曲而撕裂，整個吊點失效時荷載瞬間轉到相鄰吊點，可能引起連鎖破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lug welds made hurriedly on site without testing can crack at the weld toe during lifting; ignoring lateral force from leaning strands bends the lug out of plane until it tears, and when a lift point fails its load jumps to neighbouring points and can trigger progressive failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊耳與節點以有限元素或手算檢查淨斷面、承壓、撕裂與焊縫，焊縫做全數非破壞檢測；提升前目視與量測吊耳的垂直度與銷栓配合，並在試提升時於吊點附近貼應變計，比較量測應變與計算。
knowledge.textEn: Check lugs and nodes by finite-element or hand calculation for net section, bearing, tear-out and welds, with 100% non-destructive testing of the welds; before lifting inspect and measure lug verticality and pin fit, and install strain gauges near lift points during the trial lift to compare measured strain with calculation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊耳與提升節點要有正式設計圖、焊接程序與檢驗紀錄，並在圖上註明提升後是否保留；保留者須補防蝕並評估疲勞，切除者須規定切除方式與表面處理，由結構工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Lugs and lifting nodes need formal design drawings, welding procedures and inspection records, with a note on whether each stays after lifting; retained lugs need corrosion protection and a fatigue assessment, removed ones a specified cutting method and surface treatment, signed off by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。
吊耳與節點以有限元素或手算檢查淨斷面、承壓、撕裂與焊縫，焊縫做全數非破壞檢測。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished.
Check lugs and nodes by finite-element or hand calculation for net section, bearing, tear-out and welds, with 100% non-destructive testing of the welds.
quiz.explanation: 吊耳與節點以有限元素或手算檢查淨斷面、承壓、撕裂與焊縫，焊縫做全數非破壞檢測；提升前目視與量測吊耳的垂直度與銷栓配合，並在試提升時於吊點附近貼應變計，比較量測應變與計算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check lugs and nodes by finite-element or hand calculation for net section, bearing, tear-out and welds, with 100% non-destructive testing of the welds; before lifting inspect and measure lug verticality and pin fit, and install strain gauges near lift points during the trial lift to compare measured strain with calculation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊耳與提升節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lifting lugs and nodes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊耳焊縫在現場倉促施作且未檢測，提升時焊趾開裂；吊索偏斜產生的側向力未計入，吊耳平面外彎曲而撕裂，整個吊點失效時荷載瞬間轉到相鄰吊點，可能引起連鎖破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lug welds made hurriedly on site without testing can crack at the weld toe during lifting; ignoring lateral force from leaning strands bends the lug out of plane until it tears, and when a lift point fails its load jumps to neighbouring points and can trigger progressive failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：節點附近通常需要加勁板或臨時補強，把集中力擴散到足夠的斷面；提升完成後若要切除吊耳，切除方式與殘留部分的疲勞與防蝕也要事先規劃。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nodes usually need stiffeners or temporary strengthening to spread the concentrated force into enough section; if lugs are to be cut off after lifting, the cutting method and the fatigue and corrosion protection of what remains must be planned in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊耳焊縫在現場倉促施作且未檢測，提升時焊趾開裂；吊索偏斜產生的側向力未計入，吊耳平面外彎曲而撕裂，整個吊點失效時荷載瞬間轉到相鄰吊點，可能引起連鎖破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Lug welds made hurriedly on site without testing can crack at the weld toe during lifting; ignoring lateral force from leaning strands bends the lug out of plane until it tears, and when a lift point fails its load jumps to neighbouring points and can trigger progressive failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 吊耳焊縫在現場倉促施作且未檢測，提升時焊趾開裂；吊索偏斜產生的側向力未計入，吊耳平面外彎曲而撕裂，整個吊點失效時荷載瞬間轉到相鄰吊點，可能引起連鎖破壞。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。
optionsEn: Lug welds made hurriedly on site without testing can crack at the weld toe during lifting.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 吊耳焊縫在現場倉促施作且未檢測，提升時焊趾開裂；吊索偏斜產生的側向力未計入，吊耳平面外彎曲而撕裂，整個吊點失效時荷載瞬間轉到相鄰吊點，可能引起連鎖破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lug welds made hurriedly on site without testing can crack at the weld toe during lifting; ignoring lateral force from leaning strands bends the lug out of plane until it tears, and when a lift point fails its load jumps to neighbouring points and can trigger progressive failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂的行程、伸長與夾片：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack strokes, stretch and wedges: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼絞線與夾片錨具」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strands and wedge anchors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼絞線千斤頂源自預力技術：千斤頂上下各有一組夾片錨具，活塞伸出時上錨夾緊鋼絞線把重物拉上一個行程，回縮時下錨夾住、上錨放鬆，如此反覆。荷載越大、鋼絞線越長，鋼絞線本身的彈性伸長越大，各千斤頂的荷載不同就會造成高差。夾片每次咬合都會在鋼絞線上留下齒痕，重複使用的鋼絞線要檢查損傷並限制使用次數；下錨在停機時是唯一的保持機構，必須可靠。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼絞線與夾片錨具」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The strand jack derives from post-tensioning technology: it has upper and lower wedge anchors, and as the piston extends the upper anchor grips the strands and raises the load one stroke; on retraction the lower anchor holds while the upper one releases, and the cycle repeats. The larger the load and the longer the strands, the more the strands stretch elastically, so unequal jack loads create level differences. Each wedge bite marks the strand, so reused strands must be inspected for damage and limited in number of uses; the lower anchor is the only holding device when the jack stops and must be reliable. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strands and wedge anchors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每台千斤頂 1,350 kN，以 15.7 mm 鋼絞線（破斷 279 kN）、工作荷載 40% 破斷力計，需 1,350/(0.4×279) ≈ 12.1，取 13 根，每根約 104 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A jack carrying 1,350 kN with 15.7 mm strands (279 kN breaking) at a working load of 40% of breaking needs 1,350/(0.4×279) ≈ 12.1, so 13 strands of about 104 kN each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼絞線與夾片錨具」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strands and wedge anchors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂的行程、伸長與夾片：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack strokes, stretch and wedges: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼絞線與夾片錨具」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strands and wedge anchors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每台千斤頂 1,350 kN，以 15.7 mm 鋼絞線（破斷 279 kN）、工作荷載 40% 破斷力計，需 1,350/(0.4×279) ≈ 12.1，取 13 根，每根約 104 kN。鋼絞線長 40 m、面積 150 mm²、E = 195 GPa，伸長 ΔL = 104,000×40,000/(195,000×150) ≈ 142 mm。行程 400 mm 時提升 30 m 需 75 個行程。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A jack carrying 1,350 kN with 15.7 mm strands (279 kN breaking) at a working load of 40% of breaking needs 1,350/(0.4×279) ≈ 12.1, so 13 strands of about 104 kN each. Strands 40 m long with 150 mm² area and E = 195 GPa stretch ΔL = 104,000×40,000/(195,000×150) ≈ 142 mm. With a 400 mm stroke, lifting 30 m takes 75 strokes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼絞線進場核對材質證明與外觀，重複使用者逐根檢查夾片齒痕與斷絲；千斤頂以校正過的壓力感測器確認容量，提升前做空載與加載循環測試，確認上下錨夾持與放鬆動作正常；提升中記錄各台行程計數與伸長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On delivery check strand certificates and condition, and inspect each reused strand for wedge marks and broken wires; confirm jack capacity with calibrated pressure sensors and run unloaded and loaded cycle tests before lifting to confirm that upper and lower anchors grip and release correctly; during lifting record each jack's stroke count and strand extension.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂的行程、伸長與夾片：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strand-jack strokes, stretch and wedges: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼絞線與夾片錨具」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strands and wedge anchors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼絞線進場核對材質證明與外觀，重複使用者逐根檢查夾片齒痕與斷絲；千斤頂以校正過的壓力感測器確認容量，提升前做空載與加載循環測試，確認上下錨夾持與放鬆動作正常；提升中記錄各台行程計數與伸長。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On delivery check strand certificates and condition, and inspect each reused strand for wedge marks and broken wires; confirm jack capacity with calibrated pressure sensors and run unloaded and loaded cycle tests before lifting to confirm that upper and lower anchors grip and release correctly; during lifting record each jack's stroke count and strand extension. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：提升計畫要規定鋼絞線的安全係數、最大重複使用次數、檢查標準與報廢條件，以及下錨夾片的清潔與更換週期；本課只說明檢核邏輯，實際設備操作須由專業提升承包商的合格人員依核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan should set strand safety factor, maximum number of reuses, inspection standard and rejection criteria, and the cleaning and replacement interval of lower-anchor wedges; this course explains checking logic only, and equipment must be operated by qualified personnel of the specialist lifting contractor under an approved procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複使用多次的鋼絞線在齒痕處斷絲，荷載轉到同一束的其他鋼絞線，若連續斷裂可能使該吊點失效；下錨夾片沾污或磨損時夾持力不足，停機時鋼絞線慢慢滑移，重物在不知情下傾斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strands reused many times break wires at wedge marks, transferring load to the rest of the bundle, and successive breaks can fail the lift point; contaminated or worn lower-anchor wedges lose grip, so strands creep while the jack is stopped and the load tilts unnoticed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 重複使用多次的鋼絞線在齒痕處斷絲，荷載轉到同一束的其他鋼絞線，若連續斷裂可能使該吊點失效；下錨夾片沾污或磨損時夾持力不足，停機時鋼絞線慢慢滑移，重物在不知情下傾斜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複使用多次的鋼絞線在齒痕處斷絲，荷載轉到同一束的其他鋼絞線，若連續斷裂可能使該吊點失效；下錨夾片沾污或磨損時夾持力不足，停機時鋼絞線慢慢滑移，重物在不知情下傾斜。
knowledge.textEn: Strands reused many times break wires at wedge marks, transferring load to the rest of the bundle, and successive breaks can fail the lift point; contaminated or worn lower-anchor wedges lose grip, so strands creep while the jack is stopped and the load tilts unnoticed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼絞線千斤頂的行程、伸長與夾片」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strand-jack strokes, stretch and wedges" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
重複使用多次的鋼絞線在齒痕處斷絲，荷載轉到同一束的其他鋼絞線，若連續斷裂可能使該吊點失效。
同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Strands reused many times break wires at wedge marks, transferring load to the rest of the bundle, and successive breaks can fail the lift point.
The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work.
quiz.explanation: 重複使用多次的鋼絞線在齒痕處斷絲，荷載轉到同一束的其他鋼絞線，若連續斷裂可能使該吊點失效；下錨夾片沾污或磨損時夾持力不足，停機時鋼絞線慢慢滑移，重物在不知情下傾斜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strands reused many times break wires at wedge marks, transferring load to the rest of the bundle, and successive breaks can fail the lift point; contaminated or worn lower-anchor wedges lose grip, so strands creep while the jack is stopped and the load tilts unnoticed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多點同步提升的控制邏輯」與「提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting" and "Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多點同步提升的控制邏輯：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「多點同步控制」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multi-point synchronous control” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 整體提升通常有數個到上百個吊點，VSL 公布其系統可同步控制多達 120 個吊點。控制方式分為位置控制（各點保持相同高程）與荷載控制（各點保持設定荷載），實務上多以位置控制為主、荷載作為監控與警報。由於桁架有勁度，吊點之間的高差會直接轉成反力的重新分配，所以同步允差必須由結構勁度反推，而不是由設備精度決定。控制系統還要能在任一點異常時自動停止所有千斤頂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「多點同步控制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integral lifts usually have several to over a hundred lift points, and VSL states its system can synchronise up to 120. Control can be by position, keeping all points at the same level, or by load, keeping each point at a set load; in practice position control is primary, with load used for monitoring and alarms. Because the truss has stiffness, any level difference between points becomes a redistribution of reactions, so the synchronisation tolerance must be derived from structural stiffness rather than from equipment precision. The control system must also stop every jack automatically when any one point behaves abnormally. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Multi-point synchronous control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某吊點處桁架勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，允許反力偏差為平均 1,350 kN 的 10%，即 135 kN，則允許高差 Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm；控制系統的同步警戒值宜設在約 5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the truss stiffness at a lift point is k = 20 kN/mm and the allowable reaction deviation is 10% of the average 1,350 kN, that is 135 kN, the allowable level difference is Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm, so the control alarm should be set at about 5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「多點同步控制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Multi-point synchronous control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多點同步提升的控制邏輯
knowledge.titleEn: Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting
knowledge.text: 整體提升通常有數個到上百個吊點，VSL 公布其系統可同步控制多達 120 個吊點。控制方式分為位置控制（各點保持相同高程）與荷載控制（各點保持設定荷載），實務上多以位置控制為主、荷載作為監控與警報。
knowledge.textEn: Integral lifts usually have several to over a hundred lift points, and VSL states its system can synchronise up to 120. Control can be by position, keeping all points at the same level, or by load, keeping each point at a set load; in practice position control is primary, with load used for monitoring and alarms.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多點同步提升的控制邏輯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting" is correct?
options: 同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。
臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。
整體提升通常有數個到上百個吊點，VSL 公布其系統可同步控制多達 120 個吊點。
optionsEn: The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work.
A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.
Integral lifts usually have several to over a hundred lift points, and VSL states its system can synchronise up to 120.
quiz.explanation: 整體提升通常有數個到上百個吊點，VSL 公布其系統可同步控制多達 120 個吊點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Integral lifts usually have several to over a hundred lift points, and VSL states its system can synchronise up to 120. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多點同步提升的控制邏輯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多點同步控制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multi-point synchronous control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某吊點處桁架勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，允許反力偏差為平均 1,350 kN 的 10%，即 135 kN，則允許高差 Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm；控制系統的同步警戒值宜設在約 5 mm。若勁度為 40 kN/mm，允許高差只剩約 3.4 mm。勁度與允許偏差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the truss stiffness at a lift point is k = 20 kN/mm and the allowable reaction deviation is 10% of the average 1,350 kN, that is 135 kN, the allowable level difference is Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm, so the control alarm should be set at about 5 mm. With a stiffness of 40 kN/mm the allowance drops to about 3.4 mm. Stiffness and allowable deviation are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：提升前以結構模型逐點計算勁度，訂出每點的高差與荷載警戒值與停止值；控制系統做功能測試，包括單點故障、通訊中斷與緊急停止；提升中以獨立的測量（例如全測站或雷射測距）抽查控制系統顯示的高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting compute stiffness point by point in the structural model and set alarm and stop values for level difference and load at each point; function-test the control system for single-point faults, loss of communication and emergency stop; during lifting spot-check the levels shown by the control system with independent survey such as total station or laser ranging.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某吊點處桁架勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，允許反力偏差為平均 1,350 kN 的 10%，即 135 kN，則允許高差 Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm；控制系統的同步警戒值宜設在約 5 mm。若勁度為 40 kN/mm，允許高差只剩約 3.4 mm。勁度與允許偏差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the truss stiffness at a lift point is k = 20 kN/mm and the allowable reaction deviation is 10% of the average 1,350 kN, that is 135 kN, the allowable level difference is Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm, so the control alarm should be set at about 5 mm. With a stiffness of 40 kN/mm the allowance drops to about 3.4 mm. Stiffness and allowable deviation are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「多點同步提升的控制邏輯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting", which statement holds?
options: 若某吊點處桁架勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，允許反力偏差為平均 1,350 kN 的 10%，即 135 kN，則允許高差 Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm。
提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。
提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。
optionsEn: If the truss stiffness at a lift point is k = 20 kN/mm and the allowable reaction deviation is 10% of the average 1,350 kN, that is 135 kN, the allowable level difference is Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm, so the control alarm should be set at about 5 mm.
The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished.
quiz.explanation: 若某吊點處桁架勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，允許反力偏差為平均 1,350 kN 的 10%，即 135 kN，則允許高差 Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm；控制系統的同步警戒值宜設在約 5 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the truss stiffness at a lift point is k = 20 kN/mm and the allowable reaction deviation is 10% of the average 1,350 kN, that is 135 kN, the allowable level difference is Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm, so the control alarm should be set at about 5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多點同步提升的控制邏輯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多點同步控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Multi-point synchronous control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 提升前以結構模型逐點計算勁度，訂出每點的高差與荷載警戒值與停止值；控制系統做功能測試，包括單點故障、通訊中斷與緊急停止；提升中以獨立的測量（例如全測站或雷射測距）抽查控制系統顯示的高程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting compute stiffness point by point in the structural model and set alarm and stop values for level difference and load at each point; function-test the control system for single-point faults, loss of communication and emergency stop; during lifting spot-check the levels shown by the control system with independent survey such as total station or laser ranging. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：提升計畫應附每個吊點的勁度、允許高差、荷載警戒與停止值，並明定由誰判讀與決定繼續；警戒值設得過緊會頻繁停機，設得過鬆則失去保護，兩者都要由結構設計者與提升承包商共同確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan should attach each lift point's stiffness, allowable level difference and load alarm and stop values, and state who interprets them and decides to continue; thresholds too tight cause constant stoppages and too loose give no protection, so both must be agreed by the structural designer and lifting contractor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同步允差只依設備規格設定，未考慮桁架勁度，某些高勁度區段在幾毫米高差下反力就大幅偏移，吊耳或桿件超載；控制系統若只監控荷載而忽略位置，感測器漂移時會把錯誤的荷載當成正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting synchronisation tolerance from equipment specification alone, ignoring truss stiffness, lets reactions in stiff zones shift heavily for a few millimetres of level difference and overload lugs or members; a system monitoring only load and not position can treat a drifting sensor's wrong reading as normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 提升前以結構模型逐點計算勁度，訂出每點的高差與荷載警戒值與停止值；控制系統做功能測試，包括單點故障、通訊中斷與緊急停止；提升中以獨立的測量（例如全測站或雷射測距）抽查控制系統顯示的高程。
knowledge.textEn: Before lifting compute stiffness point by point in the structural model and set alarm and stop values for level difference and load at each point; function-test the control system for single-point faults, loss of communication and emergency stop; during lifting spot-check the levels shown by the control system with independent survey such as total station or laser ranging.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 提升計畫應附每個吊點的勁度、允許高差、荷載警戒與停止值，並明定由誰判讀與決定繼續；警戒值設得過緊會頻繁停機，設得過鬆則失去保護，兩者都要由結構設計者與提升承包商共同確認。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan should attach each lift point's stiffness, allowable level difference and load alarm and stop values, and state who interprets them and decides to continue; thresholds too tight cause constant stoppages and too loose give no protection, so both must be agreed by the structural designer and lifting contractor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多點同步提升的控制邏輯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
提升前以結構模型逐點計算勁度，訂出每點的高差與荷載警戒值與停止值。
提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before lifting compute stiffness point by point in the structural model and set alarm and stop values for level difference and load at each point.
During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
quiz.explanation: 提升前以結構模型逐點計算勁度，訂出每點的高差與荷載警戒值與停止值；控制系統做功能測試，包括單點故障、通訊中斷與緊急停止；提升中以獨立的測量（例如全測站或雷射測距）抽查控制系統顯示的高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before lifting compute stiffness point by point in the structural model and set alarm and stop values for level difference and load at each point; function-test the control system for single-point faults, loss of communication and emergency stop; during lifting spot-check the levels shown by the control system with independent survey such as total station or laser ranging. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多點同步提升的控制邏輯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多點同步控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Multi-point synchronous control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同步允差只依設備規格設定，未考慮桁架勁度，某些高勁度區段在幾毫米高差下反力就大幅偏移，吊耳或桿件超載；控制系統若只監控荷載而忽略位置，感測器漂移時會把錯誤的荷載當成正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting synchronisation tolerance from equipment specification alone, ignoring truss stiffness, lets reactions in stiff zones shift heavily for a few millimetres of level difference and overload lugs or members; a system monitoring only load and not position can treat a drifting sensor's wrong reading as normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：控制系統還要能在任一點異常時自動停止所有千斤頂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The control system must also stop every jack automatically when any one point behaves abnormally.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同步允差只依設備規格設定，未考慮桁架勁度，某些高勁度區段在幾毫米高差下反力就大幅偏移，吊耳或桿件超載；控制系統若只監控荷載而忽略位置，感測器漂移時會把錯誤的荷載當成正常。
knowledge.textEn: Setting synchronisation tolerance from equipment specification alone, ignoring truss stiffness, lets reactions in stiff zones shift heavily for a few millimetres of level difference and overload lugs or members; a system monitoring only load and not position can treat a drifting sensor's wrong reading as normal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多點同步提升的控制邏輯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。
同步允差只依設備規格設定，未考慮桁架勁度，某些高勁度區段在幾毫米高差下反力就大幅偏移，吊耳或桿件超載。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.

Setting synchronisation tolerance from equipment specification alone, ignoring truss stiffness, lets reactions in stiff zones shift heavily for a few millimetres of level difference and overload lugs or members.
quiz.explanation: 同步允差只依設備規格設定，未考慮桁架勁度，某些高勁度區段在幾毫米高差下反力就大幅偏移，吊耳或桿件超載；控制系統若只監控荷載而忽略位置，感測器漂移時會把錯誤的荷載當成正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting synchronisation tolerance from equipment specification alone, ignoring truss stiffness, lets reactions in stiff zones shift heavily for a few millimetres of level difference and overload lugs or members; a system monitoring only load and not position can treat a drifting sensor's wrong reading as normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「提升塔架與頂升機構」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifting towers and push-up mechanism” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼絞線提升需要在上方設置千斤頂，常利用永久柱或另立臨時塔架；第五航廈即使用 8 座塔架。塔架承受極大的軸壓，任何垂直度偏差、千斤頂偏心或提升單元的水平力都會在高處產生彎矩，挫屈長度又長，因此穩定性往往比強度更控制。Pantadome 則相反：結構在低處以可轉動的鉸接組成，由下方頂升，提升過程中結構呈機構狀態，只靠頂升點與導向維持穩定，到位後再補上鎖定桿件使其成為穩定的殼體。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「提升塔架與頂升機構」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strand lifting needs jacks above the load, usually on permanent columns or temporary towers; Terminal 5 used 8 towers. A tower carries very large axial compression, and any out-of-plumb, jack eccentricity or horizontal force from the lifting unit creates moments at height over a long buckling length, so stability often governs more than strength. The Pantadome works the other way: the structure is assembled low down with rotating hinges and pushed up from below, behaving as a mechanism during lifting and kept stable only by push-up points and guides, then locked by adding members once in position to become a stable shell. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lifting towers and push-up mechanism” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每座塔架承受 2 台千斤頂，P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each tower carries 2 jacks, P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「提升塔架與頂升機構」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lifting towers and push-up mechanism”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升
knowledge.text: 鋼絞線提升需要在上方設置千斤頂，常利用永久柱或另立臨時塔架；第五航廈即使用 8 座塔架。塔架承受極大的軸壓，任何垂直度偏差、千斤頂偏心或提升單元的水平力都會在高處產生彎矩，挫屈長度又長，因此穩定性往往比強度更控制。
knowledge.textEn: Strand lifting needs jacks above the load, usually on permanent columns or temporary towers; Terminal 5 used 8 towers. A tower carries very large axial compression, and any out-of-plumb, jack eccentricity or horizontal force from the lifting unit creates moments at height over a long buckling length, so stability often governs more than strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up" is correct?
options: 鋼絞線提升需要在上方設置千斤頂，常利用永久柱或另立臨時塔架；第五航廈即使用 8 座塔架。
臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。
計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。

A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.
The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality.

quiz.explanationEn: Strand lifting needs jacks above the load, usually on permanent columns or temporary towers; Terminal 5 used 8 towers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升塔架與頂升機構」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifting towers and push-up mechanism” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每座塔架承受 2 台千斤頂，P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN。1% 的垂直度偏差產生水平力 27 kN，作用在 40 m 高處使塔底彎矩約 27×40 ≈ 1,080 kN·m。若要求懸臂塔架的彈性挫屈荷載至少為 3P，P_cr = π²EI/(4L²) ≥ 8,100 kN，需 EI ≥ 8,100×4×40²/π² ≈ 5.25×10⁶ kN·m²。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each tower carries 2 jacks, P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN. A 1% out-of-plumb gives a horizontal force of 27 kN, which at 40 m height creates a base moment of about 27×40 ≈ 1,080 kN·m. Requiring the cantilever tower's elastic buckling load to be at least 3P, P_cr = π²EI/(4L²) ≥ 8,100 kN needs EI ≥ 8,100×4×40²/π² ≈ 5.25×10⁶ kN·m². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：塔架安裝後量測垂直度並記錄，設計中納入此偏差與提升時的水平力；塔架基礎做承載與沉陷檢核，提升中監測塔頂位移；Pantadome 類頂升須另外檢核機構狀態下的導向、側向約束與鎖定順序，鎖定前不得撤除任何頂升支承。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey and record tower verticality after erection, including the deviation and lifting horizontal forces in design; check tower foundations for bearing and settlement and monitor tower-top movement during lifting; for Pantadome-type push-up, check guides, lateral restraint and locking sequence in the mechanism state, and remove no push-up support before locking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每座塔架承受 2 台千斤頂，P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN。1% 的垂直度偏差產生水平力 27 kN，作用在 40 m 高處使塔底彎矩約 27×40 ≈ 1,080 kN·m。若要求懸臂塔架的彈性挫屈荷載至少為 3P，P_cr = π²EI/(4L²) ≥ 8,100 kN，需 EI ≥ 8,100×4×40²/π² ≈ 5.25×10⁶ kN·m²。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Each tower carries 2 jacks, P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN. A 1% out-of-plumb gives a horizontal force of 27 kN, which at 40 m height creates a base moment of about 27×40 ≈ 1,080 kN·m. Requiring the cantilever tower's elastic buckling load to be at least 3P, P_cr = π²EI/(4L²) ≥ 8,100 kN needs EI ≥ 8,100×4×40²/π² ≈ 5.25×10⁶ kN·m². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up", which statement holds?
options: 提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。
每座塔架承受 2 台千斤頂，P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN。
整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。
optionsEn: Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed.
Each tower carries 2 jacks, P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN.
Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change.
quiz.explanation: 每座塔架承受 2 台千斤頂，P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Each tower carries 2 jacks, P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升塔架與頂升機構」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lifting towers and push-up mechanism” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 塔架安裝後量測垂直度並記錄，設計中納入此偏差與提升時的水平力；塔架基礎做承載與沉陷檢核，提升中監測塔頂位移；Pantadome 類頂升須另外檢核機構狀態下的導向、側向約束與鎖定順序，鎖定前不得撤除任何頂升支承。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey and record tower verticality after erection, including the deviation and lifting horizontal forces in design; check tower foundations for bearing and settlement and monitor tower-top movement during lifting; for Pantadome-type push-up, check guides, lateral restraint and locking sequence in the mechanism state, and remove no push-up support before locking. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：臨時塔架應有與永久結構同等級的設計與檢查：計算書、基礎試驗、垂直度紀錄與每日巡檢；頂升構法的鎖定程序須寫明桿件安裝順序與完成判定，鎖定完成前所有支承都是停止點，由結構設計者確認後才能撤除。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Temporary towers need design and inspection to the same standard as permanent structure: calculations, foundation tests, verticality records and daily checks; push-up methods need a locking procedure stating member installation order and completion criteria, with every support a hold point until the structural designer confirms locking is complete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：臨時塔架基礎設在未壓實的地面，提升中不均勻沉陷使塔架傾斜，偏心急遽增加而挫屈；Pantadome 若在鎖定前移除頂升支承或側向導向不足，機構狀態的結構會側傾，整個屋頂可能失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A temporary tower founded on poorly compacted ground settles unevenly during lifting, tilts and buckles as eccentricity rises sharply; in a Pantadome, removing push-up supports before locking or providing too little lateral guidance lets the mechanism-state structure sway sideways and the whole roof can lose stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 塔架安裝後量測垂直度並記錄，設計中納入此偏差與提升時的水平力；塔架基礎做承載與沉陷檢核，提升中監測塔頂位移；Pantadome 類頂升須另外檢核機構狀態下的導向、側向約束與鎖定順序，鎖定前不得撤除任何頂升支承。
knowledge.textEn: Survey and record tower verticality after erection, including the deviation and lifting horizontal forces in design; check tower foundations for bearing and settlement and monitor tower-top movement during lifting; for Pantadome-type push-up, check guides, lateral restraint and locking sequence in the mechanism state, and remove no push-up support before locking.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 臨時塔架應有與永久結構同等級的設計與檢查：計算書、基礎試驗、垂直度紀錄與每日巡檢；頂升構法的鎖定程序須寫明桿件安裝順序與完成判定，鎖定完成前所有支承都是停止點，由結構設計者確認後才能撤除。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary towers need design and inspection to the same standard as permanent structure: calculations, foundation tests, verticality records and daily checks; push-up methods need a locking procedure stating member installation order and completion criteria, with every support a hold point until the structural designer confirms locking is complete.

quiz.question: 要驗證「提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
