quiz.explanation: 塔架安裝後量測垂直度並記錄，設計中納入此偏差與提升時的水平力；塔架基礎做承載與沉陷檢核，提升中監測塔頂位移；Pantadome 類頂升須另外檢核機構狀態下的導向、側向約束與鎖定順序，鎖定前不得撤除任何頂升支承。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey and record tower verticality after erection, including the deviation and lifting horizontal forces in design; check tower foundations for bearing and settlement and monitor tower-top movement during lifting; for Pantadome-type push-up, check guides, lateral restraint and locking sequence in the mechanism state, and remove no push-up support before locking. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「提升塔架與頂升機構」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lifting towers and push-up mechanism” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時塔架基礎設在未壓實的地面，提升中不均勻沉陷使塔架傾斜，偏心急遽增加而挫屈；Pantadome 若在鎖定前移除頂升支承或側向導向不足，機構狀態的結構會側傾，整個屋頂可能失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A temporary tower founded on poorly compacted ground settles unevenly during lifting, tilts and buckles as eccentricity rises sharply; in a Pantadome, removing push-up supports before locking or providing too little lateral guidance lets the mechanism-state structure sway sideways and the whole roof can lose stability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Pantadome 則相反：結構在低處以可轉動的鉸接組成，由下方頂升，提升過程中結構呈機構狀態，只靠頂升點與導向維持穩定，到位後再補上鎖定桿件使其成為穩定的殼體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Pantadome works the other way: the structure is assembled low down with rotating hinges and pushed up from below, behaving as a mechanism during lifting and kept stable only by push-up points and guides, then locked by adding members once in position to become a stable shell.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 臨時塔架基礎設在未壓實的地面，提升中不均勻沉陷使塔架傾斜，偏心急遽增加而挫屈；Pantadome 若在鎖定前移除頂升支承或側向導向不足，機構狀態的結構會側傾，整個屋頂可能失穩。
knowledge.textEn: A temporary tower founded on poorly compacted ground settles unevenly during lifting, tilts and buckles as eccentricity rises sharply; in a Pantadome, removing push-up supports before locking or providing too little lateral guidance lets the mechanism-state structure sway sideways and the whole roof can lose stability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 臨時塔架基礎設在未壓實的地面，提升中不均勻沉陷使塔架傾斜，偏心急遽增加而挫屈。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。
optionsEn: A temporary tower founded on poorly compacted ground settles unevenly during lifting, tilts and buckles as eccentricity rises sharply.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality.
quiz.explanation: 臨時塔架基礎設在未壓實的地面，提升中不均勻沉陷使塔架傾斜，偏心急遽增加而挫屈；Pantadome 若在鎖定前移除頂升支承或側向導向不足，機構狀態的結構會側傾，整個屋頂可能失穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A temporary tower founded on poorly compacted ground settles unevenly during lifting, tilts and buckles as eccentricity rises sharply; in a Pantadome, removing push-up supports before locking or providing too little lateral guidance lets the mechanism-state structure sway sideways and the whole roof can lose stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試提升、重量核對與變形量測」與「提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey" and "Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試提升、重量核對與變形量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「試提升與荷載核對」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trial lift and load check” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正式提升前要做試提升：把提升單元抬離臨時支撐數十到數百毫米後停住，觀察一段時間。這一步同時驗證幾件事：實際總重是否與計算相符（地面組裝常附帶臨時設備或多餘材料）、各吊點荷載分配是否符合預測、桁架離地後的撓度與計算是否一致、下錨保持是否可靠。若任何一項偏差超過允許值，必須查明原因後才能繼續，否則問題會在高空才暴露，處理難度與風險都大幅升高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「試提升與荷載核對」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before the main lift comes a trial lift: the unit is raised tens to hundreds of millimetres off its temporary supports and held for a period. This step verifies several things at once: whether the actual total weight matches calculation, since ground assembly often carries temporary equipment or surplus material; whether load sharing among lift points matches prediction; whether the truss deflection after lift-off agrees with calculation; and whether the lower anchors hold reliably. If any deviation exceeds its allowance the cause must be found before continuing; otherwise problems surface at height where they are far harder and riskier to deal with. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Trial lift and load check” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sixteen jack readings total 22,600 kN against a calculated weight of 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, a difference of +4.7%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「試提升與荷載核對」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Trial lift and load check”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試提升、重量核對與變形量測
knowledge.titleEn: Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey
knowledge.text: 正式提升前要做試提升：把提升單元抬離臨時支撐數十到數百毫米後停住，觀察一段時間。這一步同時驗證幾件事：實際總重是否與計算相符（地面組裝常附帶臨時設備或多餘材料）、各吊點荷載分配是否符合預測、桁架離地後的撓度與計算是否一致、下錨保持是否可靠。
knowledge.textEn: Before the main lift comes a trial lift: the unit is raised tens to hundreds of millimetres off its temporary supports and held for a period. This step verifies several things at once: whether the actual total weight matches calculation, since ground assembly often carries temporary equipment or surplus material; whether load sharing among lift points matches prediction; whether the truss deflection after lift-off agrees with calculation; and whether the lower anchors hold reliably.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試提升、重量核對與變形量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey" is correct?
options: 計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。
正式提升前要做試提升：把提升單元抬離臨時支撐數十到數百毫米後停住，觀察一段時間。
提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。
optionsEn: The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality.
Before the main lift comes a trial lift: the unit is raised tens to hundreds of millimetres off its temporary supports and held for a period.
The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
quiz.explanation: 正式提升前要做試提升：把提升單元抬離臨時支撐數十到數百毫米後停住，觀察一段時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the main lift comes a trial lift: the unit is raised tens to hundreds of millimetres off its temporary supports and held for a period. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試提升、重量核對與變形量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試提升與荷載核對」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trial lift and load check” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：16 台千斤頂讀數合計 22,600 kN，計算重量 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN，差 +4.7%。若允許偏差 ±5%，勉強合格，但應查明多出的約 1,020 kN（約 104 t）來源。若某單點讀數比預測高 18%，即使總重合格也要停下檢查同步與支承。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sixteen jack readings total 22,600 kN against a calculated weight of 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, a difference of +4.7%. Within a ±5% allowance this barely passes, but the source of the extra 1,020 kN (about 104 t) should be found. If one point reads 18% above prediction, the lift must stop to check synchronisation and supports even though the total passes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試提升前清點並移除臨時物件，記錄計算重量的組成；離地後停留規定時間（例如 30 分鐘以上），記錄各點荷載、桁架撓度與下錨滑移量，與預測比較；結果由提升承包商與結構設計者共同簽認後才進入正式提升。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the trial lift, inventory and remove temporary items and record what makes up the calculated weight; after lift-off hold for a set period, for example at least 30 minutes, recording each point's load, truss deflection and lower-anchor slip and comparing with prediction; the main lift proceeds only after the lifting contractor and structural designer jointly sign the results.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 16 台千斤頂讀數合計 22,600 kN，計算重量 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN，差 +4.7%。若允許偏差 ±5%，勉強合格，但應查明多出的約 1,020 kN（約 104 t）來源。若某單點讀數比預測高 18%，即使總重合格也要停下檢查同步與支承。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Sixteen jack readings total 22,600 kN against a calculated weight of 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, a difference of +4.7%. Within a ±5% allowance this barely passes, but the source of the extra 1,020 kN (about 104 t) should be found. If one point reads 18% above prediction, the lift must stop to check synchronisation and supports even though the total passes. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試提升、重量核對與變形量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey", which statement holds?
options: 提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。
提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
optionsEn: Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished.
During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
Sixteen jack readings total 22,600 kN against a calculated weight of 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, a difference of +4.7%.
quiz.explanation: 16 台千斤頂讀數合計 22,600 kN，計算重量 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN，差 +4.7%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Sixteen jack readings total 22,600 kN against a calculated weight of 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, a difference of +4.7%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試提升、重量核對與變形量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試提升與荷載核對」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trial lift and load check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試提升前清點並移除臨時物件，記錄計算重量的組成；離地後停留規定時間（例如 30 分鐘以上），記錄各點荷載、桁架撓度與下錨滑移量，與預測比較；結果由提升承包商與結構設計者共同簽認後才進入正式提升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the trial lift, inventory and remove temporary items and record what makes up the calculated weight; after lift-off hold for a set period, for example at least 30 minutes, recording each point's load, truss deflection and lower-anchor slip and comparing with prediction; the main lift proceeds only after the lifting contractor and structural designer jointly sign the results. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試提升要寫入提升計畫並列為停止點，明定停留時間、量測項目、允許偏差與決策人；試提升紀錄是後續正式提升與交接的基準文件，必須保存。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The trial lift belongs in the lifting plan as a hold point, stating hold duration, measurements, allowable deviations and decision-maker; its record is the baseline for the main lift and for handover and must be kept.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略試提升直接提升，若重量被低估或某支撐未完全脫離，提升中某些吊點會突然超載；在高空才發現下錨滑移或桁架撓度異常，不論繼續或下降都很困難，往往只能在不利狀態下臨時固定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping the trial lift and going straight up means that an underestimated weight or a support not fully released can suddenly overload certain lift points during travel; discovering anchor slip or abnormal deflection at height makes both continuing and lowering difficult, often leaving only emergency fixing in an unfavourable state. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試提升前清點並移除臨時物件，記錄計算重量的組成；離地後停留規定時間（例如 30 分鐘以上），記錄各點荷載、桁架撓度與下錨滑移量，與預測比較；結果由提升承包商與結構設計者共同簽認後才進入正式提升。
knowledge.textEn: Before the trial lift, inventory and remove temporary items and record what makes up the calculated weight; after lift-off hold for a set period, for example at least 30 minutes, recording each point's load, truss deflection and lower-anchor slip and comparing with prediction; the main lift proceeds only after the lifting contractor and structural designer jointly sign the results.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試提升要寫入提升計畫並列為停止點，明定停留時間、量測項目、允許偏差與決策人；試提升紀錄是後續正式提升與交接的基準文件，必須保存。
knowledge.textEn: The trial lift belongs in the lifting plan as a hold point, stating hold duration, measurements, allowable deviations and decision-maker; its record is the baseline for the main lift and for handover and must be kept.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試提升、重量核對與變形量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey"?
options: 試提升前清點並移除臨時物件，記錄計算重量的組成。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。
optionsEn: Before the trial lift, inventory and remove temporary items and record what makes up the calculated weight.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 試提升前清點並移除臨時物件，記錄計算重量的組成；離地後停留規定時間（例如 30 分鐘以上），記錄各點荷載、桁架撓度與下錨滑移量，與預測比較；結果由提升承包商與結構設計者共同簽認後才進入正式提升。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the trial lift, inventory and remove temporary items and record what makes up the calculated weight; after lift-off hold for a set period, for example at least 30 minutes, recording each point's load, truss deflection and lower-anchor slip and comparing with prediction; the main lift proceeds only after the lifting contractor and structural designer jointly sign the results. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試提升、重量核對與變形量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試提升與荷載核對」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Trial lift and load check” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略試提升直接提升，若重量被低估或某支撐未完全脫離，提升中某些吊點會突然超載；在高空才發現下錨滑移或桁架撓度異常，不論繼續或下降都很困難，往往只能在不利狀態下臨時固定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping the trial lift and going straight up means that an underestimated weight or a support not fully released can suddenly overload certain lift points during travel; discovering anchor slip or abnormal deflection at height makes both continuing and lowering difficult, often leaving only emergency fixing in an unfavourable state. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若任何一項偏差超過允許值，必須查明原因後才能繼續，否則問題會在高空才暴露，處理難度與風險都大幅升高。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If any deviation exceeds its allowance the cause must be found before continuing; otherwise problems surface at height where they are far harder and riskier to deal with.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略試提升直接提升，若重量被低估或某支撐未完全脫離，提升中某些吊點會突然超載；在高空才發現下錨滑移或桁架撓度異常，不論繼續或下降都很困難，往往只能在不利狀態下臨時固定。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping the trial lift and going straight up means that an underestimated weight or a support not fully released can suddenly overload certain lift points during travel; discovering anchor slip or abnormal deflection at height makes both continuing and lowering difficult, often leaving only emergency fixing in an unfavourable state.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試提升、重量核對與變形量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
省略試提升直接提升，若重量被低估或某支撐未完全脫離，提升中某些吊點會突然超載。
提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Skipping the trial lift and going straight up means that an underestimated weight or a support not fully released can suddenly overload certain lift points during travel.
The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
quiz.explanation: 省略試提升直接提升，若重量被低估或某支撐未完全脫離，提升中某些吊點會突然超載；在高空才發現下錨滑移或桁架撓度異常，不論繼續或下降都很困難，往往只能在不利狀態下臨時固定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping the trial lift and going straight up means that an underestimated weight or a support not fully released can suddenly overload certain lift points during travel; discovering anchor slip or abnormal deflection at height makes both continuing and lowering difficult, often leaving only emergency fixing in an unfavourable state. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「風速監測與停止準則」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wind monitoring and stop criteria” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸吊在鋼絞線下的提升單元就像一個長擺，週期長、阻尼低，橫向風力會讓它緩慢擺動，並在鋼絞線中產生偏斜與不均勻張力；若單元靠近塔架或已完成的結構，擺動可能造成碰撞。因此提升前要訂定風速上限，提升中監測現場與高處風速，並在塔架上設置導向或側向限位裝置。提升時窗要配合氣象預報，避開午後陣風或鋒面，且在整個提升期間保留可安全停止或下降的方案。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「風速監測與停止準則」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A unit hanging from strands behaves like a long pendulum with a long period and low damping; lateral wind makes it sway slowly, tilting strands and loading them unevenly, and near towers or completed structure the sway can cause collisions. A wind-speed limit must therefore be set before lifting, wind monitored at ground and at height during lifting, and guides or lateral restraints fitted to the towers. The lifting window should follow the weather forecast, avoiding afternoon gusts or fronts, with a plan for a safe stop or lowering kept available throughout. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wind monitoring and stop criteria” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸吊長度 30 m 的單擺週期 T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 30 m suspension length gives a pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「風速監測與停止準則」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wind monitoring and stop criteria”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則
knowledge.titleEn: Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting
knowledge.text: 懸吊在鋼絞線下的提升單元就像一個長擺，週期長、阻尼低，橫向風力會讓它緩慢擺動，並在鋼絞線中產生偏斜與不均勻張力；若單元靠近塔架或已完成的結構，擺動可能造成碰撞。因此提升前要訂定風速上限，提升中監測現場與高處風速，並在塔架上設置導向或側向限位裝置。
knowledge.textEn: A unit hanging from strands behaves like a long pendulum with a long period and low damping; lateral wind makes it sway slowly, tilting strands and loading them unevenly, and near towers or completed structure the sway can cause collisions. A wind-speed limit must therefore be set before lifting, wind monitored at ground and at height during lifting, and guides or lateral restraints fitted to the towers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting" is correct?
options: 提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。
提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。
懸吊在鋼絞線下的提升單元就像一個長擺，週期長、阻尼低，橫向風力會讓它緩慢擺動，並在鋼絞線中產生偏斜與不均勻張力；若單元靠近塔架或已完成的結構，擺動可能造成碰撞。
optionsEn: The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed.
A unit hanging from strands behaves like a long pendulum with a long period and low damping.
quiz.explanation: 懸吊在鋼絞線下的提升單元就像一個長擺，週期長、阻尼低，橫向風力會讓它緩慢擺動，並在鋼絞線中產生偏斜與不均勻張力；若單元靠近塔架或已完成的結構，擺動可能造成碰撞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A unit hanging from strands behaves like a long pendulum with a long period and low damping; lateral wind makes it sway slowly, tilting strands and loading them unevenly, and near towers or completed structure the sway can cause collisions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風速監測與停止準則」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wind monitoring and stop criteria” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸吊長度 30 m 的單擺週期 T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s。風速 12 m/s 時 q = ½ρV² ≈ 88 Pa，迎風邊緣面積 5 m × 156 m = 780 m²、阻力係數 1.5，風力約 103 kN，為吊重 21,580 kN 的 0.48%，30 m 吊長的水平偏移約 0.0048×30 ≈ 0.14 m。風速與幾何為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 30 m suspension length gives a pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s. At 12 m/s wind, q = ½ρV² ≈ 88 Pa; on an edge area of 5 m × 156 m = 780 m² with drag coefficient 1.5 the wind force is about 103 kN, 0.48% of the 21,580 kN load, and the horizontal offset over a 30 m suspension is about 0.0048×30 ≈ 0.14 m. Wind speed and geometry are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在提升計畫中依擺動偏移與導向間隙訂出風速停止值，提升前確認導向裝置的間隙與強度；提升中每隔固定時間記錄地面與高處風速、提升單元水平位移與鋼絞線偏角，超過門檻即停止並固定於導向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set the wind stop value in the lifting plan from sway offset and guide clearance, and confirm guide clearance and strength before lifting; during lifting record ground and high-level wind speed, horizontal movement of the unit and strand inclination at fixed intervals, stopping and securing to the guides when thresholds are exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸吊長度 30 m 的單擺週期 T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s。風速 12 m/s 時 q = ½ρV² ≈ 88 Pa，迎風邊緣面積 5 m × 156 m = 780 m²、阻力係數 1.5，風力約 103 kN，為吊重 21,580 kN 的 0.48%，30 m 吊長的水平偏移約 0.0048×30 ≈ 0.14 m。風速與幾何為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 30 m suspension length gives a pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s. At 12 m/s wind, q = ½ρV² ≈ 88 Pa; on an edge area of 5 m × 156 m = 780 m² with drag coefficient 1.5 the wind force is about 103 kN, 0.48% of the 21,580 kN load, and the horizontal offset over a 30 m suspension is about 0.0048×30 ≈ 0.14 m. Wind speed and geometry are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting", which statement holds?
options: 懸吊長度 30 m 的單擺週期 T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s。
整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。
吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。
optionsEn: A 30 m suspension length gives a pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s.
Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change.
Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
quiz.explanation: 懸吊長度 30 m 的單擺週期 T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 30 m suspension length gives a pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風速監測與停止準則」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wind monitoring and stop criteria” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在提升計畫中依擺動偏移與導向間隙訂出風速停止值，提升前確認導向裝置的間隙與強度；提升中每隔固定時間記錄地面與高處風速、提升單元水平位移與鋼絞線偏角，超過門檻即停止並固定於導向。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set the wind stop value in the lifting plan from sway offset and guide clearance, and confirm guide clearance and strength before lifting; during lifting record ground and high-level wind speed, horizontal movement of the unit and strand inclination at fixed intervals, stopping and securing to the guides when thresholds are exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：提升計畫要列出風速停止值、監測位置、決策人與緊急固定程序，並規定提升前取得氣象預報；任何超過門檻後的繼續作業，都須由提升指揮、結構設計者與安全負責人共同同意並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan should list the wind stop value, monitoring locations, decision-maker and emergency securing procedure, and require a weather forecast before lifting; continuing after a threshold is exceeded requires joint agreement of the lift commander, structural designer and safety lead, recorded in writing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看地面風速而忽略高處風速，提升單元升到高處時突遇較強風，擺動撞擊塔架；沒有預先規劃停止或固定方案，遇到天候變化時只能冒險繼續提升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Watching only ground-level wind and ignoring wind at height can expose the unit to stronger wind as it rises, swinging it into a tower; without a planned stop or securing scheme, a change in weather leaves no choice but to keep lifting at risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在提升計畫中依擺動偏移與導向間隙訂出風速停止值，提升前確認導向裝置的間隙與強度；提升中每隔固定時間記錄地面與高處風速、提升單元水平位移與鋼絞線偏角，超過門檻即停止並固定於導向。
knowledge.textEn: Set the wind stop value in the lifting plan from sway offset and guide clearance, and confirm guide clearance and strength before lifting; during lifting record ground and high-level wind speed, horizontal movement of the unit and strand inclination at fixed intervals, stopping and securing to the guides when thresholds are exceeded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 提升計畫要列出風速停止值、監測位置、決策人與緊急固定程序，並規定提升前取得氣象預報；任何超過門檻後的繼續作業，都須由提升指揮、結構設計者與安全負責人共同同意並記錄。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan should list the wind stop value, monitoring locations, decision-maker and emergency securing procedure, and require a weather forecast before lifting; continuing after a threshold is exceeded requires joint agreement of the lift commander, structural designer and safety lead, recorded in writing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在提升計畫中依擺動偏移與導向間隙訂出風速停止值，提升前確認導向裝置的間隙與強度。
同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Set the wind stop value in the lifting plan from sway offset and guide clearance, and confirm guide clearance and strength before lifting.
The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work.
quiz.explanation: 在提升計畫中依擺動偏移與導向間隙訂出風速停止值，提升前確認導向裝置的間隙與強度；提升中每隔固定時間記錄地面與高處風速、提升單元水平位移與鋼絞線偏角，超過門檻即停止並固定於導向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set the wind stop value in the lifting plan from sway offset and guide clearance, and confirm guide clearance and strength before lifting; during lifting record ground and high-level wind speed, horizontal movement of the unit and strand inclination at fixed intervals, stopping and securing to the guides when thresholds are exceeded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風速監測與停止準則」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wind monitoring and stop criteria” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看地面風速而忽略高處風速，提升單元升到高處時突遇較強風，擺動撞擊塔架；沒有預先規劃停止或固定方案，遇到天候變化時只能冒險繼續提升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Watching only ground-level wind and ignoring wind at height can expose the unit to stronger wind as it rises, swinging it into a tower; without a planned stop or securing scheme, a change in weather leaves no choice but to keep lifting at risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：提升時窗要配合氣象預報，避開午後陣風或鋒面，且在整個提升期間保留可安全停止或下降的方案。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lifting window should follow the weather forecast, avoiding afternoon gusts or fronts, with a plan for a safe stop or lowering kept available throughout.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看地面風速而忽略高處風速，提升單元升到高處時突遇較強風，擺動撞擊塔架；沒有預先規劃停止或固定方案，遇到天候變化時只能冒險繼續提升。
knowledge.textEn: Watching only ground-level wind and ignoring wind at height can expose the unit to stronger wind as it rises, swinging it into a tower; without a planned stop or securing scheme, a change in weather leaves no choice but to keep lifting at risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。
只看地面風速而忽略高處風速，提升單元升到高處時突遇較強風，擺動撞擊塔架；沒有預先規劃停止或固定方案，遇到天候變化時只能冒險繼續提升。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed.
Watching only ground-level wind and ignoring wind at height can expose the unit to stronger wind as it rises, swinging it into a tower.
quiz.explanation: 只看地面風速而忽略高處風速，提升單元升到高處時突遇較強風，擺動撞擊塔架；沒有預先規劃停止或固定方案，遇到天候變化時只能冒險繼續提升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Watching only ground-level wind and ignoring wind at height can expose the unit to stronger wind as it rises, swinging it into a tower; without a planned stop or securing scheme, a change in weather leaves no choice but to keep lifting at risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移」與「提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival" and "Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「就位連接與體系轉換」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Final connection and load transfer” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 提升單元到位後，要從千斤頂支承轉換到永久支座或與相鄰單元連接，這個體系轉換與前面的卸載同樣關鍵。由於提升完成時的溫度、鋼絞線伸長與吊點高差都會影響實際位置，連接設計必須預留調整量，例如長孔、墊片或可調支座；Arup 指出第五航廈屋蓋的鋼構連接以一般製造允差設計，安裝後再調整。荷載轉移要分級進行，並確認每個永久支座實際接手的反力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「就位連接與體系轉換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once a lifting unit arrives, it must be transferred from the jacks to permanent bearings or connected to adjacent units, a system change as critical as unloading. Temperature at arrival, strand stretch and lift-point level differences all affect the actual position, so connection design must provide adjustment such as slotted holes, shims or adjustable bearings; Arup notes that the Terminal 5 roof connections were made to normal fabrication tolerances and adjusted after installation. Load transfer should proceed in stages, confirming the reaction actually taken by each permanent bearing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Final connection and load transfer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：156 m 長的屋蓋單元若在早晨 10°C 提升到位、午後 25°C 才連接，伸長 ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm，兩端各約 14 mm，連接必須能吸收。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a 156 m roof unit arrives at 10°C in the morning and is connected at 25°C in the afternoon, it grows ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm, about 14 mm at each end, which the connections must absorb.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「就位連接與體系轉換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Final connection and load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移
knowledge.titleEn: Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival
knowledge.text: 提升單元到位後，要從千斤頂支承轉換到永久支座或與相鄰單元連接，這個體系轉換與前面的卸載同樣關鍵。由於提升完成時的溫度、鋼絞線伸長與吊點高差都會影響實際位置，連接設計必須預留調整量，例如長孔、墊片或可調支座；Arup 指出第五航廈屋蓋的鋼構連接以一般製造允差設計，安裝後再調整。
knowledge.textEn: Once a lifting unit arrives, it must be transferred from the jacks to permanent bearings or connected to adjacent units, a system change as critical as unloading. Temperature at arrival, strand stretch and lift-point level differences all affect the actual position, so connection design must provide adjustment such as slotted holes, shims or adjustable bearings; Arup notes that the Terminal 5 roof connections were made to normal fabrication tolerances and adjusted after installation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival" is correct?
options: 提升單元到位後，要從千斤頂支承轉換到永久支座或與相鄰單元連接，這個體系轉換與前面的卸載同樣關鍵。
提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。
提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。
optionsEn: Once a lifting unit arrives, it must be transferred from the jacks to permanent bearings or connected to adjacent units, a system change as critical as unloading.
Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed.
Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished.
quiz.explanation: 提升單元到位後，要從千斤頂支承轉換到永久支座或與相鄰單元連接，這個體系轉換與前面的卸載同樣關鍵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once a lifting unit arrives, it must be transferred from the jacks to permanent bearings or connected to adjacent units, a system change as critical as unloading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「就位連接與體系轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Final connection and load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：156 m 長的屋蓋單元若在早晨 10°C 提升到位、午後 25°C 才連接，伸長 ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm，兩端各約 14 mm，連接必須能吸收。若接頭只有 ±5 mm 調整量，就要改在相近溫度時段連接或改用長孔。溫度條件為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a 156 m roof unit arrives at 10°C in the morning and is connected at 25°C in the afternoon, it grows ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm, about 14 mm at each end, which the connections must absorb. If joints have only ±5 mm of adjustment, connection must be made at a similar temperature or slotted holes used instead. Temperature conditions are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：到位後量測提升單元的三維位置與當時溫度，與設計位置在參考溫度下比較；連接完成後分級下放千斤頂，每級記錄千斤頂荷載與永久支座反力或沉陷，確認荷載完全轉移且符合預測後，才拆除提升設備。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On arrival survey the unit's three-dimensional position and temperature and compare with the design position at the reference temperature; after connection lower the jacks in stages, recording jack loads and permanent bearing reactions or settlements at each stage, and remove lifting equipment only after confirming full transfer consistent with prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 156 m 長的屋蓋單元若在早晨 10°C 提升到位、午後 25°C 才連接，伸長 ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm，兩端各約 14 mm，連接必須能吸收。若接頭只有 ±5 mm 調整量，就要改在相近溫度時段連接或改用長孔。溫度條件為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If a 156 m roof unit arrives at 10°C in the morning and is connected at 25°C in the afternoon, it grows ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm, about 14 mm at each end, which the connections must absorb. If joints have only ±5 mm of adjustment, connection must be made at a similar temperature or slotted holes used instead. Temperature conditions are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival", which statement holds?
options: 提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。
156 m 長的屋蓋單元若在早晨 10°C 提升到位、午後 25°C 才連接，伸長 ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm，兩端各約 14 mm，連接必須能吸收。
鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。
optionsEn: During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.

If a 156 m roof unit arrives at 10°C in the morning and is connected at 25°C in the afternoon, it grows ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm, about 14 mm at each end, which the connections must absorb.
If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 156 m 長的屋蓋單元若在早晨 10°C 提升到位、午後 25°C 才連接，伸長 ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm，兩端各約 14 mm，連接必須能吸收。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If a 156 m roof unit arrives at 10°C in the morning and is connected at 25°C in the afternoon, it grows ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm, about 14 mm at each end, which the connections must absorb. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「就位連接與體系轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Final connection and load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 到位後量測提升單元的三維位置與當時溫度，與設計位置在參考溫度下比較；連接完成後分級下放千斤頂，每級記錄千斤頂荷載與永久支座反力或沉陷，確認荷載完全轉移且符合預測後，才拆除提升設備。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On arrival survey the unit's three-dimensional position and temperature and compare with the design position at the reference temperature; after connection lower the jacks in stages, recording jack loads and permanent bearing reactions or settlements at each stage, and remove lifting equipment only after confirming full transfer consistent with prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：連接與荷載轉移程序須寫明連接的溫度時段、可用調整量、下放分級與每級的量測項目；荷載轉移前，結構設計者應確認所有永久連接與支座已依圖完成，這是拆除提升設備前的最後停止點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The connection and load-transfer procedure should state the temperature window for connection, available adjustment, lowering stages and measurements at each stage; before transfer the structural designer should confirm that every permanent connection and bearing is complete to the drawings, the last hold point before lifting equipment is removed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高溫時強行把接頭對準鎖固，降溫後屋蓋收縮，接頭與支座承受很大的拉力或剪力；千斤頂一次全部放鬆，荷載突然轉到永久支座，若某支座還未完全就位或墊片不足，局部構件會過載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing joints into alignment and locking them in hot weather leaves joints and bearings under large tension or shear when the roof contracts as it cools; releasing all jacks at once dumps load suddenly onto permanent bearings, and if one bearing is not fully seated or under-shimmed, local members are overloaded. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 到位後量測提升單元的三維位置與當時溫度，與設計位置在參考溫度下比較；連接完成後分級下放千斤頂，每級記錄千斤頂荷載與永久支座反力或沉陷，確認荷載完全轉移且符合預測後，才拆除提升設備。
knowledge.textEn: On arrival survey the unit's three-dimensional position and temperature and compare with the design position at the reference temperature; after connection lower the jacks in stages, recording jack loads and permanent bearing reactions or settlements at each stage, and remove lifting equipment only after confirming full transfer consistent with prediction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 連接與荷載轉移程序須寫明連接的溫度時段、可用調整量、下放分級與每級的量測項目；荷載轉移前，結構設計者應確認所有永久連接與支座已依圖完成，這是拆除提升設備前的最後停止點。
knowledge.textEn: The connection and load-transfer procedure should state the temperature window for connection, available adjustment, lowering stages and measurements at each stage; before transfer the structural designer should confirm that every permanent connection and bearing is complete to the drawings, the last hold point before lifting equipment is removed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。
到位後量測提升單元的三維位置與當時溫度，與設計位置在參考溫度下比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.
On arrival survey the unit's three-dimensional position and temperature and compare with the design position at the reference temperature.
quiz.explanation: 到位後量測提升單元的三維位置與當時溫度，與設計位置在參考溫度下比較；連接完成後分級下放千斤頂，每級記錄千斤頂荷載與永久支座反力或沉陷，確認荷載完全轉移且符合預測後，才拆除提升設備。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On arrival survey the unit's three-dimensional position and temperature and compare with the design position at the reference temperature; after connection lower the jacks in stages, recording jack loads and permanent bearing reactions or settlements at each stage, and remove lifting equipment only after confirming full transfer consistent with prediction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「就位連接與體系轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Final connection and load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高溫時強行把接頭對準鎖固，降溫後屋蓋收縮，接頭與支座承受很大的拉力或剪力；千斤頂一次全部放鬆，荷載突然轉到永久支座，若某支座還未完全就位或墊片不足，局部構件會過載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing joints into alignment and locking them in hot weather leaves joints and bearings under large tension or shear when the roof contracts as it cools; releasing all jacks at once dumps load suddenly onto permanent bearings, and if one bearing is not fully seated or under-shimmed, local members are overloaded. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：荷載轉移要分級進行，並確認每個永久支座實際接手的反力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Load transfer should proceed in stages, confirming the reaction actually taken by each permanent bearing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高溫時強行把接頭對準鎖固，降溫後屋蓋收縮，接頭與支座承受很大的拉力或剪力；千斤頂一次全部放鬆，荷載突然轉到永久支座，若某支座還未完全就位或墊片不足，局部構件會過載。
knowledge.textEn: Forcing joints into alignment and locking them in hot weather leaves joints and bearings under large tension or shear when the roof contracts as it cools; releasing all jacks at once dumps load suddenly onto permanent bearings, and if one bearing is not fully seated or under-shimmed, local members are overloaded.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 高溫時強行把接頭對準鎖固，降溫後屋蓋收縮，接頭與支座承受很大的拉力或剪力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。
optionsEn: Forcing joints into alignment and locking them in hot weather leaves joints and bearings under large tension or shear when the roof contracts as it cools.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished.
quiz.explanation: 高溫時強行把接頭對準鎖固，降溫後屋蓋收縮，接頭與支座承受很大的拉力或剪力；千斤頂一次全部放鬆，荷載突然轉到永久支座，若某支座還未完全就位或墊片不足，局部構件會過載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forcing joints into alignment and locking them in hot weather leaves joints and bearings under large tension or shear when the roof contracts as it cools; releasing all jacks at once dumps load suddenly onto permanent bearings, and if one bearing is not fully seated or under-shimmed, local members are overloaded. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「提升紀錄與殘留應力」如何影響大跨度空間桁架提升的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift records and locked-in stresses” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lifting of long-span space trusses”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 整體提升完成後，結構中會留下與施工順序有關的殘留內力：吊點高差、連接時的溫度與支座就位順序，都會讓實際內力偏離只看最終狀態的分析。提升時焊上的吊耳若保留，會成為疲勞與腐蝕的弱點；切除時的熱影響與研磨痕跡也需處理。這些資訊若沒有交接，日後檢測時看到的局部應力或變形，就無法判斷是施工遺留還是使用中的劣化，因此提升紀錄是結構檔案的一部分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「提升紀錄與殘留應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After an integral lift the structure carries locked-in forces tied to the construction sequence: lift-point level differences, connection temperature and the order in which bearings seated all move actual forces away from an analysis of the final state alone. Lugs welded for lifting become fatigue and corrosion weak points if left in place, and the heat-affected zones and grinding marks from cutting them off also need treatment. Without handover of this information, later inspectors cannot tell whether local stress or deformation is left over from construction or deterioration in service, so lifting records belong in the structural file. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lift records and locked-in stresses” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若連接時某支座比相鄰支座高 10 mm 而強行鎖固，桁架在該處勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，殘留附加反力約 ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN，約為平均提升反力 1,350 kN 的 15%，並在相鄰桿件留下相應的殘留內力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If at connection one bearing sits 10 mm higher than its neighbour and is locked anyway, with a truss stiffness k = 20 kN/mm there, a residual additional reaction of about ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN remains, about 15% of the 1,350 kN mean lifting reaction, with corresponding locked-in forces in adjacent members.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「提升紀錄與殘留應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lift records and locked-in stresses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover
knowledge.text: 整體提升完成後，結構中會留下與施工順序有關的殘留內力：吊點高差、連接時的溫度與支座就位順序，都會讓實際內力偏離只看最終狀態的分析。提升時焊上的吊耳若保留，會成為疲勞與腐蝕的弱點；切除時的熱影響與研磨痕跡也需處理。
knowledge.textEn: After an integral lift the structure carries locked-in forces tied to the construction sequence: lift-point level differences, connection temperature and the order in which bearings seated all move actual forces away from an analysis of the final state alone. Lugs welded for lifting become fatigue and corrosion weak points if left in place, and the heat-affected zones and grinding marks from cutting them off also need treatment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover" is correct?
options: 提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。
整體提升完成後，結構中會留下與施工順序有關的殘留內力：吊點高差、連接時的溫度與支座就位順序，都會讓實際內力偏離只看最終狀態的分析。
整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。
optionsEn: Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished.

After an integral lift the structure carries locked-in forces tied to the construction sequence: lift-point level differences, connection temperature and the order in which bearings seated all move actual forces away from an analysis of the final state alone.
Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change.
quiz.explanation: 整體提升完成後，結構中會留下與施工順序有關的殘留內力：吊點高差、連接時的溫度與支座就位順序，都會讓實際內力偏離只看最終狀態的分析。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After an integral lift the structure carries locked-in forces tied to the construction sequence: lift-point level differences, connection temperature and the order in which bearings seated all move actual forces away from an analysis of the final state alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升紀錄與殘留應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift records and locked-in stresses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若連接時某支座比相鄰支座高 10 mm 而強行鎖固，桁架在該處勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，殘留附加反力約 ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN，約為平均提升反力 1,350 kN 的 15%，並在相鄰桿件留下相應的殘留內力。高差與勁度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If at connection one bearing sits 10 mm higher than its neighbour and is locked anyway, with a truss stiffness k = 20 kN/mm there, a residual additional reaction of about ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN remains, about 15% of the 1,350 kN mean lifting reaction, with corresponding locked-in forces in adjacent members. Level difference and stiffness are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：整理每次提升的千斤頂荷載、行程、同步紀錄、風速、試提升結果與就位量測，與施工階段分析一併歸檔；完工後量測支座反力或代表性桿件應變作為基準，並檢查保留或切除吊耳處的焊縫與塗裝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compile each lift's jack loads, strokes, synchronisation logs, wind records, trial-lift results and arrival surveys and file them with the construction-stage analysis; after completion measure bearing reactions or representative member strains as a baseline and inspect welds and coatings at retained or removed lugs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若連接時某支座比相鄰支座高 10 mm 而強行鎖固，桁架在該處勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，殘留附加反力約 ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN，約為平均提升反力 1,350 kN 的 15%，並在相鄰桿件留下相應的殘留內力。高差與勁度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If at connection one bearing sits 10 mm higher than its neighbour and is locked anyway, with a truss stiffness k = 20 kN/mm there, a residual additional reaction of about ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN remains, about 15% of the 1,350 kN mean lifting reaction, with corresponding locked-in forces in adjacent members. Level difference and stiffness are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover", which statement holds?
options: 吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。
同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。
若連接時某支座比相鄰支座高 10 mm 而強行鎖固，桁架在該處勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，殘留附加反力約 ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN，約為平均提升反力 1,350 kN 的 15%，並在相鄰桿件留下相應的殘留內力。
optionsEn: Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work.

If at connection one bearing sits 10 mm higher than its neighbour and is locked anyway, with a truss stiffness k = 20 kN/mm there, a residual additional reaction of about ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN remains, about 15% of the 1,350 kN mean lifting reaction, with corresponding locked-in forces in adjacent members.
quiz.explanation: 若連接時某支座比相鄰支座高 10 mm 而強行鎖固，桁架在該處勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，殘留附加反力約 ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN，約為平均提升反力 1,350 kN 的 15%，並在相鄰桿件留下相應的殘留內力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If at connection one bearing sits 10 mm higher than its neighbour and is locked anyway, with a truss stiffness k = 20 kN/mm there, a residual additional reaction of about ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN remains, about 15% of the 1,350 kN mean lifting reaction, with corresponding locked-in forces in adjacent members. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升紀錄與殘留應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift records and locked-in stresses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 整理每次提升的千斤頂荷載、行程、同步紀錄、風速、試提升結果與就位量測，與施工階段分析一併歸檔；完工後量測支座反力或代表性桿件應變作為基準，並檢查保留或切除吊耳處的焊縫與塗裝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compile each lift's jack loads, strokes, synchronisation logs, wind records, trial-lift results and arrival surveys and file them with the construction-stage analysis; after completion measure bearing reactions or representative member strains as a baseline and inspect welds and coatings at retained or removed lugs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含提升計畫與實際紀錄、試提升報告、就位量測、殘留應力評估、吊耳保留或切除位置圖與處理方式；日後任何在原吊點附近的改裝都要參考這些紀錄，並由結構工程師評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the lifting plan and actual records, the trial-lift report, arrival surveys, an assessment of locked-in stresses and a plan of retained or removed lug locations with their treatment; any later alteration near former lift points must refer to these records and be assessed by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保留的吊耳焊趾在風振與溫度循環下產生疲勞裂紋，多年後在檢測時才發現；沒有提升與就位紀錄，管理者面對異常變形時只能做大規模檢測，耗費大量成本，也可能誤判結構安全。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Retained lug weld toes develop fatigue cracks under wind vibration and thermal cycling that are discovered only years later at inspection; without lifting and arrival records, managers facing unusual deformation can only commission extensive surveys at great cost and may misjudge structural safety. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 整理每次提升的千斤頂荷載、行程、同步紀錄、風速、試提升結果與就位量測，與施工階段分析一併歸檔；完工後量測支座反力或代表性桿件應變作為基準，並檢查保留或切除吊耳處的焊縫與塗裝。
knowledge.textEn: Compile each lift's jack loads, strokes, synchronisation logs, wind records, trial-lift results and arrival surveys and file them with the construction-stage analysis; after completion measure bearing reactions or representative member strains as a baseline and inspect welds and coatings at retained or removed lugs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含提升計畫與實際紀錄、試提升報告、就位量測、殘留應力評估、吊耳保留或切除位置圖與處理方式；日後任何在原吊點附近的改裝都要參考這些紀錄，並由結構工程師評估。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the lifting plan and actual records, the trial-lift report, arrival surveys, an assessment of locked-in stresses and a plan of retained or removed lug locations with their treatment; any later alteration near former lift points must refer to these records and be assessed by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover"?
options: 整理每次提升的千斤頂荷載、行程、同步紀錄、風速、試提升結果與就位量測，與施工階段分析一併歸檔。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。
optionsEn: Compile each lift's jack loads, strokes, synchronisation logs, wind records, trial-lift results and arrival surveys and file them with the construction-stage analysis.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality.
quiz.explanation: 整理每次提升的千斤頂荷載、行程、同步紀錄、風速、試提升結果與就位量測，與施工階段分析一併歸檔；完工後量測支座反力或代表性桿件應變作為基準，並檢查保留或切除吊耳處的焊縫與塗裝。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compile each lift's jack loads, strokes, synchronisation logs, wind records, trial-lift results and arrival surveys and file them with the construction-stage analysis; after completion measure bearing reactions or representative member strains as a baseline and inspect welds and coatings at retained or removed lugs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「提升紀錄與殘留應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift records and locked-in stresses” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 保留的吊耳焊趾在風振與溫度循環下產生疲勞裂紋，多年後在檢測時才發現；沒有提升與就位紀錄，管理者面對異常變形時只能做大規模檢測，耗費大量成本，也可能誤判結構安全。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Retained lug weld toes develop fatigue cracks under wind vibration and thermal cycling that are discovered only years later at inspection; without lifting and arrival records, managers facing unusual deformation can only commission extensive surveys at great cost and may misjudge structural safety. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些資訊若沒有交接，日後檢測時看到的局部應力或變形，就無法判斷是施工遺留還是使用中的劣化，因此提升紀錄是結構檔案的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without handover of this information, later inspectors cannot tell whether local stress or deformation is left over from construction or deterioration in service, so lifting records belong in the structural file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 保留的吊耳焊趾在風振與溫度循環下產生疲勞裂紋，多年後在檢測時才發現；沒有提升與就位紀錄，管理者面對異常變形時只能做大規模檢測，耗費大量成本，也可能誤判結構安全。
knowledge.textEn: Retained lug weld toes develop fatigue cracks under wind vibration and thermal cycling that are discovered only years later at inspection; without lifting and arrival records, managers facing unusual deformation can only commission extensive surveys at great cost and may misjudge structural safety.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
保留的吊耳焊趾在風振與溫度循環下產生疲勞裂紋，多年後在檢測時才發現；沒有提升與就位紀錄，管理者面對異常變形時只能做大規模檢測，耗費大量成本，也可能誤判結構安全。
整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Retained lug weld toes develop fatigue cracks under wind vibration and thermal cycling that are discovered only years later at inspection.
Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change.
quiz.explanation: 保留的吊耳焊趾在風振與溫度循環下產生疲勞裂紋，多年後在檢測時才發現；沒有提升與就位紀錄，管理者面對異常變形時只能做大規模檢測，耗費大量成本，也可能誤判結構安全。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Retained lug weld toes develop fatigue cracks under wind vibration and thermal cycling that are discovered only years later at inspection; without lifting and arrival records, managers facing unusual deformation can only commission extensive surveys at great cost and may misjudge structural safety. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 張拉膜屋蓋成形
titleEn: Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
summary: 張拉膜沒有抗彎勁度，形狀必須是預應力與邊界共同決定的平衡曲面，因此設計流程從形狀尋找開始，再以膜材雙軸試驗決定勁度與裁片補償，最後在現場展開、吊升並分階段導入預應力。課程以丹佛國際機場 Jeppesen 航廈的雙層 PTFE 屋頂（約 34,800 m² 主屋頂）、吉達哈吉航廈的 210 個錐形膜單元與 Frei Otto 的 1967 年蒙特婁德國館為錨點，說明邊索與膜預應力的關係、積水與雪載、膜材強度折減、補償率誤差、吊升風速、錐形單元頂升、張力量測、顫振、潛變鬆弛與維護交接。
summaryEn: A tensile membrane has no bending stiffness, so its shape must be an equilibrium surface set by prestress and boundaries; design therefore starts with form finding, then uses biaxial fabric tests to set stiffness and pattern compensation, and finally unfolds, hoists and prestresses the membrane on site in stages. Anchored on the double-layer PTFE roof of Denver International Airport's Jeppesen Terminal (about 34,800 m² of main roof), the 210 conical membrane units of the Hajj Terminal in Jeddah and Frei Otto's 1967 German Pavilion in Montreal, the course covers edge-cable and prestress relations, ponding and snow, fabric strength reduction, compensation errors, hoisting wind limits, jacking of conical units, tension measurement, flutter, creep relaxation and maintenance handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
