workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一片四點雙曲膜的邊索、補償與敏感度。膜預應力 t = 3 kN/m，自由邊弦長 c = 20 m，邊索張力 T = 150 kN：曲率半徑 R = T/t = 50 m，邊索垂度 f ≈ c²/(8R) = 1.0 m。雙軸試驗得經向勁度 E = 1,000 kN/m，彈性應變 3/1,000 = 0.3%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.5%，20 m 長的裁片裁成 20×0.995 = 19.90 m。若實際膜材較軟（E = 750 kN/m）卻沿用 0.3% 的彈性補償，張拉到同一幾何後預應力只有 750×0.003 = 2.25 kN/m，低 25%；在 T 不變下邊索曲率半徑變為 150/2.25 ≈ 66.7 m、垂度約 0.75 m，邊界幾何也跟著改變，最後需重新調整邊索或桅桿。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: edge cable, compensation and sensitivity of a four-point anticlastic membrane. With membrane prestress t = 3 kN/m, a free-edge chord c = 20 m and edge-cable tension T = 150 kN, the radius is R = T/t = 50 m and the edge sag f ≈ c²/(8R) = 1.0 m. Biaxial tests give a warp stiffness E = 1,000 kN/m, so the elastic strain is 3/1,000 = 0.3%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.5% compensation, and a 20 m pattern is cut to 20×0.995 = 19.90 m. If the actual fabric is softer, E = 750 kN/m, while the 0.3% elastic compensation is kept, the prestress after tensioning to the same geometry is only 750×0.003 = 2.25 kN/m, 25% low; with T unchanged the edge radius becomes 150/2.25 ≈ 66.7 m and the sag about 0.75 m, so the boundary geometry changes too and edge cables or masts must be readjusted. All values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫」與「曲率不足、積水與雪載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape" and "Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「邊索垂度與膜預應力」如何影響張拉膜屋蓋成形的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress” governs force, deformation or durability in “Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 膜材只能受拉，若要在無外載時保持光滑無皺，膜面上每一點都必須處於預應力平衡。在等向均勻預應力下，平衡曲面就是肥皂膜那樣的極小曲面，兩個主曲率大小相等、方向相反；改變邊界點高度、邊索張力或不同方向的預應力比值，就會得到不同的平衡形狀。自由邊緣的邊索受膜拉力而形成圓弧，其曲率半徑等於邊索張力除以膜預應力，因此邊索垂度、邊索張力與膜預應力是一組必須同時決定的設計參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「邊索垂度與膜預應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A membrane works only in tension, so to stay smooth and wrinkle-free without load every point of its surface must be in prestress equilibrium. Under uniform isotropic prestress the equilibrium surface is a minimal surface like a soap film, with equal and opposite principal curvatures; changing boundary heights, edge-cable tension or the prestress ratio between directions produces different equilibrium shapes. A free edge cable pulled by the membrane forms a circular arc whose radius equals cable tension divided by membrane prestress, so edge sag, edge-cable force and membrane prestress form a set of design parameters that must be chosen together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：邊索曲率半徑 R = T/t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Edge-cable radius R = T/t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膜屋蓋的形狀可以像玻璃帷幕一樣由建築師自由決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A membrane roof's shape can be set freely by the architect, like a glass façade." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「邊索垂度與膜預應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫
knowledge.titleEn: Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape
knowledge.text: 膜材只能受拉，若要在無外載時保持光滑無皺，膜面上每一點都必須處於預應力平衡。在等向均勻預應力下，平衡曲面就是肥皂膜那樣的極小曲面，兩個主曲率大小相等、方向相反；改變邊界點高度、邊索張力或不同方向的預應力比值，就會得到不同的平衡形狀。
knowledge.textEn: A membrane works only in tension, so to stay smooth and wrinkle-free without load every point of its surface must be in prestress equilibrium. Under uniform isotropic prestress the equilibrium surface is a minimal surface like a soap film, with equal and opposite principal curvatures; changing boundary heights, edge-cable tension or the prestress ratio between directions produces different equilibrium shapes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：膜屋蓋的形狀可以像玻璃帷幕一樣由建築師自由決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A membrane roof's shape can be set freely by the architect, like a glass façade. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape" is correct?
options: 膜屋蓋的形狀可以像玻璃帷幕一樣由建築師自由決定。
膜材只能受拉，若要在無外載時保持光滑無皺，膜面上每一點都必須處於預應力平衡。
只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。
optionsEn: A membrane roof's shape can be set freely by the architect, like a glass façade.
A membrane works only in tension, so to stay smooth and wrinkle-free without load every point of its surface must be in prestress equilibrium.
If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem.
quiz.explanation: 膜材只能受拉，若要在無外載時保持光滑無皺，膜面上每一點都必須處於預應力平衡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A membrane works only in tension, so to stay smooth and wrinkle-free without load every point of its surface must be in prestress equilibrium. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊索垂度與膜預應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：邊索曲率半徑 R = T/t。邊索張力 T = 150 kN、膜預應力 t = 3 kN/m，R = 50 m；弦長 c = 20 m 時邊索垂度 f ≈ c²/(8R) = 400/400 = 1.0 m，約為弦長 5%。若想把垂度增為 2.0 m，在 t 不變下 T 需降為約 75 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Edge-cable radius R = T/t. With cable tension T = 150 kN and membrane prestress t = 3 kN/m, R = 50 m; over a chord c = 20 m the edge sag is f ≈ c²/(8R) = 400/400 = 1.0 m, about 5% of the chord. To deepen the sag to 2.0 m with the same t, T must drop to about 75 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以力密度法、動態鬆弛法或更新參考策略等數值方法求平衡形狀，檢查每個節點殘餘力小於允許值、膜面沒有負應力區；把邊索垂度、預應力比與膜面最小曲率列表，交給建築師確認造型，同時交給結構工程師做荷載分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Find the equilibrium shape with a numerical method such as force density, dynamic relaxation or the updated reference strategy, checking that nodal residual forces are below the allowance and no region has negative stress; tabulate edge sags, prestress ratios and minimum surface curvature for the architect to confirm the form and the structural engineer to carry into load analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 邊索曲率半徑 R = T/t。邊索張力 T = 150 kN、膜預應力 t = 3 kN/m，R = 50 m；弦長 c = 20 m 時邊索垂度 f ≈ c²/(8R) = 400/400 = 1.0 m，約為弦長 5%。若想把垂度增為 2.0 m，在 t 不變下 T 需降為約 75 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Edge-cable radius R = T/t. With cable tension T = 150 kN and membrane prestress t = 3 kN/m, R = 50 m; over a chord c = 20 m the edge sag is f ≈ c²/(8R) = 400/400 = 1.0 m, about 5% of the chord. To deepen the sag to 2.0 m with the same t, T must drop to about 75 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape", which statement holds?
options: 裁片只要照曲面展開的尺寸裁切即可，不需要補償。
膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。
邊索曲率半徑 R = T/t。
optionsEn: Patterns are simply cut to the flattened surface size; no compensation is needed.
Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning.
Edge-cable radius R = T/t.
quiz.explanation: 邊索曲率半徑 R = T/t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Edge-cable radius R = T/t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊索垂度與膜預應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以力密度法、動態鬆弛法或更新參考策略等數值方法求平衡形狀，檢查每個節點殘餘力小於允許值、膜面沒有負應力區；把邊索垂度、預應力比與膜面最小曲率列表，交給建築師確認造型，同時交給結構工程師做荷載分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Find the equilibrium shape with a numerical method such as force density, dynamic relaxation or the updated reference strategy, checking that nodal residual forces are below the allowance and no region has negative stress; tabulate edge sags, prestress ratios and minimum surface curvature for the architect to confirm the form and the structural engineer to carry into load analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：膜結構的設計交付應同時包含平衡形狀、預應力分布與邊索張力表，並寫明所用的形狀尋找方法與收斂準則；建築造型修改後，必須重新做形狀尋找，不得直接拉伸既有曲面。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Membrane design deliverables should include the equilibrium shape, prestress distribution and edge-cable tension table together, stating the form-finding method and convergence criterion; after any change in architectural form, form finding must be redone rather than stretching the existing surface.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若建築造型先畫定再要求膜材去配合，畫出的曲面往往不是預應力平衡形狀，現場張拉後出現大片皺褶或局部鬆弛；邊索垂度選得太小，邊索張力與錨點反力急增，桅桿與基礎尺寸也隨之膨脹。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drawing the architectural form first and asking the fabric to fit usually produces a surface that is not a prestress equilibrium shape, so after tensioning large wrinkles or slack zones appear; choosing too little edge sag makes edge-cable tension and anchor reactions soar, with masts and foundations growing accordingly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以力密度法、動態鬆弛法或更新參考策略等數值方法求平衡形狀，檢查每個節點殘餘力小於允許值、膜面沒有負應力區；把邊索垂度、預應力比與膜面最小曲率列表，交給建築師確認造型，同時交給結構工程師做荷載分析。
knowledge.textEn: Find the equilibrium shape with a numerical method such as force density, dynamic relaxation or the updated reference strategy, checking that nodal residual forces are below the allowance and no region has negative stress; tabulate edge sags, prestress ratios and minimum surface curvature for the architect to confirm the form and the structural engineer to carry into load analysis.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 膜結構的設計交付應同時包含平衡形狀、預應力分布與邊索張力表，並寫明所用的形狀尋找方法與收斂準則；建築造型修改後，必須重新做形狀尋找，不得直接拉伸既有曲面。
knowledge.textEn: Membrane design deliverables should include the equilibrium shape, prestress distribution and edge-cable tension table together, stating the form-finding method and convergence criterion; after any change in architectural form, form finding must be redone rather than stretching the existing surface.

quiz.question: 要驗證「形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape"?
options: 以力密度法、動態鬆弛法或更新參考策略等數值方法求平衡形狀，檢查每個節點殘餘力小於允許值、膜面沒有負應力區。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
膜屋蓋很輕，風只會讓它輕輕晃動，不會造成損壞。
optionsEn: Find the equilibrium shape with a numerical method such as force density, dynamic relaxation or the updated reference strategy, checking that nodal residual forces are below the allowance and no region has negative stress.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A membrane roof is so light that wind only makes it sway gently without damage.
quiz.explanation: 以力密度法、動態鬆弛法或更新參考策略等數值方法求平衡形狀，檢查每個節點殘餘力小於允許值、膜面沒有負應力區；把邊索垂度、預應力比與膜面最小曲率列表，交給建築師確認造型，同時交給結構工程師做荷載分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Find the equilibrium shape with a numerical method such as force density, dynamic relaxation or the updated reference strategy, checking that nodal residual forces are below the allowance and no region has negative stress; tabulate edge sags, prestress ratios and minimum surface curvature for the architect to confirm the form and the structural engineer to carry into load analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊索垂度與膜預應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若建築造型先畫定再要求膜材去配合，畫出的曲面往往不是預應力平衡形狀，現場張拉後出現大片皺褶或局部鬆弛；邊索垂度選得太小，邊索張力與錨點反力急增，桅桿與基礎尺寸也隨之膨脹。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drawing the architectural form first and asking the fabric to fit usually produces a surface that is not a prestress equilibrium shape, so after tensioning large wrinkles or slack zones appear; choosing too little edge sag makes edge-cable tension and anchor reactions soar, with masts and foundations growing accordingly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：自由邊緣的邊索受膜拉力而形成圓弧，其曲率半徑等於邊索張力除以膜預應力，因此邊索垂度、邊索張力與膜預應力是一組必須同時決定的設計參數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A free edge cable pulled by the membrane forms a circular arc whose radius equals cable tension divided by membrane prestress, so edge sag, edge-cable force and membrane prestress form a set of design parameters that must be chosen together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膜屋蓋的形狀可以像玻璃帷幕一樣由建築師自由決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A membrane roof's shape can be set freely by the architect, like a glass façade." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若建築造型先畫定再要求膜材去配合，畫出的曲面往往不是預應力平衡形狀，現場張拉後出現大片皺褶或局部鬆弛；邊索垂度選得太小，邊索張力與錨點反力急增，桅桿與基礎尺寸也隨之膨脹。
knowledge.textEn: Drawing the architectural form first and asking the fabric to fit usually produces a surface that is not a prestress equilibrium shape, so after tensioning large wrinkles or slack zones appear; choosing too little edge sag makes edge-cable tension and anchor reactions soar, with masts and foundations growing accordingly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若建築造型先畫定再要求膜材去配合，畫出的曲面往往不是預應力平衡形狀，現場張拉後出現大片皺褶或局部鬆弛。
只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Drawing the architectural form first and asking the fabric to fit usually produces a surface that is not a prestress equilibrium shape, so after tensioning large wrinkles or slack zones appear.
If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem.
quiz.explanation: 若建築造型先畫定再要求膜材去配合，畫出的曲面往往不是預應力平衡形狀，現場張拉後出現大片皺褶或局部鬆弛；邊索垂度選得太小，邊索張力與錨點反力急增，桅桿與基礎尺寸也隨之膨脹。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Drawing the architectural form first and asking the fabric to fit usually produces a surface that is not a prestress equilibrium shape, so after tensioning large wrinkles or slack zones appear; choosing too little edge sag makes edge-cable tension and anchor reactions soar, with masts and foundations growing accordingly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 曲率不足、積水與雪載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「低曲率區與積水」如何影響張拉膜屋蓋成形的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-curvature zones and ponding” governs force, deformation or durability in “Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 膜面勁度來自曲率與預應力，平坦區域在雨水或積雪下會大幅下陷，下陷形成窪地又收集更多水或雪，變形持續擴大，這就是漸進式積水。山谷線與低坡度區在融雪與強降雪時最危險；丹佛機場 2003 年 3 月暴風雪期間，大雪在膜頂撕開約 40 ft 的裂口，迫使該區疏散。因此形狀尋找完成後，必須在最不利荷載下檢查變形後的膜面坡度，確認水與雪都能排走，而不只是檢查應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「低曲率區與積水」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Membrane stiffness comes from curvature and prestress, so flat zones sag heavily under rain or snow, the resulting hollow collects more water or snow and deformation keeps growing, the mechanism of progressive ponding. Valley lines and low-slope zones are most at risk during heavy snow and thaw; during the March 2003 blizzard at Denver International Airport, heavy snow tore a gash of about 40 ft in the fabric roof and forced evacuation of that area. After form finding, the deformed surface slope under the worst loads must therefore be checked so water and snow can drain, not stress alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Low-curvature zones and ponding” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：初始近乎平坦的預應力膜條，在均布荷載 p 下中點下陷 δ ≈ pL²/(8t)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An initially near-flat prestressed strip under uniform load p sags at midspan by δ ≈ pL²/(8t).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「低曲率區與積水」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Low-curvature zones and ponding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲率不足、積水與雪載
knowledge.text: 膜面勁度來自曲率與預應力，平坦區域在雨水或積雪下會大幅下陷，下陷形成窪地又收集更多水或雪，變形持續擴大，這就是漸進式積水。山谷線與低坡度區在融雪與強降雪時最危險；丹佛機場 2003 年 3 月暴風雪期間，大雪在膜頂撕開約 40 ft 的裂口，迫使該區疏散。
knowledge.textEn: Membrane stiffness comes from curvature and prestress, so flat zones sag heavily under rain or snow, the resulting hollow collects more water or snow and deformation keeps growing, the mechanism of progressive ponding. Valley lines and low-slope zones are most at risk during heavy snow and thaw; during the March 2003 blizzard at Denver International Airport, heavy snow tore a gash of about 40 ft in the fabric roof and forced evacuation of that area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲率不足、積水與雪載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow" is correct?
options: 只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。
膜材只要看單軸拉伸強度就能完成設計。
膜面勁度來自曲率與預應力，平坦區域在雨水或積雪下會大幅下陷，下陷形成窪地又收集更多水或雪，變形持續擴大，這就是漸進式積水。
optionsEn: If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem.
Uniaxial tensile strength is all that is needed to design with a fabric.

Membrane stiffness comes from curvature and prestress, so flat zones sag heavily under rain or snow, the resulting hollow collects more water or snow and deformation keeps growing, the mechanism of progressive ponding.
quiz.explanation: 膜面勁度來自曲率與預應力，平坦區域在雨水或積雪下會大幅下陷，下陷形成窪地又收集更多水或雪，變形持續擴大，這就是漸進式積水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Membrane stiffness comes from curvature and prestress, so flat zones sag heavily under rain or snow, the resulting hollow collects more water or snow and deformation keeps growing, the mechanism of progressive ponding. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲率不足、積水與雪載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低曲率區與積水」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low-curvature zones and ponding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：初始近乎平坦的預應力膜條，在均布荷載 p 下中點下陷 δ ≈ pL²/(8t)。取跨距 L = 6 m、30 mm 積水 p = 0.3 kPa、預應力 t = 4 kN/m：δ ≈ 0.3×36/32 ≈ 0.34 m，已足以形成更大的水窪；t 加倍到 8 kN/m 時 δ ≈ 0.17 m。真正的解法是增加曲率與坡度，而不是只加預應力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An initially near-flat prestressed strip under uniform load p sags at midspan by δ ≈ pL²/(8t). With span L = 6 m, 30 mm of water p = 0.3 kPa and prestress t = 4 kN/m, δ ≈ 0.3×36/32 ≈ 0.34 m, enough to form a larger pond; doubling t to 8 kN/m gives δ ≈ 0.17 m. The real cure is more curvature and slope, not prestress alone. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性分析在雪載、不均勻雪載與積水荷載下求變形後膜面，檢查每個區域的最小坡度與是否出現封閉低點；依當地積雪規範考慮山谷與邊緣的堆積係數；完工後做淋水試驗，觀察水流路徑與停留點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the deformed surface under snow, unbalanced snow and ponding loads by nonlinear analysis, checking the minimum slope of every zone and whether closed low points appear; apply drift factors for valleys and edges from the local snow code; after completion run a water test to observe flow paths and standing points.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 初始近乎平坦的預應力膜條，在均布荷載 p 下中點下陷 δ ≈ pL²/(8t)。取跨距 L = 6 m、30 mm 積水 p = 0.3 kPa、預應力 t = 4 kN/m：δ ≈ 0.3×36/32 ≈ 0.34 m，已足以形成更大的水窪；t 加倍到 8 kN/m 時 δ ≈ 0.17 m。真正的解法是增加曲率與坡度，而不是只加預應力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An initially near-flat prestressed strip under uniform load p sags at midspan by δ ≈ pL²/(8t). With span L = 6 m, 30 mm of water p = 0.3 kPa and prestress t = 4 kN/m, δ ≈ 0.3×36/32 ≈ 0.34 m, enough to form a larger pond; doubling t to 8 kN/m gives δ ≈ 0.17 m. The real cure is more curvature and slope, not prestress alone. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「曲率不足、積水與雪載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation.

steps.title: 曲率不足、積水與雪載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低曲率區與積水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low-curvature zones and ponding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性分析在雪載、不均勻雪載與積水荷載下求變形後膜面，檢查每個區域的最小坡度與是否出現封閉低點；依當地積雪規範考慮山谷與邊緣的堆積係數；完工後做淋水試驗，觀察水流路徑與停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the deformed surface under snow, unbalanced snow and ponding loads by nonlinear analysis, checking the minimum slope of every zone and whether closed low points appear; apply drift factors for valleys and edges from the local snow code; after completion run a water test to observe flow paths and standing points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：膜結構設計基準須明列最小排水坡度、積雪與積水荷載情境，以及營運期間的除雪門檻；對有山谷線或低坡區的設計，應在圖說上標示需要特別監看的區域。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The membrane design basis must state minimum drainage slope, snow and ponding scenarios and the snow-removal threshold for operation; designs with valley lines or low-slope zones should mark the areas needing special monitoring on the drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：膜面在設計荷載下應力合格，但局部坡度在變形後趨近零，冬季融雪時形成積水，冰水重量持續累積，最後膜材在山谷線或夾具邊緣撕裂；撕裂一旦開始，預應力釋放會讓破口迅速擴大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A membrane whose stresses pass under design load may still flatten locally to near-zero slope after deformation, ponding during thaw so that ice and water keep accumulating until the fabric tears along a valley or at a clamp edge; once a tear starts, released prestress makes the opening grow quickly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 曲率不足、積水與雪載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低曲率區與積水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low-curvature zones and ponding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 膜面在設計荷載下應力合格，但局部坡度在變形後趨近零，冬季融雪時形成積水，冰水重量持續累積，最後膜材在山谷線或夾具邊緣撕裂；撕裂一旦開始，預應力釋放會讓破口迅速擴大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A membrane whose stresses pass under design load may still flatten locally to near-zero slope after deformation, ponding during thaw so that ice and water keep accumulating until the fabric tears along a valley or at a clamp edge; once a tear starts, released prestress makes the opening grow quickly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此形狀尋找完成後，必須在最不利荷載下檢查變形後的膜面坡度，確認水與雪都能排走，而不只是檢查應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After form finding, the deformed surface slope under the worst loads must therefore be checked so water and snow can drain, not stress alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「曲率不足、積水與雪載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Insufficient curvature, ponding and snow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

膜材只要看單軸拉伸強度就能完成設計。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗」與「從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fabric types, strength reduction and biaxial testing" and "From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fabric types, strength reduction and biaxial testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「PTFE 玻纖與 PVC 聚酯膜材」如何影響張拉膜屋蓋成形的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “PTFE-glass and PVC-polyester fabrics” governs force, deformation or durability in “Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 常見建築膜材是編織纖維加塗層：PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維耐久、不燃、自潔但怕折；PVC 塗覆聚酯柔軟可折、價格較低但壽命較短；ETFE 則是透明薄膜，常做成充氣枕。編織膜有經向與緯向，兩方向勁度不同，且受拉時經緯紗互相擠壓（捲曲交換），應力應變關係是非線性、雙向耦合的，因此必須以雙軸試驗量測兩方向的勁度與泊松效應，才能用於分析與裁片補償。設計強度則要考慮長期荷載、老化、溫度與接縫等多重折減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「PTFE 玻纖與 PVC 聚酯膜材」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Common architectural fabrics are woven fibres with a coating: PTFE-coated glass is durable, non-combustible and self-cleaning but dislikes folding; PVC-coated polyester is flexible and foldable, cheaper but shorter-lived; ETFE is a transparent foil often used as inflated cushions. Woven fabric has warp and fill directions with different stiffness, and under tension the yarns press on each other (crimp interchange), so the stress–strain relation is nonlinear and coupled in both directions; biaxial tests are therefore needed to measure the stiffness and Poisson effects in both directions for analysis and pattern compensation. Design strength must account for several reductions covering long-term load, ageing, temperature and seams. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “PTFE-glass and PVC-polyester fabrics” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設計強度 f_d = f_k/(γ_M·k_age·k_temp)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Design strength f_d = f_k/(γ_M·k_age·k_temp).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膜材只要看單軸拉伸強度就能完成設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uniaxial tensile strength is all that is needed to design with a fabric." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「PTFE 玻纖與 PVC 聚酯膜材」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “PTFE-glass and PVC-polyester fabrics”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fabric types, strength reduction and biaxial testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「PTFE 玻纖與 PVC 聚酯膜材」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “PTFE-glass and PVC-polyester fabrics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設計強度 f_d = f_k/(γ_M·k_age·k_temp)。取條帶抗拉強度 f_k = 120 kN/m、材料係數 γ_M = 1.4、老化係數 1.2、溫度係數 1.1：f_d = 120/(1.4×1.2×1.1) ≈ 64.9 kN/m。若再乘接縫效率 0.8，接縫處可用約 51.9 kN/m。係數皆為教學假設，實際應依適用規範取值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Design strength f_d = f_k/(γ_M·k_age·k_temp). With a strip tensile strength f_k = 120 kN/m, material factor γ_M = 1.4, ageing factor 1.2 and temperature factor 1.1: f_d = 120/(1.4×1.2×1.1) ≈ 64.9 kN/m. With a seam efficiency of 0.8, about 51.9 kN/m is available at seams. All factors are teaching assumptions; real values come from the applicable code. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每批膜材依標準做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗（例如 EN 17117-1 的方法），並以設計預應力比做循環加載求取勁度；接縫做同批材料的熱合強度試驗；所有試驗結果附批號，與裁片補償計算對應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test each batch for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, for example by the EN 17117-1 method, using cyclic loading at the design prestress ratio to derive stiffness; test welded seams from the same batch for strength; tag every result with the batch number and link it to the compensation calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With a strip tensile strength f_k = 120 kN/m, material factor γ_M = 1.4, ageing factor 1.2 and temperature factor 1.1: f_d = 120/(1.4×1.2×1.1) ≈ 64.9 kN/m. steps.title: 膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabric types, strength reduction and biaxial testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「PTFE 玻纖與 PVC 聚酯膜材」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “PTFE-glass and PVC-polyester fabrics” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每批膜材依標準做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗（例如 EN 17117-1 的方法），並以設計預應力比做循環加載求取勁度；接縫做同批材料的熱合強度試驗；所有試驗結果附批號，與裁片補償計算對應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test each batch for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, for example by the EN 17117-1 method, using cyclic loading at the design prestress ratio to derive stiffness; test welded seams from the same batch for strength; tag every result with the batch number and link it to the compensation calculation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：膜材規格應規定強度、雙軸試驗方法與頻率、接縫強度、防火分級與保固年限，並要求供應商提供批號追溯；膜材替代必須重新做雙軸試驗與補償計算，經設計者核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The fabric specification should set strength, biaxial test method and frequency, seam strength, fire classification and warranty period, with batch traceability from the supplier; any substitution requires new biaxial tests and compensation calculations approved by the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以型錄上的單軸強度與典型勁度直接設計，未做該批雙軸試驗，實際膜材比假設更軟或更硬，裁片補償錯誤，張拉後不是鬆弛就是過度受拉；接縫強度不足時，裂口常沿熱合縫開始。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing directly from catalogue uniaxial strength and typical stiffness without biaxial tests on the actual batch means the fabric may be softer or stiffer than assumed, compensation is wrong and after tensioning the membrane is either slack or over-stressed; when seam strength is short, tears often start along welded seams. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Test each batch for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, for example by the EN 17117-1 method, using cyclic loading at the design prestress ratio to derive stiffness; test welded seams from the same batch for strength; tag every result with the batch number and link it to the compensation calculation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 膜材規格應規定強度、雙軸試驗方法與頻率、接縫強度、防火分級與保固年限，並要求供應商提供批號追溯；膜材替代必須重新做雙軸試驗與補償計算，經設計者核可。

quiz.question: 要驗證「膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabric types, strength reduction and biaxial testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「PTFE 玻纖與 PVC 聚酯膜材」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “PTFE-glass and PVC-polyester fabrics” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以型錄上的單軸強度與典型勁度直接設計，未做該批雙軸試驗，實際膜材比假設更軟或更硬，裁片補償錯誤，張拉後不是鬆弛就是過度受拉；接縫強度不足時，裂口常沿熱合縫開始。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing directly from catalogue uniaxial strength and typical stiffness without biaxial tests on the actual batch means the fabric may be softer or stiffer than assumed, compensation is wrong and after tensioning the membrane is either slack or over-stressed; when seam strength is short, tears often start along welded seams. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計強度則要考慮長期荷載、老化、溫度與接縫等多重折減。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design strength must account for several reductions covering long-term load, ageing, temperature and seams.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膜材只要看單軸拉伸強度就能完成設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uniaxial tensile strength is all that is needed to design with a fabric." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以型錄上的單軸強度與典型勁度直接設計，未做該批雙軸試驗，實際膜材比假設更軟或更硬，裁片補償錯誤，張拉後不是鬆弛就是過度受拉；接縫強度不足時，裂口常沿熱合縫開始。
knowledge.textEn: Designing directly from catalogue uniaxial strength and typical stiffness without biaxial tests on the actual batch means the fabric may be softer or stiffer than assumed, compensation is wrong and after tensioning the membrane is either slack or over-stressed; when seam strength is short, tears often start along welded seams.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膜材類型、強度折減與雙軸試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fabric types, strength reduction and biaxial testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以型錄上的單軸強度與典型勁度直接設計，未做該批雙軸試驗，實際膜材比假設更軟或更硬，裁片補償錯誤，張拉後不是鬆弛就是過度受拉；接縫強度不足時，裂口常沿熱合縫開始。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
裁片只要照曲面展開的尺寸裁切即可，不需要補償。
optionsEn: Designing directly from catalogue uniaxial strength and typical stiffness without biaxial tests on the actual batch means the fabric may be softer or stiffer than assumed, compensation is wrong and after tensioning the membrane is either slack or over-stressed.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Patterns are simply cut to the flattened surface size; no compensation is needed.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「裁片圖與補償率」如何影響張拉膜屋蓋成形的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutting patterns and compensation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙曲面無法無變形地攤平，因此要沿測地線等路徑把膜面分成條狀裁片，攤平後再熱合成整片。為了讓膜在安裝後產生設計預應力，裁片必須比平衡形狀上的尺寸略小，這個縮小比例稱為補償率；它由雙軸試驗得到的勁度與預期潛變決定，經緯兩向通常不同。邊界附近則常需要反補償或加長，讓膜能扣上邊索或夾具。補償率錯一點，預應力就差很多，是膜結構成敗最敏感的參數之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「裁片圖與補償率」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A doubly curved surface cannot be flattened without distortion, so the membrane is divided into strips along paths such as geodesic lines, flattened and then welded together. For the membrane to develop its design prestress after installation, patterns are cut slightly smaller than their size on the equilibrium shape; this reduction is the compensation, set from biaxial stiffness and expected creep and usually different in warp and fill. Near boundaries de-compensation or extra length is often needed so the fabric can reach edge cables or clamps. A small error in compensation produces a large prestress error, making it one of the most sensitive parameters of a membrane structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cutting patterns and compensation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：經向勁度 E_w = 1,000 kN/m、目標預應力 4 kN/m，彈性應變 ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.6%：30 m 長的裁片裁成 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With warp stiffness E_w = 1,000 kN/m and target prestress 4 kN/m, the elastic strain is ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.6% compensation, so a 30 m pattern is cut to 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裁片只要照曲面展開的尺寸裁切即可，不需要補償。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Patterns are simply cut to the flattened surface size; no compensation is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「裁片圖與補償率」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cutting patterns and compensation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償
knowledge.titleEn: From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns
knowledge.text: 雙曲面無法無變形地攤平，因此要沿測地線等路徑把膜面分成條狀裁片，攤平後再熱合成整片。為了讓膜在安裝後產生設計預應力，裁片必須比平衡形狀上的尺寸略小，這個縮小比例稱為補償率；它由雙軸試驗得到的勁度與預期潛變決定，經緯兩向通常不同。
knowledge.textEn: A doubly curved surface cannot be flattened without distortion, so the membrane is divided into strips along paths such as geodesic lines, flattened and then welded together. For the membrane to develop its design prestress after installation, patterns are cut slightly smaller than their size on the equilibrium shape; this reduction is the compensation, set from biaxial stiffness and expected creep and usually different in warp and fill.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裁片只要照曲面展開的尺寸裁切即可，不需要補償。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
