optionsEn: Patterns are simply cut to the flattened surface size; no compensation is needed.
A doubly curved surface cannot be flattened without distortion, so the membrane is divided into strips along paths such as geodesic lines, flattened and then welded together.
Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation.
quiz.explanation: 雙曲面無法無變形地攤平，因此要沿測地線等路徑把膜面分成條狀裁片，攤平後再熱合成整片。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A doubly curved surface cannot be flattened without distortion, so the membrane is divided into strips along paths such as geodesic lines, flattened and then welded together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償：定量估算
steps.titleEn: From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裁片圖與補償率」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutting patterns and compensation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：經向勁度 E_w = 1,000 kN/m、目標預應力 4 kN/m，彈性應變 ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.6%：30 m 長的裁片裁成 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m。若補償率誤差 0.3%，長度差 90 mm，預應力誤差約 1,000×0.003 = 3 kN/m，即目標值的 75%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With warp stiffness E_w = 1,000 kN/m and target prestress 4 kN/m, the elastic strain is ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.6% compensation, so a 30 m pattern is cut to 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m. A 0.3% compensation error means a 90 mm length error and a prestress error of about 1,000×0.003 = 3 kN/m, 75% of the target. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：補償率由該批膜材的雙軸試驗推得，計算書寫明經緯兩向數值與潛變假設；裁片後量測對角線與邊長，熱合後量測整片尺寸；必要時先做小型樣片張拉，確認補償後的預應力與預期相符，再大量裁切。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Derive compensation from biaxial tests on the actual batch and state warp and fill values and creep assumptions in the calculations; after cutting measure diagonals and edge lengths, and after welding measure the whole panel; where needed, tension a small sample first to confirm that compensated prestress matches expectation before cutting in quantity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 經向勁度 E_w = 1,000 kN/m、目標預應力 4 kN/m，彈性應變 ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.6%：30 m 長的裁片裁成 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m。若補償率誤差 0.3%，長度差 90 mm，預應力誤差約 1,000×0.003 = 3 kN/m，即目標值的 75%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With warp stiffness E_w = 1,000 kN/m and target prestress 4 kN/m, the elastic strain is ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.6% compensation, so a 30 m pattern is cut to 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m. A 0.3% compensation error means a 90 mm length error and a prestress error of about 1,000×0.003 = 3 kN/m, 75% of the target. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns", which statement holds?
options: 膜面看起來平整沒有皺褶，就表示預應力正確。
膜結構完工時預應力正確，就會永久維持。
經向勁度 E_w = 1,000 kN/m、目標預應力 4 kN/m，彈性應變 ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.6%：30 m 長的裁片裁成 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m。
optionsEn: If a membrane looks smooth without wrinkles, its prestress must be correct.
If a membrane's prestress is right at completion it stays right forever.
With warp stiffness E_w = 1,000 kN/m and target prestress 4 kN/m, the elastic strain is ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%.
quiz.explanation: 經向勁度 E_w = 1,000 kN/m、目標預應力 4 kN/m，彈性應變 ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.6%：30 m 長的裁片裁成 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With warp stiffness E_w = 1,000 kN/m and target prestress 4 kN/m, the elastic strain is ε = 4/1,000 = 0.4%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.6% compensation, so a 30 m pattern is cut to 30×(1 − 0.006) = 29.82 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裁片圖與補償率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutting patterns and compensation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 補償率由該批膜材的雙軸試驗推得，計算書寫明經緯兩向數值與潛變假設；裁片後量測對角線與邊長，熱合後量測整片尺寸；必要時先做小型樣片張拉，確認補償後的預應力與預期相符，再大量裁切。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Derive compensation from biaxial tests on the actual batch and state warp and fill values and creep assumptions in the calculations; after cutting measure diagonals and edge lengths, and after welding measure the whole panel; where needed, tension a small sample first to confirm that compensated prestress matches expectation before cutting in quantity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：裁片圖每一片都要標示經緯方向、補償率、熱合邊與編號，並與試驗批號連結；補償率屬設計參數，任何更改須由膜結構設計者書面核可，裁片廠不得自行調整。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every pattern should show warp and fill direction, compensation, weld allowances and panel number, linked to the test batch; compensation is a design parameter, so any change requires the membrane designer's written approval and must not be adjusted by the fabricator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沿用其他專案或型錄的補償率，實際膜材較軟，安裝後預應力不足、膜面起皺並在風中拍動；補償過大則安裝時必須用很大力量才能扣上邊界，夾具與邊索過載，膜在角隅撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reusing compensation from another project or a catalogue for a softer actual fabric leaves prestress short after installation, so the membrane wrinkles and flaps in wind; over-compensation means huge force is needed to reach the boundary, overloading clamps and edge cables and tearing the fabric at corners. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 補償率由該批膜材的雙軸試驗推得，計算書寫明經緯兩向數值與潛變假設；裁片後量測對角線與邊長，熱合後量測整片尺寸；必要時先做小型樣片張拉，確認補償後的預應力與預期相符，再大量裁切。
knowledge.textEn: Derive compensation from biaxial tests on the actual batch and state warp and fill values and creep assumptions in the calculations; after cutting measure diagonals and edge lengths, and after welding measure the whole panel; where needed, tension a small sample first to confirm that compensated prestress matches expectation before cutting in quantity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 裁片圖每一片都要標示經緯方向、補償率、熱合邊與編號，並與試驗批號連結；補償率屬設計參數，任何更改須由膜結構設計者書面核可，裁片廠不得自行調整。
knowledge.textEn: Every pattern should show warp and fill direction, compensation, weld allowances and panel number, linked to the test batch; compensation is a design parameter, so any change requires the membrane designer's written approval and must not be adjusted by the fabricator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns"?
options: 補償率由該批膜材的雙軸試驗推得，計算書寫明經緯兩向數值與潛變假設。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
膜屋蓋的形狀可以像玻璃帷幕一樣由建築師自由決定。
optionsEn: Derive compensation from biaxial tests on the actual batch and state warp and fill values and creep assumptions in the calculations.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A membrane roof's shape can be set freely by the architect, like a glass façade.
quiz.explanation: 補償率由該批膜材的雙軸試驗推得，計算書寫明經緯兩向數值與潛變假設；裁片後量測對角線與邊長，熱合後量測整片尺寸；必要時先做小型樣片張拉，確認補償後的預應力與預期相符，再大量裁切。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Derive compensation from biaxial tests on the actual batch and state warp and fill values and creep assumptions in the calculations; after cutting measure diagonals and edge lengths, and after welding measure the whole panel; where needed, tension a small sample first to confirm that compensated prestress matches expectation before cutting in quantity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裁片圖與補償率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutting patterns and compensation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沿用其他專案或型錄的補償率，實際膜材較軟，安裝後預應力不足、膜面起皺並在風中拍動；補償過大則安裝時必須用很大力量才能扣上邊界，夾具與邊索過載，膜在角隅撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing compensation from another project or a catalogue for a softer actual fabric leaves prestress short after installation, so the membrane wrinkles and flaps in wind; over-compensation means huge force is needed to reach the boundary, overloading clamps and edge cables and tearing the fabric at corners. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：補償率錯一點，預應力就差很多，是膜結構成敗最敏感的參數之一。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A small error in compensation produces a large prestress error, making it one of the most sensitive parameters of a membrane structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裁片只要照曲面展開的尺寸裁切即可，不需要補償。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Patterns are simply cut to the flattened surface size; no compensation is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沿用其他專案或型錄的補償率，實際膜材較軟，安裝後預應力不足、膜面起皺並在風中拍動；補償過大則安裝時必須用很大力量才能扣上邊界，夾具與邊索過載，膜在角隅撕裂。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing compensation from another project or a catalogue for a softer actual fabric leaves prestress short after installation, so the membrane wrinkles and flaps in wind; over-compensation means huge force is needed to reach the boundary, overloading clamps and edge cables and tearing the fabric at corners.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「從雙曲面到平面裁片與補償」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "From doubly curved surface to compensated flat patterns" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沿用其他專案或型錄的補償率，實際膜材較軟，安裝後預應力不足、膜面起皺並在風中拍動；補償過大則安裝時必須用很大力量才能扣上邊界，夾具與邊索過載，膜在角隅撕裂。
膜材很輕，安裝時一點風不會有影響。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reusing compensation from another project or a catalogue for a softer actual fabric leaves prestress short after installation, so the membrane wrinkles and flaps in wind.
Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation.
quiz.explanation: 沿用其他專案或型錄的補償率，實際膜材較軟，安裝後預應力不足、膜面起皺並在風中拍動；補償過大則安裝時必須用很大力量才能扣上邊界，夾具與邊索過載，膜在角隅撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing compensation from another project or a catalogue for a softer actual fabric leaves prestress short after installation, so the membrane wrinkles and flaps in wind; over-compensation means huge force is needed to reach the boundary, overloading clamps and edge cables and tearing the fabric at corners. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制」與「分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels" and "Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「膜片展開與吊升」如何影響張拉膜屋蓋成形的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel unfolding and hoisting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型膜片在工廠熱合後捲起或摺疊運到現場：PTFE 玻纖膜要用大直徑捲筒且不得對折，PVC 聚酯膜較能摺疊。現場在清潔平台或索網上展開，以分散的夾具與吊樑吊升，並儘快連接到邊界。展開中的大片膜像帆一樣受風，數百平方公尺的膜片在中等風速下就能產生數十 kN 的力，遠超過工人能抓住的程度，因此展開與吊升必須在低風速時段、依預定順序並以臨時固定措施進行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「膜片展開與吊升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large panels are rolled or folded after factory welding and shipped to site: PTFE-glass needs large-diameter rolls and must never be folded double, while PVC-polyester tolerates folding better. On site the panel is unfolded on a clean platform or over the cable net, hoisted with distributed clamps and spreader beams and connected to its boundaries as soon as possible. An unfolding panel catches wind like a sail; a panel of several hundred square metres develops tens of kilonewtons in moderate wind, far beyond what a crew can hold, so unfolding and hoisting must be done in low-wind windows, in a planned sequence, with temporary restraints. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Panel unfolding and hoisting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：500 m² 的膜片在 10 m/s 風中，q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa，取阻力係數 1.2，F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN；風速降到 8 m/s 時約 23.5 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 500 m² panel in 10 m/s wind has q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa; with a drag coefficient of 1.2, F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN, falling to about 23.5 kN at 8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膜材很輕，安裝時一點風不會有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「膜片展開與吊升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Panel unfolding and hoisting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制
knowledge.titleEn: Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels
knowledge.text: 大型膜片在工廠熱合後捲起或摺疊運到現場：PTFE 玻纖膜要用大直徑捲筒且不得對折，PVC 聚酯膜較能摺疊。現場在清潔平台或索網上展開，以分散的夾具與吊樑吊升，並儘快連接到邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Large panels are rolled or folded after factory welding and shipped to site: PTFE-glass needs large-diameter rolls and must never be folded double, while PVC-polyester tolerates folding better. On site the panel is unfolded on a clean platform or over the cable net, hoisted with distributed clamps and spreader beams and connected to its boundaries as soon as possible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：膜材很輕，安裝時一點風不會有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels" is correct?
options: 膜材很輕，安裝時一點風不會有影響。
膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。
大型膜片在工廠熱合後捲起或摺疊運到現場：PTFE 玻纖膜要用大直徑捲筒且不得對折，PVC 聚酯膜較能摺疊。
optionsEn: Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation.
Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning.
Large panels are rolled or folded after factory welding and shipped to site: PTFE-glass needs large-diameter rolls and must never be folded double, while PVC-polyester tolerates folding better.
quiz.explanation: 大型膜片在工廠熱合後捲起或摺疊運到現場：PTFE 玻纖膜要用大直徑捲筒且不得對折，PVC 聚酯膜較能摺疊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large panels are rolled or folded after factory welding and shipped to site: PTFE-glass needs large-diameter rolls and must never be folded double, while PVC-polyester tolerates folding better. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膜片展開與吊升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Panel unfolding and hoisting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：500 m² 的膜片在 10 m/s 風中，q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa，取阻力係數 1.2，F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN；風速降到 8 m/s 時約 23.5 kN。由於 F 與 V² 成正比，把作業風速上限由 10 m/s 降到 8 m/s，風力約減少 36%。面積與係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 500 m² panel in 10 m/s wind has q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa; with a drag coefficient of 1.2, F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN, falling to about 23.5 kN at 8 m/s. Because F scales with V², lowering the working wind limit from 10 to 8 m/s reduces the force by about 36%. Area and coefficient are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：到貨時檢查捲筒直徑、包裝與膜面是否有折痕或塗層損傷；展開前確認平台或索網表面無尖銳物，風速計設在作業高度並持續記錄；每一片膜的吊點、夾具與臨時固定位置依安裝計畫核對，連接邊界後才解除臨時固定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On arrival check roll diameter, packaging and the fabric for creases or coating damage; before unfolding confirm the platform or net has no sharp objects, with an anemometer at working height logging continuously; check each panel's pick points, clamps and temporary restraints against the installation plan, and release temporary restraints only after connection to the boundary.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 500 m² 的膜片在 10 m/s 風中，q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa，取阻力係數 1.2，F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN；風速降到 8 m/s 時約 23.5 kN。由於 F 與 V² 成正比，把作業風速上限由 10 m/s 降到 8 m/s，風力約減少 36%。面積與係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 500 m² panel in 10 m/s wind has q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa; with a drag coefficient of 1.2, F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN, falling to about 23.5 kN at 8 m/s. Because F scales with V², lowering the working wind limit from 10 to 8 m/s reduces the force by about 36%. Area and coefficient are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels", which statement holds?
options: 500 m² 的膜片在 10 m/s 風中，q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa，取阻力係數 1.2，F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN。
膜屋蓋很輕，風只會讓它輕輕晃動，不會造成損壞。
膜屋蓋完工後只需要定期清洗。
optionsEn: A 500 m² panel in 10 m/s wind has q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa; with a drag coefficient of 1.2, F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN, falling to about 23.5 kN at 8 m/s.
A membrane roof is so light that wind only makes it sway gently without damage.
Once built, a membrane roof only needs periodic washing.
quiz.explanation: 500 m² 的膜片在 10 m/s 風中，q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa，取阻力係數 1.2，F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN；風速降到 8 m/s 時約 23.5 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 500 m² panel in 10 m/s wind has q = ½ρV² ≈ 61 Pa; with a drag coefficient of 1.2, F ≈ 61×500×1.2 ≈ 36.8 kN, falling to about 23.5 kN at 8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膜片展開與吊升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Panel unfolding and hoisting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 到貨時檢查捲筒直徑、包裝與膜面是否有折痕或塗層損傷；展開前確認平台或索網表面無尖銳物，風速計設在作業高度並持續記錄；每一片膜的吊點、夾具與臨時固定位置依安裝計畫核對，連接邊界後才解除臨時固定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On arrival check roll diameter, packaging and the fabric for creases or coating damage; before unfolding confirm the platform or net has no sharp objects, with an anemometer at working height logging continuously; check each panel's pick points, clamps and temporary restraints against the installation plan, and release temporary restraints only after connection to the boundary. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝計畫須列出每片膜的展開順序、吊點與夾具配置、作業風速上限、臨時固定與緊急收膜程序，並由膜結構承包商與結構設計者共同核可；高空與吊掛作業須由合格人員依核准程序執行，本課只說明檢核邏輯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation plan must list each panel's unfolding sequence, pick points and clamps, working wind limit, temporary restraint and emergency recovery procedure, approved jointly by the membrane contractor and structural designer; work at height and lifting must be done by qualified personnel under approved procedures, and this course explains checking logic only.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在陣風中展開膜片，膜被風鼓起拖動工人與夾具，造成人員受傷與膜材撕裂；PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被對折，玻纖斷裂留下看不見的弱線，安裝後數年在反覆風載下沿折線撕開。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unfolding a panel in gusts lets it billow and drag workers and clamps, injuring people and tearing fabric; a PTFE-glass panel folded double in handling breaks glass fibres along an invisible weak line that tears years later under repeated wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 到貨時檢查捲筒直徑、包裝與膜面是否有折痕或塗層損傷；展開前確認平台或索網表面無尖銳物，風速計設在作業高度並持續記錄；每一片膜的吊點、夾具與臨時固定位置依安裝計畫核對，連接邊界後才解除臨時固定。
knowledge.textEn: On arrival check roll diameter, packaging and the fabric for creases or coating damage; before unfolding confirm the platform or net has no sharp objects, with an anemometer at working height logging continuously; check each panel's pick points, clamps and temporary restraints against the installation plan, and release temporary restraints only after connection to the boundary.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 安裝計畫須列出每片膜的展開順序、吊點與夾具配置、作業風速上限、臨時固定與緊急收膜程序，並由膜結構承包商與結構設計者共同核可；高空與吊掛作業須由合格人員依核准程序執行，本課只說明檢核邏輯。
knowledge.textEn: The installation plan must list each panel's unfolding sequence, pick points and clamps, working wind limit, temporary restraint and emergency recovery procedure, approved jointly by the membrane contractor and structural designer; work at height and lifting must be done by qualified personnel under approved procedures, and this course explains checking logic only.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
到貨時檢查捲筒直徑、包裝與膜面是否有折痕或塗層損傷。
只要膜材強度夠，積水與雪載都不是問題。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
On arrival check roll diameter, packaging and the fabric for creases or coating damage.
If the fabric is strong enough, ponding and snow are not a problem.
quiz.explanation: 到貨時檢查捲筒直徑、包裝與膜面是否有折痕或塗層損傷；展開前確認平台或索網表面無尖銳物，風速計設在作業高度並持續記錄；每一片膜的吊點、夾具與臨時固定位置依安裝計畫核對，連接邊界後才解除臨時固定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On arrival check roll diameter, packaging and the fabric for creases or coating damage; before unfolding confirm the platform or net has no sharp objects, with an anemometer at working height logging continuously; check each panel's pick points, clamps and temporary restraints against the installation plan, and release temporary restraints only after connection to the boundary. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膜片展開與吊升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Panel unfolding and hoisting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在陣風中展開膜片，膜被風鼓起拖動工人與夾具，造成人員受傷與膜材撕裂；PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被對折，玻纖斷裂留下看不見的弱線，安裝後數年在反覆風載下沿折線撕開。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unfolding a panel in gusts lets it billow and drag workers and clamps, injuring people and tearing fabric; a PTFE-glass panel folded double in handling breaks glass fibres along an invisible weak line that tears years later under repeated wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：展開中的大片膜像帆一樣受風，數百平方公尺的膜片在中等風速下就能產生數十 kN 的力，遠超過工人能抓住的程度，因此展開與吊升必須在低風速時段、依預定順序並以臨時固定措施進行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An unfolding panel catches wind like a sail; a panel of several hundred square metres develops tens of kilonewtons in moderate wind, far beyond what a crew can hold, so unfolding and hoisting must be done in low-wind windows, in a planned sequence, with temporary restraints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膜材很輕，安裝時一點風不會有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fabric is light, so a little wind does not matter during installation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在陣風中展開膜片，膜被風鼓起拖動工人與夾具，造成人員受傷與膜材撕裂；PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被對折，玻纖斷裂留下看不見的弱線，安裝後數年在反覆風載下沿折線撕開。
knowledge.textEn: Unfolding a panel in gusts lets it billow and drag workers and clamps, injuring people and tearing fabric; a PTFE-glass panel folded double in handling breaks glass fibres along an invisible weak line that tears years later under repeated wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膜片運輸、展開與吊升的風險控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Risk control in transporting, unfolding and hoisting panels" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。
在陣風中展開膜片，膜被風鼓起拖動工人與夾具，造成人員受傷與膜材撕裂；PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被對折，玻纖斷裂留下看不見的弱線，安裝後數年在反覆風載下沿折線撕開。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning.
Unfolding a panel in gusts lets it billow and drag workers and clamps, injuring people and tearing fabric.
quiz.explanation: 在陣風中展開膜片，膜被風鼓起拖動工人與夾具，造成人員受傷與膜材撕裂；PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被對折，玻纖斷裂留下看不見的弱線，安裝後數年在反覆風載下沿折線撕開。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unfolding a panel in gusts lets it billow and drag workers and clamps, injuring people and tearing fabric; a PTFE-glass panel folded double in handling breaks glass fibres along an invisible weak line that tears years later under repeated wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錐形單元頂環頂升」如何影響張拉膜屋蓋成形的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jacking the ring of conical units” governs force, deformation or durability in “Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 膜面接上邊界後仍是鬆弛的，要靠拉緊邊索、頂升桅桿或吊起頂環，把膜拉長到補償後的尺寸，才產生設計預應力。哈吉航廈的每個錐形單元由頂環向下輻射，周邊固定在桅桿網格上，這類錐形單元的預應力主要靠把頂環吊升到設計高度產生。張拉要分階段、對稱地進行：一次把某一邊拉到位，膜會在另一邊起皺甚至撕裂，邊索與夾具受力也不均。每一階段都要量測幾何與張力，確認與分析一致後再繼續。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錐形單元頂環頂升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once connected to its boundaries a membrane is still slack; tightening edge cables, jacking masts or lifting rings stretches it to its compensated size and creates the design prestress. Each conical unit of the Hajj Terminal radiates down from a top ring with its perimeter fixed to the pylon grid, and in such conical units prestress comes mainly from lifting the ring to its design height. Tensioning must proceed in stages and symmetrically: pulling one side fully at once wrinkles or even tears the other side and loads edge cables and clamps unevenly. Geometry and tension are measured at each stage and the work continues only when they agree with the analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Jacking the ring of conical units” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：錐形單元底半徑 r = 22.4 m、高 H = 20 m，斜長 L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A conical unit with base radius r = 22.4 m and height H = 20 m has a slant length L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「錐形單元頂環頂升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Jacking the ring of conical units”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環
knowledge.titleEn: Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings
knowledge.text: 膜面接上邊界後仍是鬆弛的，要靠拉緊邊索、頂升桅桿或吊起頂環，把膜拉長到補償後的尺寸，才產生設計預應力。哈吉航廈的每個錐形單元由頂環向下輻射，周邊固定在桅桿網格上，這類錐形單元的預應力主要靠把頂環吊升到設計高度產生。
knowledge.textEn: Once connected to its boundaries a membrane is still slack; tightening edge cables, jacking masts or lifting rings stretches it to its compensated size and creates the design prestress. Each conical unit of the Hajj Terminal radiates down from a top ring with its perimeter fixed to the pylon grid, and in such conical units prestress comes mainly from lifting the ring to its design height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings" is correct?
options: 膜面接上邊界後仍是鬆弛的，要靠拉緊邊索、頂升桅桿或吊起頂環，把膜拉長到補償後的尺寸，才產生設計預應力。
膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。
膜面看起來平整沒有皺褶，就表示預應力正確。
optionsEn: Once connected to its boundaries a membrane is still slack.
Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning.
If a membrane looks smooth without wrinkles, its prestress must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 膜面接上邊界後仍是鬆弛的，要靠拉緊邊索、頂升桅桿或吊起頂環，把膜拉長到補償後的尺寸，才產生設計預應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once connected to its boundaries a membrane is still slack; tightening edge cables, jacking masts or lifting rings stretches it to its compensated size and creates the design prestress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錐形單元頂環頂升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jacking the ring of conical units” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：錐形單元底半徑 r = 22.4 m、高 H = 20 m，斜長 L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m。目標預應力 5 kN/m、膜勁度 800 kN/m，所需應變 0.625%，斜向伸長約 30.0×0.00625 ≈ 0.19 m；頂環提升 Δh 時斜長增加約 Δh·H/L = 0.667Δh，故 Δh ≈ 0.19/0.667 ≈ 0.28 m。幾何與勁度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A conical unit with base radius r = 22.4 m and height H = 20 m has a slant length L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m. For a target prestress of 5 kN/m and fabric stiffness 800 kN/m the strain is 0.625%, a slant extension of about 30.0×0.00625 ≈ 0.19 m; raising the ring by Δh lengthens the slant by about Δh·H/L = 0.667Δh, so Δh ≈ 0.19/0.667 ≈ 0.28 m. Geometry and stiffness are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張拉計畫依分析列出每階段的頂升量或邊索伸長與預期張力，每階段量測頂環高程、邊索張力與膜面皺褶分布；最後一階段以膜張力計抽查各區預應力，並與目標值比較（例如允許 ±15%），記錄當時溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The tensioning plan lists, from the analysis, the jacking height or edge-cable extension and expected tension at each stage; at each stage measure ring level, edge-cable tension and wrinkle pattern; at the final stage spot-check prestress in each zone with a membrane tensiometer against the target, for example within ±15%, recording the temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 錐形單元底半徑 r = 22.4 m、高 H = 20 m，斜長 L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m。目標預應力 5 kN/m、膜勁度 800 kN/m，所需應變 0.625%，斜向伸長約 30.0×0.00625 ≈ 0.19 m；頂環提升 Δh 時斜長增加約 Δh·H/L = 0.667Δh，故 Δh ≈ 0.19/0.667 ≈ 0.28 m。幾何與勁度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A conical unit with base radius r = 22.4 m and height H = 20 m has a slant length L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m. For a target prestress of 5 kN/m and fabric stiffness 800 kN/m the strain is 0.625%, a slant extension of about 30.0×0.00625 ≈ 0.19 m; raising the ring by Δh lengthens the slant by about Δh·H/L = 0.667Δh, so Δh ≈ 0.19/0.667 ≈ 0.28 m. Geometry and stiffness are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings", which statement holds?
options: 膜結構完工時預應力正確，就會永久維持。
錐形單元底半徑 r = 22.4 m、高 H = 20 m，斜長 L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m。
膜屋蓋的形狀可以像玻璃帷幕一樣由建築師自由決定。
optionsEn: If a membrane's prestress is right at completion it stays right forever.
A conical unit with base radius r = 22.4 m and height H = 20 m has a slant length L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m.
A membrane roof's shape can be set freely by the architect, like a glass façade.
quiz.explanation: 錐形單元底半徑 r = 22.4 m、高 H = 20 m，斜長 L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A conical unit with base radius r = 22.4 m and height H = 20 m has a slant length L = √(22.4² + 20²) ≈ 30.0 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錐形單元頂環頂升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jacking the ring of conical units” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張拉計畫依分析列出每階段的頂升量或邊索伸長與預期張力，每階段量測頂環高程、邊索張力與膜面皺褶分布；最後一階段以膜張力計抽查各區預應力，並與目標值比較（例如允許 ±15%），記錄當時溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The tensioning plan lists, from the analysis, the jacking height or edge-cable extension and expected tension at each stage; at each stage measure ring level, edge-cable tension and wrinkle pattern; at the final stage spot-check prestress in each zone with a membrane tensiometer against the target, for example within ±15%, recording the temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：張拉程序書須列出階段、對稱順序、每階段目標與允許偏差、停止條件與量測方法，由結構設計者簽認；張拉屬高能量作業，須設警戒區並由合格人員依核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The tensioning procedure must list stages, symmetric order, target and tolerance per stage, stop conditions and measurement methods, signed by the structural designer; tensioning is high-energy work requiring an exclusion zone and qualified personnel under an approved procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了趕工把頂環一次頂到位，膜面在頂環附近應力集中而沿熱合縫撕裂；只依頂升量控制而不量張力，若補償率有誤，頂升量正確但預應力完全不對。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Jacking a ring to full height in one go to save time concentrates stress around the ring and tears the fabric along welded seams; controlling by jacking height alone without measuring tension means that, if compensation is wrong, the height is right but the prestress is not. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 張拉計畫依分析列出每階段的頂升量或邊索伸長與預期張力，每階段量測頂環高程、邊索張力與膜面皺褶分布；最後一階段以膜張力計抽查各區預應力，並與目標值比較（例如允許 ±15%），記錄當時溫度。
knowledge.textEn: The tensioning plan lists, from the analysis, the jacking height or edge-cable extension and expected tension at each stage; at each stage measure ring level, edge-cable tension and wrinkle pattern; at the final stage spot-check prestress in each zone with a membrane tensiometer against the target, for example within ±15%, recording the temperature.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 張拉程序書須列出階段、對稱順序、每階段目標與允許偏差、停止條件與量測方法，由結構設計者簽認；張拉屬高能量作業，須設警戒區並由合格人員依核准程序執行。
knowledge.textEn: The tensioning procedure must list stages, symmetric order, target and tolerance per stage, stop conditions and measurement methods, signed by the structural designer; tensioning is high-energy work requiring an exclusion zone and qualified personnel under an approved procedure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
膜材只要看單軸拉伸強度就能完成設計。
張拉計畫依分析列出每階段的頂升量或邊索伸長與預期張力，每階段量測頂環高程、邊索張力與膜面皺褶分布。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Uniaxial tensile strength is all that is needed to design with a fabric.
The tensioning plan lists, from the analysis, the jacking height or edge-cable extension and expected tension at each stage.
quiz.explanation: 張拉計畫依分析列出每階段的頂升量或邊索伸長與預期張力，每階段量測頂環高程、邊索張力與膜面皺褶分布；最後一階段以膜張力計抽查各區預應力，並與目標值比較（例如允許 ±15%），記錄當時溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The tensioning plan lists, from the analysis, the jacking height or edge-cable extension and expected tension at each stage; at each stage measure ring level, edge-cable tension and wrinkle pattern; at the final stage spot-check prestress in each zone with a membrane tensiometer against the target, for example within ±15%, recording the temperature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錐形單元頂環頂升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Jacking the ring of conical units” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了趕工把頂環一次頂到位，膜面在頂環附近應力集中而沿熱合縫撕裂；只依頂升量控制而不量張力，若補償率有誤，頂升量正確但預應力完全不對。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Jacking a ring to full height in one go to save time concentrates stress around the ring and tears the fabric along welded seams; controlling by jacking height alone without measuring tension means that, if compensation is wrong, the height is right but the prestress is not. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每一階段都要量測幾何與張力，確認與分析一致後再繼續。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Geometry and tension are measured at each stage and the work continues only when they agree with the analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膜面接上邊界後自然就有預應力，不需要另外張拉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once connected to its boundaries a membrane automatically has prestress and needs no tensioning." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了趕工把頂環一次頂到位，膜面在頂環附近應力集中而沿熱合縫撕裂；只依頂升量控制而不量張力，若補償率有誤，頂升量正確但預應力完全不對。
knowledge.textEn: Jacking a ring to full height in one go to save time concentrates stress around the ring and tears the fabric along welded seams; controlling by jacking height alone without measuring tension means that, if compensation is wrong, the height is right but the prestress is not.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分階段導入預應力：邊索、桅桿與頂環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged prestressing via edge cables, masts and rings" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了趕工把頂環一次頂到位，膜面在頂環附近應力集中而沿熱合縫撕裂；只依頂升量控制而不量張力，若補償率有誤，頂升量正確但預應力完全不對。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
膜面看起來平整沒有皺褶，就表示預應力正確。
optionsEn: Jacking a ring to full height in one go to save time concentrates stress around the ring and tears the fabric along welded seams.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If a membrane looks smooth without wrinkles, its prestress must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 為了趕工把頂環一次頂到位，膜面在頂環附近應力集中而沿熱合縫撕裂；只依頂升量控制而不量張力，若補償率有誤，頂升量正確但預應力完全不對。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Jacking a ring to full height in one go to save time concentrates stress around the ring and tears the fabric along welded seams; controlling by jacking height alone without measuring tension means that, if compensation is wrong, the height is right but the prestress is not. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收」與「顫振、拍動與排水的完工驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance" and "Completion checks for flutter, flapping and drainage": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「膜張力計與皺褶檢查」如何影響張拉膜屋蓋成形的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Membrane tensiometer and wrinkle check” governs force, deformation or durability in “Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 膜的預應力無法像索那樣用千斤頂直接讀出，現場常用膜張力計：在膜面上兩支點之間施加一個小力，量測膜面的局部撓度，由幾何關係反算該方向的單位寬度張力。量測要在經向與緯向分別進行，並涵蓋高曲率區、低曲率區與邊界附近。皺褶的方向也是線索：皺褶平行於受拉方向，垂直於鬆弛方向。驗收結果應建立為基準，日後潛變與鬆弛都以此比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「膜張力計與皺褶檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Membrane prestress cannot be read directly from a jack as with cables, so a membrane tensiometer is used on site: a small force is applied between two supports on the surface, the local deflection measured and the tension per unit width back-calculated from the geometry. Measurements are taken separately in warp and fill and cover high-curvature zones, low-curvature zones and areas near boundaries. Wrinkle direction is also a clue: wrinkles run parallel to the tensioned direction and across the slack one. Acceptance results become the baseline against which later creep and relaxation are compared. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Membrane tensiometer and wrinkle check” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膜張力計與皺褶檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Membrane tensiometer and wrinkle check” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡化弦模型：支點間距 a = 200 mm、量測寬度 b = 50 mm，在中點施加 F = 20 N 得撓度 δ = 5 mm，單位寬度張力 t ≈ F·a/(4·b·δ) = 20×200/(4×50×5) = 4 N/mm = 4 kN/m。若 δ 量成 6 mm，t ≈ 3.3 kN/m；撓度量測誤差 1 mm 就造成約 17% 的張力差。儀器尺寸與讀數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A simple string model: with support spacing a = 200 mm and measuring width b = 50 mm, a midpoint force F = 20 N giving deflection δ = 5 mm means a tension per unit width t ≈ F·a/(4·b·δ) = 20×200/(4×50×5) = 4 N/mm = 4 kN/m. If δ reads 6 mm, t ≈ 3.3 kN/m, so a 1 mm deflection error gives about 17% tension difference. Instrument dimensions and readings are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：膜張力計先在已知張力的試驗架上校正；現場依網格選點，經緯向各量一次並記錄溫度、日照與風況；結果與分析預測比較，偏差超過允許值的區域再加密量測，並以皺褶照片佐證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the tensiometer on a test rig with known tension first; on site measure at gridded points in both warp and fill, recording temperature, sun and wind; compare results with predictions and densify measurements where deviations exceed the allowance, supported by photographs of wrinkles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

If δ reads 6 mm, t ≈ 3.3 kN/m, so a 1 mm deflection error gives about 17% tension difference. Instrument dimensions and readings are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膜張力計與皺褶檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Membrane tensiometer and wrinkle check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 膜張力計先在已知張力的試驗架上校正；現場依網格選點，經緯向各量一次並記錄溫度、日照與風況；結果與分析預測比較，偏差超過允許值的區域再加密量測，並以皺褶照片佐證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the tensiometer on a test rig with known tension first; on site measure at gridded points in both warp and fill, recording temperature, sun and wind; compare results with predictions and densify measurements where deviations exceed the allowance, supported by photographs of wrinkles. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收計畫要明列量測點位、方法、儀器校正、溫度條件與允許偏差；量測紀錄與照片作為維護基準移交業主，日後複測須用同一方法與點位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The acceptance plan must state measuring points, method, instrument calibration, temperature conditions and tolerance; records and photographs are handed to the owner as the maintenance baseline, and later re-measurement must use the same method and points.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在午後日照下量測，膜溫升高使張力下降，被誤判為預應力不足而過度張拉，到了冬季膜材過度受拉；只量少數點而忽略邊界附近，邊緣鬆弛在風中拍動，磨損夾具與膜材。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring in afternoon sun, when warm fabric loses tension, can be misread as low prestress and lead to over-tensioning, leaving the fabric over-stressed in winter; measuring only a few points and ignoring boundaries misses slack edges that flap in wind and wear clamps and fabric. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 在午後日照下量測，膜溫升高使張力下降，被誤判為預應力不足而過度張拉，到了冬季膜材過度受拉；只量少數點而忽略邊界附近，邊緣鬆弛在風中拍動，磨損夾具與膜材。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
