Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 索網的勁度來自預拉力與曲率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable-net stiffness comes from prestress and curvature: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預拉力與幾何勁度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prestress and geometric stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預拉力取得過低，網面在風中大幅擺動，覆面材料與接縫反覆變形而破損；取得過高，則邊界受壓環、桅桿與基礎都必須加大，而且索在長期高應力下鬆弛與疲勞風險上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Too little prestress lets the surface swing widely in wind, so cladding and joints are damaged by repeated deformation; too much forces larger compression rings, masts and foundations and raises relaxation and fatigue risk in cables kept at high stress for decades. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預拉力越大，網越硬，但索、錨具與邊界構件的受力也越大，因此預拉力是勁度、變形與構件尺寸之間的設計權衡，而不是越大越好。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: More prestress makes the net stiffer but also increases forces in cables, anchorages and boundary members, so prestress is a design trade-off among stiffness, deformation and member size rather than something to maximise.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索網的預拉力越大越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more prestress a cable net has, the safer it is." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預拉力取得過低，網面在風中大幅擺動，覆面材料與接縫反覆變形而破損；取得過高，則邊界受壓環、桅桿與基礎都必須加大，而且索在長期高應力下鬆弛與疲勞風險上升。
knowledge.textEn: Too little prestress lets the surface swing widely in wind, so cladding and joints are damaged by repeated deformation; too much forces larger compression rings, masts and foundations and raises relaxation and fatigue risk in cables kept at high stress for decades.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「索網的勁度來自預拉力與曲率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable-net stiffness comes from prestress and curvature" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
預拉力取得過低，網面在風中大幅擺動，覆面材料與接縫反覆變形而破損；取得過高，則邊界受壓環、桅桿與基礎都必須加大，而且索在長期高應力下鬆弛與疲勞風險上升。
輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Too little prestress lets the surface swing widely in wind, so cladding and joints are damaged by repeated deformation.
A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check.
quiz.explanation: 預拉力取得過低，網面在風中大幅擺動，覆面材料與接縫反覆變形而破損；取得過高，則邊界受壓環、桅桿與基礎都必須加大，而且索在長期高應力下鬆弛與疲勞風險上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too little prestress lets the surface swing widely in wind, so cladding and joints are damaged by repeated deformation; too much forces larger compression rings, masts and foundations and raises relaxation and fatigue risk in cables kept at high stress for decades. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「受壓環與輪輻式系統」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compression ring and spoked wheel” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索屋蓋最終都要把索力閉合在受壓構件上。Dorton 體育館的鞍形索網張在兩道交叉的拋物線混凝土拱之間，拱在地面以上約 26 ft 處交叉並延伸入地下，兩端以鋼索拉結，拱受壓、索受拉，外牆幾乎不承重。輪輻式屋蓋則像腳踏車輪：外圈受壓環、內圈受拉環，以徑向索相連；巴西利亞國家體育場採用平衡懸吊輪原理的雙層懸吊屋頂，與外側受壓環同心。兩種系統的共同點是內力在結構內部自我平衡，基礎主要承受豎向力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「受壓環與輪輻式系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every cable roof must close its cable forces on compression members. Dorton Arena's saddle net is stretched between two intersecting parabolic concrete arches that cross about 26 ft above ground and continue underground, where their ends are tied by steel cables, so the arches work in compression, the cables in tension and the outer walls carry almost no load. A spoked-wheel roof is like a bicycle wheel: an outer compression ring and inner tension ring connected by radial cables; Brasília's National Stadium uses a double-layer suspended roof on the balanced suspension-wheel principle, concentric with its outer compression ring. Both systems balance their internal forces within the structure, leaving foundations mainly with vertical load. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Compression ring and spoked wheel” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：圓形受壓環受均布徑向力 q 時環力 N = q·R。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A circular compression ring under uniform radial load q has a ring force N = q·R.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「受壓環與輪輻式系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Compression ring and spoked wheel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力
knowledge.titleEn: Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs
knowledge.text: 索屋蓋最終都要把索力閉合在受壓構件上。Dorton 體育館的鞍形索網張在兩道交叉的拋物線混凝土拱之間，拱在地面以上約 26 ft 處交叉並延伸入地下，兩端以鋼索拉結，拱受壓、索受拉，外牆幾乎不承重。
knowledge.textEn: Every cable roof must close its cable forces on compression members. Dorton Arena's saddle net is stretched between two intersecting parabolic concrete arches that cross about 26 ft above ground and continue underground, where their ends are tied by steel cables, so the arches work in compression, the cables in tension and the outer walls carry almost no load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs" is correct?
options: 輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。
鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。
索屋蓋最終都要把索力閉合在受壓構件上。
optionsEn: A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check.
A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation.
Every cable roof must close its cable forces on compression members.
quiz.explanation: 索屋蓋最終都要把索力閉合在受壓構件上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every cable roof must close its cable forces on compression members. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「受壓環與輪輻式系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compression ring and spoked wheel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：圓形受壓環受均布徑向力 q 時環力 N = q·R。若 n = 60 根徑向索各提供水平力 H = 3,000 kN，q = nH/(2πR)，故 N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN，與半徑無關；但 R = 120 m 時 q ≈ 239 kN/m，平面內挫屈需另行檢核。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A circular compression ring under uniform radial load q has a ring force N = q·R. If n = 60 radial cables each supply H = 3,000 kN, q = nH/(2πR), so N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN, independent of radius; with R = 120 m, q ≈ 239 kN/m and in-plane buckling must be checked separately. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以整體模型確認索力在受壓環、拱或邊界構件中閉合，基礎反力以豎向為主；檢查不對稱荷載（半邊雪、單側風）下受壓環的彎矩與變形，並確認任何一根索失效時系統仍可維持穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm in the global model that cable forces close in the compression ring, arches or boundary members, leaving foundation reactions mainly vertical; check ring bending and deformation under asymmetric loads such as half-span snow or one-sided wind, and confirm the system stays stable if any one cable is lost.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 圓形受壓環受均布徑向力 q 時環力 N = q·R。若 n = 60 根徑向索各提供水平力 H = 3,000 kN，q = nH/(2πR)，故 N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN，與半徑無關；但 R = 120 m 時 q ≈ 239 kN/m，平面內挫屈需另行檢核。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A circular compression ring under uniform radial load q has a ring force N = q·R. If n = 60 radial cables each supply H = 3,000 kN, q = nH/(2πR), so N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN, independent of radius; with R = 120 m, q ≈ 239 kN/m and in-plane buckling must be checked separately. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs", which statement holds?
options: 圓形受壓環受均布徑向力 q 時環力 N = q·R。
提升張拉時最難的是剛離地的時候，接近完成時只要慢慢拉就好。
頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。
optionsEn: A circular compression ring under uniform radial load q has a ring force N = q·R.
The hardest part of lift-and-tension is lift-off; near completion the jacks simply pull slowly.
With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly.
quiz.explanation: 圓形受壓環受均布徑向力 q 時環力 N = q·R。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A circular compression ring under uniform radial load q has a ring force N = q·R. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「受壓環與輪輻式系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compression ring and spoked wheel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以整體模型確認索力在受壓環、拱或邊界構件中閉合，基礎反力以豎向為主；檢查不對稱荷載（半邊雪、單側風）下受壓環的彎矩與變形，並確認任何一根索失效時系統仍可維持穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm in the global model that cable forces close in the compression ring, arches or boundary members, leaving foundation reactions mainly vertical; check ring bending and deformation under asymmetric loads such as half-span snow or one-sided wind, and confirm the system stays stable if any one cable is lost. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計報告應以示意圖標出每一個索力閉合路徑，並列出基礎只承受豎向力的前提條件；拱腳拉結索、受壓環接頭等關鍵閉合構件應設計為可檢查，並在維護手冊中列為一級檢查項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design report should map every closed cable-force path in diagrams and state the conditions under which foundations carry only vertical load; key closing components such as arch-foot ties and compression-ring joints should be inspectable and listed as top-priority items in the maintenance manual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：受壓環只按對稱荷載設計，不對稱荷載下環的彎矩被低估，環扭曲後徑向索張力重新分配，部分索鬆弛、部分過載；拱腳拉結索若腐蝕失效，拱腳外推，整個鞍形網的幾何與預拉力同時喪失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A compression ring designed only for symmetric load underestimates ring bending under asymmetric load; as the ring distorts, radial tensions redistribute so some cables slacken and others overload; if the tie cables at arch feet corrode and fail, the feet spread and the saddle net loses its geometry and prestress at once. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以整體模型確認索力在受壓環、拱或邊界構件中閉合，基礎反力以豎向為主；檢查不對稱荷載（半邊雪、單側風）下受壓環的彎矩與變形，並確認任何一根索失效時系統仍可維持穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm in the global model that cable forces close in the compression ring, arches or boundary members, leaving foundation reactions mainly vertical; check ring bending and deformation under asymmetric loads such as half-span snow or one-sided wind, and confirm the system stays stable if any one cable is lost.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計報告應以示意圖標出每一個索力閉合路徑，並列出基礎只承受豎向力的前提條件；拱腳拉結索、受壓環接頭等關鍵閉合構件應設計為可檢查，並在維護手冊中列為一級檢查項目。
knowledge.textEn: The design report should map every closed cable-force path in diagrams and state the conditions under which foundations carry only vertical load; key closing components such as arch-foot ties and compression-ring joints should be inspectable and listed as top-priority items in the maintenance manual.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以整體模型確認索力在受壓環、拱或邊界構件中閉合，基礎反力以豎向為主。
索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm in the global model that cable forces close in the compression ring, arches or boundary members, leaving foundation reactions mainly vertical.
Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem.
quiz.explanation: 以整體模型確認索力在受壓環、拱或邊界構件中閉合，基礎反力以豎向為主；檢查不對稱荷載（半邊雪、單側風）下受壓環的彎矩與變形，並確認任何一根索失效時系統仍可維持穩定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm in the global model that cable forces close in the compression ring, arches or boundary members, leaving foundation reactions mainly vertical; check ring bending and deformation under asymmetric loads such as half-span snow or one-sided wind, and confirm the system stays stable if any one cable is lost. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「受壓環與輪輻式系統」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compression ring and spoked wheel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 受壓環只按對稱荷載設計，不對稱荷載下環的彎矩被低估，環扭曲後徑向索張力重新分配，部分索鬆弛、部分過載；拱腳拉結索若腐蝕失效，拱腳外推，整個鞍形網的幾何與預拉力同時喪失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A compression ring designed only for symmetric load underestimates ring bending under asymmetric load; as the ring distorts, radial tensions redistribute so some cables slacken and others overload; if the tie cables at arch feet corrode and fail, the feet spread and the saddle net loses its geometry and prestress at once. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩種系統的共同點是內力在結構內部自我平衡，基礎主要承受豎向力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both systems balance their internal forces within the structure, leaving foundations mainly with vertical load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 受壓環只按對稱荷載設計，不對稱荷載下環的彎矩被低估，環扭曲後徑向索張力重新分配，部分索鬆弛、部分過載；拱腳拉結索若腐蝕失效，拱腳外推，整個鞍形網的幾何與預拉力同時喪失。
knowledge.textEn: A compression ring designed only for symmetric load underestimates ring bending under asymmetric load; as the ring distorts, radial tensions redistribute so some cables slacken and others overload; if the tie cables at arch feet corrode and fail, the feet spread and the saddle net loses its geometry and prestress at once.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。
受壓環只按對稱荷載設計，不對稱荷載下環的彎矩被低估，環扭曲後徑向索張力重新分配，部分索鬆弛、部分過載。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation.
A compression ring designed only for symmetric load underestimates ring bending under asymmetric load.
quiz.explanation: 受壓環只按對稱荷載設計，不對稱荷載下環的彎矩被低估，環扭曲後徑向索張力重新分配，部分索鬆弛、部分過載；拱腳拉結索若腐蝕失效，拱腳外推，整個鞍形網的幾何與預拉力同時喪失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A compression ring designed only for symmetric load underestimates ring bending under asymmetric load; as the ring distorts, radial tensions redistribute so some cables slacken and others overload; if the tie cables at arch feet corrode and fail, the feet spread and the saddle net loses its geometry and prestress at once. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量」與「受壓環穩定與索端節點細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range" and "Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索頭錨具與可調量」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Terminations and adjustment” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索網常用三種索體：螺旋鋼索（柔軟、適合鞍形網）、全封閉鋼索（外層 Z 形鋼絲緊扣、耐蝕且勁度較高，常用於邊索）、平行鋼絞線束（勁度高、可逐根更換，常用於大力量的拉索）。索頭以澆鑄鋅或樹脂的套筒、或壓製接頭與結構連接，並以螺桿或墊片提供可調長度。索在出廠前常做預拉處理，消除鋼絲初始排列造成的永久伸長，否則安裝後索會慢慢變長而流失預拉力。可調量必須同時涵蓋製造、量測溫度與施工誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索頭錨具與可調量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cable nets commonly use three cable types: spiral strand (flexible, suited to saddle nets), locked-coil rope (outer Z-shaped wires interlock, corrosion-resistant and stiffer, often used for edge cables) and parallel-strand bundles (high stiffness and replaceable strand by strand, common for heavily loaded stays). Terminations use zinc- or resin-cast sockets or swaged fittings connected to the structure, with threaded rods or shims giving adjustable length. Cables are usually pre-stretched in the factory to remove the permanent bedding-in extension of the wires; otherwise they slowly lengthen after installation and lose prestress. The adjustment range must cover fabrication, measuring temperature and construction tolerances together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Terminations and adjustment” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：80 m 長的索若製造允差為 L/5,000，即 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm；再加上受壓環與基礎的施工誤差 ±30 mm，以及量測溫差 15°C 造成的 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm，簡單相加約 60 mm，索頭可調量至少應有 ±60 mm，並保留餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An 80 m cable with a fabrication tolerance of L/5,000 has 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm; adding ±30 mm of compression-ring and foundation construction error and a 15°C measuring-temperature difference worth 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm gives about 60 mm by simple addition, so terminations need at least ±60 mm of adjustment with some margin.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索頭錨具與可調量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Terminations and adjustment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量
knowledge.titleEn: Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range
knowledge.text: 索網常用三種索體：螺旋鋼索（柔軟、適合鞍形網）、全封閉鋼索（外層 Z 形鋼絲緊扣、耐蝕且勁度較高，常用於邊索）、平行鋼絞線束（勁度高、可逐根更換，常用於大力量的拉索）。索頭以澆鑄鋅或樹脂的套筒、或壓製接頭與結構連接，並以螺桿或墊片提供可調長度。
knowledge.textEn: Cable nets commonly use three cable types: spiral strand (flexible, suited to saddle nets), locked-coil rope (outer Z-shaped wires interlock, corrosion-resistant and stiffer, often used for edge cables) and parallel-strand bundles (high stiffness and replaceable strand by strand, common for heavily loaded stays). Terminations use zinc- or resin-cast sockets or swaged fittings connected to the structure, with threaded rods or shims giving adjustable length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range" is correct?
options: 索網常用三種索體：螺旋鋼索（柔軟、適合鞍形網）、全封閉鋼索（外層 Z 形鋼絲緊扣、耐蝕且勁度較高，常用於邊索）、平行鋼絞線束（勁度高、可逐根更換，常用於大力量的拉索）。
鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。
受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。
optionsEn: Cable nets commonly use three cable types: spiral strand (flexible, suited to saddle nets), locked-coil rope (outer Z-shaped wires interlock, corrosion-resistant and stiffer, often used for edge cables) and parallel-strand bundles (high stiffness and replaceable strand by strand, common for heavily loaded stays).
A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation.
A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle.
quiz.explanation: 索網常用三種索體：螺旋鋼索（柔軟、適合鞍形網）、全封閉鋼索（外層 Z 形鋼絲緊扣、耐蝕且勁度較高，常用於邊索）、平行鋼絞線束（勁度高、可逐根更換，常用於大力量的拉索）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cable nets commonly use three cable types: spiral strand (flexible, suited to saddle nets), locked-coil rope (outer Z-shaped wires interlock, corrosion-resistant and stiffer, often used for edge cables) and parallel-strand bundles (high stiffness and replaceable strand by strand, common for heavily loaded stays). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索頭錨具與可調量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Terminations and adjustment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：80 m 長的索若製造允差為 L/5,000，即 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm；再加上受壓環與基礎的施工誤差 ±30 mm，以及量測溫差 15°C 造成的 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm，簡單相加約 60 mm，索頭可調量至少應有 ±60 mm，並保留餘裕。允差與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An 80 m cable with a fabrication tolerance of L/5,000 has 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm; adding ±30 mm of compression-ring and foundation construction error and a 15°C measuring-temperature difference worth 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm gives about 60 mm by simple addition, so terminations need at least ±60 mm of adjustment with some margin. Tolerances and temperature are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：索出廠前核對預拉處理紀錄、在規定荷載與溫度下的長度量測與標記；索頭澆鑄做抽樣破斷或保證荷載試驗；現場安裝前確認每個索頭的可調螺桿長度與螺紋狀態，並記錄初始調整位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before shipment check pre-stretching records and length measurement and marking under the specified load and temperature; sample socket castings for break or proof-load tests; on site before installation confirm each termination's threaded adjustment length and thread condition and record the initial adjustment position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 80 m 長的索若製造允差為 L/5,000，即 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm；再加上受壓環與基礎的施工誤差 ±30 mm，以及量測溫差 15°C 造成的 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm，簡單相加約 60 mm，索頭可調量至少應有 ±60 mm，並保留餘裕。允差與溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An 80 m cable with a fabrication tolerance of L/5,000 has 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm; adding ±30 mm of compression-ring and foundation construction error and a 15°C measuring-temperature difference worth 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm gives about 60 mm by simple addition, so terminations need at least ±60 mm of adjustment with some margin. Tolerances and temperature are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range", which statement holds?
options: 張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。
索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。
optionsEn: If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right.
An 80 m cable with a fabrication tolerance of L/5,000 has 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm.
A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction.
quiz.explanation: 80 m 長的索若製造允差為 L/5,000，即 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm；再加上受壓環與基礎的施工誤差 ±30 mm，以及量測溫差 15°C 造成的 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm，簡單相加約 60 mm，索頭可調量至少應有 ±60 mm，並保留餘裕。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An 80 m cable with a fabrication tolerance of L/5,000 has 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm; adding ±30 mm of compression-ring and foundation construction error and a 15°C measuring-temperature difference worth 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm gives about 60 mm by simple addition, so terminations need at least ±60 mm of adjustment with some margin. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索頭錨具與可調量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Terminations and adjustment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 索出廠前核對預拉處理紀錄、在規定荷載與溫度下的長度量測與標記；索頭澆鑄做抽樣破斷或保證荷載試驗；現場安裝前確認每個索頭的可調螺桿長度與螺紋狀態，並記錄初始調整位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before shipment check pre-stretching records and length measurement and marking under the specified load and temperature; sample socket castings for break or proof-load tests; on site before installation confirm each termination's threaded adjustment length and thread condition and record the initial adjustment position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：索的採購規範應寫明索體型式、最小破斷力、彈性模數範圍、預拉處理要求、長度量測條件、索頭型式與可調量；可調量用盡時應停工檢討原因，不得現場臨時加接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The cable procurement specification should state cable type, minimum breaking load, modulus range, pre-stretching requirement, length-measuring conditions, termination type and adjustment range; when adjustment runs out, work stops for review rather than improvised extensions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未經預拉處理的螺旋鋼索在使用初期持續伸長，預拉力在數月內明顯下降；可調量不足時，現場被迫在索頭加接墊片或延長件，若未經設計，可能形成彎曲或偏心受力的弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spiral strand not pre-stretched keeps lengthening early in service, and prestress drops noticeably within months; with too little adjustment, crews are forced to add shims or extensions at terminations, which, if not designed, create weak points loaded in bending or eccentrically. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索頭錨具與可調量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Terminations and adjustment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未經預拉處理的螺旋鋼索在使用初期持續伸長，預拉力在數月內明顯下降；可調量不足時，現場被迫在索頭加接墊片或延長件，若未經設計，可能形成彎曲或偏心受力的弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Spiral strand not pre-stretched keeps lengthening early in service, and prestress drops noticeably within months; with too little adjustment, crews are forced to add shims or extensions at terminations, which, if not designed, create weak points loaded in bending or eccentrically. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：可調量必須同時涵蓋製造、量測溫度與施工誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The adjustment range must cover fabrication, measuring temperature and construction tolerances together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未經預拉處理的螺旋鋼索在使用初期持續伸長，預拉力在數月內明顯下降；可調量不足時，現場被迫在索頭加接墊片或延長件，若未經設計，可能形成彎曲或偏心受力的弱點。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 受壓環穩定與索端節點細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「受壓環挫屈與索端節點」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ring buckling and cable-end nodes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 受壓環承受數萬 kN 的環向壓力，同時被每根徑向索以集中力拉向圓心，平面內與平面外挫屈都是主要檢核。索端節點把集中索力傳入環梁，需要足夠的承壓板、加勁與錨定長度，並允許索在不同荷載下改變角度而不在索頭產生彎曲。節點也要預留張拉千斤頂的作業空間與日後更換索的通路；若節點設計只考慮完成狀態，張拉時千斤頂無處安放，或更換時必須破壞節點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「受壓環挫屈與索端節點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A compression ring carries tens of thousands of kilonewtons of hoop compression while every radial cable pulls it inward with a concentrated force, so in-plane and out-of-plane buckling are primary checks. Cable-end nodes transfer concentrated forces into the ring through adequate bearing plates, stiffeners and anchorage length, and must let the cable change angle under different loads without bending at the socket. Nodes must also leave room for tensioning jacks and access for future cable replacement; if designed only for the final state, there is nowhere to place jacks during tensioning, or the node must be destroyed to replace a cable. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ring buckling and cable-end nodes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：圓環在均勻徑向壓力下的平面內彈性挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A circular ring under uniform radial pressure buckles in plane at q_cr = 3EI/R³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「受壓環挫屈與索端節點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ring buckling and cable-end nodes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 受壓環穩定與索端節點細部
knowledge.titleEn: Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details
knowledge.text: 受壓環承受數萬 kN 的環向壓力，同時被每根徑向索以集中力拉向圓心，平面內與平面外挫屈都是主要檢核。索端節點把集中索力傳入環梁，需要足夠的承壓板、加勁與錨定長度，並允許索在不同荷載下改變角度而不在索頭產生彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: A compression ring carries tens of thousands of kilonewtons of hoop compression while every radial cable pulls it inward with a concentrated force, so in-plane and out-of-plane buckling are primary checks. Cable-end nodes transfer concentrated forces into the ring through adequate bearing plates, stiffeners and anchorage length, and must let the cable change angle under different loads without bending at the socket.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「受壓環穩定與索端節點細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details" is correct?
options: 受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。
受壓環承受數萬 kN 的環向壓力，同時被每根徑向索以集中力拉向圓心，平面內與平面外挫屈都是主要檢核。
提升張拉時最難的是剛離地的時候，接近完成時只要慢慢拉就好。
optionsEn: A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle.

A compression ring carries tens of thousands of kilonewtons of hoop compression while every radial cable pulls it inward with a concentrated force, so in-plane and out-of-plane buckling are primary checks.
The hardest part of lift-and-tension is lift-off; near completion the jacks simply pull slowly.
quiz.explanation: 受壓環承受數萬 kN 的環向壓力，同時被每根徑向索以集中力拉向圓心，平面內與平面外挫屈都是主要檢核。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A compression ring carries tens of thousands of kilonewtons of hoop compression while every radial cable pulls it inward with a concentrated force, so in-plane and out-of-plane buckling are primary checks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 受壓環穩定與索端節點細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「受壓環挫屈與索端節點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ring buckling and cable-end nodes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：圓環在均勻徑向壓力下的平面內彈性挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³。要求 q_cr ≥ 2.5q，q = 239 kN/m、R = 120 m：EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m²，以鋼材 E = 2.1×10⁸ kN/m² 計，I ≥ 1.64 m⁴。若半徑改為 100 m，所需 EI 降為約 58%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A circular ring under uniform radial pressure buckles in plane at q_cr = 3EI/R³. Requiring q_cr ≥ 2.5q with q = 239 kN/m and R = 120 m gives EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m², so with steel E = 2.1×10⁸ kN/m², I ≥ 1.64 m⁴. With a 100 m radius the required EI drops to about 58%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以考慮幾何非線性與初始缺陷的分析檢查受壓環的挫屈安全係數；索端節點以有限元素檢查局部承壓與加勁，並以足尺或縮尺試驗驗證關鍵節點；節點製作後量測錨定面角度，確保索軸線與錨定面垂直。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the compression ring's buckling safety factor by analysis including geometric nonlinearity and initial imperfections; check cable-end nodes for local bearing and stiffening by finite elements and verify key nodes by full- or reduced-scale tests; after fabrication measure anchor-face angles to keep the cable axis perpendicular to the bearing face.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 圓環在均勻徑向壓力下的平面內彈性挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³。要求 q_cr ≥ 2.5q，q = 239 kN/m、R = 120 m：EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m²，以鋼材 E = 2.1×10⁸ kN/m² 計，I ≥ 1.64 m⁴。若半徑改為 100 m，所需 EI 降為約 58%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A circular ring under uniform radial pressure buckles in plane at q_cr = 3EI/R³. Requiring q_cr ≥ 2.5q with q = 239 kN/m and R = 120 m gives EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m², so with steel E = 2.1×10⁸ kN/m², I ≥ 1.64 m⁴. With a 100 m radius the required EI drops to about 58%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「受壓環穩定與索端節點細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details", which statement holds?
options: 頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。
索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。
圓環在均勻徑向壓力下的平面內彈性挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³。
optionsEn: With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly.
Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem.
A circular ring under uniform radial pressure buckles in plane at q_cr = 3EI/R³.
quiz.explanation: 圓環在均勻徑向壓力下的平面內彈性挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A circular ring under uniform radial pressure buckles in plane at q_cr = 3EI/R³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 受壓環穩定與索端節點細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「受壓環挫屈與索端節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ring buckling and cable-end nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以考慮幾何非線性與初始缺陷的分析檢查受壓環的挫屈安全係數；索端節點以有限元素檢查局部承壓與加勁，並以足尺或縮尺試驗驗證關鍵節點；節點製作後量測錨定面角度，確保索軸線與錨定面垂直。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the compression ring's buckling safety factor by analysis including geometric nonlinearity and initial imperfections; check cable-end nodes for local bearing and stiffening by finite elements and verify key nodes by full- or reduced-scale tests; after fabrication measure anchor-face angles to keep the cable axis perpendicular to the bearing face. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：受壓環的圓度與高程允差、索端節點的角度允差都要寫入製造與安裝規範並逐點量測；節點圖須同時畫出張拉千斤頂與更換工具的位置，由結構設計者確認可施工、可維護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write ring roundness and level tolerances and node angle tolerances into the fabrication and erection specification and measure them point by point; node drawings must show tensioning-jack and replacement-tool positions, confirmed buildable and maintainable by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨定面角度偏差使索頭承受彎曲，鋼絲在套筒出口處疲勞斷裂；受壓環若製造時的圓度偏差過大，等於增加初始缺陷，挫屈荷載顯著降低，在不對稱荷載下出現過大的面外變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Anchor faces at the wrong angle bend the socket so wires fatigue and break at the socket exit; excessive out-of-roundness of the compression ring acts as an initial imperfection that markedly lowers its buckling load, leading to large out-of-plane deformation under asymmetric load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 受壓環穩定與索端節點細部：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「受壓環挫屈與索端節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ring buckling and cable-end nodes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨定面角度偏差使索頭承受彎曲，鋼絲在套筒出口處疲勞斷裂；受壓環若製造時的圓度偏差過大，等於增加初始缺陷，挫屈荷載顯著降低，在不對稱荷載下出現過大的面外變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Anchor faces at the wrong angle bend the socket so wires fatigue and break at the socket exit; excessive out-of-roundness of the compression ring acts as an initial imperfection that markedly lowers its buckling load, leading to large out-of-plane deformation under asymmetric load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：節點也要預留張拉千斤頂的作業空間與日後更換索的通路；若節點設計只考慮完成狀態，張拉時千斤頂無處安放，或更換時必須破壞節點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nodes must also leave room for tensioning jacks and access for future cable replacement; if designed only for the final state, there is nowhere to place jacks during tensioning, or the node must be destroyed to replace a cable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪輻式索網的地面組裝、提升與張拉」與「張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ground assembly, lifting and tensioning of spoked-wheel nets" and "Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪輻式索網的地面組裝、提升與張拉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground assembly, lifting and tensioning of spoked-wheel nets: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「提升張拉的最後行程」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Final stroke of lift-and-tension” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大型輪輻式屋蓋常在看台或場地上把徑向索、受拉環與索夾組成整張網，再以多台鋼絞線千斤頂同時拉起徑向索端，一路把網提升到受壓環高度並張緊，最後插銷錨固。提升初期索網懸垂、所需拉力小；接近錨點時索開始被拉直，彈性伸長主導，拉力在最後幾十公分內急遽上升到設計值。因此最後行程的控制最關鍵：所有千斤頂必須同步，臨時延伸桿要能承受全力，插銷時索力已接近完成狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「提升張拉的最後行程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large spoked-wheel roofs are often assembled on the stands or field into a complete net of radial cables, tension ring and clamps, then many strand jacks pull the radial cable ends simultaneously, raising the net to compression-ring level and tightening it before the ends are pinned. Early in the lift the net hangs slack and little force is needed; near the anchors the cables straighten and elastic stretch takes over, so force climbs steeply to its design value within the last few tens of centimetres. Control of the final stroke is therefore most critical: all jacks must be synchronised, temporary extension bars must carry full force, and when the pins go in the cable force is already close to its final state. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Final stroke of lift-and-tension” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN、長 L = 100 m，軸向勁度 k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN and length L = 100 m has an axial stiffness k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升張拉時最難的是剛離地的時候，接近完成時只要慢慢拉就好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The hardest part of lift-and-tension is lift-off; near completion the jacks simply pull slowly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「提升張拉的最後行程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Final stroke of lift-and-tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 輪輻式索網的地面組裝、提升與張拉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ground assembly, lifting and tensioning of spoked-wheel nets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升張拉的最後行程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Final stroke of lift-and-tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN、長 L = 100 m，軸向勁度 k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m。設計索力 3,000 kN 對應的彈性伸長為 3,000/6,000 = 0.5 m，也就是最後 0.5 m 的行程內力量由接近 0 升到 3,000 kN，每 100 mm 約增加 600 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN and length L = 100 m has an axial stiffness k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m. Its design force of 3,000 kN corresponds to an elastic stretch of 3,000/6,000 = 0.5 m, so within the last 0.5 m of stroke the force rises from near zero to 3,000 kN, about 600 kN for every 100 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析預測提升全程各千斤頂的力—行程曲線，特別標出最後行程的勁度；提升中逐行程記錄力與行程並與曲線比較，偏差超過門檻即停止；插銷前量測索端與錨孔的相對位置，確認同步與幾何後才插銷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Predict each jack's force–stroke curve over the whole lift by construction-stage analysis, highlighting the final-stroke stiffness; during the lift record force and stroke at each stroke and compare with the curve, stopping when deviation exceeds the threshold; before pinning measure the relative position of cable ends and anchor holes and pin only after synchronisation and geometry are confirmed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN、長 L = 100 m，軸向勁度 k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m。設計索力 3,000 kN 對應的彈性伸長為 3,000/6,000 = 0.5 m，也就是最後 0.5 m 的行程內力量由接近 0 升到 3,000 kN，每 100 mm 約增加 600 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN and length L = 100 m has an axial stiffness k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m. Its design force of 3,000 kN corresponds to an elastic stretch of 3,000/6,000 = 0.5 m, so within the last 0.5 m of stroke the force rises from near zero to 3,000 kN, about 600 kN for every 100 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 輪輻式索網的地面組裝、提升與張拉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground assembly, lifting and tensioning of spoked-wheel nets: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「提升張拉的最後行程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Final stroke of lift-and-tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析預測提升全程各千斤頂的力—行程曲線，特別標出最後行程的勁度；提升中逐行程記錄力與行程並與曲線比較，偏差超過門檻即停止；插銷前量測索端與錨孔的相對位置，確認同步與幾何後才插銷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Predict each jack's force–stroke curve over the whole lift by construction-stage analysis, highlighting the final-stroke stiffness; during the lift record force and stroke at each stroke and compare with the curve, stopping when deviation exceeds the threshold; before pinning measure the relative position of cable ends and anchor holes and pin only after synchronisation and geometry are confirmed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：提升張拉計畫須把最後行程獨立成一個階段，規定較小的行程增量、同步門檻、量測頻率與決策人；臨時延伸桿與吊耳要依最大力設計並有試驗紀錄，本課只說明檢核邏輯，實際作業須依核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lift-and-tension plan must treat the final stroke as a separate stage with smaller stroke increments, synchronisation thresholds, measurement frequency and a named decision-maker; temporary extension bars and lugs must be designed for maximum force with test records, and this course explains checking logic only, actual work following an approved procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：最後行程中某台千斤頂落後，因勁度極高，相鄰索的力瞬間升高數百 kN，臨時延伸桿或吊耳超載斷裂；以為力量已到卻是摩擦造成的假讀數，插銷後索力不足，網面形狀偏離設計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If one jack lags during the final stroke, the very high stiffness raises force in neighbouring cables by hundreds of kilonewtons in moments, overloading and breaking temporary extension bars or lugs; a false reading caused by friction can suggest force has been reached when it has not, leaving the cable short of force after pinning and the surface off its design shape. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
