steps.title: 輪輻式索網的地面組裝、提升與張拉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground assembly, lifting and tensioning of spoked-wheel nets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「提升張拉的最後行程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Final stroke of lift-and-tension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 最後行程中某台千斤頂落後，因勁度極高，相鄰索的力瞬間升高數百 kN，臨時延伸桿或吊耳超載斷裂；以為力量已到卻是摩擦造成的假讀數，插銷後索力不足，網面形狀偏離設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If one jack lags during the final stroke, the very high stiffness raises force in neighbouring cables by hundreds of kilonewtons in moments, overloading and breaking temporary extension bars or lugs; a false reading caused by friction can suggest force has been reached when it has not, leaving the cable short of force after pinning and the surface off its design shape. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此最後行程的控制最關鍵：所有千斤頂必須同步，臨時延伸桿要能承受全力，插銷時索力已接近完成狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Control of the final stroke is therefore most critical: all jacks must be synchronised, temporary extension bars must carry full force, and when the pins go in the cable force is already close to its final state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升張拉時最難的是剛離地的時候，接近完成時只要慢慢拉就好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The hardest part of lift-and-tension is lift-off; near completion the jacks simply pull slowly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 最後行程中某台千斤頂落後，因勁度極高，相鄰索的力瞬間升高數百 kN，臨時延伸桿或吊耳超載斷裂；以為力量已到卻是摩擦造成的假讀數，插銷後索力不足，網面形狀偏離設計。
knowledge.textEn: If one jack lags during the final stroke, the very high stiffness raises force in neighbouring cables by hundreds of kilonewtons in moments, overloading and breaking temporary extension bars or lugs; a false reading caused by friction can suggest force has been reached when it has not, leaving the cable short of force after pinning and the surface off its design shape.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪輻式索網的地面組裝、提升與張拉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ground assembly, lifting and tensioning of spoked-wheel nets" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。
最後行程中某台千斤頂落後，因勁度極高，相鄰索的力瞬間升高數百 kN，臨時延伸桿或吊耳超載斷裂。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right.
If one jack lags during the final stroke, the very high stiffness raises force in neighbouring cables by hundreds of kilonewtons in moments, overloading and breaking temporary extension bars or lugs.
quiz.explanation: 最後行程中某台千斤頂落後，因勁度極高，相鄰索的力瞬間升高數百 kN，臨時延伸桿或吊耳超載斷裂；以為力量已到卻是摩擦造成的假讀數，插銷後索力不足，網面形狀偏離設計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If one jack lags during the final stroke, the very high stiffness raises force in neighbouring cables by hundreds of kilonewtons in moments, overloading and breaking temporary extension bars or lugs; a false reading caused by friction can suggest force has been reached when it has not, leaving the cable short of force after pinning and the surface off its design shape. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「力與幾何雙重控制」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dual force and geometry control” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 張拉驗收有兩種主軸：以力控制（每根索拉到目標力，形狀隨之產生）與以幾何控制（每根索拉到目標長度或銷孔位置，力隨之產生）。固定長度的索網本質上是幾何控制，力由索長決定；可調索則可以力控制。實務上兩者要互相驗證：力對了但幾何偏差大，代表索長或邊界有誤；幾何對了但力偏差大，代表勁度或摩擦假設有誤。哪一個量比較敏感，取決於索的垂度：垂度越淺，長度誤差造成的力誤差越大。卡加利 Saddledome 施工時，混凝土板需要多次調整才能嵌入索之間，也顯示索網幾何與覆面構件之間的配合難度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「力與幾何雙重控制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tensioning acceptance has two axes: force control, pulling each cable to a target force and letting shape follow, and geometry control, pulling each cable to a target length or pin position and letting force follow. A net of fixed-length cables is essentially geometry-controlled, its forces set by cable lengths, while adjustable cables allow force control. In practice the two must cross-check: correct force with large geometric deviation points to cable-length or boundary errors, while correct geometry with large force deviation points to wrong stiffness or friction assumptions. Which quantity is more sensitive depends on sag: the shallower the sag, the larger the force error from a length error. At Calgary's Saddledome the concrete slabs needed numerous adjustments to fit between the cables, showing how hard it is to match net geometry with cladding elements. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dual force and geometry control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：近似不伸長的垂索，長度變化 ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L)，且 ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f，合併得 ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a nearly inextensible sagging cable, the length change is ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L) and ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f, so ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「力與幾何雙重控制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dual force and geometry control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主
knowledge.text: 張拉驗收有兩種主軸：以力控制（每根索拉到目標力，形狀隨之產生）與以幾何控制（每根索拉到目標長度或銷孔位置，力隨之產生）。固定長度的索網本質上是幾何控制，力由索長決定；可調索則可以力控制。
knowledge.textEn: Tensioning acceptance has two axes: force control, pulling each cable to a target force and letting shape follow, and geometry control, pulling each cable to a target length or pin position and letting force follow. A net of fixed-length cables is essentially geometry-controlled, its forces set by cable lengths, while adjustable cables allow force control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led" is correct?
options: 張拉驗收有兩種主軸：以力控制（每根索拉到目標力，形狀隨之產生）與以幾何控制（每根索拉到目標長度或銷孔位置，力隨之產生）。
張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。
頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。
optionsEn: Tensioning acceptance has two axes: force control, pulling each cable to a target force and letting shape follow, and geometry control, pulling each cable to a target length or pin position and letting force follow.
If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right.
With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly.
quiz.explanation: 張拉驗收有兩種主軸：以力控制（每根索拉到目標力，形狀隨之產生）與以幾何控制（每根索拉到目標長度或銷孔位置，力隨之產生）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tensioning acceptance has two axes: force control, pulling each cable to a target force and letting shape follow, and geometry control, pulling each cable to a target length or pin position and letting force follow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「力與幾何雙重控制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dual force and geometry control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：近似不伸長的垂索，長度變化 ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L)，且 ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f，合併得 ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²)。L = 40 m、ΔS = 10 mm：垂度 f = 2.0 m 時張力誤差約 3×40×0.01/(16×4) ≈ 1.9%；f = 0.8 m 時約 11.7%，敏感度隨 1/f² 增加。忽略彈性伸長，數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a nearly inextensible sagging cable, the length change is ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L) and ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f, so ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²). With L = 40 m and ΔS = 10 mm, a sag f = 2.0 m gives about 3×40×0.01/(16×4) ≈ 1.9% tension error, while f = 0.8 m gives about 11.7%: sensitivity grows as 1/f². Elastic stretch is ignored and the values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收準則同時列出力與幾何兩組允差（例如索力 ±10%、節點座標 ±30 mm），並依各索垂度決定以哪一項為主控；量測後若只有一項超出，依前述邏輯判斷原因，再由設計者決定調整索長、邊界或接受偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set acceptance criteria for both force and geometry, for example cable force ±10% and node coordinates ±30 mm, deciding from each cable's sag which one governs; if only one is exceeded after measurement, diagnose the cause by the logic above and let the designer decide whether to adjust cable length, adjust boundaries or accept the deviation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 近似不伸長的垂索，長度變化 ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L)，且 ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f，合併得 ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²)。L = 40 m、ΔS = 10 mm：垂度 f = 2.0 m 時張力誤差約 3×40×0.01/(16×4) ≈ 1.9%；f = 0.8 m 時約 11.7%，敏感度隨 1/f² 增加。忽略彈性伸長，數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a nearly inextensible sagging cable, the length change is ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L) and ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f, so ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²). With L = 40 m and ΔS = 10 mm, a sag f = 2.0 m gives about 3×40×0.01/(16×4) ≈ 1.9% tension error, while f = 0.8 m gives about 11.7%: sensitivity grows as 1/f². Elastic stretch is ignored and the values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led", which statement holds?
options: 索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。
近似不伸長的垂索，長度變化 ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L)，且 ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f，合併得 ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²)。
索網的預拉力越大越安全。
optionsEn: Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem.
For a nearly inextensible sagging cable, the length change is ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L) and ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f, so ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²).
The more prestress a cable net has, the safer it is.
quiz.explanation: 近似不伸長的垂索，長度變化 ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L)，且 ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f，合併得 ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a nearly inextensible sagging cable, the length change is ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L) and ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f, so ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「力與幾何雙重控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dual force and geometry control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 驗收準則同時列出力與幾何兩組允差（例如索力 ±10%、節點座標 ±30 mm），並依各索垂度決定以哪一項為主控；量測後若只有一項超出，依前述邏輯判斷原因，再由設計者決定調整索長、邊界或接受偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set acceptance criteria for both force and geometry, for example cable force ±10% and node coordinates ±30 mm, deciding from each cable's sag which one governs; if only one is exceeded after measurement, diagnose the cause by the logic above and let the designer decide whether to adjust cable length, adjust boundaries or accept the deviation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：張拉程序書須寫明主控量（力或幾何）、副控量與兩者的允差，並規定覆面構件只能在索網張拉驗收完成後安裝；任何超出允差的處置都須由結構設計者書面決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The tensioning procedure must state the governing quantity, force or geometry, the secondary one and tolerances for both, and allow cladding installation only after net tensioning has been accepted; any action on out-of-tolerance results must be decided in writing by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以千斤頂力驗收，淺垂度區索長偏短卻因摩擦讀數看似正確，實際張力遠高於設計；只以幾何驗收，則錨具摩擦或邊界變形造成的力誤差被忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting by jack force alone can miss a short cable in a shallow zone whose friction-affected reading looks right while its real tension is far above design; accepting by geometry alone ignores force errors caused by anchorage friction or boundary deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收準則同時列出力與幾何兩組允差（例如索力 ±10%、節點座標 ±30 mm），並依各索垂度決定以哪一項為主控；量測後若只有一項超出，依前述邏輯判斷原因，再由設計者決定調整索長、邊界或接受偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Set acceptance criteria for both force and geometry, for example cable force ±10% and node coordinates ±30 mm, deciding from each cable's sag which one governs; if only one is exceeded after measurement, diagnose the cause by the logic above and let the designer decide whether to adjust cable length, adjust boundaries or accept the deviation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 張拉程序書須寫明主控量（力或幾何）、副控量與兩者的允差，並規定覆面構件只能在索網張拉驗收完成後安裝；任何超出允差的處置都須由結構設計者書面決定。
knowledge.textEn: The tensioning procedure must state the governing quantity, force or geometry, the secondary one and tolerances for both, and allow cladding installation only after net tensioning has been accepted; any action on out-of-tolerance results must be decided in writing by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。
驗收準則同時列出力與幾何兩組允差（例如索力 ±10%、節點座標 ±30 mm），並依各索垂度決定以哪一項為主控。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation.
Set acceptance criteria for both force and geometry, for example cable force ±10% and node coordinates ±30 mm, deciding from each cable's sag which one governs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收準則同時列出力與幾何兩組允差（例如索力 ±10%、節點座標 ±30 mm），並依各索垂度決定以哪一項為主控；量測後若只有一項超出，依前述邏輯判斷原因，再由設計者決定調整索長、邊界或接受偏差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set acceptance criteria for both force and geometry, for example cable force ±10% and node coordinates ±30 mm, deciding from each cable's sag which one governs; if only one is exceeded after measurement, diagnose the cause by the logic above and let the designer decide whether to adjust cable length, adjust boundaries or accept the deviation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「力與幾何雙重控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dual force and geometry control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以千斤頂力驗收，淺垂度區索長偏短卻因摩擦讀數看似正確，實際張力遠高於設計；只以幾何驗收，則錨具摩擦或邊界變形造成的力誤差被忽略。覆面構件若在索網幾何未穩定時就安裝，往往需要大量現場修改。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting by jack force alone can miss a short cable in a shallow zone whose friction-affected reading looks right while its real tension is far above design; accepting by geometry alone ignores force errors caused by anchorage friction or boundary deformation. Installing cladding before net geometry has stabilised often demands extensive site modification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：卡加利 Saddledome 施工時，混凝土板需要多次調整才能嵌入索之間，也顯示索網幾何與覆面構件之間的配合難度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At Calgary's Saddledome the concrete slabs needed numerous adjustments to fit between the cables, showing how hard it is to match net geometry with cladding elements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以千斤頂力驗收，淺垂度區索長偏短卻因摩擦讀數看似正確，實際張力遠高於設計；只以幾何驗收，則錨具摩擦或邊界變形造成的力誤差被忽略。覆面構件若在索網幾何未穩定時就安裝，往往需要大量現場修改。
knowledge.textEn: Accepting by jack force alone can miss a short cable in a shallow zone whose friction-affected reading looks right while its real tension is far above design; accepting by geometry alone ignores force errors caused by anchorage friction or boundary deformation. Installing cladding before net geometry has stabilised often demands extensive site modification.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只以千斤頂力驗收，淺垂度區索長偏短卻因摩擦讀數看似正確，實際張力遠高於設計；只以幾何驗收，則錨具摩擦或邊界變形造成的力誤差被忽略。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。
optionsEn: Accepting by jack force alone can miss a short cable in a shallow zone whose friction-affected reading looks right while its real tension is far above design.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly.
quiz.explanation: 只以千斤頂力驗收，淺垂度區索長偏短卻因摩擦讀數看似正確，實際張力遠高於設計；只以幾何驗收，則錨具摩擦或邊界變形造成的力誤差被忽略。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accepting by jack force alone can miss a short cable in a shallow zone whose friction-affected reading looks right while its real tension is far above design; accepting by geometry alone ignores force errors caused by anchorage friction or boundary deformation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「以振動頻率量測索力」與「完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring cable force from vibration frequency" and "Completion load test and node-displacement check": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 以振動頻率量測索力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measuring cable force from vibration frequency: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頻率法量測索力」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency method for cable force” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 完成的索網大多數索沒有千斤頂可以頂升量測，因此常用振動頻率法：在索上裝加速度計，記錄環境振動或輕敲後的自由振動，找出基本頻率，再以張緊弦公式反算張力。這方法快速、非破壞，適合大量索的普查與長期監測；但索的有效長度（索夾與錨具的約束位置）、抗彎勁度與垂度都會影響頻率，短而粗的索誤差尤其大。因此需要先在可以頂升量測的索上校正，再推廣到其他索。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頻率法量測索力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most cables in a finished net have no jack for a lift-off test, so the vibration frequency method is common: an accelerometer on the cable records ambient or tap-induced free vibration, the fundamental frequency is identified and tension back-calculated with the taut-string formula. The method is fast and non-destructive, suiting surveys of many cables and long-term monitoring; but effective length (where clamps and anchorages restrain the cable), bending stiffness and sag all affect frequency, with especially large errors for short, thick cables. It is therefore calibrated first on cables that can be lift-off tested and then extended to the others. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Frequency method for cable force” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：張緊弦 T = 4mL²f₁²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a taut string T = 4mL²f₁².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頻率法量測索力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Frequency method for cable force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以振動頻率量測索力
knowledge.titleEn: Measuring cable force from vibration frequency
knowledge.text: 完成的索網大多數索沒有千斤頂可以頂升量測，因此常用振動頻率法：在索上裝加速度計，記錄環境振動或輕敲後的自由振動，找出基本頻率，再以張緊弦公式反算張力。這方法快速、非破壞，適合大量索的普查與長期監測；但索的有效長度（索夾與錨具的約束位置）、抗彎勁度與垂度都會影響頻率，短而粗的索誤差尤其大。
knowledge.textEn: Most cables in a finished net have no jack for a lift-off test, so the vibration frequency method is common: an accelerometer on the cable records ambient or tap-induced free vibration, the fundamental frequency is identified and tension back-calculated with the taut-string formula. The method is fast and non-destructive, suiting surveys of many cables and long-term monitoring; but effective length (where clamps and anchorages restrain the cable), bending stiffness and sag all affect frequency, with especially large errors for short, thick cables.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以振動頻率量測索力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring cable force from vibration frequency" is correct?
options: 頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。
完成的索網大多數索沒有千斤頂可以頂升量測，因此常用振動頻率法：在索上裝加速度計，記錄環境振動或輕敲後的自由振動，找出基本頻率，再以張緊弦公式反算張力。
索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。
optionsEn: With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly.

Most cables in a finished net have no jack for a lift-off test, so the vibration frequency method is common: an accelerometer on the cable records ambient or tap-induced free vibration, the fundamental frequency is identified and tension back-calculated with the taut-string formula.
A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction.
quiz.explanation: 完成的索網大多數索沒有千斤頂可以頂升量測，因此常用振動頻率法：在索上裝加速度計，記錄環境振動或輕敲後的自由振動，找出基本頻率，再以張緊弦公式反算張力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most cables in a finished net have no jack for a lift-off test, so the vibration frequency method is common: an accelerometer on the cable records ambient or tap-induced free vibration, the fundamental frequency is identified and tension back-calculated with the taut-string formula. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以振動頻率量測索力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring cable force from vibration frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率法量測索力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency method for cable force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：張緊弦 T = 4mL²f₁²。單位長質量 m = 25 kg/m、有效長度 L = 40 m、量得基頻 f₁ = 2.0 Hz：T = 4×25×40²×2.0² = 640,000 N = 640 kN。因 T 與 L² 成正比，有效長度若誤估 2%，張力誤差約 4%；頻率誤差 2% 也造成約 4% 的張力誤差。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a taut string T = 4mL²f₁². With mass per length m = 25 kg/m, effective length L = 40 m and a measured fundamental f₁ = 2.0 Hz: T = 4×25×40²×2.0² = 640,000 N = 640 kN. Because T scales with L², a 2% error in effective length gives about 4% error in tension, and a 2% frequency error also about 4%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：選擇數根可頂升量測的索，同時做頂升試驗與頻率量測，求出修正係數（含抗彎勁度與邊界條件）；量測時記錄溫度與風況，取多個高階頻率檢查是否符合等差關係，以判斷弦公式是否適用；結果與分析預測及完工基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Choose several cables that can be lift-off tested and do both lift-off and frequency measurements to derive correction factors for bending stiffness and boundary conditions; record temperature and wind, and check whether several higher frequencies follow an arithmetic series to judge whether the string formula applies; compare results with predictions and the as-built baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 張緊弦 T = 4mL²f₁²。單位長質量 m = 25 kg/m、有效長度 L = 40 m、量得基頻 f₁ = 2.0 Hz：T = 4×25×40²×2.0² = 640,000 N = 640 kN。因 T 與 L² 成正比，有效長度若誤估 2%，張力誤差約 4%；頻率誤差 2% 也造成約 4% 的張力誤差。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a taut string T = 4mL²f₁². With mass per length m = 25 kg/m, effective length L = 40 m and a measured fundamental f₁ = 2.0 Hz: T = 4×25×40²×2.0² = 640,000 N = 640 kN. Because T scales with L², a 2% error in effective length gives about 4% error in tension, and a 2% frequency error also about 4%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以振動頻率量測索力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring cable force from vibration frequency", which statement holds?
options: 索網的每根索都很強，所以不需要考慮任何一根失效的情況。
輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。
張緊弦 T = 4mL²f₁²。
optionsEn: Every cable in a net is strong, so the loss of any single cable need not be considered.
A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check.
For a taut string T = 4mL²f₁².
quiz.explanation: 張緊弦 T = 4mL²f₁²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a taut string T = 4mL²f₁². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以振動頻率量測索力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring cable force from vibration frequency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻率法量測索力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frequency method for cable force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 選擇數根可頂升量測的索，同時做頂升試驗與頻率量測，求出修正係數（含抗彎勁度與邊界條件）；量測時記錄溫度與風況，取多個高階頻率檢查是否符合等差關係，以判斷弦公式是否適用；結果與分析預測及完工基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Choose several cables that can be lift-off tested and do both lift-off and frequency measurements to derive correction factors for bending stiffness and boundary conditions; record temperature and wind, and check whether several higher frequencies follow an arithmetic series to judge whether the string formula applies; compare results with predictions and the as-built baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：頻率法量測計畫要寫明感測器位置、取樣長度、有效長度定義、校正方法與各索的修正係數，結果附原始頻譜；監測系統的索與完工基準使用同一套修正係數，才能比較長期變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A frequency-method plan should state sensor positions, record length, effective-length definition, calibration method and each cable's correction factor, with raw spectra attached; monitored cables should use the same correction factors as the as-built baseline so long-term changes are comparable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未校正就以理論公式計算短索的張力，抗彎勁度使頻率偏高，算出的張力被高估，鬆弛的索被誤判為正常；有效長度量錯（例如把索夾當成自由），整批資料系統性偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying the theoretical formula to short cables without calibration lets bending stiffness raise the frequency so tension is overestimated and slack cables pass as normal; a wrong effective length, such as treating a clamp as free, biases a whole data set systematically. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 選擇數根可頂升量測的索，同時做頂升試驗與頻率量測，求出修正係數（含抗彎勁度與邊界條件）；量測時記錄溫度與風況，取多個高階頻率檢查是否符合等差關係，以判斷弦公式是否適用；結果與分析預測及完工基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: Choose several cables that can be lift-off tested and do both lift-off and frequency measurements to derive correction factors for bending stiffness and boundary conditions; record temperature and wind, and check whether several higher frequencies follow an arithmetic series to judge whether the string formula applies; compare results with predictions and the as-built baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 頻率法量測計畫要寫明感測器位置、取樣長度、有效長度定義、校正方法與各索的修正係數，結果附原始頻譜；監測系統的索與完工基準使用同一套修正係數，才能比較長期變化。
knowledge.textEn: A frequency-method plan should state sensor positions, record length, effective-length definition, calibration method and each cable's correction factor, with raw spectra attached; monitored cables should use the same correction factors as the as-built baseline so long-term changes are comparable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以振動頻率量測索力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring cable force from vibration frequency"?
options: 選擇數根可頂升量測的索，同時做頂升試驗與頻率量測，求出修正係數（含抗彎勁度與邊界條件）。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。
optionsEn: Choose several cables that can be lift-off tested and do both lift-off and frequency measurements to derive correction factors for bending stiffness and boundary conditions.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle.
quiz.explanation: 選擇數根可頂升量測的索，同時做頂升試驗與頻率量測，求出修正係數（含抗彎勁度與邊界條件）；量測時記錄溫度與風況，取多個高階頻率檢查是否符合等差關係，以判斷弦公式是否適用；結果與分析預測及完工基準比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Choose several cables that can be lift-off tested and do both lift-off and frequency measurements to derive correction factors for bending stiffness and boundary conditions; record temperature and wind, and check whether several higher frequencies follow an arithmetic series to judge whether the string formula applies; compare results with predictions and the as-built baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以振動頻率量測索力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring cable force from vibration frequency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率法量測索力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frequency method for cable force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未校正就以理論公式計算短索的張力，抗彎勁度使頻率偏高，算出的張力被高估，鬆弛的索被誤判為正常；有效長度量錯（例如把索夾當成自由），整批資料系統性偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying the theoretical formula to short cables without calibration lets bending stiffness raise the frequency so tension is overestimated and slack cables pass as normal; a wrong effective length, such as treating a clamp as free, biases a whole data set systematically. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此需要先在可以頂升量測的索上校正，再推廣到其他索。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is therefore calibrated first on cables that can be lift-off tested and then extended to the others.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未校正就以理論公式計算短索的張力，抗彎勁度使頻率偏高，算出的張力被高估，鬆弛的索被誤判為正常；有效長度量錯（例如把索夾當成自由），整批資料系統性偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Applying the theoretical formula to short cables without calibration lets bending stiffness raise the frequency so tension is overestimated and slack cables pass as normal; a wrong effective length, such as treating a clamp as free, biases a whole data set systematically.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「以振動頻率量測索力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measuring cable force from vibration frequency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
未校正就以理論公式計算短索的張力，抗彎勁度使頻率偏高，算出的張力被高估，鬆弛的索被誤判為正常；有效長度量錯（例如把索夾當成自由），整批資料系統性偏差。
索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying the theoretical formula to short cables without calibration lets bending stiffness raise the frequency so tension is overestimated and slack cables pass as normal.
A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction.
quiz.explanation: 未校正就以理論公式計算短索的張力，抗彎勁度使頻率偏高，算出的張力被高估，鬆弛的索被誤判為正常；有效長度量錯（例如把索夾當成自由），整批資料系統性偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying the theoretical formula to short cables without calibration lets bending stiffness raise the frequency so tension is overestimated and slack cables pass as normal; a wrong effective length, such as treating a clamp as free, biases a whole data set systematically. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Completion load test and node-displacement check: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「水袋載重試驗」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water-bag load test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 載重試驗直接驗證索網在已知荷載下的勁度是否與分析一致，是確認預拉力與幾何的整體方法。常以水袋或砂袋在指定區域施加均布荷載，量測代表性節點的撓度、相鄰索力與邊界構件變形，卸載後再量測恢復量。若實測撓度明顯大於預測，可能預拉力偏低或索的模數較小；若無法恢復，可能有索夾滑移或錨具沉陷。試驗荷載要分級施加，並在每一級確認沒有異常後才繼續。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「水袋載重試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A load test checks directly whether the net's stiffness under known load matches the analysis, an overall confirmation of prestress and geometry. Water or sand bags apply uniform load over a defined area, and deflection at representative nodes, adjacent cable forces and boundary-member deformation are measured, then recovery after unloading. Measured deflection clearly above prediction suggests low prestress or a lower cable modulus; incomplete recovery suggests clamp slip or anchorage settlement. Test load is applied in stages, each continuing only when no anomaly is seen. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Water-bag load test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：在 20 m × 20 m 區域施加 0.5 kPa 水袋荷載，總荷載 0.5×400 = 200 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Water bags at 0.5 kPa over a 20 m × 20 m area give a total of 0.5×400 = 200 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「水袋載重試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Water-bag load test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Completion load test and node-displacement check
knowledge.text: 載重試驗直接驗證索網在已知荷載下的勁度是否與分析一致，是確認預拉力與幾何的整體方法。常以水袋或砂袋在指定區域施加均布荷載，量測代表性節點的撓度、相鄰索力與邊界構件變形，卸載後再量測恢復量。
knowledge.textEn: A load test checks directly whether the net's stiffness under known load matches the analysis, an overall confirmation of prestress and geometry. Water or sand bags apply uniform load over a defined area, and deflection at representative nodes, adjacent cable forces and boundary-member deformation are measured, then recovery after unloading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Completion load test and node-displacement check" is correct?
options: 索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。
索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。
載重試驗直接驗證索網在已知荷載下的勁度是否與分析一致，是確認預拉力與幾何的整體方法。
optionsEn: A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction.
Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem.
A load test checks directly whether the net's stiffness under known load matches the analysis, an overall confirmation of prestress and geometry.
quiz.explanation: 載重試驗直接驗證索網在已知荷載下的勁度是否與分析一致，是確認預拉力與幾何的整體方法。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A load test checks directly whether the net's stiffness under known load matches the analysis, an overall confirmation of prestress and geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Completion load test and node-displacement check: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水袋載重試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water-bag load test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 20 m × 20 m 區域施加 0.5 kPa 水袋荷載，總荷載 0.5×400 = 200 kN。預測中心撓度 85 mm，實測 98 mm，超出約 15%；若驗收準則為實測不超過預測的 1.10 倍，則不合格，需檢查預拉力。卸載後殘留 6 mm，恢復率 (98 − 6)/98 ≈ 94%，若準則為 90% 則合格。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Water bags at 0.5 kPa over a 20 m × 20 m area give a total of 0.5×400 = 200 kN. The predicted centre deflection is 85 mm and the measured 98 mm, about 15% higher; against a criterion of measured not more than 1.10 times predicted this fails and prestress must be checked. A 6 mm residual after unloading means a recovery of (98 − 6)/98 ≈ 94%, passing a 90% criterion. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫事先寫明荷載區域、分級、停留時間、量測點、預測值與允收準則；量測在溫度穩定時段進行並記錄溫度；每一級比較實測與預測，超出警戒即停止加載；試驗後檢查索夾標記與錨具。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The test plan states in advance the loaded area, stages, hold times, measurement points, predictions and acceptance criteria; measure at stable temperature and record it; compare measured and predicted at each stage and stop loading at the alarm level; inspect clamp marks and anchorages after the test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 在 20 m × 20 m 區域施加 0.5 kPa 水袋荷載，總荷載 0.5×400 = 200 kN。預測中心撓度 85 mm，實測 98 mm，超出約 15%；若驗收準則為實測不超過預測的 1.10 倍，則不合格，需檢查預拉力。卸載後殘留 6 mm，恢復率 (98 − 6)/98 ≈ 94%，若準則為 90% 則合格。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Water bags at 0.5 kPa over a 20 m × 20 m area give a total of 0.5×400 = 200 kN. The predicted centre deflection is 85 mm and the measured 98 mm, about 15% higher; against a criterion of measured not more than 1.10 times predicted this fails and prestress must be checked. A 6 mm residual after unloading means a recovery of (98 − 6)/98 ≈ 94%, passing a 90% criterion. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Completion load test and node-displacement check", which statement holds?
options: 在 20 m × 20 m 區域施加 0.5 kPa 水袋荷載，總荷載 0.5×400 = 200 kN。
索網的預拉力越大越安全。
鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。
optionsEn: Water bags at 0.5 kPa over a 20 m × 20 m area give a total of 0.5×400 = 200 kN.
The more prestress a cable net has, the safer it is.
A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation.
quiz.explanation: 在 20 m × 20 m 區域施加 0.5 kPa 水袋荷載，總荷載 0.5×400 = 200 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Water bags at 0.5 kPa over a 20 m × 20 m area give a total of 0.5×400 = 200 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Completion load test and node-displacement check: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水袋載重試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water-bag load test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫事先寫明荷載區域、分級、停留時間、量測點、預測值與允收準則；量測在溫度穩定時段進行並記錄溫度；每一級比較實測與預測，超出警戒即停止加載；試驗後檢查索夾標記與錨具。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The test plan states in advance the loaded area, stages, hold times, measurement points, predictions and acceptance criteria; measure at stable temperature and record it; compare measured and predicted at each stage and stop loading at the alarm level; inspect clamp marks and anchorages after the test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：載重試驗須由結構設計者訂定準則並在場見證，水袋加卸載與人員進出屬高處作業，須依核准程序執行；試驗結果與張拉驗收一起作為完工基準移交。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural designer sets the load-test criteria and witnesses the test; placing and removing water bags and access are work at height to be done under an approved procedure; results are handed over together with tensioning acceptance as the as-built baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一次把全部荷載放上去，若網面某處已鬆弛，荷載集中使覆面撕裂或索夾滑移；忽略溫度變化，把日照造成的撓度變化誤當成荷載效應，得出錯誤的勁度結論。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying the whole load at once can, where the net is already slack, concentrate load, tear cladding or slip clamps; ignoring temperature change can mistake solar-induced deflection for load effect and give wrong stiffness conclusions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫事先寫明荷載區域、分級、停留時間、量測點、預測值與允收準則；量測在溫度穩定時段進行並記錄溫度；每一級比較實測與預測，超出警戒即停止加載；試驗後檢查索夾標記與錨具。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan states in advance the loaded area, stages, hold times, measurement points, predictions and acceptance criteria; measure at stable temperature and record it; compare measured and predicted at each stage and stop loading at the alarm level; inspect clamp marks and anchorages after the test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 載重試驗須由結構設計者訂定準則並在場見證，水袋加卸載與人員進出屬高處作業，須依核准程序執行；試驗結果與張拉驗收一起作為完工基準移交。
knowledge.textEn: The structural designer sets the load-test criteria and witnesses the test; placing and removing water bags and access are work at height to be done under an approved procedure; results are handed over together with tensioning acceptance as the as-built baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Completion load test and node-displacement check"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
試驗計畫事先寫明荷載區域、分級、停留時間、量測點、預測值與允收準則。
提升張拉時最難的是剛離地的時候，接近完成時只要慢慢拉就好。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The test plan states in advance the loaded area, stages, hold times, measurement points, predictions and acceptance criteria.
The hardest part of lift-and-tension is lift-off; near completion the jacks simply pull slowly.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫事先寫明荷載區域、分級、停留時間、量測點、預測值與允收準則；量測在溫度穩定時段進行並記錄溫度；每一級比較實測與預測，超出警戒即停止加載；試驗後檢查索夾標記與錨具。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The test plan states in advance the loaded area, stages, hold times, measurement points, predictions and acceptance criteria; measure at stable temperature and record it; compare measured and predicted at each stage and stop loading at the alarm level; inspect clamp marks and anchorages after the test. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Completion load test and node-displacement check: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水袋載重試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water-bag load test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一次把全部荷載放上去，若網面某處已鬆弛，荷載集中使覆面撕裂或索夾滑移；忽略溫度變化，把日照造成的撓度變化誤當成荷載效應，得出錯誤的勁度結論。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying the whole load at once can, where the net is already slack, concentrate load, tear cladding or slip clamps; ignoring temperature change can mistake solar-induced deflection for load effect and give wrong stiffness conclusions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗荷載要分級施加，並在每一級確認沒有異常後才繼續。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Test load is applied in stages, each continuing only when no anomaly is seen.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一次把全部荷載放上去，若網面某處已鬆弛，荷載集中使覆面撕裂或索夾滑移；忽略溫度變化，把日照造成的撓度變化誤當成荷載效應，得出錯誤的勁度結論。
knowledge.textEn: Applying the whole load at once can, where the net is already slack, concentrate load, tear cladding or slip clamps; ignoring temperature change can mistake solar-induced deflection for load effect and give wrong stiffness conclusions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Completion load test and node-displacement check" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。
一次把全部荷載放上去，若網面某處已鬆弛，荷載集中使覆面撕裂或索夾滑移；忽略溫度變化，把日照造成的撓度變化誤當成荷載效應，得出錯誤的勁度結論。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem.
Applying the whole load at once can, where the net is already slack, concentrate load, tear cladding or slip clamps.
quiz.explanation: 一次把全部荷載放上去，若網面某處已鬆弛，荷載集中使覆面撕裂或索夾滑移；忽略溫度變化，把日照造成的撓度變化誤當成荷載效應，得出錯誤的勁度結論。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying the whole load at once can, where the net is already slack, concentrate load, tear cladding or slip clamps; ignoring temperature change can mistake solar-induced deflection for load effect and give wrong stiffness conclusions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移」與「單索失效、更換工程與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep" and "Single-cable loss, replacement engineering and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「日照溫差與鬆弛漂移」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solar temperature and relaxation drift” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼索在日照下升溫比混凝土受壓環快，索伸長而索力下降；冬夜則相反。對拉直的徑向索而言，幾度的溫差就能造成數個百分比的力變化，因此量測與驗收都要做溫度修正。長期來看，鋼絲應力鬆弛、索頭澆鑄材料潛變與鍍鋅層變形，都會讓索力緩慢流失；全封閉鋼索與平行鋼絞線束的行為也不同。監測系統的任務是把這些可預期的漂移與真正的異常（斷絲、錨具滑移、邊界沉陷）分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「日照溫差與鬆弛漂移」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel cables warm in sunshine faster than a concrete compression ring, lengthening and losing force; on winter nights the opposite happens. For a straight radial cable a few degrees of difference can change force by several percent, so measurements and acceptance need temperature correction. In the long term, wire stress relaxation, creep of socket filler and deformation of zinc coatings slowly reduce force, and locked-coil ropes and parallel strands behave differently. A monitoring system must separate these expected drifts from true anomalies such as broken wires, anchorage slip or boundary settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Solar temperature and relaxation drift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN，若索比受壓環高溫 20°C，索力變化 ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN，約為設計索力 3,000 kN 的 4.8%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN running 20°C warmer than the compression ring, the force change is ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN, about 4.8% of a 3,000 kN design force.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「日照溫差與鬆弛漂移」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Solar temperature and relaxation drift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移
knowledge.titleEn: Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep
knowledge.text: 鋼索在日照下升溫比混凝土受壓環快，索伸長而索力下降；冬夜則相反。對拉直的徑向索而言，幾度的溫差就能造成數個百分比的力變化，因此量測與驗收都要做溫度修正。
knowledge.textEn: Steel cables warm in sunshine faster than a concrete compression ring, lengthening and losing force; on winter nights the opposite happens. For a straight radial cable a few degrees of difference can change force by several percent, so measurements and acceptance need temperature correction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep" is correct?
options: 鋼索在日照下升溫比混凝土受壓環快，索伸長而索力下降；冬夜則相反。
索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。
索網的每根索都很強，所以不需要考慮任何一根失效的情況。
optionsEn: Steel cables warm in sunshine faster than a concrete compression ring, lengthening and losing force; on winter nights the opposite happens.
Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem.
Every cable in a net is strong, so the loss of any single cable need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 鋼索在日照下升溫比混凝土受壓環快，索伸長而索力下降；冬夜則相反。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steel cables warm in sunshine faster than a concrete compression ring, lengthening and losing force; on winter nights the opposite happens. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「日照溫差與鬆弛漂移」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Solar temperature and relaxation drift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN，若索比受壓環高溫 20°C，索力變化 ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN，約為設計索力 3,000 kN 的 4.8%。若再假設長期鬆弛 2%，冬季低溫時與夏季日照時的索力差可接近 7%。溫差與鬆弛率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN running 20°C warmer than the compression ring, the force change is ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN, about 4.8% of a 3,000 kN design force. With an assumed 2% long-term relaxation, the difference between cold winter and sunny summer force can approach 7%. Temperature difference and relaxation rate are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性索與受壓環上同時量測溫度，建立索力—溫差回歸關係，把監測資料修正到參考溫度後再看趨勢；每年比較修正後的索力與完工基準，扣除預期鬆弛後若仍有超出門檻的下降，啟動頂升量測與目視檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure temperatures on representative cables and on the compression ring together, establish a force–temperature-difference regression and correct monitoring data to the reference temperature before reading trends; each year compare corrected forces with the as-built baseline, and if a drop beyond the threshold remains after allowing for expected relaxation, trigger lift-off measurement and visual inspection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN，若索比受壓環高溫 20°C，索力變化 ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN，約為設計索力 3,000 kN 的 4.8%。若再假設長期鬆弛 2%，冬季低溫時與夏季日照時的索力差可接近 7%。溫差與鬆弛率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN running 20°C warmer than the compression ring, the force change is ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN, about 4.8% of a 3,000 kN design force. With an assumed 2% long-term relaxation, the difference between cold winter and sunny summer force can approach 7%. Temperature difference and relaxation rate are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep", which statement holds?
options: 輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。
徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN，若索比受壓環高溫 20°C，索力變化 ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN，約為設計索力 3,000 kN 的 4.8%。
受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。
optionsEn: A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check.
For a radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN running 20°C warmer than the compression ring, the force change is ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN, about 4.8% of a 3,000 kN design force.
A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle.
quiz.explanation: 徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN，若索比受壓環高溫 20°C，索力變化 ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN，約為設計索力 3,000 kN 的 4.8%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN running 20°C warmer than the compression ring, the force change is ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN, about 4.8% of a 3,000 kN design force. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「日照溫差與鬆弛漂移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Solar temperature and relaxation drift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性索與受壓環上同時量測溫度，建立索力—溫差回歸關係，把監測資料修正到參考溫度後再看趨勢；每年比較修正後的索力與完工基準，扣除預期鬆弛後若仍有超出門檻的下降，啟動頂升量測與目視檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure temperatures on representative cables and on the compression ring together, establish a force–temperature-difference regression and correct monitoring data to the reference temperature before reading trends; each year compare corrected forces with the as-built baseline, and if a drop beyond the threshold remains after allowing for expected relaxation, trigger lift-off measurement and visual inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測報告應同時呈現原始與溫度修正後的索力、所用修正模型、預期鬆弛曲線與警戒門檻；警戒觸發後的處置流程與決策人要事先寫入維護手冊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Monitoring reports should show raw and temperature-corrected forces, the correction model used, the expected relaxation curve and alarm thresholds; the response procedure and decision-maker after an alarm must be written into the maintenance manual in advance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未做溫度修正的監測資料隨季節大幅擺盪，真正的異常被淹沒在雜訊裡；反之把正常的季節變化當成異常，頻繁要求重新張拉，反而使索與錨具承受不必要的循環。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uncorrected monitoring data swing widely with the seasons, burying real anomalies in noise; conversely, treating normal seasonal change as an anomaly leads to frequent re-tensioning that subjects cables and anchorages to unnecessary cycles. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性索與受壓環上同時量測溫度，建立索力—溫差回歸關係，把監測資料修正到參考溫度後再看趨勢；每年比較修正後的索力與完工基準，扣除預期鬆弛後若仍有超出門檻的下降，啟動頂升量測與目視檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Measure temperatures on representative cables and on the compression ring together, establish a force–temperature-difference regression and correct monitoring data to the reference temperature before reading trends; each year compare corrected forces with the as-built baseline, and if a drop beyond the threshold remains after allowing for expected relaxation, trigger lift-off measurement and visual inspection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測報告應同時呈現原始與溫度修正後的索力、所用修正模型、預期鬆弛曲線與警戒門檻；警戒觸發後的處置流程與決策人要事先寫入維護手冊。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring reports should show raw and temperature-corrected forces, the correction model used, the expected relaxation curve and alarm thresholds; the response procedure and decision-maker after an alarm must be written into the maintenance manual in advance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。
在代表性索與受壓環上同時量測溫度，建立索力—溫差回歸關係，把監測資料修正到參考溫度後再看趨勢。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right.

Measure temperatures on representative cables and on the compression ring together, establish a force–temperature-difference regression and correct monitoring data to the reference temperature before reading trends.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性索與受壓環上同時量測溫度，建立索力—溫差回歸關係，把監測資料修正到參考溫度後再看趨勢；每年比較修正後的索力與完工基準，扣除預期鬆弛後若仍有超出門檻的下降，啟動頂升量測與目視檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure temperatures on representative cables and on the compression ring together, establish a force–temperature-difference regression and correct monitoring data to the reference temperature before reading trends; each year compare corrected forces with the as-built baseline, and if a drop beyond the threshold remains after allowing for expected relaxation, trigger lift-off measurement and visual inspection. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「日照溫差與鬆弛漂移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Solar temperature and relaxation drift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未做溫度修正的監測資料隨季節大幅擺盪，真正的異常被淹沒在雜訊裡；反之把正常的季節變化當成異常，頻繁要求重新張拉，反而使索與錨具承受不必要的循環。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncorrected monitoring data swing widely with the seasons, burying real anomalies in noise; conversely, treating normal seasonal change as an anomaly leads to frequent re-tensioning that subjects cables and anchorages to unnecessary cycles. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測系統的任務是把這些可預期的漂移與真正的異常（斷絲、錨具滑移、邊界沉陷）分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A monitoring system must separate these expected drifts from true anomalies such as broken wires, anchorage slip or boundary settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未做溫度修正的監測資料隨季節大幅擺盪，真正的異常被淹沒在雜訊裡；反之把正常的季節變化當成異常，頻繁要求重新張拉，反而使索與錨具承受不必要的循環。
knowledge.textEn: Uncorrected monitoring data swing widely with the seasons, burying real anomalies in noise; conversely, treating normal seasonal change as an anomaly leads to frequent re-tensioning that subjects cables and anchorages to unnecessary cycles.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未做溫度修正的監測資料隨季節大幅擺盪，真正的異常被淹沒在雜訊裡；反之把正常的季節變化當成異常，頻繁要求重新張拉，反而使索與錨具承受不必要的循環。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
索網的每根索都很強，所以不需要考慮任何一根失效的情況。
optionsEn: Uncorrected monitoring data swing widely with the seasons, burying real anomalies in noise.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Every cable in a net is strong, so the loss of any single cable need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 未做溫度修正的監測資料隨季節大幅擺盪，真正的異常被淹沒在雜訊裡；反之把正常的季節變化當成異常，頻繁要求重新張拉，反而使索與錨具承受不必要的循環。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uncorrected monitoring data swing widely with the seasons, burying real anomalies in noise; conversely, treating normal seasonal change as an anomaly leads to frequent re-tensioning that subjects cables and anchorages to unnecessary cycles. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 單索失效、更換工程與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Single-cable loss, replacement engineering and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「單索更換與冗餘」如何影響索網屋蓋張拉的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-cable replacement and redundancy” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-net roof tensioning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索網的使用年限常與建築相同，但個別索可能因腐蝕、斷絲或索頭問題需要更換。設計時就要回答：任何一根索失效時，相鄰索能否暫時承擔它的力而不連鎖破壞；更換時如何用臨時旁通索或千斤頂把力轉移出去，再分階段放鬆、拆除與安裝新索。Dorton 體育館 1952 年完成、2002 年獲 ASCE 列為國家歷史土木工程地標，這類歷史索結構的保存更依賴完整的原始資料與歷次檢修紀錄；卡加利 Saddledome 屋頂無法承受某些巡迴演出的重型吊掛，也提醒營運限制必須在交接時寫清楚。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「單索更換與冗餘」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cable net often shares the building's service life, yet individual cables may need replacement because of corrosion, broken wires or termination problems. Design must answer whether neighbouring cables can temporarily carry a lost cable's force without progressive failure, and how, during replacement, a temporary bypass cable or jacks can take the force out so the old cable can be released, removed and replaced in stages. Dorton Arena, completed in 1952 and designated a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark by ASCE in 2002, shows that conserving historic cable structures depends even more on complete original data and repair records; Calgary's Saddledome roof cannot carry the heavy rigs of some touring shows, a reminder that operating limits must be written clearly at handover. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Single-cable replacement and redundancy” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某徑向索設計力 H = 3,000 kN、最小破斷力 9,000 kN（安全係數 3.0）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A radial cable has design force H = 3,000 kN and minimum breaking load 9,000 kN (safety factor 3.0).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索網的每根索都很強，所以不需要考慮任何一根失效的情況。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every cable in a net is strong, so the loss of any single cable need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「單索更換與冗餘」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Single-cable replacement and redundancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單索失效、更換工程與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Single-cable loss, replacement engineering and handover
knowledge.text: 索網的使用年限常與建築相同，但個別索可能因腐蝕、斷絲或索頭問題需要更換。設計時就要回答：任何一根索失效時，相鄰索能否暫時承擔它的力而不連鎖破壞；更換時如何用臨時旁通索或千斤頂把力轉移出去，再分階段放鬆、拆除與安裝新索。
knowledge.textEn: A cable net often shares the building's service life, yet individual cables may need replacement because of corrosion, broken wires or termination problems. Design must answer whether neighbouring cables can temporarily carry a lost cable's force without progressive failure, and how, during replacement, a temporary bypass cable or jacks can take the force out so the old cable can be released, removed and replaced in stages.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：索網的每根索都很強，所以不需要考慮任何一根失效的情況。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every cable in a net is strong, so the loss of any single cable need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單索失效、更換工程與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single-cable loss, replacement engineering and handover" is correct?
options: 索網的每根索都很強，所以不需要考慮任何一根失效的情況。
索網的使用年限常與建築相同，但個別索可能因腐蝕、斷絲或索頭問題需要更換。
索網的預拉力越大越安全。
optionsEn: Every cable in a net is strong, so the loss of any single cable need not be considered.
A cable net often shares the building's service life, yet individual cables may need replacement because of corrosion, broken wires or termination problems.
The more prestress a cable net has, the safer it is.
quiz.explanation: 索網的使用年限常與建築相同，但個別索可能因腐蝕、斷絲或索頭問題需要更換。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cable net often shares the building's service life, yet individual cables may need replacement because of corrosion, broken wires or termination problems. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單索失效、更換工程與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-cable loss, replacement engineering and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單索更換與冗餘」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-cable replacement and redundancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某徑向索設計力 H = 3,000 kN、最小破斷力 9,000 kN（安全係數 3.0）。若該索失效、其力由兩側相鄰索各分擔一半，相鄰索升至 3,000 + 1,500 = 4,500 kN，利用率 4,500/9,000 = 0.50，剩餘安全係數 2.0。若相鄰索已因腐蝕損失 20% 斷面，破斷力約 7,200 kN，係數降到 1.6。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A radial cable has design force H = 3,000 kN and minimum breaking load 9,000 kN (safety factor 3.0). If it fails and its force is shared equally by the two neighbours, they rise to 3,000 + 1,500 = 4,500 kN, a utilisation of 4,500/9,000 = 0.50 and a residual safety factor of 2.0. If a neighbour has already lost 20% of its section to corrosion, its breaking load is about 7,200 kN and the factor drops to 1.6. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段做單索移除分析，確認各情境下相鄰索、索夾與受壓環的利用率；更換工程前以頂升與頻率法量測相鄰索現況，擬定臨時旁通與分階段放鬆程序，每一階段量測相鄰索力與網面幾何，確認符合分析後才繼續。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage run single-cable-removal analyses to confirm utilisation of neighbouring cables, clamps and compression ring in each scenario; before replacement measure neighbouring cables by lift-off and frequency methods, plan temporary bypass and staged release, and at each stage measure neighbouring forces and net geometry, continuing only when they match the analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

If it fails and its force is shared equally by the two neighbours, they rise to 3,000 + 1,500 = 4,500 kN, a utilisation of 4,500/9,000 = 0.50 and a residual safety factor of 2.0. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
