steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝計畫要列出每一吊次的重量、迎風面積、起重機組態、容許風速與量測位置，由吊裝工程師與起重機製造商確認；吊裝前以吊鉤高度的風速計即時讀值作為放行依據，並確認荷重力矩限制器與風速警報裝置電源與校正有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The lifting plan lists each lift's weight, windward area, crane configuration, allowable wind speed and where it is measured, confirmed by the lifting engineer and the crane manufacturer; release each lift on a live anemometer reading at hook height, and confirm that load-moment limiters and wind alarms are powered and calibrated.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 陣風 11.6 m/s 時 q = 0.5×1.225×11.6² ≈ 82 Pa；吊掛面積 1,200 m²、阻力係數 1.2，水平力 F = 82×1.2×1,200 ≈ 119 kN。構件重 400 t 即 3,924 kN，水平力約為重量的 3.0%，相當於吊鉤處持續的側向荷重，必須與起重機製造商的側載容許值比較。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A gust of 11.6 m/s gives q = 0.5×1.225×11.6² ≈ 82 Pa; on a suspended area of 1,200 m² with a drag coefficient of 1.2 the horizontal force is F = 82×1.2×1,200 ≈ 119 kN. A 400 t piece weighs 3,924 kN, so the horizontal force is about 3.0% of the weight, a sustained side load at the hook that must be compared with the crane manufacturer's side-load allowance. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk", which statement holds?
options: 只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。
屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。
optionsEn: A gust of 11.6 m/s gives q = 0.5×1.225×11.6² ≈ 82 Pa.
If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe.
If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails.
quiz.explanationEn: A gust of 11.6 m/s gives q = 0.5×1.225×11.6² ≈ 82 Pa; on a suspended area of 1,200 m² with a drag coefficient of 1.2 the horizontal force is F = 82×1.2×1,200 ≈ 119 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋面板吊裝作業」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roof-panel lifting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊裝計畫要列出每一吊次的重量、迎風面積、起重機組態、容許風速與量測位置，由吊裝工程師與起重機製造商確認；吊裝前以吊鉤高度的風速計即時讀值作為放行依據，並確認荷重力矩限制器與風速警報裝置電源與校正有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The lifting plan lists each lift's weight, windward area, crane configuration, allowable wind speed and where it is measured, confirmed by the lifting engineer and the crane manufacturer; release each lift on a live anemometer reading at hook height, and confirm that load-moment limiters and wind alarms are powered and calibrated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型屋面構件吊裝屬高風險作業，必須在施工計畫中設停檢點：吊裝工程師、起重機製造商代表與結構設計者共同簽認吊裝計畫，現場由指定人員依即時風速下達放行或停止，任何人都可喊停。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lifting large roof pieces is high-risk work that needs a hold point in the construction plan: the lifting engineer, the crane manufacturer's representative and the structural designer jointly sign off the lift plan, a named person releases or stops each lift on live wind readings, and anyone on site may call a stop.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只核對構件重量與起重機額定荷重，忽略風對大面積構件的側向力與擺動，起重機可能在看似「未超重」的情況下倒塌；臨時支撐拆除順序錯誤時，屋面板在轉移到轉向架前就可能因單點受力而局部變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only the piece weight against the crane rating while ignoring wind side load and swing on a large-area piece can topple a crane that seems within capacity; removing temporary supports in the wrong order can locally distort the panel through single-point loading before it is transferred onto its bogies. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫要列出每一吊次的重量、迎風面積、起重機組態、容許風速與量測位置，由吊裝工程師與起重機製造商確認；吊裝前以吊鉤高度的風速計即時讀值作為放行依據，並確認荷重力矩限制器與風速警報裝置電源與校正有效。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan lists each lift's weight, windward area, crane configuration, allowable wind speed and where it is measured, confirmed by the lifting engineer and the crane manufacturer; release each lift on a live anemometer reading at hook height, and confirm that load-moment limiters and wind alarms are powered and calibrated.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 大型屋面構件吊裝屬高風險作業，必須在施工計畫中設停檢點：吊裝工程師、起重機製造商代表與結構設計者共同簽認吊裝計畫，現場由指定人員依即時風速下達放行或停止，任何人都可喊停。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting large roof pieces is high-risk work that needs a hold point in the construction plan: the lifting engineer, the crane manufacturer's representative and the structural designer jointly sign off the lift plan, a named person releases or stops each lift on live wind readings, and anyone on site may call a stop.

quiz.question: 要驗證「屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
吊裝計畫要列出每一吊次的重量、迎風面積、起重機組態、容許風速與量測位置，由吊裝工程師與起重機製造商確認。
軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
The lifting plan lists each lift's weight, windward area, crane configuration, allowable wind speed and where it is measured, confirmed by the lifting engineer and the crane manufacturer.
Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝計畫要列出每一吊次的重量、迎風面積、起重機組態、容許風速與量測位置，由吊裝工程師與起重機製造商確認；吊裝前以吊鉤高度的風速計即時讀值作為放行依據，並確認荷重力矩限制器與風速警報裝置電源與校正有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The lifting plan lists each lift's weight, windward area, crane configuration, allowable wind speed and where it is measured, confirmed by the lifting engineer and the crane manufacturer; release each lift on a live anemometer reading at hook height, and confirm that load-moment limiters and wind alarms are powered and calibrated. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋面板吊裝作業」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof-panel lifting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只核對構件重量與起重機額定荷重，忽略風對大面積構件的側向力與擺動，起重機可能在看似「未超重」的情況下倒塌；臨時支撐拆除順序錯誤時，屋面板在轉移到轉向架前就可能因單點受力而局部變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only the piece weight against the crane rating while ignoring wind side load and swing on a large-area piece can topple a crane that seems within capacity; removing temporary supports in the wrong order can locally distort the panel through single-point loading before it is transferred onto its bogies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個事件讓可開合屋頂的安裝計畫必須把風對吊掛構件的作用納入正式計算與停工條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Since then, erection plans for retractable roofs must treat wind on suspended pieces as a formal calculation and stop-work condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要吊裝重量低於起重機額定荷重，風速多大都可以吊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只核對構件重量與起重機額定荷重，忽略風對大面積構件的側向力與擺動，起重機可能在看似「未超重」的情況下倒塌；臨時支撐拆除順序錯誤時，屋面板在轉移到轉向架前就可能因單點受力而局部變形。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only the piece weight against the crane rating while ignoring wind side load and swing on a large-area piece can topple a crane that seems within capacity; removing temporary supports in the wrong order can locally distort the panel through single-point loading before it is transferred onto its bogies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「屋面板安裝、臨時支撐與吊裝風險」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Panel erection, temporary support and lifting risk" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。
只核對構件重量與起重機額定荷重，忽略風對大面積構件的側向力與擺動，起重機可能在看似「未超重」的情況下倒塌。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback.
Checking only the piece weight against the crane rating while ignoring wind side load and swing on a large-area piece can topple a crane that seems within capacity.
quiz.explanation: 只核對構件重量與起重機額定荷重，忽略風對大面積構件的側向力與擺動，起重機可能在看似「未超重」的情況下倒塌；臨時支撐拆除順序錯誤時，屋面板在轉移到轉向架前就可能因單點受力而局部變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only the piece weight against the crane rating while ignoring wind side load and swing on a large-area piece can topple a crane that seems within capacity; removing temporary supports in the wrong order can locally distort the panel through single-point loading before it is transferred onto its bogies. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「軌道高程與軌距」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail level and gauge” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一片屋面板通常橫跨兩條以上的軌道，兩側驅動器若速度稍有差異，屋面板就會偏斜，輪緣頂住軌道並產生很大的側向力。長軌道與屋面板本身也會隨日照溫差伸縮，因此通常只讓一側車輪受導向約束，另一側容許橫向滑動。Rogers Centre 的控制系統更新案特別指出，限制偏斜差是避免屋面板卡死、錯位與閉合後留縫的關鍵；賓士體育場的控制系統則個別調整每片花瓣速度，讓路徑長短不同的花瓣同時到達終點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「軌道高程與軌距」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A panel usually spans two or more rails, and if the drives on each side run at slightly different speeds the panel skews, its flanges bear against the rails and large lateral forces develop. Long rails and the panel itself also expand and contract with solar temperature changes, so usually only one side's wheels are guided while the other side may slide laterally. The Rogers Centre control upgrade stressed that limiting skew differential is key to avoiding jamming, misalignment and gaps when closed, and Mercedes-Benz Stadium's control system adjusts each petal's speed individually so that petals with different path lengths arrive together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rail level and gauge” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m，表示 220 m 長的屋面板兩端相對位移約 106 mm，必須由滑動支承吸收。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m, so the ends of a 220 m panel move about 106 mm relative to each other and sliding bearings must absorb it.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「軌道高程與軌距」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rail level and gauge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制
knowledge.titleEn: Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control
knowledge.text: 一片屋面板通常橫跨兩條以上的軌道，兩側驅動器若速度稍有差異，屋面板就會偏斜，輪緣頂住軌道並產生很大的側向力。長軌道與屋面板本身也會隨日照溫差伸縮，因此通常只讓一側車輪受導向約束，另一側容許橫向滑動。
knowledge.textEn: A panel usually spans two or more rails, and if the drives on each side run at slightly different speeds the panel skews, its flanges bear against the rails and large lateral forces develop. Long rails and the panel itself also expand and contract with solar temperature changes, so usually only one side's wheels are guided while the other side may slide laterally.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control" is correct?
options: 一片屋面板通常橫跨兩條以上的軌道，兩側驅動器若速度稍有差異，屋面板就會偏斜，輪緣頂住軌道並產生很大的側向力。
兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。
屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。
optionsEn: A panel usually spans two or more rails, and if the drives on each side run at slightly different speeds the panel skews, its flanges bear against the rails and large lateral forces develop.
If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback.
Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site.
quiz.explanation: 一片屋面板通常橫跨兩條以上的軌道，兩側驅動器若速度稍有差異，屋面板就會偏斜，輪緣頂住軌道並產生很大的側向力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A panel usually spans two or more rails, and if the drives on each side run at slightly different speeds the panel skews, its flanges bear against the rails and large lateral forces develop. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌道高程與軌距」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail level and gauge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m，表示 220 m 長的屋面板兩端相對位移約 106 mm，必須由滑動支承吸收。偏斜：行走速度 0.12 m/s、兩側速度差 1% 時，偏斜每秒增加 1.2 mm，若容許偏斜 50 mm，控制系統必須在約 42 s 內完成修正。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m, so the ends of a 220 m panel move about 106 mm relative to each other and sliding bearings must absorb it. Skew: at 0.12 m/s with a 1% speed difference between sides, skew grows 1.2 mm per second; with a 50 mm allowance the controls must correct within about 42 s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全站儀與精密水準在固定溫度時段量測軌道中心線、軌距與軌頂高程，並記錄量測時的鋼構溫度；試運轉時以兩側位置編碼器或雷射測距比較屋面板兩端位置，確認自動修正在偏斜達警戒值前啟動，超過停止值時能安全停車。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey rail centrelines, gauge and rail-top levels with a total station and precise levelling at a fixed temperature window, recording steel temperature at the time; during commissioning compare the positions of both panel ends with encoders or laser rangefinders on each side, confirming that automatic correction starts before skew reaches the warning value and that the panel stops safely at the stop value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m，表示 220 m 長的屋面板兩端相對位移約 106 mm，必須由滑動支承吸收。偏斜：行走速度 0.12 m/s、兩側速度差 1% 時，偏斜每秒增加 1.2 mm，若容許偏斜 50 mm，控制系統必須在約 42 s 內完成修正。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m, so the ends of a 220 m panel move about 106 mm relative to each other and sliding bearings must absorb it. Skew: at 0.12 m/s with a 1% speed difference between sides, skew grows 1.2 mm per second; with a 50 mm allowance the controls must correct within about 42 s. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control", which statement holds?
options: 可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。
溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m，表示 220 m 長的屋面板兩端相對位移約 106 mm，必須由滑動支承吸收。
可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。
optionsEn: A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter.
Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m, so the ends of a 220 m panel move about 106 mm relative to each other and sliding bearings must absorb it.
A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position.
quiz.explanation: 溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m，表示 220 m 長的屋面板兩端相對位移約 106 mm，必須由滑動支承吸收。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×220×40 ≈ 0.106 m, so the ends of a 220 m panel move about 106 mm relative to each other and sliding bearings must absorb it. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軌道高程與軌距」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail level and gauge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全站儀與精密水準在固定溫度時段量測軌道中心線、軌距與軌頂高程，並記錄量測時的鋼構溫度；試運轉時以兩側位置編碼器或雷射測距比較屋面板兩端位置，確認自動修正在偏斜達警戒值前啟動，超過停止值時能安全停車。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey rail centrelines, gauge and rail-top levels with a total station and precise levelling at a fixed temperature window, recording steel temperature at the time; during commissioning compare the positions of both panel ends with encoders or laser rangefinders on each side, confirming that automatic correction starts before skew reaches the warning value and that the panel stops safely at the stop value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：軌道驗收要規定量測溫度條件與換算方法，偏斜控制需設警戒值、停止值與手動復位程序；導向側與自由側要在圖面與現場標示清楚，避免維修人員把自由側車輪換成導向輪。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Rail acceptance must state the survey temperature and correction method; skew control needs a warning value, a stop value and a manual reset procedure; mark guided and free sides clearly on the drawings and on site so that maintenance crews never swap a free-side wheel for a guided one.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩側都設導向輪而沒有預留溫度滑動，夏季高溫時屋面板被兩條軌道夾住，輪緣與軌道側面產生巨大側推力，可能剪斷軌道固定螺栓；偏斜控制失效時屋面板斜卡在軌道上，閉合後屋面板接縫無法對齊，雨水沿縫隙滲入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If both sides are guided with no allowance for thermal sliding, in summer heat the panel is clamped between the rails and huge lateral thrust develops at the flanges, which can shear rail fastening bolts; if skew control fails the panel jams askew, panel joints cannot align when closed and rainwater enters through the gaps. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全站儀與精密水準在固定溫度時段量測軌道中心線、軌距與軌頂高程，並記錄量測時的鋼構溫度；試運轉時以兩側位置編碼器或雷射測距比較屋面板兩端位置，確認自動修正在偏斜達警戒值前啟動，超過停止值時能安全停車。
knowledge.textEn: Survey rail centrelines, gauge and rail-top levels with a total station and precise levelling at a fixed temperature window, recording steel temperature at the time; during commissioning compare the positions of both panel ends with encoders or laser rangefinders on each side, confirming that automatic correction starts before skew reaches the warning value and that the panel stops safely at the stop value.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 軌道驗收要規定量測溫度條件與換算方法，偏斜控制需設警戒值、停止值與手動復位程序；導向側與自由側要在圖面與現場標示清楚，避免維修人員把自由側車輪換成導向輪。
knowledge.textEn: Rail acceptance must state the survey temperature and correction method; skew control needs a warning value, a stop value and a manual reset procedure; mark guided and free sides clearly on the drawings and on site so that maintenance crews never swap a free-side wheel for a guided one.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。
以全站儀與精密水準在固定溫度時段量測軌道中心線、軌距與軌頂高程，並記錄量測時的鋼構溫度。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.
Survey rail centrelines, gauge and rail-top levels with a total station and precise levelling at a fixed temperature window, recording steel temperature at the time.
quiz.explanation: 以全站儀與精密水準在固定溫度時段量測軌道中心線、軌距與軌頂高程，並記錄量測時的鋼構溫度；試運轉時以兩側位置編碼器或雷射測距比較屋面板兩端位置，確認自動修正在偏斜達警戒值前啟動，超過停止值時能安全停車。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey rail centrelines, gauge and rail-top levels with a total station and precise levelling at a fixed temperature window, recording steel temperature at the time; during commissioning compare the positions of both panel ends with encoders or laser rangefinders on each side, confirming that automatic correction starts before skew reaches the warning value and that the panel stops safely at the stop value. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軌道高程與軌距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail level and gauge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若兩側都設導向輪而沒有預留溫度滑動，夏季高溫時屋面板被兩條軌道夾住，輪緣與軌道側面產生巨大側推力，可能剪斷軌道固定螺栓；偏斜控制失效時屋面板斜卡在軌道上，閉合後屋面板接縫無法對齊，雨水沿縫隙滲入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If both sides are guided with no allowance for thermal sliding, in summer heat the panel is clamped between the rails and huge lateral thrust develops at the flanges, which can shear rail fastening bolts; if skew control fails the panel jams askew, panel joints cannot align when closed and rainwater enters through the gaps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Rogers Centre 的控制系統更新案特別指出，限制偏斜差是避免屋面板卡死、錯位與閉合後留縫的關鍵；賓士體育場的控制系統則個別調整每片花瓣速度，讓路徑長短不同的花瓣同時到達終點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Rogers Centre control upgrade stressed that limiting skew differential is key to avoiding jamming, misalignment and gaps when closed, and Mercedes-Benz Stadium's control system adjusts each petal's speed individually so that petals with different path lengths arrive together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若兩側都設導向輪而沒有預留溫度滑動，夏季高溫時屋面板被兩條軌道夾住，輪緣與軌道側面產生巨大側推力，可能剪斷軌道固定螺栓；偏斜控制失效時屋面板斜卡在軌道上，閉合後屋面板接縫無法對齊，雨水沿縫隙滲入。
knowledge.textEn: If both sides are guided with no allowance for thermal sliding, in summer heat the panel is clamped between the rails and huge lateral thrust develops at the flanges, which can shear rail fastening bolts; if skew control fails the panel jams askew, panel joints cannot align when closed and rainwater enters through the gaps.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軌道對位、溫度伸縮與偏斜控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rail alignment, thermal movement and skew control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若兩側都設導向輪而沒有預留溫度滑動，夏季高溫時屋面板被兩條軌道夾住，輪緣與軌道側面產生巨大側推力，可能剪斷軌道固定螺栓。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。
optionsEn: If both sides are guided with no allowance for thermal sliding, in summer heat the panel is clamped between the rails and huge lateral thrust develops at the flanges, which can shear rail fastening bolts.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site.
quiz.explanation: 若兩側都設導向輪而沒有預留溫度滑動，夏季高溫時屋面板被兩條軌道夾住，輪緣與軌道側面產生巨大側推力，可能剪斷軌道固定螺栓；偏斜控制失效時屋面板斜卡在軌道上，閉合後屋面板接縫無法對齊，雨水沿縫隙滲入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If both sides are guided with no allowance for thermal sliding, in summer heat the panel is clamped between the rails and huge lateral thrust develops at the flanges, which can shear rail fastening bolts; if skew control fails the panel jams askew, panel joints cannot align when closed and rainwater enters through the gaps. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收」與「風況監測與開合決策」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance" and "Wind monitoring and the operating decision": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「試運轉與同步測試」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 可開合屋頂的試運轉要從單一驅動器空轉開始，逐步進行單片屋面板低速移動、全速移動、多片同步與緊急停止，每一步都同時量測結構變形、驅動電流、偏斜與噪音。SkyDome 的設計團隊曾製作約 1:400、直徑約 2.5 m 的模型確認幾何不會卡死，第一次收回屋面板時還刻意選在深夜進行以策安全。驗收指標通常包括全程時間、同步誤差、緊急停止距離與閉合後的水密。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「試運轉與同步測試」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Commissioning starts with single drives running unloaded and progresses step by step through slow travel of one panel, full-speed travel, synchronised travel of several panels and emergency stops, measuring structural deformation, drive current, skew and noise at every step. SkyDome's design team built a model of about 1:400 scale, roughly 2.5 m in diameter, to confirm that the geometry would not jam, and the first panel retraction was deliberately carried out in the middle of the night as a precaution. Acceptance usually covers total travel time, synchronisation error, emergency stopping distance and watertightness when closed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「試運轉與同步測試」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Commissioning and synchronisation tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance
knowledge.text: 可開合屋頂的試運轉要從單一驅動器空轉開始，逐步進行單片屋面板低速移動、全速移動、多片同步與緊急停止，每一步都同時量測結構變形、驅動電流、偏斜與噪音。SkyDome 的設計團隊曾製作約 1:400、直徑約 2.5 m 的模型確認幾何不會卡死，第一次收回屋面板時還刻意選在深夜進行以策安全。
knowledge.textEn: Commissioning starts with single drives running unloaded and progresses step by step through slow travel of one panel, full-speed travel, synchronised travel of several panels and emergency stops, measuring structural deformation, drive current, skew and noise at every step. SkyDome's design team built a model of about 1:400 scale, roughly 2.5 m in diameter, to confirm that the geometry would not jam, and the first panel retraction was deliberately carried out in the middle of the night as a precaution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance" is correct?
options: 屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。
可開合屋頂的試運轉要從單一驅動器空轉開始，逐步進行單片屋面板低速移動、全速移動、多片同步與緊急停止，每一步都同時量測結構變形、驅動電流、偏斜與噪音。
只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。
optionsEn: Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site.

Commissioning starts with single drives running unloaded and progresses step by step through slow travel of one panel, full-speed travel, synchronised travel of several panels and emergency stops, measuring structural deformation, drive current, skew and noise at every step.
If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 可開合屋頂的試運轉要從單一驅動器空轉開始，逐步進行單片屋面板低速移動、全速移動、多片同步與緊急停止，每一步都同時量測結構變形、驅動電流、偏斜與噪音。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Commissioning starts with single drives running unloaded and progresses step by step through slow travel of one panel, full-speed travel, synchronised travel of several panels and emergency stops, measuring structural deformation, drive current, skew and noise at every step. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試運轉與同步測試」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。行程 L = 70 m、v = 0.12 m/s、t_a = 10 s 時 t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min，可達成「10 分鐘內開合」的需求；若為降低衝擊把速度降到 0.10 m/s，t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min 就超出。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each. For L = 70 m, v = 0.12 m/s and t_a = 10 s, t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min, meeting a ten-minute requirement; slowing to 0.10 m/s to reduce impact gives t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min, which fails it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依試運轉程序書逐階段記錄：空轉、單片低速、單片全速、同步、緊急停止與斷電制動，每階段設停檢點由業主代表、機構設計者與結構工程師簽認；最終以連續多次全程開合確認時間、電流與偏斜都在規定值內，再做閉合後灑水試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record each stage against the commissioning procedure: unloaded running, slow single panel, full-speed single panel, synchronised travel, emergency stop and power-loss braking, with a hold point at each stage signed by the owner's representative, the mechanism designer and the structural engineer; finish with several consecutive full open-close cycles confirming time, current and skew within limits, followed by a water test when closed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。行程 L = 70 m、v = 0.12 m/s、t_a = 10 s 時 t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min，可達成「10 分鐘內開合」的需求；若為降低衝擊把速度降到 0.10 m/s，t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min 就超出。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each. For L = 70 m, v = 0.12 m/s and t_a = 10 s, t = 583 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min, meeting a ten-minute requirement; slowing to 0.10 m/s to reduce impact gives t ≈ 710 s ≈ 11.8 min, which fails it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。
軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。
全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。
optionsEn: If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails.
Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry.
Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each.
quiz.explanation: 全程時間 t = L/v + t_a（梯形速度曲線，加減速各需 t_a）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Total travel time t = L/v + t_a for a trapezoidal speed profile with ramps of t_a each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試運轉與同步測試」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依試運轉程序書逐階段記錄：空轉、單片低速、單片全速、同步、緊急停止與斷電制動，每階段設停檢點由業主代表、機構設計者與結構工程師簽認；最終以連續多次全程開合確認時間、電流與偏斜都在規定值內，再做閉合後灑水試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record each stage against the commissioning procedure: unloaded running, slow single panel, full-speed single panel, synchronised travel, emergency stop and power-loss braking, with a hold point at each stage signed by the owner's representative, the mechanism designer and the structural engineer; finish with several consecutive full open-close cycles confirming time, current and skew within limits, followed by a water test when closed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：總工程進度要為屋頂機構保留獨立的試運轉期程，並規定在完成全部階段試驗前屋頂須以臨時鎖定固定在設計停放位置；所有試驗數據要成為日後維護比對的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The master programme should reserve a separate commissioning window for the roof mechanism, require the roof to be temporarily locked in a design parking position until all staged tests are complete, and keep every test record as the baseline for later maintenance comparisons.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置；賓士體育場的屋頂就在場館啟用後約一年才達到完全運轉，顯示機構調整需要充分時程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months; Mercedes-Benz Stadium's roof became fully operational only about a year after the venue opened, showing that tuning the mechanism needs adequate time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.textEn: Record each stage against the commissioning procedure: unloaded running, slow single panel, full-speed single panel, synchronised travel, emergency stop and power-loss braking, with a hold point at each stage signed by the owner's representative, the mechanism designer and the structural engineer; finish with several consecutive full open-close cycles confirming time, current and skew within limits, followed by a water test when closed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Record each stage against the commissioning procedure: unloaded running, slow single panel, full-speed single panel, synchronised travel, emergency stop and power-loss braking, with a hold point at each stage signed by the owner's representative, the mechanism designer and the structural engineer.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Panels are so heavy that their weight alone resists wind when parked, so no parking brake is needed.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試運轉與同步測試」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Commissioning and synchronisation tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置；賓士體育場的屋頂就在場館啟用後約一年才達到完全運轉，顯示機構調整需要充分時程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months; Mercedes-Benz Stadium's roof became fully operational only about a year after the venue opened, showing that tuning the mechanism needs adequate time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收指標通常包括全程時間、同步誤差、緊急停止距離與閉合後的水密。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance usually covers total travel time, synchronisation error, emergency stopping distance and watertightness when closed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置；賓士體育場的屋頂就在場館啟用後約一年才達到完全運轉，顯示機構調整需要充分時程。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months; Mercedes-Benz Stadium's roof became fully operational only about a year after the venue opened, showing that tuning the mechanism needs adequate time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試運轉、首次開合與運轉時間驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置。
只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months.
If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 趕在開幕前略過階段性試運轉，第一次全速同步就出現偏斜或卡死，屋頂只能長期停在固定位置；賓士體育場的屋頂就在場館啟用後約一年才達到完全運轉，顯示機構調整需要充分時程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping staged commissioning to meet an opening date means the first full-speed synchronised run may skew or jam, leaving the roof stuck in one position for months; Mercedes-Benz Stadium's roof became fully operational only about a year after the venue opened, showing that tuning the mechanism needs adequate time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 風況監測與開合決策：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 開合決策不能只看當下風速，因為一次開合要花十到二十分鐘，風在這段時間內可能增強；控制系統因此需要屋頂氣象站、預報資料與明確的決策規則。Rogers Centre 的更新工程加裝了屋頂氣象站以改善開合條件預測，並納入自我診斷與例外報告。風速計的位置、高度與平均時間必須與設計時假設的運轉風速定義一致，否則門檻數字就失去意義；控制系統應在風速超過門檻時阻止啟動，並在移動中風速上升時把屋面板送到最近的安全位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The decision to open or close cannot rest on the current wind alone, because one operation takes ten to twenty minutes and the wind may strengthen meanwhile; the controls therefore need a rooftop weather station, forecast data and explicit decision rules. The Rogers Centre upgrade added a rooftop weather station to improve forecasting of open and close conditions, together with self-diagnostics and exception reporting. The anemometer's position, height and averaging time must match the definition of operating wind speed assumed in design, otherwise the threshold means nothing; the controls should block starts above the threshold and, if wind rises during travel, send the panel to the nearest safe position. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若運轉上限為陣風 25 m/s、陣風係數 G = 1.5，對應十分鐘平均風速約 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the operating limit is a 25 m/s gust with gust factor G = 1.5, the corresponding ten-minute mean is about 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rooftop weather station and interlocks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風況監測與開合決策
knowledge.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision
knowledge.text: 開合決策不能只看當下風速，因為一次開合要花十到二十分鐘，風在這段時間內可能增強；控制系統因此需要屋頂氣象站、預報資料與明確的決策規則。Rogers Centre 的更新工程加裝了屋頂氣象站以改善開合條件預測，並納入自我診斷與例外報告。
knowledge.textEn: The decision to open or close cannot rest on the current wind alone, because one operation takes ten to twenty minutes and the wind may strengthen meanwhile; the controls therefore need a rooftop weather station, forecast data and explicit decision rules. The Rogers Centre upgrade added a rooftop weather station to improve forecasting of open and close conditions, together with self-diagnostics and exception reporting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風況監測與開合決策」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind monitoring and the operating decision" is correct?
options: 只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。
可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。
開合決策不能只看當下風速，因為一次開合要花十到二十分鐘，風在這段時間內可能增強；控制系統因此需要屋頂氣象站、預報資料與明確的決策規則。
optionsEn: If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe.
A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter.
The decision to open or close cannot rest on the current wind alone, because one operation takes ten to twenty minutes and the wind may strengthen meanwhile.
quiz.explanation: 開合決策不能只看當下風速，因為一次開合要花十到二十分鐘，風在這段時間內可能增強；控制系統因此需要屋頂氣象站、預報資料與明確的決策規則。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The decision to open or close cannot rest on the current wind alone, because one operation takes ten to twenty minutes and the wind may strengthen meanwhile; the controls therefore need a rooftop weather station, forecast data and explicit decision rules. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風況監測與開合決策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若運轉上限為陣風 25 m/s、陣風係數 G = 1.5，對應十分鐘平均風速約 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s。現況平均風速 12 m/s、預報每小時增加 4 m/s，到達 16.7 m/s 約需 (16.7−12)/4 ≈ 1.17 h ≈ 70 min；閉合需 20 min 加 10 min 裕度，最遲須在 40 min 內啟動閉合。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the operating limit is a 25 m/s gust with gust factor G = 1.5, the corresponding ten-minute mean is about 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s. With a current mean of 12 m/s forecast to rise 4 m/s per hour, it reaches 16.7 m/s in about (16.7−12)/4 ≈ 1.17 h ≈ 70 min; with 20 min to close plus 10 min margin, closing must start within 40 min. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄；比較屋頂量測與鄰近氣象站資料以建立換算關係，並以實際運轉紀錄檢查控制系統是否在風速超限時正確阻止啟動或觸發回收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it; compare rooftop readings with a nearby weather station to establish a conversion, and use operating logs to check that the controls correctly blocked starts or triggered retraction when wind exceeded the limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若運轉上限為陣風 25 m/s、陣風係數 G = 1.5，對應十分鐘平均風速約 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s。現況平均風速 12 m/s、預報每小時增加 4 m/s，到達 16.7 m/s 約需 (16.7−12)/4 ≈ 1.17 h ≈ 70 min；閉合需 20 min 加 10 min 裕度，最遲須在 40 min 內啟動閉合。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the operating limit is a 25 m/s gust with gust factor G = 1.5, the corresponding ten-minute mean is about 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s. With a current mean of 12 m/s forecast to rise 4 m/s per hour, it reaches 16.7 m/s in about (16.7−12)/4 ≈ 1.17 h ≈ 70 min; with 20 min to close plus 10 min margin, closing must start within 40 min. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風況監測與開合決策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind monitoring and the operating decision", which statement holds?
options: 若運轉上限為陣風 25 m/s、陣風係數 G = 1.5，對應十分鐘平均風速約 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s。
可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。
只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。
optionsEn: If the operating limit is a 25 m/s gust with gust factor G = 1.5, the corresponding ten-minute mean is about 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s.
A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position.
If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.
quiz.explanation: 若運轉上限為陣風 25 m/s、陣風係數 G = 1.5，對應十分鐘平均風速約 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the operating limit is a 25 m/s gust with gust factor G = 1.5, the corresponding ten-minute mean is about 25/1.5 ≈ 16.7 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風況監測與開合決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄；比較屋頂量測與鄰近氣象站資料以建立換算關係，並以實際運轉紀錄檢查控制系統是否在風速超限時正確阻止啟動或觸發回收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it; compare rooftop readings with a nearby weather station to establish a conversion, and use operating logs to check that the controls correctly blocked starts or triggered retraction when wind exceeded the limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：操作手冊應以決策表呈現：預報、現況、趨勢與剩餘運轉時間如何組合成「可開合、需提前閉合、禁止操作」三種結論，並規定由誰做最後決定與如何留存紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operating manual should present a decision table showing how forecast, current reading, trend and remaining travel time combine into three outcomes, go, close early or do not operate, and state who makes the final call and how it is recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit; or operators watch only the instantaneous reading and ignore the trend, and the limit is exceeded with the panel half-way, leaving it stopped in mid-travel in strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄；比較屋頂量測與鄰近氣象站資料以建立換算關係，並以實際運轉紀錄檢查控制系統是否在風速超限時正確阻止啟動或觸發回收。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it; compare rooftop readings with a nearby weather station to establish a conversion, and use operating logs to check that the controls correctly blocked starts or triggered retraction when wind exceeded the limit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 操作手冊應以決策表呈現：預報、現況、趨勢與剩餘運轉時間如何組合成「可開合、需提前閉合、禁止操作」三種結論，並規定由誰做最後決定與如何留存紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: The operating manual should present a decision table showing how forecast, current reading, trend and remaining travel time combine into three outcomes, go, close early or do not operate, and state who makes the final call and how it is recorded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風況監測與開合決策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind monitoring and the operating decision"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄。
只要吊裝重量低於起重機額定荷重，風速多大都可以吊。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it.
If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind.
quiz.explanation: 以兩支以上、安裝在不同位置的風速計互相比對，定期校正並記錄；比較屋頂量測與鄰近氣象站資料以建立換算關係，並以實際運轉紀錄檢查控制系統是否在風速超限時正確阻止啟動或觸發回收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check two or more anemometers at different locations, calibrate them on a schedule and log it; compare rooftop readings with a nearby weather station to establish a conversion, and use operating logs to check that the controls correctly blocked starts or triggered retraction when wind exceeded the limit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風況監測與開合決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind monitoring and the operating decision: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「屋頂氣象站與聯鎖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rooftop weather station and interlocks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit; or operators watch only the instantaneous reading and ignore the trend, and the limit is exceeded with the panel half-way, leaving it stopped in mid-travel in strong wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風速計的位置、高度與平均時間必須與設計時假設的運轉風速定義一致，否則門檻數字就失去意義；控制系統應在風速超過門檻時阻止啟動，並在移動中風速上升時把屋面板送到最近的安全位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The anemometer's position, height and averaging time must match the definition of operating wind speed assumed in design, otherwise the threshold means nothing; the controls should block starts above the threshold and, if wind rises during travel, send the panel to the nearest safe position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要按下開合鍵時風速低於門檻，整個開合過程就一定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the wind is below the limit when the button is pressed, the whole operation is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。
knowledge.textEn: An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit; or operators watch only the instantaneous reading and ignore the trend, and the limit is exceeded with the panel half-way, leaving it stopped in mid-travel in strong wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風況監測與開合決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind monitoring and the operating decision" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。
風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter.
An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit.
quiz.explanation: 風速計被新增的看板或設備遮蔽，讀值長期偏低，操作人員在實際超限的風中開合屋頂；或只看瞬間讀值而忽略趨勢，屋面板移動到一半時風速超限，只能停在中間位置承受強風。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An anemometer shadowed by a new sign or equipment reads low for months, so operators move the roof in winds actually above the limit; or operators watch only the instantaneous reading and ignore the trend, and the limit is exceeded with the panel half-way, leaving it stopped in mid-travel in strong wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」與「控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue" and "Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「車輪與軌道磨耗」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel and rail wear” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。Rogers Centre 的控制系統要求每年可開合多達約 400 次。軌道焊接接頭、軌道固定件與軌道梁上翼板在重複輪壓下承受局部應力循環，車輪與軌頂則以滾動接觸疲勞與磨耗為主。設計需同時評估結構細部的應力範圍疲勞，以及機械元件的磨耗壽命與更換週期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「車輪與軌道磨耗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed roof's fatigue comes mainly from wind, but a retractable roof adds well-defined mechanical cycles: every operation rolls all wheels over the rails and puts the drive gears, bearings and brakes through a load cycle. Rogers Centre's control system is required to open or close up to about 400 times a year. Rail welds, rail fasteners and rail-girder top flanges see local stress cycles under repeated wheel loads, while wheels and rail heads are governed by rolling-contact fatigue and wear. Design must assess both stress-range fatigue in structural details and the wear life and replacement interval of mechanical parts. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Wheel and rail wear” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每年 400 次運轉、壽命 30 年、每一點有 8 個車輪通過，循環數 N = 400×30×8 = 96,000。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「車輪與軌道磨耗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Wheel and rail wear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估
knowledge.text: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。Rogers Centre 的控制系統要求每年可開合多達約 400 次。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed roof's fatigue comes mainly from wind, but a retractable roof adds well-defined mechanical cycles: every operation rolls all wheels over the rails and puts the drive gears, bearings and brakes through a load cycle. Rogers Centre's control system is required to open or close up to about 400 times a year.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue" is correct?
options: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。
可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。
屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。
optionsEn: A fixed roof's fatigue comes mainly from wind, but a retractable roof adds well-defined mechanical cycles: every operation rolls all wheels over the rails and puts the drive gears, bearings and brakes through a load cycle.
A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter.
If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails.
quiz.explanation: 固定屋頂的疲勞主要來自風，可開合屋頂則多了明確的機械循環：每次開合，所有車輪都碾過軌道，驅動齒輪、軸承與制動器也完成一次負載循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed roof's fatigue comes mainly from wind, but a retractable roof adds well-defined mechanical cycles: every operation rolls all wheels over the rails and puts the drive gears, bearings and brakes through a load cycle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車輪與軌道磨耗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel and rail wear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每年 400 次運轉、壽命 30 年、每一點有 8 個車輪通過，循環數 N = 400×30×8 = 96,000。以細部類別 71 MPa（2×10⁶ 次）、斜率 m = 3 推算，容許應力範圍 Δσ_R = 71×(2×10⁶/96,000)^(1/3) ≈ 195 MPa，結構細部通常不是瓶頸；但滾動接觸處的局部應力遠高於此，磨耗與剝落才是主要壽命限制。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles. Using detail category 71 MPa at 2×10⁶ cycles and slope m = 3, the allowable stress range is Δσ_R = 71×(2×10⁶/96,000)^(1/3) ≈ 195 MPa, so structural details are seldom the limit; local rolling-contact stresses are far higher, and wear and spalling govern life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立車輪直徑、輪緣厚度與軌頂斷面的定期量測紀錄，以磨耗量對運轉次數作圖預測更換時點；軌道焊接接頭以目視、磁粉或超音波定期檢查，並把檢查結果與運轉次數、溫度與異常事件連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep periodic records of wheel diameter, flange thickness and rail-head profile, and plot wear against operation count to forecast replacement; inspect rail welds by visual, magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing on a schedule, linking results to operation counts, temperature and unusual events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每年 400 次運轉、壽命 30 年、每一點有 8 個車輪通過，循環數 N = 400×30×8 = 96,000。以細部類別 71 MPa（2×10⁶ 次）、斜率 m = 3 推算，容許應力範圍 Δσ_R = 71×(2×10⁶/96,000)^(1/3) ≈ 195 MPa，結構細部通常不是瓶頸；但滾動接觸處的局部應力遠高於此，磨耗與剝落才是主要壽命限制。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles. Using detail category 71 MPa at 2×10⁶ cycles and slope m = 3, the allowable stress range is Δσ_R = 71×(2×10⁶/96,000)^(1/3) ≈ 195 MPa, so structural details are seldom the limit; local rolling-contact stresses are far higher, and wear and spalling govern life. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue", which statement holds?
options: 軌道只要施工時調平，之後屋面板移動不會改變軌道幾何。
每年 400 次運轉、壽命 30 年、每一點有 8 個車輪通過，循環數 N = 400×30×8 = 96,000。
屋面板很重，所以靜止時本身重量就足以抵抗風力，不需要停車制動。
optionsEn: Once rails are levelled during construction, panel movement will not change the rail geometry.
With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles.
Panels are so heavy that their weight alone resists wind when parked, so no parking brake is needed.
quiz.explanation: 每年 400 次運轉、壽命 30 年、每一點有 8 個車輪通過，循環數 N = 400×30×8 = 96,000。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 400 operations a year, a 30-year life and 8 wheels passing each point, N = 400×30×8 = 96,000 cycles. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車輪與軌道磨耗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel and rail wear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立車輪直徑、輪緣厚度與軌頂斷面的定期量測紀錄，以磨耗量對運轉次數作圖預測更換時點；軌道焊接接頭以目視、磁粉或超音波定期檢查，並把檢查結果與運轉次數、溫度與異常事件連結。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep periodic records of wheel diameter, flange thickness and rail-head profile, and plot wear against operation count to forecast replacement; inspect rail welds by visual, magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing on a schedule, linking results to operation counts, temperature and unusual events. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應以運轉次數而不只以日曆時間訂定檢查週期，控制系統自動累計每片屋面板的運轉次數與異常停機；車輪、軸承與制動片列為消耗品並保留備品，更換程序要包含頂升點與臨時支撐計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Base inspection intervals in the maintenance manual on operation counts as well as calendar time, have the controls log each panel's operations and abnormal stops, treat wheels, bearings and brake pads as consumables with spares on hand, and include jacking points and temporary-support calculations in the replacement procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven rail-head wear makes wheels hammer, accelerating bearing failure and loosening rail fasteners; with poor lubrication and cleaning, bird droppings, grit and standing water pit the rails, the pits become fatigue crack initiation sites, and a rail may eventually fracture under high wheel load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立車輪直徑、輪緣厚度與軌頂斷面的定期量測紀錄，以磨耗量對運轉次數作圖預測更換時點；軌道焊接接頭以目視、磁粉或超音波定期檢查，並把檢查結果與運轉次數、溫度與異常事件連結。
knowledge.textEn: Keep periodic records of wheel diameter, flange thickness and rail-head profile, and plot wear against operation count to forecast replacement; inspect rail welds by visual, magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing on a schedule, linking results to operation counts, temperature and unusual events.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊應以運轉次數而不只以日曆時間訂定檢查週期，控制系統自動累計每片屋面板的運轉次數與異常停機；車輪、軸承與制動片列為消耗品並保留備品，更換程序要包含頂升點與臨時支撐計算。
knowledge.textEn: Base inspection intervals in the maintenance manual on operation counts as well as calendar time, have the controls log each panel's operations and abnormal stops, treat wheels, bearings and brake pads as consumables with spares on hand, and include jacking points and temporary-support calculations in the replacement procedure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩側驅動器規格相同，屋面板自然會直線前進，不需要偏斜回饋控制。
建立車輪直徑、輪緣厚度與軌頂斷面的定期量測紀錄，以磨耗量對運轉次數作圖預測更換時點。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If the drives on both sides are identical, the panel will naturally travel straight with no need for skew feedback.
Keep periodic records of wheel diameter, flange thickness and rail-head profile, and plot wear against operation count to forecast replacement.
quiz.explanation: 建立車輪直徑、輪緣厚度與軌頂斷面的定期量測紀錄，以磨耗量對運轉次數作圖預測更換時點；軌道焊接接頭以目視、磁粉或超音波定期檢查，並把檢查結果與運轉次數、溫度與異常事件連結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep periodic records of wheel diameter, flange thickness and rail-head profile, and plot wear against operation count to forecast replacement; inspect rail welds by visual, magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing on a schedule, linking results to operation counts, temperature and unusual events. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Operating cycles, wear and fatigue: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車輪與軌道磨耗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel and rail wear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven rail-head wear makes wheels hammer, accelerating bearing failure and loosening rail fasteners; with poor lubrication and cleaning, bird droppings, grit and standing water pit the rails, the pits become fatigue crack initiation sites, and a rail may eventually fracture under high wheel load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計需同時評估結構細部的應力範圍疲勞，以及機械元件的磨耗壽命與更換週期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design must assess both stress-range fatigue in structural details and the wear life and replacement interval of mechanical parts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「可開合屋頂一年只開合幾百次，所以不用考慮疲勞與磨耗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A retractable roof only operates a few hundred times a year, so fatigue and wear do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven rail-head wear makes wheels hammer, accelerating bearing failure and loosening rail fasteners; with poor lubrication and cleaning, bird droppings, grit and standing water pit the rails, the pits become fatigue crack initiation sites, and a rail may eventually fracture under high wheel load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運轉循環、磨耗與疲勞評估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Operating cycles, wear and fatigue" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。
optionsEn: Uneven rail-head wear makes wheels hammer, accelerating bearing failure and loosening rail fasteners.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails.
quiz.explanation: 軌頂磨耗不均讓車輪出現衝擊，加速軸承損壞與軌道固定螺栓鬆脫；若潤滑與清潔不足，鳥糞、砂塵與積水在軌道上造成腐蝕坑，成為疲勞裂縫起點，最後可能在高輪壓處斷軌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven rail-head wear makes wheels hammer, accelerating bearing failure and loosening rail fasteners; with poor lubrication and cleaning, bird droppings, grit and standing water pit the rails, the pits become fatigue crack initiation sites, and a rail may eventually fracture under high wheel load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「控制系統與運轉紀錄」如何影響可開合體育場屋頂的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
