steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Control system and operating records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Retractable stadium roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼結構可用數十年，但控制系統的零件可能在十多年後就停產；Rogers Centre 於 1989 年啟用，2015 至 2017 年間進行約 1,000 萬加幣的控制系統更新，原因之一就是舊系統零件不再生產，更新後運轉時間縮短約 46%。可開合屋頂的交接文件除了結構圖說，還必須包含控制邏輯、聯鎖清單、試運轉基準、軌道幾何基準與緊急程序，讓下一代維護團隊能在不依賴原設計者的情況下安全運轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「控制系統與運轉紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steelwork lasts for decades, but control components may go out of production within ten or fifteen years; Rogers Centre opened in 1989 and underwent a control-system upgrade of about CAD 10 million between 2015 and 2017, partly because parts for the old system were no longer made, and the upgrade cut operating time by about 46%. Besides structural drawings, retractable-roof handover documents must include the control logic, the interlock list, commissioning baselines, rail-geometry baselines and emergency procedures so that later maintenance teams can operate the roof safely without depending on the original designers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Control system and operating records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若每次運轉成功率 0.995，一季 400 次全部成功的機率 = 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135，代表幾乎每季都會遇到故障；若關鍵通道改為雙重冗餘、單次失效率降為 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，400 次全部成功的機率 = (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a per-operation success probability of 0.995, the chance that all 400 operations in a season succeed is 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135, so a fault is almost certain each season; with dual redundancy on critical channels the per-operation failure drops to 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵ and the chance of 400 clean operations becomes (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「控制系統與運轉紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Control system and operating records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover
knowledge.text: 鋼結構可用數十年，但控制系統的零件可能在十多年後就停產；Rogers Centre 於 1989 年啟用，2015 至 2017 年間進行約 1,000 萬加幣的控制系統更新，原因之一就是舊系統零件不再生產，更新後運轉時間縮短約 46%。可開合屋頂的交接文件除了結構圖說，還必須包含控制邏輯、聯鎖清單、試運轉基準、軌道幾何基準與緊急程序，讓下一代維護團隊能在不依賴原設計者的情況下安全運轉。
knowledge.textEn: Steelwork lasts for decades, but control components may go out of production within ten or fifteen years; Rogers Centre opened in 1989 and underwent a control-system upgrade of about CAD 10 million between 2015 and 2017, partly because parts for the old system were no longer made, and the upgrade cut operating time by about 46%. Besides structural drawings, retractable-roof handover documents must include the control logic, the interlock list, commissioning baselines, rail-geometry baselines and emergency procedures so that later maintenance teams can operate the roof safely without depending on the original designers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover" is correct?
options: 屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。
鋼結構可用數十年，但控制系統的零件可能在十多年後就停產。
可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。
optionsEn: If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails.
Steelwork lasts for decades, but control components may go out of production within ten or fifteen years.
A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position.
quiz.explanation: 鋼結構可用數十年，但控制系統的零件可能在十多年後就停產；Rogers Centre 於 1989 年啟用，2015 至 2017 年間進行約 1,000 萬加幣的控制系統更新，原因之一就是舊系統零件不再生產，更新後運轉時間縮短約 46%。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steelwork lasts for decades, but control components may go out of production within ten or fifteen years; Rogers Centre opened in 1989 and underwent a control-system upgrade of about CAD 10 million between 2015 and 2017, partly because parts for the old system were no longer made, and the upgrade cut operating time by about 46%. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制系統與運轉紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Control system and operating records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每次運轉成功率 0.995，一季 400 次全部成功的機率 = 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135，代表幾乎每季都會遇到故障；若關鍵通道改為雙重冗餘、單次失效率降為 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，400 次全部成功的機率 = (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a per-operation success probability of 0.995, the chance that all 400 operations in a season succeed is 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135, so a fault is almost certain each season; with dual redundancy on critical channels the per-operation failure drops to 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵ and the chance of 400 clean operations becomes (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以故障樹或失效模式分析列出單點失效，逐項確認冗餘或手動備援；控制系統更新時以新舊系統並行或分段切換，重新執行同步、偏斜、緊急停止與斷電制動試驗，並與原始試運轉基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List single points of failure with fault-tree or failure-mode analysis and confirm redundancy or manual back-up for each; when upgrading controls, run old and new systems in parallel or cut over in stages, repeat synchronisation, skew, emergency-stop and power-loss braking tests, and compare with the original commissioning baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若每次運轉成功率 0.995，一季 400 次全部成功的機率 = 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135，代表幾乎每季都會遇到故障；若關鍵通道改為雙重冗餘、單次失效率降為 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，400 次全部成功的機率 = (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a per-operation success probability of 0.995, the chance that all 400 operations in a season succeed is 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135, so a fault is almost certain each season; with dual redundancy on critical channels the per-operation failure drops to 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵ and the chance of 400 clean operations becomes (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要車輪數量乘上單輪容量大於屋面板重量，輪壓就一定安全。
只要吊裝重量低於起重機額定荷重，風速多大都可以吊。
若每次運轉成功率 0.995，一季 400 次全部成功的機率 = 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135，代表幾乎每季都會遇到故障。
optionsEn: If the number of wheels times the single-wheel capacity exceeds the panel weight, the wheel loads are safe.
If the lift weight is below the crane rating, lifting can proceed in any wind.
With a per-operation success probability of 0.995, the chance that all 400 operations in a season succeed is 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135, so a fault is almost certain each season.
quiz.explanation: 若每次運轉成功率 0.995，一季 400 次全部成功的機率 = 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135，代表幾乎每季都會遇到故障；若關鍵通道改為雙重冗餘、單次失效率降為 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，400 次全部成功的機率 = (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a per-operation success probability of 0.995, the chance that all 400 operations in a season succeed is 0.995^400 ≈ 0.135, so a fault is almost certain each season; with dual redundancy on critical channels the per-operation failure drops to 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵ and the chance of 400 clean operations becomes (1−2.5×10⁻⁵)^400 ≈ 0.990. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「控制系統與運轉紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Control system and operating records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以故障樹或失效模式分析列出單點失效，逐項確認冗餘或手動備援；控制系統更新時以新舊系統並行或分段切換，重新執行同步、偏斜、緊急停止與斷電制動試驗，並與原始試運轉基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List single points of failure with fault-tree or failure-mode analysis and confirm redundancy or manual back-up for each; when upgrading controls, run old and new systems in parallel or cut over in stages, repeat synchronisation, skew, emergency-stop and power-loss braking tests, and compare with the original commissioning baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時應移交可編輯的控制程式、聯鎖矩陣、軌道與偏斜基準、試運轉報告與備品清單，並規定任何控制邏輯修改都需經結構工程師與機構設計者審查；建議每隔數年做一次完整的運轉性能複驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover deliver editable control programs, the interlock matrix, rail and skew baselines, commissioning reports and a spares list, require structural-engineer and mechanism-designer review of any change to control logic, and repeat a full operating-performance verification every few years.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：控制系統老化又缺乏備品時，業主只能降速運轉以免過載，開合時間拉長，運轉風速窗口變窄；若交接時沒有留下控制邏輯與聯鎖說明，故障排除只能靠猜測，甚至有人為了讓屋頂動起來而短接安全聯鎖。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When ageing controls lack spares, owners run the roof below full speed to avoid overloads, operations take longer and the usable wind window shrinks; without documented control logic and interlocks at handover, fault-finding becomes guesswork and someone may even bypass a safety interlock just to get the roof moving. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以故障樹或失效模式分析列出單點失效，逐項確認冗餘或手動備援；控制系統更新時以新舊系統並行或分段切換，重新執行同步、偏斜、緊急停止與斷電制動試驗，並與原始試運轉基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: List single points of failure with fault-tree or failure-mode analysis and confirm redundancy or manual back-up for each; when upgrading controls, run old and new systems in parallel or cut over in stages, repeat synchronisation, skew, emergency-stop and power-loss braking tests, and compare with the original commissioning baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時應移交可編輯的控制程式、聯鎖矩陣、軌道與偏斜基準、試運轉報告與備品清單，並規定任何控制邏輯修改都需經結構工程師與機構設計者審查；建議每隔數年做一次完整的運轉性能複驗。
knowledge.textEn: At handover deliver editable control programs, the interlock matrix, rail and skew baselines, commissioning reports and a spares list, require structural-engineer and mechanism-designer review of any change to control logic, and repeat a full operating-performance verification every few years.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover"?
options: 以故障樹或失效模式分析列出單點失效，逐項確認冗餘或手動備援。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
屋面板在工廠組裝試轉過，現場只要通電就能正式開合。
optionsEn: List single points of failure with fault-tree or failure-mode analysis and confirm redundancy or manual back-up for each.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Panels trial-run in the factory can be opened and closed for real as soon as power is connected on site.
quiz.explanation: 以故障樹或失效模式分析列出單點失效，逐項確認冗餘或手動備援；控制系統更新時以新舊系統並行或分段切換，重新執行同步、偏斜、緊急停止與斷電制動試驗，並與原始試運轉基準比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List single points of failure with fault-tree or failure-mode analysis and confirm redundancy or manual back-up for each; when upgrading controls, run old and new systems in parallel or cut over in stages, repeat synchronisation, skew, emergency-stop and power-loss braking tests, and compare with the original commissioning baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「控制系統與運轉紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Control system and operating records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 控制系統老化又缺乏備品時，業主只能降速運轉以免過載，開合時間拉長，運轉風速窗口變窄；若交接時沒有留下控制邏輯與聯鎖說明，故障排除只能靠猜測，甚至有人為了讓屋頂動起來而短接安全聯鎖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: When ageing controls lack spares, owners run the roof below full speed to avoid overloads, operations take longer and the usable wind window shrinks; without documented control logic and interlocks at handover, fault-finding becomes guesswork and someone may even bypass a safety interlock just to get the roof moving. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：可開合屋頂的交接文件除了結構圖說，還必須包含控制邏輯、聯鎖清單、試運轉基準、軌道幾何基準與緊急程序，讓下一代維護團隊能在不依賴原設計者的情況下安全運轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Besides structural drawings, retractable-roof handover documents must include the control logic, the interlock list, commissioning baselines, rail-geometry baselines and emergency procedures so that later maintenance teams can operate the roof safely without depending on the original designers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「屋頂結構沒有問題，控制系統只是附屬設備，壞了再換即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the roof structure is sound, the control system is an accessory that can simply be replaced when it fails." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 控制系統老化又缺乏備品時，業主只能降速運轉以免過載，開合時間拉長，運轉風速窗口變窄；若交接時沒有留下控制邏輯與聯鎖說明，故障排除只能靠猜測，甚至有人為了讓屋頂動起來而短接安全聯鎖。
knowledge.textEn: When ageing controls lack spares, owners run the roof below full speed to avoid overloads, operations take longer and the usable wind window shrinks; without documented control logic and interlocks at handover, fault-finding becomes guesswork and someone may even bypass a safety interlock just to get the roof moving.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制系統更新、可用度與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control upgrades, availability and engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
控制系統老化又缺乏備品時，業主只能降速運轉以免過載，開合時間拉長，運轉風速窗口變窄。
可開合屋頂只要按閉合後的固定屋頂設計就足夠安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
When ageing controls lack spares, owners run the roof below full speed to avoid overloads, operations take longer and the usable wind window shrinks.
A retractable roof is safe if it is simply designed as a fixed roof in the closed position.
quiz.explanation: 控制系統老化又缺乏備品時，業主只能降速運轉以免過載，開合時間拉長，運轉風速窗口變窄；若交接時沒有留下控制邏輯與聯鎖說明，故障排除只能靠猜測，甚至有人為了讓屋頂動起來而短接安全聯鎖。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When ageing controls lack spares, owners run the roof below full speed to avoid overloads, operations take longer and the usable wind window shrinks; without documented control logic and interlocks at handover, fault-finding becomes guesswork and someone may even bypass a safety interlock just to get the roof moving. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工
summary: 薄殼混凝土屋頂以數公分厚的雙曲面跨越數十公尺，靠的是形狀讓荷載以薄膜壓力傳遞；它的弱點是挫屈、邊緣彎矩、溫差裂縫與施工幾何誤差。本課從 Candela 的雙曲拋物面、Isler 的倒懸模型殼到蘇黎世聯邦理工學院在 NEST HiLo 的索網織物模板，說明殼形、配筋、模板、澆置脫模、幾何量測與長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: Thin concrete shells span tens of metres with curved surfaces only a few centimetres thick, because their form lets loads travel as membrane compression; their weak points are buckling, edge bending, thermal cracking and construction geometry errors. From Candela's hyperbolic paraboloids and Isler's inverted hanging-model shells to ETH Zurich's cable-net fabric formwork at NEST HiLo, the course explains engineering judgement on shell form, reinforcement, formwork, casting and decentering, geometry survey and long-term maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一座球形薄殼屋頂半徑 R = 40 m、厚度 t = 80 mm、E = 30,000 MPa，自重 q_g = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，雪荷載 1.0 kPa，合計 2.92 kPa。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 2.92×40/2 = 58.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 58.4/0.08 = 0.73 MPa。古典挫屈 p_cr = 1.18×30,000×(0.08/40)² MPa ≈ 141 kPa，缺陷折減 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3）後約 14.1 kPa，安全係數 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8。環向力在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉。若為省材料把厚度改為 60 mm：自重 1.44 kPa、合計 2.44 kPa，σ = 2.44×40/2/0.06 ≈ 0.81 MPa，應力反而上升；p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，折減後約 7.95 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。由此可見減薄殼體省下的是自重，失去的是挫屈裕度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際殼體的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a spherical shell roof has radius R = 40 m, thickness t = 80 mm and E = 30,000 MPa; self-weight is q_g = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa and snow 1.0 kPa, total 2.92 kPa. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 2.92×40/2 = 58.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 58.4/0.08 = 0.73 MPa. Classical buckling gives p_cr = 1.18×30,000×(0.08/40)² MPa ≈ 141 kPa; after an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) it is about 14.1 kPa, a safety factor of 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8. The hoop force turns tensile at φ ≈ 51.8°. Thinning to 60 mm to save material gives self-weight 1.44 kPa and total 2.44 kPa, so σ = 2.44×40/2/0.06 ≈ 0.81 MPa, actually higher; p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa, about 7.95 kPa after reduction, and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Thinning saves self-weight but spends buckling margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real shell.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」與「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shell form and membrane action" and "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「薄膜內力」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Membrane forces” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。理想形狀下殼面幾乎全受壓，混凝土的抗壓強度被充分利用；但只要支承條件、集中荷載或邊緣不符合薄膜假設，就會在邊緣與支點附近產生彎矩擾動區。球形殼在自重下，從頂部往下經向力一直受壓，環向力則在超過某個角度後轉為受拉，因此淺殼與深殼的配筋重點完全不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「薄膜內力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does. For an ideal form the shell is almost entirely in compression, making full use of concrete's compressive strength, but wherever supports, point loads or edges violate the membrane assumptions a zone of bending disturbance appears near edges and supports. In a spherical dome under self-weight the meridional force stays compressive from crown to base, whereas the hoop force turns tensile beyond a certain angle, so shallow and deep domes need very different reinforcement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Membrane forces” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「薄膜內力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Membrane forces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用
knowledge.text: 薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。理想形狀下殼面幾乎全受壓，混凝土的抗壓強度被充分利用；但只要支承條件、集中荷載或邊緣不符合薄膜假設，就會在邊緣與支點附近產生彎矩擾動區。
knowledge.textEn: Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does. For an ideal form the shell is almost entirely in compression, making full use of concrete's compressive strength, but wherever supports, point loads or edges violate the membrane assumptions a zone of bending disturbance appears near edges and supports.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shell form and membrane action" is correct?
options: 薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。
薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。
混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
optionsEn: Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.

Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does.
Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼之所以能用很少的材料跨越很大的空間，是因為曲面讓垂直荷載在殼面內轉成經向與環向的薄膜力，而不是像平板那樣靠彎矩承載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin shells span large spaces with little material because curvature turns vertical load into meridional and hoop membrane forces within the surface instead of carrying it by bending as a flat slab does. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄膜內力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Membrane forces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa，遠低於混凝土強度。環向力 N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] 在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉，殼面延伸超過此角度就需要環向抗拉配筋或環梁。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa, far below concrete strength. The hoop force N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] turns from compression to tension at φ ≈ 51.8°, so a shell extending beyond that angle needs hoop tension reinforcement or a ring beam. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa，遠低於混凝土強度。環向力 N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] 在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉，殼面延伸超過此角度就需要環向抗拉配筋或環梁。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 1.92×40/2 = 38.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 38.4/0.08 ≈ 0.48 MPa, far below concrete strength. The hoop force N_θ = qR[1/(1+cosφ) − cosφ] turns from compression to tension at φ ≈ 51.8°, so a shell extending beyond that angle needs hoop tension reinforcement or a ring beam. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shell form and membrane action", which statement holds?
options: 薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。
薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。
球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。
optionsEn: Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later.
Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m.
quiz.explanation: 球殼自重 q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，半徑 R = 40 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Dome self-weight q = γt = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa with radius R = 40 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄膜內力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Membrane forces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計審查時要求提交殼面薄膜力分布圖、彎矩擾動區範圍與支點推力路徑，並在圖面上標出環向受拉區與對應配筋；形狀變更（即使只是開孔或壓低矢高）都要重做整體分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At design review require plots of membrane forces, the extent of bending disturbance zones and the support thrust path, mark the hoop-tension zone and its reinforcement on the drawings, and redo the global analysis for any change of form, even a new opening or a lower rise.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。
knowledge.textEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計審查時要求提交殼面薄膜力分布圖、彎矩擾動區範圍與支點推力路徑，並在圖面上標出環向受拉區與對應配筋；形狀變更（即使只是開孔或壓低矢高）都要重做整體分析。
knowledge.textEn: At design review require plots of membrane forces, the extent of bending disturbance zones and the support thrust path, mark the hoop-tension zone and its reinforcement on the drawings, and redo the global analysis for any change of form, even a new opening or a lower rise.

quiz.question: 要驗證「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shell form and membrane action"?
options: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。
optionsEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
quiz.explanation: 以殼元素有限元素模型同時輸出薄膜力與彎矩，確認殼面大部分區域彎矩應力遠小於薄膜應力，並把邊緣擾動區的寬度與手算估計（約 √(Rt) 量級，此例約 1.8 m）比較；檢查支承反力方向是否與殼面切線一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Output both membrane forces and bending moments from a shell-element model, confirm that bending stresses are far below membrane stresses over most of the surface, and compare the width of the edge-disturbance zone with the hand estimate of order √(Rt), about 1.8 m here; check that support reactions align with the shell tangent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 殼體形狀與薄膜作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shell form and membrane action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄膜內力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Membrane forces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：球形殼在自重下，從頂部往下經向力一直受壓，環向力則在超過某個角度後轉為受拉，因此淺殼與深殼的配筋重點完全不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a spherical dome under self-weight the meridional force stays compressive from crown to base, whereas the hoop force turns tensile beyond a certain angle, so shallow and deep domes need very different reinforcement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。
knowledge.textEn: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shell form and membrane action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。
混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost.
Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
quiz.explanation: 若支點沒有提供殼面切線方向的推力或環梁不足，殼體會在邊緣產生大彎矩與裂縫，薄膜狀態被破壞；在環向受拉區只放少量構造筋，乾縮與溫差就會造成經向裂縫並讓雨水滲入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If supports cannot provide thrust along the shell tangent or the ring beam is inadequate, large edge moments and cracks develop and the membrane state is lost; with only nominal bars in the hoop-tension zone, shrinkage and temperature produce meridional cracks that let rain in. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「挫屈安全係數」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Buckling safety factor” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。古典彈性理論預測的挫屈荷載對幾何缺陷非常敏感，實際殼體常只達到理論值的一小部分；混凝土的潛變會讓有效彈性模數隨時間下降，開裂也會降低勁度。因此設計者通常以折減係數把理論挫屈荷載降到實際可用值，再要求數倍的安全係數。Isler 一生建造近 1,400 座殼，研究者回推其殼平均厚度約 10 cm，正是在挫屈與材料用量之間取得平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「挫屈安全係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing; buckling governs: under compression, wherever local curvature drops or thickness is insufficient, the surface can suddenly snap inward. The classical elastic buckling load is very sensitive to geometric imperfections, and real shells often reach only a fraction of it; concrete creep lowers the effective modulus with time and cracking also reduces stiffness. Designers therefore apply knock-down factors to bring the theoretical buckling load to a usable value and then require a safety factor of several. Isler built nearly 1,400 shells, and researchers estimate his shells averaged about 10 cm thick, a balance between buckling and material use. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Buckling safety factor” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「挫屈安全係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Buckling safety factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性
knowledge.text: 薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。古典彈性理論預測的挫屈荷載對幾何缺陷非常敏感，實際殼體常只達到理論值的一小部分；混凝土的潛變會讓有效彈性模數隨時間下降，開裂也會降低勁度。
knowledge.textEn: Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing; buckling governs: under compression, wherever local curvature drops or thickness is insufficient, the surface can suddenly snap inward. The classical elastic buckling load is very sensitive to geometric imperfections, and real shells often reach only a fraction of it; concrete creep lowers the effective modulus with time and cracking also reduces stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity" is correct?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。
optionsEn: Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼強度很少由材料壓碎控制，而是由挫屈控制：殼面受壓時，一旦局部曲率變小或厚度不足，就可能突然凹陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin shells are rarely governed by material crushing; buckling governs: under compression, wherever local curvature drops or thickness is insufficient, the surface can suddenly snap inward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「挫屈安全係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Buckling safety factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。E = 30,000 MPa、t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002 時 p_cr ≈ 141 kPa；考慮缺陷 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3），折減後約 14.1 kPa。自重 1.92 kPa 加雪 1.0 kPa，安全係數 ≈ 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8；厚度減為 60 mm 時 p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)². With E = 30,000 MPa and t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002, p_cr ≈ 141 kPa; an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) bring it to about 14.1 kPa. With self-weight 1.92 kPa plus 1.0 kPa snow the safety factor is about 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8; at 60 mm thickness p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。E = 30,000 MPa、t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002 時 p_cr ≈ 141 kPa；考慮缺陷 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3），折減後約 14.1 kPa。自重 1.92 kPa 加雪 1.0 kPa，安全係數 ≈ 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8；厚度減為 60 mm 時 p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)². With E = 30,000 MPa and t/R = 0.08/40 = 0.002, p_cr ≈ 141 kPa; an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) bring it to about 14.1 kPa. With self-weight 1.92 kPa plus 1.0 kPa snow the safety factor is about 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8; at 60 mm thickness p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity", which statement holds?
options: 球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。
柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。
薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。
optionsEn: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)².
A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation.
A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 球殼古典挫屈壓力 p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The classical dome buckling pressure is p_cr = 2E(t/R)²/√[3(1−ν²)] ≈ 1.18E(t/R)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「挫屈安全係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Buckling safety factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。必要時以縮尺模型做破壞試驗驗證形狀選擇。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude. Where needed, verify the form choice with scale-model tests to failure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：挫屈檢核須明列折減係數、潛變假設與所用初始缺陷幅值，並與施工規範的幾何容許誤差連動：若施工單位無法達成該容許誤差，就必須回頭加厚殼板或加肋，而不是放寬驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Buckling checks should state the knock-down factor, creep assumption and imperfection amplitude used, tied to the construction geometry tolerance; if the builder cannot achieve that tolerance, thicken or rib the shell rather than relax acceptance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。必要時以縮尺模型做破壞試驗驗證形狀選擇。
knowledge.textEn: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude. Where needed, verify the form choice with scale-model tests to failure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 挫屈檢核須明列折減係數、潛變假設與所用初始缺陷幅值，並與施工規範的幾何容許誤差連動：若施工單位無法達成該容許誤差，就必須回頭加厚殼板或加肋，而不是放寬驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Buckling checks should state the knock-down factor, creep assumption and imperfection amplitude used, tied to the construction geometry tolerance; if the builder cannot achieve that tolerance, thicken or rib the shell rather than relax acceptance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。
薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus.
Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
quiz.explanation: 以幾何非線性分析加入與挫屈模態同形、幅值相當於設計允許施工誤差的初始缺陷，並以長期有效模數重算；結果與折減公式比較，兩者應同一量級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run geometrically nonlinear analysis with an initial imperfection shaped like the buckling mode and as large as the permitted construction tolerance, and repeat with the long-term effective modulus; compare with the knock-down formula, which should agree in order of magnitude. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「挫屈安全係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Buckling safety factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Isler 一生建造近 1,400 座殼，研究者回推其殼平均厚度約 10 cm，正是在挫屈與材料用量之間取得平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Isler built nearly 1,400 shells, and researchers estimate his shells averaged about 10 cm thick, a balance between buckling and material use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。
knowledge.textEn: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄殼挫屈與幾何缺陷敏感性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shell buckling and imperfection sensitivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator.
quiz.explanation: 淺殼局部被做得比設計更平或更薄時，該處成為挫屈起點；在長期潛變與積雪、積水共同作用下，殼面先出現逐年增大的凹陷，最後可能突然塌陷，而事前裂縫並不明顯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Where a shallow shell is built flatter or thinner than designed, that spot becomes a buckling initiator; under long-term creep combined with snow or ponding, a dent grows year by year and may finally collapse suddenly with little prior cracking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力」與「薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear" and "Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙曲拋物面直紋」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hyperbolic-paraboloid rulings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙曲拋物面同時是雙曲面與直紋面：曲面上每一點都有兩條直線完全落在曲面內。Candela 正是利用這個性質，讓木模板沿直線母線鋪設，把複雜曲面變成可由工人以直木條施作的模板，使薄殼在當時的墨西哥成為很經濟的建造方式，而且模板可重複使用多達約 10 次。1958 年的 Los Manantiales 餐廳以四個相交的雙曲拋物面組成八瓣拱頂，跨距超過 42 m，並把殼緣切成自由邊。在均布荷載下，雙曲拋物面殼面主要承受固定的面內剪力，對角方向分別為受壓與受拉，剪力再累積到邊緣構件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙曲拋物面直紋」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hyperbolic paraboloid is both doubly curved and ruled: through every point pass two straight lines lying entirely in the surface. Candela exploited this by laying timber formwork along the straight generators, turning a complex surface into formwork that carpenters could build from straight boards, which made shells one of the cheapest ways to build in Mexico at the time, with formwork reused up to about 10 times. His 1958 Los Manantiales restaurant combines four intersecting hypars into an eight-lobed vault spanning more than 42 m, with the shell edges cut as free edges. Under uniform load a hypar carries mainly a constant in-plane shear, compression along one diagonal and tension along the other, and the shear accumulates into the edge members. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hyperbolic-paraboloid rulings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙曲拋物面 z = c·x·y，平面 10 m×10 m、角落升高 3 m 時 c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a hypar z = c·x·y on a 10 m×10 m plan with a 3 m corner rise, c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙曲拋物面直紋」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hyperbolic-paraboloid rulings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear" is correct?
options: 雙曲拋物面同時是雙曲面與直紋面：曲面上每一點都有兩條直線完全落在曲面內。
雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。

A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later.
quiz.explanation: 雙曲拋物面同時是雙曲面與直紋面：曲面上每一點都有兩條直線完全落在曲面內。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hyperbolic paraboloid is both doubly curved and ruled: through every point pass two straight lines lying entirely in the surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙曲拋物面直紋」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hyperbolic-paraboloid rulings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙曲拋物面 z = c·x·y，平面 10 m×10 m、角落升高 3 m 時 c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹。均布荷載 q = 2.2 kPa 時面內剪力 N_xy = q/(2c) = 2.2/0.06 ≈ 36.7 kN/m，受拉對角方向需鋼筋 A_s = 36,700/435 ≈ 84 mm²/m，φ6@300 提供 94 mm²/m；邊緣構件在角落累積的軸力約 36.7×10 ≈ 367 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a hypar z = c·x·y on a 10 m×10 m plan with a 3 m corner rise, c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹. Under q = 2.2 kPa the in-plane shear is N_xy = q/(2c) = 2.2/0.06 ≈ 36.7 kN/m, and the tension diagonal needs A_s = 36,700/435 ≈ 84 mm²/m, met by φ6 at 300 mm giving 94 mm²/m; the edge member accumulates about 36.7×10 ≈ 367 kN at the corner. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維模型輸出主應力方向，確認受拉主方向與配筋方向一致；模板放樣時沿兩組母線各取數條直線，以全站儀量測其端點與中點高程，確認母線確實為直線、曲面扭率與設計一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output principal-stress directions from a 3D model and confirm that the tension direction matches the reinforcement layout; when setting out the formwork, survey ends and midpoints of several generators in each family with a total station to confirm they are straight and the surface twist matches the design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 雙曲拋物面 z = c·x·y，平面 10 m×10 m、角落升高 3 m 時 c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹。均布荷載 q = 2.2 kPa 時面內剪力 N_xy = q/(2c) = 2.2/0.06 ≈ 36.7 kN/m，受拉對角方向需鋼筋 A_s = 36,700/435 ≈ 84 mm²/m，φ6@300 提供 94 mm²/m；邊緣構件在角落累積的軸力約 36.7×10 ≈ 367 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a hypar z = c·x·y on a 10 m×10 m plan with a 3 m corner rise, c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹. Under q = 2.2 kPa the in-plane shear is N_xy = q/(2c) = 2.2/0.06 ≈ 36.7 kN/m, and the tension diagonal needs A_s = 36,700/435 ≈ 84 mm²/m, met by φ6 at 300 mm giving 94 mm²/m; the edge member accumulates about 36.7×10 ≈ 367 kN at the corner. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear", which statement holds?
options: 薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。
雙曲拋物面 z = c·x·y，平面 10 m×10 m、角落升高 3 m 時 c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹。
薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。
optionsEn: Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
For a hypar z = c·x·y on a 10 m×10 m plan with a 3 m corner rise, c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹.
Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
quiz.explanation: 雙曲拋物面 z = c·x·y，平面 10 m×10 m、角落升高 3 m 時 c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a hypar z = c·x·y on a 10 m×10 m plan with a 3 m corner rise, c = 3/(10×10) = 0.03 m⁻¹. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙曲拋物面直紋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hyperbolic-paraboloid rulings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維模型輸出主應力方向，確認受拉主方向與配筋方向一致；模板放樣時沿兩組母線各取數條直線，以全站儀量測其端點與中點高程，確認母線確實為直線、曲面扭率與設計一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output principal-stress directions from a 3D model and confirm that the tension direction matches the reinforcement layout; when setting out the formwork, survey ends and midpoints of several generators in each family with a total station to confirm they are straight and the surface twist matches the design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對直紋殼，模板圖應直接以母線編號與端點座標表示，現場以拉線檢查直線度；自由邊與邊緣構件的鋼筋錨定要在施工圖上放大詳示，並列為澆置前查驗項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For ruled shells, draw the formwork by numbered generators with end coordinates and check straightness with string lines on site; detail the anchorage of reinforcement at free edges and edge members at large scale and make it a pre-pour inspection item.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把殼緣做成自由邊卻未計算剪力流在邊緣的累積，邊緣會下垂並出現斜裂縫；配筋方向若與受拉主方向相差太多，裂縫寬度變大，鋼筋保護層薄的殼面很快出現鏽蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting free edges without accounting for the accumulated shear flow lets edges sag and develop diagonal cracks; if reinforcement is oriented far from the principal tension direction, cracks widen and the thinly covered bars soon corrode. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維模型輸出主應力方向，確認受拉主方向與配筋方向一致；模板放樣時沿兩組母線各取數條直線，以全站儀量測其端點與中點高程，確認母線確實為直線、曲面扭率與設計一致。
knowledge.textEn: Output principal-stress directions from a 3D model and confirm that the tension direction matches the reinforcement layout; when setting out the formwork, survey ends and midpoints of several generators in each family with a total station to confirm they are straight and the surface twist matches the design.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對直紋殼，模板圖應直接以母線編號與端點座標表示，現場以拉線檢查直線度；自由邊與邊緣構件的鋼筋錨定要在施工圖上放大詳示，並列為澆置前查驗項目。
knowledge.textEn: For ruled shells, draw the formwork by numbered generators with end coordinates and check straightness with string lines on site; detail the anchorage of reinforcement at free edges and edge members at large scale and make it a pre-pour inspection item.

quiz.question: 要驗證「直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。
以三維模型輸出主應力方向，確認受拉主方向與配筋方向一致；模板放樣時沿兩組母線各取數條直線，以全站儀量測其端點與中點高程，確認母線確實為直線、曲面扭率與設計一致。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer.
Output principal-stress directions from a 3D model and confirm that the tension direction matches the reinforcement layout.
quiz.explanation: 以三維模型輸出主應力方向，確認受拉主方向與配筋方向一致；模板放樣時沿兩組母線各取數條直線，以全站儀量測其端點與中點高程，確認母線確實為直線、曲面扭率與設計一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Output principal-stress directions from a 3D model and confirm that the tension direction matches the reinforcement layout; when setting out the formwork, survey ends and midpoints of several generators in each family with a total station to confirm they are straight and the surface twist matches the design. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙曲拋物面直紋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hyperbolic-paraboloid rulings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把殼緣做成自由邊卻未計算剪力流在邊緣的累積，邊緣會下垂並出現斜裂縫；配筋方向若與受拉主方向相差太多，裂縫寬度變大，鋼筋保護層薄的殼面很快出現鏽蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting free edges without accounting for the accumulated shear flow lets edges sag and develop diagonal cracks; if reinforcement is oriented far from the principal tension direction, cracks widen and the thinly covered bars soon corrode. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在均布荷載下，雙曲拋物面殼面主要承受固定的面內剪力，對角方向分別為受壓與受拉，剪力再累積到邊緣構件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Under uniform load a hypar carries mainly a constant in-plane shear, compression along one diagonal and tension along the other, and the shear accumulates into the edge members.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把殼緣做成自由邊卻未計算剪力流在邊緣的累積，邊緣會下垂並出現斜裂縫；配筋方向若與受拉主方向相差太多，裂縫寬度變大，鋼筋保護層薄的殼面很快出現鏽蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting free edges without accounting for the accumulated shear flow lets edges sag and develop diagonal cracks; if reinforcement is oriented far from the principal tension direction, cracks widen and the thinly covered bars soon corrode.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「直紋曲面、雙曲拋物面與殼內剪力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ruled surfaces, hypars and in-plane shear" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把殼緣做成自由邊卻未計算剪力流在邊緣的累積，邊緣會下垂並出現斜裂縫；配筋方向若與受拉主方向相差太多，裂縫寬度變大，鋼筋保護層薄的殼面很快出現鏽蝕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。
optionsEn: Cutting free edges without accounting for the accumulated shear flow lets edges sag and develop diagonal cracks.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later.
quiz.explanation: 把殼緣做成自由邊卻未計算剪力流在邊緣的累積，邊緣會下垂並出現斜裂縫；配筋方向若與受拉主方向相差太多，裂縫寬度變大，鋼筋保護層薄的殼面很快出現鏽蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting free edges without accounting for the accumulated shear flow lets edges sag and develop diagonal cracks; if reinforcement is oriented far from the principal tension direction, cracks widen and the thinly covered bars soon corrode. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「殼板厚度與保護層」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shell thickness and cover” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼的最小厚度通常不是由應力決定，而是由施工與耐久決定：鋼筋網層數、保護層、骨材粒徑與能否在斜面上振實。雙層配筋可以抵抗邊緣彎矩，但會讓厚度明顯增加；單層置中鋼筋網較薄，卻較難控制保護層。現代研究以纖維或織物補強取代部分鋼筋，HiLo 原型的殼厚平均約 5 cm，由邊緣約 3 cm 漸變到支點約 12 cm，支點附近加厚以承受集中反力與彎矩。混凝土配比需兼顧在斜面不流淌、可噴附或可振實，以及低收縮。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「殼板厚度與保護層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A shell's minimum thickness is usually set by construction and durability rather than stress: the number of reinforcement layers, cover, aggregate size and whether concrete can be compacted on a slope. Two layers resist edge bending but noticeably increase thickness; a single central mesh is thinner but makes cover harder to control. Current research replaces some bars with fibres or textile reinforcement, and the HiLo prototype averaged about 5 cm, grading from about 3 cm at the edges to about 12 cm at the supports, where concentrated reactions and moments demand more depth. The mix must stay on slopes without slumping, be sprayable or compactable, and shrink little. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shell thickness and cover” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙層雙向 φ8 鋼筋網、保護層 25 mm：t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm，取 90 mm；單層置中雙向 φ8：t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm，取 70 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With two layers of two-way φ8 mesh and 25 mm cover, t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm, so 90 mm is used; with one central two-way φ8 mesh, t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm, so 70 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「殼板厚度與保護層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shell thickness and cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「殼板厚度與保護層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shell thickness and cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙層雙向 φ8 鋼筋網、保護層 25 mm：t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm，取 90 mm；單層置中雙向 φ8：t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm，取 70 mm。厚度減少 20 mm 使自重減少 0.02×24 = 0.48 kPa，約為 90 mm 殼自重 2.16 kPa 的 22%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With two layers of two-way φ8 mesh and 25 mm cover, t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm, so 90 mm is used; with one central two-way φ8 mesh, t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm, so 70 mm. Saving 20 mm cuts self-weight by 0.02×24 = 0.48 kPa, about 22% of the 2.16 kPa of a 90 mm shell. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試拌與斜面試體確認配比在設計最大坡度下不流淌且可振實；澆置前以保護層墊塊間距與鋼筋網高程量測確認層數與保護層，澆置後以保護層測定儀抽查，必要時以鑽心確認實際厚度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm with trial batches and sloped test panels that the mix stays put and compacts at the steepest design slope; before casting check layer count and cover from spacer spacing and mesh-level survey, and after casting spot-check cover with a covermeter and, where needed, actual thickness with cores.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 雙層雙向 φ8 鋼筋網、保護層 25 mm：t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm，取 90 mm；單層置中雙向 φ8：t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm，取 70 mm。厚度減少 20 mm 使自重減少 0.02×24 = 0.48 kPa，約為 90 mm 殼自重 2.16 kPa 的 22%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With two layers of two-way φ8 mesh and 25 mm cover, t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm, so 90 mm is used; with one central two-way φ8 mesh, t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm, so 70 mm. Saving 20 mm cuts self-weight by 0.02×24 = 0.48 kPa, about 22% of the 2.16 kPa of a 90 mm shell. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness", which statement holds?
options: 薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。
薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。
雙層雙向 φ8 鋼筋網、保護層 25 mm：t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm，取 90 mm。
optionsEn: A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
With two layers of two-way φ8 mesh and 25 mm cover, t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm, so 90 mm is used.

quiz.explanationEn: With two layers of two-way φ8 mesh and 25 mm cover, t_min = 2×25 + 4×8 = 82 mm, so 90 mm is used; with one central two-way φ8 mesh, t_min = 2×25 + 2×8 = 66 mm, so 70 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「殼板厚度與保護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shell thickness and cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試拌與斜面試體確認配比在設計最大坡度下不流淌且可振實；澆置前以保護層墊塊間距與鋼筋網高程量測確認層數與保護層，澆置後以保護層測定儀抽查，必要時以鑽心確認實際厚度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm with trial batches and sloped test panels that the mix stays put and compacts at the steepest design slope; before casting check layer count and cover from spacer spacing and mesh-level survey, and after casting spot-check cover with a covermeter and, where needed, actual thickness with cores. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範應同時規定殼厚、保護層與鋼筋網高程的容許誤差，並要求以走道板或懸吊踏板避免踩踏鋼筋網；斜面配比須先以足尺樣板試做，並列為開工前停檢點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should set tolerances for thickness, cover and mesh level together, require walk boards or suspended footplates so the mesh is not trodden down, and trial the slope mix on a full-size sample panel as a hold point before work starts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在斜面上混凝土下滑，造成上方變薄、下方堆積，薄處保護層不足且挫屈安全係數下降；鋼筋網被踩踏下沉後，原本置中的鋼筋貼近下表面，上表面收縮裂縫無筋控制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concrete sliding down a slope leaves the upper part thin and piles up below, so the thin zone has too little cover and a lower buckling margin; mesh trodden down during casting drops toward the soffit, leaving shrinkage cracks on the top surface unreinforced.
