A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試拌與斜面試體確認配比在設計最大坡度下不流淌且可振實；澆置前以保護層墊塊間距與鋼筋網高程量測確認層數與保護層，澆置後以保護層測定儀抽查，必要時以鑽心確認實際厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm with trial batches and sloped test panels that the mix stays put and compacts at the steepest design slope; before casting check layer count and cover from spacer spacing and mesh-level survey, and after casting spot-check cover with a covermeter and, where needed, actual thickness with cores.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範應同時規定殼厚、保護層與鋼筋網高程的容許誤差，並要求以走道板或懸吊踏板避免踩踏鋼筋網；斜面配比須先以足尺樣板試做，並列為開工前停檢點。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should set tolerances for thickness, cover and mesh level together, require walk boards or suspended footplates so the mesh is not trodden down, and trial the slope mix on a full-size sample panel as a hold point before work starts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness"?
options: 以試拌與斜面試體確認配比在設計最大坡度下不流淌且可振實。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。
optionsEn: Confirm with trial batches and sloped test panels that the mix stays put and compacts at the steepest design slope.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 以試拌與斜面試體確認配比在設計最大坡度下不流淌且可振實；澆置前以保護層墊塊間距與鋼筋網高程量測確認層數與保護層，澆置後以保護層測定儀抽查，必要時以鑽心確認實際厚度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm with trial batches and sloped test panels that the mix stays put and compacts at the steepest design slope; before casting check layer count and cover from spacer spacing and mesh-level survey, and after casting spot-check cover with a covermeter and, where needed, actual thickness with cores. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「殼板厚度與保護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shell thickness and cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在斜面上混凝土下滑，造成上方變薄、下方堆積，薄處保護層不足且挫屈安全係數下降；鋼筋網被踩踏下沉後，原本置中的鋼筋貼近下表面，上表面收縮裂縫無筋控制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete sliding down a slope leaves the upper part thin and piles up below, so the thin zone has too little cover and a lower buckling margin; mesh trodden down during casting drops toward the soffit, leaving shrinkage cracks on the top surface unreinforced. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：混凝土配比需兼顧在斜面不流淌、可噴附或可振實，以及低收縮。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The mix must stay on slopes without slumping, be sprayable or compactable, and shrink little.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在斜面上混凝土下滑，造成上方變薄、下方堆積，薄處保護層不足且挫屈安全係數下降；鋼筋網被踩踏下沉後，原本置中的鋼筋貼近下表面，上表面收縮裂縫無筋控制。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete sliding down a slope leaves the upper part thin and piles up below, so the thin zone has too little cover and a lower buckling margin; mesh trodden down during casting drops toward the soffit, leaving shrinkage cracks on the top surface unreinforced.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄殼混凝土、配筋層數與最小厚度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shell concrete, reinforcement layers and minimum thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
在斜面上混凝土下滑，造成上方變薄、下方堆積，薄處保護層不足且挫屈安全係數下降；鋼筋網被踩踏下沉後，原本置中的鋼筋貼近下表面，上表面收縮裂縫無筋控制。
柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Concrete sliding down a slope leaves the upper part thin and piles up below, so the thin zone has too little cover and a lower buckling margin.
A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation.
quiz.explanation: 在斜面上混凝土下滑，造成上方變薄、下方堆積，薄處保護層不足且挫屈安全係數下降；鋼筋網被踩踏下沉後，原本置中的鋼筋貼近下表面，上表面收縮裂縫無筋控制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete sliding down a slope leaves the upper part thin and piles up below, so the thin zone has too little cover and a lower buckling margin; mesh trodden down during casting drops toward the soffit, leaving shrinkage cracks on the top surface unreinforced. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模」與「澆置、養護與脫模卸載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric" and "Casting, curing and decentering": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模板與支撐系統」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Formwork and falsework” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼的成本常由模板決定。Candela 以直木條沿直紋鋪設，Isler 則以倒懸布料模型找形，並在部分殼體以保溫纖維板作為留置模板。近年的替代方案是柔性模板：NEST HiLo 原型以鋼索網張拉在可重複使用的支架上，網上鋪聚合物織物作為模板，索網約 500 kg、織物約 300 kg，承載約 20 t 濕混凝土；混凝土以噴附方式施作，下方空間在澆置期間仍保持暢通。柔性模板的形狀會隨濕混凝土重量改變，所以設計必須預先計算索網受載後的形狀，反推無載時應有的幾何。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模板與支撐系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Formwork often drives shell cost. Candela laid straight boards along rulings, Isler found forms with inverted hanging-cloth models and left insulating fibreboard in place as formwork on some shells. A recent alternative is flexible formwork: the NEST HiLo prototype stretched a steel cable net on a reusable scaffold and laid a polymer textile on it as the mould; the net weighed about 500 kg and the textile about 300 kg while carrying about 20 t of wet concrete, which was sprayed on, and the space below stayed open during casting. A flexible mould changes shape under wet-concrete weight, so designers must compute the loaded net shape and back-calculate the unloaded geometry it needs. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Formwork and falsework” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以單位寬度索帶近似柔性模板：濕混凝土 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²，跨距 L = 10 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m 時水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m；垂度增為 1.5 m 時 H ≈ 10.4 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Approximate the flexible mould as a unit-width cable strip: wet concrete 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²; with span L = 10 m and sag f = 1.0 m the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m, and with 1.5 m sag H ≈ 10.4 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模板與支撐系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Formwork and falsework”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模
knowledge.titleEn: Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric
knowledge.text: 薄殼的成本常由模板決定。Candela 以直木條沿直紋鋪設，Isler 則以倒懸布料模型找形，並在部分殼體以保溫纖維板作為留置模板。
knowledge.textEn: Formwork often drives shell cost. Candela laid straight boards along rulings, Isler found forms with inverted hanging-cloth models and left insulating fibreboard in place as formwork on some shells.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric" is correct?
options: 柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。
薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。
薄殼的成本常由模板決定。
optionsEn: A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation.
Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
Formwork often drives shell cost.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼的成本常由模板決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Formwork often drives shell cost. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模板與支撐系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Formwork and falsework” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以單位寬度索帶近似柔性模板：濕混凝土 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²，跨距 L = 10 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m 時水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m；垂度增為 1.5 m 時 H ≈ 10.4 kN/m。可見曲率越大，邊界支架承受的張力越小。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Approximate the flexible mould as a unit-width cable strip: wet concrete 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²; with span L = 10 m and sag f = 1.0 m the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m, and with 1.5 m sag H ≈ 10.4 kN/m. Greater curvature means less tension on the boundary frame. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：柔性模板在澆置前後以三維掃描或全站儀量測控制點，與預測的受載形狀比較；索力以荷重計或張力計抽測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey control points on a flexible mould with 3D scanning or a total station before and after casting and compare with the predicted loaded shape; sample cable forces with load cells or tension meters.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以單位寬度索帶近似柔性模板：濕混凝土 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²，跨距 L = 10 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m 時水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m；垂度增為 1.5 m 時 H ≈ 10.4 kN/m。可見曲率越大，邊界支架承受的張力越小。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Approximate the flexible mould as a unit-width cable strip: wet concrete 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²; with span L = 10 m and sag f = 1.0 m the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m, and with 1.5 m sag H ≈ 10.4 kN/m. Greater curvature means less tension on the boundary frame. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric", which statement holds?
options: 以單位寬度索帶近似柔性模板：濕混凝土 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²，跨距 L = 10 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m 時水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m。
薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。
薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。
optionsEn: Approximate the flexible mould as a unit-width cable strip: wet concrete 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m².
Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer.
quiz.explanation: 以單位寬度索帶近似柔性模板：濕混凝土 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²，跨距 L = 10 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m 時水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m；垂度增為 1.5 m 時 H ≈ 10.4 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Approximate the flexible mould as a unit-width cable strip: wet concrete 25 kN/m³×0.05 m = 1.25 kN/m²; with span L = 10 m and sag f = 1.0 m the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 1.25×100/8 ≈ 15.6 kN/m, and with 1.5 m sag H ≈ 10.4 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模板與支撐系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Formwork and falsework” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 柔性模板在澆置前後以三維掃描或全站儀量測控制點，與預測的受載形狀比較；索力以荷重計或張力計抽測。剛性木模則以支撐系統計算書核對澆置荷重、衝擊與施工人員荷重，並在澆置中觀察支撐沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey control points on a flexible mould with 3D scanning or a total station before and after casting and compare with the predicted loaded shape; sample cable forces with load cells or tension meters. For rigid timber forms, check falsework calculations for casting load, impact and construction live load, and watch for support settlement during casting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模板與支撐須有獨立計算書並由臨時工程設計者簽認；柔性模板要規定預張力、控制點與允許偏差，澆置中設專人監看控制點變位，超過警戒值即暫停並調整。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Formwork and falsework need their own calculations signed by the temporary-works designer; flexible moulds need specified pretension, control points and tolerances, with a person assigned to watch control-point movement during casting and to pause and adjust when an alert value is exceeded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：柔性模板若以無載形狀直接當作完成形狀，澆置後殼面下垂、局部曲率變平，降低挫屈安全係數；剛性模板支撐若沉陷不均，殼體在硬化前被扭曲，脫模後出現無法修正的幾何誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Taking the unloaded shape of a flexible mould as the finished shape lets the shell sag and flatten locally during casting, cutting the buckling margin; uneven settlement of rigid falsework twists the shell before it hardens, leaving geometry errors that cannot be corrected after striking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 柔性模板在澆置前後以三維掃描或全站儀量測控制點，與預測的受載形狀比較；索力以荷重計或張力計抽測。剛性木模則以支撐系統計算書核對澆置荷重、衝擊與施工人員荷重，並在澆置中觀察支撐沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Survey control points on a flexible mould with 3D scanning or a total station before and after casting and compare with the predicted loaded shape; sample cable forces with load cells or tension meters. For rigid timber forms, check falsework calculations for casting load, impact and construction live load, and watch for support settlement during casting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 模板與支撐須有獨立計算書並由臨時工程設計者簽認；柔性模板要規定預張力、控制點與允許偏差，澆置中設專人監看控制點變位，超過警戒值即暫停並調整。
knowledge.textEn: Formwork and falsework need their own calculations signed by the temporary-works designer; flexible moulds need specified pretension, control points and tolerances, with a person assigned to watch control-point movement during casting and to pause and adjust when an alert value is exceeded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
柔性模板在澆置前後以三維掃描或全站儀量測控制點，與預測的受載形狀比較；索力以荷重計或張力計抽測。
混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Survey control points on a flexible mould with 3D scanning or a total station before and after casting and compare with the predicted loaded shape.
Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
quiz.explanation: 柔性模板在澆置前後以三維掃描或全站儀量測控制點，與預測的受載形狀比較；索力以荷重計或張力計抽測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey control points on a flexible mould with 3D scanning or a total station before and after casting and compare with the predicted loaded shape; sample cable forces with load cells or tension meters. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模板與支撐系統」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Formwork and falsework” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 柔性模板若以無載形狀直接當作完成形狀，澆置後殼面下垂、局部曲率變平，降低挫屈安全係數；剛性模板支撐若沉陷不均，殼體在硬化前被扭曲，脫模後出現無法修正的幾何誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Taking the unloaded shape of a flexible mould as the finished shape lets the shell sag and flatten locally during casting, cutting the buckling margin; uneven settlement of rigid falsework twists the shell before it hardens, leaving geometry errors that cannot be corrected after striking. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：柔性模板的形狀會隨濕混凝土重量改變，所以設計必須預先計算索網受載後的形狀，反推無載時應有的幾何。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A flexible mould changes shape under wet-concrete weight, so designers must compute the loaded net shape and back-calculate the unloaded geometry it needs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 柔性模板若以無載形狀直接當作完成形狀，澆置後殼面下垂、局部曲率變平，降低挫屈安全係數；剛性模板支撐若沉陷不均，殼體在硬化前被扭曲，脫模後出現無法修正的幾何誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Taking the unloaded shape of a flexible mould as the finished shape lets the shell sag and flatten locally during casting, cutting the buckling margin; uneven settlement of rigid falsework twists the shell before it hardens, leaving geometry errors that cannot be corrected after striking.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模板系統：木模、倒懸成形與索網織物模」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Formwork systems: timber, hanging forms and cable-net fabric" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。
柔性模板若以無載形狀直接當作完成形狀，澆置後殼面下垂、局部曲率變平，降低挫屈安全係數；剛性模板支撐若沉陷不均，殼體在硬化前被扭曲，脫模後出現無法修正的幾何誤差。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
Taking the unloaded shape of a flexible mould as the finished shape lets the shell sag and flatten locally during casting, cutting the buckling margin.
quiz.explanation: 柔性模板若以無載形狀直接當作完成形狀，澆置後殼面下垂、局部曲率變平，降低挫屈安全係數；剛性模板支撐若沉陷不均，殼體在硬化前被扭曲，脫模後出現無法修正的幾何誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Taking the unloaded shape of a flexible mould as the finished shape lets the shell sag and flatten locally during casting, cutting the buckling margin; uneven settlement of rigid falsework twists the shell before it hardens, leaving geometry errors that cannot be corrected after striking. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 澆置、養護與脫模卸載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Casting, curing and decentering: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「澆置順序與脫模卸載」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Casting sequence and decentering” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼澆置要對稱推進，避免單側荷載讓模板或未硬化殼面不對稱變形；多數殼體從支點附近往頂部、或由低處往高處澆置，以利振實並控制斜面上的流動。脫模卸載（decentering）是殼體第一次以自身形狀承載的時刻，必須在混凝土達到規定強度後，以對稱、分級的方式逐步降低支撐，讓殼體平順地接手荷載。卸載過快或不對稱，會在早齡混凝土上造成局部彎矩與裂縫。薄殼表面積大、厚度小，水分蒸發快，早期養護不足會造成塑性收縮裂縫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「澆置順序與脫模卸載」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shell casting must advance symmetrically so that one-sided loading does not distort the formwork or the unhardened shell; most shells are cast from near the supports toward the crown, or from low to high, to aid compaction and control flow on slopes. Decentering is the moment the shell first carries load by its own form: once concrete reaches the specified strength, supports are lowered symmetrically and in stages so the shell takes up load smoothly. Decentering too fast or unevenly induces local bending and cracks in young concrete. Shells have a large surface and small thickness, so water evaporates quickly and inadequate early curing causes plastic shrinkage cracks. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Casting sequence and decentering” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：早齡強度可用 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t)（t 以天計）估算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Early strength can be estimated by f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t) with t in days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「澆置順序與脫模卸載」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Casting sequence and decentering”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 澆置、養護與脫模卸載
knowledge.text: 薄殼澆置要對稱推進，避免單側荷載讓模板或未硬化殼面不對稱變形；多數殼體從支點附近往頂部、或由低處往高處澆置，以利振實並控制斜面上的流動。脫模卸載（decentering）是殼體第一次以自身形狀承載的時刻，必須在混凝土達到規定強度後，以對稱、分級的方式逐步降低支撐，讓殼體平順地接手荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Shell casting must advance symmetrically so that one-sided loading does not distort the formwork or the unhardened shell; most shells are cast from near the supports toward the crown, or from low to high, to aid compaction and control flow on slopes. Decentering is the moment the shell first carries load by its own form: once concrete reaches the specified strength, supports are lowered symmetrically and in stages so the shell takes up load smoothly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「澆置、養護與脫模卸載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Casting, curing and decentering" is correct?
options: 薄殼澆置要對稱推進，避免單側荷載讓模板或未硬化殼面不對稱變形；多數殼體從支點附近往頂部、或由低處往高處澆置，以利振實並控制斜面上的流動。
薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。
薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。
optionsEn: Shell casting must advance symmetrically so that one-sided loading does not distort the formwork or the unhardened shell.
Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼澆置要對稱推進，避免單側荷載讓模板或未硬化殼面不對稱變形；多數殼體從支點附近往頂部、或由低處往高處澆置，以利振實並控制斜面上的流動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shell casting must advance symmetrically so that one-sided loading does not distort the formwork or the unhardened shell; most shells are cast from near the supports toward the crown, or from low to high, to aid compaction and control flow on slopes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 澆置、養護與脫模卸載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Casting, curing and decentering: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「澆置順序與脫模卸載」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Casting sequence and decentering” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：早齡強度可用 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t)（t 以天計）估算。f₂₈ = 40 MPa 時，1 天約 8.2 MPa、2 天約 14.0 MPa、3 天約 18.3 MPa；若規定脫模強度 15 MPa，至少需約 3 天，低溫時還要延長。數值為教學假設，實際應以現場養護試體或成熟度法確認。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Early strength can be estimated by f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t) with t in days. For f₂₈ = 40 MPa it gives about 8.2 MPa at 1 day, 14.0 MPa at 2 days and 18.3 MPa at 3 days; with a specified striking strength of 15 MPa at least about 3 days are needed, longer in cold weather. Values are teaching assumptions; confirm on site with field-cured cylinders or the maturity method. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以現場同條件養護試體或埋設溫度感測器以成熟度法確認脫模強度；卸載時在頂部與邊緣設沉陷量測點，每一級卸載後記錄變位並與預測值比較，偏差超過警戒值即停止並由設計者評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm striking strength with field-cured specimens or embedded temperature sensors and the maturity method; during decentering place settlement points at the crown and edges, record deflection after each stage, compare with prediction, and stop for designer assessment if the alert value is exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 早齡強度可用 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t)（t 以天計）估算。f₂₈ = 40 MPa 時，1 天約 8.2 MPa、2 天約 14.0 MPa、3 天約 18.3 MPa；若規定脫模強度 15 MPa，至少需約 3 天，低溫時還要延長。數值為教學假設，實際應以現場養護試體或成熟度法確認。
knowledge.textEn: Early strength can be estimated by f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t) with t in days. For f₂₈ = 40 MPa it gives about 8.2 MPa at 1 day, 14.0 MPa at 2 days and 18.3 MPa at 3 days; with a specified striking strength of 15 MPa at least about 3 days are needed, longer in cold weather. Values are teaching assumptions; confirm on site with field-cured cylinders or the maturity method.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「澆置、養護與脫模卸載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Casting, curing and decentering", which statement holds?
options: 薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。
早齡強度可用 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t)（t 以天計）估算。
薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。
optionsEn: Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
Early strength can be estimated by f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t) with t in days.
Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 早齡強度可用 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t)（t 以天計）估算。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Early strength can be estimated by f(t) = f₂₈·t/(4 + 0.85t) with t in days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 澆置、養護與脫模卸載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Casting, curing and decentering: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「澆置順序與脫模卸載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Casting sequence and decentering” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以現場同條件養護試體或埋設溫度感測器以成熟度法確認脫模強度；卸載時在頂部與邊緣設沉陷量測點，每一級卸載後記錄變位並與預測值比較，偏差超過警戒值即停止並由設計者評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm striking strength with field-cured specimens or embedded temperature sensors and the maturity method; during decentering place settlement points at the crown and edges, record deflection after each stage, compare with prediction, and stop for designer assessment if the alert value is exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：脫模卸載程序應由殼體設計者撰寫，列出卸載順序、每級降幅、量測點與停止條件，並在現場設停檢點，由設計者代表確認強度與變位後才進入下一級。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The shell designer should write the decentering procedure with sequence, lowering per stage, measurement points and stop conditions, with a site hold point at each stage where the designer's representative confirms strength and deflection before continuing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為趕工在強度不足時一次拆除支撐，殼體在頂部或自由邊產生過大下垂與裂縫，甚至局部凹陷；單側先拆使殼體承受不對稱荷載，支點推力方向改變，邊緣構件開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing all supports at once before strength is adequate lets the crown or free edges sag and crack, possibly with local dents; removing one side first loads the shell asymmetrically, changes the direction of support thrust and cracks the edge members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以現場同條件養護試體或埋設溫度感測器以成熟度法確認脫模強度；卸載時在頂部與邊緣設沉陷量測點，每一級卸載後記錄變位並與預測值比較，偏差超過警戒值即停止並由設計者評估。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm striking strength with field-cured specimens or embedded temperature sensors and the maturity method; during decentering place settlement points at the crown and edges, record deflection after each stage, compare with prediction, and stop for designer assessment if the alert value is exceeded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 脫模卸載程序應由殼體設計者撰寫，列出卸載順序、每級降幅、量測點與停止條件，並在現場設停檢點，由設計者代表確認強度與變位後才進入下一級。
knowledge.textEn: The shell designer should write the decentering procedure with sequence, lowering per stage, measurement points and stop conditions, with a site hold point at each stage where the designer's representative confirms strength and deflection before continuing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「澆置、養護與脫模卸載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Casting, curing and decentering"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
以現場同條件養護試體或埋設溫度感測器以成熟度法確認脫模強度。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
Confirm striking strength with field-cured specimens or embedded temperature sensors and the maturity method.
quiz.explanation: 以現場同條件養護試體或埋設溫度感測器以成熟度法確認脫模強度；卸載時在頂部與邊緣設沉陷量測點，每一級卸載後記錄變位並與預測值比較，偏差超過警戒值即停止並由設計者評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm striking strength with field-cured specimens or embedded temperature sensors and the maturity method; during decentering place settlement points at the crown and edges, record deflection after each stage, compare with prediction, and stop for designer assessment if the alert value is exceeded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 澆置、養護與脫模卸載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Casting, curing and decentering: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「澆置順序與脫模卸載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Casting sequence and decentering” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為趕工在強度不足時一次拆除支撐，殼體在頂部或自由邊產生過大下垂與裂縫，甚至局部凹陷；單側先拆使殼體承受不對稱荷載，支點推力方向改變，邊緣構件開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing all supports at once before strength is adequate lets the crown or free edges sag and crack, possibly with local dents; removing one side first loads the shell asymmetrically, changes the direction of support thrust and cracks the edge members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄殼表面積大、厚度小，水分蒸發快，早期養護不足會造成塑性收縮裂縫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Shells have a large surface and small thickness, so water evaporates quickly and inadequate early curing causes plastic shrinkage cracks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為趕工在強度不足時一次拆除支撐，殼體在頂部或自由邊產生過大下垂與裂縫，甚至局部凹陷；單側先拆使殼體承受不對稱荷載，支點推力方向改變，邊緣構件開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Removing all supports at once before strength is adequate lets the crown or free edges sag and crack, possibly with local dents; removing one side first loads the shell asymmetrically, changes the direction of support thrust and cracks the edge members.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「澆置、養護與脫模卸載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Casting, curing and decentering" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為趕工在強度不足時一次拆除支撐，殼體在頂部或自由邊產生過大下垂與裂縫，甚至局部凹陷；單側先拆使殼體承受不對稱荷載，支點推力方向改變，邊緣構件開裂。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。
optionsEn: Removing all supports at once before strength is adequate lets the crown or free edges sag and crack, possibly with local dents.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 為趕工在強度不足時一次拆除支撐，殼體在頂部或自由邊產生過大下垂與裂縫，甚至局部凹陷；單側先拆使殼體承受不對稱荷載，支點推力方向改變，邊緣構件開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing all supports at once before strength is adequate lets the crown or free edges sag and crack, possibly with local dents; removing one side first loads the shell asymmetrically, changes the direction of support thrust and cracks the edge members. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」與「模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction" and "Model tests, load tests and creep deflection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「幾何掃描與曲率檢核」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometry scan and curvature check” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼對幾何誤差的敏感度遠高於一般構件，因為挫屈荷載取決於局部曲率半徑。殼面某處若被做得比設計平坦，該處的局部曲率半徑變大，挫屈能力就以曲率半徑平方的反比下降。因此驗收不能只看整體高程誤差，還要看在數公尺弦長範圍內的局部矢高，也就是局部曲率是否被保住。現代工地可用雷射掃描取得完整點雲，把模板完成面與殼體完成面都與設計曲面比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「幾何掃描與曲率檢核」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thin shells are far more sensitive to geometry errors than ordinary members because buckling capacity depends on the local radius of curvature. Where the surface is built flatter than designed, the local radius grows and buckling capacity falls with the inverse square of that radius. Acceptance therefore cannot rely only on overall level errors; it must check local sagitta over chords of a few metres to confirm that local curvature is preserved. Modern sites can capture full point clouds by laser scanning and compare both the formwork surface and the finished shell with the design surface. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Geometry scan and curvature check” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦長 l = 4 m、設計曲率半徑 R = 40 m 時矢高 s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a chord l = 4 m and design radius R = 40 m the sagitta is s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「幾何掃描與曲率檢核」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Geometry scan and curvature check”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減
knowledge.titleEn: Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction
knowledge.text: 薄殼對幾何誤差的敏感度遠高於一般構件，因為挫屈荷載取決於局部曲率半徑。殼面某處若被做得比設計平坦，該處的局部曲率半徑變大，挫屈能力就以曲率半徑平方的反比下降。
knowledge.textEn: Thin shells are far more sensitive to geometry errors than ordinary members because buckling capacity depends on the local radius of curvature. Where the surface is built flatter than designed, the local radius grows and buckling capacity falls with the inverse square of that radius.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction" is correct?
options: 薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。
薄殼對幾何誤差的敏感度遠高於一般構件，因為挫屈荷載取決於局部曲率半徑。
薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。
optionsEn: A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
Thin shells are far more sensitive to geometry errors than ordinary members because buckling capacity depends on the local radius of curvature.
Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼對幾何誤差的敏感度遠高於一般構件，因為挫屈荷載取決於局部曲率半徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin shells are far more sensitive to geometry errors than ordinary members because buckling capacity depends on the local radius of curvature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何掃描與曲率檢核」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometry scan and curvature check” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦長 l = 4 m、設計曲率半徑 R = 40 m 時矢高 s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m。若量到的矢高只有 0.03 m，局部曲率半徑 R′ = l²/(8s′) = 16/0.24 ≈ 66.7 m，挫屈能力約按 (R/R′)² = (40/66.7)² ≈ 0.36 下降，也就是只剩約 36%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a chord l = 4 m and design radius R = 40 m the sagitta is s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m. If only 0.03 m is measured, the local radius is R′ = l²/(8s′) = 16/0.24 ≈ 66.7 m, and buckling capacity falls roughly by (R/R′)² = (40/66.7)² ≈ 0.36, leaving only about 36%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在模板完成後與殼體脫模後各做一次雷射掃描，以設計曲面為基準計算偏差色圖，並以移動弦長檢查局部矢高；局部矢高偏差超過規定值的區域須由設計者以實測幾何重算挫屈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Laser-scan the formwork when complete and the shell after decentering, compute deviation maps against the design surface and check local sagitta with a moving chord; where local sagitta deviates beyond the specified value, the designer must recompute buckling with the measured geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 弦長 l = 4 m、設計曲率半徑 R = 40 m 時矢高 s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m。若量到的矢高只有 0.03 m，局部曲率半徑 R′ = l²/(8s′) = 16/0.24 ≈ 66.7 m，挫屈能力約按 (R/R′)² = (40/66.7)² ≈ 0.36 下降，也就是只剩約 36%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a chord l = 4 m and design radius R = 40 m the sagitta is s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m. If only 0.03 m is measured, the local radius is R′ = l²/(8s′) = 16/0.24 ≈ 66.7 m, and buckling capacity falls roughly by (R/R′)² = (40/66.7)² ≈ 0.36, leaving only about 36%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction", which statement holds?
options: 薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。
混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
弦長 l = 4 m、設計曲率半徑 R = 40 m 時矢高 s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m。
optionsEn: Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer.
Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
For a chord l = 4 m and design radius R = 40 m the sagitta is s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m.
quiz.explanation: 弦長 l = 4 m、設計曲率半徑 R = 40 m 時矢高 s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a chord l = 4 m and design radius R = 40 m the sagitta is s = l²/(8R) = 16/320 = 0.05 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「幾何掃描與曲率檢核」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometry scan and curvature check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在模板完成後與殼體脫模後各做一次雷射掃描，以設計曲面為基準計算偏差色圖，並以移動弦長檢查局部矢高；局部矢高偏差超過規定值的區域須由設計者以實測幾何重算挫屈。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Laser-scan the formwork when complete and the shell after decentering, compute deviation maps against the design surface and check local sagitta with a moving chord; where local sagitta deviates beyond the specified value, the designer must recompute buckling with the measured geometry. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範要同時規定整體偏差與局部矢高（或局部曲率）容許值，並把模板完成面掃描列為澆置前停檢點；掃描點雲與偏差報告要納入竣工資料，作為日後變形監測的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify tolerances on both overall deviation and local sagitta or curvature, make a scan of the completed formwork a pre-pour hold point, and include point clouds and deviation reports in the as-built records as the baseline for later deformation monitoring.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗收控制點高程而忽略控制點之間的平坦區，殼體在驗收時看似合格，數年後在積雪或潛變下於平坦區出現凹陷；若模板誤差已知卻未在澆置前修正，事後只能以加肋或加厚補強，代價很高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting only control-point levels while ignoring flat zones between them can pass a shell that later dents in a flat zone under snow or creep; if known formwork errors are not corrected before casting, the only remedy afterwards is costly ribbing or thickening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在模板完成後與殼體脫模後各做一次雷射掃描，以設計曲面為基準計算偏差色圖，並以移動弦長檢查局部矢高；局部矢高偏差超過規定值的區域須由設計者以實測幾何重算挫屈。
knowledge.textEn: Laser-scan the formwork when complete and the shell after decentering, compute deviation maps against the design surface and check local sagitta with a moving chord; where local sagitta deviates beyond the specified value, the designer must recompute buckling with the measured geometry.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範要同時規定整體偏差與局部矢高（或局部曲率）容許值，並把模板完成面掃描列為澆置前停檢點；掃描點雲與偏差報告要納入竣工資料，作為日後變形監測的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Specify tolerances on both overall deviation and local sagitta or curvature, make a scan of the completed formwork a pre-pour hold point, and include point clouds and deviation reports in the as-built records as the baseline for later deformation monitoring.

quiz.question: 要驗證「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction"?
options: 在模板完成後與殼體脫模後各做一次雷射掃描，以設計曲面為基準計算偏差色圖，並以移動弦長檢查局部矢高；局部矢高偏差超過規定值的區域須由設計者以實測幾何重算挫屈。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。
optionsEn: Laser-scan the formwork when complete and the shell after decentering, compute deviation maps against the design surface and check local sagitta with a moving chord.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later.
quiz.explanation: 在模板完成後與殼體脫模後各做一次雷射掃描，以設計曲面為基準計算偏差色圖，並以移動弦長檢查局部矢高；局部矢高偏差超過規定值的區域須由設計者以實測幾何重算挫屈。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Laser-scan the formwork when complete and the shell after decentering, compute deviation maps against the design surface and check local sagitta with a moving chord; where local sagitta deviates beyond the specified value, the designer must recompute buckling with the measured geometry. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何掃描與曲率檢核」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometry scan and curvature check” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗收控制點高程而忽略控制點之間的平坦區，殼體在驗收時看似合格，數年後在積雪或潛變下於平坦區出現凹陷；若模板誤差已知卻未在澆置前修正，事後只能以加肋或加厚補強，代價很高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting only control-point levels while ignoring flat zones between them can pass a shell that later dents in a flat zone under snow or creep; if known formwork errors are not corrected before casting, the only remedy afterwards is costly ribbing or thickening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現代工地可用雷射掃描取得完整點雲，把模板完成面與殼體完成面都與設計曲面比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern sites can capture full point clouds by laser scanning and compare both the formwork surface and the finished shell with the design surface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只驗收控制點高程而忽略控制點之間的平坦區，殼體在驗收時看似合格，數年後在積雪或潛變下於平坦區出現凹陷；若模板誤差已知卻未在澆置前修正，事後只能以加肋或加厚補強，代價很高。
knowledge.textEn: Accepting only control-point levels while ignoring flat zones between them can pass a shell that later dents in a flat zone under snow or creep; if known formwork errors are not corrected before casting, the only remedy afterwards is costly ribbing or thickening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只驗收控制點高程而忽略控制點之間的平坦區，殼體在驗收時看似合格，數年後在積雪或潛變下於平坦區出現凹陷。
薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Accepting only control-point levels while ignoring flat zones between them can pass a shell that later dents in a flat zone under snow or creep.
Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
quiz.explanation: 只驗收控制點高程而忽略控制點之間的平坦區，殼體在驗收時看似合格，數年後在積雪或潛變下於平坦區出現凹陷；若模板誤差已知卻未在澆置前修正，事後只能以加肋或加厚補強，代價很高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accepting only control-point levels while ignoring flat zones between them can pass a shell that later dents in a flat zone under snow or creep; if known formwork errors are not corrected before casting, the only remedy afterwards is costly ribbing or thickening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Model tests, load tests and creep deflection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「載重試驗與長期變位」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load test and long-term deflection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼的設計史與實驗密不可分：Isler 以布料倒懸、凍結或灌漿硬化的模型找形並測試，再按比例放大；他的方法從 1957 年開始實驗，1968 年在實際工程中實現。完工後的驗證則包括載重試驗與長期變位監測。載重試驗以沙包或水袋分區加載，量測頂部與邊緣變位並觀察卸載後的回復；長期監測則追蹤潛變造成的緩慢下垂，因為潛變既增加變位，也降低挫屈安全係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「載重試驗與長期變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shell design history is inseparable from experiment: Isler found and tested forms with hanging cloth models that he froze or stiffened with cement, then scaled them up; he began experimenting in 1957 and realised the method in built projects in 1968. After completion, verification includes load testing and long-term deflection monitoring. Load tests apply sandbags or water bags zone by zone, measure crown and edge deflections and observe recovery after unloading; long-term monitoring follows the slow sag caused by creep, which both increases deflection and lowers the buckling margin. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Load test and long-term deflection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：長期變位 δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Long-term deflection δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「載重試驗與長期變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Load test and long-term deflection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位
knowledge.titleEn: Model tests, load tests and creep deflection
knowledge.text: 薄殼的設計史與實驗密不可分：Isler 以布料倒懸、凍結或灌漿硬化的模型找形並測試，再按比例放大；他的方法從 1957 年開始實驗，1968 年在實際工程中實現。完工後的驗證則包括載重試驗與長期變位監測。
knowledge.textEn: Shell design history is inseparable from experiment: Isler found and tested forms with hanging cloth models that he froze or stiffened with cement, then scaled them up; he began experimenting in 1957 and realised the method in built projects in 1968. After completion, verification includes load testing and long-term deflection monitoring.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Model tests, load tests and creep deflection" is correct?
options: 薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。
薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。
薄殼的設計史與實驗密不可分：Isler 以布料倒懸、凍結或灌漿硬化的模型找形並測試，再按比例放大。
optionsEn: Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging.
Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
Shell design history is inseparable from experiment: Isler found and tested forms with hanging cloth models that he froze or stiffened with cement, then scaled them up.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼的設計史與實驗密不可分：Isler 以布料倒懸、凍結或灌漿硬化的模型找形並測試，再按比例放大；他的方法從 1957 年開始實驗，1968 年在實際工程中實現。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shell design history is inseparable from experiment: Isler found and tested forms with hanging cloth models that he froze or stiffened with cement, then scaled them up; he began experimenting in 1957 and realised the method in built projects in 1968. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Model tests, load tests and creep deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「載重試驗與長期變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load test and long-term deflection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：長期變位 δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ)。彈性變位 8 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時 δ_∞ = 8×3 = 24 mm，40 m 跨約為 L/1,670。載重試驗量到最大變位 6.0 mm、卸載 24 小時後殘餘 1.0 mm，殘餘比 1.0/6.0 ≈ 17%，小於 25% 的回復準則。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Long-term deflection δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ). With an elastic deflection of 8 mm and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, δ_∞ = 8×3 = 24 mm, about L/1,670 over a 40 m span. A load test measuring a maximum of 6.0 mm and a residual of 1.0 mm after 24 hours unloaded gives a residual ratio of 1.0/6.0 ≈ 17%, below a 25% recovery criterion. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：載重試驗前寫好計畫：加載分區與分級、量測點位置、基準量測、最大荷載持載時間與回復準則（可參考 ACI 318 第 27 章的載重試驗概念），並在每級加載後檢查裂縫；長期監測以固定測點每年量測頂部高程，與潛變預測曲線比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plan the load test beforehand: loading zones and increments, gauge positions, baseline readings, holding time at peak load and recovery criteria (the load-test concepts of ACI 318 Chapter 27 are a useful reference), with a crack check after each increment; for long-term monitoring survey crown level at fixed points each year and compare with the predicted creep curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 長期變位 δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ)。彈性變位 8 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時 δ_∞ = 8×3 = 24 mm，40 m 跨約為 L/1,670。載重試驗量到最大變位 6.0 mm、卸載 24 小時後殘餘 1.0 mm，殘餘比 1.0/6.0 ≈ 17%，小於 25% 的回復準則。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term deflection δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ). With an elastic deflection of 8 mm and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, δ_∞ = 8×3 = 24 mm, about L/1,670 over a 40 m span. A load test measuring a maximum of 6.0 mm and a residual of 1.0 mm after 24 hours unloaded gives a residual ratio of 1.0/6.0 ≈ 17%, below a 25% recovery criterion. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Model tests, load tests and creep deflection", which statement holds?
options: 長期變位 δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ)。
薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。
雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
optionsEn: Long-term deflection δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ).
Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.
A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
quiz.explanation: 長期變位 δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term deflection δ_∞ = δ_el(1 + φ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Model tests, load tests and creep deflection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「載重試驗與長期變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load test and long-term deflection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 載重試驗前寫好計畫：加載分區與分級、量測點位置、基準量測、最大荷載持載時間與回復準則（可參考 ACI 318 第 27 章的載重試驗概念），並在每級加載後檢查裂縫；長期監測以固定測點每年量測頂部高程，與潛變預測曲線比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plan the load test beforehand: loading zones and increments, gauge positions, baseline readings, holding time at peak load and recovery criteria (the load-test concepts of ACI 318 Chapter 27 are a useful reference), with a crack check after each increment; for long-term monitoring survey crown level at fixed points each year and compare with the predicted creep curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：載重試驗屬於結構安全試驗，須由結構設計者與第三方檢驗機構共同核准試驗計畫，並設中止條件；長期變位量測點要以不鏽鋼標記永久保存，量測紀錄納入建築維護計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A load test is a structural safety test; the structural designer and a third-party inspection body must jointly approve the plan with stop criteria, and long-term deflection points should be permanent stainless-steel markers with readings kept in the building maintenance plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：載重試驗只加在單一區塊而未涵蓋不對稱荷載，無法反映殼體最危險的半跨加載狀態；長期監測缺席時，殼頂逐年下垂到形成積水窪，積水荷載再加速變形，形成惡性循環。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only one zone without asymmetric loading misses the critical half-span load case; without long-term monitoring the crown can sag year by year until it ponds water, and the ponding load accelerates deformation in a vicious circle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 載重試驗前寫好計畫：加載分區與分級、量測點位置、基準量測、最大荷載持載時間與回復準則（可參考 ACI 318 第 27 章的載重試驗概念），並在每級加載後檢查裂縫；長期監測以固定測點每年量測頂部高程，與潛變預測曲線比較。
knowledge.textEn: Plan the load test beforehand: loading zones and increments, gauge positions, baseline readings, holding time at peak load and recovery criteria (the load-test concepts of ACI 318 Chapter 27 are a useful reference), with a crack check after each increment; for long-term monitoring survey crown level at fixed points each year and compare with the predicted creep curve.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 載重試驗屬於結構安全試驗，須由結構設計者與第三方檢驗機構共同核准試驗計畫，並設中止條件；長期變位量測點要以不鏽鋼標記永久保存，量測紀錄納入建築維護計畫。
knowledge.textEn: A load test is a structural safety test; the structural designer and a third-party inspection body must jointly approve the plan with stop criteria, and long-term deflection points should be permanent stainless-steel markers with readings kept in the building maintenance plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Model tests, load tests and creep deflection"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
載重試驗前寫好計畫：加載分區與分級、量測點位置、基準量測、最大荷載持載時間與回復準則（可參考 ACI 318 第 27 章的載重試驗概念），並在每級加載後檢查裂縫。
柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Plan the load test beforehand: loading zones and increments, gauge positions, baseline readings, holding time at peak load and recovery criteria (the load-test concepts of ACI 318 Chapter 27 are a useful reference), with a crack check after each increment.
A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation.
quiz.explanation: 載重試驗前寫好計畫：加載分區與分級、量測點位置、基準量測、最大荷載持載時間與回復準則（可參考 ACI 318 第 27 章的載重試驗概念），並在每級加載後檢查裂縫；長期監測以固定測點每年量測頂部高程，與潛變預測曲線比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plan the load test beforehand: loading zones and increments, gauge positions, baseline readings, holding time at peak load and recovery criteria (the load-test concepts of ACI 318 Chapter 27 are a useful reference), with a crack check after each increment; for long-term monitoring survey crown level at fixed points each year and compare with the predicted creep curve. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model tests, load tests and creep deflection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「載重試驗與長期變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load test and long-term deflection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 載重試驗只加在單一區塊而未涵蓋不對稱荷載，無法反映殼體最危險的半跨加載狀態；長期監測缺席時，殼頂逐年下垂到形成積水窪，積水荷載再加速變形，形成惡性循環。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only one zone without asymmetric loading misses the critical half-span load case; without long-term monitoring the crown can sag year by year until it ponds water, and the ponding load accelerates deformation in a vicious circle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：載重試驗以沙包或水袋分區加載，量測頂部與邊緣變位並觀察卸載後的回復；長期監測則追蹤潛變造成的緩慢下垂，因為潛變既增加變位，也降低挫屈安全係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Load tests apply sandbags or water bags zone by zone, measure crown and edge deflections and observe recovery after unloading; long-term monitoring follows the slow sag caused by creep, which both increases deflection and lowers the buckling margin.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼完工後變位已固定，之後不會再繼續下垂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a shell is complete its deflection is fixed and it will not keep sagging." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 載重試驗只加在單一區塊而未涵蓋不對稱荷載，無法反映殼體最危險的半跨加載狀態；長期監測缺席時，殼頂逐年下垂到形成積水窪，積水荷載再加速變形，形成惡性循環。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only one zone without asymmetric loading misses the critical half-span load case; without long-term monitoring the crown can sag year by year until it ponds water, and the ponding load accelerates deformation in a vicious circle.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型試驗、載重試驗與潛變變位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Model tests, load tests and creep deflection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。
載重試驗只加在單一區塊而未涵蓋不對稱荷載，無法反映殼體最危險的半跨加載狀態；長期監測缺席時，殼頂逐年下垂到形成積水窪，積水荷載再加速變形，形成惡性循環。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
Testing only one zone without asymmetric loading misses the critical half-span load case.
quiz.explanation: 載重試驗只加在單一區塊而未涵蓋不對稱荷載，無法反映殼體最危險的半跨加載狀態；長期監測缺席時，殼頂逐年下垂到形成積水窪，積水荷載再加速變形，形成惡性循環。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only one zone without asymmetric loading misses the critical half-span load case; without long-term monitoring the crown can sag year by year until it ponds water, and the ponding load accelerates deformation in a vicious circle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護」與「長期耐久、修復與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection" and "Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「溫差裂縫與防水層」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal cracking and waterproofing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 薄殼暴露在日照與夜間輻射冷卻之下，上下表面溫差大，殼板又薄，溫度梯度在受約束時產生顯著彎曲應力。Isler 的作法之一是在殼體內面留置纖維板模板作為保溫層，讓內側表面溫度接近外側，避免溫差造成屋頂開裂。裂縫一旦形成，雨水就沿裂縫進入保護層很薄的鋼筋區，薄殼的耐久問題往往從這裡開始。現代殼體常加防水膜或塗層，但塗層必須能跟著殼面變形且可維修。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「溫差裂縫與防水層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thin shells face sun by day and radiative cooling by night, so top and bottom surfaces differ greatly in temperature, and the thin plate develops significant bending stress where the gradient is restrained. One of Isler's measures was to leave fibreboard formwork in place on the inner face as insulation so the inner surface stays close to the outer temperature, avoiding gradient cracking. Once cracks form, rain penetrates to the thinly covered reinforcement, and durability problems in shells usually start there. Modern shells often add a waterproof membrane or coating, but it must follow shell movements and be repairable. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thermal cracking and waterproofing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：受約束板的溫度梯度應力 σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The stress from a restrained temperature gradient is σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「溫差裂縫與防水層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Thermal cracking and waterproofing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護
knowledge.titleEn: Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection
knowledge.text: 薄殼暴露在日照與夜間輻射冷卻之下，上下表面溫差大，殼板又薄，溫度梯度在受約束時產生顯著彎曲應力。Isler 的作法之一是在殼體內面留置纖維板模板作為保溫層，讓內側表面溫度接近外側，避免溫差造成屋頂開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Thin shells face sun by day and radiative cooling by night, so top and bottom surfaces differ greatly in temperature, and the thin plate develops significant bending stress where the gradient is restrained. One of Isler's measures was to leave fibreboard formwork in place on the inner face as insulation so the inner surface stays close to the outer temperature, avoiding gradient cracking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection" is correct?
options: 薄殼暴露在日照與夜間輻射冷卻之下，上下表面溫差大，殼板又薄，溫度梯度在受約束時產生顯著彎曲應力。
薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。
薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。
optionsEn: Thin shells face sun by day and radiative cooling by night, so top and bottom surfaces differ greatly in temperature, and the thin plate develops significant bending stress where the gradient is restrained.
Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect.
Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer.
quiz.explanation: 薄殼暴露在日照與夜間輻射冷卻之下，上下表面溫差大，殼板又薄，溫度梯度在受約束時產生顯著彎曲應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin shells face sun by day and radiative cooling by night, so top and bottom surfaces differ greatly in temperature, and the thin plate develops significant bending stress where the gradient is restrained. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫差裂縫與防水層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal cracking and waterproofing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：受約束板的溫度梯度應力 σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]。E = 30,000 MPa、α = 10×10⁻⁶/°C、ν = 0.2、上下溫差 ΔT = 20°C 時 σ = 30,000×10⁻⁵×20/1.6 ≈ 3.75 MPa，超過約 3 MPa 的抗拉強度；以保溫把溫差降到 5°C 時 σ ≈ 0.94 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The stress from a restrained temperature gradient is σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]. With E = 30,000 MPa, α = 10×10⁻⁶ per °C, ν = 0.2 and ΔT = 20°C between faces, σ = 30,000×10⁻⁵×20/1.6 ≈ 3.75 MPa, above a tensile strength of about 3 MPa; insulation that cuts the difference to 5°C gives σ ≈ 0.94 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在殼體上下表面埋設或黏貼溫度感測器，量測夏季晴天日夜溫差，與設計假設比較；定期以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄裂縫位置與寬度，並以灑水或雨後檢查確認防水層是否有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Embed or attach temperature sensors on both faces to measure day-night differences on clear summer days and compare them with design assumptions; record crack location and width periodically with a crack gauge and crack maps, and check the waterproofing with water testing or after rain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 受約束板的溫度梯度應力 σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]。E = 30,000 MPa、α = 10×10⁻⁶/°C、ν = 0.2、上下溫差 ΔT = 20°C 時 σ = 30,000×10⁻⁵×20/1.6 ≈ 3.75 MPa，超過約 3 MPa 的抗拉強度；以保溫把溫差降到 5°C 時 σ ≈ 0.94 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The stress from a restrained temperature gradient is σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]. With E = 30,000 MPa, α = 10×10⁻⁶ per °C, ν = 0.2 and ΔT = 20°C between faces, σ = 30,000×10⁻⁵×20/1.6 ≈ 3.75 MPa, above a tensile strength of about 3 MPa; insulation that cuts the difference to 5°C gives σ ≈ 0.94 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度很高，薄殼只要壓應力低於強度就不會破壞。
受約束板的溫度梯度應力 σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]。
薄殼厚度只要滿足應力計算即可，保護層與鋼筋層數可以事後調整。
optionsEn: Concrete is strong in compression, so a thin shell will not fail as long as compressive stress stays below strength.
