The stress from a restrained temperature gradient is σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)].
Shell thickness only has to satisfy the stress calculation; cover and layers can be adjusted later.
quiz.explanation: 受約束板的溫度梯度應力 σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The stress from a restrained temperature gradient is σ = Eα·ΔT/[2(1−ν)]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫差裂縫與防水層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal cracking and waterproofing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在殼體上下表面埋設或黏貼溫度感測器，量測夏季晴天日夜溫差，與設計假設比較；定期以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄裂縫位置與寬度，並以灑水或雨後檢查確認防水層是否有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Embed or attach temperature sensors on both faces to measure day-night differences on clear summer days and compare them with design assumptions; record crack location and width periodically with a crack gauge and crack maps, and check the waterproofing with water testing or after rain. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計說明中要列出溫度梯度荷載假設、保溫或遮陽策略與防水層類型，並在維護手冊規定裂縫檢查週期與修補材料；任何在殼面上新增設備或開孔都需設計者審查其對溫度與防水的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State the temperature-gradient assumption, insulation or shading strategy and waterproofing type in the design notes, set crack-inspection intervals and repair materials in the maintenance manual, and have the designer review any new equipment or opening on the shell for its thermal and waterproofing effects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未考慮溫度梯度的殼體在完工後第一個夏季就出現網狀或經向裂縫，雨水滲入後鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落，薄殼保護層小，損壞速度比一般樓板快；剛性防水塗層跟不上殼體變形而龜裂，反而把水封在裂縫內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shell designed without the gradient cracks in a map or meridional pattern in its first summer, rain gets in, bars corrode and concrete spalls, and with small cover damage advances faster than in ordinary slabs; a rigid coating that cannot follow shell movement cracks and traps water inside the cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在殼體上下表面埋設或黏貼溫度感測器，量測夏季晴天日夜溫差，與設計假設比較；定期以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄裂縫位置與寬度，並以灑水或雨後檢查確認防水層是否有效。
knowledge.textEn: Embed or attach temperature sensors on both faces to measure day-night differences on clear summer days and compare them with design assumptions; record crack location and width periodically with a crack gauge and crack maps, and check the waterproofing with water testing or after rain.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計說明中要列出溫度梯度荷載假設、保溫或遮陽策略與防水層類型，並在維護手冊規定裂縫檢查週期與修補材料；任何在殼面上新增設備或開孔都需設計者審查其對溫度與防水的影響。
knowledge.textEn: State the temperature-gradient assumption, insulation or shading strategy and waterproofing type in the design notes, set crack-inspection intervals and repair materials in the maintenance manual, and have the designer review any new equipment or opening on the shell for its thermal and waterproofing effects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
薄殼混凝土很薄，硬化很快，所以可以比一般樓板更早拆模。
在殼體上下表面埋設或黏貼溫度感測器，量測夏季晴天日夜溫差，與設計假設比較；定期以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄裂縫位置與寬度，並以灑水或雨後檢查確認防水層是否有效。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Shell concrete is thin and hardens quickly, so it can be struck earlier than an ordinary slab.
Embed or attach temperature sensors on both faces to measure day-night differences on clear summer days and compare them with design assumptions.
quiz.explanation: 在殼體上下表面埋設或黏貼溫度感測器，量測夏季晴天日夜溫差，與設計假設比較；定期以裂縫寬度計與裂縫圖記錄裂縫位置與寬度，並以灑水或雨後檢查確認防水層是否有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Embed or attach temperature sensors on both faces to measure day-night differences on clear summer days and compare them with design assumptions; record crack location and width periodically with a crack gauge and crack maps, and check the waterproofing with water testing or after rain. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫差裂縫與防水層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal cracking and waterproofing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未考慮溫度梯度的殼體在完工後第一個夏季就出現網狀或經向裂縫，雨水滲入後鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落，薄殼保護層小，損壞速度比一般樓板快；剛性防水塗層跟不上殼體變形而龜裂，反而把水封在裂縫內。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shell designed without the gradient cracks in a map or meridional pattern in its first summer, rain gets in, bars corrode and concrete spalls, and with small cover damage advances faster than in ordinary slabs; a rigid coating that cannot follow shell movement cracks and traps water inside the cracks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現代殼體常加防水膜或塗層，但塗層必須能跟著殼面變形且可維修。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern shells often add a waterproof membrane or coating, but it must follow shell movements and be repairable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼裂縫只影響外觀，結構上沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cracks in a thin shell are only cosmetic and have no structural effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未考慮溫度梯度的殼體在完工後第一個夏季就出現網狀或經向裂縫，雨水滲入後鋼筋鏽蝕、混凝土剝落，薄殼保護層小，損壞速度比一般樓板快；剛性防水塗層跟不上殼體變形而龜裂，反而把水封在裂縫內。
knowledge.textEn: A shell designed without the gradient cracks in a map or meridional pattern in its first summer, rain gets in, bars corrode and concrete spalls, and with small cover damage advances faster than in ordinary slabs; a rigid coating that cannot follow shell movement cracks and traps water inside the cracks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度梯度、裂縫與防水保護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature gradients, cracking and weather protection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。
optionsEn: A shell designed without the gradient cracks in a map or meridional pattern in its first summer, rain gets in, bars corrode and concrete spalls, and with small cover damage advances faster than in ordinary slabs.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer.

quiz.explanationEn: A shell designed without the gradient cracks in a map or meridional pattern in its first summer, rain gets in, bars corrode and concrete spalls, and with small cover damage advances faster than in ordinary slabs; a rigid coating that cannot follow shell movement cracks and traps water inside the cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長期耐久、修復與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「檢查與修復紀錄」如何影響薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inspection and repair records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Thin-shell concrete roof construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 許多 1950 至 1970 年代的薄殼至今仍在使用，研究者指出 Isler 的殼體已良好表現四到五十年，但薄殼的耐久裕度天生較小：保護層薄、表面積大，碳化與氯離子較快到達鋼筋。修復時不能隨意加厚或加設備，因為額外重量與剛度改變會影響薄膜狀態與挫屈安全係數。交接資料應包含設計曲面、實測點雲、配筋與保護層紀錄、脫模變位紀錄與長期監測基準，讓日後修復能在原形狀與原假設的基礎上進行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「檢查與修復紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many shells from the 1950s to 1970s remain in use, and researchers note that Isler's shells have performed well for four to five decades, but shells inherently have smaller durability margins: thin cover and large surface area let carbonation and chlorides reach reinforcement sooner. Repairs cannot casually add thickness or equipment, because extra weight and changed stiffness alter the membrane state and buckling margin. Handover records should contain the design surface, measured point clouds, reinforcement and cover records, decentering deflections and long-term monitoring baselines so that later repairs build on the original form and assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Inspection and repair records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：碳化深度 x = k√t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Carbonation depth x = k√t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「檢查與修復紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Inspection and repair records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期耐久、修復與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover
knowledge.text: 許多 1950 至 1970 年代的薄殼至今仍在使用，研究者指出 Isler 的殼體已良好表現四到五十年，但薄殼的耐久裕度天生較小：保護層薄、表面積大，碳化與氯離子較快到達鋼筋。修復時不能隨意加厚或加設備，因為額外重量與剛度改變會影響薄膜狀態與挫屈安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Many shells from the 1950s to 1970s remain in use, and researchers note that Isler's shells have performed well for four to five decades, but shells inherently have smaller durability margins: thin cover and large surface area let carbonation and chlorides reach reinforcement sooner. Repairs cannot casually add thickness or equipment, because extra weight and changed stiffness alter the membrane state and buckling margin.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期耐久、修復與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover" is correct?
options: 薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。
許多 1950 至 1970 年代的薄殼至今仍在使用，研究者指出 Isler 的殼體已良好表現四到五十年，但薄殼的耐久裕度天生較小：保護層薄、表面積大，碳化與氯離子較快到達鋼筋。
薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。
optionsEn: Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer.

Many shells from the 1950s to 1970s remain in use, and researchers note that Isler's shells have performed well for four to five decades, but shells inherently have smaller durability margins: thin cover and large surface area let carbonation and chlorides reach reinforcement sooner.
Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 許多 1950 至 1970 年代的薄殼至今仍在使用，研究者指出 Isler 的殼體已良好表現四到五十年，但薄殼的耐久裕度天生較小：保護層薄、表面積大，碳化與氯離子較快到達鋼筋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Many shells from the 1950s to 1970s remain in use, and researchers note that Isler's shells have performed well for four to five decades, but shells inherently have smaller durability margins: thin cover and large surface area let carbonation and chlorides reach reinforcement sooner. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期耐久、修復與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢查與修復紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inspection and repair records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：碳化深度 x = k√t。k = 3 mm/√年 時 50 年 x = 3×√50 ≈ 21.2 mm；保護層 20 mm 的殼面約在 (20/3)² ≈ 44 年碳化到達鋼筋。若保護層因施工誤差只剩 15 mm，時間縮為 (15/3)² = 25 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Carbonation depth x = k√t. With k = 3 mm per √year, x = 3×√50 ≈ 21.2 mm at 50 years, so a shell with 20 mm cover is carbonated to the bars at about (20/3)² ≈ 44 years; if construction error leaves only 15 mm, that drops to (15/3)² = 25 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以酚酞試驗量測碳化深度、以保護層測定儀與半電池電位圖評估鋼筋腐蝕風險，結果與竣工保護層紀錄比對；修復設計須以實測幾何與材料重新計算薄膜力與挫屈，並由原設計者或同等資格者簽認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure carbonation depth periodically with phenolphthalein, assess corrosion risk with a covermeter and half-cell potential mapping, and compare with the as-built cover records; repair designs must recompute membrane forces and buckling from measured geometry and materials and be signed by the original designer or an equally qualified engineer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 碳化深度 x = k√t。k = 3 mm/√年 時 50 年 x = 3×√50 ≈ 21.2 mm；保護層 20 mm 的殼面約在 (20/3)² ≈ 44 年碳化到達鋼筋。若保護層因施工誤差只剩 15 mm，時間縮為 (15/3)² = 25 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Carbonation depth x = k√t. With k = 3 mm per √year, x = 3×√50 ≈ 21.2 mm at 50 years, so a shell with 20 mm cover is carbonated to the bars at about (20/3)² ≈ 44 years; if construction error leaves only 15 mm, that drops to (15/3)² = 25 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期耐久、修復與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover", which statement holds?
options: 雙曲拋物面是複雜曲面，所以模板一定要用電腦切割的曲面板才能施工。
柔性織物模板會自然形成正確的殼形，不需要計算受載後的變形。
碳化深度 x = k√t。
optionsEn: A hyperbolic paraboloid is so complex that its formwork must be made from computer-cut curved panels.
A flexible fabric mould naturally forms the correct shell shape without calculating its loaded deformation.
Carbonation depth x = k√t.
quiz.explanation: 碳化深度 x = k√t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Carbonation depth x = k√t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期耐久、修復與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢查與修復紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inspection and repair records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以酚酞試驗量測碳化深度、以保護層測定儀與半電池電位圖評估鋼筋腐蝕風險，結果與竣工保護層紀錄比對；修復設計須以實測幾何與材料重新計算薄膜力與挫屈，並由原設計者或同等資格者簽認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure carbonation depth periodically with phenolphthalein, assess corrosion risk with a covermeter and half-cell potential mapping, and compare with the as-built cover records; repair designs must recompute membrane forces and buckling from measured geometry and materials and be signed by the original designer or an equally qualified engineer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時移交設計曲面模型、實測點雲、保護層與碳化基準、監測點座標與允許變位，並在使用手冊中明訂殼面不得任意新增荷重或開孔；重大修復前須由結構設計者評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover deliver the design surface model, measured point clouds, cover and carbonation baselines, monitoring point coordinates and allowable deflections, and state in the user manual that no loads or openings may be added to the shell without approval; major repairs require prior assessment by a structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：修復時在殼面加鋪厚重防水層或增設空調設備，自重增加卻未重新檢核挫屈，安全係數在不知情下降低；缺少竣工點雲與變位紀錄，管理單位無法判斷殼體是否仍在持續下垂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding a heavy waterproofing build-up or HVAC equipment during repair raises self-weight without a buckling recheck, silently reducing the safety factor; without as-built point clouds and deflection records the owner cannot tell whether the shell is still sagging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期以酚酞試驗量測碳化深度、以保護層測定儀與半電池電位圖評估鋼筋腐蝕風險，結果與竣工保護層紀錄比對；修復設計須以實測幾何與材料重新計算薄膜力與挫屈，並由原設計者或同等資格者簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Measure carbonation depth periodically with phenolphthalein, assess corrosion risk with a covermeter and half-cell potential mapping, and compare with the as-built cover records; repair designs must recompute membrane forces and buckling from measured geometry and materials and be signed by the original designer or an equally qualified engineer.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時移交設計曲面模型、實測點雲、保護層與碳化基準、監測點座標與允許變位，並在使用手冊中明訂殼面不得任意新增荷重或開孔；重大修復前須由結構設計者評估。
knowledge.textEn: At handover deliver the design surface model, measured point clouds, cover and carbonation baselines, monitoring point coordinates and allowable deflections, and state in the user manual that no loads or openings may be added to the shell without approval; major repairs require prior assessment by a structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期耐久、修復與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover"?
options: 定期以酚酞試驗量測碳化深度、以保護層測定儀與半電池電位圖評估鋼筋腐蝕風險，結果與竣工保護層紀錄比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
薄殼只要整體高程在 ±20 mm 內就合格，局部形狀不重要。
optionsEn: Measure carbonation depth periodically with phenolphthalein, assess corrosion risk with a covermeter and half-cell potential mapping, and compare with the as-built cover records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A shell passes if overall levels are within ±20 mm; local shape does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 定期以酚酞試驗量測碳化深度、以保護層測定儀與半電池電位圖評估鋼筋腐蝕風險，結果與竣工保護層紀錄比對；修復設計須以實測幾何與材料重新計算薄膜力與挫屈，並由原設計者或同等資格者簽認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure carbonation depth periodically with phenolphthalein, assess corrosion risk with a covermeter and half-cell potential mapping, and compare with the as-built cover records; repair designs must recompute membrane forces and buckling from measured geometry and materials and be signed by the original designer or an equally qualified engineer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期耐久、修復與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢查與修復紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inspection and repair records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 修復時在殼面加鋪厚重防水層或增設空調設備，自重增加卻未重新檢核挫屈，安全係數在不知情下降低；缺少竣工點雲與變位紀錄，管理單位無法判斷殼體是否仍在持續下垂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding a heavy waterproofing build-up or HVAC equipment during repair raises self-weight without a buckling recheck, silently reducing the safety factor; without as-built point clouds and deflection records the owner cannot tell whether the shell is still sagging. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料應包含設計曲面、實測點雲、配筋與保護層紀錄、脫模變位紀錄與長期監測基準，讓日後修復能在原形狀與原假設的基礎上進行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover records should contain the design surface, measured point clouds, reinforcement and cover records, decentering deflections and long-term monitoring baselines so that later repairs build on the original form and assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄殼結構簡單，修復時只要補平裂縫、加一層防水即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shells are simple structures, so repairs only need crack filling and an extra waterproof layer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 修復時在殼面加鋪厚重防水層或增設空調設備，自重增加卻未重新檢核挫屈，安全係數在不知情下降低；缺少竣工點雲與變位紀錄，管理單位無法判斷殼體是否仍在持續下垂。
knowledge.textEn: Adding a heavy waterproofing build-up or HVAC equipment during repair raises self-weight without a buckling recheck, silently reducing the safety factor; without as-built point clouds and deflection records the owner cannot tell whether the shell is still sagging.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期耐久、修復與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term durability, repair and engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
修復時在殼面加鋪厚重防水層或增設空調設備，自重增加卻未重新檢核挫屈，安全係數在不知情下降低；缺少竣工點雲與變位紀錄，管理單位無法判斷殼體是否仍在持續下垂。
薄殼越薄越輕，所以只要強度夠，任何曲面形狀都能安全承載。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Adding a heavy waterproofing build-up or HVAC equipment during repair raises self-weight without a buckling recheck, silently reducing the safety factor.
Because thin shells are light, any curved shape is safe as long as the concrete is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 修復時在殼面加鋪厚重防水層或增設空調設備，自重增加卻未重新檢核挫屈，安全係數在不知情下降低；缺少竣工點雲與變位紀錄，管理單位無法判斷殼體是否仍在持續下垂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding a heavy waterproofing build-up or HVAC equipment during repair raises self-weight without a buckling recheck, silently reducing the safety factor; without as-built point clouds and deflection records the owner cannot tell whether the shell is still sagging. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高層建築核心筒滑模施工
summary: 滑模把核心筒牆體當成一條不停的生產線：約 1.2 m 高的模板由千斤頂沿爬桿每隔數分鐘上升一小段，下緣出模的混凝土必須已能自立，上方同時綁紮鋼筋、安裝埋件並澆置。本課以 CN Tower、ThyssenKrupp 羅特魏爾試驗塔與亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔為例，說明滑升速度與凝結時間、爬桿挫屈、埋件協調、垂直度與扭轉控制、冷縫與養護、以及竣工紀錄。
summaryEn: Slipforming turns a core wall into a non-stop production line: forms about 1.2 m high are jacked up rods a small step every few minutes, concrete leaving the bottom edge must already stand on its own, and above it crews fix rebar, set embeds and place concrete at the same time. Using the CN Tower, the ThyssenKrupp test tower in Rottweil and the elevator test tower in Atlanta, the course covers slip rate versus setting time, climbing-rod buckling, embed coordination, verticality and twist control, cold joints and curing, and as-built records.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 規劃練習：一座 120 m 高的核心筒，牆體總長 150 m、厚 0.4 m，以滑模施工。模板高 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m，20°C 時初凝 4 h，容許速度上限 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h，採用 0.10 m/h 保留裕度；日升 2.4 m，純滑升 120/2.4 = 50 天，加上 3 次計畫停機各 1 天，約 53 天。混凝土供應 150×0.4×0.10 = 6.0 m³/h，全程約 150×0.4×120 = 7,200 m³。平台荷重約 4,055 kN，爬桿 48.3×4 mm 在 1.5 m 無支撐長的容許荷重約 48 kN，需約 84 支千斤頂。若改在冬季施工，成熟度要求使速度降為約 0.067 m/h：純滑升 120/(0.067×24) ≈ 75 天，供料降為約 4.0 m³/h，工期增加約 25 天，但千斤頂數量不變。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的施工計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: a 120 m core with 150 m of wall at 0.4 m thick is slipformed. With 1.2 m forms and 0.2 m freeboard and initial set at 4 h at 20°C, the upper rate limit is 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h, and 0.10 m/h is chosen for margin; the core rises 2.4 m a day, so sliding takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, about 53 days with three planned one-day stops. Concrete supply is 150×0.4×0.10 = 6.0 m³/h, about 150×0.4×120 = 7,200 m³ in total. Deck load is about 4,055 kN and a 48.3×4 mm rod with 1.5 m unbraced length allows about 48 kN, so about 84 jacks are needed. In winter the maturity requirement cuts the rate to about 0.067 m/h: sliding takes 120/(0.067×24) ≈ 75 days, supply falls to about 4.0 m³/h and the programme grows by about 25 days, while the number of jacks is unchanged. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building's construction plan.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」與「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slipform principle and when cores suit it" and "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「連續滑升工序」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous slipform cycle” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。混凝土在模板內停留數小時，從頂部澆入、到下緣出模時已經初凝，可以支撐自身重量。因為模板不拆不組，核心筒每天可上升數公尺，但前提是斷面在高度方向少變化、開口與埋件能在滑升中連續安裝，且全天候不中斷供料。CN Tower 的混凝土塔身就是以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的模具連續成形，並在升高過程中逐步收窄形成錐形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「連續滑升工序」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top; jacks grip climbing rods embedded in the wall and climb them, lifting the forms, deck and hanging finishing scaffolds together. Concrete stays in the form for several hours, entering at the top and leaving the bottom edge after initial set, able to carry its own weight. Because nothing is struck and re-erected, a core can rise several metres a day, provided the section changes little with height, openings and embeds can be installed on the move and concrete supply continues around the clock. The CN Tower's concrete shaft was formed this way by a mould driven up by hydraulic climbing jacks, narrowing gradually as it rose to form the taper. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Continuous slipform cycle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「連續滑升工序」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Continuous slipform cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件
knowledge.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it
knowledge.text: 滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。混凝土在模板內停留數小時，從頂部澆入、到下緣出模時已經初凝，可以支撐自身重量。
knowledge.textEn: A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top; jacks grip climbing rods embedded in the wall and climb them, lifting the forms, deck and hanging finishing scaffolds together. Concrete stays in the form for several hours, entering at the top and leaving the bottom edge after initial set, able to carry its own weight.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Slipform principle and when cores suit it" is correct?
options: 滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。
滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。
滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
optionsEn: Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top.
The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top; jacks grip climbing rods embedded in the wall and climb them, lifting the forms, deck and hanging finishing scaffolds together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連續滑升工序」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Continuous slipform cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業；以排程模擬檢查預期停機次數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work; use schedule simulation to check the expected number of stoppages.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Slipform principle and when cores suit it", which statement holds?
options: 滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。
滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。
滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m。
optionsEn: Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.
Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints.
At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day.
quiz.explanation: 滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連續滑升工序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous slipform cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業；以排程模擬檢查預期停機次數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work; use schedule simulation to check the expected number of stoppages. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：決定採用滑模前，要求建築與結構設計把牆厚變化、退縮與開口集中在少數高程，並與滑模專業廠商共同檢討；同時確認預拌廠與運輸能 24 小時供料，且有備援廠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before choosing slipform, ask the architectural and structural designers to concentrate wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings at a few levels and review them with the slipform specialist; confirm that the ready-mix plant and haulage can supply 24 hours a day with a back-up plant.

steps.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slipform principle and when cores suit it: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「連續滑升工序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Continuous slipform cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：CN Tower 的混凝土塔身就是以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的模具連續成形，並在升高過程中逐步收窄形成錐形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The CN Tower's concrete shaft was formed this way by a mould driven up by hydraulic climbing jacks, narrowing gradually as it rose to form the taper.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。
knowledge.textEn: If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slipform principle and when cores suit it" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險。
滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk.
The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「出模混凝土強度」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete strength at form exit” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。若滑升太快，出模混凝土仍呈塑性，會坍落、鼓出或被模板拖裂；若太慢，混凝土在模板內硬化並與模板黏結，滑升時表面被撕開。凝結時間受水泥種類、緩凝劑、混凝土溫度與氣溫強烈影響，所以滑升速度必須隨日夜溫度調整，而不是固定一個數字。亞特蘭大試驗塔的模板高約 1.2 m（4 ft）。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「出模混凝土強度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own. If sliding is too fast, concrete leaving the form is still plastic and slumps, bulges or is dragged and torn; if too slow, concrete hardens in the form and bonds to it, tearing the surface when sliding resumes. Setting time depends strongly on cement type, retarders, concrete temperature and air temperature, so the slip rate must follow day and night temperatures rather than stay fixed. The forms on the Atlanta test tower were about 1.2 m (4 ft) high. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete strength at form exit” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「出模混凝土強度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete strength at form exit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度
knowledge.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate
knowledge.text: 滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。若滑升太快，出模混凝土仍呈塑性，會坍落、鼓出或被模板拖裂；若太慢，混凝土在模板內硬化並與模板黏結，滑升時表面被撕開。
knowledge.textEn: The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own. If sliding is too fast, concrete leaving the form is still plastic and slumps, bulges or is dragged and torn; if too slow, concrete hardens in the form and bonds to it, tearing the surface when sliding resumes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate" is correct?
options: 滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。
滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。
optionsEn: The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own.
quiz.explanation: 滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出模混凝土強度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete strength at form exit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。模板 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m 時有效高度 h_eff = 1.0 m；20°C 時初凝 4 h，v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h；10°C 時凝結時間約加倍為 8 h，v_max 降為 0.125 m/h。實際速度還要留裕度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set. With a 1.2 m form and 0.2 m freeboard, h_eff = 1.0 m; at 20°C with initial set at 4 h, v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h; at 10°C setting roughly doubles to 8 h and v_max drops to 0.125 m/h. Actual rates keep a margin below these. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係；施工中每班以手指按壓或小型貫入計檢查出模面，並記錄混凝土溫度、氣溫與滑升速度，速度調整需由滑模工程師簽記。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set; during work check the exit surface each shift by thumb pressure or a small penetrometer, log concrete temperature, air temperature and slip rate, and have the slipform engineer sign every rate change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。模板 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m 時有效高度 h_eff = 1.0 m；20°C 時初凝 4 h，v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h；10°C 時凝結時間約加倍為 8 h，v_max 降為 0.125 m/h。實際速度還要留裕度。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set. With a 1.2 m form and 0.2 m freeboard, h_eff = 1.0 m; at 20°C with initial set at 4 h, v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h; at 10°C setting roughly doubles to 8 h and v_max drops to 0.125 m/h. Actual rates keep a margin below these. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate", which statement holds?
options: 容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。
滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。
混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。
optionsEn: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set.
If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.
quiz.explanation: 容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出模混凝土強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete strength at form exit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係；施工中每班以手指按壓或小型貫入計檢查出模面，並記錄混凝土溫度、氣溫與滑升速度，速度調整需由滑模工程師簽記。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set; during work check the exit surface each shift by thumb pressure or a small penetrometer, log concrete temperature, air temperature and slip rate, and have the slipform engineer sign every rate change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應以溫度—速度對照表管理滑升，並規定每班出模面檢查的方法與紀錄；配比中的緩凝劑用量變更須由混凝土供應商與滑模工程師共同同意並先做試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage slipping with a temperature-versus-rate table in the method statement, specify how the exit surface is checked and recorded each shift, and require joint agreement and prior trials by the concrete supplier and slipform engineer for any change in retarder dosage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫；白天高溫時速度太慢，混凝土黏住模板，滑升時表面被拉出水平撕裂帶，嚴重時鋼筋外露，需大面積修補。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出模混凝土強度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete strength at form exit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫；白天高溫時速度太慢，混凝土黏住模板，滑升時表面被拉出水平撕裂帶，嚴重時鋼筋外露，需大面積修補。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Keeping the daytime rate as temperatures fall at night lets unset concrete slump out of the form, leaving bulges and horizontal cracks; sliding too slowly in daytime heat lets concrete bond to the form so that each lift drags out horizontal tear bands, in bad cases exposing bars and requiring extensive repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：亞特蘭大試驗塔的模板高約 1.2 m（4 ft）。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重」與「鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads" and "Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「千斤頂與爬桿」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jacks and climbing rods” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模的全部重量，包括模板、軛架、工作平台、懸吊修飾架、堆放材料、人員以及模板與混凝土之間的摩擦力，都由數十到上百支千斤頂經爬桿傳入已硬化的牆體。爬桿在剛硬化的混凝土與千斤頂之間有一段未受側向支撐的長度，容易挫屈；因此實際能用的單支荷重常由爬桿挫屈而非千斤頂額定值控制。美國 OSHA 1926.703 規定爬桿須為專用設計且在未埋入混凝土處要適當支撐，千斤頂荷重不得超過額定能力，並須有斷電時自動鎖住的機械裝置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「千斤頂與爬桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The entire weight of the slipform, including forms, yokes, deck, hanging finishing scaffolds, stored materials, people and the friction between forms and concrete, passes through dozens or over a hundred jacks and their climbing rods into the hardened wall. Between the newly hardened concrete and the jack each rod has an unbraced length that is prone to buckling, so the usable load per rod is often governed by rod buckling rather than the jack rating. US OSHA 1926.703 requires climbing rods to be specifically designed and braced where not encased in concrete, jack loads to stay within rated capacity, and automatic holding devices to hold the forms if power fails. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Jacks and climbing rods” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：爬桿 48.3×4 mm 鋼管，I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴、無支撐長 1.5 m，P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN，取安全係數 2.5 得 48 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 48.3×4 mm tube rod has I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴; with 1.5 m unbraced, P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN, or 48 kN with a factor of 2.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「千斤頂與爬桿」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Jacks and climbing rods”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 滑模的全部重量，包括模板、軛架、工作平台、懸吊修飾架、堆放材料、人員以及模板與混凝土之間的摩擦力，都由數十到上百支千斤頂經爬桿傳入已硬化的牆體。爬桿在剛硬化的混凝土與千斤頂之間有一段未受側向支撐的長度，容易挫屈；因此實際能用的單支荷重常由爬桿挫屈而非千斤頂額定值控制。

quiz.question: 關於「爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads" is correct?

千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。
滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。
optionsEn: The entire weight of the slipform, including forms, yokes, deck, hanging finishing scaffolds, stored materials, people and the friction between forms and concrete, passes through dozens or over a hundred jacks and their climbing rods into the hardened wall.
If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「千斤頂與爬桿」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jacks and climbing rods” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：爬桿 48.3×4 mm 鋼管，I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴、無支撐長 1.5 m，P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN，取安全係數 2.5 得 48 kN。平台荷重：靜載 250 t、活載 90 t、模板摩擦 2 kPa×(150 m×2 面×1.2 m) = 720 kN，合計 ≈ 4,055 kN，需約 4,055/48 ≈ 84 支千斤頂。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 48.3×4 mm tube rod has I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴; with 1.5 m unbraced, P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN, or 48 kN with a factor of 2.5. Deck loads: 250 t dead, 90 t live and form friction 2 kPa×(150 m×2 faces×1.2 m) = 720 kN, total about 4,055 kN, needing about 4,055/48 ≈ 84 jacks. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：滑模設計計算書須列出每支千斤頂的分擔荷重、爬桿挫屈長度與安全係數，並由滑模設計者簽認；現場在開滑前檢查每支千斤頂油壓、行程與自動鎖定功能，滑升中巡查爬桿是否彎曲，平台堆料以標示的容許荷重管控。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The slipform design calculations must list each jack's share of load, rod buckling length and safety factor, signed by the slipform designer; before starting check each jack's pressure, stroke and automatic holding function, inspect rods for bending during sliding, and control deck stockpiles against posted load limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Deck loads: 250 t dead, 90 t live and form friction 2 kPa×(150 m×2 faces×1.2 m) = 720 kN, total about 4,055 kN, needing about 4,055/48 ≈ 84 jacks. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 爬桿 48.3×4 mm 鋼管，I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴、無支撐長 1.5 m，P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN，取安全係數 2.5 得 48 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 48.3×4 mm tube rod has I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴; with 1.5 m unbraced, P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN, or 48 kN with a factor of 2.5. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「千斤頂與爬桿」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jacks and climbing rods” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 滑模設計計算書須列出每支千斤頂的分擔荷重、爬桿挫屈長度與安全係數，並由滑模設計者簽認；現場在開滑前檢查每支千斤頂油壓、行程與自動鎖定功能，滑升中巡查爬桿是否彎曲，平台堆料以標示的容許荷重管控。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The slipform design calculations must list each jack's share of load, rod buckling length and safety factor, signed by the slipform designer; before starting check each jack's pressure, stroke and automatic holding function, inspect rods for bending during sliding, and control deck stockpiles against posted load limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：平台上應以油漆或標牌劃出堆料區與容許荷重，吊料前由平台負責人確認；千斤頂與爬桿屬臨時工程關鍵構件，開滑前設停檢點由臨時工程設計者與施工主管共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark stockpile zones and allowable loads on the deck with paint or signs and have the deck supervisor approve each delivery; jacks and rods are critical temporary-works components, so set a pre-start hold point signed by the temporary-works designer and the construction manager.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平台上集中堆放鋼筋，使局部千斤頂超載，爬桿在未支撐段彎曲，平台傾斜並把模板扭曲；斷電或油管破裂時若千斤頂沒有自動鎖定，整個平台可能下滑，造成人員墜落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrating rebar bundles on the deck overloads local jacks, rods bend in their unbraced length, the deck tilts and the forms are twisted; if power fails or a hose bursts and the jacks lack automatic holding, the whole deck may slide down and throw workers off. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 滑模設計計算書須列出每支千斤頂的分擔荷重、爬桿挫屈長度與安全係數，並由滑模設計者簽認；現場在開滑前檢查每支千斤頂油壓、行程與自動鎖定功能，滑升中巡查爬桿是否彎曲，平台堆料以標示的容許荷重管控。
knowledge.textEn: The slipform design calculations must list each jack's share of load, rod buckling length and safety factor, signed by the slipform designer; before starting check each jack's pressure, stroke and automatic holding function, inspect rods for bending during sliding, and control deck stockpiles against posted load limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 平台上應以油漆或標牌劃出堆料區與容許荷重，吊料前由平台負責人確認；千斤頂與爬桿屬臨時工程關鍵構件，開滑前設停檢點由臨時工程設計者與施工主管共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Mark stockpile zones and allowable loads on the deck with paint or signs and have the deck supervisor approve each delivery; jacks and rods are critical temporary-works components, so set a pre-start hold point signed by the temporary-works designer and the construction manager.

quiz.question: 要驗證「爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。
滑模設計計算書須列出每支千斤頂的分擔荷重、爬桿挫屈長度與安全係數，並由滑模設計者簽認。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance.
The slipform design calculations must list each jack's share of load, rod buckling length and safety factor, signed by the slipform designer.
quiz.explanation: 滑模設計計算書須列出每支千斤頂的分擔荷重、爬桿挫屈長度與安全係數，並由滑模設計者簽認；現場在開滑前檢查每支千斤頂油壓、行程與自動鎖定功能，滑升中巡查爬桿是否彎曲，平台堆料以標示的容許荷重管控。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The slipform design calculations must list each jack's share of load, rod buckling length and safety factor, signed by the slipform designer; before starting check each jack's pressure, stroke and automatic holding function, inspect rods for bending during sliding, and control deck stockpiles against posted load limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「千斤頂與爬桿」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Jacks and climbing rods” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平台上集中堆放鋼筋，使局部千斤頂超載，爬桿在未支撐段彎曲，平台傾斜並把模板扭曲；斷電或油管破裂時若千斤頂沒有自動鎖定，整個平台可能下滑，造成人員墜落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrating rebar bundles on the deck overloads local jacks, rods bend in their unbraced length, the deck tilts and the forms are twisted; if power fails or a hose bursts and the jacks lack automatic holding, the whole deck may slide down and throw workers off. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：美國 OSHA 1926.703 規定爬桿須為專用設計且在未埋入混凝土處要適當支撐，千斤頂荷重不得超過額定能力，並須有斷電時自動鎖住的機械裝置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: US OSHA 1926.703 requires climbing rods to be specifically designed and braced where not encased in concrete, jack loads to stay within rated capacity, and automatic holding devices to hold the forms if power fails.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平台上集中堆放鋼筋，使局部千斤頂超載，爬桿在未支撐段彎曲，平台傾斜並把模板扭曲；斷電或油管破裂時若千斤頂沒有自動鎖定，整個平台可能下滑，造成人員墜落。
knowledge.textEn: Concentrating rebar bundles on the deck overloads local jacks, rods bend in their unbraced length, the deck tilts and the forms are twisted; if power fails or a hose bursts and the jacks lack automatic holding, the whole deck may slide down and throw workers off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 平台上集中堆放鋼筋，使局部千斤頂超載，爬桿在未支撐段彎曲，平台傾斜並把模板扭曲；斷電或油管破裂時若千斤頂沒有自動鎖定，整個平台可能下滑，造成人員墜落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。
optionsEn: Concentrating rebar bundles on the deck overloads local jacks, rods bend in their unbraced length, the deck tilts and the forms are twisted.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.
quiz.explanation: 平台上集中堆放鋼筋，使局部千斤頂超載，爬桿在未支撐段彎曲，平台傾斜並把模板扭曲；斷電或油管破裂時若千斤頂沒有自動鎖定，整個平台可能下滑，造成人員墜落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrating rebar bundles on the deck overloads local jacks, rods bend in their unbraced length, the deck tilts and the forms are twisted; if power fails or a hose bursts and the jacks lack automatic holding, the whole deck may slide down and throw workers off. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「埋件與開口」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Embeds and openings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模不會停下來等人，所以鋼筋、門窗開口框、樓板連接用的預埋鋼板、續接器與機電套管，都必須在模板經過之前到位。亞特蘭大試驗塔的核心筒有近 190 個開口、超過 3,300 塊預埋鋼板，單一高程最多約 200 件；這使埋件定位成為滑模最主要的品質風險。樓板通常在核心筒完成後再施作，因此牆內必須預留續接器或剪力鍵與樓板相接，任何漏埋都只能事後鑽孔植筋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「埋件與開口」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slipform never stops to wait, so rebar, door and window boxouts, embed plates for floor connections, couplers and services sleeves must all be in place before the form passes. The Atlanta test tower's core had nearly 190 openings and over 3,300 embed plates, with up to about 200 pieces at a single elevation, which made embed placement the main quality risk of the slipform. Floors are usually built after the core, so the walls must contain couplers or shear keys to receive them, and any missed item can only be fixed later by drilling and bonding. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Embeds and openings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：埋件 3,300 件、滑升約 54 天，平均每天 3,300/54 ≈ 61 件，相當於每小時約 2.5 件。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 3,300 embeds over about 54 days of sliding average 3,300/54 ≈ 61 per day, about 2.5 per hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「埋件與開口」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Embeds and openings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調
knowledge.titleEn: Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings
knowledge.text: 滑模不會停下來等人，所以鋼筋、門窗開口框、樓板連接用的預埋鋼板、續接器與機電套管，都必須在模板經過之前到位。亞特蘭大試驗塔的核心筒有近 190 個開口、超過 3,300 塊預埋鋼板，單一高程最多約 200 件；這使埋件定位成為滑模最主要的品質風險。
knowledge.textEn: A slipform never stops to wait, so rebar, door and window boxouts, embed plates for floor connections, couplers and services sleeves must all be in place before the form passes. The Atlanta test tower's core had nearly 190 openings and over 3,300 embed plates, with up to about 200 pieces at a single elevation, which made embed placement the main quality risk of the slipform.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings" is correct?
options: 滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。
滑模不會停下來等人，所以鋼筋、門窗開口框、樓板連接用的預埋鋼板、續接器與機電套管，都必須在模板經過之前到位。
滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。
optionsEn: Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.
A slipform never stops to wait, so rebar, door and window boxouts, embed plates for floor connections, couplers and services sleeves must all be in place before the form passes.
If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
quiz.explanation: 滑模不會停下來等人，所以鋼筋、門窗開口框、樓板連接用的預埋鋼板、續接器與機電套管，都必須在模板經過之前到位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A slipform never stops to wait, so rebar, door and window boxouts, embed plates for floor connections, couplers and services sleeves must all be in place before the form passes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「埋件與開口」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Embeds and openings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：埋件 3,300 件、滑升約 54 天，平均每天 3,300/54 ≈ 61 件，相當於每小時約 2.5 件。水平筋：牆長 150 m、雙面、間距 200 mm，每米高 5 層×2 面×150 m = 1,500 m，φ16 每米 1.58 kg，約 2,370 kg/m；日升 2.29 m 時每天約 5.4 t 水平筋。數值中的埋件數與天數取自公開報導，其餘為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 3,300 embeds over about 54 days of sliding average 3,300/54 ≈ 61 per day, about 2.5 per hour. Horizontal bars: 150 m of wall, two faces at 200 mm spacing give 5 layers×2 faces×150 m = 1,500 m per metre of height, at 1.58 kg/m for φ16 about 2,370 kg/m, or about 5.4 t per day at 2.29 m per day. Embed count and days come from public reporting; the rest are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維模型產生按高程排序的埋件與開口清單，每件有編號、座標與照片欄；平台上設專人在模板通過前逐件勾核位置與固定，並由測量人員以全站儀抽測關鍵埋件，紀錄與滑升日誌同步。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Generate an elevation-sorted list of embeds and openings from the 3D model, each with a number, coordinates and a photo field; assign a person on the deck to tick off position and fixing of each item before the form passes, have surveyors check key embeds with a total station, and keep the records in step with the slip log.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 埋件 3,300 件、滑升約 54 天，平均每天 3,300/54 ≈ 61 件，相當於每小時約 2.5 件。水平筋：牆長 150 m、雙面、間距 200 mm，每米高 5 層×2 面×150 m = 1,500 m，φ16 每米 1.58 kg，約 2,370 kg/m；日升 2.29 m 時每天約 5.4 t 水平筋。數值中的埋件數與天數取自公開報導，其餘為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 3,300 embeds over about 54 days of sliding average 3,300/54 ≈ 61 per day, about 2.5 per hour. Horizontal bars: 150 m of wall, two faces at 200 mm spacing give 5 layers×2 faces×150 m = 1,500 m per metre of height, at 1.58 kg/m for φ16 about 2,370 kg/m, or about 5.4 t per day at 2.29 m per day. Embed count and days come from public reporting; the rest are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。
核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。
埋件 3,300 件、滑升約 54 天，平均每天 3,300/54 ≈ 61 件，相當於每小時約 2.5 件。
optionsEn: Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.
Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter.
3,300 embeds over about 54 days of sliding average 3,300/54 ≈ 61 per day, about 2.5 per hour.
quiz.explanation: 埋件 3,300 件、滑升約 54 天，平均每天 3,300/54 ≈ 61 件，相當於每小時約 2.5 件。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 3,300 embeds over about 54 days of sliding average 3,300/54 ≈ 61 per day, about 2.5 per hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「埋件與開口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Embeds and openings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維模型產生按高程排序的埋件與開口清單，每件有編號、座標與照片欄；平台上設專人在模板通過前逐件勾核位置與固定，並由測量人員以全站儀抽測關鍵埋件，紀錄與滑升日誌同步。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate an elevation-sorted list of embeds and openings from the 3D model, each with a number, coordinates and a photo field; assign a person on the deck to tick off position and fixing of each item before the form passes, have surveyors check key embeds with a total station, and keep the records in step with the slip log. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：開滑前凍結埋件與開口設計，之後的變更要經過專門的變更程序並在平台上公告；每一高程的埋件勾核表需由平台品管人員與監造簽名，未簽不得繼續滑升超過該高程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Freeze the embed and opening design before sliding starts, route later changes through a dedicated change procedure posted on the deck, and require the deck quality controller and the resident engineer to sign each elevation's checklist before sliding continues past it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：埋件高程錯誤或漏埋，樓板鋼梁無法連接，只能事後鑽孔植入錨栓，承載力與耐久都打折；開口框固定不牢在滑升中被拖動，門洞位置偏移，電梯門框無法安裝。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Embeds at the wrong level or missing leave floor beams with nothing to connect to, forcing post-drilled anchors with reduced capacity and durability; poorly fixed boxouts dragged by the moving form shift door openings so that elevator door frames cannot be installed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維模型產生按高程排序的埋件與開口清單，每件有編號、座標與照片欄；平台上設專人在模板通過前逐件勾核位置與固定，並由測量人員以全站儀抽測關鍵埋件，紀錄與滑升日誌同步。
knowledge.textEn: Generate an elevation-sorted list of embeds and openings from the 3D model, each with a number, coordinates and a photo field; assign a person on the deck to tick off position and fixing of each item before the form passes, have surveyors check key embeds with a total station, and keep the records in step with the slip log.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 開滑前凍結埋件與開口設計，之後的變更要經過專門的變更程序並在平台上公告；每一高程的埋件勾核表需由平台品管人員與監造簽名，未簽不得繼續滑升超過該高程。
