knowledge.textEn: Freeze the embed and opening design before sliding starts, route later changes through a dedicated change procedure posted on the deck, and require the deck quality controller and the resident engineer to sign each elevation's checklist before sliding continues past it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings"?
options: 以三維模型產生按高程排序的埋件與開口清單，每件有編號、座標與照片欄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。
optionsEn: Generate an elevation-sorted list of embeds and openings from the 3D model, each with a number, coordinates and a photo field.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
quiz.explanation: 以三維模型產生按高程排序的埋件與開口清單，每件有編號、座標與照片欄；平台上設專人在模板通過前逐件勾核位置與固定，並由測量人員以全站儀抽測關鍵埋件，紀錄與滑升日誌同步。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Generate an elevation-sorted list of embeds and openings from the 3D model, each with a number, coordinates and a photo field; assign a person on the deck to tick off position and fixing of each item before the form passes, have surveyors check key embeds with a total station, and keep the records in step with the slip log. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「埋件與開口」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Embeds and openings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 埋件高程錯誤或漏埋，樓板鋼梁無法連接，只能事後鑽孔植入錨栓，承載力與耐久都打折；開口框固定不牢在滑升中被拖動，門洞位置偏移，電梯門框無法安裝。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Embeds at the wrong level or missing leave floor beams with nothing to connect to, forcing post-drilled anchors with reduced capacity and durability; poorly fixed boxouts dragged by the moving form shift door openings so that elevator door frames cannot be installed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：樓板通常在核心筒完成後再施作，因此牆內必須預留續接器或剪力鍵與樓板相接，任何漏埋都只能事後鑽孔植筋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Floors are usually built after the core, so the walls must contain couplers or shear keys to receive them, and any missed item can only be fixed later by drilling and bonding.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 埋件高程錯誤或漏埋，樓板鋼梁無法連接，只能事後鑽孔植入錨栓，承載力與耐久都打折；開口框固定不牢在滑升中被拖動，門洞位置偏移，電梯門框無法安裝。
knowledge.textEn: Embeds at the wrong level or missing leave floor beams with nothing to connect to, forcing post-drilled anchors with reduced capacity and durability; poorly fixed boxouts dragged by the moving form shift door openings so that elevator door frames cannot be installed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
埋件高程錯誤或漏埋，樓板鋼梁無法連接，只能事後鑽孔植入錨栓，承載力與耐久都打折；開口框固定不牢在滑升中被拖動，門洞位置偏移，電梯門框無法安裝。
滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Embeds at the wrong level or missing leave floor beams with nothing to connect to, forcing post-drilled anchors with reduced capacity and durability.
If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
quiz.explanation: 埋件高程錯誤或漏埋，樓板鋼梁無法連接，只能事後鑽孔植入錨栓，承載力與耐久都打折；開口框固定不牢在滑升中被拖動，門洞位置偏移，電梯門框無法安裝。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Embeds at the wrong level or missing leave floor beams with nothing to connect to, forcing post-drilled anchors with reduced capacity and durability; poorly fixed boxouts dragged by the moving form shift door openings so that elevator door frames cannot be installed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正」與「計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Correcting verticality, twist and deck level" and "Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Correcting verticality, twist and deck level: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「垂直度與扭轉控制」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Verticality and twist control” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模的幾何誤差會沿高度累積：平台只要稍微傾斜，模板就會往低側漂移；千斤頂行程不一致會讓平台扭轉，核心筒隨之旋轉。修正不能一次大幅調整，因為模板內的混凝土尚未硬化，突然改變方向會在牆面留下錯台或裂縫，只能以小坡度在數公尺高度內逐漸拉回。CN Tower 塔身邊升邊收窄，更需要精確控制幾何。亞特蘭大試驗塔的牆面垂直偏差控制在約 ±6 mm（±¼ in）以內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「垂直度與扭轉控制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slipform geometry errors accumulate with height: a slightly tilted deck makes the forms drift toward the low side, and uneven jack strokes twist the deck so the core rotates. Corrections cannot be large and sudden, because the concrete in the form has not hardened and an abrupt change leaves steps or cracks; drift must be pulled back gradually over several metres at a small gradient. The CN Tower shaft narrowed as it rose, demanding even tighter geometric control. At the Atlanta test tower the vertical surface deviation was held within about ±6 mm (±¼ in). Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Verticality and twist control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若量到核心筒偏離 20 mm，以 1:500 的修正坡度拉回，需要的修正高度 = 20 mm×500 = 10 m；日升 2.29 m 時約需 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 天才能完全修正，所以偏差必須在小時就被發現。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the core is found 20 mm off line and corrected at a gradient of 1:500, the correction height is 20 mm×500 = 10 m; at 2.29 m per day that takes about 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 days, so deviations must be caught while still small.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「垂直度與扭轉控制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Verticality and twist control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正
knowledge.titleEn: Correcting verticality, twist and deck level
knowledge.text: 滑模的幾何誤差會沿高度累積：平台只要稍微傾斜，模板就會往低側漂移；千斤頂行程不一致會讓平台扭轉，核心筒隨之旋轉。修正不能一次大幅調整，因為模板內的混凝土尚未硬化，突然改變方向會在牆面留下錯台或裂縫，只能以小坡度在數公尺高度內逐漸拉回。
knowledge.textEn: Slipform geometry errors accumulate with height: a slightly tilted deck makes the forms drift toward the low side, and uneven jack strokes twist the deck so the core rotates. Corrections cannot be large and sudden, because the concrete in the form has not hardened and an abrupt change leaves steps or cracks; drift must be pulled back gradually over several metres at a small gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Correcting verticality, twist and deck level" is correct?
options: 滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。
滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。
滑模的幾何誤差會沿高度累積：平台只要稍微傾斜，模板就會往低側漂移；千斤頂行程不一致會讓平台扭轉，核心筒隨之旋轉。
optionsEn: If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints.
Slipform geometry errors accumulate with height: a slightly tilted deck makes the forms drift toward the low side, and uneven jack strokes twist the deck so the core rotates.
quiz.explanation: 滑模的幾何誤差會沿高度累積：平台只要稍微傾斜，模板就會往低側漂移；千斤頂行程不一致會讓平台扭轉，核心筒隨之旋轉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Slipform geometry errors accumulate with height: a slightly tilted deck makes the forms drift toward the low side, and uneven jack strokes twist the deck so the core rotates. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Correcting verticality, twist and deck level: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直度與扭轉控制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Verticality and twist control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若量到核心筒偏離 20 mm，以 1:500 的修正坡度拉回，需要的修正高度 = 20 mm×500 = 10 m；日升 2.29 m 時約需 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 天才能完全修正，所以偏差必須在小時就被發現。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the core is found 20 mm off line and corrected at a gradient of 1:500, the correction height is 20 mm×500 = 10 m; at 2.29 m per day that takes about 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 days, so deviations must be caught while still small. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雷射垂準儀從底部基準點向平台上的接收靶投點，每班至少量測兩次並記錄 x、y 偏移與平台扭轉角；平台水平以水管水準或數位傾斜計監測，量測值超過警戒值時由滑模工程師下達修正指令。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Project from base reference points to targets on the deck with laser plumbs at least twice per shift, recording x and y offsets and deck rotation; monitor deck level with water levels or digital inclinometers, and have the slipform engineer issue correction instructions when readings exceed the alert value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若量到核心筒偏離 20 mm，以 1:500 的修正坡度拉回，需要的修正高度 = 20 mm×500 = 10 m；日升 2.29 m 時約需 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 天才能完全修正，所以偏差必須在小時就被發現。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the core is found 20 mm off line and corrected at a gradient of 1:500, the correction height is 20 mm×500 = 10 m; at 2.29 m per day that takes about 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 days, so deviations must be caught while still small. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Correcting verticality, twist and deck level", which statement holds?
options: 若量到核心筒偏離 20 mm，以 1:500 的修正坡度拉回，需要的修正高度 = 20 mm×500 = 10 m。
自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。
核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。
optionsEn: If the core is found 20 mm off line and corrected at a gradient of 1:500, the correction height is 20 mm×500 = 10 m.
Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary.
A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 若量到核心筒偏離 20 mm，以 1:500 的修正坡度拉回，需要的修正高度 = 20 mm×500 = 10 m；日升 2.29 m 時約需 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 天才能完全修正，所以偏差必須在小時就被發現。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the core is found 20 mm off line and corrected at a gradient of 1:500, the correction height is 20 mm×500 = 10 m; at 2.29 m per day that takes about 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 days, so deviations must be caught while still small. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Correcting verticality, twist and deck level: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直度與扭轉控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Verticality and twist control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以雷射垂準儀從底部基準點向平台上的接收靶投點，每班至少量測兩次並記錄 x、y 偏移與平台扭轉角；平台水平以水管水準或數位傾斜計監測，量測值超過警戒值時由滑模工程師下達修正指令。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Project from base reference points to targets on the deck with laser plumbs at least twice per shift, recording x and y offsets and deck rotation; monitor deck level with water levels or digital inclinometers, and have the slipform engineer issue correction instructions when readings exceed the alert value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：測量紀錄應繪成隨高度變化的偏差曲線並張貼在平台上，讓各班看到趨勢而非單點數值；修正指令與執行結果都寫入滑升日誌，由測量主管與滑模工程師簽記。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot survey results as deviation-versus-height curves posted on the deck so each shift sees the trend rather than a single reading; write correction instructions and their results into the slip log, signed by the survey lead and the slipform engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：發現偏差後一次大幅傾斜模板強行修正，牆面出現明顯折角與水平裂縫，電梯導軌安裝困難；長期忽略平台扭轉，核心筒逐層旋轉，與外圍樓板鋼梁連接位置錯開。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing a large single correction by tilting the forms leaves visible kinks and horizontal cracks in the wall and makes elevator rail installation difficult; ignoring deck twist for long lets the core rotate storey by storey so that connections to perimeter floor beams no longer line up. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以雷射垂準儀從底部基準點向平台上的接收靶投點，每班至少量測兩次並記錄 x、y 偏移與平台扭轉角；平台水平以水管水準或數位傾斜計監測，量測值超過警戒值時由滑模工程師下達修正指令。
knowledge.textEn: Project from base reference points to targets on the deck with laser plumbs at least twice per shift, recording x and y offsets and deck rotation; monitor deck level with water levels or digital inclinometers, and have the slipform engineer issue correction instructions when readings exceed the alert value.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 測量紀錄應繪成隨高度變化的偏差曲線並張貼在平台上，讓各班看到趨勢而非單點數值；修正指令與執行結果都寫入滑升日誌，由測量主管與滑模工程師簽記。
knowledge.textEn: Plot survey results as deviation-versus-height curves posted on the deck so each shift sees the trend rather than a single reading; write correction instructions and their results into the slip log, signed by the survey lead and the slipform engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Correcting verticality, twist and deck level"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以雷射垂準儀從底部基準點向平台上的接收靶投點，每班至少量測兩次並記錄 x、y 偏移與平台扭轉角。
滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Project from base reference points to targets on the deck with laser plumbs at least twice per shift, recording x and y offsets and deck rotation.
The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 以雷射垂準儀從底部基準點向平台上的接收靶投點，每班至少量測兩次並記錄 x、y 偏移與平台扭轉角；平台水平以水管水準或數位傾斜計監測，量測值超過警戒值時由滑模工程師下達修正指令。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Project from base reference points to targets on the deck with laser plumbs at least twice per shift, recording x and y offsets and deck rotation; monitor deck level with water levels or digital inclinometers, and have the slipform engineer issue correction instructions when readings exceed the alert value. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Correcting verticality, twist and deck level: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「垂直度與扭轉控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Verticality and twist control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 發現偏差後一次大幅傾斜模板強行修正，牆面出現明顯折角與水平裂縫，電梯導軌安裝困難；長期忽略平台扭轉，核心筒逐層旋轉，與外圍樓板鋼梁連接位置錯開。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing a large single correction by tilting the forms leaves visible kinks and horizontal cracks in the wall and makes elevator rail installation difficult; ignoring deck twist for long lets the core rotate storey by storey so that connections to perimeter floor beams no longer line up. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：亞特蘭大試驗塔的牆面垂直偏差控制在約 ±6 mm（±¼ in）以內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At the Atlanta test tower the vertical surface deviation was held within about ±6 mm (±¼ in).
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 發現偏差後一次大幅傾斜模板強行修正，牆面出現明顯折角與水平裂縫，電梯導軌安裝困難；長期忽略平台扭轉，核心筒逐層旋轉，與外圍樓板鋼梁連接位置錯開。
knowledge.textEn: Forcing a large single correction by tilting the forms leaves visible kinks and horizontal cracks in the wall and makes elevator rail installation difficult; ignoring deck twist for long lets the core rotate storey by storey so that connections to perimeter floor beams no longer line up.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Correcting verticality, twist and deck level" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。
發現偏差後一次大幅傾斜模板強行修正，牆面出現明顯折角與水平裂縫，電梯導軌安裝困難；長期忽略平台扭轉，核心筒逐層旋轉，與外圍樓板鋼梁連接位置錯開。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints.
Forcing a large single correction by tilting the forms leaves visible kinks and horizontal cracks in the wall and makes elevator rail installation difficult.
quiz.explanation: 發現偏差後一次大幅傾斜模板強行修正，牆面出現明顯折角與水平裂縫，電梯導軌安裝困難；長期忽略平台扭轉，核心筒逐層旋轉，與外圍樓板鋼梁連接位置錯開。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forcing a large single correction by tilting the forms leaves visible kinks and horizontal cracks in the wall and makes elevator rail installation difficult; ignoring deck twist for long lets the core rotate storey by storey so that connections to perimeter floor beams no longer line up. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「計畫停機與冷縫」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Planned stops and cold joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模雖以連續作業為原則，但遇到樓層大改變、設備維修、強風或供料中斷，仍需要停機。停機時要讓模板內混凝土澆到預定高程並持續以小行程「鬆模」，避免混凝土與模板黏結；重新啟動前則要把接縫面打毛、清潔與濕潤，形成可傳遞剪力的施工縫。亞特蘭大試驗塔 24 小時連續作業，期間安排了三次各約一天的停機，並在這些位置形成冷縫。冷縫是剪力牆受力的薄弱面，必須按剪力摩擦檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「計畫停機與冷縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Although slipforming aims to be continuous, major changes of section, equipment maintenance, strong winds or supply interruptions still force stops. When stopping, concrete is brought to a planned level and the forms are jogged in small strokes to keep concrete from bonding to them; before restarting, the joint surface is roughened, cleaned and wetted to form a construction joint that can transfer shear. The Atlanta test tower worked 24 hours a day with three planned stops of about a day each, which formed cold joints at those levels. A cold joint is a weak plane in a shear wall and must be checked by shear friction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Planned stops and cold joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：剪力摩擦 V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Shear friction V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「計畫停機與冷縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Planned stops and cold joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候
knowledge.titleEn: Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather
knowledge.text: 滑模雖以連續作業為原則，但遇到樓層大改變、設備維修、強風或供料中斷，仍需要停機。停機時要讓模板內混凝土澆到預定高程並持續以小行程「鬆模」，避免混凝土與模板黏結；重新啟動前則要把接縫面打毛、清潔與濕潤，形成可傳遞剪力的施工縫。
knowledge.textEn: Although slipforming aims to be continuous, major changes of section, equipment maintenance, strong winds or supply interruptions still force stops. When stopping, concrete is brought to a planned level and the forms are jogged in small strokes to keep concrete from bonding to them; before restarting, the joint surface is roughened, cleaned and wetted to form a construction joint that can transfer shear.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather" is correct?
options: 滑模雖以連續作業為原則，但遇到樓層大改變、設備維修、強風或供料中斷，仍需要停機。
滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。
混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。
optionsEn: Although slipforming aims to be continuous, major changes of section, equipment maintenance, strong winds or supply interruptions still force stops.
Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints.
Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.
quiz.explanation: 滑模雖以連續作業為原則，但遇到樓層大改變、設備維修、強風或供料中斷，仍需要停機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Although slipforming aims to be continuous, major changes of section, equipment maintenance, strong winds or supply interruptions still force stops. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「計畫停機與冷縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Planned stops and cold joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：剪力摩擦 V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y。垂直筋 φ16@200 雙面，A_vf = 2×201/0.2 = 2,010 mm²/m；f_y = 420 MPa；接縫打毛 μ = 1.0 時 φV_n = 0.75×1.0×2,010×420 ≈ 633 kN/m，大於需求 500 kN/m；若未打毛 μ = 0.6，φV_n ≈ 380 kN/m，不足。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Shear friction V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y. Vertical bars φ16 at 200 mm on both faces give A_vf = 2×201/0.2 = 2,010 mm²/m; with f_y = 420 MPa and a roughened joint μ = 1.0, φV_n = 0.75×1.0×2,010×420 ≈ 633 kN/m, above a demand of 500 kN/m; an unroughened joint with μ = 0.6 gives φV_n ≈ 380 kN/m, which is insufficient. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：停機前後各拍攝接縫面照片並量測打毛深度（例如以砂填法或深度規），重新澆置前檢查接縫是否清潔濕潤；冷縫位置與處理方式要記錄高程，並由結構設計者確認該位置的剪力需求與摩擦係數假設相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Photograph the joint before and after the stop and measure roughness amplitude with a sand-patch method or depth gauge; before restarting check that the joint is clean and damp; record the elevation and treatment of each cold joint and have the structural designer confirm that the shear demand there matches the friction coefficient assumed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 剪力摩擦 V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y。垂直筋 φ16@200 雙面，A_vf = 2×201/0.2 = 2,010 mm²/m；f_y = 420 MPa；接縫打毛 μ = 1.0 時 φV_n = 0.75×1.0×2,010×420 ≈ 633 kN/m，大於需求 500 kN/m；若未打毛 μ = 0.6，φV_n ≈ 380 kN/m，不足。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Shear friction V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y. Vertical bars φ16 at 200 mm on both faces give A_vf = 2×201/0.2 = 2,010 mm²/m; with f_y = 420 MPa and a roughened joint μ = 1.0, φV_n = 0.75×1.0×2,010×420 ≈ 633 kN/m, above a demand of 500 kN/m; an unroughened joint with μ = 0.6 gives φV_n ≈ 380 kN/m, which is insufficient. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather", which statement holds?
options: 核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。
剪力摩擦 V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y。
滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。
optionsEn: Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter.
Shear friction V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y.
Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
quiz.explanation: 剪力摩擦 V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Shear friction V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「計畫停機與冷縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Planned stops and cold joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 停機前後各拍攝接縫面照片並量測打毛深度（例如以砂填法或深度規），重新澆置前檢查接縫是否清潔濕潤；冷縫位置與處理方式要記錄高程，並由結構設計者確認該位置的剪力需求與摩擦係數假設相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Photograph the joint before and after the stop and measure roughness amplitude with a sand-patch method or depth gauge; before restarting check that the joint is clean and damp; record the elevation and treatment of each cold joint and have the structural designer confirm that the shear demand there matches the friction coefficient assumed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要預先規劃停機高程（避開高剪力區與埋件密集區），並備妥非預期停機的應變程序：鬆模頻率、停止澆置高程、接縫處理與重啟檢查，由滑模工程師負責下令。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plan stop elevations in advance, away from high-shear zones and dense embed bands, and prepare a contingency procedure for unplanned stops covering jogging frequency, the level at which pouring stops, joint treatment and restart checks, with the slipform engineer responsible for giving the orders.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未預期的停機沒有鬆模，模板與混凝土黏死，重啟時強拉撕裂牆面；冷縫未打毛就續澆，接縫成為光滑弱面，地震或強風下沿縫滑移並滲水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unplanned stop without jogging locks the forms to the concrete and restarting tears the wall; continuing over an unroughened cold joint leaves a smooth weak plane that can slip and leak under earthquake or strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 停機前後各拍攝接縫面照片並量測打毛深度（例如以砂填法或深度規），重新澆置前檢查接縫是否清潔濕潤；冷縫位置與處理方式要記錄高程，並由結構設計者確認該位置的剪力需求與摩擦係數假設相符。
knowledge.textEn: Photograph the joint before and after the stop and measure roughness amplitude with a sand-patch method or depth gauge; before restarting check that the joint is clean and damp; record the elevation and treatment of each cold joint and have the structural designer confirm that the shear demand there matches the friction coefficient assumed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要預先規劃停機高程（避開高剪力區與埋件密集區），並備妥非預期停機的應變程序：鬆模頻率、停止澆置高程、接縫處理與重啟檢查，由滑模工程師負責下令。
knowledge.textEn: Plan stop elevations in advance, away from high-shear zones and dense embed bands, and prepare a contingency procedure for unplanned stops covering jogging frequency, the level at which pouring stops, joint treatment and restart checks, with the slipform engineer responsible for giving the orders.

quiz.question: 要驗證「計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。
停機前後各拍攝接縫面照片並量測打毛深度（例如以砂填法或深度規），重新澆置前檢查接縫是否清潔濕潤。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
Photograph the joint before and after the stop and measure roughness amplitude with a sand-patch method or depth gauge.
quiz.explanation: 停機前後各拍攝接縫面照片並量測打毛深度（例如以砂填法或深度規），重新澆置前檢查接縫是否清潔濕潤；冷縫位置與處理方式要記錄高程，並由結構設計者確認該位置的剪力需求與摩擦係數假設相符。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Photograph the joint before and after the stop and measure roughness amplitude with a sand-patch method or depth gauge; before restarting check that the joint is clean and damp; record the elevation and treatment of each cold joint and have the structural designer confirm that the shear demand there matches the friction coefficient assumed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「計畫停機與冷縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Planned stops and cold joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未預期的停機沒有鬆模，模板與混凝土黏死，重啟時強拉撕裂牆面；冷縫未打毛就續澆，接縫成為光滑弱面，地震或強風下沿縫滑移並滲水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unplanned stop without jogging locks the forms to the concrete and restarting tears the wall; continuing over an unroughened cold joint leaves a smooth weak plane that can slip and leak under earthquake or strong wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：冷縫是剪力牆受力的薄弱面，必須按剪力摩擦檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A cold joint is a weak plane in a shear wall and must be checked by shear friction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未預期的停機沒有鬆模，模板與混凝土黏死，重啟時強拉撕裂牆面；冷縫未打毛就續澆，接縫成為光滑弱面，地震或強風下沿縫滑移並滲水。
knowledge.textEn: An unplanned stop without jogging locks the forms to the concrete and restarting tears the wall; continuing over an unroughened cold joint leaves a smooth weak plane that can slip and leak under earthquake or strong wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未預期的停機沒有鬆模，模板與混凝土黏死，重啟時強拉撕裂牆面；冷縫未打毛就續澆，接縫成為光滑弱面，地震或強風下沿縫滑移並滲水。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。
optionsEn: An unplanned stop without jogging locks the forms to the concrete and restarting tears the wall.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.
quiz.explanation: 未預期的停機沒有鬆模，模板與混凝土黏死，重啟時強拉撕裂牆面；冷縫未打毛就續澆，接縫成為光滑弱面，地震或強風下沿縫滑移並滲水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An unplanned stop without jogging locks the forms to the concrete and restarting tears the wall; continuing over an unroughened cold joint leaves a smooth weak plane that can slip and leak under earthquake or strong wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法」與「千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method" and "Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「出模面檢查與成熟度」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exit-surface checks and maturity” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模每天要決定好幾次速度，不可能每次等試體壓驗結果，所以實務上同時使用即時檢查與預測方法：出模面的手壓或貫入檢查、溫度感測器配合成熟度法估計早齡強度，以及定期的標準試體作最終驗收。成熟度法假設同一配比在相同溫度—時間累積下會達到相同強度，因此先在試驗室建立成熟度與強度曲線，現場只要量測混凝土溫度就能推估強度。這對日夜溫差大或冬季施工尤其重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「出模面檢查與成熟度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slipform needs speed decisions several times a day and cannot wait for cylinder results each time, so practice combines immediate checks with prediction: thumb or penetration checks at the exit surface, temperature sensors with the maturity method to estimate early strength, and standard cylinders for final acceptance. The maturity method assumes that a given mix reaches the same strength at the same accumulated temperature–time, so a laboratory maturity–strength curve is built first and site strength is then estimated from concrete temperature alone. This matters most with large day–night swings or winter work. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Exit-surface checks and maturity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt，基準溫度 T₀ = −10°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt with datum T₀ = −10°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「出模面檢查與成熟度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Exit-surface checks and maturity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法
knowledge.titleEn: Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method
knowledge.text: 滑模每天要決定好幾次速度，不可能每次等試體壓驗結果，所以實務上同時使用即時檢查與預測方法：出模面的手壓或貫入檢查、溫度感測器配合成熟度法估計早齡強度，以及定期的標準試體作最終驗收。成熟度法假設同一配比在相同溫度—時間累積下會達到相同強度，因此先在試驗室建立成熟度與強度曲線，現場只要量測混凝土溫度就能推估強度。
knowledge.textEn: A slipform needs speed decisions several times a day and cannot wait for cylinder results each time, so practice combines immediate checks with prediction: thumb or penetration checks at the exit surface, temperature sensors with the maturity method to estimate early strength, and standard cylinders for final acceptance. The maturity method assumes that a given mix reaches the same strength at the same accumulated temperature–time, so a laboratory maturity–strength curve is built first and site strength is then estimated from concrete temperature alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method" is correct?
options: 混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。
滑模每天要決定好幾次速度，不可能每次等試體壓驗結果，所以實務上同時使用即時檢查與預測方法：出模面的手壓或貫入檢查、溫度感測器配合成熟度法估計早齡強度，以及定期的標準試體作最終驗收。
自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。
optionsEn: Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.

A slipform needs speed decisions several times a day and cannot wait for cylinder results each time, so practice combines immediate checks with prediction: thumb or penetration checks at the exit surface, temperature sensors with the maturity method to estimate early strength, and standard cylinders for final acceptance.
Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 滑模每天要決定好幾次速度，不可能每次等試體壓驗結果，所以實務上同時使用即時檢查與預測方法：出模面的手壓或貫入檢查、溫度感測器配合成熟度法估計早齡強度，以及定期的標準試體作最終驗收。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A slipform needs speed decisions several times a day and cannot wait for cylinder results each time, so practice combines immediate checks with prediction: thumb or penetration checks at the exit surface, temperature sensors with the maturity method to estimate early strength, and standard cylinders for final acceptance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出模面檢查與成熟度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exit-surface checks and maturity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt，基準溫度 T₀ = −10°C。20°C 時 10 h 累積 30×10 = 300 °C·h；若出模所需成熟度為 300 °C·h，10°C 時需 300/20 = 15 h。模板有效高度 1.0 m，容許速度由 0.10 m/h 降為 1.0/15 ≈ 0.067 m/h。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt with datum T₀ = −10°C. Ten hours at 20°C accumulate 30×10 = 300 °C·h; if exit requires 300 °C·h, at 10°C it takes 300/20 = 15 h. With 1.0 m effective form height the rate must fall from 0.10 m/h to 1.0/15 ≈ 0.067 m/h. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開工前以同一配比在試驗室建立成熟度—強度曲線，並以現場早期試體驗證；滑升中在模板下緣附近埋設溫度感測器，每小時計算成熟度，與出模面手壓檢查結果互相印證，最終強度以標準養護試體驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the maturity–strength curve for the mix in the laboratory before starting and validate it with early site specimens; during sliding embed temperature sensors near the form bottom, compute maturity hourly and cross-check with exit-surface thumb tests, while final acceptance rests on standard-cured cylinders.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt，基準溫度 T₀ = −10°C。20°C 時 10 h 累積 30×10 = 300 °C·h；若出模所需成熟度為 300 °C·h，10°C 時需 300/20 = 15 h。模板有效高度 1.0 m，容許速度由 0.10 m/h 降為 1.0/15 ≈ 0.067 m/h。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt with datum T₀ = −10°C. Ten hours at 20°C accumulate 30×10 = 300 °C·h; if exit requires 300 °C·h, at 10°C it takes 300/20 = 15 h. With 1.0 m effective form height the rate must fall from 0.10 m/h to 1.0/15 ≈ 0.067 m/h. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method", which statement holds?
options: 核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。
滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt，基準溫度 T₀ = −10°C。
optionsEn: A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance.
The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt with datum T₀ = −10°C.
quiz.explanation: Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt，基準溫度 T₀ = −10°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt with datum T₀ = −10°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出模面檢查與成熟度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exit-surface checks and maturity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 開工前以同一配比在試驗室建立成熟度—強度曲線，並以現場早期試體驗證；滑升中在模板下緣附近埋設溫度感測器，每小時計算成熟度，與出模面手壓檢查結果互相印證，最終強度以標準養護試體驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the maturity–strength curve for the mix in the laboratory before starting and validate it with early site specimens; during sliding embed temperature sensors near the form bottom, compute maturity hourly and cross-check with exit-surface thumb tests, while final acceptance rests on standard-cured cylinders. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何配比、水泥或摻料來源變更都要重新建立或驗證成熟度曲線；感測器位置與遮蔽方式寫入品質計畫，資料自動上傳並設警戒值，夜班也能即時看到強度推估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Re-establish or validate the maturity curve after any change of mix, cement or admixture source; write sensor positions and shielding into the quality plan, upload data automatically with alert thresholds so the night shift sees strength estimates in real time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：配比中途更換水泥來源卻沿用舊的成熟度曲線，推估強度偏高，出模混凝土實際太軟而坍落；感測器裝在受陽光直射的位置，讀到的溫度偏高，同樣導致高估強度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing the cement source mid-job while keeping the old maturity curve overestimates strength, so concrete leaves the form too soft and slumps; sensors placed in direct sun read high temperatures and likewise overestimate strength. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 開工前以同一配比在試驗室建立成熟度—強度曲線，並以現場早期試體驗證；滑升中在模板下緣附近埋設溫度感測器，每小時計算成熟度，與出模面手壓檢查結果互相印證，最終強度以標準養護試體驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Build the maturity–strength curve for the mix in the laboratory before starting and validate it with early site specimens; during sliding embed temperature sensors near the form bottom, compute maturity hourly and cross-check with exit-surface thumb tests, while final acceptance rests on standard-cured cylinders.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 任何配比、水泥或摻料來源變更都要重新建立或驗證成熟度曲線；感測器位置與遮蔽方式寫入品質計畫，資料自動上傳並設警戒值，夜班也能即時看到強度推估。
knowledge.textEn: Re-establish or validate the maturity curve after any change of mix, cement or admixture source; write sensor positions and shielding into the quality plan, upload data automatically with alert thresholds so the night shift sees strength estimates in real time.

quiz.question: 要驗證「出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method"?
options: 開工前以同一配比在試驗室建立成熟度—強度曲線，並以現場早期試體驗證。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。
optionsEn: Build the maturity–strength curve for the mix in the laboratory before starting and validate it with early site specimens.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.
quiz.explanation: 開工前以同一配比在試驗室建立成熟度—強度曲線，並以現場早期試體驗證；滑升中在模板下緣附近埋設溫度感測器，每小時計算成熟度，與出模面手壓檢查結果互相印證，最終強度以標準養護試體驗收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the maturity–strength curve for the mix in the laboratory before starting and validate it with early site specimens; during sliding embed temperature sensors near the form bottom, compute maturity hourly and cross-check with exit-surface thumb tests, while final acceptance rests on standard-cured cylinders. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出模面檢查與成熟度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exit-surface checks and maturity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 配比中途更換水泥來源卻沿用舊的成熟度曲線，推估強度偏高，出模混凝土實際太軟而坍落；感測器裝在受陽光直射的位置，讀到的溫度偏高，同樣導致高估強度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing the cement source mid-job while keeping the old maturity curve overestimates strength, so concrete leaves the form too soft and slumps; sensors placed in direct sun read high temperatures and likewise overestimate strength. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這對日夜溫差大或冬季施工尤其重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This matters most with large day–night swings or winter work.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 配比中途更換水泥來源卻沿用舊的成熟度曲線，推估強度偏高，出模混凝土實際太軟而坍落；感測器裝在受陽光直射的位置，讀到的溫度偏高，同樣導致高估強度。
knowledge.textEn: Changing the cement source mid-job while keeping the old maturity curve overestimates strength, so concrete leaves the form too soft and slumps; sensors placed in direct sun read high temperatures and likewise overestimate strength.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
配比中途更換水泥來源卻沿用舊的成熟度曲線，推估強度偏高，出模混凝土實際太軟而坍落；感測器裝在受陽光直射的位置，讀到的溫度偏高，同樣導致高估強度。
自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Changing the cement source mid-job while keeping the old maturity curve overestimates strength, so concrete leaves the form too soft and slumps.
Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 配比中途更換水泥來源卻沿用舊的成熟度曲線，推估強度偏高，出模混凝土實際太軟而坍落；感測器裝在受陽光直射的位置，讀到的溫度偏高，同樣導致高估強度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing the cement source mid-job while keeping the old maturity curve overestimates strength, so concrete leaves the form too soft and slumps; sensors placed in direct sun read high temperatures and likewise overestimate strength. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「平台水平與千斤頂同步」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck level and jack synchronisation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模平台由數十支千斤頂同時推升，每支每一行程只上升數十毫米；只要部分千斤頂行程略短，平台就會逐漸傾斜。現代滑模以集中油壓與水平感測自動控制，但仍需人員定期量測並調整。滑升日誌是滑模的「黑盒子」：記錄每小時的高程、速度、混凝土溫度與供料、千斤頂狀況、偏差量測、停機與修正，日後若牆體出現問題，可以追溯到當時的作業條件。亞特蘭大試驗塔的千斤頂約每 15 分鐘把平台頂升約 25 mm（1 in）。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「平台水平與千斤頂同步」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dozens of jacks lift the deck together, each stroke only tens of millimetres; if some jacks stroke slightly short, the deck gradually tilts. Modern slipforms use central hydraulics with level sensing and automatic control, yet people must still measure and adjust regularly. The slip log is the slipform's black box: it records hourly level, rate, concrete temperature and supply, jack condition, deviation readings, stops and corrections, so that any later problem in the wall can be traced to the conditions at the time. At the Atlanta test tower the jacks lifted the deck about 25 mm (1 in) roughly every 15 minutes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck level and jack synchronisation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：千斤頂行程 25 mm，若某群組每行程少 1 mm，10 個行程後高差 10 mm；平台寬 22 m 時傾斜 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 25 mm jack stroke, a group that falls 1 mm short per stroke is 10 mm low after 10 strokes; across a 22 m deck that is a tilt of 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「平台水平與千斤頂同步」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck level and jack synchronisation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌
knowledge.titleEn: Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log
knowledge.text: 滑模平台由數十支千斤頂同時推升，每支每一行程只上升數十毫米；只要部分千斤頂行程略短，平台就會逐漸傾斜。現代滑模以集中油壓與水平感測自動控制，但仍需人員定期量測並調整。
knowledge.textEn: Dozens of jacks lift the deck together, each stroke only tens of millimetres; if some jacks stroke slightly short, the deck gradually tilts. Modern slipforms use central hydraulics with level sensing and automatic control, yet people must still measure and adjust regularly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log" is correct?
options: 自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。
核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。
滑模平台由數十支千斤頂同時推升，每支每一行程只上升數十毫米；只要部分千斤頂行程略短，平台就會逐漸傾斜。
optionsEn: Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary.
Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter.
Dozens of jacks lift the deck together, each stroke only tens of millimetres; if some jacks stroke slightly short, the deck gradually tilts.
quiz.explanation: 滑模平台由數十支千斤頂同時推升，每支每一行程只上升數十毫米；只要部分千斤頂行程略短，平台就會逐漸傾斜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dozens of jacks lift the deck together, each stroke only tens of millimetres; if some jacks stroke slightly short, the deck gradually tilts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平台水平與千斤頂同步」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck level and jack synchronisation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：千斤頂行程 25 mm，若某群組每行程少 1 mm，10 個行程後高差 10 mm；平台寬 22 m 時傾斜 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200。若規定平台高差警戒值為 15 mm，相當於 15 個行程、約 375 mm 的滑升高度內就必須修正。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 25 mm jack stroke, a group that falls 1 mm short per stroke is 10 mm low after 10 strokes; across a 22 m deck that is a tilt of 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200. With a 15 mm deck-level alert value, correction is needed within 15 strokes, about 375 mm of rise. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每班以水準儀或水管水準量測平台四角與中間點高程，與自動系統讀值比對；滑升日誌以固定格式每小時填寫，並由當班滑模主管與品管簽名，電子化日誌應自動記錄千斤頂油壓與行程計數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each shift level the deck corners and mid-points with an optical level or water level and compare with the automatic system; fill in the slip log hourly in a fixed format signed by the shift slipform supervisor and quality controller, and have an electronic log record jack pressures and stroke counts automatically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 千斤頂行程 25 mm，若某群組每行程少 1 mm，10 個行程後高差 10 mm；平台寬 22 m 時傾斜 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200。若規定平台高差警戒值為 15 mm，相當於 15 個行程、約 375 mm 的滑升高度內就必須修正。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 25 mm jack stroke, a group that falls 1 mm short per stroke is 10 mm low after 10 strokes; across a 22 m deck that is a tilt of 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200. With a 15 mm deck-level alert value, correction is needed within 15 strokes, about 375 mm of rise. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log", which statement holds?
options: 千斤頂行程 25 mm，若某群組每行程少 1 mm，10 個行程後高差 10 mm；平台寬 22 m 時傾斜 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200。
滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。
千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。
optionsEn: With a 25 mm jack stroke, a group that falls 1 mm short per stroke is 10 mm low after 10 strokes; across a 22 m deck that is a tilt of 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200.
Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂行程 25 mm，若某群組每行程少 1 mm，10 個行程後高差 10 mm；平台寬 22 m 時傾斜 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 25 mm jack stroke, a group that falls 1 mm short per stroke is 10 mm low after 10 strokes; across a 22 m deck that is a tilt of 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平台水平與千斤頂同步」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck level and jack synchronisation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每班以水準儀或水管水準量測平台四角與中間點高程，與自動系統讀值比對；滑升日誌以固定格式每小時填寫，並由當班滑模主管與品管簽名，電子化日誌應自動記錄千斤頂油壓與行程計數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each shift level the deck corners and mid-points with an optical level or water level and compare with the automatic system; fill in the slip log hourly in a fixed format signed by the shift slipform supervisor and quality controller, and have an electronic log record jack pressures and stroke counts automatically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：滑升日誌格式要在開工前由監造核定，紀錄項目包含時間、高程、速度、溫度、坍度、車次、偏差、千斤頂異常與修正指令；日誌每日掃描備份，作為竣工資料的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Have the resident engineer approve the slip-log format before starting, covering time, level, rate, temperatures, slump, truck numbers, deviations, jack faults and correction orders; scan and back up the log daily as part of the as-built record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：依賴自動控制而長期不做人工量測，感測器故障時平台逐漸傾斜卻無人察覺，模板扭曲並使牆厚不均；日誌缺漏或事後補寫，發生牆面缺陷時無法判斷是速度、溫度還是供料造成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Relying on automatic control without manual checks means a failed sensor can let the deck tilt unnoticed, twisting the forms and making the wall uneven in thickness; gaps or after-the-fact entries in the log make it impossible to tell whether a defect came from rate, temperature or supply. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每班以水準儀或水管水準量測平台四角與中間點高程，與自動系統讀值比對；滑升日誌以固定格式每小時填寫，並由當班滑模主管與品管簽名，電子化日誌應自動記錄千斤頂油壓與行程計數。
knowledge.textEn: Each shift level the deck corners and mid-points with an optical level or water level and compare with the automatic system; fill in the slip log hourly in a fixed format signed by the shift slipform supervisor and quality controller, and have an electronic log record jack pressures and stroke counts automatically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 滑升日誌格式要在開工前由監造核定，紀錄項目包含時間、高程、速度、溫度、坍度、車次、偏差、千斤頂異常與修正指令；日誌每日掃描備份，作為竣工資料的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Have the resident engineer approve the slip-log format before starting, covering time, level, rate, temperatures, slump, truck numbers, deviations, jack faults and correction orders; scan and back up the log daily as part of the as-built record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
每班以水準儀或水管水準量測平台四角與中間點高程，與自動系統讀值比對。
滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Each shift level the deck corners and mid-points with an optical level or water level and compare with the automatic system.
If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
quiz.explanation: 每班以水準儀或水管水準量測平台四角與中間點高程，與自動系統讀值比對；滑升日誌以固定格式每小時填寫，並由當班滑模主管與品管簽名，電子化日誌應自動記錄千斤頂油壓與行程計數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Each shift level the deck corners and mid-points with an optical level or water level and compare with the automatic system; fill in the slip log hourly in a fixed format signed by the shift slipform supervisor and quality controller, and have an electronic log record jack pressures and stroke counts automatically. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平台水平與千斤頂同步」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck level and jack synchronisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 依賴自動控制而長期不做人工量測，感測器故障時平台逐漸傾斜卻無人察覺，模板扭曲並使牆厚不均；日誌缺漏或事後補寫，發生牆面缺陷時無法判斷是速度、溫度還是供料造成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Relying on automatic control without manual checks means a failed sensor can let the deck tilt unnoticed, twisting the forms and making the wall uneven in thickness; gaps or after-the-fact entries in the log make it impossible to tell whether a defect came from rate, temperature or supply. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：亞特蘭大試驗塔的千斤頂約每 15 分鐘把平台頂升約 25 mm（1 in）。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At the Atlanta test tower the jacks lifted the deck about 25 mm (1 in) roughly every 15 minutes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 依賴自動控制而長期不做人工量測，感測器故障時平台逐漸傾斜卻無人察覺，模板扭曲並使牆厚不均；日誌缺漏或事後補寫，發生牆面缺陷時無法判斷是速度、溫度還是供料造成。
knowledge.textEn: Relying on automatic control without manual checks means a failed sensor can let the deck tilt unnoticed, twisting the forms and making the wall uneven in thickness; gaps or after-the-fact entries in the log make it impossible to tell whether a defect came from rate, temperature or supply.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。
依賴自動控制而長期不做人工量測，感測器故障時平台逐漸傾斜卻無人察覺，模板扭曲並使牆厚不均；日誌缺漏或事後補寫，發生牆面缺陷時無法判斷是速度、溫度還是供料造成。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter.
Relying on automatic control without manual checks means a failed sensor can let the deck tilt unnoticed, twisting the forms and making the wall uneven in thickness.
quiz.explanation: 依賴自動控制而長期不做人工量測，感測器故障時平台逐漸傾斜卻無人察覺，模板扭曲並使牆厚不均；日誌缺漏或事後補寫，發生牆面缺陷時無法判斷是速度、溫度還是供料造成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Relying on automatic control without manual checks means a failed sensor can let the deck tilt unnoticed, twisting the forms and making the wall uneven in thickness; gaps or after-the-fact entries in the log make it impossible to tell whether a defect came from rate, temperature or supply. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出模後修飾、養護與耐久」與「竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Finishing, curing and durability after exit" and "As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出模後修飾、養護與耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Finishing, curing and durability after exit: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「出模面修飾與養護」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exit-surface finishing and curing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土出模時表面仍很年輕，懸吊在平台下方的修飾架讓工人可以立即抹平小缺陷、填補小孔洞，並施加養護。高層核心筒外側常暴露在強風中，年輕混凝土表面水分蒸發極快，容易產生塑性收縮裂縫與表面粉化，降低保護層的耐久性。冬季則要防止出模混凝土受凍；亞特蘭大試驗塔在寒冷多雨的天氣下，混凝土本身的水化熱有助於維持溫度。修飾架也是人員作業區，需要護欄與防墜網。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「出模面修飾與養護」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete leaving the form is very young, and finishing scaffolds hung below the deck let workers immediately float small defects, fill small holes and apply curing. The outside of a high core is often exposed to strong wind, so water evaporates very fast from young surfaces, causing plastic shrinkage cracks and dusting that reduce the durability of the cover. In winter, exiting concrete must be protected from freezing; at the Atlanta test tower, heat of hydration helped keep the concrete warm in cold, rainy weather. The finishing scaffold is also a work area that needs guardrails and fall-arrest netting. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Exit-surface finishing and curing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Evaporation rate E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶ in kg/m²/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「出模面修飾與養護」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Exit-surface finishing and curing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 出模後修飾、養護與耐久
knowledge.titleEn: Finishing, curing and durability after exit
knowledge.text: 混凝土出模時表面仍很年輕，懸吊在平台下方的修飾架讓工人可以立即抹平小缺陷、填補小孔洞，並施加養護。高層核心筒外側常暴露在強風中，年輕混凝土表面水分蒸發極快，容易產生塑性收縮裂縫與表面粉化，降低保護層的耐久性。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete leaving the form is very young, and finishing scaffolds hung below the deck let workers immediately float small defects, fill small holes and apply curing. The outside of a high core is often exposed to strong wind, so water evaporates very fast from young surfaces, causing plastic shrinkage cracks and dusting that reduce the durability of the cover.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出模後修飾、養護與耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Finishing, curing and durability after exit" is correct?
options: 混凝土出模時表面仍很年輕，懸吊在平台下方的修飾架讓工人可以立即抹平小缺陷、填補小孔洞，並施加養護。
核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。
核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。
optionsEn: Concrete leaving the form is very young, and finishing scaffolds hung below the deck let workers immediately float small defects, fill small holes and apply curing.
Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter.
A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土出模時表面仍很年輕，懸吊在平台下方的修飾架讓工人可以立即抹平小缺陷、填補小孔洞，並施加養護。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete leaving the form is very young, and finishing scaffolds hung below the deck let workers immediately float small defects, fill small holes and apply curing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 出模後修飾、養護與耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Finishing, curing and durability after exit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出模面修飾與養護」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exit-surface finishing and curing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：蒸發率 E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶（kg/m²/h）。混凝土與氣溫 25°C、相對濕度 r = 0.4、風速 29 km/h（約 8 m/s）時 E = 5×(12,124 − 4,850)×33×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.2 kg/m²/h，超過常用的 1.0 kg/m²/h 警戒值，需要養護劑或圍幕防風。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Evaporation rate E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶ in kg/m²/h. With concrete and air at 25°C, r = 0.4 and wind 29 km/h (about 8 m/s), E = 5×(12,124 − 4,850)×33×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.2 kg/m²/h, above the common 1.0 kg/m²/h caution level, so curing compound or wind screens are needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在平台高度設風速計與溫濕度計，每班計算蒸發率並記錄養護措施；定期以回彈錘或表面吸水試驗比較不同高程的表層品質，發現粉化或裂縫時檢討養護方式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install an anemometer and temperature–humidity sensor at deck level, compute evaporation each shift and log curing measures; compare surface quality at different heights periodically with a rebound hammer or surface absorption tests, and revise curing when dusting or cracking appears.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 蒸發率 E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶（kg/m²/h）。混凝土與氣溫 25°C、相對濕度 r = 0.4、風速 29 km/h（約 8 m/s）時 E = 5×(12,124 − 4,850)×33×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.2 kg/m²/h，超過常用的 1.0 kg/m²/h 警戒值，需要養護劑或圍幕防風。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Evaporation rate E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶ in kg/m²/h. With concrete and air at 25°C, r = 0.4 and wind 29 km/h (about 8 m/s), E = 5×(12,124 − 4,850)×33×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.2 kg/m²/h, above the common 1.0 kg/m²/h caution level, so curing compound or wind screens are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「出模後修飾、養護與耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Finishing, curing and durability after exit", which statement holds?
options: 滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。
滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。
optionsEn: The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
Evaporation rate E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶ in kg/m²/h.
Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.
quiz.explanationEn: Evaporation rate E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶ in kg/m²/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出模後修飾、養護與耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Finishing, curing and durability after exit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出模面修飾與養護」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exit-surface finishing and curing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在平台高度設風速計與溫濕度計，每班計算蒸發率並記錄養護措施；定期以回彈錘或表面吸水試驗比較不同高程的表層品質，發現粉化或裂縫時檢討養護方式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install an anemometer and temperature–humidity sensor at deck level, compute evaporation each shift and log curing measures; compare surface quality at different heights periodically with a rebound hammer or surface absorption tests, and revise curing when dusting or cracking appears.
