Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：養護方法（養護劑、噴霧或圍幕）與適用風速條件要寫入施工計畫；修飾架的護欄、防墜網與緊急逃生路線在開滑前檢查，並在每次平台改裝後重新檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write curing methods (compound, misting or screens) and the wind conditions for each into the method statement; inspect guardrails, fall-arrest nets and escape routes on the finishing scaffold before sliding starts and again after every deck modification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：強風下出模面只做抹平未養護，表面細密裂縫與粉化使保護層透水性升高，日後碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕提前；修飾架缺乏圍幕時，工人也暴露在高處強風與墜落風險下。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Floating the exit surface without curing in strong wind leaves fine cracks and dusting that make the cover more permeable, bringing forward carbonation and bar corrosion; finishing scaffolds without screens also expose workers to high wind and fall hazards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在平台高度設風速計與溫濕度計，每班計算蒸發率並記錄養護措施；定期以回彈錘或表面吸水試驗比較不同高程的表層品質，發現粉化或裂縫時檢討養護方式。
knowledge.textEn: Install an anemometer and temperature–humidity sensor at deck level, compute evaporation each shift and log curing measures; compare surface quality at different heights periodically with a rebound hammer or surface absorption tests, and revise curing when dusting or cracking appears.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 養護方法（養護劑、噴霧或圍幕）與適用風速條件要寫入施工計畫；修飾架的護欄、防墜網與緊急逃生路線在開滑前檢查，並在每次平台改裝後重新檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Write curing methods (compound, misting or screens) and the wind conditions for each into the method statement; inspect guardrails, fall-arrest nets and escape routes on the finishing scaffold before sliding starts and again after every deck modification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「出模後修飾、養護與耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Finishing, curing and durability after exit"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。
在平台高度設風速計與溫濕度計，每班計算蒸發率並記錄養護措施；定期以回彈錘或表面吸水試驗比較不同高程的表層品質，發現粉化或裂縫時檢討養護方式。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints.
Install an anemometer and temperature–humidity sensor at deck level, compute evaporation each shift and log curing measures.
quiz.explanation: 在平台高度設風速計與溫濕度計，每班計算蒸發率並記錄養護措施；定期以回彈錘或表面吸水試驗比較不同高程的表層品質，發現粉化或裂縫時檢討養護方式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install an anemometer and temperature–humidity sensor at deck level, compute evaporation each shift and log curing measures; compare surface quality at different heights periodically with a rebound hammer or surface absorption tests, and revise curing when dusting or cracking appears. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 出模後修飾、養護與耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Finishing, curing and durability after exit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出模面修飾與養護」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exit-surface finishing and curing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 強風下出模面只做抹平未養護，表面細密裂縫與粉化使保護層透水性升高，日後碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕提前；修飾架缺乏圍幕時，工人也暴露在高處強風與墜落風險下。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Floating the exit surface without curing in strong wind leaves fine cracks and dusting that make the cover more permeable, bringing forward carbonation and bar corrosion; finishing scaffolds without screens also expose workers to high wind and fall hazards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修飾架也是人員作業區，需要護欄與防墜網。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The finishing scaffold is also a work area that needs guardrails and fall-arrest netting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 強風下出模面只做抹平未養護，表面細密裂縫與粉化使保護層透水性升高，日後碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕提前；修飾架缺乏圍幕時，工人也暴露在高處強風與墜落風險下。
knowledge.textEn: Floating the exit surface without curing in strong wind leaves fine cracks and dusting that make the cover more permeable, bringing forward carbonation and bar corrosion; finishing scaffolds without screens also expose workers to high wind and fall hazards.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出模後修飾、養護與耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Finishing, curing and durability after exit" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 強風下出模面只做抹平未養護，表面細密裂縫與粉化使保護層透水性升高，日後碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕提前；修飾架缺乏圍幕時，工人也暴露在高處強風與墜落風險下。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。
optionsEn: Floating the exit surface without curing in strong wind leaves fine cracks and dusting that make the cover more permeable, bringing forward carbonation and bar corrosion.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 強風下出模面只做抹平未養護，表面細密裂縫與粉化使保護層透水性升高，日後碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕提前；修飾架缺乏圍幕時，工人也暴露在高處強風與墜落風險下。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Floating the exit surface without curing in strong wind leaves fine cracks and dusting that make the cover more permeable, bringing forward carbonation and bar corrosion; finishing scaffolds without screens also expose workers to high wind and fall hazards. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「竣工偏差與交接紀錄」如何影響高層建築核心筒滑模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “As-built deviation and handover records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Slipform construction of high-rise cores”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 滑模核心筒完成後，後續的樓板、鋼梁、電梯導軌與帷幕牆都以核心筒為基準，所以核心筒的實際位置比設計位置更重要。竣工量測要提供每一高程的牆面位置、垂直度、扭轉、開口與埋件實際座標，讓後續工種調整連接。羅特魏爾試驗塔直徑約 21 m、內含 12 個井道，殼體高約 232 m，井道的垂直度直接決定電梯試驗能否進行。交接資料還應包括冷縫位置、修補紀錄與強度試驗結果，作為日後鑽孔、補強或變更用途的依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「竣工偏差與交接紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once a slipformed core is complete, floors, steel beams, elevator rails and the façade all reference it, so the core's actual position matters more than its design position. The as-built survey must give wall position, verticality, twist and the actual coordinates of openings and embeds at each level so following trades can adjust their connections. The Rottweil test tower, about 21 m in diameter with 12 shafts and a shell about 232 m tall, shows how shaft verticality decides whether elevator testing can proceed at all. Handover records should also include cold-joint locations, repair records and strength results, as the basis for later drilling, strengthening or change of use. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “As-built deviation and handover records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：40 個測點的垂直偏差平均 4 mm、標準差 3 mm，95% 上界 ≈ 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Forty survey points with a mean verticality deviation of 4 mm and standard deviation 3 mm give a 95% upper bound of about 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「竣工偏差與交接紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “As-built deviation and handover records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover
knowledge.text: 滑模核心筒完成後，後續的樓板、鋼梁、電梯導軌與帷幕牆都以核心筒為基準，所以核心筒的實際位置比設計位置更重要。竣工量測要提供每一高程的牆面位置、垂直度、扭轉、開口與埋件實際座標，讓後續工種調整連接。
knowledge.textEn: Once a slipformed core is complete, floors, steel beams, elevator rails and the façade all reference it, so the core's actual position matters more than its design position. The as-built survey must give wall position, verticality, twist and the actual coordinates of openings and embeds at each level so following trades can adjust their connections.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover" is correct?
options: 核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。
滑模核心筒完成後，後續的樓板、鋼梁、電梯導軌與帷幕牆都以核心筒為基準，所以核心筒的實際位置比設計位置更重要。
滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。
optionsEn: A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance.
Once a slipformed core is complete, floors, steel beams, elevator rails and the façade all reference it, so the core's actual position matters more than its design position.
Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
quiz.explanation: 滑模核心筒完成後，後續的樓板、鋼梁、電梯導軌與帷幕牆都以核心筒為基準，所以核心筒的實際位置比設計位置更重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once a slipformed core is complete, floors, steel beams, elevator rails and the façade all reference it, so the core's actual position matters more than its design position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「竣工偏差與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “As-built deviation and handover records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：40 個測點的垂直偏差平均 4 mm、標準差 3 mm，95% 上界 ≈ 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm。以 ACI 117 對高度超過約 25 m 者取高度 1/1,000、上限約 150 mm 的概念，120 m 核心筒容許約 120 mm，實測遠在容許內；但電梯導軌要求常更嚴，須另行比對。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Forty survey points with a mean verticality deviation of 4 mm and standard deviation 3 mm give a 95% upper bound of about 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm. Using the ACI 117 concept of 1/1,000 of height for heights above about 25 m, capped at about 150 mm, a 120 m core is allowed about 120 mm, so the result is well within; elevator rail requirements are often stricter and must be checked separately. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：竣工量測以獨立於施工測量的控制點進行，結果與滑升日誌中的每班量測比對，差異需可解釋；電梯井道另以雷射掃描或吊線量測淨尺寸，交給電梯廠商確認導軌安裝可行。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Carry out the as-built survey from control points independent of the construction survey, compare it with the shift readings in the slip log and explain any differences; survey elevator shaft clear dimensions separately by laser scanning or plumb lines and give them to the elevator supplier to confirm rail installation is feasible.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 40 個測點的垂直偏差平均 4 mm、標準差 3 mm，95% 上界 ≈ 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm。以 ACI 117 對高度超過約 25 m 者取高度 1/1,000、上限約 150 mm 的概念，120 m 核心筒容許約 120 mm，實測遠在容許內；但電梯導軌要求常更嚴，須另行比對。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Forty survey points with a mean verticality deviation of 4 mm and standard deviation 3 mm give a 95% upper bound of about 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm. Using the ACI 117 concept of 1/1,000 of height for heights above about 25 m, capped at about 150 mm, a 120 m core is allowed about 120 mm, so the result is well within; elevator rail requirements are often stricter and must be checked separately. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover", which statement holds?
options: 千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。
滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。
40 個測點的垂直偏差平均 4 mm、標準差 3 mm，95% 上界 ≈ 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm。
optionsEn: If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
Forty survey points with a mean verticality deviation of 4 mm and standard deviation 3 mm give a 95% upper bound of about 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm.
quiz.explanation: 40 個測點的垂直偏差平均 4 mm、標準差 3 mm，95% 上界 ≈ 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Forty survey points with a mean verticality deviation of 4 mm and standard deviation 3 mm give a 95% upper bound of about 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「竣工偏差與交接紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “As-built deviation and handover records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 竣工量測以獨立於施工測量的控制點進行，結果與滑升日誌中的每班量測比對，差異需可解釋；電梯井道另以雷射掃描或吊線量測淨尺寸，交給電梯廠商確認導軌安裝可行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Carry out the as-built survey from control points independent of the construction survey, compare it with the shift readings in the slip log and explain any differences; survey elevator shaft clear dimensions separately by laser scanning or plumb lines and give them to the elevator supplier to confirm rail installation is feasible. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含按高程排列的竣工座標表、埋件與開口實測表、冷縫與修補位置圖、強度試驗彙整與滑升日誌；任何日後在核心筒上鑽孔或開口，都須先查閱這些資料並經結構工程師核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include elevation-ordered as-built coordinate tables, measured embed and opening tables, maps of cold joints and repairs, strength-test summaries and the slip log; any future drilling or opening in the core must consult these records and be approved by a structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：竣工資料只交一張總體垂直度數字，後續鋼梁廠商依設計座標製作，到現場才發現埋件偏移，大量現場修改；冷縫與修補位置未記錄，多年後在冷縫處鑽孔或開口，削弱牆體剪力傳遞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Handing over only a single overall verticality figure leads steel fabricators to work to design coordinates and find displaced embeds on site, forcing extensive field modifications; with cold joints and repairs unrecorded, someone later drills or cuts openings at a cold joint and weakens shear transfer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含按高程排列的竣工座標表、埋件與開口實測表、冷縫與修補位置圖、強度試驗彙整與滑升日誌；任何日後在核心筒上鑽孔或開口，都須先查閱這些資料並經結構工程師核准。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include elevation-ordered as-built coordinate tables, measured embed and opening tables, maps of cold joints and repairs, strength-test summaries and the slip log; any future drilling or opening in the core must consult these records and be approved by a structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover"?
options: 竣工量測以獨立於施工測量的控制點進行，結果與滑升日誌中的每班量測比對，差異需可解釋；電梯井道另以雷射掃描或吊線量測淨尺寸，交給電梯廠商確認導軌安裝可行。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。
optionsEn: Carry out the as-built survey from control points independent of the construction survey, compare it with the shift readings in the slip log and explain any differences.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.

quiz.explanationEn: Carry out the as-built survey from control points independent of the construction survey, compare it with the shift readings in the slip log and explain any differences; survey elevator shaft clear dimensions separately by laser scanning or plumb lines and give them to the elevator supplier to confirm rail installation is feasible. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「竣工偏差與交接紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “As-built deviation and handover records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 竣工資料只交一張總體垂直度數字，後續鋼梁廠商依設計座標製作，到現場才發現埋件偏移，大量現場修改；冷縫與修補位置未記錄，多年後在冷縫處鑽孔或開口，削弱牆體剪力傳遞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Handing over only a single overall verticality figure leads steel fabricators to work to design coordinates and find displaced embeds on site, forcing extensive field modifications; with cold joints and repairs unrecorded, someone later drills or cuts openings at a cold joint and weakens shear transfer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料還應包括冷縫位置、修補紀錄與強度試驗結果，作為日後鑽孔、補強或變更用途的依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover records should also include cold-joint locations, repair records and strength results, as the basis for later drilling, strengthening or change of use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 竣工資料只交一張總體垂直度數字，後續鋼梁廠商依設計座標製作，到現場才發現埋件偏移，大量現場修改；冷縫與修補位置未記錄，多年後在冷縫處鑽孔或開口，削弱牆體剪力傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Handing over only a single overall verticality figure leads steel fabricators to work to design coordinates and find displaced embeds on site, forcing extensive field modifications; with cold joints and repairs unrecorded, someone later drills or cuts openings at a cold joint and weakens shear transfer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
竣工資料只交一張總體垂直度數字，後續鋼梁廠商依設計座標製作，到現場才發現埋件偏移，大量現場修改。
滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Handing over only a single overall verticality figure leads steel fabricators to work to design coordinates and find displaced embeds on site, forcing extensive field modifications.
Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
quiz.explanation: 竣工資料只交一張總體垂直度數字，後續鋼梁廠商依設計座標製作，到現場才發現埋件偏移，大量現場修改；冷縫與修補位置未記錄，多年後在冷縫處鑽孔或開口，削弱牆體剪力傳遞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Handing over only a single overall verticality figure leads steel fabricators to work to design coordinates and find displaced embeds on site, forcing extensive field modifications; with cold joints and repairs unrecorded, someone later drills or cuts openings at a cold joint and weakens shear transfer. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高層建築液壓爬模施工
summary: 液壓自動爬模與滑模不同：每層混凝土澆置後先硬化，再由油壓缸把模板與多層工作平台沿爬升軌道推到上一層，荷載經由預埋錨錐傳入早齡牆體。本課以哈里發塔的 226 組自爬單元與 3 天樓層循環、樂天世界塔的核心筒與巨柱爬模為例，說明循環時程、錨點荷載路徑、油壓機構、模板側壓、平台荷重、爬升停檢點、早齡強度驗收、同步監測、錨孔處理與拆除交接。
summaryEn: Hydraulic automatic climbing forms differ from slipforms: each lift of concrete hardens first, then hydraulic cylinders push the forms and multi-level working platforms along climbing rails to the next storey, with loads passing through cast-in anchor cones into young walls. Using the 226 self-climbing units and three-day floor cycle at Burj Khalifa and the core and megacolumn climbing forms at Lotte World Tower, the course covers cycle time, the anchor load path, hydraulics, form pressure, platform loads, climbing hold points, early-strength acceptance, synchronisation monitoring, anchor-hole treatment and dismantling handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 規劃練習：一座 180 層次澆置、每層 3.7 m 的核心筒採用自動爬模。標準循環 72 h，總計 180×3 = 540 天。每個爬升單元垂直荷載 60 kN、偏心 1.2 m，錨點水平力偶 36 kN；錨點拉拔基本強度在 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，因此放行強度訂為 10 MPa。油壓缸缸徑 125 mm、油壓 32 MPa，推力約 393 kN，爬升 3.7 m、速度 0.2 m/min 約 18.5 min。牆模側壓以 R = 2 m/h、20°C 計約 48.7 kPa，繫結 1.2 m 間距時每支約 70 kN。冬季時早齡強度在 20 h 只有約 8.0 MPa，若每層需再等 6.6 h，循環變為約 78.6 h，180 層多出約 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 天；若改用自充填混凝土，側壓升為約 88.8 kPa，繫結力增為約 128 kN，模板與繫結必須重新設計。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的施工計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: a core cast in 180 lifts of 3.7 m uses automatic climbing forms. The standard cycle is 72 h, so 180×3 = 540 days in total. Each climbing unit carries 60 kN at 1.2 m eccentricity, giving a 36 kN anchor couple; the basic anchor pull-out strength at 10 MPa is about 58 kN, so the release strength is set at 10 MPa. A 125 mm cylinder at 32 MPa gives about 393 kN and climbs 3.7 m at 0.2 m/min in about 18.5 min. Wall-form pressure at R = 2 m/h and 20°C is about 48.7 kPa, about 70 kN per tie at 1.2 m spacing. In winter, early strength at 20 h is only about 8.0 MPa; waiting another 6.6 h each storey stretches the cycle to about 78.6 h and adds about 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 days over 180 lifts. Switching to self-consolidating concrete raises pressure to about 88.8 kPa and tie force to about 128 kN, so forms and ties must be redesigned. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building's construction plan.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」與「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" and "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓層循環時程」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor cycle time” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。與滑模相比，它容許每層停下來檢查鋼筋與埋件，牆厚變化與退縮也較容易處理，但速度受限於循環中最慢的工序。哈里發塔以 180 次澆置、每次 3.70 m 高完成核心筒與翼牆，標準循環為每層 3 天。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓層循環時程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle. Compared with slipforming it allows a stop at every level to inspect rebar and embeds and handles changes in wall thickness and setbacks more easily, but its speed is limited by the slowest activity in the cycle. Burj Khalifa completed its core and wing walls in 180 pours of 3.70 m each on a standard three-day floor cycle. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Floor cycle time” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓層循環時程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Floor cycle time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環
knowledge.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle
knowledge.text: 自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。與滑模相比，它容許每層停下來檢查鋼筋與埋件，牆厚變化與退縮也較容易處理，但速度受限於循環中最慢的工序。
knowledge.textEn: Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle. Compared with slipforming it allows a stop at every level to inspect rebar and embeds and handles changes in wall thickness and setbacks more easily, but its speed is limited by the slowest activity in the cycle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" is correct?
options: 爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。
自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。
錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
optionsEn: The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.

Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle.
If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓層循環時程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor cycle time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。180 次澆置共 540 天；若以較高的混凝土溫度把等強度時間縮為 16 h，T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 天，總計 480 天，節省約 60 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days). 180 pours take 540 days; cutting the strength wait to 16 h with warmer concrete gives T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 days and 480 days in total, saving about 60 days. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。180 次澆置共 540 天；若以較高的混凝土溫度把等強度時間縮為 16 h，T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 天，總計 480 天，節省約 60 天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days). 180 pours take 540 days; cutting the strength wait to 16 h with warmer concrete gives T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 days and 480 days in total, saving about 60 days. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle", which statement holds?
options: 模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。
地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。
循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。
optionsEn: Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.
Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.
Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days).
quiz.explanation: 循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓層循環時程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor cycle time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以樓層循環表管理進度，標示每一工序的人員、塔吊時段與停檢點，並在開工前與爬模廠商確認牆厚變化、退縮與開口的改裝次數；哈里發塔施工中經歷超過 30 次平面配置變更，改裝要提前設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage progress with a floor-cycle chart showing crews, crane slots and hold points for each activity, and agree the number of modifications for wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings with the climbing-form supplier before starting; Burj Khalifa went through more than 30 layout changes, so modifications must be designed in advance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以樓層循環表管理進度，標示每一工序的人員、塔吊時段與停檢點，並在開工前與爬模廠商確認牆厚變化、退縮與開口的改裝次數；哈里發塔施工中經歷超過 30 次平面配置變更，改裝要提前設計。
knowledge.textEn: Manage progress with a floor-cycle chart showing crews, crane slots and hold points for each activity, and agree the number of modifications for wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings with the climbing-form supplier before starting; Burj Khalifa went through more than 30 layout changes, so modifications must be designed in advance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle"?
options: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。
optionsEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
quiz.explanation: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓層循環時程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floor cycle time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔以 180 次澆置、每次 3.70 m 高完成核心筒與翼牆，標準循環為每層 3 天。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Burj Khalifa completed its core and wing walls in 180 pours of 3.70 m each on a standard three-day floor cycle.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。
錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt.
If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錨錐與爬升靴」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。平台通常懸挑在牆外，因此錨點同時承受垂直力與由偏心造成的水平拉壓力偶；錨點的承載力取決於混凝土當時的強度、埋置深度、邊距與周邊補強筋。PERI ACS Core 400 型錄要求牆厚至少 30 cm 並在錨點周圍加補強筋，正是為了確保錨固區不會先破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨錐與爬升靴」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened. Platforms usually cantilever outside the wall, so anchors carry both vertical force and a horizontal tension–compression couple from the eccentricity; anchor capacity depends on concrete strength at the time, embedment depth, edge distance and local reinforcement. The PERI ACS Core 400 brochure requires walls at least 30 cm thick with extra reinforcement around the climbing anchors precisely so that the anchorage zone does not fail first. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「錨錐與爬升靴」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Anchor cones and climbing shoes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體
knowledge.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls
knowledge.text: 爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。平台通常懸挑在牆外，因此錨點同時承受垂直力與由偏心造成的水平拉壓力偶；錨點的承載力取決於混凝土當時的強度、埋置深度、邊距與周邊補強筋。
knowledge.textEn: All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened. Platforms usually cantilever outside the wall, so anchors carry both vertical force and a horizontal tension–compression couple from the eccentricity; anchor capacity depends on concrete strength at the time, embedment depth, edge distance and local reinforcement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls" is correct?
options: 錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。
油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。
爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。
optionsEn: If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety.

All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened.
quiz.explanation: 爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨錐與爬升靴」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。單一錨點混凝土錐體拉拔基本強度 N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5（k = 10、h_ef = 150 mm）：f_c = 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，20 MPa 時約 82 kN，強度加倍但承載只增加約 √2 倍。數值為教學假設，實際值以錨具製造商的認證資料為準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN. A single anchor's basic concrete-cone pull-out strength N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5 with k = 10 and h_ef = 150 mm is about 58 kN at f_c = 10 MPa and 82 kN at 20 MPa: doubling strength raises capacity only by about √2. Values are teaching assumptions; real values come from the anchor maker's approvals. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。單一錨點混凝土錐體拉拔基本強度 N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5（k = 10、h_ef = 150 mm）：f_c = 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，20 MPa 時約 82 kN，強度加倍但承載只增加約 √2 倍。數值為教學假設，實際值以錨具製造商的認證資料為準。
knowledge.textEn: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN. A single anchor's basic concrete-cone pull-out strength N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5 with k = 10 and h_ef = 150 mm is about 58 kN at f_c = 10 MPa and 82 kN at 20 MPa: doubling strength raises capacity only by about √2. Values are teaching assumptions; real values come from the anchor maker's approvals.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls", which statement holds?
options: 每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m。
爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。
核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。
optionsEn: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m.
Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them.
Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.
quiz.explanation: 每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨錐與爬升靴」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：錨點位置要在核心筒施工圖上與開口、埋件與鋼筋衝突一併檢查，錨錐安裝列為合模前檢查項目；爬升前的混凝土強度需求應以數字寫在每層的爬升許可單上。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check anchor positions against openings, embeds and rebar on the core shop drawings, make cone installation a pre-closing inspection item, and write the required concrete strength as a number on each storey's climbing permit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support; walls too thin or anchors without local reinforcement show radial cracks around the anchors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 錨點位置要在核心筒施工圖上與開口、埋件與鋼筋衝突一併檢查，錨錐安裝列為合模前檢查項目；爬升前的混凝土強度需求應以數字寫在每層的爬升許可單上。
knowledge.textEn: Check anchor positions against openings, embeds and rebar on the core shop drawings, make cone installation a pre-closing inspection item, and write the required concrete strength as a number on each storey's climbing permit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證。
錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval.
Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability.
quiz.explanation: 爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨錐與爬升靴」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor cones and climbing shoes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support; walls too thin or anchors without local reinforcement show radial cracks around the anchors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：PERI ACS Core 400 型錄要求牆厚至少 30 cm 並在錨點周圍加補強筋，正是為了確保錨固區不會先破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The PERI ACS Core 400 brochure requires walls at least 30 cm thick with extra reinforcement around the climbing anchors precisely so that the anchorage zone does not fail first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support; walls too thin or anchors without local reinforcement show radial cracks around the anchors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。
錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety.

A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support.
quiz.explanation: 錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support; walls too thin or anchors without local reinforcement show radial cracks around the anchors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「液壓爬升機構與行程控制」與「模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control" and "Form pressure, pour rate and ties": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」如何影響高層建築液壓爬模施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hydraulic climbing-form construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 自爬系統以固定在爬升靴上的長行程油壓缸推動爬升軌道或主架，軌道再帶動整個平台與模板上升；爬升到位後，軌道卡在新的爬升靴上，油壓缸再收回準備下一行程。PERI ACS Core 400 的長行程油壓缸每支可提供 40 t 頂升力，行程速度約 20 cm/min，一般 4 m 樓層約 20 分鐘可爬完。Doka 在哈里發塔使用 SKE100 自爬系統，並以液壓方式提升超過 5,000 m² 的大面積牆模。機構必須有防止回落的機械卡爪，以及多缸同步的控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Self-climbing systems use long-stroke hydraulic cylinders mounted on the climbing shoes to push the climbing rail or main frame, which lifts the whole platform and forms; once in position the rail latches into the new shoe and the cylinder retracts for the next stroke. Each long-stroke cylinder in PERI's ACS Core 400 provides 40 t of lifting force at a stroke speed of about 20 cm per minute, so a typical 4 m storey climbs in about 20 minutes. At Burj Khalifa Doka used the SKE100 self-climbing system and lifted more than 5,000 m² of large-area wall formwork hydraulically. The mechanism needs mechanical pawls that prevent fall-back and control to keep multiple cylinders in step. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：油壓缸推力 F = p·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cylinder force F = p·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「液壓油缸與爬升軌道」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制
knowledge.titleEn: Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control
knowledge.text: 自爬系統以固定在爬升靴上的長行程油壓缸推動爬升軌道或主架，軌道再帶動整個平台與模板上升；爬升到位後，軌道卡在新的爬升靴上，油壓缸再收回準備下一行程。PERI ACS Core 400 的長行程油壓缸每支可提供 40 t 頂升力，行程速度約 20 cm/min，一般 4 m 樓層約 20 分鐘可爬完。
knowledge.textEn: Self-climbing systems use long-stroke hydraulic cylinders mounted on the climbing shoes to push the climbing rail or main frame, which lifts the whole platform and forms; once in position the rail latches into the new shoe and the cylinder retracts for the next stroke. Each long-stroke cylinder in PERI's ACS Core 400 provides 40 t of lifting force at a stroke speed of about 20 cm per minute, so a typical 4 m storey climbs in about 20 minutes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
